verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि असतां धीरु गेला। हृदया द्रावो आला । जैसा चंद्रकळीं शिवतला। सोमकांतु॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni asatāṃ dhīru gelā| hṛdayā drāvo ālā | jaisā caṃdrakaḻīṃ śivatalā| somakāṃtu|| 91||
verses.meaning: Therefore, his courage vanished, and his heart melted, just as the moonstone responds to the touch of the moon's rays.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी पार्थ । अतिस्नेहें मोहितु। मग सखेद असे बोलतु । श्रीअच्युतेंसीं ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī pārtha | atisneheṃ mohitu| maga sakheda ase bolatu | śrīacyuteṃsīṃ || 92||
verses.meaning: Thus, Partha, overcome by great affection, then spoke with sorrow to Shri Achyuta.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो म्हणे अवधारीं देवा । म्यां पाहिला हा मेळावा । तंव गोत्रवर्गु आघवा । देखिला एथ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to mhaṇe avadhārīṃ devā | myāṃ pāhilā hā meḻāvā | taṃva gotravargu āghavā | dekhilā etha|| 93||
verses.meaning: He said, "Listen, O Lord! I have seen this gathering, and in it, I behold all my kinsmen."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे संग्रामीं उदित । जहाळे असती कीर समस्त। पण आपणपेयां उचित । केवीं होय॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: he saṃgrāmīṃ udita | jahāḻe asatī kīra samasta| paṇa āpaṇapeyāṃ ucita | kevīṃ hoya|| 94||
verses.meaning: Indeed, all these have arisen in this battle, but how can it be proper for oneself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें नांवेंचि नेणों कायी। मज आपणणपें सर्वथा नाहीं। मन बुद्धि ठायीं। स्थिर नोहे॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ nāṃveṃci neṇoṃ kāyī| maja āpaṇaṇapeṃ sarvathā nāhīṃ| mana buddhi ṭhāyīṃ| sthira nohe|| 95||
verses.meaning: By this very name, I know not what happens; I lose all sense of myself. My mind and intellect cannot remain steady.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें देह कांपत। तोंड असे कोरडें होत। विकळता उपजत। गात्रांसीही॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ deha kāṃpata| toṃḍa ase koraḍeṃ hota| vikaḻatā upajata| gātrāṃsīhī|| 96||
verses.meaning: Behold, the body trembles, the mouth becomes dry, and weakness arises in the limbs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्वांगा कांटाळा आला। अति संतापु उपनला। तेथ बेंबळ हातु गेला । गांडिवाचा॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarvāṃgā kāṃṭāḻā ālā| ati saṃtāpu upanalā| tetha beṃbaḻa hātu gelā | gāṃḍivācā|| 97||
verses.meaning: His entire body was covered in goosebumps, and extreme anger arose within him. Then, his hand instinctively reached for the Gandiva bow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें न धरतचि निष्टलें। परि नेणेंचि हातोनि पडिलें। ऐसें हृदय असे व्यापिलें। मोहें येणें॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ na dharataci niṣṭaleṃ| pari neṇeṃci hātoni paḍileṃ| aiseṃ hṛdaya ase vyāpileṃ| moheṃ yeṇeṃ|| 98||
verses.meaning: It did not hold, but slipped away; yet it is as if it unknowingly fell from the hand. Thus is the heart completely enveloped by this delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें वज्रापासोनि कठिण। दुर्धर अतिदारुण। तयाहून असाधारण हें स्नेह नवल॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ vajrāpāsoni kaṭhiṇa| durdhara atidāruṇa| tayāhūna asādhāraṇa heṃ sneha navala|| 99||
verses.meaning: That which is harder than a diamond, extremely difficult and terrible, this love is more extraordinary than that, how wonderful!

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें संग्रामीं हरु जिंतिला। निवातकवचांचा ठावो फेडिला। तो अर्जुन मोहें कवळिला। क्षणामाजीं ॥ २००॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ saṃgrāmīṃ haru jiṃtilā| nivātakavacāṃcā ṭhāvo pheḍilā| to arjuna moheṃ kavaḻilā| kṣaṇāmājīṃ || 200||
verses.meaning: That Arjuna, who had conquered Shiva in battle and uprooted the Nivatakavachas, was in a moment enveloped by delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेसा भ्रमर भेदी कोडें। भलतेसें काष्ठ कोरडें। परि 'कळिकेमाजी सांपडे । कोंबळिये॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jesā bhramara bhedī koḍeṃ| bhalateseṃ kāṣṭha koraḍeṃ| pari 'kaḻikemājī sāṃpaḍe | koṃbaḻiye|| 9||
verses.meaning: Just as a bee, though capable of piercing even hard, dry wood, gets trapped within the tender bud of a flower.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ उत्तीर्ण होईल प्राणें। परि तें 'कमळदळ चिरूं नेणें। तैसें कठिण कोवळेपणें। स्नेह देखा॥२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha uttīrṇa hoīla prāṇeṃ| pari teṃ 'kamaḻadaḻa cirūṃ neṇeṃ| taiseṃ kaṭhiṇa kovaḻepaṇeṃ| sneha dekhā||2||
verses.meaning: There, life will pass away, but it will not know how to tear a lotus petal. Such is the tenderness of love, though it appears difficult.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे आदिपुरुषाची माया । ब्रहोयाही नयेचि आया । म्हणौनि भुलविला ऐकें राया । संजयो म्हणे॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: he ādipuruṣācī māyā | brahoyāhī nayeci āyā | mhaṇauni bhulavilā aikeṃ rāyā | saṃjayo mhaṇe|| 3||
verses.meaning: O King, listen, this is the illusion of the Primordial Being, which even Brahma cannot comprehend. Thus, Sanjaya says, he was deluded.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवधारीं मग तो अर्जुनु। देखोनि सकळ स्वजनु। बिसरला अभिमानु । संग्रामींचा॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: avadhārīṃ maga to arjunu| dekhoni sakaḻa svajanu| bisaralā abhimānu | saṃgrāmīṃcā|| 4||
verses.meaning: Listen then, that Arjuna, seeing all his kinsmen, forgot his pride in battle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसी नेणों सदयता। उपनली तेथें चित्ता। मग म्हणे कृष्णा आतां। नसिजे एथ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaisī neṇoṃ sadayatā| upanalī tetheṃ cittā| maga mhaṇe kṛṣṇā ātāṃ| nasije etha|| 5||
verses.meaning: I do not know how compassion arose in his heart then. He then said, "Krishna, I will not stay here now."

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझें अतिशय मन व्याकुळ। होतसे बाचा बरळ। जे वधावे हे सकळ। येणें नांवें॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheṃ atiśaya mana vyākuḻa| hotase bācā baraḻa| je vadhāve he sakaḻa| yeṇeṃ nāṃveṃ|| 6||
verses.meaning: My mind is exceedingly distressed, and I speak incoherently, saying that all these should be slain by this name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या कौरवबां जरी वधावें। तरी युधिष्ठिरादिकां कां न वधावें। हे येरयेर आघवे । गोत्रज आमुचे ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā kauravabāṃ jarī vadhāveṃ| tarī yudhiṣṭhirādikāṃ kāṃ na vadhāveṃ| he yerayera āghave | gotraja āmuce || 7||
verses.meaning: If these Kauravas are to be slain, then why not slay Yudhishthira and others? All of them, on both sides, are our kinsmen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि जळो हें झुंज । प्रत्यया न ये मज । एणें 'काय काज। महापापें॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni jaḻo heṃ jhuṃja | pratyayā na ye maja | eṇeṃ 'kāya kāja| mahāpāpeṃ|| 8||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let this conflict be burned away; it does not appeal to me. What is the use of such great sins?

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा बहुतापरी पाहतां। एथ वोखटें होईल झुंजतां। वर कांहीं चुकवितां। लाभु आथी ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā bahutāparī pāhatāṃ| etha vokhaṭeṃ hoīla jhuṃjatāṃ| vara kāṃhīṃ cukavitāṃ| lābhu āthī || 9||
verses.meaning: O God, if one considers it in many ways, it would be bad to fight here. If one avoids it, there is benefit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया विजयवृत्ती कांहीं । मज सर्वथा काज नाहीं। एथ राज्य तरी कायी । हे पाहूनियां॥ २१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā vijayavṛttī kāṃhīṃ | maja sarvathā kāja nāhīṃ| etha rājya tarī kāyī | he pāhūniyāṃ|| 210||
verses.meaning: I have absolutely no desire for such a victorious attitude. What is the use of a kingdom then, seeing this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: यां सकळांतें वधावें। मग जे भोग भोगावे । ते जळोत आघवे पार्थ म्हणे॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāṃ sakaḻāṃteṃ vadhāveṃ| maga je bhoga bhogāve | te jaḻota āghave pārtha mhaṇe|| 11||
verses.meaning: Arjuna said, "Let all these be slain, and then whatever pleasures are to be enjoyed, let them all be consumed by fire."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें सुखेंबिण होईल। तें भलतैसें साहिजेल। वरी जीवितही वेंचिजेळ। याचिलागीं ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ sukheṃbiṇa hoīla| teṃ bhalataiseṃ sāhijela| varī jīvitahī veṃcijeḻa| yācilāgīṃ || 92||
verses.meaning: For that joy, any hardship can be endured; for its sake, even life itself can be sacrificed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी यांसी घातु कौजे। मग आपण राज्यसुख भोगिजे । हें स्वप्नींही मन माझें । करूं न शके॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī yāṃsī ghātu kauje| maga āpaṇa rājyasukha bhogije | heṃ svapnīṃhī mana mājheṃ | karūṃ na śake|| 13||
verses.meaning: But to kill them, and then enjoy the happiness of a kingdom, my mind cannot even dream of doing such a thing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आम्हीं कां जन्मावें। कवणालागीं जियावें। जरी वडिलां यां चिंतावें । विरुद्ध मनें॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī āmhīṃ kāṃ janmāveṃ| kavaṇālāgīṃ jiyāveṃ| jarī vaḍilāṃ yāṃ ciṃtāveṃ | viruddha maneṃ|| 94||
verses.meaning: Then why should we be born? For whom should we live? If our elders are to be worried by our opposing minds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुत्रातें इच्छी कुळ। तयाचें कायि हेंचि फळ। जे निर्दाळिजे केवळ। गोत्र आपुलें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: putrāteṃ icchī kuḻa| tayāceṃ kāyi heṃci phaḻa| je nirdāḻije kevaḻa| gotra āpuleṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: A family desires a son; is this the only fruit of that desire, that one's own lineage is completely destroyed?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें मनींचि केविं धरिजे। आपण वज्राचेयां होईजे। बरी घडे तरी कौजे। भलें इयां॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ manīṃci keviṃ dharije| āpaṇa vajrāceyāṃ hoīje| barī ghaḍe tarī kauje| bhaleṃ iyāṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: How can this be held in the mind? One should become like a thunderbolt. If it happens well, then it is good for these.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं जें जें जोडावें। तें समस्तीं इहीं भोगावे । हें जीवितही उपकारावें । काजीं यांच्या ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ jeṃ jeṃ joḍāveṃ| teṃ samastīṃ ihīṃ bhogāve | heṃ jīvitahī upakārāveṃ | kājīṃ yāṃcyā || 97||
verses.meaning: Whatever we accumulate, let it be enjoyed by all. Let this life also be dedicated to their service.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्ही दिगंतींचे भूपाळ। विभांडूनिे सकळ। मग संतोषविजे कुळ। आपुलें जें॥१८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhī digaṃtīṃce bhūpāḻa| vibhāṃḍūnie sakaḻa| maga saṃtoṣavije kuḻa| āpuleṃ jeṃ||18||
verses.meaning: We, the kings of all directions, having conquered all, then satisfy our own lineage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेचि हे समस्त। परी कैसें कर्म विपरीत। जे जाहळे असती उद्यत। झुंजावया॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teci he samasta| parī kaiseṃ karma viparīta| je jāhaḻe asatī udyata| jhuṃjāvayā|| 19||
verses.meaning: All this is the same, but how strange is the karma that they are ready to fight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अंतौरिया कुमरें। सांडोनियां भांडारें। शस्त्राग्रीं जिव्हारें। आरोपुनी ॥ २२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aṃtauriyā kumareṃ| sāṃḍoniyāṃ bhāṃḍāreṃ| śastrāgrīṃ jivhāreṃ| āropunī || 220||
verses.meaning: Like a warrior who, abandoning his home and treasures, offers his very life at the forefront of battle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसियांतें कैसेनि मारूं। कवणावरी शस्त्र धरूं। निज हृदया करूं । घातु केवीं ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyāṃteṃ kaiseni mārūṃ| kavaṇāvarī śastra dharūṃ| nija hṛdayā karūṃ | ghātu kevīṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: How can I kill such ones? Against whom shall I wield my weapons? How can I inflict harm upon my own heart?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें नेणसी तूं. कवण। परी पैल भीष्म दोण। जयांचे उपकार असाधारण । आम्हां बहुत॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ neṇasī tūṃ. kavaṇa| parī paila bhīṣma doṇa| jayāṃce upakāra asādhāraṇa | āmhāṃ bahuta|| 22||
verses.meaning: You do not know this. But Bhishma and Drona, whose extraordinary favors upon us are many.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ शालक सासरे मातुळ। आणि बंधु कीं हे सकळ। पुत्र नातू केवळ। इष्टही असती ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha śālaka sāsare mātuḻa| āṇi baṃdhu kīṃ he sakaḻa| putra nātū kevaḻa| iṣṭahī asatī || 23||
verses.meaning: Here are brothers-in-law, fathers-in-law, maternal uncles, and indeed all these brothers, sons, and grandsons; they are all dear ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवधारीं अति जवळिकेचे। हे सकळही सोयरे आमुचे । म्हणौनि दोष आधि वाचे। बोलितांचि ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: avadhārīṃ ati javaḻikece| he sakaḻahī soyare āmuce | mhaṇauni doṣa ādhi vāce| bolitāṃci || 24||
verses.meaning: Listen, these are all our very close relatives, therefore, I speak of their faults first.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे बरी भलतें करितु। आतांचि येथें मारितु। परि आपण मनें घातु। न चिंतावा ॥ २५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: he barī bhalateṃ karitu| ātāṃci yetheṃ māritu| pari āpaṇa maneṃ ghātu| na ciṃtāvā || 25 ||
verses.meaning: Oh, let anything happen, let me be struck down right here and now, but I should not contemplate harming myself with my own mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्रैलोक्यींचें अनकळित। जरी राज्य होईल प्राप्त । तरी हें अनुचित नाचरें मी॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: trailokyīṃceṃ anakaḻita| jarī rājya hoīla prāpta | tarī heṃ anucita nācareṃ mī|| 26||
verses.meaning: Even if I were to attain the kingship of the three worlds, which is beyond comprehension, I would not engage in such an improper act.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी आजि एथ ऐसें कीजे। तरी कवणाच्या मनीं उरिजे। सांगें मुख केवीं पाहिजे । तुझें कृष्णा ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī āji etha aiseṃ kīje| tarī kavaṇācyā manīṃ urije| sāṃgeṃ mukha kevīṃ pāhije | tujheṃ kṛṣṇā || 27||
verses.meaning: If such a thing were to happen today, who would remember it in their mind? Tell me, Krishna, how could I ever see your face again?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी वधु करूनि गोत्रजांचा। तरी वसौटा होऊनि दोषांचा। मज जोडिलासि तूं हातींचा । दूरी होसी ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī vadhu karūni gotrajāṃcā| tarī vasauṭā hoūni doṣāṃcā| maja joḍilāsi tūṃ hātīṃcā | dūrī hosī || 28||
verses.meaning: Even if you commit the sin of killing your own kinsmen, and thus become a dwelling place for all faults, you have still joined yourself to me, and will not be far from me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुळहरणीं पातकें । तियें आंगीं जडती अशेखें। तये वेळीं तूं कवणें कें। देखावासी॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuḻaharaṇīṃ pātakeṃ | tiyeṃ āṃgīṃ jaḍatī aśekheṃ| taye veḻīṃ tūṃ kavaṇeṃ keṃ| dekhāvāsī|| 29||
verses.meaning: If sins accumulate in your lineage, how will you then be able to see Me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा उद्यानामाजीं अनळु । संचरला देखोनि प्रबळु । मग क्षणभरी कोकिळु। स्थिर नोहे॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā udyānāmājīṃ anaḻu | saṃcaralā dekhoni prabaḻu | maga kṣaṇabharī kokiḻu| sthira nohe|| 230||
verses.meaning: Just as a cuckoo, seeing a powerful fire spreading in the forest, does not stay still for a moment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां सकर्दम सरोबरु। अवलोकूनि चकोरु। न सेवितु अव्हेर । करूनि निघे॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ sakardama sarobaru| avalokūni cakoru| na sevitu avhera | karūni nighe|| 31||
verses.meaning: Just as a chakora bird, upon seeing a muddy lake, does not partake of its water, but rather rejects it and flies away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी तूं देवा। मज झकवूं न येसी मावा । जरी पुण्याचा बोलावा । नाशिजैळ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī tūṃ devā| maja jhakavūṃ na yesī māvā | jarī puṇyācā bolāvā | nāśijaiḻa|| 32||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Lord, do not deceive me, even if the call of merit is destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मी हें न करीं । इये संग्रामीं शस्त्र न धरीं। हें किडाळ बहुतीं परी । दिसतसे ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mī heṃ na karīṃ | iye saṃgrāmīṃ śastra na dharīṃ| heṃ kiḍāḻa bahutīṃ parī | disatase || 33||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I will not do this. I will not wield weapons in this battle. This appears to be a great misfortune in many ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुजसीं अंतराय होईल। मग सांगे आमुचें काय उरेल तेणें दुःखें हियें फुटेळ। तुजबीण कृष्णा॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujasīṃ aṃtarāya hoīla| maga sāṃge āmuceṃ kāya urela teṇeṃ duḥkheṃ hiyeṃ phuṭeḻa| tujabīṇa kṛṣṇā|| 34||
verses.meaning: If there is a separation from You, then tell me, what will remain of us? With that sorrow, my heart will burst, without You, Krishna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कौरव हे वधिजती। मग आम्ही भोग भोगिजती। हे असो मात अघडती। अर्जुन म्हणे॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kaurava he vadhijatī| maga āmhī bhoga bhogijatī| he aso māta aghaḍatī| arjuna mhaṇe|| 35||
verses.meaning: Therefore, if these Kauravas are slain, then we will enjoy the pleasures. Arjun said, "Let this impossible thought be."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे अभिमानमदें भुलले। जरी पां संग्रामा आले। तऱही आम्हीं हित आपुलें । जाणावें लागे॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: he abhimānamadeṃ bhulale| jarī pāṃ saṃgrāmā āle| taṟahī āmhīṃ hita āpuleṃ | jāṇāveṃ lāge|| 36||
verses.meaning: Even if they come to battle, deluded by pride and arrogance, we must still consider what is good for us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें ऐसें कैसें करावें । जे आपुले आपण मारावे । जाणत जाणतांचि सेवावें। काळकूट॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aiseṃ kaiseṃ karāveṃ | je āpule āpaṇa mārāve | jāṇata jāṇatāṃci sevāveṃ| kāḻakūṭa|| 37||
verses.meaning: How can one do such a thing, to knowingly and willingly consume a deadly poison, as if serving it to oneself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां जी मार्गी चालतां। पुढां सिंहु जाहला आवचिता। तो तंव चुकवितां। लाभु आथी ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ jī mārgī cālatāṃ| puḍhāṃ siṃhu jāhalā āvacitā| to taṃva cukavitāṃ| lābhu āthī || 38||
verses.meaning: If, while walking on a path, a lion suddenly appears, then avoiding it is indeed a gain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: असता प्रकाशु सांडावा। मग अंधकूप आश्राबा । तरी तेथ कवणु देवा । लाभु सांगें॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: asatā prakāśu sāṃḍāvā| maga aṃdhakūpa āśrābā | tarī tetha kavaṇu devā | lābhu sāṃgeṃ|| 39||
verses.meaning: If one were to abandon light and then take refuge in a dark well, what gain, O Lord, would there be in that, tell me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां समोर अग्नि देखोनी। जरी न वचिजे बोसंडोनी। तरी क्षणा एका कवळूनी। जाळूं सके॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ samora agni dekhonī| jarī na vacije bosaṃḍonī| tarī kṣaṇā ekā kavaḻūnī| jāḻūṃ sake|| 240||
verses.meaning: If one does not approach fire, even when seeing it, it can still consume and burn in an instant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे दोष हे मूर्त। अंगीं वाजों असती 'पहात। हें जाणतांही केवीं एथ । प्रवर्तावें ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise doṣa he mūrta| aṃgīṃ vājoṃ asatī 'pahāta| heṃ jāṇatāṃhī kevīṃ etha | pravartāveṃ || 41||
verses.meaning: When one clearly perceives that these faults are embodied and present, how can one then proceed?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें पार्थ तिये अवसरीं । म्हणे देवा अवधारीं।॥ या कल्मषाची थोरी । सांगेन तुज ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ pārtha tiye avasarīṃ | mhaṇe devā avadhārīṃ||| yā kalmaṣācī thorī | sāṃgena tuja || 42||
verses.meaning: At that moment, Arjuna said, "O Lord, listen! I will tell You the greatness of this impurity."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें काष्ठें काष्ठ मथिजे। तेथ वन्हि एक उपजे। तेणें काष्ठजात जाळिजे। प्रज्बळळेनि॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ kāṣṭheṃ kāṣṭha mathije| tetha vanhi eka upaje| teṇeṃ kāṣṭhajāta jāḻije| prajbaḻaḻeni|| 43||
verses.meaning: Just as when wood is rubbed against wood, fire is produced, and that fire, once ignited, burns all the wood.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा गोत्रींची परस्परें। जरी वधु घडे मत्सरें। तरी तेणें महादोषें घोरें। कुळचि नाशे ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā gotrīṃcī paraspareṃ| jarī vadhu ghaḍe matsareṃ| tarī teṇeṃ mahādoṣeṃ ghoreṃ| kuḻaci nāśe || 44||
verses.meaning: Similarly, if, due to envy, there is a killing among relatives, then that terrible and grave sin destroys the entire lineage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि येणें पापें । वंशजधर्मु 'लोपे। मग अधर्मुचि आरोपे। कुळामाजीं ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yeṇeṃ pāpeṃ | vaṃśajadharmu 'lope| maga adharmuci ārope| kuḻāmājīṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by these sins, the family's dharma is lost, and then adharma takes root in the family.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ सारासार विचारावें। कवणें काय आचरावें। आणि विधिनिषेध आघवे । पारुषती॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha sārāsāra vicārāveṃ| kavaṇeṃ kāya ācarāveṃ| āṇi vidhiniṣedha āghave | pāruṣatī|| 46||
verses.meaning: Here, one should contemplate what is essential and what is not, what actions one should undertake, and how all injunctions and prohibitions become irrelevant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: असता दीपु दवडिजे। मग अंधकारीं राहाटिजे। तरी उजूचि कां आडळिजे। जयापरी॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: asatā dīpu davaḍije| maga aṃdhakārīṃ rāhāṭije| tarī ujūci kāṃ āḍaḻije| jayāparī|| 47||
verses.meaning: If, having a lamp, one casts it aside, and then wanders in darkness, why then does one stumble straight ahead, as if by fate?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसा कुळीं कुळक्षयो होय । तये वेळीं तो आद्यधर्मु जाय। मग आन कांहीं आहे। पापावांचुनी ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tesā kuḻīṃ kuḻakṣayo hoya | taye veḻīṃ to ādyadharmu jāya| maga āna kāṃhīṃ āhe| pāpāvāṃcunī || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, when a family is destroyed, its ancient dharma is lost. Then, what else remains but sin?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैं यमनियम ठाकती । तेथ इंद्रियें सैरा राहाटती । म्हणौनि व्यभिचार घडती । कुळस्त्रियांसी ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiṃ yamaniyama ṭhākatī | tetha iṃdriyeṃ sairā rāhāṭatī | mhaṇauni vyabhicāra ghaḍatī | kuḻastriyāṃsī || 49||
verses.meaning: Where self-restraint and spiritual disciplines are absent, the senses wander unrestrained, leading to moral transgressions, even among virtuous women.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उत्तम अधमीं संचरती । ऐसे वर्णावर्ण मिसळती । तेथ समूळ उपडती। जातिधर्म॥ २५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: uttama adhamīṃ saṃcaratī | aise varṇāvarṇa misaḻatī | tetha samūḻa upaḍatī| jātidharma|| 250||
verses.meaning: When the noble and the ignoble intermingle, all distinctions of caste and dharma are uprooted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी चोहटाचिये बळी । पाविजे सैरा काउळीं। तैसीं महापापें कुळीं। प्रवेशती ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī cohaṭāciye baḻī | pāvije sairā kāuḻīṃ| taisīṃ mahāpāpeṃ kuḻīṃ| praveśatī || 51||
verses.meaning: Just as crows gather freely at a crossroads offering, so do great sins enter the family.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग कुळा तया अशेखा। आणि कुळघातकां। येरयेरां नरका । जाणें आथी ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kuḻā tayā aśekhā| āṇi kuḻaghātakāṃ| yerayerāṃ narakā | jāṇeṃ āthī || 52||
verses.meaning: Then, for the entire lineage, and for those who destroy their lineage, both are destined to go to hell.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें वंशवृद्धि समस्त । यापरी होय पतित। मग वोवांडिती स्वर्गस्थ। पूर्वपुरुष॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ vaṃśavṛddhi samasta | yāparī hoya patita| maga vovāṃḍitī svargastha| pūrvapuruṣa|| 53||
verses.meaning: Behold, the entire lineage thus becomes fallen. Then the ancestors in heaven lament.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ नित्यादि क्रिया ठाके। आणि नैमित्तिक क्रिया पारुखे। तेथ कवणा तिळोदकें । कवण अर्पी॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha nityādi kriyā ṭhāke| āṇi naimittika kriyā pārukhe| tetha kavaṇā tiḻodakeṃ | kavaṇa arpī|| 54||
verses.meaning: Where daily rituals cease, and occasional rites are abandoned, to whom then would one offer water and sesame seeds, and who would offer them?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पितर काय करिती । कैसेनि स्वर्गी वसती । म्हणोनी तेही येती । कुळापासीं ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pitara kāya karitī | kaiseni svargī vasatī | mhaṇonī tehī yetī | kuḻāpāsīṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: What then do the ancestors do? How do they reside in heaven? Therefore, they too come to their descendants.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा नखाग्रीं व्याळु लागे। तो शिखांत व्यापी वेगें।॥ तेवीं आब्रह्म कुळ अवघें। आप्लविजे॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā nakhāgrīṃ vyāḻu lāge| to śikhāṃta vyāpī vegeṃ||| tevīṃ ābrahma kuḻa avagheṃ| āplavije|| 56||
verses.meaning: Just as a snake's venom, starting from the fingertip, swiftly spreads throughout the entire body, so too does the divine essence pervade the entire lineage, from Brahma downwards.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा अवधारी आणीक एक। एथ घडे महापातक । जे संगदोषें हा लौकिक । भ्रंशु पावे ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā avadhārī āṇīka eka| etha ghaḍe mahāpātaka | je saṃgadoṣeṃ hā laukika | bhraṃśu pāve || 57||
verses.meaning: O Lord, listen to one more thing. A great sin occurs here, by which this world falls into error due to the fault of association.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा घरीं आपुला । वानिवसें अग्नि लागला । तो आणिकांहीं प्रज्बळिला । जाळूनि घाली ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā gharīṃ āpulā | vānivaseṃ agni lāgalā | to āṇikāṃhīṃ prajbaḻilā | jāḻūni ghālī || 58||
verses.meaning: Just as a fire that has started in one's own house due to a spark, when fueled by others, burns and destroys everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसिया तया कुळसंगती। जे जे लोक वर्तती। तेही बाधा पावती । निमित्ते येणें ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisiyā tayā kuḻasaṃgatī| je je loka vartatī| tehī bādhā pāvatī | nimitte yeṇeṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who associate with such a lineage also encounter obstacles because of it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें नाना दोषें सकळ । अर्जुन म्हणे तें कुळ। मग महाघोर केवळ। निरय भोगी ॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ nānā doṣeṃ sakaḻa | arjuna mhaṇe teṃ kuḻa| maga mahāghora kevaḻa| niraya bhogī || 260||
verses.meaning: Arjuna says that such a family, afflicted by various sins, will then experience only the most dreadful hell.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'पडिलिया तिये ठायीं । मग कल्पांतींही उकलु नाहीं । येसणें पतन कुळक्षयीं। अर्जुन म्हणे॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'paḍiliyā tiye ṭhāyīṃ | maga kalpāṃtīṃhī ukalu nāhīṃ | yesaṇeṃ patana kuḻakṣayīṃ| arjuna mhaṇe|| 61||
verses.meaning: Arjuna said, "Falling into such a state, there is no liberation even at the end of a kalpa. Such is the downfall when a lineage is destroyed."

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा हें विविध कानीं ऐकिजे। परी अझुनिवरी त्रासु नुपजे। हृदय वज्राचें हें काय कौजे। अवधारीं पां॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā heṃ vividha kānīṃ aikije| parī ajhunivarī trāsu nupaje| hṛdaya vajrāceṃ heṃ kāya kauje| avadhārīṃ pāṃ||62||
verses.meaning: O God, these diverse things are heard by the ears, yet still, no weariness arises. What is this wonder, that the heart is made of thunderbolt? Listen!

verses.shloka_devanagari: अपेक्षिजे राज्यसुख। जयालागीं तें तंब क्षणिक । ऐसे जाणतांही दोख। अव्हेरू ना॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: apekṣije rājyasukha| jayālāgīṃ teṃ taṃba kṣaṇika | aise jāṇatāṃhī dokha| avherū nā||63||
verses.meaning: Even knowing that the happiness of a kingdom, which is so desired, is but momentary and flawed, one does not reject it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे हे वडिल सकळ आपुले) बधावया दिठी सूदले। सांग पां 'काय थेंकुलें। घडलें आम्हां॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: je he vaḍila sakaḻa āpule) badhāvayā diṭhī sūdale| sāṃga pāṃ 'kāya theṃkuleṃ| ghaḍaleṃ āmhāṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: These elders, our own kin, have come forth to bind us with their gaze. Tell me, what misfortune has befallen us?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां यावरी जें जियावें। तयापासूनि हें बरवें। जे शस्त्रे सांडूनि साहावे। बाण यांचे ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yāvarī jeṃ jiyāveṃ| tayāpāsūni heṃ baraveṃ| je śastre sāṃḍūni sāhāve| bāṇa yāṃce || 65||
verses.meaning: Now, to live after this, it is better to endure their arrows by abandoning weapons.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयावरी होय जितुकें । तें मरणही वरी निकें । परी येणें कल्मषें। चाड नाहीं ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāvarī hoya jitukeṃ | teṃ maraṇahī varī nikeṃ | parī yeṇeṃ kalmaṣeṃ| cāḍa nāhīṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: Whatever is prepared, even death is better than that. But there is no desire for these impurities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें देखून सकळ। अर्जुने आपुलें 'कुळ। मग म्हणे राज्य तें केवळ। निरयभोगु॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ dekhūna sakaḻa| arjune āpuleṃ 'kuḻa| maga mhaṇe rājya teṃ kevaḻa| nirayabhogu|| 67||
verses.meaning: Seeing all this, Arjuna then considered his own lineage and said, "This kingdom is nothing but an experience of hell."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें तिये अवसरीं । अर्जुन बोलिला समरीं। संजयो म्हणे अवधारी । धृतराष्ट्रातें ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ tiye avasarīṃ | arjuna bolilā samarīṃ| saṃjayo mhaṇe avadhārī | dhṛtarāṣṭrāteṃ || 68 ||
verses.meaning: At that very moment, Arjuna spoke on the battlefield. Sanjaya said, "Listen, O Dhritarashtra."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अत्यंत उद्ेगला। न धरत गहिंबरु आला। तेथ उडी घातली खालां। रथौनियां ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga atyaṃta udegalā| na dharata gahiṃbaru ālā| tetha uḍī ghātalī khālāṃ| rathauniyāṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: Then, overwhelmed by extreme distress, unable to control his emotions, he was overcome with grief. From there, he jumped down from his chariot.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा राजकुमरु पदच्युतु। सर्वथा होय उपहतु। कां रवि राहुग्रस्तु। प्रभाहीनु॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā rājakumaru padacyutu| sarvathā hoya upahatu| kāṃ ravi rāhugrastu| prabhāhīnu|| 270||
verses.meaning: Just as a prince, when dethroned, becomes utterly disgraced, or as the sun, when eclipsed by Rahu, loses its brilliance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी महासिद्िसंभ्रमें । जिंतिला तापसु भ्रमें। मग आकळूनि कामें। दीनु कीजे॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī mahāsidisaṃbhrameṃ | jiṃtilā tāpasu bhrameṃ| maga ākaḻūni kāmeṃ| dīnu kīje||71||
verses.meaning: Or, deluded by the illusion of great spiritual powers, the ascetic is overcome by desires, and then made miserable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा तो धनुर्धरु । अत्यंत दुःखें जर्जरु । दिसे जेथ रहंबरु । त्यजिला तेणें ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā to dhanurdharu | atyaṃta duḥkheṃ jarjaru | dise jetha rahaṃbaru | tyajilā teṇeṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: Just as that archer, Arjuna, was utterly ravaged by sorrow, he appeared as if he had abandoned his very self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग धनुष्यबाण सांडिळे। न धरत अश्रुपात आले। ऐसें ऐके राया वर्तलें। संजयो म्हणे ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga dhanuṣyabāṇa sāṃḍiḻe| na dharata aśrupāta āle| aiseṃ aike rāyā vartaleṃ| saṃjayo mhaṇe || 73||
verses.meaning: Then he cast aside his bow and arrows; tears flowed uncontrollably. Such was the event, O King, that transpired, said Sanjaya.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां यावरी तो वैकुंठनाथु। देखोनि सखेद पार्थ । कवणेपरी परमार्थ । निरूपीळ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yāvarī to vaikuṃṭhanāthu| dekhoni sakheda pārtha | kavaṇeparī paramārtha | nirūpīḻa|| 74||
verses.meaning: Now, after this, how will the Lord of Vaikuntha explain the ultimate truth to the sorrowful Partha?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते सविस्तर पुढारी कथा। अति सकौतुक ऐकतां। ज्ञानदेव म्हणे आतां। निवृत्तिदासु॥ २७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: te savistara puḍhārī kathā| ati sakautuka aikatāṃ| jñānadeva mhaṇe ātāṃ| nivṛttidāsu|| 275||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev now says, "Nivruttidas, this detailed story that follows is very fascinating to hear."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग संजयो म्हणे रायातें। आइके तो पार्थ तेथें । शोकाकुल रुदनातें। करीतु असे॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga saṃjayo mhaṇe rāyāteṃ| āike to pārtha tetheṃ | śokākula rudanāteṃ| karītu ase|| 1||
verses.meaning: Then Sanjaya said to the King, "Listen, Arjuna there, overwhelmed with sorrow, was weeping."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें कुळ देखोनि समस्त । स्नेह उपनलें अदभुत । तेणें द्रवले असे चित्त। कवणेपरी ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ kuḻa dekhoni samasta | sneha upanaleṃ adabhuta | teṇeṃ dravale ase citta| kavaṇeparī || 2||
verses.meaning: Upon seeing that entire lineage, an extraordinary affection arose, by which the heart was melted in a way that cannot be described.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें लबण जळें झळंबलें। ना तरी अभ्र वातें हाले । तैसें सधीर परी विरमळें। हृदय तयाचें ॥ ३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ labaṇa jaḻeṃ jhaḻaṃbaleṃ| nā tarī abhra vāteṃ hāle | taiseṃ sadhīra parī viramaḻeṃ| hṛdaya tayāceṃ || 3 ||
verses.meaning: Just as salt dissolves in water, or a cloud is moved by the wind, so too is the heart of such a person, though outwardly steady, inwardly dissolved and restless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कृपा आकळिला। दिसतसे अति कोमाइला। जैसा कर्दमीं रुपला । राजहंस ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kṛpā ākaḻilā| disatase ati komāilā| jaisā kardamīṃ rupalā | rājahaṃsa || 4||
verses.meaning: Therefore, compassion, when grasped, appears exceedingly withered, like a royal swan stuck in mud.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी तो पांडुकुमरु । महामोहें अति जर्जरु । देखोनि श्रीशार्हुधरु । काय बोळे॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī to pāṃḍukumaru | mahāmoheṃ ati jarjaru | dekhoni śrīśārhudharu | kāya boḻe|| 5||
verses.meaning: Seeing Arjuna, the son of Pandu, greatly afflicted and weakened by profound delusion, what did the glorious Lord Vishnu then say?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे अर्जुना आदि पाहीं । हें उचित काय इये ठायीं। तूं. कवण हें कायी । करीत आहासी॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe arjunā ādi pāhīṃ | heṃ ucita kāya iye ṭhāyīṃ| tūṃ. kavaṇa heṃ kāyī | karīta āhāsī|| 6||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, first consider this: Is this appropriate here? Who are you, and what are you doing?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुज सांगें काय जाहलें कवण उणें आलें। करितां काय ठेलें। खेदु कायिसा॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuja sāṃgeṃ kāya jāhaleṃ kavaṇa uṇeṃ āleṃ| karitāṃ kāya ṭheleṃ| khedu kāyisā|| 7||
verses.meaning: What has happened to you, what deficiency has arisen? What has stopped you from acting? Why this sorrow?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं अनुचिता चित्त नेदिसी। धीरु कहीं न संडिसी। तुझेनि नामें अपयशीं। दिशा ल॑ंघिजे॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ anucitā citta nedisī| dhīru kahīṃ na saṃḍisī| tujheni nāmeṃ apayaśīṃ| diśā la̭ṃghije|| 8||
verses.meaning: You do not allow your mind to dwell on the improper. You never abandon your steadfastness. Through your name, even ill-repute is overcome and transformed into glory, spreading in all directions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं शूरवृत्तीचा ठावो । क्षत्रियांमाजीं रावो । तुझिया लाठेपणाचा आवो। तिहीं लोकीं॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ śūravṛttīcā ṭhāvo | kṣatriyāṃmājīṃ rāvo | tujhiyā lāṭhepaṇācā āvo| tihīṃ lokīṃ|| 9||
verses.meaning: You are the very embodiment of valor, the king among warriors. Your prowess is renowned throughout the three worlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुवां संग्रामीं हरु जिंकिला। निवातकवचांचा ठावो फेडिला । पवाडा तुवां केला । गंधर्वांसीं ॥ ९१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuvāṃ saṃgrāmīṃ haru jiṃkilā| nivātakavacāṃcā ṭhāvo pheḍilā | pavāḍā tuvāṃ kelā | gaṃdharvāṃsīṃ || 910||
verses.meaning: You conquered Hara (Shiva) in battle, you destroyed the abode of the Nivatakavachas, and you performed a great feat for the Gandharvas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहतां तुझेनि पाडें। दिसे त्रैलोक्यही थोकडें। ऐसें पुरुषत्व चोखडें। पार्था तुझें॥११॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhatāṃ tujheni pāḍeṃ| dise trailokyahī thokaḍeṃ| aiseṃ puruṣatva cokhaḍeṃ| pārthā tujheṃ||11||
verses.meaning: Compared to your prowess, the three worlds appear insignificant. Such is your pure and excellent valor, O Partha!

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो तूं कीं आजि येथें। सांडूनियां वीरवृत्तीतें। अधोमुख रुदनातें । करितु आहासी ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to tūṃ kīṃ āji yetheṃ| sāṃḍūniyāṃ vīravṛttīteṃ| adhomukha rudanāteṃ | karitu āhāsī || 12||
verses.meaning: Are you the same person who, abandoning your warrior's duty today, is weeping with downcast face?

verses.shloka_devanagari: विचारी तूं अर्जुनु। 'कौं कारुण्यें किजसी दीनु। सांग पां अंधकारें भानु । ग्रासिला आथी ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vicārī tūṃ arjunu| 'kauṃ kāruṇyeṃ kijasī dīnu| sāṃga pāṃ aṃdhakāreṃ bhānu | grāsilā āthī || 13||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, tell me, how can you be overcome by compassion and become so dejected? Can the sun ever be eclipsed by darkness?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी पवनु मेघासी बरिहे। कौं अमृतासी मरण आहे। पाहें पां इंधनचि गिळोनि जाये । पावकातें ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī pavanu meghāsī barihe| kauṃ amṛtāsī maraṇa āhe| pāheṃ pāṃ iṃdhanaci giḻoni jāye | pāvakāteṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind cannot carry away the clouds, or death cannot touch the immortal nectar, or fuel cannot consume the fire itself, so too is the nature of the soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं लबणेंचि जळ विरे। संसर्गे काळकूट मरे। सांग पां महाफणी दर्दरें। गिळिजे कायी॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ labaṇeṃci jaḻa vire| saṃsarge kāḻakūṭa mare| sāṃga pāṃ mahāphaṇī dardareṃ| giḻije kāyī|| 15||
verses.meaning: Or does salt dissolve water? Does poison die by contact? Tell me, can a great serpent be swallowed by a frog?

verses.shloka_devanagari: सिंहासी झोंबे कोल्हा । ऐसा अपाडु आथि कें जाहला। परी तो त्वां साच केला। आजि एथ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: siṃhāsī jhoṃbe kolhā | aisā apāḍu āthi keṃ jāhalā| parī to tvāṃ sāca kelā| āji etha|| 16||
verses.meaning: A jackal attacking a lion, such an impossible feat, yet you have made it true today.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अझुनी अर्जुना । झणें चित्त देसी या हीना। वेगीं धीर करूनियां मना । सावधु होई ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ajhunī arjunā | jhaṇeṃ citta desī yā hīnā| vegīṃ dhīra karūniyāṃ manā | sāvadhu hoī || 17||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, do not let your mind dwell on this lowly state. Quickly steady your mind and become alert.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांडीं हें मूर्खपण । उठीं घे धनुष्यबाण । संग्रामीं हें कवण। कारुण्य तुझें॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃḍīṃ heṃ mūrkhapaṇa | uṭhīṃ ghe dhanuṣyabāṇa | saṃgrāmīṃ heṃ kavaṇa| kāruṇya tujheṃ|| 18||
verses.meaning: Cast aside this foolishness. Arise, take up your bow and arrow. In battle, what is this compassion of yours?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा तूं जाणता । तरी न विचारिसी कां आतां। सांगे झुंजावेळे सदयता । उचित कायी॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā tūṃ jāṇatā | tarī na vicārisī kāṃ ātāṃ| sāṃge jhuṃjāveḻe sadayatā | ucita kāyī|| 19||
verses.meaning: Indeed, you are wise, so why do you not consider now? Tell me, is kindness appropriate at the time of battle?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे असतीये कौर्तीसी नाशु। आणि पारत्रिकासि अपभ्रंशु। म्हणे जगन्निवासु । अर्जुनातें ॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he asatīye kaurtīsī nāśu| āṇi pāratrikāsi apabhraṃśu| mhaṇe jagannivāsu | arjunāteṃ || 20||
verses.meaning: Lord Jagannivasa (Krishna) said to Arjuna: "This leads to the destruction of one's reputation in this world and causes a downfall in the afterlife."

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि शोकु न करीं। तूं पुरता धीरु धरीं। हें शोच्यता अव्हेरीं। पंडुकुमरा। २१॥ तुज नव्हे हें उचित। येणें नासेल जोडलें बहुत। तूं अझुनीवरी हित। विचारीं पां॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni śoku na karīṃ| tūṃ puratā dhīru dharīṃ| heṃ śocyatā avherīṃ| paṃḍukumarā| 21|| tuja navhe heṃ ucita| yeṇeṃ nāsela joḍaleṃ bahuta| tūṃ ajhunīvarī hita| vicārīṃ pāṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: Therefore, do not grieve. Hold firm to your complete courage. Cast away this sorrow, O son of Pandu. This is not befitting for you; by this, much that you have gained will be destroyed. Consider what is truly beneficial even now.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें संग्रामाचेनि अवसरें। एथ 'कृपाळुपण नुपकरे। हे आतांचि काय सोयरे) जाहले तुज॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ saṃgrāmāceni avasareṃ| etha 'kṛpāḻupaṇa nupakare| he ātāṃci kāya soyare) jāhale tuja|| 23||
verses.meaning: In this time of battle, compassion is of no use here. Have they now become your relatives?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं आधींचि काय नेणसी। कीं हे गोत्र नोळखसी। वायांचि काय करिसी । अतिशो आतां॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ ādhīṃci kāya neṇasī| kīṃ he gotra noḻakhasī| vāyāṃci kāya karisī | atiśo ātāṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: Do you not already know this? Or do you not recognize this lineage? Why do you unnecessarily make such a fuss now?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आजिचें हें झुंज । काय जन्मा नवल तुज हें परस्परे तुम्हां व्याज) सदांचि आथी ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ājiceṃ heṃ jhuṃja | kāya janmā navala tuja heṃ paraspare tumhāṃ vyāja) sadāṃci āthī || 25||
verses.meaning: This conflict today, what is so new to your birth? This animosity between you two has always existed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आतां काय जाहलें। कायि स्नेह उपनलें। हें नेणिजे परी कुडें केलें। अर्जुना तुवां ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātāṃ kāya jāhaleṃ| kāyi sneha upanaleṃ| heṃ neṇije parī kuḍeṃ keleṃ| arjunā tuvāṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: So what has happened now? What affection has arisen? This is unknown, but you have done wrong, Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोहो धरिलीया ऐसें होईल। जे असती प्रतिष्ठा जाईल। आणि परळलोकही अंतरेळ। ऐहिकेंसी ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: moho dharilīyā aiseṃ hoīla| je asatī pratiṣṭhā jāīla| āṇi paraḻalokahī aṃtareḻa| aihikeṃsī || 27||
verses.meaning: If one is overcome by delusion, their existing reputation will be lost, and the other world will also become distant, just like this earthly one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हृदयाचें ढिळेपण। एथ निकयासी नव्हे कारण हें संग्रामीं पतन जाण । क्षत्रियांसीं ॥ २८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: hṛdayāceṃ ḍhiḻepaṇa| etha nikayāsī navhe kāraṇa heṃ saṃgrāmīṃ patana jāṇa | kṣatriyāṃsīṃ || 28 ||
verses.meaning: Faint-heartedness is not a virtue here; know that falling in battle is the duty of a Kshatriya.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि तो कृपावंतु। नानापरी असे शिकवितु । हें ऐकोनि पंडुसुतु। काय बोळे॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni to kṛpāvaṃtu| nānāparī ase śikavitu | heṃ aikoni paṃḍusutu| kāya boḻe|| 29||
verses.meaning: Thus, that compassionate one, in various ways, teaches. Hearing this, what did the son of Pandu say?

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा हें येतुलेवरी । बोलावें नलगे अवधारीं । आधीं तूंचि चित्तीं विचारीं । संग्रामु हा॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā heṃ yetulevarī | bolāveṃ nalage avadhārīṃ | ādhīṃ tūṃci cittīṃ vicārīṃ | saṃgrāmu hā|| 30||
verses.meaning: O Lord, there is no need to speak so much; consider this battle in your own mind first.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें झुंज नव्हे प्रमादु। एथ प्रवर्तल्िया दिसतसे बाधु। हा उघडा लिंगभेदु। वोढवला आम्हां॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jhuṃja navhe pramādu| etha pravartaliyā disatase bādhu| hā ughaḍā liṃgabhedu| voḍhavalā āmhāṃ|| 39||
verses.meaning: This is not a mere quarrel; engaging in it clearly brings harm. This open distinction of gender has befallen us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें मातापितरें अर्चिजती। सर्वस्वें तोषु पावविजती । तिये पाठीं केवीं बधिजती । आपुलिया हातीं ॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ mātāpitareṃ arcijatī| sarvasveṃ toṣu pāvavijatī | tiye pāṭhīṃ kevīṃ badhijatī | āpuliyā hātīṃ ||32||
verses.meaning: Behold, parents are worshipped and pleased with all devotion. How then can one harm them with one's own hands?

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा संतवृंद नमस्कारिजे। कां घडे तरी पूजिजे। हें वांचूनि केवीं निंदिजे। स्वयें बाचा ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā saṃtavṛṃda namaskārije| kāṃ ghaḍe tarī pūjije| heṃ vāṃcūni kevīṃ niṃdije| svayeṃ bācā || 33||
verses.meaning: One should bow down to the assembly of saints, or if possible, worship them. How then can one, with one's own mouth, condemn them?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे गोत्रगुरु आमुचे । हे पूजनीय आम्हां नियमाचे । मज बहुत भौष्मद्रोणांचें । वर्ततसे ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise gotraguru āmuce | he pūjanīya āmhāṃ niyamāce | maja bahuta bhauṣmadroṇāṃceṃ | vartatase || 34||
verses.meaning: Just as our clan-elders are revered by us as a matter of principle, so too do Bhishma and Drona hold great reverence for me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांलागीं मनें विरू। आम्ही स्वप्नींही न शकों धरूं । तयां प्रत्यक्ष केवीं करूं। घातु देवा॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃlāgīṃ maneṃ virū| āmhī svapnīṃhī na śakoṃ dharūṃ | tayāṃ pratyakṣa kevīṃ karūṃ| ghātu devā|| 35||
verses.meaning: Those whom we cannot even conceive of harming in our dreams, how can we actually harm them, O Lord?

verses.shloka_devanagari: वर जळो हें जियालें एथ आघवेयांसि हेंचि काय जाहलें। जे यांच्या वधीं अभ्यासिलें। मिरविजे आम्हीं ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: vara jaḻo heṃ jiyāleṃ etha āghaveyāṃsi heṃci kāya jāhaleṃ| je yāṃcyā vadhīṃ abhyāsileṃ| miravije āmhīṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: Let this life burn away; has this happened to everyone here? That we have become skilled in their destruction, and now we display it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी पार्थ द्रोणाचा केल् । येणें धनुर्वेदु मज दिधला । तेणें उपकारें काय आभारेला । वधीं तयातें ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī pārtha droṇācā kel | yeṇeṃ dhanurvedu maja didhalā | teṇeṃ upakāreṃ kāya ābhārelā | vadhīṃ tayāteṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: I am Arjuna, and Dronacharya taught me the science of archery. How can I repay that kindness by killing him?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथींचिया कृपा लाहिजे वरु । तेथेंचि मनें व्यभिचारु । तरी काय मी भस्मासुरु । अर्जुन म्हणे॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jethīṃciyā kṛpā lāhije varu | tetheṃci maneṃ vyabhicāru | tarī kāya mī bhasmāsuru | arjuna mhaṇe|| 38||
verses.meaning: Arjuna said, "If I were to betray with my mind the very grace from which I receive blessings, then what would I be but a demon like Bhasmasura?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा समुद्र गंभीर आइकिजे। वरि तोहि आहाच देखिजे । परी क्षोभु मनीं नेणिजे । द्रोणाचिये॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā samudra gaṃbhīra āikije| vari tohi āhāca dekhije | parī kṣobhu manīṃ neṇije | droṇāciye|| 39||
verses.meaning: The ocean is heard to be deep and appears vast, yet it does not know the agitation that was in Dronacharya's mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें अपार जें गगन | वरी तयाही होईल मान। परि अगाध भलें गहन। हृदय याचें ॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ apāra jeṃ gagana | varī tayāhī hoīla māna| pari agādha bhaleṃ gahana| hṛdaya yāceṃ || 40||
verses.meaning: This heart is so profoundly unfathomable, that even the boundless sky would be considered small in comparison.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरी अमृतही विटे। कीं काळवशें वज्र फुटे। परी मनोधर्मु न लोटे। विकरविलाही ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: varī amṛtahī viṭe| kīṃ kāḻavaśeṃ vajra phuṭe| parī manodharmu na loṭe| vikaravilāhī || 41||
verses.meaning: Even nectar can spoil, or a diamond can break due to the passage of time, but the virtuous nature of the mind does not waver, even when provoked.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वेहालागीं माये । म्हणिपे तें कीरु होये। परी कृपा ते मूर्त आहे। द्रोणीं इये॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: svehālāgīṃ māye | mhaṇipe teṃ kīru hoye| parī kṛpā te mūrta āhe| droṇīṃ iye|| 42||
verses.meaning: The love of a mother is indeed called 'maya' (illusion), but in this Drona, that compassion is truly embodied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा कारुण्याची आदि। सकल गुणांचा निधि। विद्यासिंधु निरवधि। अर्जुन म्हणे॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā kāruṇyācī ādi| sakala guṇāṃcā nidhi| vidyāsiṃdhu niravadhi| arjuna mhaṇe|| 43||
verses.meaning: Arjuna said, "He is the origin of compassion, the treasure of all virtues, and an endless ocean of knowledge."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा येणें मानें महंतु। बरी आम्हांलागीं कृपावंतु। आतां सांग पां येथ घातु । चिंतूं येईल ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā yeṇeṃ māneṃ mahaṃtu| barī āmhāṃlāgīṃ kṛpāvaṃtu| ātāṃ sāṃga pāṃ yetha ghātu | ciṃtūṃ yeīla || 44||
verses.meaning: Thus, by this very nature, the great ones are indeed merciful to us. Now, tell me, can any harm be conceived here?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे हे रणीं बधावे । मग आपण राज्यसुख भोगावें। तें मना नये आघवें। जीवितेसीं ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise he raṇīṃ badhāve | maga āpaṇa rājyasukha bhogāveṃ| teṃ manā naye āghaveṃ| jīvitesīṃ || 45 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, if one were to bind them in battle, and then enjoy the pleasures of kingship, all of that would not be acceptable to the soul, for it would be at the cost of their lives.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें येणें मानें दुर्धर। जे याहीहुनी भोग सधर। ते असतु येथवर । भिक्षा मागतां भली ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ yeṇeṃ māneṃ durdhara| je yāhīhunī bhoga sadhara| te asatu yethavara | bhikṣā māgatāṃ bhalī || 46||
verses.meaning: This is so difficult to achieve, that even if there were more severe sufferings than this, it would be better to beg for alms than to endure them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी देशत्यागें जाइजे। कां गिरिकंदर सेविजे। परी शस्त्र आतां न धरिजे। इयांबरी ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī deśatyāgeṃ jāije| kāṃ girikaṃdara sevije| parī śastra ātāṃ na dharije| iyāṃbarī || 47||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, one might leave the country, or seek refuge in mountain caves, but weapons should not be taken up against these people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा नवनिशतीं शरीं। बाबरोनी यांच्या जिव्हारीं । भोग गिंबसावे रुधिरीं। बुडाळे जे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā navaniśatīṃ śarīṃ| bābaronī yāṃcyā jivhārīṃ | bhoga giṃbasāve rudhirīṃ| buḍāḻe je|| 48||
verses.meaning: O God, with these new arrows, piercing their vital parts, let them experience the consequences in their blood, those who are immersed in sin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते काढूनि काय किजती। लिप्त केवीं सेविजती। मज नये हे उपपत्ति) याचिलागीं ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: te kāḍhūni kāya kijatī| lipta kevīṃ sevijatī| maja naye he upapatti) yācilāgīṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: What can be done by removing them? How can they be enjoyed when tainted? This reasoning does not appeal to me, for this very reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अर्जुन तिये अवसरीं। म्हणे श्रीकृष्णा अवधारीं। परी तें मना न येचि मुरारी । आइकोनियां॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ arjuna tiye avasarīṃ| mhaṇe śrīkṛṣṇā avadhārīṃ| parī teṃ manā na yeci murārī | āikoniyāṃ|| 50||
verses.meaning: At that moment, Arjuna said to Shri Krishna, "Listen." But Murari did not heed it, even after hearing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जाणोनि पार्थ बिहाळा । मग पुनरपि बोलों लागला । म्हणे देवो कां चित्त या बोला। देतीचि ना॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jāṇoni pārtha bihāḻā | maga punarapi boloṃ lāgalā | mhaṇe devo kāṃ citta yā bolā| detīci nā|| 51||
verses.meaning: Knowing this, Arjuna was bewildered. Then he spoke again, saying, "Why does God not pay attention to these words?" (51)

verses.shloka_devanagari: येऱ्हवीं माझ्या चित्तीं जें होतें । तें मी विचारूनि बोलिलो येथें । परी निकें काय यापरीतें। तें तुम्ही जाणा॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṟhavīṃ mājhyā cittīṃ jeṃ hoteṃ | teṃ mī vicārūni bolilo yetheṃ | parī nikeṃ kāya yāparīteṃ| teṃ tumhī jāṇā|| 52||
verses.meaning: What was in my mind, I have spoken here after much thought. But what is better than this, that you know.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं बीरु जयांसी ऐकिजे। आणि या बोलींचि प्राणु सांडिजे। ते एथ संग्रामव्याजें। उभे आहाती ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ bīru jayāṃsī aikije| āṇi yā bolīṃci prāṇu sāṃḍije| te etha saṃgrāmavyājeṃ| ubhe āhātī || 53||
verses.meaning: Behold, those whose very names strike fear, and at whose mere words life itself departs, they stand here, disguised as warriors in this battle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां ऐसियांतें वधावें। कौं अव्हेरूनिया निघावें। या दोहोंमाजीं बरवें। तें नेणों आम्ही ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ aisiyāṃteṃ vadhāveṃ| kauṃ avherūniyā nighāveṃ| yā dohoṃmājīṃ baraveṃ| teṃ neṇoṃ āmhī || 54||
verses.meaning: Now, whether to kill such people, or to leave them aside and depart, we do not know which of these two is better.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हां काय उचित। तें पाहतां न स्फुरे येथ। जें मोहें येणें चित्त । व्याकुळ माझें ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhāṃ kāya ucita| teṃ pāhatāṃ na sphure yetha| jeṃ moheṃ yeṇeṃ citta | vyākuḻa mājheṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: What is proper for me to do, I cannot discern here, for my mind is distressed by this delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिमिरावरुद्ध जेसें। दृष्टीचें तेज भ्रंशे । मग पासींच असतां न दिसे। वस्तुजात ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: timirāvaruddha jeseṃ| dṛṣṭīceṃ teja bhraṃśe | maga pāsīṃca asatāṃ na dise| vastujāta || 56||
verses.meaning: Just as the light of sight is lost against darkness, then even though objects are nearby, they are not seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा तैसें मज जाहलें। जें मन हें भ्रांती ग्रासिलें। आतां काय हित आपुलें। तेंही नेणें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā taiseṃ maja jāhaleṃ| jeṃ mana heṃ bhrāṃtī grāsileṃ| ātāṃ kāya hita āpuleṃ| teṃhī neṇeṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: O Lord, such has become my state, that my mind is engulfed by delusion. Now, what is beneficial for myself, even that I do not know.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी श्रीकृष्णा तुवां जाणावें। निकें तें आम्हां सांगावें। जे सखा सर्वस्व आघवें। आम्हांसि तूं॥५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī śrīkṛṣṇā tuvāṃ jāṇāveṃ| nikeṃ teṃ āmhāṃ sāṃgāveṃ| je sakhā sarvasva āghaveṃ| āmhāṃsi tūṃ||58||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Shri Krishna, you should know that you are our dearest friend and our everything. Please tell us what is good for us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं गुरु बंधु पिता। तूं आमची इष्ट देवता । तूंचि सदा रक्षिता । आपदीं आमुतें॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ guru baṃdhu pitā| tūṃ āmacī iṣṭa devatā | tūṃci sadā rakṣitā | āpadīṃ āmuteṃ||59||
verses.meaning: You are our Guru, our brother, our father. You are our cherished deity. You are always our protector in times of adversity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा शिष्यांतें गुरु। सर्वथा नेणे अव्हेरू। कीं सरितांतें सागरू । त्यजी केवीं ॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā śiṣyāṃteṃ guru| sarvathā neṇe avherū| kīṃ saritāṃteṃ sāgarū | tyajī kevīṃ || 60||
verses.meaning: Just as a guru never rejects a disciple, or how can the ocean ever abandon rivers?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी अपत्यांतें माये। सांडूनि जरी जाये। तरी तें कैसेनि जिये। ऐकें कृष्णा॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī apatyāṃteṃ māye| sāṃḍūni jarī jāye| tarī teṃ kaiseni jiye| aikeṃ kṛṣṇā|| 61||
verses.meaning: Just as a mother, if she abandons her child, how can that child survive, O Krishna, listen to this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सर्वांपरी आम्हांसी । देवा तूंची एक आहासि। आणि बोलिलें जरी न मानिसी। मागील माझें ॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sarvāṃparī āmhāṃsī | devā tūṃcī eka āhāsi| āṇi bolileṃ jarī na mānisī| māgīla mājheṃ ||62||
verses.meaning: In the same way, for us, O Lord, You alone are everything. And even if You do not heed my past words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी उचित काय आम्हां। जें व्यभिचरेना धर्मा। तें झडकरी पुरुषोत्तमा। सांगे आतां॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ucita kāya āmhāṃ| jeṃ vyabhicarenā dharmā| teṃ jhaḍakarī puruṣottamā| sāṃge ātāṃ|| 63||
verses.meaning: Therefore, what is proper for us, that which does not deviate from Dharma, O Purushottama, tell us quickly now.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें सकळ कुळ देखोनि। जो शोकु उपनलासे मनीं। तो तुझिया वाक्‍्यावबांचुनी। न जाय आणिकें ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ sakaḻa kuḻa dekhoni| jo śoku upanalāse manīṃ| to tujhiyā vāk‍yāvabāṃcunī| na jāya āṇikeṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: Seeing this entire lineage, the sorrow that has arisen in my mind will not depart by any other means than by your words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ पृथ्वीतळ आपु होईल हें महेंद्रपदही पाविजेळ। परी मोह हा न फिटेळ। मानसींचा ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha pṛthvītaḻa āpu hoīla heṃ maheṃdrapadahī pāvijeḻa| parī moha hā na phiṭeḻa| mānasīṃcā || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Even if one were to attain the entire earth or the position of Indra, the king of gods, this delusion would not leave the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसीं बीजें सर्वथा आहाळलीं। तीं सुक्षेत्री जऱ्ही पेरिलीं। तरी न विरूढती सिंचिली। आवडे तैसीं ॥६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisīṃ bījeṃ sarvathā āhāḻalīṃ| tīṃ sukṣetrī jaṟhī perilīṃ| tarī na virūḍhatī siṃcilī| āvaḍe taisīṃ ||66||
verses.meaning: Just as seeds that are completely spoiled, even if sown in fertile soil and watered as much as desired, will not sprout.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी आयुष्य पुरलें आहे । तरी औषधें कांहीं नोहे । 'एथ एकचि उपेगा जाये । परमामृत॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī āyuṣya puraleṃ āhe | tarī auṣadheṃ kāṃhīṃ nohe | 'etha ekaci upegā jāye | paramāmṛta|| 67||
verses.meaning: Even if life is prolonged, medicines are of no use. Here, only one thing is beneficial: the supreme nectar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें राज्यभोगसमृम्द्वि। उज्जीवन नोहे जीवबुब्धि। एथ जिव्हाळा कृपानिधि। कारुण्य तुझें ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ rājyabhogasamṛmdvi| ujjīvana nohe jīvabubdhi| etha jivhāḻā kṛpānidhi| kāruṇya tujheṃ || 68||
verses.meaning: Just as worldly prosperity cannot truly uplift the soul, so too, O Ocean of Compassion, Your grace is the true essence of life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अर्जुन तेथ बोलिला । जंव क्षणएक भ्रांति सांडिला। मग पुनरपि व्यापिला। उर्मी तेणें ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ arjuna tetha bolilā | jaṃva kṣaṇaeka bhrāṃti sāṃḍilā| maga punarapi vyāpilā| urmī teṇeṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: Thus spoke Arjuna there, for a moment casting aside his delusion. But then, he was again overcome by that wave of emotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं मज पाहतां उर्मी नोहे । हे अनारिसें गमत आहे । तो ग्रासिला महामोहें॥ काळसर्पे ॥७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ maja pāhatāṃ urmī nohe | he anāriseṃ gamata āhe | to grāsilā mahāmoheṃ|| kāḻasarpe ||70||
verses.meaning: Or, seeing me, if one does not feel joy, and instead finds it unpleasant, then know that such a person is swallowed by the great delusion, like by a black serpent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सवर्म हृदयकल्हारीं। तेथ कारुण्यवेळेच्या भरीं । लागला म्हणौनि लहरी । भांजेचिना ॥ ७१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: savarma hṛdayakalhārīṃ| tetha kāruṇyaveḻecyā bharīṃ | lāgalā mhaṇauni laharī | bhāṃjecinā || 719||
verses.meaning: In the lotus of the heart, the waves of compassion surge, yet they do not break or diminish, for they are ever-present.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जाणोनि ऐसी प्रौढी । जो दृष्टिसवेंचि विष फेडी। तो धांवया श्रीहरी गारुडी) पातला कीं ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jāṇoni aisī prauḍhī | jo dṛṣṭisaveṃci viṣa pheḍī| to dhāṃvayā śrīharī gāruḍī) pātalā kīṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: Knowing this great power, the one who removes poison with just a glance, that Shri Hari, the snake charmer, has arrived running.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसिया पंडुकुमरा व्याकुळा। मिरवतसे श्रीकृष्ण जवबळा। तो कृपावशें अवलीळा । रक्षील आतां॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisiyā paṃḍukumarā vyākuḻā| miravatase śrīkṛṣṇa javabaḻā| to kṛpāvaśeṃ avalīḻā | rakṣīla ātāṃ|| 73||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, Krishna, who is the very embodiment of strength, will now effortlessly protect you out of His boundless compassion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि तो पार्थ । मोहफणिग्रस्तु। म्यां म्हणितला हा हेतु । जाणोनियां ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni to pārtha | mohaphaṇigrastu| myāṃ mhaṇitalā hā hetu | jāṇoniyāṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, being gripped by the serpent of delusion, I have declared this reason, knowing it well.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग देखा तेथ फाल्गुनु। घेतला असे थ्रांती कवळूनु। जैसा घनपटळीं भानु। आच्छादिजे॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga dekhā tetha phālgunu| ghetalā ase thrāṃtī kavaḻūnu| jaisā ghanapaṭaḻīṃ bhānu| ācchādije|| 75||
verses.meaning: Then, behold, Arjuna was enveloped by delusion, just as the sun is covered by dense clouds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी तो धनुर्धर । जाहलासे दुःखें जर्जरु। जैसा ग्रीष्मकाळीं गिरिवरु। बणवला कां॥७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī to dhanurdhara | jāhalāse duḥkheṃ jarjaru| jaisā grīṣmakāḻīṃ girivaru| baṇavalā kāṃ||76||
verses.meaning: Thus, that archer (Arjuna) was consumed by sorrow, like a mountain scorched and withered in the summer heat.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सहजें सुनीळु। कृपामृतें सजळु। तो बोळलासे श्रीगोपाळु । महामेघु ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sahajeṃ sunīḻu| kṛpāmṛteṃ sajaḻu| to boḻalāse śrīgopāḻu | mahāmeghu || 77||
verses.meaning: Thus, naturally dark blue, filled with the nectar of compassion, that Shri Gopala, the great cloud, has descended.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सुदशनांची द्युति । तेचि विद्युल्लता झळकती । गंभीर वाचा ते आयती । गर्जनेची ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha sudaśanāṃcī dyuti | teci vidyullatā jhaḻakatī | gaṃbhīra vācā te āyatī | garjanecī || 78||
verses.meaning: There, the brilliance of the Sudarshana Chakra manifests as flashes of lightning, and its deep voice is like the thunder's roar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तो उदार कैसा वर्षेल। तेणें अर्जुनाचळु निवेळ। मग नवी विरूढी फुटेळ। उन्मेषाची ॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ to udāra kaisā varṣela| teṇeṃ arjunācaḻu niveḻa| maga navī virūḍhī phuṭeḻa| unmeṣācī ||79||
verses.meaning: Now, how will that generous one shower his grace? By it, the mountain of Arjuna's doubt will be cleansed, and then a new sprout of spiritual awakening will emerge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते कथा आइका । मनाचिया आराणुका। ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे देखा । निवृत्तिदासु॥ ८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: te kathā āikā | manāciyā ārāṇukā| jñānadevo mhaṇe dekhā | nivṛttidāsu|| 80||
verses.meaning: Listen to this story, for the peace of your mind, says Dnyandev, the servant of Nivrutti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें संजयो असे सांगतु। म्हणे राया तो पार्थ । पुनरपि शोकाकुळितु। 'काय बोले॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ saṃjayo ase sāṃgatu| mhaṇe rāyā to pārtha | punarapi śokākuḻitu| 'kāya bole|| 81||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya thus continued, "O King, Arjuna, again overwhelmed with sorrow, what did he say?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: आडके सखेदु बोले श्रीकृष्णातें। आतां नाळवावें तुम्हीं मातें।॥ मी सर्वथा न झुंजे येथें। भरंवसेनि॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āḍake sakhedu bole śrīkṛṣṇāteṃ| ātāṃ nāḻavāveṃ tumhīṃ māteṃ||| mī sarvathā na jhuṃje yetheṃ| bharaṃvaseni|| 82||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, with a heart full of sorrow, spoke to Shri Krishna, "Now, you must not compel me. I will certainly not fight here, of this I am certain."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें येकिहेळां बोलिला । मग मौन धरूनि ठेला । तेथ श्रीकृष्णा विस्मो पातला । देखोनि तयातें ॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ yekiheḻāṃ bolilā | maga mauna dharūni ṭhelā | tetha śrīkṛṣṇā vismo pātalā | dekhoni tayāteṃ ||83||
verses.meaning: Having spoken thus in a single breath, he then fell silent. Seeing this, Shri Krishna was filled with wonder.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आपुलां चित्तीं म्हणे। एथ हें कायी आदरिलें येणें । अर्जुन सर्वथा कांहीं नेणे। काय कीजे॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āpulāṃ cittīṃ mhaṇe| etha heṃ kāyī ādarileṃ yeṇeṃ | arjuna sarvathā kāṃhīṃ neṇe| kāya kīje|| 84||
verses.meaning: Then He thought to Himself, "What has he undertaken here? Arjuna knows absolutely nothing. What should be done?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा उमजे आतां कवणेपरी। कैसेनि धीरू स्वीकारी। जैसा ग्रहातें पंचाक्षरी । अनुमानी कां॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā umaje ātāṃ kavaṇeparī| kaiseni dhīrū svīkārī| jaisā grahāteṃ paṃcākṣarī | anumānī kāṃ|| 85||
verses.meaning: How then can this be understood? How can one accept such steadfastness? It is like a person skilled in mantras (Panchakshari) discerning a planet's influence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी असाध्य देखोनि व्याधि । अमृतासम दिव्य औषधी । वैद्य सूचि निरबधि । निदानींची ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī asādhya dekhoni vyādhi | amṛtāsama divya auṣadhī | vaidya sūci nirabadhi | nidānīṃcī || 86||
verses.meaning: Or, if a disease is seen as incurable, a physician, knowing the ultimate diagnosis, prescribes a divine medicine like nectar, without fail.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें विवरीतु असे श्रीअनंतु। तया दोन्हीं सैन्याआंतु। जयापरी पार्थु। भ्रांती सांडी ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ vivarītu ase śrīanaṃtu| tayā donhīṃ sainyāāṃtu| jayāparī pārthu| bhrāṃtī sāṃḍī || 87||
verses.meaning: Thus, Lord Ananta (Vishnu) was explaining to Arjuna, who was standing between the two armies, how he could dispel his delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें कारण मनीं धरिलें। मग सरोष बोलों आदरिलें। जेसें मातेच्या कोपी थोकुलें। स्नेह आथी ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ kāraṇa manīṃ dharileṃ| maga saroṣa boloṃ ādarileṃ| jeseṃ mātecyā kopī thokuleṃ| sneha āthī || 88||
verses.meaning: He held that reason in His mind, and then began to speak with anger, just as a mother's anger holds affection.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं औषधाचिया कडुवटपणीं। जैसी अमृताची पुरवणी । ते आहाच न दिसे परी गुणीं। प्रकट होय ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ auṣadhāciyā kaḍuvaṭapaṇīṃ| jaisī amṛtācī puravaṇī | te āhāca na dise parī guṇīṃ| prakaṭa hoya || 89||
verses.meaning: Just as the bitterness of medicine, though not outwardly visible, reveals its अमृत (amrut) like qualities through its effects, so too does the divine manifest itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं वरिवरी पाहतां उदासें। आंत तरी अतिसुरसें। तियें वाक्यें हृषीकेशें। बोलों आदरिलीं॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ varivarī pāhatāṃ udāseṃ| āṃta tarī atisuraseṃ| tiyeṃ vākyeṃ hṛṣīkeśeṃ| boloṃ ādarilīṃ|| 90||
verses.meaning: Just as some things appear uninteresting on the surface but are exceedingly delightful within, so too did Hrishikesha begin to speak those words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अर्जूनातें म्हणितलें। आम्हीं आजि हें नवल देखिलें। जें तुवां एथ आदरिलें। माझारींचि॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga arjūnāteṃ mhaṇitaleṃ| āmhīṃ āji heṃ navala dekhileṃ| jeṃ tuvāṃ etha ādarileṃ| mājhārīṃci|| 91||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said, "Today I have witnessed a wonder, that you have begun this in the middle."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं जाणता तरी म्हणविसी । परी नेणिवेतें न संडिसी । आणि शिकवू म्हणों तरी बोलसी । बहुसाल नीति॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ jāṇatā tarī mhaṇavisī | parī neṇiveteṃ na saṃḍisī | āṇi śikavū mhaṇoṃ tarī bolasī | bahusāla nīti|| 92||
verses.meaning: Though you are called knowledgeable, you do not abandon ignorance. And if I say I will teach you, you speak much wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जात्यंधा लागे पिसें। मग तें सैरा धांवे जैसें । तुझें शहाणपण तैसें । दिसतसे॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jātyaṃdhā lāge piseṃ| maga teṃ sairā dhāṃve jaiseṃ | tujheṃ śahāṇapaṇa taiseṃ | disatase|| 93||
verses.meaning: Your wisdom appears like a blind person who, having gone mad, runs aimlessly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं आपणपें तरी नेणसी। परी या कौरवांतें शोचूं पहासी। हा बहु विस्मय आम्हांसी । पुढतपुढती ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ āpaṇapeṃ tarī neṇasī| parī yā kauravāṃteṃ śocūṃ pahāsī| hā bahu vismaya āmhāṃsī | puḍhatapuḍhatī || 94||
verses.meaning: You do not know your own true Self, yet you grieve for these Kauravas. This is a great wonder to us, again and again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सांग पां अर्जुना । तुजपासूनि स्थिति या त्रिभुवना। हे अनादि विश्वरचना। तें लटकें कायी ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sāṃga pāṃ arjunā | tujapāsūni sthiti yā tribhuvanā| he anādi viśvaracanā| teṃ laṭakeṃ kāyī || 95||
verses.meaning: Tell me, Arjuna, is it false that this creation of the three worlds, this beginningless universal structure, originates from you?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ समर्थ एक आथी । तयापासूनि भूतें होती । तरी हें बायांचि काय बोलती । जगामाजीं ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha samartha eka āthī | tayāpāsūni bhūteṃ hotī | tarī heṃ bāyāṃci kāya bolatī | jagāmājīṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: If there is one powerful entity from which all beings originate, then what is this meaningless talk that prevails in the world?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां सांप्रत ऐसें जाहलें। जे हे जन्ममृत्यु तुवां सृजिळे। आणि नाशु पावे नाशिलें। तुझेनि कायी ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ sāṃprata aiseṃ jāhaleṃ| je he janmamṛtyu tuvāṃ sṛjiḻe| āṇi nāśu pāve nāśileṃ| tujheni kāyī || 97||
verses.meaning: Is it so now, that You have created this cycle of birth and death, and that which is destroyed, is destroyed by You?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं भ्रमलेपणें अहंकृती । यांसि घातु न धरिसी चित्तीं। तरी सांगे कायि हे होती। चिरंतन ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ bhramalepaṇeṃ ahaṃkṛtī | yāṃsi ghātu na dharisī cittīṃ| tarī sāṃge kāyi he hotī| ciraṃtana || 98||
verses.meaning: If, due to your delusion, you do not hold the ego in your mind as an obstacle, then tell me, how will it ever cease to be eternal?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं तूं एक वबधिता। आणि सकळ लोकु हा मरता । ऐसी भ्रांति झणें चित्ता। येवो देसी॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ tūṃ eka vabadhitā| āṇi sakaḻa loku hā maratā | aisī bhrāṃti jhaṇeṃ cittā| yevo desī|| 99||
verses.meaning: Do not let your mind be deluded into thinking that you alone are the one who is bound, and all other people are free from this cycle of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनादिसिद्ध हें आघवें। होत जात स्वभावें। तरी तुवां कां शोचावें। सांगें मज॥ १००॥
verses.shloka_iast: anādisiddha heṃ āghaveṃ| hota jāta svabhāveṃ| tarī tuvāṃ kāṃ śocāveṃ| sāṃgeṃ maja|| 100||
verses.meaning: All this is eternally established, happening naturally. So why should you grieve, tell me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी मूर्खपणें नेणसी। न चिंतावें तें चिंतीसी। आणि तूंचि नीति सांगसी । आम्हांप्रति॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī mūrkhapaṇeṃ neṇasī| na ciṃtāveṃ teṃ ciṃtīsī| āṇi tūṃci nīti sāṃgasī | āmhāṃprati|| 9||
verses.meaning: But in your foolishness, you contemplate what should not be contemplated, and then you yourself preach morality to us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें विवेकी जे होती। ते दोहीतेंहीं न शोचिती। जे होय जाय हे भ्रांती । म्हणौनियां॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ vivekī je hotī| te dohīteṃhīṃ na śocitī| je hoya jāya he bhrāṃtī | mhaṇauniyāṃ|| 2||
verses.meaning: The wise, therefore, do not grieve for either, knowing that birth and death are but an illusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना सांगेन आइक । एथ आम्ही तुम्ही देख। आणि हे भूपति अशेख। आदिकरूनी ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā sāṃgena āika | etha āmhī tumhī dekha| āṇi he bhūpati aśekha| ādikarūnī || 3||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, listen, I will tell you. Here, you and I, and all these kings, are present from the very beginning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नित्यता ऐसेचि असोनी । ना तरी निश्‍चित क्षया जाउनी । हे भ्रांति वेगळी करूनी। दोन्ही नाहीं॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nityatā aiseci asonī | nā tarī niś‍cita kṣayā jāunī | he bhrāṃti vegaḻī karūnī| donhī nāhīṃ||4||
verses.meaning: Even if it is eternal, or if it is certainly perishable, setting aside both these illusions, neither of them truly exists.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें उपजे आणि नाशे] तें मायावशें दिसे। येऱ्हवीं तत्त्वता वस्तु जें असे। तें अविनाशचि ॥ ५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ upaje āṇi nāśe] teṃ māyāvaśeṃ dise| yeṟhavīṃ tattvatā vastu jeṃ ase| teṃ avināśaci || 5 ||
verses.meaning: That which appears to be born and to perish, is seen due to the influence of Maya. Otherwise, the true essence of reality is indeed imperishable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें पवनें तोय हालविलें। आणि तरंगाकार जाहळें। तरी कवण कें जन्मलें। म्हणों ये तेथ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ pavaneṃ toya hālavileṃ| āṇi taraṃgākāra jāhaḻeṃ| tarī kavaṇa keṃ janmaleṃ| mhaṇoṃ ye tetha|| 6||
verses.meaning: Just as water is stirred by the wind, and waves are formed, who can then say where one was born from the other?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि वायूचें स्फुरण ठेलें। आणि उदक सहज सपाट जाहलें) तरी आतां काय निमालें। विचारीं पां॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci vāyūceṃ sphuraṇa ṭheleṃ| āṇi udaka sahaja sapāṭa jāhaleṃ) tarī ātāṃ kāya nimāleṃ| vicārīṃ pāṃ|| 7||
verses.meaning: When the pulsation of the wind ceases, and the water naturally becomes still, then what has truly vanished? Reflect upon this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आडके शरीर तरी एक । परी बयसा भेद अनेक हें प्रत्यक्षच देख । प्रमाण तूं ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āḍake śarīra tarī eka | parī bayasā bheda aneka heṃ pratyakṣaca dekha | pramāṇa tūṃ || 8||
verses.meaning: Though the body is one, the differences in its states are many; this is directly evident, and you are the proof.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ कौमारत्व दिसे। मग तारुण्यीं तें भ्रंशे। परी देहचि न नाशे। एकेकासवें ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha kaumāratva dise| maga tāruṇyīṃ teṃ bhraṃśe| parī dehaci na nāśe| ekekāsaveṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Here, childhood is seen, then it perishes in youth; but the body itself does not perish with each passing stage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं चैतन्याच्या ठायीं । इयें शरीरांतरें होती जाती पाहीं। ऐसें जाणे तया नाहीं। व्यामोहदुःख॥ ११०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ caitanyācyā ṭhāyīṃ | iyeṃ śarīrāṃtareṃ hotī jātī pāhīṃ| aiseṃ jāṇe tayā nāhīṃ| vyāmohaduḥkha|| 110||
verses.meaning: Similarly, in the realm of pure Consciousness, these various bodies come and go. One who understands this does not experience the sorrow of delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ नेणावया हेंचि कारण। जें इंद्रियां आधीनपण। तिहीं आकळिजे अंत:करण । म्हणौनि भ्रमे ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha neṇāvayā heṃci kāraṇa| jeṃ iṃdriyāṃ ādhīnapaṇa| tihīṃ ākaḻije aṃta:karaṇa | mhaṇauni bhrame || 91||
verses.meaning: The reason for this ignorance is that the mind is under the control of the senses, and because the senses grasp the inner consciousness, it leads to delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियें विषय सेविती । तेथ हर्ष शोक उपजती। ते अंतर आप्लविती। संगें येणें॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyeṃ viṣaya sevitī | tetha harṣa śoka upajatī| te aṃtara āplavitī| saṃgeṃ yeṇeṃ|| 12||
verses.meaning: When the senses indulge in their objects, joy and sorrow arise, and these then flood the inner being through their association.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयां विषयांच्या ठायीं । एकनिष्ठता कहीं नाहीं। तेथ दुःख आणि कांहीं । सुखही दिसे॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃ viṣayāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ | ekaniṣṭhatā kahīṃ nāhīṃ| tetha duḥkha āṇi kāṃhīṃ | sukhahī dise|| 13||
verses.meaning: Where there is no steadfastness in worldly pleasures, there appears both sorrow and some semblance of happiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें शब्दाची व्याप्ति। निंदा आणि स्तुति । तेथ द्वेषाद्वेष उपजती । श्रवणद्वारें ॥ १४ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ śabdācī vyāpti| niṃdā āṇi stuti | tetha dveṣādveṣa upajatī | śravaṇadvāreṃ || 14 ||
verses.meaning: Behold the power of words! Through them, praise and blame arise, and through the ear, feelings of attraction and aversion are born.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मृदु आणि कठिण। हे स्पर्शाचे दोन्ही गुण। जे बपूचेनि संगें कारण । संतोषखेदां॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mṛdu āṇi kaṭhiṇa| he sparśāce donhī guṇa| je bapūceni saṃgeṃ kāraṇa | saṃtoṣakhedāṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: Softness and hardness, these two qualities of touch, which, due to their association with the body, cause joy and sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भ्यासुर आणि सुरेख। हें रूपांचें स्वरूप देख । जें उपजवबी सुखदुःख । नेत्रद्वारें॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhyāsura āṇi surekha| heṃ rūpāṃceṃ svarūpa dekha | jeṃ upajavabī sukhaduḥkha | netradvāreṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: Fearsome and beautiful, such is the nature of forms. They give rise to joy and sorrow through the eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुगंधु आणि दुर्गंधु। हा परिमळाचा भेदु। जो घ्राणसंगें विषादु। तोषु देता ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sugaṃdhu āṇi durgaṃdhu| hā parimaḻācā bhedu| jo ghrāṇasaṃgeṃ viṣādu| toṣu detā || 17||
verses.meaning: Fragrance and foul odor, these are the distinctions of smell. That which, through contact with the nose, causes distress or gives pleasure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसाचि द्विविध रसु। उपजवी प्रीतित्रासु। म्हणौनि हा अपभ्रंशु। विषयसंगु ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisāci dvividha rasu| upajavī prītitrāsu| mhaṇauni hā apabhraṃśu| viṣayasaṃgu || 18||
verses.meaning: Similarly, this dual taste gives rise to both love and fear. Therefore, this association with worldly objects is a perversion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें इंद्रियां आधीन होईजे । तैं शीतोष्णांतें पाविजे। आणि सुखदुःखीं आकळिजे। आपणपें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ iṃdriyāṃ ādhīna hoīje | taiṃ śītoṣṇāṃteṃ pāvije| āṇi sukhaduḥkhīṃ ākaḻije| āpaṇapeṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: When one becomes subservient to the senses, they experience heat and cold, and are then caught in the grip of pleasure and pain, losing their true self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या विषयांवांचूनि कांहीं। आणीक सर्वथा रम्य नाहीं। ऐसा स्वभावोचि पाहीं । इंद्रियांचा ॥ ९२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā viṣayāṃvāṃcūni kāṃhīṃ| āṇīka sarvathā ramya nāhīṃ| aisā svabhāvoci pāhīṃ | iṃdriyāṃcā || 920||
verses.meaning: Indeed, there is nothing else truly delightful apart from these sense objects. Such is the very nature of the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे विषय तरी कैसे। रोहिणीचें जळ जैसें । कां स्वप्नींचा आभासे। भद्रजाति॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: he viṣaya tarī kaise| rohiṇīceṃ jaḻa jaiseṃ | kāṃ svapnīṃcā ābhāse| bhadrajāti|| 21||
verses.meaning: These worldly pleasures are like the water in a mirage, or like the illusion of a precious gem seen in a dream.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें अनित्य तियापरी। म्हणौनि तूं अव्हेरीं। हा सर्वथा संगु न धरीं । धनुर्धरा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ anitya tiyāparī| mhaṇauni tūṃ avherīṃ| hā sarvathā saṃgu na dharīṃ | dhanurdharā|| 22||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Arjuna, abandon this attachment completely, for it is impermanent like that. Do not hold onto it at all, O Dhanurdhara (wielder of the bow).

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे विषय जयातें नाकळिती। तया सुखदुःखें दोनी न पवती। आणि गर्भवासुसंगती । नाहीं तया॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: he viṣaya jayāteṃ nākaḻitī| tayā sukhaduḥkheṃ donī na pavatī| āṇi garbhavāsusaṃgatī | nāhīṃ tayā|| 23||
verses.meaning: One who is untouched by worldly pleasures and pains, for them there is no experience of happiness or sorrow, nor do they undergo the cycle of birth and rebirth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो नित्यरूप पार्था । वोळखावा सर्वथा । जो या इंद्रियार्था। नागवेचि॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to nityarūpa pārthā | voḻakhāvā sarvathā | jo yā iṃdriyārthā| nāgaveci|| 24||
verses.meaning: O Partha, know that which is eternal and never deceived by the objects of the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां अर्जुना आणिक कांहीं एक । सांगेन मी आइक । जें विचारपर 'लोक। बोळखिती॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ arjunā āṇika kāṃhīṃ eka | sāṃgena mī āika | jeṃ vicārapara 'loka| boḻakhitī|| 25||
verses.meaning: Now, Arjuna, I will tell you something else, listen to me. It is that which discerning people recognize.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या उपाधिमाजीं गुप्त। चैतन्य असे सर्वगत। तें तत्त्वज्ञ संत। स्वीकारिती ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā upādhimājīṃ gupta| caitanya ase sarvagata| teṃ tattvajña saṃta| svīkāritī || 26||
verses.meaning: Within these limitations, the all-pervading consciousness remains hidden. That is the truth which the wise saints accept.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सलिलीं पय जैसें। एक होऊनि मीनलें असे । परी निवडूनि राजहंसें। वेगळें कीजे ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: salilīṃ paya jaiseṃ| eka hoūni mīnaleṃ ase | parī nivaḍūni rājahaṃseṃ| vegaḻeṃ kīje || 27||
verses.meaning: Just as water and milk, once mixed, appear as one, yet a royal swan can separate them, so too is the distinction made.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं अग्निमुखें किडाळ। तोडोनियां चोखाळ । निवडिती केवळ । बुन्दिमंत ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ agnimukheṃ kiḍāḻa| toḍoniyāṃ cokhāḻa | nivaḍitī kevaḻa | bundimaṃta || 28||
verses.meaning: Just as gold, purified by fire, is separated from its dross by the wise, so too are the truly intelligent able to discern the essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी जाणिवेच्या आयणी | करितां दधिकडसणी। मग नवनीत निर्वाणीं। दिसे जैसें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī jāṇivecyā āyaṇī | karitāṃ dadhikaḍasaṇī| maga navanīta nirvāṇīṃ| dise jaiseṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Or, just as by churning the curds of knowledge, the butter of ultimate truth eventually becomes visible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कौं भूस बीज एकवट । उपणितां राहे घनवट । तेथ उडे तें फळकट । जाणों आलें॥ १३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kauṃ bhūsa bīja ekavaṭa | upaṇitāṃ rāhe ghanavaṭa | tetha uḍe teṃ phaḻakaṭa | jāṇoṃ āleṃ|| 130||
verses.meaning: When chaff and grain are winnowed together, the solid grain remains, and what flies away is known to be the worthless husk.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें विचारितां निरसलें। तें प्रपंचु सहजें सांडवलें। मग तत्त्वता तत्त्व उरलें। ज्ञानियांसि॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ vicāritāṃ nirasaleṃ| teṃ prapaṃcu sahajeṃ sāṃḍavaleṃ| maga tattvatā tattva uraleṃ| jñāniyāṃsi|| 31||
verses.meaning: When one contemplates thus, the worldly illusion naturally dissipates. Then, for the wise, only the true essence remains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अनित्याच्या ठायीं । तयां आस्तिक्यबुद्धि नाहीं। निष्कर्षु दोहींही । देखिला असे॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni anityācyā ṭhāyīṃ | tayāṃ āstikyabuddhi nāhīṃ| niṣkarṣu dohīṃhī | dekhilā ase|| 32||
verses.meaning: Therefore, they do not have faith in the impermanent. They have seen the conclusion of both (the permanent and the impermanent).

verses.shloka_devanagari: शड श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी देखें सारासार विचारितां। भ्रांति ते पाहीं असारता। तरी सार तें स्वभावता। नित्य जाणें ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: śaḍa śrījñāneśvarī dekheṃ sārāsāra vicāritāṃ| bhrāṃti te pāhīṃ asāratā| tarī sāra teṃ svabhāvatā| nitya jāṇeṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Thus, in the Dnyaneshwari, upon discerning the essence from the non-essence, one realizes that illusion is indeed the non-essential. Therefore, the essential is naturally to be known as eternal.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा लोकत्रयाकारु। तो जयाचा विस्तारु । तेथ नाम वर्ण आकारु । चिन्ह नाहीं ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā lokatrayākāru| to jayācā vistāru | tetha nāma varṇa ākāru | cinha nāhīṃ || 34||
verses.meaning: The creator of the three worlds, whose manifestation is this entire universe, has no name, no form, and no distinguishing mark.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो सर्वदा सर्वगतु। जन्मक्षयातीतु । तया केलियाहि घातु। कदा नोहे॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo sarvadā sarvagatu| janmakṣayātītu | tayā keliyāhi ghātu| kadā nohe|| 35||
verses.meaning: That which is eternal, all-pervading, and beyond birth and destruction, can never be harmed, even if one attempts to destroy it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि शरीरजात आघवें। हें नाशिवंत स्वभावें । म्हणौनि तुवां झुंजावें। पंडुकुमरा॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi śarīrajāta āghaveṃ| heṃ nāśivaṃta svabhāveṃ | mhaṇauni tuvāṃ jhuṃjāveṃ| paṃḍukumarā|| 36||
verses.meaning: And this entire body, by its very nature, is perishable. Therefore, O son of Pandu, you must fight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं धरूनि देहाभिमानातें। दिठी सूनि शरीरातें। मी मारिता हे मरते। म्हणतु आहासी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ dharūni dehābhimānāteṃ| diṭhī sūni śarīrāteṃ| mī māritā he marate| mhaṇatu āhāsī || 37||
verses.meaning: You, holding onto the ego of the body, fixing your gaze upon the body, say, "I kill them, and they die."
