verses.shloka_iast: pārthā āṇīkahī parī| to jāṇoṃ yeīla avadhārīṃ| jaisī akṣobhatā sāgarīṃ| akhaṃḍita || 57||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, in another way, He can be known, just as the ocean remains undisturbed and unbroken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जऱ्ही सरितावोघध समस्त। परिपूर्ण होऊनि मिळत। तरी अधिक नोहे ईषत्‌। मर्यादा न संडी ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṟhī saritāvoghadha samasta| paripūrṇa hoūni miḻata| tarī adhika nohe īṣat‌| maryādā na saṃḍī || 58||
verses.meaning: Just as all rivers, though flowing, meet the ocean and become full, yet the ocean does not increase even slightly, nor does it transgress its bounds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी ग्रीष्मकाळीं सरिता । शोषूनि जाती समस्ता । परी न्यून नव्हे पार्था । समुद्र जैसा ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī grīṣmakāḻīṃ saritā | śoṣūni jātī samastā | parī nyūna navhe pārthā | samudra jaisā || 59||
verses.meaning: Just as rivers dry up completely in summer, yet the ocean does not diminish, so too, the true self remains undiminished by worldly changes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा प्राप्तीं क्रव्द्विसिद्धी । तयासि क्षोभु नाहीं बुद्धि) आणि न पवतां न बाधी । अधृति तयातें ॥ ३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā prāptīṃ kravdvisiddhī | tayāsi kṣobhu nāhīṃ buddhi) āṇi na pavatāṃ na bādhī | adhṛti tayāteṃ || 360||
verses.meaning: Just as one who has attained spiritual perfection is not disturbed by the attainment of worldly powers, so too, if they are not attained, impatience does not afflict them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगैं सूर्याच्या घरीं । प्रकाशु काय वातीवेरी । कां न लविजे तरी अंधारीं। कोंडेल तो॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgaiṃ sūryācyā gharīṃ | prakāśu kāya vātīverī | kāṃ na lavije tarī aṃdhārīṃ| koṃḍela to|| 61||
verses.meaning: Tell me, in the house of the sun, is light dependent on a lamp? Or would it be plunged into darkness if a lamp were not lit?

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें क्रन्द्रिसित्ि तयापरी । आली गेली से न करी। तो विगुंतला असे अंतरीं । महासुखीं ॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ krandrisiti tayāparī | ālī gelī se na karī| to viguṃtalā ase aṃtarīṃ | mahāsukhīṃ ||62||
verses.meaning: Behold, just as the sun's rays neither come nor go, so too is the one who is absorbed within, in supreme bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो आपुलेनि नागरपणें। इंद्रभुवनातें पाबळें म्हणे। तो केवीं रंजे पालिवणें । भिल्लांचेनि॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo āpuleni nāgarapaṇeṃ| iṃdrabhuvanāteṃ pābaḻeṃ mhaṇe| to kevīṃ raṃje pālivaṇeṃ | bhillāṃceni|| 63||
verses.meaning: One who, by their own cleverness, considers Indra's abode to be insignificant, how could they find joy in the rustic upbringing of tribals?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो अमृतासि ठी ठेवी। तो जैसा कांजी न सेवी । तैसा स्वसुखानुभवी। न भोगी क्रब्द्ि॥६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo amṛtāsi ṭhī ṭhevī| to jaisā kāṃjī na sevī | taisā svasukhānubhavī| na bhogī krabdi||64||
verses.meaning: Just as one who has access to ambrosia would not partake of sour gruel, so too, one who experiences the bliss of the Self does not seek worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्था नवल हें पाहीं। जेथ स्वर्गसुख ळेखनीय नाहीं । तेथ क्रन्छ्विसिव्यि कायी। प्राकृता होती ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārthā navala heṃ pāhīṃ| jetha svargasukha ḻekhanīya nāhīṃ | tetha kranchvisivyi kāyī| prākṛtā hotī || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, behold this wonder: where the joy of heaven is deemed insignificant, how can the suffering of ordinary worldly life even compare?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा आत्मबोधें तोषला । जो परमानंदें पोखला। तोचि स्थिरप्रजु भला । बोळख तूं॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā ātmabodheṃ toṣalā | jo paramānaṃdeṃ pokhalā| toci sthirapraju bhalā | boḻakha tūṃ|| 66||
verses.meaning: He who is thus content with self-realization, nourished by supreme bliss, is indeed the truly stable and wise one; know him to be so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अहंकारातें दंडुनी। सकळ कामु सांडोनी । विचरे विश्व होऊनि । विश्‍वामाजीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to ahaṃkārāteṃ daṃḍunī| sakaḻa kāmu sāṃḍonī | vicare viśva hoūni | viś‍vāmājīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Having subdued ego and abandoned all desires, he moves through the world, having become the world itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे ब्रह्मस्थिति निःसीम। जे अनुभवितां निष्काम। ते पावले परब्रह्म । अनायासे ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: he brahmasthiti niḥsīma| je anubhavitāṃ niṣkāma| te pāvale parabrahma | anāyāse || 68||
verses.meaning: This state of Brahman, which is boundless, when experienced without desire, easily leads one to the Supreme Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे चिद्रूपी मिळतां। देहांतीचि व्याकुळता। आड ठाकों न सके चित्ता। प्राज्ञा जया॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je cidrūpī miḻatāṃ| dehāṃtīci vyākuḻatā| āḍa ṭhākoṃ na sake cittā| prājñā jayā|| 69||
verses.meaning: When the intellect, which is the form of pure consciousness, merges, the distress of the body at the time of death cannot obstruct the mind of the wise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेचि हे स्थिति। स्वमुखें श्रीपति। सांगत अर्जुनाप्रति। संजयो म्हणे ॥ ३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teci he sthiti| svamukheṃ śrīpati| sāṃgata arjunāprati| saṃjayo mhaṇe || 370||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said: "This very state, the Lord of Wealth himself, is narrating to Arjuna."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें कृष्णवाक्य ऐकिलें। तेथ अर्जूनें मनीं म्हणितळें। आतां आमुचियाचि काजा कौर आलें। उपपत्ति इया ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ kṛṣṇavākya aikileṃ| tetha arjūneṃ manīṃ mhaṇitaḻeṃ| ātāṃ āmuciyāci kājā kaura āleṃ| upapatti iyā || 71||
verses.meaning: When Arjuna heard these words of Krishna, he thought to himself, "Now, for our own sake, this explanation has come."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें कर्मजात आघवें। एथ निराकारिलें देवें। तरी पारुषलें म्यां झुंजावें। म्हणौनियां ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ karmajāta āghaveṃ| etha nirākārileṃ deveṃ| tarī pāruṣaleṃ myāṃ jhuṃjāveṃ| mhaṇauniyāṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: Since all actions have been nullified by the Divine here, I must therefore fight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा श्रीअच्युताचिया बोला । चित्तीं धनुर्धर उबायिला । आतां प्रश्‍नु करील भला। आशंकोनि॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā śrīacyutāciyā bolā | cittīṃ dhanurdhara ubāyilā | ātāṃ praś‍nu karīla bhalā| āśaṃkoni|| 73||
verses.meaning: Upon hearing the words of Shri Achyuta, Arjuna's mind was stirred, and he prepared to ask a profound question, filled with apprehension.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो प्रसंगु असे नागरु। जो सकळ धर्मासि आगरु । कीं विवेकामृतसागरु । प्रांतहीनु॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to prasaṃgu ase nāgaru| jo sakaḻa dharmāsi āgaru | kīṃ vivekāmṛtasāgaru | prāṃtahīnu|| 74||
verses.meaning: That occasion is like a wise and discerning person, who is the very source of all righteousness, or like an endless ocean of the nectar of wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो आपण सर्वज्ञनाथु। निरूपिता होईल श्रीअनंतु। ज्ञानदेवो सांगेळ मातु । निवृत्तिदासु ॥ ३७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo āpaṇa sarvajñanāthu| nirūpitā hoīla śrīanaṃtu| jñānadevo sāṃgeḻa mātu | nivṛttidāsu || 375 ||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev, the servant of Nivrutti, says that the Lord, the all-knowing Ananta, will be revealed through this discourse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आइका अर्जुनें म्हणितलें। देवा तुम्ही जें वाक्य बोलिलें। तें निकें म्यां परिसिळें। कमळापती॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āikā arjuneṃ mhaṇitaleṃ| devā tumhī jeṃ vākya bolileṃ| teṃ nikeṃ myāṃ parisiḻeṃ| kamaḻāpatī|| 1||
verses.meaning: Then listen, Arjuna said, "O Lord, the words you spoke, I have heard them well, O Lord of Kamala (Vishnu)."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ कर्म आणि कर्ता । उरेचिना पाहतां। ऐसें मत तुझें श्रीअनंता। निश्‍चित जरी॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha karma āṇi kartā | urecinā pāhatāṃ| aiseṃ mata tujheṃ śrīanaṃtā| niś‍cita jarī|| 2||
verses.meaning: If, O Ananta, this is your firm conviction, that upon reflection, neither action nor the doer remains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मातें केवीं श्रीहरी । म्हणसी पार्था संग्रामु करीं । इये लाजसीना महाघोरीं। कर्मी सुतां॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī māteṃ kevīṃ śrīharī | mhaṇasī pārthā saṃgrāmu karīṃ | iye lājasīnā mahāghorīṃ| karmī sutāṃ|| 3||
verses.meaning: Then, O Partha, you might say, "How can I, Shri Hari, engage in this extremely dreadful act of war, and not be ashamed of it?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा कर्म तूंचि अशेष। निराकरिसी निःऐेष। तरी मजकरवीं हें हिंसक । कां करविसी ॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā karma tūṃci aśeṣa| nirākarisī niḥaieṣa| tarī majakaravīṃ heṃ hiṃsaka | kāṃ karavisī ||4||
verses.meaning: O Lord, You alone are the destroyer of all karma, annihilating it completely. Then why do You make me, who is inherently non-violent, perform this act of violence?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी हेंचि विचारीं हृषीकेशा । तूं मानु देसी कर्मलेशां। आणि येसणी हे हिंसा। करवीतु आहासी ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī heṃci vicārīṃ hṛṣīkeśā | tūṃ mānu desī karmaleśāṃ| āṇi yesaṇī he hiṃsā| karavītu āhāsī || 5||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Hrishikesha, consider this: You give importance to even a small part of karma, yet you are making me commit such violence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा तुवांचि ऐसें बोलावें । तरी आम्हीं नेणतीं काय करावें । आतां संपलें म्हण पां आघवें। विवेकाचें ॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā tuvāṃci aiseṃ bolāveṃ | tarī āmhīṃ neṇatīṃ kāya karāveṃ | ātāṃ saṃpaleṃ mhaṇa pāṃ āghaveṃ| vivekāceṃ ||6||
verses.meaning: O Lord, if You Yourself speak in such a way, then what should we ignorant ones do? Now, it seems, all discourse on discrimination has come to an end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा उपदेश जरी ऐसा । तरी अपभ्रंशु तो कैसा। आतां पुरला आम्हां धिंवसा। आत्मबोधाचा॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā upadeśa jarī aisā | tarī apabhraṃśu to kaisā| ātāṃ puralā āmhāṃ dhiṃvasā| ātmabodhācā|| 7||
verses.meaning: Even if the teaching is such, how can there be any distortion? Now our longing for self-realization is fulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वैद्यु पथ्य वारूनि जाये। मग जरी आपणचि विष सुये। तरी रोगिया कैसेनि जिये । सांगे मज॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vaidyu pathya vārūni jāye| maga jarī āpaṇaci viṣa suye| tarī rogiyā kaiseni jiye | sāṃge maja|| 8||
verses.meaning: If a patient disregards the doctor's advice and consumes poison himself, how can he survive? Tell me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें आंधळें सुइजे आव्हांटा। कां माजवण दीजे मर्कटा। तैसा उपदेशु हा गोमटा। बोढवला आम्हां॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ āṃdhaḻeṃ suije āvhāṃṭā| kāṃ mājavaṇa dīje markaṭā| taisā upadeśu hā gomaṭā| boḍhavalā āmhāṃ||9||
verses.meaning: Just as a blind person is given a needle to thread, or a monkey is given intoxicating liquor, so this excellent teaching has been given to us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी आधींचि कांहीं नेणें । बरी कवळिलों मोहें येणें । श्रीकृष्णा विवेकु याकारणें । पुसिला तुज॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī ādhīṃci kāṃhīṃ neṇeṃ | barī kavaḻiloṃ moheṃ yeṇeṃ | śrīkṛṣṇā viveku yākāraṇeṃ | pusilā tuja|| 10||
verses.meaning: I knew nothing before, but now I am completely enveloped by this delusion. Therefore, O Shri Krishna, I asked You for discrimination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव तुझी एकेक नवाई । एथ उपदेशामाजीं गोवाई । तरी अनुसरलळिया काई । ऐसें कीजे॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva tujhī ekeka navāī | etha upadeśāmājīṃ govāī | tarī anusaralaḻiyā kāī | aiseṃ kīje|| 19||
verses.meaning: Then, each of your wonders, if hidden within this teaching, what would be gained by following it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं तनुमनुजीवें। तुझिया बोला वोटंगावें। आणि तुवांचि ऐसें करावें। तरी सरलें म्हण॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ tanumanujīveṃ| tujhiyā bolā voṭaṃgāveṃ| āṇi tuvāṃci aiseṃ karāveṃ| tarī saraleṃ mhaṇa|| 12||
verses.meaning: We should dedicate our body, mind, and life to your words. And if you yourself make it so, then alone will it be truly accomplished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां ऐसियापरी बोधिसी । तरी निकें आम्हां करिसी । एथ ज्ञानाची आस कायसी । अर्जुन म्हणे ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ aisiyāparī bodhisī | tarī nikeṃ āmhāṃ karisī | etha jñānācī āsa kāyasī | arjuna mhaṇe || 13||
verses.meaning: Arjuna said, "If you teach me in this manner, you will do me great good. What need is there for any other knowledge here?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: ष्र श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तरी ये जाणिवेचें तरी सरळें। परी आणीक एक असे जाहलें। जें थितें हें डहुळलें। मानस माझें ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ṣra śrījñāneśvarī tarī ye jāṇiveceṃ tarī saraḻeṃ| parī āṇīka eka ase jāhaleṃ| jeṃ thiteṃ heṃ ḍahuḻaleṃ| mānasa mājheṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: This Dnyaneshwari, though a straightforward path to knowledge, has also stirred my settled mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि श्रीकृष्णा हें तुझें। चरित्र कांहीं नेणिजे। जरी चित्त पाहसी माझें। येणें मिषें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci śrīkṛṣṇā heṃ tujheṃ| caritra kāṃhīṃ neṇije| jarī citta pāhasī mājheṃ| yeṇeṃ miṣeṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: O Shri Krishna, your divine play is indeed unfathomable. Yet, if you look into my heart, you will find that I have understood it through this very discourse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी झकवीतु आहासी मातें। कौं तत्त्वचि कथिलें ध्वनितें। हें अवगमितां निरुतें। जाणवेना॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī jhakavītu āhāsī māteṃ| kauṃ tattvaci kathileṃ dhvaniteṃ| heṃ avagamitāṃ niruteṃ| jāṇavenā|| 16||
verses.meaning: Or are you deceiving me? Or have you truly revealed the essence through suggestion? As I ponder this, I cannot discern the truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आइकें देवा। हा भावार्थ आतां न बोळावा। मज विवेकु सांगावा। मऱ्हाटा जी॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āikeṃ devā| hā bhāvārtha ātāṃ na boḻāvā| maja viveku sāṃgāvā| maṟhāṭā jī|| 17||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen, O Lord, this spiritual essence should not be lost now. Please explain this wisdom to me in Marathi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी अत्यंत जड असें। परी ऐसाही निकें परियेसें। श्रीकृष्णा बोलावें तुवां तैसें । एकनिष्ठ ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī atyaṃta jaḍa aseṃ| parī aisāhī nikeṃ pariyeseṃ| śrīkṛṣṇā bolāveṃ tuvāṃ taiseṃ | ekaniṣṭha || 18||
verses.meaning: I am very dull-witted, yet listen carefully to this: You should speak to Shri Krishna with such unwavering devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें रोगातें जिणावें। औषध तरी देयावें।॥ परी तें अतिरुच्य व्हावें। मधुर जैसें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ rogāteṃ jiṇāveṃ| auṣadha tarī deyāveṃ||| parī teṃ atirucya vhāveṃ| madhura jaiseṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: Behold, to conquer illness, medicine must be given. But that medicine should be very palatable, like something sweet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सकळार्थभरित । तत्त्व सांगावें उचित । परी बोधें माझें चित्त । जयापरी ॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sakaḻārthabharita | tattva sāṃgāveṃ ucita | parī bodheṃ mājheṃ citta | jayāparī || 20||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the principle should be explained appropriately, filled with all meaning, but in a way that enlightens my mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा तुजऐसा निजगुरु । आजि आर्तीधणी कां न करूं। एथ भीड कवणाची धरूं। तूं माय आमुची ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā tujaaisā nijaguru | āji ārtīdhaṇī kāṃ na karūṃ| etha bhīḍa kavaṇācī dharūṃ| tūṃ māya āmucī || 29||
verses.meaning: O Lord, when I have a true Guru like You, why should I not express my heartfelt longing today? Whose hesitation should I hold onto here? You are our Mother.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा कामधेनूचें दुभतें। दैवें जाहलें जरी आपेतें। तरी कामनेची कां तेथें। वानी कीजे॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā kāmadhenūceṃ dubhateṃ| daiveṃ jāhaleṃ jarī āpeteṃ| tarī kāmanecī kāṃ tetheṃ| vānī kīje|| 22||
verses.meaning: If, by good fortune, one has obtained the milk of the wish-fulfilling cow (Kamadhenu), then why should one still speak of desires?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी चिंतामणी हातां चढे। तरी वांछेचें कवण सांकडें। कां आपुलेनि सुरवाडे । इच्छावें ना।॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī ciṃtāmaṇī hātāṃ caḍhe| tarī vāṃcheceṃ kavaṇa sāṃkaḍeṃ| kāṃ āpuleni suravāḍe | icchāveṃ nā||| 23||
verses.meaning: If one obtains the Chintamani, then what difficulty is there in fulfilling desires? Or why should one not wish for one's own happiness?

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखा अमृतसिंधूतें ठाकावें। मग ताहानाचि जरी फुटावें। तरी सायासु कां करावे। मागील ते॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhā amṛtasiṃdhūteṃ ṭhākāveṃ| maga tāhānāci jarī phuṭāveṃ| tarī sāyāsu kāṃ karāve| māgīla te|| 24||
verses.meaning: Behold, if one were to stand in the ocean of nectar, and yet still die of thirst, then why undertake the previous efforts?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा जन्मांतरी बहुतीं। उपासितां श्रीलक््मीपती। तूं दैवे आजि हातीं । जाहलासी जरी ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā janmāṃtarī bahutīṃ| upāsitāṃ śrīlakmīpatī| tūṃ daive āji hātīṃ | jāhalāsī jarī || 25||
verses.meaning: Just as after many lifetimes of devotion to Lord Vishnu, you have, by divine grace, come into my hands today.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आपुलिया सवेशा। कां न मागावासि परेशा। देवा सुकाळु हा मानसा। पाहलळा असे॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī āpuliyā saveśā| kāṃ na māgāvāsi pareśā| devā sukāḻu hā mānasā| pāhalaḻā ase|| 26||
verses.meaning: Then why do you not ask the Lord, in your own form, for this abundance that is available to humanity?

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें सकळार्तींचें जियाळे। आजि पुण्य यशासि आलें। हे मनोरथ जहाळे। विजयी माझे॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ sakaḻārtīṃceṃ jiyāḻe| āji puṇya yaśāsi āleṃ| he manoratha jahāḻe| vijayī mājhe|| 27||
verses.meaning: Behold, the very source of all auspiciousness has today brought merit to fruition. All my aspirations have become victorious.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी जी परममंगळधामा। सकळ देवदेवोत्तमा। तूं स्वाधीन आजि आम्हां । म्हणौनियां ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī jī paramamaṃgaḻadhāmā| sakaḻa devadevottamā| tūṃ svādhīna āji āmhāṃ | mhaṇauniyāṃ || 28||
verses.meaning: O abode of supreme auspiciousness, O best of all gods, today You are at our command, and so we pray.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें मातेच्या ठायीं । अपत्या अनवसरू नाहीं। स्तन्यालागूनि पाहीं। जियापरी॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ mātecyā ṭhāyīṃ | apatyā anavasarū nāhīṃ| stanyālāgūni pāhīṃ| jiyāparī|| 29||
verses.meaning: Just as a child is never untimely for its mother, so too is it for the breast milk.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें देवा तूतें। पुसिजतसे आवडे तें। आपुलेनि आते । कृपानिधी ॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ devā tūteṃ| pusijatase āvaḍe teṃ| āpuleni āte | kṛpānidhī || 30||
verses.meaning: O Lord, I ask of You what I desire, with my own earnestness, O ocean of compassion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पारत्रिकीं हित। आणि आचरितां तरी उचित। तें सांगे एक निश्‍चित। पार्थ म्हणे॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pāratrikīṃ hita| āṇi ācaritāṃ tarī ucita| teṃ sāṃge eka niś‍cita| pārtha mhaṇe|| 31||
verses.meaning: Arjuna said, "Therefore, tell me for certain that which is beneficial for the afterlife and proper to practice."

verses.shloka_devanagari: या बोला श्रीअच्युतु। म्हणतसे विस्मितु) अर्जुना हा ध्वनितु। अभिप्राबो॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā bolā śrīacyutu| mhaṇatase vismitu) arjunā hā dhvanitu| abhiprābo|| 32||
verses.meaning: Upon hearing these words, Lord Achyuta, filled with wonder, said, "Arjuna, this is the essence of the profound truth."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे बुद्धियोगु सांगतां । सांख्यमतसंस्था । प्रकटिली स्वभावता । प्रसंगें आम्हीं ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je buddhiyogu sāṃgatāṃ | sāṃkhyamatasaṃsthā | prakaṭilī svabhāvatā | prasaṃgeṃ āmhīṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: While explaining the Yoga of Wisdom, I naturally revealed the principles of Samkhya philosophy as the occasion arose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो उद्देशु तूं नेणसीचि । म्हणौनि क्षोभलासि वायांचि। तरी आतां जाणें म्यांचि। उक्त दोन्ही ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to uddeśu tūṃ neṇasīci | mhaṇauni kṣobhalāsi vāyāṃci| tarī ātāṃ jāṇeṃ myāṃci| ukta donhī || 34||
verses.meaning: You do not know that purpose, and therefore you are needlessly agitated. Now, know that both these things have been spoken by Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवधारीं वीरश्रेष्ठा । ये लोकीं या दोन्ही निष्ठा । मजचिपासूनि प्रगटा । अनादिसिद्धा ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: avadhārīṃ vīraśreṣṭhā | ye lokīṃ yā donhī niṣṭhā | majacipāsūni pragaṭā | anādisiddhā || 35||
verses.meaning: Listen, O best among warriors, these two paths in this world have originated from Me, eternally established.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकु ज्ञानयोगु म्हणिजे। जो सांख्यीं अनुष्ठिजे। जेथ बोळखीसबें पाविजे । तद्रूपता ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eku jñānayogu mhaṇije| jo sāṃkhyīṃ anuṣṭhije| jetha boḻakhīsabeṃ pāvije | tadrūpatā || 36||
verses.meaning: One is the path of knowledge, which is practiced by the followers of Samkhya philosophy, through which one attains identity with the Supreme Reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकु कर्मयोगु जाण। जेथ साधकजन निपुण । होऊनियां निर्वाण । पावती वेळे॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: eku karmayogu jāṇa| jetha sādhakajana nipuṇa | hoūniyāṃ nirvāṇa | pāvatī veḻe|| 37||
verses.meaning: This is known as Karma Yoga, where practitioners, becoming adept, attain liberation in due course.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे मार्गु तरी दोनी। परी एकवटतीं निदानीं। जैसी सिद्धसाध्य भोजनीं । तृप्ती एक ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: he mārgu tarī donī| parī ekavaṭatīṃ nidānīṃ| jaisī siddhasādhya bhojanīṃ | tṛptī eka || 38||
verses.meaning: Though there are two paths, they ultimately converge into one, just as both a prepared meal and a meal obtained through effort lead to the same satisfaction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां पूर्वापर सरितां। भिन्न दिसती पाहतां । मग सिंधुमिळणीं ऐक्यता। पावती शेखीं ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ pūrvāpara saritāṃ| bhinna disatī pāhatāṃ | maga siṃdhumiḻaṇīṃ aikyatā| pāvatī śekhīṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Just as rivers, though appearing distinct at first glance, ultimately achieve unity upon merging with the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं दोनीही मतें। सूचितीं एका कारणातें। परी उपास्ति ते योग्यते-। आधीन असे॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ donīhī mateṃ| sūcitīṃ ekā kāraṇāteṃ| parī upāsti te yogyate-| ādhīna ase|| 40||
verses.meaning: Similarly, both these views point to the same cause, but devotion is dependent on one's qualification.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें उत्प्लबनासरिसा। पक्षी फळासि झोंबे जेसा। सांगे नरु केवीं तेसा। पावे वेगा॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ utplabanāsarisā| pakṣī phaḻāsi jhoṃbe jesā| sāṃge naru kevīṃ tesā| pāve vegā|| 41||
verses.meaning: Just as a bird swiftly snatches a fruit, so too does a person quickly attain their desired goal.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो हळूहळू ढाळेंढाळें। केउतेनि एके वेळे। तया मार्गाचेनि बळें।॥ निश्‍चित ठाकी॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to haḻūhaḻū ḍhāḻeṃḍhāḻeṃ| keuteni eke veḻe| tayā mārgāceni baḻeṃ||| niś‍cita ṭhākī|| 42||
verses.meaning: Then, gradually, step by step, by the strength of that path, at some point, one will surely reach the destination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें देख पां विहंगममतें । अधिष्ठूनि ज्ञानातें । सांख्य सद्य मोक्षातें। आकळिती॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ dekha pāṃ vihaṃgamamateṃ | adhiṣṭhūni jñānāteṃ | sāṃkhya sadya mokṣāteṃ| ākaḻitī|| 43||
verses.meaning: Just as a bird, by its very nature, swiftly reaches its destination, so too do the followers of Samkhya philosophy, by firmly grasping knowledge, attain liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर योगिये कर्माधारें। बिहितेंचि निजाचारें। पूर्णता अवसरें। पावतें होती ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera yogiye karmādhāreṃ| bihiteṃci nijācāreṃ| pūrṇatā avasareṃ| pāvateṃ hotī || 44||
verses.meaning: Other yogis, through the support of their actions and their prescribed duties, attain perfection in due course.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचोनि कर्मारंभ उचित। न करितांचि सिद्धवत। कर्महीना निश्‍चित । होईजेना ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃconi karmāraṃbha ucita| na karitāṃci siddhavata| karmahīnā niś‍cita | hoījenā || 45 ||
verses.meaning: Without undertaking appropriate actions, one cannot attain the state of being free from action, nor can one achieve perfection without performing deeds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां प्राप्तकर्म सांडिजे। येतुलेनि नेष्कर्म्य होईजे । हें अर्जुना वायां बोलिजे । मूर्खपणें ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ prāptakarma sāṃḍije| yetuleni neṣkarmya hoīje | heṃ arjunā vāyāṃ bolije | mūrkhapaṇeṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: Or, if one abandons prescribed actions, does that lead to a state of actionlessness? Arjuna, such talk is in vain, born of foolishness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगैं पैलतीरा जावें । ऐसें व्यसन कां जेथ पावे। तेथ नावेतें त्यजावें। घडे केवीं ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgaiṃ pailatīrā jāveṃ | aiseṃ vyasana kāṃ jetha pāve| tetha nāveteṃ tyajāveṃ| ghaḍe kevīṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: How can one abandon the boat when the desire to reach the other shore is so strong?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी तृप्ति इच्छिजे। तरी कैसेनि पाकु न कीजे। कीं सिद्धुही न सेविजे। केवीं सांगैं ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī tṛpti icchije| tarī kaiseni pāku na kīje| kīṃ siddhuhī na sevije| kevīṃ sāṃgaiṃ || 48 ||
verses.meaning: If one desires satisfaction, how can one not cook? Or how can one not partake of what is prepared? Tell me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंब निरार्तता नाहीं। तंब व्यापारु असे पाहीं। मग संतुष्टीच्या ठायीं । कुंठें सहजें ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃba nirārtatā nāhīṃ| taṃba vyāpāru ase pāhīṃ| maga saṃtuṣṭīcyā ṭhāyīṃ | kuṃṭheṃ sahajeṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: As long as there is no complete cessation of desire, so long does activity persist. Then, in the state of contentment, it naturally ceases.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आईइकें पार्था) जया नेष्कर्म्यपपदीं आस्था। तया उचित कर्म सर्वथा । त्याज्य नोहे ॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āīikeṃ pārthā) jayā neṣkarmyapapadīṃ āsthā| tayā ucita karma sarvathā | tyājya nohe || 50||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen, Arjuna, for those who aspire to the state of actionlessness (Nishkarmya), performing their prescribed duties is never to be abandoned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आपुलिये चाडे । आपादिलें हें मांडे । कीं त्यजिलें कर्म सांडे । ऐसें आहे ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi āpuliye cāḍe | āpādileṃ heṃ māṃḍe | kīṃ tyajileṃ karma sāṃḍe | aiseṃ āhe || 59||
verses.meaning: And if one desires it, this is what is established: that actions, once renounced, cease to exist.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें वायांचि सैरा बोलिजे । उकलु तरी देखोनि पाहिजे । परी त्यजितां कर्म न त्यजे । निभ्रांत मानीं ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ vāyāṃci sairā bolije | ukalu tarī dekhoni pāhije | parī tyajitāṃ karma na tyaje | nibhrāṃta mānīṃ || 52||
verses.meaning: This is spoken in vain, without proper understanding. One should examine it carefully. But even if one tries to abandon karma, it cannot be abandoned; consider this as an absolute truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंब प्रकृतीचे अधिष्ठान। तंव सांडी मांडी हें अज्ञान। जे चेष्टा ते गुणाधीन। आपैसी असे॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃba prakṛtīce adhiṣṭhāna| taṃva sāṃḍī māṃḍī heṃ ajñāna| je ceṣṭā te guṇādhīna| āpaisī ase|| 53||
verses.meaning: As long as one is under the sway of Prakriti (primordial nature), there is ignorance, leading to actions of creation and destruction. All such activities are inherently governed by the Gunas (qualities of nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें विहित कर्म जेतुलें। तें सगळें जरी बोसंडिलें। तरी स्वभाव काय निमाले। इंद्रियांचे ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ vihita karma jetuleṃ| teṃ sagaḻeṃ jarī bosaṃḍileṃ| tarī svabhāva kāya nimāle| iṃdriyāṃce || 54||
verses.meaning: Even if all prescribed actions are abandoned, do the inherent natures of the senses cease?

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगें श्रवणीं ऐकावें ठेलें। कीं नेत्रींचें तेज गेलें। हें नासारंश्र बुझालें। परिमळु नेघे ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgeṃ śravaṇīṃ aikāveṃ ṭheleṃ| kīṃ netrīṃceṃ teja geleṃ| heṃ nāsāraṃśra bujhāleṃ| parimaḻu neghe || 55||
verses.meaning: Tell me, if the ears have become deaf, or the light of the eyes has gone, or the nose has become numb and cannot perceive fragrance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी प्राणापानगति। कीं निर्विकल्प जाहली मति। कीं क्षुधातृषादि आर्ति। खुंटलिया॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī prāṇāpānagati| kīṃ nirvikalpa jāhalī mati| kīṃ kṣudhātṛṣādi ārti| khuṃṭaliyā|| 56||
verses.meaning: Or is it that the movement of the vital breaths has ceased, or the mind has become free from all thoughts and desires, or the pangs of hunger and thirst have come to an end?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे स्वप्नाबबोधु ठेळे। कौं चरण चालो विसरले। हें असो 'काय निमाले। जन्ममृत्यु॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: he svapnābabodhu ṭheḻe| kauṃ caraṇa cālo visarale| heṃ aso 'kāya nimāle| janmamṛtyu|| 57||
verses.meaning: Are these like the states of waking from a dream, or like forgetting how to walk? Let this be; what has truly ceased are birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें न ठकेचि जरी कांहीं। तरी सांडिलें तें कायी । म्हणोनि कर्मत्यागु नाहीं । प्रकृतिमंतां॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ na ṭhakeci jarī kāṃhīṃ| tarī sāṃḍileṃ teṃ kāyī | mhaṇoni karmatyāgu nāhīṃ | prakṛtimaṃtāṃ|| 58||
verses.meaning: If this (action) is not abandoned in any way, then what is given up? Therefore, for those embodied in nature, there is no abandonment of action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्म पराधीनपणें । निपजतसे प्रकृतिगुणें। येरी धरीं मोकलीं अंतःकरणें। वाहिजे वायां॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: karma parādhīnapaṇeṃ | nipajatase prakṛtiguṇeṃ| yerī dharīṃ mokalīṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇeṃ| vāhije vāyāṃ|| 59||
verses.meaning: Actions are performed by the qualities of nature, due to their dependence. Otherwise, the mind, by holding on or letting go, carries a burden in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें रथीं आरूढिजे। मग जरी निश्‍्चळा बैसिजे। तरी चळु होऊनि हिंडिजे। परतंत्रा ॥६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ rathīṃ ārūḍhije| maga jarī niś‍caḻā baisije| tarī caḻu hoūni hiṃḍije| parataṃtrā ||60||
verses.meaning: Behold, if one mounts a chariot, and then sits motionlessly, still one is moved and travels, being dependent on another.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां उचलिलें वायुबशें। चळे शुष्क पत्र जैसें। निचेष्ट आकाशें। परिभ्रमे॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ucalileṃ vāyubaśeṃ| caḻe śuṣka patra jaiseṃ| niceṣṭa ākāśeṃ| paribhrame|| 61||
verses.meaning: Or as a dry leaf, lifted by the force of the wind, moves about, though it is inert in the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें प्रकतिआधारें। कर्मेद्रियविकारें। नैष्कर्म्यही व्यापारे। निरंतर॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ prakatiādhāreṃ| karmedriyavikāreṃ| naiṣkarmyahī vyāpāre| niraṃtara|| 62||
verses.meaning: Similarly, even the state of actionlessness, due to the influence of Prakriti and the modifications of the organs of action, continues to operate ceaselessly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि संगू जंव प्रकृतीचा । तंववरी त्यागु न घडे कर्माचा। ऐसियाही करूं म्हणती तयांचा । आग्रहोचि उरे॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni saṃgū jaṃva prakṛtīcā | taṃvavarī tyāgu na ghaḍe karmācā| aisiyāhī karūṃ mhaṇatī tayāṃcā | āgrahoci ure|| 63||
verses.meaning: Therefore, as long as there is attachment to prakriti (nature), the renunciation of actions cannot happen. Even if they say they will do it, only their insistence remains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे उचित कर्म सांडिती। मग नैष्कर्म्य होऊं पाहती । परी कर्मेन्द्रियप्रवृत्ती । निरोधुनी ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: je ucita karma sāṃḍitī| maga naiṣkarmya hoūṃ pāhatī | parī karmendriyapravṛttī | nirodhunī || 64||
verses.meaning: Those who abandon appropriate actions, then seek to attain a state of actionlessness, but only by suppressing the activity of their organs of action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां कर्मत्यागु न घडे । जें कर्तव्य मनीं सांपडे । वरी नटती तें फुडें। दरिद्र जाण ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ karmatyāgu na ghaḍe | jeṃ kartavya manīṃ sāṃpaḍe | varī naṭatī teṃ phuḍeṃ| daridra jāṇa || 65||
verses.meaning: They cannot renounce actions, for the sense of duty remains in their minds. What they outwardly feign is, in truth, mere poverty (of understanding).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे ते पार्था । विषयासक्त सर्वथा । ओळखावे तत्त्वता । भ्रांति नाहीं ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise te pārthā | viṣayāsakta sarvathā | oḻakhāve tattvatā | bhrāṃti nāhīṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, know for certain that those who are completely engrossed in worldly pleasures are indeed deluded; there is no doubt about this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां देई अवधान । प्रसंगें तुज सांगेन । या नैराश्याचें चिन्ह। धनुर्धरा ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ deī avadhāna | prasaṃgeṃ tuja sāṃgena | yā nairāśyāceṃ cinha| dhanurdharā || 67||
verses.meaning: Now, pay attention, I will tell you about the signs of this despair, O Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो अंतरीं दृढ । परमात्मरूपीं गूढ । बाह्य भागू तरी रूढु। लौकिकु जैसा॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo aṃtarīṃ dṛḍha | paramātmarūpīṃ gūḍha | bāhya bhāgū tarī rūḍhu| laukiku jaisā|| 68||
verses.meaning: One who is firmly established within, deeply absorbed in the Supreme Self, yet outwardly appears to live a conventional life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो इंद्रियां आज्ञा न करी । विषयांचें भय न धरी । प्राप्त कर्म नाव्हेरी। उचित जें जें ॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo iṃdriyāṃ ājñā na karī | viṣayāṃceṃ bhaya na dharī | prāpta karma nāvherī| ucita jeṃ jeṃ ||69||
verses.meaning: One who does not command the senses, does not fear worldly pleasures, and does not reject the duties that are appropriate and come his way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो कर्मेन्द्रियें कर्मी । राहटतां तरी न नियमी। परी तेथिचेनि उर्मी । झांकोळेना ॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: to karmendriyeṃ karmī | rāhaṭatāṃ tarī na niyamī| parī tethiceni urmī | jhāṃkoḻenā || 70||
verses.meaning: Even if the organs of action are engaged in their respective actions, the Yogi does not control them, nor is he overwhelmed by the impulses arising from them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो कामनामात्रें न घेपे। मोहमळें न लिंपे। जैसें जळीं जळें न शिंपे। पदापत्र ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: to kāmanāmātreṃ na ghepe| mohamaḻeṃ na liṃpe| jaiseṃ jaḻīṃ jaḻeṃ na śiṃpe| padāpatra || 71||
verses.meaning: It is not grasped by mere desire, nor is it stained by the impurity of delusion. Just as a lotus leaf is not moistened by water, so too is it untouched.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा संसर्गामाजीं असे । सकळांसारिखा दिसे। जैसें तोयसंगें आभासे। भानुबिंब॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā saṃsargāmājīṃ ase | sakaḻāṃsārikhā dise| jaiseṃ toyasaṃgeṃ ābhāse| bhānubiṃba|| 72||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun's reflection appears in water, so too does the Self, though ever-present amidst all worldly interactions, seem to be like everyone else.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सामान्यत्वें पाहिजे। तरी साधारणुचि देखिजे । येरवीं निर्धारितां नेणिजे । सोय जयाची ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sāmānyatveṃ pāhije| tarī sādhāraṇuci dekhije | yeravīṃ nirdhāritāṃ neṇije | soya jayācī || 73||
verses.meaning: Similarly, if one looks at it generally, it appears ordinary. Otherwise, when one tries to ascertain its true nature, its essence cannot be grasped.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशा चिन्हीं चिन्हितु। देखसी तोचि मुक्त । आशापाशरहितु । बोळख पां॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśā cinhīṃ cinhitu| dekhasī toci mukta | āśāpāśarahitu | boḻakha pāṃ|| 74||
verses.meaning: Recognize him as truly liberated, free from the bonds of desire, who is marked by such signs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना तोचि योगी । विशेषिजे जो जगीं। म्हणौनि ऐसा होय यालागीं। म्हणिपें तूतें ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā toci yogī | viśeṣije jo jagīṃ| mhaṇauni aisā hoya yālāgīṃ| mhaṇipeṃ tūteṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, that indeed is the Yogi who is distinguished in the world. Therefore, I tell you to become like that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं मानसा नियमु करीं । निशचळु होय अंतरीं । मग कर्मेन्द्रियें व्यापारी । वर्ततु सुखें । ७६॥ नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मण: । शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्धथेदकर्मण:॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ mānasā niyamu karīṃ | niśacaḻu hoya aṃtarīṃ | maga karmendriyeṃ vyāpārī | vartatu sukheṃ | 76|| niyataṃ kuru karma tvaṃ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇa: | śarīrayātrāpi ca te na prasiddhathedakarmaṇa:|| 8||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O mind, make a resolve and become steadfast within. Then, engage in the actions of the senses with joy. You must perform your prescribed duties, for action is superior to inaction. Even the maintenance of your body would not be possible without action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि नेष्कर्म्य होआवें। तरी एथ तें न संभवें। आणि निषिद्ध केवीं राहाटावें। विचारीं पां ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni neṣkarmya hoāveṃ| tarī etha teṃ na saṃbhaveṃ| āṇi niṣiddha kevīṃ rāhāṭāveṃ| vicārīṃ pāṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Therefore, if one wishes to attain 'naishkarmya' (actionlessness or freedom from the bondage of action), it is not possible through such means. And how can one engage in forbidden actions? Consider this carefully.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि जें जें उचित । आणि अवसरेंकरूनि प्राप्त। तें कर्म हेतुरहित। आचरें तूं ८ ७८॥ पार्था आणीकही एक । नेणसी तूं हें कवतिक । जे ऐसें कर्ममोचक । आपैसें असे ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni jeṃ jeṃ ucita | āṇi avasareṃkarūni prāpta| teṃ karma heturahita| ācareṃ tūṃ 8 78|| pārthā āṇīkahī eka | neṇasī tūṃ heṃ kavatika | je aiseṃ karmamocaka | āpaiseṃ ase || 79||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever is appropriate and comes naturally with the occasion, perform that action without attachment to its results. O Partha, there is another wonder you do not know: that such a liberator from karma exists spontaneously.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें अनुक्रमाधारें। स्वधर्मु जो आचरे। तो मोक्षु तेणें व्यापारें। निश्चित पावे॥ ८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ anukramādhāreṃ| svadharmu jo ācare| to mokṣu teṇeṃ vyāpāreṃ| niścita pāve|| 80||
verses.meaning: Behold, one who practices their own dharma in due order, certainly attains liberation through that very action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वधर्मु जो बापा । तोचि नित्ययज्ञु जाण पां। म्हणौनि वर्ततां तेथ पापा । संचारु नाहीं ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: svadharmu jo bāpā | toci nityayajñu jāṇa pāṃ| mhaṇauni vartatāṃ tetha pāpā | saṃcāru nāhīṃ || 89||
verses.meaning: Understand, my child, that one's own dharma is indeed the eternal sacrifice. Therefore, by adhering to it, there is no room for sin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा निजधर्म जैं सांडे। आणि कुकर्मी रति घडे । तैंचि बंधु पडे । संसारिक ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā nijadharma jaiṃ sāṃḍe| āṇi kukarmī rati ghaḍe | taiṃci baṃdhu paḍe | saṃsārika || 82||
verses.meaning: When one abandons their true nature and engages in unrighteous actions, then they fall into the bondage of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि स्वधर्मानुष्ठान । तें अखंड यज्ञ याजन । जो करी तया बंधन। कहींच न घडे॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni svadharmānuṣṭhāna | teṃ akhaṃḍa yajña yājana | jo karī tayā baṃdhana| kahīṃca na ghaḍe||83||
verses.meaning: Therefore, performing one's own dharma is a continuous sacrifice. One who performs it is never bound.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा लोकु कर्मे बांधिला। जो परतंत्रा भूत झाला । तो नित्ययज्ञातें चुकला । म्हणौनियां॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā loku karme bāṃdhilā| jo parataṃtrā bhūta jhālā | to nityayajñāteṃ cukalā | mhaṇauniyāṃ|| 84||
verses.meaning: This world is bound by karma, having become subservient to the elements. Therefore, it has missed the eternal sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां येचिबिशीं पार्था । तुज सांगेन एक मी कथा । जें सृष्ट्यादि संस्था । ब्रहोनें केली॥८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yecibiśīṃ pārthā | tuja sāṃgena eka mī kathā | jeṃ sṛṣṭyādi saṃsthā | brahoneṃ kelī||85||
verses.meaning: Now, on this very subject, Arjuna, I will tell you a story, how Brahma created the universe from the very beginning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ५६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तैं नित्ययागसहितें। सूजिलीं भूतें समस्तें । परी नेणतीचि तियें यज्ञातें । सूक्ष्म म्हणौनि॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: 56 śrījñāneśvarī taiṃ nityayāgasahiteṃ| sūjilīṃ bhūteṃ samasteṃ | parī neṇatīci tiyeṃ yajñāteṃ | sūkṣma mhaṇauni|| 86||
verses.meaning: The entire creation is sustained by the eternal sacrifice (Yagnya), yet beings do not comprehend this subtle sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वेळीं प्रजीं विनविला ब्रह्मा। देवा काय आश्रयो एथ आम्हां । तंव म्हणे तो कमळजन्मा । भूतांप्रति॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: te veḻīṃ prajīṃ vinavilā brahmā| devā kāya āśrayo etha āmhāṃ | taṃva mhaṇe to kamaḻajanmā | bhūtāṃprati|| 87||
verses.meaning: At that time, the beings pleaded with Brahma, "O Lord, what refuge is there for us here?" Then, the lotus-born one spoke to the beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुम्हां वर्णविशेषवशें । आम्हीं हा स्वधर्मुचि विहिला असे। यातें उपासा मग आपैसे। पुरती 'काम॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tumhāṃ varṇaviśeṣavaśeṃ | āmhīṃ hā svadharmuci vihilā ase| yāteṃ upāsā maga āpaise| puratī 'kāma|| 88||
verses.meaning: According to your specific varna, we have ordained this as your inherent duty. If you diligently perform it, all your desires will naturally be fulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुम्हीं व्रते नियमु न करावे । शरीरातें न पीडावें। दुरी केंही न वचावें। तीथासी गा॥ ८९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tumhīṃ vrate niyamu na karāve | śarīrāteṃ na pīḍāveṃ| durī keṃhī na vacāveṃ| tīthāsī gā|| 89 ||
verses.meaning: You do not need to observe vows or rules, nor torment your body. You do not need to go far away to places of pilgrimage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: योगादिकें साधनें। साकांक्ष आराधनें । मंत्रयंत्रविधानें। झणीं करा॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yogādikeṃ sādhaneṃ| sākāṃkṣa ārādhaneṃ | maṃtrayaṃtravidhāneṃ| jhaṇīṃ karā|| 90||
verses.meaning: Do not perform spiritual practices like Yoga, or worship with desires, or rituals involving mantras and yantras.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवतांतरा न भजावें। हें सर्वथा कांहीं न करावें। तुम्हीं स्वधर्मयज्ञीं यजावें । अनायासे ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: devatāṃtarā na bhajāveṃ| heṃ sarvathā kāṃhīṃ na karāveṃ| tumhīṃ svadharmayajñīṃ yajāveṃ | anāyāse || 91||
verses.meaning: Do not worship other deities. Never do this at all. You should worship through the sacrifice of your own dharma, effortlessly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहेतुकें चित्तें। अनुष्ठा पां ययातें । पतिव्रता पतीतें । जियापरी ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahetukeṃ citteṃ| anuṣṭhā pāṃ yayāteṃ | pativratā patīteṃ | jiyāparī || 92||
verses.meaning: Just as a devoted wife serves her husband with selfless love, so too should one serve the divine with a pure and unmotivated heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा स्वधर्मरूप मखु । हाचि सेव्यु तुम्हां एकु । ऐसें सत्यळोकनायकु। बोलता जाहला॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā svadharmarūpa makhu | hāci sevyu tumhāṃ eku | aiseṃ satyaḻokanāyaku| bolatā jāhalā|| 93||
verses.meaning: The Lord of Satyaloka spoke thus: "This path of one's own Dharma is the only one to be served by you."

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखा स्वर्धर्मातें भजाल। तरी कामधेनु हा होईल। मग प्रजाहो न संडील। तुमतें कदा ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhā svardharmāteṃ bhajāla| tarī kāmadhenu hā hoīla| maga prajāho na saṃḍīla| tumateṃ kadā || 94||
verses.meaning: Behold, if you worship your own dharma, it will become a wish-fulfilling cow for you. Then, it will never abandon you, my people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैं येणेंकरूनि समस्तां। परितोषु होईल देवतां। मग ते तुम्हां ईप्सिता । अर्थातें देती॥९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiṃ yeṇeṃkarūni samastāṃ| paritoṣu hoīla devatāṃ| maga te tumhāṃ īpsitā | arthāteṃ detī||95||
verses.meaning: When by this, all deities are pleased, then they will grant you your desired objects.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या स्वधर्मपूजा पूजितां। देवतागणां ( देवगणां ) समस्तां । योगक्षेमु निश्‍चिता। करिती तुमचा ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā svadharmapūjā pūjitāṃ| devatāgaṇāṃ ( devagaṇāṃ ) samastāṃ | yogakṣemu niś‍citā| karitī tumacā || 96||
verses.meaning: By worshipping your own Dharma, all the deities will certainly ensure your well-being and prosperity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुम्हीं देवांतें भजाल। देव तुम्हां तुष्टतील। ऐसी परस्परें घडेल । प्रीति जेथ ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tumhīṃ devāṃteṃ bhajāla| deva tumhāṃ tuṣṭatīla| aisī paraspareṃ ghaḍela | prīti jetha || 97||
verses.meaning: You worship the gods, and the gods will be pleased with you. Such mutual love will arise there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ तुम्ही जें करूं म्हणाल तें आपैसें सिद्धी जाईल। बांछितही पुरेळ। मानसींचें ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha tumhī jeṃ karūṃ mhaṇāla teṃ āpaiseṃ siddhī jāīla| bāṃchitahī pureḻa| mānasīṃceṃ || 98 ||
verses.meaning: Whatever you wish to do there will automatically be accomplished. Even your desires will be fulfilled, those that are in your mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वाचासिन्दि पावाल। आज्ञापक होआल। म्हणियें तुमतें मागतील। महाक्रन्द्रि॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vācāsindi pāvāla| ājñāpaka hoāla| mhaṇiyeṃ tumateṃ māgatīla| mahākrandri|| 99||
verses.meaning: You will attain the power of speech, you will become a commander, and people will seek your guidance in times of great distress.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें क्रतुपतीचें द्वार । वनश्री निरंतर। बोळगे फळभार। लावण्येंसीं ॥ १००॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ kratupatīceṃ dvāra | vanaśrī niraṃtara| boḻage phaḻabhāra| lāvaṇyeṃsīṃ || 100||
verses.meaning: Just as the entrance to the spring season is continuously adorned by the forest's beauty, laden with fruits and charm.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सर्व सुखेंसहित । दैवचि मूर्तिमंत । येईल देखा काढत । तुम्हांपाठीं ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sarva sukheṃsahita | daivaci mūrtimaṃta | yeīla dekhā kāḍhata | tumhāṃpāṭhīṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: In the same way, all happiness, along with destiny itself, will come to you, manifesting in a tangible form, following closely behind you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें समस्त भोगभरित। होआल तुम्ही अनार्त। जरी स्वधरमेनिरत। वर्ताल बापा॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ samasta bhogabharita| hoāla tumhī anārta| jarī svadharamenirata| vartāla bāpā|| 2||
verses.meaning: Thus, you will experience all pleasures and be free from suffering, if you steadfastly adhere to your own dharma, my child.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जालिया सकळ संपदा। जो अनुसरेल इंद्रियमदा। लुब्ध होऊनियां स्वादा । विषयांचिया ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jāliyā sakaḻa saṃpadā| jo anusarela iṃdriyamadā| lubdha hoūniyāṃ svādā | viṣayāṃciyā || 3||
verses.meaning: Even if one possesses all wealth, if they succumb to the intoxication of the senses, becoming greedy for the taste of worldly pleasures...

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिहीं यज्ञभाविकीं सुरीं। जे हे संपत्ति दिधली पुरी । तयां स्वधर्मी सर्वेश्‍वरीं । न भजेल जो॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tihīṃ yajñabhāvikīṃ surīṃ| je he saṃpatti didhalī purī | tayāṃ svadharmī sarveś‍varīṃ | na bhajela jo|| 4||
verses.meaning: The one who does not worship the All-pervading Lord, who has bestowed this abundant wealth upon those devoted to the sacrificial rites, through their own righteous duties.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अग्निमुखीं हवन । न करील देवतापूजन । प्राप्तवेळे भोजन । ब्राह्मणाचे ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: agnimukhīṃ havana | na karīla devatāpūjana | prāptaveḻe bhojana | brāhmaṇāce || 5||
verses.meaning: One who does not perform oblation into the fire, nor worship the deities, nor offer food to Brahmins at the appointed time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा स्वधर्मक्रियारहितु। आधिलेपणें प्रमत्तु।) केवळ भोगासक्तु । होईल जो॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā svadharmakriyārahitu| ādhilepaṇeṃ pramattu|) kevaḻa bhogāsaktu | hoīla jo|| 7||
verses.meaning: Such a person, devoid of the actions prescribed by their own dharma, intoxicated by their past merits, will become solely attached to worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया मग अपावो थोर आहे। जेणें तें हातींचें सकळ जाये। देखा प्राप्तही न लाहे। भोग भोगूं॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā maga apāvo thora āhe| jeṇeṃ teṃ hātīṃceṃ sakaḻa jāye| dekhā prāptahī na lāhe| bhoga bhogūṃ|| 8||
verses.meaning: Then there is a great misfortune, by which all that is in hand is lost. See, even what is attained cannot be enjoyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें गतायुषीं शरीरीं । चैतन्य वासु न करी। कां निदैवाच्या घरीं। न राहे लक्ष्मी ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ gatāyuṣīṃ śarīrīṃ | caitanya vāsu na karī| kāṃ nidaivācyā gharīṃ| na rāhe lakṣmī || 9||
verses.meaning: Just as consciousness does not reside in a body that has lost its life, or as Lakshmi (goddess of wealth) does not stay in the house of the unfortunate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा स्वधर्मु जरी लोपला । तरी सर्व सुखांचा थारा मोडला । जैसा दीपासबें हरपला । प्रकाशु जाय ॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā svadharmu jarī lopalā | tarī sarva sukhāṃcā thārā moḍalā | jaisā dīpāsabeṃ harapalā | prakāśu jāya || 190||
verses.meaning: Just as light vanishes when a lamp is extinguished, so too, if one's own dharma (righteous conduct/duty) is lost, all sources of happiness are destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी निजवृत्ति जेथ सांडे । तेथ स्वतंत्रते बस्ती न घडे । आइका प्रजाहो हें फुडें। विरंचि म्हणे॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī nijavṛtti jetha sāṃḍe | tetha svataṃtrate bastī na ghaḍe | āikā prajāho heṃ phuḍeṃ| viraṃci mhaṇe|| 11||
verses.meaning: Just as one's inherent nature is shed, independence cannot reside there. Listen, O people, this is the truth, says Brahma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि स्वधर्मु जो सांडील। तयातें काळु दंडीळ। चोरू म्हणौनि हरीळ। सर्वस्व तयाचें ॥ ९१२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni svadharmu jo sāṃḍīla| tayāteṃ kāḻu daṃḍīḻa| corū mhaṇauni harīḻa| sarvasva tayāceṃ || 912||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whoever abandons their own dharma, time will punish them. It will snatch away their everything, like a thief.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग सकळ दोषु भंवते। गिंवसोनि घेति तयातें। रात्रिसमयीं स्मशानातें। भूतें जैसीं ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga sakaḻa doṣu bhaṃvate| giṃvasoni gheti tayāteṃ| rātrisamayīṃ smaśānāteṃ| bhūteṃ jaisīṃ || 13||
verses.meaning: Then all faults surround and seize that person, just as ghosts gather at a cremation ground at night.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं त्रिभुवनींचीं दुःखें । आणि नानाविधें पातकें । दैन्यजात तितुकें । तेथेंचि वसे॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ tribhuvanīṃcīṃ duḥkheṃ | āṇi nānāvidheṃ pātakeṃ | dainyajāta titukeṃ | tetheṃci vase|| 14||
verses.meaning: Similarly, all the sorrows of the three worlds, and various kinds of sins, and all forms of misery, reside there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें होय तया उन्मत्ता। मग न सुटे बापा रुदतां। कल्यपांतींही सर्वथा । प्राणिंगण हो ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ hoya tayā unmattā| maga na suṭe bāpā rudatāṃ| kalyapāṃtīṃhī sarvathā | prāṇiṃgaṇa ho || 15||
verses.meaning: Such a person becomes mad, and then, my child, even if they cry, they will never be freed, not even at the end of a kalpa, from the cycle of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि निजवृत्ती हे न संडावी । इंद्रियें बरळों नेदावीं। ऐसें प्रजांतें शिकवी । चतुराननु ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni nijavṛttī he na saṃḍāvī | iṃdriyeṃ baraḻoṃ nedāvīṃ| aiseṃ prajāṃteṃ śikavī | caturānanu || 16||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should not abandon one's true nature, nor allow the senses to go astray. Thus, the four-faced Brahma teaches the people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें जळचरा जळ सांडे । आणि तत्क्षणी मरण मांडे। हा स्वधर्मु तेणें पाडें। बिसंबो नये॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ jaḻacarā jaḻa sāṃḍe | āṇi tatkṣaṇī maraṇa māṃḍe| hā svadharmu teṇeṃ pāḍeṃ| bisaṃbo naye|| 17||
verses.meaning: Just as a water creature perishes the moment it leaves water, so too one should never abandon their own Dharma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तुम्हीं समस्तीं । आपुलालिया कर्मी उचितीं । निरत व्हावें पुढतपुढती । म्हणिपत असे॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tumhīṃ samastīṃ | āpulāliyā karmī ucitīṃ | nirata vhāveṃ puḍhatapuḍhatī | mhaṇipata ase|| 18||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all of you should repeatedly engage in your respective, appropriate duties, as it is said.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखा विहित क्रियाविधि। निर्हेतुका बुन्धि। जो असतिये समृद्धि। विनियोगु करी॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhā vihita kriyāvidhi| nirhetukā bundhi| jo asatiye samṛddhi| viniyogu karī|| 19||
verses.meaning: Behold, one who, with an unattached intellect, dedicates their prosperity to prescribed actions and rituals.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरु गोत्र (गो) अग्नि पूजी । अवसरीं भजे द्विजीं। निमित्तादिकीं यजी। पितरोहेशें॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: guru gotra (go) agni pūjī | avasarīṃ bhaje dvijīṃ| nimittādikīṃ yajī| pitaroheśeṃ|| 120||
verses.meaning: He worships the Guru, the lineage, and fire. At appropriate times, he serves Brahmins. He performs sacrifices for specific occasions and for the ancestors.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या यज्ञक्रिया उचिता। यज्ञेशीं हवन करितां। हुतशेष स्वभावतः । उरे जें जें॥२१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā yajñakriyā ucitā| yajñeśīṃ havana karitāṃ| hutaśeṣa svabhāvataḥ | ure jeṃ jeṃ||21||
verses.meaning: Whatever remains naturally as the residue of the offering, after performing the sacrificial rites and offering oblations to the Lord of Sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें सुखें आपुले घरीं । कुटुंबेंसी भोजन करी । कीं भोग्यचि तें निवारी। कल्मषातें॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ sukheṃ āpule gharīṃ | kuṭuṃbeṃsī bhojana karī | kīṃ bhogyaci teṃ nivārī| kalmaṣāteṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: That joy, in its own home, partakes of a meal with its family, or rather, it removes the impurities that are to be experienced.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें यज्ञावशिष्ट भोगी । म्हणौनि सांडिजे तो अघीं। जयापरी महारोगी । अमृतसिन्दि॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ yajñāvaśiṣṭa bhogī | mhaṇauni sāṃḍije to aghīṃ| jayāparī mahārogī | amṛtasindi|| 23||
verses.meaning: One who partakes of the remnants of the sacrifice is freed from sin, just as a person suffering from a great disease is cured by the elixir of immortality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कौ तत्त्वनिष्ठु जैसा । नागवे भ्रांतिळेशा। तो शेषभोगी तैसा। नाकळे दोषा॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kau tattvaniṣṭhu jaisā | nāgave bhrāṃtiḻeśā| to śeṣabhogī taisā| nākaḻe doṣā|| 24||
verses.meaning: Just as a truly devoted person is not touched by the slightest illusion, so too, the one who rests on the divine serpent (Shesha) is not affected by any fault.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि स्वधर्मे जें अर्जे। तें स्वधर्मेचि ५८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी विनियोगिजे। मग उरे तें भोगिजे। संतोषेंसीं ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni svadharme jeṃ arje| teṃ svadharmeci 58 śrījñāneśvarī viniyogije| maga ure teṃ bhogije| saṃtoṣeṃsīṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever is earned through one's own dharma (righteous duty), that should be utilized in accordance with one's own dharma. Whatever remains after that, one should enjoy with contentment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें वांचूनि पार्था । राहाटों नये अन्यथा । ऐसी आद्य हे कथा श्रीमुरारी सांगे ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ vāṃcūni pārthā | rāhāṭoṃ naye anyathā | aisī ādya he kathā śrīmurārī sāṃge || 26||
verses.meaning: Lord Krishna said, "O Partha, there is no other way to live except this. This is the primordial teaching."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे देहचि आपणपें मानिती। आणि विषयांतें भोग्य म्हणती । यापरतें न स्मरती। आणिक कांहीं ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: je dehaci āpaṇapeṃ mānitī| āṇi viṣayāṃteṃ bhogya mhaṇatī | yāparateṃ na smaratī| āṇika kāṃhīṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Those who consider their body to be their very self, and deem sense objects as things to be enjoyed, remember nothing else beyond this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें यज्ञोपकरण सकळ । नेणतसां ते बरळ । अहंबुद्ि केवळ। भोगूं पाहती ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ yajñopakaraṇa sakaḻa | neṇatasāṃ te baraḻa | ahaṃbudi kevaḻa| bhogūṃ pāhatī || 28||
verses.meaning: These instruments of sacrifice, not understanding them properly, they merely seek to enjoy them with egoistic intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियरुचीसारिखे। करविती पाक निके। ते 'पापिये पातकें।॥ सेविती जाण॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyarucīsārikhe| karavitī pāka nike| te 'pāpiye pātakeṃ||| sevitī jāṇa|| 29||
verses.meaning: Those who indulge in delicious dishes, prepared according to the taste of their senses, are indeed sinners who commit sins.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संपत्तिजात आघवें। हें हवनद्रव्य मानावें। मग स्वधर्मयज्ञें अर्पावें। आदिपुरुषीं ॥ १३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃpattijāta āghaveṃ| heṃ havanadravya mānāveṃ| maga svadharmayajñeṃ arpāveṃ| ādipuruṣīṃ || 130||
verses.meaning: Consider all your accumulated wealth as an offering for a sacrifice. Then, offer it to the Primeval Being through the sacrifice of your own dharma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें सांडोनियां मूर्ख । आपणपेंयालागीं देख। निपजविती पाक। नानाविध॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ sāṃḍoniyāṃ mūrkha | āpaṇapeṃyālāgīṃ dekha| nipajavitī pāka| nānāvidha|| 39||
verses.meaning: Leaving this aside, the foolish, for their own sake, prepare various kinds of food.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं यज सिद्धी जाये । परेशा तोषु होये । तें हे सामान्य अन्न न होये । म्हणौनियां॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ yaja siddhī jāye | pareśā toṣu hoye | teṃ he sāmānya anna na hoye | mhaṇauniyāṃ|| 32||
verses.meaning: That by which the success of sacrifice is achieved, and by which the Supreme Lord is pleased, that is not ordinary food. Therefore, know this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें न म्हणावें साधारण । अन्न ब्रह्मरूप जाण । जें जीवनहेतु कारण। विश्वा यया॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ na mhaṇāveṃ sādhāraṇa | anna brahmarūpa jāṇa | jeṃ jīvanahetu kāraṇa| viśvā yayā|| 33||
verses.meaning: Do not consider this ordinary; know that food itself is the form of Brahman, for it is the very cause of life for this entire universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अन्नास्तव भूतें । प्रोहो पावती समस्तें। मग पर्जन्यु या अन्नातें । सर्वत्र प्रसवे ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: annāstava bhūteṃ | proho pāvatī samasteṃ| maga parjanyu yā annāteṃ | sarvatra prasave || 34||
verses.meaning: From food, all beings are born. Then, rain produces this food everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया पर्जन्या यज्ञीं जन्म । यज्ञातें प्रगटी कर्म। कर्मासि आदि ब्रह्म। वेदरूप॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā parjanyā yajñīṃ janma | yajñāteṃ pragaṭī karma| karmāsi ādi brahma| vedarūpa|| 35||
verses.meaning: From that sacrifice, rain is born; from sacrifice, action manifests; and action has its origin in the Brahman, which is the form of the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वेदांतें परात्पर । प्रसवतसे अक्षर। म्हणोनि हें चराचर । ब्रह्मबद्ध ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vedāṃteṃ parātpara | prasavatase akṣara| mhaṇoni heṃ carācara | brahmabaddha || 36||
verses.meaning: Then, from the Vedas, the Supreme, the Imperishable, manifests. Therefore, this entire animate and inanimate world is bound by Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी कर्माचिये मूर्ति। यज्ञी अधिवासु श्रुति । ऐकें सुभद्रापति। अखंड गा॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī karmāciye mūrti| yajñī adhivāsu śruti | aikeṃ subhadrāpati| akhaṃḍa gā|| 37||
verses.meaning: But know, O husband of Subhadra, that the Vedas eternally reside in the form of action, in the sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशी हे आदि परंपरा । संक्षेपें तुज धनुर्धरा । सांगितली या अध्वरा। लागूनियां ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśī he ādi paraṃparā | saṃkṣepeṃ tuja dhanurdharā | sāṃgitalī yā adhvarā| lāgūniyāṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: Thus, this ancient tradition, O Arjuna, I have briefly explained to you, concerning this sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणूनि समूळ हा उचितु। स्वधर्मरूप क्रतु। नानुष्ठी जो मत्तु) लोकीं इये॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇūni samūḻa hā ucitu| svadharmarūpa kratu| nānuṣṭhī jo mattu) lokīṃ iye|| 39||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whoever in this world does not perform this proper sacrifice, which is one's own dharma, is indeed foolish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो पातकांची राशी। जाण भार भूमीसी । जो कुकर्मे इंद्रियांसी। उपेगा गेला ॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: to pātakāṃcī rāśī| jāṇa bhāra bhūmīsī | jo kukarme iṃdriyāṃsī| upegā gelā || 140||
verses.meaning: He who is a heap of sins, a burden to the earth, and whose senses are consumed by evil deeds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें जन्मकर्म सकळ। अर्जुना अति निष्फळ। जैसें कां अभ्रपटळ। अकाळींचे ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ janmakarma sakaḻa| arjunā ati niṣphaḻa| jaiseṃ kāṃ abhrapaṭaḻa| akāḻīṃce || 41||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, all such birth and action are utterly fruitless, like untimely clouds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां गळां स्तन अजेचे । तैसें जियालें देखें तयाचें । जया अनुष्ठान स्वधर्माचें। घडेचिना॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ gaḻāṃ stana ajece | taiseṃ jiyāleṃ dekheṃ tayāceṃ | jayā anuṣṭhāna svadharmāceṃ| ghaḍecinā|| 42||
verses.meaning: Or like breasts on a goat's neck, so is the life of one who does not perform the duties of their own dharma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ऐकें पांडवा। हा स्वधर्मु कवणें न संडावा। सर्वभावें भजावा । हाचि एकु ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aikeṃ pāṃḍavā| hā svadharmu kavaṇeṃ na saṃḍāvā| sarvabhāveṃ bhajāvā | hāci eku || 43||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen, Pandava, this 'Swadharma' (one's own duty/nature) should not be abandoned by anyone. It alone should be worshipped with all devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा शरीर जरी जाहलें। तरी कर्तव्य बोघें आलें। मग उचित कां आपुलें) ओसंडावें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā śarīra jarī jāhaleṃ| tarī kartavya bogheṃ āleṃ| maga ucita kāṃ āpuleṃ) osaṃḍāveṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: Even if the body is born, it comes with a sense of duty. Why then should one abandon what is proper for oneself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परिस पां सव्यसाची । मूर्ति लाहोनि देहाची । खंती करिती कर्माची । ते गांबढे गा॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: parisa pāṃ savyasācī | mūrti lāhoni dehācī | khaṃtī karitī karmācī | te gāṃbaḍhe gā|| 45||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, those who, having taken on a physical form, lament over their actions, are indeed ignorant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें असतेनि देहधर्मे । एथ तोचि एकु न लिंपे कर्मे । जो अखंडित स्मे। आपणपांचि ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ asateni dehadharme | etha toci eku na liṃpe karme | jo akhaṃḍita sme| āpaṇapāṃci || 46||
verses.meaning: Look, despite having a body, only that one is not tainted by actions, who constantly smiles at their own self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे तो आत्मबोधें तोषला । तरी कृतकार्यु देखें जाहला । म्हणौनि सहजें सांडबला। कर्मसंगु॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: je to ātmabodheṃ toṣalā | tarī kṛtakāryu dekheṃ jāhalā | mhaṇauni sahajeṃ sāṃḍabalā| karmasaṃgu|| 47||
verses.meaning: When one is content with the knowledge of the Self, then indeed, they become fulfilled. Therefore, the attachment to action naturally falls away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तृप्ति जालिया जैसीं। साधनें सरती आपैसीं। देखें आत्मतुष्टीं तैसीं । कर्मे नाहीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tṛpti jāliyā jaisīṃ| sādhaneṃ saratī āpaisīṃ| dekheṃ ātmatuṣṭīṃ taisīṃ | karme nāhīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: Just as when one is satiated, the means to achieve that satiation naturally cease, similarly, in the state of self-satisfaction, there are no actions left to perform.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंबवरी अर्जुना। तो बोधु भेटेना मना। तंवचि यया साधना । भजाबें लागे॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃbavarī arjunā| to bodhu bheṭenā manā| taṃvaci yayā sādhanā | bhajābeṃ lāge|| 49||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, until that realization is attained by the mind, one must continue to practice these spiritual disciplines.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तूं नियतु) सकळ कामरहितु। होऊनियां उचितु। स्वधर्म रहाटें ॥१५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tūṃ niyatu) sakaḻa kāmarahitu| hoūniyāṃ ucitu| svadharma rahāṭeṃ ||150||
verses.meaning: Therefore, you should perform your prescribed duties without any desire for the fruits of your actions, becoming free from all worldly desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे स्वधर्मे निष्कामता। अनुसरले पार्था। ते कैवल्यपद तत्त्वतां। पातळे जगीं ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je svadharme niṣkāmatā| anusarale pārthā| te kaivalyapada tattvatāṃ| pātaḻe jagīṃ ||59||
verses.meaning: O Partha, those who, through their own dharma, without desire, have followed this path, have truly attained the state of liberation in this world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देख पां जनकादिक। कर्मजात अशेख। न सांडितां मोक्षसुख। पावते जाहळे॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekha pāṃ janakādika| karmajāta aśekha| na sāṃḍitāṃ mokṣasukha| pāvate jāhaḻe|| 52||
verses.meaning: Behold, Janaka and others, without abandoning any of their actions, attained the bliss of liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें पार्था । होआवी कर्मी आस्था । हे आणिकाही एका अर्था । उपकांरेळ ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ pārthā | hoāvī karmī āsthā | he āṇikāhī ekā arthā | upakāṃreḻa || 53||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, one should be enthusiastic in performing actions. This also benefits others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे आचरतां आपणपयां। देखी लागेल लोका यया। तरी चुकेल अपाया। प्रसंगेंचि ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: je ācaratāṃ āpaṇapayāṃ| dekhī lāgela lokā yayā| tarī cukela apāyā| prasaṃgeṃci || 54||
verses.meaning: If one practices self-restraint, people will observe it, and by that example, they will naturally avoid misfortune.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें प्राप्तार्थ जाहले। जे निष्कामता पावळे। तयांही कर्तव्य असे उरलें) लोकांलागीं ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ prāptārtha jāhale| je niṣkāmatā pāvaḻe| tayāṃhī kartavya ase uraleṃ) lokāṃlāgīṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Even for those who have attained the ultimate goal and are free from desires, there remains the duty of guiding and benefiting humanity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मार्गी ६० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी अंधासरिसा। पुढें देखणाही चाळे जैसा। अज्ञाना प्रकटावा धर्मु तैसा । आचरोनी॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mārgī 60 śrījñāneśvarī aṃdhāsarisā| puḍheṃ dekhaṇāhī cāḻe jaisā| ajñānā prakaṭāvā dharmu taisā | ācaronī|| 56||
verses.meaning: Just as a sighted person guides a blind person on the path, so too should one reveal Dharma to the ignorant through their own conduct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा ऐसें जरी न कौजे। तरी अज्ञानां काय उमजे। तिहीं 'कवणेंपरी जाणिजे । मार्गातें या॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā aiseṃ jarī na kauje| tarī ajñānāṃ kāya umaje| tihīṃ 'kavaṇeṃparī jāṇije | mārgāteṃ yā|| 57||
verses.meaning: If this is not understood, then how will the ignorant comprehend? How will they know this path?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ वडील जें जें करिती । तया नाम धर्मु ठेविती । तेंचि येर अनुष्ठिती । सामान्य सकळ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha vaḍīla jeṃ jeṃ karitī | tayā nāma dharmu ṭhevitī | teṃci yera anuṣṭhitī | sāmānya sakaḻa|| 58||
verses.meaning: Whatever the elders do, that is called Dharma, and the common people follow it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें ऐसें असे स्वभावें। म्हणोनि कर्म न संडावें। विशेषें आचरावें। लागे संतीं ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aiseṃ ase svabhāveṃ| mhaṇoni karma na saṃḍāveṃ| viśeṣeṃ ācarāveṃ| lāge saṃtīṃ ||59||
verses.meaning: Such is its nature; therefore, one should not abandon action. Especially, it is essential for saints to perform actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां आणिकांचिया गोठी। कायशा सांगों किरीटी। देखें मीच इये राहाटी । वर्तत असें ॥ १६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ āṇikāṃciyā goṭhī| kāyaśā sāṃgoṃ kirīṭī| dekheṃ mīca iye rāhāṭī | vartata aseṃ || 160||
verses.meaning: Now, why speak of others' ways, O Kiriti? Behold, I Myself abide in this very state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय सांकडें कांहीं मातें। कौं कवणें एकें आते । आचरें मी धर्मातें। म्हणसी जरी ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya sāṃkaḍeṃ kāṃhīṃ māteṃ| kauṃ kavaṇeṃ ekeṃ āte | ācareṃ mī dharmāteṃ| mhaṇasī jarī || 61||
verses.meaning: If you say that I follow Dharma, then what difficulty could I possibly face, or what could ever be lacking for me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पुरतेपणालागीं । आणिकु दुसरा नाहीं जगीं। ऐसी सामुग्री माझ्या अंगीं। जाणसी तूं॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī puratepaṇālāgīṃ | āṇiku dusarā nāhīṃ jagīṃ| aisī sāmugrī mājhyā aṃgīṃ| jāṇasī tūṃ|| 62||
verses.meaning: There is no other in this world who can complete me. You know that such completeness resides within me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मृत गुरुपुत्र आणिला । तो तुवां पवाडा देखिला। तोही मी उगला। कर्मी वर्ते ॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mṛta guruputra āṇilā | to tuvāṃ pavāḍā dekhilā| tohī mī ugalā| karmī varte ||63||
verses.meaning: You witnessed the miracle of the dead guru's son being brought back to life by me, yet I remain engaged in action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी स्वधर्मी वर्ते कैसा । साकांक्षु कां होय जैसा। तयाचि एका उद्देशा-। 'लागोनियां॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī svadharmī varte kaisā | sākāṃkṣu kāṃ hoya jaisā| tayāci ekā uddeśā-| 'lāgoniyāṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: But how does one act in their own dharma? It is as if they are full of desire, for that one purpose alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे भूतजात सकळ। असे आम्हांचि आधीन केवळ। तरी न व्हावें बरळ। म्हणौनियां ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: je bhūtajāta sakaḻa| ase āmhāṃci ādhīna kevaḻa| tarī na vhāveṃ baraḻa| mhaṇauniyāṃ || 65 ||
verses.meaning: All beings are entirely under Our control; therefore, they should not become unruly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्ही पूर्णकाम होउनी । जरी आत्मस्थिति राहुनी । तरी प्रजा हे कैसेनि । निस्तरेळ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhī pūrṇakāma hounī | jarī ātmasthiti rāhunī | tarī prajā he kaiseni | nistareḻa|| 66||
verses.meaning: Even if we, being complete and perfect, remain in the state of the Self, how will the common people be uplifted and cross over (the ocean of worldly existence)?

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहीं आमुची वास पाहावी । मग वर्ततीपरी जाणावी । ते 'लोकस्थिति आघवी। नासिली होईल॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃ āmucī vāsa pāhāvī | maga vartatīparī jāṇāvī | te 'lokasthiti āghavī| nāsilī hoīla|| 67||
verses.meaning: If these (people) were to wait for us, then their conduct would be known. That entire 'social order' would be destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि समर्थ जो येथें। आथिला सर्वज्ञते। तेणें सविशेषें कर्मातें। त्यजावें ना।॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni samartha jo yetheṃ| āthilā sarvajñate| teṇeṃ saviśeṣeṃ karmāteṃ| tyajāveṃ nā||| 68||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one who is truly capable and possesses all knowledge should not abandon specific actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें फळाचिया आशा । आचरे कामकु जैसा । कर्मी भरु होआवा तैसा । निराशाही ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ phaḻāciyā āśā | ācare kāmaku jaisā | karmī bharu hoāvā taisā | nirāśāhī || 69||
verses.meaning: Just as a farmer works with the hope of fruit, so too should one engage in action, even in disappointment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे पुढतपुढतीं पार्था। हे सकळ लोकसंस्था। रक्षणीय सर्वथा । म्हणौनियां॥ १७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je puḍhatapuḍhatīṃ pārthā| he sakaḻa lokasaṃsthā| rakṣaṇīya sarvathā | mhaṇauniyāṃ|| 170||
verses.meaning: O Partha, these entire systems of the world must always be protected, for this reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मार्गाधारें वर्तावें। विश्व हें मोहरें लावावें । अलौकिक नोहावें। लोकांप्रति॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mārgādhāreṃ vartāveṃ| viśva heṃ mohareṃ lāvāveṃ | alaukika nohāveṃ| lokāṃprati|| 79||
verses.meaning: One should follow the path of righteousness, engage with the world, and not appear extraordinary to people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें सायासें स्तन्य सेवी । तें पक्वान्ने केवीं जेवी । म्हणौनि बाळका जैशीं नेदाबीं। धनुर्धरा ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sāyāseṃ stanya sevī | teṃ pakvānne kevīṃ jevī | mhaṇauni bāḻakā jaiśīṃ nedābīṃ| dhanurdharā || 72||
verses.meaning: Just as a child who with great effort drinks milk, cannot eat rich food, so too, O Arjuna, such things should not be given to a child.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी कर्मी जयां अयोग्यता । तयांप्रति नैष्कर्म्यता । न प्रगटावी खेळतां। आदिकरुनी॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī karmī jayāṃ ayogyatā | tayāṃprati naiṣkarmyatā | na pragaṭāvī kheḻatāṃ| ādikarunī|| 73||
verses.meaning: Similarly, for those who are not yet qualified for action, the state of inaction should not be revealed playfully or prematurely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथें सत्क्रियाचि लावावी । तेचि 'एकी प्रशंसावी । नेष्कर्मीही दावावी । आचरोनी ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetheṃ satkriyāci lāvāvī | teci 'ekī praśaṃsāvī | neṣkarmīhī dāvāvī | ācaronī || 74||
verses.meaning: There, one should engage in good deeds. Some praise this as 'unity,' while others consider it 'inaction.' One should demonstrate this through their actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया लोकसंग्रहालागीं । वर्ततां कर्मसंगीं। तो कर्मबंधु आंगीं । वाजैळ ना ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā lokasaṃgrahālāgīṃ | vartatāṃ karmasaṃgīṃ| to karmabaṃdhu āṃgīṃ | vājaiḻa nā || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, for the sake of the welfare of the world, when one acts engaged in karma, the bondage of karma will not affect them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी बहुरुपियांचीं राबो राणी । स्त्रीपुरुषभावो नाहीं मनीं । परी लोकसंपादणी । तैशीच करिती ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī bahurupiyāṃcīṃ rābo rāṇī | strīpuruṣabhāvo nāhīṃ manīṃ | parī lokasaṃpādaṇī | taiśīca karitī || 76||
verses.meaning: Just as actors, though not truly male or female in their hearts, perform their roles as king and queen, so too do they engage in worldly affairs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें पुढिळाचें बोझें। जरी आपुला माथां घेइजे। तरी सांगैं कां न दटिजे। धनुर्धरा॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ puḍhiḻāceṃ bojheṃ| jarī āpulā māthāṃ gheije| tarī sāṃgaiṃ kāṃ na daṭije| dhanurdharā|| 77||
verses.meaning: If one takes on the burden of others upon their own head, then tell me, O Arjuna, why would one not be crushed?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेशीं शुभाशुभें कर्मे। जियें निपजती प्रकृतिधर्मे। तियें मूर्ख मतिभ्रमें। मी कर्ता म्हणे॥७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teśīṃ śubhāśubheṃ karme| jiyeṃ nipajatī prakṛtidharme| tiyeṃ mūrkha matibhrameṃ| mī kartā mhaṇe||78||
verses.meaning: The good and bad actions that arise from the nature of the individual, the foolish person, due to delusion of intellect, says, "I am the doer."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अहंकारादिरूढ। एकदेशी मूढ। तया हा परमार्थ गूढ । प्रगटावा ना॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā ahaṃkārādirūḍha| ekadeśī mūḍha| tayā hā paramārtha gūḍha | pragaṭāvā nā|| 79||
verses.meaning: To such a person, who is deluded by ego and limited in understanding, this ultimate truth will not be revealed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो प्रस्तुत । सांगिजेळ तुज हित। तें अर्जुना देऊनि चित्त। अवधारीं पां॥१८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso prastuta | sāṃgijeḻa tuja hita| teṃ arjunā deūni citta| avadhārīṃ pāṃ||180||
verses.meaning: Let this be. I shall now tell you what is beneficial. Therefore, Arjuna, listen attentively with a focused mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें तत्त्वज्ञानियांच्या ठायीं । प्रकतिभावो नाहीं। जेथ कर्मजात पाहीं । निपजत असे॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ tattvajñāniyāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ | prakatibhāvo nāhīṃ| jetha karmajāta pāhīṃ | nipajata ase|| 89||
verses.meaning: That, in which the philosophers find no trace of material nature, and from which all actions originate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते देहाभिमानु सांडुनी । गुणकर्मे बोलांडुनि। साक्षिभूत होउनी । वर्तती देहीं ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te dehābhimānu sāṃḍunī | guṇakarme bolāṃḍuni| sākṣibhūta hounī | vartatī dehīṃ || 82||
verses.meaning: They abandon the identification with the body, transcend the qualities and actions, and remain as a witness in the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि शरीरी जरी होती। तरी कर्मबंधा नातळती। जैसा कां भूतचेष्टा गभस्ती । घेपवेना ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni śarīrī jarī hotī| tarī karmabaṃdhā nātaḻatī| jaisā kāṃ bhūtaceṣṭā gabhastī | ghepavenā || 83||
verses.meaning: Therefore, even though they reside in the body, they are not entangled by the bonds of karma, just as the actions of a ghost cannot be grasped by the sun.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ कर्मी तोचि लिंपे। जो गुणसंभ्रमें घेपे। प्रकृतीचेनि आटोपें। वर्ततु असे॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha karmī toci liṃpe| jo guṇasaṃbhrameṃ ghepe| prakṛtīceni āṭopeṃ| vartatu ase|| 84||
verses.meaning: Only those who are caught in the illusion of the gunas and act under the sway of prakriti are entangled by karma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इन्द्रियें गुणाधारें। राहाटती निजव्यापारें। तें परकर्म बलात्कारें। आपादी जो॥८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: indriyeṃ guṇādhāreṃ| rāhāṭatī nijavyāpāreṃ| teṃ parakarma balātkāreṃ| āpādī jo||85||
verses.meaning: The senses, based on their inherent qualities, perform their natural functions. But the ignorant person forcibly attributes these actions to himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी उचितें कर्मे आघवीं। तुवां आचरोनि मज अर्पावीं। परी चित्तवृत्ति न्यासावी। आत्मरूपीं ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī uciteṃ karme āghavīṃ| tuvāṃ ācaroni maja arpāvīṃ| parī cittavṛtti nyāsāvī| ātmarūpīṃ || 86||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all proper actions, you should perform and offer to Me. But your mind's inclinations should be placed in the form of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि हें कर्म मी कर्ता। कां आचरैन या अर्था। ऐसा अभिमानु झणें चित्ता। रिगों देसीं ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi heṃ karma mī kartā| kāṃ ācaraina yā arthā| aisā abhimānu jhaṇeṃ cittā| rigoṃ desīṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: And let not the pride that 'I am the doer of this action' or 'I shall perform this' enter your mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुवां शरीरपरा नोहावें। कामनाजात सांडावें। मग अवसरोचित भोगावे । भोग सकळ ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuvāṃ śarīraparā nohāveṃ| kāmanājāta sāṃḍāveṃ| maga avasarocita bhogāve | bhoga sakaḻa || 88 ||
verses.meaning: You should not be attached to the body; abandon all desires. Then, you may experience all enjoyments as appropriate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां कोदंड घेऊनि हातीं । आरूढ पां इयें रथीं। देई आलिंगन वीरवृत्ती । समाधानें ॥८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ kodaṃḍa gheūni hātīṃ | ārūḍha pāṃ iyeṃ rathīṃ| deī āliṃgana vīravṛttī | samādhāneṃ ||89||
verses.meaning: Now, take the bow in your hand, ascend this chariot, and with contentment, embrace the heroic spirit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जगीं कौर्ति रूढवीं। स्वधर्माचा मानु वाढवीं। इया भारापासोनि सोडवीं। मेदिनी हे॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jagīṃ kaurti rūḍhavīṃ| svadharmācā mānu vāḍhavīṃ| iyā bhārāpāsoni soḍavīṃ| medinī he|| 190||
verses.meaning: Establish glory in the world, enhance the honor of one's own dharma, and free this earth from its burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां पार्था निःशंकु होई । या संग्रामा चित्त देई। एथ हें वांचूनि काहीं । बोलों नये॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ pārthā niḥśaṃku hoī | yā saṃgrāmā citta deī| etha heṃ vāṃcūni kāhīṃ | boloṃ naye||91||
verses.meaning: Now, Arjuna, be free from doubt. Focus your mind on this battle. Nothing else should be spoken of here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें अनुपरोध मत माझें। जिहीं परमादरें स्वीकारिजे। श्रद्धापूर्वक अनुष्ठिजे। धनुर्धरा ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ anuparodha mata mājheṃ| jihīṃ paramādareṃ svīkārije| śraddhāpūrvaka anuṣṭhije| dhanurdharā || 92||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, those who respectfully and faithfully accept and follow this unobstructed teaching of mine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेही सकळ कर्मी वर्ततु। जाण पां कर्मरहितु। म्हणौनि हें निश्‍चितु। करणीय गा॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tehī sakaḻa karmī vartatu| jāṇa pāṃ karmarahitu| mhaṇauni heṃ niś‍citu| karaṇīya gā|| 93||
verses.meaning: Even while performing all actions, know that one is actionless. Therefore, this is certainly to be done.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी प्रकृतिमंतु होउनी । इंद्रियां लळा देउनी । जे हें माझें मत अव्हेरुनी । ओसंडिती॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī prakṛtimaṃtu hounī | iṃdriyāṃ laḻā deunī | je heṃ mājheṃ mata avherunī | osaṃḍitī|| 94||
verses.meaning: Or, becoming engrossed in worldly nature, indulging the senses, those who reject this teaching of Mine, overflow with delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे सामान्यत्वें लेखिती। अवज्ञा करूनि देखती। कां हा अर्थवादु म्हणती । वाचाळपणें ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: je sāmānyatveṃ lekhitī| avajñā karūni dekhatī| kāṃ hā arthavādu mhaṇatī | vācāḻapaṇeṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: Those who generally write, or look upon it with disrespect, or dismiss it as mere empty talk, due to their garrulous nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते मोहमदिरा भ्रमळे। विषयविखें घारले। अज्ञानपंकीं बुडाले। निभ्रांत मानीं॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: te mohamadirā bhramaḻe| viṣayavikheṃ ghārale| ajñānapaṃkīṃ buḍāle| nibhrāṃta mānīṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: They are deluded by the wine of infatuation, intoxicated by the poison of worldly pleasures, and drowned in the mire of ignorance; consider this to be absolutely true.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें शवाच्या हातीं दिधलळें। जैसें कां रत्न वायां गेळें। नातरी जात्यंधा पाहलें। प्रमाण नोहे ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ śavācyā hātīṃ didhalaḻeṃ| jaiseṃ kāṃ ratna vāyāṃ geḻeṃ| nātarī jātyaṃdhā pāhaleṃ| pramāṇa nohe || 97||
verses.meaning: Behold, a jewel given into the hands of a corpse is wasted, or a lamp given to one born blind is of no use.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां चंद्राचा उदयो जैसा । उपयोगा न वचे वायसा । मूर्खा विवेकु हा तैसा । रुचेल ना॥९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ caṃdrācā udayo jaisā | upayogā na vace vāyasā | mūrkhā viveku hā taisā | rucela nā||98||
verses.meaning: Just as the rising moon is of no use to a crow, so too, wisdom does not appeal to a fool.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे जे पार्था। विमुख या परमार्था। तयांसी संभाषण सर्वथा। करावें ना॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise je pārthā| vimukha yā paramārthā| tayāṃsī saṃbhāṣaṇa sarvathā| karāveṃ nā|| 99||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, one should never converse with those who are averse to this ultimate truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ते न मानिती। आणि निंदाही करूं लागती । सांगैं पतंगु काय साहती। प्रकाशातें॥ २००॥
