verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni te na mānitī| āṇi niṃdāhī karūṃ lāgatī | sāṃgaiṃ pataṃgu kāya sāhatī| prakāśāteṃ|| 200||
verses.meaning: Therefore, they do not accept it and begin to criticize it. Tell me, can a moth endure the light?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पतंगा दीपीं आलिंगन । तेथ त्यासी अचुक मरण तेवीं विषयाचरण। आत्मघाता॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: pataṃgā dīpīṃ āliṃgana | tetha tyāsī acuka maraṇa tevīṃ viṣayācaraṇa| ātmaghātā|| 1||
verses.meaning: Just as a moth, embracing the flame, meets certain death, so too does indulgence in worldly pleasures lead to self-destruction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि इंद्रियें एके । जाणतेनि पुरुखें। लाळावीं ना कौतुकें। आदिकरुनी॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni iṃdriyeṃ eke | jāṇateni purukheṃ| lāḻāvīṃ nā kautukeṃ| ādikarunī|| 2||
verses.meaning: Therefore, a wise person should not indulge the senses out of curiosity or attachment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा सर्पेसीं खेळों येईल। कीं व्याघरसंसर्ग सिद्धि जाईल सांगे हाळाहाळ जिरेल। सेविलिया काई ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā sarpesīṃ kheḻoṃ yeīla| kīṃ vyāgharasaṃsarga siddhi jāīla sāṃge hāḻāhāḻa jirela| seviliyā kāī || 3||
verses.meaning: Can one play with snakes? Or will association with tigers bring success? Tell me, will poison be digested if consumed?

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें खेळतां अग्नि लागला । मग तो न सांबरे जैसा उधबला। तेसा इंद्रियां लळा दिधला। भला नोहे ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ kheḻatāṃ agni lāgalā | maga to na sāṃbare jaisā udhabalā| tesā iṃdriyāṃ laḻā didhalā| bhalā nohe || 4||
verses.meaning: Behold, if fire is ignited playfully, it cannot be contained once it blazes up. Similarly, indulging the senses is not good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी अर्जुना। या शरीरा पराधीना । कां नाना भोगरचना। मेळवावी ॥ ५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī arjunā| yā śarīrā parādhīnā | kāṃ nānā bhogaracanā| meḻavāvī || 5 ||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, Arjuna, why should one accumulate various pleasures for this dependent body?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपण सायासेंकरुनि बहुतें। सकळही समृब्द्विजातें । उदोअस्तु या देहातें। प्रतिपाळावें कां॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpaṇa sāyāseṃkaruni bahuteṃ| sakaḻahī samṛbdvijāteṃ | udoastu yā dehāteṃ| pratipāḻāveṃ kāṃ|| 6||
verses.meaning: Why should one, with great effort, nurture this body, which is subject to rise and fall, and all its worldly possessions?

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्वस्वे शिणोनि एथें। अर्जवाबीं संपत्तिजातें । तेणें स्वधर्म सांडूनि देहातें । पोखावें काई ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarvasve śiṇoni etheṃ| arjavābīṃ saṃpattijāteṃ | teṇeṃ svadharma sāṃḍūni dehāteṃ | pokhāveṃ kāī || 7||
verses.meaning: Having exhausted all resources here, and having acquired wealth through supplication, should one then abandon their own dharma and merely nourish the body?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग हें तंव पांचमेळावा। शेखीं अनुसरेल पंचत्वा। ते वेळीं केला कें गिंवसावा। शीणु आपुला॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga heṃ taṃva pāṃcameḻāvā| śekhīṃ anusarela paṃcatvā| te veḻīṃ kelā keṃ giṃvasāvā| śīṇu āpulā|| 8||
verses.meaning: This body, a mere assembly of five elements, will ultimately dissolve into those very five elements. At that time, how will one find the fruit of their efforts?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि केवळ देहभरण । ते जाणें उघडी नागवण । यालागीं एथ अंतःकरण । देयावेंना॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kevaḻa dehabharaṇa | te jāṇeṃ ughaḍī nāgavaṇa | yālāgīṃ etha aṃtaḥkaraṇa | deyāveṃnā|| 9||
verses.meaning: Therefore, merely nourishing the body is a clear deception. For this reason, one should not dedicate their inner self to it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱहवी इंद्रियांचिया अर्था-। सारिखा विषो पोखितां। संतोषु कौर चित्ता। आपजेलळ॥ २१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟahavī iṃdriyāṃciyā arthā-| sārikhā viṣo pokhitāṃ| saṃtoṣu kaura cittā| āpajelaḻa|| 210||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, if one nourishes the senses with their objects, how will satisfaction arise in the mind?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तो संवबचोराचा सांगातु। जैसा नावेक स्वस्थु। जंब नगराचा प्रांतु। सांडिजेना ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī to saṃvabacorācā sāṃgātu| jaisā nāveka svasthu| jaṃba nagarācā prāṃtu| sāṃḍijenā || 91||
verses.meaning: But the company of a thief is only temporarily peaceful, as long as the city limits are not yet left behind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बापा विषाची मधुरता । झणें आवडी उपजे चित्ता । परी तो परिणामु विचारितां। प्राणु हरी ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāpā viṣācī madhuratā | jhaṇeṃ āvaḍī upaje cittā | parī to pariṇāmu vicāritāṃ| prāṇu harī || 12||
verses.meaning: Oh father, poison may taste sweet, and the mind may desire it, but considering its outcome, it takes one's life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें इंद्रियीं कामु असे। तो लावी सुखदुराशे । जैसा गळीं मीनु आमिषें। भुलविजे गा॥१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ iṃdriyīṃ kāmu ase| to lāvī sukhadurāśe | jaisā gaḻīṃ mīnu āmiṣeṃ| bhulavije gā||13||
verses.meaning: Behold, desire resides in the senses, and it entices with the false hope of pleasure, just as a fish is lured by bait on a hook.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तयामाजीं गळु आहे। जो प्राणातें घेऊनि जाये। तो जैसा 'ठाउवा नोहे। झांकळेपणें ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī tayāmājīṃ gaḻu āhe| jo prāṇāteṃ gheūni jāye| to jaisā 'ṭhāuvā nohe| jhāṃkaḻepaṇeṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: But within it is a snare, which takes away life. It is like something unknown, hidden by its very nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें अभिलाषें येणें कीजेळ। विषयांची दड श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आशा धरिजेल। तरी वरपडा होईजेल। क्रोधानळा ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ abhilāṣeṃ yeṇeṃ kījeḻa| viṣayāṃcī daḍa śrījñāneśvarī āśā dharijela| tarī varapaḍā hoījela| krodhānaḻā || 15||
verses.meaning: Just as by such desires, if one holds onto the hope of worldly pleasures, one will surely fall prey to the fire of anger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा कवळोनियां पारधी । घातेचिये संधी । आणी मृगातें बुद्धि। साधावया॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā kavaḻoniyāṃ pāradhī | ghāteciye saṃdhī | āṇī mṛgāteṃ buddhi| sādhāvayā|| 16||
verses.meaning: Just as a hunter, having cornered a deer, brings it to a trap by cunning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ तैसीचि परी आहे। म्हणूनि संगु हा तुज नोहे। पार्था दोन्ही कामक्रोध हे। घातुक जाणें ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha taisīci parī āhe| mhaṇūni saṃgu hā tuja nohe| pārthā donhī kāmakrodha he| ghātuka jāṇeṃ || 17||
verses.meaning: The situation here is similar. Therefore, O Partha, these two, desire and anger, are not your companions; know them to be destructive.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि हा आश्रोचि न करावा। मनेंहि आठवो न धरावा । एकु निजवृत्तीचा बोलावा । नासों नेदी॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni hā āśroci na karāvā| maneṃhi āṭhavo na dharāvā | eku nijavṛttīcā bolāvā | nāsoṃ nedī|| 18||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should not even take refuge in this (worldly attachment), nor should one even remember it in the mind. Only the call of one's true nature (self-realization) does not allow one to be destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा स्वधर्मु हा आपुलळा। जरी कां कठिणु जाहला। तरी हाचि अनुष्ठिला। भला देखें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā svadharmu hā āpulaḻā| jarī kāṃ kaṭhiṇu jāhalā| tarī hāci anuṣṭhilā| bhalā dekheṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: Oh, even if one's own dharma becomes difficult, I see that following it is indeed good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरु आचारु जो परावा। तो देखतां कौर बरवा । परी आचरतेनि आचरावा। आपुलाचि॥ २२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeru ācāru jo parāvā| to dekhatāṃ kaura baravā | parī ācarateni ācarāvā| āpulāci|| 220||
verses.meaning: Any conduct that appears good when observed by others, should be adopted as one's own only if it is truly good for oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगैं शूद्रघरीं आधवीं। पक्वान्ने आहाति बरवीं। तीं द्विजें केवीं सेवावीं। दुर्बळु जरी जाहला॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgaiṃ śūdragharīṃ ādhavīṃ| pakvānne āhāti baravīṃ| tīṃ dvijeṃ kevīṃ sevāvīṃ| durbaḻu jarī jāhalā|| 29||
verses.meaning: Tell me, if delicious dishes are prepared in a Shudra's house, how can a Brahmin partake of them, even if he is weak with hunger?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें अनुचित कैसेनि कौजे। अग्राह्य केवीं इच्छिजे। अथवा इच्छिलेंही पाविजे। विचारीं पां॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ anucita kaiseni kauje| agrāhya kevīṃ icchije| athavā icchileṃhī pāvije| vicārīṃ pāṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: How can this improper thing be praised? How can that which is unacceptable be desired? Or, even if desired, how can it be attained? Consider this carefully.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी लोकांचीं धवळारें। देखोनियां मनोहरें। असतीं आपुलीं तणारें। मोडावीं केवीं ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī lokāṃcīṃ dhavaḻāreṃ| dekhoniyāṃ manohareṃ| asatīṃ āpulīṃ taṇāreṃ| moḍāvīṃ kevīṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: When one sees the beautiful, grand mansions of others, how can one then demolish one's own humble hut?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो वनिता आपुली । कुरूप जरी जाहली। तऱही भोगितां तेचि भली । जियापरी॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso vanitā āpulī | kurūpa jarī jāhalī| taṟahī bhogitāṃ teci bhalī | jiyāparī|| 24||
verses.meaning: Just as a man, even if his wife is unattractive, still finds satisfaction in her company,

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं आवडे तैसा सांकडु। आचरतां जरी दुवाडु । तऱही स्वधर्मुचि सुरवाडु। परत्रींचा ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ āvaḍe taisā sāṃkaḍu| ācaratāṃ jarī duvāḍu | taṟahī svadharmuci suravāḍu| paratrīṃcā || 25||
verses.meaning: Just as one might find it difficult to follow their own dharma, even if it is challenging, it is still the most beneficial path for the afterlife.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा साकर आणि दूध हें गौल्य कौर प्रसिध्द । परी कृमिदोषीं विरुद्ध। घेपे केवीं ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā sākara āṇi dūdha heṃ gaulya kaura prasidhda | parī kṛmidoṣīṃ viruddha| ghepe kevīṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: Indeed, sugar and milk are famously sweet, but how can they be consumed by one afflicted with intestinal worms?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनिही जरी सेविजेळ। तरी ते अळुकीचि उरेल। जे तें परिणामीं पथ्य नव्हेल। धनुर्धरा॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisenihī jarī sevijeḻa| tarī te aḻukīci urela| je teṃ pariṇāmīṃ pathya navhela| dhanurdharā|| 27||
verses.meaning: Even if it is served in this manner, it will remain a mere craving, for it will not prove beneficial in the end, O Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आणिकांसी जें विहित। आणि आपणपेयां अनुचित । तें नाचरावें जरी हित। वबिचारिजे॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āṇikāṃsī jeṃ vihita| āṇi āpaṇapeyāṃ anucita | teṃ nācarāveṃ jarī hita| vabicārije|| 28||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that which is prescribed for others, but is improper for oneself, should not be practiced, even if it seems beneficial.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या स्वधर्मातें अनुष्ठितां। वेंचु होईल जीविता । तोहि निका वर उभयतां। दिसत असे॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā svadharmāteṃ anuṣṭhitāṃ| veṃcu hoīla jīvitā | tohi nikā vara ubhayatāṃ| disata ase|| 29||
verses.meaning: Even if one's life is spent in the performance of one's own dharma, that too appears to be excellent for both worlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें समस्तसुरशिरोमणी। बोलिले जेथ शार्जुुपाणी। तेथ अर्जुन म्हणे विनवणी । असे देवा॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ samastasuraśiromaṇī| bolile jetha śārjuupāṇī| tetha arjuna mhaṇe vinavaṇī | ase devā|| 230||
verses.meaning: When the Lord, the crown jewel of all gods, spoke thus, Arjuna humbly submitted, "O Lord!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जें तुम्हीं सांगितलें। तें सकळ कौर म्यां परिसिलें। तरी आतां पुसेन कांहीं आपलें। अपेक्षित ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jeṃ tumhīṃ sāṃgitaleṃ| teṃ sakaḻa kaura myāṃ parisileṃ| tarī ātāṃ pusena kāṃhīṃ āpaleṃ| apekṣita || 39||
verses.meaning: All that you have explained, I have heard completely. Now, I will ask something that I desire to know.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी देवा हें ऐसें कैसें। जे ज्ञानियांही स्थिति भ्रंशे। मार्गु सांडुनी अनारिसे। चालत देखो ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī devā heṃ aiseṃ kaiseṃ| je jñāniyāṃhī sthiti bhraṃśe| mārgu sāṃḍunī anārise| cālata dekho || 32||
verses.meaning: O Lord, how is it that even the wise can fall from their state, abandoning the right path and going astray?

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्वज्ञुही जे होती । हेयोपादेयही जाणती । तेही परधर्मे व्यभिचरति। कवणें गुणें॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarvajñuhī je hotī | heyopādeyahī jāṇatī | tehī paradharme vyabhicarati| kavaṇeṃ guṇeṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: Even those who are omniscient and know what is to be accepted and what is to be rejected, deviate from their own dharma by following another's dharma. By what quality do they do this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: बीजा आणि भूसा। अंधु निवाडू नेणे जैसा । नावेक देखणाही तैसा । बरळे कां पां॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: bījā āṇi bhūsā| aṃdhu nivāḍū neṇe jaisā | nāveka dekhaṇāhī taisā | baraḻe kāṃ pāṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: Just as a blind person cannot distinguish between a seed and its husk, why would even a partially sighted person babble on about such a distinction?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे असता संगु सांडिती। तेचि संसर्गु करितां न धाती । बनवासीही सेविती । जनपदातें॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: je asatā saṃgu sāṃḍitī| teci saṃsargu karitāṃ na dhātī | banavāsīhī sevitī | janapadāteṃ|| 35 ||
verses.meaning: Those who renounce worldly attachments, even when they engage in worldly affairs, do not become entangled. Even hermits living in forests serve the people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपण तरी लपती। सर्वस्वें पाप चुकविती। परी बळात्कारें सुइुजती । 'तयाचिमाजीं ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpaṇa tarī lapatī| sarvasveṃ pāpa cukavitī| parī baḻātkāreṃ suiujatī | 'tayācimājīṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: Even if they try to hide themselves, completely avoiding all sin, they are still forcibly drawn into it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाची जीवें घेती विवसी। तेचि जडोनि ठाके जीवेंसीं । चुकवितां ते गिंवसी। तयातेंचि ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayācī jīveṃ ghetī vivasī| teci jaḍoni ṭhāke jīveṃsīṃ | cukavitāṃ te giṃvasī| tayāteṃci || 37||
verses.meaning: That which the living beings seek with their very life, that very thing becomes fixed in their life. If they try to avoid it, it pursues them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा बलात्कारु एकु दिसे। तो कवणाचा एथ आग्रहो असे। हें बोलावें हृषीकेशें। पार्थ म्हणे॥३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā balātkāru eku dise| to kavaṇācā etha āgraho ase| heṃ bolāveṃ hṛṣīkeśeṃ| pārtha mhaṇe||38||
verses.meaning: Arjuna said, "Such a forceful act is seen; whose insistence is this here? Hrishikesha, please explain this."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव हृदयकमळआरामु। जो योगियांचा निष्काम कामु। तो म्हणतसे पुरुषोत्तमु। सांगेन आइक ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva hṛdayakamaḻaārāmu| jo yogiyāṃcā niṣkāma kāmu| to mhaṇatase puruṣottamu| sāṃgena āika || 39||
verses.meaning: Then the Supreme Being, who is the resting place in the lotus of the heart, the selfless desire of yogis, said, "I will tell you, listen."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी हे काम क्रोधु पाहीं । जयांतें कृपेची सांठवण नाहीं। हें कृतांताच्या ठायीं । मानिजती ॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī he kāma krodhu pāhīṃ | jayāṃteṃ kṛpecī sāṃṭhavaṇa nāhīṃ| heṃ kṛtāṃtācyā ṭhāyīṃ | mānijatī || 240||
verses.meaning: Therefore, these desires and anger, in whom there is no store of compassion, are considered to be like death itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे ज्ञाननिधीचे भुजंग । विषयदरीचे वाघ । भजनमार्गीचे मांग । मारक जे॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: he jñānanidhīce bhujaṃga | viṣayadarīce vāgha | bhajanamārgīce māṃga | māraka je|| 49||
verses.meaning: These (senses) are like serpents guarding the treasure of knowledge, tigers in the valley of worldly pleasures, and hunters on the path of devotion, indeed they are destroyers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे देहदुर्गींचे धोंड । इंद्रियग्रामींचे कोंड । यांचें व्यामोहादिक दबड। जगावरी॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: he dehadurgīṃce dhoṃḍa | iṃdriyagrāmīṃce koṃḍa | yāṃceṃ vyāmohādika dabaḍa| jagāvarī|| 42||
verses.meaning: These strongholds of the body, these prisons of the senses, their delusive power holds sway over the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे रजोगुण मानसींचे । समूळ आसुरियेचे । धाळेपण ययांचें। अविद्या केळें॥ ४३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: he rajoguṇa mānasīṃce | samūḻa āsuriyece | dhāḻepaṇa yayāṃceṃ| avidyā keḻeṃ|| 43 ||
verses.meaning: This rajas attribute, residing in the mind, is entirely demonic in nature. Its wildness is nurtured by ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे रजाचे कौर जाहले) परी तमासी पढियंते भळे। तेणें निजपद यां दिधलें। प्रमादमोहो ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: he rajāce kaura jāhale) parī tamāsī paḍhiyaṃte bhaḻe| teṇeṃ nijapada yāṃ didhaleṃ| pramādamoho || 44||
verses.meaning: These (Kauravas) were born of Rajas (passion), yet they were fond of Tamas (ignorance). Therefore, Tamas bestowed upon them their own state of delusion and error.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे मृत्यूच्या नगरीं । मानिजती निकियापरी । जे जीविताचे वैरी । म्हणौनियां ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: he mṛtyūcyā nagarīṃ | mānijatī nikiyāparī | je jīvitāce vairī | mhaṇauniyāṃ || 45 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in the city of death, those who are enemies of life are considered good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांसि भुकेलिया आमिषा। हें विश्व न पुरेचि घांसा। कुळवाडियांचिया आशा । चाळीत असे॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃsi bhukeliyā āmiṣā| heṃ viśva na pureci ghāṃsā| kuḻavāḍiyāṃciyā āśā | cāḻīta ase|| 46||
verses.meaning: For those who hunger for worldly pleasures, this entire universe is not enough even for a single morsel. They are like farmers who cultivate their hopes, ever seeking more.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कौतुकें कवळितां मुठीं।॥ जिये चवदा भुवनें थेंकुटी । तिये भ्रांतिही धाकुटी । वाल्हीदुल्ही ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kautukeṃ kavaḻitāṃ muṭhīṃ||| jiye cavadā bhuvaneṃ theṃkuṭī | tiye bhrāṃtihī dhākuṭī | vālhīdulhī || 47||
verses.meaning: When the fourteen worlds are playfully held in a fist, even that illusion is smaller than a tiny creeper.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें लोकत्रयाचें भातुकें । खेळतांचि खाय कवतिकें । तिच्या दासीपणाचेनि बिकें । तृष्णा जिये॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ lokatrayāceṃ bhātukeṃ | kheḻatāṃci khāya kavatikeṃ | ticyā dāsīpaṇāceni bikeṃ | tṛṣṇā jiye|| 48||
verses.meaning: She playfully consumes the entire three worlds as if they were a mere meal. By virtue of her servitude, even desire itself comes into being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो मोहें मानिजे। यांतें अहंकारें घेपे दीजे । जेणें जग आपुलेनि भोजें। नाचवीत असे॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso moheṃ mānije| yāṃteṃ ahaṃkāreṃ ghepe dīje | jeṇeṃ jaga āpuleni bhojeṃ| nācavīta ase|| 49||
verses.meaning: Let this be, it is considered by delusion. It is taken and given by ego, by which the world is made to dance to its own tune.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें सत्याचा भोकसा ६६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी काढिला । मग अकृत्य तृणकुटा भरिला। तो दंभु रूढविला। जगीं इहीं ॥ २५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ satyācā bhokasā 66 śrījñāneśvarī kāḍhilā | maga akṛtya tṛṇakuṭā bharilā| to daṃbhu rūḍhavilā| jagīṃ ihīṃ || 250||
verses.meaning: They (the hypocrites) uprooted the very foundation of truth and filled that void with the worthless straw of unrighteous deeds, thereby establishing hypocrisy firmly in the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साध्वी शांति नागविली । मग माया मांगी शृंगारिली । तियेकरवीं विटाळविलीं । साधुवृंदें ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: sādhvī śāṃti nāgavilī | maga māyā māṃgī śṛṃgārilī | tiyekaravīṃ viṭāḻavilīṃ | sādhuvṛṃdeṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: The chaste peace was then defiled. Then Maya, the enchantress, adorned herself, and through her, the assemblies of saints were polluted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहीं विवेकाची त्राय फेडिली । वैराग्याची खाली काढिली । जितया मान मोडिली। उपशमाची ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃ vivekācī trāya pheḍilī | vairāgyācī khālī kāḍhilī | jitayā māna moḍilī| upaśamācī || 52||
verses.meaning: These (the senses) have destroyed the shield of discrimination, cast down the foundation of dispassion, and broken the living pride of tranquility.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहीं संतोषवन खांडिलें। धैेर्यदुर्ग 'पाडिले। आनंदरोप सांडिले। उपडूनियां ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃ saṃtoṣavana khāṃḍileṃ| dhaieryadurga 'pāḍile| ānaṃdaropa sāṃḍile| upaḍūniyāṃ || 53||
verses.meaning: With these, satisfaction was shattered, the fortress of courage was demolished, and the tree of joy was uprooted and cast aside.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहीं बोधाचीं रोपें लुंचिलीं। सुखाची लिपी पुसिली । जिव्हारी आगी सूदली । तापत्रयाची ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃ bodhācīṃ ropeṃ luṃcilīṃ| sukhācī lipī pusilī | jivhārī āgī sūdalī | tāpatrayācī || 54||
verses.meaning: These (worldly attachments) have uprooted the saplings of spiritual knowledge, erased the scripture of happiness, and ignited the fire of the three miseries (Adhyatmika, Adhidaivika, Adhibhautika) in the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे आंगा तंब घडले। जीवींची आथी जडळले। परी नातुडती गिंबसिले। ब्रह्मादिकां ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: he āṃgā taṃba ghaḍale| jīvīṃcī āthī jaḍaḻale| parī nātuḍatī giṃbasile| brahmādikāṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: This body is made of the five elements, and the soul is intertwined within it. Yet, even great beings like Brahma cannot grasp its true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे चैतन्याचे शेजारीं । वसती ज्ञानाच्या एका हारीं । म्हणोनि प्रवर्तळे महामारी । सांबवरती ना॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: he caitanyāce śejārīṃ | vasatī jñānācyā ekā hārīṃ | mhaṇoni pravartaḻe mahāmārī | sāṃbavaratī nā|| 56||
verses.meaning: These (senses) reside in the vicinity of consciousness, in the same row as knowledge. Therefore, the great delusion (of worldly existence) prevails, O Sambhu (Shiva).

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे जळेंबीण बुडविती । आगीवीण जाळिती। न बोलतां 'कवळिती। प्राणियांतें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: he jaḻeṃbīṇa buḍavitī | āgīvīṇa jāḻitī| na bolatāṃ 'kavaḻitī| prāṇiyāṃteṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: They drown without water, burn without fire, and embrace living beings without speaking.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे शस्त्रेंबीण साधिती । दोरेंबीण बांधिती । ज्ञानियांसी तरी बधिती। पैज घेउनि॥५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: he śastreṃbīṇa sādhitī | doreṃbīṇa bāṃdhitī | jñāniyāṃsī tarī badhitī| paija gheuni||58||
verses.meaning: They accomplish tasks without weapons, bind without ropes, and even challenge the wise to a wager, defeating them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे चिखलेंबीण रोंबिती। 'पाशिकेंबीण गोंविती। हे कवणाजोगे न होती । आंतौटेपणें ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: he cikhaleṃbīṇa roṃbitī| 'pāśikeṃbīṇa goṃvitī| he kavaṇājoge na hotī | āṃtauṭepaṇeṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: These (actions) are like planting without mud, or stringing beads without a thread. They are of no use due to their inherent futility.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी चंदनाची मुळी । गिंवसोनि घेपे व्याळीं । नातरी उल्बाची खोळी । गर्भस्थासी ॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī caṃdanācī muḻī | giṃvasoni ghepe vyāḻīṃ | nātarī ulbācī khoḻī | garbhasthāsī || 260||
verses.meaning: Just as a snake seeks out the root of a sandalwood tree, or as an embryo is enveloped by the amnion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां प्रभावीण भानु । धूमेंबीण हुताशनु। जैसा दर्पण मळहीनु। कहींच नसे॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ prabhāvīṇa bhānu | dhūmeṃbīṇa hutāśanu| jaisā darpaṇa maḻahīnu| kahīṃca nase|| 61||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun is inherently radiant, fire is inherently free from smoke, and a mirror is inherently free from blemish, so too is the true nature of the self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें इहींबीण एकलें। आम्हीं ज्ञान नाहीं देखिलें। जैसें कोंडेनि पां गुंतलें। बीज निपजे॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ ihīṃbīṇa ekaleṃ| āmhīṃ jñāna nāhīṃ dekhileṃ| jaiseṃ koṃḍeni pāṃ guṃtaleṃ| bīja nipaje|| 62||
verses.meaning: Similarly, without these (qualities), I have not seen knowledge existing alone, just as a seed entangled in a husk does not sprout.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें ज्ञान तरी शुद्ध । परी इहीं असे प्ररुद्ध । म्हणोनि तें अगाध । होऊनि ठेलें॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jñāna tarī śuddha | parī ihīṃ ase praruddha | mhaṇoni teṃ agādha | hoūni ṭheleṃ||63||
verses.meaning: Similarly, though knowledge is pure, it is obscured by these (worldly attachments), and therefore it remains profound and unattainable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधीं यांतें जिणावें। मग तें ज्ञान पाबावें। तंव पराभवो न संभवे । रागद्वेषां॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhīṃ yāṃteṃ jiṇāveṃ| maga teṃ jñāna pābāveṃ| taṃva parābhavo na saṃbhave | rāgadveṣāṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: First, one must conquer these (desire and aversion). Only then can one attain that knowledge, and then defeat by attachment and hatred becomes impossible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यांतें साधावयालागीं। जे बळ आणिजे आंगीं । तें इंधनें जैसी आगी । सावाबो होय ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāṃteṃ sādhāvayālāgīṃ| je baḻa āṇije āṃgīṃ | teṃ iṃdhaneṃ jaisī āgī | sāvābo hoya || 65 ||
verses.meaning: To achieve these, the strength that is brought into the body, just as fuel makes fire stronger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे उपाय कौजती जे जे। ते यांसीचि होती विरजे । म्हणौनि हटियांतें जिणिजे । इहींचि जगीं ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise upāya kaujatī je je| te yāṃsīci hotī viraje | mhaṇauni haṭiyāṃteṃ jiṇije | ihīṃci jagīṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: Similarly, all the efforts and remedies that are undertaken, they too become purified and effective through these very means. Therefore, the stubbornness of the mind is conquered in this world by these very practices.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसियांही सांकडां बोला। एक उपायो आहे भला। तो करितां जरी आंगवला। तरी सांगेन तुज ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyāṃhī sāṃkaḍāṃ bolā| eka upāyo āhe bhalā| to karitāṃ jarī āṃgavalā| tarī sāṃgena tuja || 67||
verses.meaning: Even in such a difficult situation, there is one excellent solution. If you are able to adopt it, then I will tell it to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यांचा पहिला कुरुठा इंद्रियें। एथूनि प्रवृत्ति कर्मातें विये। आधीं निर्दळूनि घालीं तियें। सर्वथैव ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāṃcā pahilā kuruṭhā iṃdriyeṃ| ethūni pravṛtti karmāteṃ viye| ādhīṃ nirdaḻūni ghālīṃ tiyeṃ| sarvathaiva || 68||
verses.meaning: The senses are the primary abode of these (vices). From there, actions are born. First, completely destroy them (the senses).

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग मनाची धांव पारुषेळ। आणि बुद्धीची सोडवण होईल। इतुकेन थारा मोडेल। या पापियांचा ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga manācī dhāṃva pāruṣeḻa| āṇi buddhīcī soḍavaṇa hoīla| itukena thārā moḍela| yā pāpiyāṃcā || 69||
verses.meaning: Then the mind's restless pursuit will cease, and the intellect will be liberated. With this, the stronghold of these sinners will be broken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे अंतरींहूनि जरी फिटले। तरी निश्रांत जाण निवटले। जैसें रश्मीवीण उरलें। मृगजळ नाहीं ॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he aṃtarīṃhūni jarī phiṭale| tarī niśrāṃta jāṇa nivaṭale| jaiseṃ raśmīvīṇa uraleṃ| mṛgajaḻa nāhīṃ || 270||
verses.meaning: If these (desires) are removed from within, then know that they are completely eradicated, just as a mirage does not remain without the sun's rays.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे रागद्वेष जरी निमाळे। तरी ब्रह्मींचें स्वराज्य आलें। मग तो भोगी सुख आपुलें आपणचि ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise rāgadveṣa jarī nimāḻe| tarī brahmīṃceṃ svarājya āleṃ| maga to bhogī sukha āpuleṃ āpaṇaci || 71||
verses.meaning: Similarly, if anger and hatred are extinguished, then the sovereignty of Brahman is attained. Then, one experiences their own happiness by themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते गुरुशिष्याची गोठी । पदपिंडाची गांठी । तेथ स्थिर राहोनि नुठी। कवणे काळीं ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te guruśiṣyācī goṭhī | padapiṃḍācī gāṃṭhī | tetha sthira rāhoni nuṭhī| kavaṇe kāḻīṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: The conversation between the Guru and disciple, the knot of the body and soul, remains steadfast and never departs at any time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें सकळ सिद्धांचा रावो। देवी लक्ष्मीयेचा नाहो। राया ऐकें देवदेवो। बोलता जाहला ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ sakaḻa siddhāṃcā rāvo| devī lakṣmīyecā nāho| rāyā aikeṃ devadevo| bolatā jāhalā || 73||
verses.meaning: Thus spoke the Lord of Lords, the King of all Siddhas, the consort of Goddess Lakshmi, saying, "O King, listen!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां पुनरपि तो अनंतु। आद्य एकी मातु । सांगैळ तेथ पंडुसुतु। प्रश्‍नु करील ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ punarapi to anaṃtu| ādya ekī mātu | sāṃgaiḻa tetha paṃḍusutu| praś‍nu karīla || 74||
verses.meaning: Now, when that infinite, primeval being is about to reveal another matter, the son of Pandu will pose a question.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया बोलाचा हन पाडु । कां रसवृत्तीचा निवाडु । येणें श्रोतयां होईल सुरवाडु । श्रवणसुखाचा ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā bolācā hana pāḍu | kāṃ rasavṛttīcā nivāḍu | yeṇeṃ śrotayāṃ hoīla suravāḍu | śravaṇasukhācā || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, the words will be arranged, or the essence of their meaning will be extracted, so that the listeners may experience the delight of hearing, a true feast for their ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे निवृत्तीचा । चांग उठावा करूनि उन्मेषाचा। मग संवादु श्रीहरिपार्थाचा । भोगावा बापा ॥ २७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñānadevo mhaṇe nivṛttīcā | cāṃga uṭhāvā karūni unmeṣācā| maga saṃvādu śrīharipārthācā | bhogāvā bāpā || 276||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev says, "May the good fortune of Nivritti's awakening arise, so that we may then partake in the dialogue between Shri Hari and Partha, my child."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आजि श्रवणेंद्रियां पाहलें। जें येणें गीतानिधान देखिलें। आतां स्वप्नचि हें तुकलें। साचासरिसें ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āji śravaṇeṃdriyāṃ pāhaleṃ| jeṃ yeṇeṃ gītānidhāna dekhileṃ| ātāṃ svapnaci heṃ tukaleṃ| sācāsariseṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Today, the ears have been blessed, for they have witnessed this treasure of the Gita. Now, this dream has been weighed and found to be as true as reality itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधींचि विवेकाची गोठी । वरी प्रतिपादी श्रीकृष्ण जगजेठी। आणि भकक्‍्तराजु किरिटी । परिसत असे॥२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhīṃci vivekācī goṭhī | varī pratipādī śrīkṛṣṇa jagajeṭhī| āṇi bhakak‍tarāju kiriṭī | parisata ase||2||
verses.meaning: The discussion itself was already profound, and on top of that, Lord Krishna, the master of the universe, was expounding it, while Arjuna, the king among devotees, was listening intently.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा पंचमालापु सुगंधु। कीं परिमळु आणि सुस्वादु। तैसा भला जाहला विनोदु । कथेचा इये ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā paṃcamālāpu sugaṃdhu| kīṃ parimaḻu āṇi susvādu| taisā bhalā jāhalā vinodu | kathecā iye || 3||
verses.meaning: Just as the five elements possess a fragrant essence, or a delightful aroma and sweet taste, so too has this narrative become a source of great joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसी आगळिक दैवाची । जे गंगा जोडली अमृताची । हो कां जपतपें श्रोतयांचीं । फळा आलीं ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaisī āgaḻika daivācī | je gaṃgā joḍalī amṛtācī | ho kāṃ japatapeṃ śrotayāṃcīṃ | phaḻā ālīṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: How wonderful is this divine grace, that the Ganga of immortality has been attained! Or perhaps, it is the fruit of the listeners' penance and spiritual practices.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां इंद्रियजात आघवें। तिहीं श्रवणाचें घर रिघावें। मग संवादसुख भोगावें । गीताख्य हें ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ iṃdriyajāta āghaveṃ| tihīṃ śravaṇāceṃ ghara righāveṃ| maga saṃvādasukha bhogāveṃ | gītākhya heṃ || 5||
verses.meaning: Now, all the senses should enter the abode of hearing, and then experience the joy of this dialogue, which is called the Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा अतिसो अतिप्रसंगें । सांडूनि कथाचि ते सांगे । जे कृष्णार्जुन दोघे । बोळत होते॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā atiso atiprasaṃgeṃ | sāṃḍūni kathāci te sāṃge | je kṛṣṇārjuna doghe | boḻata hote|| 6||
verses.meaning: This is an extraordinary and opportune moment. Let us set aside other narratives and tell only that story where Krishna and Arjuna were conversing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वेळीं संजयो रायातें म्हणे । अर्जुनु अधिष्ठिला दैवगुणें। जे अतिप्रीति श्री नारायणें। बोलतु असे॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: te veḻīṃ saṃjayo rāyāteṃ mhaṇe | arjunu adhiṣṭhilā daivaguṇeṃ| je atiprīti śrī nārāyaṇeṃ| bolatu ase|| 7||
verses.meaning: At that time, Sanjaya said to the King, "Arjuna, blessed by divine fortune, is being addressed with great affection by Shri Narayana."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें न संगेचि पितया वसुदेवासी । जें न संगेचि माते देवकीसी। जें न संगेचि बंधु बळिभद्रासी। तें गुह्य अर्जुनेंशीं बोलत ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ na saṃgeci pitayā vasudevāsī | jeṃ na saṃgeci māte devakīsī| jeṃ na saṃgeci baṃdhu baḻibhadrāsī| teṃ guhya arjuneṃśīṃ bolata || 8||
verses.meaning: That which was not spoken to father Vasudeva, that which was not spoken to mother Devaki, that which was not spoken to brother Balabhadra, that secret was spoken to Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवी लक्ष्मीयेवढी जवळिक। परी तेही न देखे या प्रेमाचें सुख। आजि कृष्णस्नेहाचें बिक। यातेंचि आथी॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: devī lakṣmīyevaḍhī javaḻika| parī tehī na dekhe yā premāceṃ sukha| āji kṛṣṇasnehāceṃ bika| yāteṃci āthī|| 9||
verses.meaning: Even Goddess Lakshmi, who is so close to Him, does not experience the joy of this love. Today, the seed of Krishna's affection resides within this very love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सनकादिकांचिया आशा । वाढीनल्या होतिया कीर बहुवसा। परी त्याही येणें मानें यशा । येतीचिना॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: sanakādikāṃciyā āśā | vāḍhīnalyā hotiyā kīra bahuvasā| parī tyāhī yeṇeṃ māneṃ yaśā | yetīcinā|| 10||
verses.meaning: The hopes of sages like Sanaka and others, though they had grown immensely, could not attain fulfillment in this manner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या जगदीशवराचें प्रेम। एथ दिसतसे निरुपम | कैसें पार्थ येणें सर्वोत्तम । पुण्य केलें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā jagadīśavarāceṃ prema| etha disatase nirupama | kaiseṃ pārtha yeṇeṃ sarvottama | puṇya keleṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: The unparalleled love of the Lord of the Universe is evident here. What supreme merit has Arjuna accumulated to deserve this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां जयाचिया प्रीती । अमूर्त हा आला व्यक्ती) मज एकवंकी याची स्थिति) आवडतु असे॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ jayāciyā prītī | amūrta hā ālā vyaktī) maja ekavaṃkī yācī sthiti) āvaḍatu ase|| 12||
verses.meaning: Indeed, by whose love this formless one has taken on a personal form, I find this singular state of His very pleasing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं हा योगियां नाडळे। वेदार्थासी नाकळे । जेथ ध्यानाचेही डोळे । पावतीना ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ hā yogiyāṃ nāḍaḻe| vedārthāsī nākaḻe | jetha dhyānācehī ḍoḻe | pāvatīnā || 13||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, this (state) is unattainable for yogis, incomprehensible to the meaning of the Vedas, and even the eyes of meditation cannot reach it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो हा निजस्वरूप। अनादि निष्कंप। परी कवणें मानें सकृप। जाहला आहे॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to hā nijasvarūpa| anādi niṣkaṃpa| parī kavaṇeṃ māneṃ sakṛpa| jāhalā āhe|| 14||
verses.meaning: That very Self, eternal and unwavering, yet by what measure has it become compassionate?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा त्रैलोक्यपटाची घडी । आकाराची पैलथडी। कैसा याचिये आवडी । आवरला असे॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā trailokyapaṭācī ghaḍī | ākārācī pailathaḍī| kaisā yāciye āvaḍī | āvaralā ase|| 15||
verses.meaning: This entire universe, this canvas of the three worlds, and the very limit of all forms, how is it all contained within His love?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग देव म्हणे अगा पंडुसुता । हाचि योगु आम्हीं विवस्वता। कथिला परी ते वार्ता। बहुतां दिवसांची ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga deva mhaṇe agā paṃḍusutā | hāci yogu āmhīṃ vivasvatā| kathilā parī te vārtā| bahutāṃ divasāṃcī || 16||
verses.meaning: Then the Lord said, "O son of Pandu, this very yoga I had revealed to Vivasvan, but that account is of many days past."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेणें विवस्वतें रवी। हे योगस्थिति आघवी । निरूपिली बरवी । मनूप्रती॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga teṇeṃ vivasvateṃ ravī| he yogasthiti āghavī | nirūpilī baravī | manūpratī|| 97||
verses.meaning: Then, Vivasvan (the Sun God) beautifully expounded this entire state of Yoga to Manu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मनूने आपण अनुष्ठिली । मग इक्ष्वाकुवा उपदेशिळी। ऐसी परंपरा विस्तारिलळी । आद्य हे गा॥१८॥
verses.shloka_iast: manūne āpaṇa anuṣṭhilī | maga ikṣvākuvā upadeśiḻī| aisī paraṃparā vistārilaḻī | ādya he gā||18||
verses.meaning: Manu himself practiced it, then he instructed Ikshvaku. Thus, this tradition was expanded, O original one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आणिकही या योगातें। राजर्षि जाहळे जाणते । परि तेथोनि आतां सांप्रतें। नेणिजे कोण्ही ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āṇikahī yā yogāteṃ| rājarṣi jāhaḻe jāṇate | pari tethoni ātāṃ sāṃprateṃ| neṇije koṇhī || 99||
verses.meaning: Many other royal sages also became knowers of this Yoga, but from that time until now, none are known.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे प्राणियां कामीं भरु । देहाचिवरी आदरु । म्हणौनि पडिला विसरु । आत्मबोधाचा ॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je prāṇiyāṃ kāmīṃ bharu | dehācivarī ādaru | mhaṇauni paḍilā visaru | ātmabodhācā || 20||
verses.meaning: Those who are engrossed in worldly desires and hold great affection for the body, have therefore forgotten the knowledge of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अव्हांटलिया आस्थाबुद्यि। विषयसुखची परमावधि। जीवु तैसा उपाधि। आवडे लोकां॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: avhāṃṭaliyā āsthābudyi| viṣayasukhacī paramāvadhi| jīvu taisā upādhi| āvaḍe lokāṃ|| 21||
verses.meaning: When the intellect is entangled, considering worldly pleasures as the ultimate goal, people become fond of such a limited existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एव्हवीं तरी खवणेयांच्या गांवीं । पाटाउवें काय करावीं । सांगें जात्यंधा रवी । काय आथी ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: evhavīṃ tarī khavaṇeyāṃcyā gāṃvīṃ | pāṭāuveṃ kāya karāvīṃ | sāṃgeṃ jātyaṃdhā ravī | kāya āthī || 22||
verses.meaning: Indeed, what use are silk garments in a village of weavers? Tell me, what can the sun do for one born blind?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां बहिरयांच्या आस्थानीं। कवण गौीतातें मानी। कीं कोल्हेया चांदणीं। आवडी उपजें ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bahirayāṃcyā āsthānīṃ| kavaṇa gauītāteṃ mānī| kīṃ kolheyā cāṃdaṇīṃ| āvaḍī upajeṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: Who appreciates a song in an assembly of the deaf? Or when do foxes develop a fondness for moonlight?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं चंद्रोदयाआरौतें । जयांचे डोळे फुटती असते। ते काउळे केवीं चंद्रातें। बोळखती ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ caṃdrodayāārauteṃ | jayāṃce ḍoḻe phuṭatī asate| te kāuḻe kevīṃ caṃdrāteṃ| boḻakhatī || 24||
verses.meaning: Just as those whose eyes are blinded by the moonrise, how can those crows recognize the moon?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी वैराग्याची शिंब न देखती । जे विवेकाची भाष नेणती ते मूर्ख केवीं पावती । मज ईशवरातें ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī vairāgyācī śiṃba na dekhatī | je vivekācī bhāṣa neṇatī te mūrkha kevīṃ pāvatī | maja īśavarāteṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Those who do not see the seed of detachment, who do not understand the language of discrimination—how can such ignorant ones attain Me, the Lord?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसा नेणों मोहो वाढीनला। तेणें बहुतेक काळु व्यर्थ गेला। म्हणौनि योगु हा लोपला । लोकीं इये॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaisā neṇoṃ moho vāḍhīnalā| teṇeṃ bahuteka kāḻu vyartha gelā| mhaṇauni yogu hā lopalā | lokīṃ iye|| 26||
verses.meaning: I do not know how this delusion grew so strong, due to which most of my time was wasted. Therefore, this yoga (spiritual path) became hidden from the people in this world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोचि हा आजि आतां। तुजप्रती कुंतीसुता। सांगितला आम्हीं तत्त्वतां । भ्रांति न करीं॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: toci hā āji ātāṃ| tujapratī kuṃtīsutā| sāṃgitalā āmhīṃ tattvatāṃ | bhrāṃti na karīṃ|| 27||
verses.meaning: This very truth, O son of Kunti, has now been truly explained to you by us. Do not be deluded.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जीवींचें निज गुज। परी केवीं राखो तुज। जे 'पढियेसी तूं मज । म्हणौनियां ॥ २८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jīvīṃceṃ nija guja| parī kevīṃ rākho tuja| je 'paḍhiyesī tūṃ maja | mhaṇauniyāṃ || 28 ||
verses.meaning: This is the innermost secret of my heart, but how can I keep it from you, since you are so dear to me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं प्रेमाचा पुतळा । भक्तीचा जिव्हाळा । मैत्रियेची चित्कळा। धनुर्धरा ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ premācā putaḻā | bhaktīcā jivhāḻā | maitriyecī citkaḻā| dhanurdharā || 29||
verses.meaning: You are the very embodiment of love, the essence of devotion, the radiant consciousness of friendship, O Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं अनुसंगाचा ठावो। आतां तुज काय वंचूं जावो ।॥ जरी संग्रामारूढ आहों। जाहलों आम्ही ॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ anusaṃgācā ṭhāvo| ātāṃ tuja kāya vaṃcūṃ jāvo ||| jarī saṃgrāmārūḍha āhoṃ| jāhaloṃ āmhī || 30||
verses.meaning: You are the very essence of companionship; what can I possibly hide from you now? Even though we are engaged in battle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी नावेक हें सहावें। गाजाबज्यही न धरावें । परी तुझें अज्ञानत्व हरावें। लागे आधीं ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī nāveka heṃ sahāveṃ| gājābajyahī na dharāveṃ | parī tujheṃ ajñānatva harāveṃ| lāge ādhīṃ || 31||
verses.meaning: Therefore, do not consider this sixth chapter as merely a boat or a loud proclamation. But first, your ignorance must be dispelled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव अर्जुन म्हणे श्रीहरी । माय आपुळेयाचा स्नेहो करी। एथ विस्मयो 'काय अवधारीं। कृपानिधी॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva arjuna mhaṇe śrīharī | māya āpuḻeyācā sneho karī| etha vismayo 'kāya avadhārīṃ| kṛpānidhī|| 32||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said to Shrihari, "My Lord, it is natural for one to show affection to their own. What is there to wonder at in this, O ocean of compassion?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं संसारश्रांतांची साउली । अनाथ जीवांची माउली । आमुतें कौर प्रसवली । तुझीच कृपा॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ saṃsāraśrāṃtāṃcī sāulī | anātha jīvāṃcī māulī | āmuteṃ kaura prasavalī | tujhīca kṛpā|| 33||
verses.meaning: You are the shade for those weary of worldly existence, the mother for orphaned souls. Your grace alone has brought forth our well-being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा पांगुळ एकादें विजे। तरी जन्मौनि जोजारु साहिजे। हें बोलों काय तुझें । तुजचि पुढां॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā pāṃguḻa ekādeṃ vije| tarī janmauni jojāru sāhije| heṃ boloṃ kāya tujheṃ | tujaci puḍhāṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: O Lord, if a lame person were to win, then they would have to endure the burden of birth. Why should I speak of this before You, as it is You alone who knows all?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां पुसेन जें मी कांहीं। तेथ निकें चित्त देई । तेवींचि देवें कोपावें ना कांहीं। बोळा एका॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ pusena jeṃ mī kāṃhīṃ| tetha nikeṃ citta deī | tevīṃci deveṃ kopāveṃ nā kāṃhīṃ| boḻā ekā|| 35||
verses.meaning: Now, whatever I ask, please listen attentively. And, my Lord, do not be angry with this simpleton.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मागील जे वार्ता । तुवां सांगितली होती अनंता। ते नावेक मज चित्ता। मानेचिना॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī māgīla je vārtā | tuvāṃ sāṃgitalī hotī anaṃtā| te nāveka maja cittā| mānecinā|| 36||
verses.meaning: However, the previous discourse, which you, O Ananta, had narrated, did not quite settle in my mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे तो विवस्वतु म्हणजे कायी। ऐसे हें वडिलां ठाउवें नाहीं । तरी तुवांचि केवीं पाहीं । उपदेशिला॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: je to vivasvatu mhaṇaje kāyī| aise heṃ vaḍilāṃ ṭhāuveṃ nāhīṃ | tarī tuvāṃci kevīṃ pāhīṃ | upadeśilā|| 37||
verses.meaning: If even the elders do not know who this Vivasvat is, then how could you have instructed him?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो तरी आइकिजे बहुतां काळांचा। आणि तूं तंव श्रीकृष्ण सांपेचा । म्हणौनि गा इये मातुचा। विसंवादु ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: to tarī āikije bahutāṃ kāḻāṃcā| āṇi tūṃ taṃva śrīkṛṣṇa sāṃpecā | mhaṇauni gā iye mātucā| visaṃvādu || 38||
verses.meaning: That (knowledge) is heard over many ages, and you, Shri Krishna, are indeed the very source of it. Therefore, there is no disagreement in this matter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेबींचि देवा चरित्र तुझें। आपण कांहींचि नेणिजे। हें लटिकें केवीं म्हणिजे। एकिहेळां॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tebīṃci devā caritra tujheṃ| āpaṇa kāṃhīṃci neṇije| heṃ laṭikeṃ kevīṃ mhaṇije| ekiheḻāṃ|| 39||
verses.meaning: O Lord, Your divine deeds are the very seed of all existence. We, ourselves, know nothing at all. How then can this be called false, even for a moment?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हेचि मातु आघवी । मी परियेसें ऐशी सांगावी । जे तुवांचि रवी केवीं। पाही उपदेशु केला॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī heci mātu āghavī | mī pariyeseṃ aiśī sāṃgāvī | je tuvāṃci ravī kevīṃ| pāhī upadeśu kelā|| 40||
verses.meaning: But please tell me this entire matter in such a way that I can understand it, just as you, the Sun, have imparted this teaching.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव श्रीकृष्ण म्हणे पंडुसुता। तो विवस्वतु जैं होता । तें आम्हीं नसों ऐसी चित्ता । भ्रांति जरी तुज॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva śrīkṛṣṇa mhaṇe paṃḍusutā| to vivasvatu jaiṃ hotā | teṃ āmhīṃ nasoṃ aisī cittā | bhrāṃti jarī tuja|| 41||
verses.meaning: Then Shri Krishna said to the son of Pandu, "If you have the misconception in your mind that I did not exist when Vivasvat was there."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तूं गा हें नेणसी। पैं जन्में आम्हां तुम्हांसी । बहुतें गेळीं परी तियें न स्मरसी । आपुलीं तूं ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tūṃ gā heṃ neṇasī| paiṃ janmeṃ āmhāṃ tumhāṃsī | bahuteṃ geḻīṃ parī tiyeṃ na smarasī | āpulīṃ tūṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: You, however, do not know this. Many births have passed for both you and me, but you do not remember your own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी जेणें जेणें अवसरें। जें जें होऊनि अवतरें। तें समस्तही स्मरें। धनुर्धरा ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī jeṇeṃ jeṇeṃ avasareṃ| jeṃ jeṃ hoūni avatareṃ| teṃ samastahī smareṃ| dhanurdharā || 43||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, whatever forms I assume and manifest in, at whatever times, remember all of them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि हें आघवें। मागील मज आठवें। मी अजुही परि संभवें। प्रकृतियोगें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni heṃ āghaveṃ| māgīla maja āṭhaveṃ| mī ajuhī pari saṃbhaveṃ| prakṛtiyogeṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all this past comes to my remembrance. I, though unborn, am still born through the union with Prakriti (primordial matter).

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझें अव्ययत्व तरी न नसे। परी होणें जाणें एक दिसे । तें प्रतिबिंबे मायावशें । माझ्याचि ठायीं ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheṃ avyayatva tarī na nase| parī hoṇeṃ jāṇeṃ eka dise | teṃ pratibiṃbe māyāvaśeṃ | mājhyāci ṭhāyīṃ || 45 ||
verses.meaning: My imperishability, however, does not cease. Yet, a coming into being and a passing away appear. This is due to the reflection through Maya, within Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझी स्वतंत्रता तरी न मोडे । परी कर्माधीनु ऐसा आवडे । तेही भ्रांतिबुद्धि तरी घडे । एम्हवीं नाहीं ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhī svataṃtratā tarī na moḍe | parī karmādhīnu aisā āvaḍe | tehī bhrāṃtibuddhi tarī ghaḍe | emhavīṃ nāhīṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: My independence is never broken, yet I appear to be subject to karma. This perception arises only due to deluded intellect; otherwise, it is not so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कौं एकचि दिसे दुसरें। तें दर्पणाचेनि आधारें। एम्हवीं काय वस्तुविचारें। दुजें आहे॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kauṃ ekaci dise dusareṃ| teṃ darpaṇāceni ādhāreṃ| emhavīṃ kāya vastuvicāreṃ| dujeṃ āhe|| 47||
verses.meaning: Sometimes, one sees a second reflection, but that is only due to the presence of a mirror. Otherwise, in reality, is there truly a second entity?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा अमूर्तचि मी किरीटी। परी प्रकृति जें अधिष्ठीं। तें साकारपणें नट नटीं। कार्यालागीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā amūrtaci mī kirīṭī| parī prakṛti jeṃ adhiṣṭhīṃ| teṃ sākārapaṇeṃ naṭa naṭīṃ| kāryālāgīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: Just as I am formless, O Kiriti, yet when I manifest through Prakriti, I assume a form for the purpose of creation and action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें धर्मजात आघवें। युगायुगीं म्यां रक्षावें। ऐसा ओघु हा स्वभावें । आद्यु असे॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ dharmajāta āghaveṃ| yugāyugīṃ myāṃ rakṣāveṃ| aisā oghu hā svabhāveṃ | ādyu ase|| 49||
verses.meaning: This is my primordial and inherent nature, that I protect all that is born of Dharma, age after age.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अजत्व परतें ठेवीं। मी अव्यक्‍तपणही नाठवीं। जे वेळीं धर्मातें अभिभवी। अधर्मु हा॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ajatva parateṃ ṭhevīṃ| mī avyak‍tapaṇahī nāṭhavīṃ| je veḻīṃ dharmāteṃ abhibhavī| adharmu hā|| 50||
verses.meaning: Therefore, set aside the idea of my unborn nature; I do not even remember my unmanifest state, at the time when unrighteousness overwhelms righteousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वेळीं आपुल्याचेनि कैवारें। मी साकारु होऊनि अवतरें। मग अज्ञानाचें आंधारें। गिळूनि घालीं ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: te veḻīṃ āpulyāceni kaivāreṃ| mī sākāru hoūni avatareṃ| maga ajñānāceṃ āṃdhāreṃ| giḻūni ghālīṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: At that time, for the sake of my devotees, I take a form and descend. Then, I swallow and destroy the darkness of ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अधर्माची अवधी तोडीं। दोषांची लिहिलीं फाडीं। सज्जनांकरवबीं गुढी । सुखाची उभवीं ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: adharmācī avadhī toḍīṃ| doṣāṃcī lihilīṃ phāḍīṃ| sajjanāṃkaravabīṃ guḍhī | sukhācī ubhavīṃ || 52||
verses.meaning: He cuts short the reign of unrighteousness, tears up the records of sins, and raises the banner of happiness for the virtuous.

verses.shloka_iast: daityāṃcīṃ kuḻeṃ nāśīṃ| sādhūṃcā mānu giṃvaśīṃ| dharmāsīṃ nītīśīṃ| śeṃsa bharīṃ||53||
verses.meaning: I destroy the clans of demons, uphold the honor of saints, and fill the treasury of Dharma with righteousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी अविवेकाची काजळी। फेडूनि विवेकदीप उजळीं। तैं योगियां पाहे दिवाळी । निरंतर॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī avivekācī kājaḻī| pheḍūni vivekadīpa ujaḻīṃ| taiṃ yogiyāṃ pāhe divāḻī | niraṃtara|| 54||
verses.meaning: When I remove the darkness of ignorance and ignite the lamp of discrimination, then for the yogis, it is an unceasing Diwali.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सत्सुखें विश्व कोंदे। धर्मचि जगीं नांदे। भक्तां निघती दोंदें। सात्त्विकाचीं ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: satsukheṃ viśva koṃde| dharmaci jagīṃ nāṃde| bhaktāṃ nighatī doṃdeṃ| sāttvikācīṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: The universe overflows with true happiness, righteousness prevails in the world, and devotees experience the abundance of sattvic qualities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैं पापांचा अचळु फिटे। पुण्याची पहांट फुटे। जैं मूर्ति माझी प्रगटे । पंडुकुमरा॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiṃ pāpāṃcā acaḻu phiṭe| puṇyācī pahāṃṭa phuṭe| jaiṃ mūrti mājhī pragaṭe | paṃḍukumarā|| 56||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, when My form manifests, the mountain of sins is removed, and the dawn of merit breaks forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेया काजालागीं। अवतरें मी युगीं युगीं। परी हेंचि बोळखे जो जगीं। तो विवेकिया ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseyā kājālāgīṃ| avatareṃ mī yugīṃ yugīṃ| parī heṃci boḻakhe jo jagīṃ| to vivekiyā || 57||
verses.meaning: For such a purpose, I incarnate in every age. But he who recognizes this truth in the world is truly discerning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझें अजत्बें जन्मणें । अक्रियताचि कर्म करणें । हें अविकार जो जाणे । तो परममुक्‍त॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheṃ ajatbeṃ janmaṇeṃ | akriyatāci karma karaṇeṃ | heṃ avikāra jo jāṇe | to paramamuk‍ta|| 58||
verses.meaning: My birth is unborn, my actions are inaction. One who knows this unchanging truth is truly liberated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो चालिला संगें न चळे। देहींचा देहा नाकळे । मग पंचत्वीं तंब मिळे । माझ्याचि रूपीं॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to cālilā saṃgeṃ na caḻe| dehīṃcā dehā nākaḻe | maga paṃcatvīṃ taṃba miḻe | mājhyāci rūpīṃ||59||
verses.meaning: That which accompanies the body throughout life, yet remains unknown to it, ultimately merges into my true form upon the body's dissolution into the five elements.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ७२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी एऱ्हवीं परापर न शोचिती। जे कामनाशून्य होती । वाटा कें वेळीं न बचती । क्रोधाचिया॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: 72 śrījñāneśvarī eṟhavīṃ parāpara na śocitī| je kāmanāśūnya hotī | vāṭā keṃ veḻīṃ na bacatī | krodhāciyā|| 60||
verses.meaning: Indeed, those who are free from desires do not contemplate the higher or lower, nor do they fall into the paths of anger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे सदा मियांचि आधथिले। माझिया सेवा जियाळे। कां आत्मबोधें तोषले। बीतराग जे ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: je sadā miyāṃci ādhathile| mājhiyā sevā jiyāḻe| kāṃ ātmabodheṃ toṣale| bītarāga je || 61||
verses.meaning: Those who always depend on Me, who live by My service, or who are content with self-realization, those who are free from attachment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे तपोतेजाचिया राशी । कां एकायतन ज्ञानासी। जे पवित्रता तीर्थांसी। तीर्थरूप॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je tapotejāciyā rāśī | kāṃ ekāyatana jñānāsī| je pavitratā tīrthāṃsī| tīrtharūpa||62||
verses.meaning: They are like heaps of the radiance of penance, or a sole abode of knowledge, and they are the very form of sacredness to holy places.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते मद्‌भावा सहजें आलळे। मी तेचि ते होऊनि ठेळे। जे मज तयां उरले। पदर नाहीं ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: te mad‌bhāvā sahajeṃ ālaḻe| mī teci te hoūni ṭheḻe| je maja tayāṃ urale| padara nāhīṃ || 63||
verses.meaning: They naturally attain My state of being; I become one with them, and there remains no distinction between Me and them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगैं पितळेची गंधिकाळिक। जैं फिटली होय निःशेख। तें सुवर्ण काई आणिक । जोडूं जाईजे॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgaiṃ pitaḻecī gaṃdhikāḻika| jaiṃ phiṭalī hoya niḥśekha| teṃ suvarṇa kāī āṇika | joḍūṃ jāīje|| 64||
verses.meaning: Just as the blackness of brass, when completely removed, does not require any additional gold to be added to it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे यमनियमीं कडसले। जे तपोज्ञाने चोखाळळे। मी तेचि ते जाहळे। एथ संशयो कायसा ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise yamaniyamīṃ kaḍasale| je tapojñāne cokhāḻaḻe| mī teci te jāhaḻe| etha saṃśayo kāyasā || 65||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who are purified by self-restraint and discipline, and made pure through penance and knowledge—they become Me. What doubt can there be in this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी पाहीं। जे जैसे माझ्या ठायीं। भजती तयां मीही । तैसाचि भजें ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī pāhīṃ| je jaise mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ| bhajatī tayāṃ mīhī | taisāci bhajeṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: Indeed, behold! As they worship Me, so too do I worship them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें मनुष्यजात सकळ। हें स्वभावता भजनशीळ। जाहलें असे केवळ। माझ्याचि ठायीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ manuṣyajāta sakaḻa| heṃ svabhāvatā bhajanaśīḻa| jāhaleṃ ase kevaḻa| mājhyāci ṭhāyīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Behold, all of humanity is naturally inclined to devotion, having become solely focused on Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी ज्ञानेंबीण नाशिले। जे बुद्धिभेदासी आले। तेणेंचि त्या कल्पिळें। अनेकत्व ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī jñāneṃbīṇa nāśile| je buddhibhedāsī āle| teṇeṃci tyā kalpiḻeṃ| anekatva || 68 ||
verses.meaning: But those who, devoid of true knowledge, have fallen into intellectual confusion, they themselves have imagined this multiplicity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अभेदीं भेदु देखती । यया अनाम्या नामें ठेविती । देवी देवो म्हणती । अचर्चातें ( अवाच्यातें )॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni abhedīṃ bhedu dekhatī | yayā anāmyā nāmeṃ ṭhevitī | devī devo mhaṇatī | acarcāteṃ ( avācyāteṃ )|| 69||
verses.meaning: Therefore, they perceive difference in the undifferentiated, give names to the nameless, and call the unmanifested as gods and goddesses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें सर्वत्र सदा सम। तेथ विभाग अधभमोत्तम। मतिवशें संभ्रम। विवंचिती॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sarvatra sadā sama| tetha vibhāga adhabhamottama| mativaśeṃ saṃbhrama| vivaṃcitī|| 70||
verses.meaning: That which is ever-present and equal everywhere, yet due to the deluded intellect, people perceive distinctions of high and low, good and bad, and contemplate them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग नानाहेतुप्रकारें। यथोचितें उपचारें। मानिलीं देवतांतरें। उपासिती ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga nānāhetuprakāreṃ| yathociteṃ upacāreṃ| mānilīṃ devatāṃtareṃ| upāsitī || 79||
verses.meaning: Then, with various intentions and appropriate rituals, they worship other deities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ जें जें अपेक्षित । तें तैसेचि पावती समस्त । परी तें कर्मफळ निश्‍चित । बोळख तूं ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha jeṃ jeṃ apekṣita | teṃ taiseci pāvatī samasta | parī teṃ karmaphaḻa niś‍cita | boḻakha tūṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: There, whatever is desired, they attain exactly that. But know that to be the certain fruit of their actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचून देतें घेतें आणिक । निभ्रांत नाहीं सम्यक । एथ कर्मचि फळसूचक । मनुष्यळोकीं ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūna deteṃ gheteṃ āṇika | nibhrāṃta nāhīṃ samyaka | etha karmaci phaḻasūcaka | manuṣyaḻokīṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: There is no doubt that in this human world, actions alone are the indicators of their fruits, apart from giving and taking.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेसें क्षेत्री जें पेरिजे। तेंबांचूनि आन न निपजे। कां पाहिजे तेंचि देखिजे। दर्पणाधारें॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeseṃ kṣetrī jeṃ perije| teṃbāṃcūni āna na nipaje| kāṃ pāhije teṃci dekhije| darpaṇādhāreṃ|| 74||
verses.meaning: Just as in a field, whatever is sown, nothing else but that will grow. Or, what is desired is seen, as if in a mirror.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी 'कडेयातळवटीं। जैसा आपुलाचि बोलु किरीटी । पडिसादु होऊनि उठी। निमित्तयोगें ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī 'kaḍeyātaḻavaṭīṃ| jaisā āpulāci bolu kirīṭī | paḍisādu hoūni uṭhī| nimittayogeṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Just as, O Kiriti, one's own words, due to a suitable cause, echo back as a reverberation, so too is the nature of the divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा समस्तां यां भजनां। मी साक्षिभूतु पैं अर्जुना । एथ प्रतिफळे भावना। आपुलाली॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā samastāṃ yāṃ bhajanāṃ| mī sākṣibhūtu paiṃ arjunā | etha pratiphaḻe bhāvanā| āpulālī|| 76||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, I am indeed the witness to all these forms of devotion. Here, each one's intention bears fruit according to its own nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां याचिपरी जाण । चाऱही हे वर्ण । सूजिले म्यां गुण-। कर्मविभागें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yāciparī jāṇa | cāṟahī he varṇa | sūjile myāṃ guṇa-| karmavibhāgeṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Understand that in the same way, all four varnas (social orders) were created by Me, based on the division of their qualities and actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे प्रकृतीचेनि आधारें। गुणाचेनि व्यभिचारें। कर्मे तदनुसारें। विवंचिलीं ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: je prakṛtīceni ādhāreṃ| guṇāceni vyabhicāreṃ| karme tadanusāreṃ| vivaṃcilīṃ || 78||
verses.meaning: Actions are thus understood to arise from the support of Prakriti, through the interplay of the Gunas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ एकचि हे धनुष्यपाणी। परी जाहले गा चहूं वर्णी । ऐसी गुणकर्म- 'कडसणी। केली सहजें ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha ekaci he dhanuṣyapāṇī| parī jāhale gā cahūṃ varṇī | aisī guṇakarma- 'kaḍasaṇī| kelī sahajeṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: Here, there is only one wielder of the bow (the Divine), yet He manifested in four varnas (social orders). Thus, the divisions of qualities and actions were naturally made.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आइकें पार्था । हे वर्णभेदसंस्था । मी कर्ता नव्हें सर्वथा। याचिलागीं ॥८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āikeṃ pārthā | he varṇabhedasaṃsthā | mī kartā navheṃ sarvathā| yācilāgīṃ ||80||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen, Arjuna, I am certainly not the doer of this system of the fourfold social order.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें मजचिस्तव जाहलें। परी म्यां नाहीं केलें। ऐसें जेणें जाणितळें। तो सुटला गा॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ majacistava jāhaleṃ| parī myāṃ nāhīṃ keleṃ| aiseṃ jeṇeṃ jāṇitaḻeṃ| to suṭalā gā||81||
verses.meaning: This has happened because of me, yet I have not done it. One who understands this truth is liberated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मागील मुमुक्षु जे होते । तिहीं ऐशिया जाणोनि मातें । कर्मे केलीं समस्तें। धनुर्धरा ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: māgīla mumukṣu je hote | tihīṃ aiśiyā jāṇoni māteṃ | karme kelīṃ samasteṃ| dhanurdharā || 82||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, the seekers of liberation in the past, knowing Me in this way, performed all their actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तें बीजें जैसीं दग्धलीं । नुगवतींचि पेरिलीं । तैशीं कर्मेचि परि तयां जाहलीं। मोक्षहेतु॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teṃ bījeṃ jaisīṃ dagdhalīṃ | nugavatīṃci perilīṃ | taiśīṃ karmeci pari tayāṃ jāhalīṃ| mokṣahetu|| 83||
verses.meaning: Just as burnt seeds, even if sown, do not sprout, so too for them, actions themselves become the cause of liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ आणिकही एक अर्जुना। हे कर्माकर्मविवंचना। आपुल्िये चाडें सज्ञाना । योग्यु नोहे ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha āṇikahī eka arjunā| he karmākarmavivaṃcanā| āpuliye cāḍeṃ sajñānā | yogyu nohe || 84||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, there is another thing to consider here: this deliberation on action and inaction is not suitable for the wise, according to their own inclination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्म म्हणिपे तें कबण। अथवा अकर्मा काय लक्षण । ऐसें विचारितां विचक्षण । गुंफोनि ठेळे॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: karma mhaṇipe teṃ kabaṇa| athavā akarmā kāya lakṣaṇa | aiseṃ vicāritāṃ vicakṣaṇa | guṃphoni ṭheḻe|| 85||
verses.meaning: What is called action (karma), or what are the characteristics of inaction (akarma)? When wise people ponder such questions, they become entangled and stop.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें कां कुडें नाणें । खऱ्याचेनि सारखेपणें । डोळ्यांचेंहि देखणें । संशयीं घाली ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ kāṃ kuḍeṃ nāṇeṃ | khaṟyāceni sārakhepaṇeṃ | ḍoḻyāṃceṃhi dekhaṇeṃ | saṃśayīṃ ghālī || 86||
verses.meaning: Just as a counterfeit coin, resembling a genuine one, casts doubt even upon the eye's perception.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें नैष्कर्म्यतेचेनि भ्रमे । गिंवसिजत आहाती कर्मे) जे दुजी सृष्टि मनोधरमे। करू सकती ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ naiṣkarmyateceni bhrame | giṃvasijata āhātī karme) je dujī sṛṣṭi manodharame| karū sakatī || 87||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who, under the illusion of 'naishkarmya' (actionlessness), grasp at actions, are capable of creating a second world through their mental resolve.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि मूर्खाची गोठी कायसी। एथ मोहले गा क्रांतदर्शी । म्हणौनि आतां तेंचि परियेसीं । सांगेन तुज॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni mūrkhācī goṭhī kāyasī| etha mohale gā krāṃtadarśī | mhaṇauni ātāṃ teṃci pariyesīṃ | sāṃgena tuja|| 88||
verses.meaning: What is the point of speaking to a fool? Even the seers are deluded here. Therefore, listen now, I will tell you that very thing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ७४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तरी कर्म म्हणजे स्वभावें। जेणें विश्वाकारु संभवे । तें सम्यक आधीं जाणावें। लागे एथ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: 74 śrījñāneśvarī tarī karma mhaṇaje svabhāveṃ| jeṇeṃ viśvākāru saṃbhave | teṃ samyaka ādhīṃ jāṇāveṃ| lāge etha|| 89||
verses.meaning: Dnyaneshwari says that karma, by its very nature, is that through which the form of the universe comes into being. This must first be properly understood here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वर्णाश्रमासि उचित। जें विशेष कर्म वबिहित। तेंही बोळखावें निश्‍चित । उपयोगेंसीं ॥९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga varṇāśramāsi ucita| jeṃ viśeṣa karma vabihita| teṃhī boḻakhāveṃ niś‍cita | upayogeṃsīṃ ||90||
verses.meaning: Then, the specific actions prescribed as appropriate for one's Varna and Ashrama should also be understood with certainty, along with their utility.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं जें निषिद्ध म्हणिपे । तेंही बुझावें स्वरूपें । येतुलेनि येथ कांहीं न गुंफे। आपैसेंचि॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ jeṃ niṣiddha mhaṇipe | teṃhī bujhāveṃ svarūpeṃ | yetuleni yetha kāṃhīṃ na guṃphe| āpaiseṃci|| 91||
verses.meaning: That which is called forbidden, even that should be understood as the Self. By this, nothing here remains entangled; it is naturally freed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं जग हें कर्माधीन। ऐसी याची व्याप्ती गहन। परी तें असो आकठकें चिन्ह। प्राप्तांचें गा॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ jaga heṃ karmādhīna| aisī yācī vyāptī gahana| parī teṃ aso ākaṭhakeṃ cinha| prāptāṃceṃ gā|| 92||
verses.meaning: Indeed, this world is under the sway of karma; its pervasive influence is profound. But let that be, for it is a clear sign for those who have attained (spiritual realization).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो सकळकर्मी वर्ततां। देखें आपुली नेष्कर्म्यता। कर्मसंगें निराशता । 'फळाचिया॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo sakaḻakarmī vartatāṃ| dekheṃ āpulī neṣkarmyatā| karmasaṃgeṃ nirāśatā | 'phaḻāciyā|| 93||
verses.meaning: One who, while performing all actions, perceives their own actionlessness, and through detachment from actions, becomes free from the desire for their fruits.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि कर्तव्यतेलागीं। जया दुसरें नाहीं जगीं । ऐसिया नैष्कर्म्यता तरी चांगीं। बोधला असे॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi kartavyatelāgīṃ| jayā dusareṃ nāhīṃ jagīṃ | aisiyā naiṣkarmyatā tarī cāṃgīṃ| bodhalā ase|| 94||
verses.meaning: And for the sake of duty, for which there is no other in the world, such a state of actionlessness is well taught.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी क्रियाकलापु आघवा । आचरतु दिसे बरवा । तोचि तो ये चिन्हीं जाणावा । ज्ञानिया गा॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kriyākalāpu āghavā | ācaratu dise baravā | toci to ye cinhīṃ jāṇāvā | jñāniyā gā|| 95||
verses.meaning: Therefore, know that the one who appears to perform all actions beautifully is indeed the wise one, O knower of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा कां जळापाशीं उभा ठाके। तो जरी आपणपें जळामाजिं देखे । तरी तो निभ्रांत बोळखे। म्हणे मी वेगळा आहें॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā kāṃ jaḻāpāśīṃ ubhā ṭhāke| to jarī āpaṇapeṃ jaḻāmājiṃ dekhe | tarī to nibhrāṃta boḻakhe| mhaṇe mī vegaḻā āheṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: Just as one standing by water, even if they see their own reflection in the water, they undoubtedly understand and say, "I am separate from it."

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा नावें हन जो रिगे। तो थडियेचे रुख जातां देखे वेगें। तेचि साचोकारें जों पाहों लागे । तंव रुख म्हणे अचळ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā nāveṃ hana jo rige| to thaḍiyece rukha jātāṃ dekhe vegeṃ| teci sācokāreṃ joṃ pāhoṃ lāge | taṃva rukha mhaṇe acaḻa|| 97||
verses.meaning: Or, a person in a boat sees the trees on the bank moving swiftly. But when he truly looks, he realizes the trees are unmoving.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सर्व कर्मी असणें। तें फुडें मानूनि वायाणें । मग आपणया जो जाणे । नेष्कर्म्यु ऐसा ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sarva karmī asaṇeṃ| teṃ phuḍeṃ mānūni vāyāṇeṃ | maga āpaṇayā jo jāṇe | neṣkarmyu aisā || 98 ||
verses.meaning: Similarly, considering all actions as futile, one who knows oneself as actionless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि उदोअस्तुचेनि प्रमाणें । जैसें न चालतां सूर्याचें चालणें। तैसें नैष्कर्म्यत्व जाणे। कर्मींचि असतां॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi udoastuceni pramāṇeṃ | jaiseṃ na cālatāṃ sūryāceṃ cālaṇeṃ| taiseṃ naiṣkarmyatva jāṇe| karmīṃci asatāṃ|| 99||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun appears to move from sunrise to sunset without actually moving, so too can one attain a state of actionlessness (naishkarmya) even while engaged in action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो मनुष्यासारिखा तरी आवडे । परी मनुष्यत्व तया न घडे । जैसें जळामाजीं न बुडे। भानुबिंब॥ १००॥
verses.shloka_iast: to manuṣyāsārikhā tarī āvaḍe | parī manuṣyatva tayā na ghaḍe | jaiseṃ jaḻāmājīṃ na buḍe| bhānubiṃba|| 100||
verses.meaning: Though he appears like a human, humanity does not truly belong to him, just as the reflection of the sun does not drown in water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें न पाहतां विश्‍व देखिलें। न करितां सर्व केलें। न भोगितां भोगिलें। भोग्यजात ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ na pāhatāṃ viś‍va dekhileṃ| na karitāṃ sarva keleṃ| na bhogitāṃ bhogileṃ| bhogyajāta || 91||
verses.meaning: Without seeing, the universe was seen. Without doing, everything was done. Without experiencing, all experiences were enjoyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकेचि ठायीं बैसला । परि सर्वत्र तोचि गेला। हें असो विश्व जाहला । आंगेंचि तो॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeci ṭhāyīṃ baisalā | pari sarvatra toci gelā| heṃ aso viśva jāhalā | āṃgeṃci to|| 2||
verses.meaning: Though He is seated in one place, He has pervaded everywhere. Let this be; He Himself has become the universe by His own being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया पुरुषाच्या ठायीं । कर्माचा तरी खेदु नाहीं । परी फलापेक्षा कहीं । संचरेना॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā puruṣācyā ṭhāyīṃ | karmācā tarī khedu nāhīṃ | parī phalāpekṣā kahīṃ | saṃcarenā|| 3||
verses.meaning: The person in whom there is no regret for actions, nor any desire for their fruits.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि हें कर्म मी करीन । अथवा आदरिळें सिद्धी नेईन । येणें संकल्पेंही जयाचें मन। विटाळेना॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi heṃ karma mī karīna | athavā ādariḻeṃ siddhī neīna | yeṇeṃ saṃkalpeṃhī jayāceṃ mana| viṭāḻenā|| 4||
verses.meaning: And the mind of one who is not defiled even by the resolve that "I will perform this action" or "I will bring what I have undertaken to completion."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानाग्नीचेनि मुखें। जेणें जाळिलीं कर्मे अशेखें। तो परब्रह्मचि मनुष्यवेखें। बोळख तूं॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñānāgnīceni mukheṃ| jeṇeṃ jāḻilīṃ karme aśekheṃ| to parabrahmaci manuṣyavekheṃ| boḻakha tūṃ|| 5||
verses.meaning: Recognize that one who has burned all karma through the fire of knowledge is indeed the Supreme Brahman in human form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो शरीरीं उदासु। फळभोगीं निरासु । नित्यता उल्हासु । होऊनि असे ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo śarīrīṃ udāsu| phaḻabhogīṃ nirāsu | nityatā ulhāsu | hoūni ase || 6||
verses.meaning: One who is detached from the body, indifferent to the fruits of actions, and always joyful.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो संतोषाचा गाभारा। आत्मबोधाचिया वोगरां। पुरे न म्हणेचि धनुर्धरा। आरोगितां ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo saṃtoṣācā gābhārā| ātmabodhāciyā vogarāṃ| pure na mhaṇeci dhanurdharā| ārogitāṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, one who is content never says 'enough' while partaking of the inner knowledge, which is like a sacred offering within the sanctuary of contentment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसी अधिकाधिक आवडी । घेत महासुखाची गोडी । सांडोनियां आशा कुरोंडी। अहंभावेंसीं ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaisī adhikādhika āvaḍī | gheta mahāsukhācī goḍī | sāṃḍoniyāṃ āśā kuroṃḍī| ahaṃbhāveṃsīṃ || 8||
verses.meaning: How, with ever-increasing love, one tastes the sweetness of supreme bliss, abandoning the crooked hopes and the sense of ego.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अवसरें जें जें पावे। कीं तेणेंचि तो सुखावे। जया आपुलें आणि परावें। दोन्ही नाहीं ॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni avasareṃ jeṃ jeṃ pāve| kīṃ teṇeṃci to sukhāve| jayā āpuleṃ āṇi parāveṃ| donhī nāhīṃ ||9||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever comes to him by chance, he finds joy in it, for he makes no distinction between his own and another's.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो दिठीं जें पाहे । तें आपणचि होऊनि जाये। आइके तें आहे। तोचि जाहला ॥ ११० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: to diṭhīṃ jeṃ pāhe | teṃ āpaṇaci hoūni jāye| āike teṃ āhe| toci jāhalā || 110 ||
verses.meaning: Whatever he sees with his eyes, he himself becomes that. Whatever he hears, he himself becomes that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चरणीं हन चाले। मुखें जें जें बोले । ऐसें चेष्टाजात तेतुळें। आपणचि जो॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: caraṇīṃ hana cāle| mukheṃ jeṃ jeṃ bole | aiseṃ ceṣṭājāta tetuḻeṃ| āpaṇaci jo|| 11||
verses.meaning: Whatever the feet walk, whatever the mouth speaks, all such actions are indeed His own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो विश्‍व पाहीं । जयासि आपणपेंवांचूनि नाहीं । आतां कवण तें कर्म कायी । बाधी तयातें ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso viś‍va pāhīṃ | jayāsi āpaṇapeṃvāṃcūni nāhīṃ | ātāṃ kavaṇa teṃ karma kāyī | bādhī tayāteṃ || 92||
verses.meaning: Consider this universe: it has no existence apart from the Self. So, what action could possibly bind that Self?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा मत्सरु जेथ उपजे । तेतुलें नुरेचि जया दुजें । तो निर्मत्सरु काइ म्हणिजे। बोलवरी॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā matsaru jetha upaje | tetuleṃ nureci jayā dujeṃ | to nirmatsaru kāi mhaṇije| bolavarī|| 13||
verses.meaning: When envy arises, there remains no other (separate entity) for it to act upon. How then can such a one be called free from envy, even in words?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सर्वांपरी मुक्तु। तो सकर्मुचि कर्मरहितु। सगुण परि गुणातीतु। एथ भ्रांति नाहीं ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sarvāṃparī muktu| to sakarmuci karmarahitu| saguṇa pari guṇātītu| etha bhrāṃti nāhīṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in all respects, the liberated one, though performing actions, is free from their bondage; though possessing qualities, is beyond them. There is no doubt in this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो देहसंगें तरी असे । चैतन्यासारिखा दिसे । पाहतां परब्रह्माचेनि कसें । चोखाळु भला॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: to dehasaṃgeṃ tarī ase | caitanyāsārikhā dise | pāhatāṃ parabrahmāceni kaseṃ | cokhāḻu bhalā|| 15||
verses.meaning: Though it is associated with the body, it appears like pure consciousness. When tested against the touchstone of the Supreme Brahman, it proves to be truly pure and excellent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसाही परी कौतुकें। जरी कर्मे करी यज्ञादिकें । तरी तियें लया जाती निःशेखें। तयाच्याचि ठायीं ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisāhī parī kautukeṃ| jarī karme karī yajñādikeṃ | tarī tiyeṃ layā jātī niḥśekheṃ| tayācyāci ṭhāyīṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: Even if such a person performs ritualistic actions like sacrifices with great enthusiasm, those actions completely dissolve and merge back into their very being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अकाळींचीं अग्ने जैशीं। उर्मीवबीण आकाशीं । हारपती आपैशीं। उदयलीं सांतीं ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: akāḻīṃcīṃ agne jaiśīṃ| urmīvabīṇa ākāśīṃ | hārapatī āpaiśīṃ| udayalīṃ sāṃtīṃ || 17||
verses.meaning: Just as untimely clouds, without any wind, spontaneously disappear from the sky as they arise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशीं विधिविधानें विहितें। जरी आचरे तो समस्तें । तरी तियें ऐक्यभावें ऐक्यातें । पावतीचि गा॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśīṃ vidhividhāneṃ vihiteṃ| jarī ācare to samasteṃ | tarī tiyeṃ aikyabhāveṃ aikyāteṃ | pāvatīci gā|| 18||
verses.meaning: Similarly, even if one performs all prescribed rituals and injunctions, they ultimately lead to the realization of oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें हवन मी होता। कां इयें यज्ञीं हा भोक्ता। ऐसिया बुन्दिसि नाहीं भिन्नता । म्हणौनियां॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ havana mī hotā| kāṃ iyeṃ yajñīṃ hā bhoktā| aisiyā bundisi nāhīṃ bhinnatā | mhaṇauniyāṃ|| 99||
verses.meaning: Whether I am the oblation, or the enjoyer in this sacrifice, there is no difference in this understanding. Therefore.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे इष्टयज्ञ यजावे। तें हविर्मत्रादि आघवें। तो देखतसे अविनाशभावें । आत्मबुद्धि॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je iṣṭayajña yajāve| teṃ havirmatrādi āghaveṃ| to dekhatase avināśabhāveṃ | ātmabuddhi|| 120||
verses.meaning: Whatever sacrifices are to be performed, all the offerings and mantras, He perceives with an imperishable attitude, as His own Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ब्रह्म तेंचि कर्म । ऐसें बोधा आलें जया सम। तया कर्तव्य तें नैष्कर्म्य। धनुर्धगा॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni brahma teṃci karma | aiseṃ bodhā āleṃ jayā sama| tayā kartavya teṃ naiṣkarmya| dhanurdhagā|| 29||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for one who has realized through wisdom that Brahman itself is action, for them, duty is non-action, O Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां अविवेकुकुमारत्वा मुकले। जयां विरक्‍्तीचें पाणिग्रहण जाहलें मग उपासन जिहीं आणिलें। योगाग्नीचें ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ avivekukumāratvā mukale| jayāṃ virak‍tīceṃ pāṇigrahaṇa jāhaleṃ maga upāsana jihīṃ āṇileṃ| yogāgnīceṃ || 22||
verses.meaning: Now, those who have shed the immaturity of indiscrimination, and have embraced dispassion, have then brought forth the worship of the fire of Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे यजनशील अहर्निशीं। जिहीं अविद्या हविली मनेंसीं । गुरुवाक्य- हुताशीं । हवन केलें॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je yajanaśīla aharniśīṃ| jihīṃ avidyā havilī maneṃsīṃ | guruvākya- hutāśīṃ | havana keleṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: Those who are truly sacrificial, day and night, have offered their ignorance as oblation into the fire of the Guru's word, with their minds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिहीं योगाग्निकीं यजिजे। तो दैवयजञु म्हणिजे । जेणें आत्मसुख कामिजे। पंडुकुमरा॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tihīṃ yogāgnikīṃ yajije| to daivayajañu mhaṇije | jeṇeṃ ātmasukha kāmije| paṃḍukumarā|| 24||
verses.meaning: He who performs this sacrifice with the fire of Yoga, he is called a divine sacrificer, who desires the happiness of the Self, O son of Pandu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दैवास्तब पाळण। जो चिंतीना देहभरण। तो महायोगी जाण। दैवयोगें ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: daivāstaba pāḻaṇa| jo ciṃtīnā dehabharaṇa| to mahāyogī jāṇa| daivayogeṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: One who, by divine grace, does not worry about the sustenance of the body, is indeed a great yogi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां अवधारीं सांगैन आणिक । जे ब्रह्माग्नी साग्निक । तयांतें यज्ञेंचि यज्ञु देख । उपासिजे॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ avadhārīṃ sāṃgaina āṇika | je brahmāgnī sāgnika | tayāṃteṃ yajñeṃci yajñu dekha | upāsije|| 26||
verses.meaning: Now listen, I will tell you more. Those who are endowed with the fire of Brahman, they worship the sacrifice itself through sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक संयमाग्निहोत्री। ते युक्तित्रयाच्या मंत्री । यजन करिती पवित्रीं। इंद्रियद्रव्यीं ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka saṃyamāgnihotrī| te yuktitrayācyā maṃtrī | yajana karitī pavitrīṃ| iṃdriyadravyīṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Some perform the sacred fire ritual of self-control, offering the senses as oblations into the pure fire of spiritual wisdom, guided by the three-fold path of right knowledge, right action, and right devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकां वैराग्य रवि विवळे । तंब संयती विहार केळे। तेथ अपावृत जाहळे। इंद्रियानळ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekāṃ vairāgya ravi vivaḻe | taṃba saṃyatī vihāra keḻe| tetha apāvṛta jāhaḻe| iṃdriyānaḻa|| 28||
verses.meaning: When the sun of detachment shines, the restrained senses roam freely, and the fire of the senses is extinguished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिहीं विरक्तीची ज्वाळा घेतली । तंव विकारांचीं इंधनें पळिपलीं । तेथ आशाधूमें सांडिलीं। पांचही कुंडें॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tihīṃ viraktīcī jvāḻā ghetalī | taṃva vikārāṃcīṃ iṃdhaneṃ paḻipalīṃ | tetha āśādhūmeṃ sāṃḍilīṃ| pāṃcahī kuṃḍeṃ|| 29||
verses.meaning: When they ignited the flame of dispassion, the fuel of vices was consumed. There, the smoke of desire abandoned all five senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वाक्‍यविधीचिया निरवडी। विषयआहुती उदंडीं। हवन केलें कुंडीं। इंद्रियाग्नीच्या॥ ९३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vāk‍yavidhīciyā niravaḍī| viṣayaāhutī udaṃḍīṃ| havana keleṃ kuṃḍīṃ| iṃdriyāgnīcyā|| 930||
verses.meaning: Then, with the offerings of sense objects, a grand sacrifice was performed in the sacrificial fire of the senses, according to the prescribed rituals of speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'एकीं ययापरी पार्था । दोषु क्षाळिळे सर्वथा । आणिकीं हृदयारणीं मंथा । बिवेकु केला॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'ekīṃ yayāparī pārthā | doṣu kṣāḻiḻe sarvathā | āṇikīṃ hṛdayāraṇīṃ maṃthā | biveku kelā|| 31||
verses.meaning: In this way, Arjuna, some completely cleansed themselves of faults, while others churned the fire-stick of their hearts to kindle discrimination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो उपशमें निहटिला। धैर्यॅवरी दाटिला। गुरुवाक्यें काढिला। बळकटपणें ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to upaśameṃ nihaṭilā| dhairyaॅvarī dāṭilā| guruvākyeṃ kāḍhilā| baḻakaṭapaṇeṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: Thus, he was subdued by tranquility, overwhelmed by courage, and powerfully drawn out by the Guru's words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें समरसें मंथन केलें। तेथ झडकरी काजा आलें । जें उज्जीबन जाहालें। ज्ञानाग्नीचें ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ samaraseṃ maṃthana keleṃ| tetha jhaḍakarī kājā āleṃ | jeṃ ujjībana jāhāleṃ| jñānāgnīceṃ || 33 ||
verses.meaning: When such a harmonious churning was performed, it quickly yielded results, igniting the fire of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पहिला क्रब्द्विसिद्धींचा संभ्रमु। तो निवर्तोनि गेला धूमु । मग प्रगटला सूक्ष्मु। बिस्फुलिंगु॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pahilā krabdvisiddhīṃcā saṃbhramu| to nivartoni gelā dhūmu | maga pragaṭalā sūkṣmu| bisphuliṃgu|| 34||
verses.meaning: First, the confusion of the two-fold accomplishment vanished like smoke. Then, a subtle spark manifested.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया मनाचें मोकळें। तेंचि पेटबण घातलें। जें यमनियमीं हळुवारलें। आइईतें होतें ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā manāceṃ mokaḻeṃ| teṃci peṭabaṇa ghātaleṃ| jeṃ yamaniyamīṃ haḻuvāraleṃ| āiīteṃ hoteṃ || 35||
verses.meaning: The mind, thus freed from worldly attachments, was like a prepared field. It had been softened and made fertile by the practice of yama and niyama, ready for the seed of spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें सादुकुपणें ज्वाळा समृत्धधा । मग वासनांतराचिया समिधा । स्नेहेंसीं नानाविधा । जाळिळिया॥ ३६॥
