verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni viṣayabhogīṃ jeṃ sukha| teṃ sādyaṃtaci jāṇa duḥkha| pari kāya kauje mūrkha | na sevitāṃ na sare|| 120||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the pleasure derived from worldly enjoyments is, from beginning to end, nothing but sorrow. But what can be done with a fool who cannot be satisfied without indulging in them?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अंतर नेणती बापुडे । म्हणौनि अगत्य सेवणें घडे । सांगैं पूयपंकींचे किडे। काय चिळसी घेती॥ २९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ aṃtara neṇatī bāpuḍe | mhaṇauni agatya sevaṇeṃ ghaḍe | sāṃgaiṃ pūyapaṃkīṃce kiḍe| kāya ciḻasī ghetī|| 291||
verses.meaning: These poor creatures do not understand the inner essence, and therefore they are compelled to serve. Tell me, do the worms in a pus-filled mire ever feel disgust?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां दुःखियां दुःखचि जिव्हार। ते विषयकर्दमींचे दर्दुर। ते भोगजळींचे जळचर। सांडिती केवीं ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ duḥkhiyāṃ duḥkhaci jivhāra| te viṣayakardamīṃce dardura| te bhogajaḻīṃce jaḻacara| sāṃḍitī kevīṃ || 22||
verses.meaning: How can those who are deeply distressed, like frogs in the mud of worldly pleasures, or aquatic creatures in the waters of enjoyment, ever abandon them?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि दुःखयोनि जिया आहाती । तिया निरर्थका तरी नव्हती । जरी विषयांवरी विरक्ती । धरिती जीव॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi duḥkhayoni jiyā āhātī | tiyā nirarthakā tarī navhatī | jarī viṣayāṃvarī viraktī | dharitī jīva|| 23||
verses.meaning: And those things that are the source of sorrow, they would not be meaningless if beings were to cultivate detachment from worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी गर्भवासादि संकट। कां जन्ममरणींचे कष्ट। हे विसांवेबीण वाट। वाहावी कवणें॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī garbhavāsādi saṃkaṭa| kāṃ janmamaraṇīṃce kaṣṭa| he visāṃvebīṇa vāṭa| vāhāvī kavaṇeṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, who would endure the hardships of conception and birth, or the pains of birth and death, without a moment's rest?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी विषयीं विषयो सांडिजेल। तरी महादोषी कें बवसिजेल। आणि संसारु हा शब्दु नव्हेल। लटिका जगीं॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī viṣayīṃ viṣayo sāṃḍijela| tarī mahādoṣī keṃ bavasijela| āṇi saṃsāru hā śabdu navhela| laṭikā jagīṃ|| 25||
verses.meaning: Even if one were to abandon worldly pleasures, how could one escape great sins? And then, the word 'worldly existence' would not be false in this world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अविद्याजात नाधिलें। तें तिहींचि साच दाविलें। जिहीं सुखबुद्धी घेतलें। विषयदुःख॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni avidyājāta nādhileṃ| teṃ tihīṃci sāca dāvileṃ| jihīṃ sukhabuddhī ghetaleṃ| viṣayaduḥkha|| 26||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the illusion-born world, which they truly showed, is nothing but the suffering of worldly pleasures, which they embraced with the intellect of happiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या- कारणें गा सुभटा। हा विचारितां विषय वोखटा । तूं झणें कहीं या वाटा । बिसरोनि जाशी॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā- kāraṇeṃ gā subhaṭā| hā vicāritāṃ viṣaya vokhaṭā | tūṃ jhaṇeṃ kahīṃ yā vāṭā | bisaroni jāśī|| 27||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O brave one, this subject is unpleasant to contemplate. Do not, by any chance, forget this path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं यातें विरक्त पुरुष। त्यजिती कां जैसें विष। निराशा तयां दुःख दाविलें नावडे॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ yāteṃ virakta puruṣa| tyajitī kāṃ jaiseṃ viṣa| nirāśā tayāṃ duḥkha dāvileṃ nāvaḍe|| 28||
verses.meaning: Indeed, detached individuals abandon this as if it were poison, for they dislike the suffering that despair reveals.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानियांच्या हन ठायीं। यांची मातुही कीर नाहीं। देहीं देहभावो जिहीं । स्ववश केले॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñāniyāṃcyā hana ṭhāyīṃ| yāṃcī mātuhī kīra nāhīṃ| dehīṃ dehabhāvo jihīṃ | svavaśa kele|| 29||
verses.meaning: Amongst the truly wise, there is not even a mention of these things, for they have brought their bodily consciousness under their own control.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांतें बाह्याची भाष। नेणिजेचि निःशेष। अंतरीं सुख। एक आथि॥ १३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃteṃ bāhyācī bhāṣa| neṇijeci niḥśeṣa| aṃtarīṃ sukha| eka āthi|| 130||
verses.meaning: In whom the external language is not at all known, but within, there is only one happiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तें वेगळेपणें भोगिजे। जैसें पक्षियें फळ चुंबिजे। तैसें नव्हे तेथ विसरिजे । भोगितेपणही ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teṃ vegaḻepaṇeṃ bhogije| jaiseṃ pakṣiyeṃ phaḻa cuṃbije| taiseṃ navhe tetha visarije | bhogitepaṇahī || 31||
verses.meaning: But it is not enjoyed separately, like a bird pecking at a fruit. There, even the sense of being the enjoyer is forgotten.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भोगीं अवस्था एकी उठी। ते अहंकाराचा अंचळु लोटी । मग सुखेंसि घे आंटी । गाढेपणें ॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhogīṃ avasthā ekī uṭhī| te ahaṃkārācā aṃcaḻu loṭī | maga sukheṃsi ghe āṃṭī | gāḍhepaṇeṃ ||32||
verses.meaning: In the midst of enjoyment, a state arises, casting aside the veil of ego, and then it embraces happiness with profound intensity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये आलिंगनमेळीं । होय आपेंआप कवळी । तेथ जळ जैसें जळीं । वेगळें न दिसे॥३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye āliṃganameḻīṃ | hoya āpeṃāpa kavaḻī | tetha jaḻa jaiseṃ jaḻīṃ | vegaḻeṃ na dise||33||
verses.meaning: In that embrace, one becomes completely absorbed within oneself, just as water merges with water, becoming indistinguishable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां आकाशीं वायु हारपे। तेथ दोन्ही हे भाष लोपे। तैसें सुखचि उरे स्वरूपे । सुरतीं तिये ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ākāśīṃ vāyu hārape| tetha donhī he bhāṣa lope| taiseṃ sukhaci ure svarūpe | suratīṃ tiye || 34||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind dissolves into the sky, and both the sky and the wind cease to be distinct, so too does only pure bliss remain in that state of union.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशी द्वैताची भाष जाय । मग म्हणों जरी एक होय। तरी तेथ साक्षी कवणु आहे। जाणतें जें ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśī dvaitācī bhāṣa jāya | maga mhaṇoṃ jarī eka hoya| tarī tetha sākṣī kavaṇu āhe| jāṇateṃ jeṃ || 35||
verses.meaning: When such a sense of duality vanishes, and it is said that there is only oneness, then who is the witness to that oneness? What is it that knows?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी म्हणौनि असो हें आधवें। एथ न बोलणें काय बोलावें। ते खुणाचि पावले स्वभावें। आत्माराम ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: 92 śrījñāneśvarī mhaṇauni aso heṃ ādhaveṃ| etha na bolaṇeṃ kāya bolāveṃ| te khuṇāci pāvale svabhāveṃ| ātmārāma || 36||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let all this be. What is there to speak when silence itself is the answer? Those who are naturally attuned to the Self-realized Being understand this sign.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे ऐसेनि सुखें मातळे। आपणपांचि आपण गुंतळे। ते मी जाणें निखळ वोतले। सामरस्याचे ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: je aiseni sukheṃ mātaḻe| āpaṇapāṃci āpaṇa guṃtaḻe| te mī jāṇeṃ nikhaḻa votale| sāmarasyāce || 37||
verses.meaning: Those who are intoxicated by such bliss, and become absorbed in themselves, I know them to be entirely imbued with the essence of spiritual unity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते आनंदाचे अनुकार। सुखाचे अंकुर। कीं महाबोधें विहार। केळे जैसे॥३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: te ānaṃdāce anukāra| sukhāce aṃkura| kīṃ mahābodheṃ vihāra| keḻe jaise||38||
verses.meaning: They are like the imitation of joy, the sprouts of happiness, or like the sport of great enlightenment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते विवेकाचे गांव। कौं परब्रह्मींचे स्वभाव। नातरी अळंकारळे अवयव। ब्रह्मविद्येचे ।॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: te vivekāce gāṃva| kauṃ parabrahmīṃce svabhāva| nātarī aḻaṃkāraḻe avayava| brahmavidyece ||| 39||
verses.meaning: Are they the abode of discrimination, or the very nature of the Supreme Brahman? Or are they the adorned limbs of the knowledge of Brahman?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते सत्त्वाचे सात्त्विक । कीं चैतन्याचे आंगिक हें बहु असो एकैक। वानिसी काई ॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: te sattvāce sāttvika | kīṃ caitanyāce āṃgika heṃ bahu aso ekaika| vānisī kāī || 140||
verses.meaning: Are they the sattvic nature of Sattva, or are they the very limbs of Consciousness? Let this much be, why describe each one individually?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं संतस्तवनीं रतसी। तरी कथेची से न करिसी । कीं निराळीं बोळ देखसी। सनागर॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ saṃtastavanīṃ ratasī| tarī kathecī se na karisī | kīṃ nirāḻīṃ boḻa dekhasī| sanāgara|| 41||
verses.meaning: If you are engrossed in praising saints, then you will not attend to the story, or you will see separate paths, O wise one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तो रसातिशयो मुकुळीं। मग ग्रंथार्थदीपु उजळीं। करीं साधुहृदयराउळीं । मंगळ उखा॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari to rasātiśayo mukuḻīṃ| maga graṃthārthadīpu ujaḻīṃ| karīṃ sādhuhṛdayarāuḻīṃ | maṃgaḻa ukhā|| 42||
verses.meaning: When that ultimate essence is in bud, then the lamp of the scripture's meaning is lit, performing an auspicious arati in the temple of the saints' hearts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा श्रीगुरूचा उवायिला। निवृत्तिदासासी पातळा। मग तो म्हणे श्रीकृष्ण बोलिला । तेंचि आइका॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā śrīgurūcā uvāyilā| nivṛttidāsāsī pātaḻā| maga to mhaṇe śrīkṛṣṇa bolilā | teṃci āikā|| 43||
verses.meaning: Thus, the teaching of Shri Guru reached Nivrittidasa. Then he said, "Listen to what Shri Krishna spoke."

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना अनंत सुखाच्या डोहीं ।॥ एकसरा तळुचि घेतला जिहीं । मग स्थिराऊनि तेही । तेंचि जाहळे॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā anaṃta sukhācyā ḍohīṃ ||| ekasarā taḻuci ghetalā jihīṃ | maga sthirāūni tehī | teṃci jāhaḻe|| 44||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, those who have plunged into the depths of infinite bliss and become stable there, have indeed become that very bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा आत्मप्रकाशें चोखें। जो आपणपेंचि विश्व देखे । तो देहेंचि परब्रह्म सुखें । मानूं येईल ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā ātmaprakāśeṃ cokheṃ| jo āpaṇapeṃci viśva dekhe | to deheṃci parabrahma sukheṃ | mānūṃ yeīla || 45||
verses.meaning: Or, one who, through the pure light of the Self, sees the entire universe within oneself, can truly be considered the Supreme Brahman, even while embodied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें साचोकारें परम। ना तें अक्षर निःसीम । जिये गांबींचे निष्काम। अधिकारिये॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sācokāreṃ parama| nā teṃ akṣara niḥsīma | jiye gāṃbīṃce niṣkāma| adhikāriye|| 46||
verses.meaning: That which is truly supreme, that which is the boundless, imperishable Brahman, is the profound secret, the ultimate goal for those who are truly desireless and worthy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें महर्षी वाढलें। विरक्‍्तां भागा फिटलें। जें निःसंशया पिकलें। निरंतर ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ maharṣī vāḍhaleṃ| virak‍tāṃ bhāgā phiṭaleṃ| jeṃ niḥsaṃśayā pikaleṃ| niraṃtara || 47||
verses.meaning: That which has grown for the great sages, that which has been fulfilled for the detached, that which has ripened without doubt, eternally.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं विषयांपासोनि हिरतलें। चित्त आपुलें आपण जिंतिलें। ते निश्‍चित जेथ सुतळे। चेतीचिना ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ viṣayāṃpāsoni hirataleṃ| citta āpuleṃ āpaṇa jiṃtileṃ| te niś‍cita jetha sutaḻe| cetīcinā || 48||
verses.meaning: Those who have withdrawn their minds from worldly objects and conquered themselves, they certainly do not awaken from the sleep of ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें परब्रह्म निर्वाण । जें आत्मविदांचें कारण । तेंचि ते पुरुष जाण। पंडुकुमरा॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ parabrahma nirvāṇa | jeṃ ātmavidāṃceṃ kāraṇa | teṃci te puruṣa jāṇa| paṃḍukumarā|| 49||
verses.meaning: That Supreme Brahman, the ultimate liberation, which is the very cause of those who know the Self—know that to be the Purusha, O son of Pandu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते ऐसे कैसेंनि जहाले । जे देहींचि ब्रह्मत्वा आले। हें पुससी तरी भलें। संक्षेपें सांगों ॥ १५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: te aise kaiseṃni jahāle | je dehīṃci brahmatvā āle| heṃ pusasī tarī bhaleṃ| saṃkṣepeṃ sāṃgoṃ || 150||
verses.meaning: How did they achieve such a state, where they attained Brahmanhood while still embodied? If you ask this, then it is good; we shall explain it concisely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी वैराग्याचेनि आधारें । जिहीं विषय दवडूनि बाहिरें। शरीरीं एकंदरें। केलें मन॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī vairāgyāceni ādhāreṃ | jihīṃ viṣaya davaḍūni bāhireṃ| śarīrīṃ ekaṃdareṃ| keleṃ mana|| 51||
verses.meaning: Thus, with the support of detachment, they drove out worldly desires and made the mind one with the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सहजें तिहीं संधी भेटी । जेथ भ्रूपल्लवां पडे गांठी । तेथ 'पाठिमोरी दिठी । पारखोनियां ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: sahajeṃ tihīṃ saṃdhī bheṭī | jetha bhrūpallavāṃ paḍe gāṃṭhī | tetha 'pāṭhimorī diṭhī | pārakhoniyāṃ || 52||
verses.meaning: Where the three nadis naturally meet, where the eyebrows converge, there, with a backward glance, one discerns.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांडूनि दक्षिण वाम । प्राणापानसम । चित्तेंसीं व्योम-। गामिये करिती॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃḍūni dakṣiṇa vāma | prāṇāpānasama | citteṃsīṃ vyoma-| gāmiye karitī|| 53||
verses.meaning: Abandoning the left and right (nadis), they make the prana and apana equal, and with their consciousness, they make them move through the sky (brahmarandhra).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ जैसीं रथ्योदकें सकळें । घेऊनि गंगा समुद्री मिळे। मग एकेकु वेगळें । निवडूं नये॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha jaisīṃ rathyodakeṃ sakaḻeṃ | gheūni gaṃgā samudrī miḻe| maga ekeku vegaḻeṃ | nivaḍūṃ naye|| 54||
verses.meaning: Just as all the waters from the streets, upon joining the Ganga, merge into the ocean, and then it is impossible to separate each one individually.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी वासनांतराची विवंचना । मग आपैसी पारुखे अर्जुना । जे वेळीं गगनीं लयो मना। पवनें कीजे॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī vāsanāṃtarācī vivaṃcanā | maga āpaisī pārukhe arjunā | je veḻīṃ gaganīṃ layo manā| pavaneṃ kīje|| 55||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, when the mind, like the wind, dissolves into the sky-like consciousness, then the anxieties arising from desires naturally cease.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ हें संसारचित्र उमटे। तो मनोरूप पटु फाटे । जैसें सरोवर आटे । मग प्रतिभा नाहीं ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha heṃ saṃsāracitra umaṭe| to manorūpa paṭu phāṭe | jaiseṃ sarovara āṭe | maga pratibhā nāhīṃ || 56||
verses.meaning: When the canvas of the mind, upon which this painting of the world appears, is torn, just as a lake dries up, then the reflection vanishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें मन एथ मुद्दल जाय । मग अहंभावादिक कें आहे। म्हणौनि शरीरेंचि ब्रह्म होये। अनुभवी तो॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ mana etha muddala jāya | maga ahaṃbhāvādika keṃ āhe| mhaṇauni śarīreṃci brahma hoye| anubhavī to|| 57||
verses.meaning: In the same way, the mind itself is fundamentally dissolved here, then where do ego and other such things remain? Therefore, the body itself becomes Brahman, for one who experiences it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्ही मागां हन सांगितलें। जे देहींचि ब्रह्मत्व पावळे। ते येणें मार्गे आले। म्हणौनियां॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhī māgāṃ hana sāṃgitaleṃ| je dehīṃci brahmatva pāvaḻe| te yeṇeṃ mārge āle| mhaṇauniyāṃ|| 58||
verses.meaning: As we have previously stated, those who attain Brahmanhood while still embodied have come through this very path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि यमनियमांचे डोंगर। अभ्यासाचे सागर । क्रमोनि हे पार। पातले ते॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi yamaniyamāṃce ḍoṃgara| abhyāsāce sāgara | kramoni he pāra| pātale te|| 59||
verses.meaning: And having crossed the mountains of yama and niyama, and the oceans of spiritual practice, they have reached the other shore.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिहीं आपणपें करूनि निर्लेप । प्रपंचाचें घेतलें माप । मग साचाचेंचि रूप। होऊनि ठेळले॥ १६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tihīṃ āpaṇapeṃ karūni nirlepa | prapaṃcāceṃ ghetaleṃ māpa | maga sācāceṃci rūpa| hoūni ṭheḻale|| 160||
verses.meaning: Having made themselves detached, they measured the worldly illusion. Then, they remained as the very form of truth itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा योगयुक्‍तीचा उद्देशु। जेथ बोलिला हृषीकेश । तेथ अर्जुनु सुदंशु। म्हणौनि चमत्कारला ॥६९१ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā yogayuk‍tīcā uddeśu| jetha bolilā hṛṣīkeśa | tetha arjunu sudaṃśu| mhaṇauni camatkāralā ||691 ||
verses.meaning: Such was the purpose of the yoga-technique, which Hrishikesha (Lord Krishna) expounded. Arjuna, being a worthy disciple, was therefore greatly astonished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें देखिलिया कृष्णे जाणितलें। मग हांसोनि पार्थातें म्हणितळें। काई पां चित्त उबाइलें। इये बोलीं तुझें ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ dekhiliyā kṛṣṇe jāṇitaleṃ| maga hāṃsoni pārthāteṃ mhaṇitaḻeṃ| kāī pāṃ citta ubāileṃ| iye bolīṃ tujheṃ || 62||
verses.meaning: Krishna, seeing this, understood. Then, smiling, he said to Partha, "Why has your mind become agitated by these words?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव अर्जुन म्हणे देवो । परचित्तलक्षणांचा रावो) भला जाणितला जी भावो। मानसु माझा ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva arjuna mhaṇe devo | paracittalakṣaṇāṃcā rāvo) bhalā jāṇitalā jī bhāvo| mānasu mājhā || 63||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said, "O Lord, You are the king of those who understand the minds of others. You have indeed understood my inner feeling."

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्यां जें कांहीं विवरोनि पुसावें। तें आधींचि जाणितलें देवें। तरी बोलिलें तेंचि सांगावें। विवळ करूनि॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: myāṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ vivaroni pusāveṃ| teṃ ādhīṃci jāṇitaleṃ deveṃ| tarī bolileṃ teṃci sāṃgāveṃ| vivaḻa karūni|| 64||
verses.meaning: Whatever I intended to ask and elaborate upon, the Lord already knew it. Therefore, He should explain what He has already spoken, making it clear and elaborate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी अबधारा। जो दाविला तुम्ही अनुसारा । तो पव्हण्याहूनि पायउतारा । सोहपा जैसा ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī abadhārā| jo dāvilā tumhī anusārā | to pavhaṇyāhūni pāyautārā | sohapā jaisā || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, please consider this: the path you have shown us to follow is like a shallow ford, making it easy to cross, rather than a deep river.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सांख्याहूनि प्रांजळा । आम्हांसारिखियां अभोळां। एथ आहाति परि कांहीं काळा। तो साहों ये वर॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sāṃkhyāhūni prāṃjaḻā | āmhāṃsārikhiyāṃ abhoḻāṃ| etha āhāti pari kāṃhīṃ kāḻā| to sāhoṃ ye vara|| 66||
verses.meaning: Just as for us, who are simple and uninitiated, the path of Sankhya is straightforward, yet it requires enduring some time to realize its truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि एक वेळ देवा। तोचि पडताळा घेयावा। विस्तरेल तरी ९ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी सांगावा । साद्यंतुचि ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni eka veḻa devā| toci paḍatāḻā gheyāvā| vistarela tarī 9 śrījñāneśvarī sāṃgāvā | sādyaṃtuci || 67||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Lord, once again, let that very test be taken. If it expands, then the entire Dnyaneshwari should be narrated from beginning to end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव श्रीकृष्ण म्हणती हो कां। तुज हा मार्ग गमल्म निका। तरी काय जाहलें आईकीजो कां । सुखें बोलों ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva śrīkṛṣṇa mhaṇatī ho kāṃ| tuja hā mārga gamalma nikā| tarī kāya jāhaleṃ āīkījo kāṃ | sukheṃ boloṃ || 68||
verses.meaning: Then Shri Krishna said, "Indeed, if this path seems good to you, then listen to what happened, and we shall speak happily."

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना तूं परिससी। परिसोनि अनुष्ठिसी। तरी आम्हांसीचि वानी कायसी । सांगावयाची ॥ ६९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā tūṃ parisasī| parisoni anuṣṭhisī| tarī āmhāṃsīci vānī kāyasī | sāṃgāvayācī || 69 ||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, if you listen and then practice what you hear, then why should we even bother to tell you anything?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधींचि चित्त मायेचे । वरी मिष जाहलें पढियंतयाचें । आतां तें अदभुतपण स्नेहाचें। कवण जाणे॥ १७० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhīṃci citta māyece | varī miṣa jāhaleṃ paḍhiyaṃtayāceṃ | ātāṃ teṃ adabhutapaṇa snehāceṃ| kavaṇa jāṇe|| 170 ||
verses.meaning: The mind is already entangled in illusion, and on top of that, it has found a beloved object. Now, who can comprehend the wondrous nature of such affection?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें म्हणों कारुण्यरसाची वृष्टि। कीं नवया स्नेहाची सृष्टि । हें असो नेणिजे दृष्टी । हरीची वान्‌ ॥ ७१ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ mhaṇoṃ kāruṇyarasācī vṛṣṭi| kīṃ navayā snehācī sṛṣṭi | heṃ aso neṇije dṛṣṭī | harīcī vān‌ || 71 ||
verses.meaning: Is it a shower of compassion? Or a new creation of love? Let it be, the sight of Hari cannot be described.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे अमृताची बोतली। कीं प्रेमचचे पिऊनि मातली। म्हणौनि अर्जुनमोहें गुंतली । निघों नेणें ॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je amṛtācī botalī| kīṃ premacace piūni mātalī| mhaṇauni arjunamoheṃ guṃtalī | nighoṃ neṇeṃ ||72||
verses.meaning: It is as if she has drunk the nectar of love and is intoxicated by it. Therefore, she is entangled in the illusion of Arjuna and does not know how to escape.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बहु जें जें जल्पिजेळ। तेथें कथेसि फांकु होईल। परि तें स्नेहरूपा न येळ। बोलबरी ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ bahu jeṃ jeṃ jalpijeḻa| tetheṃ kathesi phāṃku hoīla| pari teṃ sneharūpā na yeḻa| bolabarī || 73||
verses.meaning: Whatever is spoken at great length, the story will become convoluted. But it will not come forth as an expression of love, however much is said.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विसुरा काय येणें।॥ तो ईश्वरु कवळावा कवणें। जो आपुलें मान नेणें । आपणचि ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni visurā kāya yeṇeṃ||| to īśvaru kavaḻāvā kavaṇeṃ| jo āpuleṃ māna neṇeṃ | āpaṇaci || 74||
verses.meaning: Therefore, what is the use of forgetting? Who can grasp that God, who does not even know His own measure, being Himself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मागील ध्वनीआंतु। मज गमला सावियाचि मोहितु। जे बलात्कारें असे म्हणतु। परिस बापा ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī māgīla dhvanīāṃtu| maja gamalā sāviyāci mohitu| je balātkāreṃ ase mhaṇatu| parisa bāpā || 75||
verses.meaning: Even then, in the sound that came before, I was captivated by the very essence, which forcefully declares, "Listen, my child."

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना जेणें जेणें भेदें। तुझें कां चित्त बोधे । तैसें तैसें विनोदें। निरूपिजेळ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā jeṇeṃ jeṇeṃ bhedeṃ| tujheṃ kāṃ citta bodhe | taiseṃ taiseṃ vinodeṃ| nirūpijeḻa|| 76||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, whatever means will enlighten your mind, by those very means, with delight, I shall expound upon it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो काइसया नाम योगु। तयाचा 'कवण उपेगु।) अथवा अधिकारप्रसंगु) कवणा येथ॥७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to kāisayā nāma yogu| tayācā 'kavaṇa upegu|) athavā adhikāraprasaṃgu) kavaṇā yetha||77||
verses.meaning: What kind of Yoga is that? What is its use? Or, who is qualified for it here?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जें जें कांहीं ॥ उक्त असे इये ठाई । तें आघवेंचि पाहीं। सांगेन आतां॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jeṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ || ukta ase iye ṭhāī | teṃ āghaveṃci pāhīṃ| sāṃgena ātāṃ|| 78||
verses.meaning: Whatever has been said here, I will now explain all of it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं चित्त देऊनि अवधारीं। ऐसें म्हणौनि श्रीहरी । बोळिजेल ते पुढारी। कथा आहे॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ citta deūni avadhārīṃ| aiseṃ mhaṇauni śrīharī | boḻijela te puḍhārī| kathā āhe|| 79||
verses.meaning: Listen attentively, giving your full mind to it, said Shri Hari. The story that follows is indeed profound.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीकृष्ण अर्जुनासी संगु। न सांडोनि सांगेल योगु। तो व्यक्‍त करूं प्रसंगु। म्हणे निवृत्तिदासु॥ १८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīkṛṣṇa arjunāsī saṃgu| na sāṃḍoni sāṃgela yogu| to vyak‍ta karūṃ prasaṃgu| mhaṇe nivṛttidāsu|| 180||
verses.meaning: Shri Krishna will explain the Yoga to Arjuna without any concealment. Nivruttidas says that he will now reveal that very discourse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग रायातें म्हणे संजयो । तोचि अभिप्रावो अवधारिजो। कृष्ण सांगती आतां जो। योगरूप॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga rāyāteṃ mhaṇe saṃjayo | toci abhiprāvo avadhārijo| kṛṣṇa sāṃgatī ātāṃ jo| yogarūpa|| 1||
verses.meaning: Then Sanjay said to the King, "Now listen to the same intention, which Krishna is now explaining, in the form of Yoga."

verses.shloka_devanagari: सहजें ब्रह्मरसाचें पारणें। केलें अर्जुनालागीं नारायणें। कीं तेचि अवसरीं पाहुणे । पातलों आम्ही ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: sahajeṃ brahmarasāceṃ pāraṇeṃ| keleṃ arjunālāgīṃ nārāyaṇeṃ| kīṃ teci avasarīṃ pāhuṇe | pātaloṃ āmhī || 2||
verses.meaning: Naturally, Narayana offered Arjuna the feast of Brahman's essence. And at that very moment, we too arrived as guests.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसी दैवाची आगळिक नेणिजे। जैसें तान्हेळिया तोय सेविजे। कीं तेंचि चवी करूनि पाहिजे । तंव अमृत आहे ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaisī daivācī āgaḻika neṇije| jaiseṃ tānheḻiyā toya sevije| kīṃ teṃci cavī karūni pāhije | taṃva amṛta āhe || 3||
verses.meaning: How can one not know the abundance of divine grace? It is like a thirsty person drinking water, and then, upon tasting it, realizing it is nectar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें आम्हां तुम्हां जाहळें। जें आडमुठीं तत्त्व 'फावलें। तंव धृतराष्ट्रे म्हणितलें। हें न पुसों तूंतें ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ āmhāṃ tumhāṃ jāhaḻeṃ| jeṃ āḍamuṭhīṃ tattva 'phāvaleṃ| taṃva dhṛtarāṣṭre mhaṇitaleṃ| heṃ na pusoṃ tūṃteṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: It is as if we have both stumbled upon the truth by chance, like finding a hidden treasure. Upon hearing this, Dhritarashtra said, "I will not question you further on this."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया संजया येणें बोलें। रायाचें हृदय चोजवलें। जें अवसरीं आहे घेतलें। कुमारांचिया॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā saṃjayā yeṇeṃ boleṃ| rāyāceṃ hṛdaya cojavaleṃ| jeṃ avasarīṃ āhe ghetaleṃ| kumārāṃciyā|| 5||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya, by these words, the king's heart was moved, as it was already captivated by his sons.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जाणोनि मनीं हांसिला । म्हणे म्हातारा मोहें नाशिला । एऱ्हवीं बोलु तरी भला जाहला । अवसरीं इये ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jāṇoni manīṃ hāṃsilā | mhaṇe mhātārā moheṃ nāśilā | eṟhavīṃ bolu tarī bhalā jāhalā | avasarīṃ iye || 6||
verses.meaning: Knowing this, he laughed in his mind, saying, "The old man is destroyed by delusion. Otherwise, his words were good at this opportune moment."

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तें तैसें कैसेनि होईल। जात्यंधु कैसें 'पाहेळ। तेवींची ये रुसें घेईल। म्हणौनि बिहे ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teṃ taiseṃ kaiseni hoīla| jātyaṃdhu kaiseṃ 'pāheḻa| tevīṃcī ye ruseṃ gheīla| mhaṇauni bihe || 7||
verses.meaning: But how can that be? How can one born blind see? Similarly, how can this anger be taken? Therefore, one fears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि आपण चित्तीं आपुल्म। निकियापरी संतोषला । जे तो संवादु फावला । कृष्णार्जुनांचा ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari āpaṇa cittīṃ āpulma| nikiyāparī saṃtoṣalā | je to saṃvādu phāvalā | kṛṣṇārjunāṃcā || 8||
verses.meaning: When You, in Your own heart, were greatly pleased, then the dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna became manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें आनंदाचेनि धालेपणें । साभिप्राय अंतःकरणें । आतां आदरेंसीं बोलणें । घडेल तया॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ ānaṃdāceni dhālepaṇeṃ | sābhiprāya aṃtaḥkaraṇeṃ | ātāṃ ādareṃsīṃ bolaṇeṃ | ghaḍela tayā||9||
verses.meaning: With the fullness of that joy, and with a heart full of purpose, now a respectful discourse will ensue.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो गीतेमाजि षष्ठींचा। प्रसंगु असे आयणीचा । जैसा क्षीरार्णवीं अमृताचा । निवाडु जाहळा॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: to gītemāji ṣaṣṭhīṃcā| prasaṃgu ase āyaṇīcā | jaisā kṣīrārṇavīṃ amṛtācā | nivāḍu jāhaḻā|| 10||
verses.meaning: Thus, in the sixth chapter of the Gita, there is an occasion for profound insight, just as nectar was churned out of the ocean of milk.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें गीतार्थाचें सार। जें विवेकसिंधूचें पार। नाना योगविभवभाडार। उघडलें कां ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ gītārthāceṃ sāra| jeṃ vivekasiṃdhūceṃ pāra| nānā yogavibhavabhāḍāra| ughaḍaleṃ kāṃ || 11||
verses.meaning: Thus, the essence of the Gita's meaning, the shore of the ocean of discrimination, or the treasure house of yogic power, has been opened.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें आदिप्रकृतीचें विसवणें। जें शब्दब्रह्मासि न बोलणें। जेथूनि गीतावल्लीचें ठाणें। प्ररोहो पावे॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ ādiprakṛtīceṃ visavaṇeṃ| jeṃ śabdabrahmāsi na bolaṇeṃ| jethūni gītāvallīceṃ ṭhāṇeṃ| praroho pāve|| 12||
verses.meaning: That which is the resting place of the primordial nature, that which is beyond the speech of the Shabda Brahman, from which the creeper of the Gita sprouts and flourishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अध्यायो सहावा। वरि साहित्याचिया बरवा । सांगिजैल म्हणौनि परिसावा। चित्त देउनी ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to adhyāyo sahāvā| vari sāhityāciyā baravā | sāṃgijaila mhaṇauni parisāvā| citta deunī || 13||
verses.meaning: Therefore, this sixth chapter, adorned with literary beauty, will be expounded. So, listen attentively.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझा मराठाचि बोलु कौतुकें । परि अमृतातेंही पैजां जिंके । ऐसीं अक्षरें रसिकें । मेळवीन ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhā marāṭhāci bolu kautukeṃ | pari amṛtāteṃhī paijāṃ jiṃke | aisīṃ akṣareṃ rasikeṃ | meḻavīna || 14||
verses.meaning: My Marathi speech, though spoken with affection, will surely conquer even nectar in its sweetness. Such words, full of aesthetic delight, I shall bring together.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये कोंबळिकेचेनि पाडें । दिसती नादींचे रंग थोडे । वेधें परिमळाचें बीक मोडे । जयाचेनि॥ १५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye koṃbaḻikeceni pāḍeṃ | disatī nādīṃce raṃga thoḍe | vedheṃ parimaḻāceṃ bīka moḍe | jayāceni|| 15 ||
verses.meaning: By the tenderness of which sprout, the colors of the sound appear diminished; by whose allure, the power of fragrance is broken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐका रसाळपणाचिया लोभा । कीं श्रवणींचि होति जिभा । बोलें इंद्रियां लागे कळंभा। एकामेकां॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aikā rasāḻapaṇāciyā lobhā | kīṃ śravaṇīṃci hoti jibhā | boleṃ iṃdriyāṃ lāge kaḻaṃbhā| ekāmekāṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: Listen to the allure of this sweetness, as if the ears themselves become tongues. The words create a delightful commotion among the senses, each vying for attention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सहजें शब्दु तरी विषो श्रवणाचा । परि रसना म्हणे रसु हा आमुचा। घ्राणासि भावो जाय परिमळाचा। हा तोचि ९६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी होईल॥ ९१७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sahajeṃ śabdu tarī viṣo śravaṇācā | pari rasanā mhaṇe rasu hā āmucā| ghrāṇāsi bhāvo jāya parimaḻācā| hā toci 96 śrījñāneśvarī hoīla|| 917||
verses.meaning: Naturally, sound is the object of hearing, but the tongue says, 'This taste is ours.' The nose perceives fragrance. This is indeed that same (experience of the Divine).

verses.shloka_devanagari: नवल बोलतीये रेखेची वाहणी । देखतां डोळ्यांही पुरों लागे धणी। ते म्हणती उघडली खाणी। रूपाची हे॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: navala bolatīye rekhecī vāhaṇī | dekhatāṃ ḍoḻyāṃhī puroṃ lāge dhaṇī| te mhaṇatī ughaḍalī khāṇī| rūpācī he|| 18||
verses.meaning: The wonder of its form is spoken of, a sight that satisfies the eyes. They say, "A mine of beauty has opened up here."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ संपूर्ण पद उभारे। तेथ मनचि धांवे बाहिरें। बोलु भुजाही आविष्करे। आलिंगावया ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha saṃpūrṇa pada ubhāre| tetha manaci dhāṃve bāhireṃ| bolu bhujāhī āviṣkare| āliṃgāvayā || 19||
verses.meaning: When the complete spiritual experience manifests, the mind itself rushes forth to embrace it, and words too emerge from the arms, as if to encompass it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशीं इंद्रियें आपुलालिया भावीं । झोंबती परि तो सरिसेपणेंचि बुझावी । जैसा एकला जग चेववी। सहस्त्रकरु ॥२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśīṃ iṃdriyeṃ āpulāliyā bhāvīṃ | jhoṃbatī pari to sarisepaṇeṃci bujhāvī | jaisā ekalā jaga cevavī| sahastrakaru ||20||
verses.meaning: In the same way that the sun, with its thousand rays, awakens the entire world, the Self, though one, pacifies the senses, each striving in its own way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें शब्दाचे व्यापकपण। देखिजे असाधारण । पाहातयां भावज्ञां फावती गुण। चिंतामणीचे ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ śabdāce vyāpakapaṇa| dekhije asādhāraṇa | pāhātayāṃ bhāvajñāṃ phāvatī guṇa| ciṃtāmaṇīce || 21||
verses.meaning: Just as the vastness of words is seen as extraordinary, so too do discerning devotees attain the qualities of a wish-fulfilling gem.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असोतु या बोलांचीं ताटें भली । बरी कैवल्यरसें बोगरिलीं । ही प्रतिपत्ति मियां केली। निष्कामासी॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ asotu yā bolāṃcīṃ tāṭeṃ bhalī | barī kaivalyaraseṃ bogarilīṃ | hī pratipatti miyāṃ kelī| niṣkāmāsī|| 22||
verses.meaning: Let it be so. These plates of words are excellent, well-filled with the nectar of liberation. This offering I have made to the desireless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां आत्मप्रभा नीच नवी। तेचि करूनि 'ठाणदिवी । जो इंद्रियांतें चोरूनि जेवी । तयासीचि फावे॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ ātmaprabhā nīca navī| teci karūni 'ṭhāṇadivī | jo iṃdriyāṃteṃ corūni jevī | tayāsīci phāve|| 23||
verses.meaning: Now, the ever-new light of the Self, making that its lamp, whoever secretly partakes of the senses, only they attain it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ श्रवणाचेनि पांगे-। वीण श्रोतयां होआवें लागे । हें मनाचेनि निजांगें। भोगिजे गा॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha śravaṇāceni pāṃge-| vīṇa śrotayāṃ hoāveṃ lāge | heṃ manāceni nijāṃgeṃ| bhogije gā|| 24||
verses.meaning: Here, without the support of listening, the listener must become one with the experience. This is to be enjoyed by the very essence of the mind itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आहाच बोलाची वाळीफ फेडिजे। आणि ब्रह्माचियाचि आंगा घडिजे। मग सुखेंसीं सुरवाडिजे। सुखाचिमाजीं ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āhāca bolācī vāḻīpha pheḍije| āṇi brahmāciyāci āṃgā ghaḍije| maga sukheṃsīṃ suravāḍije| sukhācimājīṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Then, the debt of mere words is repaid, and one is fashioned into the very form of Brahman. Thus, one is immersed in bliss, within the very essence of happiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें हळुवारपण जरी येईल। तरीच हें उपेगा जाईल। एऱ्हबीं आघवी गोठी होईल। मुकया बहिरयाची ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ haḻuvārapaṇa jarī yeīla| tarīca heṃ upegā jāīla| eṟhabīṃ āghavī goṭhī hoīla| mukayā bahirayācī || 26||
verses.meaning: If such gentleness is achieved, only then will this be useful. Otherwise, the entire discussion will be like that of the mute and the deaf.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तें असो आतां आघवें । नलगे श्रोतयांतें कडसावें। जे अधिकारिये येथ स्वभावें। निष्कामकामु॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teṃ aso ātāṃ āghaveṃ | nalage śrotayāṃteṃ kaḍasāveṃ| je adhikāriye yetha svabhāveṃ| niṣkāmakāmu|| 27||
verses.meaning: But let all that be now. There is no need to sift the listeners, for those who are naturally qualified here are those who desire nothing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं आत्मबोधाचिया आवडी। केली स्वर्गसंसाराची कुरोंडी। तेवांचूनि एथींची गोडी। नेणती आणिक ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ ātmabodhāciyā āvaḍī| kelī svargasaṃsārācī kuroṃḍī| tevāṃcūni ethīṃcī goḍī| neṇatī āṇika || 28||
verses.meaning: Those who, out of love for self-knowledge, have sacrificed the pleasures of heaven and worldly life, only they can truly understand the sweetness of this path; others cannot.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा वायसीं चंद्र नोळखिजे। तैसा प्राकृतीं हा ग्रंथु नेणिजे। आणि तो हिमांशुचि जेविं खाजें। चकोराचें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā vāyasīṃ caṃdra noḻakhije| taisā prākṛtīṃ hā graṃthu neṇije| āṇi to himāṃśuci jeviṃ khājeṃ| cakorāceṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Just as a crow does not recognize the moon, so too this scripture is not understood by ordinary people. And just as the moon itself is the food for the chakora bird.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सज्ञानासी तरी हा ठावो। आणि अज्ञानासी आन गांवो। म्हणौनि बोलावया विषय पहा हो। बिशेषु नाहीं ॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sajñānāsī tarī hā ṭhāvo| āṇi ajñānāsī āna gāṃvo| mhaṇauni bolāvayā viṣaya pahā ho| biśeṣu nāhīṃ || 30||
verses.meaning: Thus, for the enlightened, this is the only abode, and for the ignorant, there is no other village. Therefore, there is nothing special to speak about, behold!

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी अनुवादलों मी प्रसंगें। तें सज्जनीं उपसाहाबें लागे। आतां सांगेन काय श्रीरंगें। निरोपिलें जें॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī anuvādaloṃ mī prasaṃgeṃ| teṃ sajjanīṃ upasāhābeṃ lāge| ātāṃ sāṃgena kāya śrīraṃgeṃ| niropileṃ jeṃ|| 31||
verses.meaning: I have translated this as best as I could, given the circumstances. The wise and good people should bear with me. Now, what shall I say about what Lord Krishna has revealed?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें बुद्धीही आकळितां सांकडें। म्हणौनि बोलीं विपायें सांपडे। परि श्रीनिवृत्तिकृपादीपउजियेडें। देखैन मी॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ buddhīhī ākaḻitāṃ sāṃkaḍeṃ| mhaṇauni bolīṃ vipāyeṃ sāṃpaḍe| pari śrīnivṛttikṛpādīpaujiyeḍeṃ| dekhaina mī||32||
verses.meaning: Even the intellect struggles to grasp it, so it is rarely captured in words. But by the illuminating lamp of Shri Nivruttinath's grace, I shall perceive it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें दिठीही न पविजे। तें दिठीविण देखिजे। जरी अतींद्रिय लाहिजे। ज्ञानबळ ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ diṭhīhī na pavije| teṃ diṭhīviṇa dekhije| jarī atīṃdriya lāhije| jñānabaḻa || 33||
verses.meaning: That which cannot be perceived by the eye, can be seen without the eye, if the strength of knowledge beyond the senses is attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी जें धातुबादाही न जोडे । तें लोहींचि पंधरें सांपडे। जरी दैवयोगें चढे। परिसु हातां॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī jeṃ dhātubādāhī na joḍe | teṃ lohīṃci paṃdhareṃ sāṃpaḍe| jarī daivayogeṃ caḍhe| parisu hātāṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: That which cannot be achieved even by alchemy, is found in iron itself, if by divine fortune, the touchstone comes into hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी गुरुकृपा होये। तरी करितां काय आपु नोहे । म्हणौनि तें अपार मातें आहे । ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī gurukṛpā hoye| tarī karitāṃ kāya āpu nohe | mhaṇauni teṃ apāra māteṃ āhe | jñānadevo mhaṇe || 35||
verses.meaning: Thus, if there is the Guru's grace, then what is there that cannot be achieved by oneself? Therefore, that boundless grace is upon me, says Dnyandev.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें कारणें मी बोलेन) बोलीं अरूपाचें रूप दावीन। अतींद्रिय परी भोगवीन । इंद्रियांकरवीं ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ kāraṇeṃ mī bolena) bolīṃ arūpāceṃ rūpa dāvīna| atīṃdriya parī bhogavīna | iṃdriyāṃkaravīṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: For that reason, I will speak; through my words, I will reveal the form of the formless. Though it is beyond the senses, I will make it experienced by the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आइका यश श्री औदार्य । ज्ञान वैराग्य ऐश्वर्य। हे साही गुणवर्य। बसती जेथ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āikā yaśa śrī audārya | jñāna vairāgya aiśvarya| he sāhī guṇavarya| basatī jetha|| 37||
verses.meaning: Listen, where these six excellent qualities reside: glory, prosperity, generosity, knowledge, detachment, and divine power.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तो भगवंतु। जो निःसंगाचा सांगातु। तो म्हणे पार्था दत्तचित्तु। होड आतां॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni to bhagavaṃtu| jo niḥsaṃgācā sāṃgātu| to mhaṇe pārthā dattacittu| hoḍa ātāṃ|| 38||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that Lord, who is the companion of the unattached, said, "Arjuna, now be attentive."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आडके योगी आणि संन्यासी जनीं। हे एकचि सिनानें झणीं मानीं। एऱ्हवीं विचारिजती जंब दोन्ही। तंव एकचि ते॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āḍake yogī āṇi saṃnyāsī janīṃ| he ekaci sināneṃ jhaṇīṃ mānīṃ| eṟhavīṃ vicārijatī jaṃba donhī| taṃva ekaci te|| 39||
verses.meaning: Yogis and renunciates are considered one and the same. When both are contemplated, they are indeed one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांडिजे दुजया नामाचा आभासु। तरी योगु तोचि संन्यासु। पाहतां ब्रह्मी नाहीं अवकाशु । दोहींमाजीं ॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃḍije dujayā nāmācā ābhāsu| tarī yogu toci saṃnyāsu| pāhatāṃ brahmī nāhīṃ avakāśu | dohīṃmājīṃ || 40||
verses.meaning: If the illusion of duality is abandoned, then that very state is both Yoga and Sannyasa. Upon realizing Brahman, there is no room for these two distinctions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें नामाचेनि अनारिसेपणें। एका पुरुषातें बोलावणें । कां दोहींमार्गी जाणें । एकाचि ठायां ॥ ४९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ nāmāceni anārisepaṇeṃ| ekā puruṣāteṃ bolāvaṇeṃ | kāṃ dohīṃmārgī jāṇeṃ | ekāci ṭhāyāṃ || 491||
verses.meaning: Just as by calling out a name, one calls a person, or by walking on two paths, one reaches the same place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी एकचि उदक सहजें। परि सिनाना घटीं भरिजे। तैसें भिन्नत्व हें जाणिजे । योगसंन्यासांचें ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī ekaci udaka sahajeṃ| pari sinānā ghaṭīṃ bharije| taiseṃ bhinnatva heṃ jāṇije | yogasaṃnyāsāṃceṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: Just as there is only one water, yet it is filled into various pots, so too should the apparent difference between Yoga and Sannyasa be understood.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आडइकें सकळ संमतें जगीं। अर्जुना गा तोचि योगी। जो कर्मे करूनि रागी । नोहेचि फळीं॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āḍaikeṃ sakaḻa saṃmateṃ jagīṃ| arjunā gā toci yogī| jo karme karūni rāgī | noheci phaḻīṃ|| 43||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, the one who performs actions without attachment to their fruits, is considered by all in the world to be a true Yogi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी मही हे उद्धिजें। जनी अहंबुद्धीबीण सहजें। आणि तेथिंचीं तियें बीजें। अपेक्षीना ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī mahī he uddhijeṃ| janī ahaṃbuddhībīṇa sahajeṃ| āṇi tethiṃcīṃ tiyeṃ bījeṃ| apekṣīnā || 44||
verses.meaning: Just as the earth naturally sprouts forth seeds without ego, and does not expect anything in return from those seeds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसा अन्वयाचेनि ( आम्नायाचेनि ) आधारें। जातीचेनि अनुकारें। जें जेणें अवसरें।॥ करणें पावे॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tesā anvayāceni ( āmnāyāceni ) ādhāreṃ| jātīceni anukāreṃ| jeṃ jeṇeṃ avasareṃ||| karaṇeṃ pāve|| 45||
verses.meaning: That which, through the support of tradition and the imitation of its nature, reaches its fulfillment at the appropriate time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें तैसेंचि उच्चित करी। परी साटोपु नोहे शरीरीं । आणि बुव्दिही करोनि 'फळवेरी। जायेचिना॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ taiseṃci uccita karī| parī sāṭopu nohe śarīrīṃ | āṇi buvdihī karoni 'phaḻaverī| jāyecinā|| 46||
verses.meaning: He performs actions in that manner, but without any strain on his body. His intellect, too, does not become entangled in the desire for results.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा तोचि संन्यासी। पार्था गा परियेसीं । तोचि भरंबसेनिसीं। योगीश्वरु ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā toci saṃnyāsī| pārthā gā pariyesīṃ | toci bharaṃbasenisīṃ| yogīśvaru || 47||
verses.meaning: Such a one is indeed a renunciate, O Partha, listen to me. He is truly a great yogi, full of unwavering faith.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि उचित कर्म प्रासंगिक । तयातें म्हणे हें सांडावें बद्धक। तरी टांकोटांकी आणिक । मांडीचि तो॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni ucita karma prāsaṃgika | tayāteṃ mhaṇe heṃ sāṃḍāveṃ baddhaka| tarī ṭāṃkoṭāṃkī āṇika | māṃḍīci to|| 48||
verses.meaning: If one were to say that appropriate and incidental actions should be abandoned because they are binding, then with every step, he would only create more bonds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा क्षाळुनिया लेपु एकु । सवेंचि लाविजे आणिकु । तैसेनि आग्रहाचा पाइकु । विचंबे वायां॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā kṣāḻuniyā lepu eku | saveṃci lāvije āṇiku | taiseni āgrahācā pāiku | vicaṃbe vāyāṃ|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as one washes off one stain only to apply another, so too does a servant of obstinacy waste away in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गृहस्थाश्रमाचें वबोझें। कपाळीं आधींचे आहे सहजें। कौं तेंचि संन्याससबा ठेविजे। सरिसें पुढती ॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: gṛhasthāśramāceṃ vabojheṃ| kapāḻīṃ ādhīṃce āhe sahajeṃ| kauṃ teṃci saṃnyāsasabā ṭhevije| sariseṃ puḍhatī || 50||
verses.meaning: The burden of household life is already naturally on one's forehead. Why then should the burden of renunciation be placed upon it again, equally?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अग्निसेवा न सांडितां। कर्माची रेखा नोलांडितां। आहे योगसुख स्वभावता। आपणपांचि॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni agnisevā na sāṃḍitāṃ| karmācī rekhā nolāṃḍitāṃ| āhe yogasukha svabhāvatā| āpaṇapāṃci||51||
verses.meaning: Therefore, without abandoning the service of the sacred fire, and without transgressing the boundaries of prescribed actions, the joy of Yoga naturally arises within oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ९८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी ऐकें संन्यासी तोचि योगी। ऐसी एकवाक्‍्यतेचि जगीं । गुढी उभविली अनेगीं । शास्त्रांतरीं ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: 98 śrījñāneśvarī aikeṃ saṃnyāsī toci yogī| aisī ekavāk‍yateci jagīṃ | guḍhī ubhavilī anegīṃ | śāstrāṃtarīṃ || 52||
verses.meaning: Listen, in the scriptures, it has been proclaimed in many places, with one voice, that a renunciate (sannyasi) is indeed a yogi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ संन्यासिला संकल्पु तुटे । तेथचि योगाचें सार भेटे। ऐसें हें अनुभवाचेनि धटें। साचें जया॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha saṃnyāsilā saṃkalpu tuṭe | tethaci yogāceṃ sāra bheṭe| aiseṃ heṃ anubhavāceni dhaṭeṃ| sāceṃ jayā|| 53||
verses.meaning: Where the very intention of renunciation is severed, there the essence of Yoga is found. Such is the truth for those who realize it through direct experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां योगाचळाचा निमथा। जरी ठाकावा आधि पार्था । तरी सोपाना या कर्मपथा। चुका झणी ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yogācaḻācā nimathā| jarī ṭhākāvā ādhi pārthā | tarī sopānā yā karmapathā| cukā jhaṇī || 54||
verses.meaning: Now, O Arjuna, if you wish to reach the summit of Yoga, then do not neglect this path of action, which is like a staircase.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें यमनियमांचेनि तळवटें। रिगे आसनाचिये पाउलवाटे । येई प्राणायामाचेनि आडकंठें। वरौता गा॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ yamaniyamāṃceni taḻavaṭeṃ| rige āsanāciye pāulavāṭe | yeī prāṇāyāmāceni āḍakaṃṭheṃ| varautā gā|| 55||
verses.meaning: Through the foundation of yama and niyama, one enters the path of asana. From there, through the narrow passage of pranayama, one ascends higher.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग प्रत्याहाराचा अधाडा। जो बुन्दिचियाही पायां निसरडा । जेथ हटिये सांडिती होडा। कडेलग॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga pratyāhārācā adhāḍā| jo bundiciyāhī pāyāṃ nisaraḍā | jetha haṭiye sāṃḍitī hoḍā| kaḍelaga|| 56||
verses.meaning: Then comes the practice of Pratyahara, which is so subtle that it slips from the grasp even of the intellect. It is here that even the most stubborn yogis abandon their efforts, reaching their limit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी अभ्यासाचेनि बळें । प्रत्याहारीं निराळें । नखी लागेल ढाळें ढाळें । वैराग्याची ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī abhyāsāceni baḻeṃ | pratyāhārīṃ nirāḻeṃ | nakhī lāgela ḍhāḻeṃ ḍhāḻeṃ | vairāgyācī || 57||
verses.meaning: Through the strength of spiritual practice, detachment will naturally and gradually manifest in the form of dispassion, even in the smallest actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा पवनाचेनि पाठारें। येतां धारणेचेनि पैसारें ( पैयारें )। क्रमी ध्यानाचें चवरें। सांपडे तंव ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā pavanāceni pāṭhāreṃ| yetāṃ dhāraṇeceni paisāreṃ ( paiyāreṃ )| kramī dhyānāceṃ cavareṃ| sāṃpaḍe taṃva || 58||
verses.meaning: Thus, by the support of the breath, and with the expanse of concentration, one traverses the crossroads of meditation until one finds it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तया मार्गाची धांब। पुरेल प्रवृत्तीची हांव। जेथ साध्यसाधना खेंब । समरसें होय॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayā mārgācī dhāṃba| purela pravṛttīcī hāṃva| jetha sādhyasādhanā kheṃba | samaraseṃ hoya|| 59||
verses.meaning: Then, the path itself becomes the fulfillment of all desires, where the goal and the means merge into a single, harmonious experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ पुढील पैसु पारुखे। मागील स्मराबें तें ठाके । ऐसिये सरिसीये भूमिके । समाधि राहे॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha puḍhīla paisu pārukhe| māgīla smarābeṃ teṃ ṭhāke | aisiye sarisīye bhūmike | samādhi rāhe|| 60||
verses.meaning: Where the future is not perceived, and the past is not remembered, in such an equalized state, samadhi abides.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें उपायें योगारूढु। जो निरवधि जाहला प्रौढु। तयाचिया चिन्हांचा निवाडु । सांगैन आइकें ॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ upāyeṃ yogārūḍhu| jo niravadhi jāhalā prauḍhu| tayāciyā cinhāṃcā nivāḍu | sāṃgaina āikeṃ ||61||
verses.meaning: Listen, I will now explain the characteristics of one who, through these means, has become firmly established and mature in Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जयाचिया इंद्रियांचिया घरा। नाहीं विषयांचिया येरझारा। जो आत्माबोधाचिया वोवरां। पहुडला असे॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jayāciyā iṃdriyāṃciyā gharā| nāhīṃ viṣayāṃciyā yerajhārā| jo ātmābodhāciyā vovarāṃ| pahuḍalā ase||62||
verses.meaning: One whose senses' abode is free from the comings and goings of worldly objects, who rests in the cave of self-realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचें सुखदुःखाचेनि आंगें । झगटळलें मानस चेवो नेघे । विषय पासींही आलिया से न रिगे। हें काय म्हणौनि॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceṃ sukhaduḥkhāceni āṃgeṃ | jhagaṭaḻaleṃ mānasa cevo neghe | viṣaya pāsīṃhī āliyā se na rige| heṃ kāya mhaṇauni|| 63||
verses.meaning: Whose mind, entangled in the experiences of joy and sorrow, does not awaken, and even when sense objects come near, does not engage with them, saying, "What is this?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियें कर्माच्या ठायीं । वाढीनलीं परि कहीं । फळहेतूची चाड नाहीं। अंतःकरणी ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyeṃ karmācyā ṭhāyīṃ | vāḍhīnalīṃ pari kahīṃ | phaḻahetūcī cāḍa nāhīṃ| aṃtaḥkaraṇī || 64||
verses.meaning: Though the senses are engaged in actions, there is no desire for the fruits of those actions in the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: असतेनि देहें एतुला। जो चेतुचि दिसे निदेला। तोचि योगारूढु भला । बोळखें तूं ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: asateni deheṃ etulā| jo cetuci dise nidelā| toci yogārūḍhu bhalā | boḻakheṃ tūṃ || 65||
verses.meaning: Know him to be truly established in Yoga, who, though embodied, appears to be asleep while fully conscious.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अर्जुन म्हणे अनंता । हें मज विस्मो बहु आइकतां। सांगें तया ऐसी योग्यता । कवणें दीजे॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha arjuna mhaṇe anaṃtā | heṃ maja vismo bahu āikatāṃ| sāṃgeṃ tayā aisī yogyatā | kavaṇeṃ dīje|| 66||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said to the Infinite One, "I am greatly astonished to hear this. Tell me, by whom is such capability bestowed?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब हांसोनि श्रीकृष्ण म्हणे । तुझें नवल ना हें बोलणें । कवणासि काय दिजेळ कवणें। अद्वैतीं इये ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba hāṃsoni śrīkṛṣṇa mhaṇe | tujheṃ navala nā heṃ bolaṇeṃ | kavaṇāsi kāya dijeḻa kavaṇeṃ| advaitīṃ iye || 67||
verses.meaning: Smiling, Shri Krishna said, "Is this not a wonder, your words? Who can give what to whom in this non-dual reality?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं व्यामोहाचिये शेजे। बळिया अविद्या निद्रितु होईजे। ते वेळीं दुःस्वप्न हा भोगिजे। जन्ममृत्यूंचा ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ vyāmohāciye śeje| baḻiyā avidyā nidritu hoīje| te veḻīṃ duḥsvapna hā bhogije| janmamṛtyūṃcā || 68 ||
verses.meaning: When, on the bed of delusion, powerful ignorance falls asleep, then one experiences the nightmare of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं अवसांत ये चेवो। तैं तें अवघेचि होय वाबो। ऐसा उपजे नित्य सदभावो। तोहि आपणपांचि ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ avasāṃta ye cevo| taiṃ teṃ avagheci hoya vābo| aisā upaje nitya sadabhāvo| tohi āpaṇapāṃci || 69||
verses.meaning: When awareness dawns in the midst of unconsciousness, everything becomes futile. Such a constant, pure feeling arises from within oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आपणचि आपणयां। घातु कीजतु असे धनंजया । चित्त देऊनि नाथिलिया। देहाभिमाना ॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āpaṇaci āpaṇayāṃ| ghātu kījatu ase dhanaṃjayā | citta deūni nāthiliyā| dehābhimānā || 70||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Dhananjaya, by giving importance to this body, one is harming oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा विचारूनि अहंकारु सांडिजे। मग असतीच वस्तु होईजे । तरी आपली स्वस्ति सहजें। आपण केली॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā vicārūni ahaṃkāru sāṃḍije| maga asatīca vastu hoīje | tarī āpalī svasti sahajeṃ| āpaṇa kelī|| 71||
verses.meaning: By questioning and abandoning this ego, one becomes the true Self that always exists. Thus, one naturally achieves one's own well-being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱहवी कोशकीटकाचिया परी । तो आपणया आपण वैरी। जो आत्मबुद्धि शरीरीं । चारुस्थळीं ॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟahavī kośakīṭakāciyā parī | to āpaṇayā āpaṇa vairī| jo ātmabuddhi śarīrīṃ | cārusthaḻīṃ ||72||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, like a silkworm, he is his own enemy, who considers the body as the Self, in all four states (waking, dreaming, deep sleep, and Turiya).

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसे प्राप्तीचिये वेळे। निदैवा अंधळेपणाचे डोहळे। कीं असते आपुले डोळे। आपण झांकी॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaise prāptīciye veḻe| nidaivā aṃdhaḻepaṇāce ḍohaḻe| kīṃ asate āpule ḍoḻe| āpaṇa jhāṃkī|| 73||
verses.meaning: How can one, at the moment of attainment, be so unfortunate as to be blind, or how can one close one's own eyes when they are open?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां कवण एकु भ्रमलेपर्णे। मी तो नव्हे गा चोरलों म्हणे। ऐसा नाथिला छंदु अंतःकरणें। घेऊनि ठाके ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ kavaṇa eku bhramaleparṇe| mī to navhe gā coraloṃ mhaṇe| aisā nāthilā chaṃdu aṃtaḥkaraṇeṃ| gheūni ṭhāke || 74||
verses.meaning: Or, just as someone deluded by a false perception might say, "I am not that, I have been stolen," similarly, the mind clings to such baseless notions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं होय तें तोचि आहे। परि काई कीजे बुद्धि तेशी नोहे। देखा स्वप्नींचेनि घायें। कीं मरे साचें ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ hoya teṃ toci āhe| pari kāī kīje buddhi teśī nohe| dekhā svapnīṃceni ghāyeṃ| kīṃ mare sāceṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Indeed, whatever happens, it is He alone. But what can be done when the intellect is not of that understanding? Does one truly die from a wound received in a dream?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैशी ते शुकाचेनि आंगभारें। नळिका भोविन्नलळी एरी मोहरें। तेणें उडावें परी न पुरे। मनशंका ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiśī te śukāceni āṃgabhāreṃ| naḻikā bhovinnalaḻī erī mohareṃ| teṇeṃ uḍāveṃ parī na pure| manaśaṃkā || 76||
verses.meaning: Just as a parrot, by its very weight, causes the branch to sway and bend, yet it is not enough to dispel the doubt in its mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वायांचि मान पिळी । अटुबें हियें आंबळी । टिटांतु नळी। धरूनि ठाके॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāyāṃci māna piḻī | aṭubeṃ hiyeṃ āṃbaḻī | ṭiṭāṃtu naḻī| dharūni ṭhāke|| 77||
verses.meaning: He needlessly twists the neck, and with a stubborn heart, he holds a pipe to the nostril and remains still.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे बांधला मी फुडा। ऐसिया भावनेचिया पडे खोडां। कीं मोकळिया पायांचा चवबडा। गोंबी अधिकें ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe bāṃdhalā mī phuḍā| aisiyā bhāvaneciyā paḍe khoḍāṃ| kīṃ mokaḻiyā pāyāṃcā cavabaḍā| goṃbī adhikeṃ || 78||
verses.meaning: He thinks, "I am bound by the ties of this world." Such a thought becomes a hindrance, like a hobble on a free-footed horse, making it stumble more.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा काजेंबीण आंतुडला | तो सांग पां काय आणिकें बांधला । मग न सोडीच जऱ्ही नेला । तोडूनि अर्धा ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā kājeṃbīṇa āṃtuḍalā | to sāṃga pāṃ kāya āṇikeṃ bāṃdhalā | maga na soḍīca jaṟhī nelā | toḍūni ardhā || 79||
verses.meaning: If someone is thus caught without any reason, tell me, what else has bound him? Even if he is taken away, he will not be freed, even if cut in half.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आपणयां आपणचि रिपु । जेणें वाढविला हा संकल्पु । येर स्वयंबुद्धि म्हणे बापु। जो नाथिलें नेघे॥८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āpaṇayāṃ āpaṇaci ripu | jeṇeṃ vāḍhavilā hā saṃkalpu | yera svayaṃbuddhi mhaṇe bāpu| jo nāthileṃ neghe||80||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one is one's own enemy, who has fostered this resolve. The other, self-realized wisdom, says, "Alas, it accepts nothing that is not real."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ९०० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तया स्वांतःकरणजिता। सकळकामोपशांता। परमात्मा परौता। दूरी नाहीं ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: 900 śrījñāneśvarī tayā svāṃtaḥkaraṇajitā| sakaḻakāmopaśāṃtā| paramātmā parautā| dūrī nāhīṃ || 81||
verses.meaning: To one who has conquered their inner self, whose desires are completely pacified, the Supreme Soul is not far away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा किडाळाचा दोषु जाये । तरी पंधरें तेंचि होये। तैसें जीवा ब्रह्मत्व आहे। संकल्पळोपीं॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā kiḍāḻācā doṣu jāye | tarī paṃdhareṃ teṃci hoye| taiseṃ jīvā brahmatva āhe| saṃkalpaḻopīṃ|| 82||
verses.meaning: Just as the impurity of brass is removed, it becomes pure gold. Similarly, the soul attains Brahmanhood when its संकल्प (thoughts/intentions) are dissolved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा घटाकारु जैसा । निमालिया तया अवकाशा। नलगे मिळों जाणें आकाशा। आना ठाया॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ghaṭākāru jaisā | nimāliyā tayā avakāśā| nalage miḻoṃ jāṇeṃ ākāśā| ānā ṭhāyā|| 83||
verses.meaning: Just as a pot, when it breaks, does not need to go and merge into space elsewhere, because it was always space itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा देहाहंकारु नाथिला। हा समूळ जयाचा नाशिला। तोचि परमात्मा संचला । आधींचि आहे॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā dehāhaṃkāru nāthilā| hā samūḻa jayācā nāśilā| toci paramātmā saṃcalā | ādhīṃci āhe||84||
verses.meaning: Similarly, for one whose ego of the body has been completely destroyed, the Supreme Self is already present within them from the very beginning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां शीतोष्णाचिया वाहणी। तेथ सुखदुःखाची 'कडसणी। इयें न समाती कांहीं बोलणीं। मानापमानांचीं ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ śītoṣṇāciyā vāhaṇī| tetha sukhaduḥkhācī 'kaḍasaṇī| iyeṃ na samātī kāṃhīṃ bolaṇīṃ| mānāpamānāṃcīṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: Now, in the flow of heat and cold, the distinctions of pleasure and pain, and the talks of honor and dishonor, do not hold any meaning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे जिये वाटा सूर्य जाये । तेउतें तेजाचें विश्व होये। तैसें तया पावे तें आहे। तोचि म्हणौनी ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: je jiye vāṭā sūrya jāye | teuteṃ tejāceṃ viśva hoye| taiseṃ tayā pāve teṃ āhe| toci mhaṇaunī || 86||
verses.meaning: Just as the world becomes illuminated wherever the sun goes, so too, whatever reaches Him, becomes Him. Therefore, He is that very thing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें मेघोनि सुटती धारा। तिया न रुपती जैसिया सागरा । तैंशीं शुभाशुभें योगीश्‍वरा । नव्हती आनें ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ meghoni suṭatī dhārā| tiyā na rupatī jaisiyā sāgarā | taiṃśīṃ śubhāśubheṃ yogīś‍varā | navhatī āneṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: Just as the rain showers, released from the clouds, do not affect the ocean, similarly, good and bad deeds do not affect the Yogi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो हा विज्ञानात्मकु भावो । तया विवरितां जाहळा वाबो। मग लागला जंब पाहों। तंव ज्ञान तें तोचि ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo hā vijñānātmaku bhāvo | tayā vivaritāṃ jāhaḻā vābo| maga lāgalā jaṃba pāhoṃ| taṃva jñāna teṃ toci || 88||
verses.meaning: When this scientific understanding was analyzed, it became clear that it was a mere illusion. Then, upon closer inspection, it was revealed that knowledge itself is that very illusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां व्यापकु कीं एकदेशी । हे ऊहापोही जे ऐसी। ते करावी ठेली आपैशी । दुजेनवीण ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ vyāpaku kīṃ ekadeśī | he ūhāpohī je aisī| te karāvī ṭhelī āpaiśī | dujenavīṇa || 89||
verses.meaning: Now, whether it is all-pervading or localized, such a debate ceases naturally, without any duality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा शरीरीचि परी कौतुकें । परब्रह्माचेनि पाडें तुके । जेणें जिंतलीं एकें । इंद्रियें गा ॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā śarīrīci parī kautukeṃ | parabrahmāceni pāḍeṃ tuke | jeṇeṃ jiṃtalīṃ ekeṃ | iṃdriyeṃ gā || 90||
verses.meaning: Such is the wonder of the body, that it rivals the Supreme Brahman, by which the senses are conquered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो जितेंद्रियु सहजें। तोचि योगयुक्तु म्हणिजे । जेणें सानें थोर नेणिजे। कवणे काळीं ॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: to jiteṃdriyu sahajeṃ| toci yogayuktu mhaṇije | jeṇeṃ sāneṃ thora neṇije| kavaṇe kāḻīṃ ||91||
verses.meaning: He who is naturally self-controlled, he alone is called a yogi, by whom small and great are not known at any time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें सोनयाचें निखळ। मेरुयेसणें ढिसाळ) आणि मातियेचें डिखळ। सरिसेंचि मानी ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ sonayāceṃ nikhaḻa| meruyesaṇeṃ ḍhisāḻa) āṇi mātiyeceṃ ḍikhaḻa| sariseṃci mānī || 92||
verses.meaning: Behold, a pure lump of gold, like Mount Meru, and a clod of earth, are considered equal.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहतां पृथ्वीचे मोल थोडें । ऐसें अनर्घ्य रत्न चोखडें। देखे दगडाचेनि पाडें। निचाडु ऐसा॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhatāṃ pṛthvīce mola thoḍeṃ | aiseṃ anarghya ratna cokhaḍeṃ| dekhe dagaḍāceni pāḍeṃ| nicāḍu aisā|| 93||
verses.meaning: When one sees the Earth, its value seems little. Such a priceless, pure gem is seen as mere stone, utterly worthless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सुहृद आणि शत्रु। कां उदासु आणि मित्रु। हा भावभेदु विचित्रु। कल्पूं कँंचा॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha suhṛda āṇi śatru| kāṃ udāsu āṇi mitru| hā bhāvabhedu vicitru| kalpūṃ ka~ṃcā|| 94||
verses.meaning: How can one even imagine such strange distinctions as friend and foe, or indifferent and ally?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया बंधु कोण काह्याचा। द्वरेषिया कवणु तयाचा । मीचि विश्व ऐसा जयाचा । बोधु जाहलळा॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā baṃdhu koṇa kāhyācā| dvareṣiyā kavaṇu tayācā | mīci viśva aisā jayācā | bodhu jāhalaḻā|| 95||
verses.meaning: To such a one, who is a brother to whom? Who is an enemy to him? For he has realized that 'I am the universe'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तयाचिये दिठी। अधमोत्तम असे किरीटी । काय परिसाचिये कसवटी । वानिया कौजे॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayāciye diṭhī| adhamottama ase kirīṭī | kāya parisāciye kasavaṭī | vāniyā kauje|| 96||
verses.meaning: Then, in his sight, O Kiriti, what is high or low? How can one describe the touchstone's value?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते जैशी निर्वाण वर्णुचि करी। तैसी जयाची बुद्धी चराचरीं। होय साम्याची उजरी। निरंतर ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: te jaiśī nirvāṇa varṇuci karī| taisī jayācī buddhī carācarīṃ| hoya sāmyācī ujarī| niraṃtara || 97||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp illuminates everything, so too does the intellect of such a person continuously shine with the light of equality throughout the animate and inanimate world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे ते विश्‍वालंकाराचें विसुरे। जरी आहाती आनानें आकारें। तरी घडले एकचि भांगारें। परब्रहों ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: je te viś‍vālaṃkārāceṃ visure| jarī āhātī ānāneṃ ākāreṃ| tarī ghaḍale ekaci bhāṃgāreṃ| parabrahoṃ || 98 ||
verses.meaning: Though the ornaments of the universe appear in various forms, they are all fashioned from the same gold, which is the Supreme Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जाणणें जें बरवें । तें फावलें तया आधवें। म्हणौनि आहाचवाहाच न झकवे। येणें आकारचित्रें ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jāṇaṇeṃ jeṃ baraveṃ | teṃ phāvaleṃ tayā ādhaveṃ| mhaṇauni āhācavāhāca na jhakave| yeṇeṃ ākāracitreṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: Such excellent knowledge, when attained by someone, prevents them from being deluded by the illusory forms of the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घापे पटामाजि दृष्टी । दिसे तंतूंची सैंघ सृष्टी । परी तो एकवांचूनि गोठी । दुजी नाहीं ॥ ९००॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghāpe paṭāmāji dṛṣṭī | dise taṃtūṃcī saiṃgha sṛṣṭī | parī to ekavāṃcūni goṭhī | dujī nāhīṃ || 900||
verses.meaning: Though the eye perceives a vast creation of threads within the cloth, in reality, there is no second entity apart from that one (the thread itself).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि प्रतीती हें गवसे। ऐसा अनुभव जयातें असे । तोचि समबुद्धि हें अनारिसें । नव्हे जाणें ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni pratītī heṃ gavase| aisā anubhava jayāteṃ ase | toci samabuddhi heṃ anāriseṃ | navhe jāṇeṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: One who has such an experience, who has attained such a realization, truly knows that this equanimity is not something different or separate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचें नांब तीर्थराबो। दर्शनें प्रशस्तीसि ठावो। जयाचेनि संगें ब्रह्मभावो। भ्रांतासही ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceṃ nāṃba tīrtharābo| darśaneṃ praśastīsi ṭhāvo| jayāceni saṃgeṃ brahmabhāvo| bhrāṃtāsahī || 2||
verses.meaning: Whose name is a pilgrimage site, whose sight is a place of praise, by whose association even the deluded attain the state of Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचेनि बोलें धर्मु जिये। दिठी महासिद्धीतें विये । देखें स्वर्गसुखादि इयें।॥ खेळु जयाचा ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceni boleṃ dharmu jiye| diṭhī mahāsiddhīteṃ viye | dekheṃ svargasukhādi iyeṃ||| kheḻu jayācā || 3||
verses.meaning: By whose word Dharma lives, whose mere glance gives birth to great spiritual powers, and by whom even the joys of heaven are seen as mere play.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विपायें जरी आठवला चित्ता । तरी दे आपुली योग्यता । हें असो तयातें प्रशंसितां। लाभु आथि॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: vipāyeṃ jarī āṭhavalā cittā | tarī de āpulī yogyatā | heṃ aso tayāteṃ praśaṃsitāṃ| lābhu āthi|| 4||
verses.meaning: Even if remembered in adversity, He bestows His own worth. Moreover, praising Him brings benefit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढती अस्तवेना ऐसें। जया पाहलें अह्वैतदिवसें। मग आपणपांचि आपणु असे। अखंडित ॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhatī astavenā aiseṃ| jayā pāhaleṃ ahvaitadivaseṃ| maga āpaṇapāṃci āpaṇu ase| akhaṃḍita ||5||
verses.meaning: Then, that which never sets, the day of non-duality dawned for him. And then, he himself remained as himself, unbroken, forever.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया वृष्टी जो विवेकी। पार्था तो एकाकी । सहजें अपरिग्रही जो तिहीं लोकीं । तोचि म्हणौनि ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā vṛṣṭī jo vivekī| pārthā to ekākī | sahajeṃ aparigrahī jo tihīṃ lokīṃ | toci mhaṇauni || 6||
verses.meaning: O Partha, such a discerning person, who is naturally unattached in all three worlds, is indeed the one who truly understands this shower of wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसियें असाधारणें । निष्पन्नाचीं लक्षणें । आपुलेनि बहुवसपणें । श्रीकृष्ण बोळे॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyeṃ asādhāraṇeṃ | niṣpannācīṃ lakṣaṇeṃ | āpuleni bahuvasapaṇeṃ | śrīkṛṣṇa boḻe|| 7||
verses.meaning: With such extraordinary and profound characteristics of the realized soul, Shri Krishna spoke.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो ज्ञानियांचा बापु। देखणेयांचे दिठीचा दीपु। जया दादुलयाचा संकल्पु । विश्व रची ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo jñāniyāṃcā bāpu| dekhaṇeyāṃce diṭhīcā dīpu| jayā dādulayācā saṃkalpu | viśva racī || 8||
verses.meaning: He is the father of the wise, the lamp of the seer's eye, whose mere intention creates the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रणवाचिये पेठे । जाहलें शब्दब्रह्म माजिठें। तें जयाचिये यशा धाकुटें । वेढूं न पुरे ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: praṇavāciye peṭhe | jāhaleṃ śabdabrahma mājiṭheṃ| teṃ jayāciye yaśā dhākuṭeṃ | veḍhūṃ na pure || 9||
verses.meaning: The marketplace of Om (Pranava) gave rise to the vast expanse of the Word-Brahman (Shabdabrahma), yet even that immense glory is insufficient to encompass His fame.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचेनि आंगिकें तेजें। आवो रविशशीचिये वणिजे। म्हणौनि जग हें वेशजे-। वीण असे तया॥ ११०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceni āṃgikeṃ tejeṃ| āvo raviśaśīciye vaṇije| mhaṇauni jaga heṃ veśaje-| vīṇa ase tayā|| 110||
verses.meaning: By whose inherent radiance, the sun and moon are but a reflection, and therefore, this world exists without any other adornment or light.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा नामची एक जयाचें। पाहतां गगनही दिसे टांचें। गुण एकैक काय तयाचे । आकळशील तूं॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā nāmacī eka jayāceṃ| pāhatāṃ gaganahī dise ṭāṃceṃ| guṇa ekaika kāya tayāce | ākaḻaśīla tūṃ|| 11||
verses.meaning: Ah, how can you comprehend even a single one of His qualities, before whom the vast sky itself appears insignificant?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि असो हें वानणें। सांगों नेणों कवणाचीं लक्षणें । दाबावीं मिषें येणें। कां बोलिलों तें ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aso heṃ vānaṇeṃ| sāṃgoṃ neṇoṃ kavaṇācīṃ lakṣaṇeṃ | dābāvīṃ miṣeṃ yeṇeṃ| kāṃ boliloṃ teṃ || 12||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let this description be. I do not know whose characteristics I am describing. Why did I speak, using this pretext?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐके द्वैताचा ठावोचि फेडी। ते ब्रह्मविद्या कीजेळ उघडी । तरि अर्जुना पढिये हे गोडी । नासेल हन॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aike dvaitācā ṭhāvoci pheḍī| te brahmavidyā kījeḻa ughaḍī | tari arjunā paḍhiye he goḍī | nāsela hana|| 13||
verses.meaning: Listen, this spiritual knowledge (Brahma-vidya) completely removes the very root of duality. If it is revealed openly, then Arjuna, this sweetness (of spiritual experience) will be lost.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तें तैसें बोलणें । नव्हे सपातळ आड लावणें। केलें मनचि वेगळवाणें। भोगावया ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni teṃ taiseṃ bolaṇeṃ | navhe sapātaḻa āḍa lāvaṇeṃ| keleṃ manaci vegaḻavāṇeṃ| bhogāvayā || 94||
verses.meaning: Therefore, such a statement is not a superficial or misleading adornment. It is the mind itself that has been set apart for the experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया सो$हंभाव अटकु । मोक्षसुखालागोनि रंकु । तयाचिये दिठीचा झणें कळंकु । लागेल तुझिया प्रेमा ॥ ९१५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā so$haṃbhāva aṭaku | mokṣasukhālāgoni raṃku | tayāciye diṭhīcā jhaṇeṃ kaḻaṃku | lāgela tujhiyā premā || 915||
verses.meaning: Beware lest the stain of the gaze of one who is attached to the 'I am He' notion and is poor in the bliss of liberation, should fall upon your love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विपायें अहंभावो ययाचा जाईल। मी तेंचि हा जरी होईल। तरी मग काय कौजेल। १०२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी एकलेया॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: vipāyeṃ ahaṃbhāvo yayācā jāīla| mī teṃci hā jarī hoīla| tarī maga kāya kaujela| 102 śrījñāneśvarī ekaleyā|| 16||
verses.meaning: If by this means one's ego is dissolved, and one becomes that very Self, then what more could be desired from the solitary Dnyaneshwari?

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिठीचि पाहतां निविजे। कां तोंड भरोनि बोलिजे । नातरी दाटूनि खेंब दीजे। ऐसें कवण आहे॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: diṭhīci pāhatāṃ nivije| kāṃ toṃḍa bharoni bolije | nātarī dāṭūni kheṃba dīje| aiseṃ kavaṇa āhe|| 17||
verses.meaning: Who is there who can be satisfied by merely seeing, or speak with a full mouth, or give a tight embrace?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलिया मना बरवी । असमाई गोठी जीवीं। ते कवणेंसि चावळावी। जरी ऐक्य जाहलें॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpuliyā manā baravī | asamāī goṭhī jīvīṃ| te kavaṇeṃsi cāvaḻāvī| jarī aikya jāhaleṃ|| 18||
verses.meaning: When one's mind is filled with a profound and inexpressible truth, how can it be shared with others if there is already a state of oneness?

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया काकुळती जनार्दनें। अन्योपदेशाचेनि हाताशनें। बोलामाजि मन मनें। आलिंगूं सरलें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā kākuḻatī janārdaneṃ| anyopadeśāceni hātāśaneṃ| bolāmāji mana maneṃ| āliṃgūṃ saraleṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: With such compassion, Janardana (Lord Krishna) embraced Arjuna's mind with His words, as if with the hands of another's teaching.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे परिसतां जरी कानडें। तरि जाण पां पार्थ उघडें। कृष्णसुखाचेंचि रूपडें। बोतळें गा॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he parisatāṃ jarī kānaḍeṃ| tari jāṇa pāṃ pārtha ughaḍeṃ| kṛṣṇasukhāceṃci rūpaḍeṃ| botaḻeṃ gā|| 120||
verses.meaning: Even if this seems difficult to comprehend, O Arjuna, know that it is clearly the very form of Krishna's bliss, which is being revealed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो वयसेचिये शेवटीं । जैसें एकचि विये वांझोटी । मग ते मोहाची त्रिपुटी । नाचों लागे॥ २१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso vayaseciye śevaṭīṃ | jaiseṃ ekaci viye vāṃjhoṭī | maga te mohācī tripuṭī | nācoṃ lāge|| 219||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Just as a barren woman gives birth to a single child in her old age, then the three-fold illusion of attachment begins to dance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जाहलें श्रीअनंता । ऐसें तरी मी न म्हणतां । जरी तयाचा न देखतां । अतिशयो एथ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jāhaleṃ śrīanaṃtā | aiseṃ tarī mī na mhaṇatāṃ | jarī tayācā na dekhatāṃ | atiśayo etha|| 22||
verses.meaning: O Infinite One, it has become like this. Even if I do not say so, it is because I do not see its greatness here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहा पां नवल कैसें चोज। कें उपदेशु केउतें झुंज। परि पुढें वालभाचें भोज। नाचत असे॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhā pāṃ navala kaiseṃ coja| keṃ upadeśu keuteṃ jhuṃja| pari puḍheṃ vālabhāceṃ bhoja| nācata ase|| 23||
verses.meaning: Behold, what a wonder, what a marvel! Where is the teaching, and where is the battle? Yet, before it, the feast of love dances.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आवडी आणि लाजवी। व्यसन आणि शिणवी। पिसें आणि न भुलवी। तरीं तेंचि काई॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āvaḍī āṇi lājavī| vyasana āṇi śiṇavī| piseṃ āṇi na bhulavī| tarīṃ teṃci kāī|| 24||
verses.meaning: If love does not make one yearn, if addiction does not tire, if madness does not delude, then what is it truly?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भावार्थ तो ऐसा। अर्जुन मैत्रियेचा कुवासा । कीं सुखें शृंगारळिया मानसा । दर्पणु तो॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhāvārtha to aisā| arjuna maitriyecā kuvāsā | kīṃ sukheṃ śṛṃgāraḻiyā mānasā | darpaṇu to|| 25||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the essence is this: Arjuna is a wellspring of friendship, or a mirror to a mind adorned with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यापरी बाप पुण्यपवित्र। जगीं भक्तिबीजासि सुक्षेत्र। तो श्रीकृष्णकृपे पात्र। याचिलागीं॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāparī bāpa puṇyapavitra| jagīṃ bhaktibījāsi sukṣetra| to śrīkṛṣṇakṛpe pātra| yācilāgīṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: In this way, the father (Arjuna) is pure and holy, a fertile ground for the seed of devotion in the world. Therefore, he is worthy of Shri Krishna's grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां आत्मनिवेदनातळींची। जे पीठिका होय सख्याची। पार्थ अधिष्ठात्री तेथिंची। मातृका गा॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ ātmanivedanātaḻīṃcī| je pīṭhikā hoya sakhyācī| pārtha adhiṣṭhātrī tethiṃcī| mātṛkā gā|| 27||
verses.meaning: Or is it that the very foundation of self-surrender, O Arjuna, becomes the presiding deity, the mother, of that place?

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'पासींचि गोसावी न वर्णिजे। मग पाइकाचा गुण घेईजे। ऐसा अर्जुनु तो सहजें। पढिये हरी ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'pāsīṃci gosāvī na varṇije| maga pāikācā guṇa gheīje| aisā arjunu to sahajeṃ| paḍhiye harī || 28||
verses.meaning: The Lord does not describe those who are close to Him; instead, He praises the qualities of His servant. Such an Arjuna is naturally dear to Lord Hari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहां पां अनुरागें भजे । जे प्रियोत्तमें मानिजे । ते 'पतीहूनि काय न वानिजे। पतित्रता ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhāṃ pāṃ anurāgeṃ bhaje | je priyottameṃ mānije | te 'patīhūni kāya na vānije| patitratā || 29||
verses.meaning: Behold, a devoted wife who worships her beloved husband with deep affection, is she not praised even more than her husband?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा अर्जुनचि बिशेषें स्तवावा । ऐसें आवडलें मज जीवा। जे तो त्रिभुवनींचिया दैवां। एकायतनु जाहला ॥ १३० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā arjunaci biśeṣeṃ stavāvā | aiseṃ āvaḍaleṃ maja jīvā| je to tribhuvanīṃciyā daivāṃ| ekāyatanu jāhalā || 130 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna is especially worthy of praise, as it pleased me to see that he became the sole abode of the good fortune of all three worlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचिया आवडीचेनि पांगें। अमूर्तुही मूर्ति आवगे। पूर्णाहि परी लागे। अवस्था जयाची ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāciyā āvaḍīceni pāṃgeṃ| amūrtuhī mūrti āvage| pūrṇāhi parī lāge| avasthā jayācī || 31||
verses.meaning: For the love of whom, even the formless takes on form, and even the complete one experiences states of being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव श्रोते म्हणती दैव। कैसी बोलाची हवाव। काय नादातें हन बरव। जिणोनि आली॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva śrote mhaṇatī daiva| kaisī bolācī havāva| kāya nādāteṃ hana barava| jiṇoni ālī|| 32||
verses.meaning: Then the listeners exclaimed, "Oh, what a divine flow of words! What a beautiful sound, as if it has conquered all other melodies and arrived!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो नवल नोहे देशी । मऱ्हाटी बोलिजे तरी ऐशी । वाणें उमटताहे आकाशीं । साहित्य रंगाचें ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho navala nohe deśī | maṟhāṭī bolije tarī aiśī | vāṇeṃ umaṭatāhe ākāśīṃ | sāhitya raṃgāceṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: This is no wonder, that in the Marathi language, such a literary hue is emerging in the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसें उन्मेखचांदिणें तार। आणि भावार्थ पडे गार। हेचि श्लोकार्थ कुमुदिनी फार। साविया होती॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaiseṃ unmekhacāṃdiṇeṃ tāra| āṇi bhāvārtha paḍe gāra| heci ślokārtha kumudinī phāra| sāviyā hotī|| 34||
verses.meaning: How the moonlight of spiritual insight and the cool shade of devotion cause the lotus of the verse's meaning to fully blossom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चाडचि निचाडां करी । ऐसी मनोरथीं ये थोरी । तेणें विवळले अंतरीं । तेथ डोळु आला ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: cāḍaci nicāḍāṃ karī | aisī manorathīṃ ye thorī | teṇeṃ vivaḻale aṃtarīṃ | tetha ḍoḻu ālā || 35 ||
verses.meaning: When such a great desire arises in the heart, even in the most indifferent, it causes a profound stirring within, and tears well up in the eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें निवृत्तिदासें जाणितलें। मग अवधान द्या म्हणितलें। नवल पांडवकुळीं पाहलें। कृष्णदिवसें॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ nivṛttidāseṃ jāṇitaleṃ| maga avadhāna dyā mhaṇitaleṃ| navala pāṃḍavakuḻīṃ pāhaleṃ| kṛṣṇadivaseṃ|| 36||
verses.meaning: Nivrittinath understood this and then said, 'Pay attention! A new dawn has broken in the Pandava lineage, a day illuminated by Krishna.'

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवकीया उदरीं वाहिला। यशोदा सायासें 'पाळिला। कीं शेखीं उपेगा गेला। पांडवांसी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: devakīyā udarīṃ vāhilā| yaśodā sāyāseṃ 'pāḻilā| kīṃ śekhīṃ upegā gelā| pāṃḍavāṃsī || 37||
verses.meaning: He was carried in Devaki's womb, and Yashoda lovingly nurtured Him; but ultimately, He was of use to the Pandavas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि बहुदिवस बोळगावा। कां अवसरु पाहोनि विनवावा। हाही सोसु तया सदैवा। पडेचिना॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bahudivasa boḻagāvā| kāṃ avasaru pāhoni vinavāvā| hāhī sosu tayā sadaivā| paḍecinā|| 38||
verses.meaning: Therefore, there is no need for that fortunate one to wait for many days or to seek an opportune moment to make a request.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो कथा सांगें वेगीं । मग अर्जुन म्हणे सलगी । देवा इयें संतचिन्हे आंगीं। न ठकती माझ्या॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso kathā sāṃgeṃ vegīṃ | maga arjuna mhaṇe salagī | devā iyeṃ saṃtacinhe āṃgīṃ| na ṭhakatī mājhyā|| 39||
verses.meaning: Let this be. I will quickly tell the story. Then Arjuna said intimately, "O Lord, these signs of saints do not appear in me."

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं या लक्षणांचिया निजसारा। मी अपाडें कौर अपुरा। परि तुमचेनि बोलें अवधारा । थोरावें जरी॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ yā lakṣaṇāṃciyā nijasārā| mī apāḍeṃ kaura apurā| pari tumaceni boleṃ avadhārā | thorāveṃ jarī|| 140||
verses.meaning: Ordinarily, I am quite inadequate and insufficient to grasp the true essence of these characteristics. But, by your grace and words, please listen, I might yet achieve greatness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी तुम्ही चित्त देयाल। तरी ब्रह्म मियां होडइजेळ। काय जहालें अभ्यासिजेळ। सांगाल जें॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī tumhī citta deyāla| tarī brahma miyāṃ hoḍaijeḻa| kāya jahāleṃ abhyāsijeḻa| sāṃgāla jeṃ|| 41||
verses.meaning: If you pay attention, then I will become Brahman. What has happened, what should be practiced, that you will tell me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो नेणों कवणाची काहाणी । आइकोनि श्लाघिजत असों अंतःकरणीं। ऐसी जहाळेपणाची शिरयाणी । कायसी देवा॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho neṇoṃ kavaṇācī kāhāṇī | āikoni ślāghijata asoṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇīṃ| aisī jahāḻepaṇācī śirayāṇī | kāyasī devā|| 42||
verses.meaning: Ah, I do not know whose story this is, that upon hearing it, we praise it in our hearts. What is this tradition of foolishness, O Lord?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें आंगें म्यां होईजो कां। येतुलें गोसावी आपुलेपणें कौजो कां। तंब हांसोनि श्रीकृष्ण हो कां। करूं म्हणती ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ āṃgeṃ myāṃ hoījo kāṃ| yetuleṃ gosāvī āpulepaṇeṃ kaujo kāṃ| taṃba hāṃsoni śrīkṛṣṇa ho kāṃ| karūṃ mhaṇatī || 43||
verses.meaning: Let this body become yours, O Lord, and let it be filled with your divine presence. Thus, smiling, Lord Krishna said, "So be it."

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखा संतोषु एक न जोडे। तंबचि सुखाचें सैंघ सांकडें।॥ मग जोडलिया 'कवणीकडे। अपुरें असे॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhā saṃtoṣu eka na joḍe| taṃbaci sukhāceṃ saiṃgha sāṃkaḍeṃ||| maga joḍaliyā 'kavaṇīkaḍe| apureṃ ase|| 44||
verses.meaning: Behold, if contentment is not attained, then all happiness is surely lacking. What then remains incomplete, even if everything else is acquired?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सर्वेश्‍वरु बळिया सेवकें । म्हणोनि ब्रह्ही होय तो कौतुकें। परि कैसा भारें आतला पिकें । दैवाचेनि॥ ४५॥
