verses.shloka_iast: taisā sarveś‍varu baḻiyā sevakeṃ | mhaṇoni brahhī hoya to kautukeṃ| pari kaisā bhāreṃ ātalā pikeṃ | daivāceni|| 45||
verses.meaning: Just as the all-powerful Lord, through His devotees, joyfully becomes the Brahman, so too does He become laden with the fruits of destiny.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो जन्मसहस्त्रांचियासाठीं। इंद्रादिकांहीं महागु भेटी) तो आधीनु केतुला किरटी। जे बोलुही न साहे ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo janmasahastrāṃciyāsāṭhīṃ| iṃdrādikāṃhīṃ mahāgu bheṭī) to ādhīnu ketulā kiraṭī| je boluhī na sāhe || 46||
verses.meaning: He, whom even Indra and other great gods seek for thousands of births, how can He be subservient to you, O Kiriti (Arjuna), when He cannot even bear to speak of it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग ऐका जें पांडवें । म्हणितलें म्यां ब्रह्म होआवें। तें अशेषही देवें। अवधारिळें॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga aikā jeṃ pāṃḍaveṃ | mhaṇitaleṃ myāṃ brahma hoāveṃ| teṃ aśeṣahī deveṃ| avadhāriḻeṃ|| 47||
verses.meaning: Then listen, what Arjuna said, "I wish to become Brahman." The Lord heard all of it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ ऐसेंचि एक विचारिलें। जे या ब्रह्मत्वाचे डोहळे जाहळे। परि उदरा वैराग्य आहे आलें। बुद्धिचिया ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha aiseṃci eka vicārileṃ| je yā brahmatvāce ḍohaḻe jāhaḻe| pari udarā vairāgya āhe āleṃ| buddhiciyā || 48||
verses.meaning: There, a similar thought arose: that the longing for Brahman has manifested, but wisdom has brought forth detachment in the womb of the intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं दिवस तरी अपुरे। परी वैराग्यवसंताचेनि भरें। जें सो5हंभाव महुरे। मोडोनि आला ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ divasa tarī apure| parī vairāgyavasaṃtāceni bhareṃ| jeṃ so5haṃbhāva mahure| moḍoni ālā || 49||
verses.meaning: Even if the days are few, by the abundance of the spring of dispassion, the egoistic sense of "I am He" breaks down and comes forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि प्राप्तिफळीं फळतां। यासि वेळु न लगेल आतां । होय विरक्तु ऐसा अनंता । भरंवसा जाहला॥ १५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni prāptiphaḻīṃ phaḻatāṃ| yāsi veḻu na lagela ātāṃ | hoya viraktu aisā anaṃtā | bharaṃvasā jāhalā|| 150||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for the fruit of attainment to ripen, it will not take long now. Such a detached one becomes certain of the Infinite.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे जें जें हा अधिष्ठील। तें आरंभींच यया फळेल। म्हणौनि सांगितला न बचेल। अभ्यासु वायां ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe jeṃ jeṃ hā adhiṣṭhīla| teṃ āraṃbhīṃca yayā phaḻela| mhaṇauni sāṃgitalā na bacela| abhyāsu vāyāṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Whatever he undertakes, will bear fruit right from the beginning. Therefore, it is said that his spiritual practice will not go in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें विवरोनियां श्रीहरी । म्हणितळें तिये अवसरीं । अर्जुना हा अवधारीं । पंथराजु॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ vivaroniyāṃ śrīharī | mhaṇitaḻeṃ tiye avasarīṃ | arjunā hā avadhārīṃ | paṃtharāju|| 52||
verses.meaning: Having thus explained, Shri Hari said at that moment, "Arjuna, listen to this, the king of paths."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ प्रवृत्तितरूच्या बुडीं । दिसती निवृत्तिफळाचिया कोडी । जिये मार्गांचा कापडी । महेशु आझुनी॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha pravṛttitarūcyā buḍīṃ | disatī nivṛttiphaḻāciyā koḍī | jiye mārgāṃcā kāpaḍī | maheśu ājhunī|| 53||
verses.meaning: There, at the root of the tree of worldly action, are seen heaps of the fruit of renunciation, on the path of which even the great Shiva is still a traveler.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं योगिवृंदें बहिलीं। आडवीं आकाशीं निघालीं। कीं तेथ अनुभवाच्या पाउलीं । धोरणु पडिला ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ yogivṛṃdeṃ bahilīṃ| āḍavīṃ ākāśīṃ nighālīṃ| kīṃ tetha anubhavācyā pāulīṃ | dhoraṇu paḍilā || 54||
verses.meaning: The yogis, having transcended the physical, traverse the sky, leaving behind a path of experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिहीं आत्मबोधाचेनि उजुकारें। धांब घेतली एकसरें। कीं येर सकळ मार्ग १०४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी निदसुरे। सांडूनिया ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tihīṃ ātmabodhāceni ujukāreṃ| dhāṃba ghetalī ekasareṃ| kīṃ yera sakaḻa mārga 104 śrījñāneśvarī nidasure| sāṃḍūniyā || 55||
verses.meaning: With the straight path of self-realization, they took a single leap, abandoning all other paths.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं महर्षी येणें आळे। साधकांचे सिद्ध जाहाले। आत्मविद थोरावले। येणेंचि पंथें ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ maharṣī yeṇeṃ āḻe| sādhakāṃce siddha jāhāle| ātmavida thorāvale| yeṇeṃci paṃtheṃ || 56||
verses.meaning: Following this path, great sages became perfected, and those who knew the Self attained greatness, all through this very path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा मार्ग जें देखिजे। तें 'तहान भूक विसरिजे। रात्रिदिवसु नेणिजे। वाटे इये ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā mārga jeṃ dekhije| teṃ 'tahāna bhūka visarije| rātridivasu neṇije| vāṭe iye || 57||
verses.meaning: When this path is seen, thirst and hunger are forgotten. Day and night are not perceived on this path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चालतां पाऊल जेथ पडे। तेथ अपवर्गाची खाणी उघडे । आव्हांटळिया तरी जोडे । स्वर्गसुख ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: cālatāṃ pāūla jetha paḍe| tetha apavargācī khāṇī ughaḍe | āvhāṃṭaḻiyā tarī joḍe | svargasukha || 58||
verses.meaning: Wherever one's foot treads, there opens a mine of liberation. Even if one wanders aimlessly, the joy of heaven is attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निगिजे पूर्वीलिया मोहरा । कीं येइजे पश्चिमेच्या घरा । निश्चळपणें धनुर्धरा। चालणें एथिंचें ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nigije pūrvīliyā moharā | kīṃ yeije paścimecyā gharā | niścaḻapaṇeṃ dhanurdharā| cālaṇeṃ ethiṃceṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, the nature of this path is to move steadily, like the sun that rises in the east and sets in the west, yet remains ever still.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें मार्गे जया ठाया जाइजे । तो गांबो आपणचि होइजे । हें सांगों काय सहजें। जाणसी तूं ॥ ९६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ mārge jayā ṭhāyā jāije | to gāṃbo āpaṇaci hoije | heṃ sāṃgoṃ kāya sahajeṃ| jāṇasī tūṃ || 960||
verses.meaning: By this path, wherever one goes, one becomes that very destination. Why should I tell you this? You know it easily.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ पार्थे म्हणितळलें देवा। तरि तेंचि मग केव्हां। कां आर्तिसमुद्रौनि न काढावा । बुडतु जी मी॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha pārthe mhaṇitaḻaleṃ devā| tari teṃci maga kevhāṃ| kāṃ ārtisamudrauni na kāḍhāvā | buḍatu jī mī||69||
verses.meaning: Arjuna then said, "O Lord, if that is the case, then when will it be? Why do you not rescue me, who am drowning in this ocean of distress?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब कृष्ण म्हणती ऐसें । हें उत्सृंखळ बोलणें कायसें। आम्ही सांगतसों आपैसें। वरि पुशिलें तुवां॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba kṛṣṇa mhaṇatī aiseṃ | heṃ utsṛṃkhaḻa bolaṇeṃ kāyaseṃ| āmhī sāṃgatasoṃ āpaiseṃ| vari puśileṃ tuvāṃ|| 62||
verses.meaning: Then Krishna said, "What is this unrestrained talk? We are explaining it ourselves, and you are asking questions on top of that."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी बिशेषें आतां बोलिजेळ। परि तें अनुभवें उपेगा जाईल। म्हणौनि तैसें एक लागेल। स्थान पाहावें ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī biśeṣeṃ ātāṃ bolijeḻa| pari teṃ anubhaveṃ upegā jāīla| mhaṇauni taiseṃ eka lāgela| sthāna pāhāveṃ || 63 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, what is now being said will be useful only through experience. Hence, one must seek such a place (or state of being).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ अराणुकेचेनि कोडें । बैसलिया उठों नावडे । वैराग्यासी दुणीव चढे। देखिलिया जें॥६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha arāṇukeceni koḍeṃ | baisaliyā uṭhoṃ nāvaḍe | vairāgyāsī duṇīva caḍhe| dekhiliyā jeṃ||64||
verses.meaning: Where, due to the joy of solitude, once seated, one does not wish to rise, and upon seeing it, detachment intensifies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो संतीं बसविला ठावो। संतोषासि सावाबो। मना होय उत्साबो। धैर्याचा ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo saṃtīṃ basavilā ṭhāvo| saṃtoṣāsi sāvābo| manā hoya utsābo| dhairyācā || 65||
verses.meaning: The place where saints have settled, that is the very abode of contentment. The mind becomes enthusiastic and filled with courage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अभ्यासुचि आपणयातें करी। हृदयातें अनुभवु वरी। ऐसी रम्यपणाची थोरी। अखंड जेथ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: abhyāsuci āpaṇayāteṃ karī| hṛdayāteṃ anubhavu varī| aisī ramyapaṇācī thorī| akhaṃḍa jetha|| 66 ||
verses.meaning: Through practice, one makes the heart experience itself, such is the greatness of its beauty, which is eternal.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया आड जातां पार्था। तपश्चर्या मनोरथा । 'पाखांडियाही आस्था । समूळ होय ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā āḍa jātāṃ pārthā| tapaścaryā manorathā | 'pākhāṃḍiyāhī āsthā | samūḻa hoya || 67||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, when one approaches Him, even the most hypocritical and faithless person develops a profound and sincere devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वभावें वाटे येतां । जरी वरपडा जाहला अवचितां। तरी सकामुही परि माघौता । निघो विसरे॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: svabhāveṃ vāṭe yetāṃ | jarī varapaḍā jāhalā avacitāṃ| tarī sakāmuhī pari māghautā | nigho visare|| 68||
verses.meaning: Even if one accidentally falls into the path of worldly desires by nature, a person with desires (sakama) forgets to turn back.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि न राहतयातें राहवी । भ्रमतयातें बैसवी । थापटूनि चेववी । विरक्तीतें ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni na rāhatayāteṃ rāhavī | bhramatayāteṃ baisavī | thāpaṭūni cevavī | viraktīteṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: Thus, it makes the restless stay, makes the wandering sit, and awakens dispassion by patting it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें राज्य वर सांडिजे। मग निवांता एथेंचि असिजे । ऐसें श्रृंगारियांहि उपजे । देखतखेंबो ॥ १७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ rājya vara sāṃḍije| maga nivāṃtā etheṃci asije | aiseṃ śrṛṃgāriyāṃhi upaje | dekhatakheṃbo || 170||
verses.meaning: Upon seeing this, even the most adorned and worldly individuals would desire to abandon their kingdom and reside here peacefully.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें येणें मानें बरवंट । आणि तैसेंचि अति चोखट । जेथ अधिष्ठान प्रगट। डोळां दिसे ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ yeṇeṃ māneṃ baravaṃṭa | āṇi taiseṃci ati cokhaṭa | jetha adhiṣṭhāna pragaṭa| ḍoḻāṃ dise || 71||
verses.meaning: That which is beautiful in this manner, and also exceedingly pure, where the divine abode is clearly visible to the eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिकही एक पहावें। जें साधकीं वसतें होआवें। आणि जनाचेनि पायरबवें। रुळेचिना॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇikahī eka pahāveṃ| jeṃ sādhakīṃ vasateṃ hoāveṃ| āṇi janāceni pāyarabaveṃ| ruḻecinā||72||
verses.meaning: And behold another thing: that which should reside in the seekers, and which does not get trampled by the footsteps of people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ अमृताचेनि पाडें। मुळाहीसकट गोडें । जोडती दाटें झाडें । सदा फळतीं ॥ ७३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha amṛtāceni pāḍeṃ| muḻāhīsakaṭa goḍeṃ | joḍatī dāṭeṃ jhāḍeṃ | sadā phaḻatīṃ || 73 ||
verses.meaning: Where, in comparison to nectar, even the roots are sweet, and dense trees always bear fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'पाउला पाउला उदकें । वर्षाकाळेंही अतिचोखें। निर्झरें कां विशेखें। सुलभें जेथ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'pāulā pāulā udakeṃ | varṣākāḻeṃhī aticokheṃ| nirjhareṃ kāṃ viśekheṃ| sulabheṃ jetha|| 74||
verses.meaning: At every step, water, even in the rainy season, is exceptionally pure. Springs, or perhaps special ones, are easily accessible there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा आतपुही आळुमाळु। जाणिजे तरी शीतळु। पवनु अति निश्‍चळु । मंदु झुळके ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ātapuhī āḻumāḻu| jāṇije tarī śītaḻu| pavanu ati niś‍caḻu | maṃdu jhuḻake || 75||
verses.meaning: Even if it is hot within, it is known to be cool. The wind is extremely still, blowing gently.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बहुतकरूनि निःशब्द। दाट न रिगे श्‍वापद। शुक हन षट्पद। तेउतें नाहीं ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: bahutakarūni niḥśabda| dāṭa na rige ś‍vāpada| śuka hana ṣaṭpada| teuteṃ nāhīṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: Mostly, where there is absolute silence, no wild animal dares to enter. Even parrots and bees do not go there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाणिलगें हंसें। दोनी चारी सारसें। 'कवणे एके वेळे बेसे। तरी कोकिळही हो॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṇilageṃ haṃseṃ| donī cārī sāraseṃ| 'kavaṇe eke veḻe bese| tarī kokiḻahī ho|| 77||
verses.meaning: A swan among water birds, two or four cranes, or at some time, even a cuckoo.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निरंतर नाहीं। तरी आलीं गेलीं कांहीं। होतु कां मयुरेंही। आम्ही ना न म्हणों ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: niraṃtara nāhīṃ| tarī ālīṃ gelīṃ kāṃhīṃ| hotu kāṃ mayureṃhī| āmhī nā na mhaṇoṃ || 78 ||
verses.meaning: Even if they are not eternal, but come and go, let them be like peacocks. We will not say no to them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि आवश्यक पांडवा । ऐसा ठावो जोडावा । तेथ निगूढ मठ होआवा । कां शिवालय ॥ ७९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari āvaśyaka pāṃḍavā | aisā ṭhāvo joḍāvā | tetha nigūḍha maṭha hoāvā | kāṃ śivālaya || 79 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Pandava, such a place should be found, where there is a secluded monastery or a temple of Shiva.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दोहींमाजीं आवडे तें। जें मानलें होय चित्तें। बहुतकरूनि एकांतें। बैसिजे गा॥ १८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: dohīṃmājīṃ āvaḍe teṃ| jeṃ mānaleṃ hoya citteṃ| bahutakarūni ekāṃteṃ| baisije gā|| 180||
verses.meaning: Of the two, choose what pleases your mind. Mostly, one should sit in solitude.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तैसें तें जाणावें। मन राहतें पाहावें।॥ राहील तेथ रचावें। आसन ऐसें॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni taiseṃ teṃ jāṇāveṃ| mana rāhateṃ pāhāveṃ||| rāhīla tetha racāveṃ| āsana aiseṃ||81||
verses.meaning: Therefore, know it thus. Observe where the mind settles. Where it settles, there arrange the seat.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरी चोखट मृगसेवडी। माजीं धूतवस्त्राची घडी । तळवटीं अमोडी। कुशांकुर॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: varī cokhaṭa mṛgasevaḍī| mājīṃ dhūtavastrācī ghaḍī | taḻavaṭīṃ amoḍī| kuśāṃkura|| 82||
verses.meaning: Above, a clean deer-skin; within, a fold of washed cloth; and underneath, unbroken blades of Kusha grass.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सकोमळ सरिसे। सुबद्ध राहती आपैसे । एकपाडें तेसें। बोजा घालीं ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sakomaḻa sarise| subaddha rāhatī āpaise | ekapāḍeṃ teseṃ| bojā ghālīṃ || 83||
verses.meaning: Just as soft threads naturally remain well-bound, similarly, with a single, unified effort, one should bear the burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि सावियाचि उंच होईल। तरी आंग हन डोलेळ। नीच तरी पावेळ। भूमिदोषु॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari sāviyāci uṃca hoīla| tarī āṃga hana ḍoleḻa| nīca tarī pāveḻa| bhūmidoṣu|| 84||
verses.meaning: If the ground is high, the body will sway; if it is low, it will be affected by the flaws of the earth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तैसें न करावें। समभावें धरावें। हें बहु असो होआवें। आसन ऐसें॥८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni taiseṃ na karāveṃ| samabhāveṃ dharāveṃ| heṃ bahu aso hoāveṃ| āsana aiseṃ||85||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should not act in such a way. One should maintain equanimity. Let this suffice; the posture should be like this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेथ आपण। एकाग्र अंतःकरण। करूनि सदगुरुस्मरण। अनुभविजे॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tetha āpaṇa| ekāgra aṃtaḥkaraṇa| karūni sadagurusmaraṇa| anubhavije|| 86||
verses.meaning: Then, with a concentrated mind, remembering the Sadguru, one should experience it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ स्मरतेनि आदरें। सबाह्य सात्त्विकें भरे। जंव काठिण्य विरे। अहंभावाचें ॥८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha smarateni ādareṃ| sabāhya sāttvikeṃ bhare| jaṃva kāṭhiṇya vire| ahaṃbhāvāceṃ ||87||
verses.meaning: Where, with reverent remembrance, one is filled with sattvic qualities, both internally and externally, until the hardness of ego dissolves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विषयांचा विसरु पडे । इंद्रियांची 'कसमस मोडे । मनाची घडी घडे । हृदयामाजीं ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: viṣayāṃcā visaru paḍe | iṃdriyāṃcī 'kasamasa moḍe | manācī ghaḍī ghaḍe | hṛdayāmājīṃ || 88 ||
verses.meaning: The memory of worldly objects fades, the restlessness of the senses ceases, and the mind settles in the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें ऐक्य हें सहजें। फांबें तंव राहिजे। मग तेणेंचि बोधें बैसिजे। आसनावरी॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ aikya heṃ sahajeṃ| phāṃbeṃ taṃva rāhije| maga teṇeṃci bodheṃ baisije| āsanāvarī|| 89||
verses.meaning: Such unity is naturally attained, and then, with that very understanding, one is seated upon the spiritual throne.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां आंगातें आंग वरी। पवनातें पवनु धरी। ऐसी अनुभवाची उजरी। होंचि लागे॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ āṃgāteṃ āṃga varī| pavanāteṃ pavanu dharī| aisī anubhavācī ujarī| hoṃci lāge|| 190||
verses.meaning: Now, body merges into body, and wind merges into wind. Such a clear experience begins to unfold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रवृत्ति माघोति मोहरे। समाधि ऐलाडी उतरे । आघवे अभ्यास सरे। बैसतखेंबो ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pravṛtti māghoti mohare| samādhi ailāḍī utare | āghave abhyāsa sare| baisatakheṃbo || 91||
verses.meaning: The worldly inclination recedes, and the state of deep meditation descends. All spiritual practices cease as soon as one sits down.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुद्रेची प्रौढी ऐशी । तेचि सांगिजेळ आतां परियेसीं । तरि ऊरु या जघनासी । जडोनि घालीं ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mudrecī prauḍhī aiśī | teci sāṃgijeḻa ātāṃ pariyesīṃ | tari ūru yā jaghanāsī | jaḍoni ghālīṃ || 92||
verses.meaning: Now listen, I will explain the greatness of the mudra. Join your thighs to your hips.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चरणतळें देव्हडीं । आधारद्रुमाच्या बुडीं। सुघटितें गाढीं। संचरीं पां॥९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: caraṇataḻeṃ devhaḍīṃ | ādhāradrumācyā buḍīṃ| sughaṭiteṃ gāḍhīṃ| saṃcarīṃ pāṃ||93||
verses.meaning: The feet are the threshold, the base of the tree of support; firmly established, they move forward.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सव्य तो तळीं ठेविजे। तेणें सिवणीमध्यें पीडिजे। वरी बैसे तो सहजें। बामचरणु ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: savya to taḻīṃ ṭhevije| teṇeṃ sivaṇīmadhyeṃ pīḍije| varī baise to sahajeṃ| bāmacaraṇu || 94||
verses.meaning: The right foot is placed below, and it is pressed in the middle of the seam. The left foot naturally rests above it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुदमेढ़ाआंतोतीं । चारी अंगुळें निगुतीं । तेथ सार्ध सार्ध प्रांती । सांडूनियां ॥ ९५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: gudamer̤hāāṃtotīṃ | cārī aṃguḻeṃ nigutīṃ | tetha sārdha sārdha prāṃtī | sāṃḍūniyāṃ || 95 ||
verses.meaning: From the anus, four fingers precisely, leaving aside one and a half fingers on each side.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माजी अंगुळ १०६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी एक निगे। तेथ टांचेचेनि उत्तरभागें। नेहेटिजे वरि आंगें। पेललेनि॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājī aṃguḻa 106 śrījñāneśvarī eka nige| tetha ṭāṃceceni uttarabhāgeṃ| neheṭije vari āṃgeṃ| pelaleni|| 96||
verses.meaning: My finger, 106, in Shri Dnyaneshwari, is like a sprout. There, with the upper part of the heel, it is supported from above by the body, which is lifted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उचलिलें कां नेणिजे। तैसें पृष्ठांत उचलिजे। गुल्फद्र्‍य धरिजे। तेणेंचि मानें॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ucalileṃ kāṃ neṇije| taiseṃ pṛṣṭhāṃta ucalije| gulphadr‍ya dharije| teṇeṃci māneṃ|| 97||
verses.meaning: It is as if it is lifted without being known; similarly, the back is lifted, and the ankles are held with the same measure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग शरीरसंचु पार्था। अशेषही सर्वथा । पाष्णींचा माथा । स्वयंभु होय ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga śarīrasaṃcu pārthā| aśeṣahī sarvathā | pāṣṇīṃcā māthā | svayaṃbhu hoya || 98||
verses.meaning: Then, O Partha, the entire collection of bodies, without exception, becomes spontaneously the very head of the heel, meaning the source or origin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना हें जाण । मूळबंधाचें लक्षण। वज्रासन गौण । नाम यासी ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā heṃ jāṇa | mūḻabaṃdhāceṃ lakṣaṇa| vajrāsana gauṇa | nāma yāsī || 99||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, know this: the characteristic of Moolbandha is that Vajrasana is secondary to it, and it is also known by this name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी आधारीं मुद्रा पडे। आणि आधींचा मार्ग मोडे । तेथ अपानु आंतुलेकडे। बोहोटों लागे॥ २००॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī ādhārīṃ mudrā paḍe| āṇi ādhīṃcā mārga moḍe | tetha apānu āṃtulekaḍe| bohoṭoṃ lāge|| 200||
verses.meaning: When such a seal is placed at the base, the old path is broken. Then, the apana vayu begins to move inwards.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव करसंपुट आपैसें। वामचरणीं बैसे। बाहुमूळीं दिसे। थोरीव आली ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva karasaṃpuṭa āpaiseṃ| vāmacaraṇīṃ baise| bāhumūḻīṃ dise| thorīva ālī || 1||
verses.meaning: Then, automatically, the folded hands rested on the left foot, and a great glory appeared at the armpit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माजीं उभारलेनि दंडें। शिरकमळ होय गाढें। नेत्रद्वारींचीं कवाडें। लागूं पाहती ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājīṃ ubhāraleni daṃḍeṃ| śirakamaḻa hoya gāḍheṃ| netradvārīṃcīṃ kavāḍeṃ| lāgūṃ pāhatī || 2||
verses.meaning: When the staff of Kundalini rises within me, the lotus of the head becomes firm, and the doors of the eyes begin to close.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरचिलें पातीं ढळती। तळींचीं तळीं पुंजाळती । तेथ अर्धोन्मीलित स्थिती । उपजे तया ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: varacileṃ pātīṃ ḍhaḻatī| taḻīṃcīṃ taḻīṃ puṃjāḻatī | tetha ardhonmīlita sthitī | upaje tayā || 3||
verses.meaning: The upper eyelids droop, and the lower ones rise, creating a state of semi-closed eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिठी राहोनि आंतुलीकडे । बाहेर 'पाऊल घाली कोडें। ते ठायीं ठावो पडे । नासाग्रपीठीं ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: diṭhī rāhoni āṃtulīkaḍe | bāhera 'pāūla ghālī koḍeṃ| te ṭhāyīṃ ṭhāvo paḍe | nāsāgrapīṭhīṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: The gaze, remaining inward, then curiously steps outward, and finds its resting place at the tip of the nose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें आंतुच्या आंतुचि रचे । बाहेरी मागुतें न वचे । म्हणौनि राहणें आधिये दिठीचें । तेथेंचि होय॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ āṃtucyā āṃtuci race | bāherī māguteṃ na vace | mhaṇauni rāhaṇeṃ ādhiye diṭhīceṃ | tetheṃci hoya|| 5||
verses.meaning: Thus, it is formed within itself, and does not go outside again. Therefore, the dwelling of the primal sight is established there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां दिशांची भेटी घ्यावी। कां रूपाची वाट पहावी । हे चाड सरे आघवी । आपैसया॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ diśāṃcī bheṭī ghyāvī| kāṃ rūpācī vāṭa pahāvī | he cāḍa sare āghavī | āpaisayā|| 6||
verses.meaning: Now, to meet the directions, or to await a form, all such desires spontaneously cease.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग कंठनाळ आटे। हनुवटी हडौती दाटे। ते गाढी होऊनि नेहटे। वक्षःस्थळीं ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kaṃṭhanāḻa āṭe| hanuvaṭī haḍautī dāṭe| te gāḍhī hoūni nehaṭe| vakṣaḥsthaḻīṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: Then the throat constricts, the chin presses down firmly, and the head becomes heavy and rests upon the chest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माजीं घंटिका लोपे। वरी बंधु जो आरोपे। तो जालंधरु म्हणिपे। पंडुकुमरा॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājīṃ ghaṃṭikā lope| varī baṃdhu jo ārope| to jālaṃdharu mhaṇipe| paṃḍukumarā|| 8||
verses.meaning: My bell disappears, and the one who ascends above it, that one is called Jalandhar, O son of Pandu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाभी वरी पोखे। उदर हें थोके। अंतरीं फांके। हृदयकोशु॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nābhī varī pokhe| udara heṃ thoke| aṃtarīṃ phāṃke| hṛdayakośu||9||
verses.meaning: Above the navel, the stomach expands, and within it, the heart-lotus blossoms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वाधिष्ठानावरिचिळे कांठीं । नाभिस्थानातळवटीं। बंधु पडे किरीटी । बोढियाणा तो॥ २१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: svādhiṣṭhānāvariciḻe kāṃṭhīṃ | nābhisthānātaḻavaṭīṃ| baṃdhu paḍe kirīṭī | boḍhiyāṇā to|| 210||
verses.meaning: The knot of the Sushumna Nadi, which is called the 'Boḍhiyāṇā' (Uddiyana Bandha), is formed between the Swadhisthana Chakra and the Manipura Chakra (navel region).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी शरीराबाहेरलीकडे । अभ्यासाची पांखर पडे । तंव आंतु त्राय मोडे । मनोधर्माची ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī śarīrābāheralīkaḍe | abhyāsācī pāṃkhara paḍe | taṃva āṃtu trāya moḍe | manodharmācī || 11||
verses.meaning: When the practice of meditation extends beyond the physical body, the inner strength of the mind's nature is broken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कल्पना निमे। प्रवृत्ती शमे। आंग मन विरमे। सावियाची ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kalpanā nime| pravṛttī śame| āṃga mana virame| sāviyācī || 12||
verses.meaning: When imagination ceases, activity subsides, and the mind naturally finds rest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्षुधा काय जाहली । निद्रा केउती गेली। हे आठवणही हारपळी। न दिसे वेगां॥१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṣudhā kāya jāhalī | nidrā keutī gelī| he āṭhavaṇahī hārapaḻī| na dise vegāṃ||13||
verses.meaning: When did hunger arise? When did sleep depart? Even this awareness is lost, and its swiftness is not perceived.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो मूळबंधें कोंडला। अपानु माघौता मुरडला। तो सवेंचि वरी सांकडला। धरी फुगूं॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo mūḻabaṃdheṃ koṃḍalā| apānu māghautā muraḍalā| to saveṃci varī sāṃkaḍalā| dharī phugūṃ|| 94||
verses.meaning: When the apana vayu is restrained by the root lock (mulabandha) and turned back, it immediately swells upwards, causing the body to inflate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्षोभलेपणें माजे । उबाइला ठायीं गाजे। मणिपूरेंसी झुंजे। राहोनियां ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṣobhalepaṇeṃ māje | ubāilā ṭhāyīṃ gāje| maṇipūreṃsī jhuṃje| rāhoniyāṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: When agitated, it roars in its place, fighting with the Manipura chakra, remaining there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग थावल्ि वाहटुळी । सैंघ घेऊनि घर डहुळी । बाळपणींची कुहीटुळी । बाहेर घाली ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga thāvali vāhaṭuḻī | saiṃgha gheūni ghara ḍahuḻī | bāḻapaṇīṃcī kuhīṭuḻī | bāhera ghālī || 16||
verses.meaning: Then the whirlwind of worldly life, which had been carrying away the house of the body, now calms down. It casts out the childish foolishness that had been dwelling within.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भीतरीं वळी न धरे। कोठ्यामाजीं संचरे। कफपित्तांचे थारे । उरों नेदी ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhītarīṃ vaḻī na dhare| koṭhyāmājīṃ saṃcare| kaphapittāṃce thāre | uroṃ nedī || 97||
verses.meaning: It does not allow the inner coil to remain, it moves within the stomach, not allowing the accumulation of phlegm and bile.

verses.shloka_devanagari: धातूंचे समुद्र उलंडी । मेदाचे पर्वत फोडी । आंतली मज्जा काढी । अस्थिगत ॥। १८॥ नाडीतें सोडवी । गात्रांते विघडवी। साधकातें भेडसावी। परि ब्िहावें ना॥१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: dhātūṃce samudra ulaṃḍī | medāce parvata phoḍī | āṃtalī majjā kāḍhī | asthigata ||| 18|| nāḍīteṃ soḍavī | gātrāṃte vighaḍavī| sādhakāteṃ bheḍasāvī| pari bihāveṃ nā||19||
verses.meaning: It crosses oceans of metals, breaks mountains of fat, and extracts the marrow from within the bones. It loosens the nerves, dislocates the limbs, and frightens the seeker, but one should not be afraid.

verses.shloka_devanagari: व्याधीतें दावी। सवेंचि हरवी। आप पृथ्वी कालवी। एकवाट॥ २२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vyādhīteṃ dāvī| saveṃci haravī| āpa pṛthvī kālavī| ekavāṭa|| 220||
verses.meaning: It reveals diseases, then instantly removes them; it mixes earth and water into one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब येरीकडे धनुर्धगा। आसनाचा उबारा। शक्ति करी उजगरा। कुंडलिनीतें ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba yerīkaḍe dhanurdhagā| āsanācā ubārā| śakti karī ujagarā| kuṃḍalinīteṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: Then, on the other side, the archer (the yogi) with the warmth of his posture, awakens the Kundalini power.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नागिणीचें पिलें। कुंकुमें नाहलें। वळण घेऊनि आलें। सेजे जैसें॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāgiṇīceṃ pileṃ| kuṃkumeṃ nāhaleṃ| vaḻaṇa gheūni āleṃ| seje jaiseṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: Like a young serpent, bathed in vermillion, gracefully coiling itself on a bed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशी ते कुंडलिनी) मोटकी औट वळणी । अधोमुख सर्पिणी। निदेली असे॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśī te kuṃḍalinī) moṭakī auṭa vaḻaṇī | adhomukha sarpiṇī| nidelī ase|| 23||
verses.meaning: In the same way, that Kundalini, coiled in three and a half turns, like a serpent with its head downwards, lies asleep.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विद्युल्लतेची विडी । बन्हिज्वाळांची घडी । पंधरेयाची चोखडी । घोटीव जैशी ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: vidyullatecī viḍī | banhijvāḻāṃcī ghaḍī | paṃdhareyācī cokhaḍī | ghoṭīva jaiśī || 24||
verses.meaning: Like a flash of lightning, a fold of fire, or a perfectly polished gold ornament.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेशी सुबद्ध आटली । पुटीं होती दाटली। ते वज्रासनें चिमुटली। सावधु होय ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teśī subaddha āṭalī | puṭīṃ hotī dāṭalī| te vajrāsaneṃ cimuṭalī| sāvadhu hoya || 25||
verses.meaning: Just as a tightly bound knot, which was firmly compressed, is loosened by a thunderbolt, so too does one become alert and aware.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ नक्षत्र जैसें उलंडलें। कीं सूर्याचे आसन मोडलें। तेजाचें बीज विरूढलें। अंकुरेंशीं ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha nakṣatra jaiseṃ ulaṃḍaleṃ| kīṃ sūryāce āsana moḍaleṃ| tejāceṃ bīja virūḍhaleṃ| aṃkureṃśīṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: There, it was as if a constellation had unfurled, or the sun's seat had been disturbed, or the very seed of light had sprouted with its shoots.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशी वेढियातें सोडिती। कवतिके आंग मोडिती । कंदावरी शक्‍ती । उठली दिसे॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśī veḍhiyāteṃ soḍitī| kavatike āṃga moḍitī | kaṃdāvarī śak‍tī | uṭhalī dise|| 27||
verses.meaning: Just as a creeper, released from its support, playfully sways its body, so too does the power of Kundalini appear to rise from its base.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सहजें बहुतां दिवसांची भूक । वरी चेबविली तें होय मिष। मग आवेशें पसरी मुख। ऊर्ध्वा उजू॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sahajeṃ bahutāṃ divasāṃcī bhūka | varī cebavilī teṃ hoya miṣa| maga āveśeṃ pasarī mukha| ūrdhvā ujū|| 28||
verses.meaning: When hunger has persisted for many days, and then food is offered, the mouth opens wide with eagerness, straight upwards.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ हृदयकोशातळवटीं। जो पबनु भरे किरीटी। तया सगळेयाचि मिठी। देऊनि घालळी॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha hṛdayakośātaḻavaṭīṃ| jo pabanu bhare kirīṭī| tayā sagaḻeyāci miṭhī| deūni ghālaḻī|| 29||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), the breath that fills the heart's core, it is completely embraced and then dissolved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुखोंच्या ज्वाळीं। तळीं वरी कवळी । मांसाची बडवाळी । आरोगूं लागे॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mukhoṃcyā jvāḻīṃ| taḻīṃ varī kavaḻī | māṃsācī baḍavāḻī | ārogūṃ lāge|| 230||
verses.meaning: With flames from its mouth, it began to devour the flesh, both above and below, with great relish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे जे ठाय समांस। तेथ आहाच जोडे घाउस। पाठी एकदोनी घांस । हियाही भरी ॥ ३१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je je ṭhāya samāṃsa| tetha āhāca joḍe ghāusa| pāṭhī ekadonī ghāṃsa | hiyāhī bharī || 319||
verses.meaning: Wherever there is a gathering of people, there is a ready opportunity to obtain food. Even if it's just one or two morsels, it is enough to fill one's hunger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तळवे तळहात शोधी । उर्ध्वींचे खंड भेदी। झाडा घे संधी । प्रत्यंगाचा ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga taḻave taḻahāta śodhī | urdhvīṃce khaṃḍa bhedī| jhāḍā ghe saṃdhī | pratyaṃgācā || 32||
verses.meaning: Then, searching the palms of the hands, and piercing the upper regions, he examines every joint and limb.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अधोभाग तरी न संडी। परि नखींचेंही सत्त्व काढी । त्वचा धुवूनि जडी। पांजरेंशीं ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: adhobhāga tarī na saṃḍī| pari nakhīṃceṃhī sattva kāḍhī | tvacā dhuvūni jaḍī| pāṃjareṃśīṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Though it doesn't leave the lower part, it extracts the essence even from the nails, washing the skin and embedding itself like a skeleton.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अस्थींचे नळे निरपे। शिरांचे हीर बोरपे। तंब बाहेरी विरूढी करपे। रोमबीजांची ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: asthīṃce naḻe nirape| śirāṃce hīra borape| taṃba bāherī virūḍhī karape| romabījāṃcī || 34||
verses.meaning: The bones are like pipes, the veins like strings, the skin outside is like a withered creeper, and the hair are like seeds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग सप्तधातूंच्या सागरीं। ताहानेली घोंट भरी । आणि सवेंचि उन्हाळा करी । खडखडीत ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga saptadhātūṃcyā sāgarīṃ| tāhānelī ghoṃṭa bharī | āṇi saveṃci unhāḻā karī | khaḍakhaḍīta || 35 ||
verses.meaning: Then, in the ocean of the seven bodily constituents, it drinks its fill when thirsty, and immediately thereafter, it creates a scorching summer, making everything parched.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नासापुटौनि वारा। जो जातसे अंगुळें बारा। तो गच्च धरूनि माघारा । आंतु घाली ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāsāpuṭauni vārā| jo jātase aṃguḻeṃ bārā| to gacca dharūni māghārā | āṃtu ghālī || 36||
verses.meaning: The breath that naturally extends twelve finger-widths beyond the nostrils is forcefully drawn back and retained within.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अध वरीतें आकुंचे। ऊर्ध्व तळौतें खांचे। तया खेंवामाजि चक्रांचे । पदर उरती ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha adha varīteṃ ākuṃce| ūrdhva taḻauteṃ khāṃce| tayā kheṃvāmāji cakrāṃce | padara uratī || 37||
verses.meaning: There, the lower part contracts, and the upper part expands. In that embrace, the layers of the chakras remain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी दोन्ही तेव्हांचि मिळती । परी कुंडलिनी नावेक दुश्चित्त होती। ते तयांतें म्हणे परौति। तुम्हीचि कायसी एथें ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī donhī tevhāṃci miḻatī | parī kuṃḍalinī nāveka duścitta hotī| te tayāṃteṃ mhaṇe parauti| tumhīci kāyasī etheṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: Both (Prana and Apana) would have united then, but Kundalini becomes a little distracted. She asks them, "Why are you here?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: आईडुकें पार्थिव धातु आघवी । आरोगितां कांहीं नुरवी । १०८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आणि आपातें तंब ठेवी । पुसोनियां ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āīḍukeṃ pārthiva dhātu āghavī | ārogitāṃ kāṃhīṃ nuravī | 108 śrījñāneśvarī āṇi āpāteṃ taṃba ṭhevī | pusoniyāṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: The earth element, when consumed, leaves nothing behind. Similarly, it completely erases all traces of danger, leaving no residue.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी दोनी भूतें खाये । ते वेळीं संपूर्ण धाये। मग सौम्य होऊनि राहे । सुषुम्नेपाशीं ॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī donī bhūteṃ khāye | te veḻīṃ saṃpūrṇa dhāye| maga saumya hoūni rāhe | suṣumnepāśīṃ || 240||
verses.meaning: When it consumes these two entities, it becomes completely satisfied. Then, becoming tranquil, it rests near the Sushumna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ तृप्तीचेनि संतोषें। गरळ जें वमी मुखें। तेणें तियेचेनि पीयुषें। प्राणु जिये ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha tṛptīceni saṃtoṣeṃ| garaḻa jeṃ vamī mukheṃ| teṇeṃ tiyeceni pīyuṣeṃ| prāṇu jiye || 49||
verses.meaning: There, with the contentment of satisfaction, the poison that is vomited from the mouth, with that nectar, life is sustained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अग्नि आंतूनि निघे। परि सबाह्य निववूंचि लागे। ते वेळीं कसु बांधिती आंगें। सांडिला पुढती ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to agni āṃtūni nighe| pari sabāhya nivavūṃci lāge| te veḻīṃ kasu bāṃdhitī āṃgeṃ| sāṃḍilā puḍhatī || 42||
verses.meaning: When that fire emerges from within, it begins to cool everything, both inside and out. At that time, what strength can the body muster, having been abandoned once more?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मार्ग मोडिती नाडीचे । नवविधपण वायूचे । जाय म्हणौनि शरीराचे । धर्मु नाहीं ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mārga moḍitī nāḍīce | navavidhapaṇa vāyūce | jāya mhaṇauni śarīrāce | dharmu nāhīṃ || 43||
verses.meaning: The channels of the body are obstructed, and the nine types of vital airs become disordered. Therefore, the body loses its natural functions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इडा पिंगळा एकवटती। गांठी तिन्ही सुटती । साही पदर फुटती । चक्रांचे हे ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: iḍā piṃgaḻā ekavaṭatī| gāṃṭhī tinhī suṭatī | sāhī padara phuṭatī | cakrāṃce he || 44||
verses.meaning: Ida and Pingala unite, the three knots are untied, and the six layers of the chakras open.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग शशी आणि भानु । ऐसा कल्पिजे जो अनुमानु। तो वातीवरी पवनु। गिंवसितां न दिसे॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga śaśī āṇi bhānu | aisā kalpije jo anumānu| to vātīvarī pavanu| giṃvasitāṃ na dise|| 45||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon and sun are imagined, so too is the wind on a lamp's wick, but it cannot be seen when sought.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुद्धीची पुळिका विरे) परिमळु पघ्राणीं उरे। तोही शक्‍्तीसबें संचरे। मध्यमेमाजीं ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: buddhīcī puḻikā vire) parimaḻu paghrāṇīṃ ure| tohī śak‍tīsabeṃ saṃcare| madhyamemājīṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: The intellect's essence dissolves, yet its fragrance remains in the breath. That too, with its power, moves within the middle (Madhyama) stage of speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव वरिळेकडोनि ढाळें। चंद्रामृताचें तळें।॥ कानवडोनि मिळे । शकक्‍तिमुखीं ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva variḻekaḍoni ḍhāḻeṃ| caṃdrāmṛtāceṃ taḻeṃ||| kānavaḍoni miḻe | śakak‍timukhīṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: From the upper side, the moon's nectar-filled lake, tilting, meets the mouth of Shakti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें नाळकें रस भरे। तो सर्वांगामाजीं संचरे। जेथिंचा तेथ मुरे। प्राणपवनु॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ nāḻakeṃ rasa bhare| to sarvāṃgāmājīṃ saṃcare| jethiṃcā tetha mure| prāṇapavanu|| 48 ||
verses.meaning: Through that channel, the essence fills and pervades the entire body, and the vital breath (prana) dissolves back into its source.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तातलिये मुसें। मेण निघोनि जाय जैसें। मग कोंदली राहे रसें। बोतलेनी॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tātaliye museṃ| meṇa nighoni jāya jaiseṃ| maga koṃdalī rāhe raseṃ| botalenī|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as the wax melts away from the mold, and then the metal remains, solidified in its form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें पिंडाचेनि आकारें। ते कळाचि कां अवतरे। वरि त्वचेचेनि पदरें। पांघुरली असे ॥ २५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ piṃḍāceni ākāreṃ| te kaḻāci kāṃ avatare| vari tvaceceni padareṃ| pāṃghuralī ase || 250||
verses.meaning: In the same way, that very art (or divine power) takes the form of the body, and is covered by layers of skin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैशी आभाळाची बुंथी। करूनि राहे गभस्ती। मग फिटलिया दीप्ती। धरूनि ये॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiśī ābhāḻācī buṃthī| karūni rāhe gabhastī| maga phiṭaliyā dīptī| dharūni ye||51||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun, having created a canopy of clouds, remains hidden, and then, when the light returns, it reappears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा आहाचवरि कोरडा। त्वचेचा असे पातोडा। तो झडोनि जाय कोंडा। जैसा होय॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā āhācavari koraḍā| tvacecā ase pātoḍā| to jhaḍoni jāya koṃḍā| jaisā hoya|| 52||
verses.meaning: Just as the dry outer layer, the husk, falls away from the grain, so too does the superficial skin of the body eventually shed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग काश्मीरीचे स्वयंभ। कां रत्नबीजा निघाले कोंभ। अवयकांतीची भांब। तैसी दिसे॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kāśmīrīce svayaṃbha| kāṃ ratnabījā nighāle koṃbha| avayakāṃtīcī bhāṃba| taisī dise|| 53||
verses.meaning: Then, like the self-born Kashmir saffron, or the sprouts emerging from a precious gem, such was the brilliance of his bodily radiance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी संध्यारागींचे रंग। काढूनि वळिलें तें आंग। कीं अंतर्ज्योतीचें लिंग) निर्वाळिलें॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī saṃdhyārāgīṃce raṃga| kāḍhūni vaḻileṃ teṃ āṃga| kīṃ aṃtarjyotīceṃ liṃga) nirvāḻileṃ|| 54||
verses.meaning: It is as if the colors of the evening twilight have been gathered and formed into a body, or as if the very essence of the inner light has been purified and made manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुंकुमाचें भरींब। सिद्धरसाचें बोतींब। मज पाहतां सावेव। शांतिचि ते॥५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuṃkumāceṃ bharīṃba| siddharasāceṃ botīṃba| maja pāhatāṃ sāveva| śāṃtici te||55||
verses.meaning: She is like a full vessel of vermillion, or a statue made of mercury. When I look at her, she is the very embodiment of peace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें आनंदचित्रींचे लेप। नातरी महासुखाचें रूप। कीं संतोषतरूचें रोप। थांबले जैसें ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ ānaṃdacitrīṃce lepa| nātarī mahāsukhāceṃ rūpa| kīṃ saṃtoṣatarūceṃ ropa| thāṃbale jaiseṃ || 56||
verses.meaning: It is like a painting of bliss, or the very form of supreme happiness, or as if a sapling of contentment has taken root.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो कनकचंपकाचा कळा । कीं अमृताचा पुतळा । नाना सासिन्नला मळा । कोंबळिकेचा॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to kanakacaṃpakācā kaḻā | kīṃ amṛtācā putaḻā | nānā sāsinnalā maḻā | koṃbaḻikecā|| 57||
verses.meaning: He is like the golden glow of the Champaka flower, or an idol made of nectar, or a tender sprout from a well-tended garden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां जे शारदियेचेनि वोलें। चंद्रबिंब पाल्हेलें। कां तेजचि मूर्त बेसलें। आसनावरी॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ je śāradiyeceni voleṃ| caṃdrabiṃba pālheleṃ| kāṃ tejaci mūrta besaleṃ| āsanāvarī|| 58||
verses.meaning: Is it that the moon, having blossomed with the autumn's freshness, has taken a seat, or is it brilliance itself that has incarnated and settled upon a throne?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें शरीर होये। जे वेळीं कुंडलिनी चंद्र पीये। मग देहाकृति बिहे। कृतांतु गा॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śarīra hoye| je veḻīṃ kuṃḍalinī caṃdra pīye| maga dehākṛti bihe| kṛtāṃtu gā|| 59||
verses.meaning: In the same way, when the Kundalini drinks the lunar nectar, then even Death fears the form of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वार्धक्य तरी बहुडे । तारुण्याची गांठी विघडे । लोपळी उघडे । बाळदशा॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vārdhakya tarī bahuḍe | tāruṇyācī gāṃṭhī vighaḍe | lopaḻī ughaḍe | bāḻadaśā|| 260||
verses.meaning: Old age arrives, the knots of youth unravel, and the state of childhood is revealed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वयसा तरी येतुळेवरी। एऱ्हवीं बळाचा बळार्थू करी। धेर्याची थोरी । निरुपमु॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: vayasā tarī yetuḻevarī| eṟhavīṃ baḻācā baḻārthū karī| dheryācī thorī | nirupamu|| 61||
verses.meaning: Thus, though of such an age, he performed feats of strength, and his greatness of courage was incomparable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कनकद्रुमाच्या पालबी । रत्नकळिका नित्य नवी । नखें तैसीं बरवीं। नबीं निघती ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kanakadrumācyā pālabī | ratnakaḻikā nitya navī | nakheṃ taisīṃ baravīṃ| nabīṃ nighatī || 62||
verses.meaning: Just as a wish-fulfilling tree of gold constantly sprouts new buds of jewels, so too do the beautiful nails emerge anew.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दांतही आन होती । परि अपाडें सानेजती । जैसी दुबाहीं बैसे पांती । हिरेयांची ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: dāṃtahī āna hotī | pari apāḍeṃ sānejatī | jaisī dubāhīṃ baise pāṃtī | hireyāṃcī || 63 ||
verses.meaning: Even the teeth, though they are there, appear to be small and delicate, like a row of diamonds set in a double-edged sword.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माणिकुलियांचिया कणिया । सावियाचि अणुमानिया । तैसिया सर्वांगी उधवती अणिया । रोमांचिया ॥ ६४ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: māṇikuliyāṃciyā kaṇiyā | sāviyāci aṇumāniyā | taisiyā sarvāṃgī udhavatī aṇiyā | romāṃciyā || 64 ||
verses.meaning: Just as tiny, delicate buds sprout from a plant, so too do goosebumps, like sharp points, emerge all over the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: करचरणतळें। जैसीं कां रातोत्पळें। पाखाळींब होती डोळे। काय सांगों ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: karacaraṇataḻeṃ| jaisīṃ kāṃ rātotpaḻeṃ| pākhāḻīṃba hotī ḍoḻe| kāya sāṃgoṃ || 65 ||
verses.meaning: His hands and feet were like red lotus flowers. What can I say about His eyes, which were like the petals of those lotuses?

verses.shloka_devanagari: निडाराचेनि कोंदाटें। मोतियें नावरती संपुटें। मग शिवणी जैशी उतटे। शुक्तिपल्लबांची ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: niḍārāceni koṃdāṭeṃ| motiyeṃ nāvaratī saṃpuṭeṃ| maga śivaṇī jaiśī utaṭe| śuktipallabāṃcī || 66||
verses.meaning: Just as the shell of an oyster bursts open due to the abundance of pearls within, so too does the spiritual truth reveal itself when it can no longer be contained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशी पातियांचिये कवळिये न समाये। दिठी जाकळोनि निघों पाहे। आधिलीचि परी होये । गगना कवळिती ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśī pātiyāṃciye kavaḻiye na samāye| diṭhī jākaḻoni nighoṃ pāhe| ādhilīci parī hoye | gaganā kavaḻitī || 67||
verses.meaning: Just as the eye, though covered by the eyelid, tries to look out and perceives the vastness of the sky, so too the inner vision, even when obscured, can still grasp the boundless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आइकें देह होय सोनियाचे । परि लाघव ये वायूचें। जे आप आणि पृशथ्वीचे। अंशु नाहीं ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āikeṃ deha hoya soniyāce | pari lāghava ye vāyūceṃ| je āpa āṇi pṛśathvīce| aṃśu nāhīṃ || 68 ||
verses.meaning: Listen, the body may become golden, yet it attains the lightness of air, for it has no trace of water or earth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग समुद्रापैलीकडीळ देखे। स्वर्गींचा आलोचु आइके। मनोगत वोळखे। मुंगियेचें॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga samudrāpailīkaḍīḻa dekhe| svargīṃcā ālocu āike| manogata voḻakhe| muṃgiyeceṃ|| 69||
verses.meaning: Then he sees beyond the ocean, hears the thoughts of heaven, and knows the mind of an ant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पवनाचा वारिकां वळघे । चाळे तरी उदकीं पाऊल न लागे । येणें येणें प्रसंगें। येती बहुता सिन्दि ॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pavanācā vārikāṃ vaḻaghe | cāḻe tarī udakīṃ pāūla na lāge | yeṇeṃ yeṇeṃ prasaṃgeṃ| yetī bahutā sindi || 270||
verses.meaning: Just as a boatman skillfully navigates the water without his feet touching it, so too do many saints effortlessly cross the ocean of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आडके प्राणाचा हात धरूनी । गगनाची पाउटी करूनी । मध्यमेचेनि दादराहुनि। हृदया आली ॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āḍake prāṇācā hāta dharūnī | gaganācī pāuṭī karūnī | madhyameceni dādarāhuni| hṛdayā ālī ||79||
verses.meaning: Holding the hand of the vital breath, making the sky a stepping stone, through the ladder of the middle path, it reached the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते कुंडलिनी जगदंबा । जे चैतन्यचक्रवर्तीची शोभा। जया विशवबीजाचिया कोंभा। साउली केली ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te kuṃḍalinī jagadaṃbā | je caitanyacakravartīcī śobhā| jayā viśavabījāciyā koṃbhā| sāulī kelī || 72||
verses.meaning: That Kundalini, the Mother of the Universe, is the splendor of the Emperor of Consciousness, who provides shade to the sprout of the universal seed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे शून्यलिंगाची पिंडी । जे परमात्मया शिवाची करंडी । जे प्रणवाची उघडी । जन्मभूमी ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je śūnyaliṃgācī piṃḍī | je paramātmayā śivācī karaṃḍī | je praṇavācī ughaḍī | janmabhūmī || 73||
verses.meaning: It is the sacred form of the formless, the very casket of the supreme Shiva, the open birthplace of the primordial sound Om.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो ते कुंडलिनी बाळी । हृदयाआंतु आली । तंब अनुहताची बोली । चावळे ते॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso te kuṃḍalinī bāḻī | hṛdayāāṃtu ālī | taṃba anuhatācī bolī | cāvaḻe te|| 74||
verses.meaning: Let this be. When that young Kundalini enters the heart, then the sound of Anahata spontaneously manifests.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शकक्‍्तीचिया आंगा लागलें। बुद्धीचें चैतन्य होतें जाहलें। तें तेणें आइकिलें। अळुमाळु ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: śakak‍tīciyā āṃgā lāgaleṃ| buddhīceṃ caitanya hoteṃ jāhaleṃ| teṃ teṇeṃ āikileṃ| aḻumāḻu || 75||
verses.meaning: The intellect's consciousness, which had become attached to the body's power, heard it slightly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घोषाच्या कुंडीं । नादचित्रांचीं रूपडीं । प्रणवाचिया मोडी । रेखिलीं ऐसीं ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghoṣācyā kuṃḍīṃ | nādacitrāṃcīṃ rūpaḍīṃ | praṇavāciyā moḍī | rekhilīṃ aisīṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: In the crucible of sound, the forms of sound-pictures, drawn in the twists and turns of Om, are thus etched.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेंचि कल्पाबें तरी जाणिजे । परी आतां कल्पितें कैंचें आणिजे। तरी नेणों काय गाजे। तिये ठायीं ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃci kalpābeṃ tarī jāṇije | parī ātāṃ kalpiteṃ kaiṃceṃ āṇije| tarī neṇoṃ kāya gāje| tiye ṭhāyīṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: If this were to be imagined, then it would be known. But now, where is the imagination to be brought from? Therefore, I do not know what resounds in that state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विसरोनि गेलों अर्जुना । जंव नाशु नाहीं पवना । तंव वाचा आथी गगना । म्हणौनि घुमे ॥७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: visaroni geloṃ arjunā | jaṃva nāśu nāhīṃ pavanā | taṃva vācā āthī gaganā | mhaṇauni ghume ||78||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, I had forgotten that as long as the breath (life-force) is not destroyed, the voice (sound) exists in the sky (space), and therefore it resonates.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अनाहताचेनि मेघें। मग आकाश दुमदुमों लागे । तंव ब्रह्मस्थानींचें बेगें। फिटले सहजें ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā anāhatāceni megheṃ| maga ākāśa dumadumoṃ lāge | taṃva brahmasthānīṃceṃ begeṃ| phiṭale sahajeṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: Then, with the cloud of that Anahata sound, the sky began to reverberate. At that moment, the knot in the Brahmasthana was effortlessly untied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आइकें कमळगर्भाकारें। जें महदाकाश दुसरें। जेथ चैतन्यें आधातुरें। करूनि असिजे॥ २८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āikeṃ kamaḻagarbhākāreṃ| jeṃ mahadākāśa dusareṃ| jetha caitanyeṃ ādhātureṃ| karūni asije|| 280||
verses.meaning: Listen, it is like a lotus-shaped womb, a second great expanse, where consciousness resides, half-formed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया हृदयाच्या परिवरीं । कुंडलिनिया परमेश्वरी । तेजाची शिदोरी । विनियोगिळी॥ ८१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā hṛdayācyā parivarīṃ | kuṃḍaliniyā parameśvarī | tejācī śidorī | viniyogiḻī|| 819||
verses.meaning: Around that heart, the supreme goddess Kundalini, like a provision of light, is utilized.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुब्धीचेनि शाकें । हातबोनें निकें। द्वैत जेथ न देखे। तैसें केलें॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: bubdhīceni śākeṃ | hātaboneṃ nikeṃ| dvaita jetha na dekhe| taiseṃ keleṃ|| 82||
verses.meaning: With the sharp intellect, a good harvest is reaped, where duality is no longer perceived; thus it was done.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निजकांती हारविली। मग प्राणुचि केवळ जाहाली । ते वेळीं कैसी गमली। म्हणावी पां॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nijakāṃtī hāravilī| maga prāṇuci kevaḻa jāhālī | te veḻīṃ kaisī gamalī| mhaṇāvī pāṃ||83||
verses.meaning: When the self-radiance is lost, and only the life-force remains, how can one describe that state?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां जे पवनाची पुतळी । पांघुरली होती सोनसळी । ते फेडुनियां वेगळी । ठेविली तिया॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ je pavanācī putaḻī | pāṃghuralī hotī sonasaḻī | te pheḍuniyāṃ vegaḻī | ṭhevilī tiyā|| 84||
verses.meaning: It is as if the golden garment that adorned the statue of wind was removed and set aside by her.

verses.shloka_devanagari: १९० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी नातरी वायूचेनि आंगें झगटली । दीपाची दिठी निवटली। कां लखलखोनि हारपली । बीजु गगनीं ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: 190 śrījñāneśvarī nātarī vāyūceni āṃgeṃ jhagaṭalī | dīpācī diṭhī nivaṭalī| kāṃ lakhalakhoni hārapalī | bīju gaganīṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: Or, just as the lamp's flame is extinguished by the force of the wind, or lightning flashes and vanishes in the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशी हृदयकमळवेऱहीं । दिसे जैशी सोनियाची सरी । नातरी प्रकाशजळाची झरी । वाहत आली ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśī hṛdayakamaḻaveṟahīṃ | dise jaiśī soniyācī sarī | nātarī prakāśajaḻācī jharī | vāhata ālī || 86||
verses.meaning: Similarly, within the lotus of the heart, it appears like a golden stream, or as if a spring of luminous water has begun to flow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग ते हृदयभूमी 'पोकळे। जिराली कां एके वेळे। तैसें शक्‍तीचें रूप मावळे। शक्‍तीचिमाजीं ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga te hṛdayabhūmī 'pokaḻe| jirālī kāṃ eke veḻe| taiseṃ śak‍tīceṃ rūpa māvaḻe| śak‍tīcimājīṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: Then, just as a hollow space in the heart-land disappears at some point, so too the form of Shakti dissolves within Shakti itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां तरी शक्‍्तीचि म्हणिजे। एऱ्हवीं तो प्राणु केवळ जाणिजे । आतां नादुबिंदु नेणिजे। कळाज्योती ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ tarī śak‍tīci mhaṇije| eṟhavīṃ to prāṇu kevaḻa jāṇije | ātāṃ nādubiṃdu neṇije| kaḻājyotī || 88||
verses.meaning: Then it is called power, otherwise it is known as mere life-force. Now, the sound and the bindu (point of creation) are not known, nor the light of the arts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मनाचा हन मारु। कां पवनाचा आधारु । ध्यानाचा आदरु । नाहीं परी॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: manācā hana māru| kāṃ pavanācā ādhāru | dhyānācā ādaru | nāhīṃ parī|| 89||
verses.meaning: There is no need to suppress the mind, nor to rely on breath control, nor to engage in meditation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे कल्पना घे सांडी । तें नाहीं इये परवडी । हे महाभूतांची फुडी। आटणी देखां॥ २९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he kalpanā ghe sāṃḍī | teṃ nāhīṃ iye paravaḍī | he mahābhūtāṃcī phuḍī| āṭaṇī dekhāṃ|| 290||
verses.meaning: Discard this imagination. It is not of this order. This is the clear dissolution of the great elements.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पिंडें पिंडाचा ग्रासु। तो हा नाथसंकेतींचा दंशु । परि दावूनि गेला उद्देशु। श्री महाविष्णु॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: piṃḍeṃ piṃḍācā grāsu| to hā nāthasaṃketīṃcā daṃśu | pari dāvūni gelā uddeśu| śrī mahāviṣṇu|| 91||
verses.meaning: The individual soul devours the individual soul; this is the bite of the Nath tradition's secret, yet Shri Mahavishnu revealed its true purpose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया ध्वनिताचें केणें सोडुनि। यथार्थाची घडी झाडुनी। उपलबिली म्यां जाणुनी । ग्राहीक श्रोते ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā dhvanitāceṃ keṇeṃ soḍuni| yathārthācī ghaḍī jhāḍunī| upalabilī myāṃ jāṇunī | grāhīka śrote || 92||
verses.meaning: Having untied the knot of that sound, and swept away the folds of the literal meaning, I have understood the receptive listeners.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐकें शक्‍तीचें तेज जेव्हां लोपे। तेथ देहाचें रूप हारपे। मग तो डोळ्यांमाजीं लपे । जगाचिया ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aikeṃ śak‍tīceṃ teja jevhāṃ lope| tetha dehāceṃ rūpa hārape| maga to ḍoḻyāṃmājīṃ lape | jagāciyā || 93||
verses.meaning: Listen, when the power of the body fades, its form disappears. Then it hides within the eyes of the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं आधिलाचि ऐसें । सावयव तरी असे। परी वायूचें कां जैसें। वळिलें होय ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ ādhilāci aiseṃ | sāvayava tarī ase| parī vāyūceṃ kāṃ jaiseṃ| vaḻileṃ hoya || 94||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, it is like the primordial, though it has parts, yet it is like the wind that has been shaped.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी कर्दळीचा गाभा । बुंथी सांडोनी उभा। कां अवयवचि नभा। उदयला तो॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī kardaḻīcā gābhā | buṃthī sāṃḍonī ubhā| kāṃ avayavaci nabhā| udayalā to|| 95||
verses.meaning: Is it the core of a banana plant, standing tall after shedding its outer layers, or is it a part of the sky itself that has risen?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें होय शरीर तैं तें म्हणिजे खेचर। हें पद होतां चमत्कार। पिंडजनीं ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ hoya śarīra taiṃ teṃ mhaṇije khecara| heṃ pada hotāṃ camatkāra| piṃḍajanīṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when the body becomes such, it is called a celestial being. This state is a miracle among embodied beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें साधकु निघोनि जाये । मागां पाउलांची बोळ राहे। तेथ ठायीं ठायीं होये । अणिमादिक ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ sādhaku nighoni jāye | māgāṃ pāulāṃcī boḻa rāhe| tetha ṭhāyīṃ ṭhāyīṃ hoye | aṇimādika || 97||
verses.meaning: Behold, when a seeker departs, the path of their footsteps remains behind, and at every step, powers like anima (minuteness) manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तेणें काय काज आपणयां। अवधारीं ऐसा धनंजया । लोप आथी भूतत्रया। देहींचा देहीं ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teṇeṃ kāya kāja āpaṇayāṃ| avadhārīṃ aisā dhanaṃjayā | lopa āthī bhūtatrayā| dehīṃcā dehīṃ || 98||
verses.meaning: But what is the use of that to us? Listen, O Dhananjaya, the three states of being are hidden within the body itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पृथ्वीतें आप विरवी। आपातें तेज जिरवी। तेजातें पवनु हरवी । हृदयामाजीं ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pṛthvīteṃ āpa viravī| āpāteṃ teja jiravī| tejāteṃ pavanu haravī | hṛdayāmājīṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: Water absorbs the earth, fire consumes water, and wind dissipates fire, all within the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं आपण एकला उरे। परि शरीराचेनि अनुकारें। मग तोही निगे अंतरें। गगना मिळे॥ ३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ āpaṇa ekalā ure| pari śarīrāceni anukāreṃ| maga tohī nige aṃtareṃ| gaganā miḻe|| 300||
verses.meaning: Then, only the Self remains alone. But through the imitation of the body, even that Self departs inwardly and merges with the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वेळीं कुंडलिनी हे भाष जाये । मग मारुत ऐसें नाम होये । परि शक्तिपण तें आहे। जंब न मिळे शिवीं ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: te veḻīṃ kuṃḍalinī he bhāṣa jāye | maga māruta aiseṃ nāma hoye | pari śaktipaṇa teṃ āhe| jaṃba na miḻe śivīṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: At that time, Kundalini transcends its name. Then it is called Marut (wind/prana). But its power remains until it merges with Shiva.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग जालंधर सांडी । 'ककारांत फोडी। गगनाचिये पाहाडीं। पैठी होय॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga jālaṃdhara sāṃḍī | 'kakārāṃta phoḍī| gaganāciye pāhāḍīṃ| paiṭhī hoya|| 2||
verses.meaning: Then, the जालंधर (Jalandhar Bandha) is released, and the 'ककारांत' (the sound 'Ka') breaks forth, entering the lofty mountains of the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते अकाराचिये 'पाठी। पाय देत उठाउठी । पश्यंतीचिये पाउटी। मागां घाली ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: te akārāciye 'pāṭhī| pāya deta uṭhāuṭhī | paśyaṃtīciye pāuṭī| māgāṃ ghālī || 3||
verses.meaning: Then, with great haste, it steps upon the back of the 'Akara' (the formless, unmanifest sound), and leaves behind the 'Pashyanti' stage (the stage of subtle vision and thought).

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढां तन्मात्रा अर्धवेरी । आकाशाच्या अंतरीं । भरती गमे सागरीं । सरिता जेवीं ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhāṃ tanmātrā ardhaverī | ākāśācyā aṃtarīṃ | bharatī game sāgarīṃ | saritā jevīṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: Further, the subtle elements (tanmatras) half-filled the space within the ether, just as rivers fill the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग ब्रह्मरंश्रीं स्थिरावोनी। सो$हंभावाच्या बाह्या पसरुनी। परमात्मलिंगा धांबोनी। आंगा घडे॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga brahmaraṃśrīṃ sthirāvonī| so$haṃbhāvācyā bāhyā pasarunī| paramātmaliṃgā dhāṃbonī| āṃgā ghaḍe|| 5||
verses.meaning: Then, stabilizing in the divine essence, extending the arms of 'I am That' consciousness, embracing the Supreme Lingam, it becomes one with the self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब महाभूतांची जवनिका फिटे । मग दोहींसि होय झटें। तेथ गगनासकट आटे । समरसीं तिये॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba mahābhūtāṃcī javanikā phiṭe | maga dohīṃsi hoya jhaṭeṃ| tetha gaganāsakaṭa āṭe | samarasīṃ tiye|| 6||
verses.meaning: Then the curtain of the great elements is drawn aside, and the two (individual soul and universal soul) unite. There, even the sky dissolves into that oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं मेघाचेनि मुखीं निवडिला। समुद्र कां बोघीं पडिला । तो मागुता जैसा आला । आपणपयां ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ meghāceni mukhīṃ nivaḍilā| samudra kāṃ boghīṃ paḍilā | to māgutā jaisā ālā | āpaṇapayāṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: Just as the water drawn from the ocean by the clouds, after falling as rain, returns to the ocean itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं पिंडाचेनि मिषें । पदीं पद प्रवेशे। तें एकत्व होय तैसें । पंडुकुमरा ॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ piṃḍāceni miṣeṃ | padīṃ pada praveśe| teṃ ekatva hoya taiseṃ | paṃḍukumarā ||8||
verses.meaning: Just as a foot enters another foot, so too does the individual soul merge into the universal Self, O Arjuna, becoming one with it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां दुजें हन होतें। कौ एकचि हें आइतें। ऐशिये विवंचनेपुरतें। उरेचिना॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ dujeṃ hana hoteṃ| kau ekaci heṃ āiteṃ| aiśiye vivaṃcanepurateṃ| urecinā|| 9||
verses.meaning: Now, the question of whether there is a second entity or if everything is inherently one, such a deliberation does not even remain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गगनीं गगन लया जाये। ऐसें जें कांहीं आहे। तें अनुभबवें जो होये। तो होऊनि ठाके ॥ ३१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: gaganīṃ gagana layā jāye| aiseṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ āhe| teṃ anubhabaveṃ jo hoye| to hoūni ṭhāke || 310||
verses.meaning: When the sky merges into the sky, whatever that state is, one who experiences it becomes that very state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तेथिंची मातु। न चढेचि बोलाचा हातु। जेणें संवादाचिया गांवाआंतु। पैठी कीजे॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tethiṃcī mātu| na caḍheci bolācā hātu| jeṇeṃ saṃvādāciyā gāṃvāāṃtu| paiṭhī kīje|| 19||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the discourse about that cannot be grasped by words, nor can it enter the realm of conversation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना एऱ्हबीं तरी । इया अभिप्रायाचा जे गर्व धरी । ते पाहें पां वैखरी । दुरी ठेली ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā eṟhabīṃ tarī | iyā abhiprāyācā je garva dharī | te pāheṃ pāṃ vaikharī | durī ṭhelī || 92||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, if someone becomes proud of this understanding, then see how even speech (Vaikhari) remains far away from them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भ्रूलता मागिलीकडे । तेथ मकाराचेंचि आंग न मांडे । सडेया प्राणा सांकडें । गगना येतां॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhrūlatā māgilīkaḍe | tetha makārāceṃci āṃga na māṃḍe | saḍeyā prāṇā sāṃkaḍeṃ | gaganā yetāṃ|| 13||
verses.meaning: Behind the eyebrows, the 'M' sound (representing the M-kara, the third part of Om) cannot fully manifest. The vital breath (prana) finds it difficult to ascend to the sky (the spiritual realm beyond the physical).

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं तेथेंचि तो भेसळला। तंव शब्दाचा दिवो मावळला । मग 'तयाहिवरी आटु भविन्नला। आकाशाचा॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ tetheṃci to bhesaḻalā| taṃva śabdācā divo māvaḻalā | maga 'tayāhivarī āṭu bhavinnalā| ākāśācā|| 14||
verses.meaning: Then, it merged into that very place, and the light of words faded. Subsequently, even beyond that, the sky's expanse dissolved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां महाशून्याचिया डोहीं ॥ जेथ गगनासीचि थावो नाहीं।॥ तेथ तागा लागेल कार्ड । बोलाचा इया॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ mahāśūnyāciyā ḍohīṃ || jetha gaganāsīci thāvo nāhīṃ||| tetha tāgā lāgela kārḍa | bolācā iyā|| 15||
verses.meaning: Now, in the abyss of the great void, where even the sky finds no place, how can words possibly reach there?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आखरामाजीं सांपडे । कीं कानवरी जोडे । हें तैसें नव्हे फुडें। त्रिशुद्धी गा॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ākharāmājīṃ sāṃpaḍe | kīṃ kānavarī joḍe | heṃ taiseṃ navhe phuḍeṃ| triśuddhī gā|| 16||
verses.meaning: Therefore, it is not something that can be grasped by letters or understood by the ears; this is truly not the case, in all three ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें कहीं दैवें। अनुभविलें फावे। तें आपणचि हें ठाकावें । होऊनियां ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ kahīṃ daiveṃ| anubhavileṃ phāve| teṃ āpaṇaci heṃ ṭhākāveṃ | hoūniyāṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Whatever is experienced by destiny, that itself becomes the Self and remains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढती जाणणें तें नाहींचि । म्हणौनि असो किती हेंचि। बोलावें आतां वायांचि । धनुर्धरा ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhatī jāṇaṇeṃ teṃ nāhīṃci | mhaṇauni aso kitī heṃci| bolāveṃ ātāṃ vāyāṃci | dhanurdharā || 18||
verses.meaning: There is nothing further to know; therefore, let this be enough. Why speak more in vain, O Arjuna?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें शब्दजात माघोतें सरे। तेथ संकल्पाचें आयुष्य पुरे। वाराही जेथ न शिरे। विचाराचा॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ śabdajāta māghoteṃ sare| tetha saṃkalpāceṃ āyuṣya pure| vārāhī jetha na śire| vicārācā|| 19||
verses.meaning: Where the realm of words recedes, where the life of thought ceases, where even the wind of deliberation cannot enter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें उन्मनियेचें लावण्य । जें तुर्येचें तारुण्य । अनादि जें अगण्य । परमतत्त्व ॥ ३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ unmaniyeceṃ lāvaṇya | jeṃ turyeceṃ tāruṇya | anādi jeṃ agaṇya | paramatattva || 320||
verses.meaning: That which is the beauty of the unmanifested state, that which is the youthfulness of the fourth state of consciousness, that which is beginningless and immeasurable—that is the Supreme Reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें विश्‍वाचें मूळ। जें योगद्रुमाचें फळ। जें आनंदाचें केवळ। चैतन्य गा॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ viś‍vāceṃ mūḻa| jeṃ yogadrumāceṃ phaḻa| jeṃ ānaṃdāceṃ kevaḻa| caitanya gā|| 29||
verses.meaning: That which is the origin of the universe, the fruit of the tree of Yoga, the very essence of bliss, that is Consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें आकाराचा प्रांतु । जें मोक्षाचा एकांतु। जेथ आदि आणि अंतु । बिरोनी गेळे ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ ākārācā prāṃtu | jeṃ mokṣācā ekāṃtu| jetha ādi āṇi aṃtu | bironī geḻe || 22||
verses.meaning: That which is the boundary of all forms, that which is the sole abode of liberation, where beginning and end have vanished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें महाभूतांचें बीज। जें महातेजाचें तेज। एवं पार्था जें निज। स्वरूप माझें ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ mahābhūtāṃceṃ bīja| jeṃ mahātejāceṃ teja| evaṃ pārthā jeṃ nija| svarūpa mājheṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: That which is the seed of the great elements, that which is the radiance of the great light; that, O Partha, is My true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते हे चतुर्भुज कोंभेळी। जयाची शोभा रूपा आली । देखोनि नास्तिकीं नोकिलीं । भक्‍तवंदें ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: te he caturbhuja koṃbheḻī| jayācī śobhā rūpā ālī | dekhoni nāstikīṃ nokilīṃ | bhak‍tavaṃdeṃ || 24||
verses.meaning: That four-armed form, whose beauty manifested, was not rejected by the non-believers, but rather revered by the devotees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अनिर्वाच्य महासुख । पैं आपणचि जाहले जे पुरुष। जयांचे कां निष्कर्ष। प्राप्तिवेरीं ॥ २५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ anirvācya mahāsukha | paiṃ āpaṇaci jāhale je puruṣa| jayāṃce kāṃ niṣkarṣa| prāptiverīṃ || 25 ||
verses.meaning: Those who have become one with that ineffable great bliss, for them, all conclusions and attainments culminate in this very realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं साधन हें जें सांगितलें) तेंचि शरीरीं जिहीं केलें। ते आमुचेनि पाडें आले निर्वाळलेया ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ sādhana heṃ jeṃ sāṃgitaleṃ) teṃci śarīrīṃ jihīṃ keleṃ| te āmuceni pāḍeṃ āle nirvāḻaleyā || 26||
verses.meaning: Those who have embodied this spiritual practice that we have expounded, they have attained a state of purity and liberation, equal to ours.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परब्रह्माचेनि रसें। देहाकृतीचिये मुसें। वबोतींव १९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जाहले तैसे। दिसती आंगें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parabrahmāceni raseṃ| dehākṛtīciye museṃ| vabotīṃva 192 śrījñāneśvarī jāhale taise| disatī āṃgeṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Just as the Supreme Brahman, through its essence, takes on the mold of the body, so too do the limbs appear as if formed by that very essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी हे प्रतीति हन अंतरीं फांके। तरी बिश्‍वचि हें अवघें झांके। तंव अर्जुन म्हणे निकें। साचचि जी हें॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī he pratīti hana aṃtarīṃ phāṃke| tarī biś‍vaci heṃ avagheṃ jhāṃke| taṃva arjuna mhaṇe nikeṃ| sācaci jī heṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: When this realization dawns within, the entire universe is enveloped by it. Then Arjuna says, "Indeed, this is truly so!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे आपण आतां देवो। हा बोलिले जो उपावो। तो प्राप्तीचा ठावो । म्हणोनि घडे॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je āpaṇa ātāṃ devo| hā bolile jo upāvo| to prāptīcā ṭhāvo | mhaṇoni ghaḍe|| 29||
verses.meaning: Because the means that have now been spoken of, by which one becomes God, are indeed the very abode of attainment, and thus it happens.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इये अभ्यासीं जे दृढ होती। ते भरंबसेनि ब्रह्मत्वा येती । हें सांगतियाचि रीती। कळलें मज ॥ ३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: iye abhyāsīṃ je dṛḍha hotī| te bharaṃbaseni brahmatvā yetī | heṃ sāṃgatiyāci rītī| kaḻaleṃ maja || 330||
verses.meaning: Those who become steadfast in this practice, they certainly attain Brahmanhood. This, I have understood through the manner of its telling.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा गोठीचि हे ऐकतां । बोधु उपजतसे चित्ता । मा अनुभबें तल्लीनता । नोहेळ केवीं ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā goṭhīci he aikatāṃ | bodhu upajatase cittā | mā anubhabeṃ tallīnatā | noheḻa kevīṃ || 31||
verses.meaning: O God, just by hearing these words, understanding arises in the mind. How then can one not be absorbed in the experience?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि एथ कांहीं । अनारिसें नाहीं। परी नावभरी चित्त देई। बोला एका॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni etha kāṃhīṃ | anāriseṃ nāhīṃ| parī nāvabharī citta deī| bolā ekā|| 32||
verses.meaning: Therefore, there is nothing amiss here; but for a moment, pay attention to this one word.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां कृष्णा तुवां सांगितला योगु। तो मना तरी आला चांगु। परि न शके करू पांगु। योग्यतेचा ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ kṛṣṇā tuvāṃ sāṃgitalā yogu| to manā tarī ālā cāṃgu| pari na śake karū pāṃgu| yogyatecā || 33||
verses.meaning: O Krishna, the Yoga you have described is indeed good and has appealed to my mind. However, due to my unworthiness, I am unable to practice it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सहजें आंगिक जेतुलें आहे। तेतुलियाची जरी सिव्द्रि जाये। तरी हाचि मार्गु सुखोपायें।॥ अभ्यासीन ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: sahajeṃ āṃgika jetuleṃ āhe| tetuliyācī jarī sivdri jāye| tarī hāci mārgu sukhopāyeṃ||| abhyāsīna || 34||
verses.meaning: If I can naturally achieve all that is inherently within me, then I will practice this path with ease.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी देवो जैसें सांगतील । तैसें आपणपें जरी न ठकेल। तरी योग्यतेबीण होईल। तेंचि पुसों ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī devo jaiseṃ sāṃgatīla | taiseṃ āpaṇapeṃ jarī na ṭhakela| tarī yogyatebīṇa hoīla| teṃci pusoṃ || 35||
verses.meaning: If one does not understand the divine teachings as they are expounded, then it is appropriate to inquire about that which is beyond one's comprehension.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जीवींचीये ऐसी धारण । म्हणोनि पुसावया जाहळें कारण। मग म्हणे तरी आपण । चित्त देइजो॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jīvīṃcīye aisī dhāraṇa | mhaṇoni pusāvayā jāhaḻeṃ kāraṇa| maga mhaṇe tarī āpaṇa | citta deijo|| 36||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for the sake of the living beings, this question arose. Then, he said, "Please pay attention."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो जी अवधारिलें। हें जें साधन तुम्हीं निरूपिलें। तें आवडतयाहि अभ्यासिलें। फावो शके॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho jī avadhārileṃ| heṃ jeṃ sādhana tumhīṃ nirūpileṃ| teṃ āvaḍatayāhi abhyāsileṃ| phāvo śake|| 37||
verses.meaning: Yes, indeed, I have listened attentively. This spiritual practice that you have expounded, even if it is beloved, can be attained through diligent effort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं योग्यतेवीण नाहीं। ऐसें हन आहे कांहीं। तेथ श्रीकृष्ण म्हणती काई । धनुर्धरा ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ yogyatevīṇa nāhīṃ| aiseṃ hana āhe kāṃhīṃ| tetha śrīkṛṣṇa mhaṇatī kāī | dhanurdharā || 38||
verses.meaning: Or is it that there is nothing without worth? To this, what does Shri Krishna say, O Arjuna?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें काज कौर निर्वाण । परि आणिकही जें कांहीं साधारण । तेंही अधिकाराचे बोडवेविण। काय सिव्दरि जाय॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ kāja kaura nirvāṇa | pari āṇikahī jeṃ kāṃhīṃ sādhāraṇa | teṃhī adhikārāce boḍaveviṇa| kāya sivdari jāya|| 39||
verses.meaning: Even if the task is as profound as achieving liberation, or anything else that is ordinary, without the authority of spiritual experience, how can one attain it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं योग्यता जे म्हणिजे। ते प्राप्तीची अधीन जाणिजे। कां जे योग्य होऊनि कीजे तें आरंभिळें फळे॥ ३४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ yogyatā je mhaṇije| te prāptīcī adhīna jāṇije| kāṃ je yogya hoūni kīje teṃ āraṃbhiḻeṃ phaḻe|| 340||
verses.meaning: That which is called 'worthiness' or 'competence' should be understood as being subservient to attainment. For whatever is undertaken by one who is worthy, that endeavor bears fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तैसी एथ कांहीं। सावियाची केणी नाहीं । आणि योग्यतेची काई। खाणी असे॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī taisī etha kāṃhīṃ| sāviyācī keṇī nāhīṃ | āṇi yogyatecī kāī| khāṇī ase|| 41||
verses.meaning: Therefore, there is no such thing as a mere transaction here, nor is there any mine of merit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नावेक विरक्तु। जाहला देहधर्मी नियतु । तरि तोचि नव्हे व्यवस्थितु। अधिकारिया ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāveka viraktu| jāhalā dehadharmī niyatu | tari toci navhe vyavasthitu| adhikāriyā || 42||
verses.meaning: Even if a person, by nature attached to the body, becomes somewhat detached, he is still not truly established as a deserving spiritual seeker.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलाल्िये आयणीमाजिवबडें । योग्यपण तूंतेंही जोडे। ऐसें प्रसंगें सांकडें। फेडिलें तयाचें ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetulāliye āyaṇīmājivabaḍeṃ | yogyapaṇa tūṃteṃhī joḍe| aiseṃ prasaṃgeṃ sāṃkaḍeṃ| pheḍileṃ tayāceṃ || 43 ||
verses.meaning: Besides this, I also granted him the appropriate status. Thus, in due course, his difficulty was resolved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणे पार्था । ते हे ऐसी व्यवस्था । अनियतासि सर्वथा । योग्यता नाहीं ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇe pārthā | te he aisī vyavasthā | aniyatāsi sarvathā | yogyatā nāhīṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: Then, Arjuna, this is the arrangement: the one who is not disciplined has no worth whatsoever.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो रसनेंद्रियाचा अंकिला। कां निद्रेसी जीवें विकला । तो नाहींच एथ म्हणितला । अधिकारिया ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo rasaneṃdriyācā aṃkilā| kāṃ nidresī jīveṃ vikalā | to nāhīṃca etha mhaṇitalā | adhikāriyā || 45||
verses.meaning: One who is enslaved by the sense of taste, or who has sold his life to sleep, is not considered worthy here (to understand this knowledge).

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा आग्रहाचिये बांदोडी। क्षुधा तृषा कोंडी। आहारातें तोडी । मारूनियां ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā āgrahāciye bāṃdoḍī| kṣudhā tṛṣā koṃḍī| āhārāteṃ toḍī | mārūniyāṃ || 46 ||
verses.meaning: Or, bound by obstinacy, one suppresses hunger and thirst, and abstains from food, thereby harming oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निद्रेचिया बाटा नवचे। ऐसा दूढिवेचेनि अवतरणें नाचे । तें शरीरचि नव्हे तयाचें । मा योगु कवणाचा ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nidreciyā bāṭā navace| aisā dūḍhiveceni avataraṇeṃ nāce | teṃ śarīraci navhe tayāceṃ | mā yogu kavaṇācā || 47||
verses.meaning: One who does not stray into the path of sleep, who dances with the manifestation of firmness, that is not his body. Then whose yoga is it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अतिशयें विषयो सेवावा। तैसा विरोधु नोहावा। कां सर्वथा निरोधावा । हेंही नको ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni atiśayeṃ viṣayo sevāvā| taisā virodhu nohāvā| kāṃ sarvathā nirodhāvā | heṃhī nako || 48||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should not indulge excessively in worldly pleasures, nor should one completely suppress them. Neither extreme is desirable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आहार तरी सेविजे | परी युक्‍तीचेनि मापें मविजे। क्रियाजात आचरिजे । 'तयाचि स्थिती ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āhāra tarī sevije | parī yuk‍tīceni māpeṃ mavije| kriyājāta ācarije | 'tayāci sthitī || 49||
verses.meaning: Food should be consumed, but measured with discretion. All actions should be performed in the same manner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मितला बोलीं बोलिजे। मितलिया पाउलीं चालिजे । निद्रेही मानु दीजे। अवसरें एकें ॥ ३५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mitalā bolīṃ bolije| mitaliyā pāulīṃ cālije | nidrehī mānu dīje| avasareṃ ekeṃ || 350||
verses.meaning: Speak measured words, walk with measured steps, and even in sleep, give due respect at the appropriate time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जागणें जरी जाहलें। तरी होआवें तें मितलें। येतुलेनि धातुसाम्य संचलें। असेल सहजें ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jāgaṇeṃ jarī jāhaleṃ| tarī hoāveṃ teṃ mitaleṃ| yetuleni dhātusāmya saṃcaleṃ| asela sahajeṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Even if one awakens, it should be in moderation. With this, the balance of the bodily humors will naturally be maintained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें युक्‍तीचेनि हातें। जें इंद्रियां बोपिजे मातें। तें संतोषासी वाढतें । मनचि करी॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ yuk‍tīceni hāteṃ| jeṃ iṃdriyāṃ bopije māteṃ| teṃ saṃtoṣāsī vāḍhateṃ | manaci karī||52||
verses.meaning: When the mind, with the hand of wisdom, offers itself to the senses, it itself increases in contentment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाहेर युक्‍तीची मुद्रा पडे। तंव आंत आंत सुख वाढे। तेथें सहजेंचि योगु घडे । नाभ्यासितां॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāhera yuk‍tīcī mudrā paḍe| taṃva āṃta āṃta sukha vāḍhe| tetheṃ sahajeṃci yogu ghaḍe | nābhyāsitāṃ|| 53||
verses.meaning: When the outer form of spiritual practice is adopted, inner joy spontaneously increases, and thus, union with the divine naturally occurs, even without strenuous effort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें भाग्याचिया भडसें। उद्यमाचेनि मिसें। मग समृव्द्विजात आपेसें। घर रिघे॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ bhāgyāciyā bhaḍaseṃ| udyamāceni miseṃ| maga samṛvdvijāta āpeseṃ| ghara righe|| 54||
verses.meaning: Just as good fortune, under the guise of effort, naturally brings prosperity into one's home.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा युक्तिमंतु कौतुकें। अभ्यासाचिया मोहरा ठाके । आणि आत्मसिद्धीचि पिके । अनुभवु तयाचा ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā yuktimaṃtu kautukeṃ| abhyāsāciyā moharā ṭhāke | āṇi ātmasiddhīci pike | anubhavu tayācā || 55||
verses.meaning: Just as a skillful person, with delight, dedicates themselves to the practice (of spiritual discipline), and through that, the harvest of self-realization becomes their direct experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि युक्ति हे पांडवा । घडे जया सदैवा । तो अपवर्गीचिये राणिवा । अळंकारिजे॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni yukti he pāṃḍavā | ghaḍe jayā sadaivā | to apavargīciye rāṇivā | aḻaṃkārije|| 56||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Pandava, the fortunate one who attains this spiritual wisdom is adorned with the sovereignty of liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: युक्ति योगाचें आंग पावे । ऐसें प्रयाग जेथ होय बरवें । तेथ क्षेत्रसंन्यासें स्थिरावें। मानस जयाचें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yukti yogāceṃ āṃga pāve | aiseṃ prayāga jetha hoya baraveṃ | tetha kṣetrasaṃnyāseṃ sthirāveṃ| mānasa jayāceṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: Where the confluence of spiritual practice and yogic discipline occurs, like a sacred pilgrimage site, there the mind of such a person becomes steadfast through the renunciation of worldly attachments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयातें योगयुक्‍त तूं म्हण। हेंही प्रसंगें जाण।॥ तें दीपाचें उपलक्षण। निर्वातींचिया ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāteṃ yogayuk‍ta tūṃ mhaṇa| heṃhī prasaṃgeṃ jāṇa||| teṃ dīpāceṃ upalakṣaṇa| nirvātīṃciyā || 58||
verses.meaning: You may call such a person 'yogi' or 'united with God' in certain contexts. This is like calling a lamp 'steady' when it is in a windless place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तुझें मनोगत जाणोनी । कांहीं एक आम्ही म्हणौनि। तें निकें चित्त देऊनी। परिसावें गा॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ tujheṃ manogata jāṇonī | kāṃhīṃ eka āmhī mhaṇauni| teṃ nikeṃ citta deūnī| parisāveṃ gā||59||
verses.meaning: Now, understanding your inner desire, I shall speak a few words. Please listen to them with a focused mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं प्राप्तीची चाड वाहसी। परि अभ्यासीं दक्षु नव्हसी। तें सांग पां काय बिहसी । दुवाडपणा ॥ ३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ prāptīcī cāḍa vāhasī| pari abhyāsīṃ dakṣu navhasī| teṃ sāṃga pāṃ kāya bihasī | duvāḍapaṇā || 360||
verses.meaning: You desire attainment, but you are not diligent in practice. Tell me then, what difficulty do you fear?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पार्था हें झणें । सायास घेशीं हो मनें। वायां बागूल इये दुर्जनें। इंद्रियें करिती ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pārthā heṃ jhaṇeṃ | sāyāsa gheśīṃ ho maneṃ| vāyāṃ bāgūla iye durjaneṃ| iṃdriyeṃ karitī || 61||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Arjuna, do not trouble your mind with these efforts, for these wicked senses merely create a false illusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां आयुष्यातें १९४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी अढळ करी। जें सरतें जीवित वारी। तया औषधातें वैरी। काय जिव्हा न म्हणे ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ āyuṣyāteṃ 194 śrījñāneśvarī aḍhaḻa karī| jeṃ sarateṃ jīvita vārī| tayā auṣadhāteṃ vairī| kāya jivhā na mhaṇe || 62||
verses.meaning: Behold, does the tongue not call that medicine an enemy, which, in the span of life, makes the fleeting existence of Shri Dnyaneshwari steadfast and wards off its transience?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें हितासि जें जें निकें । तें सदाचि या इंद्रियां दुखे । एऱ्हवीं सोपें योगासारिखें। कांहीं आहे ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ hitāsi jeṃ jeṃ nikeṃ | teṃ sadāci yā iṃdriyāṃ dukhe | eṟhavīṃ sopeṃ yogāsārikheṃ| kāṃhīṃ āhe || 63||
verses.meaning: Whatever is truly beneficial for the self is always painful to these senses. Otherwise, is there anything as easy as Yoga?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आसनाचिया गाढिका। जो आम्हीं अभ्यासु सांगितला निका । तेणें होईल तरी हो कां। निरोधु यया॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āsanāciyā gāḍhikā| jo āmhīṃ abhyāsu sāṃgitalā nikā | teṇeṃ hoīla tarī ho kāṃ| nirodhu yayā|| 64||
verses.meaning: Therefore, through the profound practice of asanas that we have described, if it is possible, let the mind be restrained.
