verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी येणें योगें। जें इंद्रियां विंदाण लागे। तें चित्त भेटों रिगे। आपणपेयां॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī yeṇeṃ yogeṃ| jeṃ iṃdriyāṃ viṃdāṇa lāge| teṃ citta bheṭoṃ rige| āpaṇapeyāṃ|| 65 ||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, through this yoga, the senses become attuned, and the mind begins to meet its true self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परतोनि पाठिमोरें ठाके । आणि आपणियांतें आपण देखे । देखतखेंबो बोळखे । म्हणे तत्त्व हें मी ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paratoni pāṭhimoreṃ ṭhāke | āṇi āpaṇiyāṃteṃ āpaṇa dekhe | dekhatakheṃbo boḻakhe | mhaṇe tattva heṃ mī || 66 ||
verses.meaning: Turning back, it stands facing itself, and sees itself within itself. Upon seeing, it recognizes and says, "This principle, this truth, is I."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये ओळखीचिसरिसें। सुखाचिया साप्राज्यीं बैसे । मग आपणपां समरसें। विरोनि जाय ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye oḻakhīcisariseṃ| sukhāciyā sāprājyīṃ baise | maga āpaṇapāṃ samaraseṃ| vironi jāya || 67||
verses.meaning: Upon recognizing that truth, one ascends to the empire of bliss, and then, merging with one's own true Self, dissolves into it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयापरतें आणिक नाहीं । जयातें इंद्रियें नेणती कहीं। तें आपणचि आपुलिया ठायीं। होऊनि ठाके॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāparateṃ āṇika nāhīṃ | jayāteṃ iṃdriyeṃ neṇatī kahīṃ| teṃ āpaṇaci āpuliyā ṭhāyīṃ| hoūni ṭhāke|| 68||
verses.meaning: That beyond which there is nothing else, which the senses can never perceive, that itself becomes manifest within its own being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग मेरूपासूनि थोरें । देह दुःखाचेनि डोंगरें। दाटिजो पां पडिभरें। चित्त न दटे॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga merūpāsūni thoreṃ | deha duḥkhāceni ḍoṃgareṃ| dāṭijo pāṃ paḍibhareṃ| citta na daṭe||69||
verses.meaning: Then, even if the body is overwhelmed by mountains of suffering greater than Mount Meru, the mind is not distressed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां शस्त्रें वरी तोडिलिया। देह अग्निमाजीं पडलिया । चित्त महासुखीं पहुडलिया। चेबोचि नये॥ ३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ śastreṃ varī toḍiliyā| deha agnimājīṃ paḍaliyā | citta mahāsukhīṃ pahuḍaliyā| ceboci naye|| 370||
verses.meaning: Even if the body is cut by weapons, or falls into fire, the mind, immersed in supreme bliss, does not awaken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें आपणपां रिगोनि ठाये । मग देहाची वासु न पाहे। आणिकचि सुख होऊनि जाये। म्हणूनि विसरे ॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ āpaṇapāṃ rigoni ṭhāye | maga dehācī vāsu na pāhe| āṇikaci sukha hoūni jāye| mhaṇūni visare ||71||
verses.meaning: Thus, having entered and established oneself within, one no longer cares for the body. One becomes another kind of happiness, and therefore forgets everything else.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया सुखाचिया गोडी । मन आरतीची सेचि सोडी । संसाराचिया तोंडीं । गुंतलें जें॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā sukhāciyā goḍī | mana āratīcī seci soḍī | saṃsārāciyā toṃḍīṃ | guṃtaleṃ jeṃ|| 72||
verses.meaning: The mind, entangled in worldly affairs, longs for the taste of that happiness, and thus abandons all other desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें योगाची बरव। संतोषाची राणीव। ज्ञानाची जाणीव । जयालागीं ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ yogācī barava| saṃtoṣācī rāṇīva| jñānācī jāṇīva | jayālāgīṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: He who is the excellence of Yoga, the queen of contentment, and the very awareness of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अभ्यासिळेनि योगें। सावयव देखावें लागे। देखिलें तरी आंगें। होईजेळ गा॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ abhyāsiḻeni yogeṃ| sāvayava dekhāveṃ lāge| dekhileṃ tarī āṃgeṃ| hoījeḻa gā|| 74||
verses.meaning: Through the practice of yoga, one must perceive the embodied form. If perceived, one becomes that form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तोचि योगु बापा । एके परी आहे सोपा । जरी पुत्रशोकु संकल्पा । 'दाखविजे॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari toci yogu bāpā | eke parī āhe sopā | jarī putraśoku saṃkalpā | 'dākhavije|| 75||
verses.meaning: But that very yoga, my child, is in one way simple, if the sorrow for a son is shown to the mind's intention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा विषयांतें निमालिया आडके । इंद्रियें नेमाचिया धारणीं देखे । तरी हिये घाळूनि मुके । जीवित्वासी ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā viṣayāṃteṃ nimāliyā āḍake | iṃdriyeṃ nemāciyā dhāraṇīṃ dekhe | tarī hiye ghāḻūni muke | jīvitvāsī || 76||
verses.meaning: When the senses, having overcome the obstacles of worldly objects, are seen to be established in the discipline of spiritual practice, then the seeker, abandoning all worldly attachments, attains liberation even while living.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें वैराग्य हें करी । तरी संकल्पाची सरे वारी। सुखें धृतीचिया धवळारीं । बुल्धि नांदे ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ vairāgya heṃ karī | tarī saṃkalpācī sare vārī| sukheṃ dhṛtīciyā dhavaḻārīṃ | buldhi nāṃde || 77||
verses.meaning: When such detachment is practiced, all mental resolves cease. Then, intellect resides peacefully in the mansion of steadfastness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुद्यि धेर्या होय वसौटा। मनातें अनुभवाचिया वाटा। हळु हळु करी प्रतिष्ठा । आत्मभुवनीं ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: budyi dheryā hoya vasauṭā| manāteṃ anubhavāciyā vāṭā| haḻu haḻu karī pratiṣṭhā | ātmabhuvanīṃ || 78 ||
verses.meaning: Let the intellect become the abode of courage. Guide the mind along the path of experience. Slowly, establish yourself in the realm of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याही एके परी । प्राप्ति आहे विचारीं। हें न ठके तरी सोपारी। आणिक ऐकें ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāhī eke parī | prāpti āhe vicārīṃ| heṃ na ṭhake tarī sopārī| āṇika aikeṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: In this way too, there is attainment through contemplation. If this is not possible, then listen to another easier method.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां नियमुचि हा एकला । जीवें करावा आपुला । जैसा कृतनिश्चयाचिया बोला । बाहेरा नोहे॥ ३८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ niyamuci hā ekalā | jīveṃ karāvā āpulā | jaisā kṛtaniścayāciyā bolā | bāherā nohe|| 380||
verses.meaning: Now, this is the only rule one should adopt wholeheartedly, just as one never deviates from a firm resolve.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी येतुलेनि चित्त स्थिरावें। तरी काजा आलें स्वभावें। नाहीं तरी घालावें । मोकलुनी॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī yetuleni citta sthirāveṃ| tarī kājā āleṃ svabhāveṃ| nāhīṃ tarī ghālāveṃ | mokalunī|| 81||
verses.meaning: If the mind becomes steady by this much, then it has naturally achieved its purpose. Otherwise, it should be abandoned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग मोकलिलें जेथ जाईल। तेथूनि नियमूचि घेऊनि येईल। ऐसेनि स्थैर्यचि होईल। सावियाचि ॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mokalileṃ jetha jāīla| tethūni niyamūci gheūni yeīla| aiseni sthairyaci hoīla| sāviyāci ||82||
verses.meaning: Then, wherever it is released, it will return with discipline, and thus, stability will naturally arise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं केतुलेनि एके वेळे । तया स्थैर्याचेनि मेळें। आत्मस्वरूपाजवळें । येईल सहजें ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ ketuleni eke veḻe | tayā sthairyāceni meḻeṃ| ātmasvarūpājavaḻeṃ | yeīla sahajeṃ || 83||
verses.meaning: Then, at some point, through the union with that steadfastness, one will effortlessly approach the true nature of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयातें देखोनि आंगा घडेळ। तेथ अद्वैतीं ह्वैत बुडेल। आणि ऐक्यतेजें उघडेल त्रैलोक्य हें ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāteṃ dekhoni āṃgā ghaḍeḻa| tetha advaitīṃ hvaita buḍela| āṇi aikyatejeṃ ughaḍela trailokya heṃ || 84||
verses.meaning: When one sees that, the body becomes one with it. Then, duality dissolves into non-duality, and the three worlds are illuminated by the light of oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आकाशीं दिसे दुसरें। तें अभ्र जैं बिरे। तैं गगनचि कां भरे। विश्व जैसें ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ākāśīṃ dise dusareṃ| teṃ abhra jaiṃ bire| taiṃ gaganaci kāṃ bhare| viśva jaiseṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: When a second form appears in the sky, like a cloud, and then dissolves, the sky itself remains full, just as the universe does.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें चित्त लया जाये। आणि चैतन्यचि आघवें होये। ऐसी प्राप्ति सुखोपायें । आहे येणें ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ citta layā jāye| āṇi caitanyaci āghaveṃ hoye| aisī prāpti sukhopāyeṃ | āhe yeṇeṃ || 86||
verses.meaning: In the same way, the mind dissolves, and all becomes pure consciousness. Such attainment is easily achieved by this means.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ११९६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी या सोपिया योगिस्थिती। उकलु देखिला गा बहुतीं। संकल्पाचिया संपत्ती । रुसोनियां ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: 1196 śrījñāneśvarī yā sopiyā yogisthitī| ukalu dekhilā gā bahutīṃ| saṃkalpāciyā saṃpattī | rusoniyāṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: Many have seen the unraveling of this simple yogic state in the Shri Dnyaneshwari, having turned away from the wealth of worldly desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें सुखाचेनि सांगातें। आलें परब्रह्मा आंतोतें । तेथ लवण जैसें जळातें। सांडूं नेणें ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ sukhāceni sāṃgāteṃ| āleṃ parabrahmā āṃtoteṃ | tetha lavaṇa jaiseṃ jaḻāteṃ| sāṃḍūṃ neṇeṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: That bliss, in companionship, came into the Supreme Brahman. There, it is like salt that does not know how to leave water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें होय तिये मेळीं। मग सामरस्याचिया राउळीं। महासुखाची दिवाळी । जगेंसि दिसे॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ hoya tiye meḻīṃ| maga sāmarasyāciyā rāuḻīṃ| mahāsukhācī divāḻī | jageṃsi dise|| 89||
verses.meaning: In that union, within the temple of oneness, the great festival of supreme bliss becomes visible to the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें आपुले पायवरी। चालिजे आपुले पाठीवरी । हें पार्था नागवे तरी। आन ऐकें ॥३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ āpule pāyavarī| cālije āpule pāṭhīvarī | heṃ pārthā nāgave tarī| āna aikeṃ ||390||
verses.meaning: O Partha, if one cannot walk upon their own feet, upon their own back, then listen to another way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि मी तंव सकळ देहीं । असें एथ विचारु नाहीं । आणि तैसेंचि माझ्या ठायीं । सकळ असे॥ ९१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari mī taṃva sakaḻa dehīṃ | aseṃ etha vicāru nāhīṃ | āṇi taiseṃci mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ | sakaḻa ase|| 919||
verses.meaning: Thus, I am indeed present in all bodies; there is no doubt about this. And similarly, all of existence resides within Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें ऐसेंचि संचलें। परस्परे मिसळलें। बुद्धि घेपे एतुलें। होआवें गा॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aiseṃci saṃcaleṃ| paraspare misaḻaleṃ| buddhi ghepe etuleṃ| hoāveṃ gā|| 92||
verses.meaning: This is how it is arranged, intertwined with each other. The intellect should grasp only this much.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी अर्जुना। जो एकवटलिया भावना । सर्वभूतीं अभिन्ना। मातें भजे॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī arjunā| jo ekavaṭaliyā bhāvanā | sarvabhūtīṃ abhinnā| māteṃ bhaje|| 93||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, Arjuna, one who, with unified devotion, worships Me as non-different in all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भूतांचेनि अनेकपणें। अनेक नोहे अंतःकरणे । केवळ एकत्वचि माझें जाणे । सर्वत्र जो॥९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhūtāṃceni anekapaṇeṃ| aneka nohe aṃtaḥkaraṇe | kevaḻa ekatvaci mājheṃ jāṇe | sarvatra jo||94||
verses.meaning: My inner being is not manifold due to the multiplicity of beings. Know that my oneness alone pervades everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तो एक हा मियां। बोलतां दिसतसे वायां। एऱ्हबीं न बोळिजे तरी धनंजया । तो मीचि आहें॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga to eka hā miyāṃ| bolatāṃ disatase vāyāṃ| eṟhabīṃ na boḻije tarī dhanaṃjayā | to mīci āheṃ|| 95||
verses.meaning: Then, if it seems that I am speaking in vain, know that otherwise, if I were not to speak, Dhananjaya, I am indeed that very Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दीपा आणि प्रकाशा। एकवंकीचा पाडु जैसा। तो माझ्या ठायीं तैसा। मी तयामाजीं ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: dīpā āṇi prakāśā| ekavaṃkīcā pāḍu jaisā| to mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ taisā| mī tayāmājīṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Just as the lamp and its light are of one essence, so too am I in them, and they are in Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा उदकाचेनि आयुष्यें रसु। कां गगनाचेनि मानें अवकाशु। तैसा माझेनि रूपें रूपसु। पुरुषु तो गा॥९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā udakāceni āyuṣyeṃ rasu| kāṃ gaganāceni māneṃ avakāśu| taisā mājheni rūpeṃ rūpasu| puruṣu to gā||97||
verses.meaning: Just as water gives life to taste, or space defines the vastness of the sky, so too is the Purusha (the Supreme Being) made beautiful by My form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें ऐक्याचिये दिठी । सर्वत्र मातेंचि किरीटी । देखिला जैसा पटीं। तंतु एकु ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ aikyāciye diṭhī | sarvatra māteṃci kirīṭī | dekhilā jaisā paṭīṃ| taṃtu eku || 98||
verses.meaning: Through which vision of oneness, O Kiriti, I am seen everywhere, just as a single thread is seen throughout the cloth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां स्वरूपें तरी बहुतें आहाती । परी तैसीं सोनीं बहुवें न होती । ऐसी ऐक्याचळाची स्थिती । केली जेणें ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ svarūpeṃ tarī bahuteṃ āhātī | parī taisīṃ sonīṃ bahuveṃ na hotī | aisī aikyācaḻācī sthitī | kelī jeṇeṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: For though there are many forms, they do not become many in that way. Such is the state of unity, which he created.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी वृक्षांची पानें जेतुलीं । तेतुलीं रोपें नाहीं लाविलीं। ऐसी अद्वैतदिवसें पाहली। रात्री जया॥ ४००॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī vṛkṣāṃcī pāneṃ jetulīṃ | tetulīṃ ropeṃ nāhīṃ lāvilīṃ| aisī advaitadivaseṃ pāhalī| rātrī jayā|| 400||
verses.meaning: Just as the number of leaves on a tree is not equal to the number of saplings planted, so too, for the one who experiences the day of non-duality, the night is also perceived in that same light.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो पंचात्मकीं सांपडे । तरि मग सांग पां कैसेनि अडे । जो प्रतीतीचेनि पाडें । मजसीं तुके॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to paṃcātmakīṃ sāṃpaḍe | tari maga sāṃga pāṃ kaiseni aḍe | jo pratītīceni pāḍeṃ | majasīṃ tuke|| 9||
verses.meaning: If that (Brahman) can be grasped by the five elements, then tell me, how can it be contained? For it is equal to Me in direct experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझें व्यापकपण आधवें। गवसलें तयाचेनि अनुभवें। तरी न म्हणतां स्वभावें । व्यापकु जाहला ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheṃ vyāpakapaṇa ādhaveṃ| gavasaleṃ tayāceni anubhaveṃ| tarī na mhaṇatāṃ svabhāveṃ | vyāpaku jāhalā || 2||
verses.meaning: My all-pervasiveness, when fully grasped through their experience, naturally makes them all-pervading without even needing to say so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां शरीरीं तरी आहे । परी शरीराचा तो नोहे। ऐसें बोलवरी होये। तें करूं काई॥३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ śarīrīṃ tarī āhe | parī śarīrācā to nohe| aiseṃ bolavarī hoye| teṃ karūṃ kāī||3||
verses.meaning: Now, though it is in the body, it is not of the body. How can such a state be achieved?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि असो तें विशेषें। आपणपेंयासारिखें। जो चराचर देखे। अखंडित ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aso teṃ viśeṣeṃ| āpaṇapeṃyāsārikheṃ| jo carācara dekhe| akhaṃḍita || 4||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let it be said specifically: one who constantly sees the entire animate and inanimate world as oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुखदुःखादि वर्मे । कां शुभाशुभें कर्मे । दोनी ऐसीं मनोधमें । नेणेचि जो॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: sukhaduḥkhādi varme | kāṃ śubhāśubheṃ karme | donī aisīṃ manodhameṃ | neṇeci jo|| 5||
verses.meaning: One who does not know the two mental states of happiness and sorrow, or good and bad actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे समविषम भाव। आणिकही विचित्र जें सर्व। तें मानी जैसे अवयव। आपुले होती ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: he samaviṣama bhāva| āṇikahī vicitra jeṃ sarva| teṃ mānī jaise avayava| āpule hotī || 6||
verses.meaning: All these diverse and varied phenomena, and indeed everything else that is wondrous, consider them to be like the limbs of your own body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें एकैक काय सांगावें। जया त्रैलोक्यचि आधघवें। मी ऐसें स्वभावें। बोधा आलें॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ ekaika kāya sāṃgāveṃ| jayā trailokyaci ādhaghaveṃ| mī aiseṃ svabhāveṃ| bodhā āleṃ|| 7||
verses.meaning: Why should I describe each individual thing? When the entire three worlds naturally came to know me as 'I am'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाही देह एकु कौर आथी । 'लौकिकीं सुखदुःखी तयातें म्हणती । परी आम्हांतें ऐसी प्रतीती । परब्रह्मचि हा॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāhī deha eku kaura āthī | 'laukikīṃ sukhaduḥkhī tayāteṃ mhaṇatī | parī āmhāṃteṃ aisī pratītī | parabrahmaci hā|| 8||
verses.meaning: Even though people perceive this body as experiencing worldly joys and sorrows, for us, the firm conviction is that this is indeed the Supreme Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आपणपां विश्‍व देखिजे। आणि आपण विश्‍व होईजे । ऐसें साम्यचि एक उपासिजे। पांडवा गा॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āpaṇapāṃ viś‍va dekhije| āṇi āpaṇa viś‍va hoīje | aiseṃ sāmyaci eka upāsije| pāṃḍavā gā|| 9||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one perceives the universe within oneself, and one becomes the universe. Such oneness is to be worshipped, O Pandava.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें तूतें बहुतीं प्रसंगीं । आम्ही म्हणों याचिलागीं। जे साम्यापरौती जगीं । प्राप्ति नाहीं ॥ ४९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ tūteṃ bahutīṃ prasaṃgīṃ | āmhī mhaṇoṃ yācilāgīṃ| je sāmyāparautī jagīṃ | prāpti nāhīṃ || 490||
verses.meaning: We tell you this on many occasions, that there is no greater attainment in this world than equanimity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब अर्जुन म्हणे देवा । तुम्ही सांगा कीर आमुचिया कणवा । परी न पुरों जी स्वभावा। मनाचिया॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba arjuna mhaṇe devā | tumhī sāṃgā kīra āmuciyā kaṇavā | parī na puroṃ jī svabhāvā| manāciyā|| 11||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said, "O Lord, You may speak out of compassion for us, but my nature, the mind's inherent disposition, is not satisfied."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें मन कैसें केवढें। ऐसें पाहों म्हणों तरी न सांपडे । एऱ्हबीं राहटावया थोडें । त्रेलो क्य यया॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ mana kaiseṃ kevaḍheṃ| aiseṃ pāhoṃ mhaṇoṃ tarī na sāṃpaḍe | eṟhabīṃ rāhaṭāvayā thoḍeṃ | trelo kya yayā|| 12||
verses.meaning: How vast and how great is this mind? If one tries to perceive it, it cannot be grasped. Yet, for it to reside, the three worlds are too small.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ऐसें कैसें घडेल। जे मर्कट समाधी येईल। कां राहा म्हणतलिया राहेळ। महावातु॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aiseṃ kaiseṃ ghaḍela| je markaṭa samādhī yeīla| kāṃ rāhā mhaṇataliyā rāheḻa| mahāvātu|| 13||
verses.meaning: Therefore, how can such a thing happen, that a monkey would achieve samadhi, or that a great wind would stop when asked to stay?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें बुद्धीतें सळी । निश्चयातें टाळी । धैर्येसीं हातफळी। मिळऊनि जाय॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ buddhīteṃ saḻī | niścayāteṃ ṭāḻī | dhairyesīṃ hātaphaḻī| miḻaūni jāya|| 14||
verses.meaning: That which shakes the intellect, removes certainty, and destroys courage, goes on to meet its end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें विवेकातें भुलवबी। संतोषासी चाड लावी । बैसिजे तरी हिंडवी। दाही दिशा॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ vivekāteṃ bhulavabī| saṃtoṣāsī cāḍa lāvī | baisije tarī hiṃḍavī| dāhī diśā|| 15||
verses.meaning: That which deludes discrimination, instills a longing for contentment, and though one sits still, makes one wander in all ten directions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें निरोधलें घे उबाबो। जया ११८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी संयमुचि होय सावावो। तें मन आपुला स्वभावो। सांडील काई॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ nirodhaleṃ ghe ubābo| jayā 118 śrījñāneśvarī saṃyamuci hoya sāvāvo| teṃ mana āpulā svabhāvo| sāṃḍīla kāī|| 16||
verses.meaning: When the mind is restrained, and self-control becomes its very nature, will it then abandon its inherent disposition?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि मन एक निश्चळ राहेळ। मग आम्हांसि साम्य येईल। हें विशेषेंही न घडेल। याचिलागीं॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni mana eka niścaḻa rāheḻa| maga āmhāṃsi sāmya yeīla| heṃ viśeṣeṃhī na ghaḍela| yācilāgīṃ|| 17||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the mind will remain unwavering, and then equality will come to us. This will not happen easily for this reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव कृष्ण म्हणती साचचि। बोलत आहासि तें तैसेंचि। यया मनाचा कौर चपळचि । स्वभावो गा॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva kṛṣṇa mhaṇatī sācaci| bolata āhāsi teṃ taiseṃci| yayā manācā kaura capaḻaci | svabhāvo gā|| 18||
verses.meaning: Then Krishna said, "What you say is indeed true. The nature of this mind is certainly restless."

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि वैराग्याचेनि आधारें। जरि लाविलें अभ्यासाचिये मोहरें। तरी केतुलेनि एके अवसरें। स्थिरावेल॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari vairāgyāceni ādhāreṃ| jari lāvileṃ abhyāsāciye mohareṃ| tarī ketuleni eke avasareṃ| sthirāvela|| 19||
verses.meaning: But if, with the support of detachment, one applies the bridle of spiritual practice, then in a short time, the mind will become steady.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जें यया मनाचें एक निकें। जें देखिलें गोडीचिया ठाया सोके । म्हणौनि अनुभवसुखचि कवतिके । दाबीत जाइजे॥ ४२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jeṃ yayā manāceṃ eka nikeṃ| jeṃ dekhileṃ goḍīciyā ṭhāyā soke | mhaṇauni anubhavasukhaci kavatike | dābīta jāije|| 420||
verses.meaning: For the mind has one good quality: it is drawn to that which it perceives as sweet. Therefore, one should always present the joy of experience with delight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं विरक्ति जयांसि नाहीं। जे अभ्यासीं न रिघती कहीं। तयां नाकळे हें आम्हीही। न मनं कायी॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ virakti jayāṃsi nāhīṃ| je abhyāsīṃ na righatī kahīṃ| tayāṃ nākaḻe heṃ āmhīhī| na manaṃ kāyī|| 21||
verses.meaning: Those who lack dispassion and never engage in spiritual practice cannot comprehend this, nor can they accept it in their minds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि यमनियमांचिया वाटा न वचिजे। कहीं वैराग्याची से न करिजे। केवळ विषयजळीं ठाकिजे। बुडी देउनी ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari yamaniyamāṃciyā vāṭā na vacije| kahīṃ vairāgyācī se na karije| kevaḻa viṣayajaḻīṃ ṭhākije| buḍī deunī || 22||
verses.meaning: However, one does not tread the path of Yama and Niyama, nor does one embrace detachment. Instead, one plunges headfirst into the waters of worldly pleasures, drowning completely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया जालिया मानसा कहीं। युक्‍तीची कांबी लागली नाहीं । तरी निश्चळ होईल काई । कैसेनि सांगें ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā jāliyā mānasā kahīṃ| yuk‍tīcī kāṃbī lāgalī nāhīṃ | tarī niścaḻa hoīla kāī | kaiseni sāṃgeṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: If a person is born without the support of spiritual wisdom, how can they ever attain steadiness? Tell me, how is that possible?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मनाचा निग्रहो होये । ऐसा उपाय जो आहे। तो आरंभीं मग नोहे। कैसा पाहों ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni manācā nigraho hoye | aisā upāya jo āhe| to āraṃbhīṃ maga nohe| kaisā pāhoṃ || 24||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever means exist to control the mind, begin that practice. Then, how can it not succeed?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी योगसाधन जितुकें । तें अवघेचि काय लटिकें । परि आपणयां अभ्यासू न ठाके । हेंचि म्हणे॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī yogasādhana jitukeṃ | teṃ avagheci kāya laṭikeṃ | pari āpaṇayāṃ abhyāsū na ṭhāke | heṃci mhaṇe|| 25||
verses.meaning: Then, is all the practice of Yoga false? But one says, "I am not able to practice it."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंगीं योगाचें होय बळ। तरी मन केतुलें चपळ । काय महदादि हें सकळ। आपु नोहे॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃgīṃ yogāceṃ hoya baḻa| tarī mana ketuleṃ capaḻa | kāya mahadādi heṃ sakaḻa| āpu nohe|| 26||
verses.meaning: If one gains the strength of Yoga, how much can the mind, however restless, truly belong to oneself? What of this entire creation, from the Mahat onwards? Does it truly belong to oneself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अर्जुन म्हणे निकें। देवो बोलती तें न चुके । साच योगबळेंसीं न तुके। मनोबळ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha arjuna mhaṇe nikeṃ| devo bolatī teṃ na cuke | sāca yogabaḻeṃsīṃ na tuke| manobaḻa|| 27||
verses.meaning: Arjuna then said, "What the Lord says is indeed true. The power of yoga cannot be compared to the power of the mind."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तोचि योगु कैसा केवीं जाणों। आम्ही येतुळे दिवस याची मातुही नेणों। म्हणौनि मनातें जी म्हणों । अनावर॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī toci yogu kaisā kevīṃ jāṇoṃ| āmhī yetuḻe divasa yācī mātuhī neṇoṃ| mhaṇauni manāteṃ jī mhaṇoṃ | anāvara|| 28||
verses.meaning: How then can we know that Yoga? For so many days we have not even heard of it. Therefore, we consider the mind uncontrollable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा आतां अघवेया जन्मा । तुझेनि प्रसादें पुरुषोत्तमा। योगपरिचयो आम्हां। जाहळा आजी ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ātāṃ aghaveyā janmā | tujheni prasādeṃ puruṣottamā| yogaparicayo āmhāṃ| jāhaḻā ājī || 29||
verses.meaning: O Purushottama, by your grace, we have today attained the acquaintance of Yoga throughout all our lives.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानस: । अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गति कृष्ण गच्छति॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasa: | aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gati kṛṣṇa gacchati|| 37||
verses.meaning: O Krishna, what becomes of the one who, though endowed with faith, strays from the path of Yoga and fails to attain its perfection?

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'परि आणिक एक गोसांविया। मज संशयो असे साविया। तो तूंबांचूनि फेडावया। समर्थ नाहीं ॥ ४३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'pari āṇika eka gosāṃviyā| maja saṃśayo ase sāviyā| to tūṃbāṃcūni pheḍāvayā| samartha nāhīṃ || 430||
verses.meaning: But, O Lord, I have one more doubt, which no one but You is capable of resolving.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सांगें गोविंदा। कवण एकु मोक्षपदा । झोंबत होत श्रद्धा । उपायेंबिण॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sāṃgeṃ goviṃdā| kavaṇa eku mokṣapadā | jhoṃbata hota śraddhā | upāyeṃbiṇa|| 39||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Govinda, tell me, who is it that strives for the state of liberation without any means or effort, solely through faith?

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियग्रामोनि निघाला । आस्थेचिया वाटे लागला । आत्मसि्धीचिया पुढिला। नगरा यावया॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyagrāmoni nighālā | āstheciyā vāṭe lāgalā | ātmasidhīciyā puḍhilā| nagarā yāvayā|| 32||
verses.meaning: Having emerged from the realm of the senses, he set out on the path of earnest endeavor, to reach the city of self-realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव आत्मसिन्दि न ठकेचि। आणि मागुतें न येववेचि। ऐसा अस्तु गेला माझारींचि । आयुष्यभानु॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva ātmasindi na ṭhakeci| āṇi māguteṃ na yevaveci| aisā astu gelā mājhārīṃci | āyuṣyabhānu|| 33||
verses.meaning: Then, the sun of life sets in the middle, without the self-realization being achieved, and without the possibility of returning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें अकाळीं आभाळ । अळुमाळु सपातळ। विपायें आलें केवळ। वसे ना वर्षे ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ akāḻīṃ ābhāḻa | aḻumāḻu sapātaḻa| vipāyeṃ āleṃ kevaḻa| vase nā varṣe || 34||
verses.meaning: Just as a cloud that appears out of season, thin and scattered, might come by chance but does not settle or rain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं दोन्ही दुरावलीं। जे प्राप्त तंब अलग ठेलळी। आणि अप्राप्तीही सांडवली । श्रव्धा तया॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ donhī durāvalīṃ| je prāpta taṃba alaga ṭhelaḻī| āṇi aprāptīhī sāṃḍavalī | śravdhā tayā|| 35||
verses.meaning: Similarly, both the attained and the unattained are set aside; the attained is kept separate, and the unattained is also abandoned, for such is the nature of faith.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा दोंला अंतरला कां जी। जो श्रद्धेच्या समाजीं। बुडाला तया हो जी। कवण गति॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā doṃlā aṃtaralā kāṃ jī| jo śraddhecyā samājīṃ| buḍālā tayā ho jī| kavaṇa gati|| 36||
verses.meaning: How can one who is immersed in the company of faith ever be separated from it? What other state can such a person attain?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव कृष्ण म्हणती पार्था । जया मोक्षसुखीं आस्था । तया मोक्षावांचूनि अन्यथा। गती आहे गा॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva kṛṣṇa mhaṇatī pārthā | jayā mokṣasukhīṃ āsthā | tayā mokṣāvāṃcūni anyathā| gatī āhe gā|| 37||
verses.meaning: Then Krishna said, "Arjuna, for those who aspire to the bliss of liberation, there is no other path than liberation itself."

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि ऐतुलें हेंचि एक घडे। जें माझारीं विसवावें पडे। तेंही परी ऐसेनि सुरवाडें। जो देवां नाहीं ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari aituleṃ heṃci eka ghaḍe| jeṃ mājhārīṃ visavāveṃ paḍe| teṃhī parī aiseni suravāḍeṃ| jo devāṃ nāhīṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: But such a thing happens only once, that one has to rest in the middle. And that too, with such ease, which even the gods do not possess.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं अभ्यासाचा उचलता । पाउलीं जरी चालता । तरी दिवसाआधीं ठाकिता । सो$हंसिद्धीतें ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ abhyāsācā ucalatā | pāulīṃ jarī cālatā | tarī divasāādhīṃ ṭhākitā | so$haṃsiddhīteṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, if one were to take steps in spiritual practice, even if slowly, they would reach the state of 'I am That' before the day ends.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तेतुला वेगु नव्हेचि। म्हणौनि विसांबा तरी निकाचि । पाठीं मोक्षु तंव तैसाचि । ठेविला असे॥ ४४० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari tetulā vegu navheci| mhaṇauni visāṃbā tarī nikāci | pāṭhīṃ mokṣu taṃva taisāci | ṭhevilā ase|| 440 ||
verses.meaning: But that speed is not possible, so rest is indeed good. Moreover, liberation is similarly reserved for you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐके कवतिक हें कैसें। जे शतमखा लोक सायासें। तें तो पावे अनायासें। कैवल्यकामु॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aike kavatika heṃ kaiseṃ| je śatamakhā loka sāyāseṃ| teṃ to pāve anāyāseṃ| kaivalyakāmu|| 41||
verses.meaning: Listen to this wonder: how he effortlessly attains the state of liberation, which even the lord of a hundred sacrifices achieves only with great effort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेथिंचे जे अमोघ । अलौकिक भोग। भोगितांही सांग। कांटाळे मन॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tethiṃce je amogha | alaukika bhoga| bhogitāṃhī sāṃga| kāṃṭāḻe mana|| 42||
verses.meaning: Then, experiencing the unfailing and extraordinary enjoyments there, the mind still becomes weary.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा अंतरायो अवचितां। कां बोढवला भगवंता । ऐसा दिविभोग भोगितां। अनुतापी नित्य॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā aṃtarāyo avacitāṃ| kāṃ boḍhavalā bhagavaṃtā | aisā divibhoga bhogitāṃ| anutāpī nitya|| 43||
verses.meaning: Why has this obstacle suddenly appeared, O Lord? Even while experiencing such divine bliss, I am constantly filled with remorse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं जन्मे संसारीं । परि सकळ धर्माचिया माहेरी । लांबा उगवे आगरीं । विभवश्रियेचा ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ janme saṃsārīṃ | pari sakaḻa dharmāciyā māherī | lāṃbā ugave āgarīṃ | vibhavaśriyecā || 44||
verses.meaning: Though born into the world, he is the very abode of all righteousness, a vast and auspicious source of prosperity and glory.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयातें नीतिपंथें चाळिजे । सत्यधूत बोलिजे । देखाबें तें देखिजे । शास्त्रदृष्टीं ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāteṃ nītipaṃtheṃ cāḻije | satyadhūta bolije | dekhābeṃ teṃ dekhije | śāstradṛṣṭīṃ || 45 ||
verses.meaning: One should walk the path of righteousness, speak the truth, and see everything through the lens of scripture.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वेद तो जागेश्वरु। जया व्यवसाय निजाचारु । सारासार विचारु । मंत्री जया॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: veda to jāgeśvaru| jayā vyavasāya nijācāru | sārāsāra vicāru | maṃtrī jayā|| 46||
verses.meaning: The Vedas are the Lord of the universe, whose very nature is righteous conduct, and whose minister is the discernment of the essential from the non-essential.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाच्या कुळीं चिंता। जाळी ईश्वराची पतित्रता। जयातें गृहदेवता। आदि क्रब्द्ि॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayācyā kuḻīṃ ciṃtā| jāḻī īśvarācī patitratā| jayāteṃ gṛhadevatā| ādi krabdi|| 47||
verses.meaning: In whose lineage, worry burns away the purity of God, and to whom the household deities, and so on, are devoted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी निजपुण्याची जोडी। वाढिन्नली सर्वसुखाची कुळवाडी । तिये जन्मे तो सुरवाडी । योगच्युतु ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī nijapuṇyācī joḍī| vāḍhinnalī sarvasukhācī kuḻavāḍī | tiye janme to suravāḍī | yogacyutu || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, the one who has accumulated such a treasure of merit, a lineage of all happiness, is born into a joyful state, even if fallen from yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा ज्ञानाग्निहोत्री । जे परब्रह्मण्य श्रोत्री । महासुखक्षेत्री । आदिवंत ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā jñānāgnihotrī | je parabrahmaṇya śrotrī | mahāsukhakṣetrī | ādivaṃta || 49 ||
verses.meaning: Or, the one who performs the fire sacrifice of knowledge, a scholar of the Supreme Brahman, who is the beginning and end in the field of great bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे सिद्धांताचिया सिंहासनीं। राज्य करिती त्रिभुवनीं। जे कूजती कोकिल वनीं। संतोषाच्या ॥ ४५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je siddhāṃtāciyā siṃhāsanīṃ| rājya karitī tribhuvanīṃ| je kūjatī kokila vanīṃ| saṃtoṣācyā || 450||
verses.meaning: Those who, seated on the throne of ultimate truth, reign supreme throughout the three worlds, and who, like cuckoos in a forest, sing sweetly of contentment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे विवेकद्रुमाचे मुळीं। बैसळे आहाति नित्य 'फळीं॥ तया योगियांचिया कुळीं। जन्म पावे॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: je vivekadrumāce muḻīṃ| baisaḻe āhāti nitya 'phaḻīṃ|| tayā yogiyāṃciyā kuḻīṃ| janma pāve|| 51||
verses.meaning: One who is born into the lineage of those yogis who are eternally seated at the root of the tree of discrimination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोटकी देहाकृती उमटे । आणि निजज्ञानाची पाहांट फुटे । सूर्यापुढें प्रगटे । प्रकाशु जैसा ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: moṭakī dehākṛtī umaṭe | āṇi nijajñānācī pāhāṃṭa phuṭe | sūryāpuḍheṃ pragaṭe | prakāśu jaisā || 52||
verses.meaning: A small form emerges, and the dawn of self-knowledge breaks forth, just as light appears before the sun.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशी दशेची वाट न पाहतां। वयसेचिया गांवा न येतां। बाळपणींच सर्वज्ञता। वरी तयातें ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśī daśecī vāṭa na pāhatāṃ| vayaseciyā gāṃvā na yetāṃ| bāḻapaṇīṃca sarvajñatā| varī tayāteṃ || 53||
verses.meaning: Similarly, without waiting for the stages of life, without reaching the village of old age, omniscience embraces him even in childhood.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये सिद्धप्रज्ञेचेनि लाभें। मनचि सारस्वतें दुभे। मग सकळ शास्त्रें स्वयंभें। निघती मुखें ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye siddhaprajñeceni lābheṃ| manaci sārasvateṃ dubhe| maga sakaḻa śāstreṃ svayaṃbheṃ| nighatī mukheṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: Through the attainment of such perfect wisdom, the mind itself overflows with eloquence, and then all scriptures spontaneously issue forth from the mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जें जन्म । जयालागीं देव सकाम । स्वर्गी ठेळे जप होम । करिती सदा ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jeṃ janma | jayālāgīṃ deva sakāma | svargī ṭheḻe japa homa | karitī sadā || 55||
verses.meaning: Such is the birth for which even the gods, with desires, constantly perform japa and homa in heaven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अमरीं भाट होईजे । मग मृत्युलोकातें वानिजे। ऐसें जन्म पार्था गा जें। तें तो पावे॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: amarīṃ bhāṭa hoīje | maga mṛtyulokāteṃ vānije| aiseṃ janma pārthā gā jeṃ| teṃ to pāve|| 56||
verses.meaning: O Partha, one who attains such a birth, becomes a bard in the heavens and then praises the mortal world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मागील जे सदबुन्धि। जेथ जीवित्वा जाहाली होती अबधि । मग तेचि पुढती निरवधि। नवी लाहे ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi māgīla je sadabundhi| jetha jīvitvā jāhālī hotī abadhi | maga teci puḍhatī niravadhi| navī lāhe || 57||
verses.meaning: And the previous good intellect, where life had reached its limit, that very intellect then attains new, boundless existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सदैवा आणि पायाळा। वरि दिव्यांजन होय डोळां । मग देखे जैसी अबलीळा। पाताळधनें॥ ५८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha sadaivā āṇi pāyāḻā| vari divyāṃjana hoya ḍoḻāṃ | maga dekhe jaisī abalīḻā| pātāḻadhaneṃ|| 58 ||
verses.meaning: There, for the fortunate and the discerning, it is as if a divine ointment is applied to their eyes, and then they effortlessly perceive the treasures of the netherworld.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें दुर्भद जे अभिप्राय। कां गुरुगम्य हन ठाय। तेथ सौरसेंबीण जाय । बुद्धि तयाची ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ durbhada je abhiprāya| kāṃ gurugamya hana ṭhāya| tetha sauraseṃbīṇa jāya | buddhi tayācī || 59||
verses.meaning: Similarly, for those difficult concepts or places understood only through the Guru's guidance, their intellect, without proper understanding, goes astray.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बळियें इंद्रियें येती मना । मन एकवटे पवना । पवन सहजें गगना । मिळोंचि लागे॥ ४६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: baḻiyeṃ iṃdriyeṃ yetī manā | mana ekavaṭe pavanā | pavana sahajeṃ gaganā | miḻoṃci lāge|| 460||
verses.meaning: The powerful senses come under the control of the mind. The mind then unites with the breath. And the breath, naturally, begins to merge into the void (ether).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें नेणों काय अपैसें। तयातेंचि कौजे अभ्यासें। समाधि घर पुसे । मानसाचें ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ neṇoṃ kāya apaiseṃ| tayāteṃci kauje abhyāseṃ| samādhi ghara puse | mānasāceṃ || 61||
verses.meaning: I do not know how, but the mind, through practice, spontaneously seeks the abode of Samadhi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जाणिजे योगपीठींचा भेरवु । काय हा आरंभरंभेचा गोरवु। कीं वैराग्यसिऱ्धीचा अनुभवु । रूपा आला॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jāṇije yogapīṭhīṃcā bheravu | kāya hā āraṃbharaṃbhecā goravu| kīṃ vairāgyasiṟdhīcā anubhavu | rūpā ālā|| 62||
verses.meaning: Know that this is the Bhairava (a fierce form of Shiva) of the yogic seat, or the glory of a grand beginning, or the experience of perfected detachment that has taken form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा संसारु उमाणितें माप। कां अष्टांगसामग्रीचें ट्रीप । जैसें परिमळेंचि धरिजे रूप। चंदनाचें ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā saṃsāru umāṇiteṃ māpa| kāṃ aṣṭāṃgasāmagrīceṃ ṭrīpa | jaiseṃ parimaḻeṃci dharije rūpa| caṃdanāceṃ || 63||
verses.meaning: This worldly existence is like a measure filled with fragrance, or a trip made with all eight spiritual disciplines. It is as if the form of sandalwood is perceived through its fragrance alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा संतोषाचा काय घडिला । कीं सिद्धिभांडारींहूनि काढिला । दिसे तेणें मानें रूढला। साधकदशे॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā saṃtoṣācā kāya ghaḍilā | kīṃ siddhibhāṃḍārīṃhūni kāḍhilā | dise teṇeṃ māneṃ rūḍhalā| sādhakadaśe|| 64||
verses.meaning: Similarly, what is the nature of contentment? It is as if it has been drawn from the storehouse of spiritual attainments. It appears to be established in that manner during the stage of spiritual practice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे वर्षशतांचिया कोडी । जन्मसहस्त्रांचिया आडी । लंघितां पातला थडी । आत्मसिद्धीची ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: je varṣaśatāṃciyā koḍī | janmasahastrāṃciyā āḍī | laṃghitāṃ pātalā thaḍī | ātmasiddhīcī || 65||
verses.meaning: Having crossed the countless crores of years and thousands of births, one reaches the shore of self-realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि साधनजात आघवबें। अनुसरे तया स्वभावें । मग आयतिये बैसे राणिवे। विवेकाचिये॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sādhanajāta āghavabeṃ| anusare tayā svabhāveṃ | maga āyatiye baise rāṇive| vivekāciye|| 66||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all spiritual practices naturally follow that person, and then they effortlessly ascend to the throne of discrimination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं विचारितया वेगां। तो विवेकुही ठाके मागां। मग अविचारणीय तें आंगा। घडोनि जाय ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ vicāritayā vegāṃ| to vivekuhī ṭhāke māgāṃ| maga avicāraṇīya teṃ āṃgā| ghaḍoni jāya || 67||
verses.meaning: When the intellect tries to follow with speed, even that discriminative faculty falls behind. Then, that which is beyond thought and comprehension happens to the self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ मनाचें मेहुडें विरे। पवनाचें पवबनपण सरे। आपणपां आपण मुरे। आकाशही ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha manāceṃ mehuḍeṃ vire| pavanāceṃ pavabanapaṇa sare| āpaṇapāṃ āpaṇa mure| ākāśahī || 68||
verses.meaning: There, the mind's entanglement dissolves, the wind's very nature ceases to be, the self merges into itself, and even the sky disappears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रणवाचा माथा बुडे। येतुलेनि अनिर्वाच्य सुख जोडे । म्हणौनि आधींचि बोलु बहुडे। तयालागीं ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: praṇavācā māthā buḍe| yetuleni anirvācya sukha joḍe | mhaṇauni ādhīṃci bolu bahuḍe| tayālāgīṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: When the 'Pranava' (Om) merges, an inexpressible joy is attained. Therefore, much is said about it even before it is experienced.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी ब्रह्मींची स्थिती । जे सकळा गतींसी गती। तया अमूर्ताची मूर्ति। होऊनि ठाके ॥ ४७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī brahmīṃcī sthitī | je sakaḻā gatīṃsī gatī| tayā amūrtācī mūrti| hoūni ṭhāke || 470||
verses.meaning: Such is the state of Brahman, which is the ultimate goal of all paths. It becomes the very form of that formless one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें बहुतीं जन्मीं मागिलीं । विक्षेपांची पाणिवळें झाडिलीं । म्हणोनि उपजतखेवों बुडाली । लग्नघटिका ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ bahutīṃ janmīṃ māgilīṃ | vikṣepāṃcī pāṇivaḻeṃ jhāḍilīṃ | mhaṇoni upajatakhevoṃ buḍālī | lagnaghaṭikā || 71||
verses.meaning: Through many past births, the distractions were cleared away, like water-filled obstacles, and thus, from birth itself, the auspicious moment of union was established.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तद्रूपतेसीं लग्न। लागोनि ठेलें अभिन्न । जैसें लोपलें अभ्र गगन। होऊनि ठाके ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tadrūpatesīṃ lagna| lāgoni ṭheleṃ abhinna | jaiseṃ lopaleṃ abhra gagana| hoūni ṭhāke || 72||
verses.meaning: And the individual soul, having merged into the Supreme, becomes indistinguishable from it, just as a cloud, having dissolved, becomes one with the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें विश्‍व जेथ होये । मागोतें जेथ लया जाये। तें विद्यमानेंचि देहें। जाहला तो गा॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ viś‍va jetha hoye | māgoteṃ jetha layā jāye| teṃ vidyamāneṃci deheṃ| jāhalā to gā|| 73||
verses.meaning: The one who has realized that from which the universe originates and into which it ultimately dissolves, has achieved this realization while still embodied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया लाभाचिया आशा । करूनि धेर्यबाहूंचा भरंवसा । घालीत षट्कर्मांचा धारसा। कर्मनिष्ठ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā lābhāciyā āśā | karūni dheryabāhūṃcā bharaṃvasā | ghālīta ṣaṭkarmāṃcā dhārasā| karmaniṣṭha|| 74||
verses.meaning: One who, in the hope of attaining spiritual gain, relies on the strength of their unwavering resolve, and diligently performs the six prescribed Vedic duties, is truly devoted to action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जिये एकी वस्तूलागीं। बाणोनि ज्ञानाची वज्रांगी। झुंजत प्रपंचेंशीं समरंगीं। ज्ञानिये गा ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jiye ekī vastūlāgīṃ| bāṇoni jñānācī vajrāṃgī| jhuṃjata prapaṃceṃśīṃ samaraṃgīṃ| jñāniye gā || 75||
verses.meaning: Or, for the sake of that one Reality, having donned the armor of knowledge, the wise ones fight the battle of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा निलागें निसरडा । तपोदुर्गाचा आडकडा । झोंबती तपिये चाडा। जयाचिया ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā nilāgeṃ nisaraḍā | tapodurgācā āḍakaḍā | jhoṃbatī tapiye cāḍā| jayāciyā || 76||
verses.meaning: Or, for those who are prone to slipping, it is a strong fortress of penance, to which ascetics eagerly cling.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें भजतियां भज्य। याजिकांचें याज्य। एवं जें पूज्य । सकळां सदा ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ bhajatiyāṃ bhajya| yājikāṃceṃ yājya| evaṃ jeṃ pūjya | sakaḻāṃ sadā || 77||
verses.meaning: That which is worshipped by devotees, that which is offered by sacrificers, and that which is always revered by all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि तो आपण स्वयें जाहला निर्वाण। जें साधकांचें कारण। सिद्ध तत्त्व ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci to āpaṇa svayeṃ jāhalā nirvāṇa| jeṃ sādhakāṃceṃ kāraṇa| siddha tattva || 78||
verses.meaning: That very Self has become the ultimate liberation, which is the established truth and the goal of all seekers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कर्मनिष्ठां वंद्यु| तो ज्ञानियांसी वेद्यु। तापसांचा आद्यु। तपोनाथु॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni karmaniṣṭhāṃ vaṃdyu| to jñāniyāṃsī vedyu| tāpasāṃcā ādyu| taponāthu|| 79||
verses.meaning: Therefore, He is revered by those devoted to action, known to the wise, and the primal lord of ascetics, the master of penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जीवपरमात्मसंगमा । जयाचें येणें जाहलें मनोधर्मा । तो शरीरीचि परी महिमा । ऐशी पावे ॥ ४८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jīvaparamātmasaṃgamā | jayāceṃ yeṇeṃ jāhaleṃ manodharmā | to śarīrīci parī mahimā | aiśī pāve || 480||
verses.meaning: The one whose mind, through this coming together, experiences the union of the individual soul and the Supreme Soul, attains such glory even while embodied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि याकारणें । तूंतें मी सदा म्हणें। योगी होय अंतःकरणे । पंडुकुमरा॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yākāraṇeṃ | tūṃteṃ mī sadā mhaṇeṃ| yogī hoya aṃtaḥkaraṇe | paṃḍukumarā|| 81||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for this very reason, I always tell you, O son of Pandu, become a yogi in your heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा योगी जो म्हणिजे। तो देवांचा देवो जाणिजे । आणि सुखसर्वस्व माझें । चैतन्य तो॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā yogī jo mhaṇije| to devāṃcā devo jāṇije | āṇi sukhasarvasva mājheṃ | caitanya to|| 82||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the one who is called a Yogi, know that he is the God of gods. And he is my very essence of happiness, my consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया भजता भजन भजावें। हें भक्तिसाधन जें आधवें। तें मीचि जाहलो अनुभवें। अखंडित ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā bhajatā bhajana bhajāveṃ| heṃ bhaktisādhana jeṃ ādhaveṃ| teṃ mīci jāhalo anubhaveṃ| akhaṃḍita || 83||
verses.meaning: When one worships, the act of worship itself, and all the means of devotion, I have become that through experience, eternally.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तया आम्हां प्रीतीचे । स्वरूप बोलीं निर्वचे। ऐसें नव्हे गा तो साचें । सुभद्रापती॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayā āmhāṃ prītīce | svarūpa bolīṃ nirvace| aiseṃ navhe gā to sāceṃ | subhadrāpatī|| 84||
verses.meaning: Then, the very nature of our love cannot be expressed in words, O husband of Subhadra, it is truly beyond description.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'तया एकवटळल्िया प्रेमा। जरी पाडें पाहिजे उपमा । तरी मी देह तो आत्मा । हेंचि होय॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'tayā ekavaṭaḻaliyā premā| jarī pāḍeṃ pāhije upamā | tarī mī deha to ātmā | heṃci hoya|| 85||
verses.meaning: When such love becomes concentrated, if an analogy is needed, then it is like saying 'I am the body' and 'that is the soul'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें भक्‍तचकोरचंद्रें। त्रिभुवनेकनरेंद्रे। बोलिलें गुणसमुद्रें। संजयो म्हणे॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ bhak‍tacakoracaṃdreṃ| tribhuvanekanareṃdre| bolileṃ guṇasamudreṃ| saṃjayo mhaṇe|| 86||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said, "Thus spoke the Lord of the three worlds, the moon to the chakora birds of devotion, the ocean of virtues."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ आदिलापासूनि पार्था। ऐकिजे ऐसीचि आस्था । दुणावली हें यदुनाथा । भावों सरलें॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha ādilāpāsūni pārthā| aikije aisīci āsthā | duṇāvalī heṃ yadunāthā | bhāvoṃ saraleṃ|| 87||
verses.meaning: From the very beginning, O Partha, such was the eagerness to listen, which doubled, O Yadunatha, as the devotion became simpler.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं सावियाचि मनीं संतोषला । जे बोला आरिसा जोडला । तेणें हरिखें आतां उपलवबला । निरूपील॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ sāviyāci manīṃ saṃtoṣalā | je bolā ārisā joḍalā | teṇeṃ harikheṃ ātāṃ upalavabalā | nirūpīla|| 88||
verses.meaning: Or, if the mind is truly pleased that it has found a mirror for its words, then with that joy, it will now overflow and expound.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो प्रसंगु आहे पुढां। जेथ शांतु दिसेल उघडा। तो पालविजेल मुडा। प्रमेयबीजाचा॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to prasaṃgu āhe puḍhāṃ| jetha śāṃtu disela ughaḍā| to pālavijela muḍā| prameyabījācā|| 89||
verses.meaning: That occasion is yet to come, where peace will be revealed openly. Then, the root of all spiritual truths will sprout.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे सात्त्विकाचेनि बडपें। गेलें आध्यात्मिक खरपें। सहजें निडारळे वाफे । चतुरचित्ताचे ॥ ४९० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: je sāttvikāceni baḍapeṃ| geleṃ ādhyātmika kharapeṃ| sahajeṃ niḍāraḻe vāphe | caturacittāce || 490 ||
verses.meaning: Through the heat of sattva, the spiritual impurities are naturally burnt away, and the clever mind becomes clear and steady.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरी अवधानाचा वाफसा । लाधला सोनयाऐसा। म्हणौनि पेरावया धिंवसा। श्रीनिवृत्तीसी ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: varī avadhānācā vāphasā | lādhalā sonayāaisā| mhaṇauni perāvayā dhiṃvasā| śrīnivṛttīsī || 91||
verses.meaning: The field of attention, having been prepared and made fertile like gold, is now ready for sowing. Therefore, Shri Nivritti is eager to sow the seeds of spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानदेव म्हणे मी चाडे । सदगुरूंनीं केलें कोडें । माथां हात ठेविला तें फुडें । बीजचि वाइलें॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñānadeva mhaṇe mī cāḍe | sadagurūṃnīṃ keleṃ koḍeṃ | māthāṃ hāta ṭhevilā teṃ phuḍeṃ | bījaci vāileṃ|| 92||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev says, "I am a mere child. The Sadguru has showered me with grace. When he placed his hand on my head, it was as if he sowed the very seed of spiritual knowledge within me."

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि येणें मुखें जें जें निगे। तें संतांच्या हृदयीं साचचि लागे। हें असो सांगों श्रीरंगें। बोलिलें जें ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yeṇeṃ mukheṃ jeṃ jeṃ nige| teṃ saṃtāṃcyā hṛdayīṃ sācaci lāge| heṃ aso sāṃgoṃ śrīraṃgeṃ| bolileṃ jeṃ || 93||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever emanates from this mouth truly resonates in the hearts of saints. Let this suffice; what Shri Ranga (Lord Vishnu) Himself spoke.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तें मनाच्या कानीं ऐकावें। बोल बुद्धीच्या डोळां देखावें। हे सांटोवाटीं घ्यावे । चित्ताचिया ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teṃ manācyā kānīṃ aikāveṃ| bola buddhīcyā ḍoḻāṃ dekhāveṃ| he sāṃṭovāṭīṃ ghyāve | cittāciyā || 94||
verses.meaning: Listen to it with the ears of your mind, see it with the eyes of your intellect, and take it to heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवधानाचेनि हातें । नेयावें हृदयाआंतोतें । हे रिझवितील आयणीतें । सजनांचिये ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: avadhānāceni hāteṃ | neyāveṃ hṛdayāāṃtoteṃ | he rijhavitīla āyaṇīteṃ | sajanāṃciye || 95||
verses.meaning: With the hands of attention, one should bring this into the heart. This will please the assembly of the virtuous.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे स्वहितातें निवविती । परिणामातें जीवविती । सुखाची वाहविती। लाखोली जीवां॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: he svahitāteṃ nivavitī | pariṇāmāteṃ jīvavitī | sukhācī vāhavitī| lākholī jīvāṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: They bring peace to one's own well-being, give life to the consequences, and shower countless blessings of happiness upon beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां अर्जनेंसीं श्रीमुकुंदें। नागर बोलिजेल विनोदें। तें बोंबियेचेनि प्रबंधें। सांगेन मी ॥। ४९७॥ इति श्रीज्ञानदेवविरचितायां धावार्थदीपिकायां षष्ठो5ध्याय:॥ ६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ arjaneṃsīṃ śrīmukuṃdeṃ| nāgara bolijela vinodeṃ| teṃ boṃbiyeceni prabaṃdheṃ| sāṃgena mī ||| 497|| iti śrījñānadevaviracitāyāṃ dhāvārthadīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭho5dhyāya:|| 6 ||
verses.meaning: Now, what Shri Mukunda (Krishna) playfully and skillfully said to Arjuna, I will narrate through the medium of this composition, like the core of a fruit. Thus ends the sixth chapter in Dnyanadeva's Dnyaneshwari, titled 'Dhavartha Dipika'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आइका मग तो श्रीअनंतु। पार्थातें असे म्हणतु। पैं गा तूं योगयुक्तु । जालासि आतां॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: āikā maga to śrīanaṃtu| pārthāteṃ ase mhaṇatu| paiṃ gā tūṃ yogayuktu | jālāsi ātāṃ|| 1||
verses.meaning: Listen then, that Shri Ananta, said to Partha, "Indeed, you have now become united with Yoga."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज समग्रातें जाणसी ऐसें। आपुलिया तळहातींचें स्ल जैसें । तुज ज्ञान सांगेन तैसें । विज्ञानेंसी ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja samagrāteṃ jāṇasī aiseṃ| āpuliyā taḻahātīṃceṃ sla jaiseṃ | tuja jñāna sāṃgena taiseṃ | vijñāneṃsī || 2||
verses.meaning: You will know Me, the complete and whole, as clearly as one sees the fruit in their own palm. I will impart to you that knowledge, along with its profound realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ विज्ञानें काय करावें । ऐसें घेसी जरी मनोभावें। तरी पैं आधीं जाणावें । तेंचि लागे॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha vijñāneṃ kāya karāveṃ | aiseṃ ghesī jarī manobhāveṃ| tarī paiṃ ādhīṃ jāṇāveṃ | teṃci lāge|| 3||
verses.meaning: If you ask with such a mindset, 'What can knowledge accomplish here?' then first, you must understand what that knowledge is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग ज्ञानाचिये वेळे। झांकती जाणिवेचे डोळे। जैसी तीरीं नाव न ढळे। टेकलीसांती ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga jñānāciye veḻe| jhāṃkatī jāṇivece ḍoḻe| jaisī tīrīṃ nāva na ḍhaḻe| ṭekalīsāṃtī || 4||
verses.meaning: Then, at the time of true knowledge, the eyes of worldly understanding close, just as a boat, having reached the shore, no longer drifts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी जाणीव जेथ न रिघे। विचार मागुता पाउलीं निघे। तर्क आयणी नेघे । आंगीं जयाच्या ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī jāṇīva jetha na righe| vicāra māgutā pāulīṃ nighe| tarka āyaṇī neghe | āṃgīṃ jayācyā || 5||
verses.meaning: Where consciousness cannot enter, where thought retreats, and where logic finds no access within its being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना तया नांव ज्ञान । येर प्रपंचु हें विज्ञान । तेथ सत्यबुद्धि तें अज्ञान । हेंही जाण ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā tayā nāṃva jñāna | yera prapaṃcu heṃ vijñāna | tetha satyabuddhi teṃ ajñāna | heṃhī jāṇa || 6||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, that alone is true knowledge. All else, the worldly existence, is but a form of science or worldly understanding. To hold this worldly existence as ultimately real is ignorance; know this too.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां अज्ञान अवघें हरपे। विज्ञान निःशेष करपे। आणि ज्ञान तें स्वरूपें। होऊनि जाइजे ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ ajñāna avagheṃ harape| vijñāna niḥśeṣa karape| āṇi jñāna teṃ svarūpeṃ| hoūni jāije || 7||
verses.meaning: Now, all ignorance vanishes, and knowledge completely dissolves, and then one becomes the very essence of knowledge itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें सांगतयाचें बोलणें खुंटे । ऐकतयाचें व्यसन तुटे । हें जाणणें सानें मोठें । उरों नेदी॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ sāṃgatayāceṃ bolaṇeṃ khuṃṭe | aikatayāceṃ vyasana tuṭe | heṃ jāṇaṇeṃ sāneṃ moṭheṃ | uroṃ nedī|| 8||
verses.meaning: This knowledge silences the speaker, frees the listener from worldly attachments, and leaves no room for distinctions of small or great.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें वर्म जें गूढ। तें किजेळ वाक्‍्यारूढ। जेणें थोडेन पुरे कोड। बहुत मनींचें॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ varma jeṃ gūḍha| teṃ kijeḻa vāk‍yārūḍha| jeṇeṃ thoḍena pure koḍa| bahuta manīṃceṃ||9||
verses.meaning: This secret, which is so profound, is revealed through words, so that with just a little, the heart's many desires are fulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा मनुष्यांचिया सहस्त्रशां- । माजि विपाइले याचि धिंबसा । तैसे यां धिंबसेकरां बहुवसां-। माजीं विरळा जाणे॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā manuṣyāṃciyā sahastraśāṃ- | māji vipāile yāci dhiṃbasā | taise yāṃ dhiṃbasekarāṃ bahuvasāṃ-| mājīṃ viraḻā jāṇe|| 10||
verses.meaning: Among thousands of people, only a few are truly wise. Similarly, among many who appear wise, only a rare one truly knows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा भरलेया त्रिभुवना-। आंतु एकएकु चांगु अर्जुना । निवडूनि कीजे सेना । लक्षवरी ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā bharaleyā tribhuvanā-| āṃtu ekaeku cāṃgu arjunā | nivaḍūni kīje senā | lakṣavarī || 19||
verses.meaning: Just as, from the entire universe, one selects the best of each kind, Arjuna, to form an army of a hundred thousand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कौं तयाही पाठीं। जे वेळीं लोह मांसातें घांटी। ते वेळीं विजयश्रियेच्या पाटीं। एकुचि बैसे॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kauṃ tayāhī pāṭhīṃ| je veḻīṃ loha māṃsāteṃ ghāṃṭī| te veḻīṃ vijayaśriyecyā pāṭīṃ| ekuci baise|| 12||
verses.meaning: Even after all that, when iron (weapons) clash with flesh, only one sits on the throne of victory.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे आस्थेच्या महापुरीं। रिघताती कोटिवरी। परी प्राप्तीच्या पैलतीरी । विपाइला निगे ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise āsthecyā mahāpurīṃ| righatātī koṭivarī| parī prāptīcyā pailatīrī | vipāilā nige || 13||
verses.meaning: Similarly, millions plunge into the great flood of faith, but only a few reach the other shore of attainment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सामान्य गा नोहे । हें सांगतां बडिल गोठी आहे। परी तें बोलों येईल पाहें । आतां प्रस्तुत ऐकें॥१४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sāmānya gā nohe | heṃ sāṃgatāṃ baḍila goṭhī āhe| parī teṃ boloṃ yeīla pāheṃ | ātāṃ prastuta aikeṃ||14||
verses.meaning: Therefore, this is not a common matter, it is a profound subject to explain. But it can be spoken of, so now listen to the present topic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी अवधारीं गा धनंजया । हे महदादिक माझी माया । जैसी प्रतिबिंबे छाया । निजांगाची ॥ १५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī avadhārīṃ gā dhanaṃjayā | he mahadādika mājhī māyā | jaisī pratibiṃbe chāyā | nijāṃgācī || 15 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen, O Dhananjaya, this great creation and all its elements are My Maya, just as a reflection or a shadow is of one's own body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि इयेतें प्रकृति म्हणिजे। जे अष्टधा भिन्न जाणिजे । लोकत्रय निपजे। इयेस्तव॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi iyeteṃ prakṛti mhaṇije| je aṣṭadhā bhinna jāṇije | lokatraya nipaje| iyestava|| 16||
verses.meaning: And this is called Prakriti, which is known to be eight-fold different. From this, the three worlds are created.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे अष्टधा भिन्न कैसी । ऐसा ध्वनि धरिसी जरी मानसीं । तरी तेचि गा आतां परियेसीं । विवंचना ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: he aṣṭadhā bhinna kaisī | aisā dhvani dharisī jarī mānasīṃ | tarī teci gā ātāṃ pariyesīṃ | vivaṃcanā || 97||
verses.meaning: If you are wondering how these eightfold distinctions arise, then listen now to that very explanation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आप तेज गगन। मही मारुत मन। बुद्छि अहंकारु हे भिन्न। आठे भाग॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpa teja gagana| mahī māruta mana| budchi ahaṃkāru he bhinna| āṭhe bhāga|| 18||
verses.meaning: Fire, water, sky, earth, wind, mind, intellect, and ego - these are the eight distinct parts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या आठांची जे साम्यावस्था। ते माझी परम प्रकृति पार्था । तिये नाम व्यवस्था । जीवु ऐसी॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā āṭhāṃcī je sāmyāvasthā| te mājhī parama prakṛti pārthā | tiye nāma vyavasthā | jīvu aisī|| 19||
verses.meaning: The state of equilibrium of these eight (elements) is My supreme nature, O Partha. That is called the individual soul (Jiva).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे जडातें जीववी। चेतनेतें चेतवी । मनाकरवीं मानवी । शोक मोहो॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je jaḍāteṃ jīvavī| cetaneteṃ cetavī | manākaravīṃ mānavī | śoka moho|| 20||
verses.meaning: That which enlivens the inert, awakens consciousness, and through the mind, makes one experience sorrow and delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं बुद्धीच्या अंगीं जाणणें । तें जिये जवळिकेचें करणें।॥ जिया अहंकाराचेनि विंदाणें। जगचि धरिजे॥ २९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ buddhīcyā aṃgīṃ jāṇaṇeṃ | teṃ jiye javaḻikeceṃ karaṇeṃ||| jiyā ahaṃkārāceni viṃdāṇeṃ| jagaci dharije|| 291||
verses.meaning: The intellect's capacity for knowing, that which is the essence of closeness, by which the world is sustained through the ego's contrivance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते सूक्ष्म प्रकृति कोडें । जें स्थूळाचिया आंगा घडे । तैं भूतसृष्टीची पडे । टांकसाळ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te sūkṣma prakṛti koḍeṃ | jeṃ sthūḻāciyā āṃgā ghaḍe | taiṃ bhūtasṛṣṭīcī paḍe | ṭāṃkasāḻa|| 22||
verses.meaning: That subtle nature, when it takes form in the gross body, then the mint of creation of beings is established.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चतुर्विध ठसा। उमटों लागे आपैसा। मोला तरी सरसा । 'परी थरचि आनान॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: caturvidha ṭhasā| umaṭoṃ lāge āpaisā| molā tarī sarasā | 'parī tharaci ānāna|| 23||
verses.meaning: The four types of creation spontaneously manifest, yet their value and nature are distinct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: होती चौर्‍यांशीं लक्ष थरा। येरा मिती नेणिजे भांडारा। भरे आदिशून्याचा गाभारा। नाणेयांसी॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hotī caur‍yāṃśīṃ lakṣa tharā| yerā mitī neṇije bhāṃḍārā| bhare ādiśūnyācā gābhārā| nāṇeyāṃsī|| 24||
verses.meaning: There were eighty-four lakh layers. The rest of the treasury's measure is unknown. The inner sanctum of the primordial void is filled with coins.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें एकतुके 'पांचभौतिक। पडती बहुवस टांक। मग तिये समृद्धीचे लेख। प्रकृतीचि १२६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी धरी ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ ekatuke 'pāṃcabhautika| paḍatī bahuvasa ṭāṃka| maga tiye samṛddhīce lekha| prakṛtīci 126 śrījñāneśvarī dharī || 25||
verses.meaning: Thus, from the union of the five elements, many forms are created, and the account of their abundance is maintained by Prakriti (Nature) herself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे आंखूनि नाणें विस्तारी । पाठीं तयाची आटणी करी । माजी कर्माकर्माचिया व्यवहारीं। प्रवर्तु दावी ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: je āṃkhūni nāṇeṃ vistārī | pāṭhīṃ tayācī āṭaṇī karī | mājī karmākarmāciyā vyavahārīṃ| pravartu dāvī || 26||
verses.meaning: Just as a goldsmith, after shaping and expanding gold into various ornaments, can melt them back down, so too does the divine principle manifest itself in the actions and inactions of the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें रूपक परी असो सांगों उघड जेसें परियेसों॥ तरी नामरूपाचा अतिसो । प्रकृतीच कोजे॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ rūpaka parī aso sāṃgoṃ ughaḍa jeseṃ pariyesoṃ|| tarī nāmarūpācā atiso | prakṛtīca koje|| 27||
verses.meaning: Let this analogy be, I will explain it clearly, so listen. The excess of name and form, indeed, is born from Prakriti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि प्रकृति तंव माझ्या ठायीं । बिंबे येथें आन नाहीं । म्हणोनि आदि मध्य अवसान पाहीं। जगासि मी॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi prakṛti taṃva mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ | biṃbe yetheṃ āna nāhīṃ | mhaṇoni ādi madhya avasāna pāhīṃ| jagāsi mī|| 28||
verses.meaning: And nature, indeed, is reflected in Me; there is no other place. Therefore, I am the beginning, middle, and end of the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें रोहिणीचें जळ। तयाचें पाहतां येइजे मूळ । तें रशमि नव्हती केवळ । होय तें भानु॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ rohiṇīceṃ jaḻa| tayāceṃ pāhatāṃ yeije mūḻa | teṃ raśami navhatī kevaḻa | hoya teṃ bhānu|| 29||
verses.meaning: This water of the mirage, if one traces its origin, it is not merely rays of light; it is the sun itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचिपरी किरीटी। इया प्रकृति जालिये सृष्टी । जैं उपसंहरूनि कीजेल ठी । तें मीचि आहें ॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāciparī kirīṭī| iyā prakṛti jāliye sṛṣṭī | jaiṃ upasaṃharūni kījela ṭhī | teṃ mīci āheṃ || 30||
verses.meaning: In the same way, O Kiriti (Arjuna), when this creation, born from Prakriti, is dissolved and brought to an end, that too am I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें होय दिसे न दिसे। हें मजचि माजीं असे। मियां विश्व धरिजे जैसें । सूत्रें मणि ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ hoya dise na dise| heṃ majaci mājīṃ ase| miyāṃ viśva dharije jaiseṃ | sūtreṃ maṇi || 31||
verses.meaning: Thus it is, appearing and disappearing, yet it resides within Me. Just as a thread holds beads, so do I sustain the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुवर्णाचे मणी केले। ते सोनियाचे सुतीं बोविले। तैसें म्यां जग धरिळें। सबाह्याभ्यंतरीं ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: suvarṇāce maṇī kele| te soniyāce sutīṃ bovile| taiseṃ myāṃ jaga dhariḻeṃ| sabāhyābhyaṃtarīṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: Just as golden beads are strung together on a golden thread, so too have I held the entire world, both externally and internally.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि उदकीं रसु। कां पवनीं जो स्पर्शु। शशिसूर्यी जो प्रकाशु । तो मीचि जाण॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni udakīṃ rasu| kāṃ pavanīṃ jo sparśu| śaśisūryī jo prakāśu | to mīci jāṇa|| 33||
verses.meaning: Therefore, know that I am the taste in water, the touch in the wind, and the light in the moon and sun.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसाचि नैसर्गिकु शुद्ध । मी पृथ्वीच्या ठायीं गंधु । गगनीं मी शब्दु। वेदीं प्रणवु॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisāci naisargiku śuddha | mī pṛthvīcyā ṭhāyīṃ gaṃdhu | gaganīṃ mī śabdu| vedīṃ praṇavu|| 34||
verses.meaning: Just as naturally pure, I am the fragrance in the earth, I am the sound in the sky, and I am the Pranava (Om) in the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नराच्या ठायीं नरत्व। जें अहंभाविये सत्त्व । तें पौरुष मी हें तत्त्व। बोलिजत असें ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: narācyā ṭhāyīṃ naratva| jeṃ ahaṃbhāviye sattva | teṃ pauruṣa mī heṃ tattva| bolijata aseṃ || 35||
verses.meaning: The very essence of manhood in a man, that egoistic sattva, that is what I call valor.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अग्नि ऐसें आहाच। तेज नामाचें आहे कवच । तें परतें केलिया साच । निजतेज तें मी॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: agni aiseṃ āhāca| teja nāmāceṃ āhe kavaca | teṃ parateṃ keliyā sāca | nijateja teṃ mī|| 36||
verses.meaning: Just as fire is a mere name, and its brilliance is its covering, so too, when that covering is removed, the true light is Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि नानाविध योनीं। जन्मोनि भूतें त्रिभुवनीं। वर्तत आहाति जीवनीं। आपुलाल्या॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi nānāvidha yonīṃ| janmoni bhūteṃ tribhuvanīṃ| vartata āhāti jīvanīṃ| āpulālyā|| 37||
verses.meaning: And in various species, beings are born in the three worlds, living their own lives.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एके पवनेंचि पिती। एकें तृणास्तब जिती । एकें अन्नाधारें राहती । जळें एकें ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: eke pavaneṃci pitī| ekeṃ tṛṇāstaba jitī | ekeṃ annādhāreṃ rāhatī | jaḻeṃ ekeṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: Some sustain themselves by merely drinking air, some by eating grass, some by consuming food, and some by drinking water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें भूतांप्रति आनान । जें प्रकृतिवशें दिसे जीवन तें आघवांठायीं अभिन्न। मीचि एक॥३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ bhūtāṃprati ānāna | jeṃ prakṛtivaśeṃ dise jīvana teṃ āghavāṃṭhāyīṃ abhinna| mīci eka||39||
verses.meaning: Thus, to all beings, that which appears as life due to the sway of nature, in all those places, I alone am the undivided one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आदिचेनि अवसरें। विरूढे गगनाचेनि अंकुरे। जें अंतीं गिळी अक्षरें। प्रणवपीठींचीं ॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ ādiceni avasareṃ| virūḍhe gaganāceni aṃkure| jeṃ aṃtīṃ giḻī akṣareṃ| praṇavapīṭhīṃcīṃ || 40||
verses.meaning: In the beginning, from the very first sprout of the sky, that which ultimately swallows the syllables of the sacred syllable 'Om' (Pranava), emerges.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंब हा विश्‍वाकारु असे| तंव जें विश्‍वाचिसारिखें दिसे। मग महाप्रळयदशे। कैसेंही नव्हे ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃba hā viś‍vākāru ase| taṃva jeṃ viś‍vācisārikheṃ dise| maga mahāpraḻayadaśe| kaiseṃhī navhe || 49||
verses.meaning: As long as this universe exists in its current form, it appears as the universe. But in the state of the great dissolution, it will not be like this at all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अनादि जें सहज तें मी गा विश्‍वबीज। हें हातातळीं तुज। देइजत असे॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ anādi jeṃ sahaja teṃ mī gā viś‍vabīja| heṃ hātātaḻīṃ tuja| deijata ase|| 42||
verses.meaning: Such is the primordial, the spontaneous, that I am the seed of the universe. This I am placing in your hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग उघड करूनि पांडवा। जैं हें आणिसील सांख्याचिया गांवा । तैं ययाचा उपेगु बरवा | देखशील॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga ughaḍa karūni pāṃḍavā| jaiṃ heṃ āṇisīla sāṃkhyāciyā gāṃvā | taiṃ yayācā upegu baravā | dekhaśīla|| 43||
verses.meaning: Then, O Pandava, when you reveal this and bring it to the realm of Sankhya, you will see its excellent utility.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हे अप्रासंगिक आलाप । आतां असतु न बोलों संक्षेप। जाण तपियांच्या ठायीं तप। तें रूप माझें॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī he aprāsaṃgika ālāpa | ātāṃ asatu na boloṃ saṃkṣepa| jāṇa tapiyāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ tapa| teṃ rūpa mājheṃ|| 44||
verses.meaning: But let these irrelevant talks cease now; let's not speak at length. Know that the penance in ascetics, that form is Mine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बळियांमाजीं बळ] तें मी जाणें अढळ । बुद्धिमंतीं केवळ । बुद्धि तें मी ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: baḻiyāṃmājīṃ baḻa] teṃ mī jāṇeṃ aḍhaḻa | buddhimaṃtīṃ kevaḻa | buddhi teṃ mī || 45||
verses.meaning: Among the strong, I am the unwavering strength. Among the intelligent, I am pure intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भूतांच्या ठायीं कामु। तो मी म्हणे आत्मारामु । जेणें अर्थास्तव धर्मु। थोरु होय॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhūtāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ kāmu| to mī mhaṇe ātmārāmu | jeṇeṃ arthāstava dharmu| thoru hoya|| 46||
verses.meaning: Among all beings, the desire for righteousness, that is Me, the Atmarama, by which dharma becomes great.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं विकाराचेनि पैसें। करी कौर इंद्रियांचि ऐसें। परी धर्मासि वेखासें। जावों नेदी॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ vikārāceni paiseṃ| karī kaura iṃdriyāṃci aiseṃ| parī dharmāsi vekhāseṃ| jāvoṃ nedī|| 47||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, though the senses may indulge in their natural tendencies, they never allow Dharma (righteousness) to be compromised.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे अप्रवृत्तीचा अव्हांटा । सांडूनि विधीचिया निघे वाटा । तेवींचि नियमाचा दिवटा। सवें चाळे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: je apravṛttīcā avhāṃṭā | sāṃḍūni vidhīciyā nighe vāṭā | tevīṃci niyamācā divaṭā| saveṃ cāḻe|| 48||
verses.meaning: Just as one abandons the path of unrighteousness and follows the path of prescribed duties, so too does one carry the lamp of discipline along.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कामु ऐसिया बोजा प्रवर्ते । म्हणोनि धर्मासि होय पुरतें। मोक्षतीर्थीचें मुक्तें। संसार भोगी ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāmu aisiyā bojā pravarte | mhaṇoni dharmāsi hoya purateṃ| mokṣatīrthīceṃ mukteṃ| saṃsāra bhogī || 49||
verses.meaning: When such a burden of desire arises, it fulfills righteousness, and the liberated soul, having bathed in the sacred waters of liberation, enjoys the worldly life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो श्रुतिगौरवाच्या मांडवीं। काम सृष्टीचा वेलु वाढवी । जंब कर्मफळेंसि 'पालवी। अपवर्गी टेंके॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo śrutigauravācyā māṃḍavīṃ| kāma sṛṣṭīcā velu vāḍhavī | jaṃba karmaphaḻeṃsi 'pālavī| apavargī ṭeṃke|| 50||
verses.meaning: He who, in the glorious canopy of the Vedas, nurtures the creeper of desire for creation, and whose leaves are the fruits of actions, ultimately reaches liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा नियुत कां कंदर्पु। जो भूतां यां बीजरूपु। तो मी म्हणे बापु। योगियांचा ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā niyuta kāṃ kaṃdarpu| jo bhūtāṃ yāṃ bījarūpu| to mī mhaṇe bāpu| yogiyāṃcā || 51||
verses.meaning: I am the father of yogis, just as the mighty Kamadeva is the seed-form for all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें एकेक किती सांगावें । आतां वस्तुजातचि आघवें। मजपासूनि जाणावें । विकारलें असे॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ ekeka kitī sāṃgāveṃ | ātāṃ vastujātaci āghaveṃ| majapāsūni jāṇāveṃ | vikāraleṃ ase||52||
verses.meaning: How much more can I say about each individual thing? Know that all existing things have emanated from Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे सात्त्विक हन भाव। कां रजतमादि सर्व । ते ममरूपसंभव। वोळखें तूं॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je sāttvika hana bhāva| kāṃ rajatamādi sarva | te mamarūpasaṃbhava| voḻakheṃ tūṃ||53||
verses.meaning: Understand that all these states of being, whether sattvic, or rajasic and tamasic, originate from Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे जाळे तरी माझ्या ठायीं। परी तयांमाजीं मी नाहीं। जैसी स्वणींच्या डोहीं । जागृती न बुडे ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: he jāḻe tarī mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ| parī tayāṃmājīṃ mī nāhīṃ| jaisī svaṇīṃcyā ḍohīṃ | jāgṛtī na buḍe || 54||
verses.meaning: This net (of the world) is indeed within Me, yet I am not contained within it. Just as wakefulness does not drown in the depths of a dream.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी रसाचीच सुघट । बीजकणिका १२८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी घनवट । परी तियेस्तव होय काष्ठ । अंकुरद्वारें ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī rasācīca sughaṭa | bījakaṇikā 128 śrījñāneśvarī ghanavaṭa | parī tiyestava hoya kāṣṭha | aṃkuradvāreṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, the seed, though dense with the essence of the Shri Dnyaneshwari, through its sprout, becomes wood.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तया काष्ठाच्या ठायीं । सांग पां बीजपण असे काई । तैसा मी विकारीं नाहीं । जरी विकारला दिसे ॥५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayā kāṣṭhācyā ṭhāyīṃ | sāṃga pāṃ bījapaṇa ase kāī | taisā mī vikārīṃ nāhīṃ | jarī vikāralā dise ||56||
verses.meaning: Then, tell me, does the seed-nature reside in that wood? Similarly, I am not subject to change, even if I appear to be undergoing transformations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गगनीं उपजे आभाळ । परी तेथ गगन नाहीं केवळ। अथवा आभाळीं होय सलिल। तेथ अभ्र नाहीं ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gaganīṃ upaje ābhāḻa | parī tetha gagana nāhīṃ kevaḻa| athavā ābhāḻīṃ hoya salila| tetha abhra nāhīṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: Just as clouds arise in the sky, yet the sky itself is not merely clouds; or as water forms in the clouds, yet there is no cloud in the water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तया उदकाचेनि आवेशें। प्रगटलें तेज जें लखलखीत दिसे। तिये विजूमाजीं असे। सलिल कायी ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayā udakāceni āveśeṃ| pragaṭaleṃ teja jeṃ lakhalakhīta dise| tiye vijūmājīṃ ase| salila kāyī || 58||
verses.meaning: Then, with the force of that water, a dazzling light appeared. Is there any water within that lightning?

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगें अग्नीस्तव धूम होये । तिये धूमीं काय अग्नि आहे । तैसा विकारु हा मी नोहें। जरी विकारला असें ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgeṃ agnīstava dhūma hoye | tiye dhūmīṃ kāya agni āhe | taisā vikāru hā mī noheṃ| jarī vikāralā aseṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: As smoke arises from fire, but fire is not contained within that smoke, similarly, I am not this modification, even though I appear to be modified.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी उदकीं जाली बाबुळी। ते उदकातें जैसी झांकोळी। कां वायांचि आभाळीं। आकाश लोपे॥६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī udakīṃ jālī bābuḻī| te udakāteṃ jaisī jhāṃkoḻī| kāṃ vāyāṃci ābhāḻīṃ| ākāśa lope||60||
verses.meaning: Just as a bubble formed in water seems to cover the water itself, or as a cloud in the sky seems to hide the sky, so too does the illusion of the world obscure the true nature of reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा स्वप्न लटिकें म्हणों ये। परि निद्रावशें बाणलें होये। तंव आठवु काय देत आहे। आपणपेयां॥ ६१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā svapna laṭikeṃ mhaṇoṃ ye| pari nidrāvaśeṃ bāṇaleṃ hoye| taṃva āṭhavu kāya deta āhe| āpaṇapeyāṃ|| 619||
verses.meaning: Indeed, a dream may be called false, yet it arises due to the state of sleep. So, what remembrance does it offer to oneself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो डोळ्यांचें । डोळांचि पडळ रचे । तेणें देखणेंपण डोळ्यांचें ॥ न गिळिजे कायी ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso ḍoḻyāṃceṃ | ḍoḻāṃci paḍaḻa race | teṇeṃ dekhaṇeṃpaṇa ḍoḻyāṃceṃ || na giḻije kāyī || 62||
verses.meaning: Let this be about the eyes. If the eyes themselves form a cataract, would not the vision of the eyes be swallowed up?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी हे माझीच बिंबली । त्रिगुणात्मक साउली। कीं म्जचि आड वोडवली । जवनिका जैसी ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī he mājhīca biṃbalī | triguṇātmaka sāulī| kīṃ mjaci āḍa voḍavalī | javanikā jaisī || 63||
verses.meaning: Similarly, this three-qualitied shadow is but My own reflection, or perhaps a curtain drawn before Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भूतें मातें नेणती । माझींच परी मी नव्हती। जैसी जळींचीं जळीं न वबिरती। मुक्‍ताफळें॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhūteṃ māteṃ neṇatī | mājhīṃca parī mī navhatī| jaisī jaḻīṃcīṃ jaḻīṃ na vabiratī| muk‍tāphaḻeṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: Therefore, beings do not know Me, even though they are Mine, they are not Me. Just as pearls in water do not merge with the water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं पृथ्वीयेचा घटु कौीजे। सवेंचि पृथ्वीसि मिळे तरी मेळविजे। एऱ्हवीं तोचि अग्निसंगें सिजे। तरी वेगळा होय॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ pṛthvīyecā ghaṭu kauīje| saveṃci pṛthvīsi miḻe tarī meḻavije| eṟhavīṃ toci agnisaṃgeṃ sije| tarī vegaḻā hoya|| 65||
verses.meaning: If a pot made of earth is broken, it merges back into the earth. But if it is baked in fire, it becomes separate and distinct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें भूतजात सर्व। हे माझेचि कौर अवयव । परी मायायोगें जीव-। दशे आले॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ bhūtajāta sarva| he mājheci kaura avayava | parī māyāyogeṃ jīva-| daśe āle|| 66||
verses.meaning: Just as all beings are my very own limbs, yet through the influence of Maya, they have come into the state of individual souls.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि माझेचि मी नव्हती । माझेचि मज नोळखती । अहंममताभ्रांती । विषयांध जाळे॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni mājheci mī navhatī | mājheci maja noḻakhatī | ahaṃmamatābhrāṃtī | viṣayāṃdha jāḻe|| 67||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I was not myself, I did not recognize myself; the delusion of ego and possessiveness had blinded me to worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां महदादि हे माझी माया । उतरोनियां धनंजया । मी होइजे हें आया । कैसेनि ये॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ mahadādi he mājhī māyā | utaroniyāṃ dhanaṃjayā | mī hoije heṃ āyā | kaiseni ye|| 68||
verses.meaning: Now, O Dhananjaya, how can I transcend this Maya, which manifests as the Mahat and other principles, and become Myself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये ब्रह्माचळाचा आधाडा । पहिलिया संकल्पजळाचा उभडा । सवेंचि महाभूतांचा बुडबुडा । साना आल्म ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye brahmācaḻācā ādhāḍā | pahiliyā saṃkalpajaḻācā ubhaḍā | saveṃci mahābhūtāṃcā buḍabuḍā | sānā ālma || 69||
verses.meaning: From the base of that cosmic mountain (Brahma), the first waters of resolve (creation) surged forth. With them, the bubbles of the great elements (Pancha Mahabhutas) appeared, small at first.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे सृष्टिविस्ताराचेनि बोघें। चढत काळकळनेचेनि वेगें। प्रवृत्तिनिवृत्तीचीं तुंगें। तटें सांडी ॥ ७० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: je sṛṣṭivistārāceni bogheṃ| caḍhata kāḻakaḻaneceni vegeṃ| pravṛttinivṛttīcīṃ tuṃgeṃ| taṭeṃ sāṃḍī || 70 ||
verses.meaning: That which, through the understanding of the expansion of creation, swiftly transcends the limitations of time and the towering shores of action and inaction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे गुणघनाचेनि वृष्टिभरें। भरली मोहाचेनि महापुरें। घेऊनि जात नगरें। यमनियमांचीं ॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: je guṇaghanāceni vṛṣṭibhareṃ| bharalī mohāceni mahāpureṃ| gheūni jāta nagareṃ| yamaniyamāṃcīṃ ||71||
verses.meaning: The downpour of worldly qualities, like a great flood of delusion, sweeps away the cities of spiritual disciplines and vows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे द्वेषाच्या आवर्ती दाटत। मत्सराचे वळसे पडत । माजी प्रमादादि तळपत । महामीन ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je dveṣācyā āvartī dāṭata| matsarāce vaḻase paḍata | mājī pramādādi taḻapata | mahāmīna || 72||
verses.meaning: Where the whirlpools of hatred abound, and the eddies of jealousy form, within which the great fish of delusion and other vices gleam.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ प्रपंचाचीं वळणें। कर्माकर्मांचीं बोभाणें। वरी तरताती बोसाणें। सुखदुःखांचीं ॥७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha prapaṃcācīṃ vaḻaṇeṃ| karmākarmāṃcīṃ bobhāṇeṃ| varī taratātī bosāṇeṃ| sukhaduḥkhāṃcīṃ ||73||
verses.meaning: Where the entanglements of worldly life, the clamor of actions and inactions, and above them, the burdens of joy and sorrow, all float.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रतीचिया बेटा। आदळती कामाचिया लाटा। जेथ जीवफेन संघटा। सैंघ दिसे॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ratīciyā beṭā| ādaḻatī kāmāciyā lāṭā| jetha jīvaphena saṃghaṭā| saiṃgha dise|| 74||
verses.meaning: Waves of desire crash upon the son of love, where the foam of life is constantly visible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहंकाराचिया चळिया। वरि मदत्रयाचिया उकळिया। जेथ विषयोर्मीच्या आकळिया। उल्लाळ घेती ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahaṃkārāciyā caḻiyā| vari madatrayāciyā ukaḻiyā| jetha viṣayormīcyā ākaḻiyā| ullāḻa ghetī || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Where the waves of ego's agitation, the boiling of the three intoxications, and the surging of worldly desires rise and fall.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदयास्ताचे लोंढे। पाडीत जन्ममरणाचे चोंढे। जेथ पांचभौतिक बुडबुडे । होती जाती ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: udayāstāce loṃḍhe| pāḍīta janmamaraṇāce coṃḍhe| jetha pāṃcabhautika buḍabuḍe | hotī jātī || 76||
verses.meaning: The cycles of rising and setting, like waves, create the continuous succession of birth and death, where the bubbles of the five elements constantly appear and disappear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संमोह विभ्रम मासे । गिळिताती धैर्याची आविसें। तेथ देव्हडे भोंबत वळसे । अज्ञानाचे ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃmoha vibhrama māse | giḻitātī dhairyācī āviseṃ| tetha devhaḍe bhoṃbata vaḻase | ajñānāce || 77||
verses.meaning: The fish of delusion and confusion swallow the bait of courage. There, the whirlpools of ignorance swirl around.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भ्रांतीचेनि खडुळें । रेवलें आस्थेचे अवगाळें। रजोगुणाचेनि खळाळें । स्वर्ग गाजे॥ ७८॥
