verses.shloka_iast: bhrāṃtīceni khaḍuḻeṃ | revaleṃ āsthece avagāḻeṃ| rajoguṇāceni khaḻāḻeṃ | svarga gāje|| 78||
verses.meaning: The heavens resound with the clamor of Rajas (passion), stirred by the dust of delusion, which has soiled the purity of faith.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तमाचे धारसे वाड। सत्त्वाचें स्थिरपण जाड। किंबहुना हे दुवाड। मायानदी ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tamāce dhārase vāḍa| sattvāceṃ sthirapaṇa jāḍa| kiṃbahunā he duvāḍa| māyānadī || 79||
verses.meaning: The darkness of ignorance grows, the stability of goodness becomes thick, and indeed, this river of illusion is difficult to cross.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं पुनरावृत्तीचेनि उभडें। झळंबती सत्यलोकींचे हुडे। घायें गडबडती धोंडे। ब्रह्मयोळकाचे॥ ८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ punarāvṛttīceni ubhaḍeṃ| jhaḻaṃbatī satyalokīṃce huḍe| ghāyeṃ gaḍabaḍatī dhoṃḍe| brahmayoḻakāce|| 80||
verses.meaning: The intense heat of repeated cycles of creation and dissolution scorches even the highest realms, and the very foundations of Brahma's abode are shaken and crumble.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया पाणियाचेनि वबहिलेपणें। अझुनी न धरिती बोभाणें। ऐसा मायापूर हा कवणें। तरिजेळ गा॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā pāṇiyāceni vabahilepaṇeṃ| ajhunī na dharitī bobhāṇeṃ| aisā māyāpūra hā kavaṇeṃ| tarijeḻa gā||81||
verses.meaning: Even with the constant flow of that water, they still do not hold onto the boat. How then can this flood of Maya be crossed?

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ एक नवलावो। जो जो कीजे तरणोपावो। तो तो अपावो। होय तें ऐक ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha eka navalāvo| jo jo kīje taraṇopāvo| to to apāvo| hoya teṃ aika || 82||
verses.meaning: Here is a wonder: whatever means one adopts for liberation, that very means becomes an obstacle, listen to this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक स्वयंबुध्दीच्या बाहीं । रिगाळे तयांची शुध्दीचि नाहीं ॥ एक जाणिवेचे डोहीं। गर्वेंचे गिळिळे॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka svayaṃbudhdīcyā bāhīṃ | rigāḻe tayāṃcī śudhdīci nāhīṃ || eka jāṇivece ḍohīṃ| garveṃce giḻiḻe|| 83||
verses.meaning: Some, relying on their own intellect, lose their purity. Others, swallowed by pride, drown in the depths of their own knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकीं वेदत्रयाचिया सांगडी । घेतल्या अहंभावाचिया धोंडी । ते मदमीनाच्या तोंडी । सगळेचि गेळे॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekīṃ vedatrayāciyā sāṃgaḍī | ghetalyā ahaṃbhāvāciyā dhoṃḍī | te madamīnācyā toṃḍī | sagaḻeci geḻe|| 84||
verses.meaning: Some, taking the raft of the three Vedas, and with the stone of egoism, all fell into the mouth of the fish of pride.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकीं बयसेचें जाड बांधळे। मग मन्मथाचिये कांसे लागले । ते विषयमगरीं सांडिले। चघळूनियां ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekīṃ bayaseceṃ jāḍa bāṃdhaḻe| maga manmathāciye kāṃse lāgale | te viṣayamagarīṃ sāṃḍile| caghaḻūniyāṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: Some, having become entangled in worldly attachments, then fell into the clutches of lust. They were then devoured by the crocodile of worldly pleasures, chewed up completely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां वार्धक्याच्या तरंगा-। माजीं मतिभ्रंशाचा जरंगा। तेणें कवळिजताती पैं गा। चहूंकडे॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ vārdhakyācyā taraṃgā-| mājīṃ matibhraṃśācā jaraṃgā| teṇeṃ kavaḻijatātī paiṃ gā| cahūṃkaḍe|| 86||
verses.meaning: Now, in the waves of old age, the decay of mental delusion envelops one from all sides.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि शोकाचा कडा उपडत। क्रोधाच्या आवर्ती दाटत। आपदागिधीं चुंबिजत। उधवला ठायीं ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi śokācā kaḍā upaḍata| krodhācyā āvartī dāṭata| āpadāgidhīṃ cuṃbijata| udhavalā ṭhāyīṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: And the cliff of sorrow crumbles, dense with whirlpools of anger, kissed by the flames of calamity, scattered in that very place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग दुःखाचेनि बरबटें बोंबलें। पाठीं मरणाचिये रेवे रेवले। ऐसे कामाचे कांसे लागले। ते गेळे वायां ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga duḥkhāceni barabaṭeṃ boṃbaleṃ| pāṭhīṃ maraṇāciye reve revale| aise kāmāce kāṃse lāgale| te geḻe vāyāṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: Then, smeared with sorrow, they cried out, and later, dragged by death's current, those who were thus bound by the waist of desire, they perished in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकीं यजनक्रियेची पेटी । बांधोनि घातली पोटीं । ते स्वर्गसुखाच्या कपाटीं । शिरकोनि ठेळे॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekīṃ yajanakriyecī peṭī | bāṃdhoni ghātalī poṭīṃ | te svargasukhācyā kapāṭīṃ | śirakoni ṭheḻe|| 89||
verses.meaning: Some, having tied a chest of sacrificial rites and placed it within their belly, remain confined within the doors of heavenly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकीं मोक्षीं लागावयाचिया आशा । केला कर्मबाह्यांचा भरंवसा । परी ते १३० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी पडिले वळसां। विधिनिषेधांच्या ॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekīṃ mokṣīṃ lāgāvayāciyā āśā | kelā karmabāhyāṃcā bharaṃvasā | parī te 130 śrījñāneśvarī paḍile vaḻasāṃ| vidhiniṣedhāṃcyā || 90||
verses.meaning: Some, in the hope of attaining liberation, relied on external rituals and actions. But they, as Dnyaneshwari says, became entangled in the cycle of injunctions and prohibitions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ वैराग्याची नाव न रिगे। विवेकाचा तागा न लगे। वरि कांहीं तरों ये योगें। तरी विपाय तो॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha vairāgyācī nāva na rige| vivekācā tāgā na lage| vari kāṃhīṃ taroṃ ye yogeṃ| tarī vipāya to|| 91||
verses.meaning: Where the boat of dispassion cannot enter, and the rope of discrimination cannot reach, if one tries to cross by some other means, it is indeed a perilous endeavor.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें तरी जीवाचिये आंगवणें। इये मायानदीचें तरणें। हें कासयासारिखें बोलणें । म्हणावें पां॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ tarī jīvāciye āṃgavaṇeṃ| iye māyānadīceṃ taraṇeṃ| heṃ kāsayāsārikheṃ bolaṇeṃ | mhaṇāveṃ pāṃ||92||
verses.meaning: If this is the case, then to cross this river of Maya (illusion) by the strength of the individual soul, what kind of talk can this be called?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी अपथ्यशीळा व्याधी। कळे साधूसी दुर्जनाची बुद्धि। कीं रागी सांडी रिद्धी । आली सांती ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī apathyaśīḻā vyādhī| kaḻe sādhūsī durjanācī buddhi| kīṃ rāgī sāṃḍī riddhī | ālī sāṃtī || 93||
verses.meaning: Just as a doctor understands the disease of a patient who disregards dietary restrictions, or a saint comprehends the intellect of a wicked person, or a furious person rejects the prosperity that has come to him peacefully.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी चोरां सभा दाटे । अथवा मीनां गळु घोटे। ना तरी भेडा उळटे। विवसी जरी॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī corāṃ sabhā dāṭe | athavā mīnāṃ gaḻu ghoṭe| nā tarī bheḍā uḻaṭe| vivasī jarī|| 94||
verses.meaning: Even if a thief gathers a crowd, or a fish swallows a hook, or a sheep is slaughtered, it is all the same.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाडस वागुर करांडी। कां मुंगी मेरु बोलांडी । तरी मायेची पैलथडी । देखती जीव॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāḍasa vāgura karāṃḍī| kāṃ muṃgī meru bolāṃḍī | tarī māyecī pailathaḍī | dekhatī jīva|| 95||
verses.meaning: Just as a fawn can cross a trap, or an ant can surmount Mount Meru, so too can beings perceive the other shore of Maya (illusion) through divine grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौन गा पंडुसुता । जैसी सकामा न जिणवेचि वनिता । तेवीं मायामय हे सरिता । न तरवे जीवां॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauna gā paṃḍusutā | jaisī sakāmā na jiṇaveci vanitā | tevīṃ māyāmaya he saritā | na tarave jīvāṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O son of Pandu, just as a woman cannot be conquered by a lustful man, so too, this river of Maya cannot be crossed by beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ एकचि लीला तरले । जे सर्वभावे मज भजळे। तयां ऐळीच थडि सरळें। मायाजळ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha ekaci līlā tarale | je sarvabhāve maja bhajaḻe| tayāṃ aiḻīca thaḍi saraḻeṃ| māyājaḻa|| 97||
verses.meaning: Here, only one play unfolds: those who worship Me with all their being easily cross the ocean of illusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयां सदगुरुतारूं फुडें। जे अनुभवाचे कांसे गाढे। जयां आत्मनिवेदनतरांडें । आकळलें॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃ sadagurutārūṃ phuḍeṃ| je anubhavāce kāṃse gāḍhe| jayāṃ ātmanivedanatarāṃḍeṃ | ākaḻaleṃ|| 98||
verses.meaning: Those who have the Sadguru's boat ahead, who are firm in the rope of experience, and who have understood the raft of self-surrender.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे अहंभावाचें बोझें सांडुनी। विकल्पाचिया झुळका चुकाउनी। अनुरागाचा निरुता होउनी । पाणिढाळु ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je ahaṃbhāvāceṃ bojheṃ sāṃḍunī| vikalpāciyā jhuḻakā cukāunī| anurāgācā nirutā hounī | pāṇiḍhāḻu || 99||
verses.meaning: Having cast off the burden of ego, having avoided the gusts of doubt, and having become truly devoted, one pours forth the water of love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया ऐक्याचिया उतारा । बोधाचा जोडला तारा। मग निवृत्तीचिया पैल तीरा। झेंपावले जे॥१००॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā aikyāciyā utārā | bodhācā joḍalā tārā| maga nivṛttīciyā paila tīrā| jheṃpāvale je||100||
verses.meaning: They, by the descent of oneness, and with the star of enlightenment joined, then leaped to the other shore of Nivrutti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते उपरतीच्या वांबीं सेळत। सोहंभावाचेनि थावें पेळत। मग निघाळे अनकळित । निवृत्तितटीं ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: te uparatīcyā vāṃbīṃ seḻata| sohaṃbhāvāceni thāveṃ peḻata| maga nighāḻe anakaḻita | nivṛttitaṭīṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: Then, from the roots of detachment, nurtured by the essence of "I am He," the unmanifested emerges on the shore of ultimate cessation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें उपायें मज भजलळे। ते हे माझी माया तरळे। परि ऐसे भक्‍त विपाइले। बहुवस नाहीं॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ upāyeṃ maja bhajalaḻe| te he mājhī māyā taraḻe| pari aise bhak‍ta vipāile| bahuvasa nāhīṃ|| 2||
verses.meaning: By these means, those who worship Me, they indeed cross over My illusion. But such devoted ones are very few.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे बहुतां एकां अव्हांतरु । अहंकाराचा भूतसंचारु। जाहला म्हणौनि विसरु । आत्मबोधाचा॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je bahutāṃ ekāṃ avhāṃtaru | ahaṃkārācā bhūtasaṃcāru| jāhalā mhaṇauni visaru | ātmabodhācā|| 3||
verses.meaning: When many are possessed by the ghost of ego, they forget the knowledge of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वेळीं नियमाचें वस्त्र नाठवे। पुढील अधोगतीची लाज नेणवे। आणि करिताति जें न कराबें। वेदु म्हणे॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: te veḻīṃ niyamāceṃ vastra nāṭhave| puḍhīla adhogatīcī lāja neṇave| āṇi karitāti jeṃ na karābeṃ| vedu mhaṇe|| 4||
verses.meaning: At that time, the garment of discipline is forgotten. The shame of future degradation is not known. And they do what should not be done, says the Veda.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां शरीराचिया गांवा । जयालागीं आले पांडवा । तो कार्यार्थ्‌ आघवा । सांडूनियां ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ śarīrāciyā gāṃvā | jayālāgīṃ āle pāṃḍavā | to kāryārth‌ āghavā | sāṃḍūniyāṃ || 5||
verses.meaning: Behold, O Pandava, having abandoned all the purposes for which one has come to the village of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियग्रामींचे राजबिदीं। अहंममतेचिया जल्पवादीं । विकारांतरांचि मांदी । मेळवूनियां ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyagrāmīṃce rājabidīṃ| ahaṃmamateciyā jalpavādīṃ | vikārāṃtarāṃci māṃdī | meḻavūniyāṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: In the royal highways of the senses, with the clamor of 'I' and 'mine' (ego and possessiveness), and the multitude of other modifications (of the mind), all gathered together.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दुःखशोकांच्या घाई । मारिलियाची सेचि नाहीं। हें सांगावया कारण काई । जे ग्रासिळे माया ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: duḥkhaśokāṃcyā ghāī | māriliyācī seci nāhīṃ| heṃ sāṃgāvayā kāraṇa kāī | je grāsiḻe māyā || 7||
verses.meaning: When one is consumed by illusion, there is no need to explain that they are afflicted by sorrow and grief.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ते मातें चुकले। ऐका चतुर्विध मज भजले। जिहीं आत्महित केलें। वाढतें गा॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni te māteṃ cukale| aikā caturvidha maja bhajale| jihīṃ ātmahita keleṃ| vāḍhateṃ gā||8||
verses.meaning: Therefore, those who have understood Me, listen, they are of four kinds who worship Me. They have achieved their spiritual well-being, which continues to grow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो पहिला आर्तु म्हणिजे। दुसरा जिज्ञासु बोलिजे । तिजा अर्थार्थी जाणिजे । ज्ञानिया चौथा ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to pahilā ārtu mhaṇije| dusarā jijñāsu bolije | tijā arthārthī jāṇije | jñāniyā cauthā || 9||
verses.meaning: The first is called the distressed, the second is known as the seeker of knowledge, the third is understood as the seeker of wealth, and the fourth is the man of wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ आर्तु तो आर्तीचेनि व्याजें। जिज्ञासु तो जाणावयाचिलागीं भजे । तिजेनि तेणें इच्छिजे । अर्थसिऱ्यि ॥ ९१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha ārtu to ārtīceni vyājeṃ| jijñāsu to jāṇāvayācilāgīṃ bhaje | tijeni teṇeṃ icchije | arthasiṟyi || 910||
verses.meaning: There, the distressed worships by virtue of their distress; the seeker of knowledge worships to know; and the third, the seeker of wealth, worships for the attainment of riches.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग चौथियाच्या ठायीं । कांहींचि करणें नाहीं। म्हणौनि भक्‍्तु एकु पाहीं। ज्ञानिया जो॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga cauthiyācyā ṭhāyīṃ | kāṃhīṃci karaṇeṃ nāhīṃ| mhaṇauni bhak‍tu eku pāhīṃ| jñāniyā jo|| 11||
verses.meaning: Then, in the fourth state, there is nothing to be done. Therefore, behold, the devotee who is a knower of truth is one with it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे तया ज्ञानाचेनि प्रकाशें। फिटलें भेदाभेदांचें कडवसें। मग मीचि जाहला समरसें। आणि भक्तुही तेवींचि॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je tayā jñānāceni prakāśeṃ| phiṭaleṃ bhedābhedāṃceṃ kaḍavaseṃ| maga mīci jāhalā samaraseṃ| āṇi bhaktuhī tevīṃci|| 12||
verses.meaning: When, by the light of that knowledge, the bitterness of distinctions and differences is removed, then the devotee becomes one with Me, in perfect harmony, and so does the devotee become one with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि आणिकांचिये दिठी नावेक । जैसा स्फटिकुचि आभासे उदक । तैसा ज्ञानी नव्हे कौतुक । सांगतां तो॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari āṇikāṃciye diṭhī nāveka | jaisā sphaṭikuci ābhāse udaka | taisā jñānī navhe kautuka | sāṃgatāṃ to|| 13||
verses.meaning: Just as a crystal, to another's eye, appears momentarily as water, so is the wise one, a wonder to behold, beyond words to describe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा वारा कां गगनीं विरे। मग वारेपण वेगळें नुरे। तेवी भक्‍त हे पैज न सरे। जरी ऐक्या आला ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā vārā kāṃ gaganīṃ vire| maga vārepaṇa vegaḻeṃ nure| tevī bhak‍ta he paija na sare| jarī aikyā ālā || 14||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind dissolves into the sky, and its separate identity as wind no longer remains, so too, the devotee, even when merged into oneness, does not lose their distinct devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी पबनु हालवूनि पाहिजे । तरी गगनावेगळा देखिजे। एऱ्हवीं गगन तो सहजें। असे जैसें ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī pabanu hālavūni pāhije | tarī gaganāvegaḻā dekhije| eṟhavīṃ gagana to sahajeṃ| ase jaiseṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Even if one wishes to stir the wind, it is perceived as distinct from the sky. Otherwise, the sky naturally remains as it is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें शरीरीं हन कर्मे । तो भक्‍्तु ऐसा गमे। परी अंतरप्रतीतिधर्मे। मीचि जाहला॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śarīrīṃ hana karme | to bhak‍tu aisā game| parī aṃtarapratītidharme| mīci jāhalā|| 16||
verses.meaning: Thus, though he performs actions in the body, he appears to be a devotee; yet, by the inner realization of truth, he has become one with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ज्ञानाचेनि उजिडळेपणें । मी आत्मा ऐसें तो जाणे । म्हणौनि मीही तैसेंचि म्हणें उचंबळला सांता॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jñānāceni ujiḍaḻepaṇeṃ | mī ātmā aiseṃ to jāṇe | mhaṇauni mīhī taiseṃci mhaṇeṃ ucaṃbaḻalā sāṃtā|| 17||
verses.meaning: And by the light of knowledge, he knows that 'I am the Self.' Therefore, I too, being overwhelmed, say the same.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा जीवापैलीकडिलीये खुणे। जो 'पावोनि वावरों जाणे। तो देहाचेनि वेगळेपणें । काय वेगळा होय॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā jīvāpailīkaḍilīye khuṇe| jo 'pāvoni vāvaroṃ jāṇe| to dehāceni vegaḻepaṇeṃ | kāya vegaḻā hoya|| 18||
verses.meaning: Indeed, one who, having attained the sign beyond the individual soul, knows how to act, how can such a one be separate from the body?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आपुलाल्या हिताचेनि लोभें। मज आवडे तोहि भक्‍त झोंबे। परी मीचि करी वाल्भें। ऐसा ज्ञानिया एकु ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āpulālyā hitāceni lobheṃ| maja āvaḍe tohi bhak‍ta jhoṃbe| parī mīci karī vālbheṃ| aisā jñāniyā eku || 19||
verses.meaning: Therefore, out of love for their own well-being, even those devotees who cling to me are dear to me. But the one who truly loves me, that is the wise one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां दुभतयाचिया आशा । जगचि धेनूसि करीतसे फांसा । परि दोरेंबीण कैसा । वत्साचा बळी ॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ dubhatayāciyā āśā | jagaci dhenūsi karītase phāṃsā | pari doreṃbīṇa kaisā | vatsācā baḻī || 120||
verses.meaning: Behold, for the hope of milk, the world sets a snare for the cow. But how can the calf be sacrificed without a rope?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे तनुमनुप्राणें। तें आणिक कांहींचि नेणे । देखे तयातें १३२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी म्हणे। हे माय माझी॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je tanumanuprāṇeṃ| teṃ āṇika kāṃhīṃci neṇe | dekhe tayāteṃ 132 śrījñāneśvarī mhaṇe| he māya mājhī|| 29||
verses.meaning: Because with body, mind, and life, it knows nothing else. It sees that as my mother, says Shri Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें येणें मानें अनन्यगती । म्हणौनि धेनुही तैसीचि प्रीती। यालागीं लक्ष्मीपती। बोलिले साचें ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ yeṇeṃ māneṃ ananyagatī | mhaṇauni dhenuhī taisīci prītī| yālāgīṃ lakṣmīpatī| bolile sāceṃ || 22||
verses.meaning: Therefore, with such devotion and unwavering faith, the Lord of Lakshmi truly spoke, just as a cow loves its calf.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो मग म्हणितलें। जे कां तुज सांगितले। तेही भक्‍त भले। पढियंते आम्हां॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso maga mhaṇitaleṃ| je kāṃ tuja sāṃgitale| tehī bhak‍ta bhale| paḍhiyaṃte āmhāṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Then it was said, those devotees who were told to you, they are also dear to us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि जाणोनियां मातें। जो पाहों विसरले मागोतें। जैसें सागरा येऊनि सरितें। मुरडाबें ठेलें॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari jāṇoniyāṃ māteṃ| jo pāhoṃ visarale māgoteṃ| jaiseṃ sāgarā yeūni sariteṃ| muraḍābeṃ ṭheleṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: But those who, having known Me, forget to look back, are like rivers that, having reached the ocean, cease to turn back.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी अंतःकरणकुहरीं जन्मली । जयाची प्रतीतिगंगा मज मीनली। तो मी हे काय बोली । फार करूं॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī aṃtaḥkaraṇakuharīṃ janmalī | jayācī pratītigaṃgā maja mīnalī| to mī he kāya bolī | phāra karūṃ|| 25||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganga of realization, born in the cave of the heart, merges into me, so too, what more can I say about this 'I'?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं ज्ञानिया जो म्हणिजे। तो चेतन्यच् केवळ माझें। हें न म्हणावें परि काय कौजे। न बोलणें बोलों ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ jñāniyā jo mhaṇije| to cetanyac kevaḻa mājheṃ| heṃ na mhaṇāveṃ pari kāya kauje| na bolaṇeṃ boloṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, what is called a knower of the Self is verily My own pure Consciousness. This should not be said, but what is the use of not speaking? I speak the unspeakable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे तो विषयांची दाट झाडी-। माजीं कामक्रोधांचीं सांकडीं । चुकावूनि आला पाडी । सद्वासनेचिया ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: je to viṣayāṃcī dāṭa jhāḍī-| mājīṃ kāmakrodhāṃcīṃ sāṃkaḍīṃ | cukāvūni ālā pāḍī | sadvāsaneciyā || 27||
verses.meaning: If, having navigated through the dense thicket of worldly desires and the narrow passages of lust and anger, one cultivates good inclinations...

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग साधुसंगें सुभटा । उजू सत्कर्माचिया वाटा । अप्रवृत्तीचा अव्हांटा । डावळूनि ॥ २८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga sādhusaṃgeṃ subhaṭā | ujū satkarmāciyā vāṭā | apravṛttīcā avhāṃṭā | ḍāvaḻūni || 28 ||
verses.meaning: Then, O brave one, through the company of saints, one directly takes the path of good deeds, having cleared away the crooked ways of unrighteousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जन्मशतांचा बाहतवणा । तेवींचि आशेचिया न लेचि वाहणा। तेथ फलहेतूचा उगाणा) कवणु चाळी ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi janmaśatāṃcā bāhatavaṇā | tevīṃci āśeciyā na leci vāhaṇā| tetha phalahetūcā ugāṇā) kavaṇu cāḻī || 29||
verses.meaning: And just as a hundred births are not enough to bear the burden of desire, and there is no vehicle to carry the burden of hope, who then would drive the cart of fruit-seeking?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा शरीरसंयोगाचिये राती-। माजीं धांवतां सडिया आयती । तंव कर्मक्षयाची पाहाती। पाहांट जाली॥ १३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā śarīrasaṃyogāciye rātī-| mājīṃ dhāṃvatāṃ saḍiyā āyatī | taṃva karmakṣayācī pāhātī| pāhāṃṭa jālī|| 130||
verses.meaning: As one runs swiftly through the night of bodily union, the dawn of karma's exhaustion breaks.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीच गुरुकृपाउखा उजळली । ज्ञानाची बोतपली पडली। तेथ साम्याची क्रुन्द्वि उघडली । 'तयाचिये दिठी॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīca gurukṛpāukhā ujaḻalī | jñānācī botapalī paḍalī| tetha sāmyācī krundvi ughaḍalī | 'tayāciye diṭhī|| 31||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when the light of the Guru's grace shone forth, the lamp of knowledge was lit. Then, the path of equanimity was revealed to his sight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वेळीं जयाकडे वास पाहे। तेउता मीचि तया एकु आहे। अथवा निवांत जरी राहे। तरी मीचि तया॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te veḻīṃ jayākaḍe vāsa pāhe| teutā mīci tayā eku āhe| athavā nivāṃta jarī rāhe| tarī mīci tayā|| 32||
verses.meaning: At that time, towards whomever one looks, I alone am there for them. Or if one remains still and quiet, then too, I am there for them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो आणिक कांहीं॥ तया सर्वत्र मीवांचूनि नाहीं। जैसें सबाह्य जळ डोहीं। बुडालिया घटा॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso āṇika kāṃhīṃ|| tayā sarvatra mīvāṃcūni nāhīṃ| jaiseṃ sabāhya jaḻa ḍohīṃ| buḍāliyā ghaṭā|| 33||
verses.meaning: Let this be. There is nothing for them anywhere except Me. Just as a pot submerged in a pond is entirely filled with water, inside and out.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा तो मजभीतरीं। मी तया आंतुबाहेरी । हें सांगिजे बोलवरी । तेसें नव्हे ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā to majabhītarīṃ| mī tayā āṃtubāherī | heṃ sāṃgije bolavarī | teseṃ navhe || 34||
verses.meaning: Just as I am within him, he is within and without me. This cannot be expressed in words; it is not like that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि असो हें इयापरी । तो देखे ज्ञानाची वाखारी । तेणें संसरळेनि करी। आपु विश्‍व॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aso heṃ iyāparī | to dekhe jñānācī vākhārī | teṇeṃ saṃsaraḻeni karī| āpu viś‍va|| 35||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let this be. In this way, he sees the treasure of knowledge. With that, he embraces the entire universe as his own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें समस्तही श्रीवासुदेवो। ऐसा प्रतीतिरसाचा बोतळा भावो । म्हणौनि भक्तांमाजीं रावो। आणि ज्ञानिया तोचि ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ samastahī śrīvāsudevo| aisā pratītirasācā botaḻā bhāvo | mhaṇauni bhaktāṃmājīṃ rāvo| āṇi jñāniyā toci || 36||
verses.meaning: All this is indeed Shri Vasudeva. Such is the profound sentiment of realization. Therefore, among devotees, he is the king, and he alone is the true knower.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचिये प्रतीतीचा वाखारां। पवाडु होय चराचरा। तो महात्मा धनुर्धरा। दुर्लभु आथी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāciye pratītīcā vākhārāṃ| pavāḍu hoya carācarā| to mahātmā dhanurdharā| durlabhu āthī || 37||
verses.meaning: The great soul, Arjuna, whose realization spreads throughout the animate and inanimate world, is indeed rare.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर बहुत जोडती किरीटी। जयांचीं भजनें भोगासाठीं । जे आशातिमिरें दृष्टी । विषयांध जाळे॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera bahuta joḍatī kirīṭī| jayāṃcīṃ bhajaneṃ bhogāsāṭhīṃ | je āśātimireṃ dṛṣṭī | viṣayāṃdha jāḻe|| 38||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), many people worship for the sake of worldly pleasures. Their eyes are blinded by the darkness of desire, making them blind to true spiritual insight, as they are engrossed in material pursuits.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि फळाचिया हांवा। हृदयीं कामा जाला रिगावा। कीं तयाचिये घसणी दिवा । ज्ञानाचा गेला॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi phaḻāciyā hāṃvā| hṛdayīṃ kāmā jālā rigāvā| kīṃ tayāciye ghasaṇī divā | jñānācā gelā|| 39||
verses.meaning: And due to the desire for fruits (of action), lust entered the heart, and in its friction, the lamp of knowledge was extinguished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे उभयतां आंधारीं पडले। म्हणौनि 'पासींचि मातें चुकले। मग सर्वभावें अनुसरळे। देवतांतरां ॥ ९४० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise ubhayatāṃ āṃdhārīṃ paḍale| mhaṇauni 'pāsīṃci māteṃ cukale| maga sarvabhāveṃ anusaraḻe| devatāṃtarāṃ || 940 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, both (the seeker and the deity) are enveloped in darkness. Therefore, they miss Me, who am very near. Then, with their whole being, they surrender to other deities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधींच प्रकृतीचे पाइक । वरी भोगालागीं तंब रंक। मग तेणें लोलुपत्बें कौतुक । कैसेनि भजती ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhīṃca prakṛtīce pāika | varī bhogālāgīṃ taṃba raṃka| maga teṇeṃ lolupatbeṃ kautuka | kaiseni bhajatī || 49||
verses.meaning: They are already servants of nature, and on top of that, they are poor for the sake of enjoyment. How then, with such greed, can they worship?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कवणी तिया नियमबुद्धि। केसिया हन उपचारसमृन्दि। कां अर्पण यथाविधि। विहित करणें ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kavaṇī tiyā niyamabuddhi| kesiyā hana upacārasamṛndi| kāṃ arpaṇa yathāvidhi| vihita karaṇeṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: What is that disciplined intellect? How is the abundance of offerings? Or how is the offering to be made according to the prescribed method?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जो जिये देवतांतरीं । भजावयाची चाड करी । तयाची ते चाड पुरी । पुरविता मी॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jo jiye devatāṃtarīṃ | bhajāvayācī cāḍa karī | tayācī te cāḍa purī | puravitā mī|| 43||
verses.meaning: Indeed, whoever desires to worship any deity, I fulfill their desire completely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवोदेवीं मीचि पाहीं । हाही निश्चय त्यासि नाहीं । भावो ते ते ठायीं। वेगळा धरिती ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: devodevīṃ mīci pāhīṃ | hāhī niścaya tyāsi nāhīṃ | bhāvo te te ṭhāyīṃ| vegaḻā dharitī || 44||
verses.meaning: They do not even have the conviction that "I am indeed God in all gods." Instead, they hold different beliefs in each place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स तया श्रद्धया युक्‍्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते । लभते च तत: कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान्‌ । २२॥ मग तिया श्रब्धायुक्‍त । तेथिंचें आराधन जें उचित । तें सिऱ्धीवरी समस्त । वर्तो लागे॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: sa tayā śraddhayā yuk‍tastasyārādhanamīhate | labhate ca tata: kāmānmayaiva vihitānhi tān‌ | 22|| maga tiyā śrabdhāyuk‍ta | tethiṃceṃ ārādhana jeṃ ucita | teṃ siṟdhīvarī samasta | varto lāge|| 45 ||
verses.meaning: Then, imbued with that faith, all the appropriate worship for that deity begins to manifest perfectly. And through Me alone, all their desires are fulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जेणें जें भाविजे। तें फळ तेणें पाविजे। परी तेंही सकळ निपजे। मजचिस्तव॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jeṇeṃ jeṃ bhāvije| teṃ phaḻa teṇeṃ pāvije| parī teṃhī sakaḻa nipaje| majacistava|| 46||
verses.meaning: Whatever one contemplates, that fruit one attains; but all that too comes into being only through Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी ते भक्‍त मातें नेणती । जे कल्पनेबाहेरी न निघती । म्हणौनि कल्पित 'फळ पावती। अंतवंत॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī te bhak‍ta māteṃ neṇatī | je kalpanebāherī na nighatī | mhaṇauni kalpita 'phaḻa pāvatī| aṃtavaṃta|| 47||
verses.meaning: But those devotees do not truly know Me, for they do not transcend their own imaginations. Therefore, they attain only the imagined fruits, which are perishable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना ऐसें जें भजन। तें संसाराचेंचि साधन। येर फळभोग तो स्वप्न। नावभरी दिसे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā aiseṃ jeṃ bhajana| teṃ saṃsārāceṃci sādhana| yera phaḻabhoga to svapna| nāvabharī dise|| 48||
verses.meaning: Indeed, such devotion is itself the means to worldly existence. The enjoyment of its fruits is but a dream, visible for a fleeting moment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो परोतें । मग हो कां आवडे तें। परी यजी जो देवतांतें। तो देवत्वासीचि ये ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso paroteṃ | maga ho kāṃ āvaḍe teṃ| parī yajī jo devatāṃteṃ| to devatvāsīci ye || 49||
verses.meaning: Let this be set aside for now. Then, whatever one desires, let it be. But whoever worships the deities, attains divinity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: १३४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी येर तनुमनुप्राणीं। जे अनुसरले माझेयाचि वाहणीं। ते देहाच्या निर्वाणीं। मीचि होती॥ १५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: 134 śrījñāneśvarī yera tanumanuprāṇīṃ| je anusarale mājheyāci vāhaṇīṃ| te dehācyā nirvāṇīṃ| mīci hotī|| 150||
verses.meaning: Those who, with body, mind, and life-breath, have aligned themselves with My path, they become one with Me at the dissolution of their body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तैसें न करिती प्राणिये। वायां आपुलिया हितीं वाणिये। जे 'पोहताती पाणिये। तळहातींचेनि॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī taiseṃ na karitī prāṇiye| vāyāṃ āpuliyā hitīṃ vāṇiye| je 'pohatātī pāṇiye| taḻahātīṃceni|| 51||
verses.meaning: But living beings do not act in that way. They waste their own well-being, as if trying to swim in water with the palms of their hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना अमृताच्या सागरीं बुडिजे। मग तोंडा कां वज्रमिठी पाडिजे। आणि मनीं तरी आठविजे। थिल्लरोदकातें ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā amṛtācyā sāgarīṃ buḍije| maga toṃḍā kāṃ vajramiṭhī pāḍije| āṇi manīṃ tarī āṭhavije| thillarodakāteṃ || 52||
verses.meaning: If one is immersed in an ocean of nectar, why would one then seal their mouth shut and in their mind, remember a puddle of water?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें ऐसें कासया करावें। जें अमृतींही रिगोनि मरावें। तें सुखें अमृत होऊनि कां नसावें। अमृतामाजीं ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aiseṃ kāsayā karāveṃ| jeṃ amṛtīṃhī rigoni marāveṃ| teṃ sukheṃ amṛta hoūni kāṃ nasāveṃ| amṛtāmājīṃ || 53||
verses.meaning: Why should one do such a thing, that even after entering immortality, one should die? Why not simply become immortal and remain in that state of immortality?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा फळहेतूचा पांजरा। सांडूनियां धनुर्धरा। कां प्रतीतिपाखीं चिदंबरा। गोसाविया नोहावें॥५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā phaḻahetūcā pāṃjarā| sāṃḍūniyāṃ dhanurdharā| kāṃ pratītipākhīṃ cidaṃbarā| gosāviyā nohāveṃ||54||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Arjuna, abandoning the cage of desire for fruit, why should one not become the master of the Chidambara (the inner sky of consciousness) through the wings of realization?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ उंचाबलेनि पवाडें। सुखाचा पैसारू जोडे। आपुलेनि सुरवाडें। उडों ये ऐसा ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha uṃcābaleni pavāḍeṃ| sukhācā paisārū joḍe| āpuleni suravāḍeṃ| uḍoṃ ye aisā || 55||
verses.meaning: Where, with an elevated expanse, the abundance of happiness is attained, one can soar with one's own comfort and ease.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया उमपा माप कां सुवावें। मज अव्यकता व्यक्‍त कां मानावें । सिद्ध असतां कां निमावें। साधनवरी॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā umapā māpa kāṃ suvāveṃ| maja avyakatā vyak‍ta kāṃ mānāveṃ | siddha asatāṃ kāṃ nimāveṃ| sādhanavarī|| 56||
verses.meaning: Why should I be measured or compared? Why should I, the unmanifest, be considered manifest? When already perfect, why should I strive for means (to attain perfection)?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हा बोळ आघवा । जरी विचारीजतसे पांडवा । तरी विशेषें या जीवां। न चोजवे गा॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī hā boḻa āghavā | jarī vicārījatase pāṃḍavā | tarī viśeṣeṃ yā jīvāṃ| na cojave gā|| 57||
verses.meaning: But even if this entire discussion is pondered upon, O Pandava, it is especially difficult for these individual souls to comprehend.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे योगमायापडळें । हे जाळे आहाति आंधळे । म्हणौनि प्रकाशाचेनि देहबळें।॥ न देखती मातें ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je yogamāyāpaḍaḻeṃ | he jāḻe āhāti āṃdhaḻe | mhaṇauni prakāśāceni dehabaḻeṃ||| na dekhatī māteṃ || 58||
verses.meaning: Because they are blinded by the veil of Yogamaya, they do not see Me, even with the strength of the light of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं मी नसें ऐसें। काय वस्तुजात असे । पाहें पां कवण जळ रसें-। रहित आहे॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ mī naseṃ aiseṃ| kāya vastujāta ase | pāheṃ pāṃ kavaṇa jaḻa raseṃ-| rahita āhe|| 59||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, if I were not, what would exist? Tell me, what water is devoid of its essence?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पवनु कवणातें न शिवेचि। आकाश कें न समायेचि। हें असो एकु मीचि। विश्‍वबीं आहें॥ १६० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pavanu kavaṇāteṃ na śiveci| ākāśa keṃ na samāyeci| heṃ aso eku mīci| viś‍vabīṃ āheṃ|| 160 ||
verses.meaning: The wind does not touch what it cannot; the sky does not contain what it cannot. Let this be. I alone am the seed of the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथें भूतें जियें अतीतलीं। तियें मीचि होऊनि ठेलीं। आणि वर्तत आहाति जेतुलीं। तींही मीचि॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetheṃ bhūteṃ jiyeṃ atītalīṃ| tiyeṃ mīci hoūni ṭhelīṃ| āṇi vartata āhāti jetulīṃ| tīṃhī mīci||61||
verses.meaning: All beings that have passed away have become Me, and all those that exist now are also Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां भविष्यमाणें जियें हीं। तींही मजवेगळीं नाहीं । हा बोलचि एऱ्हवीं कांहीं । होय ना जाय ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bhaviṣyamāṇeṃ jiyeṃ hīṃ| tīṃhī majavegaḻīṃ nāhīṃ | hā bolaci eṟhavīṃ kāṃhīṃ | hoya nā jāya || 62||
verses.meaning: For even these future events are not separate from Me. This statement itself is neither created nor destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दोराचिया सापासी। डोंबा बडिया ना गव्हाळा ऐसी । संख्या न करवे कोण्हासी । तेवीं भूतांसि मिथ्यत्वें॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: dorāciyā sāpāsī| ḍoṃbā baḍiyā nā gavhāḻā aisī | saṃkhyā na karave koṇhāsī | tevīṃ bhūtāṃsi mithyatveṃ|| 63||
verses.meaning: Just as no one can count the snakes, whether big or small, that are merely an illusion in a rope, similarly, the existence of beings is also illusory.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी ऐसा पंडुसुता । अनुस्यूतु सदा असतां। या संसार जो भूतां। तो आनें बोलळें॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī aisā paṃḍusutā | anusyūtu sadā asatāṃ| yā saṃsāra jo bhūtāṃ| to āneṃ bolaḻeṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, I am always present and pervading in this manner. Yet, the worldly existence that beings experience is spoken of as separate from Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तेचि आतां थोडीसी । गोठी सांगिजेल परियेसीं। जें अहंकारा तनूंसीं । बालभ पडिलें॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī teci ātāṃ thoḍīsī | goṭhī sāṃgijela pariyesīṃ| jeṃ ahaṃkārā tanūṃsīṃ | bālabha paḍileṃ|| 65||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I will now briefly explain to you how the ego became attached to the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ इच्छा हे कुमारी जाळी । मग ते कामाचिया तारुण्या आली । तेथ ह्वेषेंसीं मांडिली । बऱ्हाडिक ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha icchā he kumārī jāḻī | maga te kāmāciyā tāruṇyā ālī | tetha hveṣeṃsīṃ māṃḍilī | baṟhāḍika || 66||
verses.meaning: There, desire, like a young maiden, is born. Then, reaching the prime of youth, it is wedded to hatred.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया दोघांस्तब जन्मला । ऐसा दवंद्वमोह जाला। मग तो आजेयानें वाढविला। अहंकारें॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā doghāṃstaba janmalā | aisā davaṃdvamoha jālā| maga to ājeyāneṃ vāḍhavilā| ahaṃkāreṃ|| 67||
verses.meaning: From these two, a delusion of duality was born, which was then nurtured by the ego.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो धृतीसी सदा प्रतिकूळु। नियमाही नागवे सळु। आशारसें दोंदिलु। जाला सांता ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo dhṛtīsī sadā pratikūḻu| niyamāhī nāgave saḻu| āśāraseṃ doṃdilu| jālā sāṃtā || 68||
verses.meaning: He who is always contrary to steadfastness, who is not bound by any rules, and who has become bloated with the desire for worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: असंतुष्टीचिया मदिरा । मत्त होऊनि धनुर्धरा । विषयांचे बोवरां। विकृतीशीं असे॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: asaṃtuṣṭīciyā madirā | matta hoūni dhanurdharā | viṣayāṃce bovarāṃ| vikṛtīśīṃ ase|| 69||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, intoxicated by the wine of discontent, one becomes entangled in the whirlpool of worldly pleasures, leading to perversion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें भावशुद्धधधीचिया वाटे । विखुरले विकल्पाचे कांटे। मग चिरिळे आव्हांटे । अप्रवृत्तीचे ॥ ९७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ bhāvaśuddhadhadhīciyā vāṭe | vikhurale vikalpāce kāṃṭe| maga ciriḻe āvhāṃṭe | apravṛttīce || 970||
verses.meaning: By that pure devotion, the thorns of doubt scattered from the path, and then the byways of non-action were cleared.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें भूतें भांबावलीं। म्हणौनि संसाराचिया आडवामाजीं पडिली । मग महादुःखाच्या घेतलीं । दांडे वरी ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ bhūteṃ bhāṃbāvalīṃ| mhaṇauni saṃsārāciyā āḍavāmājīṃ paḍilī | maga mahāduḥkhācyā ghetalīṃ | dāṃḍe varī || 79||
verses.meaning: Due to this, beings became bewildered and fell into the wilderness of worldly existence. Then, they were severely beaten by great suffering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे विकल्पाचे वांयाणे। कांटे देखोनि सणाणे। जे मतिशभ्रमाचें 'पासवणें । घेतीचिना ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise vikalpāce vāṃyāṇe| kāṃṭe dekhoni saṇāṇe| je matiśabhramāceṃ 'pāsavaṇeṃ | ghetīcinā || 72||
verses.meaning: Seeing the thorns of such delusive thoughts, the wise do not accept the offerings of mental confusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उजू एकनिष्ठेच्या पाउलीं । रगडूनि विकल्पाचिया भालीं । महापातकांची सांडिली। अटवी जिहीं ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ujū ekaniṣṭhecyā pāulīṃ | ragaḍūni vikalpāciyā bhālīṃ | mahāpātakāṃcī sāṃḍilī| aṭavī jihīṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: They, who with steps of unwavering devotion, crushed the forehead of doubt and cleared the dense forest of great sins.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पुण्याचे धांवा घेतळे। आणि माझी जवळीक पातले। किंबहुना चुकले। वाटवधेयां ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga puṇyāce dhāṃvā ghetaḻe| āṇi mājhī javaḻīka pātale| kiṃbahunā cukale| vāṭavadheyāṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Then, they pursued righteousness and came close to Me; indeed, they no longer needed any guides.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी पार्था । जन्ममरणाची निमे कथा । ऐसिया प्रयत्नातें आस्था । विये जयांची ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī pārthā | janmamaraṇācī nime kathā | aisiyā prayatnāteṃ āsthā | viye jayāṃcī || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, O Partha, the story of birth and death is but half-told for those whose efforts bear fruit in such endeavors.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां तो प्रयत्नुचि एके वेळे । मग समग्र परब्रहों फळे । जया पिकलेया रसु गळे। पूर्णतेचा ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ to prayatnuci eke veḻe | maga samagra parabrahoṃ phaḻe | jayā pikaleyā rasu gaḻe| pūrṇatecā || 76||
verses.meaning: For them, that very effort, in a single moment, yields the fruit of the complete Supreme Brahman, from which, when ripened, the essence of perfection flows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवेळीं कृतकृत्यता जग भरे। तेथ अध्यात्माचे नबळपण पुरे। कर्माचें काम सरे। विरमे मन ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teveḻīṃ kṛtakṛtyatā jaga bhare| tetha adhyātmāce nabaḻapaṇa pure| karmāceṃ kāma sare| virame mana || 77||
verses.meaning: At that time, the whole world is filled with a sense of fulfillment. The spiritual weakness then ceases completely. The work of karma ends, and the mind finds rest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अध्यात्मलाभु तया। होय गा धनंजया । भांडबळ जया । उद्यमीं मी ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā adhyātmalābhu tayā| hoya gā dhanaṃjayā | bhāṃḍabaḻa jayā | udyamīṃ mī || 78||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, such a spiritual gain comes to him whose capital for the endeavor is Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: १३६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तयातें साम्याचिये वाढी। ऐक्याची सांदे कुळवाडी । तेथ भेदाचिया दुबळवाडी । नेणिजे तया ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: 136 śrījñāneśvarī tayāteṃ sāmyāciye vāḍhī| aikyācī sāṃde kuḻavāḍī | tetha bhedāciyā dubaḻavāḍī | neṇije tayā || 79||
verses.meaning: In that state, the growth of equality and the family of oneness are perfected. There, the poverty of duality is not known.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं साधिभूता मातें । प्रतीतीचेनि हातें । धरूनि अधिदैवातें । शिवतलें गा ॥१८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ sādhibhūtā māteṃ | pratītīceni hāteṃ | dharūni adhidaivāteṃ | śivataleṃ gā ||180||
verses.meaning: Those who, with the hand of experience, have grasped Me, the primordial element, and touched the divine principle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया जाणिवेचेनि वेगें) मी अधियजु ही दृष्टी रिगें। ते तनूचेनि वियोगें । विऱ्हये नव्हती ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā jāṇiveceni vegeṃ) mī adhiyaju hī dṛṣṭī rigeṃ| te tanūceni viyogeṃ | viṟhaye navhatī || 81||
verses.meaning: That knowledge, by whose swiftness I enter into the vision of being the enjoyer of the sacrifice, does not perish with the separation of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं आयुष्याचे सूत्र विघडतां । भूतांची उमटे खडाडता । काय न मरतयाचियाहि चित्ता । युगांतु नोहे ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ āyuṣyāce sūtra vighaḍatāṃ | bhūtāṃcī umaṭe khaḍāḍatā | kāya na maratayāciyāhi cittā | yugāṃtu nohe || 82||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, when the thread of life is broken, the beings experience a great upheaval. Is it not the end of an age even for the minds of those who do not die?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी नेणों कैसे पैं गा। जे जडोनि गेले माझिया आंगा। ते प्रयाणींचिया 'लगबगा। न सांडितीच मातें॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī neṇoṃ kaise paiṃ gā| je jaḍoni gele mājhiyā āṃgā| te prayāṇīṃciyā 'lagabagā| na sāṃḍitīca māteṃ|| 83||
verses.meaning: But I do not know how it is that those who have become attached to Me do not abandon Me even in the haste of their departure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी जाण। ऐसे जे निपुण । तेचि अंतःकरण-। युक्‍त योगी ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī jāṇa| aise je nipuṇa | teci aṃtaḥkaraṇa-| yuk‍ta yogī || 84||
verses.meaning: Indeed, those who are thus skilled, they are the yogis endowed with a discerning inner self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब इये शब्दकुपिकेतळीं। नोडवेचि अवधानाची अंजुळी। जे नावेक अर्जुन तये वेळीं। मागांचि होता॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba iye śabdakupiketaḻīṃ| noḍaveci avadhānācī aṃjuḻī| je nāveka arjuna taye veḻīṃ| māgāṃci hotā|| 85 ||
verses.meaning: In this well of words, the attention's cupped hands cannot reach, for at that time, Arjuna was still behind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ तद्‌ब्नह्मवाक्यफळें। जिये नानार्थरसें रसाळें। बहकताती परिमळें। भावाचेनि॥८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha tad‌bnahmavākyaphaḻeṃ| jiye nānārtharaseṃ rasāḻeṃ| bahakatātī parimaḻeṃ| bhāvāceni||86||
verses.meaning: Where the fruits of the Brahman-knowledge-statement, juicy with various meanings and flavors, exude fragrance through devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सहजकृपामंदानिळें। कृष्णद्रुमाची वचनफळें। अर्जुनश्नरवणाचिये खोळें। अवचित पडिलीं ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sahajakṛpāmaṃdāniḻeṃ| kṛṣṇadrumācī vacanaphaḻeṃ| arjunaśnaravaṇāciye khoḻeṃ| avacita paḍilīṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: By the gentle breeze of spontaneous grace, the fruit-like words from the Krishna-tree, unexpectedly fell into the lap of Arjuna's ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियें प्रमेयाची हो कां वळलीं। कीं ब्रह्मरसाच्या सागरीं चुबुकळिली । मग तैसींचि कां घोळिली । परमानंदें ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyeṃ prameyācī ho kāṃ vaḻalīṃ| kīṃ brahmarasācyā sāgarīṃ cubukaḻilī | maga taisīṃci kāṃ ghoḻilī | paramānaṃdeṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: Or perhaps they were immersed in the ocean of Brahman's essence, and then, in that very state, they were enveloped by supreme bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें बरवेपणें निर्मळें। अर्जुना उन्मेषाचे डोहळे । घेताति गळाळे । विस्मयामृताचे ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ baravepaṇeṃ nirmaḻeṃ| arjunā unmeṣāce ḍohaḻe | ghetāti gaḻāḻe | vismayāmṛtāce || 89||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, by that pure beauty, the cravings for the blossoming of spiritual insight are fulfilled, as if by draughts of the nectar of wonder.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिया सुखसंपत्ती जोडलिया। मग स्वर्गा वाती बांकुलिया । हृदयाच्या जीवीं गुतकुलिया । होत आहाती॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyā sukhasaṃpattī joḍaliyā| maga svargā vātī bāṃkuliyā | hṛdayācyā jīvīṃ gutakuliyā | hota āhātī|| 190||
verses.meaning: When such happiness and wealth are attained, then the mind becomes entangled in the heavenly pleasures, like a creeper entwining itself around a tree.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें वरचिळीचि बरवा। सुख जावों लागलें फावा। तंव रसस्वादाचिया हांबा। लाहो केला॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ varaciḻīci baravā| sukha jāvoṃ lāgaleṃ phāvā| taṃva rasasvādāciyā hāṃbā| lāho kelā|| 91||
verses.meaning: As this superficial beauty began to spread joy, the taste of its essence was fully realized.

verses.shloka_devanagari: झडकरी अनुमानाचेनि करतळें। घेऊनि तिथें वाक्‍्यफळें । प्रतीतिमुखीं एके वेळे। घाळूं पाहे॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jhaḍakarī anumānāceni karataḻeṃ| gheūni titheṃ vāk‍yaphaḻeṃ | pratītimukhīṃ eke veḻe| ghāḻūṃ pāhe|| 92||
verses.meaning: Quickly, with the palm of estimation, taking the fruit of the words, he tries to place it in the mouth of experience at once.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव विचाराचिया रसना न दाटती। परी हेतूच्या दशनीं न फुटती । ऐसें जाणौनि सुभद्रापती। चुंबिचिना ॥ ९३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva vicārāciyā rasanā na dāṭatī| parī hetūcyā daśanīṃ na phuṭatī | aiseṃ jāṇauni subhadrāpatī| cuṃbicinā || 93 ||
verses.meaning: Knowing that such words cannot be uttered by the tongue of thought, nor can they be broken by the teeth of intention, Arjuna did not kiss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग चमत्कारला म्हणे । इयें जळींचीं मा तारांगणे । कैसा झकविलो असलगपणें। अक्षरांचेनि॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga camatkāralā mhaṇe | iyeṃ jaḻīṃcīṃ mā tārāṃgaṇe | kaisā jhakavilo asalagapaṇeṃ| akṣarāṃceni|| 94||
verses.meaning: Then, as if in wonder, he said, "How have I, with these words, illuminated the stars in this water, as if they were real?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें पदें नव्हती फुडिया। गगनाचिया घडिया। येथ आमुची मति बुडालिया। थावो न निघे॥ ९५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ padeṃ navhatī phuḍiyā| gaganāciyā ghaḍiyā| yetha āmucī mati buḍāliyā| thāvo na nighe|| 95 ||
verses.meaning: These words are not meant to be broken down. Even the vastness of the sky cannot contain them. Here, our intellect drowns, unable to find its depth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि जाणावयाची कें गोठी । ऐसें जीवीं कल्पूनि किरीटी। तिया पुनरपि केली दृष्टी । यादवेंद्रा ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni jāṇāvayācī keṃ goṭhī | aiseṃ jīvīṃ kalpūni kirīṭī| tiyā punarapi kelī dṛṣṭī | yādaveṃdrā || 96||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), considering in his heart that there was no other way to make him understand, the Lord of the Yadavas (Krishna) looked at him again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग विनविलें सुभटें। हां हो जी ये एकवाटे। सातही पदें अनुच्छिष्टें। नवले आहाती॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vinavileṃ subhaṭeṃ| hāṃ ho jī ye ekavāṭe| sātahī padeṃ anucchiṣṭeṃ| navale āhātī|| 97||
verses.meaning: Then the brave warrior (Arjuna) pleaded, "Indeed, these seven steps are untouched and new."

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं अवधानाचेनि वबहिलेपणें । नाना प्रमेयांचे उगाणे। काय श्रवणाचेनि आंगवणें। बोलों 'लाहाती॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ avadhānāceni vabahilepaṇeṃ | nānā prameyāṃce ugāṇe| kāya śravaṇāceni āṃgavaṇeṃ| boloṃ 'lāhātī|| 98||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, how can the various profound truths, which are beyond the grasp of ordinary attention, be spoken of and understood through the mere act of hearing?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तेसें हें नोहेचि देवा । देखिला अक्षरांचा मेळावा । आणि विस्मयाचिया जीवा । विस्मयो जाला ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teseṃ heṃ noheci devā | dekhilā akṣarāṃcā meḻāvā | āṇi vismayāciyā jīvā | vismayo jālā || 99||
verses.meaning: But it is not so, O Lord. When I saw this gathering of letters, my very soul was filled with wonder.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कानाचेनि गवाक्षद्वारें। बोलाचे रश्मी अभ्यंतरें। पाहेना तंव चमत्कारें। अवधान ठकलें॥ २००॥
verses.shloka_iast: kānāceni gavākṣadvāreṃ| bolāce raśmī abhyaṃtareṃ| pāhenā taṃva camatkāreṃ| avadhāna ṭhakaleṃ|| 200||
verses.meaning: Through the window of the ears, the rays of speech enter within. Before one can even perceive them, the attention is captivated by their wonder.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि अर्थाची चाड मज आहे। तें सांगतांही वेळु न साहे। म्हणौनि निरूपण 'लबलाहें । कौजो देवा॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci arthācī cāḍa maja āhe| teṃ sāṃgatāṃhī veḻu na sāhe| mhaṇauni nirūpaṇa 'labalāheṃ | kaujo devā|| 1||
verses.meaning: I have the same eagerness for the meaning, but there is no time to explain it. Therefore, O Lord, please explain it quickly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा मागील पडताळा घेउनी । पुढां अभिप्राय दृष्टी सूनी । तेवींचि माजीं शिरउनि। आर्ती आपुली ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā māgīla paḍatāḻā gheunī | puḍhāṃ abhiprāya dṛṣṭī sūnī | tevīṃci mājīṃ śirauni| ārtī āpulī || 2||
verses.meaning: Thus, taking into account past experiences, and looking ahead with understanding, one should then, with devotion, immerse oneself in me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसी पुसती पाहें पां जाणिव । भिडेचि तरी लंघों नेदी शिंब। एऱ्हवीं श्रीकृष्ण हृदयासि खेंव । देवों सरला॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaisī pusatī pāheṃ pāṃ jāṇiva | bhiḍeci tarī laṃghoṃ nedī śiṃba| eṟhavīṃ śrīkṛṣṇa hṛdayāsi kheṃva | devoṃ saralā|| 3||
verses.meaning: See how she asks, yet her modesty does not allow her to cross the threshold. Otherwise, she would have rushed to embrace Shri Krishna in her heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो श्रीगुरूतें जें पुसावें। तैं येणें मानें सावध होआवें । हें एकचि जाणे आघवें। सव्यसाची ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho śrīgurūteṃ jeṃ pusāveṃ| taiṃ yeṇeṃ māneṃ sāvadha hoāveṃ | heṃ ekaci jāṇe āghaveṃ| savyasācī || 4||
verses.meaning: Oh, what is to be asked of the Guru? One should become alert in this manner. Arjuna alone knows all of this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तयाचें तें प्रश्‍न करणें । वरी सर्वज्ञ श्रीहरीचे बोलणें। संजयो आवडलेपणें। सांगैल कैसें॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ tayāceṃ teṃ praś‍na karaṇeṃ | varī sarvajña śrīharīce bolaṇeṃ| saṃjayo āvaḍalepaṇeṃ| sāṃgaila kaiseṃ||5||
verses.meaning: Now, how will Sanjaya narrate the questioning by Dhritarashtra and the discourse of the omniscient Lord Shri Hari, with such fondness?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये अवधान द्यावें गोठी । बोलिजेल नीट मऱ्हाटी । जैसी कानाचे आधीं दिष्ठी। उपेगा जाये ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye avadhāna dyāveṃ goṭhī | bolijela nīṭa maṟhāṭī | jaisī kānāce ādhīṃ diṣṭhī| upegā jāye || 6||
verses.meaning: Please give your attention to these words, which will be spoken in clear Marathi, just as sight is useful even before hearing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुद्धीचिया जिभा । बोलाचा न चाखतां गाभा । अक्षरांचिया भांबा । इंद्रियें जिती ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: buddhīciyā jibhā | bolācā na cākhatāṃ gābhā | akṣarāṃciyā bhāṃbā | iṃdriyeṃ jitī || 7||
verses.meaning: The senses, without tasting the essence of speech through the tongue of intellect, merely grasp at the outer form of letters.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पहा पां मालतीचे कळे । घ्राणासि कौर वाटले परिमळें।॥ परि बवरचिला बरवा काइ डोळे । सुखिये नव्हती॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pahā pāṃ mālatīce kaḻe | ghrāṇāsi kaura vāṭale parimaḻeṃ||| pari bavaracilā baravā kāi ḍoḻe | sukhiye navhatī||8||
verses.meaning: Behold, the buds of the Malati flower, though their fragrance delights the sense of smell, do not bring joy to the eyes of a bee, for it is only attracted to the beauty it sees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें देशियेचिया हवावा । इंद्रियें करिती राणिवा । मग प्रमेयाचिया गांवा । लेसां जाइजे ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ deśiyeciyā havāvā | iṃdriyeṃ karitī rāṇivā | maga prameyāciyā gāṃvā | lesāṃ jāije || 9||
verses.meaning: Just as the senses, by their very nature, rule over the body, so too do they effortlessly lead one to the realm of objects of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि नागरपणें । बोलु निमे तें बोलणें । ऐका ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे । निवृत्तीचा॥ २१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni nāgarapaṇeṃ | bolu nime teṃ bolaṇeṃ | aikā jñānadevo mhaṇe | nivṛttīcā|| 210||
verses.meaning: With such skillful articulation, the discourse culminates in that very speech, says Dnyandev, the disciple of Nivrutti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अर्जुनें म्हणितळें। हां हो जी अवधारिलें। जें म्यां पुसिलें। तें निरूपिजो॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga arjuneṃ mhaṇitaḻeṃ| hāṃ ho jī avadhārileṃ| jeṃ myāṃ pusileṃ| teṃ nirūpijo|| 1||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said, "Yes, I have heard. Please explain what I have asked."

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगा कवण तें ब्रह्म। कायसया नाम कर्म। अथवा अध्यात्म। काय म्हणिपे॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgā kavaṇa teṃ brahma| kāyasayā nāma karma| athavā adhyātma| kāya mhaṇipe|| 2||
verses.meaning: Tell me, what is that Brahman? What is called Karma? Or what is known as Adhyatma?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अधिभूत तें कैसें । एथ अधिदैव तें कवण असे। हें उघड मी परियेसें। ऐसें बोळा ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: adhibhūta teṃ kaiseṃ | etha adhidaiva teṃ kavaṇa ase| heṃ ughaḍa mī pariyeseṃ| aiseṃ boḻā || 3||
verses.meaning: How is Adhibhuta (the material manifestation)? And who is Adhidaiva (the presiding deity) here? Please explain this clearly to me, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा अधियज्ञ तो काई। कवण पां इये देहीं। हें अनुमानासि कांहीं । दिठी न भरे॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā adhiyajña to kāī| kavaṇa pāṃ iye dehīṃ| heṃ anumānāsi kāṃhīṃ | diṭhī na bhare|| 4||
verses.meaning: O Lord, what is this 'Adhiyajna'? Who is it that dwells in this body? This cannot be grasped by mere conjecture; it cannot be seen with the eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि नियता अंतःकरणीं। तूं जाणिजसी देहप्रयाणीं । तें कैसेनि हें शार्ईुुपाणी । परिसवा मातें ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi niyatā aṃtaḥkaraṇīṃ| tūṃ jāṇijasī dehaprayāṇīṃ | teṃ kaiseni heṃ śārīuupāṇī | parisavā māteṃ || 5||
verses.meaning: And how is it that You are known by the disciplined mind at the time of departing the body, O Sharngapani? Please tell me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखा धवळारीं चिंतामणीचां । जरी पहुडला होय दैवाचा । तरी बोसणतांही बोलु तयाचा । परी सोपु न वचे ॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhā dhavaḻārīṃ ciṃtāmaṇīcāṃ | jarī pahuḍalā hoya daivācā | tarī bosaṇatāṃhī bolu tayācā | parī sopu na vace ||6||
verses.meaning: Behold, if a fortunate person were to recline in a palace made of Chintamani (the wish-fulfilling gem), even if he were to speak idly, his words would still be profound, and his ease would never diminish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें अर्जुनाचिया बोलासबें। आलें तेंचि म्हणितलें देवें। तें परियेसें गा बरवें। जें पुसिलें तुवां ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ arjunāciyā bolāsabeṃ| āleṃ teṃci mhaṇitaleṃ deveṃ| teṃ pariyeseṃ gā baraveṃ| jeṃ pusileṃ tuvāṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: Just as Arjuna's words prompted the Lord's discourse, so too will I now explain clearly what you have asked.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किरीटी कामधेनुचा पाडा । बरी 'कल्पतरूचा आहे मांदोडा। म्हणौनि मनोरथसिल्धीचिया चाडा। तो नवल नोहे ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kirīṭī kāmadhenucā pāḍā | barī 'kalpatarūcā āhe māṃdoḍā| mhaṇauni manorathasildhīciyā cāḍā| to navala nohe || 8||
verses.meaning: The wish-fulfilling cow Kamadhenu's calf, or rather, the wish-fulfilling tree Kalpataru's offspring, is not a wonder for those who desire the fulfillment of their wishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कृष्ण कोपोनि ज्यासी मारी। तो पावे परब्रह्मसाक्षात्कारीं। मा कृपेनें उपदेशु करी। तो कैशापरी न पवेल॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṛṣṇa koponi jyāsī mārī| to pāve parabrahmasākṣātkārīṃ| mā kṛpeneṃ upadeśu karī| to kaiśāparī na pavela|| 9||
verses.meaning: If Krishna, in anger, slays someone, that person attains the realization of the Supreme Brahman. Then how can one not attain it if He lovingly imparts spiritual instruction?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैं कृष्णचि होइजे आपण । तैं कृष्ण होय आपुलें अंतःकरण। मग संकल्पाचें आंगण। वबोळंगती सिन्द्धी॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiṃ kṛṣṇaci hoije āpaṇa | taiṃ kṛṣṇa hoya āpuleṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇa| maga saṃkalpāceṃ āṃgaṇa| vaboḻaṃgatī sinddhī|| 10||
verses.meaning: When one becomes Krishna, then Krishna becomes one's inner being. Then the courtyard of one's resolves becomes filled with accomplishments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि ऐसें जें प्रेम। तें अर्जुनींचि आधि निस्सीम। म्हणौनि तयाचे काम। सदां सफळ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari aiseṃ jeṃ prema| teṃ arjunīṃci ādhi nissīma| mhaṇauni tayāce kāma| sadāṃ saphaḻa|| 11||
verses.meaning: Such love, however, is first and foremost in Arjuna, and therefore his endeavors are always fruitful.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें श्रीअनंतें। तें मनोगत तयाचें पुसते । होईल जाणौनि आहते । बोगरूनि ठेविलें॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ śrīanaṃteṃ| teṃ manogata tayāceṃ pusate | hoīla jāṇauni āhate | bogarūni ṭhevileṃ|| 12||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the Infinite Lord, knowing his inner desire, had already prepared and kept it ready.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें अपत्य थानींहुनि निगे। तयाची भूक ते मायेसीचि लागे। एऱ्हवीं तें शब्दें काय सांगे । मग स्तन्य दे येरी॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ apatya thānīṃhuni nige| tayācī bhūka te māyesīci lāge| eṟhavīṃ teṃ śabdeṃ kāya sāṃge | maga stanya de yerī|| 13||
verses.meaning: When a child is born from the womb, its hunger is felt by the mother herself. Otherwise, what can it express through words? Then, the mother offers her breast milk.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कृपाळुवा गुरूचिया ठायीं। हें नवल नोहे कांहीं ।॥ परि तें असो आइका काई । जें देव बोलते जाहळे॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kṛpāḻuvā gurūciyā ṭhāyīṃ| heṃ navala nohe kāṃhīṃ ||| pari teṃ aso āikā kāī | jeṃ deva bolate jāhaḻe|| 14||
verses.meaning: Therefore, this is not at all surprising for the compassionate Guru. But let that be; listen to what the Lord Himself said.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणितलें सर्वेश्‍वरें। जें आकारीं इयें खोंकरें। कोंदलें असत न खिरे। कवणें काळीं॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇitaleṃ sarveś‍vareṃ| jeṃ ākārīṃ iyeṃ khoṃkareṃ| koṃdaleṃ asata na khire| kavaṇeṃ kāḻīṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: Then the Lord of all said: "This body, which is hollow, is not permanent. When will it ever last?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं सपूरपण तयाचें पहावें। तरी शून्यचि नव्हे स्वभावें । वरि गगनाचेनि पालवे । गाळूनि घेतलें॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ sapūrapaṇa tayāceṃ pahāveṃ| tarī śūnyaci navhe svabhāveṃ | vari gaganāceni pālave | gāḻūni ghetaleṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, if one were to observe its fullness, it is naturally not empty. Moreover, it is as if it has been filtered through the expanse of the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें ऐसेंही परि वबिरुळें। इये बिज्ञानाचिये खोळे। हालळवलेंहि न गळे। तें परब्रह्म ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ aiseṃhī pari vabiruḻeṃ| iye bijñānāciye khoḻe| hālaḻavaleṃhi na gaḻe| teṃ parabrahma || 97||
verses.meaning: Even if such a thing, like a seed, is shaken in the cradle of this knowledge, it does not fall away; that is the Parabrahma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आकाराचेनि जालेपणें । जन्मधर्मातें नेणे । आकारलोपीं निमणें । नाहीं कहीं॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ākārāceni jālepaṇeṃ | janmadharmāteṃ neṇe | ākāralopīṃ nimaṇeṃ | nāhīṃ kahīṃ|| 18||
verses.meaning: And by the very existence of form, it does not know the law of birth; nor is there any cessation in the dissolution of form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशिया आपुलियाची सहजस्थिती। जया ब्रह्माची नित्यता असती । तया नाम सुभद्रापती। अध्यात्म गा॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśiyā āpuliyācī sahajasthitī| jayā brahmācī nityatā asatī | tayā nāma subhadrāpatī| adhyātma gā|| 19||
verses.meaning: Such is the natural state of one who constantly abides in Brahman. That is called the husband of Subhadra, the spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग गगनीं जेविं निर्मळें। नेणों कैंची एके वेळे। उठती घनपटळें। नानावर्णे ॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga gaganīṃ jeviṃ nirmaḻeṃ| neṇoṃ kaiṃcī eke veḻe| uṭhatī ghanapaṭaḻeṃ| nānāvarṇe || 20||
verses.meaning: Just as in the clear sky, one knows not from where, at some time, clouds of various colors arise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें अपूर्ती तिये विशुद्धें। महदादि भूतभेदें। ब्रह्मांडाचे बांधे । होंचि लागती ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ apūrtī tiye viśuddheṃ| mahadādi bhūtabhedeṃ| brahmāṃḍāce bāṃdhe | hoṃci lāgatī || 29||
verses.meaning: In the same way, from that pure, unmanifested state, the distinctions of Mahat and other elements begin to form the structure of the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं निर्विकल्पाचिये बरडीं । फुटे आदिसंकल्पाची विरूढी । आणि ते सवेंचि मोडोनि ये ढोंढी । ब्रह्मगोळकांच्या ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ nirvikalpāciye baraḍīṃ | phuṭe ādisaṃkalpācī virūḍhī | āṇi te saveṃci moḍoni ye ḍhoṃḍhī | brahmagoḻakāṃcyā || 22||
verses.meaning: From the barren land of the attributeless, sprouts the shoot of the primordial resolve. And with that, the hollow spheres of Brahma's cosmic eggs are formed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया एकैकाचे भीतरीं पाहिजे । तंब बीजाचाचि भरिला देखिजे। माजीं होतिया जातिया नेणिजे। लेख जीवां॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā ekaikāce bhītarīṃ pāhije | taṃba bījācāci bharilā dekhije| mājīṃ hotiyā jātiyā neṇije| lekha jīvāṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: Within each individual, one should perceive the seed itself, filled with its essence. The coming and going of beings is not truly known, nor is their count.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तया ब्रह्मगोळकांचे अंशांश। प्रसवती आदिसंकल्प असमसहास। हें असो ऐसी बहुवस। सृष्टी वाढे॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayā brahmagoḻakāṃce aṃśāṃśa| prasavatī ādisaṃkalpa asamasahāsa| heṃ aso aisī bahuvasa| sṛṣṭī vāḍhe|| 24||
verses.meaning: Then, from the parts and sub-parts of that cosmic egg (Brahma's sphere), countless primordial intentions (sankalpas) are born. But let that be; in this way, creation expands greatly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि दुजेनविण एकला । परब्रह्मींचि संचला। अनेकत्वाचा आला । पूर जैसा॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari dujenaviṇa ekalā | parabrahmīṃci saṃcalā| anekatvācā ālā | pūra jaisā|| 25||
verses.meaning: But the One, without a second, is established in the Supreme Brahman, like a flood of multiplicity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें समविषमत्व नेणों कैंचें । वायांचि चराचर रचे । पाहतां प्रसवतिया योनीचे । लक्ष दिसती॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ samaviṣamatva neṇoṃ kaiṃceṃ | vāyāṃci carācara race | pāhatāṃ prasavatiyā yonīce | lakṣa disatī|| 26||
verses.meaning: How can there be inequality or equality? The animate and inanimate creation is formed in vain. When observed, millions of wombs are seen giving birth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरी जीवभावाचिये पालविये। कांहीं मर्यादा करूं नये। पाहिजे कवण हें आधवें विये। तंव मूळ तें शून्य ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yerī jīvabhāvāciye pālaviye| kāṃhīṃ maryādā karūṃ naye| pāhije kavaṇa heṃ ādhaveṃ viye| taṃva mūḻa teṃ śūnya || 27||
verses.meaning: One should not impose any limits on the sprout of individual existence. When one seeks to know what this entire creation gives birth to, the root itself is found to be nothingness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कर्ता मुदल न दिसे। आणि सेखीं कारणही कांहीं नसे। माजीं कार्यचि आपैसें। वाढों लागे॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kartā mudala na dise| āṇi sekhīṃ kāraṇahī kāṃhīṃ nase| mājīṃ kāryaci āpaiseṃ| vāḍhoṃ lāge|| 28||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the doer is not initially visible, and ultimately there is no cause either. In between, the effect itself spontaneously begins to manifest and grow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा करितेनविण गोचरु। अव्यक्तीं हा आकारू । निपजे जो व्यापारु। तया नाम कर्म॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā karitenaviṇa gocaru| avyaktīṃ hā ākārū | nipaje jo vyāpāru| tayā nāma karma|| 29||
verses.meaning: That which, without any perceivable action, manifests as form from the unmanifest, and the activity that arises from it, is called Karma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: १४० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आतां अधिभूत जें म्हणिपे। तेंहि सांगों संक्षेपें। तरी होय आणि हारपे। अभ्र जैसें॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: 140 śrījñāneśvarī ātāṃ adhibhūta jeṃ mhaṇipe| teṃhi sāṃgoṃ saṃkṣepeṃ| tarī hoya āṇi hārape| abhra jaiseṃ|| 30||
verses.meaning: Now, I will briefly explain what is called 'Adhibhuta'. It is like a cloud, which appears and then vanishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें असतेपण आहाच । नाहीं होइजे हें साच। जयातें रूपा आणिती पांचपांच। मिळोनियां॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ asatepaṇa āhāca | nāhīṃ hoije heṃ sāca| jayāteṃ rūpā āṇitī pāṃcapāṃca| miḻoniyāṃ|| 31||
verses.meaning: Similarly, this existence is not truly real; it is merely brought into form by the combination of the five elements.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भूतांतें अधिकरूनि असे । आणि भूतसंयोगें तरी दिसे। जें वियोगावेळे भ्रंशे। नामरूपादिक ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhūtāṃteṃ adhikarūni ase | āṇi bhūtasaṃyogeṃ tarī dise| jeṃ viyogāveḻe bhraṃśe| nāmarūpādika || 32||
verses.meaning: It exists by pervading all beings, and it appears through the combination of elements. But at the time of separation, its name and form are destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयातें अधिभूत म्हणिजे। मग अधिदैव पुरुष जाणिजे। जेणें प्रकृतीचे भोगिजे । उपार्जिलें॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāteṃ adhibhūta mhaṇije| maga adhidaiva puruṣa jāṇije| jeṇeṃ prakṛtīce bhogije | upārjileṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: That is called Adhibhuta (the material manifestation). Then know the Purusha (the cosmic being) as Adhidaiva, by whom the experiences of Prakriti (primordial nature) are enjoyed, which were accumulated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो चेतनेचा चक्षु । जो इंद्रियदेशींचा अध्यशक्षु। जो देहास्तमानीं वृक्षु) संकल्प विहंगमाचा॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo cetanecā cakṣu | jo iṃdriyadeśīṃcā adhyaśakṣu| jo dehāstamānīṃ vṛkṣu) saṃkalpa vihaṃgamācā|| 34||
verses.meaning: He is the eye of consciousness, the overseer of the senses, the tree at the body's end, where the bird of resolve rests.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो परमात्माचि परी दुसरा । जो अहंकारनिद्रा निदसुरा । म्हणौनि स्वप्नीचिया बोरबारा । संतोषे शिणे ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo paramātmāci parī dusarā | jo ahaṃkāranidrā nidasurā | mhaṇauni svapnīciyā borabārā | saṃtoṣe śiṇe || 35 ||
verses.meaning: He who is like the Supreme Self, yet is asleep in the slumber of ego, is therefore pleased and wearied by the trivialities of a dream.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जीव येणें नांवें। जयाते आळविजे स्वभावें। तें अधिदैवत जाणावें । पंचायतनींचें ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jīva yeṇeṃ nāṃveṃ| jayāte āḻavije svabhāveṃ| teṃ adhidaivata jāṇāveṃ | paṃcāyatanīṃceṃ || 36 ||
verses.meaning: That which is naturally invoked by the name 'Jiva' (individual soul) is to be known as the presiding deity of the five elements (Panchayatana).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां इयेचि शरीरग्रामी ।॥ जो शरीरभावातें उपशमी। तो अधियज्ञु एथ गा मी। पंडुकुमरा॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ iyeci śarīragrāmī ||| jo śarīrabhāvāteṃ upaśamī| to adhiyajñu etha gā mī| paṃḍukumarā|| 37||
verses.meaning: Now, in this very body, he who pacifies the sense of identification with the body, know that I am that Adhiyajna, O son of Pandu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर अधिदैवाधिभूत। तेहि मीचि कौर समस्त। परि पंधरें किडाळा मिळत । तें काय सांकें नोहे ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera adhidaivādhibhūta| tehi mīci kaura samasta| pari paṃdhareṃ kiḍāḻā miḻata | teṃ kāya sāṃkeṃ nohe || 38||
verses.meaning: The other, the presiding deity and the presiding element, are also entirely Me. But when a pure substance mixes with an impure one, does it not become impure?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि तें पंधरेपण न मैळे। आणि किडाळाचियाही अंशा न मिळे । परि जंव असे तयाचेनि मेळें। तंव सांकेंचि म्हणिजे ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari teṃ paṃdharepaṇa na maiḻe| āṇi kiḍāḻāciyāhī aṃśā na miḻe | pari jaṃva ase tayāceni meḻeṃ| taṃva sāṃkeṃci mhaṇije || 39||
verses.meaning: Thus, its purity is not tainted, nor does it mix with the impurity of the dross. But as long as it remains in association with it, it is called an alloy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें अधिभूतादि आघवें। हें अविद्येचेनि पालवे । झांकलें तंव मानावें । वेगळें ऐसें ॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ adhibhūtādi āghaveṃ| heṃ avidyeceni pālave | jhāṃkaleṃ taṃva mānāveṃ | vegaḻeṃ aiseṃ || 40||
verses.meaning: Similarly, all that is related to the material world, when covered by the sprout of ignorance, should be considered as separate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेचि अविद्येची जवबनिका फिटे। आणि भेदभावाची अवधी तुटे । मग म्हणों एक होऊनि जरी आटे। तरी काय दोनी होती॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teci avidyecī javabanikā phiṭe| āṇi bhedabhāvācī avadhī tuṭe | maga mhaṇoṃ eka hoūni jarī āṭe| tarī kāya donī hotī|| 49||
verses.meaning: When the curtain of ignorance is lifted, and all distinctions of duality are broken, then even if one says that the two become one and merge, how can they ever be two?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं केशांचा गुंडाळा । वरि ठेविली स्फटिकशिळा। ते वरि पाहिजे डोळां। तंव भेदली गमती ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ keśāṃcā guṃḍāḻā | vari ṭhevilī sphaṭikaśiḻā| te vari pāhije ḍoḻāṃ| taṃva bhedalī gamatī || 42||
verses.meaning: Just as a crystal placed on a coiled lock of hair appears to pierce through it when viewed from above, so too does the illusion of the world seem to penetrate the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं केश परौते नेळे। आणि भेदलेपण काय नेणों जाहालें। तरि डांक देऊनि सांदिलें। शिळेतें कार्ड ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ keśa paraute neḻe| āṇi bhedalepaṇa kāya neṇoṃ jāhāleṃ| tari ḍāṃka deūni sāṃdileṃ| śiḻeteṃ kārḍa || 43||
verses.meaning: The hair on the back of the head does not go far, and I do not know what kind of separation has occurred, but it is like a crack in a stone that has been mended with a patch.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना ते अखंडचि आयती । परि संगें भिन्न गमली होती । ते सारिलिया मागौती। जैसी कां तैसी ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā te akhaṃḍaci āyatī | pari saṃgeṃ bhinna gamalī hotī | te sāriliyā māgautī| jaisī kāṃ taisī || 44||
verses.meaning: It was always undivided, but due to association, it appeared to be different. When that association is removed, it becomes as it was before.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि अहंभावो जाये । तरी ऐक्य तें आधींचि आहे। हेंचि साचें जेथ होये। तो अधियज्ञु मी ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci ahaṃbhāvo jāye | tarī aikya teṃ ādhīṃci āhe| heṃci sāceṃ jetha hoye| to adhiyajñu mī || 45||
verses.meaning: When the ego is thus dissolved, then the oneness that already exists becomes evident. Where this truth is realized, there I am the Adhiyajna (the Supreme Sacrifice, the indwelling Lord).

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा आम्हीं तुज। सकळ यज्ञ कर्मज। सांगितलें कां जें काज। मनीं धरूनि॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā āmhīṃ tuja| sakaḻa yajña karmaja| sāṃgitaleṃ kāṃ jeṃ kāja| manīṃ dharūni|| 46||
verses.meaning: Indeed, I have explained to you all the actions born of sacrifice, keeping in mind the purpose behind them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो हा सकळ जीवांचा विसांवा । नैष्कर्म्यसुखाचा ठेवा । परि उघड करूनि पांडवा । दाविजत असे॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to hā sakaḻa jīvāṃcā visāṃvā | naiṣkarmyasukhācā ṭhevā | pari ughaḍa karūni pāṃḍavā | dāvijata ase|| 47||
verses.meaning: This is the resting place for all beings, the treasure of the joy of actionlessness. But, O Pandava, it is revealed openly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पहिल्या वैराग्यइंधन परिपूर्ती । इंद्रियानळीं प्रदीप्तीं । विषयद्रव्याचिया आहुती । देऊनियां ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pahilyā vairāgyaiṃdhana paripūrtī | iṃdriyānaḻīṃ pradīptīṃ | viṣayadravyāciyā āhutī | deūniyāṃ || 48 ||
verses.meaning: First, with the complete fuel of dispassion, one ignites the fire of the senses, offering oblations of worldly objects into it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वज्रासन तेचि उर्वबी। शोधूनि आधारमुद्रा बरवी । वेदिका रचे मांडवीं। शरीराच्या ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vajrāsana teci urvabī| śodhūni ādhāramudrā baravī | vedikā race māṃḍavīṃ| śarīrācyā || 49||
verses.meaning: Then, having firmly established the Vajrasana, and carefully formed the Adharamudra, one constructs a sacred altar within the pavilion of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ संयमाग्नीचीं कुंडे । इंद्रियद्रव्याचेनि पवाडें । यजिजती उदंडें। युक्तिघोषें ॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha saṃyamāgnīcīṃ kuṃḍe | iṃdriyadravyāceni pavāḍeṃ | yajijatī udaṃḍeṃ| yuktighoṣeṃ || 50||
verses.meaning: There, the sacrificial fires of self-control are kindled with abundant offerings of the senses, accompanied by the resounding chants of wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग मनप्राणसंयमु। हाचि हवनसंपदेचा संभ्रमु। येणें संतोषविजे निर्धूमु। ज्ञानानळु ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga manaprāṇasaṃyamu| hāci havanasaṃpadecā saṃbhramu| yeṇeṃ saṃtoṣavije nirdhūmu| jñānānaḻu || 51||
verses.meaning: Then, the control of the mind and vital breath is indeed the abundant offering for the sacrificial fire. With this, the smokeless fire of knowledge is pleased.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि हें सकळ ज्ञानीं समर्पे । मग ज्ञान तें ज्ञेयीं हारपे। पाठीं ज्ञेयचि स्वरूपें। निखिल उरे॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni heṃ sakaḻa jñānīṃ samarpe | maga jñāna teṃ jñeyīṃ hārape| pāṭhīṃ jñeyaci svarūpeṃ| nikhila ure|| 52||
verses.meaning: In this way, all knowledge is surrendered to the Knower. Then, that knowledge merges into the Knowable. Thereafter, only the Knowable remains in its true form, all-encompassing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया नांव गा अधियजु । ऐसें बोलला जंव सर्वज्ञु। तंव अर्जुन अतिप्राजु। तया पातलें तें ॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā nāṃva gā adhiyaju | aiseṃ bolalā jaṃva sarvajñu| taṃva arjuna atiprāju| tayā pātaleṃ teṃ ||53||
verses.meaning: As soon as the Omniscient One spoke of Him as Adhiyajna, Arjuna, who was very intelligent, understood it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जाणोनि म्हणितलें देवें। पार्था परिसतु आहासि बरवें। या 'कृष्णाचिया बोलासवें। येरु सुखाचा जाहाला॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jāṇoni mhaṇitaleṃ deveṃ| pārthā parisatu āhāsi baraveṃ| yā 'kṛṣṇāciyā bolāsaveṃ| yeru sukhācā jāhālā|| 54||
verses.meaning: Knowing this, the Lord said, "Partha, you are listening well." With these words of Krishna, the other (Arjuna) became filled with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखा बाळकाचिया धणि धाइजे। कां शिष्याचेनि जाहलेपणें होईजे । हें सदगुरूचि एकलेनि जाणिजे । कां प्रसवतिया॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhā bāḻakāciyā dhaṇi dhāije| kāṃ śiṣyāceni jāhalepaṇeṃ hoīje | heṃ sadagurūci ekaleni jāṇije | kāṃ prasavatiyā|| 55||
verses.meaning: Behold, just as a mother finds contentment in her child's satisfaction, or a guru rejoices in the disciple's attainment, so too does the Sadguru alone know this joy, like a mother giving birth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सात्त्विक भावांची मांदी । कृष्णाआंगीं अर्जुनाआधीं। न समातसे परी बुद्धी। सांबरूनि देवें ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sāttvika bhāvāṃcī māṃdī | kṛṣṇāāṃgīṃ arjunāādhīṃ| na samātase parī buddhī| sāṃbarūni deveṃ || 56||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the multitude of pure, sattvic emotions, though overflowing from Krishna's being even before Arjuna, were contained by the Lord through His intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पिकलिया सुखाचा परिमळु। कां निवालिया अमृताचा कल़ोळु। तैसा 'कोंबळा आणि सरळु। बोलु बोलिला ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga pikaliyā sukhācā parimaḻu| kāṃ nivāliyā amṛtācā kala़oḻu| taisā 'koṃbaḻā āṇi saraḻu| bolu bolilā || 57||
verses.meaning: Then, like the fragrance of ripened joy, or the cool wave of nectar, such a tender and straightforward speech was uttered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे परिसणेयांचिया राया । आइकें बापा धनंजया। ऐसी जळों सरलळिया माया । तेथ जाळितें तेंही जळे ॥५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe parisaṇeyāṃciyā rāyā | āikeṃ bāpā dhanaṃjayā| aisī jaḻoṃ saralaḻiyā māyā | tetha jāḻiteṃ teṃhī jaḻe ||58||
verses.meaning: Says the King of Listeners, "Hear, my child Dhananjaya, when such a Maya (illusion) burns completely, then that which burns also burns away."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें आतांचि सांगितलें होतें अगा अधियज्ञ म्हणितला जयातें। जे आदींचि तया मातें । जाणोनि अंतीं ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ ātāṃci sāṃgitaleṃ hoteṃ agā adhiyajña mhaṇitalā jayāteṃ| je ādīṃci tayā māteṃ | jāṇoni aṃtīṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: That which was just explained, O Adhiyajna, knowing Me from the very beginning, at the end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते देह झोल ऐसें मानुनी । ठेले आपणपें आपण होउनी । जैसा मठ गगना भरुनी । गगनींचि असे॥६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: te deha jhola aiseṃ mānunī | ṭhele āpaṇapeṃ āpaṇa hounī | jaisā maṭha gaganā bharunī | gaganīṃci ase||60||
verses.meaning: Considering the body to be merely a covering, they remain established in their true Self, just as the space within a pot, though filling the pot, remains essentially one with the vast sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ये प्रतीतीचिया माजघरीं। तया निश्चयाची बोबरी । आली म्हणौनि बाहेरी । नव्हेचि से॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ye pratītīciyā mājagharīṃ| tayā niścayācī bobarī | ālī mhaṇauni bāherī | navheci se|| 61||
verses.meaning: In the inner sanctum of this realization, the certainty of that truth has become so profound that it cannot be expressed externally.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें सबाह्य ऐक्य संचलें। मीचि होऊनि असतां रचिलें। बाहेरि भूतांची पांचही खवलें। नेणतांचि पडिलीं ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ sabāhya aikya saṃcaleṃ| mīci hoūni asatāṃ racileṃ| bāheri bhūtāṃcī pāṃcahī khavaleṃ| neṇatāṃci paḍilīṃ || 62||
verses.meaning: Thus, this external and internal unity was established. While I Myself existed, it was created. Unknowingly, the five elements of beings fell into place externally.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आता उभेयां उभेपण नाहीं जयाचें। मा पडिलिया गहन कवण तयाचें। म्हणोनि प्रतीतीचिये पोटींचें। पाणी न हाळे॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātā ubheyāṃ ubhepaṇa nāhīṃ jayāceṃ| mā paḍiliyā gahana kavaṇa tayāceṃ| mhaṇoni pratītīciye poṭīṃceṃ| pāṇī na hāḻe|| 63||
verses.meaning: Now, that which has no standing, how can it fall into a deep abyss? Therefore, the water within the womb of experience never dries up.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते ऐक्याची आहे वोतिली । कीं नित्यतेचिया हृदयीं घातली । जैसी समरससमुद्रीं धुतली । रुळेचिना ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: te aikyācī āhe votilī | kīṃ nityateciyā hṛdayīṃ ghātalī | jaisī samarasasamudrīṃ dhutalī | ruḻecinā || 64||
verses.meaning: It is cast in the mold of unity, or placed within the heart of eternity. Washed in the ocean of oneness, it remains unblemished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं अथावीं घट बुडाला । तो आंतबाहेरी उदकें भरला। पाठीं दैवगत्या जरी फुटला। तरी उदक काय फुटे ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ athāvīṃ ghaṭa buḍālā | to āṃtabāherī udakeṃ bharalā| pāṭhīṃ daivagatyā jarī phuṭalā| tarī udaka kāya phuṭe || 65||
verses.meaning: Consider a pot submerged in water, filled both inside and out. If by chance it breaks, does the water itself break?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी सर्पे कवच सांडिलें। कां उबारेनें वस्त्र फेडिलें। तरी सांग पां काय मोडलें। अवेवामाजीं ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī sarpe kavaca sāṃḍileṃ| kāṃ ubāreneṃ vastra pheḍileṃ| tarī sāṃga pāṃ kāya moḍaleṃ| avevāmājīṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: Or if a snake sheds its skin, or if a person removes their clothes due to heat, tell me, what part of the body is lost?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा आकारु हा आहाच श्रंशे। वांचूनि वस्तु ते सांचलीचि असे। तेचि बुद्धि १४२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जालिया विसकुसे। कैसेनि आतां ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā ākāru hā āhāca śraṃśe| vāṃcūni vastu te sāṃcalīci ase| teci buddhi 142 śrījñāneśvarī jāliyā visakuse| kaiseni ātāṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Just as this form is transient and illusory, the true essence remains constant. When this understanding dawns, how can one remain entangled?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि यापरी मातें । अंतकाळीं जाणतसाते। जे मोकलिती देहातें। ते मीचि होती॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yāparī māteṃ | aṃtakāḻīṃ jāṇatasāte| je mokalitī dehāteṃ| te mīci hotī|| 68||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in this way, those who know Me at the time of death, and relinquish their bodies, they become Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं तरी साधारण। उरीं आदळळलिया मरण। जो आठवु धरी अंतःकरण। तेंचि होइजे ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ tarī sādhāraṇa| urīṃ ādaḻaḻaliyā maraṇa| jo āṭhavu dharī aṃtaḥkaraṇa| teṃci hoije || 69||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, when death strikes the chest, whatever one remembers in their heart, that indeed they become.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा कवणु एकु काकुळती । पळतां पवनगती । दुपाउलीं अवचितीं। कुहामाजीं पडियेला ॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā kavaṇu eku kākuḻatī | paḻatāṃ pavanagatī | dupāulīṃ avacitīṃ| kuhāmājīṃ paḍiyelā || 70||
verses.meaning: Just as someone, in great distress, fleeing with the speed of wind, suddenly falls into a well with both feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तया पडणयाआरोतें। पडण चुकवावया परोतें। नाहीं म्हणौनि तेथें। पडावेंचि पडे॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ tayā paḍaṇayāāroteṃ| paḍaṇa cukavāvayā paroteṃ| nāhīṃ mhaṇauni tetheṃ| paḍāveṃci paḍe||71||
verses.meaning: Now, to avoid falling into that very fall, there is no other way; therefore, one must fall into it.
