verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे 'लळेयांचे लळे सरती । मनोरथांचे मनोरथ पुरती । जरी माहेरें श्रीमंतें होती । तुम्हांऐसीं ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je 'laḻeyāṃce laḻe saratī | manorathāṃce manoratha puratī | jarī māhereṃ śrīmaṃteṃ hotī | tumhāṃaisīṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: For the desires of the beloved ones are fulfilled, and their aspirations are met, if they have a wealthy maternal home like yours.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुमचेया दिठिवेयाचिये बोलें। सासिन्नले प्रसन्नतेचे मळे । ते साउली देखोनि लोळें। श्रांतु जी मी॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tumaceyā diṭhiveyāciye boleṃ| sāsinnale prasannatece maḻe | te sāulī dekhoni loḻeṃ| śrāṃtu jī mī|| 4||
verses.meaning: By the very sight of you, the gardens of serenity are nurtured. Seeing that shade, I, a weary soul, recline in blissful repose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रभू तुम्ही सुखामृताचे डोहो । म्हणौनि आम्ही आपुलिया स्वेच्छा बोलावो लाहों। येथही जरी सलगी करूं बिहों। तरी निवों कें पां॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: prabhū tumhī sukhāmṛtāce ḍoho | mhaṇauni āmhī āpuliyā svecchā bolāvo lāhoṃ| yethahī jarī salagī karūṃ bihoṃ| tarī nivoṃ keṃ pāṃ|| 5||
verses.meaning: Lord, you are the very pools of the nectar of bliss. Therefore, we can speak freely as we wish. If even here we fear to be intimate, then where else can we find solace?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी बाळक बोबडां बोलीं। कां वांकुडा विचुका पाउलीं। ते चोज करूनि माउली। रिझे जेवीं ॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī bāḻaka bobaḍāṃ bolīṃ| kāṃ vāṃkuḍā vicukā pāulīṃ| te coja karūni māulī| rijhe jevīṃ ||6||
verses.meaning: Just as a mother delights in the lisping words or the crooked, stumbling steps of her child.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं तुम्हां संतांचा पढियावो। कैसेनि तरी आम्हांवरी हो। या बहुवा आळुकिया जी आहों। सलगी करीत॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ tumhāṃ saṃtāṃcā paḍhiyāvo| kaiseni tarī āmhāṃvarī ho| yā bahuvā āḻukiyā jī āhoṃ| salagī karīta||7||
verses.meaning: Similarly, how can we, with such great longing, approach you, the saints, and make ourselves close to you?

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि माझिये बोलतिये योग्यते। सर्वज्ञ भवादृश श्रोते। काय धड्यावरी सारस्वतें। पढों सिकिजे॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni mājhiye bolatiye yogyate| sarvajña bhavādṛśa śrote| kāya dhaḍyāvarī sārasvateṃ| paḍhoṃ sikije|| 8||
verses.meaning: Except for my speaking ability, what can a knower like you, O listener, learn from me? Can Saraswati herself learn to read from a mere slate?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवधारां आवडे तेसणां धुंधुरु । परि महातेजीं न मिरवे काय करूं । अमृताचिया ताटीं बोगरूं । ऐसी रससोय कैंची ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: avadhārāṃ āvaḍe tesaṇāṃ dhuṃdhuru | pari mahātejīṃ na mirave kāya karūṃ | amṛtāciyā tāṭīṃ bogarūṃ | aisī rasasoya kaiṃcī || 9||
verses.meaning: Listen, the sound of the small bells is pleasing, but what can I do when it cannot shine in the great light? How can there be a taste as sweet as that of a banana peel on a plate of nectar?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो हिमकरासी विंजणें । की नादापुढें आइकवणें। लेणियासी लेणें। हें कहीं आथी॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho himakarāsī viṃjaṇeṃ | kī nādāpuḍheṃ āikavaṇeṃ| leṇiyāsī leṇeṃ| heṃ kahīṃ āthī|| 10||
verses.meaning: Is it possible to fan the moon, or to listen to a sound, or to adorn an ornament? These things are not possible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगा परिमळें काय तुरंबावें । सागरें कवणें ठायीं नाहावें। हें गगनचि आडे आघवें। ऐसा पवाडु कैंचा॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgā parimaḻeṃ kāya turaṃbāveṃ | sāgareṃ kavaṇeṃ ṭhāyīṃ nāhāveṃ| heṃ gaganaci āḍe āghaveṃ| aisā pavāḍu kaiṃcā|| 11||
verses.meaning: What can fragrance adorn? Where can the ocean bathe? This entire sky is already filled; where is there room for such a display?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तुमचें अवधान धाये । आणि तुम्ही म्हणा हें होये । ऐसें वक्तृत्व कवणा आहे। जेणें रिझा तुम्ही॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ tumaceṃ avadhāna dhāye | āṇi tumhī mhaṇā heṃ hoye | aiseṃ vaktṛtva kavaṇā āhe| jeṇeṃ rijhā tumhī|| 92||
verses.meaning: If you were to grant your attention and declare, "This is good," what eloquence could possibly exist that would truly please you?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी विश्‍वप्रगटितिया गभस्ती। काय हातिवेन न कीजे आरती। कां चुळोदकें आपांपती। अर्घ्य नेदिजे॥ ९१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī viś‍vapragaṭitiyā gabhastī| kāya hātivena na kīje āratī| kāṃ cuḻodakeṃ āpāṃpatī| arghya nedije|| 913||
verses.meaning: Can the sun, which illuminates the entire universe, be worshipped with a lamp? Or can the ocean, the lord of all waters, be offered water from a cupped hand?

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रभू तुम्ही महेशाचिया मूर्ती। आणि मी दुबळा अर्चितसें भक्‍ती । म्हणोनि बोल जऱ्ही गंगावती । तऱही स्वीकाराळ कौं॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: prabhū tumhī maheśāciyā mūrtī| āṇi mī dubaḻā arcitaseṃ bhak‍tī | mhaṇoni bola jaṟhī gaṃgāvatī | taṟahī svīkārāḻa kauṃ|| 14||
verses.meaning: Lord, you are the very embodiment of Mahesh (Shiva), and I, a humble devotee, offer my worship. Therefore, even if my words are like the Ganges (pure and flowing), please accept them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाळक बापाचिये ताटीं रिगे। आणि बापातेंचि जेवऊं लागे। कौं तो संतोषिलेनि वेगें। मुखचि बोढवी॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāḻaka bāpāciye tāṭīṃ rige| āṇi bāpāteṃci jevaūṃ lāge| kauṃ to saṃtoṣileni vegeṃ| mukhaci boḍhavī|| 15||
verses.meaning: When a child sits down to eat with its father, and begins to feed the father himself, the father, overcome with joy, lovingly feeds the child's mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मी जरी तुम्हांप्रती। चावटी करीतसें १५६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी बाळमती । तरी तुम्ही संतोषिजे ऐसी जाती । प्रेमाची असे॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mī jarī tumhāṃpratī| cāvaṭī karītaseṃ 156 śrījñāneśvarī bāḻamatī | tarī tumhī saṃtoṣije aisī jātī | premācī ase|| 16||
verses.meaning: Even if I, Dnyaneshwar, speak childishly to you, please be pleased, for such is the nature of love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तेणें आपुलेपणाचेनि मोहें। तुम्ही संत घेतळे असा बहुबें। म्हणौनि केलिये सलगीचा नोहे। आभारु तुम्हां॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi teṇeṃ āpulepaṇāceni moheṃ| tumhī saṃta ghetaḻe asā bahubeṃ| mhaṇauni keliye salagīcā nohe| ābhāru tumhāṃ|| 17||
verses.meaning: And because of this affection for your own, you saints have embraced me with great love. Therefore, the intimacy I have shown is not a burden to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो तान्हयाचें लागतां झटें । तेणें अधिकचि पान्हा फुटे। रोषें प्रेम दुणवटे । पढियंतयाचेनि॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho tānhayāceṃ lāgatāṃ jhaṭeṃ | teṇeṃ adhikaci pānhā phuṭe| roṣeṃ prema duṇavaṭe | paḍhiyaṃtayāceni|| 18||
verses.meaning: When a baby tugs at the breast, the milk flows even more abundantly. Similarly, a beloved one's anger only doubles the love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मज लेंकुरवाचेनि बोलें। तुमचें कृपाळूपण निदैलें। तें चेइलें ऐसें जी जाणवलें। यालागीं बोळिलों मी॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni maja leṃkuravāceni boleṃ| tumaceṃ kṛpāḻūpaṇa nidaileṃ| teṃ ceileṃ aiseṃ jī jāṇavaleṃ| yālāgīṃ boḻiloṃ mī|| 19||
verses.meaning: Therefore, through the words of a child like me, your compassionate nature, which was dormant, has awakened. This is what I have realized, and for this reason, I have been sent forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं चांदिणें पिकविजत आहे चेपणीं। कीं वारया घापत आहे वाहणी । हां हो गगनासि गंबसणी । घालिजे केवीं ॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ cāṃdiṇeṃ pikavijata āhe cepaṇīṃ| kīṃ vārayā ghāpata āhe vāhaṇī | hāṃ ho gaganāsi gaṃbasaṇī | ghālije kevīṃ || 20||
verses.meaning: Can moonlight be harvested from a field? Or can the wind be caught and carried away? How then can the sky be contained or covered?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आइका पाणी वबोथिजावें न लगे। नवनीतीं माथुला न रिगे। तेवीं लाजिलें व्याख्यान न निगे। देखोनि जयातें ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āikā pāṇī vabothijāveṃ na lage| navanītīṃ māthulā na rige| tevīṃ lājileṃ vyākhyāna na nige| dekhoni jayāteṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: Listen, water does not need to be churned. Butter does not enter the churn. Similarly, a discourse, though prepared, does not emerge when one sees Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो शब्दब्रह्म जिये बाजे। शब्द मावळलेया निवांतु निजे। तो गीतार्थ्‌ मऱ्हाठिया बोलिजे । हा पाडु काई॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso śabdabrahma jiye bāje| śabda māvaḻaleyā nivāṃtu nije| to gītārth‌ maṟhāṭhiyā bolije | hā pāḍu kāī|| 22||
verses.meaning: Let this be. The Word-Brahman, where it resounds, and where words cease, it rests in silence. That meaning of the Gita is spoken in Marathi. What is the significance of this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि ऐसियाही मज धिंवसा। तो पुढतियाचि येकी आशा । जे धिटींबा करूनि भवादृशां । पढियंतया होआवें॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari aisiyāhī maja dhiṃvasā| to puḍhatiyāci yekī āśā | je dhiṭīṃbā karūni bhavādṛśāṃ | paḍhiyaṃtayā hoāveṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: Even with such audacity, I have one hope: that by making bold those like you, I may become beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि आतां चंद्रापासोनि निववितें। जें अमृताहूनि जीववितें॥ तेणें अबधानें कीजो वाढतें। मनोरथां माझिया॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari ātāṃ caṃdrāpāsoni nivaviteṃ| jeṃ amṛtāhūni jīvaviteṃ|| teṇeṃ abadhāneṃ kījo vāḍhateṃ| manorathāṃ mājhiyā|| 24||
verses.meaning: Therefore, now, that which cools more than the moon, that which gives life more than nectar, with that attention, may my desires be fulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जैं दिठिवा तुमचा वरुषे। तें सकळार्थसिद्धी मती पिके। एऱ्हवीं कोंभेला उन्मेषु सुके। जरी उदास तुम्ही ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jaiṃ diṭhivā tumacā varuṣe| teṃ sakaḻārthasiddhī matī pike| eṟhavīṃ koṃbhelā unmeṣu suke| jarī udāsa tumhī || 25||
verses.meaning: When your divine gaze showers upon us, then the intellect ripens with the accomplishment of all purposes. Otherwise, the bud of inspiration withers if you remain indifferent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सहजें तरी अवधारा । वक्तृत्वा अवधानाचा होय चारा । तरी दोंदे पेलती अक्षरां। प्रमेयाचीं ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: sahajeṃ tarī avadhārā | vaktṛtvā avadhānācā hoya cārā | tarī doṃde pelatī akṣarāṃ| prameyācīṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: Listen, if the speaker's words are nourished by the listener's attention, then the letters themselves will bear the fruits of profound truths.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्थ बोलाची वाट पाहे। तेथ अभिप्राबोचि अभिप्रायातें विये। भावाचा फुलौरा होत जाये । मतिवरी ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: artha bolācī vāṭa pāhe| tetha abhiprāboci abhiprāyāteṃ viye| bhāvācā phulaurā hota jāye | mativarī || 27||
verses.meaning: The meaning awaits the utterance of words, where the intention itself gives birth to further intentions, and the blossoming of emotions unfolds upon the intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि संवादाचा सुवावो ढळे। तऱही हृदयाकाश सारस्वतें बोळे। आणि श्रोता दुश्चिता तरि वितुळे। मांडला रसु॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni saṃvādācā suvāvo ḍhaḻe| taṟahī hṛdayākāśa sārasvateṃ boḻe| āṇi śrotā duścitā tari vituḻe| māṃḍalā rasu|| 28||
verses.meaning: Therefore, if the conversation's fragrance is lost, even then the heart's sky will be filled with the divine Saraswati's wisdom. But if the listener is distracted, the essence that has been presented will dissipate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो चंद्रकांतु द्रवता कीर होये। परि ते हातवटी चंद्रीं कौं आहे। म्हणौनि वक्ता तो वक्ता नोहे। श्रोतेनिविण ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho caṃdrakāṃtu dravatā kīra hoye| pari te hātavaṭī caṃdrīṃ kauṃ āhe| mhaṇauni vaktā to vaktā nohe| śroteniviṇa || 29||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the moonstone melts, but why does that power reside in the moon? Therefore, a speaker is not a speaker without an audience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि आतां आमुतें गोड करावें। ऐसें तांदुळीं कासया विनवावें। साइखडियानें काड प्रार्थावें। सूत्रधारातें ॥ ३० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari ātāṃ āmuteṃ goḍa karāveṃ| aiseṃ tāṃduḻīṃ kāsayā vinavāveṃ| sāikhaḍiyāneṃ kāḍa prārthāveṃ| sūtradhārāteṃ || 30 ||
verses.meaning: But now, why should the rice grains plead with the cook, "Make us sweet"? Why should the puppets implore the puppeteer?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो काय बाहुलियांचिया काजा नाचवी । कीं आपुलिये जाणिवेची कळा वाढवी । म्हणौनि आम्हां या ठेवाठेवी । काय काज॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: to kāya bāhuliyāṃciyā kājā nācavī | kīṃ āpuliye jāṇivecī kaḻā vāḍhavī | mhaṇauni āmhāṃ yā ṭhevāṭhevī | kāya kāja|| 31||
verses.meaning: What does He gain by making puppets dance? Or does He enhance the art of His own knowledge? Therefore, what is the use of these arrangements for us?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव श्रीगुरु म्हणती काइ जाहलें। हें समस्तही आम्हां पावलें। आतां सांगे जें निरोपिळें। नारायणे ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva śrīguru mhaṇatī kāi jāhaleṃ| heṃ samastahī āmhāṃ pāvaleṃ| ātāṃ sāṃge jeṃ niropiḻeṃ| nārāyaṇe || 32||
verses.meaning: Then the Guru said, "What has happened? All this has come to me. Now, tell me what Narayana has instructed."

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ संतोषोनि निवृत्तिदासें। जी जी म्हणौनि उल्हासें। अवधारां श्रीकृष्ण ऐसें। बोलते जाहले ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha saṃtoṣoni nivṛttidāseṃ| jī jī mhaṇauni ulhāseṃ| avadhārāṃ śrīkṛṣṇa aiseṃ| bolate jāhale || 33||
verses.meaning: Pleased by this, Nivruttidas, with great joy, said, "Yes, yes!" and then began to speak, saying, "Listen, this is what Shri Krishna said."

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरि अर्जुना हें बीज। पुढती सांगिजेल तुज । जें हें अंतःकरणींचें गुज । जीवाचिये ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātari arjunā heṃ bīja| puḍhatī sāṃgijela tuja | jeṃ heṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇīṃceṃ guja | jīvāciye || 34||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, Arjuna, this seed will be told to you again, which is the secret of the heart, of the very soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें मानें जीवाचें हियें फोडावें। मग गुज कां पां मज सांगावें । ऐसें कांहीं स्वभावें । कल्पिशी जरी ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ māneṃ jīvāceṃ hiyeṃ phoḍāveṃ| maga guja kāṃ pāṃ maja sāṃgāveṃ | aiseṃ kāṃhīṃ svabhāveṃ | kalpiśī jarī || 35 ||
verses.meaning: If you imagine that by such means the heart of the soul would be broken, then why should you tell me your secret?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी परियेसीं गा प्राज्ञा । तूं आस्थेचीच संज्ञा) बोलिलिये गोष्टीची अवज्ञा) नेणसी करूं॥३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pariyesīṃ gā prājñā | tūṃ āsthecīca saṃjñā) boliliye goṣṭīcī avajñā) neṇasī karūṃ||36||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen, O wise one! You are the very embodiment of faith, and you do not know how to disregard what has been spoken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गूढपण आपुलें मोडो। वरि न बोलणेंही बोलावें घडो। परि आमुचिये जीवींचें पडो। तुझ्या जिवीं ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gūḍhapaṇa āpuleṃ moḍo| vari na bolaṇeṃhī bolāveṃ ghaḍo| pari āmuciye jīvīṃceṃ paḍo| tujhyā jivīṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let my secret be revealed, and let my unspoken words be spoken, so that what is in my heart may fall into yours.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा थानीं कौर दूध गूढ । परि थानासीचि नव्हे कीं गोड। म्हणौनि सरो कां सेवितयाची चाड। जरी अनन्यु मिळे॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā thānīṃ kaura dūdha gūḍha | pari thānāsīci navhe kīṃ goḍa| mhaṇauni saro kāṃ sevitayācī cāḍa| jarī ananyu miḻe|| 38||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the udder holds milk, profound and sweet, yet the udder itself does not taste sweet. Therefore, let the desire of the seeker be fulfilled, if they find the non-dual.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुडांहूनि बीज काढिलें। मग निर्वाळलिये भूमीं पेरिळें। तरि तें सांडीविखुरीं गेलें। म्हणों ये कायी ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: muḍāṃhūni bīja kāḍhileṃ| maga nirvāḻaliye bhūmīṃ periḻeṃ| tari teṃ sāṃḍīvikhurīṃ geleṃ| mhaṇoṃ ye kāyī || 39||
verses.meaning: If a seed is taken from a barren plant and then sown in barren land, can it be said that it will be wasted?

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं सुमनु आणि शुद्धमती। जो अनिंदकु अनन्यगती । पैं गा गौप्यही परी तयाप्रती । चावळिजे सुखें ॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ sumanu āṇi śuddhamatī| jo aniṃdaku ananyagatī | paiṃ gā gaupyahī parī tayāpratī | cāvaḻije sukheṃ || 40||
verses.meaning: Therefore, to one who is pure-hearted and of clear intellect, who is not a detractor and is solely devoted, even the most profound secrets can be joyfully revealed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि प्रस्तुत आतां गुणींहीं । तूं बांचूनि आणिक नाहीं । म्हणौनि गुज तरी तुझ्या ठायीं । लपऊं नये॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari prastuta ātāṃ guṇīṃhīṃ | tūṃ bāṃcūni āṇika nāhīṃ | mhaṇauni guja tarī tujhyā ṭhāyīṃ | lapaūṃ naye|| 41||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in the present qualities, there is no one but You. Hence, a secret should not be hidden from You.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां किती नावानाबा गुज। म्हणतां कानडें वाटेल तुज । तरि ज्ञान सांगेन सहज । विज्ञानेंसीं ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ kitī nāvānābā guja| mhaṇatāṃ kānaḍeṃ vāṭela tuja | tari jñāna sāṃgena sahaja | vijñāneṃsīṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: Now, how much more should I explain? You might find it difficult to understand. Therefore, I will easily explain this knowledge, along with its practical application.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तेंचि ऐसेनि निवाडें। जैसें भेसळलें खरें कुडें। मग काढिजे फाडोवाडें। 'पारखूनियां॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teṃci aiseni nivāḍeṃ| jaiseṃ bhesaḻaleṃ khareṃ kuḍeṃ| maga kāḍhije phāḍovāḍeṃ| 'pārakhūniyāṃ|| 43||
verses.meaning: However, just as genuine and counterfeit coins are mixed together and then separated and distinguished by careful examination, so too is the truth discerned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां चांचूचेनि सांडसें। खांडिजे पय पाणी राजहंसें। तुज ज्ञान विज्ञान तैसें। वांटूनि देऊ ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ cāṃcūceni sāṃḍaseṃ| khāṃḍije paya pāṇī rājahaṃseṃ| tuja jñāna vijñāna taiseṃ| vāṃṭūni deū || 44||
verses.meaning: Just as a royal swan, with its beak, separates milk from water, so too will I bestow upon you the knowledge (jnana) and wisdom (vijnana), distinguishing them for you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वारयाचिया धारसा। पडिन्नलळा कोंडा कां नुरेचि जैसा। आणि कणांचा आपैसा। राशिवा जोडे ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vārayāciyā dhārasā| paḍinnalaḻā koṃḍā kāṃ nureci jaisā| āṇi kaṇāṃcā āpaisā| rāśivā joḍe || 45||
verses.meaning: Just as the chaff, caught in a strong gust of wind, is completely blown away, while the grains naturally gather into a pile.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जें जाणितलेयासाठीं । संसार संसाराचिये गांठीं । लाऊनि बैसबी पाटीं। मोक्षश्रियेच्या ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jeṃ jāṇitaleyāsāṭhīṃ | saṃsāra saṃsārāciye gāṃṭhīṃ | lāūni baisabī pāṭīṃ| mokṣaśriyecyā || 46||
verses.meaning: Just as, for the sake of that knowledge, one is made to sit at the doorstep of the wealth of liberation, having tied the worldly existence to the knot of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें जाणणेया आपवेयांच्या गांवीं । गुरुत्वाची आचार्यपदवी। जें सकळ गुह्यांचा गोसावी । पवित्रा रावो ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ jāṇaṇeyā āpaveyāṃcyā gāṃvīṃ | gurutvācī ācāryapadavī| jeṃ sakaḻa guhyāṃcā gosāvī | pavitrā rāvo || 47||
verses.meaning: That which, by its very nature, holds the supreme position of a Guru among all knowledge, that which is the master of all secrets, the king of all that is pure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि धर्माचें निजधाम । तेवींचि उत्तमाचें उत्तम। पैं जया येतां नाहीं काम। जन्मांतराचें ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi dharmāceṃ nijadhāma | tevīṃci uttamāceṃ uttama| paiṃ jayā yetāṃ nāhīṃ kāma| janmāṃtarāceṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: And the true abode of Dharma, likewise the best of the best, is that which, upon attainment, eliminates the need for rebirths.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोटकें १५८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी गुरुमुखें उदैजत दिसे। आणि हृदयीं स्वयंभचि असे । प्रत्यक्ष फावों लागे तैसें आपैसयाचि॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: moṭakeṃ 158 śrījñāneśvarī gurumukheṃ udaijata dise| āṇi hṛdayīṃ svayaṃbhaci ase | pratyakṣa phāvoṃ lāge taiseṃ āpaisayāci|| 49||
verses.meaning: Thus, the Dnyaneshwari, though appearing to arise from the Guru's mouth, is inherently present in the heart, and then manifests spontaneously as if directly perceived.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि गा सुखाच्या पाउटीं। चढतां येइजे जयाच्या भेटी। मग भेटल्या कौर मीठी । भोगणेंयाही पडे॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci gā sukhācyā pāuṭīṃ| caḍhatāṃ yeije jayācyā bheṭī| maga bheṭalyā kaura mīṭhī | bhogaṇeṃyāhī paḍe|| 50||
verses.meaning: In the same way, one can ascend to the abode of happiness and meet Him. And once met, one can embrace Him and experience the joy of union.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि भोगाचिया ऐलीकडिलिये मेरे। चित्त उभें ठेलें सुखा भरे। ऐसें सुलभ आणि सोपारें। वरि परब्रह्म ॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari bhogāciyā ailīkaḍiliye mere| citta ubheṃ ṭheleṃ sukhā bhare| aiseṃ sulabha āṇi sopāreṃ| vari parabrahma ||51||
verses.meaning: But on this side of worldly enjoyments, the mind stands filled with joy. So easy and simple it is, and above all, it is the Supreme Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा आणिकही एक याचें । जें हाता आलिया तरी न वचे । आणि अनुभवितां कांहीं न वेचे। वरि विटेहि ना॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā āṇikahī eka yāceṃ | jeṃ hātā āliyā tarī na vace | āṇi anubhavitāṃ kāṃhīṃ na vece| vari viṭehi nā||52||
verses.meaning: Listen, there is another aspect of this: once attained, it never departs. And in experiencing it, nothing is spent; moreover, it never diminishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ जरी तूं तार्किका। ऐसी हन घेसी शंका। ना येवढी वस्तु हे लोकां । उरली केविं पां॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha jarī tūṃ tārkikā| aisī hana ghesī śaṃkā| nā yevaḍhī vastu he lokāṃ | uralī keviṃ pāṃ||53||
verses.meaning: Here, even if you, O logician, raise such a doubt: "How could such a great entity remain hidden from people?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे एकोत्तरेयाचिया वाढी । जळतिये आगीं घालिती उडी । ते अनायासें स्वगोडी। सांडिती केविं॥५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: je ekottareyāciyā vāḍhī | jaḻatiye āgīṃ ghālitī uḍī | te anāyāseṃ svagoḍī| sāṃḍitī keviṃ||54||
verses.meaning: Those who, for the sake of increasing their own self-interest, jump into a burning fire, how can they effortlessly abandon their own inherent sweetness?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पवित्र आणि रम्य। तेवींचि सुखोपायगम्य । आणि स्वसुख परम धर्म्य । वरि आपणपां जोडे ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pavitra āṇi ramya| tevīṃci sukhopāyagamya | āṇi svasukha parama dharmya | vari āpaṇapāṃ joḍe || 55||
verses.meaning: Thus, it is pure and delightful, easily attainable through the path of happiness, and moreover, it is one's own supreme righteousness, which is attained within oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अवघाचि हा सुरवाडु आहे । तरी जना हातीं केविं उरों लाहे। हा शंकेचा ठावो कौर होये। परि न धरावी तुवां॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā avaghāci hā suravāḍu āhe | tarī janā hātīṃ keviṃ uroṃ lāhe| hā śaṃkecā ṭhāvo kaura hoye| pari na dharāvī tuvāṃ|| 56||
verses.meaning: This entire creation is indeed a delightful experience. How then can it remain in the hands of ordinary people? This might seem like a cause for doubt, but you should not entertain it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां दूध पवित्र आणि गोड । पासीं त्वचेचिया पदराआड । परि तें अव्हेरूनि गोचिड । अशुद्ध काय न सेविती ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ dūdha pavitra āṇi goḍa | pāsīṃ tvaceciyā padarāāḍa | pari teṃ avherūni gociḍa | aśuddha kāya na sevitī || 57||
verses.meaning: Look, milk is pure and sweet, yet it is hidden behind a layer of skin. But does a tick, ignoring that, not consume impure blood?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां कमलकंदा आणि दर्दुरीं। नांदणूक एकेचि घरीं । परि परागु सेविजे भ्रमरीं। येरा चिखलुचि उरे॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ kamalakaṃdā āṇi dardurīṃ| nāṃdaṇūka ekeci gharīṃ | pari parāgu sevije bhramarīṃ| yerā cikhaluci ure|| 58||
verses.meaning: Just as the lotus root and the frog reside in the same water, yet the bee enjoys the pollen while the frog is left with only mud.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी निदैवाच्या परिवरीं। लोह्या रुतळिया आहाति सहतस्त्रवरी । परि तेथ बैसोनि उपवबासु करी । कां दरिद्रे जिये॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī nidaivācyā parivarīṃ| lohyā rutaḻiyā āhāti sahatastravarī | pari tetha baisoni upavabāsu karī | kāṃ daridre jiye|| 59||
verses.meaning: Or, in the family of the unfortunate, there are thousands of iron pots, but sitting there, why should one fast or live in poverty?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा हृदयामध्ये मी रामु । असतां सर्वसुखाचा आरामु । कीं भ्रांतासी कामु। विषयावरी ॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā hṛdayāmadhye mī rāmu | asatāṃ sarvasukhācā ārāmu | kīṃ bhrāṃtāsī kāmu| viṣayāvarī || 60||
verses.meaning: Just as I, Rama, reside in the heart, the abode of all happiness, why then does the deluded mind desire worldly pleasures?

verses.shloka_devanagari: बहु मृगजळ देखोनि डोळां। थुंकिजे अमृताचा गिळितां गळाळा। तोडिला परिसु बांधिला गळां । शुक्तिकालाभें ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: bahu mṛgajaḻa dekhoni ḍoḻāṃ| thuṃkije amṛtācā giḻitāṃ gaḻāḻā| toḍilā parisu bāṃdhilā gaḻāṃ | śuktikālābheṃ || 61||
verses.meaning: Seeing a mirage, one spits out the nectar that was in their throat. One throws away the philosopher's stone and ties a seashell around their neck, mistaking it for something valuable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी अहंममतेचिये लवडसवडीं। मातें न पवतीची बापुडीं । म्हणौनि जन्ममरणाची दुथडीं । डहुळितें ठेलीं ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī ahaṃmamateciye lavaḍasavaḍīṃ| māteṃ na pavatīcī bāpuḍīṃ | mhaṇauni janmamaraṇācī duthaḍīṃ | ḍahuḻiteṃ ṭhelīṃ || 62||
verses.meaning: Thus, caught in the haste of ego and possessiveness, these poor souls cannot reach Me. Therefore, they remain caught in the turbulent currents of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं मी तरी कैसा। मुखाप्रति भानु कां जैसा । कहीं दिसे न दिसे ऐसा । वाणीचा नोहे॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ mī tarī kaisā| mukhāprati bhānu kāṃ jaisā | kahīṃ dise na dise aisā | vāṇīcā nohe||63||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, how am I? Like the sun to the mouth, sometimes seen, sometimes not seen, I am not of speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझेया विस्तारळेपणा नांवें । हें जगचि नोहे आघवें। जैसें दूध मुराळें स्वभावें। तरि तेंचि दहीं ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheyā vistāraḻepaṇā nāṃveṃ | heṃ jagaci nohe āghaveṃ| jaiseṃ dūdha murāḻeṃ svabhāveṃ| tari teṃci dahīṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: The entire universe is nothing but the manifestation of My expansive nature. Just as milk naturally curdles, it becomes yogurt.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां बीजचि जाहलें तरु । अथवा भांगारचि अळंकारु । तैसा मज एकाचा विस्तारु। तें हें जग॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bījaci jāhaleṃ taru | athavā bhāṃgāraci aḻaṃkāru | taisā maja ekācā vistāru| teṃ heṃ jaga|| 65||
verses.meaning: Just as a seed becomes a tree, or gold becomes an ornament, so too is this world an expansion of My single Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें अव्यक्‍्तपणें थिजलें। तेंचि मग बिश्‍वाकारें बोथिजलें। तैसें अमूर्तमूर्ति मियां विस्तारळें। त्रैलोक्य जाणें ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ avyak‍tapaṇeṃ thijaleṃ| teṃci maga biś‍vākāreṃ bothijaleṃ| taiseṃ amūrtamūrti miyāṃ vistāraḻeṃ| trailokya jāṇeṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: That which was solidified in an unmanifest state, then blossomed forth as the form of the universe. In the same way, I, the formless one, expanded into form, and thus the three worlds came to be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: महदादि देहांतें। इयें अशेषेंही भूतें । परी माझ्या ठायीं बिंबतें। जैसें जळीं फेण ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mahadādi dehāṃteṃ| iyeṃ aśeṣeṃhī bhūteṃ | parī mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ biṃbateṃ| jaiseṃ jaḻīṃ pheṇa || 67||
verses.meaning: From the great principle (Mahat) down to the physical body, all these beings exist within Me, just as foam appears on water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तया फेणांआंतु पाहातां। जेवीं जळ न दिसे पंडुसुता । नातरी स्वप्नींची अनेकता । चेइलिया नोहिजे॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari tayā pheṇāṃāṃtu pāhātāṃ| jevīṃ jaḻa na dise paṃḍusutā | nātarī svapnīṃcī anekatā | ceiliyā nohije|| 68||
verses.meaning: Just as, O son of Pandu, water is not seen within the foam, or as the multiplicity of a dream vanishes upon waking.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं भूतें इयें माझ्या ठायीं । बिंबती तयांमाजीं मी नाहीं । इया उपपत्ती तुज पाहीं । सांगितळिया मागां ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ bhūteṃ iyeṃ mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ | biṃbatī tayāṃmājīṃ mī nāhīṃ | iyā upapattī tuja pāhīṃ | sāṃgitaḻiyā māgāṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: Similarly, these beings exist within Me, yet I am not contained within them. This explanation, I have already given to you before.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि बोळिळिया बोलाचा अतिसो। न कौजे यालागीं हें असो। परि मजआंत पैसो। दिठी तुझी ॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni boḻiḻiyā bolācā atiso| na kauje yālāgīṃ heṃ aso| pari majaāṃta paiso| diṭhī tujhī || 70||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let us not exaggerate with words; let this suffice. But let your gaze penetrate within me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आमुचा प्रकृतीपैलीकडील भावो । जरी कल्पनेवीण लागसी पाहों । तरी मजमाजीं भूतें हेंही वावो । जें मी सर्व म्हणौनि ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmucā prakṛtīpailīkaḍīla bhāvo | jarī kalpanevīṇa lāgasī pāhoṃ | tarī majamājīṃ bhūteṃ heṃhī vāvo | jeṃ mī sarva mhaṇauni || 71||
verses.meaning: If you try to perceive my nature, which transcends all material forms, without the aid of imagination, then even the notion that all beings are within me becomes meaningless, for I am indeed everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं संकल्पाचिये सांजवेळे। नावेक तिमिरेजती बुद्धीचे डोळे । म्हणौनि अखंडितचि परि झांवळे। भूतभिन्न ऐसें देखे॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ saṃkalpāciye sāṃjaveḻe| nāveka timirejatī buddhīce ḍoḻe | mhaṇauni akhaṃḍitaci pari jhāṃvaḻe| bhūtabhinna aiseṃ dekhe||72||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, in the twilight of संकल्प (resolve/will), the eyes of the intellect become somewhat clouded. Therefore, it continuously perceives all beings as separate and distinct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेचि संकल्पाची सांज जैं लोपे। तैं अखंडितचि आहे स्वरूपें। जैसें शंका जातखेबों लोपे । सापपण माळेचें ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teci saṃkalpācī sāṃja jaiṃ lope| taiṃ akhaṃḍitaci āhe svarūpeṃ| jaiseṃ śaṃkā jātakheboṃ lope | sāpapaṇa māḻeceṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: When the evening of संकल्प (resolve/intention) fades, then the true nature (स्वरूप) remains unbroken, just as the snake-like appearance of a garland vanishes as soon as the doubt (शंका) is dispelled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं तरी भूमीआंतूनि स्वयंभ। काय घडेयागाडगेयाचे निघती कोंभ। परि ते कुलालमतीचे गर्भ। उमटले कौं॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ tarī bhūmīāṃtūni svayaṃbha| kāya ghaḍeyāgāḍageyāce nighatī koṃbha| pari te kulālamatīce garbha| umaṭale kauṃ|| 74||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, do pots and pitchers sprout from the earth on their own? No, they emerge from the intention and skill of the potter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी सागरींच्या पाणीं। काय तरंगाचिया आहाती खाणी । ते अवांतर करणी । वारयाची नव्हे ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī sāgarīṃcyā pāṇīṃ| kāya taraṃgāciyā āhātī khāṇī | te avāṃtara karaṇī | vārayācī navhe || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Or, are the waves a separate mine within the ocean's water? That additional action is not of the wind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां कापसाच्या पोटीं । काय कापडाची होती पेटी । तो वेढितयाचिया दिठी । 'कापड जाहला ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ kāpasācyā poṭīṃ | kāya kāpaḍācī hotī peṭī | to veḍhitayāciyā diṭhī | 'kāpaḍa jāhalā || 76||
verses.meaning: Behold, within the cotton, was there ever a box of cloth? Yet, to the eyes of the one who wraps it, it has become cloth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी सोनें लेणें होउनी घडे । तरी तयाचें सोनेंपण न मोडे। येर अळंकार हे वरचिळीकडे। लेतयाचेनि भावें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī soneṃ leṇeṃ hounī ghaḍe | tarī tayāceṃ soneṃpaṇa na moḍe| yera aḻaṃkāra he varaciḻīkaḍe| letayāceni bhāveṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Even if gold becomes an ornament, its gold-ness is not destroyed. The ornaments are merely superficial, arising from the wearer's perception.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगें 'पडिसादाचीं प्रत्युत्तरे । कां आरिसां जें आविष्करें। तें आपलें कीं साचोकारें। तेथेंचि होतें ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgeṃ 'paḍisādācīṃ pratyuttare | kāṃ ārisāṃ jeṃ āviṣkareṃ| teṃ āpaleṃ kīṃ sācokāreṃ| tetheṃci hoteṃ || 78||
verses.meaning: Tell me, are the echoes of a sound or the reflections in a mirror truly their own, or do they originate from the source itself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसी इये निर्मळे माझ्या स्वरूपीं। जो भूतभावना आरोपी । तयासि तयाच्या संकल्पीं। भूताभासु असे ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tesī iye nirmaḻe mājhyā svarūpīṃ| jo bhūtabhāvanā āropī | tayāsi tayācyā saṃkalpīṃ| bhūtābhāsu ase || 79||
verses.meaning: Thus, whoever superimposes the idea of separate beings onto my pure form, for them, the illusion of beings exists within their own संकल्प (resolve/conception).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेचि कल्पिती प्रकृती पुरे । तरि भूताभासु आधींचि सरे । मग स्वरूप उरे एकसरें । १६० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी निखळ माझें ॥ ८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teci kalpitī prakṛtī pure | tari bhūtābhāsu ādhīṃci sare | maga svarūpa ure ekasareṃ | 160 śrījñāneśvarī nikhaḻa mājheṃ || 80||
verses.meaning: If that very nature is imagined to be complete, then the illusion of beings ceases beforehand. Then the true nature remains, pure and singular. This is the pure essence of Shri Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो आंगीं भरलिया भवंडी। जैशा भोंबत दिसती अरडीदरडी। तैशी आपुलिया कल्पना अखंडीं। गमती भूतें ॥ ८१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso āṃgīṃ bharaliyā bhavaṃḍī| jaiśā bhoṃbata disatī araḍīdaraḍī| taiśī āpuliyā kalpanā akhaṃḍīṃ| gamatī bhūteṃ || 819||
verses.meaning: Just as mountains and valleys appear to spin when one is dizzy, so too do beings appear to exist continuously within one's own imagination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेचि कल्पना सांडूनि पाहीं । तरि मी भूतीं भूतें माझिया ठायीं। हें स्वप्नींही परि नाहीं॥। कल्पाबयाजोगें ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teci kalpanā sāṃḍūni pāhīṃ | tari mī bhūtīṃ bhūteṃ mājhiyā ṭhāyīṃ| heṃ svapnīṃhī pari nāhīṃ||| kalpābayājogeṃ || 82||
verses.meaning: If you abandon that very imagination, then the idea of "I am in beings and beings are in me" would not even occur in a dream, let alone be conceived.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां मीच एक भूतांतें धर्ता। अथवा भूतांमाजीं मी असता । या संकल्पसन्निपाता-। आंतुळिया बोलिया॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ mīca eka bhūtāṃteṃ dhartā| athavā bhūtāṃmājīṃ mī asatā | yā saṃkalpasannipātā-| āṃtuḻiyā boliyā|| 83||
verses.meaning: Now, the thought that "I alone sustain all beings" or "I exist within all beings" is a delusion, a feverish utterance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि परियेसीं गा प्रियोत्तमा। यापरी मी बिशवबेंसीं विश्‍वात्मा। जो इया 'लटकिया भूतग्रामा। भाव्यु सदा॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni pariyesīṃ gā priyottamā| yāparī mī biśavabeṃsīṃ viś‍vātmā| jo iyā 'laṭakiyā bhūtagrāmā| bhāvyu sadā|| 84||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen, my dearest, in this way, I, the Universal Soul, am always the support of this illusory multitude of beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रश्मीचेनि आधारें जैसें । नव्हे तेंचि मृगजळ आभासे। माझ्या ठायीं भूतजात तैसें । आणि मातेंही भावी ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: raśmīceni ādhāreṃ jaiseṃ | navhe teṃci mṛgajaḻa ābhāse| mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ bhūtajāta taiseṃ | āṇi māteṃhī bhāvī || 85||
verses.meaning: Just as a mirage appears to be real due to the sun's rays, so too do all beings appear to exist within Me, and they also perceive Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी ये परीचा भूतभावनु। परि सर्व भूतांसि अभिन्नु। जैसी प्रभा आणि भानु । एकचि ते॥८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī ye parīcā bhūtabhāvanu| pari sarva bhūtāṃsi abhinnu| jaisī prabhā āṇi bhānu | ekaci te||86||
verses.meaning: I am the protector of all beings, yet I am not separate from any of them, just as light and the sun are one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा आमुचा ऐश्वर्ययोगु। तुवां देखिला कीं चांगु । आतां सांगें कांहीं एथ लागु। भूतभेदाचा असे ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā āmucā aiśvaryayogu| tuvāṃ dekhilā kīṃ cāṃgu | ātāṃ sāṃgeṃ kāṃhīṃ etha lāgu| bhūtabhedācā ase || 87||
verses.meaning: You have indeed seen this Yoga of My opulence well. Now tell Me, is there any connection here with the distinction of beings?

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं मजपासूनि भूतें । आनें नव्हती हें निरुतें। आणि भूतांवेगळिया मातें। कहींच न मनीं हो॥८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ majapāsūni bhūteṃ | āneṃ navhatī heṃ niruteṃ| āṇi bhūtāṃvegaḻiyā māteṃ| kahīṃca na manīṃ ho||88||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all beings are not separate from Me, this is certain. And never consider Me as separate from beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गगन जेवढें जैसें । पवनुहि गगनीं तेवढाचि असे । सहजें हालविलिया वेगळा दिसे। एम्हवीं गगन तेंचि तो॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gagana jevaḍheṃ jaiseṃ | pavanuhi gaganīṃ tevaḍhāci ase | sahajeṃ hālaviliyā vegaḻā dise| emhavīṃ gagana teṃci to|| 89||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky is vast, so too is the wind within the sky. Only when it moves does it appear distinct; otherwise, it is one with the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें भूतजात माझ्या ठायीं। कल्पिजे तरी आभासे कांहीं। निर्विकल्पीं तरि नाहीं। तेथ मीचि मी आधघवें॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ bhūtajāta mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ| kalpije tarī ābhāse kāṃhīṃ| nirvikalpīṃ tari nāhīṃ| tetha mīci mī ādhaghaveṃ|| 90||
verses.meaning: In the same way, all beings are imagined to be in Me, and they appear as something. But in the state beyond all concepts, they do not exist; there, I alone am, completely and entirely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि नाहीं आणि असे। हें कल्पनेचेनि सौरसें। जें कल्पनालोपें भ्रंशे। आणि कल्पनेसवें होय॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni nāhīṃ āṇi ase| heṃ kalpaneceni sauraseṃ| jeṃ kalpanālopeṃ bhraṃśe| āṇi kalpanesaveṃ hoya|| 91||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that which is not and that which is, these arise from the delight of imagination. When imagination ceases, they perish, and with imagination, they come into being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि कल्यपितें मुद्दल जाये। तैं असे नाहीं हें कें आहे। म्हणौनि पुढती तूं पाहें । हा ऐएवर्ययोगु॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci kalyapiteṃ muddala jāye| taiṃ ase nāhīṃ heṃ keṃ āhe| mhaṇauni puḍhatī tūṃ pāheṃ | hā aievaryayogu|| 92||
verses.meaning: That which is imagined as the original, itself perishes. Then, how can there be 'is' or 'is not'? Therefore, look again, this is the yoga of divine opulence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशिया प्रतीतिबोधसागरीं। तूं आपणेयातें कल्लोळु एक करीं । मग जंब 'पाहासी चराचरीं। तंव तूंचि आहासी॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśiyā pratītibodhasāgarīṃ| tūṃ āpaṇeyāteṃ kalloḻu eka karīṃ | maga jaṃba 'pāhāsī carācarīṃ| taṃva tūṃci āhāsī|| 93||
verses.meaning: In such an ocean of self-realization, make yourself a single wave. Then, when you perceive the animate and inanimate world, you will find that it is only you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या जाणणेयाचा चेवो। तुज आला ना म्हणती देवो। तरी आतां द्वैतस्वप्न वावो। जालें कीं ना॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā jāṇaṇeyācā cevo| tuja ālā nā mhaṇatī devo| tarī ātāṃ dvaitasvapna vāvo| jāleṃ kīṃ nā|| 94||
verses.meaning: When this awakening of knowledge has come to you, O Lord, then has not the dream of duality become futile?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पुढती जरी विपायें। बुद्धीसी कल्पनेची झोंप ये। तरी अभेदबोधु जाये । जैं स्वप्नीं पडिजे॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī puḍhatī jarī vipāyeṃ| buddhīsī kalpanecī jhoṃpa ye| tarī abhedabodhu jāye | jaiṃ svapnīṃ paḍije|| 95||
verses.meaning: However, if the intellect is again overcome by the sleep of imagination, then the knowledge of non-duality is lost, just as when one falls into a dream.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ये निद्रेची वाट मोडे । निखळ उद्घोधाचेंचि आपणणें घडे । ऐसें वर्म जें आहे फुडें । तें दाबों आतां ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ye nidrecī vāṭa moḍe | nikhaḻa udghodhāceṃci āpaṇaṇeṃ ghaḍe | aiseṃ varma jeṃ āhe phuḍeṃ | teṃ dāboṃ ātāṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the path of this sleep is broken, and only pure awakening occurs. This secret, which is yet to be revealed, I shall now disclose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी धनुर्धरा धैर्या। निकें अवधान देई बा धनंजया । पैं सर्व भूतांतें माया। करी हरी गा॥९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī dhanurdharā dhairyā| nikeṃ avadhāna deī bā dhanaṃjayā | paiṃ sarva bhūtāṃteṃ māyā| karī harī gā||97||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O great archer, Dhananjaya, listen carefully with patience. Indeed, Hari (the Lord) creates illusion for all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये नांव गा प्रकृती । जे द्विविधा सांगितली तुजप्रती। एकीं अष्टधा भेदव्यक्ती। दुजी जीवरूपा॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye nāṃva gā prakṛtī | je dvividhā sāṃgitalī tujapratī| ekīṃ aṣṭadhā bhedavyaktī| dujī jīvarūpā|| 98||
verses.meaning: That which is called Prakriti, which has been described to you as twofold: one is the eightfold differentiated manifestation, and the other is the form of the individual soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा प्रकृतीविखो आघवा । तुवां मागां 'परिसिलासी पांडवा । म्हणौनि असो काई सांगावा । पुढतपुढती ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā prakṛtīvikho āghavā | tuvāṃ māgāṃ 'parisilāsī pāṃḍavā | mhaṇauni aso kāī sāṃgāvā | puḍhatapuḍhatī || 99||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, you have already heard about this entire matter of Prakriti. Therefore, why should I repeat it again and again?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी ये माझिये प्रकृती । महाकल्पाच्या अंतीं। सर्व भूतें अव्यक्‍तीं। ऐक्यासि येती॥ १००॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ye mājhiye prakṛtī | mahākalpācyā aṃtīṃ| sarva bhūteṃ avyak‍tīṃ| aikyāsi yetī|| 100||
verses.meaning: At the end of a great cosmic cycle, all beings merge into My unmanifested nature, becoming one with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ग्रीष्माच्या अतिरसीं। सबीजें तृणें जैसीं। मागुती भूमीसी । सुलीनें होतीं ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: grīṣmācyā atirasīṃ| sabījeṃ tṛṇeṃ jaisīṃ| māgutī bhūmīsī | sulīneṃ hotīṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: Just as during the intense heat of summer, seeds and grass merge back into the earth, so too do they become dormant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां वार्षिये ढेंढें फिटे । जेव्हां शारदीयेचा अनुघडु फुटे । तेव्हां घनजात आटे । गगनींचें गगनीं ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ vārṣiye ḍheṃḍheṃ phiṭe | jevhāṃ śāradīyecā anughaḍu phuṭe | tevhāṃ ghanajāta āṭe | gaganīṃceṃ gaganīṃ || 2||
verses.meaning: When the autumn clouds burst forth, the monsoon's heavy downpour ceases. Then, the dense clouds dissipate, and the sky becomes clear, remaining as it is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी आकाशाचे खोंपे। वायु निवांतुचि लोपे। कां तरंगता हारपे। जळीं जेवीं ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī ākāśāce khoṃpe| vāyu nivāṃtuci lope| kāṃ taraṃgatā hārape| jaḻīṃ jevīṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: Or, just as the wind peacefully merges into the vastness of space, or as a wave disappears into the water, so too does the individual soul merge into the Supreme Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा जागिनल्यि वेळे । स्वप्न मनींचें मनीं मावळे । तैसें प्राकृत प्रकृतीं मिळे । कल्पक्षयीं ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā jāginalyi veḻe | svapna manīṃceṃ manīṃ māvaḻe | taiseṃ prākṛta prakṛtīṃ miḻe | kalpakṣayīṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: Or, just as a dream, born in the mind, dissolves back into the mind upon waking, so too does the manifest world merge back into its fundamental nature at the end of a cosmic cycle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग कल्पादीं पुढती । मीचि सूजीं ऐसी बदंती। तरी इयेविषयीं निरुती। उपपत्ती आइक ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kalpādīṃ puḍhatī | mīci sūjīṃ aisī badaṃtī| tarī iyeviṣayīṃ nirutī| upapattī āika || 5||
verses.meaning: Then, at the beginning of the next creation, I alone create again, so it is said. Now, listen to the clear explanation regarding this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी हेचि प्रकृती किरीटी । मी स्वकीया सहजें अधिष्ठीं । तेथ तंतुसमवाय पटीं । जेंबि विणावणी दिसे ॥ ६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī heci prakṛtī kirīṭī | mī svakīyā sahajeṃ adhiṣṭhīṃ | tetha taṃtusamavāya paṭīṃ | jeṃbi viṇāvaṇī dise || 6 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, I effortlessly preside over this very nature, just as the weaving appears in a cloth due to the combination of threads.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तिये विणावणीचेनि आधारें।॥ लहाना चौकडियां पटत्व भरे। तैसी पंचात्मकें आकारें। प्रकृतीचि होय॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tiye viṇāvaṇīceni ādhāreṃ||| lahānā caukaḍiyāṃ paṭatva bhare| taisī paṃcātmakeṃ ākāreṃ| prakṛtīci hoya|| 7||
verses.meaning: Then, supported by that entreaty, just as a small thread fills the entire cloth, so too does Prakriti (primordial nature) take on a five-element form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेसें विरजणियाचेनि संगें। दूधच आटेजों लागे। तैशी प्रकृति आंगा रिगे। सृष्टिपणाचिया ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeseṃ virajaṇiyāceni saṃgeṃ| dūdhaca āṭejoṃ lāge| taiśī prakṛti āṃgā rige| sṛṣṭipaṇāciyā || 8||
verses.meaning: Just as milk, by coming into contact with a starter, begins to curdle, so too does Prakriti (primordial nature) enter the body, giving rise to the state of creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बीज जळाची जवळीक लाहे । आणि तेंचि शाखोपशाखीं होये । तैसें मज करणें आहे । भूतांचे हें ॥ ९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: bīja jaḻācī javaḻīka lāhe | āṇi teṃci śākhopaśākhīṃ hoye | taiseṃ maja karaṇeṃ āhe | bhūtāṃce heṃ || 9 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a seed, upon contact with water, sprouts into branches and sub-branches, so too is my creation of all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा नगर हें रायें केलें । या म्हणणया साचपण कौर आलें। परि निरुतें पाहतां काय शिणले। रायाचे हात॥ ११०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā nagara heṃ rāyeṃ keleṃ | yā mhaṇaṇayā sācapaṇa kaura āleṃ| pari niruteṃ pāhatāṃ kāya śiṇale| rāyāce hāta|| 110||
verses.meaning: If it is said that a king built a city, how can this statement be true? For, if one looks closely, were the king's hands truly tired from the labor?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मी प्रकृती अधिष्ठीं तें कैसें । जैसा स्वप्नीं जो असे। मग तोचि प्रवेशे। जागृतावस्थे ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mī prakṛtī adhiṣṭhīṃ teṃ kaiseṃ | jaisā svapnīṃ jo ase| maga toci praveśe| jāgṛtāvasthe || 11||
verses.meaning: And how do I reside in Prakriti (primordial nature)? Just as one who is in a dream, then enters the waking state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी स्वप्नौनि जागृती येतां। काय 'पाय दुखती पंडुसुता । कीं स्वप्नामाजीं असतां । प्रवासु होय ॥१२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī svapnauni jāgṛtī yetāṃ| kāya 'pāya dukhatī paṃḍusutā | kīṃ svapnāmājīṃ asatāṃ | pravāsu hoya ||12||
verses.meaning: When one awakens from a dream, do their feet ache, O son of Pandu? Or does the journey truly happen while one is in the dream?

verses.shloka_devanagari: १६२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी या आधघवियाचा अभिप्राबो कायी। जे हें भूतसृष्टीचें कांहीं। मज एकही करणें नाहीं। ऐसाचि अर्थ ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: 162 śrījñāneśvarī yā ādhaghaviyācā abhiprābo kāyī| je heṃ bhūtasṛṣṭīceṃ kāṃhīṃ| maja ekahī karaṇeṃ nāhīṃ| aisāci artha || 13||
verses.meaning: What is the essence of this primordial ovi of Shri Dnyaneshwari? It is that I have no role in the creation of this world of beings; such is the meaning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी रायें अधिष्ठिली प्रजा । व्यापारे आपुलालिया काजा । तैसा प्रकृतीसंगु हा माझा । येर करणें तें इयेचें ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī rāyeṃ adhiṣṭhilī prajā | vyāpāre āpulāliyā kājā | taisā prakṛtīsaṃgu hā mājhā | yera karaṇeṃ teṃ iyeceṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Just as subjects, established by the king, engage in their own affairs, so too is this association with Prakriti (nature) mine, and all actions are hers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां पूर्णचंद्राचिये भेटी । समुद्री अपार भरतें दाटी । तेथ चंद्रासि काय किरीटी । उपखा पडे॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ pūrṇacaṃdrāciye bheṭī | samudrī apāra bharateṃ dāṭī | tetha caṃdrāsi kāya kirīṭī | upakhā paḍe|| 15||
verses.meaning: Behold, when the full moon appears, the ocean swells with an immense tide. What effort, O Kiriti, does the moon exert for this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जड परि जवळिका। लोह चळे तरि चळो कां। तरि कवणु शीणु भ्रामका। सन्निधानाचा॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaḍa pari javaḻikā| loha caḻe tari caḻo kāṃ| tari kavaṇu śīṇu bhrāmakā| sannidhānācā|| 16||
verses.meaning: If a heavy iron moves due to proximity, why should the magnet be troubled by its presence?

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना यापरी। मी निजप्रकृति अंगिकारीं। आणि भूतसृष्टी एकसरी। प्रसवोंचि लागे॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā yāparī| mī nijaprakṛti aṃgikārīṃ| āṇi bhūtasṛṣṭī ekasarī| prasavoṃci lāge|| 17||
verses.meaning: Indeed, in this manner, I embrace My own nature, and the entire creation of beings begins to manifest simultaneously.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो हा भूतग्रामु आघवा । असे प्रकृतिआधीन पांडवा। जैसी बीजाचिया वेळपालवा। समर्थ भूमि॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo hā bhūtagrāmu āghavā | ase prakṛtiādhīna pāṃḍavā| jaisī bījāciyā veḻapālavā| samartha bhūmi|| 18||
verses.meaning: All this multitude of beings, O Pandava, is subject to Prakriti, just as the sprouts and shoots of seeds are dependent on the earth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरि बाळादिकां वयसा । गोसावी देहसंगु जैसा। अथवा घनावळी आकाशा । वार्षिये जेवीं॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātari bāḻādikāṃ vayasā | gosāvī dehasaṃgu jaisā| athavā ghanāvaḻī ākāśā | vārṣiye jevīṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: Or, just as a child's age is associated with the body, or as clouds are associated with the sky during the rainy season.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां स्वप्नासि कारण निद्रा। तैसी प्रकृती हे नरेंद्रा। या अशेषाहि भूतसमुद्रा । गोसाविणी गा॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ svapnāsi kāraṇa nidrā| taisī prakṛtī he nareṃdrā| yā aśeṣāhi bhūtasamudrā | gosāviṇī gā|| 120||
verses.meaning: Just as sleep is the cause of dreams, so too, O King, is this Prakriti (primordial nature) the mistress of this entire ocean of beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्थावरा आणि जंगमा। स्थूळा अथवा सूक्ष्मा। हे असो भूतग्रामा। प्रकतिचि मूळ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: sthāvarā āṇi jaṃgamā| sthūḻā athavā sūkṣmā| he aso bhūtagrāmā| prakatici mūḻa|| 21||
verses.meaning: Whether it be the unmoving or the moving, the gross or the subtle, all these beings originate from the fundamental nature of Prakriti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भूतें हन सृजावीं। कां सूजिलीं प्रतिपाळावीं। इयें करणीं न येती आघवीं । आमुचिया आंगा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhūteṃ hana sṛjāvīṃ| kāṃ sūjilīṃ pratipāḻāvīṃ| iyeṃ karaṇīṃ na yetī āghavīṃ | āmuciyā āṃgā|| 22||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whether to create beings, or to sustain those already created, all these actions do not fall upon Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जळीं चंद्रिकेचिया पसरती वेली। ते वाढी चंद्रें नाहीं वाढविली । तेविं मातें 'पाबोनि ठेलीं। दूरी कर्मे ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaḻīṃ caṃdrikeciyā pasaratī velī| te vāḍhī caṃdreṃ nāhīṃ vāḍhavilī | teviṃ māteṃ 'pāboni ṭhelīṃ| dūrī karme || 23||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon's reflection spreads on the water, but the moon itself does not grow with it, so too, actions remain distant from me, having been nourished by me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सुटलिया सिंधुजळाचा लोटु। न शके धरूं सैंधवाचा घाटु । तेविं सकळ कर्मा मीचि शेवटु। तीं काय बांधती मातें॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi suṭaliyā siṃdhujaḻācā loṭu| na śake dharūṃ saiṃdhavācā ghāṭu | teviṃ sakaḻa karmā mīci śevaṭu| tīṃ kāya bāṃdhatī māteṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: Just as a dam of salt cannot hold back the surging waters of the ocean, so too, all actions, of which I am the ultimate end, cannot bind Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: धूग्ररजांची पिंजरीं। वाजतिया वायूतें जरी होकारी। कां सूर्यबिंबामाझारीं । आंधारें शिरे॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: dhūgrarajāṃcī piṃjarīṃ| vājatiyā vāyūteṃ jarī hokārī| kāṃ sūryabiṃbāmājhārīṃ | āṃdhāreṃ śire|| 25||
verses.meaning: Can darkness enter the sun's orb, or can a cage of smoke and dust contain the wind?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो पर्वताचिये हृदयींचें । जेविं पर्जन्यधारास्तब न खोंचे । तेविं कर्मजात प्रकृतीचें। न लगे मज॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso parvatāciye hṛdayīṃceṃ | jeviṃ parjanyadhārāstaba na khoṃce | teviṃ karmajāta prakṛtīceṃ| na lage maja|| 26||
verses.meaning: Just as a mountain's heart is untouched by the torrents of rain, so too am I unaffected by the actions born of Prakriti (material nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं इये प्रकृतिविकारीं। एकु मीचि असे अवधारीं । परि उदासीनाचिया परी । करीं ना करवीं ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ iye prakṛtivikārīṃ| eku mīci ase avadhārīṃ | pari udāsīnāciyā parī | karīṃ nā karavīṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: In reality, I alone exist in these transformations of nature, but I neither act nor cause action, like one who is indifferent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा दीपु ठेविला परिवरीं। कवणातें नियमी ना निवारी। आणि कवण 'कवणिये व्यापारीं। राहाटे तेंहि नेणें॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā dīpu ṭhevilā parivarīṃ| kavaṇāteṃ niyamī nā nivārī| āṇi kavaṇa 'kavaṇiye vyāpārīṃ| rāhāṭe teṃhi neṇeṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp placed in a house neither controls nor restrains anyone, nor does it know what business anyone is engaged in.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो जैसा कां साक्षिभूतु। गृहव्यापारप्रवृत्तिहेतु । तैसा भूतकर्मी अनासक्तु । मी भूतीं असें ॥२९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to jaisā kāṃ sākṣibhūtu| gṛhavyāpārapravṛttihetu | taisā bhūtakarmī anāsaktu | mī bhūtīṃ aseṃ ||29||
verses.meaning: Just as a witness, though not involved, is the cause of household activities, so too am I present in all beings, yet unattached to their actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा एकच्यि अभिप्राबो पुढतपुढती। काय सांगों बहुतां उपपत्तीं। येथ एकहेळां सुभद्रापती। येतुलें जाण पां॥ १३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ekacyi abhiprābo puḍhatapuḍhatī| kāya sāṃgoṃ bahutāṃ upapattīṃ| yetha ekaheḻāṃ subhadrāpatī| yetuleṃ jāṇa pāṃ|| 130||
verses.meaning: This is the one and only intention, repeatedly expressed. Why should I explain with many examples? Know that the husband of Subhadra (Arjuna) understands this all at once.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे लोकचेष्टां समस्तां। जैसा निमित्तमात्र कां सविता । तैसा जगत्प्रभवीं पंडुसुता। हेतु मी जाणें॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: je lokaceṣṭāṃ samastāṃ| jaisā nimittamātra kāṃ savitā | taisā jagatprabhavīṃ paṃḍusutā| hetu mī jāṇeṃ|| 31||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun is merely the cause of all worldly activities, so too, O son of Pandu, know that I am the sole cause of the world's creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जें मियां अधिष्ठिलिया प्रकृती । होती चराचराचिया संभूती । म्हणौनि मी हेतु हे उपपत्ती । घडे यया ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jeṃ miyāṃ adhiṣṭhiliyā prakṛtī | hotī carācarāciyā saṃbhūtī | mhaṇauni mī hetu he upapattī | ghaḍe yayā || 32||
verses.meaning: Because it is through My presence in Prakriti (primordial nature) that all animate and inanimate beings come into existence. Therefore, it is fitting that I am considered the cause of this creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां येणें उजिवडें निरुतें। न्याहाळीं पां ऐश्वर्ययोगातें । जे माझ्या ठायीं भूतें । परी भूतीं मी नसें॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yeṇeṃ ujivaḍeṃ niruteṃ| nyāhāḻīṃ pāṃ aiśvaryayogāteṃ | je mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ bhūteṃ | parī bhūtīṃ mī naseṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: Now, with this illumination, clearly perceive the yoga of divine power: that all beings reside within Me, yet I do not reside within them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा भूतें ना माझ्या ठायीं । आणि भूतांमाजि मी नाहीं॥ या खुणा तूं कहीं। चुको नको॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā bhūteṃ nā mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ | āṇi bhūtāṃmāji mī nāhīṃ|| yā khuṇā tūṃ kahīṃ| cuko nako|| 34||
verses.meaning: Or, beings are not in Me, and I am not in beings. Do not ever miss these subtle points.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें सर्वस्व आमुचें गूढ । परि दाविलें तुज उघड । आतां इंद्रियां देऊनि कवाड । हृदयीं भोगीं ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ sarvasva āmuceṃ gūḍha | pari dāvileṃ tuja ughaḍa | ātāṃ iṃdriyāṃ deūni kavāḍa | hṛdayīṃ bhogīṃ || 35||
verses.meaning: This entire secret of ours, though profound, has been revealed openly to you. Now, close the doors of your senses and experience it within your heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा दंशु जंब न ये हातां। तंव माझें साचोकारपण पार्था । न संपडे गा सर्वथा । जेबिं तुषीं कणु॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā daṃśu jaṃba na ye hātāṃ| taṃva mājheṃ sācokārapaṇa pārthā | na saṃpaḍe gā sarvathā | jebiṃ tuṣīṃ kaṇu|| 36||
verses.meaning: As long as this bite (of illusion) does not come into your hands, my true nature, O Partha, will never be fully grasped by you, just as a grain is not found in chaff.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं अनुमानाचेनि पैसें। आवडे कौर कळलें ऐसें। परि मृगजळाचेनि बोलांशें। काय भूमि तिमे॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ anumānāceni paiseṃ| āvaḍe kaura kaḻaleṃ aiseṃ| pari mṛgajaḻāceni bolāṃśeṃ| kāya bhūmi time|| 37||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, by mere inference, it might seem as if one has understood, but can the earth ever be moistened by the mere talk of a mirage?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें जाळ जळीं पांगिलें। तेथ चंद्रबिंब दिसे आतुडलें। परि थडिये काढूनि झाडिलें। तेव्हां बिंब कें सांगैं॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ jāḻa jaḻīṃ pāṃgileṃ| tetha caṃdrabiṃba dise ātuḍaleṃ| pari thaḍiye kāḍhūni jhāḍileṃ| tevhāṃ biṃba keṃ sāṃgaiṃ|| 38||
verses.meaning: When a net is cast into the water, the moon's reflection appears caught within it. But if you pull the net to the shore and shake it out, where then is the moon's reflection?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें बोलळवरी वाचाबळें। वायांचि झकविजती प्रतीतीचे डोळे । मग साचोकारें बोधावेळे। आधि ना होइजे॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ bolaḻavarī vācābaḻeṃ| vāyāṃci jhakavijatī pratītīce ḍoḻe | maga sācokāreṃ bodhāveḻe| ādhi nā hoije|| 39||
verses.meaning: Similarly, by the mere power of words, the eyes of experience are needlessly deluded. Then, at the time of true realization, one does not attain the primordial state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना भवा बिहाया। आणि साचें चाड आधि जरी मियां। तरि तूं गा उपपत्ती इया। जतन कीजे॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā bhavā bihāyā| āṇi sāceṃ cāḍa ādhi jarī miyāṃ| tari tūṃ gā upapattī iyā| jatana kīje|| 140||
verses.meaning: Indeed, if you fear worldly existence and truly desire the ultimate truth, then you must carefully preserve this knowledge of the divine origin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं दिठी वेधली कवळें। तें चांदणियातें म्हणे पिंवळें । तेविं माझ्या स्वरूपीं निर्मळें । देखती दोष॥ ४९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ diṭhī vedhalī kavaḻeṃ| teṃ cāṃdaṇiyāteṃ mhaṇe piṃvaḻeṃ | teviṃ mājhyā svarūpīṃ nirmaḻeṃ | dekhatī doṣa|| 49 ||
verses.meaning: Just as an eye afflicted with jaundice perceives the moonlight as yellow, similarly, those with a flawed vision see defects in my pure form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी ज्वरें विटाळलें मुख तें दुधातें म्हणे कडू विख। तेविं अमानुषा मानुष। मानिती मातें ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī jvareṃ viṭāḻaleṃ mukha teṃ dudhāteṃ mhaṇe kaḍū vikha| teviṃ amānuṣā mānuṣa| mānitī māteṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: Just as a mouth tainted by fever finds milk bitter and poisonous, so too do those who are not truly human consider me, the divine, to be merely human.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि पुढतपुढती धनंजया । झणें विसंबसी या अभिप्राया। जे इया स्थूलदृष्टी वायां । जाइजेळ गा॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni puḍhatapuḍhatī dhanaṃjayā | jhaṇeṃ visaṃbasī yā abhiprāyā| je iyā sthūladṛṣṭī vāyāṃ | jāijeḻa gā|| 43||
verses.meaning: Therefore, again and again, O Dhananjaya, do not forget this profound truth, lest by this superficial understanding, you go astray.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं स्थूलदृष्टी देखती मातें। तेंचि न देखणें जाण निरुतें। जैसें स्वप्नींचेनि अमृतें । अमरा नोहीजे॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ sthūladṛṣṭī dekhatī māteṃ| teṃci na dekhaṇeṃ jāṇa niruteṃ| jaiseṃ svapnīṃceni amṛteṃ | amarā nohīje|| 44||
verses.meaning: Those who perceive Me with their gross vision, truly do not perceive Me at all. Just as one does not become immortal by the nectar seen in a dream.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं स्थूलदृष्टी मूढ । मातें जाणती कौर दृढ। परि तें १६४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जाणणेंचि जाणणेया आड। रिगोनि ठाके॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ sthūladṛṣṭī mūḍha | māteṃ jāṇatī kaura dṛḍha| pari teṃ 164 śrījñāneśvarī jāṇaṇeṃci jāṇaṇeyā āḍa| rigoni ṭhāke|| 45||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, those with a gross intellect firmly believe they know Me, but that very knowing becomes an obstacle to true knowing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा नक्षत्राचिया आभासा-। साठीं घातु झाला तया हंसा। माजीं रतनबुद्धीचिया आशा । रिगोनियां॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā nakṣatrāciyā ābhāsā-| sāṭhīṃ ghātu jhālā tayā haṃsā| mājīṃ ratanabuddhīciyā āśā | rigoniyāṃ|| 46||
verses.meaning: Just as a swan, deceived by the illusion of stars, plunges into the water hoping to find jewels.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांगैं गंगा या बुद्धी मृगजळ । ठाकोनि आलियाचें कवण 'फळ । काय सुरतरु म्हणौनि बाबुळ। सेविलळी करी ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃgaiṃ gaṃgā yā buddhī mṛgajaḻa | ṭhākoni āliyāceṃ kavaṇa 'phaḻa | kāya surataru mhaṇauni bābuḻa| sevilaḻī karī || 47||
verses.meaning: Tell me, if one mistakes a mirage for the Ganga, what fruit will come from reaching it? Will a babul tree, simply because it is called a wish-fulfilling tree, yield sweet fruit?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हार निळयाचाचि दुसरा। या बुद्धी हातु घातला विखारा। कां रत्ने म्हणौनि गारा । वेंचि जेंबीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāra niḻayācāci dusarā| yā buddhī hātu ghātalā vikhārā| kāṃ ratne mhaṇauni gārā | veṃci jeṃbīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: It is like someone who, mistaking a garland of blue sapphires for a poisonous snake, reaches out to touch it, or like someone who, thinking they are precious gems, gathers ordinary pebbles into their pocket.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा निधान हें प्रगटलें। म्हणौनि खदिरांगार खोळे भरिले। कां साउली नेणतां घातलें। कुहां सिंहें ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā nidhāna heṃ pragaṭaleṃ| mhaṇauni khadirāṃgāra khoḻe bharile| kāṃ sāulī neṇatāṃ ghātaleṃ| kuhāṃ siṃheṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: Or, as if a treasure was revealed, and one filled their lap with acacia charcoal. Or, unknowingly, a lion was thrown into a well.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं मी म्हणौनि प्रपंची । जिहीं बुडी दिधली कृतनिश्चयाची । तिहीं चंद्रासाठीं जेवीं जळींची । प्रतिमा धरिली ॥ ९१५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ mī mhaṇauni prapaṃcī | jihīṃ buḍī didhalī kṛtaniścayācī | tihīṃ caṃdrāsāṭhīṃ jevīṃ jaḻīṃcī | pratimā dharilī || 9150||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who, saying "I am the doer," have plunged into worldly affairs with firm resolve, are like those who try to grasp the moon's reflection in the water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा कृतनिश्चयो वायां गेला । जैसा कोण्ही एकु कांजी प्याला। मग परिणाम पाहों लागला। अमृताचा ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā kṛtaniścayo vāyāṃ gelā | jaisā koṇhī eku kāṃjī pyālā| maga pariṇāma pāhoṃ lāgalā| amṛtācā || 51||
verses.meaning: Just as someone who has drunk sour gruel then seeks the taste of nectar, so too does one who has made a firm resolve and then abandoned it, lose out.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें स्थूलाकारीं नाशिवंतें।॥ भरंवसा बांधोनि चित्तें। पाहती मज अविनाशातें। तरि कैंचा दिसें॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sthūlākārīṃ nāśivaṃteṃ||| bharaṃvasā bāṃdhoni citteṃ| pāhatī maja avināśāteṃ| tari kaiṃcā diseṃ|| 52||
verses.meaning: In the same way, if one places their trust in the perishable, gross form with their mind, and then seeks Me, the imperishable, how can I be seen?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आगा काइ पश्‍चिमसमुद्राचिया तटा । निघिजत आहे पूर्विलिया वाटा। कां कोंडा कांडतां सुभटा। कणु आतुडे॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āgā kāi paś‍cimasamudrāciyā taṭā | nighijata āhe pūrviliyā vāṭā| kāṃ koṃḍā kāṃḍatāṃ subhaṭā| kaṇu ātuḍe|| 53||
verses.meaning: Oh, can one reach the western shore by traveling the eastern path? Or can one find grain by pounding chaff?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें विकारलें हें स्थूळ । जाणितलेया मी जाणवतसें केवळ। काई फेण पितां जळ। सेविलें होय ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ vikāraleṃ heṃ sthūḻa | jāṇitaleyā mī jāṇavataseṃ kevaḻa| kāī pheṇa pitāṃ jaḻa| sevileṃ hoya || 54||
verses.meaning: Just as this gross body is known to be afflicted, so too am I known purely. Is foam consumed when one drinks water?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मोहिळेंनि मनोधर्मे। हेंचि मी मानूनि संभ्रमें। मग येथिंची जियें जन्मकरमे । तियें मजचि म्हणति ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mohiḻeṃni manodharme| heṃci mī mānūni saṃbhrameṃ| maga yethiṃcī jiyeṃ janmakarame | tiyeṃ majaci mhaṇati || 55||
verses.meaning: Therefore, with a deluded mind, I mistakenly believe this to be myself. Then, whatever births and actions occur here, they are attributed to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलेनि अनामा नाम । मज अक्रियासि कर्म। विदेहासि देहधर्म। आरोपिती ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetuleni anāmā nāma | maja akriyāsi karma| videhāsi dehadharma| āropitī || 56 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, they attribute name to Me, the nameless; action to Me, the actionless; and the attributes of the body to Me, the bodiless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज आकारणून्या आकारु । निरुपाधिका उपचारु । मग विधिवर्जिता व्यवहारु । आचारादिक॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja ākāraṇūnyā ākāru | nirupādhikā upacāru | maga vidhivarjitā vyavahāru | ācārādika|| 57||
verses.meaning: To give me form, to give me a form, is a treatment for the formless. Then, for that which is devoid of rituals, there are practices like prescribed conduct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज वर्णहीना वर्णु। गुणातीतासि गुणु) मज अचरणा चरणु। अपाणिया 'पाणी॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja varṇahīnā varṇu| guṇātītāsi guṇu) maja acaraṇā caraṇu| apāṇiyā 'pāṇī|| 58||
verses.meaning: How can I, who am without attributes, describe You who are beyond all attributes? How can I, who am without feet, approach You who are without feet? How can I, who am without hands, offer water to You who are without hands?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज अमेया मान। सर्वगतासी स्थान। जैसें सेजेमाजीं बन। निदेला देखे ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja ameyā māna| sarvagatāsī sthāna| jaiseṃ sejemājīṃ bana| nidelā dekhe || 59||
verses.meaning: I am immeasurable, the abode of all. Just as a forest is seen to be asleep within its seed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें अश्रवणा श्रोत्र। मज अचक्षूसी नेत्र । अगोत्रा गोत्र । अरूपा रूप॥ १६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ aśravaṇā śrotra| maja acakṣūsī netra | agotrā gotra | arūpā rūpa|| 160||
verses.meaning: Just as for the one without ears, I am the ears; for the one without eyes, I am the eyes; for the one without lineage, I am the lineage; and for the formless, I am the form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज अव्यक्तासी व्यक्‍ती । अनार्तासी आरती । स्वयंतृप्ता तृप्ती । भाविती गा॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja avyaktāsī vyak‍tī | anārtāsī āratī | svayaṃtṛptā tṛptī | bhāvitī gā|| 61||
verses.meaning: They attribute form to Me, the formless; they offer worship to Me, who needs none; they offer satisfaction to Me, the self-satisfied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज अनावरणा प्रावरण । भूषणातीतासि भूषण । मज सकळ कारणा कारण। देखती ते॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja anāvaraṇā prāvaraṇa | bhūṣaṇātītāsi bhūṣaṇa | maja sakaḻa kāraṇā kāraṇa| dekhatī te||62||
verses.meaning: They see Me as the covering for the uncovered, the ornament for the unadorned, the cause of all causes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज सहजातें करिती। स्वयंभातें प्रतिष्ठिती। निरंतरातें आव्हानिती। विसर्जिती गा॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja sahajāteṃ karitī| svayaṃbhāteṃ pratiṣṭhitī| niraṃtarāteṃ āvhānitī| visarjitī gā||63||
verses.meaning: They effortlessly make me their companion, establish me as self-existent, invoke me as the eternal, and finally merge into me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी सर्वदा स्वतःसिद्धु। तो कीं बाळ तरुण वृद्धु। मज एकरूपा संबंधु। जाणती ऐसे ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī sarvadā svataḥsiddhu| to kīṃ bāḻa taruṇa vṛddhu| maja ekarūpā saṃbaṃdhu| jāṇatī aise || 64||
verses.meaning: I am eternally self-existent. How then can I be a child, youth, or old man? Those who truly know me understand that I am of one unchanging form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज अद्वैतासि दुजें। मज अकर्तयासि काजें। मी अभोक्ता कीं भुंजें। ऐसें म्हणती ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja advaitāsi dujeṃ| maja akartayāsi kājeṃ| mī abhoktā kīṃ bhuṃjeṃ| aiseṃ mhaṇatī || 65 ||
verses.meaning: They say, "How can there be a second to Me, who am non-dual? How can there be action for Me, who am actionless? How can I, who am not an enjoyer, experience enjoyment?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज अकुळाचें कुळ वानिती। मज नित्याचेनि निधनें शिणती। मज सर्वांतरातें कल्पिती। आरि मित्र गा॥६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja akuḻāceṃ kuḻa vānitī| maja nityāceni nidhaneṃ śiṇatī| maja sarvāṃtarāteṃ kalpitī| āri mitra gā||66||
verses.meaning: They speak of My family, though I have none. They grieve over My death, though I am eternal. They imagine Me as an enemy, though I am the indwelling Self of all, and a friend.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी स्वानंदाभिरामु। तया मज अनेक सुखांचा कामु। आधवाचि मी असें समु । कीं म्हणती एकदेशी॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī svānaṃdābhirāmu| tayā maja aneka sukhāṃcā kāmu| ādhavāci mī aseṃ samu | kīṃ mhaṇatī ekadeśī|| 67||
verses.meaning: I am the one who delights in My own bliss. I am the source of countless joys. I am indeed the complete and whole, yet some call Me partial.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी आत्मा एक चराचरीं। म्हणती एकाचा कैंपक्ष करीं । आणि कोपोनि एकातें मारीं । हेंचि वाढविती ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī ātmā eka carācarīṃ| mhaṇatī ekācā kaiṃpakṣa karīṃ | āṇi koponi ekāteṃ mārīṃ | heṃci vāḍhavitī || 68||
verses.meaning: I am the one Soul in all animate and inanimate beings. How then can I take sides with one, and in anger, strike another? This is what they propagate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना ऐसे समस्त । जे हे मानुषधर्म प्राकृत । तयाचि नांव मी ऐसें विपरीत । ज्ञान तयांचे ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā aise samasta | je he mānuṣadharma prākṛta | tayāci nāṃva mī aiseṃ viparīta | jñāna tayāṃce || 69||
verses.meaning: In short, all these human-like, ordinary characteristics, to call them 'I' is indeed perverse knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंब आकारु एक पुढां देखती। तंव हा देव येणें भावें भजती । मग तोचि विघडलिया टाकिती । नाहीं म्हणौनि ॥ १७० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃba ākāru eka puḍhāṃ dekhatī| taṃva hā deva yeṇeṃ bhāveṃ bhajatī | maga toci vighaḍaliyā ṭākitī | nāhīṃ mhaṇauni || 170 ||
verses.meaning: When they perceive a form before them, they worship this God with devotion. But when that very form dissolves, they abandon it, saying it no longer exists.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मातें येणें येणें प्रकारें। जाणती मनुष्य ऐसेनि आकारें। म्हणौनि ज्ञानचि तें आंधारें। ज्ञानासि करी॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: māteṃ yeṇeṃ yeṇeṃ prakāreṃ| jāṇatī manuṣya aiseni ākāreṃ| mhaṇauni jñānaci teṃ āṃdhāreṃ| jñānāsi karī|| 71||
verses.meaning: In this way, people perceive Me in such a form, and thus, that very knowledge becomes a darkness to true knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं जन्मळेचि ते मोघ। जैसें वार्षियेबीण मेघ । कां मृगजळाचे तरंग । दुरूनीचि पाहावे ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ janmaḻeci te mogha| jaiseṃ vārṣiyebīṇa megha | kāṃ mṛgajaḻāce taraṃga | durūnīci pāhāve || 72||
verses.meaning: Therefore, such births are futile, like clouds without rain, or like the waves of a mirage that should only be observed from a distance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा कोल्हेरीचे असिवार। नातरी वबोडंबरीचे अळंकार । की गंधर्वनगरीचे आवार। आभासती कां॥ ७३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā kolherīce asivāra| nātarī vaboḍaṃbarīce aḻaṃkāra | kī gaṃdharvanagarīce āvāra| ābhāsatī kāṃ|| 73 ||
verses.meaning: Or do the ornaments of a barren woman, or the city of Gandharvas, appear real?

verses.shloka_devanagari: साबरी वाढिन्नल्या सरळा। वरी फळ ना आंतु पोकळा। कां स्तन जाले गळां। शेळिये जैसें ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: sābarī vāḍhinnalyā saraḻā| varī phaḻa nā āṃtu pokaḻā| kāṃ stana jāle gaḻāṃ| śeḻiye jaiseṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Like a straight tree that grows tall but bears no fruit and is hollow inside, or like a goat with udders hanging from its neck.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें मूर्खाचें तयां जियाळें। आणि धिग्‌ कर्म तयांचें निपजलें। जैसें साबरी फळ आलें। घेपे ना दीजे ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ mūrkhāceṃ tayāṃ jiyāḻeṃ| āṇi dhig‌ karma tayāṃceṃ nipajaleṃ| jaiseṃ sābarī phaḻa āleṃ| ghepe nā dīje || 75||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the life of the ignorant is futile, and their actions are despicable, like the fruit of the prickly pear cactus, which is neither taken nor given.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग जें कांहीं ते पढिन्नळें। तें मर्कटें नारळ तोडिळे। कां आंधळ्या हातीं पडिलें। मोतीं जैसें ॥७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga jeṃ kāṃhīṃ te paḍhinnaḻeṃ| teṃ markaṭeṃ nāraḻa toḍiḻe| kāṃ āṃdhaḻyā hātīṃ paḍileṃ| motīṃ jaiseṃ ||76||
verses.meaning: Whatever was learned then, it was like a monkey breaking open a coconut, or a blind person finding a pearl.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना तयांचीं शास्त्रें । जैशीं कुमारीहातीं दिधलीं शस्त्रें कां अशौच्या मंत्रे बीजें कथिलीं ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā tayāṃcīṃ śāstreṃ | jaiśīṃ kumārīhātīṃ didhalīṃ śastreṃ kāṃ aśaucyā maṃtre bījeṃ kathilīṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Indeed, their scriptures are like weapons given into the hands of an immature girl, or like sacred mantras and seed-syllables revealed to the impure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: । तैसें ज्ञानजात तयां। आणि जें कांहीं आचरलें गा धनंजया । तें आघवेंचि गेलें वायां। जें चित्तहीन ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: | taiseṃ jñānajāta tayāṃ| āṇi jeṃ kāṃhīṃ ācaraleṃ gā dhanaṃjayā | teṃ āghaveṃci geleṃ vāyāṃ| jeṃ cittahīna || 78||
verses.meaning: Just as knowledge is born to them, and whatever they have practiced, O Dhananjaya, all of it goes to waste if it is without a focused mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं तमोगुणाची राक्षसी । जे सदबुद्धीतें ग्रासी । विवेकाचा ठावोचि पुसी । निशाचरी जे ॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ tamoguṇācī rākṣasī | je sadabuddhīteṃ grāsī | vivekācā ṭhāvoci pusī | niśācarī je ||79||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the demonic quality of Tamas devours good intellect, erasing all traces of discrimination, like a night-prowling demoness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये प्रकृती वरपडे जाले । म्हणौनि चिंतेचेनि कपोलें गेळे। वरि तामसीयेचिये पडिले। मुखामार्जी ॥ १८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye prakṛtī varapaḍe jāle | mhaṇauni ciṃteceni kapoleṃ geḻe| vari tāmasīyeciye paḍile| mukhāmārjī || 180||
verses.meaning: Thus, due to the influence of Prakriti, it became entangled in the clutches of worry and fell into the mouth of Tamas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ आशेचिये लाळे । आंतु हिंसा जीभ लोळे । तेवींचि असंतोषाचे चाकळे । अखंड चघळी ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha āśeciye lāḻe | āṃtu hiṃsā jībha loḻe | tevīṃci asaṃtoṣāce cākaḻe | akhaṃḍa caghaḻī || 89||
verses.meaning: Where the tongue of violence lolls in the saliva of desire, so too does it incessantly chew on the cud of discontent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे अनर्थाचे कानवेरी । आवाळुवें चाटीत निघे बाहेरी । जे प्रमादपर्वतींची दरी । सदाचि मातली॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je anarthāce kānaverī | āvāḻuveṃ cāṭīta nighe bāherī | je pramādaparvatīṃcī darī | sadāci mātalī|| 82||
verses.meaning: That which is the very root of calamities, that which emerges licking its lips like a demon, that which is the valley of the mountain of errors, always intoxicated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: १६६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जेथ द्वेषाचिया दाढा। खसखसां ज्ञानाचा करिती रगडा। जे अगस्ती गवसणी मूढां। स्थूलबुन्धि॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: 166 śrījñāneśvarī jetha dveṣāciyā dāḍhā| khasakhasāṃ jñānācā karitī ragaḍā| je agastī gavasaṇī mūḍhāṃ| sthūlabundhi|| 83||
verses.meaning: Where the fangs of hatred fiercely grind knowledge to dust, and where Agasti, the sage who swallowed the ocean, is but a mere covering for the foolish and dull-witted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे आसुरिये प्रकृतीचे तोंडीं। जे जाले गा भूतोंडीं। ते बुडोनि गेले कुंडी । व्यामोहाच्या ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise āsuriye prakṛtīce toṃḍīṃ| je jāle gā bhūtoṃḍīṃ| te buḍoni gele kuṃḍī | vyāmohācyā || 84||
verses.meaning: Those who are born with such demonic nature, who have become a multitude of evil spirits, they drown in the pit of delusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं तमाचिये पडिले गर्ते। न पविजतीचि विचाराचेनि हातें। हें असो ते गेले जेथें। ते शुद्धीचि नाहीं ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ tamāciye paḍile garte| na pavijatīci vicārāceni hāteṃ| heṃ aso te gele jetheṃ| te śuddhīci nāhīṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: Thus, fallen into the pit of darkness, they cannot be reached by the hand of reason. Let this be; those who have gone there, their very trace is lost.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि असोतु इयें वायाणीं। कायशीं मूर्खांची बोलणीं। वायां वाढवितां वाणी । शिणेळ हन॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni asotu iyeṃ vāyāṇīṃ| kāyaśīṃ mūrkhāṃcī bolaṇīṃ| vāyāṃ vāḍhavitāṃ vāṇī | śiṇeḻa hana|| 86||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let these foolish words be. Why bother with the talk of fools? Vainly prolonging speech will only lead to weariness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें बोलिलें देवें। तेथ जी जी म्हणितलें पांडवें। आइकें जेथ वाचा विसवे। ते साधुकथा॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ bolileṃ deveṃ| tetha jī jī mhaṇitaleṃ pāṃḍaveṃ| āikeṃ jetha vācā visave| te sādhukathā|| 87||
verses.meaning: Thus spoke the Lord, and Arjuna responded, "Yes, indeed!" Listen now to this sacred narrative, where words themselves find rest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जयाचे चोखटे मानसीं। मी होऊनि असें क्षेत्रसंन्यासी। जया निजेलियातें उपासी । वैराग्य गा॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jayāce cokhaṭe mānasīṃ| mī hoūni aseṃ kṣetrasaṃnyāsī| jayā nijeliyāteṃ upāsī | vairāgya gā|| 88||
verses.meaning: In the pure mind of such a one, I reside as a renunciate of the field of action. Even in their sleep, detachment (vairagya) serves them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचिया आस्थेचिया सदभावा। आंतु धर्म करी राणिवा। जयाचें मन ओलावा । विवेकासी॥८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāciyā āstheciyā sadabhāvā| āṃtu dharma karī rāṇivā| jayāceṃ mana olāvā | vivekāsī||89||
verses.meaning: In whose sincere devotion, righteousness reigns supreme, and whose mind is softened by discrimination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे ज्ञानगंगे नाहाळे। पूर्णता जेऊनि धाळे। जे शांतीसी आळे। पालव नवे॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je jñānagaṃge nāhāḻe| pūrṇatā jeūni dhāḻe| je śāṃtīsī āḻe| pālava nave|| 190||
verses.meaning: Those who bathe in the Ganges of knowledge, those who are fully satiated by partaking of it, they become a new sprout for peace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे परिणामा निघाले कोंभ। जे धैर्यमंडपाचे स्तंभ। जे आनंदसमुद्रीं कुंभ। चुबकळोनि भरिळे॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: je pariṇāmā nighāle koṃbha| je dhairyamaṃḍapāce staṃbha| je ānaṃdasamudrīṃ kuṃbha| cubakaḻoni bhariḻe|| 91||
verses.meaning: They are like the sprouts that emerge from the ultimate result, the pillars of the pavilion of courage, and the pitchers filled by dipping into the ocean of bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयां भक्तीची येतुली प्राप्ती। जे केवल्यातें परौतें सर म्हणती । जयांचिये लीळेमाजीं नीति। जियालळी दिसे॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃ bhaktīcī yetulī prāptī| je kevalyāteṃ parauteṃ sara mhaṇatī | jayāṃciye līḻemājīṃ nīti| jiyālaḻī dise||92||
verses.meaning: Such is the attainment of devotion for them, that they tell even liberation to step aside. In their playful actions, righteousness itself is seen to live.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे आघवांचि करणीं। लेडले शांतीचीं लेणीं । जयांचें चित्त गवसणी । व्यापका मज॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je āghavāṃci karaṇīṃ| leḍale śāṃtīcīṃ leṇīṃ | jayāṃceṃ citta gavasaṇī | vyāpakā maja|| 93||
verses.meaning: Those whose every action is adorned with the ornaments of peace, whose minds are completely absorbed in Me, the all-pervading One.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे जे महानुभाव। जे दैविये प्रकृतीचें दैव। जे जाणोनियां सर्व। स्वरूप माझें ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise je mahānubhāva| je daiviye prakṛtīceṃ daiva| je jāṇoniyāṃ sarva| svarūpa mājheṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Such great souls, who are the very essence of divine nature, truly know My complete and ultimate form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वाढतेनि प्रेमें। मातें भजती जे महात्मे । परि दुजेपण मनोधर्मे । शिवतलें नाहीं ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vāḍhateni premeṃ| māteṃ bhajatī je mahātme | pari dujepaṇa manodharme | śivataleṃ nāhīṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: Then, those great souls, with ever-increasing love, worship Me, and no duality has ever touched their minds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें मीच होऊनि पांडवा । करिती माझी सेवा । परि नवलावो तो सांगावा। असे आइक ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ mīca hoūni pāṃḍavā | karitī mājhī sevā | pari navalāvo to sāṃgāvā| ase āika || 96||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, they become Me and serve Me, but listen to this wonder.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी कौर्तनाचेनि नटनाचें । नाशिले व्यवसाय प्रायश्‍चित्तांचे । जें नामचि नाहीं पापाचें।॥ ऐसें केलळें॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kaurtanāceni naṭanāceṃ | nāśile vyavasāya prāyaś‍cittāṃce | jeṃ nāmaci nāhīṃ pāpāceṃ||| aiseṃ kelaḻeṃ|| 97||
verses.meaning: Through the dance of kirtan, the need for penance and atonement is destroyed, to the extent that the very concept of sin ceases to exist.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ॥ यमदमां अवकळा आणिली तीर्थे 'ठायावरूनि उठविलीं। यमलोकींची खुंटिली। राहाटी आघवी ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: || yamadamāṃ avakaḻā āṇilī tīrthe 'ṭhāyāvarūni uṭhavilīṃ| yamalokīṃcī khuṃṭilī| rāhāṭī āghavī || 98||
verses.meaning: The practice of Yama and Niyama (self-restraint and observances) was brought to disgrace, and holy places were uprooted from their significance. All the activities of the realm of Yama (the god of death) were brought to a halt.
