verses.shloka_devanagari: यमु म्हणे काय यमावें। दमु म्हणे कवणातें दमावें। तीर्थे म्हणती काय खावें। दोष ओखदासि नाहीं ॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yamu mhaṇe kāya yamāveṃ| damu mhaṇe kavaṇāteṃ damāveṃ| tīrthe mhaṇatī kāya khāveṃ| doṣa okhadāsi nāhīṃ ||99||
verses.meaning: Yama (the god of death) asks, "What is there to control?" Dama (self-restraint) asks, "Whom should I restrain?" Sacred places (Tirtha) ask, "What sins are there to consume?" There is no fault for the medicine (of devotion).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें माझेनि नामघोषें। नाहींचि करिती विश्वाचीं दुःखें। अवघें जगचि महासुखें। दुमदुमित भरलें॥२००॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ mājheni nāmaghoṣeṃ| nāhīṃci karitī viśvācīṃ duḥkheṃ| avagheṃ jagaci mahāsukheṃ| dumadumita bharaleṃ||200||
verses.meaning: Through the chanting of My name, the sorrows of the world are utterly destroyed. The entire world becomes filled and resounding with great joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते 'पाहांटेबीण पाहावित। अमृतेंबीण जीववित। योगेंबीण दावित। कैवल्य डोळां॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: te 'pāhāṃṭebīṇa pāhāvita| amṛteṃbīṇa jīvavita| yogeṃbīṇa dāvita| kaivalya ḍoḻāṃ|| 1||
verses.meaning: They make one see without dawn, give life without nectar, and reveal liberation to the eyes without any yogic practice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी राया रंका पाड धरूं । नेणती सानेयां थोरां कडसणी करूं । एकसरें आनंदाचें आवारु। होत जगा॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī rāyā raṃkā pāḍa dharūṃ | neṇatī sāneyāṃ thorāṃ kaḍasaṇī karūṃ | ekasareṃ ānaṃdāceṃ āvāru| hota jagā|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun does not differentiate between a king and a pauper, nor does it distinguish between the young and the old, so too does the divine joy equally embrace the entire world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कहीं एकाधेनि वैकुंठा जावें। तें तिहीं बैकुंठचचि केलें आघवें। ऐसें नामघोषगोरवें। धवळळलें विश्व ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kahīṃ ekādheni vaikuṃṭhā jāveṃ| teṃ tihīṃ baikuṃṭhacaci keleṃ āghaveṃ| aiseṃ nāmaghoṣagoraveṃ| dhavaḻaḻaleṃ viśva || 3||
verses.meaning: Some may go to Vaikuntha, but they have made the entire world into Vaikuntha itself. Thus, the whole universe is purified and brightened by the glory of chanting the Divine Name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेजें सूर्य तैसे सोज्वळ। परि तोहि अस्तवे हें किडाळ। चंद्र संपूर्ण एखादे वेळ। हे सदा पुरते॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tejeṃ sūrya taise sojvaḻa| pari tohi astave heṃ kiḍāḻa| caṃdra saṃpūrṇa ekhāde veḻa| he sadā purate|| 4||
verses.meaning: Like the sun, it is radiant, but even the sun sets, which is a flaw. The moon is full only sometimes, but this (divine light) is always complete.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मेघ उदार परी बोसरे। म्हणौनि उपमेसी न पुरे। हे निःशंकपणें सपांखरे। पंचानन ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: megha udāra parī bosare| mhaṇauni upamesī na pure| he niḥśaṃkapaṇeṃ sapāṃkhare| paṃcānana || 5||
verses.meaning: Though the clouds are generous, they are not fearless, and therefore, they are not sufficient for comparison. This lion is undoubtedly fearless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचे वाचेपुढां भोजें । नाम नाचत असे माझें । जें जन्मसहस्त्री बोळगिजे। एकवेळ यावया ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃce vācepuḍhāṃ bhojeṃ | nāma nācata ase mājheṃ | jeṃ janmasahastrī boḻagije| ekaveḻa yāvayā || 6||
verses.meaning: In whose speech My Name dances with joy, that Name which is attained only once in a thousand births.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो मी वैकुंठीं नसे। वेळु एक भानुबिंबींही न दिसें। वरी योगियांचींही मानसें। उमरडोनि जाय॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to mī vaikuṃṭhīṃ nase| veḻu eka bhānubiṃbīṃhī na diseṃ| varī yogiyāṃcīṃhī mānaseṃ| umaraḍoni jāya|| 7||
verses.meaning: I am not in Vaikuntha (Vishnu's abode), nor am I seen in the orb of the sun. Indeed, I transcend even the minds of yogis.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तयांपाशीं पांडवा । मी हारपला गिंबसावा । जेथ नामघोषु बरवा। करिती माझा॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī tayāṃpāśīṃ pāṃḍavā | mī hārapalā giṃbasāvā | jetha nāmaghoṣu baravā| karitī mājhā||8||
verses.meaning: But, O Pandava, I am lost and hidden among them, where they beautifully chant My name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसे माझ्या गुणीं धाळे। देशकाळातें विसरलळे। कौर्तनें सुखी झाळे। आपणपांचि ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaise mājhyā guṇīṃ dhāḻe| deśakāḻāteṃ visaralaḻe| kaurtaneṃ sukhī jhāḻe| āpaṇapāṃci || 9||
verses.meaning: How, by My virtues, they become absorbed, forgetting time and space, and find happiness in chanting My glories, becoming one with themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कृष्ण विष्णु हरि गोविंद। या नामाचे निखळ प्रबंध। माजी आत्मचर्चा विशद। उदंड गाती॥ २१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṛṣṇa viṣṇu hari goviṃda| yā nāmāce nikhaḻa prabaṃdha| mājī ātmacarcā viśada| udaṃḍa gātī|| 210||
verses.meaning: The pure and profound discourses on the names Krishna, Vishnu, Hari, and Govinda, extensively sing of the clear discussion of the Self within.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बहु असो यापरी । कौर्तित मातें अवधारीं । एक विचरती चराचरीं। पंडुकुमरा॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ bahu aso yāparī | kaurtita māteṃ avadhārīṃ | eka vicaratī carācarīṃ| paṃḍukumarā|| 19||
verses.meaning: Let this be enough. In this way, O Arjuna, listen to Me as I am glorified. Some contemplate Me as pervading all animate and inanimate creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आणिक ते अर्जुना) साविया बहुवा जतना। पंचप्राण मना। पाढाऊ घेउनी ॥ ९१२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āṇika te arjunā) sāviyā bahuvā jatanā| paṃcaprāṇa manā| pāḍhāū gheunī || 912||
verses.meaning: Then, O Arjuna, with great care and effort, one must bring the five vital breaths and the mind under control.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाहेरी यमनियमांची कांटी लाविली । आंतु वज्रासनाची पौळी पन्नासिली । वरी प्राणायामाचीं मांडिलीं। वाहातीं यंत्रें॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāherī yamaniyamāṃcī kāṃṭī lāvilī | āṃtu vajrāsanācī pauḻī pannāsilī | varī prāṇāyāmācīṃ māṃḍilīṃ| vāhātīṃ yaṃtreṃ|| 13||
verses.meaning: Outwardly, the fence of Yama and Niyama is erected. Within, the strong foundation of Vajrasana is laid. Above, the flowing mechanisms of Pranayama are set in motion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ उल्हाट शक्‍तीचेनि उजिवडें। मन पवनाचेनि सुरवाडें। सतरावियेचें पाणियाडें। बळीयाविलें॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha ulhāṭa śak‍tīceni ujivaḍeṃ| mana pavanāceni suravāḍeṃ| satarāviyeceṃ pāṇiyāḍeṃ| baḻīyāvileṃ|| 14||
verses.meaning: There, by the light of the power of joy, and with the delight of the mind and vital breath, the water-source of the seventeenth (kala) was made strong.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां प्रत्याहारें ख्याती केली। विकारांची सपिलीं बोहली। इंद्रियें बांधोनि आणिली । हृदयाआंतु ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ pratyāhāreṃ khyātī kelī| vikārāṃcī sapilīṃ bohalī| iṃdriyeṃ bāṃdhoni āṇilī | hṛdayāāṃtu || 95||
verses.meaning: Then, through Pratyahara, the senses, which were like wild horses, were brought under control and tied within the heart, thus subduing their unruly nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब धारणावारु दाटिन्नले। महाभूतांतें एकवटिलें। मग चतुरंग सैन्य निवटिलें। संकल्पाचे ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba dhāraṇāvāru dāṭinnale| mahābhūtāṃteṃ ekavaṭileṃ| maga caturaṃga sainya nivaṭileṃ| saṃkalpāce || 16||
verses.meaning: The darkness of ignorance thickened, the great elements were unified, and then the four-fold army of संकल्प (resolve/will) was destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयावरी जैत रे जैत । म्हणौनि ध्यानाचे निशाण वाजत। दिसे तन्मयाचें झळकत । एकछत्र॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāvarī jaita re jaita | mhaṇauni dhyānāce niśāṇa vājata| dise tanmayāceṃ jhaḻakata | ekachatra|| 97||
verses.meaning: Thus, the victory drum of meditation resounds, and the shining canopy of oneness is seen, signifying absolute triumph.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं समाधिश्रियेचा अशेखा । आत्मानुभवराज्यसुखा । पट्टाभिषेकु देखा । समरसें जाहला ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ samādhiśriyecā aśekhā | ātmānubhavarājyasukhā | paṭṭābhiṣeku dekhā | samaraseṃ jāhalā || 18||
verses.meaning: Then, through the boundless glory of samadhi, the coronation of the joy of self-realization's kingdom was accomplished with perfect oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें हें गहन। अर्जुना माझें भजन । आतां ऐकें सांगेन । १६८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जे करिती एक॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ heṃ gahana| arjunā mājheṃ bhajana | ātāṃ aikeṃ sāṃgena | 168 śrījñāneśvarī je karitī eka|| 19||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, such is the profound nature of My devotion. Now listen, I will explain it to you. This is what the Shri Dnyaneshwari does for those who truly understand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी दोन्ही पालववेरी । जैसा एक तंतू अंबरीं । तैसा मीवांचूनि चराचरीं। जाणती ना॥ २२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī donhī pālavaverī | jaisā eka taṃtū aṃbarīṃ | taisā mīvāṃcūni carācarīṃ| jāṇatī nā|| 220||
verses.meaning: Just as a single thread runs through both warp and weft, so too, without Me, there is no knowing in the animate and inanimate world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आदि ब्रह्मा करूनी। शेवटीं मशक धरूनी। माजी समस्त हें जाणोनी । स्वरूप माझें ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādi brahmā karūnī| śevaṭīṃ maśaka dharūnī| mājī samasta heṃ jāṇonī | svarūpa mājheṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: From the primordial Brahma to the smallest mosquito, know that all in between is my very own form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वाड धाकुटें न म्हणती । सजीव निर्जीब नेणती । देखिलिये वस्तु उजू लुंटिती। मीचि म्हणौनि॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vāḍa dhākuṭeṃ na mhaṇatī | sajīva nirjība neṇatī | dekhiliye vastu ujū luṃṭitī| mīci mhaṇauni|| 22||
verses.meaning: Then they do not distinguish between big and small, nor do they differentiate between living and non-living. Whatever object they see, they plunder it directly, saying, "It is I."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलें उत्तमत्व नाठवे। पुढील योग्यायोग्य नेणवे । एकसरें व्यक्तिमात्राचेनि नांवें। नमूंचि आवडे॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpuleṃ uttamatva nāṭhave| puḍhīla yogyāyogya neṇave | ekasareṃ vyaktimātrāceni nāṃveṃ| namūṃci āvaḍe|| 23||
verses.meaning: One forgets one's own excellence, and cannot discern what is proper or improper. One simply likes to be called by the name of a mere individual.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें उंचीं उदक पडिलें। तें तळवटवरी ये उगेलें। तैसें नमिजे भूतजात देखिलें। ऐसा स्वभावोचि तयांचा ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ uṃcīṃ udaka paḍileṃ| teṃ taḻavaṭavarī ye ugeleṃ| taiseṃ namije bhūtajāta dekhileṃ| aisā svabhāvoci tayāṃcā || 24||
verses.meaning: Just as water poured from a height naturally flows downwards, so too do all beings naturally bow down to those who are humble. Such is their inherent nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां फळलिया तरूची शाखा । सहजें भूमीसी उतरे देखा। तैसे जीवमात्रां अशेखां। खालावती ते॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ phaḻaliyā tarūcī śākhā | sahajeṃ bhūmīsī utare dekhā| taise jīvamātrāṃ aśekhāṃ| khālāvatī te|| 25||
verses.meaning: Just as the branch of a fruit-laden tree naturally bends towards the earth, so too do all beings, without exception, humble themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अखंड अगर्वता होऊनि असती। तयांची विनय हेचि संपत्ती) जे जयजयपमंत्रें अर्पिती। माझ्याचि ठायीं ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: akhaṃḍa agarvatā hoūni asatī| tayāṃcī vinaya heci saṃpattī) je jayajayapamaṃtreṃ arpitī| mājhyāci ṭhāyīṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: They remain in constant humility, considering modesty their true wealth. With prayers of victory and glory, they offer themselves to Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नमितां मानापमान गळाले। म्हणौनि अवचिता ते मीचि जहाले। ऐसे निरंतर मिसळळे। उपासिती ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: namitāṃ mānāpamāna gaḻāle| mhaṇauni avacitā te mīci jahāle| aise niraṃtara misaḻaḻe| upāsitī || 27||
verses.meaning: By bowing down, honor and dishonor dissolve. Thus, suddenly, they become one with Me. Those who constantly merge in this way, worship Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना हे गुरुवी भक्‍ती । सांगितली तुजप्रती । आतां ज्ञानयज्ञे यजिती । ते भक्त आइकें ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā he guruvī bhak‍tī | sāṃgitalī tujapratī | ātāṃ jñānayajñe yajitī | te bhakta āikeṃ || 28||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, I have thus explained devotion to the Guru to you. Now, listen to those devotees who worship through the sacrifice of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि भजन करिती हातवटी। तूं जाणत आहासि किरीटी। जे मागां इया गोष्टी । केलिया आम्हीं ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari bhajana karitī hātavaṭī| tūṃ jāṇata āhāsi kirīṭī| je māgāṃ iyā goṣṭī | keliyā āmhīṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: But those who worship with devotion, you know, Arjuna, that these things have been done by us before.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब आधि जी अर्जुन म्हणे। हें दैविकिया प्रसादाचें करणें । तरि काय अमृताचें आरोगणें । पुरे म्हणवे॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba ādhi jī arjuna mhaṇe| heṃ daivikiyā prasādāceṃ karaṇeṃ | tari kāya amṛtāceṃ ārogaṇeṃ | pure mhaṇave|| 230||
verses.meaning: Arjuna says, "If this (the vision of the Cosmic Form) is merely a divine blessing, then how can one say that partaking of nectar is enough?" (Meaning, a divine blessing is far superior to even nectar).

verses.shloka_devanagari: या बोला श्रीअनंतें। लागटा देखिलें तयांतें। कौं सुखावलेनि चित्तें। डोलतु असे॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā bolā śrīanaṃteṃ| lāgaṭā dekhileṃ tayāṃteṃ| kauṃ sukhāvaleni citteṃ| ḍolatu ase|| 31||
verses.meaning: Upon hearing these words, Lord Ananta (Krishna) looked at them, and with a joyful heart, He swayed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे भलें केलें पार्था। एऱ्हवीं हा अनवसरु सर्वथा । परि बोलबीतसे आस्था । तुझी मातें॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe bhaleṃ keleṃ pārthā| eṟhavīṃ hā anavasaru sarvathā | pari bolabītase āsthā | tujhī māteṃ|| 32||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, you have done well. Otherwise, this was not the opportune moment at all. But your devotion makes me speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब अर्जुन म्हणे हें कायी। चकोरेंबीण चांद्णेंचि नाहीं । जगचि निवविजे हा तयाच्या ठायीं । स्वभावो कौं जी॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba arjuna mhaṇe heṃ kāyī| cakoreṃbīṇa cāṃdṇeṃci nāhīṃ | jagaci nivavije hā tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ | svabhāvo kauṃ jī|| 33||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said, "Is it that there is no moonlight without the chakora bird? Or is it that cooling the world is simply its inherent nature?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरें चकोरें तियें आपुलिये चाडे । चांचू करिती चंद्राकडे । तेविं आम्ही विनवूं तें थोकडें। देवो कृपासिंधु ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yereṃ cakoreṃ tiyeṃ āpuliye cāḍe | cāṃcū karitī caṃdrākaḍe | teviṃ āmhī vinavūṃ teṃ thokaḍeṃ| devo kṛpāsiṃdhu || 34||
verses.meaning: Just as the chakora bird, out of its longing, turns its beak towards the moon, so too do our prayers, however small, reach the ocean of compassion that is God.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी मेघ आपुलिये प्रौढी । जगाची आर्ती दवडी । वांचूनि चातकाची ताहान केवढी । तो वर्षावो पाहुनी ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī megha āpuliye prauḍhī | jagācī ārtī davaḍī | vāṃcūni cātakācī tāhāna kevaḍhī | to varṣāvo pāhunī || 35||
verses.meaning: The cloud, in its grandeur, quenches the thirst of the entire world. What then is the thirst of a mere chataka bird, when it witnesses such a downpour?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि चुळा एकाचिया चाडे । जेविं गंगेतेंचि ठाकणें पडे । तेवीं आर्त बहु कां थोडें । तरी सांगावें देवें ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari cuḻā ekāciyā cāḍe | jeviṃ gaṃgeteṃci ṭhākaṇeṃ paḍe | tevīṃ ārta bahu kāṃ thoḍeṃ | tarī sāṃgāveṃ deveṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: Just as a single handful of water, out of love, must eventually return to the Ganges, so too, whether my devotion is great or small, I must offer it to God.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथें देवें म्हणितलें राहें। जो संतोषु आम्हां जाहला आहे । तयावरी स्तुति साहे। ऐसें उरलें नाहीं ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetheṃ deveṃ mhaṇitaleṃ rāheṃ| jo saṃtoṣu āmhāṃ jāhalā āhe | tayāvarī stuti sāhe| aiseṃ uraleṃ nāhīṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: There, the Lord said, "Stop! The contentment that has arisen within Us is so complete that there is no room left for any praise to be endured."

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं परिसतु आहासि निकियापरी। तेंचि वक्तृत्वा बऱ्हाडीक करी । ऐसें पुरस्करोनि श्रीहरी। आदरिलें बोलों ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ parisatu āhāsi nikiyāparī| teṃci vaktṛtvā baṟhāḍīka karī | aiseṃ puraskaroni śrīharī| ādarileṃ boloṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: The Lord Hari, having thus encouraged Arjuna, saying, "You are indeed a good listener, and that very quality will make your speech excellent," then began to speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि ज्ञानयज्ञु तो एवंरूपु। तेथ आदिसंकल्पु हा यूपु। महाभूतें मंडपु । भेदु तो पशु॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari jñānayajñu to evaṃrūpu| tetha ādisaṃkalpu hā yūpu| mahābhūteṃ maṃḍapu | bhedu to paśu|| 39||
verses.meaning: Such is the form of the sacrifice of knowledge: the primordial resolve is the sacrificial post, the great elements are the pavilion, and differentiation is the sacrificial animal.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पांचांचे जे विशेष गुण । अथवा इंद्रियें आणि प्राण। हेचि यज्ञोपचारभरण। अज्ञान घृत॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga pāṃcāṃce je viśeṣa guṇa | athavā iṃdriyeṃ āṇi prāṇa| heci yajñopacārabharaṇa| ajñāna ghṛta|| 240||
verses.meaning: Then, the specific qualities of the five elements, or the senses and the vital breath, these very things become the offerings in the sacrifice, with ignorance as the ghee.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ मनबुद्धीचिया कुंडा-। आंतु ज्ञानाग्नि धडफुडा । साम्य तेचि सुहाडा। वेदिका जाणें ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha manabuddhīciyā kuṃḍā-| āṃtu jñānāgni dhaḍaphuḍā | sāmya teci suhāḍā| vedikā jāṇeṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: There, in the sacrificial pit of mind and intellect, the fire of knowledge blazes forth. Know that equanimity itself is the sacred altar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सविवेकमतिपाटव । तेचि मंत्रविद्यागौरव । शांति स्त्रुक्रत्रुव । जीवु यज्वा ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: savivekamatipāṭava | teci maṃtravidyāgaurava | śāṃti strukratruva | jīvu yajvā || 42||
verses.meaning: The sharpness of a discerning intellect is the glory of the mantra-vidya (knowledge of sacred chants); peace is the sacrificial fire, and the individual soul is the sacrificer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो प्रतीतीचेनि पात्रें। विवेकमहामंत्रें। ज्ञानाग्निहोत्रें। भेदु नाशी ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to pratītīceni pātreṃ| vivekamahāmaṃtreṃ| jñānāgnihotreṃ| bhedu nāśī || 43||
verses.meaning: Through the vessel of experience, with the great mantra of discrimination, and the sacrificial fire of knowledge, he destroys all duality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अज्ञान सरोनि जाये। आणि यजिता यजन हें ठाये। आत्मसमरसीं न्हाये। अवभूथीं जेव्हां ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha ajñāna saroni jāye| āṇi yajitā yajana heṃ ṭhāye| ātmasamarasīṃ nhāye| avabhūthīṃ jevhāṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: Then ignorance vanishes, and the worshipper realizes that the act of worship itself is absorbed in the oneness of the Self, when he bathes in the complete realization of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां भूतें विषय करणें । हें वेगळालें कांहीं न म्हणे । आघवें एकचि ऐसें जाणें । आत्मबुव्द्वि॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ bhūteṃ viṣaya karaṇeṃ | heṃ vegaḻāleṃ kāṃhīṃ na mhaṇe | āghaveṃ ekaci aiseṃ jāṇeṃ | ātmabuvdvi|| 45||
verses.meaning: Then, to consider beings as objects of enjoyment, this is not seen as separate. All is known as one, through the wisdom of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा चेइला तो अर्जुना । म्हणे स्वणींची हे विचित्र सेना। मीचि जाहालों होतों ना । निद्रावशें ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā ceilā to arjunā | mhaṇe svaṇīṃcī he vicitra senā| mīci jāhāloṃ hotoṃ nā | nidrāvaśeṃ || 46 ||
verses.meaning: Just as Arjuna, the disciple, said, "This strange army of my own kin, I myself had become, as if under the sway of sleep."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां सेना ते सेना नव्हे। हें मीच एक आधचवें। ऐसें एकत्वें मानवें। विएव तया ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ senā te senā navhe| heṃ mīca eka ādhacaveṃ| aiseṃ ekatveṃ mānaveṃ| vieva tayā || 47||
verses.meaning: Now, the army is not an army; rather, I alone am the one who has become many. In this way, the many are accepted as one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तो जीवु हे भाष सरे। आब्रह्म परमात्मबोधें भरे। ऐसे भजती ज्ञानाध्वरें। एकत्वें येणें ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga to jīvu he bhāṣa sare| ābrahma paramātmabodheṃ bhare| aise bhajatī jñānādhvareṃ| ekatveṃ yeṇeṃ || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Then that individual soul, this speech ends, and it is filled with the knowledge of the Supreme Self, from Brahma. Thus, they worship through this sacrifice of knowledge, attaining oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा अनादि हें अनेक । जें आनासारिखें एका एक । आणि नामरूपादिक। तेंही विषम ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā anādi heṃ aneka | jeṃ ānāsārikheṃ ekā eka | āṇi nāmarūpādika| teṃhī viṣama || 49||
verses.meaning: Or, this beginningless and manifold creation, where each thing is unlike the other, and even its names and forms are diverse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विश्व भिन्न। परि न भेदे तयाचें ज्ञान। जैसे अवयव तरी आन आन । परि एकेचि देहींचे॥ २५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni viśva bhinna| pari na bhede tayāceṃ jñāna| jaise avayava tarī āna āna | pari ekeci dehīṃce|| 250||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the world is diverse, yet its knowledge does not differ, just as limbs are distinct but belong to the same body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां शाखा सानिया थोरा। परि आहाति एकाचिया तरुवरा। बहु रश्मि परि दिनकरा। एकाचे जेवीं ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ śākhā sāniyā thorā| pari āhāti ekāciyā taruvarā| bahu raśmi pari dinakarā| ekāce jevīṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Just as branches, whether small or large, belong to the same tree, and just as many rays emanate from a single sun, so too are all things ultimately one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं नानाविधा व्यक्‍ती । आनानें नामें आनानी वृत्ती । ऐसें जाणती भेदलां भूतीं। अभेदा मातें ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ nānāvidhā vyak‍tī | ānāneṃ nāmeṃ ānānī vṛttī | aiseṃ jāṇatī bhedalāṃ bhūtīṃ| abhedā māteṃ || 52||
verses.meaning: Just as there are various forms and different names and natures, so too do people perceive Me, the undivided, as divided among beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें वेगळालेपणें पांडवा । करिती ज्ञानयज्ञु बरवा । जे न भेदती जाणिवा । जाणते म्हणौनि॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ vegaḻālepaṇeṃ pāṃḍavā | karitī jñānayajñu baravā | je na bhedatī jāṇivā | jāṇate mhaṇauni|| 53||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, those who perform the excellent sacrifice of knowledge, do not differentiate themselves through their knowing, even though they are knowers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी जेधवां जिये ठायीं । देखती कां जें जें कांहीं। तें मीवांचूनि नाहीं । ऐसाचि बोधु॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī jedhavāṃ jiye ṭhāyīṃ | dekhatī kāṃ jeṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ| teṃ mīvāṃcūni nāhīṃ | aisāci bodhu|| 54||
verses.meaning: Whatever they see, wherever they see it, they are enlightened with the understanding that there is nothing but Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां बुडबुडा जेउता जाये। तेउतें जळचि एक तया आहे। मग विरे अथवा राहे। तऱही जळाचिमाजीं ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ buḍabuḍā jeutā jāye| teuteṃ jaḻaci eka tayā āhe| maga vire athavā rāhe| taṟahī jaḻācimājīṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Behold, wherever a bubble goes, there is only water for it. Whether it dissolves or remains, it is still within the water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां पवनें परमाणु उचलले । ते पृथ्वीपणावेगळे नाहीं १७० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी केले। आणि माघोतें जरी पडले। तरी पृथ्वीचिवरी॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ pavaneṃ paramāṇu ucalale | te pṛthvīpaṇāvegaḻe nāhīṃ 170 śrījñāneśvarī kele| āṇi māghoteṃ jarī paḍale| tarī pṛthvīcivarī|| 56||
verses.meaning: When the wind lifts particles, they are not separate from their earth-nature. And if they fall back, they fall upon the earth itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें भलतेथ भलतेणें भावें। भलतेंही हो अथवा नोहावें। परि तें मी ऐसें आघवें। होऊनि ठेले॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ bhalatetha bhalateṇeṃ bhāveṃ| bhalateṃhī ho athavā nohāveṃ| pari teṃ mī aiseṃ āghaveṃ| hoūni ṭhele|| 57||
verses.meaning: In the same way, whatever may be, in whatever way, whether it happens or not, all of that has become Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा हे जेव्हडी माझी व्याप्ती । तेव्हडीचि तयांची प्रतीती । ऐसें बहुधाकारीं वर्तती । बहुचि होउनि॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā he jevhaḍī mājhī vyāptī | tevhaḍīci tayāṃcī pratītī | aiseṃ bahudhākārīṃ vartatī | bahuci houni|| 58||
verses.meaning: As vast as My omnipresence, so too is their experience of Me. Thus, they manifest in diverse forms, becoming many.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें भानुबिंब आवडे तया । सन्मुख जैसें धनंजया। तैसे ते विश्वा यया। समोर सदा॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ bhānubiṃba āvaḍe tayā | sanmukha jaiseṃ dhanaṃjayā| taise te viśvā yayā| samora sadā|| 59||
verses.meaning: Just as the orb of the sun is always directly facing Arjuna, so too is the universe always directly facing that (divine being).

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा तयांचिया ज्ञाना। पाठी पोट नाहीं अर्जुना । वायु जैसा गगना । सर्वांगी असे॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā tayāṃciyā jñānā| pāṭhī poṭa nāhīṃ arjunā | vāyu jaisā gaganā | sarvāṃgī ase|| 260||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, their knowledge has no front or back, just as the wind pervades the entire sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मी जेतुला आघवा । तेंचि तुक तयांचिया सदभावा। तरी न करितां पांडवा । भजन जहालें॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mī jetulā āghavā | teṃci tuka tayāṃciyā sadabhāvā| tarī na karitāṃ pāṃḍavā | bhajana jahāleṃ|| 61||
verses.meaning: Just as I am entirely within them, so too is their devotion to me. Thus, O Pandava, without any formal worship, their devotion is complete.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी सकळ मीचि आहें। तरी कवणीं कें उपासिला नोहें। एथ एकें जाणणेबीण ठाये । अप्राप्तासी ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī sakaḻa mīci āheṃ| tarī kavaṇīṃ keṃ upāsilā noheṃ| etha ekeṃ jāṇaṇebīṇa ṭhāye | aprāptāsī || 62||
verses.meaning: Indeed, I am all that exists. So, by whom have I not been worshipped? Here, without this understanding, one remains unfulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तें असो येणें उचितें । ज्ञानयज्ञे यजितसांते । उपासिती मातें । तें सांगितलें॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teṃ aso yeṇeṃ uciteṃ | jñānayajñe yajitasāṃte | upāsitī māteṃ | teṃ sāṃgitaleṃ|| 63||
verses.meaning: But let that be. Those who worship Me through this proper sacrifice of knowledge, I have already described them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अखंड सकळ हें सकळां मुखीं। सहज अर्पत असे मज एकीं। कीं नेणणे यासाठीं मूर्खी। न पविजेचि मातें ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: akhaṃḍa sakaḻa heṃ sakaḻāṃ mukhīṃ| sahaja arpata ase maja ekīṃ| kīṃ neṇaṇe yāsāṭhīṃ mūrkhī| na pavijeci māteṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: All this, in everyone's mouth, is naturally offered to Me alone. But because of this ignorance, the foolish do not attain Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोचि जाणिवेचा जरी उदयो होये । तरी मुद्दळ वेदु मीचि आहें।॥ आणि तो बिधानातें जया विये। तो क्रतुही मीचि ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: toci jāṇivecā jarī udayo hoye | tarī muddaḻa vedu mīci āheṃ||| āṇi to bidhānāteṃ jayā viye| to kratuhī mīci || 65 ||
verses.meaning: If that very dawn of realization occurs, then I am the fundamental Veda itself. And the ritual that gives birth to the injunctions, that ritual too am I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तया कर्मापासूनि बरवा । जो सांगोपांगु आघवा । यज्नु प्रगटे पांडवा) तोही मी गा॥६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayā karmāpāsūni baravā | jo sāṃgopāṃgu āghavā | yajnu pragaṭe pāṃḍavā) tohī mī gā||66||
verses.meaning: Then, from that action, a beautiful, complete, and perfect sacrifice manifests, O Pandava; that too am I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वाहा मी स्वधा। सोमादि औषधी विविधा । आज्य मी समिधा मंत्रु मी हवि॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: svāhā mī svadhā| somādi auṣadhī vividhā | ājya mī samidhā maṃtru mī havi|| 67||
verses.meaning: I am Svaha, I am Svadha. I am the various medicinal herbs like Soma. I am the clarified butter, the sacrificial fuel, and the sacred mantra, I am the oblation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: होता मी हवन कौोजे। तेथ अग्नी तो स्वरूप माझें। आणि हुतक वस्तु जें जें। तेंही मीचि ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: hotā mī havana kauoje| tetha agnī to svarūpa mājheṃ| āṇi hutaka vastu jeṃ jeṃ| teṃhī mīci || 68||
verses.meaning: I am the sacrificial fire itself in the act of oblation, and whatever is offered into it, that too is Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जयाचेनि अंगसंगें। इये प्रकृतीस्तव अष्टांगें। जन्म पाविजत असे जगें॥ तो पिता मी गा॥ ६९ ।। अर्धनारीनटेशवरीं । जो पुरुष तोचि नारी । तेवीं मी चराचरीं। माताही होय ॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jayāceni aṃgasaṃgeṃ| iye prakṛtīstava aṣṭāṃgeṃ| janma pāvijata ase jageṃ|| to pitā mī gā|| 69 || ardhanārīnaṭeśavarīṃ | jo puruṣa toci nārī | tevīṃ mī carācarīṃ| mātāhī hoya || 270||
verses.meaning: By whose association, these eightfold aspects of Prakriti (nature) come into being in the world, know that I am that Father. Just as in Ardhanarishvara, the male is also the female, so too am I the Mother in all creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जाहाळलें जग जेथ राहे। जेणें जीवित वाढत आहे । तें मीवबांचूनि नोहे । आन निरुतें॥ ७१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jāhāḻaleṃ jaga jetha rāhe| jeṇeṃ jīvita vāḍhata āhe | teṃ mīvabāṃcūni nohe | āna niruteṃ|| 719||
verses.meaning: And the world, which is scorched, where it resides, by which life continues to grow, that is nothing but Me. There is no other truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें प्रकृतिपुरुषें दोन्हीं । उपजलीं जयाचिया अमनमनीं। तो पितामह त्रिभुवनीं। विश्वाचा मी॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ prakṛtipuruṣeṃ donhīṃ | upajalīṃ jayāciyā amanamanīṃ| to pitāmaha tribhuvanīṃ| viśvācā mī||72||
verses.meaning: From whose unmanifested mind both Prakriti (primordial matter) and Purusha (consciousness) arose, that grandfather of the three worlds, I am the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आधवेया जाणणेयाचिया वाटा। जया गांवा येती गा सुभटा। वेदांचिया चोहटां। वेद्य जें म्हिणिजे॥७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ādhaveyā jāṇaṇeyāciyā vāṭā| jayā gāṃvā yetī gā subhaṭā| vedāṃciyā cohaṭāṃ| vedya jeṃ mhiṇije||73||
verses.meaning: And the paths of knowing and understanding, O brave one, lead to that village which is called the knowable (Brahman) at the crossroads of the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ नानामतां बुझावणी जाहाली । एकमेकां शास्त्रांची अनोळखी फिटली। चुकलीं ज्ञानें जेथ मिळों आलीं । जें पवित्र म्हणिजे ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha nānāmatāṃ bujhāvaṇī jāhālī | ekamekāṃ śāstrāṃcī anoḻakhī phiṭalī| cukalīṃ jñāneṃ jetha miḻoṃ ālīṃ | jeṃ pavitra mhaṇije || 74||
verses.meaning: Where various opinions are reconciled, where the unfamiliarity between scriptures is removed, where mistaken understandings are corrected and united, that is called sacred.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं ब्रह्मबीजा जाहला अंकुरु । घोषध्वनीनादाकारु । तयाचें गा भुवन जो कारु। तोही मी गा॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ brahmabījā jāhalā aṃkuru | ghoṣadhvanīnādākāru | tayāceṃ gā bhuvana jo kāru| tohī mī gā|| 75||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the sprout that emerged from the seed of Brahman, taking the form of the resounding sound (Om) and the primordial vibration (Nada), and the entire universe that is its creation—that too, verily, am I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया अकाराचिये कुशीं। अक्षरें होतीं अउमकारेंसीं । जियें उपजत वेदेंसीं । उठलीं तिन्हीं ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā akārāciye kuśīṃ| akṣareṃ hotīṃ aumakāreṃsīṃ | jiyeṃ upajata vedeṃsīṃ | uṭhalīṃ tinhīṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: From the womb of the letter 'A' (Akara), the letters 'U' and 'M' (Aumkara) were born. These three, as soon as they manifested, gave rise to the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि क्रग्‌ यजुः सामु । हे तीन्ही म्हणें मी आत्मारामु। एवं मीचि कुलक्रमु। शब्दब्रह्माचा ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni krag‌ yajuḥ sāmu | he tīnhī mhaṇeṃ mī ātmārāmu| evaṃ mīci kulakramu| śabdabrahmācā || 77||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I am the very essence of Rig, Yajur, and Sama Vedas. Indeed, I am the entire lineage of the Word-Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें चराचर आधवें। जिये प्रकृतीआंत सांठवें। ते शिणली जेथ विसवे। ते परमगती मी॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ carācara ādhaveṃ| jiye prakṛtīāṃta sāṃṭhaveṃ| te śiṇalī jetha visave| te paramagatī mī|| 78||
verses.meaning: This entire animate and inanimate creation, in which nature is contained, and where it rests when weary, that supreme state am I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जयाचेनि प्रकृती जिये। जेणें अधिष्ठिली विश्‍व विये। जो येऊनि प्रकृती इये। गुणातें भोगी ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jayāceni prakṛtī jiye| jeṇeṃ adhiṣṭhilī viś‍va viye| jo yeūni prakṛtī iye| guṇāteṃ bhogī || 79||
verses.meaning: And by whom nature is enlivened, by whom the universe is sustained and brought forth, He, entering into this nature, experiences its qualities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो विश्‍वश्रियेचा भर्ता। मीचि गा एथ पंडुसुता । मी गोसावी समस्ता । त्रैलोक्याचा ॥ २८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: to viś‍vaśriyecā bhartā| mīci gā etha paṃḍusutā | mī gosāvī samastā | trailokyācā || 280||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, I am indeed the husband of the prosperity of the universe. I am the master of all, of the three worlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आकाशें सर्वत्र बसावें । वायुनें नावभरी उगें नसावें । पावकें दाहावें। वर्षावें जळें॥८९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ākāśeṃ sarvatra basāveṃ | vāyuneṃ nāvabharī ugeṃ nasāveṃ | pāvakeṃ dāhāveṃ| varṣāveṃ jaḻeṃ||891||
verses.meaning: The sky should pervade everywhere, the wind should never cease its movement, fire should burn, and water should rain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पर्वती बैसका न संडावी। समुद्री रेखा नोलांडावी । पृथ्वीया भूतें वाहावीं। हे आज्ञा माझी ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parvatī baisakā na saṃḍāvī| samudrī rekhā nolāṃḍāvī | pṛthvīyā bhūteṃ vāhāvīṃ| he ājñā mājhī || 82||
verses.meaning: Mountains should not abandon their steadfastness; the ocean should not transgress its boundaries; the earth should bear all beings—this is My command.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्यां बोलविल्या वेदु बोले म्यां चालविल्या सूर्यु चाले। म्यां हालविल्या प्राणु हाळे। जो जगातें चाळिता ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: myāṃ bolavilyā vedu bole myāṃ cālavilyā sūryu cāle| myāṃ hālavilyā prāṇu hāḻe| jo jagāteṃ cāḻitā || 83||
verses.meaning: When I speak, the Vedas speak; when I make it move, the sun moves. When I stir, the life-breath stirs; I am the one who animates the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मियांचि नियमिलासांता। काळु ग्रासितसे भूतां । इयें म्हणियागतें पंडुसुता । सकळें जयाचीं॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: miyāṃci niyamilāsāṃtā| kāḻu grāsitase bhūtāṃ | iyeṃ mhaṇiyāgateṃ paṃḍusutā | sakaḻeṃ jayācīṃ||84||
verses.meaning: I Myself have ordained that Time devours all beings. O son of Pandu, all these are but My manifestations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहीं नामरूपीं आघवा । जो भरला असे पांडवा। आणि नामरूपांचाही बोल्हावा। आपणचि जो॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃ nāmarūpīṃ āghavā | jo bharalā ase pāṃḍavā| āṇi nāmarūpāṃcāhī bolhāvā| āpaṇaci jo|| 86||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, He who pervades all these names and forms, and who Himself is the very essence of these names and forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसे जळाचे कल़लोळ। आणि कल़्लोळीं आथी जळ। ऐसेनि बसबीतसे सकळ। तो निवासु मी॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaise jaḻāce kala़loḻa| āṇi kal़loḻīṃ āthī jaḻa| aiseni basabītase sakaḻa| to nivāsu mī|| 87||
verses.meaning: Just as waves are of water, and within those waves is water itself, so too do I pervade all existence. I am that abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो मज होय अनन्य शरण । त्याचें निवारीं मी जन्ममरण । यालागीं शरणागता शरण्य। मीचि एकु ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo maja hoya ananya śaraṇa | tyāceṃ nivārīṃ mī janmamaraṇa | yālāgīṃ śaraṇāgatā śaraṇya| mīci eku || 88||
verses.meaning: One who takes refuge in Me with undivided devotion, I remove their cycle of birth and death. Therefore, for those who seek refuge, I alone am the ultimate refuge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मीचि एक अनेकपणें। वेगळालेनि प्रकृतीगुणें। जीत जगाचेनि प्राणें। वर्तत असें॥८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mīci eka anekapaṇeṃ| vegaḻāleni prakṛtīguṇeṃ| jīta jagāceni prāṇeṃ| vartata aseṃ||89||
verses.meaning: I alone, though appearing as many, through the diverse qualities of nature, exist as the very life-breath of the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा समुद्र थिल्लर न म्हणतां। भलतेथ बिंबे सविता । तैसा ब्रह्मादि सर्वा भूतां । १७२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी सुहृद तो मी॥ २९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā samudra thillara na mhaṇatāṃ| bhalatetha biṃbe savitā | taisā brahmādi sarvā bhūtāṃ | 172 śrījñāneśvarī suhṛda to mī|| 290||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun, without considering any puddle insignificant, reflects in it, so too am I, the friend of all beings, from Brahma downwards.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मीचि गा पांडवा। या त्रिभुबनासि बोलावा । सृष्टिक्षयप्रभवा। मूळ तें मी ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mīci gā pāṃḍavā| yā tribhubanāsi bolāvā | sṛṣṭikṣayaprabhavā| mūḻa teṃ mī || 91||
verses.meaning: Indeed, Pandava, I am the very call for these three worlds; I am the fundamental origin of creation, dissolution, and sustenance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बीज शाखांतें प्रसवे। मग तें रूखपण बीजीं सामावे। तैसें संकल्पें होय आघवें। पाठीं संकल्पीं मिळे॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: bīja śākhāṃteṃ prasave| maga teṃ rūkhapaṇa bījīṃ sāmāve| taiseṃ saṃkalpeṃ hoya āghaveṃ| pāṭhīṃ saṃkalpīṃ miḻe|| 92||
verses.meaning: A seed gives birth to branches, and then the tree-ness is contained within the seed. Similarly, everything comes into being through resolve, and then merges back into that resolve.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जगाचें बीज जो संकल्पु। अव्यक्त वासनारूपु। तया कल्पांतीं जेथ निक्षेपु। होय तें स्थान मी॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jagāceṃ bīja jo saṃkalpu| avyakta vāsanārūpu| tayā kalpāṃtīṃ jetha nikṣepu| hoya teṃ sthāna mī|| 93||
verses.meaning: Such is the seed of the world, the resolve, the unmanifest form of desire. That place where it is deposited at the end of the kalpa, that place am I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें नामरूपें लोटती । वर्णव्यक्ती आटती । जातीचे भेद फिटती। जें आकारू नाहीं ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ nāmarūpeṃ loṭatī | varṇavyaktī āṭatī | jātīce bheda phiṭatī| jeṃ ākārū nāhīṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: In that formless state, names and forms cease to exist, distinctions of color and individuality dissolve, and all differences of caste vanish, for it has no form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैं संकल्पवासनासंस्कार। माघोतें रचावया चराचर। जेथ राहोनि असती अमर तें निधान मी॥९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiṃ saṃkalpavāsanāsaṃskāra| māghoteṃ racāvayā carācara| jetha rāhoni asatī amara teṃ nidhāna mī||95||
verses.meaning: I am that treasure, the repository of the latent impressions of desires and intentions, from which the entire animate and inanimate creation is again fashioned, and where the immortal beings reside.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी सूर्याचेनि वेषें। तपें तें हें शोषे। पाठीं इंद्र होऊनि वर्षे । तें पुढति भरे॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī sūryāceni veṣeṃ| tapeṃ teṃ heṃ śoṣe| pāṭhīṃ iṃdra hoūni varṣe | teṃ puḍhati bhare|| 96||
verses.meaning: I, in the form of the sun, dry up the earth with my heat; then, becoming Indra, I shower rain and fill it up again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अग्नि काष्ठें खाये। तें काष्ठचि अग्नि होये । तैसें मरतें मारितें पाहें॥ स्वरूप माझें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: agni kāṣṭheṃ khāye| teṃ kāṣṭhaci agni hoye | taiseṃ marateṃ māriteṃ pāheṃ|| svarūpa mājheṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Just as fire consumes wood, and that wood itself becomes fire, so too, know that both the killer and the killed are but my own form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं मृत्यूच्या भागीं जें जें। तेंही पैं रूप माझें। आणि न मरतें तंव सहजें। मीचि आहें॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ mṛtyūcyā bhāgīṃ jeṃ jeṃ| teṃhī paiṃ rūpa mājheṃ| āṇi na marateṃ taṃva sahajeṃ| mīci āheṃ|| 98||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever is subject to death, that too is My form. And that which is immortal, that indeed am I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां बहु बोलोनि सांगावें। तें एकिहेळां घे पां आघवें। तरी सतासतही जाणावे। मीचि पैं गा॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ bahu boloni sāṃgāveṃ| teṃ ekiheḻāṃ ghe pāṃ āghaveṃ| tarī satāsatahī jāṇāve| mīci paiṃ gā|| 99||
verses.meaning: Why speak much? Understand this all at once: know that both existence and non-existence are indeed Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अर्जुना मी नसें। ऐसा कवणु ठाव असे । परि प्राणियांचें दैव कैसें। जे न देखती मातें ॥ ३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni arjunā mī naseṃ| aisā kavaṇu ṭhāva ase | pari prāṇiyāṃceṃ daiva kaiseṃ| je na dekhatī māteṃ || 300||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, is there any place where I am not present? But such is the fate of beings that they do not perceive Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरंग पाणियेवबीण सुकती। रश्मि वातीवीण न देखती । तैसे मीचि ते मी नव्हती। विस्मो देखें॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: taraṃga pāṇiyevabīṇa sukatī| raśmi vātīvīṇa na dekhatī | taise mīci te mī navhatī| vismo dekheṃ|| 1||
verses.meaning: Just as waves dry up without water, and rays cannot be seen without a lamp, so too, without Me, they are not themselves. This is a wonder I see.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें आंतबाहेर मियां कोंदलें। जग निखिल माझेंचि बोतिलें। कौं कैसें कर्म तयां आड आलें। जें मीचि नाहीं म्हणती॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ āṃtabāhera miyāṃ koṃdaleṃ| jaga nikhila mājheṃci botileṃ| kauṃ kaiseṃ karma tayāṃ āḍa āleṃ| jeṃ mīci nāhīṃ mhaṇatī|| 2||
verses.meaning: I have encompassed everything, within and without. The entire universe is my very own manifestation. How then can karma obstruct them, that they say I do not exist?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि अमृतकुहां पडिजे। कां आपणयांतें कडिये काडिजे। ऐसें आथी काय कौजे। अप्राप्तासी॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari amṛtakuhāṃ paḍije| kāṃ āpaṇayāṃteṃ kaḍiye kāḍije| aiseṃ āthī kāya kauje| aprāptāsī|| 3||
verses.meaning: Can one fall into a well of nectar, or be taken into one's own lap? Such a thing is not possible for that which is not attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ग्रासा एका अन्नासाठी । अंधु धांबताहे किरीटी। आढळला चिंतामणि पायें लोटी । आंधळेपणें ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: grāsā ekā annāsāṭhī | aṃdhu dhāṃbatāhe kirīṭī| āḍhaḻalā ciṃtāmaṇi pāyeṃ loṭī | āṃdhaḻepaṇeṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: For a single morsel of food, a blind person runs, O Kiriti (Arjuna). He unknowingly kicks away a wish-fulfilling gem with his foot, due to his blindness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें ज्ञान जैं सांडूनि जाये । तैं ऐसी हे दशा आहे। म्हणौनि कौजे तें केलें नोहे। ज्ञानेंबीण ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jñāna jaiṃ sāṃḍūni jāye | taiṃ aisī he daśā āhe| mhaṇauni kauje teṃ keleṃ nohe| jñāneṃbīṇa || 5||
verses.meaning: When knowledge departs, such a state of being arises. Therefore, nothing can be accomplished without knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंधळेया गरुडाचे पांख आहाती । ते कवणा उपेगा जाती । तैसें सत्कर्माचे उपखे ठाती । ज्ञानेंबीण ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃdhaḻeyā garuḍāce pāṃkha āhātī | te kavaṇā upegā jātī | taiseṃ satkarmāce upakhe ṭhātī | jñāneṃbīṇa || 6||
verses.meaning: What good are the wings of an eagle to a blind person? Similarly, good deeds are useless without spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देख पां गा किरीटी । आश्रमधर्माचिया राहाटी । विधिमार्गा कसवटी। जे आपणचि होती॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekha pāṃ gā kirīṭī | āśramadharmāciyā rāhāṭī | vidhimārgā kasavaṭī| je āpaṇaci hotī|| 7||
verses.meaning: Behold, Arjuna, those who themselves embody the very touchstone of the path of prescribed duties, following the conduct of the ashrama dharma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यजन करितां कौतुकें । तिहीं वेदांचा माथा तुके । क्रिया फळेंसि उभी ठाके । पुढां जयां॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yajana karitāṃ kautukeṃ | tihīṃ vedāṃcā māthā tuke | kriyā phaḻeṃsi ubhī ṭhāke | puḍhāṃ jayāṃ|| 8||
verses.meaning: When the sacrifice is performed with devotion, the essence of the three Vedas bows before it. The actions, along with their fruits, stand ready to serve those who perform it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे दीक्षित जे सोमप। जे आपणचि यज्ञाचें स्वरूप। तिहीं तया पुण्याचेनि नांवें पाप। जोडिलें देखें ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise dīkṣita je somapa| je āpaṇaci yajñāceṃ svarūpa| tihīṃ tayā puṇyāceni nāṃveṃ pāpa| joḍileṃ dekheṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Those who are initiated into the Soma sacrifice, who are themselves the embodiment of the sacrifice, they have, in the name of merit, accumulated sin, so I see.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रुतित्रयातें जाणोनि। शतवरी यज्ञ करुनी) यजिलिया मातें चुकोनि। स्वर्गु वरिती॥ ३१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrutitrayāteṃ jāṇoni| śatavarī yajña karunī) yajiliyā māteṃ cukoni| svargu varitī|| 310||
verses.meaning: Even after knowing the three Vedas, and performing hundreds of sacrifices, if they miss Me, they only attain heaven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें कल्पतरूतळवटीं। बैसोनि झोळिये देतसे गांठी । मग निदैव निघे किरीटी । दैन्यचिच करूं॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ kalpatarūtaḻavaṭīṃ| baisoni jhoḻiye detase gāṃṭhī | maga nidaiva nighe kirīṭī | dainyacica karūṃ|| 11||
verses.meaning: Just as one sits under a wish-fulfilling tree and ties knots in a sling, so too, O Kiriti, does the unfortunate one leave, having only made poverty for himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे शतक्रतु यजिलें मातें। कीं ईप्सिताति स्वर्गसुखातें। आतां पुण्य कीं हें निरुतें। पाप नोहे ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise śatakratu yajileṃ māteṃ| kīṃ īpsitāti svargasukhāteṃ| ātāṃ puṇya kīṃ heṃ niruteṃ| pāpa nohe || 12||
verses.meaning: Similarly, if Indra worships Me, desiring the joys of heaven, is this truly a virtuous act, or is it not a sin?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मजवीण पाविजे स्वर्गु। तो अज्ञानाचा पुण्यमार्गु। ज्ञानिये तयातें उपसर्गु। हानि म्हणती ॥ ९१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni majavīṇa pāvije svargu| to ajñānācā puṇyamārgu| jñāniye tayāteṃ upasargu| hāni mhaṇatī || 913||
verses.meaning: Therefore, to attain heaven without Me is a virtuous path of ignorance. The wise consider it a misfortune, a loss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी नरकींचें दुःख । 'पाबोनि स्वर्गा नाम कीं सुख वांचूनि नित्यानंद गा निर्दोख। तें स्वरूप माझें ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī narakīṃceṃ duḥkha | 'pāboni svargā nāma kīṃ sukha vāṃcūni nityānaṃda gā nirdokha| teṃ svarūpa mājheṃ || 14||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, the suffering in hell, or the so-called happiness of heaven, is not eternal bliss. That blemishless, eternal bliss is My true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज येतां पैं सुभटा । या द्विविधा गा आव्हांटा । स्वर्गु नरकु या वाटा । चोरांचिया ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja yetāṃ paiṃ subhaṭā | yā dvividhā gā āvhāṃṭā | svargu naraku yā vāṭā | corāṃciyā || 15||
verses.meaning: Oh brave warrior, when I come, these two paths, heaven and hell, are like the ways of thieves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वर्गा पुण्यात्मकें पापें येइजे। पापात्मकें पापें नरका जाइजे। मग मातें जेणें पाविजे। तें शुद्ध पुण्य॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: svargā puṇyātmakeṃ pāpeṃ yeije| pāpātmakeṃ pāpeṃ narakā jāije| maga māteṃ jeṇeṃ pāvije| teṃ śuddha puṇya|| 16||
verses.meaning: Through meritorious deeds, one attains heaven. Through sinful deeds, one goes to hell. But that by which I am attained, that is pure merit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मजचिमाजीं असतां। जेणें मी दुऱ्हावें पंडुसुता । तें पुण्य ऐसें म्हणतां। जीभ न तुटे काई॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi majacimājīṃ asatāṃ| jeṇeṃ mī duṟhāveṃ paṃḍusutā | teṃ puṇya aiseṃ mhaṇatāṃ| jībha na tuṭe kāī|| 17||
verses.meaning: And even while residing within Me, if one considers an act that separates them from Me as meritorious, will not their tongue be severed for uttering such a thing?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि हें असो आतां प्रस्तुत । ऐकें यापरि तें दीक्षित । यजूनि मातें याचित । स्वर्गभभोगु॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari heṃ aso ātāṃ prastuta | aikeṃ yāpari teṃ dīkṣita | yajūni māteṃ yācita | svargabhabhogu|| 18||
verses.meaning: But let this be for now. Hear how such a sacrificer, having worshipped Me, asks for the enjoyment of heaven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग मी न पविजे ऐसें। जें पापरूप पुण्य असे। तेणें लाधलेनि सौरसें। स्वर्गा येती ॥ ९१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mī na pavije aiseṃ| jeṃ pāparūpa puṇya ase| teṇeṃ lādhaleni sauraseṃ| svargā yetī || 919||
verses.meaning: Then, those who perform such meritorious deeds, which are in fact sinful because they do not lead to Me, attain the joys of heaven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ अमरत्व हें सिंहासन । ऐरावतासारिखें बाहन। राजधानी भुवन। अमरावती ॥ ३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha amaratva heṃ siṃhāsana | airāvatāsārikheṃ bāhana| rājadhānī bhuvana| amarāvatī || 320||
verses.meaning: Where immortality is the throne, a vehicle like Airavata, and the capital city is Amravati.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ महासिद्धींचीं भांडारें। अमृताचीं कोठारें। जिये गांबीं खिल्लारें। कामधेनूंचीं ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha mahāsiddhīṃcīṃ bhāṃḍāreṃ| amṛtācīṃ koṭhāreṃ| jiye gāṃbīṃ khillāreṃ| kāmadhenūṃcīṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: Where there are treasuries of great spiritual powers, storehouses of nectar, and herds of wish-fulfilling cows in that village.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ बोळगे देव पाइका । सैंघ चिंतामणीचिया भूमिका । वबिनोदवनवाटिका । सुरतरूंचिया ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha boḻage deva pāikā | saiṃgha ciṃtāmaṇīciyā bhūmikā | vabinodavanavāṭikā | suratarūṃciyā || 22||
verses.meaning: Where the very pebbles are like wish-fulfilling gems, and the pleasure gardens are groves of celestial trees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गंधर्व गात गाणीं । जेथ रंभेऐसिया नाचणी । उर्वशी मुख्य विलासिनी । अंतौरिया॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: gaṃdharva gāta gāṇīṃ | jetha raṃbheaisiyā nācaṇī | urvaśī mukhya vilāsinī | aṃtauriyā|| 23||
verses.meaning: Where Gandharvas sing songs, where dancers like Rambha, and Urvashi, the chief enchantress, are present in the inner chambers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मदन बोळगे शेजारें। जेथ चंद्र शिंपे सांबरें। पवना ऐसें म्हणियारें। धांवणें जेथ ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: madana boḻage śejāreṃ| jetha caṃdra śiṃpe sāṃbareṃ| pavanā aiseṃ mhaṇiyāreṃ| dhāṃvaṇeṃ jetha || 24||
verses.meaning: Where the god of love, Madana, walks alongside, where the moon sprinkles its deer, and where the wind is said to run swiftly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं बृहस्पति मुख्य आपण। ऐसे स्वस्तिश्रियेचे ब्राह्मण। ताटियेचे सुरगण । बहुवस जेथें ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ bṛhaspati mukhya āpaṇa| aise svastiśriyece brāhmaṇa| tāṭiyece suragaṇa | bahuvasa jetheṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: There, Brihaspati himself is the chief, a Brahmin of auspicious glory, and many gods are present at the feast.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लोकपाळ रांगेचे। राउत जिये पदवीचे । उच्चैःश्रवा १७४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी खांचे। खोळणिये॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: lokapāḻa rāṃgece| rāuta jiye padavīce | uccaiḥśravā 174 śrījñāneśvarī khāṃce| khoḻaṇiye|| 26||
verses.meaning: The celestial horse Uchchaihshravas, which is the mount of the guardians of the directions, is but a small niche in the Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो बहु ऐसे। भोग इंद्रसुखासरिसे। ते भोगिजती जंब असे। पुण्यळेशु॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso bahu aise| bhoga iṃdrasukhāsarise| te bhogijatī jaṃba ase| puṇyaḻeśu|| 27||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Many such enjoyments, similar to the pleasures of the senses, are experienced as long as there is a trace of merit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तया पुण्याची पाउटी सरे। सवेंचि इंद्रपणाची उटी उतरे। आणि येऊं लागती माघारे। मृत्युलोका ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayā puṇyācī pāuṭī sare| saveṃci iṃdrapaṇācī uṭī utare| āṇi yeūṃ lāgatī māghāre| mṛtyulokā || 28||
verses.meaning: Then the accumulated merit of their good deeds diminishes, and with it, their status as Indra also fades. They are then compelled to return to the mortal world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा वेश्याभोगी कवडा वेंचे । मग दारही चेपं नये तियेचें । तैसें लाजिरवाणे दीक्षितांचें। काय सांगों ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā veśyābhogī kavaḍā veṃce | maga dārahī cepaṃ naye tiyeceṃ | taiseṃ lājiravāṇe dīkṣitāṃceṃ| kāya sāṃgoṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Just as a man who frequents prostitutes, after spending his money, should not even knock on her door, so too, what can I say about the shameful state of those who perform rituals?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं थितिया मातें चुकले। जींहीं पुण्यें स्वर्ग कामिलें। तयां अमरपण तें वाबो जालें । अंतीं मृत्युलोकु ॥ ३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ thitiyā māteṃ cukale| jīṃhīṃ puṇyeṃ svarga kāmileṃ| tayāṃ amarapaṇa teṃ vābo jāleṃ | aṃtīṃ mṛtyuloku || 330||
verses.meaning: Thus, those who, through their merits, desired heaven, found their immortality to be in vain, for in the end, they returned to the mortal world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मातेचिया उदरकुहरीं । पचूनि विष्ठेच्या दाथरीं। उकडूनि नवमासवरी। जन्मजन्मोनि मरती ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: māteciyā udarakuharīṃ | pacūni viṣṭhecyā dātharīṃ| ukaḍūni navamāsavarī| janmajanmoni maratī || 31||
verses.meaning: In the mother's womb, within the cavity, they ripen amidst filth, boiling for nine months, and are born only to die again and again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा स्वणीं निधान फावे। परि चेइलिया हारपे आघवें। तैसें स्वर्गसुख जाणावें । वेदज्ञाचें ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā svaṇīṃ nidhāna phāve| pari ceiliyā hārape āghaveṃ| taiseṃ svargasukha jāṇāveṃ | vedajñāceṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: Just as a treasure found in a dream vanishes upon waking, so too should one understand the heavenly pleasures attained by those who know the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना वेदविद जऱ्ही जाहला। तरि मातें नेणतां वायां गेला। कणु सांडूनि उपणिला। कोंडा जैसा ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā vedavida jaṟhī jāhalā| tari māteṃ neṇatāṃ vāyāṃ gelā| kaṇu sāṃḍūni upaṇilā| koṃḍā jaisā || 33||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, even if one becomes learned in the Vedas, if they do not know Me, their learning is in vain, like chaff threshed after discarding the grain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मज एकेंविण । हे त्रयीधर्म अकारण। आतां मातें जाणोनि कांहीं नेण। तूं सुखिया होसी ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni maja ekeṃviṇa | he trayīdharma akāraṇa| ātāṃ māteṃ jāṇoni kāṃhīṃ neṇa| tūṃ sukhiyā hosī || 34||
verses.meaning: Therefore, without Me alone, these three-fold dharmas are futile. Now, knowing Me, and yet knowing nothing else, you will become blissful.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सर्वभावेंसीं उखितें। जे बोपिले मज चित्ते । जैसा गर्भगोळु उद्यमातें । कोणाही नेणे॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ sarvabhāveṃsīṃ ukhiteṃ| je bopile maja citte | jaisā garbhagoḻu udyamāteṃ | koṇāhī neṇe|| 35||
verses.meaning: Those who are completely absorbed in Me, with their minds fixed upon Me, are like a fetus in the womb, unaware of any other activity or endeavor.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मीवांचूनि कांहीं। आणीक गोमटेंचि नाहीं। मजचि नाम पाहीं। जिणेया ठेविलें॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mīvāṃcūni kāṃhīṃ| āṇīka gomaṭeṃci nāhīṃ| majaci nāma pāhīṃ| jiṇeyā ṭhevileṃ|| 36||
verses.meaning: There is nothing good other than Me. Indeed, life itself is named after Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अनन्यगतिकें चित्ते । चिंतितसांते मातें। जे उपासिती तयांतें। मीचि सेवीं॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ ananyagatikeṃ citte | ciṃtitasāṃte māteṃ| je upāsitī tayāṃteṃ| mīci sevīṃ|| 37||
verses.meaning: Those who, with a mind solely devoted to Me, meditate upon Me, them I Myself serve.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते एकवटूनि जिये क्षणीं। अनुसरळे गा माझिये वाहणीं। तेव्हांचि तयांची चिंतवणी । मजचि पडली॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: te ekavaṭūni jiye kṣaṇīṃ| anusaraḻe gā mājhiye vāhaṇīṃ| tevhāṃci tayāṃcī ciṃtavaṇī | majaci paḍalī|| 38||
verses.meaning: The moment they unite and align themselves with My flow, from that very moment, their welfare becomes My concern.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तींहीं जें जें करावें। तें मजचि पडिलें आघवें। जैसी अजातपक्षाचेनि जीवें । पक्षिणी जिये ।॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tīṃhīṃ jeṃ jeṃ karāveṃ| teṃ majaci paḍileṃ āghaveṃ| jaisī ajātapakṣāceni jīveṃ | pakṣiṇī jiye ||| 39||
verses.meaning: Whatever they do, all of it falls upon Me, just as the mother bird lives for the life of her unhatched chicks.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुली तहानभूक नेणे । तान्हया निकें तें माउलीसीचि करणें। तैसे अनुसरळे जे मज प्राणें । तयांचें सर्व मी करीं ॥ ३४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpulī tahānabhūka neṇe | tānhayā nikeṃ teṃ māulīsīci karaṇeṃ| taise anusaraḻe je maja prāṇeṃ | tayāṃceṃ sarva mī karīṃ || 340||
verses.meaning: Just as a small child does not know its own hunger and thirst, and it is the mother who instinctively knows what is best for it, similarly, for those who surrender their very life to Me, I take care of their every need.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया माझिया सायुज्याची चाड। तरि तेंचि पुरवी कोड। कां सेवा म्हणती तरी आड । प्रेम सुयें॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā mājhiyā sāyujyācī cāḍa| tari teṃci puravī koḍa| kāṃ sevā mhaṇatī tarī āḍa | prema suyeṃ|| 49||
verses.meaning: If you desire to attain oneness with Me, then fulfill that longing. Or if you speak of service, then love itself becomes the obstacle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा मनीं जो जो धरिती भावो। तो तो पुढां पुढां लागें तयां देवो । आणि दिधलियाचा निर्वाहो। तोही मीचि करीं ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā manīṃ jo jo dharitī bhāvo| to to puḍhāṃ puḍhāṃ lāgeṃ tayāṃ devo | āṇi didhaliyācā nirvāho| tohī mīci karīṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: Whatever devotion one holds in their heart, that devotion leads them to God again and again. And whatever is offered, I Myself ensure its fulfillment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा योगक्षेमु आघवा । तयांचा म्जचि पडिला पांडवा। जयांचिया सर्वभावा। आश्रयो मी॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā yogakṣemu āghavā | tayāṃcā mjaci paḍilā pāṃḍavā| jayāṃciyā sarvabhāvā| āśrayo mī|| 43||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, all their well-being and security are my responsibility, for I am the sole refuge of their entire being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां आणिकही संप्रदायें। परि मातें नेणती समवायें । जें अग्निइंद्रसूर्यसोमाये । म्हणौनि यजिती॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ āṇikahī saṃpradāyeṃ| pari māteṃ neṇatī samavāyeṃ | jeṃ agniiṃdrasūryasomāye | mhaṇauni yajitī|| 44||
verses.meaning: Now, there are others who, following their own traditions, do not truly know Me, but worship Me as Agni, Indra, Surya, or Soma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेही कौर मातेंचि होये। कां जे हें आघवें मीचि आहें। परि ते भजती उजरी नव्हे। विषम पडे॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tehī kaura māteṃci hoye| kāṃ je heṃ āghaveṃ mīci āheṃ| pari te bhajatī ujarī navhe| viṣama paḍe|| 45 ||
verses.meaning: They too are indeed Mine, for I am all of this. But their worship is not direct; it becomes distorted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां शाखा पल्लव रुखाचे। हे काय नव्हती एकाचि बीजाचे । परि पाणी घेणें मुळाचें। तें मुळींचि घापे॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ śākhā pallava rukhāce| he kāya navhatī ekāci bījāce | pari pāṇī gheṇeṃ muḻāceṃ| teṃ muḻīṃci ghāpe|| 46||
verses.meaning: Look, are not the branches and leaves of a tree from a single seed? Yet, the watering of the roots is done only at the roots.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां दहाही इंद्रियें आहाती । इयें जरी एकेचि देहींचीं होती। आणि इहीं सेविळे विषयो जाती। एकाचि ठायीं ४७॥ तरि करोनि रससोय बरवी । कानीं केवीं भरावी) फुलें आणोनि बांधावीं। डोळां केविं॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ dahāhī iṃdriyeṃ āhātī | iyeṃ jarī ekeci dehīṃcīṃ hotī| āṇi ihīṃ seviḻe viṣayo jātī| ekāci ṭhāyīṃ 47|| tari karoni rasasoya baravī | kānīṃ kevīṃ bharāvī) phuleṃ āṇoni bāṃdhāvīṃ| ḍoḻāṃ keviṃ|| 48||
verses.meaning: If all ten senses, though residing in one body, were to experience their respective objects in a single place, then how could a delicious dish, once prepared, be heard by the ears? Or how could flowers, once brought, be tied to the eyes?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ रसु तो मुखेंचि सेवावा। परिमळु तो प्राणेंचि घ्यावा । तैसा मी तो यजावा। मीचि म्हणौनि॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha rasu to mukheṃci sevāvā| parimaḻu to prāṇeṃci ghyāvā | taisā mī to yajāvā| mīci mhaṇauni|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as taste is enjoyed by the mouth, and fragrance is inhaled by the breath, so too should I be worshipped, by realizing that I am indeed that very essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर मातें नेणोनि भजन] तें 'वायांचि गा आनेंआन । म्हणौनि कर्माचे डोळे ज्ञान | तें निर्दोष होआवें ॥ ३५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera māteṃ neṇoni bhajana] teṃ 'vāyāṃci gā āneṃāna | mhaṇauni karmāce ḍoḻe jñāna | teṃ nirdoṣa hoāveṃ || 350||
verses.meaning: Therefore, without the knowledge of the Self, devotion is in vain. Hence, knowledge is the eye of action, and it must be flawless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं पाहें पां पंडुसुता । या यज्ञोपहारां समस्तां। मीवांचूनि भोक्ता । कवणु आहे॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ pāheṃ pāṃ paṃḍusutā | yā yajñopahārāṃ samastāṃ| mīvāṃcūni bhoktā | kavaṇu āhe||51||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, behold, O son of Pandu, among all these sacrificial offerings, who is the enjoyer other than Me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी सकळां यज्ञांचा आदि। आणि यजना या मीचि अवधि । कीं मातें चुकोनि दुर्बुद्धि। देवां भजळे॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī sakaḻāṃ yajñāṃcā ādi| āṇi yajanā yā mīci avadhi | kīṃ māteṃ cukoni durbuddhi| devāṃ bhajaḻe|| 52||
verses.meaning: I am the origin of all sacrifices, and I am also the culmination of these rituals. Yet, those of misguided intellect, missing Me, worship other deities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गंगेचें उदक गंगे जैसें । अर्पिजे देवपितरोद्देशें । माझें मज देती तेसें। परि आनानीं भावीं॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: gaṃgeceṃ udaka gaṃge jaiseṃ | arpije devapitaroddeśeṃ | mājheṃ maja detī teseṃ| pari ānānīṃ bhāvīṃ|| 53||
verses.meaning: Just as the water of the Ganges is offered to the Ganges itself, for the sake of gods and ancestors, so too do they offer back to me what is mine, but with different intentions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ते पार्था । मातें न पवतीचि सर्वथा । मग मनीं वाहिली जे आस्था । तेथ आले॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni te pārthā | māteṃ na pavatīci sarvathā | maga manīṃ vāhilī je āsthā | tetha āle|| 54||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Partha, they can never attain Me. Then, the desires they harbored in their minds, they reach those.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मनें बाचा करणीं। जयांचीं भजनें देवांचिया वाहणीं। ते शरीर १७६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जातियेक्षणीं। देवचि जाळे॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maneṃ bācā karaṇīṃ| jayāṃcīṃ bhajaneṃ devāṃciyā vāhaṇīṃ| te śarīra 176 śrījñāneśvarī jātiyekṣaṇīṃ| devaci jāḻe|| 55||
verses.meaning: Those whose devotion, through mind, speech, and action, flows towards God, their very bodies, at the moment of their passing, become God Himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा पितरांचीं व्रतें। वाहती जयांचीं चित्ते जीवित सरलिया तयांतें । पितृत्व वरी ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā pitarāṃcīṃ vrateṃ| vāhatī jayāṃcīṃ citte jīvita saraliyā tayāṃteṃ | pitṛtva varī || 56||
verses.meaning: Or, those whose minds are dedicated to the rites for ancestors, after their life ends, they attain the state of an ancestor.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां क्षुद्रदेवतादि भूतें। तियेंचि जयांचि परमदैवतें। जिहीं अभिचारिकीं तयांतें। उपासिलें॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ kṣudradevatādi bhūteṃ| tiyeṃci jayāṃci paramadaivateṃ| jihīṃ abhicārikīṃ tayāṃteṃ| upāsileṃ|| 57||
verses.meaning: Or those whose supreme deities are petty gods and spirits, whom they worship through sorcery.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां देहाची जवनिका फिटली । आणि भूतत्वाची प्राप्ति जाहळी। एवं संकल्पबशें फळलीं। कर्मे तयां॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ dehācī javanikā phiṭalī | āṇi bhūtatvācī prāpti jāhaḻī| evaṃ saṃkalpabaśeṃ phaḻalīṃ| karme tayāṃ|| 58||
verses.meaning: The curtain of their body was removed, and they attained the state of being a spirit. Thus, their actions bore fruit according to their resolve.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग मीचि डोळां देखिला । जिहीं कानीं मीचि ऐकिला। मीचि मनीं भाविला। वानिलळा वाचा ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mīci ḍoḻāṃ dekhilā | jihīṃ kānīṃ mīci aikilā| mīci manīṃ bhāvilā| vānilaḻā vācā || 59||
verses.meaning: Then, I am the one seen by the eyes, I am the one heard by the ears, I am the one contemplated by the mind, and I am the one praised by speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्वांगी सर्वाठायीं । मीचि नमस्कारिल्ा जिहीं । दानपुण्यादिकें जें कांहीं । तें माझियाचि मोहरां ॥ ३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarvāṃgī sarvāṭhāyīṃ | mīci namaskārilā jihīṃ | dānapuṇyādikeṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ | teṃ mājhiyāci moharāṃ || 360||
verses.meaning: Those who have bowed down to Me in every aspect and in every place, whatever acts of charity and merit they perform, are all directed towards Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं मातेंचि अध्ययन केलें। जे आंतबाहेरि मियांचि धालळे। जयांचें जीवित्व जोडलें) मजचिलागीं ॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ māteṃci adhyayana keleṃ| je āṃtabāheri miyāṃci dhālaḻe| jayāṃceṃ jīvitva joḍaleṃ) majacilāgīṃ ||61||
verses.meaning: Those who have studied Me alone, who are filled with Me, both internally and externally, and whose very lives are dedicated to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे अहंकारु वाहत आंगीं । आम्ही हरीचे भूषावयालागीं। जे लोभिये एकचि जगीं । माझेनि लोभें॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je ahaṃkāru vāhata āṃgīṃ | āmhī harīce bhūṣāvayālāgīṃ| je lobhiye ekaci jagīṃ | mājheni lobheṃ|| 62||
verses.meaning: Those who bear the pride in their being that they are solely for adorning Hari, they are the only covetous ones in the world, covetous of Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे माझेनि कामें सकाम । जे माझेनि प्रेमें सप्रेम । जे माझिया भुली सभ्रम। नेणती लोक ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je mājheni kāmeṃ sakāma | je mājheni premeṃ saprema | je mājhiyā bhulī sabhrama| neṇatī loka || 63||
verses.meaning: Those who are devoted to Me through their actions, those who are filled with love for Me, those who are bewildered by My illusion, such people do not know Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते मरणा ऐलीचकडे। मज मिळोनि गेले फुडे । मग मरणीं आणिकीकडे । जातील केवीं ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: te maraṇā ailīcakaḍe| maja miḻoni gele phuḍe | maga maraṇīṃ āṇikīkaḍe | jātīla kevīṃ || 65 ||
verses.meaning: They merged with Me even before death, and went forth. How then could they go elsewhere after death?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मद्याजी जे जाहाळे। ते माझियाचि सायुज्या आळे । जिहीं उपचारमिषें दिधलें। आपणपें मज॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni madyājī je jāhāḻe| te mājhiyāci sāyujyā āḻe | jihīṃ upacāramiṣeṃ didhaleṃ| āpaṇapeṃ maja|| 66||
verses.meaning: Therefore, those who have become my worshippers, they have attained union with me. For they have offered themselves to me under the guise of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं अर्जुना माझे ठायीं । आपणपेंवीण सौरसु नाहीं । मी उपचारें कवणाही। नाकळें गा॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ arjunā mājhe ṭhāyīṃ | āpaṇapeṃvīṇa saurasu nāhīṃ | mī upacāreṃ kavaṇāhī| nākaḻeṃ gā|| 67||
verses.meaning: Oh Arjuna, without surrendering your individual self to Me, you cannot experience true joy. I cannot be understood by anyone through mere rituals or external practices.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ जाणीव करी तोचि नेणें। आथिलेंपण मिरवबी तेंचि उणें। आम्ही जाहलों ऐसें जो म्हणे। तो कांहींचि नव्हे ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha jāṇīva karī toci neṇeṃ| āthileṃpaṇa miravabī teṃci uṇeṃ| āmhī jāhaloṃ aiseṃ jo mhaṇe| to kāṃhīṃci navhe || 68||
verses.meaning: One who claims to know, truly does not know. One who boasts of their abundance, truly lacks. One who declares, "I have become thus," is truly nothing at all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा यज्ञदानादि किरीटी। कां तपें हन जे हुटहुटी। ते तृणा एकासाठीं । न सरे एथ॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā yajñadānādi kirīṭī| kāṃ tapeṃ hana je huṭahuṭī| te tṛṇā ekāsāṭhīṃ | na sare etha||69||
verses.meaning: Or, O Kiriti, even if one performs sacrifices, gives donations, or undertakes severe penances, none of these are worth even a blade of grass here (in comparison to true devotion).

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां जाणिवेचेनि बळें । कोण्ही वेदांपासूनि असे आगळें । कीं शेषाहूनि तोंडाळें। बोळकें आथी ॥ ३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ jāṇiveceni baḻeṃ | koṇhī vedāṃpāsūni ase āgaḻeṃ | kīṃ śeṣāhūni toṃḍāḻeṃ| boḻakeṃ āthī || 370||
verses.meaning: Behold, by the power of knowledge, who is greater than the Vedas? Or is there anyone more talkative than Shesha, the serpent with a thousand mouths?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोही आंथरुणातळवटीं दडे । येरु नेति नेति म्हणौनि बहुडे । एथ सनकादिक वेडे। पिसे जाहळे॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tohī āṃtharuṇātaḻavaṭīṃ daḍe | yeru neti neti mhaṇauni bahuḍe | etha sanakādika veḍe| pise jāhaḻe|| 71||
verses.meaning: Even He (Brahma) hides beneath the bed of sleep (Maya), while the other (Shiva) returns, saying 'not this, not this'. Here, even great sages like Sanaka and others became bewildered and mad with longing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: करितां तापसांची कडसणी। कवणु जवळां ठेविजे शूळपाणी। तोहि अभिमानु सांडूनि पायवणी। माथां वाहे ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: karitāṃ tāpasāṃcī kaḍasaṇī| kavaṇu javaḻāṃ ṭhevije śūḻapāṇī| tohi abhimānu sāṃḍūni pāyavaṇī| māthāṃ vāhe || 72||
verses.meaning: Even Lord Shiva, who holds the trident, abandons his pride and carries on his head the water that has washed the feet of the ascetics, who perform severe penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरि आधिलेपणें सरिशी। कवणी आहे लक्लिमये ऐसी । श्रियेसारिखिया दासी । घरीं जियेतें॥७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātari ādhilepaṇeṃ sariśī| kavaṇī āhe laklimaye aisī | śriyesārikhiyā dāsī | gharīṃ jiyeteṃ||73||
verses.meaning: Or, who is there, from the very beginning, like Lakshmi, whose maidservants are like Shri (goddess of wealth and prosperity) herself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिया खेळतां करिती घरकुलीं। तयां नामें अमरपुरें जरि ठेविलीं। तरि न होती काय बाहुलीं। इंद्रादिक तयांचीं ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyā kheḻatāṃ karitī gharakulīṃ| tayāṃ nāmeṃ amarapureṃ jari ṭhevilīṃ| tari na hotī kāya bāhulīṃ| iṃdrādika tayāṃcīṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: When children play, they build small houses. Even if these are named 'cities of immortals,' do not Indra and other gods become mere dolls in them?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिया नावडोनि जेव्हां मोडिती । तेव्हां महेंद्राचे रंक होती । तिया झाडा जेउते पाहती । ते कल्पवृक्ष ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyā nāvaḍoni jevhāṃ moḍitī | tevhāṃ maheṃdrāce raṃka hotī | tiyā jhāḍā jeute pāhatī | te kalpavṛkṣa || 75||
verses.meaning: When they break free from that dislike, they become as rich as Indra. Wherever they cast their gaze, those trees become wish-fulfilling trees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया जियेचिया जवळिका। सामर्थ्य घरींचिया पाइका। ते लक्ष्मी मुख्यनायका। न मनेचि एथ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā jiyeciyā javaḻikā| sāmarthya gharīṃciyā pāikā| te lakṣmī mukhyanāyakā| na maneci etha|| 76||
verses.meaning: Such is the proximity of the Divine, that even Lakshmi, the chief consort, does not consider the power of her own servants as significant here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग सर्वस्वें करूनि सेवा। अभिमानु सांडूनि पांडवा। ते पाय धुवावयाचिया दैवा। पात्र जाहाली ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga sarvasveṃ karūni sevā| abhimānu sāṃḍūni pāṃḍavā| te pāya dhuvāvayāciyā daivā| pātra jāhālī || 77||
verses.meaning: Then, by serving with all their being, O Pandava, and abandoning all pride, they became worthy of the fortune of washing those feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि थोरपण पऱहां सांडिजे। एथ व्युत्पत्ती आघवी विसरिजे। जैं जगा धाकुटें होईजे। तैं जवळीक माझी ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni thorapaṇa paṟahāṃ sāṃḍije| etha vyutpattī āghavī visarije| jaiṃ jagā dhākuṭeṃ hoīje| taiṃ javaḻīka mājhī || 78 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, abandon greatness; here, forget all erudition. When one becomes the smallest in the world, then they are close to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा सहस्त्रकिरणाचिये दिठी-। पुढां चंद्रही लोपे किरीटी। तेथ खद्योत कां हुटहुटी। आपुलेनि तेजें ॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā sahastrakiraṇāciye diṭhī-| puḍhāṃ caṃdrahī lope kirīṭī| tetha khadyota kāṃ huṭahuṭī| āpuleni tejeṃ ||79||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, in the presence of the thousand-rayed sun, even the moon fades away. What then of a firefly, can it shine with its own light?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें लक्ष्मियेचें थोरपण न सरे। जेथ शंभूचेंही तप न पुरे। तेथ येर प्राकृत हेंदरें। केवीं जाणों लाहे॥ ३८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ lakṣmiyeceṃ thorapaṇa na sare| jetha śaṃbhūceṃhī tapa na pure| tetha yera prākṛta heṃdareṃ| kevīṃ jāṇoṃ lāhe|| 380||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the greatness of Lakshmi is immeasurable; even the penance of Shiva is insufficient to comprehend it. How then can ordinary, insignificant beings ever hope to know it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं शरीरसांडोबा कीजे। सकळ गुणांचें लोण उतरिजे। संपत्तिमदु सांडिजे। कुरवंडी करुनी॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ śarīrasāṃḍobā kīje| sakaḻa guṇāṃceṃ loṇa utarije| saṃpattimadu sāṃḍije| kuravaṃḍī karunī|| 81||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should abandon the body, cast off all qualities like an offering, and renounce the intoxication of wealth by performing a ritualistic waving and discarding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग निस्सीमभाव उल्हासें। मज अर्पाबयाचेनि मिसें। फळ एक आवडे तैसें। भळलतयाचें हो ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga nissīmabhāva ulhāseṃ| maja arpābayāceni miseṃ| phaḻa eka āvaḍe taiseṃ| bhaḻalatayāceṃ ho || 82||
verses.meaning: Then, with unadulterated devotion and joy, through the act of offering to Me, a single fruit, as desired, becomes that of the devoted one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भक्तु माझियाकडे दावी । आणि मी दोन्ही हात बोडवीं । मग देंठु न फेडितां सेवीं। आदरेंशीं ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhaktu mājhiyākaḍe dāvī | āṇi mī donhī hāta boḍavīṃ | maga deṃṭhu na pheḍitāṃ sevīṃ| ādareṃśīṃ || 83||
verses.meaning: The devotee shows me devotion, and I, with both hands, accept it. Then, without removing the stem, I partake of it with reverence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा भक्‍तीचेनि नांवें । फूल एक मज द्यावें। तें लेखें तरि म्यां तुरंबावें । परि मुखींचि घालीं॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā bhak‍tīceni nāṃveṃ | phūla eka maja dyāveṃ| teṃ lekheṃ tari myāṃ turaṃbāveṃ | pari mukhīṃci ghālīṃ|| 84||
verses.meaning: Indeed, in the name of devotion, grant me a single flower. Though it is meant for my hair, I will place it directly into my mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो कायसीं फुलें पानचि एक आवडे तें जाहलें। तें साजुकही न हो सुकलें । भलतैसें ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso kāyasīṃ phuleṃ pānaci eka āvaḍe teṃ jāhaleṃ| teṃ sājukahī na ho sukaleṃ | bhalataiseṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: Let this be. What kind of flowers? Even a single leaf, if it is liked, becomes that. It is not even fresh, but withered, and of any kind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि सर्वभावें भरलें देखें। आणि भुकेला अमृतें तोखे। तैसें पत्रचि परि तेणें सुखें। आरोगूं लागें ॥ ८६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari sarvabhāveṃ bharaleṃ dekheṃ| āṇi bhukelā amṛteṃ tokhe| taiseṃ patraci pari teṇeṃ sukheṃ| ārogūṃ lāgeṃ || 86 ||
verses.meaning: When one sees everything filled with the Divine, and the hungry soul is satisfied by nectar, then even a mere leaf, filled with such joy, begins to partake of it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा ऐसेंही एक घडे। जे पालाही परी न जोडे। तरि उदकाचें तंव सांकडें। नव्हेल कौं॥८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā aiseṃhī eka ghaḍe| je pālāhī parī na joḍe| tari udakāceṃ taṃva sāṃkaḍeṃ| navhela kauṃ||87||
verses.meaning: Or, if such a situation arises that even a leaf cannot be found, then surely there will be no scarcity of water, will there?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें भलतेथ निमोलें। न जोडितां आहे जोडलें। तेंचि सर्वस्व करूनि अर्पिलें। जेणें मज॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ bhalatetha nimoleṃ| na joḍitāṃ āhe joḍaleṃ| teṃci sarvasva karūni arpileṃ| jeṇeṃ maja|| 88||
verses.meaning: That which was spontaneously attained without effort, that very thing was offered to Me as everything by him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें वैकुंठापासोनि विशाळें । मजलागीं केलीं राउळें। कौस्तुभाहोनि निर्मळें। लेणीं दिधलीं ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ vaikuṃṭhāpāsoni viśāḻeṃ | majalāgīṃ kelīṃ rāuḻeṃ| kaustubhāhoni nirmaḻeṃ| leṇīṃ didhalīṃ || 89||
verses.meaning: With that, temples grander than Vaikuntha were built for me, and ornaments purer than the Kaustubha gem were bestowed upon me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दुधाचीं सेजारें। क्षीराब्धीऐसीं मनोहरें। मजलागीं अपारें। सृजिलीं तेणें ॥ ३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: dudhācīṃ sejāreṃ| kṣīrābdhīaisīṃ manohareṃ| majalāgīṃ apāreṃ| sṛjilīṃ teṇeṃ || 390||
verses.meaning: He created for me countless beautiful oceans of milk, like the mythical Ksheerasagar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्पूर चंदन अगरु । ऐसेया सुगंधाचा महामेरु। मज हातिवा लाविला दिनकरु । १७८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी 'दीपमाळे ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: karpūra caṃdana agaru | aiseyā sugaṃdhācā mahāmeru| maja hātivā lāvilā dinakaru | 178 śrījñāneśvarī 'dīpamāḻe || 91||
verses.meaning: A mountain of fragrance, like camphor, sandalwood, and agarwood, has been placed in my hand by the sun.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गरुडासारिखीं वाहनें। मज सुरतरूंचीं उद्यानें। कामधेनूंचीं गोधनें। अर्पिलीं तेणें ॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: garuḍāsārikhīṃ vāhaneṃ| maja suratarūṃcīṃ udyāneṃ| kāmadhenūṃcīṃ godhaneṃ| arpilīṃ teṇeṃ ||92||
verses.meaning: He offered me vehicles like Garudas, gardens of wish-fulfilling trees, and herds of wish-fulfilling cows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज अमृताहूनि सुरसें। बोनीं वबोगरिलीं बहुवसें। ऐसा भक्तांचेनि उदकलेशें । परितोषें गा॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja amṛtāhūni suraseṃ| bonīṃ vabogarilīṃ bahuvaseṃ| aisā bhaktāṃceni udakaleśeṃ | paritoṣeṃ gā|| 93||
verses.meaning: I am more delightful than even nectar, having been served with abundant and delicious offerings. Thus, I am greatly pleased by even a drop of water offered by my devotees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें सांगावें काय किरीटी। तुवांचि देखिलें आपुलिया दिठी। मी सुदामयाचिया सोडीं गांठी । पव्हयांलागीं ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ sāṃgāveṃ kāya kirīṭī| tuvāṃci dekhileṃ āpuliyā diṭhī| mī sudāmayāciyā soḍīṃ gāṃṭhī | pavhayāṃlāgīṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, why should I tell you this? You yourself have seen it with your own eyes. I untie the knots of Sudama's poverty for his friends.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं भक्ति एकी मी जाणें। तेथ सानें थोर न म्हणें । आम्ही भावाचे पाहुणे। भलतेया॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ bhakti ekī mī jāṇeṃ| tetha sāneṃ thora na mhaṇeṃ | āmhī bhāvāce pāhuṇe| bhalateyā|| 95||
verses.meaning: I know only one thing: devotion. There, I do not distinguish between small or great. I am a guest of pure feeling, for anyone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर पत्र पुष्प फळ। हें भजावया मिस केवळ। वांचूनि आमुचा लाग निष्कळ। भक्क्‍तितत्त्व ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera patra puṣpa phaḻa| heṃ bhajāvayā misa kevaḻa| vāṃcūni āmucā lāga niṣkaḻa| bhakk‍titattva || 96||
verses.meaning: Leaves, flowers, and fruits are merely pretexts for worship; otherwise, our true connection is with the pure essence of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अर्जुना अवधारीं। तूं बुद्धी एकी सोपारी करीं। तरी सहजें आपुलिया मनोमंदिरीं। न विसंबें मातें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni arjunā avadhārīṃ| tūṃ buddhī ekī sopārī karīṃ| tarī sahajeṃ āpuliyā manomaṃdirīṃ| na visaṃbeṃ māteṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, listen. If you make your intellect simple and focused, then naturally, within the temple of your mind, you will not forget Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे जे कांहीं व्यापार करिसी। कां भोग हन भोगिसी। अथवा यज्ञीं यजिसी। नानाविधीं ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: je je kāṃhīṃ vyāpāra karisī| kāṃ bhoga hana bhogisī| athavā yajñīṃ yajisī| nānāvidhīṃ || 98||
verses.meaning: Whatever actions you perform, or enjoy the various pleasures, or offer sacrifices in diverse ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी पात्रविशेषें दानें। कां सेवकां देसी जीवनें।॥ तपादि हन साधनें । व्रतें करिसी॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī pātraviśeṣeṃ dāneṃ| kāṃ sevakāṃ desī jīvaneṃ||| tapādi hana sādhaneṃ | vrateṃ karisī|| 99||
verses.meaning: Or, like giving gifts to deserving recipients, or providing sustenance to your servants, you perform austerities and other such spiritual practices and vows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें क्रियाजात आघवें। जें जैसें निपजेल स्वभावें। तें भावना करोनि करावें । माझिया मोहरा ॥ ४००॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ kriyājāta āghaveṃ| jeṃ jaiseṃ nipajela svabhāveṃ| teṃ bhāvanā karoni karāveṃ | mājhiyā moharā || 400||
verses.meaning: Whatever actions naturally arise, perform them with the understanding that they are offered to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि सर्वथा आपुले जीवीं । केलियाची से कांहींचि नुरवीं । ऐसीं धुबोनि कर्मे द्यावीं। माझिया हातीं ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari sarvathā āpule jīvīṃ | keliyācī se kāṃhīṃci nuravīṃ | aisīṃ dhuboni karme dyāvīṃ| mājhiyā hātīṃ || 91||
verses.meaning: Therefore, having completely washed away all actions, so that nothing of their effects remains in one's heart, offer them into My hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अग्निकुंडीं बीजें घातली । तियें अंकुरदशे जेवीं मुकलीं। तेवीं न 'फळतीचि मज अर्पिलीं। शुभाशुभें॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga agnikuṃḍīṃ bījeṃ ghātalī | tiyeṃ aṃkuradaśe jevīṃ mukalīṃ| tevīṃ na 'phaḻatīci maja arpilīṃ| śubhāśubheṃ|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as seeds cast into a fire pit are deprived of the chance to sprout, so too, good and bad deeds offered to Me bear no fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा कर्मे जैं उरावें। तैं तिहीं सुखदुःखीं फळावें। आणि तयातें भोगावया यावें। देहा एका॥३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā karme jaiṃ urāveṃ| taiṃ tihīṃ sukhaduḥkhīṃ phaḻāveṃ| āṇi tayāteṃ bhogāvayā yāveṃ| dehā ekā||3||
