verses.meaning: When actions remain, they bear the fruits of happiness and sorrow, and to experience them, one must take on a body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें उगाणिलें मज कर्म । तेव्हांचि पुसिलें मरण जन्म । जन्मासबें श्रम । वरचिलही गेळे॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ ugāṇileṃ maja karma | tevhāṃci pusileṃ maraṇa janma | janmāsabeṃ śrama | varacilahī geḻe|| 4||
verses.meaning: When I thus churned the Self, the cycle of birth and death was erased, and with it, all the suffering associated with births also vanished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अर्जुना यापरी । पाहेचा वेळु नव्हेळ भारी । हे संन्यासयुक्ति सोपारी । दिधली तुज ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni arjunā yāparī | pāhecā veḻu navheḻa bhārī | he saṃnyāsayukti sopārī | didhalī tuja || 5||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, it is not the time to delay. This easy method of renunciation has been given to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या देहाचिया बांदोडीं न पडिजे | सुखदुःखांचिया सागरीं न बुडिजे। सुखें सुखरूपा घडिजे। माझियाचि आंगा॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā dehāciyā bāṃdoḍīṃ na paḍije | sukhaduḥkhāṃciyā sāgarīṃ na buḍije| sukheṃ sukharūpā ghaḍije| mājhiyāci āṃgā|| 6||
verses.meaning: Do not be bound by the shackles of this body; do not drown in the ocean of pleasure and pain. Instead, joyfully merge into My very being, which is the embodiment of bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो मी पुससी कैसा। तरि जो सर्वभूतीं सदा सरिसा। जेथ आपपरु ऐसा । भागु नाहीं ॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to mī pusasī kaisā| tari jo sarvabhūtīṃ sadā sarisā| jetha āpaparu aisā | bhāgu nāhīṃ ||7||
verses.meaning: How then can I describe Him? He is ever equal in all beings, where there is no distinction of 'mine' or 'other'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे ऐसिया मातें जाणोनि। अहंकाराचा कुरुठा मोडोनि। जे जीवें कर्मे करूनि। मातें भजळे॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: je aisiyā māteṃ jāṇoni| ahaṃkārācā kuruṭhā moḍoni| je jīveṃ karme karūni| māteṃ bhajaḻe|| 8||
verses.meaning: Those who, understanding me in this way, break the stronghold of ego and worship me with their very life and actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वर्तत दिसती देहीं । परि ते देहीं ना माझ्या ठायीं । आणि मी तयांच्या हृदयीं । समग्र असें॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: te vartata disatī dehīṃ | pari te dehīṃ nā mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ | āṇi mī tayāṃcyā hṛdayīṃ | samagra aseṃ||9||
verses.meaning: They appear to exist in bodies, yet they are not in My body. And I am entirely present in their hearts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सविस्तर वटत्व जैसें बीजकणिकेमाजीं असे। आणि बीजकणु वसे। बटीं जेबीं॥ ४१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: savistara vaṭatva jaiseṃ bījakaṇikemājīṃ ase| āṇi bījakaṇu vase| baṭīṃ jebīṃ|| 410||
verses.meaning: Just as the detailed form of the banyan tree is contained within its tiny seed, and the seed itself resides within the banyan tree.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं आम्हां तयां परस्परें। बाहेरी नामाचींचि अंतरें। वांचूनि आंतुवट वस्तुविचारें। मी तेचि ते॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ āmhāṃ tayāṃ paraspareṃ| bāherī nāmācīṃci aṃtareṃ| vāṃcūni āṃtuvaṭa vastuvicāreṃ| mī teci te|| 11||
verses.meaning: Thus, between us, there is only a difference in names externally; otherwise, in the inner reality of being, I am indeed that very same.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां जायांचें जैसें लेणें। आंगावरी आहाचवाणें। तैसें देह धरणें। उदास तयांचें ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ jāyāṃceṃ jaiseṃ leṇeṃ| āṃgāvarī āhācavāṇeṃ| taiseṃ deha dharaṇeṃ| udāsa tayāṃceṃ || 12||
verses.meaning: Just as ornaments are a burden to a woman, so is the body a source of indifference to them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परिमळु निघाळिया पवनापाठीं । मार्गे बोस फूल राहे देठीं । तैसें आयुष्याचिये मुठीं। केवळ देह॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parimaḻu nighāḻiyā pavanāpāṭhīṃ | mārge bosa phūla rāhe deṭhīṃ | taiseṃ āyuṣyāciye muṭhīṃ| kevaḻa deha|| 13||
verses.meaning: Just as the fragrance departs with the wind, leaving behind a withered flower on its stem, so too, from the grasp of life, only the body remains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर अवष्टंभु जो आघवा । तो आरूढोनि मद्‌भावा । मजचि आंतु पांडवा । पैठा जाहला ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera avaṣṭaṃbhu jo āghavā | to ārūḍhoni mad‌bhāvā | majaci āṃtu pāṃḍavā | paiṭhā jāhalā || 14||
verses.meaning: The entire support, having ascended to My being, O Pandava, has entered into Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें भजतेनि प्रेमभावें । जयां शरीरही पाठीं न पवे । तेणें भलतया व्हावें । जातीचिया ॥ १५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ bhajateni premabhāveṃ | jayāṃ śarīrahī pāṭhīṃ na pave | teṇeṃ bhalatayā vhāveṃ | jātīciyā || 15 ||
verses.meaning: Those who worship with such love, whose bodies do not even follow them, they should become of any caste.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आचरण पाहतां सुभटा । तो दुष्कृताचा कौर सेल वांटा । परि जीवित वेंचिलें चोहटां। भक्‍तीचिया कौं ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ācaraṇa pāhatāṃ subhaṭā | to duṣkṛtācā kaura sela vāṃṭā | pari jīvita veṃcileṃ cohaṭāṃ| bhak‍tīciyā kauṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: And looking at his actions, O brave one, he might seem to be a share of evil deeds, but his life is spent in the marketplace of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा अंतींचिया मती । साचपण पुढिले गती । म्हणौनि जीवित जेणें भक्‍ती । दिधळें शेखीं ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā aṃtīṃciyā matī | sācapaṇa puḍhile gatī | mhaṇauni jīvita jeṇeṃ bhak‍tī | didhaḻeṃ śekhīṃ || 17||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the final thought determines the future path. Therefore, life is ultimately given to devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो आधीं जरी दुराचारी । तरी सर्वोत्तमुचि अबधारीं। जैसा बुडाला महापुरीं। न मरतु निघाला॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: to ādhīṃ jarī durācārī | tarī sarvottamuci abadhārīṃ| jaisā buḍālā mahāpurīṃ| na maratu nighālā|| 18||
verses.meaning: Even if he was previously a great sinner, consider him to be the best of all, just as one who was submerged in a great flood emerges without dying.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचें जीवित ऐळथडिये आलें। म्हणौनि बुडालेपण जेवीं वायां गेलें। तेवीं नुरेचि पाप केलें शेवटलिये भक्‍ती ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāceṃ jīvita aiḻathaḍiye āleṃ| mhaṇauni buḍālepaṇa jevīṃ vāyāṃ geleṃ| tevīṃ nureci pāpa keleṃ śevaṭaliye bhak‍tī || 19||
verses.meaning: Just as a life that has reached its end is considered wasted, so too, sins committed are completely nullified by ultimate devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं दुष्कृती जऱ्ही जाहाला । तरी अनुतापतीर्थी न्हाला । न्हाऊनि मजआंतु आला । सर्वभावें॥ ४२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ duṣkṛtī jaṟhī jāhālā | tarī anutāpatīrthī nhālā | nhāūni majaāṃtu ālā | sarvabhāveṃ|| 420||
verses.meaning: Therefore, even if one has committed misdeeds, if they bathe in the purifying waters of repentance, and having bathed, come to Me with their whole being, they are accepted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आतां पवित्र तयाचेंचि कुळ) आभिजात्य तेंचि निर्मळ । जन्मळेयाचें फळ। तयासीच जोडलें॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātāṃ pavitra tayāceṃci kuḻa) ābhijātya teṃci nirmaḻa | janmaḻeyāceṃ phaḻa| tayāsīca joḍaleṃ|| 21||
verses.meaning: Therefore, their lineage is now pure, their nobility is truly untainted. The fruit of their birth has been attained by them alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो सकळही पढिन्नला। तपें तोचि तपिन्नला । अष्टांग अभ्यासिला । योगु तेणें ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to sakaḻahī paḍhinnalā| tapeṃ toci tapinnalā | aṣṭāṃga abhyāsilā | yogu teṇeṃ || 22||
verses.meaning: He has studied everything, he has performed all penances, and he has practiced the eight-fold yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो बहुत पार्था । तो उतरल्म कर्मे सर्वथा । जयाची अखंड गा आस्था । मजचिलागीं ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso bahuta pārthā | to utaralma karme sarvathā | jayācī akhaṃḍa gā āsthā | majacilāgīṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: Let this be, O Partha. All actions are transcended by one whose constant devotion is solely directed towards Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: १८० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी अवघिया मनोबुद्धीचिया राहटी। भरोनि एकनिष्ठेची पेटी। मजमाजीं किरीटी । निक्षेपिली जेणें ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: 180 śrījñāneśvarī avaghiyā manobuddhīciyā rāhaṭī| bharoni ekaniṣṭhecī peṭī| majamājīṃ kirīṭī | nikṣepilī jeṇeṃ || 24||
verses.meaning: He who, having filled the chest of single-minded devotion with all the workings of mind and intellect, has deposited it within Me, O Kiriti (Arjuna).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो आतां अवसरें मजसारिखा होईल। ऐसा हन भाव तुज जाईल हां गा अमृताआंत राहील। तया मरण कैचें ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: to ātāṃ avasareṃ majasārikhā hoīla| aisā hana bhāva tuja jāīla hāṃ gā amṛtāāṃta rāhīla| tayā maraṇa kaiceṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Perhaps you think that he will become like me in due course. But how can death touch one who abides in the nectar of immortality?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सूर्यु जो वेळु नुदैजे। तया वेळा कीं रात्रि म्हणिजे। तेवी माझिये भक्‍तीविण जें कौजे। तें महापाप नोहे ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ sūryu jo veḻu nudaije| tayā veḻā kīṃ rātri mhaṇije| tevī mājhiye bhak‍tīviṇa jeṃ kauje| teṃ mahāpāpa nohe || 26||
verses.meaning: Just as there is no night when the sun has not risen, similarly, whatever is done without devotion to Me is not a great sin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तयाचिया चित्ता । माझी जवळिक पंडुसुता । तेव्हांच तो तत्त्वता । स्वरूप माझें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tayāciyā cittā | mājhī javaḻika paṃḍusutā | tevhāṃca to tattvatā | svarūpa mājheṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O son of Pandu, when his mind is thus absorbed in Me, he truly becomes My very form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा दीपें दीपु लाविजे। तेथ आदील कोण हें नोळखिजे। तैसा सर्वस्वें जो मज भजे। तो मीचि होऊनि ठाके॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā dīpeṃ dīpu lāvije| tetha ādīla koṇa heṃ noḻakhije| taisā sarvasveṃ jo maja bhaje| to mīci hoūni ṭhāke|| 28||
verses.meaning: Just as one lamp lights another, and it's impossible to tell which was the first, so too, one who worships Me with their whole being becomes one with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग माझी नित्य शांती। तया दशा तेचि कांती। किंबहुना जिती । माझेनि जीवें ॥२९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mājhī nitya śāṃtī| tayā daśā teci kāṃtī| kiṃbahunā jitī | mājheni jīveṃ ||29||
verses.meaning: Then my eternal peace, that state, that very radiance, or rather, they live by my very life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ पार्था पुढतपुढती। तेंचि तें सांगों किती । जरी मियां चाड तरी भक्‍ती । न विसंबिजे गा॥ ४३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha pārthā puḍhatapuḍhatī| teṃci teṃ sāṃgoṃ kitī | jarī miyāṃ cāḍa tarī bhak‍tī | na visaṃbije gā|| 430||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, again and again, how much more can I tell you the same thing? If you desire me, then do not abandon devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा कुळाचिया चोखटपणा नलगा । आभिजात्य झणीं शलाघा । व्युत्पत्तीचा वाउगा । सोसु कां वाहावा॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā kuḻāciyā cokhaṭapaṇā nalagā | ābhijātya jhaṇīṃ śalāghā | vyutpattīcā vāugā | sosu kāṃ vāhāvā|| 31||
verses.meaning: Oh, do not be concerned with the purity of lineage, nor boast about high birth. Why carry the unnecessary burden of erudition?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां रूपबयसा माजा। आधथिलेपणें कां गाजा। एक भाव नाहीं माझा। तरी पाल्हाळ तें ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ rūpabayasā mājā| ādhathilepaṇeṃ kāṃ gājā| eka bhāva nāhīṃ mājhā| tarī pālhāḻa teṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: If my inner being is not aligned with the divine, then what is the use of outward show or boasting? All such display is ultimately futile.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कणेंबिण सोपटें। कणसें लागली घनदाटें। काय करावें गोमटें। बोस नगर॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaṇeṃbiṇa sopaṭeṃ| kaṇaseṃ lāgalī ghanadāṭeṃ| kāya karāveṃ gomaṭeṃ| bosa nagara|| 33||
verses.meaning: Without the grain, the husk is empty; the ears of corn appear dense. What good is such a beautiful, hollow city?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी सरोवर आटळलें। रानीं दुःखिया दुःखी भेटलें। कां वांझ फुलीं फुलले । झाड जैसें ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī sarovara āṭaḻaleṃ| rānīṃ duḥkhiyā duḥkhī bheṭaleṃ| kāṃ vāṃjha phulīṃ phulale | jhāḍa jaiseṃ || 34||
verses.meaning: Or like a dried-up lake, or a sorrowful person meeting another sorrowful person in the wilderness, or a barren tree blossoming with flowers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सकळ तें वैभव । अथवा कुळजातिगौरव । जैसें शरीर आहे सावेव। परि जीवचि नाहीं॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sakaḻa teṃ vaibhava | athavā kuḻajātigaurava | jaiseṃ śarīra āhe sāveva| pari jīvaci nāhīṃ|| 35||
verses.meaning: Just as all that splendor, or the pride of lineage and caste, is like a body with all its limbs, but without life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें माझिये भक्‍तीविण। जळो तें जियाळेपण। अगा पृथ्वीवरी पाषाण। नसती काई॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ mājhiye bhak‍tīviṇa| jaḻo teṃ jiyāḻepaṇa| agā pṛthvīvarī pāṣāṇa| nasatī kāī|| 36||
verses.meaning: Similarly, without devotion to Me, let that life be burned. Are there no stones on the earth?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं हिंवराची दाट साउली । सजनीं जैसी वाळिली। तैसीं पुण्यें डावळूनि गेलीं। अभवक्तांतें ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ hiṃvarācī dāṭa sāulī | sajanīṃ jaisī vāḻilī| taisīṃ puṇyeṃ ḍāvaḻūni gelīṃ| abhavaktāṃteṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: Just as the dense shade of a snow-covered mountain withers away in the summer, so too do the merits of the unfaithful diminish and vanish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निंब निंबोळियां मोडोनि आला । तरी तो काउळियांसीचि सुकाळु जाहला । तैसा भक्तिहीनु वाढिन्नलळा। दोषांचिलागीं ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: niṃba niṃboḻiyāṃ moḍoni ālā | tarī to kāuḻiyāṃsīci sukāḻu jāhalā | taisā bhaktihīnu vāḍhinnalaḻā| doṣāṃcilāgīṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: When a neem tree grows tall, laden with neem fruits, it becomes a feast for crows. Similarly, a person devoid of devotion, though they may flourish, only serves to multiply their own faults.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां षडूस खापरीं वाढिले। वाढूनि चोहटां ठेविलें। ते सुणियांचेचि ऐसें झालें। जियापरी ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ṣaḍūsa khāparīṃ vāḍhile| vāḍhūni cohaṭāṃ ṭhevileṃ| te suṇiyāṃceci aiseṃ jhāleṃ| jiyāparī || 39||
verses.meaning: Just as a meal served in a broken pot and left at a crossroads becomes food for dogs, so too is the fate of those who do not understand the true meaning of spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें भक्क्‍िहीनाचें जिणें। जो स्वप्नींहि परि सुकृत नेणे। तेणें संसारदुःखासि भाणें। वोगरिलें॥ ४४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ bhakk‍ihīnāceṃ jiṇeṃ| jo svapnīṃhi pari sukṛta neṇe| teṇeṃ saṃsāraduḥkhāsi bhāṇeṃ| vogarileṃ|| 440||
verses.meaning: Just as the life of one devoid of devotion, who does not know good deeds even in dreams, has served up the suffering of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कुळ उत्तम नोहावें। जाती अंत्यजही व्हावें। वरि देहाचेनि नांवें । पशूचेंही लाभो ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kuḻa uttama nohāveṃ| jātī aṃtyajahī vhāveṃ| vari dehāceni nāṃveṃ | paśūceṃhī lābho || 41||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one need not be born into a high lineage; even if one is born into a low caste, or even if one is born as an animal in this body, it is still beneficial.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां सावजें हातिरूं धरिलें। तेणें तया काकुळती मातें स्मरिळें। कीं तयाचें पशुत्व बाबो जाहलें । 'पावळिया मातें ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ sāvajeṃ hātirūṃ dharileṃ| teṇeṃ tayā kākuḻatī māteṃ smariḻeṃ| kīṃ tayāceṃ paśutva bābo jāhaleṃ | 'pāvaḻiyā māteṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: Behold, when the elephant was caught by the beast of prey, it remembered Me in its distress. Did its animality then become a mere trifle, O Father, as it called out to Me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा नांवें घेतां बोखटीं। जे आघवेया अधमांचिये शेवटीं। तिये 'पापयोनींही किरीटी । जन्मले जे॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā nāṃveṃ ghetāṃ bokhaṭīṃ| je āghaveyā adhamāṃciye śevaṭīṃ| tiye 'pāpayonīṃhī kirīṭī | janmale je|| 43||
verses.meaning: Oh, those whose names are considered inauspicious, who are at the very bottom of all the wicked, even those born in such 'sinful wombs', O Kiriti (Arjuna),

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते पापयोनि मूढ। मूर्ख जैसे कां दगड । परि माझ्या ठायीं दृढ। सर्वभावें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: te pāpayoni mūḍha| mūrkha jaise kāṃ dagaḍa | pari mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ dṛḍha| sarvabhāveṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: Those born in sinful wombs, who are foolish and dull like stones, yet if they have firm faith in Me with their whole being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचिये वाचे माझे आलाप । दृष्टी भोगी माझेंचि रूप। जयांचें मन संकल्प। माझाचि वाहे ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃciye vāce mājhe ālāpa | dṛṣṭī bhogī mājheṃci rūpa| jayāṃceṃ mana saṃkalpa| mājhāci vāhe || 45 ||
verses.meaning: Those whose speech utters My name, whose eyes behold My form, whose minds are filled with thoughts of Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझिया कौर्तिविण। जयांचें रितें नाहीं श्रवण । जयां सर्वांगी भूषण। माझी सेवा ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhiyā kaurtiviṇa| jayāṃceṃ riteṃ nāhīṃ śravaṇa | jayāṃ sarvāṃgī bhūṣaṇa| mājhī sevā || 46||
verses.meaning: Whose ears are never empty of My glory, and whose entire being is adorned by My service.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचें ज्ञान विषो नेणे। जाणीव मज एकातेंचि जाणे । जयां ऐसें लाभे तरी जिणें। एऱहवी मरण ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃceṃ jñāna viṣo neṇe| jāṇīva maja ekāteṃci jāṇe | jayāṃ aiseṃ lābhe tarī jiṇeṃ| eṟahavī maraṇa || 47||
verses.meaning: Whose knowledge does not know worldly pleasures, but knows only Me. If one attains such a state, then alone is life; otherwise, it is death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा आघवाचि परी पांडवा । जिहीं आपुलिया सर्वभावा। जियावयालागीं बोलावा । मीचि केला॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā āghavāci parī pāṃḍavā | jihīṃ āpuliyā sarvabhāvā| jiyāvayālāgīṃ bolāvā | mīci kelā|| 48||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, in all these ways, those who have called upon Me with their whole being to live, have made Me their very own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते पापयोनीही होतु कां। ते श्रुताधीतही न होतु कां। परि मजसीं तुकितां तुकां। तुटी नाहीं ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: te pāpayonīhī hotu kāṃ| te śrutādhītahī na hotu kāṃ| pari majasīṃ tukitāṃ tukāṃ| tuṭī nāhīṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: They may be of sinful birth, or they may not have studied the Vedas. But when they are weighed against Me, there is no deficiency.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां भक्‍तीचेनि आधिलेपणें। दैत्यीं देवां आणिलें उणें । माझें नृसिंहत्व लेणें। जयाचिये महिमें ॥ ४५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ bhak‍tīceni ādhilepaṇeṃ| daityīṃ devāṃ āṇileṃ uṇeṃ | mājheṃ nṛsiṃhatva leṇeṃ| jayāciye mahimeṃ || 450||
verses.meaning: Behold, through the preeminence of devotion, the demons brought low the gods. It was by the glory of that devotion that my Narasimha form was adorned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो प्रल्हादु गा मजसाठीं। घेतां बहुतें संकटें सदा किरीटी | कां जें मियां द्यावें ते गोष्टी । 'तयाचिया जोडे॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: to pralhādu gā majasāṭhīṃ| ghetāṃ bahuteṃ saṃkaṭeṃ sadā kirīṭī | kāṃ jeṃ miyāṃ dyāveṃ te goṣṭī | 'tayāciyā joḍe|| 51||
verses.meaning: That Prahlada, for my sake, always endured many difficulties, O Kiriti. For whatever I had to give, he attained it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं दैत्यकुळ साचोकारें। परि इंद्रही सरी न लाहे उपरें। म्हणौनि भक्ति गा एथ सरे। जाति अप्रमाण ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ daityakuḻa sācokāreṃ| pari iṃdrahī sarī na lāhe upareṃ| mhaṇauni bhakti gā etha sare| jāti apramāṇa || 52||
verses.meaning: Indeed, though born in a demonic lineage, yet even Indra cannot compare to them in reverence. Therefore, devotion reigns supreme here, and lineage holds no sway.

verses.shloka_devanagari: राजाज्ञेचीं अक्षरें आहाती । तियें चामा एका जया पडती । तया चामासाठीं जोडती। सकळ वस्तु ॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: rājājñecīṃ akṣareṃ āhātī | tiyeṃ cāmā ekā jayā paḍatī | tayā cāmāsāṭhīṃ joḍatī| sakaḻa vastu ||53||
verses.meaning: The words of the king's command, when they fall upon a single piece of leather, for that piece of leather, all things are obtained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि सोनें रुपें प्रमाण नोहे। एथ राजाज्ञाचि समर्थ आहे । तेंचि चाम एक जें लाहे। तेणें विकती आघवीं॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni soneṃ rupeṃ pramāṇa nohe| etha rājājñāci samartha āhe | teṃci cāma eka jeṃ lāhe| teṇeṃ vikatī āghavīṃ|| 54||
verses.meaning: Without the king's command, gold and silver hold no authority. Only the royal seal possesses true power, and with it, all things can be purchased.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें उत्तमत्व तैंचि तरे। तैंचि सर्वज्ञता सरे। जैं मनोबुद्धि भरे। माझेनि प्रेमें ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ uttamatva taiṃci tare| taiṃci sarvajñatā sare| jaiṃ manobuddhi bhare| mājheni premeṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Similarly, excellence is attained, and omniscience is perfected, when the mind and intellect are filled with My love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कुळ जाति वर्ण। हें आघवेंचि गा अकारण। एथ अर्जुना माझेपण। सार्थक एक ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kuḻa jāti varṇa| heṃ āghaveṃci gā akāraṇa| etha arjunā mājhepaṇa| sārthaka eka || 56||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, lineage, caste, and varna—all these are indeed meaningless. Here, only My being (oneness with Me) is truly worthwhile.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि भलतेणें भावें) मन मज आंतु येतें होआवें। आलें तरी आघवें।॥ मागील वावो ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci bhalateṇeṃ bhāveṃ) mana maja āṃtu yeteṃ hoāveṃ| āleṃ tarī āghaveṃ||| māgīla vāvo || 57||
verses.meaning: With whatever feeling, the mind should come into Me. If it comes, then all the past is in vain (meaning, all past actions and their consequences become null and void).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसे तंवचि बहाळ बोहळ। जंब न पवती गंगाजळ। मग होऊनि ठाकती केवळ। गंगारूप॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaise taṃvaci bahāḻa bohaḻa| jaṃba na pavatī gaṃgājaḻa| maga hoūni ṭhākatī kevaḻa| gaṃgārūpa|| 58||
verses.meaning: Just as streams and rivers remain distinct only until they meet the waters of the Ganges, after which they become purely the Ganges itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां खैर चंदन १८२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी काष्ठें। हे विवंचना तंवचि घटे । जंब न घापती एकवटे। अग्नीमाजीं ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ khaira caṃdana 182 śrījñāneśvarī kāṣṭheṃ| he vivaṃcanā taṃvaci ghaṭe | jaṃba na ghāpatī ekavaṭe| agnīmājīṃ ||59||
verses.meaning: Just as the distinction between acacia and sandalwood wood exists only until they are both cast into the fire, so too are worldly distinctions temporary.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे क्षत्री वैश्य स्त्रिया । कां शूद्र अंत्यजादि इया । जाती तंवचि वेगळालिया । जंब न पवती मातें ॥ ४६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise kṣatrī vaiśya striyā | kāṃ śūdra aṃtyajādi iyā | jātī taṃvaci vegaḻāliyā | jaṃba na pavatī māteṃ || 460||
verses.meaning: Similarly, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, women, Shudras, and those of lower castes are considered distinct only until they realize Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग जाती व्यक्ती पडे बिंदुलें। जेव्हां भावें होती मज मीनलळे। जैसे लबणकण घातळे। सागरामाजीं ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga jātī vyaktī paḍe biṃduleṃ| jevhāṃ bhāveṃ hotī maja mīnalaḻe| jaise labaṇakaṇa ghātaḻe| sāgarāmājīṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: Then, individual identities dissolve when they lovingly merge into Me, just as grains of salt dissolve in the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंबवरी नदानदींचीं नांवें। तंबचि पूर्वपश््चिमेचे यावे) जंव न येती आघवे। समुद्रामाजीं ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃbavarī nadānadīṃcīṃ nāṃveṃ| taṃbaci pūrvapaścimece yāve) jaṃva na yetī āghave| samudrāmājīṃ || 62||
verses.meaning: Just as rivers and streams do not lose their individual names and their east-west flow until they all merge into the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेंचि कवणें एकें मिसें। चित्त माझे ठायीं प्रवेशे । येतुलें हो मग आपैसें। मीचि होणें असे॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃci kavaṇeṃ ekeṃ miseṃ| citta mājhe ṭhāyīṃ praveśe | yetuleṃ ho maga āpaiseṃ| mīci hoṇeṃ ase|| 63||
verses.meaning: If by any means, the mind enters into Me, then it will naturally become Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा वरी फोडावयालागीं। लोहो मिळो कां परिसाचे आंगीं । कां जे मिळतिये प्रसंगीं । सोनेंचि होईल ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā varī phoḍāvayālāgīṃ| loho miḻo kāṃ parisāce āṃgīṃ | kāṃ je miḻatiye prasaṃgīṃ | soneṃci hoīla || 64||
verses.meaning: Even if iron is brought to be broken, if it touches the philosopher's stone, it will instantly turn into gold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां वालभाचेनि व्याजें। तिया व्रजांगनांचीं निजें। मज मीनलिया काय माझें॥। स्वरूप नव्हती ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ vālabhāceni vyājeṃ| tiyā vrajāṃganāṃcīṃ nijeṃ| maja mīnaliyā kāya mājheṃ||| svarūpa navhatī || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Behold, through the pretext of Krishna, were not those Gopis truly united with My very own Self?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी भयाचेनि मिसें। मातें न पविजेचि 'काय कंसें। कीं अखंड वैरवशें। चैद्यादिकीं ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī bhayāceni miseṃ| māteṃ na pavijeci 'kāya kaṃseṃ| kīṃ akhaṃḍa vairavaśeṃ| caidyādikīṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: Or, is it that out of fear, I am not attained, as by Kamsa? Or, due to continuous enmity, as by Shishupala and others?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा सोयरेपणेंचि पांडवा । माझें सायुज्य यादवां। कीं ममत्बें बसुदेवा-। दिकां सकळां ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā soyarepaṇeṃci pāṃḍavā | mājheṃ sāyujya yādavāṃ| kīṃ mamatbeṃ basudevā-| dikāṃ sakaḻāṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, the Yadavas attain My Sayujya (oneness) through kinship, and Vasudeva and others through their sense of 'mineness' or belonging to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नारदा श्रुवा अक्रूरा। शुका हन सनत्कुमारा । इयां भक्‍ती मी धनुर्धरा । प्राप्यु जैसा॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāradā śruvā akrūrā| śukā hana sanatkumārā | iyāṃ bhak‍tī mī dhanurdharā | prāpyu jaisā|| 68||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, just as Narada, Dhruva, Akrura, Shuka, and Sanatkumara attained Me through devotion, so too can others attain Me through devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसाचि गोपिकांसि कामें। तया कंसा भयसंभ्रमें। येरां घातकां मनोधर्मे । शिशुपालादिकां॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisāci gopikāṃsi kāmeṃ| tayā kaṃsā bhayasaṃbhrameṃ| yerāṃ ghātakāṃ manodharme | śiśupālādikāṃ|| 69||
verses.meaning: Similarly, for the Gopis, it was love; for Kamsa, it was fear and apprehension; and for others, like Shishupala, it was malice and ill-will.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा मी एकुलाणीचें खागें । मज येवो पां भलतेनि मार्गे) भक्‍तीं कां विषयविरागें। अथवा वैरें॥ ४७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā mī ekulāṇīceṃ khāgeṃ | maja yevo pāṃ bhalateni mārge) bhak‍tīṃ kāṃ viṣayavirāgeṃ| athavā vaireṃ|| 470||
verses.meaning: I am the sole destination. One may reach me through any path: devotion, detachment from worldly pleasures, or even enmity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि पार्था पाहीं । प्रवेशाबया माझ्या ठायीं । उपायांची नाहीं । बाणी एथ ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni pārthā pāhīṃ | praveśābayā mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ | upāyāṃcī nāhīṃ | bāṇī etha || 71||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, see that there is no need for any special means or efforts to enter into My being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि भलतिया जातीं जन्मावें। मग भजिजे कां बिरोधावें। परि भक्‍त कां वैरिया व्हावें। माझियाचि ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi bhalatiyā jātīṃ janmāveṃ| maga bhajije kāṃ birodhāveṃ| pari bhak‍ta kāṃ vairiyā vhāveṃ| mājhiyāci || 72||
verses.meaning: And if one is born into any caste, then why should one worship or oppose Me? But why should a devotee become My enemy?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा कवणें एकें बोलें। माझेपण जऱ्ही जाहालें। तरी मी होणें आलें। हाता निरुतें ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā kavaṇeṃ ekeṃ boleṃ| mājhepaṇa jaṟhī jāhāleṃ| tarī mī hoṇeṃ āleṃ| hātā niruteṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: If, by any single word, my sense of 'I-ness' (ego) has arisen, then I have truly come into being, perfectly and completely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं पापयोनीही अर्जुना । कां बैश्य शूद्र अंगना । मातें भजतां सदना । माझिया येती ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ pāpayonīhī arjunā | kāṃ baiśya śūdra aṃganā | māteṃ bhajatāṃ sadanā | mājhiyā yetī || 74||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, even those of sinful birth, or Vaishyas, Shudras, and women, by devotion to Me, attain My supreme abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वर्णांमाजीं छत्रचामर। स्वर्ग जयांचें अग्रहार । मंत्रविद्येसि माहेर । ब्राह्मण जे॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga varṇāṃmājīṃ chatracāmara| svarga jayāṃceṃ agrahāra | maṃtravidyesi māhera | brāhmaṇa je|| 75||
verses.meaning: Among all social classes, the Brahmins are like the royal canopy and whisk, their heavenly abode is their ancestral land, and they are the very home of mantra knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे पृथ्वबीतळींचे देव। जे तपोबतार सावयव। सकळ तीर्थांसि दैव। उदयलें जें॥७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: je pṛthvabītaḻīṃce deva| je tapobatāra sāvayava| sakaḻa tīrthāṃsi daiva| udayaleṃ jeṃ||76||
verses.meaning: They are the gods on earth, the very embodiment of penance, and the auspicious fortune that has dawned upon all holy places.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ अखंड वसिजे यागीं। जे वेदांची बज़रांगी। जयांचेनि दिठीचिया उत्संगीं । मंगळ वाढे ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha akhaṃḍa vasije yāgīṃ| je vedāṃcī bazarāṃgī| jayāṃceni diṭhīciyā utsaṃgīṃ | maṃgaḻa vāḍhe || 77||
verses.meaning: Where sacrifices are constantly performed, where the Vedas are like a strong armor, and by whose mere glance, auspiciousness flourishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचिये आस्थेचिनि बोलें। सत्कर्म पाल्हाळीं गेलें। संकल्पें सत्य जियाळें। जयांचेनि ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃciye āsthecini boleṃ| satkarma pālhāḻīṃ geleṃ| saṃkalpeṃ satya jiyāḻeṃ| jayāṃceni || 78 ||
verses.meaning: Through whose steadfast words, good deeds flourished, and by whose resolve, truth was brought to life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचेनि गा बोलें। अग्नीसि आयुष्य जाहलें। म्हणोनि समुद्रे पाणी आपुलें । दिधलें यांचिया प्रीती ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃceni gā boleṃ| agnīsi āyuṣya jāhaleṃ| mhaṇoni samudre pāṇī āpuleṃ | didhaleṃ yāṃciyā prītī || 79||
verses.meaning: By whose very word, fire gained its life, and therefore, out of love for them, the ocean offered its waters.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मियां लक्ष्मी डावलोनि केली परौती। फेडोनि कौस्तुभ घेतला हातीं । मग बोडविली वक्षःस्थळाची वाखती । चरणरजां ॥४८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: miyāṃ lakṣmī ḍāvaloni kelī parautī| pheḍoni kaustubha ghetalā hātīṃ | maga boḍavilī vakṣaḥsthaḻācī vākhatī | caraṇarajāṃ ||480||
verses.meaning: I (Lord Vishnu) cast aside Lakshmi and made her secondary, taking the Kaustubha gem in my hand. Then, I adorned my chest with the dust of your feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आझुनि पाउलाची मुद्रा। मी हृदयीं बाहें गा सुभद्रा । जे आपुलिया दैवसमुद्रा । जतनेलागीं ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ājhuni pāulācī mudrā| mī hṛdayīṃ bāheṃ gā subhadrā | je āpuliyā daivasamudrā | jatanelāgīṃ || 81||
verses.meaning: O Subhadra, I still carry the imprint of your footsteps in my heart, carefully preserved as if it were my own ocean of destiny.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचा कोप सुभटा । काळाग्निरुद्राचा वसौटा । जयांचे प्रसादीं फुकटा। जोडती सिद्धी॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃcā kopa subhaṭā | kāḻāgnirudrācā vasauṭā | jayāṃce prasādīṃ phukaṭā| joḍatī siddhī|| 82||
verses.meaning: Those whose wrath is like the fierce fire of the Rudra at the time of cosmic dissolution, and by whose grace, spiritual attainments are easily gained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे पुण्यपूज्य जे ब्राह्मण । आणि माझ्या ठायीं अतिनिपुण। आतां मातें पावती हें कवण। समर्थावें॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise puṇyapūjya je brāhmaṇa | āṇi mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ atinipuṇa| ātāṃ māteṃ pāvatī heṃ kavaṇa| samarthāveṃ||83||
verses.meaning: Such Brahmins, revered for their virtue, and profoundly devoted to Me, how can I describe their attainment of Me? It is beyond words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां चंदनाचेनि अंगानिळें। शिवतिळे निंब होते जे जवळें। तिहीं निर्जीबींही देवांची निडळें । बैसणीं केलीं ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ caṃdanāceni aṃgāniḻeṃ| śivatiḻe niṃba hote je javaḻeṃ| tihīṃ nirjībīṃhī devāṃcī niḍaḻeṃ | baisaṇīṃ kelīṃ || 84||
verses.meaning: Behold, by the touch of sandalwood, even the neem trees and other lifeless objects nearby were made worthy to adorn the forehead of Shiva.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तो चंदनु तेथ न पवे। ऐसें मनीं कैसेनि धरावें। अथवा पातला हें समर्थावें। तेव्हां कायी साच॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga to caṃdanu tetha na pave| aiseṃ manīṃ kaiseni dharāveṃ| athavā pātalā heṃ samarthāveṃ| tevhāṃ kāyī sāca|| 85||
verses.meaning: Then, how can one conceive in their mind that the sandalwood tree does not reach there? Or, if it is assumed to have reached, what truth does that hold?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ निववीलळ ऐशिया आशा । हरें चंद्रमा आधा ऐसा । वाहिजत असे शिरसा। निरंतर॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha nivavīlaḻa aiśiyā āśā | hareṃ caṃdramā ādhā aisā | vāhijata ase śirasā| niraṃtara|| 86||
verses.meaning: Where the moon, like a cooling balm, is held by Shiva on his head, constantly, to soothe the burning desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ निवविता आणि सगळा। परिमळें चंद्राहूनि आगळा । तो चंदनु केवीं अवलीळा । सर्वांगी न बैसे ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha nivavitā āṇi sagaḻā| parimaḻeṃ caṃdrāhūni āgaḻā | to caṃdanu kevīṃ avalīḻā | sarvāṃgī na baise || 87||
verses.meaning: There, the one who cools and is entirely more fragrant than the moon, how could that sandalwood not effortlessly permeate the entire body?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां रथ्योदकें जियेचिये कासे। लागलिया समुद्र जालीं अनायासें। तिये गंगेसि काय अनारिसें । गत्यंतर असे ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ rathyodakeṃ jiyeciye kāse| lāgaliyā samudra jālīṃ anāyāseṃ| tiye gaṃgesi kāya anāriseṃ | gatyaṃtara ase || 88||
verses.meaning: Just as the waters from the streets, upon joining the Ganga, effortlessly become the ocean itself, what other destination could there be for that Ganga?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि राजर्षि कां ब्राह्मण । जयां गति मति मीचि शरण्य । तयां त्रिशुद्धी मीच निर्वाण । स्थितीही मीचि॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni rājarṣi kāṃ brāhmaṇa | jayāṃ gati mati mīci śaraṇya | tayāṃ triśuddhī mīca nirvāṇa | sthitīhī mīci|| 89||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for royal sages or Brahmins, to whom I am the refuge for their progress and intellect, I am truly their ultimate liberation, and I am also their steadfast state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं शतजर्जर नावें। रिगोनि केवीं निश्‍चिंत होआवें। कैसेनि उघडिया असावें। शस्त्रवर्षी ॥ ४९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ śatajarjara nāveṃ| rigoni kevīṃ niś‍ciṃta hoāveṃ| kaiseni ughaḍiyā asāveṃ| śastravarṣī || 490||
verses.meaning: Therefore, how can one remain carefree on a hundred-times-shattered boat? How can one stay exposed in a shower of weapons?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अंगावरी पडतां पाषाण। न सुवावें केवीं वबोडण॥ रोगें दाटला आणि उदासपण। वोखदेंसी ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aṃgāvarī paḍatāṃ pāṣāṇa| na suvāveṃ kevīṃ vaboḍaṇa|| rogeṃ dāṭalā āṇi udāsapaṇa| vokhadeṃsī || 91||
verses.meaning: When a stone falls upon the body, how can one not be bruised? Similarly, when afflicted by disease and despondency, how can one not take medicine?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ चहूंकडे जळत वणवा । तेथूनि न निगिजे केवीं पांडवा। तेवीं लोकां येऊनि सोपद्रवां। केवीं न भजिजे मातें॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha cahūṃkaḍe jaḻata vaṇavā | tethūni na nigije kevīṃ pāṃḍavā| tevīṃ lokāṃ yeūni sopadravāṃ| kevīṃ na bhajije māteṃ||92||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, how can one not escape from a place where a forest fire rages on all sides? Similarly, how can people, having fallen into distress, not worship Me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा मातें न भजावयालागीं। कवण बळ पां आपुलिया आंगीं। काई घरीं कौं भोगीं। निश्‍चिंती केली॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā māteṃ na bhajāvayālāgīṃ| kavaṇa baḻa pāṃ āpuliyā āṃgīṃ| kāī gharīṃ kauṃ bhogīṃ| niś‍ciṃtī kelī|| 93||
verses.meaning: Oh, what strength do you possess within yourself that you do not worship Me? What do you hold dear in your home, or what pleasures do you enjoy, that have made you so carefree?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी विद्या कौं बयसा। ययां प्राणियांसि हा ऐसा। मज न भजतां भरंवसा । सुखाचा कोण॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī vidyā kauṃ bayasā| yayāṃ prāṇiyāṃsi hā aisā| maja na bhajatāṃ bharaṃvasā | sukhācā koṇa|| 94||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, what hope of happiness can these beings, whether learned or young, have without worshipping Me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी भोग्यजात जेतुलें। तें एका देहाचिया निकिया लागलें। आणि येथ देह तंव असे पडिलें। काळाचिये १८४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तोंडीं ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī bhogyajāta jetuleṃ| teṃ ekā dehāciyā nikiyā lāgaleṃ| āṇi yetha deha taṃva ase paḍileṃ| kāḻāciye 184 śrījñāneśvarī toṃḍīṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: All that is to be experienced is tied to one's body, and this body, in turn, is already fallen into the mouth of time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाप दुःखाचें केणें सुटलें। जेथ मरणाचे भरे लोटले। तिये मृत्युलोकींचिये शेवटिलें। येणें जाहाळें हाटवेळे॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāpa duḥkhāceṃ keṇeṃ suṭaleṃ| jetha maraṇāce bhare loṭale| tiye mṛtyulokīṃciye śevaṭileṃ| yeṇeṃ jāhāḻeṃ hāṭaveḻe|| 96||
verses.meaning: The market of sorrow has opened, where waves of death surge. This is the final market of the mortal world, which has become a place of great suffering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां सुखेंसि जीविता। कैंची ग्राहिकी कीजेल पंडुसुता। काय राखोंडी फुंकिता। दीपु लागे॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ sukheṃsi jīvitā| kaiṃcī grāhikī kījela paṃḍusutā| kāya rākhoṃḍī phuṃkitā| dīpu lāge|| 97||
verses.meaning: Now, with life itself being happiness, how can there be any desire to acquire anything else, O son of Pandu? Can a lamp be lit by blowing on ashes?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा विषाचे कांदे वाटुनी। जो रसु घेईजे पिळुनी। तया नाम अमृत ठेवुनी । जैसें अमर होणें ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā viṣāce kāṃde vāṭunī| jo rasu gheīje piḻunī| tayā nāma amṛta ṭhevunī | jaiseṃ amara hoṇeṃ || 98||
verses.meaning: Just as one might extract juice from poisonous bulbs, name it 'nectar,' and expect to become immortal by drinking it, so too is the folly of those who seek true happiness in worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेविं विषयांचें जें सुख। तें केवळ परम दुःख।॥ परि काय कीजे मूर्ख। न सेवितां न सरे॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teviṃ viṣayāṃceṃ jeṃ sukha| teṃ kevaḻa parama duḥkha||| pari kāya kīje mūrkha| na sevitāṃ na sare||99||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the pleasure derived from worldly objects is nothing but extreme sorrow. But what can be done, the ignorant cannot give it up without experiencing it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां शीस खांडूनि आपुलें। पायींच्या खतीं बांधिलें। तैसें मृत्युलोकींचें भलें। आहे आघवबें॥ ५००॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ śīsa khāṃḍūni āpuleṃ| pāyīṃcyā khatīṃ bāṃdhileṃ| taiseṃ mṛtyulokīṃceṃ bhaleṃ| āhe āghavabeṃ|| 500||
verses.meaning: Or, it is like cutting off one's own head and tying it to a wound on the foot. Such is all the good that exists in the mortal world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मृत्युलोकीं सुखाची कहाणी । ऐकिजेळ कवणाचिये श्रवणीं। कैंची सुखनिद्रा अंथरुणीं । इंगळांच्या ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mṛtyulokīṃ sukhācī kahāṇī | aikijeḻa kavaṇāciye śravaṇīṃ| kaiṃcī sukhanidrā aṃtharuṇīṃ | iṃgaḻāṃcyā || 91||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in this mortal world, who would hear the tale of happiness? Where is peaceful sleep on a bed of embers?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये लोकोंचा चंद्र क्षयरोगी। जेथ उदयो होय अस्तालागीं। दुःख लेऊनि सुखाची आंगी । सळित जगातें॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye lokoṃcā caṃdra kṣayarogī| jetha udayo hoya astālāgīṃ| duḥkha leūni sukhācī āṃgī | saḻita jagāteṃ|| 2||
verses.meaning: Where the moon is diseased and waning, where rising leads to setting, and where happiness is intertwined with sorrow, the world is afflicted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ मंगळाचिया अंकुरीं। सवेंचि अमंगळाची पडे 'पोहरी। मृत्यु उदराचिया परिवरीं। गर्भ गिंवसी॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha maṃgaḻāciyā aṃkurīṃ| saveṃci amaṃgaḻācī paḍe 'poharī| mṛtyu udarāciyā parivarīṃ| garbha giṃvasī|| 3||
verses.meaning: Where the sprout of auspiciousness immediately falls into the pit of inauspiciousness; death seeks out the embryo in the womb's enclosure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें नाहीं तयातें चिंतवी। तंब तेंचि नेइजे गंधर्वी। गेळियाची कवणें गांबीं। शुद्धी न लगे॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ nāhīṃ tayāteṃ ciṃtavī| taṃba teṃci neije gaṃdharvī| geḻiyācī kavaṇeṃ gāṃbīṃ| śuddhī na lage|| 4||
verses.meaning: That which does not exist, it makes one contemplate. Then it is taken away by the Gandharvas. Who can find the trace of what is lost?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा गिंवसितां आघविया वाटीं । परतलें पाउलचि नाहीं किरीटी । सैंघ निमालियांचियाचि गोठी। तियें पुराणें जेथिंचीं॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā giṃvasitāṃ āghaviyā vāṭīṃ | parataleṃ pāulaci nāhīṃ kirīṭī | saiṃgha nimāliyāṃciyāci goṭhī| tiyeṃ purāṇeṃ jethiṃcīṃ|| 5||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, though one may search all paths, no one has ever returned from there. The ancient scriptures speak only of those who have merged and disappeared into that ultimate reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथींचिये अनित्यतेची थोरी। करितया ब्रह्मयाचे आयुष्यवेरी। कैसें नाहीं होणें अवधारीं। निपटूनियां ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jethīṃciye anityatecī thorī| karitayā brahmayāce āyuṣyaverī| kaiseṃ nāhīṃ hoṇeṃ avadhārīṃ| nipaṭūniyāṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: Consider how the impermanence of this world, which extends to the very lifespan of Brahma, will utterly cease to be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी लोकोंची जिये नांदणूक। तेथ जन्मले आधि जे लोक। तयांचिये निश्‍चिंतीचें कौतुक। दिसत असे॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī lokoṃcī jiye nāṃdaṇūka| tetha janmale ādhi je loka| tayāṃciye niś‍ciṃtīceṃ kautuka| disata ase||7||
verses.meaning: In such a world, the wonder of the unwavering peace of those who were born there first is evident.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं दृष्टादृष्टाचिये जोडी-। लागीं भांडबळ न सुटे कवडी । जेथ सर्वस्वें हानि तेथ कोडी। वेंचिती गा॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭāciye joḍī-| lāgīṃ bhāṃḍabaḻa na suṭe kavaḍī | jetha sarvasveṃ hāni tetha koḍī| veṃcitī gā||8||
verses.meaning: For the sake of visible and invisible gains, they do not hesitate to spend even a single cowrie. Where there is complete loss, they spend crores (millions) there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो बहुवें विषयविलासें गुंफे। तो म्हणती उबायें पडिला सापें। जो अभिलाषभारें दडपे। तयातें सज्ञान म्हणती ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo bahuveṃ viṣayavilāseṃ guṃphe| to mhaṇatī ubāyeṃ paḍilā sāpeṃ| jo abhilāṣabhāreṃ daḍape| tayāteṃ sajñāna mhaṇatī || 9||
verses.meaning: One who is entangled in the pleasures of worldly objects, they say, is caught in a trap. One who is crushed by the burden of desires, they call him a wise person.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचें आयुष्य धाकुटें होय । बळ प्रज्ञा जिरौनि जाय । तयाचे नमस्कारिती 'पाय। बडिल म्हणुनी॥ ५१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceṃ āyuṣya dhākuṭeṃ hoya | baḻa prajñā jirauni jāya | tayāce namaskāritī 'pāya| baḍila mhaṇunī|| 510||
verses.meaning: One whose life is short, whose strength and wisdom fade away, people still bow at their feet, considering them elders.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंव जंब बाळ बळिया वाढे । तंव तंब भोजें नाचती कोडें। आयुष्य निमालें आंतुलियेकडे। ते ग्लानीचि नाहीं॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃva jaṃba bāḻa baḻiyā vāḍhe | taṃva taṃba bhojeṃ nācatī koḍeṃ| āyuṣya nimāleṃ āṃtuliyekaḍe| te glānīci nāhīṃ|| 11||
verses.meaning: As long as the child grows strong, so long do the parents rejoice. But the life within is diminishing, and of that, there is no awareness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जन्मलिया दिवसदिवसें। हों लागे काळाचेंचि ऐसें। कौं वाढती करिती उल्हासें। उभविती गुढिया॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: janmaliyā divasadivaseṃ| hoṃ lāge kāḻāceṃci aiseṃ| kauṃ vāḍhatī karitī ulhāseṃ| ubhavitī guḍhiyā|| 12||
verses.meaning: From the day of birth, with each passing day, one becomes a captive of time. How then can one grow and celebrate with joy, raising banners of victory?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा मर हा बोलु न साहती। आणि मेलिया तरी रडती । परि असतें जात न गणिती । गहिंसपणें॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā mara hā bolu na sāhatī| āṇi meliyā tarī raḍatī | pari asateṃ jāta na gaṇitī | gahiṃsapaṇeṃ|| 13||
verses.meaning: Alas, they cannot bear to hear the word 'death,' and yet they weep when someone dies. But they do not consider the coming and going (of life) due to their ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दर्दुर सापें गिळिजतु आहे उभा। कीं तो मासिया वेंटाळी जिभा । तैसें प्राणिये कवणा लोभा । वाढविती तृष्णा ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: dardura sāpeṃ giḻijatu āhe ubhā| kīṃ to māsiyā veṃṭāḻī jibhā | taiseṃ prāṇiye kavaṇā lobhā | vāḍhavitī tṛṣṇā || 14||
verses.meaning: Just as a frog is being swallowed by a snake, or a fish is caught on a hook, so too do living beings, for what gain, increase their desires?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहा कटकटा हें बोखटें। इये मृत्युलोकींचें उफराटें । एथ अर्जुना जरी अवचटें । जन्मलासी तूं॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahā kaṭakaṭā heṃ bokhaṭeṃ| iye mṛtyulokīṃceṃ upharāṭeṃ | etha arjunā jarī avacaṭeṃ | janmalāsī tūṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: Alas, what a wretched and perverse place this mortal world is! O Arjuna, even if you were born here by chance,

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि झडझडोनि वहिला निघ। इये भक्‍तीचिये वाटे लाग) जिया पावसी अव्यंग । निजधाम माझें ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari jhaḍajhaḍoni vahilā nigha| iye bhak‍tīciye vāṭe lāga) jiyā pāvasī avyaṃga | nijadhāma mājheṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Therefore, quickly rise and depart; embark on this path of devotion, by which you will attain My flawless, true abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं मन हें मीचि करीं । माझिया भजनी प्रेम धरीं । सर्वत्र नमस्कारी । मज 'एकातें॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ mana heṃ mīci karīṃ | mājhiyā bhajanī prema dharīṃ | sarvatra namaskārī | maja 'ekāteṃ|| 97||
verses.meaning: Fix your mind on Me alone. Hold love for My devotion. Bow down to Me, the One, everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझेनि अनुसंधानें देख। संकल्पु जाळणें निःशेख । मद्याजी चोख याचि नांव॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheni anusaṃdhāneṃ dekha| saṃkalpu jāḻaṇeṃ niḥśekha | madyājī cokha yāci nāṃva|| 18||
verses.meaning: Through my contemplation, the complete eradication of all desires and intentions is achieved. This is indeed the pure and true worship of Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा मियां आधिला होसी । तेथ माझियाचि स्वरूपा पावसी । हें अंतःकरणींचे तुजपासीं। बोलिजत असें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā miyāṃ ādhilā hosī | tetha mājhiyāci svarūpā pāvasī | heṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇīṃce tujapāsīṃ| bolijata aseṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: If you become like this, you will attain my very form. This is what I am telling you from the bottom of my heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा अवघिया चोरिया आपुलें। जें सर्वस्व आम्हीं असे ठेविलें। तें पाबोनि सुख संचलें। होऊनि ठासी ॥ ५२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā avaghiyā coriyā āpuleṃ| jeṃ sarvasva āmhīṃ ase ṭhevileṃ| teṃ pāboni sukha saṃcaleṃ| hoūni ṭhāsī || 520||
verses.meaning: Oh, all the thefts, all that we have treasured as our very own, having drunk that happiness, you will become it and remain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें सांबळेनि परब्रहों॥। भक्‍तकामकल्यपद्रुमें। बोलिलें आत्मारामें। संजयो म्हणे ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ sāṃbaḻeni parabrahoṃ||| bhak‍takāmakalyapadrumeṃ| bolileṃ ātmārāmeṃ| saṃjayo mhaṇe || 21||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said, "Thus, the Supreme Brahman, the wish-fulfilling tree for devotees, spoke through the inner Self."

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो ऐकिजत असें कीं अवधारा । तंव इया बोला निवांत म्हातारा । जैसा म्हैसा नुठी कां पुरा। तैसा उगाचि असे॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho aikijata aseṃ kīṃ avadhārā | taṃva iyā bolā nivāṃta mhātārā | jaisā mhaisā nuṭhī kāṃ purā| taisā ugāci ase|| 22||
verses.meaning: It is heard that he should listen. Then, at these words, the old man remained silent, like a buffalo that does not move from the floodwaters, he just stayed still.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ संजयें माथा तुकिला । अहा अमृताचा पाऊस वर्षला । कीं हा एथ असतुचि गेला। सेजिया गांवा॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha saṃjayeṃ māthā tukilā | ahā amṛtācā pāūsa varṣalā | kīṃ hā etha asatuci gelā| sejiyā gāṃvā|| 23||
verses.meaning: There, Sanjaya bowed his head, exclaiming, "Ah, a shower of nectar has fallen! Or has he, while still present here, gone to the other village (the spiritual realm)?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तऱही दातारु हा आमुचा । म्हणौनि हें बोलतां मैळेल वाचा। काय कीजे ययाचा। स्वभावोचि ऐसा ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṟahī dātāru hā āmucā | mhaṇauni heṃ bolatāṃ maiḻela vācā| kāya kīje yayācā| svabhāvoci aisā || 24||
verses.meaning: Such is the nature of our generous giver, that even speaking of it would defile the tongue. What can be done, for such is its very nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि बाप भाग्य माझें। जें वृत्तांतु सांगावयाचेनि व्याजें। कैसा रक्षिलो मुनिराजें। श्रीव्यासदेवें ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari bāpa bhāgya mājheṃ| jeṃ vṛttāṃtu sāṃgāvayāceni vyājeṃ| kaisā rakṣilo munirājeṃ| śrīvyāsadeveṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Oh, how fortunate I am! Under the pretext of narrating this story, the sage Vyasadeva has protected me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलें हें बाड सायासें। जंब बोलत असे दृढमानसें। तंव न धरवेचि आपुलिया ऐसें। सात्त्विकें केलें॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetuleṃ heṃ bāḍa sāyāseṃ| jaṃba bolata ase dṛḍhamānaseṃ| taṃva na dharaveci āpuliyā aiseṃ| sāttvikeṃ keleṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: When the mind, with such great effort, speaks with firm resolve, it cannot be held back by its own accord; it is propelled by sattvic (pure) qualities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चित्त चाकाटलें आटु घेत । वाचा पांगुळळी जेथिंची तेथ। आपाद कंचुकित। रोमांच आळे॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: citta cākāṭaleṃ āṭu gheta | vācā pāṃguḻaḻī jethiṃcī tetha| āpāda kaṃcukita| romāṃca āḻe|| 27||
verses.meaning: The mind is bewildered and drawn in, the speech is crippled right where it is, and the body is covered with goosebumps.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्धोन्मीलित डोळे। वर्षताति आनंदजळें । १८६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आंतुलिया सुखोर्मीचेनि बळें । बाहेरी कांपे॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ardhonmīlita ḍoḻe| varṣatāti ānaṃdajaḻeṃ | 186 śrījñāneśvarī āṃtuliyā sukhormīceni baḻeṃ | bāherī kāṃpe|| 28||
verses.meaning: With half-closed eyes, tears of joy stream forth. From the strength of the inner waves of bliss, the body trembles outwardly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आघवाचि रोममूळीं । आली स्वेदकणिका निर्मळीं। लेडइला मोतियांची कडियाळीं । आवडे तैसा ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āghavāci romamūḻīṃ | ālī svedakaṇikā nirmaḻīṃ| leḍailā motiyāṃcī kaḍiyāḻīṃ | āvaḍe taisā || 29||
verses.meaning: Behold, on every hair root, pure drops of sweat appeared, adorning him like a garland of pearls, as if by his own will.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा महासुखाचेनि अतिरसें। जेथ आटणी हों पाहे जीवदशे । तेथ निरोपिलें व्यासें। तें नेदीच हों ॥ ५३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā mahāsukhāceni atiraseṃ| jetha āṭaṇī hoṃ pāhe jīvadaśe | tetha niropileṃ vyāseṃ| teṃ nedīca hoṃ || 530||
verses.meaning: When the individual soul is about to dissolve into the overwhelming bliss of the Supreme, Vyasa's teachings prevent it from happening, maintaining its distinct existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिक श्रीकृष्णाचें बोलणें । घोंकरी आलें श्रवणें । कौं देहस्मृतीचा तेणें। वापसा केला॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇika śrīkṛṣṇāceṃ bolaṇeṃ | ghoṃkarī āleṃ śravaṇeṃ | kauṃ dehasmṛtīcā teṇeṃ| vāpasā kelā|| 39||
verses.meaning: And Krishna's words, upon being heard, brought about a state as if the memory of the body had been completely erased.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां नेत्रींचे जळ विसर्जी । सर्वांगींचा स्वेदु परिमार्जी। तेवींचि अवधारा म्हणे हो जी। धृतराष्ट्राते ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ netrīṃce jaḻa visarjī | sarvāṃgīṃcā svedu parimārjī| tevīṃci avadhārā mhaṇe ho jī| dhṛtarāṣṭrāte || 32||
verses.meaning: Then, wiping the tears from his eyes and the sweat from his entire body, he said, "Listen, O Dhritarashtra!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां श्रीकृष्णबाक्यबीजा निवाडु।) आणि संजय सात्त्विकाचा बिवडु । म्हणौनि श्रोतयां होईल सुरवाडु । प्रमेयपिकाचा ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ śrīkṛṣṇabākyabījā nivāḍu|) āṇi saṃjaya sāttvikācā bivaḍu | mhaṇauni śrotayāṃ hoīla suravāḍu | prameyapikācā || 33 ||
verses.meaning: Now, the words of Shri Krishna are the seed, and Sanjaya is the pure soil. Therefore, the listeners will enjoy the harvest of profound spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो अळुमाळ अवधान देयावें। येतुलेनि आनंदाचे राशीवरी बैसावें। बाप श्रवणेंद्रिया दैवें। घातळी माळ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho aḻumāḻa avadhāna deyāveṃ| yetuleni ānaṃdāce rāśīvarī baisāveṃ| bāpa śravaṇeṃdriyā daiveṃ| ghātaḻī māḻa|| 34||
verses.meaning: Oh, just pay a little attention, and you will be seated upon heaps of joy. Indeed, by good fortune, the garland has been placed upon the ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विभूतींचा ठावो । अर्जुना दाबील सिद्धांचा रावो। तो ऐका म्हणे ज्ञानदेवो । निवृत्तीचा ॥ ५३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vibhūtīṃcā ṭhāvo | arjunā dābīla siddhāṃcā rāvo| to aikā mhaṇe jñānadevo | nivṛttīcā || 535 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, the king of the Siddhas will reveal the abode of the vibhutis. Listen to that, says Dnyandev, the disciple of Nivrutti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नमो विशदबोधविदग्धा। विद्यारविंदप्रबोधा। पराप्रमेयप्रमदा-। बिलासिया॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: namo viśadabodhavidagdhā| vidyāraviṃdaprabodhā| parāprameyapramadā-| bilāsiyā|| 1||
verses.meaning: Salutations to the one who is skilled in pure knowledge, who awakens the lotus of wisdom, and who delights in the sport of the immeasurable, supreme beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नमो संसारतमसूर्या। अपरिमितपरमवीर्या । तरुणतरतूर्या- । 'लालनलीला ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: namo saṃsāratamasūryā| aparimitaparamavīryā | taruṇataratūryā- | 'lālanalīlā || 2||
verses.meaning: Salutations to the Sun that dispels the darkness of worldly existence, to the immeasurable supreme power, to the ever-youthful and vibrant, whose sport is the nurturing of all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नमो जगदखिलपालना । मंगळमणिनिधाना । सज्जनवनचंदना । आराध्यलिंगा ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: namo jagadakhilapālanā | maṃgaḻamaṇinidhānā | sajjanavanacaṃdanā | ārādhyaliṃgā || 3||
verses.meaning: Salutations to the protector of the entire universe, the abode of auspicious jewels, the sandalwood tree in the garden of saints, the revered Shiva Lingam.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नमो चतुरचित्तचकोरचंद्रा । आत्मानुभवनरेंद्रा । श्रृतिसारसमुद्रा । मन्मथमन्मथा॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: namo caturacittacakoracaṃdrā | ātmānubhavanareṃdrā | śrṛtisārasamudrā | manmathamanmathā|| 4||
verses.meaning: Salutations to the moon for the chakor-like minds of the wise, to the king of self-realization, to the ocean of the essence of the Vedas, to the one who conquers even the god of love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नमो सुभावभजनभाजना। भवेभकुंभभंजना। बिश्‍्बोदभवभुवना । श्रीगुरुराया ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: namo subhāvabhajanabhājanā| bhavebhakuṃbhabhaṃjanā| biś‍bodabhavabhuvanā | śrīgururāyā || 5||
verses.meaning: Salutations to the Guru, who is the abode of natural devotion, the destroyer of the elephant of worldly existence, and the origin of the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुमचा अनुग्रहो गणेशु । जैं दे आपुला सौरसु। तें सारस्वतीं प्रवेशु, बाळकाही आथी॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tumacā anugraho gaṇeśu | jaiṃ de āpulā saurasu| teṃ sārasvatīṃ praveśu, bāḻakāhī āthī|| 6||
verses.meaning: When your grace, O Ganesha, bestows its essence, even a child gains entry into the realm of Saraswati (divine knowledge).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी दैविकी उदार वाचा । जैं उद्देशु दे नाभिकाराचा । तैं नवरससुधाब्धीचा । थाबो लाभे ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī daivikī udāra vācā | jaiṃ uddeśu de nābhikārācā | taiṃ navarasasudhābdhīcā | thābo lābhe || 7||
verses.meaning: When the divine, generous speech (of the Guru) bestows its intention, then one attains the shore of the ocean of nine nectarean rasas (emotions/flavors).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी आपुलिया स्नेहाची वागेश्‍्वरी । जरी मुकेयातें अंगिकारी । तो वाचस्पतीशीं करी । प्रबंधु होडा॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī āpuliyā snehācī vāgeś‍varī | jarī mukeyāteṃ aṃgikārī | to vācaspatīśīṃ karī | prabaṃdhu hoḍā|| 8||
verses.meaning: If the Goddess of Speech, out of her own love, embraces even a mute person, that person can then compose works that rival those of Brihaspati (the guru of the gods, known for his eloquence).

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो दिठी जयावरी झळके । कीं हा पद्यकरु माथां पारुखे। तो जीवचि परि तुके । महेशेंसी ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso diṭhī jayāvarī jhaḻake | kīṃ hā padyakaru māthāṃ pārukhe| to jīvaci pari tuke | maheśeṃsī || 9||
verses.meaning: Let this be. The one on whom His gaze falls, or on whose head His lotus-like hand rests, that soul, though a mere being, becomes equal to Lord Shiva Himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवढें जिये महिमेचें करणें। तें वाचाबळें वानूं मी कवणें। का सूर्याचिया आंगा उटणें। लागत असे॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaḍheṃ jiye mahimeceṃ karaṇeṃ| teṃ vācābaḻeṃ vānūṃ mī kavaṇeṃ| kā sūryāciyā āṃgā uṭaṇeṃ| lāgata ase|| 10||
verses.meaning: How can I, with the power of my words, describe such a glorious deed? Is it possible to apply an anointing paste to the sun?

verses.shloka_devanagari: केउता कल्पतरुवरी फुलौीरा। कायसेनि पाहुणेरु क्षीरसागरा । कवणें वासीं कापुरा। सुवासु देवो ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: keutā kalpataruvarī phulauīrā| kāyaseni pāhuṇeru kṣīrasāgarā | kavaṇeṃ vāsīṃ kāpurā| suvāsu devo || 99||
verses.meaning: How can one offer flowers to a wish-fulfilling tree? How can one be a guest to the ocean of milk? What fragrance can one give to camphor?

verses.shloka_devanagari: चंदनातें कायसेनि चर्चावें। अमृतातें केउतें रांधावें। गगनावरी उभवावें। घडे केवीं॥१२॥
verses.shloka_iast: caṃdanāteṃ kāyaseni carcāveṃ| amṛtāteṃ keuteṃ rāṃdhāveṃ| gaganāvarī ubhavāveṃ| ghaḍe kevīṃ||12||
verses.meaning: How can sandalwood be adorned? How can nectar be cooked? How can the sky be erected?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें श्रीगुरूचें महिमान। आकळितें कें असे साधन। हें जाणोनि मियां नमन। निवांत केलें॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ śrīgurūceṃ mahimāna| ākaḻiteṃ keṃ ase sādhana| heṃ jāṇoni miyāṃ namana| nivāṃta keleṃ|| 93||
verses.meaning: Such is the glory of the Guru, what means can grasp it? Knowing this, I have simply offered my obeisance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी प्रज्ञेचेनि आथिलेपणें । श्रीगुरुसामर्थ्या रूप करूं म्हणे। तरि ते मोतियां भिंग देणें। तेसें होईल॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī prajñeceni āthilepaṇeṃ | śrīgurusāmarthyā rūpa karūṃ mhaṇe| tari te motiyāṃ bhiṃga deṇeṃ| teseṃ hoīla|| 14||
verses.meaning: Even if one were to attempt to give form to the power of the Guru, through the abundance of one's own intellect, it would be like trying to give a mirror to a pearl.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां साडेपंधरया रजतवणी । तैशीं स्तुतीचीं बोलणीं। उगियाचि माथा ठेविजे चरणीं । हेंचि भलें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ sāḍepaṃdharayā rajatavaṇī | taiśīṃ stutīcīṃ bolaṇīṃ| ugiyāci māthā ṭhevije caraṇīṃ | heṃci bhaleṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: Or like the silver of fifteen and a half parts, so are words of praise. It is better to simply bow one's head at the feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणितलें जी स्वामी । भलेनि ममत्वें देखिलें तुम्हीं । म्हणोनि कृष्णार्जुनसंगमीं । प्रयागवटु जाहलो ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇitaleṃ jī svāmī | bhaleni mamatveṃ dekhileṃ tumhīṃ | mhaṇoni kṛṣṇārjunasaṃgamīṃ | prayāgavaṭu jāhalo || 16||
verses.meaning: Then, the Lord said, "Because you have looked upon me with such loving devotion, I have become the sacred banyan tree at the confluence of Krishna and Arjuna."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मागां दूध दे म्हणतलियासाठीं। आघविया क्षीराब्धीची करूनि वाटी । उपमन्यूपुढें धूर्जटी । ठेविली जैसी ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: māgāṃ dūdha de mhaṇataliyāsāṭhīṃ| āghaviyā kṣīrābdhīcī karūni vāṭī | upamanyūpuḍheṃ dhūrjaṭī | ṭhevilī jaisī || 17||
verses.meaning: Just as, when Upamanyu asked for milk, Lord Shiva placed the entire ocean of milk before him as a small bowl.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी वैकुंठपीठनायकें । रुसला ध्रुव कवतिकें । बुझाविला देऊनि भातुकें । १८८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी थ्रुबपदाचें ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī vaikuṃṭhapīṭhanāyakeṃ | rusalā dhruva kavatikeṃ | bujhāvilā deūni bhātukeṃ | 188 śrījñāneśvarī thrubapadāceṃ || 18||
verses.meaning: Or, the Lord of Vaikuntha, the master of the highest abode, appeased the playfully sulking Dhruva by offering him a sweet treat.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी जे ब्रह्मविद्याराबो। सकळ शास्त्रांचा विसंवता ठावो। ते भगवद्‌गीता वोंबिये गावों। ऐसें केलें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī je brahmavidyārābo| sakaḻa śāstrāṃcā visaṃvatā ṭhāvo| te bhagavad‌gītā voṃbiye gāvoṃ| aiseṃ keleṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: In the same way, I have sung this Bhagavad Gita, which is the very essence of Brahman-knowledge and the trusted abode of all scriptures, in the form of an ovi (a Marathi poetic meter).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे बोलणियाचे रानीं हिंडतां। नायकिजे फळलिया अक्षराची वार्ता। परि ते बाचाचि केली 'कल्पलता। विवेकाची॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je bolaṇiyāce rānīṃ hiṃḍatāṃ| nāyakije phaḻaliyā akṣarācī vārtā| pari te bācāci kelī 'kalpalatā| vivekācī|| 20||
verses.meaning: In the realm of ordinary speech, one does not hear of words bearing fruit. But that very speech has been transformed into a wish-fulfilling tree of wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: होती देहबुद्धी एकसरी। ते आनंदभांडारा केली बोबरी। मन गीतार्थसागरीं। जळशयन जाळें॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: hotī dehabuddhī ekasarī| te ānaṃdabhāṃḍārā kelī bobarī| mana gītārthasāgarīṃ| jaḻaśayana jāḻeṃ|| 21||
verses.meaning: The body-consciousness, which was singular and unwavering, was made to wander in the treasury of bliss. The mind, in the ocean of the Gita's meaning, found its water-bed, as if in a net.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें एकेक देवांचें करणें। तें अपार बोलों केवीं मी जाणें। तऱही अनुवादलों धीटपणें । तें उपसाहिजो जी॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ ekeka devāṃceṃ karaṇeṃ| teṃ apāra boloṃ kevīṃ mī jāṇeṃ| taṟahī anuvādaloṃ dhīṭapaṇeṃ | teṃ upasāhijo jī|| 22||
verses.meaning: Such are the deeds of each deity, immeasurable; how can I, a mere mortal, comprehend and speak of them? Yet, I have dared to translate them with boldness. Please forgive this audacity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां आपुलेनि कृपाप्रसादें। मियां भगवद्गीता बोवीप्रबंधें । पूर्वखंड विनोदें। बाखाणिलें॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ āpuleni kṛpāprasādeṃ| miyāṃ bhagavadgītā bovīprabaṃdheṃ | pūrvakhaṃḍa vinodeṃ| bākhāṇileṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: Now, by Your grace, I have playfully expounded the first part of the Bhagavad Gita in the form of ovis.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रथमीं अर्जुनाचा विषादु। दुजीं बोळिला योगु विशदु। परि सांख्यबुद्धीसि भेदु। दाऊनियां॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: prathamīṃ arjunācā viṣādu| dujīṃ boḻilā yogu viśadu| pari sāṃkhyabuddhīsi bhedu| dāūniyāṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: First, Arjuna's sorrow was dispelled. Second, the clear path of Yoga was explained, but by revealing the distinction of Sankhya-buddhi (the wisdom of discrimination).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिजीं केवळ कर्म प्रतिष्ठिलें। तेंचि चतुर्थी ज्ञानेंशीं प्रगटिलें। पंचमी गव्हरिळें। योगतत्त्व ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tijīṃ kevaḻa karma pratiṣṭhileṃ| teṃci caturthī jñāneṃśīṃ pragaṭileṃ| paṃcamī gavhariḻeṃ| yogatattva || 25||
verses.meaning: That which was established as mere action in the third, manifested with knowledge in the fourth, and in the fifth, the essence of Yoga was revealed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि षष्ठामाजीं प्रगट । आसनालागोनि स्पष्ट । जीवात्मभाव एकवट । होती जेणें ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci ṣaṣṭhāmājīṃ pragaṭa | āsanālāgoni spaṣṭa | jīvātmabhāva ekavaṭa | hotī jeṇeṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: That same (yoga) is clearly manifested in the sixth chapter, where the individual soul and the universal soul become one through the practice of asana (posture).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसी जे योगस्थिति। आणि योगश्रष्टां जे गति। ते आघवीचि उपपत्ती । सांगितली षष्ठीं ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tesī je yogasthiti| āṇi yogaśraṣṭāṃ je gati| te āghavīci upapattī | sāṃgitalī ṣaṣṭhīṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Thus, the state of Yoga and the destiny of those who fall from Yoga, all these principles have been explained in the sixth chapter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयावरी सप्तमीं । प्रकृतिपरिहार उपक्रमीं। भजती जे पुरुषोत्तमीं। ते बोलिले चाऱ्ही ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāvarī saptamīṃ | prakṛtiparihāra upakramīṃ| bhajatī je puruṣottamīṃ| te bolile cāṟhī || 28||
verses.meaning: Upon this, the seventh chapter begins with the renunciation of Prakriti. Those who worship the Purushottama, the Supreme Being, are spoken of in four ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं सप्तप्रश्‍नविधि । बोलोनि प्रयाणसमयसिद्धी । एवं ते सकळ वाक्‍्यावधि । अष्टमाध्यायीं ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ saptapraś‍navidhi | boloni prayāṇasamayasiddhī | evaṃ te sakaḻa vāk‍yāvadhi | aṣṭamādhyāyīṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Thus, after explaining the seven types of questions and the method of departure at the time of death, all these topics are covered in the eighth chapter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां शब्दब्रह्मी असंख्याकें। जेतुला कांहीं अभिप्राय पिके । तेतुला महाभारतें एकें । लक्षें जोडे ॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ śabdabrahmī asaṃkhyākeṃ| jetulā kāṃhīṃ abhiprāya pike | tetulā mahābhārateṃ ekeṃ | lakṣeṃ joḍe || 30||
verses.meaning: Now, whatever meaning is conveyed by the innumerable Vedic scriptures, that entire meaning is encompassed within the single Mahabharata, which contains one hundred thousand verses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये आघवांचि जें महाभारतीं। तें लाभे कृष्णार्जुनवाचोक्तीं । आणि जो अभिप्रावो सातेंशतीं । तो एकल्ग्रचि नवमीं ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye āghavāṃci jeṃ mahābhāratīṃ| teṃ lābhe kṛṣṇārjunavācoktīṃ | āṇi jo abhiprāvo sāteṃśatīṃ | to ekalgraci navamīṃ || 31||
verses.meaning: All that is contained within the Mahabharata is attained through the dialogues of Krishna and Arjuna. And the essence found in the seven hundred verses (of the Gita) is singularly present in the ninth chapter (of the Gita).

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि नवमींचिया अभिप्राया । सहसा मुद्रा लावावया। बिहाला मग मी वायां। गर्व कां करूं॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni navamīṃciyā abhiprāyā | sahasā mudrā lāvāvayā| bihālā maga mī vāyāṃ| garva kāṃ karūṃ|| 32||
verses.meaning: Therefore, to suddenly seal the ninth chapter's intent, I became afraid. Why then should I foolishly boast?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो गूळासाखरे माल्याचे। हे बांधे तरी 'एकाचि रसाचे । परि स्वाद गोडियेचे । आनआन जेसें ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho gūḻāsākhare mālyāce| he bāṃdhe tarī 'ekāci rasāce | pari svāda goḍiyece | ānaāna jeseṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Just as jaggery and sugar, though both derived from the same sugarcane juice, offer distinct and different tastes of sweetness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक जाणोनियां बोलती । एक ठायेंठावो जाणविती। एक जाणों जातां हारपती। जाणते गुणेंशीं ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka jāṇoniyāṃ bolatī | eka ṭhāyeṃṭhāvo jāṇavitī| eka jāṇoṃ jātāṃ hārapatī| jāṇate guṇeṃśīṃ || 34||
verses.meaning: Some speak of it as one, some make it known in various places, and some, in the very act of knowing, lose themselves in its qualities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे ऐसे अध्याय गीतेचे । परि अनिर्वाच्यपण नवमाचें। तो अनुवादलों हें तुमचें । सामर्थ्य प्रभू ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: he aise adhyāya gītece | pari anirvācyapaṇa navamāceṃ| to anuvādaloṃ heṃ tumaceṃ | sāmarthya prabhū || 35 ||
verses.meaning: These are the chapters of the Gita, but the ineffable nature of the ninth chapter - that I have translated it, O Lord, is Your power.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो एकाचि शाटी तपिन्नली। एकी सृष्टीवरी सृष्टी केळी। एकीं पाषाणीं बाऊनि उतरलीं। समुद्री कटकें॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho ekāci śāṭī tapinnalī| ekī sṛṣṭīvarī sṛṣṭī keḻī| ekīṃ pāṣāṇīṃ bāūni utaralīṃ| samudrī kaṭakeṃ|| 36||
verses.meaning: Some performed penance in a single garment. Some created worlds upon worlds. Some, by carving stones, made them float on the sea like an army.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकीं आकाशीं सूर्याते धरिलें। एकीं चुळींचि सागरातें भरिलें। तैसें मज मुकयाकरवीं बोलविलें। अनिर्वाच्य तुम्ही ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekīṃ ākāśīṃ sūryāte dharileṃ| ekīṃ cuḻīṃci sāgarāteṃ bharileṃ| taiseṃ maja mukayākaravīṃ bolavileṃ| anirvācya tumhī || 37||
verses.meaning: Some have held the sun in the sky; some have filled the ocean in a mere handful. Similarly, you have made me, a mute, speak the inexpressible, O Ineffable One.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि हें असो एथ ऐसें।॥ राम रावण झुंजिन्नळे कैसे। राम रावण जैसे। मीनले समरीं ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari heṃ aso etha aiseṃ||| rāma rāvaṇa jhuṃjinnaḻe kaise| rāma rāvaṇa jaise| mīnale samarīṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: Let this be so. How did Rama and Ravana fight? As Rama and Ravana met in battle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें नवमीं कृष्णाचें बोलणें । तें नवमींचियाचि ऐसें मी म्हणें । या निवाडा तत्त्वज्ञु जाणे। जया गौतार्थ्‌ हातीं ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ navamīṃ kṛṣṇāceṃ bolaṇeṃ | teṃ navamīṃciyāci aiseṃ mī mhaṇeṃ | yā nivāḍā tattvajñu jāṇe| jayā gautārth‌ hātīṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Similarly, Krishna's discourse in the ninth chapter is, I say, like the ninth chapter itself. Only a true philosopher, one who has grasped the profound meaning, can discern this truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं नवही अध्याय 'पहिले। मियां मतीसारिखे वाखाणिळे। आतां उत्तरखंड उवाइलें। ग्रंथाचें ऐका॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ navahī adhyāya 'pahile| miyāṃ matīsārikhe vākhāṇiḻe| ātāṃ uttarakhaṃḍa uvāileṃ| graṃthāceṃ aikā|| 40||
verses.meaning: Thus, the first nine chapters I have expounded to the best of my understanding. Now, listen to the unfolding of the latter part of this scripture.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ विभूती प्रतिविभूती। प्रस्तुत अर्जुना सांगिजेती। ते बिदग्धा रसवृत्ती। म्हणिपैळ कथा॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha vibhūtī prativibhūtī| prastuta arjunā sāṃgijetī| te bidagdhā rasavṛttī| mhaṇipaiḻa kathā|| 41||
verses.meaning: Here, the manifestations and counter-manifestations are being told to Arjuna. This is a delightful story for the discerning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देशियेचेनि नागरपणें। शांतु शृंगारातें जिणें । तरि ओंबिया होती लेणें । साहित्यासि॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: deśiyeceni nāgarapaṇeṃ| śāṃtu śṛṃgārāteṃ jiṇeṃ | tari oṃbiyā hotī leṇeṃ | sāhityāsi|| 42||
verses.meaning: With the elegance of the native language, peace surpasses even romance, then these ovis become ornaments for literature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मूळग्रंथींचिया संस्कृता। वरि मऱ्हाटी नीट पढतां। अभिप्राय मानल्या उच्िता। कवण भूमी हें न चोजवे॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mūḻagraṃthīṃciyā saṃskṛtā| vari maṟhāṭī nīṭa paḍhatāṃ| abhiprāya mānalyā ucitā| kavaṇa bhūmī heṃ na cojave|| 43||
verses.meaning: When the original Sanskrit text is read properly in Marathi, and its meaning is considered appropriate, it is not discernible which land it belongs to.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेसें अंगाचेनि सुंदरपणें । लेणिया आंगचि होय लेणें। तेथ अळंकारिलें कवण कवणें। हें निर्वचेना ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeseṃ aṃgāceni suṃdarapaṇeṃ | leṇiyā āṃgaci hoya leṇeṃ| tetha aḻaṃkārileṃ kavaṇa kavaṇeṃ| heṃ nirvacenā || 44||
verses.meaning: Just as the inherent beauty of the body itself becomes the ornament, it is impossible to determine who adorns whom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी देशी आणि संस्कृत वाणी। एका भावार्थाच्या सुखासनीं। शोभती आयणी। चोखट आइका ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī deśī āṇi saṃskṛta vāṇī| ekā bhāvārthācyā sukhāsanīṃ| śobhatī āyaṇī| cokhaṭa āikā || 45 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the native and Sanskrit languages, when conveying a single profound meaning, beautifully adorn the throne of bliss, so too should you listen attentively.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उठावलिया भावा रूप। करितां रसवृत्तीचें लागे वडप। चातुर्य म्हणे पडप। जोडलें आम्हां ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: uṭhāvaliyā bhāvā rūpa| karitāṃ rasavṛttīceṃ lāge vaḍapa| cāturya mhaṇe paḍapa| joḍaleṃ āmhāṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: When the form of devotion arises, it becomes a delightful experience for the mind. Wisdom then declares, "We have gained a great treasure."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें देशियेचें लावण्य । हिरोनि आणिलें तारुण्य। मग रचिलें अगण्य। गीतातत्त्व॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ deśiyeceṃ lāvaṇya | hironi āṇileṃ tāruṇya| maga racileṃ agaṇya| gītātattva|| 47||
verses.meaning: Thus, having stolen the beauty of the native language, and brought forth its youth, then was composed the immeasurable essence of the Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो चराचरपरमगुरु। चतुरचित्तचमत्कारुी। तो ऐका यादवेश्वरु। बोलता जाहला ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo carācaraparamaguru| caturacittacamatkāruī| to aikā yādaveśvaru| bolatā jāhalā || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Listen, the Lord of Yadavas, who is the supreme guru of all animate and inanimate beings, and who is the wonder of the intelligent mind, began to speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानदेव निवृत्तीचा म्हणे । ऐसें बोलिलें श्रीहरी तेणें । अर्जुना आघवियाची मातु अंतःकरणें। धडौता आहासि ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñānadeva nivṛttīcā mhaṇe | aiseṃ bolileṃ śrīharī teṇeṃ | arjunā āghaviyācī mātu aṃtaḥkaraṇeṃ| dhaḍautā āhāsi || 49||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev says, "Nivritti, Shri Hari spoke thus: 'Arjuna, you are indeed steadfast in heart regarding all these matters.'"

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं मागील जें निरूपण केलें। तें तुझें अबधानचि पाहिलें । तंव टांचें नव्हे भलें। पुरतें आहे ॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ māgīla jeṃ nirūpaṇa keleṃ| teṃ tujheṃ abadhānaci pāhileṃ | taṃva ṭāṃceṃ navhe bhaleṃ| purateṃ āhe || 50||
verses.meaning: The discourse we presented earlier, it was your attention that truly observed it. It was not merely a fleeting glance, but a complete and thorough understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घटीं थोडेंसें उदक घालिजे। तेणें न गळे तरी वरिता भरिजे। तैसा परिसौनि पाहिलासि तंव परिसविजे । ऐसेंचि होतसे ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghaṭīṃ thoḍeṃseṃ udaka ghālije| teṇeṃ na gaḻe tarī varitā bharije| taisā parisauni pāhilāsi taṃva parisavije | aiseṃci hotase || 59||
verses.meaning: If a little water is poured into a pot, and it doesn't dissolve, then more is added from above. Similarly, after hearing, if you haven't fully understood, then more is explained until it is grasped. This is how it happens.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवचितयावरी सर्वस्व सांडिजे। मग चोख तरी तोचि भांडारी कीजे। तैसा किरीटी तूं आतां माझें। निजधाम कौं ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: avacitayāvarī sarvasva sāṃḍije| maga cokha tarī toci bhāṃḍārī kīje| taisā kirīṭī tūṃ ātāṃ mājheṃ| nijadhāma kauṃ || 52||
verses.meaning: Suddenly, all is surrendered to Him. Then, He alone is made the pure treasurer. Similarly, Arjuna, you are now My true abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अर्जुना येउतें सर्वेश्‍वरें। पाहोनि बोलिलें अत्यादरें। गिरी देखोनि सुभरे। मेघु जैसा॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ arjunā yeuteṃ sarveś‍vareṃ| pāhoni bolileṃ atyādareṃ| girī dekhoni subhare| meghu jaisā|| 53||
verses.meaning: Seeing Arjuna in such a state, the Lord of all spoke with great affection, just as a cloud, heavy with rain, speaks to a mountain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा कृपाळुबांचा रावो । म्हणे आइकें गा महाबाहो । सांगितलाचि अभिप्रावो । १९० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी सांगेन पुढती ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā kṛpāḻubāṃcā rāvo | mhaṇe āikeṃ gā mahābāho | sāṃgitalāci abhiprāvo | 190 śrījñāneśvarī sāṃgena puḍhatī || 54||
verses.meaning: The king of the compassionate, Lord Krishna, said, "Listen, O mighty-armed Arjuna, I will explain the same meaning again in the Shri Dnyaneshwari." (This ovi is from Dnyaneshwari, chapter 19, ovi 54)

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं प्रतिवर्षी क्षेत्र पेरिजे। पिकाची जंब जंब वाढी देखिजे। यालागीं नुबगिजे। बाहो करितां ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ prativarṣī kṣetra perije| pikācī jaṃba jaṃba vāḍhī dekhije| yālāgīṃ nubagije| bāho karitāṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Just as a field is sown every year, and one sees the crop grow abundantly, so too, one should not tire of performing good deeds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढतपुढती पुटें देतां । जोडे वबानियेची अधिकता । म्हणौनि सोनें पांडुसुता। शोधूंचि आवडे ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhatapuḍhatī puṭeṃ detāṃ | joḍe vabāniyecī adhikatā | mhaṇauni soneṃ pāṃḍusutā| śodhūṃci āvaḍe || 56||
verses.meaning: Just as gold, the more it is refined, the more its purity increases, so too, O son of Pandu, the more one purifies the self, the more it is cherished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें एथ पार्था । तुज आभार नाहीं सर्वथा । आम्ही आपुल्ियाचि स्वार्था । बोलों पुढती ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ etha pārthā | tuja ābhāra nāhīṃ sarvathā | āmhī āpuliyāci svārthā | boloṃ puḍhatī || 57||
verses.meaning: Just as here, O Partha, there is no obligation upon you whatsoever. We speak further for our own benefit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें बाळका लेवविजे लेणें। तया शृंगारा बाळ काई जाणे । परि ते सुखाचे सोहळे भोगणें। माउलिये दिठी ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ bāḻakā levavije leṇeṃ| tayā śṛṃgārā bāḻa kāī jāṇe | pari te sukhāce sohaḻe bhogaṇeṃ| māuliye diṭhī || 58||
verses.meaning: Just as a child is adorned with ornaments, what does the child know of that adornment? But the joy of that beauty is experienced through the mother's eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तुझें हित आधवें। जंब जंब कां तुज फावे। तंव तंब आमुचें सुख दुणावे। ऐसें आहे॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ tujheṃ hita ādhaveṃ| jaṃba jaṃba kāṃ tuja phāve| taṃva taṃba āmuceṃ sukha duṇāve| aiseṃ āhe|| 59||
verses.meaning: Just as your well-being, whenever and however it comes to you, so too our happiness doubles. Such is our state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां अर्जुना असो हे विकडी। मज उघड तुझी आवडी । म्हणोनि तृप्तीची सवडी। बोलतां न पडे॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ arjunā aso he vikaḍī| maja ughaḍa tujhī āvaḍī | mhaṇoni tṛptīcī savaḍī| bolatāṃ na paḍe|| 60||
verses.meaning: Now, Arjuna, let this be. Your devotion to Me is evident, and therefore, the satisfaction of speaking about it is boundless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हां येतुलियाची कारणें। तेंचि तें तुजशीं बोलणें। परि असो हें अंतःकरणें। अवधान देई॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhāṃ yetuliyācī kāraṇeṃ| teṃci teṃ tujaśīṃ bolaṇeṃ| pari aso heṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇeṃ| avadhāna deī|| 61||
verses.meaning: For this very reason have I come, and this is what I wish to speak to you. But let that be; now, with a concentrated mind, please give your attention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी ऐकें गा सुवर्म। वाक्‍य माझें परम। जें अक्षरें लेऊनि परब्रह्म। तुज खेंबासि आलें॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī aikeṃ gā suvarma| vāk‍ya mājheṃ parama| jeṃ akṣareṃ leūni parabrahma| tuja kheṃbāsi āleṃ|| 62||
verses.meaning: Listen then, to my supreme words, which are the very Parabrahma (Supreme Reality) itself, having taken on the form of letters, to embrace you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी किरीटी तूं मातें। नेणसी ना निरुतें। तरि गा जो मी एथें। तें विश्‍वचि हें॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kirīṭī tūṃ māteṃ| neṇasī nā niruteṃ| tari gā jo mī etheṃ| teṃ viś‍vaci heṃ||63||
verses.meaning: Yet, Arjuna, if you do not truly know Me here, then know that this entire universe is indeed Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ वेद मुके जाहाळे। मन पवन पांगुळळे। रातीविण मावळले। रविशशी जेथ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha veda muke jāhāḻe| mana pavana pāṃguḻaḻe| rātīviṇa māvaḻale| raviśaśī jetha|| 64||
verses.meaning: Here, the Vedas fall silent, the mind and vital breath become crippled, and the sun and moon set without nightfall.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा उदरींचा गर्भ जैसा। न देखे आपुलिये मातेची वयसा । मी आघवेयां देवां तैसा। नेणवे कांहीं ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā udarīṃcā garbha jaisā| na dekhe āpuliye mātecī vayasā | mī āghaveyāṃ devāṃ taisā| neṇave kāṃhīṃ || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a fetus in the womb does not perceive its mother's age, so too am I to all the gods; they cannot comprehend me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जळचरां उदधीचें मान। मशका नोलांडवेचि गगन। तेवीं महर्षींचें ज्ञान। न देखेचि मातें॥६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jaḻacarāṃ udadhīceṃ māna| maśakā nolāṃḍaveci gagana| tevīṃ maharṣīṃceṃ jñāna| na dekheci māteṃ||66||
verses.meaning: Just as aquatic creatures cannot fathom the ocean's true measure, and a tiny mosquito cannot traverse the vast sky, so too the profound knowledge of great sages cannot fully comprehend Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी कवण पां केतुला। कवणाचा कैं जाहला। या निरुती- करितां बोला। कल्प गेले॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī kavaṇa pāṃ ketulā| kavaṇācā kaiṃ jāhalā| yā nirutī- karitāṃ bolā| kalpa gele|| 67||
verses.meaning: Who am I, and how much? Whose did I become? For the sake of this resolution, ages have passed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे महर्षी आणि या देवां। येरां भूतजातां सर्वा । मी आदि म्हणौनि पांडवा । अवघड जाणतां ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je maharṣī āṇi yā devāṃ| yerāṃ bhūtajātāṃ sarvā | mī ādi mhaṇauni pāṃḍavā | avaghaḍa jāṇatāṃ || 68||
verses.meaning: Because, O Pandava, even great sages and gods, let alone all other beings, know Me as the origin, though it is difficult to comprehend.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उतरले उदक पर्वत वळघे। जरी झाड वाढत मुळीं लागे। तरी मियां जालेनि जगें। जाणिजे मातें॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: utarale udaka parvata vaḻaghe| jarī jhāḍa vāḍhata muḻīṃ lāge| tarī miyāṃ jāleni jageṃ| jāṇije māteṃ|| 69||
