verses.meaning: Just as water flows down from the mountains, and a tree grows from its roots, so too, the entire world that has come into being should recognize Me as its source.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां गाभेवने बटु गिंवसवे। जरी तरंगीं सागरु सांठवे । कां परमाणूमाजीं सामावे। भूगोलु हा॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ gābhevane baṭu giṃvasave| jarī taraṃgīṃ sāgaru sāṃṭhave | kāṃ paramāṇūmājīṃ sāmāve| bhūgolu hā|| 70||
verses.meaning: Can a small seed contain a huge tree? Can the ocean be held in a wave? Or can the entire world be contained within an atom?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मियां जालिया जीवां। महर्षी अथवा देवां । मातें जाणावया होआवा। अवकाशु गा ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī miyāṃ jāliyā jīvāṃ| maharṣī athavā devāṃ | māteṃ jāṇāvayā hoāvā| avakāśu gā || 71||
verses.meaning: Even if I were to become a living being, whether a great sage or a deity, there would still be no opportunity for them to truly know me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसाही जरी विपायें। सांडुनि पुढील पाये । सर्वेंद्रियांसि होये । पाठिमोरा जो॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisāhī jarī vipāyeṃ| sāṃḍuni puḍhīla pāye | sarveṃdriyāṃsi hoye | pāṭhimorā jo|| 72||
verses.meaning: Even if, by chance, one abandons the path ahead and turns their back on all their senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रवर्तलाही वेगीं बहुडे। देह सांडूनि मागलळीकडे। महाभूतांचिया चढे। माथयावरी ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pravartalāhī vegīṃ bahuḍe| deha sāṃḍūni māgalaḻīkaḍe| mahābhūtāṃciyā caḍhe| māthayāvarī || 73||
verses.meaning: It swiftly moves forward, leaving the body behind, and ascends above the great elements.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ राहोनि ठायठिके । स्वप्रकाशें चोखें । अजत्व माझें देखे। आपुलिया डोळां॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha rāhoni ṭhāyaṭhike | svaprakāśeṃ cokheṃ | ajatva mājheṃ dekhe| āpuliyā ḍoḻāṃ|| 74||
verses.meaning: Remaining steadfast there, through one's own pure self-illumination, one perceives My unborn nature with one's own eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी आदीसि परु। सकळलोकमहेश्वरु। ऐसिया मातें जो नरु । यापरी जाणे॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī ādīsi paru| sakaḻalokamaheśvaru| aisiyā māteṃ jo naru | yāparī jāṇe|| 75||
verses.meaning: I am the primordial, the supreme Lord of all worlds. The person who knows Me in this way...

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो पाषाणांमाजीं परिसु। जैसा रसांआंतु सिद्धरसु। तैसा मनुष्याआंतु तो अंशु । माझाचि जाण ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: to pāṣāṇāṃmājīṃ parisu| jaisā rasāṃāṃtu siddharasu| taisā manuṣyāāṃtu to aṃśu | mājhāci jāṇa || 76||
verses.meaning: Just as the philosopher's stone is found among ordinary stones, or the elixir of life is found among other liquids, so too, know that the divine essence within humans is indeed a part of Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो चालतें ज्ञानाचें बिंब । तयाचे अवयव ते सुखाचें कोंभ। येर माणुसपण ते भांब। लौकिक भागु॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to cālateṃ jñānāceṃ biṃba | tayāce avayava te sukhāceṃ koṃbha| yera māṇusapaṇa te bhāṃba| laukika bhāgu|| 77||
verses.meaning: He is the very embodiment of knowledge, and His limbs are sprouts of bliss. His human form is merely a facade, a part of the worldly play.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा अवचिता कापुरा-। माजीं सांपडला हिरा । वरि पडिलिया नीरा। न निगे केवीं ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā avacitā kāpurā-| mājīṃ sāṃpaḍalā hirā | vari paḍiliyā nīrā| na nige kevīṃ || 78||
verses.meaning: If a diamond is unexpectedly found amidst camphor, how can it not emerge unscathed even if water falls upon it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मनुष्यलोकाआंतु। तो जरी जाहाला प्राकृतु। तऱही प्रकृतिदोषाची मातु। नेणेंचि कौं॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā manuṣyalokāāṃtu| to jarī jāhālā prākṛtu| taṟahī prakṛtidoṣācī mātu| neṇeṃci kauṃ||79||
verses.meaning: Similarly, even if a person is born into the human world, they do not know the slightest trace of the defects of material nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो आपसयेंचि सांडिजे पापीं।॥ जैसा जळत चंदनु सर्पी । तेवीं मातें जाणे तो संकल्पीं। वर्जूनि घापे॥ ८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: to āpasayeṃci sāṃḍije pāpīṃ||| jaisā jaḻata caṃdanu sarpī | tevīṃ māteṃ jāṇe to saṃkalpīṃ| varjūni ghāpe|| 80||
verses.meaning: The sinful abandon Him of their own accord, just as a burning sandalwood tree is abandoned by snakes. Similarly, one who knows Me, abandons all worldly thoughts and is absorbed in Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि आमुतें कैसें जाणिजे । ऐसें कल्पी जरी चित्त तुझें । तरी मी ऐसा हें माझें। भाव ऐकें॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci āmuteṃ kaiseṃ jāṇije | aiseṃ kalpī jarī citta tujheṃ | tarī mī aisā heṃ mājheṃ| bhāva aikeṃ||81||
verses.meaning: If your mind ponders how to know that very Self, then listen to these thoughts of mine, which describe what I am.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे वेगळालिया भूतीं। सारिखे होऊनि प्रकृती । विखुरले आहेति त्रिजगतीं। आघविये॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je vegaḻāliyā bhūtīṃ| sārikhe hoūni prakṛtī | vikhurale āheti trijagatīṃ| āghaviye|| 82||
verses.meaning: Which, though distinct in each being, becomes one with nature, scattered throughout the three worlds, entirely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते प्रथम जाण बुद्धी । मग ज्ञान जें निरवधी । असंमोह सहनसिद्धी। क्षमा सत्य॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: te prathama jāṇa buddhī | maga jñāna jeṃ niravadhī | asaṃmoha sahanasiddhī| kṣamā satya||83||
verses.meaning: First, understand this: wisdom, then knowledge that is boundless, freedom from delusion, patience, and truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग शम दम दोन्ही। सुखदुःख वर्ते जें जनीं। अर्जुना भावाभाव मानीं। भावाचिमाजीं॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga śama dama donhī| sukhaduḥkha varte jeṃ janīṃ| arjunā bhāvābhāva mānīṃ| bhāvācimājīṃ|| 84||
verses.meaning: Then, Arjuna, in the world where happiness and sorrow prevail, both inner peace (shama) and self-control (dama) are considered as states of being, within the very essence of existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं भय आणि निर्भयता । अहिंसा आणि समता । तुष्टि तप पंडुसुता । दान जें गा ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ bhaya āṇi nirbhayatā | ahiṃsā āṇi samatā | tuṣṭi tapa paṃḍusutā | dāna jeṃ gā || 85 ||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, fear and fearlessness, non-violence and equanimity, contentment, austerity, and charity—these are also My manifestations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा यश अपकौर्ती । हे जे भाव सर्वत्र दिसती । ते मजचिपासूनि होती । भूतांचिया ठायीं ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā yaśa apakaurtī | he je bhāva sarvatra disatī | te majacipāsūni hotī | bhūtāṃciyā ṭhāyīṃ || 86||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, these feelings of fame and infamy, which are seen everywhere, originate from Me in all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसीं भूतें आहाति सिनानीं। तैसेचि हे वेगळाले मानीं । एक उपजती माझ्या ज्ञानीं। एक नेणती मातें ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisīṃ bhūteṃ āhāti sinānīṃ| taiseci he vegaḻāle mānīṃ | eka upajatī mājhyā jñānīṃ| eka neṇatī māteṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: Just as there are beings with different natures, so too are these considered distinct. Some are born with knowledge of Me, while others do not know Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रकाशु आणि कडवसें। हें सूर्याचिस्तव १९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जैसें। प्रकाश उदयीं दिसे। तम अस्तुसीं ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: prakāśu āṇi kaḍavaseṃ| heṃ sūryācistava 192 śrījñāneśvarī jaiseṃ| prakāśa udayīṃ dise| tama astusīṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: Just as light and darkness are due to the sun, so too, in the Dnyaneshwari, light appears at sunrise and darkness at sunset.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि माझें जाणणें नेणणें । तें तंव भूतांचिया दैवाचें करणें । म्हणौनि भूती भावाचें होणें । विषम पडे॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mājheṃ jāṇaṇeṃ neṇaṇeṃ | teṃ taṃva bhūtāṃciyā daivāceṃ karaṇeṃ | mhaṇauni bhūtī bhāvāceṃ hoṇeṃ | viṣama paḍe|| 89||
verses.meaning: And my knowing and not knowing, that indeed is due to the destiny of beings. Therefore, the manifestation of devotion in beings becomes uneven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यापरी माझिया भावीं। हे जीवसृष्टि आहे आघवी । गुंतली असे जाणावी । पंडुकुमरा॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāparī mājhiyā bhāvīṃ| he jīvasṛṣṭi āhe āghavī | guṃtalī ase jāṇāvī | paṃḍukumarā|| 90||
verses.meaning: In this way, know that this entire creation of living beings is entangled in My being, O son of Pandu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां इये सृष्टीचे पालक। जयां आधीन वर्तती लोक। ते अकरा भाव आणिक । सांगेन तुज ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ iye sṛṣṭīce pālaka| jayāṃ ādhīna vartatī loka| te akarā bhāva āṇika | sāṃgena tuja || 91||
verses.meaning: Now, the eleven emotions, which are the protectors of this creation and to whom the people are subservient, I will tell you about them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आघवांचि गुणीं वृद्ध । जे महर्षींमाजीं प्रबुद्ध । कश्यपादि प्रसिद्ध । सप्तक्रषी ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī āghavāṃci guṇīṃ vṛddha | je maharṣīṃmājīṃ prabuddha | kaśyapādi prasiddha | saptakraṣī || 92||
verses.meaning: Among all those endowed with virtues, the most enlightened among the great sages, the renowned seven sages like Kashyapa.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिकही सांगिजतीळ। जे कां चौदाआंतुल मुद्दळ। स्वायंभू मुख्य वडील । चारी मनु॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇikahī sāṃgijatīḻa| je kāṃ caudāāṃtula muddaḻa| svāyaṃbhū mukhya vaḍīla | cārī manu|| 93||
verses.meaning: Furthermore, it is said that among the fourteen Manus, the four primary and most ancient ones are self-born.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे हे अकरा । माझ्या मनीं जाहाले धनुर्धरा। सृष्टीचिया व्यापारा-। लागोनियां ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise he akarā | mājhyā manīṃ jāhāle dhanurdharā| sṛṣṭīciyā vyāpārā-| lāgoniyāṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Thus, these eleven, O Arjuna, arose in My mind for the purpose of the creation's activities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैं लोकांची व्यवस्था न पडे। जें या त्रिभुवनाचें कांहीं न मांडे । तैं महाभूतांचें दळवाडें । अचुंबित असे॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiṃ lokāṃcī vyavasthā na paḍe| jeṃ yā tribhuvanāceṃ kāṃhīṃ na māṃḍe | taiṃ mahābhūtāṃceṃ daḻavāḍeṃ | acuṃbita ase|| 95||
verses.meaning: When the order of the people is not established, when the three worlds are not created, then the great elements remain unmanifested.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैंचि हे जाहाळे। मग इहीं लोक केले। तेथ अध्यक्ष रचूनि ठेविळे। इहीं जन ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiṃci he jāhāḻe| maga ihīṃ loka kele| tetha adhyakṣa racūni ṭheviḻe| ihīṃ jana || 96||
verses.meaning: Then these (beings) were born, and they created these worlds. There, they appointed overseers for these people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अकराही हे राजा । मग येर जग यांचिया प्रजा। एवं विश्‍वविस्तारु हा माझा । ऐसेंचि जाण॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni akarāhī he rājā | maga yera jaga yāṃciyā prajā| evaṃ viś‍vavistāru hā mājhā | aiseṃci jāṇa|| 97||
verses.meaning: Therefore, these eleven are the king, and the rest of the world is their subjects. Thus, know that this expansion of the universe is indeed mine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां आरंभीं बीज एकलें। मग तेंचि विरूढलिया बूड जाहालें। बुडीं कोंभ निघाले। खांदियांचे ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ āraṃbhīṃ bīja ekaleṃ| maga teṃci virūḍhaliyā būḍa jāhāleṃ| buḍīṃ koṃbha nighāle| khāṃdiyāṃce || 98 ||
verses.meaning: Behold, in the beginning, there was a single seed. Then, as it sprouted, it became the root. From the root, shoots emerged, which then became branches.

verses.shloka_devanagari: खांदियांपासूनि अनेका । फुटलिया नाना शाखा । शाखांस्तव देखा। पललब पानें ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: khāṃdiyāṃpāsūni anekā | phuṭaliyā nānā śākhā | śākhāṃstava dekhā| palalaba pāneṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: From the shoulders, many branches emerge. And from these branches, behold, come forth tender leaves and foliage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पल्लबीं फूल फळ । एवं वृक्षत्व जाहाळें सकळ । तें निर्धारितां केवळ । बीजचि आघवें॥ १००॥
verses.shloka_iast: pallabīṃ phūla phaḻa | evaṃ vṛkṣatva jāhāḻeṃ sakaḻa | teṃ nirdhāritāṃ kevaḻa | bījaci āghaveṃ|| 100||
verses.meaning: Just as flowers and fruits are inherent in the seed, and the entire tree-ness is contained within it, so too, upon careful consideration, everything is ultimately the seed itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें मी एकचि पहिलें। मग मी तेंचि मनातें व्याळें। तेथ सप्तत्रचषि जाहाळे। आणि चारी मनु॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ mī ekaci pahileṃ| maga mī teṃci manāteṃ vyāḻeṃ| tetha saptatracaṣi jāhāḻe| āṇi cārī manu|| 9||
verses.meaning: Thus, I was the only one in the beginning. Then, I conceived the mind within Myself. From that, the seven sages were born, and also the four Manus.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहीं 'लोकपाळ केळे। लोकपाळीं विविध लोक सृजिलळे। लोकांपासूनि निपजलें। प्रजाजात॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃ 'lokapāḻa keḻe| lokapāḻīṃ vividha loka sṛjilaḻe| lokāṃpāsūni nipajaleṃ| prajājāta|| 2||
verses.meaning: From these (the Lokapalas) were created the Lokapalas (guardians of the worlds). The Lokapalas created various worlds. From these worlds, all beings were born.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि हें विश्व येथें। मीचि विस्तारिलोसें निरुतें। परी भावाचेनि हातें। माने जया॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni heṃ viśva yetheṃ| mīci vistāriloseṃ niruteṃ| parī bhāvāceni hāteṃ| māne jayā|| 3||
verses.meaning: Thus, this entire universe, I have indeed manifested it perfectly. But it is by the hand of devotion that it is accepted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं सुभद्रापती। हे भाव इया माझिया विभूती । आणि यांचिया व्याप्तीं। व्यापिले जग॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ subhadrāpatī| he bhāva iyā mājhiyā vibhūtī | āṇi yāṃciyā vyāptīṃ| vyāpile jaga|| 4||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Subhadra's husband (Arjuna), these states of being are my divine manifestations, and through their pervasive influence, the entire world is encompassed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गा यापरी । ब्रह्मादिपिपीलिकावरी। मीवांचूनि दुसरी । गोठी नाहीं ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gā yāparī | brahmādipipīlikāvarī| mīvāṃcūni dusarī | goṭhī nāhīṃ || 5||
verses.meaning: Therefore, from Brahma down to the smallest ant, there is nothing else but Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जाणे जो साचें । तया चेडरें जाहाले ज्ञानाचें। म्हणौनि उत्तमाधम भेदाचें। दुःस्वप्न न देखे॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jāṇe jo sāceṃ | tayā ceḍareṃ jāhāle jñānāceṃ| mhaṇauni uttamādhama bhedāceṃ| duḥsvapna na dekhe||6||
verses.meaning: One who truly understands this, for them, knowledge has dawned. Therefore, they do not experience the nightmare of distinctions between superior and inferior.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी माझिया विभूती । विभूती आधिष्ठिलिया व्यक्‍ती । हें आघवें योगप्रतीती। एकचि मानी॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī mājhiyā vibhūtī | vibhūtī ādhiṣṭhiliyā vyak‍tī | heṃ āghaveṃ yogapratītī| ekaci mānī|| 7||
verses.meaning: I consider all these, my manifestations and the individuals in whom they reside, as one through the experience of Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि निःशंकें येणें महायोगें। मज मीनला मनाचेनि आंगें। एथ संशय करणें न लगे। तो त्रिशुद्धी जाहला॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni niḥśaṃkeṃ yeṇeṃ mahāyogeṃ| maja mīnalā manāceni āṃgeṃ| etha saṃśaya karaṇeṃ na lage| to triśuddhī jāhalā|| 8||
verses.meaning: Therefore, without doubt, through this great yoga, one who is united with Me with all their heart, there is no need to have any doubt about it; they are truly liberated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे ऐसें किरीटी । मातें भजे जो अभेदा दिठी। तयाचिये भजनाचे नाटीं। सूती मज॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je aiseṃ kirīṭī | māteṃ bhaje jo abhedā diṭhī| tayāciye bhajanāce nāṭīṃ| sūtī maja|| 9||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, whoever worships me with the vision of non-duality, through their devotion, they weave me into their very being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अभेदें जो भक्तियोगु । तेथ शंका नाहीं नये खंगु। करितां ठेला तरी चांगु। तें सांगितलें षष्ठीं॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni abhedeṃ jo bhaktiyogu | tetha śaṃkā nāhīṃ naye khaṃgu| karitāṃ ṭhelā tarī cāṃgu| teṃ sāṃgitaleṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ|| 190||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the path of devotion, which is non-dual, leaves no room for doubt or decay. If one remains steadfast in it, it is truly good. This was explained in the sixth chapter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोचि अभेदु कैसा । हें जाणावया मानसा । साद जाली तरी परियेसा । बोलिजेळ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: toci abhedu kaisā | heṃ jāṇāvayā mānasā | sāda jālī tarī pariyesā | bolijeḻa|| 19||
verses.meaning: How is that very one non-dual? To understand this, if you are ready to listen, then hear what is said.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मीचि एक सर्वा। या जगा जन्म पांडवा। आणि मजचिपासूनि आघवा । निर्वाहो यांचा ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī mīci eka sarvā| yā jagā janma pāṃḍavā| āṇi majacipāsūni āghavā | nirvāho yāṃcā || 92||
verses.meaning: Indeed, I alone am the origin of this entire world, O Pandava, and from Me alone comes the sustenance of all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कल्लोळमाळा अनेगा । जन्म जळींचि पैं गा। आणि तयां जळचि आश्रयो तरंगा। जीवनही जळ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kalloḻamāḻā anegā | janma jaḻīṃci paiṃ gā| āṇi tayāṃ jaḻaci āśrayo taraṃgā| jīvanahī jaḻa|| 13||
verses.meaning: The multitude of waves, O Arjuna, are born from the water itself. And water is the very support for these waves; indeed, water is their life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें आघवाचि ठायीं । तयां जळचि जेवीं पाहीं । तैसा मीवांचूनि नाहीं । विश्वीं इये॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ āghavāci ṭhāyīṃ | tayāṃ jaḻaci jevīṃ pāhīṃ | taisā mīvāṃcūni nāhīṃ | viśvīṃ iye|| 14||
verses.meaning: Just as water is present everywhere, so too, in this universe, there is nothing without Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया व्यापका मातें। मानूनि जे भजती भलतेथें। परि साचोकारें उदितें। प्रेमभावें ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā vyāpakā māteṃ| mānūni je bhajatī bhalatetheṃ| pari sācokāreṃ uditeṃ| premabhāveṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Those who worship Me, the all-pervading, wherever they may be, with true and arising devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देश काळ वर्तमान। आधघवें मजसीं करूनि अभिन्न । जैसा वायु होऊन गगन। गगनींचि विचरे॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: deśa kāḻa vartamāna| ādhaghaveṃ majasīṃ karūni abhinna | jaisā vāyu hoūna gagana| gaganīṃci vicare|| 16||
verses.meaning: Time, place, and the present moment—all these become one with Me, just as the wind, becoming the sky itself, moves within the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि जे निजज्ञानीं। खेळत सुखें त्रिभुवनी । जगदरूपा मनीं । सांठऊनि मातें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni je nijajñānīṃ| kheḻata sukheṃ tribhuvanī | jagadarūpā manīṃ | sāṃṭhaūni māteṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Thus, those who are truly wise, play joyfully in the three worlds, having enshrined Me, the form of the universe, in their minds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें जें भेटे भूत तें तें मानिजे भगवंत। हा भक्तियोगु निश्चित । जाण माझा॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ jeṃ bheṭe bhūta teṃ teṃ mānije bhagavaṃta| hā bhaktiyogu niścita | jāṇa mājhā|| 18||
verses.meaning: Whatever being one encounters, that should be regarded as the Divine. This, know for certain, is My path of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चित्ते मीचि जाहाळे। मियांचि प्राणें धाळे। जीवों मरो विसरले । बोधाचिया भुली॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: citte mīci jāhāḻe| miyāṃci prāṇeṃ dhāḻe| jīvoṃ maro visarale | bodhāciyā bhulī|| 19||
verses.meaning: My consciousness has become Me; My life has become satiated. Life and death are forgotten in the oblivion of enlightenment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तया बोधाचेनि माजें। नाचती संवादसुखाचीं भोजें। आतां एकमेकां घेपे दीजे। बोधचि वरी॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayā bodhāceni mājeṃ| nācatī saṃvādasukhācīṃ bhojeṃ| ātāṃ ekamekāṃ ghepe dīje| bodhaci varī|| 120||
verses.meaning: Then, in the grandeur of that spiritual wisdom, the feasts of conversational bliss dance. Now, there is only the giving and taking of wisdom itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेशीं जवळिकेचीं सरोवरें।॥ उचंबळळिया कालवती परस्परें। मग तरंगासि धवळारें। तरंगचि होती ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeśīṃ javaḻikecīṃ sarovareṃ||| ucaṃbaḻaḻiyā kālavatī paraspareṃ| maga taraṃgāsi dhavaḻāreṃ| taraṃgaci hotī || 21||
verses.meaning: Just as when the waters of nearby lakes swell, they merge into each other, and then waves themselves become mansions for other waves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी येरयेरांचिये मिळणी। पडत आनंदकल्लोळांची वेणी । १९४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तेथ बोध बोधाचीं लेणीं। बोधेंचि मिरवी॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī yerayerāṃciye miḻaṇī| paḍata ānaṃdakalloḻāṃcī veṇī | 194 śrījñāneśvarī tetha bodha bodhācīṃ leṇīṃ| bodheṃci miravī|| 22||
verses.meaning: Just as the confluence of these two creates a braid of joyful waves, so too does the spiritual knowledge adorn itself with the ornaments of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें सूर्ये सूर्यातें बोंबाळिलें। कीं चंद्रे चंद्रम्या क्षेम दिधळें। नातरी सरिसेनि पाडें मीनले। दोनी वबोघ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ sūrye sūryāteṃ boṃbāḻileṃ| kīṃ caṃdre caṃdramyā kṣema didhaḻeṃ| nātarī sariseni pāḍeṃ mīnale| donī vabogha|| 23||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun calls out to the sun, or the moon greets the moon, or two rivers merge into one, so too do two enlightened beings unite.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें प्रयाग होत सामरस्याचें । वरी बोसाण तरत सात्त्विकाचें । ते संवादचतुष्पथींचे। गणेश जाहले॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ prayāga hota sāmarasyāceṃ | varī bosāṇa tarata sāttvikāceṃ | te saṃvādacatuṣpathīṃce| gaṇeśa jāhale|| 24||
verses.meaning: Thus, a confluence of harmony was formed, upon which the pure sattvic essence floated. They became the Ganeshas of that four-way intersection of dialogue.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां तया महासुखाचेनि भरें। धांबोनि देहाचिये गावांबाहेरें। मियां धाले तेणें उद्गारें। लागती गाजों ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ tayā mahāsukhāceni bhareṃ| dhāṃboni dehāciye gāvāṃbāhereṃ| miyāṃ dhāle teṇeṃ udgāreṃ| lāgatī gājoṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Then, filled with that great bliss, I transcended the confines of the body, and the exclamations of my contentment began to resound.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गुरुशिष्यांचिया एकांतीं। जे अक्षरा एकाची वदंती। ते मेघाचियापरी त्रिजगतीं। गर्जती सैंघ ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ guruśiṣyāṃciyā ekāṃtīṃ| je akṣarā ekācī vadaṃtī| te meghāciyāparī trijagatīṃ| garjatī saiṃgha || 26||
verses.meaning: In the solitude of guru and disciple, the discourse on the singular imperishable (Brahman) resonates throughout the three worlds like the thunder of clouds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी कमळकळिका जालेपणें । हृदयींचिया मकरंदातें राखों नेणें। दे राया रंका पारणें। आमोदाचें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī kamaḻakaḻikā jālepaṇeṃ | hṛdayīṃciyā makaraṃdāteṃ rākhoṃ neṇeṃ| de rāyā raṃkā pāraṇeṃ| āmodāceṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Just as a lotus bud, upon blossoming, cannot contain the nectar within its heart, but offers its fragrance to kings and paupers alike, so too is the divine wisdom shared universally.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसेंचि मातें विश्‍्वबीं कथित। कथितेनि तोषें कथं विसरत। मग तया विसरामाजीं विरत । आंगें जीवें॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃci māteṃ viś‍vabīṃ kathita| kathiteni toṣeṃ kathaṃ visarata| maga tayā visarāmājīṃ virata | āṃgeṃ jīveṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when I am described as the seed of the universe, the joy of that description makes one forget the act of describing. Then, in that forgetfulness, one merges completely, with body and soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें प्रेमाचेनि बहुवसपणें। नाहीं राती दिवो जाणणे । केलें माझें सुख अव्यंगवाणें। आपणपेयां जिहीं ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ premāceni bahuvasapaṇeṃ| nāhīṃ rātī divo jāṇaṇe | keleṃ mājheṃ sukha avyaṃgavāṇeṃ| āpaṇapeyāṃ jihīṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Such is the abundance of love, that it knows neither day nor night. It has made my happiness complete and flawless, by those who have realized their true self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां मग जें आम्हीं कांहीं। द्यावें अर्जुना पाहीं। ते ठायींचीच तिहीं । घेतली सेल॥ १३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ maga jeṃ āmhīṃ kāṃhīṃ| dyāveṃ arjunā pāhīṃ| te ṭhāyīṃcīca tihīṃ | ghetalī sela|| 130||
verses.meaning: Then, whatever we had to give, Arjuna, they took their share from that very place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे ते जिया वाटा । निगाले गा सुभटा । ते सोय पाहोनि अव्हांटा। स्वर्गापवर्ग॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je te jiyā vāṭā | nigāle gā subhaṭā | te soya pāhoni avhāṃṭā| svargāpavarga|| 39||
verses.meaning: Because the path they took, O brave one, observing that path, leads to both heaven and liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि तिहीं जें प्रेम धरिलें। तेंचि आमुचें देणें उपाइलें। परि आम्हीं देयावें हेंहि केलें। तिहींची म्हणिपे॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni tihīṃ jeṃ prema dharileṃ| teṃci āmuceṃ deṇeṃ upāileṃ| pari āmhīṃ deyāveṃ heṃhi keleṃ| tihīṃcī mhaṇipe|| 32||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the love they hold for Me is itself My offering and gift. Yet, even this act of My giving is said to be theirs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां यावरी येतुलें घडे । जें तेंचि सुख आगळें वाढे । आणि काळाची दृष्टि न पडे। हें आम्हां करणें ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yāvarī yetuleṃ ghaḍe | jeṃ teṃci sukha āgaḻeṃ vāḍhe | āṇi kāḻācī dṛṣṭi na paḍe| heṃ āmhāṃ karaṇeṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Now, if this much happens, that very joy will exceedingly grow, and the gaze of time will not fall upon it. This is what we must do.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ळळेयाचिया बाळका किरीटी। गवसणी करूनि स्नेहाचिया दिठी। जैसी खेळतां पाठोपाठीं । माउली धांवे ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ḻaḻeyāciyā bāḻakā kirīṭī| gavasaṇī karūni snehāciyā diṭhī| jaisī kheḻatāṃ pāṭhopāṭhīṃ | māulī dhāṃve || 34||
verses.meaning: Just as a mother, with eyes full of love, runs after her playful child, covering him with her gaze, so does the divine mother pursue her devotees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें जो जो खेळ दावी। तो तो पुढें सोनयाचा करूनि ठेवी। तैसी उपास्तीची 'पदवी। पोषित मी जायें ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ jo jo kheḻa dāvī| to to puḍheṃ sonayācā karūni ṭhevī| taisī upāstīcī 'padavī| poṣita mī jāyeṃ || 35||
verses.meaning: Whatever play it (the devotion) shows, it makes it golden in the future. Similarly, I go on nourishing the 'status' of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये पदवीचेनि पोषकें। ते मातें पावती यथासुखें।॥ हे पाळती मज विशेखें। आवडे करूं॥३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye padavīceni poṣakeṃ| te māteṃ pāvatī yathāsukheṃ||| he pāḻatī maja viśekheṃ| āvaḍe karūṃ||36||
verses.meaning: Those who nourish themselves with that state attain Me with ease. I especially love to protect them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा भक्‍तासि माझें कोड। मज तयाचे अनन्यगतीची चाड। कां जें प्रेमळांचें सांकड । आमुचिया घरीं ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā bhak‍tāsi mājheṃ koḍa| maja tayāce ananyagatīcī cāḍa| kāṃ jeṃ premaḻāṃceṃ sāṃkaḍa | āmuciyā gharīṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: Indeed, I am fond of my devotees. I cherish their unwavering devotion, for the loving ones are like family in my home.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां स्वर्ग मोक्ष उपायिले। दोन्ही मार्ग तयाचिये वाहणी केळे) आम्ही आंगही शेखीं वेंचिलें। लक्ष्मीयेसीं ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ svarga mokṣa upāyile| donhī mārga tayāciye vāhaṇī keḻe) āmhī āṃgahī śekhīṃ veṃcileṃ| lakṣmīyesīṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: Behold, both the path to heaven and the path to liberation are created by Him. We have ultimately dedicated ourselves to Lakshmi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि आपणपेंवीण जें एक।॥ तें तैसेंचि सुख साजुक । सप्रेमळांलागीं देख । ठेविलें जतन॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari āpaṇapeṃvīṇa jeṃ eka||| teṃ taiseṃci sukha sājuka | sapremaḻāṃlāgīṃ dekha | ṭhevileṃ jatana|| 39||
verses.meaning: That which is one, without any other, that pure joy, behold, is lovingly preserved for those who are truly devoted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठायवरी किरीटी । आम्ही प्रेमळु घेवों आपणयासाठीं । या बोलीं बोलिजत गोष्टी । तैसिया नव्हती गा॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāyavarī kirīṭī | āmhī premaḻu ghevoṃ āpaṇayāsāṭhīṃ | yā bolīṃ bolijata goṣṭī | taisiyā navhatī gā|| 140||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), we lovingly accept this for ourselves. The things spoken in these words are not like that (i.e., they are profound and not mere words).

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मज आत्मयाचा भावो। जिहीं जियावया केला ठावो। एक मीवांचूनि वावो । येर मानिलें जिहीं ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni maja ātmayācā bhāvo| jihīṃ jiyāvayā kelā ṭhāvo| eka mīvāṃcūni vāvo | yera mānileṃ jihīṃ || 41||
verses.meaning: Therefore, those who have made my Self their very life, who consider everything else as vain except Me, they are truly alive.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां तत्त्वज्ञां चोखटां। दिवी 'पोतासाची सुभटा। मग मीचि होऊनि दिवटा। पुढां पुढां चाले॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ tattvajñāṃ cokhaṭāṃ| divī 'potāsācī subhaṭā| maga mīci hoūni divaṭā| puḍhāṃ puḍhāṃ cāle|| 42||
verses.meaning: To those pure philosophers, I become the lamp, O brave one, and then, becoming the torchbearer myself, I walk ahead, leading the way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अज्ञानाचिये राती-। माजीं तमाची मिळणी दाटती। ते नाशूनि घालीं परौती। तयां करीं नित्योदयो॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ajñānāciye rātī-| mājīṃ tamācī miḻaṇī dāṭatī| te nāśūni ghālīṃ parautī| tayāṃ karīṃ nityodayo|| 43||
verses.meaning: In the night of ignorance, the dense darkness gathers. Destroying that and casting it away, He brings about the eternal dawn.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें प्रेमळाचेनि प्रियोत्तमें। बोलिलें जेथ पुरुषोत्तमें। तेथ अर्जुन मनोधर्मे। निवालों म्हणतसे॥४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ premaḻāceni priyottameṃ| bolileṃ jetha puruṣottameṃ| tetha arjuna manodharme| nivāloṃ mhaṇatase||44||
verses.meaning: When the Beloved of the devotees, the Supreme Being, spoke thus, Arjuna, with his mind and heart, felt completely refreshed and said so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो जी अवधारा । भला केरु फेडिला संसारा । जाहलों जननीजठरजोहरा-। वेगळा प्रभू ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho jī avadhārā | bhalā keru pheḍilā saṃsārā | jāhaloṃ jananījaṭharajoharā-| vegaḻā prabhū || 45||
verses.meaning: Yes, indeed, listen! The burden of worldly existence has been lifted. I have become free from the torment of the mother's womb, O Lord!

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी जन्मळेपण आपुलें। हें आजि मियां डोळां देखिलें। जीवित हातां चढले आवडतसें॥ ४६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī janmaḻepaṇa āpuleṃ| heṃ āji miyāṃ ḍoḻāṃ dekhileṃ| jīvita hātāṃ caḍhale āvaḍataseṃ|| 46 ||
verses.meaning: Today, I have seen with my own eyes the very essence of my being. It feels as if life itself has come into my hands, dearly cherished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आजि आयुष्या उजवण जाहली । माझिया दैवा दशा उदयली। जे वाक्‍्यकृपा लाधली । दैविकेनि मुखें ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āji āyuṣyā ujavaṇa jāhalī | mājhiyā daivā daśā udayalī| je vāk‍yakṛpā lādhalī | daivikeni mukheṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: Today, my life has been illuminated; my destiny has dawned. For I have received the grace of these words from a divine mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां येणें बचन तेजाकारें। फिटलें आंतील बाहेरील आंधारें। म्हणौनि देखतसें साचोकारें। स्वरूप तुझें ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yeṇeṃ bacana tejākāreṃ| phiṭaleṃ āṃtīla bāherīla āṃdhāreṃ| mhaṇauni dekhataseṃ sācokāreṃ| svarūpa tujheṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: Now, by the brilliance of these words, the inner and outer darkness has vanished. Therefore, I truly behold your true form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी होसी गा तूं परब्रह्म । जें या महाभूतां विसंवतें धाम । पवित्र तूं परम । जगन्नाथा॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī hosī gā tūṃ parabrahma | jeṃ yā mahābhūtāṃ visaṃvateṃ dhāma | pavitra tūṃ parama | jagannāthā|| 49||
verses.meaning: Therefore, you are indeed the Supreme Brahman, the abode where these great elements find their rest and dissolution. You are the ultimate purity, O Lord of the Universe!

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं परम दैवत तिहीं देवां। तूं पुरुष जी पंचविसावा । दिव्य तूं प्रकृतीभावा-। पैलीकडीलळ॥ १५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ parama daivata tihīṃ devāṃ| tūṃ puruṣa jī paṃcavisāvā | divya tūṃ prakṛtībhāvā-| pailīkaḍīlaḻa|| 150||
verses.meaning: You are the supreme deity of the three gods. You are the twenty-fifth Purusha (the ultimate consciousness). You are divine, beyond the realm of Prakriti (primordial nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनादिसिद्ध तूं स्वामी) जो नाकळिजसी जन्मधर्मी । तो तूं हें आम्हीं । जाणितलें आतां॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: anādisiddha tūṃ svāmī) jo nākaḻijasī janmadharmī | to tūṃ heṃ āmhīṃ | jāṇitaleṃ ātāṃ||51||
verses.meaning: You are the eternal, beginningless Lord, whom those born into this world cannot comprehend. Yet, we have now come to know that You are indeed that very One.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं या कालत्रयासि सूत्री) तू॑ जीवकळेची अधिष्ठात्री। तूं ब्रह्मकटाहधात्री । हें कळलें फुडें॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ yā kālatrayāsi sūtrī) tṷ̄ jīvakaḻecī adhiṣṭhātrī| tūṃ brahmakaṭāhadhātrī | heṃ kaḻaleṃ phuḍeṃ||52||
verses.meaning: You are the thread that holds the three divisions of time. You are the presiding deity of the life-force. You are the sustainer of the cosmic egg of Brahma. This has now become clear to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: १९६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी पैं आणिकही एके परी । इयेचि प्रतीतीची येतसे थोरी । जे मागें ऐसेंचि क्रषीश्‍वरीं। सांगितलें तूंतें ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: 196 śrījñāneśvarī paiṃ āṇikahī eke parī | iyeci pratītīcī yetase thorī | je māgeṃ aiseṃci kraṣīś‍varīṃ| sāṃgitaleṃ tūṃteṃ || 53||
verses.meaning: Furthermore, there is another way to understand this truth, which I have already explained to you, O Krishna, in the past.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तया सांगितलियाचें साचपण । हें आतां देखतसे अंतःकरण जे कृपा केली आपण । म्हणौनि देवा॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari tayā sāṃgitaliyāceṃ sācapaṇa | heṃ ātāṃ dekhatase aṃtaḥkaraṇa je kṛpā kelī āpaṇa | mhaṇauni devā|| 54||
verses.meaning: My heart now perceives the truth of what You have spoken, O Lord, because You have bestowed Your grace upon me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं नारदु अखंड जवळां ये। तोही ऐसेंचि बचनीं गाये। परि अर्थ न बुजोनि ठाये। गीतसुखचि ऐकों॥५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ nāradu akhaṃḍa javaḻāṃ ye| tohī aiseṃci bacanīṃ gāye| pari artha na bujoni ṭhāye| gītasukhaci aikoṃ||55||
verses.meaning: Even Narada, who is always near, sings in the same way. But without understanding the true meaning, he only enjoys the pleasure of the song.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा आंधळेयांच्या गांवीं । आपणणपें प्रगटले रवीं। तरि तिहीं बोतपलीचि घ्यावी । वांचूनि प्रकाशु कैंचा॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā āṃdhaḻeyāṃcyā gāṃvīṃ | āpaṇaṇapeṃ pragaṭale ravīṃ| tari tihīṃ botapalīci ghyāvī | vāṃcūni prakāśu kaiṃcā|| 56||
verses.meaning: If the sun were to rise in a village of the blind, they would only perceive its warmth, for how could they experience its light?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि देवर्षि अध्यात्म गातां। आहाच रागांगेंसी जे मधुरता । तेचि फावे येर चित्ता । नलगेचि कांहीं ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari devarṣi adhyātma gātāṃ| āhāca rāgāṃgeṃsī je madhuratā | teci phāve yera cittā | nalageci kāṃhīṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: But when the divine sage sings of spirituality, the sweetness that comes with the very essence of devotion is what truly resonates with the mind; nothing else is needed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं असिता देवलाचेनि मुखें। मी एवंबिधा तूंतें आइकें । परि तैं बुद्धी विषयविखें। घारिली होती ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ asitā devalāceni mukheṃ| mī evaṃbidhā tūṃteṃ āikeṃ | pari taiṃ buddhī viṣayavikheṃ| ghārilī hotī || 58||
verses.meaning: Indeed, I heard of your greatness from the mouth of Asita and Devala, but at that time, my intellect was poisoned by worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विषयविषाचा पडिपाडू। गोड परमार्थ लागे कडू। कडू विषय तो गोडू। जीवासी जाहला॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: viṣayaviṣācā paḍipāḍū| goḍa paramārtha lāge kaḍū| kaḍū viṣaya to goḍū| jīvāsī jāhalā|| 59||
verses.meaning: The poison of worldly pleasures has such a devastating effect that the sweet spiritual path seems bitter, and the bitter worldly pleasures become sweet to the soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि हें आणिकांचें काय सांगावें। राउळा आपणचि येऊनि व्यासदेवें। तुझे स्वरूप आघवें। सर्वदा सांगिजे॥ १६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi heṃ āṇikāṃceṃ kāya sāṃgāveṃ| rāuḻā āpaṇaci yeūni vyāsadeveṃ| tujhe svarūpa āghaveṃ| sarvadā sāṃgije|| 160||
verses.meaning: And what more can be said of others? Vyasadeva himself came to the temple and always narrated your entire form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तो अंधारीं चिंतामणी देखिला । जेवीं नव्हे या बुद्धी उपेक्षिला । पाठीं दिनोदयीं बोळखिला। होय म्हणौनि ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari to aṃdhārīṃ ciṃtāmaṇī dekhilā | jevīṃ navhe yā buddhī upekṣilā | pāṭhīṃ dinodayīṃ boḻakhilā| hoya mhaṇauni || 61||
verses.meaning: It is like a chintamani jewel seen in darkness, which is then disregarded by the intellect. But later, when day breaks, it is recognized and accepted as such.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं व्यासादिकांची बोलणीं । तिया मजपाशीं चिद्रत्ांचिया खाणी । परि उपेक्षिल्या जात होतिया तरणी । तुजवीण कृष्णा॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ vyāsādikāṃcī bolaṇīṃ | tiyā majapāśīṃ cidratāṃciyā khāṇī | pari upekṣilyā jāta hotiyā taraṇī | tujavīṇa kṛṣṇā|| 62||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the words of Vyasa and others are like mines of spiritual gems to me, but they were being neglected, O Krishna, without you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते आतां वाक्‍यसूर्यकर तुझे फांकळे। आणि क्रुषीं मार्ग होते जे कथिले। तयां आघवियांचेंचि फिटलें। अनोळखपण ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: te ātāṃ vāk‍yasūryakara tujhe phāṃkaḻe| āṇi kruṣīṃ mārga hote je kathile| tayāṃ āghaviyāṃceṃci phiṭaleṃ| anoḻakhapaṇa || 63||
verses.meaning: Now, by the sun-like rays of your words, all the paths that were taught to the seekers have shed their unfamiliarity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी ज्ञानाचें बीज तयांचे बोल माजीं हृदयभूमिके पडिले सखोळ। वरि इये कृपेची जाहाली बोळ। म्हणोनि संवादफळेंशीं उठलें॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī jñānāceṃ bīja tayāṃce bola mājīṃ hṛdayabhūmike paḍile sakhoḻa| vari iye kṛpecī jāhālī boḻa| mhaṇoni saṃvādaphaḻeṃśīṃ uṭhaleṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: The seed of knowledge, sown deep within the heart's soil by their words, has sprouted into the fruit of this discourse, nurtured by the grace that has descended upon it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो नारदादिकां संतां। त्यांचिया उक्तिरूप सरिता । मी महोदधी जाहलों अनंता । संवादसुखाचा ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho nāradādikāṃ saṃtāṃ| tyāṃciyā uktirūpa saritā | mī mahodadhī jāhaloṃ anaṃtā | saṃvādasukhācā || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Oh, for the saints like Narada, I have become the great ocean of the joy of conversation, a boundless one, for the rivers of their utterances.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रभु आघवेनि येणें जऱ्में। जियें पुण्यें केलीं मियां उत्तमें। तयांची न ठकतीचि अंगीं कामें । सद्गुरु तुवां ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: prabhu āghaveni yeṇeṃ jaṟmeṃ| jiyeṃ puṇyeṃ kelīṃ miyāṃ uttameṃ| tayāṃcī na ṭhakatīci aṃgīṃ kāmeṃ | sadguru tuvāṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: O Sadguru, all the excellent merits I have accumulated throughout all my births, their effects cannot be thwarted by you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं बडिलवडिलांचेनि मुखें। मी सदा तूंतें कानीं आइकें।॥ परि कृपा न कौजेचि तुवां एकें।॥ तंव नेणवेचि कांहीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ baḍilavaḍilāṃceni mukheṃ| mī sadā tūṃteṃ kānīṃ āikeṃ||| pari kṛpā na kaujeci tuvāṃ ekeṃ||| taṃva neṇaveci kāṃhīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Indeed, through the mouths of elders, I always hear of You with my ears. Yet, You alone have not bestowed Your grace upon me. Therefore, I understand nothing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भाग्य जैं सानुकूळ। जालिया केले उद्यम सदां सफळ] तैसें श्रुताधीत सकळ। गुरुकृपा साच॥६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhāgya jaiṃ sānukūḻa| jāliyā kele udyama sadāṃ saphaḻa] taiseṃ śrutādhīta sakaḻa| gurukṛpā sāca||68||
verses.meaning: Therefore, just as all endeavors become fruitful when fortune is favorable, so too all scriptural knowledge becomes truly effective through the grace of the Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी बनकरु झाडें सिंपी जीवेंसाटीं । पाडूनि जन्में काढी आटी । परि फळेंसि तैंचि भेटी । जें वबसंतु पावे॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī banakaru jhāḍeṃ siṃpī jīveṃsāṭīṃ | pāḍūni janmeṃ kāḍhī āṭī | pari phaḻeṃsi taiṃci bheṭī | jeṃ vabasaṃtu pāve|| 69||
verses.meaning: Just as a gardener waters trees with great care, and through many births (efforts) nurtures them, yet only meets the fruits when spring arrives.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो विषमा जैं बोहट पडे। तें मधुर तें मधुर आवडे। पैं रसायनें तें गोडें। जें आरोग्य देहीं ॥ ९७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho viṣamā jaiṃ bohaṭa paḍe| teṃ madhura teṃ madhura āvaḍe| paiṃ rasāyaneṃ teṃ goḍeṃ| jeṃ ārogya dehīṃ || 970||
verses.meaning: When a difficult situation arises, it is considered sweet and pleasant. But that which is truly sweet is like a life-giving elixir, bringing health to the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां इंद्रियें बाचा प्राण । यां जाल्यांचें तैंचि सार्थकपण । जैं चैतन्य येऊनि आपण । संचरे माजीं ॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ iṃdriyeṃ bācā prāṇa | yāṃ jālyāṃceṃ taiṃci sārthakapaṇa | jaiṃ caitanya yeūni āpaṇa | saṃcare mājīṃ ||79||
verses.meaning: For the senses, speech, and vital breath, their true purpose is fulfilled only when the consciousness itself enters and pervades them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें शब्दजात आलोडिलें। अथवा योगादिक जें अभ्यासिलें। तें तैंचि म्हणों ये आपुलें। जें सानुकूल श्रीगुरु ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śabdajāta āloḍileṃ| athavā yogādika jeṃ abhyāsileṃ| teṃ taiṃci mhaṇoṃ ye āpuleṃ| jeṃ sānukūla śrīguru || 72||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the knowledge gained from scriptures or the practices of Yoga can only be truly considered one's own when it is favorably bestowed by the revered Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिये जालिये प्रतीतीचेनि माजें। अर्जुन निशचयाचि नाचतुसे भोजें। तेवींचि म्हणे देवा तुझें। वाक्य मज मानलें॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiye jāliye pratītīceni mājeṃ| arjuna niśacayāci nācatuse bhojeṃ| tevīṃci mhaṇe devā tujheṃ| vākya maja mānaleṃ|| 73||
verses.meaning: With such an experience of conviction, Arjuna was dancing with joy and certainty. He said, "O Lord, your words are acceptable to me."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि साचचि हे कैवल्यपती । मज त्रिशुद्धी आली प्रतीती । जे तूं देवदानवांचिये मती-। जोगा नव्हसी॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari sācaci he kaivalyapatī | maja triśuddhī ālī pratītī | je tūṃ devadānavāṃciye matī-| jogā navhasī|| 74||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Lord of Liberation, I have truly realized that You are beyond the comprehension of both gods and demons.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुझें वाक्‍य व्यक्‍ती न येतां देवा। जो आपुलिया जाणे जाणिवा। तो कहींचि नोहे हें मदभावा। भरंबसेनि आलें॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujheṃ vāk‍ya vyak‍tī na yetāṃ devā| jo āpuliyā jāṇe jāṇivā| to kahīṃci nohe heṃ madabhāvā| bharaṃbaseni āleṃ|| 75 ||
verses.meaning: O Lord, to him who understands through his own intellect without your words being explicitly uttered, it is clear that he is nothing, and this conviction has come to me with full assurance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ आपुलें वाढपण जैसें । आपणचि जाणिजे आकाशें। कां मी येतुली घनवट ऐसें। पृथ्वीचि जाणे॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha āpuleṃ vāḍhapaṇa jaiseṃ | āpaṇaci jāṇije ākāśeṃ| kāṃ mī yetulī ghanavaṭa aiseṃ| pṛthvīci jāṇe|| 76||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky alone knows its own vastness, or the earth itself knows its own density and solidity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा आपुलिये सर्वशक्‍्ती। तुज तूंचि जाणसी लक्ष्मीपती । येर वेदादिक मती । मिरवती वायां ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā āpuliye sarvaśak‍tī| tuja tūṃci jāṇasī lakṣmīpatī | yera vedādika matī | miravatī vāyāṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as with all your power, O Lord of Lakshmi, you alone know yourself. All other intellects, like the Vedas, merely boast in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा मनातें मागां सांडावें। पवनातें बाबीं मवावें। आदिशून्य तरोनि जावें। केउतें बाहीं ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā manāteṃ māgāṃ sāṃḍāveṃ| pavanāteṃ bābīṃ mavāveṃ| ādiśūnya taroni jāveṃ| keuteṃ bāhīṃ || 78||
verses.meaning: How can the mind be left behind, the wind be bound in a bundle, or the primordial void be crossed by swimming?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें हें तुझें जाणणें आहे। म्हणौनि कोणाही ठाउकें नोहे । आतां तुझें ज्ञान होये। तुजचिजोगें ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ heṃ tujheṃ jāṇaṇeṃ āhe| mhaṇauni koṇāhī ṭhāukeṃ nohe | ātāṃ tujheṃ jñāna hoye| tujacijogeṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: Such is Your knowing, therefore no one else can comprehend it. Now, Your knowledge is indeed worthy of You alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी आपणयातें तूंचि जाणसी । आणिकांतें सांगावयाही समर्थ होसी। तरी आतां एक वेळ घाम पुसीं। आतीचिये निडळींचा॥ १८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī āpaṇayāteṃ tūṃci jāṇasī | āṇikāṃteṃ sāṃgāvayāhī samartha hosī| tarī ātāṃ eka veḻa ghāma pusīṃ| ātīciye niḍaḻīṃcā|| 180||
verses.meaning: If you yourself know your true self, and are capable of explaining it to others, then for once, wipe the sweat from the brow of this humble one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें आइकिलें कौ भूतभावना। त्रिभुबनगजपंचानना । सकलदेवदेवतार्चना । जगन्नायका ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ āikileṃ kau bhūtabhāvanā| tribhubanagajapaṃcānanā | sakaladevadevatārcanā | jagannāyakā || 81||
verses.meaning: When the creator of all beings, the lion to the elephants of the three worlds, the one worshipped by all gods and goddesses, the Lord of the universe, heard this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी थोरी तुझी पाहात आहों। तरी पासीं उभे ठाकावयाही योग्य नोहों। या शोच्यता जरी विनवूं बरिहों। तरी आन उपायो नाहीं॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī thorī tujhī pāhāta āhoṃ| tarī pāsīṃ ubhe ṭhākāvayāhī yogya nohoṃ| yā śocyatā jarī vinavūṃ barihoṃ| tarī āna upāyo nāhīṃ||82||
verses.meaning: Though I perceive your greatness, I am not worthy to stand near you. Even if I humbly make this plea, there is no other way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भरले समुद्र सरिता चहूंकडे । परि ते बापियासि कोरडे। कां जैं मेघौनि थेंबुटा पडे । तैं पाणी कौं तया॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: bharale samudra saritā cahūṃkaḍe | pari te bāpiyāsi koraḍe| kāṃ jaiṃ meghauni theṃbuṭā paḍe | taiṃ pāṇī kauṃ tayā|| 83||
verses.meaning: The oceans and rivers are full on all sides, yet they are dry for the thirsty. Similarly, when a drop falls from a cloud, how can that be water for them?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे श्रीगुरु सर्वत्र आथी । परि कृष्णा आम्हां तूंचि गती। हें असो मजप्रती। विभूती सांगें॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise śrīguru sarvatra āthī | pari kṛṣṇā āmhāṃ tūṃci gatī| heṃ aso majapratī| vibhūtī sāṃgeṃ|| 84||
verses.meaning: Just as the revered Guru is omnipresent, so too, Krishna, are you our sole refuge. Let this be; now, tell me of your manifestations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी तुझिया विभूती आघविया । परि व्यापिती या शक्ति दिव्या जिया । तिया आपुलिया दावाविया। आपण मज॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī tujhiyā vibhūtī āghaviyā | pari vyāpitī yā śakti divyā jiyā | tiyā āpuliyā dāvāviyā| āpaṇa maja|| 85||
verses.meaning: O Lord, please reveal to me those divine powers of Yours, which, though they are Your manifestations, pervade and encompass all of them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं विभूती ययां समस्तां । लोकांतें व्यापूनि आहासी अनंता । तिया प्रधाना नामांकिता । प्रगटा करीं ॥८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ vibhūtī yayāṃ samastāṃ | lokāṃteṃ vyāpūni āhāsī anaṃtā | tiyā pradhānā nāmāṃkitā | pragaṭā karīṃ ||86||
verses.meaning: O Infinite One, by which manifestations You pervade all these worlds, reveal those principal ones by name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी कैसें मियां जाणावें । काय जाणोनि सदा चिंतावें। जरी तूंचि म्हणों आघवें।॥ तरि चिंतनचि न घडे॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī kaiseṃ miyāṃ jāṇāveṃ | kāya jāṇoni sadā ciṃtāveṃ| jarī tūṃci mhaṇoṃ āghaveṃ||| tari ciṃtanaci na ghaḍe|| 87||
verses.meaning: How can I know what to know, and what should I always contemplate? If I say that everything is You, then contemplation itself becomes impossible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मागां भाव जैसे। आपुले सांगितले तुवां उद्देशें। आतां विस्तारोनि तैसें। एक वेळ बोलें॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni māgāṃ bhāva jaise| āpule sāṃgitale tuvāṃ uddeśeṃ| ātāṃ vistāroni taiseṃ| eka veḻa boleṃ|| 88||
verses.meaning: Therefore, just as you previously explained the nature of devotion, now please elaborate on it once more.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया जया भावाचिया ठायीं। तूंतें चिंतितां मज सायासु नाहीं । तो विवळ करूनि देई। योगु आपुला॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā jayā bhāvāciyā ṭhāyīṃ| tūṃteṃ ciṃtitāṃ maja sāyāsu nāhīṃ | to vivaḻa karūni deī| yogu āpulā|| 89||
verses.meaning: In whatever state of being, when I contemplate You, I find no effort. Grant me that union with You, making it clear and accessible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि पुसलिया जिया विभूती। त्याही बोलाविया भूतपती। येथ म्हणसी जरी पुढती । काय सांगों ॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi pusaliyā jiyā vibhūtī| tyāhī bolāviyā bhūtapatī| yetha mhaṇasī jarī puḍhatī | kāya sāṃgoṃ || 190||
verses.meaning: And if you ask about the glories, the Lord of beings Himself has spoken of them. If you ask again, what more can I say?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी हा भाव मना। झणें जाय हो जनार्दना। पैं प्राकृताही अमृतपाना। ना न म्हणवे जेवीं॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī hā bhāva manā| jhaṇeṃ jāya ho janārdanā| paiṃ prākṛtāhī amṛtapānā| nā na mhaṇave jevīṃ||91||
verses.meaning: O Janardana, may this sentiment not vanish from my mind, just as one cannot refuse the nectar of immortality, even if it is offered in a common vessel.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें 'काळकूटाचें सहोदर जें मृत्यूभेणें प्याले अमर। तरि दिहाचे पुरंदर। चौदा जाती॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ 'kāḻakūṭāceṃ sahodara jeṃ mṛtyūbheṇeṃ pyāle amara| tari dihāce puraṃdara| caudā jātī|| 92||
verses.meaning: Even though the gods, fearing death, drank the nectar, the sibling of the deadly poison, they still undergo fourteen transformations of their bodies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा कवण एक क्षीराब्धीचा रसु। जया वायांचि अमृतपणाचा आभासु। तयाचाही मीठांशु। जे पुरे म्हणों नेदी॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā kavaṇa eka kṣīrābdhīcā rasu| jayā vāyāṃci amṛtapaṇācā ābhāsu| tayācāhī mīṭhāṃśu| je pure mhaṇoṃ nedī|| 93||
verses.meaning: What is that essence of the ocean of milk, which without reason, gives the illusion of immortality? Even its saltiness, it is said, cannot be fully appreciated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया पाबळेयाही येतुळेवरी । गोडियेचि आथि थोरी। मग हें तंव अवधारीं। परमामृत साचें॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā pābaḻeyāhī yetuḻevarī | goḍiyeci āthi thorī| maga heṃ taṃva avadhārīṃ| paramāmṛta sāceṃ|| 94||
verses.meaning: Even in those (worldly pleasures), there is so much sweetness. But listen, this (divine experience) is truly the supreme nectar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें मंदराचळु न ढाळितां। क्षीरसागरु न डहुळितां। अनादि स्वभावता। आइतें आहे॥९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ maṃdarācaḻu na ḍhāḻitāṃ| kṣīrasāgaru na ḍahuḻitāṃ| anādi svabhāvatā| āiteṃ āhe||95||
verses.meaning: Just as the Mandara mountain does not need to be churned, and the milk ocean does not need to be stirred, so too is the primordial nature inherently present, without effort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें द्रव ना नव्हे बद्ध । जेथ नेणिजती रस गंध। जें भलतयांही सिन्ध। आठवलेंचि फावे॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ drava nā navhe baddha | jetha neṇijatī rasa gaṃdha| jeṃ bhalatayāṃhī sindha| āṭhavaleṃci phāve|| 96||
verses.meaning: That which is not bound by any substance, where taste and smell are unknown, and which is attained by anyone who remembers it, however they may be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाची गोठीचि ऐकतखेंबो। आघवा संसारु होय वाबो। बळिया नित्यता लागे येवो । आपणपेयां ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayācī goṭhīci aikatakheṃbo| āghavā saṃsāru hoya vābo| baḻiyā nityatā lāge yevo | āpaṇapeyāṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Just by hearing His discourse, the entire worldly existence becomes insignificant, and one's own eternal nature becomes evident.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जन्ममृत्यूची भाख। हारपोनि जाय निःशेख। आंत बाहेरी महासुख। वाढोंचि लागे॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: janmamṛtyūcī bhākha| hāraponi jāya niḥśekha| āṃta bāherī mahāsukha| vāḍhoṃci lāge|| 98||
verses.meaning: The fear of birth and death completely vanishes, and immense joy begins to grow both within and without.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग दैवगत्या जरी सेविजे। तरि तें आपणचि होऊनि ठाकिजे। तें तुज देतां चित्त माझें । पुरे म्हणों न शके॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga daivagatyā jarī sevije| tari teṃ āpaṇaci hoūni ṭhākije| teṃ tuja detāṃ citta mājheṃ | pure mhaṇoṃ na śake|| 99||
verses.meaning: Even if by chance it is served, then one becomes it oneself. My mind cannot say 'enough' when giving that to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुझें नामचि आम्हां आवडे । वरि भेटी होय आणि जवळिक जोडे । पाठीं गोठी सांगसी सुरवाडें।॥ आनंदाचेनी ॥ २००॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujheṃ nāmaci āmhāṃ āvaḍe | vari bheṭī hoya āṇi javaḻika joḍe | pāṭhīṃ goṭhī sāṃgasī suravāḍeṃ||| ānaṃdācenī || 200||
verses.meaning: Your name alone delights us. If we meet and attain closeness, then you will tell us stories of joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां हें सुख 'कायिसयासारिखें। कांहीं निर्वचेना मज परितोखें। तरि येतुलें जाणें जे येणें मुखें । पुनरुक्‍्तही हो॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ heṃ sukha 'kāyisayāsārikheṃ| kāṃhīṃ nirvacenā maja paritokheṃ| tari yetuleṃ jāṇeṃ je yeṇeṃ mukheṃ | punaruk‍tahī ho|| 9||
verses.meaning: Now, what can this joy be compared to? I cannot express it due to my immense delight. But know this much, that through this mouth, repetition itself becomes new.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा सूर्य काय शिळा । अग्नि म्हणों येत आहे बोंबिळा। कां नित्य बाहातया गंगाजळा । पारसेपण असे॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā sūrya kāya śiḻā | agni mhaṇoṃ yeta āhe boṃbiḻā| kāṃ nitya bāhātayā gaṃgājaḻā | pārasepaṇa ase|| 2||
verses.meaning: Indeed, can the sun be called a stone? Can fire be called a mere spark? Or does the ever-flowing water of the Ganga possess the quality of a touchstone?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुवां स्वमुखें जें बोलिलें। हें आम्ही नादासि रूप देखिलें। आजि चंदनतरूचीं फुलें। तुरंबीत आहों मां॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuvāṃ svamukheṃ jeṃ bolileṃ| heṃ āmhī nādāsi rūpa dekhileṃ| āji caṃdanatarūcīṃ phuleṃ| turaṃbīta āhoṃ māṃ|| 3||
verses.meaning: What you have spoken with your own mouth, we have seen as the very form of the divine sound (Nada). Today, we are adorning ourselves with the flowers of the sandalwood tree.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया पार्थाचिया बोला । सर्वांगें श्रीकृष्ण डोळला । म्हणे भक्तिज्ञानासि जाहला । आगरु हा॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā pārthāciyā bolā | sarvāṃgeṃ śrīkṛṣṇa ḍoḻalā | mhaṇe bhaktijñānāsi jāhalā | āgaru hā|| 4||
verses.meaning: At these words of Arjuna, Shri Krishna was delighted in every limb, saying, "He has become a treasure house of devotion and knowledge."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा पतिकराचिया तोषाआंतु । प्रेमाचा वेग उचंबळतु। तो सायासें सांवरूनि अनंतु।) काय बोले॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā patikarāciyā toṣāāṃtu | premācā vega ucaṃbaḻatu| to sāyāseṃ sāṃvarūni anaṃtu|) kāya bole|| 5||
verses.meaning: Thus, within the joy of her husband, the surge of love welled up. With great effort, Ananta (Dnyaneshwari) composed herself and then spoke.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी पितामहाचा पिता । हें आठवितांही नाठवे चित्ता। कीं म्हणतसे बा पंडुसुता । भलें केलें ॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī pitāmahācā pitā | heṃ āṭhavitāṃhī nāṭhave cittā| kīṃ mhaṇatase bā paṃḍusutā | bhaleṃ keleṃ ||6||
verses.meaning: I am the father of the great-grandfather (Brahma); even remembering this, it doesn't come to mind, yet he says, "O son of Pandu, well done!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुनातें बा म्हणे एथ कांहीं । आम्हां विस्मो करावया कारण नाहीं। आंगें तो लेंकरूं कार्ड । नव्हेचि नंदाचें ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunāteṃ bā mhaṇe etha kāṃhīṃ | āmhāṃ vismo karāvayā kāraṇa nāhīṃ| āṃgeṃ to leṃkarūṃ kārḍa | navheci naṃdāceṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, listen, there is no reason for us to be surprised here. He is not Nanda's child, but rather a child of his own making.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि प्रस्तुत ऐसें असो। हें करवी आवडीचा अतिसो। मग म्हणे आईकें सांगतसों। धनुर्धरा ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari prastuta aiseṃ aso| heṃ karavī āvaḍīcā atiso| maga mhaṇe āīkeṃ sāṃgatasoṃ| dhanurdharā || 8||
verses.meaning: So, let it be as it is. This is done out of excessive love. Then he says, "Listen, I am telling you, O Arjuna."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि तुवां पुसल्या विभूती। तयांचें अपारपण सुभद्रापती। ज्या माझियाचि परि माझिये मती। आकळती ना॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari tuvāṃ pusalyā vibhūtī| tayāṃceṃ apārapaṇa subhadrāpatī| jyā mājhiyāci pari mājhiye matī| ākaḻatī nā||9||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the glories you have inquired about, O husband of Subhadra, are immeasurable. Even my own intellect cannot fully comprehend them, just as it cannot fully comprehend Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंगींचिया रोमा किती। जयाचिया तयासि न गणवती। तैसिया माझिया विभूती । असंख्य मज॥ २१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃgīṃciyā romā kitī| jayāciyā tayāsi na gaṇavatī| taisiyā mājhiyā vibhūtī | asaṃkhya maja|| 210||
verses.meaning: Just as one cannot count the hairs on one's own body, so too are My manifestations countless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी मी कैसा केवढा। म्हणौनि आपणपयांही नव्हेचि फुडा । यालागीं प्रधाना जिया रूढा । तिया आइकें ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī mī kaisā kevaḍhā| mhaṇauni āpaṇapayāṃhī navheci phuḍā | yālāgīṃ pradhānā jiyā rūḍhā | tiyā āikeṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, how could I be, and how great? Therefore, I am not clearly manifest even to myself. For this reason, listen to those primary qualities that are well-established.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिया जाणितलियासाठीं। आघवीया जाणवतील किरीटी। जैसें बीज आल्िा मुठीं। तरूचिं आला होय॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiyā jāṇitaliyāsāṭhīṃ| āghavīyā jāṇavatīla kirīṭī| jaiseṃ bīja āliā muṭhīṃ| tarūciṃ ālā hoya|| 12||
verses.meaning: By knowing that one thing, everything else, O Kiriti, will be known, just as when the seed is held in hand, the whole tree is as good as obtained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां उद्यान हातां चढिन्नलें। तरी आपैसीं सांपडलीं फळें फुलें। तेवीं देखिळिया जिया देखवलें। विश्‍व सकळ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ udyāna hātāṃ caḍhinnaleṃ| tarī āpaisīṃ sāṃpaḍalīṃ phaḻeṃ phuleṃ| tevīṃ dekhiḻiyā jiyā dekhavaleṃ| viś‍va sakaḻa|| 13||
verses.meaning: Just as when a garden is attained, fruits and flowers are naturally found, so too, by seeing that which is to be seen, the entire universe is seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं साचचि गा धनुर्धरा । नाहीं शेवटु माझिया विस्तारा । पैं गगनाऐशिया अपारा। मजमाजीं लपणें ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ sācaci gā dhanurdharā | nāhīṃ śevaṭu mājhiyā vistārā | paiṃ gaganāaiśiyā apārā| majamājīṃ lapaṇeṃ || 14||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Arjuna, there is no end to My expanse. Even the boundless sky is contained within Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आइकें कुटिलालकमस्तका । धनुर्वेदत्र्यंबका। मी आत्मा असें एकैका। भूतमात्राच्या ठायीं ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āikeṃ kuṭilālakamastakā | dhanurvedatryaṃbakā| mī ātmā aseṃ ekaikā| bhūtamātrācyā ṭhāyīṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Listen, O Lord of the crooked locks, O master of the three Vedas of archery, I am the Self, residing uniquely in every single being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंतुलीकडे मीचि यांचे अंत:करणीं । भूतांबाहेरी माझीच गंबवसणी । आदि मी निर्वाणीं। मध्यही मीचि ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃtulīkaḍe mīci yāṃce aṃta:karaṇīṃ | bhūtāṃbāherī mājhīca gaṃbavasaṇī | ādi mī nirvāṇīṃ| madhyahī mīci || 16||
verses.meaning: Within, I am indeed in their hearts. Outside all beings, my presence pervades. I am the beginning, the end, and also the middle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें मेघां या तळीं वरी। एक आकाशचि आंत बाहेरी) आणि आकाशींचि जाले अवधारीं । असणेंही आकाशीं ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ meghāṃ yā taḻīṃ varī| eka ākāśaci āṃta bāherī) āṇi ākāśīṃci jāle avadhārīṃ | asaṇeṃhī ākāśīṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Just as for the clouds, above and below, it is only the sky within and without; and all their existence, indeed, is in the sky itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं लया जे वेळीं जाती। ते वेळीं आकाशचि होऊनि ठाती | तेवीं आदि स्थिती गती । भूतांसि मी॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ layā je veḻīṃ jātī| te veḻīṃ ākāśaci hoūni ṭhātī | tevīṃ ādi sthitī gatī | bhūtāṃsi mī|| 18||
verses.meaning: When all things ultimately dissolve, they become one with the sky. Similarly, I am the origin, the sustenance, and the dissolution of all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें बहुबस आणि व्यापकपण। माझें विभूतियोगें जाण। तरी जीवचि करूनि श्रवण। आइकोनि आइक॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ bahubasa āṇi vyāpakapaṇa| mājheṃ vibhūtiyogeṃ jāṇa| tarī jīvaci karūni śravaṇa| āikoni āika|| 19||
verses.meaning: Such is the vastness and pervasiveness of My divine manifestations. Therefore, O Jiva (individual soul), listen with devotion and understand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याहीवरी त्या विभूती । सांगणें ठेलें सुभट्रापती । सांगेन म्हणितळलें तुजप्रती । त्या प्रधाना आइकें ॥२२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāhīvarī tyā vibhūtī | sāṃgaṇeṃ ṭheleṃ subhaṭrāpatī | sāṃgena mhaṇitaḻaleṃ tujapratī | tyā pradhānā āikeṃ ||220||
verses.meaning: Beyond this, the manifestations (vibhutis) that were to be told, O best among warriors, I had promised to tell you. Now listen to those principal ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बोलोनि तो कृपावंतु। म्हणें विष्णु मी आदित्यांआंतु। रवी मी रश्मिवंतु । सुप्रभांमाजीं ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ boloni to kṛpāvaṃtu| mhaṇeṃ viṣṇu mī ādityāṃāṃtu| ravī mī raśmivaṃtu | suprabhāṃmājīṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: Having spoken thus, that compassionate one said, "Among the Adityas, I am Vishnu. Among the radiant ones, I am Ravi (the Sun), full of rays."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मरुद्गणांच्या वर्गी । मरीचि म्हणे मी शार्ड़ी । चंद्र मी गगनरंगीं। तारांमाजीं॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: marudgaṇāṃcyā vargī | marīci mhaṇe mī śārr̤ī | caṃdra mī gaganaraṃgīṃ| tārāṃmājīṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: Among the Maruts, I am Marichi; among the celestial bodies, I am the moon, shining brightly amidst the stars.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वेदांआंतु सामवेदु। तो मी म्हणे गोविंदु । देवांमाजी मरुदबंधु । महेंद्र तो मी॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vedāṃāṃtu sāmavedu| to mī mhaṇe goviṃdu | devāṃmājī marudabaṃdhu | maheṃdra to mī|| 23||
verses.meaning: Among the Vedas, I am the Samaveda, says Govinda. Among the gods, I am Mahendra, the chief of the Maruts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियांमाजीं अकरावें। मन तें मी हें जाणावें । भूतांमाजीं स्वभावें । चेतना ते मी॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyāṃmājīṃ akarāveṃ| mana teṃ mī heṃ jāṇāveṃ | bhūtāṃmājīṃ svabhāveṃ | cetanā te mī|| 24||
verses.meaning: Know that among the senses, the eleventh, the mind, is Me. And among all beings, their inherent consciousness is also Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अशेषांही रुद्रांमाझारीं। शंकर जो मदनारी। तो मी येथ न धरीं। भ्रांति कांहीं ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aśeṣāṃhī rudrāṃmājhārīṃ| śaṃkara jo madanārī| to mī yetha na dharīṃ| bhrāṃti kāṃhīṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Among all the Rudras, I am Shankara, the destroyer of Kama. Do not entertain any doubt about this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यक्षरक्षोगणांआंतु। शंभूचा सखा जो धनवंतु। तो कुबेरु मी हें अनंतु। म्हणता जाहला॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yakṣarakṣogaṇāṃāṃtu| śaṃbhūcā sakhā jo dhanavaṃtu| to kuberu mī heṃ anaṃtu| mhaṇatā jāhalā|| 26||
verses.meaning: Amongst the Yakshas and Rakshasas, I am Kubera, the wealthy friend of Shiva, thus spoke the Infinite One.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आठांही बसूंमाझारीं। पावकु तो मी अवधारीं । शिखराधिल्ियां सर्वोपरी। मेरु तो मी॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āṭhāṃhī basūṃmājhārīṃ| pāvaku to mī avadhārīṃ | śikharādhiliyāṃ sarvoparī| meru to mī|| 27||
verses.meaning: Among the eight Vasus, know that I am Pavaka. Among all the mountain peaks, I am Mount Meru, the highest of all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो स्वर्गसिंहासना सावावो। सर्वज्ञते आदीचा ठावो। तो पुरोहितांमाजीं रावो। बृहस्पती मी॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo svargasiṃhāsanā sāvāvo| sarvajñate ādīcā ṭhāvo| to purohitāṃmājīṃ rāvo| bṛhaspatī mī|| 28||
verses.meaning: I am Brihaspati, the king among priests, who is the support of the throne of heaven and the abode of omniscience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्रिभुवनींचिया सेनापतीं-। आंत स्कंदु तो मी महामती । जो हरवीर्ये अग्निसंगती । कृत्तिकाआंतु जाहला ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tribhuvanīṃciyā senāpatīṃ-| āṃta skaṃdu to mī mahāmatī | jo haravīrye agnisaṃgatī | kṛttikāāṃtu jāhalā || 29||
verses.meaning: Among the commanders of the three worlds, I am Skanda, the great warrior, who was born from the union of Shiva's virility and Agni, within the Krittikas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सकळिकां सरोवरांसीं । माजीं समुद्र तो मी जळराशी । महर्षीआंतु तपोराशी। भृगु तो मी॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: sakaḻikāṃ sarovarāṃsīṃ | mājīṃ samudra to mī jaḻarāśī | maharṣīāṃtu taporāśī| bhṛgu to mī|| 230||
verses.meaning: Among all reservoirs, I am the ocean, the vast expanse of water. Among the great sages, I am Bhrigu, the embodiment of penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अशेषांही वाचा-। माजीं नटनाच सत्याचा । तें अक्षर एक मी बैकुंठींचा । वेल्हाळु म्हणे ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aśeṣāṃhī vācā-| mājīṃ naṭanāca satyācā | teṃ akṣara eka mī baikuṃṭhīṃcā | velhāḻu mhaṇe || 31||
verses.meaning: In all the Vedas, the truth dances and manifests. That one imperishable word, I am the charming one from Vaikuntha, says the Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: समस्तांही यज्ञांच्यापैकीं। जपयज्ञु तो मी ये लोकीं। जो कर्मत्यागें प्रणवादिकीं । निफजविजे॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: samastāṃhī yajñāṃcyāpaikīṃ| japayajñu to mī ye lokīṃ| jo karmatyāgeṃ praṇavādikīṃ | niphajavije|| 32||
verses.meaning: Among all sacrifices, I am the sacrifice of chanting (Japa-yajna) in this world, which is performed by renouncing actions and beginning with Om.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नामजपयज्ञु तो परम। बाधूं न शके स्मानादि कर्म। नामें पावन धर्माधर्म। नाम परब्रह्म वेदार्थे ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāmajapayajñu to parama| bādhūṃ na śake smānādi karma| nāmeṃ pāvana dharmādharma| nāma parabrahma vedārthe || 33||
verses.meaning: The chanting of the Divine Name is the supreme sacrifice. It is not bound by rituals like bathing. Through the Name, both dharma (righteousness) and adharma (unrighteousness) become purified. The Name, according to the Vedas, is the Supreme Brahman itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्थावरां गिरीं आंतु। पुण्यपुंज जो हिमवंतु। तो मी म्हणे कांतु। लक्षिमियेचा ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: sthāvarāṃ girīṃ āṃtu| puṇyapuṃja jo himavaṃtu| to mī mhaṇe kāṃtu| lakṣimiyecā || 34||
verses.meaning: Amongst immovable things, I am the Himalayas, the accumulated merit, says the beloved of Lakshmi (Vishnu).

verses.shloka_devanagari: कल्पद्रुम हन पारिजातु। गुणें चंदनुही वाड विख्यातु। तरि ययां वृक्षजातांआंतु। अश्वत्थु तो मी॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kalpadruma hana pārijātu| guṇeṃ caṃdanuhī vāḍa vikhyātu| tari yayāṃ vṛkṣajātāṃāṃtu| aśvatthu to mī|| 35||
verses.meaning: Among wish-fulfilling trees like the Kalpataru and Parijat, and the renowned sandalwood tree, I am the Ashwattha (peepal tree).

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवक्रषींआंतु पांडवा । नारदु तो मी जाणावा । चित्ररथु मी गंधर्वा। सकळिकांमाजीं ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: devakraṣīṃāṃtu pāṃḍavā | nāradu to mī jāṇāvā | citrarathu mī gaṃdharvā| sakaḻikāṃmājīṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: Amongst the divine sages, O Arjuna, know Me to be Narada. Among the Gandharvas, I am Chitraratha, the foremost of them all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ययां अशेषांही सिद्धां-। माजीं कपिलाचार्यु मी प्रबुद्धा। तुरंगजातां प्रसिद्धां-॥ आंत उच्चैःश्रवा मी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayāṃ aśeṣāṃhī siddhāṃ-| mājīṃ kapilācāryu mī prabuddhā| turaṃgajātāṃ prasiddhāṃ-|| āṃta uccaiḥśravā mī || 37||
verses.meaning: Among all these perfected beings, I am Kapila, the enlightened one. Among famous horses, I am Uchchaihshravas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: राजभूषण गजांआंतु। अर्जुना मी गा ऐरावतु। 'पयोराशी सुरमथितु। अमृतांशु तो मी॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: rājabhūṣaṇa gajāṃāṃtu| arjunā mī gā airāvatu| 'payorāśī suramathitu| amṛtāṃśu to mī|| 38||
verses.meaning: Amongst the royal elephants, Arjuna, I am Airavata. Among the things churned from the ocean of milk by the gods, I am the moon, the source of nectar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ययां नरांमाजीं राजा। तो विभूतिविशेष माझा । जयातें सकळ लोक प्रजा। होऊनि सेविती ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayāṃ narāṃmājīṃ rājā| to vibhūtiviśeṣa mājhā | jayāteṃ sakaḻa loka prajā| hoūni sevitī || 39||
verses.meaning: Among these human beings, the king is a special manifestation of My glory, whom all people serve as their subjects.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आघवेयां हातियेरां-। आंत वज़ तें मी धनुर्धरा। जें शतमखोत्तीर्णकरा । आरूढोनि असे॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āghaveyāṃ hātiyerāṃ-| āṃta vaza teṃ mī dhanurdharā| jeṃ śatamakhottīrṇakarā | ārūḍhoni ase|| 240||
verses.meaning: Among all weapons, I am the thunderbolt, O Arjuna, that which is mounted upon by Indra, the one who has defeated a hundred sacrifices.

verses.shloka_devanagari: धेनूंमध्यें कामधेनु। तें मी म्हणे विष्वक्सेनु । जन्मवितयाआंत मदनु। तो मी जाणें ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: dhenūṃmadhyeṃ kāmadhenu| teṃ mī mhaṇe viṣvaksenu | janmavitayāāṃta madanu| to mī jāṇeṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: Amongst cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow, Kamadhenu. I am Vishvaksena. Among those who give birth, I am the god of love, Madana.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्पकुळाआंत अधिष्ठाता । वासुकी गा मी कुंतीसुता । नागांमाजीं समस्तां। अनंतु तो मी॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarpakuḻāāṃta adhiṣṭhātā | vāsukī gā mī kuṃtīsutā | nāgāṃmājīṃ samastāṃ| anaṃtu to mī|| 42||
verses.meaning: Among the serpent races, I am Vasuki, O son of Kunti. And among all the Nagas, I am Ananta.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा यादसांआंतु। जो पश्‍चिम प्रमदेचा कांतु। तो वरुण मी हें अनंतु। सांगत असे॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā yādasāṃāṃtu| jo paś‍cima pramadecā kāṃtu| to varuṇa mī heṃ anaṃtu| sāṃgata ase|| 43||
verses.meaning: Amongst all the Yadavas, I am Varuna, the beloved husband of the western direction. This is what I, the Endless One, am telling you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि पितृगणां समस्तां-। माजीं अर्यमा जो पितृदेवता। तो मी हें तत्त्वतां। बोलत आहें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi pitṛgaṇāṃ samastāṃ-| mājīṃ aryamā jo pitṛdevatā| to mī heṃ tattvatāṃ| bolata āheṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: Amongst all the ancestors, I am Aryama, the deity of the ancestors. This I am truly telling you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जगाचोीं शुभाशुभें लिहिती । प्राणियांच्या मानसांचा झाडा घेती । मग केलियानुरूप होती । भोगनियम जे॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jagācoīṃ śubhāśubheṃ lihitī | prāṇiyāṃcyā mānasāṃcā jhāḍā ghetī | maga keliyānurūpa hotī | bhoganiyama je|| 45 ||
verses.meaning: They record the good and bad deeds of the world, taking account of the minds of beings. Then, according to what has been done, the rules of experience are formed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां नियमितयांमाजी यमु । जो कर्मसाक्षी धर्मु। तो मी म्हणे आत्मारामु। रमापती ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ niyamitayāṃmājī yamu | jo karmasākṣī dharmu| to mī mhaṇe ātmārāmu| ramāpatī || 46||
verses.meaning: Among those who exercise self-restraint, I am Yama, the witness of all actions, Dharma itself. So says Lord Rama, the beloved of Lakshmi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा दैत्यांचिया कुळीं। प्रऱ्हादु तो मी न्याहाळीं । म्हणौनि दैत्यभावादिमेळीं। लिंपेचिना ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā daityāṃciyā kuḻīṃ| praṟhādu to mī nyāhāḻīṃ | mhaṇauni daityabhāvādimeḻīṃ| liṃpecinā || 47||
verses.meaning: Behold, Prahlad, born in the lineage of demons, was not tainted by their demonic nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं कळितयांमाजीं महाकाळु। तो मी म्हणे गोपाळु। इबापदांमाजीं शार्दूळु। तो मी जाण ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kaḻitayāṃmājīṃ mahākāḻu| to mī mhaṇe gopāḻu| ibāpadāṃmājīṃ śārdūḻu| to mī jāṇa || 48||
verses.meaning: Among all that is known, I am the great Destroyer, the very embodiment of time. Among all creatures, I am the tiger, the most formidable and powerful.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पक्षिजातीमाझारीं। गरुड तो मी अवधारीं। यालागीं जो पाठीवरी। वाहों शके मातें ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pakṣijātīmājhārīṃ| garuḍa to mī avadhārīṃ| yālāgīṃ jo pāṭhīvarī| vāhoṃ śake māteṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: Amongst all species of birds, know that I am the Garuda, for only he has the strength to carry Me on his back.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पृथ्वीचिया पैसारा-। माजीं घडी न लगतां धनुर्धरा। एकेंचि उड्डाणे सातांहि सागरां। प्रदक्षिणा करी जो॥ २५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pṛthvīciyā paisārā-| mājīṃ ghaḍī na lagatāṃ dhanurdharā| ekeṃci uḍḍāṇe sātāṃhi sāgarāṃ| pradakṣiṇā karī jo|| 250||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, without taking a moment's rest, with a single leap, he circumambulates all seven oceans.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां वहिलियां गतिमंतां-। आंत पवनु तो मी पंडुसुता । शस्त्रधरां समस्तां-। माजीं श्रीराम तो मी॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ vahiliyāṃ gatimaṃtāṃ-| āṃta pavanu to mī paṃḍusutā | śastradharāṃ samastāṃ-| mājīṃ śrīrāma to mī||51||
verses.meaning: Among the swift, I am the wind, O son of Pandu. Among all who bear weapons, I am Rama.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें सांकडलियां धर्माचें कैवारें। आपणपयां धनुष्य करूनि दुसरें विजयलक्च्िमिये एक मोहरें। केलें त्रेतीं॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ sāṃkaḍaliyāṃ dharmāceṃ kaivāreṃ| āpaṇapayāṃ dhanuṣya karūni dusareṃ vijayalakcimiye eka mohareṃ| keleṃ tretīṃ|| 52||
verses.meaning: In the Treta Yuga, when dharma was in distress, He Himself, taking up the bow, became the sole champion for the victory of Lakshmi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं उभें ठाकूनि सुवेळीं। प्रतापलंकेश्वराचीं सिसाळीं। गगनीं उदो म्हणतया हस्तबळीं । दिधलीं भूतां॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ ubheṃ ṭhākūni suveḻīṃ| pratāpalaṃkeśvarācīṃ sisāḻīṃ| gaganīṃ udo mhaṇatayā hastabaḻīṃ | didhalīṃ bhūtāṃ|| 53||
verses.meaning: Standing behind him at the opportune moment, the heads of the glorious Ravana were offered as a powerful sacrifice to the spirits, proclaiming victory in the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें देवांचा मानु गिंबसिला। धर्मासि जीर्णोद्द्वारु केला। सूर्यवंशी उदेला। सूर्य जो कां॥५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ devāṃcā mānu giṃbasilā| dharmāsi jīrṇoddvāru kelā| sūryavaṃśī udelā| sūrya jo kāṃ||54||
verses.meaning: He who restored the honor of the gods, who rejuvenated Dharma, that sun who rose in the solar dynasty.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो हातियेरुपरजितयांआंतु। रामचंद्र मी जानकीकांतु। मकर मी पुच्छवंतु। जळचरांमाजीं ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: to hātiyeruparajitayāṃāṃtu| rāmacaṃdra mī jānakīkāṃtu| makara mī pucchavaṃtu| jaḻacarāṃmājīṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Among those who bear weapons, I am Rama, the beloved of Janaki. Among aquatic creatures, I am the crocodile with its tail.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं समस्तांही बोघां-। मध्यें जे भगीरथें आणितां गंगा । जन्हूनें गिळिली मग जंघा। फाडूनि दिधली ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ samastāṃhī boghāṃ-| madhyeṃ je bhagīratheṃ āṇitāṃ gaṃgā | janhūneṃ giḻilī maga jaṃghā| phāḍūni didhalī || 56||
verses.meaning: Just as among all the rivers, the Ganga, brought by Bhagiratha, was swallowed by Jahnu, who then released her by tearing open his thigh.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते त्रिभुबवनैकसरिता। जान्हवी मी पंडुसुता । जळप्रवाहां समस्तां-। माझारीं जाणें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: te tribhubavanaikasaritā| jānhavī mī paṃḍusutā | jaḻapravāhāṃ samastāṃ-| mājhārīṃ jāṇeṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, know that I am the Ganga, the sole river of the three worlds, present in all flowing waters.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि वेगळालां सृष्टीपैकीं। विभूती नाम सुतां एकेकीं । सगळेन जन्मसहस्त्रें अबलोकीं। अर्ध्या नव्हती ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni vegaḻālāṃ sṛṣṭīpaikīṃ| vibhūtī nāma sutāṃ ekekīṃ | sagaḻena janmasahastreṃ abalokīṃ| ardhyā navhatī || 58||
verses.meaning: Even if one were to describe each of these manifestations separately, for thousands of lifetimes, they would not be fully described, not even by half.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसीं अवघींचि नक्षत्रे वेंचावीं। ऐसी चाड उपजेल जेैं जीवीं। तें गगनाची बांधावी। लोथ जेवीं ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisīṃ avaghīṃci nakṣatre veṃcāvīṃ| aisī cāḍa upajela jeaiṃ jīvīṃ| teṃ gaganācī bāṃdhāvī| lotha jevīṃ ||59||
verses.meaning: Just as one might desire to gather all the stars, such a longing in the heart is like trying to tie up the entire sky in a bundle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां पृथ्वीये परमाणूंचा उगाणा घ्यावा । तरि भूगोलुचि काखे सुवावा। तैसा विस्तार माझा पहावा । तरि जाणावें मातें ॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ pṛthvīye paramāṇūṃcā ugāṇā ghyāvā | tari bhūgoluci kākhe suvāvā| taisā vistāra mājhā pahāvā | tari jāṇāveṃ māteṃ || 260||
verses.meaning: Just as one would have to embrace the entire globe to count the atoms of the earth, so too, to truly know me, one must comprehend my vastness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें शाखांसी फूळफळ। एकिहेळां वेटाळूं म्हणिजे सकळ ।। तरि उपडूनियां मूळ । जेवीं हातीं घेपे॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ śākhāṃsī phūḻaphaḻa| ekiheḻāṃ veṭāḻūṃ mhaṇije sakaḻa || tari upaḍūniyāṃ mūḻa | jevīṃ hātīṃ ghepe|| 61||
verses.meaning: Just as one might wish to gather all the flowers and fruits from a branch at once, it is like uprooting the entire tree and taking it into one's hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं माझे विभूतिविशेष । जरी जाणों पाहिजेती अशेष। तरी स्वरूप निर्दोष। जाणिजे माझें ॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ mājhe vibhūtiviśeṣa | jarī jāṇoṃ pāhijetī aśeṣa| tarī svarūpa nirdoṣa| jāṇije mājheṃ ||62||
verses.meaning: In the same way, if you wish to know all my special manifestations, then know my flawless true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं वेगळालिया विभूती । कायिएक परिससी किती । म्हणौनि एकिहेळां महामती। सर्व मी जाण॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ vegaḻāliyā vibhūtī | kāyieka parisasī kitī | mhaṇauni ekiheḻāṃ mahāmatī| sarva mī jāṇa||63||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, how many separate manifestations would you hear about? Therefore, O great-minded one, know that I am all of them, simultaneously.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी आधवियेचि सृष्टी। आदिमध्यांतीं किरीटी। ओतप्रोत पटीं। तंतु जेवीं ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī ādhaviyeci sṛṣṭī| ādimadhyāṃtīṃ kirīṭī| otaprota paṭīṃ| taṃtu jevīṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: I am the creation of Adhaviye, O Kiriti, pervading it from beginning to end, just as a thread pervades a cloth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया व्यापका मातें जें जाणावें। तैं बिभूतिभेदें काय करावें। परि हे तुझी योग्यता नव्हे। म्हणौनि असो॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā vyāpakā māteṃ jeṃ jāṇāveṃ| taiṃ bibhūtibhedeṃ kāya karāveṃ| pari he tujhī yogyatā navhe| mhaṇauni aso|| 65||
verses.meaning: When one knows Me, the all-pervading, what is the need to understand through various manifestations? But this is not your capacity, so let it be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे तुवां पुसिलिया विभूती। म्हणौनि तिया आईक सुभद्रापती । तरी विद्यांमाजीं प्रस्तुती । अध्यात्मविद्या ते मी॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je tuvāṃ pusiliyā vibhūtī| mhaṇauni tiyā āīka subhadrāpatī | tarī vidyāṃmājīṃ prastutī | adhyātmavidyā te mī|| 66||
verses.meaning: Since you have inquired about My glories, O husband of Subhadra, listen to them. Among all branches of knowledge, I am the knowledge of the Self (Adhyatma Vidya).

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा बोलतयांचिया ठायीं। वादु तो मी पाहीं। जो सकलशास्त्रसंमतें कहीं । सरेचिना॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā bolatayāṃciyā ṭhāyīṃ| vādu to mī pāhīṃ| jo sakalaśāstrasaṃmateṃ kahīṃ | sarecinā|| 67||
verses.meaning: Among those who debate, I am that very debate which, even with the consensus of all scriptures, never concludes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो निर्वचूं जातां वाढे। आइकतयां उत्प्रेक्षे सळु चढे। जयावरी बोलतयांचीं गोडें। बोलणीं होतीं ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo nirvacūṃ jātāṃ vāḍhe| āikatayāṃ utprekṣe saḻu caḍhe| jayāvarī bolatayāṃcīṃ goḍeṃ| bolaṇīṃ hotīṃ || 68||
verses.meaning: When one attempts to describe it, its greatness only expands. The listener's imagination soars, and all the sweet words spoken about it become true.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा प्रतिपादनामाजीं वादु। तो मी म्हणे गोविंदु। अक्षरांमाजीं विशदु।) अकारु तो मी॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā pratipādanāmājīṃ vādu| to mī mhaṇe goviṃdu| akṣarāṃmājīṃ viśadu|) akāru to mī||69||
verses.meaning: Among all discussions and debates, I am that Govinda. Among all letters, I am the clear and distinct 'A' (अकारु).

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा समासांमाझारीं। द्वन तो मी अवधारीं। मशकालागोनि ब्रह्मावेरीं। २०४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी ग्रासिता तो मी॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā samāsāṃmājhārīṃ| dvana to mī avadhārīṃ| maśakālāgoni brahmāverīṃ| 204 śrījñāneśvarī grāsitā to mī|| 270||
verses.meaning: In all things, from the smallest mosquito to the greatest Brahma, I am the one who pervades and encompasses all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मेरुमंदरादिकीं सर्वी । सहित पृथ्वीतें विरवी। जो एकार्णवातेंही जिरवी। जेथिंचा तेथ॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: merumaṃdarādikīṃ sarvī | sahita pṛthvīteṃ viravī| jo ekārṇavāteṃhī jiravī| jethiṃcā tetha||71||
verses.meaning: The one who dissolves all, including Mount Meru and Mandara, along with the earth, and even absorbs the cosmic ocean back into its original state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो प्रळयतेजा देत मिठी । सगळिया पवनातें गिळी किरीटी । आकाश जयाचिया पोटीं । सामावलळें॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo praḻayatejā deta miṭhī | sagaḻiyā pavanāteṃ giḻī kirīṭī | ākāśa jayāciyā poṭīṃ | sāmāvalaḻeṃ||72||
