verses.meaning: He who embraces the destructive cosmic fire, who swallows all winds, and within whose being the entire sky is contained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अपार जो काळु । तो मी म्हणे लक्ष्मीलीळु । मग पुढती सृष्टीचा मेळु । सूजिता तो मी॥७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā apāra jo kāḻu | to mī mhaṇe lakṣmīlīḻu | maga puḍhatī sṛṣṭīcā meḻu | sūjitā to mī||73||
verses.meaning: Such immeasurable time, I am He, the playful Lord of Lakshmi. Then, the entire creation that follows, I am the one who brings it forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सृजिलिया भूतांतें मीचि धरीं । सकळां जीवनही मीचि अवधारीं । शेखीं सर्वातें या संहारीं । तेव्हा मृत्युही मीचि ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sṛjiliyā bhūtāṃteṃ mīci dharīṃ | sakaḻāṃ jīvanahī mīci avadhārīṃ | śekhīṃ sarvāteṃ yā saṃhārīṃ | tevhā mṛtyuhī mīci || 74||
verses.meaning: I alone sustain all created beings. I alone am the life of all. Ultimately, I destroy everything. Therefore, I am also death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां स्त्रीगणांच्या पैकीं । माझिया विभूती सात आणिकी। तिया ऐक कवतिकीं। सांगिजतीळ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ strīgaṇāṃcyā paikīṃ | mājhiyā vibhūtī sāta āṇikī| tiyā aika kavatikīṃ| sāṃgijatīḻa|| 75||
verses.meaning: Now, among the feminine qualities, listen to seven more of My divine manifestations, which I shall narrate with delight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी नित्य नवी जे कौर्ति। अर्जुना ते माझी मूर्ती । आणि औदार्येसी जे संपत्ती । तेही मीचि जाणें॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī nitya navī je kaurti| arjunā te mājhī mūrtī | āṇi audāryesī je saṃpattī | tehī mīci jāṇeṃ|| 76||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, know that the ever-new glory is My form. And the wealth that comes with generosity, that too is Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ते गा मी वाचा । जे सुखासनीं न्यायाचा । आरूढोनि विवेकाचा । मार्गी चाळे॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi te gā mī vācā | je sukhāsanīṃ nyāyācā | ārūḍhoni vivekācā | mārgī cāḻe|| 77||
verses.meaning: And I will sing of that village, which, seated on the throne of bliss and justice, moves along the path of discrimination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखिलेनि पदार्थे। जे आठवूनि दे मातें। ते स्मृतिही एथें। त्रिशुद्धी मी॥७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhileni padārthe| je āṭhavūni de māteṃ| te smṛtihī etheṃ| triśuddhī mī||78||
verses.meaning: Whatever is seen, and whatever memory brings Me to mind, that memory too is verily Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं स्वहिता अनुयायिनी। मेधा ते गा मी इये जनीं । धृती मी त्रिभुवनीं। क्षमा ते मी॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ svahitā anuyāyinī| medhā te gā mī iye janīṃ | dhṛtī mī tribhuvanīṃ| kṣamā te mī||79||
verses.meaning: Among people, I am the intellect that guides one towards self-welfare. In all three worlds, I am the steadfastness, and I am forgiveness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं नारींमाझारीं। या सातही शक्ति मी अवधारीं। ऐसें संसारगजकेसरी । म्हणता जाहला॥ २८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ nārīṃmājhārīṃ| yā sātahī śakti mī avadhārīṃ| aiseṃ saṃsāragajakesarī | mhaṇatā jāhalā|| 280||
verses.meaning: Thus, among women, I am indeed these seven powers, said the lion to the elephant of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वेदराशीचिया सामा-। आंत बृहत्साम जें प्रियोत्तमा। तें मी म्हणे रमा-। प्राणेश्‍्वरु॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: vedarāśīciyā sāmā-| āṃta bṛhatsāma jeṃ priyottamā| teṃ mī mhaṇe ramā-| prāṇeś‍varu|| 81||
verses.meaning: Amongst the entire collection of Vedas, the most beloved and supreme is the Brihatsama, and that, says the Lord of Lakshmi, is Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गायत्रीछंद जें म्हणिजे। तें सकळां छंदांमाजीं माझें । स्वरूप हें जाणिजे । निभ्रांत तुवां ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: gāyatrīchaṃda jeṃ mhaṇije| teṃ sakaḻāṃ chaṃdāṃmājīṃ mājheṃ | svarūpa heṃ jāṇije | nibhrāṃta tuvāṃ || 82||
verses.meaning: When Gayatri meter is mentioned, know that it is My form among all meters, without a doubt.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मासांआंत मार्गशीरु। तो मी म्हणे शार्डुुधरु । क्रतूंमाजीं कुसुमाकरु। बसंतु तो मी॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: māsāṃāṃta mārgaśīru| to mī mhaṇe śārḍuudharu | kratūṃmājīṃ kusumākaru| basaṃtu to mī|| 83||
verses.meaning: Among months, I am Margashirsha; among seasons, I am the spring, the flower-bearer. Thus says the wielder of the Sharanga bow (Lord Krishna).

verses.shloka_devanagari: छळितयां विंदाणा-। माजीं जूं तें मी विचक्षणा । म्हणोनि चोहटां चोरी परी कवणा । निवारूं न ये॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: chaḻitayāṃ viṃdāṇā-| mājīṃ jūṃ teṃ mī vicakṣaṇā | mhaṇoni cohaṭāṃ corī parī kavaṇā | nivārūṃ na ye||84||
verses.meaning: I am the one who, with my discerning intellect, endures the suffering of those who are tormented. Therefore, no one can prevent me from stealing from the crossroads (of life).

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा अशेषांही तेजसां-। आंत तेज तें मी भरंवसा । विजयो मी कार्योहेशां। सकळांमाजी ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā aśeṣāṃhī tejasāṃ-| āṃta teja teṃ mī bharaṃvasā | vijayo mī kāryoheśāṃ| sakaḻāṃmājī || 85 ||
verses.meaning: Among all splendors, I am that very splendor, the assurance. I am the victory in all endeavors.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें चोखाळत दिसे न्याय। तो व्यवसायांत व्यवसाय । माझें स्वरूप हें राय। सुरांचा म्हणे ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ cokhāḻata dise nyāya| to vyavasāyāṃta vyavasāya | mājheṃ svarūpa heṃ rāya| surāṃcā mhaṇe || 86||
verses.meaning: That by which justice appears pure, that is the very essence of my being, says the Lord of the gods.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सत्त्वाथिलियांआंतु। सत्त्व मी म्हणे अनंतु। यादवांमाजीं श्रीमंतु। तोचि तो मी॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sattvāthiliyāṃāṃtu| sattva mī mhaṇe anaṃtu| yādavāṃmājīṃ śrīmaṃtu| toci to mī|| 87||
verses.meaning: Among all things that are sattvic (pure, good, virtuous), I am the endless sattva. Among the Yadavas, I am the glorious one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो देवकी वसुदेवास्तव जाहला । कुमारीसाठीं गोकुळीं गेला। तो मी प्राणासकट पियाला। पूतनेतें ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo devakī vasudevāstava jāhalā | kumārīsāṭhīṃ gokuḻīṃ gelā| to mī prāṇāsakaṭa piyālā| pūtaneteṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: He who was born to Devaki and Vasudeva, and for the sake of the maiden (Yashoda's daughter) went to Gokul, that very Krishna I (Pootana) drank with my life-breath.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नुघडतां बाळपणाची फुली । जेणें मियां अदानवी सृष्टि केलळी। करीं गिरि धरूनि उमाणिली । महेंद्रमहिमा ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nughaḍatāṃ bāḻapaṇācī phulī | jeṇeṃ miyāṃ adānavī sṛṣṭi kelaḻī| karīṃ giri dharūni umāṇilī | maheṃdramahimā || 89||
verses.meaning: Without even shedding the innocence of childhood, I, who am beyond human comprehension, created the universe. I held the mountain in my hand and measured it, such is the glory of the great Indra.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कालिंदीचें हृदयशल्य फेडिलें। जेणें मियां जळत गोकुळ राखिलें। वासरुवांसाठीं लाविलें। विरंचीस पिसें॥ २९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāliṃdīceṃ hṛdayaśalya pheḍileṃ| jeṇeṃ miyāṃ jaḻata gokuḻa rākhileṃ| vāsaruvāṃsāṭhīṃ lāvileṃ| viraṃcīsa piseṃ|| 290||
verses.meaning: He who removed the sorrow from the heart of Kalindi (Yamuna), who protected Gokul from being consumed by fire, and for the sake of the calves, made Brahma bewildered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रथमदशेचिये पहांटे- । माजि कंसाऐशीं अचाटें । महाधेंडीं अवचटें । लीळाचि नासिलीं ॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: prathamadaśeciye pahāṃṭe- | māji kaṃsāaiśīṃ acāṭeṃ | mahādheṃḍīṃ avacaṭeṃ | līḻāci nāsilīṃ ||91||
verses.meaning: In the very dawn of His first incarnation, He effortlessly destroyed mighty and formidable demons like Kamsa, as if in play.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें काय कितीएक सांगावें। तुवांही देखिलें ऐकिलें असे आधघवें। तरि यादवांमाजीं जाणावें । हेंचि स्वरूप माझें ॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ kāya kitīeka sāṃgāveṃ| tuvāṃhī dekhileṃ aikileṃ ase ādhaghaveṃ| tari yādavāṃmājīṃ jāṇāveṃ | heṃci svarūpa mājheṃ ||92||
verses.meaning: Why should I say much about this? You have already seen and heard everything. Therefore, know that among the Yadavas, this is indeed My form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सोमवंशीं तुम्हां पांडवां-। माजीं अर्जुन तो मी जाणावा । म्हणौनि एकमेकांचिया प्रेमभावा। विघडु न पडे॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi somavaṃśīṃ tumhāṃ pāṃḍavāṃ-| mājīṃ arjuna to mī jāṇāvā | mhaṇauni ekamekāṃciyā premabhāvā| vighaḍu na paḍe|| 93||
verses.meaning: And among you Pandavas of the Somavamsha (Lunar Dynasty), know that I am Arjuna. Therefore, the loving bond between us shall not be broken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संन्यासी तुवां होऊनि जनीं। चोरूनि नेली माझी भगिनी । तऱही विकल्पु नुपजे मनीं। मी तूं दोन्ही स्वरूप एक ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃnyāsī tuvāṃ hoūni janīṃ| corūni nelī mājhī bhaginī | taṟahī vikalpu nupaje manīṃ| mī tūṃ donhī svarūpa eka || 94||
verses.meaning: Even if you, a renunciate, were to abduct my sister from among the people, no doubt would arise in my mind, for you and I are but one and the same essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुनीआंत व्यासदेवो। तो मी म्हणे यादवराबो। कवीशवरांमाजीं धैर्या ठावो। उशनाचार्य तो मी॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: munīāṃta vyāsadevo| to mī mhaṇe yādavarābo| kavīśavarāṃmājīṃ dhairyā ṭhāvo| uśanācārya to mī|| 95||
verses.meaning: Amongst the sages, I am Vyasadeva. Amongst the great poets, I am Ushana, the embodiment of steadfastness. Thus says Yadava, the Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा दमितयांमाझारीं । अनिवार दंडु तो मी अवधारीं । जो मुंगियेलागोनि ब्रह्मावेरी । नियमित पावे ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā damitayāṃmājhārīṃ | anivāra daṃḍu to mī avadhārīṃ | jo muṃgiyelāgoni brahmāverī | niyamita pāve || 96||
verses.meaning: Among those who suppress and punish, know that I am the irresistible punishment, which reaches and regulates everything from an ant to Brahma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सारासार निर्धारितयां। धर्मज्ञानाचा पक्षु धरितयां । सकळशास्त्रांमाजीं ययां। नीतिशास्त्र तें मी ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ sārāsāra nirdhāritayāṃ| dharmajñānācā pakṣu dharitayāṃ | sakaḻaśāstrāṃmājīṃ yayāṃ| nītiśāstra teṃ mī || 97||
verses.meaning: Among those who discern the essence of things, who uphold the path of righteousness and knowledge, and among all scriptures, I am the scripture of ethics.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आघवियाचि गूढां-। माजीं मौन तें मी सुहाडा। म्हणौनि न बोलतयां पुढां । स्त्रष्टाही नेण होय ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āghaviyāci gūḍhāṃ-| mājīṃ mauna teṃ mī suhāḍā| mhaṇauni na bolatayāṃ puḍhāṃ | straṣṭāhī neṇa hoya || 98||
verses.meaning: Among all secrets, silence is my delight. Therefore, even the Creator Himself does not comprehend those who do not speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा ज्ञानियांचिया ठायीं। ज्ञान तें मी पाहीं। आतां असो हें ययां कांहीं । पार न देखो ॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā jñāniyāṃciyā ṭhāyīṃ| jñāna teṃ mī pāhīṃ| ātāṃ aso heṃ yayāṃ kāṃhīṃ | pāra na dekho ||99||
verses.meaning: Indeed, among the wise, I am that very knowledge. Now let this be, for I see no end to this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं पर्जन्याचिया धारां। वरी लेख करवेल धनुर्धरा। कां पृथ्वीचिया तृणांकुरां। होईल ठी ॥ ३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ parjanyāciyā dhārāṃ| varī lekha karavela dhanurdharā| kāṃ pṛthvīciyā tṛṇāṃkurāṃ| hoīla ṭhī || 300||
verses.meaning: Indeed, Arjuna, you could count the raindrops, or number the blades of grass on the earth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं महोदधीचिया तरंगां। व्यवस्था धरूं नये जेवीं गा। तेवीं माझिया विशेषलिंगां। नाहीं मिती ॥ १ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ mahodadhīciyā taraṃgāṃ| vyavasthā dharūṃ naye jevīṃ gā| tevīṃ mājhiyā viśeṣaliṃgāṃ| nāhīṃ mitī || 1 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the waves of the great ocean cannot be counted, so too are My particular manifestations immeasurable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशियाही सातपांच प्रधाना । विभूती सांगितळिया तुज अर्जुना । तो हा उद्देशु जो गा मना । आहाच गमला ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśiyāhī sātapāṃca pradhānā | vibhūtī sāṃgitaḻiyā tuja arjunā | to hā uddeśu jo gā manā | āhāca gamalā || 2||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, I have thus explained to you the manifestations of these seven and five chief elements. This is the essence that has been revealed to your mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरां विभूतिविस्तारांसि कांहीं। एथ सर्वथा लेख नाहीं । म्हणौनि परिससी तूं काई । आम्हीं सांगों किती ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yerāṃ vibhūtivistārāṃsi kāṃhīṃ| etha sarvathā lekha nāhīṃ | mhaṇauni parisasī tūṃ kāī | āmhīṃ sāṃgoṃ kitī || 3||
verses.meaning: There is no account whatsoever here of other manifestations. So what will you hear? How much can we tell you?

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं एकिहेळां तुज। दाऊं आतां वर्म निज। तरी सर्वभूतांकुरें बीज। विरुढत असे तें मी॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ ekiheḻāṃ tuja| dāūṃ ātāṃ varma nija| tarī sarvabhūtāṃkureṃ bīja| viruḍhata ase teṃ mī||4||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I will now reveal to you, all at once, my true secret: I am the seed from which all beings sprout.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि सानें थोर न म्हणावें । उंच नीच भाव सांडावे। एक मीचि ऐसें मानावें । वस्तुजातातें ॥ ५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni sāneṃ thora na mhaṇāveṃ | uṃca nīca bhāva sāṃḍāve| eka mīci aiseṃ mānāveṃ | vastujātāteṃ || 5 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, do not call anything small or great; abandon the feelings of high and low. Believe that I alone am in all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी यावरी साधारण। आईक पां आणिकही खूण। तरि अर्जुना तें तू॑ जाण । विभूति माझी ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī yāvarī sādhāraṇa| āīka pāṃ āṇikahī khūṇa| tari arjunā teṃ tṷ̄ jāṇa | vibhūti mājhī || 6||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen further to another sign; know then, Arjuna, that it is My divine manifestation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ जेथ संपत्ति आणि दया । दोन्ही वसती आल्या ठाया । ते ते जाण धनंजया । विभूति माझी ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha jetha saṃpatti āṇi dayā | donhī vasatī ālyā ṭhāyā | te te jāṇa dhanaṃjayā | vibhūti mājhī || 7||
verses.meaning: Wherever prosperity and compassion both reside, know that place, Dhananjaya, to be My divine manifestation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा एकलें एक बिंब गगनीं । प्रभा फांके त्रिभुवनी । तेबीं एकाकियाची सकळ जनीं। आज्ञा पाळिजे॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā ekaleṃ eka biṃba gaganīṃ | prabhā phāṃke tribhuvanī | tebīṃ ekākiyācī sakaḻa janīṃ| ājñā pāḻije|| 8||
verses.meaning: Just as a single sun in the sky illuminates all three worlds with its light, so too should the command of a single, supreme being be obeyed by all people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयांतें एकलें झणीं म्हण। तो निर्धन या भाषा नेण। काय कामधेनुसवें सर्वस्व हन। चालत असे॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃteṃ ekaleṃ jhaṇīṃ mhaṇa| to nirdhana yā bhāṣā neṇa| kāya kāmadhenusaveṃ sarvasva hana| cālata ase||9||
verses.meaning: Do not consider them to be alone, nor poor, nor ignorant of this language. Does the wish-fulfilling cow (Kamadhenu) ever walk without all its wealth?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियेतें जें जेधवां जो मागे। तें ते एकसरेंचि प्रसवों लागे । तेवीं विश्‍वविभव तया अंगें । होऊनि असती॥ ३१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyeteṃ jeṃ jedhavāṃ jo māge| teṃ te ekasareṃci prasavoṃ lāge | tevīṃ viś‍vavibhava tayā aṃgeṃ | hoūni asatī|| 310||
verses.meaning: Whatever is desired from her, she immediately brings forth. Similarly, all the glory of the universe manifests from Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयातें बोळखावया हेचि संज्ञा । जे जगें नमस्कारिजे आज्ञा। ऐसें आथि ते जाण प्राज्ञा। अवतार माझे॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāteṃ boḻakhāvayā heci saṃjñā | je jageṃ namaskārije ājñā| aiseṃ āthi te jāṇa prājñā| avatāra mājhe|| 11||
verses.meaning: To recognize them, this is the sign: that the world bows to their command. Know that such are My incarnations, O wise one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सामान्य विशेष। हें जाणणें एथ महादोष। कां जे मीचि एक अशेष। विश्‍व हें म्हणौनि॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sāmānya viśeṣa| heṃ jāṇaṇeṃ etha mahādoṣa| kāṃ je mīci eka aśeṣa| viś‍va heṃ mhaṇauni|| 12||
verses.meaning: To perceive distinctions between the general and the particular is a great flaw here, for I alone am the entirety of this universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आतां साधारण आणि चांगु। ऐसा कैसेनि पां कल्पावा विभागु। वायां आपुलिये मती वंगु। भेदाचा लावावा॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātāṃ sādhāraṇa āṇi cāṃgu| aisā kaiseni pāṃ kalpāvā vibhāgu| vāyāṃ āpuliye matī vaṃgu| bhedācā lāvāvā|| 13||
verses.meaning: Then, how can one imagine a division between ordinary and good? Why should one needlessly stain their own intellect with the blemish of differentiation?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तूप कासया घुसळावें। अमृत कां रांधूनि अर्धे करावें। हां गा वायूसि काय पां डावें। उजवें अंग आहे॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tūpa kāsayā ghusaḻāveṃ| amṛta kāṃ rāṃdhūni ardhe karāveṃ| hāṃ gā vāyūsi kāya pāṃ ḍāveṃ| ujaveṃ aṃga āhe|| 14||
verses.meaning: Indeed, why churn ghee? Why cook nectar and halve it? Oh, why should one offer the right side to the wind?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सूर्यबिंबासि पोट पाठीं । पाहातां नासेल आपुली दिठी। तेवीं माझ्या स्वरूपीं गोठीं। सामान्यविशेषाची नाहीं ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ sūryabiṃbāsi poṭa pāṭhīṃ | pāhātāṃ nāsela āpulī diṭhī| tevīṃ mājhyā svarūpīṃ goṭhīṃ| sāmānyaviśeṣācī nāhīṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: Just as looking at the sun's orb directly will harm one's sight, so too, in my true nature, there is no distinction of general or specific.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सिनाना इहीं विभूतीं। मज अपारातें मविसील किती । म्हणौनि किंबहुना सुभद्रापती। असो हें जाणणें ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sinānā ihīṃ vibhūtīṃ| maja apārāteṃ mavisīla kitī | mhaṇauni kiṃbahunā subhadrāpatī| aso heṃ jāṇaṇeṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: And by these manifestations, how much more can you measure My immeasurable self? Therefore, O husband of Subhadra, let this understanding suffice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां पैं माझेनि एकें अंशें। हें जग व्यापिळें असे। यालागीं भेदु सांडूनि सरिसें। साम्यें भज॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ paiṃ mājheni ekeṃ aṃśeṃ| heṃ jaga vyāpiḻeṃ ase| yālāgīṃ bhedu sāṃḍūni sariseṃ| sāmyeṃ bhaja|| 17||
verses.meaning: Now, by a mere fraction of My being, this entire universe is pervaded. Therefore, abandoning all sense of difference, worship Me with equanimity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें विबुधवनवसंतें। तेणें विरक्‍तांचेनि एकांतें। बोलिलें जेथ श्रीमंतें। श्रीकृष्णदेवें ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ vibudhavanavasaṃteṃ| teṇeṃ virak‍tāṃceni ekāṃteṃ| bolileṃ jetha śrīmaṃteṃ| śrīkṛṣṇadeveṃ || 98||
verses.meaning: Thus, in the spring of wisdom, in the solitude of the detached, did the glorious Lord Shri Krishna speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अर्जुन म्हणे स्वामी । येतुलें हें राभस्य बोलिलें तुम्हीं । जे भेदु एक आणि आम्हीं । सांडावा एकीं ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha arjuna mhaṇe svāmī | yetuleṃ heṃ rābhasya bolileṃ tumhīṃ | je bhedu eka āṇi āmhīṃ | sāṃḍāvā ekīṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Arjuna then said, "Lord, you have spoken so vehemently that the distinction between 'one' and 'we' must be abandoned."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो सूर्य म्हणे काय जगातें। अंधारें दवडा कां परोतें। तेवीं धसाळ म्हणों देवा तूंतें । तरी अधिक हा बोलु॥ ३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho sūrya mhaṇe kāya jagāteṃ| aṃdhāreṃ davaḍā kāṃ paroteṃ| tevīṃ dhasāḻa mhaṇoṃ devā tūṃteṃ | tarī adhika hā bolu|| 320||
verses.meaning: Indeed, if the sun were to say, "What is this world? Drive away the darkness!" and if I were to call you, O God, a mere mortal, then this would be an even greater transgression.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुझें नामचि एक कोण्ही वेळें। जयांचिये मुखासि कां कानां मिळे। तयांचिया हृदयातें सांडूनि पळे। भेदु जी साच॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujheṃ nāmaci eka koṇhī veḻeṃ| jayāṃciye mukhāsi kāṃ kānāṃ miḻe| tayāṃciyā hṛdayāteṃ sāṃḍūni paḻe| bhedu jī sāca|| 21||
verses.meaning: When Your name, even for a moment, reaches someone's mouth or ears, all duality truly flees from their heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो तूं परब्रह्मच्चि असकें। मज दैवें दिधलासि हस्तोदकें । तरी आतां भेदु कायसा कें । देखावा कवणें॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to tūṃ parabrahmacci asakeṃ| maja daiveṃ didhalāsi hastodakeṃ | tarī ātāṃ bhedu kāyasā keṃ | dekhāvā kavaṇeṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: You are indeed the Supreme Brahman, given to me by destiny as an offering. What difference or separation can there be now, and who can perceive it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी चंद्रबिंबाचा गाभारां । रिगालियावरीही उबारा । परी राणेपणें शार्ईुुधरा। बोला हें तुम्ही ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī caṃdrabiṃbācā gābhārāṃ | rigāliyāvarīhī ubārā | parī rāṇepaṇeṃ śārīuudharā| bolā heṃ tumhī || 23||
verses.meaning: Even if one enters the very core of the moon's orb, there is still a warmth there. But by your sovereign power, O Sharngadhara, you can command even this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सावियाचि परितोषोनि देवें। अर्जुनातें आलिंगिळें जीवें । मग म्हणे तुवां न कोपावें। आमुचिया बोला ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha sāviyāci paritoṣoni deveṃ| arjunāteṃ āliṃgiḻeṃ jīveṃ | maga mhaṇe tuvāṃ na kopāveṃ| āmuciyā bolā || 24||
verses.meaning: Then, the Lord, greatly pleased, embraced Arjuna with all His heart, and said, "You must not be angry at My words."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं तुज भेदाचिया वाहाणीं । सांगितली जे बिभूतींची कहाणी। ते अभेदें काय अंतःकरणीं। मानिली कीं न मने॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ tuja bhedāciyā vāhāṇīṃ | sāṃgitalī je bibhūtīṃcī kahāṇī| te abhedeṃ kāya aṃtaḥkaraṇīṃ| mānilī kīṃ na mane|| 25||
verses.meaning: The story of the Lord's manifestations (vibhuti) that I narrated to you, describing the distinctions, has your heart accepted it as non-dual, or not?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेंचि पाहावयालागीं। नावेक बोलिलों बाहेरिसवडिया भंगीं। तंब विभूती तुज चांगी। आलिया बोधा॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃci pāhāvayālāgīṃ| nāveka boliloṃ bāherisavaḍiyā bhaṃgīṃ| taṃba vibhūtī tuja cāṃgī| āliyā bodhā|| 26||
verses.meaning: To make you understand this, I have spoken a little in an external, indirect way, so that this glory of mine may come to your understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अर्जुन म्हणे देवें। हें आपुलें आपण जाणावें। परी देखतसें विश्व आघवें। तुवां भरलें ॥२७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha arjuna mhaṇe deveṃ| heṃ āpuleṃ āpaṇa jāṇāveṃ| parī dekhataseṃ viśva āghaveṃ| tuvāṃ bharaleṃ ||27||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said, "O Lord, this is known by Yourself. But I see the entire universe filled with You."

verses.shloka_devanagari: २०८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी पैं राया तो पंडुसुतु। ऐसिये प्रतीतीसि जाहला वरितु। या संजयाचिया बोला निवांतु । धृतराष्ट्र राहे॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: 208 śrījñāneśvarī paiṃ rāyā to paṃḍusutu| aisiye pratītīsi jāhalā varitu| yā saṃjayāciyā bolā nivāṃtu | dhṛtarāṣṭra rāhe|| 28||
verses.meaning: King Dhritarashtra, hearing Sanjaya's words, was reassured that Pandu's son (Arjuna) had attained such conviction (in the Lord's teachings).

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं संजयो दुखवलेनि अंतःकरणें। म्हणतसे नवल नव्हे दैव दवडणें।॥ हा जीवें धाडसा आहे मी म्हणें। तंव आंतुही आंधळा॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ saṃjayo dukhavaleni aṃtaḥkaraṇeṃ| mhaṇatase navala navhe daiva davaḍaṇeṃ||| hā jīveṃ dhāḍasā āhe mī mhaṇeṃ| taṃva āṃtuhī āṃdhaḻā|| 29||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya, with a heavy heart, says, "It is no wonder that fate has been so cruel. I believe this person is audacious, yet he is also blind within."

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी असो हें तो अर्जुनु। स्वहिताचा वाढवितसे मानु। कीं याहीवरी तया आनु । धिंवसा उपनला॥ ३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī aso heṃ to arjunu| svahitācā vāḍhavitase mānu| kīṃ yāhīvarī tayā ānu | dhiṃvasā upanalā|| 330||
verses.meaning: But let it be, Arjuna, he is increasing his own well-being, or rather, beyond this, a greater courage has arisen in him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे हेचि हृदया आंतुली प्रतीती । बाहेरी अवतरो कां डोळ्यांप्रती। इये आर्तीचिया पाउलीं मती । उठती जाहली ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe heci hṛdayā āṃtulī pratītī | bāherī avataro kāṃ ḍoḻyāṃpratī| iye ārtīciyā pāulīṃ matī | uṭhatī jāhalī || 39||
verses.meaning: He says, "Let this inner experience manifest outwardly before my eyes." With such intense longing, his intellect began to rise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मियां इहींच दोहीं डोळां। झोंबावें विश्‍्वरूपा सकळा । एवढी हांव तो देवा आगळा । म्हणौनि करी॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: miyāṃ ihīṃca dohīṃ ḍoḻāṃ| jhoṃbāveṃ viś‍varūpā sakaḻā | evaḍhī hāṃva to devā āgaḻā | mhaṇauni karī|| 32||
verses.meaning: With these very two eyes, I wish to embrace the entire Cosmic Form. Such is his immense longing for God, and thus he acts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आजि तो कल्पतरूची शाखा । म्हणौनि वांझोळें न लगती देखा। जें जें येईल तयाचिया मुखा) तें तें साचचि करीतसे येरु॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āji to kalpatarūcī śākhā | mhaṇauni vāṃjhoḻeṃ na lagatī dekhā| jeṃ jeṃ yeīla tayāciyā mukhā) teṃ teṃ sācaci karītase yeru|| 33||
verses.meaning: Today, he is like a branch of the wish-fulfilling tree, hence, he is not barren. Whatever comes to his lips, he truly makes it happen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो प्रल्हादाचिया बोला। विषाहीसकट आपणचि जाहला। तो सद्गुरू असे जोडला । किरीटीसी॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo pralhādāciyā bolā| viṣāhīsakaṭa āpaṇaci jāhalā| to sadgurū ase joḍalā | kirīṭīsī|| 34||
verses.meaning: The one who, for Prahlada's words, himself became the poison (and consumed it), that Satguru is now attained by Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि बिशवरूप पुसावयालागीं। पार्थ रिगता होईल कवणें भंगीं। तें सांगेन पुढिलिये प्रसंगीं । ज्ञानदेव म्हणे निवृत्तीचा ॥ ३३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni biśavarūpa pusāvayālāgīṃ| pārtha rigatā hoīla kavaṇeṃ bhaṃgīṃ| teṃ sāṃgena puḍhiliye prasaṃgīṃ | jñānadeva mhaṇe nivṛttīcā || 335 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, to inquire about the Universal Form, in what manner will Arjuna enter? That I will explain in the next occasion, says Dnyandev, the disciple of Nivrutti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां यावरी एकादशीं। कथा आहे दोही रसीं । येथ पार्था विश्‍्वरूपेसीं । होईल भेटी ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yāvarī ekādaśīṃ| kathā āhe dohī rasīṃ | yetha pārthā viś‍varūpesīṃ | hoīla bheṭī || 1||
verses.meaning: Now, on this Ekadashi, there is a narrative of two emotions. Here, O Partha, there will be a meeting with the Universal Form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ शांताचिया घरा। अदभुत आला आहे पाहुणेरा । आणि येरांही रसां पांतिकरां। जाहला मानु॥२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha śāṃtāciyā gharā| adabhuta ālā āhe pāhuṇerā | āṇi yerāṃhī rasāṃ pāṃtikarāṃ| jāhalā mānu||2||
verses.meaning: Where the wondrous guest has arrived at the house of tranquility, and all other sentiments have been honored.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो वधुवरांचिये मिळणीं । जैशीं वराडियां लुगडीं लेणीं। तैसे देशियेच्या सुखासनीं । मिरविले रस॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho vadhuvarāṃciye miḻaṇīṃ | jaiśīṃ varāḍiyāṃ lugaḍīṃ leṇīṃ| taise deśiyecyā sukhāsanīṃ | miravile rasa|| 3||
verses.meaning: Just as the wedding guests are adorned with clothes and ornaments for the union of the bride and groom, so too are the sentiments (rasas) displayed in the comfortable seat of the native language.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी शांतादभुत बरवे । जे डोळियांच्या अंजुळीं घ्यावे । जैसे हरिहर प्रेमभावें। आले खेंबा ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī śāṃtādabhuta barave | je ḍoḻiyāṃcyā aṃjuḻīṃ ghyāve | jaise harihara premabhāveṃ| āle kheṃbā || 4||
verses.meaning: But the tranquil and wondrous sight is so beautiful, it should be received with the cupped hands of the eyes, like Hari and Hara (Vishnu and Shiva) embracing each other with love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी अंबसेच्या दिवशीं। भेटलीं बिंबें दोनी जैशीं। तेवी एकवळा रसीं। केला एथ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī aṃbasecyā divaśīṃ| bheṭalīṃ biṃbeṃ donī jaiśīṃ| tevī ekavaḻā rasīṃ| kelā etha|| 5||
verses.meaning: Or, just as two reflections meet on the day of the new moon, so too, here, a union of essences has been made.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मीनले गंगेयमुनेचे ओघ । तैसें रसां जाहलें प्रयाग । म्हणौनि सुस्नात होत जग। आघवें एथ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mīnale gaṃgeyamunece ogha | taiseṃ rasāṃ jāhaleṃ prayāga | mhaṇauni susnāta hota jaga| āghaveṃ etha|| 6||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganga and Yamuna rivers merge, so too do all poetic sentiments converge here, making this a sacred confluence where the entire world can bathe and be purified.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माजीं गीता सरस्वती गुप्त। आणि दोनी रस ते ओघ मूर्त । यालागीं त्रिवेणी हे उचित। फावली बापा॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājīṃ gītā sarasvatī gupta| āṇi donī rasa te ogha mūrta | yālāgīṃ triveṇī he ucita| phāvalī bāpā|| 7||
verses.meaning: In me, the Gita is the hidden Saraswati, and the two sentiments (rasas) are the embodied streams. Therefore, this confluence of three (Triveni) is appropriately found, O father.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ श्रवणाचेनि ह्वारें। तीर्थी रिघतां सोपारें। ज्ञानदेबो म्हणे दातारें। माझेनि केलें॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha śravaṇāceni hvāreṃ| tīrthī righatāṃ sopāreṃ| jñānadebo mhaṇe dātāreṃ| mājheni keleṃ|| 8||
verses.meaning: Through the gateway of listening, entering the sacred pilgrimage becomes easy. Dnyandev says, "My generous Lord has made this possible."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोौरें संस्कृताचीं गहनें। तोडोनि मऱ्हाठिया शब्दसोपानें। रचिलीं धर्मनिधानें । श्रीनिवृत्तिदेवें ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: toaureṃ saṃskṛtācīṃ gahaneṃ| toḍoni maṟhāṭhiyā śabdasopāneṃ| racilīṃ dharmanidhāneṃ | śrīnivṛttideveṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Breaking down the profundities of Sanskrit, Shri Nivrutti Deva constructed the treasures of Dharma through the steps of Marathi words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भलतेणें एथ सद्भावें नाहावें। प्रयागमाधब विश्वरूप पहावें। येतुलेनि संसारासि द्यावें। तिळोदक ॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhalateṇeṃ etha sadbhāveṃ nāhāveṃ| prayāgamādhaba viśvarūpa pahāveṃ| yetuleni saṃsārāsi dyāveṃ| tiḻodaka || 10||
verses.meaning: Therefore, with sincere devotion, one should bathe in this sacred place, and behold the universal form of Prayag Madhav. By this much, one can offer the ritualistic sesame and water to the worldly existence, signifying its end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो ऐसें सावयव । येथ सासिन्नले आथी रसभाव। तेथ श्रवणसुखाची राणीब। जोडली जगा॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso aiseṃ sāvayava | yetha sāsinnale āthī rasabhāva| tetha śravaṇasukhācī rāṇība| joḍalī jagā|| 11||
verses.meaning: Let this be so. Here, the emotions and sentiments are deeply ingrained, and through them, the world has gained the joy of listening.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ शांतादभुत रोकडे । आणि येरां रसां पडप जोडे । हें अल्पचि परी उघडें। कैवल्य एथ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha śāṃtādabhuta rokaḍe | āṇi yerāṃ rasāṃ paḍapa joḍe | heṃ alpaci parī ughaḍeṃ| kaivalya etha|| 12||
verses.meaning: Where peace and wonder are immediately present, and other emotions are also joined, this, though subtle, is clearly the ultimate liberation here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो हा अकरावा अध्यायो। जो देवाचा आपणपें बिसंवता ठावो। परि अर्जुन सदैवांचा रावो। जे एथही पातला॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to hā akarāvā adhyāyo| jo devācā āpaṇapeṃ bisaṃvatā ṭhāvo| pari arjuna sadaivāṃcā rāvo| je ethahī pātalā|| 13||
verses.meaning: This is the eleventh chapter, which is the very resting place of God Himself. But Arjuna is the king of the fortunate, for he has reached even here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ अर्जुनचि काय म्हणों पातला। आजि आवडतयाही सुकाळु जाहला । जे गीतार्थ्‌ हा आला । मऱ्हाठिये॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha arjunaci kāya mhaṇoṃ pātalā| āji āvaḍatayāhī sukāḻu jāhalā | je gītārth‌ hā ālā | maṟhāṭhiye|| 94||
verses.meaning: What to say of Arjuna, today even those who love it have been blessed with abundance, as the meaning of the Gita has come into Marathi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याचिलागीं माझें । विनविळें आइकिजे । तरि अबधान दीजे। सजनीं तुम्हीं ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yācilāgīṃ mājheṃ | vinaviḻeṃ āikije | tari abadhāna dīje| sajanīṃ tumhīṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen to my humble request. So, please pay attention, my dear ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि तुम्हां संतांचिये सभे । ऐसी सलगी कौर करूं न लभे। परी मानावें जी तुम्ही लोभें। अपत्या मज॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci tumhāṃ saṃtāṃciye sabhe | aisī salagī kaura karūṃ na labhe| parī mānāveṃ jī tumhī lobheṃ| apatyā maja|| 16||
verses.meaning: In the same way, in the assembly of you saints, such familiarity is not easily attained. But you should lovingly consider me your child.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो पुंसा आपणचि पढविजे । मग पढे तरी माथा तुकिजे। २९० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी कां करविलेनि चोजें न रिझे। बाळका माय॥ ९१७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho puṃsā āpaṇaci paḍhavije | maga paḍhe tarī māthā tukije| 290 śrījñāneśvarī kāṃ karavileni cojeṃ na rijhe| bāḻakā māya|| 917||
verses.meaning: Oh, if a child is taught by its own mother, and then learns, the mother does not find joy in such a forced act. Similarly, the Lord is not pleased by forced devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं मी जें जें बोलें। तें प्रभु तुमचेंचि शिकविलें। म्हणौनि अवधारिजो आपुलें। आपण देवा॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ mī jeṃ jeṃ boleṃ| teṃ prabhu tumaceṃci śikavileṃ| mhaṇauni avadhārijo āpuleṃ| āpaṇa devā|| 18||
verses.meaning: Whatever I speak, O Lord, is but Your own teaching. Therefore, O God, please listen to Your own words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें सारस्वताचें गोड । तुम्हींचि लाविलें जी झाड। तरी आतां अवधानामृतें वाड। सिंपोनि कीजे॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ sārasvatāceṃ goḍa | tumhīṃci lāvileṃ jī jhāḍa| tarī ātāṃ avadhānāmṛteṃ vāḍa| siṃponi kīje|| 19||
verses.meaning: This sweet tree of knowledge, you yourselves have planted. Now, please nourish it with the nectar of your attention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग हें रसभावफुलीं फुलेळ। नानार्थफळभारें फळा येईल। तुमचेनि धर्मे होईल। सुरवाडु जगा॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga heṃ rasabhāvaphulīṃ phuleḻa| nānārthaphaḻabhāreṃ phaḻā yeīla| tumaceni dharme hoīla| suravāḍu jagā|| 20||
verses.meaning: Then, this tree, laden with the blossoms of various emotions and sentiments, will bear fruits of diverse meanings. Through your righteousness, the world will experience delight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या बोला संत रिझले। म्हणती तोषलों गा भलें केलें। आतां सांगे जें बोलिलें । अर्जुन तेथ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā bolā saṃta rijhale| mhaṇatī toṣaloṃ gā bhaleṃ keleṃ| ātāṃ sāṃge jeṃ bolileṃ | arjuna tetha|| 21||
verses.meaning: The saints were pleased by these words. They said, "We are very much pleased; you have done well. Now, tell us what Arjuna said there."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव निवृत्तिदास म्हणे। जी कृष्णार्जुनांचें बोलणें । मी प्राकृत 'काय सांगों जाणें । परी सांगवा तुम्ही ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva nivṛttidāsa mhaṇe| jī kṛṣṇārjunāṃceṃ bolaṇeṃ | mī prākṛta 'kāya sāṃgoṃ jāṇeṃ | parī sāṃgavā tumhī || 22||
verses.meaning: Then Nivrittidas says, "O Lord, how can I, a simple person, narrate the conversation between Krishna and Arjuna? Yet, you (the divine) make me narrate it."

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो रानींचिया पाळेखाइरा । नेवाणें करविले ल॑केश्वरा। एकला अर्जुन परी अक्षौहिणी अकरा। न जिणेचि काई ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho rānīṃciyā pāḻekhāirā | nevāṇeṃ karavile la̭keśvarā| ekalā arjuna parī akṣauhiṇī akarā| na jiṇeci kāī || 23||
verses.meaning: Oh, the forest dwellers, the hunters, made Ravana, the lord of Lanka, bow down. Was it not Arjuna alone who conquered eleven akshauhinis (armies)?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि समर्थ जें जें करी। तें न हो न ये चराचरीं। तुम्ही संत तयापरी । बोलवा मातें॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni samartha jeṃ jeṃ karī| teṃ na ho na ye carācarīṃ| tumhī saṃta tayāparī | bolavā māteṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever the Almighty does, it is not impossible in this universe. You, the saints, are like that; make me speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां बोलिजतसें आइका । हा गीताभाव निका । जो श्रीवैकुंठनायका। मुखौनि निघाळा॥ २५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ bolijataseṃ āikā | hā gītābhāva nikā | jo śrīvaikuṃṭhanāyakā| mukhauni nighāḻā|| 25 ||
verses.meaning: Now listen to this beautiful essence of the Gita, which emanated from the mouth of the Lord of Vaikuntha.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाप बाप ग्रंथ गीता । जो वेदीं प्रतिपाद्य देवता । तो श्रीकृष्ण वकता । जिये ग्रंथी ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāpa bāpa graṃtha gītā | jo vedīṃ pratipādya devatā | to śrīkṛṣṇa vakatā | jiye graṃthī || 26||
verses.meaning: The Gita is the father of all scriptures, the very deity expounded in the Vedas, and the speaker of this scripture is Lord Krishna himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथिंचें गौरव कैसें वानावें। जें श्री शंभूचिये मती नागवे। तें आतां नमस्कारिजे जीवेंभावें। हेंचि भळें॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tethiṃceṃ gaurava kaiseṃ vānāveṃ| jeṃ śrī śaṃbhūciye matī nāgave| teṃ ātāṃ namaskārije jīveṃbhāveṃ| heṃci bhaḻeṃ|| 27||
verses.meaning: How can one describe the glory of that place, which even Lord Shiva's intellect cannot grasp? Therefore, let us now offer our salutations with all our heart and soul; this is indeed the best course.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आइका तो किरीटी | घालूनि बिश्वरूपीं दिठी । पहिली कैसी गोठी। करिता जाहला॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āikā to kirīṭī | ghālūni biśvarūpīṃ diṭhī | pahilī kaisī goṭhī| karitā jāhalā|| 28||
verses.meaning: Then listen, how Arjuna, casting his gaze upon the Universal Form, began to speak for the first time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें सर्वही सर्वेश्‍वरू। ऐसा प्रतीतिगत जो पतिकरु। तो बाहेरी होआवा गोचरु । 'लोचनांसी ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ sarvahī sarveś‍varū| aisā pratītigata jo patikaru| to bāherī hoāvā gocaru | 'locanāṃsī || 29||
verses.meaning: This entire universe is the Supreme Lord. The husband (Lord) who is thus perceived within should become visible to the eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे जिवाआंतुली चाड । परि देवासि सांगतां सांकड। कां जें विश्वरूप गूढ। कैसेनि पुसावें॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he jivāāṃtulī cāḍa | pari devāsi sāṃgatāṃ sāṃkaḍa| kāṃ jeṃ viśvarūpa gūḍha| kaiseni pusāveṃ|| 30||
verses.meaning: This longing within the soul, yet how can one express this difficulty to God? For He is the mysterious form of the universe, how then can one question Him?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे मागां कवणीं कहीं । जें पढियंतेनें पुसिलें नाहीं । तें सहसा कैसें काई । सांगा म्हणों ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe māgāṃ kavaṇīṃ kahīṃ | jeṃ paḍhiyaṃteneṃ pusileṃ nāhīṃ | teṃ sahasā kaiseṃ kāī | sāṃgā mhaṇoṃ || 31||
verses.meaning: He says, "How can I suddenly speak of something that has never been asked by a beloved disciple?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी जरी सलगीचा चांगु । तरी काय आइसीहूनि अंतरंगु । परी तेही हा प्रसंगु। ब्रिहाळी पुसों ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī jarī salagīcā cāṃgu | tarī kāya āisīhūni aṃtaraṃgu | parī tehī hā prasaṃgu| brihāḻī pusoṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: Even if I am very close and intimate, how can I be more intimate than the mother? But even she would ask Brihaspati about this matter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझी आवडे तैसी सेवा जाहली । तरी काय होईल गरुडाचिया येतुली। परी तोही हे बोली। करीचिना॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhī āvaḍe taisī sevā jāhalī | tarī kāya hoīla garuḍāciyā yetulī| parī tohī he bolī| karīcinā|| 33||
verses.meaning: If my service were to be as pleasing as I desire, what would it be like? It would be like that of Garuda. But even he does not speak of this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी काय सनकादिकांहूनि जवळां। परी तयांही नागवेचि हा चाळा। मी आवडेन काय प्रेमळां। गोकुळींचिया ऐसा ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī kāya sanakādikāṃhūni javaḻāṃ| parī tayāṃhī nāgaveci hā cāḻā| mī āvaḍena kāya premaḻāṃ| gokuḻīṃciyā aisā || 34||
verses.meaning: Am I closer to the likes of Sanaka and others? Yet, even they could not grasp this divine play. Am I loved by the devotees as I was by those in Gokul?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयांतेंही लेंकुरपणें झकविलें। एकाचे गर्भवासही साहिले। परी विश्वरूप हें राहविळें। न दावीच कवणा॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃteṃhī leṃkurapaṇeṃ jhakavileṃ| ekāce garbhavāsahī sāhile| parī viśvarūpa heṃ rāhaviḻeṃ| na dāvīca kavaṇā|| 35||
verses.meaning: Even to them, He appeared as a child, endured the confinement of a womb for some, yet this universal form, He did not reveal to anyone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठायवरी गुज। याचिये अंतरींचें हें निज। केवीं उराउरी मज पुसों ये पां॥३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāyavarī guja| yāciye aṃtarīṃceṃ heṃ nija| kevīṃ urāurī maja pusoṃ ye pāṃ||36||
verses.meaning: How can I ask about the secret of this place, which is so intimately held within it, as if face-to-face?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि न पुसेंचि जरी म्हणे। तरी विश्वरूप देखिलियाविणें। सुख नोहेचि परी जिणें । तेंही विपायें ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi na puseṃci jarī mhaṇe| tarī viśvarūpa dekhiliyāviṇeṃ| sukha noheci parī jiṇeṃ | teṃhī vipāyeṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: And if one says, "I will not ask," then without seeing the cosmic form, there is no happiness, and life itself becomes precarious.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आतां पुसों अळुमाळसें । मग करूं देवा आवडे तेैसें। येणें प्रवर्तला साध्वसें। पार्थ बोलों ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ātāṃ pusoṃ aḻumāḻaseṃ | maga karūṃ devā āvaḍe teaiseṃ| yeṇeṃ pravartalā sādhvaseṃ| pārtha boloṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: Therefore, now I will ask a little hesitantly, and then do as the Lord wishes. With this resolve, Arjuna began to speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तेंचि ऐसेनि भावें। जें एका दों उत्तरांसवें। दाबी विश्वरूप आघवें। झाडा देउनी ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teṃci aiseni bhāveṃ| jeṃ ekā doṃ uttarāṃsaveṃ| dābī viśvarūpa āghaveṃ| jhāḍā deunī || 39||
verses.meaning: But that very devotion, with just one or two words, reveals the entire cosmic form, making everything clear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो वांसरूं देखिलियाचिसाठीं। धेनु खडबडोनि मोहें उठी । मग स्तनामुखाचिये भेटी । काय पान्हा धरे॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho vāṃsarūṃ dekhiliyācisāṭhīṃ| dhenu khaḍabaḍoni moheṃ uṭhī | maga stanāmukhāciye bheṭī | kāya pānhā dhare|| 40||
verses.meaning: Behold, just by seeing her calf, the cow stirs with affection. Then, when the udder and mouth meet, how can the milk not flow?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहा पां तया पांडवाचेनि नांबें। जो कृष्ण रानींही प्रतिपाळूं धांवे। तयातें अर्जुनें जंव पुसावें। तंव साहील काई ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhā pāṃ tayā pāṃḍavāceni nāṃbeṃ| jo kṛṣṇa rānīṃhī pratipāḻūṃ dhāṃve| tayāteṃ arjuneṃ jaṃva pusāveṃ| taṃva sāhīla kāī || 41||
verses.meaning: Behold, in the name of that Pandava (Arjuna), Krishna Himself rushes to protect even in battle. When Arjuna questions Him, how can He refuse to answer?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो सहजेंचि स्नेहाचे अवतरण । आणि येरु स्नेहा घातलें आहे माजवण । ऐसिये मिळवणी वेगळेपण। उरे हेंचि बहु॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to sahajeṃci snehāce avataraṇa | āṇi yeru snehā ghātaleṃ āhe mājavaṇa | aisiye miḻavaṇī vegaḻepaṇa| ure heṃci bahu|| 42||
verses.meaning: One is naturally an incarnation of love, and the other has nurtured love. In such a union, this distinction alone remains significant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अर्जुनाचिया बोलासरिसा। देव विश्वरूप होईल आपैसा। तोचि पहिला प्रसंगु ऐसा । ऐकिजे तरी ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni arjunāciyā bolāsarisā| deva viśvarūpa hoīla āpaisā| toci pahilā prasaṃgu aisā | aikije tarī || 43||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in response to Arjuna's words, the Lord will naturally assume His universal form. This is the first occasion of such an event, so listen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पार्थु देवातें म्हणे। जी तुम्ही मजकारणें । वाच्य केलें जें न बोलणें । कृपानिधे॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga pārthu devāteṃ mhaṇe| jī tumhī majakāraṇeṃ | vācya keleṃ jeṃ na bolaṇeṃ | kṛpānidhe|| 44||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna said to the Lord, "O Ocean of Compassion, you have, for my sake, made speakable that which is unspeakable."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें महाभूतें ब्रह्मी आटती। जीवमहदादींचे ठाय फिटती। तैं जें देव होऊनि ठाकती। तें विसवणें शेषींचें ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ mahābhūteṃ brahmī āṭatī| jīvamahadādīṃce ṭhāya phiṭatī| taiṃ jeṃ deva hoūni ṭhākatī| teṃ visavaṇeṃ śeṣīṃceṃ || 45 ||
verses.meaning: When the great elements merge into Brahman, and the individual soul, intellect, and other principles dissolve, then that which remains as the divine essence is the ultimate resting place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: होतें हृदयाचिये परिवरीं । रोंबिलें कृपणाचिये परी । शब्दब्रह्मासही चोरी । जयाची केळी ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: hoteṃ hṛdayāciye parivarīṃ | roṃbileṃ kṛpaṇāciye parī | śabdabrahmāsahī corī | jayācī keḻī || 46 ||
verses.meaning: It was embedded in the heart, like a miser's treasure, so deeply that even the Word-Brahman could not steal its essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें तुम्ही आजि आपुलें। मजपुढां हियें फोडिलें। जया अध्यात्मा बोबाळिलें। ऐश्वर्य हरें ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ tumhī āji āpuleṃ| majapuḍhāṃ hiyeṃ phoḍileṃ| jayā adhyātmā bobāḻileṃ| aiśvarya hareṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: Today, you have revealed to me that spiritual knowledge, which, when attained, diminishes the glory of even the greatest worldly power.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वस्तु मज स्वामी । एकिहेळां दिधली तुम्हीं । हें बोलों तरी आम्ही । तुज पाबोनि कैंचे ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: te vastu maja svāmī | ekiheḻāṃ didhalī tumhīṃ | heṃ boloṃ tarī āmhī | tuja pāboni kaiṃce || 48||
verses.meaning: You, my Lord, have bestowed that very essence upon me in an instant. If I were to speak of this, how could I ever repay you?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी साचचि महामोहाचिये पुरीं। बुडालेया देखोनि सीसवरी। तुवां आपणपें घालोनि श्रीहरी। मग काढिले मातें ॥४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī sācaci mahāmohāciye purīṃ| buḍāleyā dekhoni sīsavarī| tuvāṃ āpaṇapeṃ ghāloni śrīharī| maga kāḍhile māteṃ ||49||
verses.meaning: O Shrihari, seeing me completely drowned in the flood of great delusion, you yourself plunged in and then pulled me out.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक तूंबांचूनि कांहीं। विश्वीं दुजियाची भाष नाहीं। कीं आमुचें कर्म पाहीं । जें आम्ही आथी म्हणों ॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka tūṃbāṃcūni kāṃhīṃ| viśvīṃ dujiyācī bhāṣa nāhīṃ| kīṃ āmuceṃ karma pāhīṃ | jeṃ āmhī āthī mhaṇoṃ || 50||
verses.meaning: There is nothing else in the universe apart from You. Our actions are such that we consider them to be real.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी जगीं एक अर्जूनु। ऐसा देहीं वाहे अभिमानु । आणि कौरबांतें इयां स्वजनु । आपुलें म्हणें ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī jagīṃ eka arjūnu| aisā dehīṃ vāhe abhimānu | āṇi kaurabāṃteṃ iyāṃ svajanu | āpuleṃ mhaṇeṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: I am the only Arjuna in the world, such is the pride I carry in my body. And among these Kauravas, I call them my own people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याहीवरी यांतें मी मारीन । म्हणें तेणें पापें कें रिगेन। ऐसें देखत होतों दुःस्वप्न। तो चेवविला प्रभु॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāhīvarī yāṃteṃ mī mārīna | mhaṇeṃ teṇeṃ pāpeṃ keṃ rigena| aiseṃ dekhata hotoṃ duḥsvapna| to cevavilā prabhu|| 52||
verses.meaning: Moreover, I will kill them. Then, where will I go with that sin? I was seeing such a nightmare, when the Lord awakened me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा गंधर्वनगरींची वस्ती । सोडूनि निघालो लक्ष्मीपती। होतो उदकाचिया आर्ती। रोहिणी पीत॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā gaṃdharvanagarīṃcī vastī | soḍūni nighālo lakṣmīpatī| hoto udakāciyā ārtī| rohiṇī pīta||53||
verses.meaning: O Lord, I, the husband of Lakshmi, left the abode of the Gandharva city, thirsty for water, like Rohini drinking.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जी किरडूं तरी कापडाचें। परी लहरी येत होतिया साचें । ऐसें वायां मरतया जीवाचें। श्रेय तुवां घेतलें ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: 292 śrījñāneśvarī jī kiraḍūṃ tarī kāpaḍāceṃ| parī laharī yeta hotiyā sāceṃ | aiseṃ vāyāṃ maratayā jīvāceṃ| śreya tuvāṃ ghetaleṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: Though Dnyaneshwari is like a small piece of cloth, it truly brings forth waves of spiritual experience. In this way, you have taken the credit for the salvation of those who were perishing in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलें प्रतिबिंब नेणतां। सिंह कुहां घालील देखोनि आतां। ऐसा धरिजे तेवीं अनंता । राखिलें मातें ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpuleṃ pratibiṃba neṇatāṃ| siṃha kuhāṃ ghālīla dekhoni ātāṃ| aisā dharije tevīṃ anaṃtā | rākhileṃ māteṃ || 55 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a lion, seeing its own reflection, might mistakenly think it's another lion and leap into a well, so too, O Infinite One, have you protected me from such self-deception.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं माझा तरी येतुलेवरी। एथ निश्चय होता अवधारीं। जे आतांचि सातांही सागरीं । एकत्र मिळिजे॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ mājhā tarī yetulevarī| etha niścaya hotā avadhārīṃ| je ātāṃci sātāṃhī sāgarīṃ | ekatra miḻije|| 56||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, my resolve was so firm, that all seven oceans would merge into one right now.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जगचि आधघवें बुडावें। वरी आकाशही तुटोनि पडावें। परि झुंजणें न घडावें। गोत्रजेंशीं मज ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jagaci ādhaghaveṃ buḍāveṃ| varī ākāśahī tuṭoni paḍāveṃ| pari jhuṃjaṇeṃ na ghaḍāveṃ| gotrajeṃśīṃ maja || 57||
verses.meaning: Even if this entire world were to be submerged, and the very sky were to fall, still I would not fight with my kinsmen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया अहंकाराचिये वाढी । मियां आग्रहजळीं दिधली होती बुडी । चांगचि तूं जवळां एऱहवी काढी। कवणु मातें ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā ahaṃkārāciye vāḍhī | miyāṃ āgrahajaḻīṃ didhalī hotī buḍī | cāṃgaci tūṃ javaḻāṃ eṟahavī kāḍhī| kavaṇu māteṃ || 58||
verses.meaning: In the growth of such ego, I had drowned myself in the waters of obstinacy. You, my good one, pulled me out; otherwise, who would have saved me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाथिळें आपणपां एक मानिलें। आणि नव्हतया नाम गोत्र ठेविलें। थोर पिसें होतें लागलें। परि राखिलें तुम्हीं ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāthiḻeṃ āpaṇapāṃ eka mānileṃ| āṇi navhatayā nāma gotra ṭhevileṃ| thora piseṃ hoteṃ lāgaleṃ| pari rākhileṃ tumhīṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: Considering myself as one who is unbridled, I gave a name and lineage to that which had none. A great madness had afflicted me, but you protected me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मागां जळत काढिलें जोहरीं। तैं तें देहासीच भय अवधारीं। आतां हे जोहरवाहर दुसरी । चैतन्यासकट ॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: māgāṃ jaḻata kāḍhileṃ joharīṃ| taiṃ teṃ dehāsīca bhaya avadhārīṃ| ātāṃ he joharavāhara dusarī | caitanyāsakaṭa || 60||
verses.meaning: Previously, when the body was burned by poison, it was only the body that feared. But now, this second poison, it affects even the consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दुराग्रह- हिरण्याक्षें। माझी बुऱ्दि वसुंधरा सूदली काखे । मग मोहार्णवगवाक्षें । रिघोनि ठेला॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: durāgraha- hiraṇyākṣeṃ| mājhī buṟdi vasuṃdharā sūdalī kākhe | maga mohārṇavagavākṣeṃ | righoni ṭhelā|| 61||
verses.meaning: Hiranyaksha, with his obstinacy, had hidden the earth in his armpit. Then, through the window of the ocean of delusion, he entered and remained there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ तुझेनि गोसावीपणें। एकवेळ बुद्धीचिया ठाया येणें। हें दुसरें वराह होणें। पडिलें तुज ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha tujheni gosāvīpaṇeṃ| ekaveḻa buddhīciyā ṭhāyā yeṇeṃ| heṃ dusareṃ varāha hoṇeṃ| paḍileṃ tuja || 62||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by your lordship, you had to come to the realm of intellect once again. This was your second incarnation as a boar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अपार तुझें केलें) एकी वाचा काय मी बोलें। परी पांचही पाळब मोकलिले। मजप्रती॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ apāra tujheṃ keleṃ) ekī vācā kāya mī boleṃ| parī pāṃcahī pāḻaba mokalile| majapratī|| 63||
verses.meaning: Such is Your boundless grace, what can I, with a single voice, possibly express? Yet, all five senses have been released to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें कांही न वचेचि वायां। भलें यश फावलें देवराया । जे साद्यंत माया। निरसिली माझी ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ kāṃhī na vaceci vāyāṃ| bhaleṃ yaśa phāvaleṃ devarāyā | je sādyaṃta māyā| nirasilī mājhī || 64||
verses.meaning: That effort was not in vain; the Lord of Gods achieved great success, for my Maya (illusion) was completely dispelled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आजीं आनंदसरोवरींचीं कमळें। तैसे हे तुझे डोळे । आपुलिया प्रसादाची राउळें। जयालागीं करिती ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ājīṃ ānaṃdasarovarīṃcīṃ kamaḻeṃ| taise he tujhe ḍoḻe | āpuliyā prasādācī rāuḻeṃ| jayālāgīṃ karitī || 65||
verses.meaning: Your eyes are like lotuses in a lake of joy, and they serve as temples of your grace for those who seek it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो तयाही आणि मोहाची भेटी । हे कायसी पाबळी गोठी । केउती मृगजळाची वृष्टी । बडवानळेंसी ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho tayāhī āṇi mohācī bheṭī | he kāyasī pābaḻī goṭhī | keutī mṛgajaḻācī vṛṣṭī | baḍavānaḻeṃsī || 66||
verses.meaning: How can the illusion of worldly attachment (moha) even approach those who are already enlightened? It is like asking how a mirage can bring rain to a submarine fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मी तंव दातारा। ये कृपेचिये रिघोनि गाभारां। घेत आहें चारा । ब्रह्मरसाचा ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mī taṃva dātārā| ye kṛpeciye righoni gābhārāṃ| gheta āheṃ cārā | brahmarasācā || 67||
verses.meaning: And I, O Giver, having entered the sanctuary of this grace, am partaking of the essence of Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें माझा जी मोह जाये । एथ विस्मो कांहीं आहे । तरी उद्धरलों कौों तुझे पाये। शिवतळे आहाती ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ mājhā jī moha jāye | etha vismo kāṃhīṃ āhe | tarī uddharaloṃ kauoṃ tujhe pāye| śivataḻe āhātī || 68||
verses.meaning: By that, my delusion will surely vanish. Is there any wonder in this? If I am uplifted, it is because your feet are touched, O Shiva.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं कमलायतडोळसा। सूर्यकोटितेजसा। मियां तुजपासोनि महेशा । परिसिलें आजीं ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kamalāyataḍoḻasā| sūryakoṭitejasā| miyāṃ tujapāsoni maheśā | parisileṃ ājīṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: O lotus-eyed Lord, whose radiance is like a million suns, I have heard this from you today, O great Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें भूतें जयापरी होती। अथवा लया हन जैसेनि जाती। ते मजपुढां प्रकृती । विवंचिली देवें ॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ bhūteṃ jayāparī hotī| athavā layā hana jaiseni jātī| te majapuḍhāṃ prakṛtī | vivaṃcilī deveṃ || 70||
verses.meaning: The Lord then explained to me the nature of Prakriti, from which these beings originate and into which they ultimately dissolve.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि प्रकृती कौर उगाणा दिधला । वरि पुरुषाचाही ठावो दाविला। जयाचा महिमा पांघरोनि जाहला । धडौता वेदु॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi prakṛtī kaura ugāṇā didhalā | vari puruṣācāhī ṭhāvo dāvilā| jayācā mahimā pāṃgharoni jāhalā | dhaḍautā vedu||71||
verses.meaning: And thus, Prakriti was given a clear explanation, and the abode of Purusha was also revealed. It is by wearing His glory that the Vedas became complete and authoritative.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी शब्दराशी वाढे जिये। कां धर्माऐशिया रत्नातें विये। ते एथिंचे प्रभेचे पाये। बोळगे म्हणौनि ॥ ७२ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī śabdarāśī vāḍhe jiye| kāṃ dharmāaiśiyā ratnāteṃ viye| te ethiṃce prabhece pāye| boḻage mhaṇauni || 72 ||
verses.meaning: The very abundance of words, or the birth of a jewel like Dharma, are but servants at the feet of this divine light.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अगाध माहात्म्य । जें सकळपमार्गैकगम्य । जें स्वात्मानुभवरम्य । तें इयापरी दाविळें॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ agādha māhātmya | jeṃ sakaḻapamārgaikagamya | jeṃ svātmānubhavaramya | teṃ iyāparī dāviḻeṃ|| 73||
verses.meaning: Such is the profound glory, which is attainable only through all paths, and which is delightful in the experience of one's own Self; this has been revealed in this manner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा केरु फिटलिया आभाळीं। दिठी रिगे सूर्यमंडळीं। कां हातें सारूनि बाबुळी। जळ देखिजे॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā keru phiṭaliyā ābhāḻīṃ| diṭhī rige sūryamaṃḍaḻīṃ| kāṃ hāteṃ sārūni bābuḻī| jaḻa dekhije|| 74||
verses.meaning: Just as when clouds disperse from the sky, the sun's orb becomes visible, or as when one clears away moss with their hands, water becomes visible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी उकलतया सापाचे वेढे। जैसें चंदना खेंब देणें घडे। अथवा विवसी पळे मग चढे । निधान हातां ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī ukalatayā sāpāce veḍhe| jaiseṃ caṃdanā kheṃba deṇeṃ ghaḍe| athavā vivasī paḻe maga caḍhe | nidhāna hātāṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Or, like a snake uncoiling itself, it entwines around sandalwood. Or, when a treasure is revealed, it comes into one's hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी प्रकृती हे आड होती। ते देवेंचि सारोनी परौती । मग परतत्त्व माझिये मती । शेजार केलें॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī prakṛtī he āḍa hotī| te deveṃci sāronī parautī | maga paratattva mājhiye matī | śejāra keleṃ|| 76||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when the material nature (Prakriti) was an obstruction, the Lord Himself removed it, and then the Supreme Reality made a dwelling in my mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि इयेविषयींचा मज देवा । भरंवसा कीर जाहला जीवा । परी आणीक एक हेवा । उपनला असे ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni iyeviṣayīṃcā maja devā | bharaṃvasā kīra jāhalā jīvā | parī āṇīka eka hevā | upanalā ase || 77||
verses.meaning: Therefore, regarding this matter, my soul has indeed gained trust in God. However, another desire has arisen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो भिडां जरी म्हणों राहों।॥ तरी आना कवणा पुसों जावों। काय तुजवांचोनि ठावो । जाणत आहों आम्ही ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: to bhiḍāṃ jarī mhaṇoṃ rāhoṃ||| tarī ānā kavaṇā pusoṃ jāvoṃ| kāya tujavāṃconi ṭhāvo | jāṇata āhoṃ āmhī || 78||
verses.meaning: Even if we were to feel shy and remain silent, to whom else could we go to ask? What other refuge do we know besides You?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जळचरु जळाचा आभारु धरी । बाळक स्तनपानीं उपरोधु करी। तरी तया जिणया श्रीहरी । आन उपायो असे ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaḻacaru jaḻācā ābhāru dharī | bāḻaka stanapānīṃ uparodhu karī| tarī tayā jiṇayā śrīharī | āna upāyo ase || 79||
verses.meaning: Can a creature of the water survive without water? Can a baby survive without its mother's milk? Similarly, is there any other way for a soul to live except through Shri Hari?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भीड सांकडी न धरवे। जीवा आवडे तेंही तुजपुढां बोलावें । तंव राहें म्हणितलें देवें) चाड सांगैं॥ ८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhīḍa sāṃkaḍī na dharave| jīvā āvaḍe teṃhī tujapuḍhāṃ bolāveṃ | taṃva rāheṃ mhaṇitaleṃ deveṃ) cāḍa sāṃgaiṃ|| 80||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I cannot hold back my shyness or hesitation. I must speak before You whatever my soul desires. Then the Lord said, "Speak your wish."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग बोलिला तो किरीटी । म्हणे तुम्हीं केली जे गोठी । तिया प्रतीतीची दिठी । निवाळी माझी ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga bolilā to kirīṭī | mhaṇe tumhīṃ kelī je goṭhī | tiyā pratītīcī diṭhī | nivāḻī mājhī || 81||
verses.meaning: Then spoke that Arjuna, saying, "The words you have spoken, their profound truth illuminates my understanding."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां जयाचेनि संकल्पें। हे लोकपरंपरा होय हारपे।॥ जया ठायातें आपणपें। मी ऐसें म्हणसी ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ jayāceni saṃkalpeṃ| he lokaparaṃparā hoya hārape||| jayā ṭhāyāteṃ āpaṇapeṃ| mī aiseṃ mhaṇasī || 82||
verses.meaning: Now, by whose mere will this succession of worlds comes into being and dissolves; that very abode, that very Self, you refer to as 'I'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें मुद्दळ रूप तुझें । जेथूनि इयें द्विभुजें हन चतुर्भुजें। सुरकार्याचेनि व्याजें। घेवो घेवों येसी ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ muddaḻa rūpa tujheṃ | jethūni iyeṃ dvibhujeṃ hana caturbhujeṃ| surakāryāceni vyājeṃ| ghevo ghevoṃ yesī || 83||
verses.meaning: That original form of Yours, from which You assume these two-armed or four-armed forms, taking them on as if for the sake of divine work.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जळशयनाचिया अवगणिया। कां मत्स्य कूर्म इया मिरवणिया। खेळु सरलिया तूं गुणिया। सांठविसी जेथ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jaḻaśayanāciyā avagaṇiyā| kāṃ matsya kūrma iyā miravaṇiyā| kheḻu saraliyā tūṃ guṇiyā| sāṃṭhavisī jetha|| 84||
verses.meaning: Just as after the sport of the fish and tortoise, which are but the manifestations of the Lord's sleep in the cosmic waters, You, O virtuous one, withdraw them into Yourself when the play is over.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उपनिषदे जें गाती । योगिये हृदयीं रिगोनि पाहाती । तयातें सनकादिक आहाती । पोटाळुनियां ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: upaniṣade jeṃ gātī | yogiye hṛdayīṃ rigoni pāhātī | tayāteṃ sanakādika āhātī | poṭāḻuniyāṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: The Upanishads sing of it, yogis delve into their hearts to perceive it, and Sanaka and others embrace it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अगाध जें तुझें। विश्वरूप कानीं ऐकिजे। तें देखावया चित्त माझें । उतावीळ देवा॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ agādha jeṃ tujheṃ| viśvarūpa kānīṃ aikije| teṃ dekhāvayā citta mājheṃ | utāvīḻa devā|| 86||
verses.meaning: O Lord, my heart yearns to behold Your cosmic form, which is so profound and about which I have only heard.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवें फेडूनियां सांकड । लोभें पुसिली जरी चाड । तरी हेंचि एकीं वाड। आर्ती जी मज॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: deveṃ pheḍūniyāṃ sāṃkaḍa | lobheṃ pusilī jarī cāḍa | tarī heṃci ekīṃ vāḍa| ārtī jī maja|| 87||
verses.meaning: Even if the Lord, having removed all my difficulties, lovingly asks what my desire is, this alone is my great longing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुझें विश्वरूप आघवें। माझिये दिठीसि गोचर होआवें। ऐशी थोर आस जीवें। बांधोनि आहें ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujheṃ viśvarūpa āghaveṃ| mājhiye diṭhīsi gocara hoāveṃ| aiśī thora āsa jīveṃ| bāṃdhoni āheṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: I hold a great longing in my heart, that your universal form, in its entirety, may become visible to my sight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'परी आणीक एक एथ शार्ड्ी। तुज विशवरूपातें देखावयालागीं। पैं योग्यता माझिया आंगीं । असे कीं नाहीं ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'parī āṇīka eka etha śārḍī| tuja viśavarūpāteṃ dekhāvayālāgīṃ| paiṃ yogyatā mājhiyā āṃgīṃ | ase kīṃ nāhīṃ || 89||
verses.meaning: But there is one more doubt here. To see your universal form, do I possess the worthiness or not?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें आपलें आपण मी नेणें । तें कां नेणसी जरी देव म्हणे । तरी सरोगु काय जाणे । निदान रोगाचें ॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ āpaleṃ āpaṇa mī neṇeṃ | teṃ kāṃ neṇasī jarī deva mhaṇe | tarī sarogu kāya jāṇe | nidāna rogāceṃ || 90||
verses.meaning: I do not know myself. If God says, "Why do you not know?", then how can a sick person know the diagnosis of their own illness?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जी आर्तीचेनि पडिभरें। आर्तु आपुली ठाकी पैं विसरे । जैसा तान्हेला म्हणे न पुरे। समुद्र मज ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jī ārtīceni paḍibhareṃ| ārtu āpulī ṭhākī paiṃ visare | jaisā tānhelā mhaṇe na pure| samudra maja || 91||
verses.meaning: And that intense longing, in its overwhelming fervor, makes one forget their own desire, just as a thirsty person might say, "The ocean is not enough for me."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशा सचाडपणाचिये भुली । न सांभाळवे समस्या आपुली । यालागीं योग्यता जेवीं माउली । बाळकाची जाणे॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśā sacāḍapaṇāciye bhulī | na sāṃbhāḻave samasyā āpulī | yālāgīṃ yogyatā jevīṃ māulī | bāḻakācī jāṇe|| 92||
verses.meaning: In such a state of deluded foolishness, one cannot even take care of their own problems. Therefore, just as a mother knows the needs of her child, so too does true competence understand what is required.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी श्रीजनार्दना। विचारिजो माझी संभावना । मग विश्‍वरूपदर्शना । उपक्रम कोजे॥९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī śrījanārdanā| vicārijo mājhī saṃbhāvanā | maga viś‍varūpadarśanā | upakrama koje||93||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Shri Janardana, consider my worthiness. Then, let the endeavor of beholding the Universal Form begin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी ऐसी ते कृपा करा। एऱ्हबीं नव्हे हें म्हणा अवधारा । वायां पंचमालापें बधिरा। सुख केउतें देणें ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī aisī te kṛpā karā| eṟhabīṃ navhe heṃ mhaṇā avadhārā | vāyāṃ paṃcamālāpeṃ badhirā| sukha keuteṃ deṇeṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Therefore, please bestow such grace. Otherwise, it is not possible, listen. What joy can be given to a deaf person through useless chatter?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं येकले बापियाचे तृषे। मेघ जगापुरतें काय न वर्षे। परी जहालीही वृष्टि उपखे। जऱ्ही खडकीं होय॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ yekale bāpiyāce tṛṣe| megha jagāpurateṃ kāya na varṣe| parī jahālīhī vṛṣṭi upakhe| jaṟhī khaḍakīṃ hoya|| 95||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, does a cloud not rain enough for the whole world just for the thirst of one thirsty person? But even if such rain falls, it is wasted if it falls on barren rock.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चकोरा चंद्रामृत फावलें। येरां आण वाहूनि काय वारिलें। परी डोळ्यांबीण पाहलें। वायां जाय ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: cakorā caṃdrāmṛta phāvaleṃ| yerāṃ āṇa vāhūni kāya vārileṃ| parī ḍoḻyāṃbīṇa pāhaleṃ| vāyāṃ jāya || 96||
verses.meaning: The chakora bird has received the moon's nectar. What has prevented others from receiving it? But without eyes, the dawn is wasted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विश्वरूप तूं सहसा। दाविसी कीर हा भरंबवसा। कां जे कडाडां आणि गहिंसा-। माजीं नित्य नवा तूं कीं ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni viśvarūpa tūṃ sahasā| dāvisī kīra hā bharaṃbavasā| kāṃ je kaḍāḍāṃ āṇi gahiṃsā-| mājīṃ nitya navā tūṃ kīṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Therefore, you spontaneously reveal your universal form, this is indeed a certainty. For, in both the manifest and the unmanifest, you are eternally new.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुझें औदार्य जाणों स्वतंत्र । देतां न म्हणसी पात्रापात्र। पैं कैवल्याऐसें पवित्र । जें वैरियांही दिधलें॥९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujheṃ audārya jāṇoṃ svataṃtra | detāṃ na mhaṇasī pātrāpātra| paiṃ kaivalyāaiseṃ pavitra | jeṃ vairiyāṃhī didhaleṃ||98||
verses.meaning: Your generosity is truly independent; when giving, you do not distinguish between deserving and undeserving. Indeed, you bestowed the sacred state of liberation even upon your enemies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोक्षु दुराराध्यु कीर होय। परी तोही आराधी तुझे पाय। म्हणौनि धाडिसी तेथ जाय। पाइकु जैसा॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mokṣu durārādhyu kīra hoya| parī tohī ārādhī tujhe pāya| mhaṇauni dhāḍisī tetha jāya| pāiku jaisā|| 99||
verses.meaning: Even if liberation is difficult to attain, it too worships your feet. Therefore, like a loyal servant, it goes wherever you send it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुवां सनकादिकांचेनि मानें। सायुज्यीं सौरसु दिधला पूतने। जे विषाचेनि स्तनपानें॥ मारूं आली॥ १००॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuvāṃ sanakādikāṃceni māneṃ| sāyujyīṃ saurasu didhalā pūtane| je viṣāceni stanapāneṃ|| mārūṃ ālī|| 100||
verses.meaning: You, through the respect shown by sages like Sanaka, granted liberation to Putana, who came to kill with poisoned milk from her breast.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा राजसूय यागाचिया सभासदीं। देखतां त्रिभुवनाची मांदी। कैसा शतधा दुर्वाक्य शब्दीं । निस्तेजिलासी ॥ ९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā rājasūya yāgāciyā sabhāsadīṃ| dekhatāṃ tribhuvanācī māṃdī| kaisā śatadhā durvākya śabdīṃ | nistejilāsī || 9 ||
verses.meaning: Indeed, in the assembly of the Rajasuya sacrifice, before the gathering of the three worlds, how were you, through a hundred harsh words, stripped of your radiance?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशिया अपराधिया शिशुपाळा। आपणपें ठावो दिधला गोपाळा। आणि उत्तानचरणाचिया बाळा। काय ध्रुवपदीं चाड॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśiyā aparādhiyā śiśupāḻā| āpaṇapeṃ ṭhāvo didhalā gopāḻā| āṇi uttānacaraṇāciyā bāḻā| kāya dhruvapadīṃ cāḍa|| 2||
verses.meaning: To such an offender as Shishupala, the Gopala (Krishna) gave a place in Himself. And what desire did the child of Uttanapada (Dhruva) have for the Dhruvapada (eternal abode)?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो वना आल् याचिलागीं। जे बैसावें पितयाचिया उत्संगीं । कीं तो चंद्रसूर्यादिकांपरिस जगीं । एलाघ्यु केला ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to vanā āl yācilāgīṃ| je baisāveṃ pitayāciyā utsaṃgīṃ | kīṃ to caṃdrasūryādikāṃparisa jagīṃ | elāghyu kelā || 3||
verses.meaning: He came to the forest, so that he might sit on his father's lap. Or, he was made insignificant in the world compared to the moon, sun, and other celestial bodies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा वनवासियां सकळां। देतां एकचि तूं धसाळा। पुत्रा आळवितां अजामिळा। आपणपें देसी॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā vanavāsiyāṃ sakaḻāṃ| detāṃ ekaci tūṃ dhasāḻā| putrā āḻavitāṃ ajāmiḻā| āpaṇapeṃ desī|| 4||
verses.meaning: Just as you, the one and only, gave yourself to all the forest dwellers, so too do you give yourself to Ajamila when he calls out to his son.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें उरीं हाणितलासि पांपरा। तयाचा चरणु वाहासी दातारा। अझुनी बैरियांचिया कळेवरा। विसंबसीना ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ urīṃ hāṇitalāsi pāṃparā| tayācā caraṇu vāhāsī dātārā| ajhunī bairiyāṃciyā kaḻevarā| visaṃbasīnā || 5||
verses.meaning: You, who were struck on the chest by a kick, still carry the mark of that foot, O Giver! You do not forget the bodies of your enemies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अपकारियां तुझा उपकारु । तूं अपात्रींही परि उदारु । दे दान म्हणौनि दारवंठेकरु । जाहलासी बळीचा ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā apakāriyāṃ tujhā upakāru | tūṃ apātrīṃhī pari udāru | de dāna mhaṇauni dāravaṃṭhekaru | jāhalāsī baḻīcā || 6||
verses.meaning: Such is your beneficence even towards those who harm you. You are generous even to the undeserving. You became the doorkeeper of Bali, just to ask for a donation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूंतें आराधी ना आयके । होती पुंसा बोलावीत कौतुकें । तिये बैकुंठीं तुवां गणिके । सुरवाडु केला॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃteṃ ārādhī nā āyake | hotī puṃsā bolāvīta kautukeṃ | tiye baikuṃṭhīṃ tuvāṃ gaṇike | suravāḍu kelā|| 7||
verses.meaning: You did not worship or listen to her, but out of curiosity, she called out to men. Yet, in Vaikuntha, you made her a courtesan.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसीं पाहूनि वायाणीं मिषें। आपणपें देवों 'लागसी वानिवसें। तो तूं कां अनारिसें। मजलागीं करिसी॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisīṃ pāhūni vāyāṇīṃ miṣeṃ| āpaṇapeṃ devoṃ 'lāgasī vānivaseṃ| to tūṃ kāṃ anāriseṃ| majalāgīṃ karisī||8||
verses.meaning: Seeing such vain pretexts, you offer yourself to me with praise. Why then do you treat me as an enemy?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा दुभतयाचेनि पवाडें । जे जगाचें फेडी सांकडें । तिये कामधेनूचे पाडे । काय भुकेले ठाती॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā dubhatayāceni pavāḍeṃ | je jagāceṃ pheḍī sāṃkaḍeṃ | tiye kāmadhenūce pāḍe | kāya bhukele ṭhātī|| 9||
verses.meaning: Indeed, by the abundance of her milk, she removes the world's distress. How can the calves of such a wish-fulfilling cow ever remain hungry?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मियां जें विनविलें कांहीं । तें देव न दाखविती हें कीर नाहीं । परी देखावयालागीं देई । पात्रता मज ॥ ११०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni miyāṃ jeṃ vinavileṃ kāṃhīṃ | teṃ deva na dākhavitī heṃ kīra nāhīṃ | parī dekhāvayālāgīṃ deī | pātratā maja || 110||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever I have requested, it is not that God will not reveal it. But to be able to see it, grant me the worthiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुझें विश्वरूप आकळे । ऐसें जरी जाणसी माझे डोळे। तरि आरतीचे डोहळे। पुरवी देवा॥ ११९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujheṃ viśvarūpa ākaḻe | aiseṃ jarī jāṇasī mājhe ḍoḻe| tari āratīce ḍohaḻe| puravī devā|| 119||
verses.meaning: If you believe my eyes are capable of comprehending your universal form, then fulfill my longing to behold your divine light, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी ठायेंठावो विनंती। जंब करूं सरला सुभद्रापती। तंव तया षड्गुणचक्रवर्ती। साहवेचिना॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī ṭhāyeṃṭhāvo vinaṃtī| jaṃba karūṃ saralā subhadrāpatī| taṃva tayā ṣaḍguṇacakravartī| sāhavecinā|| 12||
verses.meaning: When Subhadra's husband (Arjuna) finished his prayer, the Lord of six divine attributes (Krishna) could not bear it (the separation/waiting) any longer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो कृपापीयूषसजळु। आणि येरु जवळां आला वर्षाकाळु। ना ना श्रीकृष्ण कोकिळु । अर्जुन बसंतु॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to kṛpāpīyūṣasajaḻu| āṇi yeru javaḻāṃ ālā varṣākāḻu| nā nā śrīkṛṣṇa kokiḻu | arjuna basaṃtu|| 93||
verses.meaning: He is the cloud of the nectar of grace, and the rainy season has arrived. No, no, Krishna is the cuckoo, and Arjuna is the spring.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी चंद्रबिंब वाटोळें। देखोनि क्षीरसागर उचंबळे। तैसा दुणेंहीवरी प्रेमबळें। उल्लसितु जाहला ॥ १९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī caṃdrabiṃba vāṭoḻeṃ| dekhoni kṣīrasāgara ucaṃbaḻe| taisā duṇeṃhīvarī premabaḻeṃ| ullasitu jāhalā || 194||
verses.meaning: Just as the ocean surges upon seeing the full moon, so too did he become overjoyed, his love intensifying manifold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तिये प्रसन्नतेचेनि आटोपें। गाजोनि म्हणितळें सकृपें। पार्था देख देख अमुपें। स्वरूपे माझीं ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tiye prasannateceni āṭopeṃ| gājoni mhaṇitaḻeṃ sakṛpeṃ| pārthā dekha dekha amupeṃ| svarūpe mājhīṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Then, with that joyous and compassionate disposition, He said, "Arjuna, behold My innumerable forms!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकचि विश्वरूप देखावें। ऐसा मनोरथु केला पांडवें। कीं विश्‍एवरूपमय आधघवें। करूनि घातलें॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekaci viśvarūpa dekhāveṃ| aisā manorathu kelā pāṃḍaveṃ| kīṃ viś‍evarūpamaya ādhaghaveṃ| karūni ghātaleṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: Arjuna desired to see the universal form, and the Lord, as if to fulfill this wish, manifested the entire universe within Himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाप उदार देवो अपरिमितु। याचक स्वेच्छा सदोदितु । असे सहस्त्रवरी देतु। सर्वस्व आपुलें॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāpa udāra devo aparimitu| yācaka svecchā sadoditu | ase sahastravarī detu| sarvasva āpuleṃ|| 17||
verses.meaning: The Father, the generous God, gives immeasurably. The seeker, by their own will, always receives. He gives thousands of such boons, indeed, His very all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो शेषाचेहि डोळे चोरिळे। वेद जयालागीं झकविले। लक्ष्मीयेही राहविलें। जिव्हार जें ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho śeṣācehi ḍoḻe coriḻe| veda jayālāgīṃ jhakavile| lakṣmīyehī rāhavileṃ| jivhāra jeṃ || 18||
verses.meaning: Ah, that which stole the eyes of even Shesha, bewildered the Vedas, and captivated the very heart of Lakshmi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें आतां प्रकटुनि अनेकधा। करीत विश्‍वरूपदर्शनाचा धांदा । बाप भाग्या अगाधा। पार्थाचिया॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ ātāṃ prakaṭuni anekadhā| karīta viś‍varūpadarśanācā dhāṃdā | bāpa bhāgyā agādhā| pārthāciyā|| 19||
verses.meaning: Now, revealing Himself in many forms, He undertakes the task of displaying His universal form. Oh, the immeasurable good fortune of Arjuna!

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो जागता स्वप्नावस्थे जाये। तो जेवीं स्वणींचें आघवें होये। तेवीं अनंत ब्रह्मकटाह आहे। आपणचि जाहला॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo jāgatā svapnāvasthe jāye| to jevīṃ svaṇīṃceṃ āghaveṃ hoye| tevīṃ anaṃta brahmakaṭāha āhe| āpaṇaci jāhalā|| 120||
verses.meaning: Just as one who is awake enters the dream state and becomes all that is in the dream, so too the infinite cosmic egg of Brahman becomes oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते सहसा मुद्रा सोडिली। आणि स्थूळदृष्टीची जवनिका फेडिली। किंबहुना उघडिली । योगक्रस्द्वि ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: te sahasā mudrā soḍilī| āṇi sthūḻadṛṣṭīcī javanikā pheḍilī| kiṃbahunā ughaḍilī | yogakrasdvi || 29||
verses.meaning: Then, the seal of ordinary perception was easily broken, and the veil of gross vision was lifted, as if unveiled by the practice of Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हा हें देखेळ कीं नाहीं । ऐसी सेचि न करी कांहीं । एकसरां म्हणतसे पाहीं। स्नेहातुर॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī hā heṃ dekheḻa kīṃ nāhīṃ | aisī seci na karī kāṃhīṃ | ekasarāṃ mhaṇatase pāhīṃ| snehātura|| 22||
verses.meaning: But whether he will see this or not, he does not care at all. He just says, 'Look!' overcome with affection.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना तुवां एक दावा म्हणितलें। आणि तेंचि दावूं तरी काय दाविलें। आतां देखें आघवें भरिलें। माझ्याचि रूपीं ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā tuvāṃ eka dāvā mhaṇitaleṃ| āṇi teṃci dāvūṃ tarī kāya dāvileṃ| ātāṃ dekheṃ āghaveṃ bharileṃ| mājhyāci rūpīṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, you asked me to show you one thing, but if I were to show you that one thing, what would I be showing? Now, behold, everything is filled with My very form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें कृशें एकें स्थूळें । एके सस्वें एकें विशाळें । पृथुतरें सरळें। अप्रांते एके ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ kṛśeṃ ekeṃ sthūḻeṃ | eke sasveṃ ekeṃ viśāḻeṃ | pṛthutareṃ saraḻeṃ| aprāṃte eke || 24||
verses.meaning: Some are thin, some are stout. Some are short, some are tall. Some are very broad, some are straight, and some are endless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें अनावरें प्रांजळें । सव्यापारें एके निश्चळें । उदासीनें स्नेहाळें । तीव्रे एकें ॥ २५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ anāvareṃ prāṃjaḻeṃ | savyāpāreṃ eke niścaḻeṃ | udāsīneṃ snehāḻeṃ | tīvre ekeṃ || 25 ||
verses.meaning: With one that is uncontrollably pure, with one that is active yet unwavering, with one that is detached yet affectionate, with one that is intensely focused.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें घूर्णितें सावधें। असलगें एकें अगाधें। एकें उदारें अतिबद्धे । क्रुद्धें एकें॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ ghūrṇiteṃ sāvadheṃ| asalageṃ ekeṃ agādheṃ| ekeṃ udāreṃ atibaddhe | kruddheṃ ekeṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: One is vigilant in its whirling, another is unfathomable in its detachment, one is exceedingly bound in its generosity, and another is enraged.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें शांतें सन्मदें। स्तब्धें एकें सानंदें । गर्जितें निःशब्दें । सौम्यें एकें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ śāṃteṃ sanmadeṃ| stabdheṃ ekeṃ sānaṃdeṃ | garjiteṃ niḥśabdeṃ | saumyeṃ ekeṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: One is tranquil, one is filled with joy. One is silent, one is filled with bliss. One roars without sound, one is gentle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एके साभिलाषें विरक्ते । उन्निद्रितें एकें निद्रितें। परितुष्टें एकें आर्ते । प्रसन्नें एकें॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: eke sābhilāṣeṃ virakte | unnidriteṃ ekeṃ nidriteṃ| parituṣṭeṃ ekeṃ ārte | prasanneṃ ekeṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: Some are filled with desire, some are detached; some are awake, some are asleep; some are content, some are distressed; some are pleased.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें अशस्त्रे सशस्त्रें। एकें रोद्रें अतिमित्रें। भयानकें एकें विचित्रें। लयस्थें एकें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ aśastre saśastreṃ| ekeṃ rodreṃ atimitreṃ| bhayānakeṃ ekeṃ vicitreṃ| layastheṃ ekeṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Some are unarmed, some are armed. Some are fierce, some are very friendly. Some are terrifying, some are wondrous. Some are absorbed in dissolution.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एके जननलीलाविलासें। एके पालनशीळें 'लालसें। एकें संहारकें सावेशें। साक्षिभूतें एकें ॥ १३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: eke jananalīlāvilāseṃ| eke pālanaśīḻeṃ 'lālaseṃ| ekeṃ saṃhārakeṃ sāveśeṃ| sākṣibhūteṃ ekeṃ || 130||
verses.meaning: One (manifests) through the playful sport of creation, another through the nurturing desire of sustenance, and yet another through the passionate act of destruction, while one remains as the witnessing consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं नानाविधें परी बहुवसें । आणि दिव्यतेजप्रकाशें । तेवींचि एकएकाऐसें। वर्णेंही नव्हे ॥ ३१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ nānāvidheṃ parī bahuvaseṃ | āṇi divyatejaprakāśeṃ | tevīṃci ekaekāaiseṃ| varṇeṃhī navhe || 319||
verses.meaning: In this way, there are many varieties, and with divine, radiant light, yet each one is incomparable, beyond description.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें तातलें साडेपंधरें। तैसी कपिलवर्णे अपारें। एकें सर्वांगी जैसें सेंदुरें। डवरलें नभ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ tātaleṃ sāḍepaṃdhareṃ| taisī kapilavarṇe apāreṃ| ekeṃ sarvāṃgī jaiseṃ seṃdureṃ| ḍavaraleṃ nabha|| 32||
verses.meaning: Just as a single sunrise paints the sky with a reddish hue, so too did the vast expanse of the sky appear entirely adorned in a deep red, as if covered in vermilion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें सावियाची चुळुकीं। जैसें ब्रह्मकटाह खचिलें माणिकीं। एकें अरुणोदयासारिखीं। कुंकुमवर्णे ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ sāviyācī cuḻukīṃ| jaiseṃ brahmakaṭāha khacileṃ māṇikīṃ| ekeṃ aruṇodayāsārikhīṃ| kuṃkumavarṇe || 33||
verses.meaning: In a single, small sip, as if the cosmic egg (Brahma-kataha) were filled with jewels, one appears like the dawn, crimson-colored.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें शुद्धस्फटिक- सोज्वळें । एकें इंद्रनीळसुनीळें । एके अंजनवर्णे सकाळें । रक्‍तवर्णे एकें॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ śuddhasphaṭika- sojvaḻeṃ | ekeṃ iṃdranīḻasunīḻeṃ | eke aṃjanavarṇe sakāḻeṃ | rak‍tavarṇe ekeṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: Some are pure and radiant like crystal, some are dark blue like sapphire, some are black like collyrium, and some are red.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एके लसत्कांचनसम पिंवळीं। एके नवजलदश्यामळीं। एकें चांपेगोरीं केवळीं। हरितें एके ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: eke lasatkāṃcanasama piṃvaḻīṃ| eke navajaladaśyāmaḻīṃ| ekeṃ cāṃpegorīṃ kevaḻīṃ| hariteṃ eke || 35 ||
verses.meaning: Some are yellow like shining gold, some are dark like fresh rain clouds, some are fair like champak flowers, and some are green.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें तप्तताग्रतांबडीं । एकें शवेतचंद्र चोखडीं । ऐसीं नानावर्णे रूपडीं। देखें माझीं ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ taptatāgratāṃbaḍīṃ | ekeṃ śavetacaṃdra cokhaḍīṃ | aisīṃ nānāvarṇe rūpaḍīṃ| dekheṃ mājhīṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: Some are red like molten copper, others are pure white like the moon. Thus, I behold My various forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे जैसे कां आनान वर्ण | तैसें आकृतींही अनारिसेपण। लाजा कंदर्प रिघाला शरण । तैसीं सुंदरें एकें ॥ ३७॥
