verses.shloka_iast: he jaise kāṃ ānāna varṇa | taiseṃ ākṛtīṃhī anārisepaṇa| lājā kaṃdarpa righālā śaraṇa | taisīṃ suṃdareṃ ekeṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: Just as a face is adorned with beautiful features, so too is the form of the divine. It is so beautiful that even Kamadeva, the god of love, would be ashamed and seek refuge in its presence. Such is the unparalleled beauty.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें अतिलावण्यसाकारें। एकें स्त्रिं्धवपु मनोहरें। श्ंगारश्रियेचीं भांडारें। उघडिलीं जैसीं ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ atilāvaṇyasākāreṃ| ekeṃ striṃdhavapu manohareṃ| śṃgāraśriyecīṃ bhāṃḍāreṃ| ughaḍilīṃ jaisīṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: One, with an exceedingly beautiful form, and the other, with a charming, soft body, as if the treasures of the goddess of beauty have been opened.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें पीनावयव मांसाळें । एकें शुष्कें अतिविक्राळें। एकें दीर्घकंठें विताळें। विकटें एकें ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ pīnāvayava māṃsāḻeṃ | ekeṃ śuṣkeṃ ativikrāḻeṃ| ekeṃ dīrghakaṃṭheṃ vitāḻeṃ| vikaṭeṃ ekeṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Some are fat and fleshy, some are extremely dry and hideous. Some have long, distorted necks, and some are grotesque.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं नानाविधाकृती। इयां पाहतां पारु नाहीं सुभद्रापती। ययांच्या एकेकीं अंगप्रांतीं। देख पां जग॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ nānāvidhākṛtī| iyāṃ pāhatāṃ pāru nāhīṃ subhadrāpatī| yayāṃcyā ekekīṃ aṃgaprāṃtīṃ| dekha pāṃ jaga|| 140||
verses.meaning: Oh Arjuna, there is no end to these diverse forms. In each and every part of them, behold the entire universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ उन्मीलन होत आहे दिठी। तेथ पसरती आदित्यांचिया सृष्टी । पुढती निमीलनीं मिठी । देत आहाती ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha unmīlana hota āhe diṭhī| tetha pasaratī ādityāṃciyā sṛṣṭī | puḍhatī nimīlanīṃ miṭhī | deta āhātī || 49||
verses.meaning: Where the eyes open, there the sun's creations spread. Again, with the closing of the eyes, they are embraced and disappear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वदनींचिया वाफेसवें। होत ज्वाळामय आघवें। जेथ पावकादिक पावे। समूह वबसूंचा ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: vadanīṃciyā vāphesaveṃ| hota jvāḻāmaya āghaveṃ| jetha pāvakādika pāve| samūha vabasūṃcā || 42||
verses.meaning: With the very breath from the mouth, everything becomes fiery, even fire itself, along with all its blazing forms, gathers there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि भ्रूलतांचे शेवट । कोपें मिळों पाहती एकवट । तेथ रुद्रगणांचे संघाट । अवतरत देखें॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi bhrūlatāṃce śevaṭa | kopeṃ miḻoṃ pāhatī ekavaṭa | tetha rudragaṇāṃce saṃghāṭa | avatarata dekheṃ|| 43||
verses.meaning: And where the ends of the eyebrows meet in anger, there I see hosts of Rudras descending.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सौम्यतेचा बोलावा । मिती नेणिजे अश्‍विनौदेवां । श्रोत्री होती पांडवा । अनेक वायु ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ saumyatecā bolāvā | mitī neṇije aś‍vinaudevāṃ | śrotrī hotī pāṃḍavā | aneka vāyu || 44||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ashwini Kumaras are called the gentle ones, and their measure is unknown, so too, O Pandava, were there many winds in the ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यापरी एकेकाचिये लीळे । जन्मती सुरसिद्धांचीं कुळें। ऐसीं अपारें आणि विशाळें। रूपें इयें पाहीं ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāparī ekekāciye līḻe | janmatī surasiddhāṃcīṃ kuḻeṃ| aisīṃ apāreṃ āṇi viśāḻeṃ| rūpeṃ iyeṃ pāhīṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: In this way, from each of His divine plays, lineages of gods and perfected beings are born. Behold, these forms are thus immeasurable and vast.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांतें सांगावया वेद बोबडे । पहावया काळाचेंही आयुष्य थोडें । धातयाही परी न सांपडे। ठाव जयांचा ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃteṃ sāṃgāvayā veda bobaḍe | pahāvayā kāḻāceṃhī āyuṣya thoḍeṃ | dhātayāhī parī na sāṃpaḍe| ṭhāva jayāṃcā || 46||
verses.meaning: The Vedas stammer when trying to describe them, and even the lifespan of time itself is too short to fully comprehend them. Even Brahma, the creator, cannot grasp their true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांतें वेदत्रयीं कधीं नायके । तियें इयें प्रत्यक्ष देख अनेकें । भोगीं आश्‍चर्याचीं कवतिकें । महासिद्धी ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃteṃ vedatrayīṃ kadhīṃ nāyake | tiyeṃ iyeṃ pratyakṣa dekha anekeṃ | bhogīṃ āś‍caryācīṃ kavatikeṃ | mahāsiddhī || 47||
verses.meaning: Those great spiritual powers (Mahasiddhis) which are never heard of in the three Vedas, are directly experienced here in many astonishing and delightful ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया मूर्तीचिया किरीटी। रोममूळीं देखें पां सृष्टी । सुरतरूतळवटीं । तृणांकुर जैसे ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā mūrtīciyā kirīṭī| romamūḻīṃ dekheṃ pāṃ sṛṣṭī | suratarūtaḻavaṭīṃ | tṛṇāṃkura jaise || 48 ||
verses.meaning: On the crown of this idol, I behold creation at the root of each hair, like blades of grass at the base of a wish-fulfilling tree.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चंडवाताचेनि प्रकाशें। उडत परमाणु दिसती जेसें। भ्रमत ब्रह्मकटाह तैसे। अवयवसंधीं ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: caṃḍavātāceni prakāśeṃ| uḍata paramāṇu disatī jeseṃ| bhramata brahmakaṭāha taise| avayavasaṃdhīṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: Just as atoms are seen flying in the light of a strong wind, so too the entire universe, like a cosmic egg, rotates within the joints of His limbs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ एकैकाचिया प्रदेशीं। बिश्व देख विस्तारेंशीं। आणि विश्‍वाही परौतें मानसीं। जरी देखावें वर्ते ॥ १५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha ekaikāciyā pradeśīṃ| biśva dekha vistāreṃśīṃ| āṇi viś‍vāhī parauteṃ mānasīṃ| jarī dekhāveṃ varte || 150||
verses.meaning: Here, in each and every part, behold the universe in its vastness. And even beyond the universe, if one wishes to see it in the mind, it exists.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी इयेही विषयींचें कांहीं । एथ सर्वथा सांकडें नाहीं । सुखें आवडे तें माझिया देहीं। देखसी तूं ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī iyehī viṣayīṃceṃ kāṃhīṃ | etha sarvathā sāṃkaḍeṃ nāhīṃ | sukheṃ āvaḍe teṃ mājhiyā dehīṃ| dekhasī tūṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in this matter, there is no difficulty at all. You will happily see whatever you desire within My form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें विशवमूर्ती तेणें । बोलिलें कारुण्यपूर्णे। तंव देखत आहे कीं नाहीं न म्हणे । निवांतुचि येरु॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ viśavamūrtī teṇeṃ | bolileṃ kāruṇyapūrṇe| taṃva dekhata āhe kīṃ nāhīṃ na mhaṇe | nivāṃtuci yeru||52||
verses.meaning: Thus spoke the Universal Form, full of compassion. Yet, the other (Arjuna) neither said 'I see' nor 'I do not see', but remained silent and still.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ कां पां हा उगला । म्हणौनि श्रीकृष्णें जंव पाहिला । तंव आर्तीचें लेणें लेइला। तैसाचि आहे॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha kāṃ pāṃ hā ugalā | mhaṇauni śrīkṛṣṇeṃ jaṃva pāhilā | taṃva ārtīceṃ leṇeṃ leilā| taisāci āhe||53||
verses.meaning: Why is he so silent? As soon as Shri Krishna looked at him, he was adorned with the ornament of longing, just as he was.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणे उत्कंठे बोहट न पडे। अझुनी सुखाची सोय न सांपडे । परी दाविले तें फुडें। नाकळेचि यया॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇe utkaṃṭhe bohaṭa na paḍe| ajhunī sukhācī soya na sāṃpaḍe | parī dāvile teṃ phuḍeṃ| nākaḻeci yayā|| 54||
verses.meaning: Then he says, "My longing is not satisfied; I still haven't found the source of true happiness. But what was shown to me earlier, this one does not understand."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बोलोनि देवो हांसिले। २९८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी हांसोनि देखणियातें म्हणितळें। आम्हीं विश्वरूप तरी दाविलें। परी न देखसीच तूं ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ boloni devo hāṃsile| 298 śrījñāneśvarī hāṃsoni dekhaṇiyāteṃ mhaṇitaḻeṃ| āmhīṃ viśvarūpa tarī dāvileṃ| parī na dekhasīca tūṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Having said this, the Lord smiled. (298) Shri Dnyaneshwari: Smiling, He said to the one who sees, "I have indeed shown you My universal form, yet you do not see it."

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया बोला येरें विचक्षणें । म्हणितलें हां जी कवणासि तें उणें। तुम्ही बकाकरवीं चांदिणें । चरुऊं पहा मा॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā bolā yereṃ vicakṣaṇeṃ | mhaṇitaleṃ hāṃ jī kavaṇāsi teṃ uṇeṃ| tumhī bakākaravīṃ cāṃdiṇeṃ | caruūṃ pahā mā|| 56||
verses.meaning: Upon hearing this, the wise ones said, "Indeed, who is lacking in that? You are trying to make a crane graze on moonlight."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो उटोनियां आरिसा | आंधळिया दाऊं बैसा । बहिरियापुढें हृषीकेशा । गाणीव करा ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho uṭoniyāṃ ārisā | āṃdhaḻiyā dāūṃ baisā | bahiriyāpuḍheṃ hṛṣīkeśā | gāṇīva karā || 57||
verses.meaning: Indeed, it is like taking a mirror and showing it to a blind person, or, O Hrishikesha, singing before a deaf person.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मकरंदकणाचा चारा । जाणतां घालूनि दर्दुरा। वायां धाडा शार्डुधरा। कोपा 'कवणा॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: makaraṃdakaṇācā cārā | jāṇatāṃ ghālūni dardurā| vāyāṃ dhāḍā śārḍudharā| kopā 'kavaṇā|| 58||
verses.meaning: Knowing that the frog eats pollen, why would you send a tiger to catch it? Who would be angry at such a foolish act?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें अतींद्रिय म्हणौनि व्यवस्थिलें। केवळ ज्ञानदृष्टीचिया भागा फिटलें। तें तुम्हीं चर्मचश्चूंपुढें सूदलें। मी कैसेंनि देखें ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ atīṃdriya mhaṇauni vyavasthileṃ| kevaḻa jñānadṛṣṭīciyā bhāgā phiṭaleṃ| teṃ tumhīṃ carmacaścūṃpuḍheṃ sūdaleṃ| mī kaiseṃni dekheṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: That which is established as beyond the senses, perceivable only by the eye of knowledge, you have revealed before these eyes of flesh. How then can I perceive it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि हें तुमचें उणें न बोलावें। मीचि साहें तेंचि बरवें। एथ आथि म्हणितलें देवें । मानूं बापा॥ १६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari heṃ tumaceṃ uṇeṃ na bolāveṃ| mīci sāheṃ teṃci baraveṃ| etha āthi mhaṇitaleṃ deveṃ | mānūṃ bāpā|| 160||
verses.meaning: Do not speak of this as your shortcoming. I will bear it myself, that is better. Here, the Lord has said it, so let us accept it, my child.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साच विश्वरूप जरी आम्हीं दावाबें। तरी आधीं देखावया सामर्थ्य कीं द्यावें। परी बोळत बोलत प्रेमभावें। धसाळ गेलों ॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāca viśvarūpa jarī āmhīṃ dāvābeṃ| tarī ādhīṃ dekhāvayā sāmarthya kīṃ dyāveṃ| parī boḻata bolata premabhāveṃ| dhasāḻa geloṃ ||61||
verses.meaning: Though I should truly reveal the cosmic form, I must first grant the power to perceive it. But speaking with loving devotion, I have gone too far.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय जाहलें न वाहतां भुई पेरिजे। तरी तो वेलु विलया जाइजे । तरी आतां माझें निजरूप देखिजे। ते दृष्टी देवों तुज ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya jāhaleṃ na vāhatāṃ bhuī perije| tarī to velu vilayā jāije | tarī ātāṃ mājheṃ nijarūpa dekhije| te dṛṣṭī devoṃ tuja || 62||
verses.meaning: What happens if a seed is sown without watering the earth? The creeper will wither away. Therefore, now I shall grant you the vision to behold My true form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तिया दृष्टीं पांडवा। आमुचा ऐएश्वर्ययोगु आघवा । देखोनियां अनुभवा । माजिवडा करीं ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tiyā dṛṣṭīṃ pāṃḍavā| āmucā aieśvaryayogu āghavā | dekhoniyāṃ anubhavā | mājivaḍā karīṃ || 63||
verses.meaning: Then, Arjuna, by that vision, seeing all My divine yoga, experience its grandeur.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें तेणें वेदांतवेदये। सकळलोकआदयें। बोलिलें आराध्यें। जगाचेनि॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ teṇeṃ vedāṃtavedaye| sakaḻalokaādayeṃ| bolileṃ ārādhyeṃ| jagāceni|| 64||
verses.meaning: Thus, by that knower of Vedanta, the primal source of all worlds, the revered one of the universe, it was spoken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं कौरवकुलचक्रवर्ती। मज हाचि विस्मयो पुढतपुढती । जें श्रियेहूनि त्रिजगतीं। सदैव असे कवणी॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kauravakulacakravartī| maja hāci vismayo puḍhatapuḍhatī | jeṃ śriyehūni trijagatīṃ| sadaiva ase kavaṇī|| 65||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Emperor of the Kuru dynasty, this is what repeatedly astonishes me: who in the three worlds is more fortunate than Lakshmi herself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी खुणेचें वानाबयालागीं । श्रुतीवांचूनि दावा पां जगीं। ना सेवकपण तरी अंगीं। शेषाच्याचि आधि॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī khuṇeceṃ vānābayālāgīṃ | śrutīvāṃcūni dāvā pāṃ jagīṃ| nā sevakapaṇa tarī aṃgīṃ| śeṣācyāci ādhi|| 66||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, show me a sign in this world without the Vedas. Or, if it is about servitude, then it is only Shesha who possesses it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो जयाचेनि सोसें। शिणत आठही पहार योगी जेसे। अनुसरले गरुडाऐसें। कवण आहे॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho jayāceni soseṃ| śiṇata āṭhahī pahāra yogī jese| anusarale garuḍāaiseṃ| kavaṇa āhe|| 67||
verses.meaning: Who is there that, with such longing, like a yogi toils through all eight watches of the day, pursuing with the swiftness of an eagle?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तें आघवेंचि एकीकडे ठेलें। सांपें कृष्णसुख एकंदरें जाहलें। जिये दिवूनि जन्मळे। पांडव हे ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teṃ āghaveṃci ekīkaḍe ṭheleṃ| sāṃpeṃ kṛṣṇasukha ekaṃdareṃ jāhaleṃ| jiye divūni janmaḻe| pāṃḍava he || 68||
verses.meaning: But all that was set aside; the joy of Krishna became complete, from whom these Pandavas were born.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी पांचांही आंतु अर्जुना । श्रीकृष्ण सावियाची जाहला अधीना। कामुक कां जैसा अंगना। आपैता कीजे॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī pāṃcāṃhī āṃtu arjunā | śrīkṛṣṇa sāviyācī jāhalā adhīnā| kāmuka kāṃ jaisā aṃganā| āpaitā kīje|| 69||
verses.meaning: But among the five Pandavas, Arjuna, Shri Krishna became completely subservient, just as a passionate lover becomes devoted to his beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पढविलें पाखरूं ऐसें न बोळे। यापरी क्रौडामृगही तैसा न चले। कैसें दैव एथें सुरवाडलें। तें जाणों न ये॥ १७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paḍhavileṃ pākharūṃ aiseṃ na boḻe| yāparī krauḍāmṛgahī taisā na cale| kaiseṃ daiva etheṃ suravāḍaleṃ| teṃ jāṇoṃ na ye|| 170||
verses.meaning: A parrot, though taught, does not speak like this. Even a wild animal does not move like this. How has destiny unfolded here? It cannot be known.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आजि परब्रह्म हें सगळें । भोगावया सदैव याचेचि डोळे । कैसें वाचेनि हन लळे । पाळीत असे॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āji parabrahma heṃ sagaḻeṃ | bhogāvayā sadaiva yāceci ḍoḻe | kaiseṃ vāceni hana laḻe | pāḻīta ase||71||
verses.meaning: Today, this entire Parabrahma, to experience it forever, these very eyes are present. How, through speech, does it fulfill its desires?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा कोपे कीं निवांतु साहे। हा रुसे तरी बुझावीत जाये । नवल पिसें लागलें आहे। पार्थाचें देवा ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā kope kīṃ nivāṃtu sāhe| hā ruse tarī bujhāvīta jāye | navala piseṃ lāgaleṃ āhe| pārthāceṃ devā || 72||
verses.meaning: If he is angry, he endures it silently; if he is displeased, he goes to appease him. A strange madness has possessed the Lord for Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं विषय जिणोनि जन्मळे। जे शुकादिक दादुले। ते विषयोचि वानितां जाहले। भाट ययाचे ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ viṣaya jiṇoni janmaḻe| je śukādika dādule| te viṣayoci vānitāṃ jāhale| bhāṭa yayāce || 73||
verses.meaning: Even those like Shuka, who have conquered worldly desires from birth, become like bards praising these very desires when they speak of them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा योगियांचें समाधिधन । कीं होऊनि ठेलें पार्थाआधीन । यालागीं विस्मयो माझें मन। करीतसे राया॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā yogiyāṃceṃ samādhidhana | kīṃ hoūni ṭheleṃ pārthāādhīna | yālāgīṃ vismayo mājheṃ mana| karītase rāyā|| 74||
verses.meaning: This treasure of the yogis' samadhi, O Partha, has become subservient to you. Therefore, my mind is filled with wonder, O King.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि संजय म्हणे कायसा । विस्मयो एथें कौरवेशा। श्रीकृष्णें स्वीकारिजे तया ऐसा । भाग्योदय होय ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci saṃjaya mhaṇe kāyasā | vismayo etheṃ kauraveśā| śrīkṛṣṇeṃ svīkārije tayā aisā | bhāgyodaya hoya || 75||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said: "What is there to be surprised about, O King of the Kauravas, that Shri Krishna has accepted him? Such is his good fortune!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तो देवांचा रावो । म्हणे पार्थातें तुज दृष्टि देवो । जया बिशवरूपाचा ठावो । देखसी तूं ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni to devāṃcā rāvo | mhaṇe pārthāteṃ tuja dṛṣṭi devo | jayā biśavarūpācā ṭhāvo | dekhasī tūṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the King of Gods, Lord Krishna, said to Arjuna, "I grant you divine vision, through which you shall behold My universal form."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसीं श्रीमुखौनि अक्षरें। निघती ना जंब एकसरें।॥ तंव अविद्येचें आंधारें। जावोंचि लागे॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisīṃ śrīmukhauni akṣareṃ| nighatī nā jaṃba ekasareṃ||| taṃva avidyeceṃ āṃdhāreṃ| jāvoṃci lāge|| 77||
verses.meaning: As such, from the divine mouth, words emerge not all at once, but as they do, the darkness of ignorance begins to dissipate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तीं अक्षरें नव्हतीं देखा । ब्रह्मसाप्राज्यदीपिका । अर्जुनालागीं चित्कळिका । उजळलिया श्रीकृष्णें ॥७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tīṃ akṣareṃ navhatīṃ dekhā | brahmasāprājyadīpikā | arjunālāgīṃ citkaḻikā | ujaḻaliyā śrīkṛṣṇeṃ ||78||
verses.meaning: Those words, behold, were not mere letters; they were the lamp illuminating the empire of Brahman, a spark of consciousness that Shri Krishna kindled for Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग दिव्यचक्षुप्रकाशु प्रगटला। तया ज्ञानदृष्टी फांटा फुटला । ययापरी दाविता जाहला । ऐश्वर्य आपुलें॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga divyacakṣuprakāśu pragaṭalā| tayā jñānadṛṣṭī phāṃṭā phuṭalā | yayāparī dāvitā jāhalā | aiśvarya āpuleṃ||79||
verses.meaning: Then the light of divine vision manifested, and the branch of spiritual insight blossomed. In this way, He revealed His own divine glory.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे अवतार जे सकळ] ते जिये समुद्रींचे कां कल़लोळ। विश्व हें मृगजळ। जया रश्मीस्तव दिसे॥ १८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he avatāra je sakaḻa] te jiye samudrīṃce kāṃ kala़loḻa| viśva heṃ mṛgajaḻa| jayā raśmīstava dise|| 180||
verses.meaning: These incarnations are all like the waves of the ocean. This world is like a mirage, which appears due to His rays.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये अनादिभूमिके निटे। चराचर हें चित्र उमटे । आपणणपें श्रीबैकुंठें । दाविळें तया ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye anādibhūmike niṭe| carācara heṃ citra umaṭe | āpaṇaṇapeṃ śrībaikuṃṭheṃ | dāviḻeṃ tayā || 81||
verses.meaning: Upon that primordial canvas, the entire moving and unmoving creation is depicted, and in that very form, the divine abode of Vaikuntha is revealed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मागां बाळपणीं येणें श्रीपती । जैं एक वेळ खादली होती माती । तैं कोपोनियां हातीं । यशोदां धरिला॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: māgāṃ bāḻapaṇīṃ yeṇeṃ śrīpatī | jaiṃ eka veḻa khādalī hotī mātī | taiṃ koponiyāṃ hātīṃ | yaśodāṃ dharilā|| 82||
verses.meaning: Once, in his childhood, when the Lord of Lakshmi had eaten dirt, Yashoda, in anger, caught him by the hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग भेणें भेणें जैसें। मुखीं झाडा द्यावयाचेनि मिसें। चवदाही भुवनें सावकाशें। दाविलीं तिये॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga bheṇeṃ bheṇeṃ jaiseṃ| mukhīṃ jhāḍā dyāvayāceni miseṃ| cavadāhī bhuvaneṃ sāvakāśeṃ| dāvilīṃ tiye|| 83||
verses.meaning: Then, as if in fear, under the pretext of showing the mouth, she slowly revealed all fourteen worlds to him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी मधुवनीं ध्रुवासि केलें। जैसें कपोल शंखें शिवतलें। आणि वेदांचियेही मती ठेलें। तें लागला बोलों ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī madhuvanīṃ dhruvāsi keleṃ| jaiseṃ kapola śaṃkheṃ śivataleṃ| āṇi vedāṃciyehī matī ṭheleṃ| teṃ lāgalā boloṃ || 84||
verses.meaning: Or, like Dhruva in the forest, whose cheeks were touched by a conch, and whose intellect, which had been stopped even by the Vedas, began to speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा अनुग्रहो पैं राया । श्रीहरी केला धनंजया । आतां कवणेकडेही माया । ऐसी भाष नेणेंचि तो॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā anugraho paiṃ rāyā | śrīharī kelā dhanaṃjayā | ātāṃ kavaṇekaḍehī māyā | aisī bhāṣa neṇeṃci to|| 85||
verses.meaning: O King, Shri Hari bestowed His grace upon Dhananjaya (Arjuna). Now, Arjuna knows no such thing as illusion (maya) in any direction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकसरें ऐशवर्यतेजें पाहळें। तया चमत्काराचें 'एकार्णव जाहळें। चित्त समाजीं बुडोनि ठेलें। विस्मयाचिया॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekasareṃ aiśavaryatejeṃ pāhaḻeṃ| tayā camatkārāceṃ 'ekārṇava jāhaḻeṃ| citta samājīṃ buḍoni ṭheleṃ| vismayāciyā|| 86||
verses.meaning: A single, magnificent splendor unfolded, and from that wonder, an ocean of astonishment arose. The mind became completely immersed in this societal marvel, lost in utter amazement.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा आब्रह्म पूर्णोदकीं। पव्हे मार्कडेय एकाकी । तैसा विश्‍्वरूपकौतुकीं। पार्थ लोळे ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā ābrahma pūrṇodakīṃ| pavhe mārkaḍeya ekākī | taisā viś‍varūpakautukīṃ| pārtha loḻe || 87||
verses.meaning: Just as Markandeya floated alone in the cosmic waters of dissolution, so too did Arjuna revel in the wonder of the universal form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे केवढें गगन एथ होतें। तें कवणें नेलें पां केउतें। तीं चराचरें महाभूतें। काय जाहलीं ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe kevaḍheṃ gagana etha hoteṃ| teṃ kavaṇeṃ neleṃ pāṃ keuteṃ| tīṃ carācareṃ mahābhūteṃ| kāya jāhalīṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: He asks, "How vast was the sky here? Who took it away and where? What became of those animate and inanimate beings, those great elements?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिशांचे ठावही हारपळे। अधोर्ध्व 'काय नेणों जाहळलें। चेइलिया स्वप्न तैसे गेळे। लोकाकार॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: diśāṃce ṭhāvahī hārapaḻe| adhordhva 'kāya neṇoṃ jāhaḻaleṃ| ceiliyā svapna taise geḻe| lokākāra|| 89||
verses.meaning: The directions themselves were lost. What to say of above and below, they too vanished. Just as a dream disappears upon waking, so did the forms of the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २२० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी नाना सूर्यतेजप्रतापें। सचंद्र तारांगण जैसें लोपे । तैसीं गिळिलीं विशवरूपें। प्रपंचरचना ॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: 220 śrījñāneśvarī nānā sūryatejapratāpeṃ| sacaṃdra tārāṃgaṇa jaiseṃ lope | taisīṃ giḻilīṃ viśavarūpeṃ| prapaṃcaracanā || 190||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon and stars vanish in the brilliant light of the sun, so too the entire creation, with all its worldly affairs, is absorbed and disappears into the Universal Form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां मनासी मनपण न स्फुरे। बुद्धि आपणपें न सांबरे। इंद्रियांचे रश्मी माघारे) हृदयवरी भरले॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ manāsī manapaṇa na sphure| buddhi āpaṇapeṃ na sāṃbare| iṃdriyāṃce raśmī māghāre) hṛdayavarī bharale|| 91||
verses.meaning: Then the mind loses its mental faculty, the intellect forgets itself, and the reins of the senses are drawn back, filling the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ ताटस्थ्या ताटस्थ्य पडिळें। टकासी टक लागलें) जैसें मोहनास्त्र घातळें। विचारजातां॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha tāṭasthyā tāṭasthya paḍiḻeṃ| ṭakāsī ṭaka lāgaleṃ) jaiseṃ mohanāstra ghātaḻeṃ| vicārajātāṃ|| 92||
verses.meaning: There, neutrality itself became neutral, and one perfect coin struck another, as if a captivating spell was cast upon the very act of contemplation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा विस्मितु पाहे कोडें । तंब पुढां होतें चतुर्भुज रूपडें। तेंचि नानारूप चहूंकडे । मांडोनि ठेलें॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā vismitu pāhe koḍeṃ | taṃba puḍhāṃ hoteṃ caturbhuja rūpaḍeṃ| teṃci nānārūpa cahūṃkaḍe | māṃḍoni ṭheleṃ|| 93||
verses.meaning: Just as he gazed in wonder, the four-armed form that was before him then manifested itself into various forms all around him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसे वर्षाकाळींचे मेघोडे । कां महाप्रळयींचें तेज वाढे। तैसें. आपणावीण कवणीकडे। नेदीचि उरों॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaise varṣākāḻīṃce meghoḍe | kāṃ mahāpraḻayīṃceṃ teja vāḍhe| taiseṃ. āpaṇāvīṇa kavaṇīkaḍe| nedīci uroṃ|| 94||
verses.meaning: Just as clouds gather during the rainy season, or the light of the great dissolution intensifies, so too does it allow nothing to remain anywhere without itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रथम स्वरूपसमाधान । पावोनि ठेला अर्जुन । सवेंचि उघडी लोचन । तंव विश्वरूप देखे ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: prathama svarūpasamādhāna | pāvoni ṭhelā arjuna | saveṃci ughaḍī locana | taṃva viśvarūpa dekhe || 95||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, having first attained satisfaction in his true self, then opened his eyes and beheld the cosmic form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहींचि दोहीं डोळां। पाहावें विश्‍वरूपा सकळा । तो श्रीकृष्णें सोहळा । पुरविला ऐसा॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃci dohīṃ ḍoḻāṃ| pāhāveṃ viś‍varūpā sakaḻā | to śrīkṛṣṇeṃ sohaḻā | puravilā aisā|| 96||
verses.meaning: With these very eyes, to behold the complete cosmic form—such a joyous occasion was fulfilled by Shri Krishna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेथ सैंघ देखे बदनें। जैसीं रमानायकाचीं राजभुवनें। नाना प्रगटलीं निधानें। लावण्यश्रियेचीं ॥९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tetha saiṃgha dekhe badaneṃ| jaisīṃ ramānāyakācīṃ rājabhuvaneṃ| nānā pragaṭalīṃ nidhāneṃ| lāvaṇyaśriyecīṃ ||97||
verses.meaning: Then, everywhere, faces were seen, like the royal palaces of Lord Vishnu, or as if treasures of beauty and grace had manifested.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कों आनंदाचीं वनें सासिन्नलीं। जैसी सौंदर्या राणीव जोडली । तैसीं मनोहरें देखिलीं। हरीचीं वक्‍्त्रें तेणें ॥९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: koṃ ānaṃdācīṃ vaneṃ sāsinnalīṃ| jaisī sauṃdaryā rāṇīva joḍalī | taisīṃ manohareṃ dekhilīṃ| harīcīṃ vak‍treṃ teṇeṃ ||98||
verses.meaning: As if forests of joy had blossomed, as if beauty had found its queenly abode, so did he behold the enchanting faces of Hari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'तयांहीमाजीं एकैकें । सावियाचीं भयानकें । काळरात्रीचीं कटकें । उठावलीं जैसीं॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'tayāṃhīmājīṃ ekaikeṃ | sāviyācīṃ bhayānakeṃ | kāḻarātrīcīṃ kaṭakeṃ | uṭhāvalīṃ jaisīṃ||99||
verses.meaning: Among them, each one was truly terrifying, like armies rising up on the night of doomsday.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं मृत्यूसीचि मुखें जाहलीं। हो कां जे भयाचीं दुर्ग पन्नासिलीं। कीं महाकुंडें उघडलीं। प्रळयानळाचीं ॥ २००॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ mṛtyūsīci mukheṃ jāhalīṃ| ho kāṃ je bhayācīṃ durga pannāsilīṃ| kīṃ mahākuṃḍeṃ ughaḍalīṃ| praḻayānaḻācīṃ || 200||
verses.meaning: Or perhaps these are the mouths of Death itself, or the fifty fortresses of fear, or the great pits of the fire of cosmic dissolution have opened up.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं अदभुतें भयासुरें। तेथ वदनें देखिलीं वीरें। आणिकें असाधारणें साळंकारें। सौम्यें बहुतें॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ adabhuteṃ bhayāsureṃ| tetha vadaneṃ dekhilīṃ vīreṃ| āṇikeṃ asādhāraṇeṃ sāḻaṃkāreṃ| saumyeṃ bahuteṃ|| 1||
verses.meaning: In that very place, the warriors beheld wondrous and terrifying forms, along with many other extraordinary and gentle adornments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं ज्ञानदृष्टीचेनि अवलोकें । परि बदनांचा शेवटु न टके। मग लोचन ते कवतिकें । लागला पाहों ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jñānadṛṣṭīceni avalokeṃ | pari badanāṃcā śevaṭu na ṭake| maga locana te kavatikeṃ | lāgalā pāhoṃ || 2||
verses.meaning: With the vision of divine knowledge, the end of the words could not be reached. Then, with great curiosity, the eyes began to gaze.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव नानावर्णे कमळवनें। विकासिलीं तैसें अर्जुनें । नेत्र देखिले पालिंगनें । आदित्यांचीं ॥ ३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva nānāvarṇe kamaḻavaneṃ| vikāsilīṃ taiseṃ arjuneṃ | netra dekhile pāliṃganeṃ | ādityāṃcīṃ || 3 ||
verses.meaning: Then, Arjuna saw the suns, as if a lotus forest of various colors had bloomed, with his eyes, as if embraced.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथेंचि कृष्णमेघांचिया दाटी-। माजीं कल्पांत विजूंचिया स्फुटी। तैसिया बन्हि पिंगळा दिठी। भ्रूभंगातळीं ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetheṃci kṛṣṇameghāṃciyā dāṭī-| mājīṃ kalpāṃta vijūṃciyā sphuṭī| taisiyā banhi piṃgaḻā diṭhī| bhrūbhaṃgātaḻīṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: There, amidst the dense clouds of Krishna's form, like the bursting of doomsday lightning, His eyes, reddish-brown like fire, were seen beneath His furrowed brows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें एकेक आश्‍चर्य पाहतां । तिये एकेचि रूपीं पंडुसुता । दर्शनाची अनेकता। प्रतिफळली॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ ekeka āś‍carya pāhatāṃ | tiye ekeci rūpīṃ paṃḍusutā | darśanācī anekatā| pratiphaḻalī|| 5||
verses.meaning: As each wonder was beheld, O son of Pandu, in that one form, the multiplicity of visions manifested.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणे चरण ते कवणेकडे। केउते मुकुट कें दोर्दडें। ऐसी वाढविताहे कोडें। चाड देखावयाची॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇe caraṇa te kavaṇekaḍe| keute mukuṭa keṃ dordaḍeṃ| aisī vāḍhavitāhe koḍeṃ| cāḍa dekhāvayācī|| 6||
verses.meaning: Then he would ask, "Where are the feet? Where is the crown? Where are the mighty arms?" Thus, his longing to see Him grew with such eagerness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ भाग्यनिधि पार्था । कां विफलत्व होईल मनोरथा । काय पिनाकपाणीचिया भातां। वायकांडीं आहाती॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha bhāgyanidhi pārthā | kāṃ viphalatva hoīla manorathā | kāya pinākapāṇīciyā bhātāṃ| vāyakāṃḍīṃ āhātī||7||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, how can the treasure of good fortune be fruitless, or desires unfulfilled? Are the arrows of Lord Shiva mere reeds?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी चतुराननाचिये वाचे। काय आहाती लटिकिया अक्षरांचे सांचे । म्हणोनि साद्यंतपण अपरांचें । देखिलें तेणें ॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī caturānanāciye vāce| kāya āhātī laṭikiyā akṣarāṃce sāṃce | mhaṇoni sādyaṃtapaṇa aparāṃceṃ | dekhileṃ teṇeṃ ||8||
verses.meaning: Or, are there any false words in the speech of the four-faced Brahma? Therefore, he saw the complete truth of the others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाची सोय वेदां नाकळे। तयाचे सकळावयव एकेचि वेळे । अर्जुनाचे दोन्ही डोळे। भोगिते जाहळे॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayācī soya vedāṃ nākaḻe| tayāce sakaḻāvayava ekeci veḻe | arjunāce donhī ḍoḻe| bhogite jāhaḻe|| 9||
verses.meaning: Whose true nature is incomprehensible even to the Vedas, all of His limbs, at that very moment, became a feast for Arjuna's two eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चरणौनी मुकुटवरी। देखत विश्वरूपाची थोरी। जे नाना रत्न अळंकारीं। मिरवत असे॥२१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: caraṇaunī mukuṭavarī| dekhata viśvarūpācī thorī| je nānā ratna aḻaṃkārīṃ| miravata ase||210||
verses.meaning: From the feet to the crown, beholding the grandeur of the Universal Form, which shines with various jeweled ornaments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परब्रह्म आपुलेनि आंगें। ल्यावया आपणचि जाहल्या अनेगें। तियें लेणीं मी सांगें। काइसयासारिखीं॥ ९१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parabrahma āpuleni āṃgeṃ| lyāvayā āpaṇaci jāhalyā anegeṃ| tiyeṃ leṇīṃ mī sāṃgeṃ| kāisayāsārikhīṃ|| 919||
verses.meaning: The Supreme Brahman, by its own nature, became manifold to adorn itself. What can these ornaments be compared to?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये प्रभेचिये झळाळा । उजाळू चंद्रादित्यमंडळा । जे महातेजाचा जिव्हाळा । जेणें विश्व प्रगटे॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye prabheciye jhaḻāḻā | ujāḻū caṃdrādityamaṃḍaḻā | je mahātejācā jivhāḻā | jeṇeṃ viśva pragaṭe|| 12||
verses.meaning: By the radiance of which light, the moon and sun are illuminated; that which is the very essence of the great light, by which the universe manifests.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो दिव्यतेजशृंगारु । 'कोणाचिये मतीसी होय गोचरु । देव आपणपेंचि लेइले ऐसें बीरु। देखत असे॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to divyatejaśṛṃgāru | 'koṇāciye matīsī hoya gocaru | deva āpaṇapeṃci leile aiseṃ bīru| dekhata ase|| 13||
verses.meaning: Who can comprehend the divine splendor, as if God Himself has adorned Himself with such glory, and is seen in this form?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेथेंचि ज्ञानाचिया डोळां। पहात करपल्लवां जंव सरळा । तंब तोडित कल्पांतींचिया ज्वाळा । तेसीं शस्त्रें झळकत देखे॥९१४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tetheṃci jñānāciyā ḍoḻāṃ| pahāta karapallavāṃ jaṃva saraḻā | taṃba toḍita kalpāṃtīṃciyā jvāḻā | tesīṃ śastreṃ jhaḻakata dekhe||914||
verses.meaning: Then, with the eye of knowledge, he saw the weapons gleaming like the flames of the cosmic dissolution, as if they were cutting through the very branches of the kalpa-ending conflagration.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपण आंग आपण अलंकार। आपण हात आपण हतियार। आपण जीव आपण शरीर। देखे चराचर कोंदलें देवें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpaṇa āṃga āpaṇa alaṃkāra| āpaṇa hāta āpaṇa hatiyāra| āpaṇa jīva āpaṇa śarīra| dekhe carācara koṃdaleṃ deveṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: He Himself is the ornament, He Himself is the adorned. He Himself is the hand, He Himself is the weapon. He Himself is the life, He Himself is the body. Thus, the entire animate and inanimate world is seen to be pervaded by God.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचिया किरणांचे निखरपणें। नक्षत्रांचे होत फुटाणे। तेजें खिरडला वह्लि म्हणे। समुद्री रिघों॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃciyā kiraṇāṃce nikharapaṇeṃ| nakṣatrāṃce hota phuṭāṇe| tejeṃ khiraḍalā vahli mhaṇe| samudrī righoṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: The brilliance of whose rays causes the stars to burst forth, and whose intense heat makes even fire exclaim, "I shall enter the ocean!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग काळकूटकल्लोळीं कवळिलें। नाना महाविजूंचे दांग उमटळे। तैसे अपार कर देखिळे। उदितायुधीं ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kāḻakūṭakalloḻīṃ kavaḻileṃ| nānā mahāvijūṃce dāṃga umaṭaḻe| taise apāra kara dekhiḻe| uditāyudhīṃ || 17||
verses.meaning: Then, as if engulfed in a tumultuous ocean of poison, or as if countless formidable weapons had emerged, so were seen his innumerable arms, each bearing a weapon.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं भेणें तेथूनि काढिली दिठी। मग कंठमुगुट पहातसे किरीटी । तंव सुरतरूंची सृष्टी। जयापासोनि कां जाहली॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ bheṇeṃ tethūni kāḍhilī diṭhī| maga kaṃṭhamuguṭa pahātase kirīṭī | taṃva suratarūṃcī sṛṣṭī| jayāpāsoni kāṃ jāhalī|| 18||
verses.meaning: Or, out of fear, he averted his gaze from there. Then he looked at the crown on his neck, and saw that it was from him that the creation of wish-fulfilling trees had come into being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जियें महासिद्धींचीं मूळपीठें। शिणलळी कमळा जेथ वावटे। तैसीं कुसुमें अति चोखटें । तुरंबिलीं देखिलीं ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiyeṃ mahāsiddhīṃcīṃ mūḻapīṭheṃ| śiṇalaḻī kamaḻā jetha vāvaṭe| taisīṃ kusumeṃ ati cokhaṭeṃ | turaṃbilīṃ dekhilīṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Where the very foundations of great spiritual powers are established, and where the lotuses of the mind, though weary, still flutter, there I saw very pure and beautiful flowers adorned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुगुटावरी स्तबक। ठायीं ठायीं पूजाबंध अनेक । कंठीं रुळताति अलौकिक । माळादंड॥ २२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: muguṭāvarī stabaka| ṭhāyīṃ ṭhāyīṃ pūjābaṃdha aneka | kaṃṭhīṃ ruḻatāti alaukika | māḻādaṃḍa|| 220||
verses.meaning: On the crown, there are bouquets of flowers, and at various places, numerous garlands are tied for worship. Around the neck, extraordinary garlands hang down.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वर्ग सूर्यतेज वेढिलें। जेसें पंधरेनें मेरूतें मढिलें। तेसें नितंबावरी गाढिलें। पीतांबरु झळके ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: svarga sūryateja veḍhileṃ| jeseṃ paṃdhareneṃ merūteṃ maḍhileṃ| teseṃ nitaṃbāvarī gāḍhileṃ| pītāṃbaru jhaḻake || 29||
verses.meaning: The yellow garment shone, covering the hips, like the sun's brilliance enveloping heaven, or like the full moon adorning Mount Meru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीमहादेबो कापुरें उटिला। कां कैलासु पारजें डवरिला। नाना क्षीरोदकें 'पांघरविला। क्षीरार्णवो जैसा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīmahādebo kāpureṃ uṭilā| kāṃ kailāsu pārajeṃ ḍavarilā| nānā kṣīrodakeṃ 'pāṃgharavilā| kṣīrārṇavo jaisā|| 22||
verses.meaning: It is as if Lord Mahadeva Himself has been anointed with camphor, or Mount Kailash has been adorned with a white garment, or the milky ocean has been covered with various milky waters.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेसी चंद्रमयाची घडी उपलबिली। मग गगनाकरवीं बुंथी घेवविली। तैसी चंदनपिंजरी देखिली । सर्वांगी २२२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तेणें॥२३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jesī caṃdramayācī ghaḍī upalabilī| maga gaganākaravīṃ buṃthī ghevavilī| taisī caṃdanapiṃjarī dekhilī | sarvāṃgī 222 śrījñāneśvarī teṇeṃ||23||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon's orb is revealed, and then the sky is made to embrace it, so too did Dnyaneshwari appear, like a fragrant sandalwood cage, enveloping all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें स्वप्रकाशा कांती चढे। ब्रह्मानंदाचा निदाघु मोडे । जयाचेनि सौरभ्यें जीवित जोडे । वेदवतीये ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ svaprakāśā kāṃtī caḍhe| brahmānaṃdācā nidāghu moḍe | jayāceni saurabhyeṃ jīvita joḍe | vedavatīye || 24||
verses.meaning: By whose self-effulgence, splendor increases; the heat of Brahmananda is dispelled. By whose fragrance, life is attained, O Vedavati.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचे निळेंप अनुलेपु करी। जे अनंगुही सर्वांगी धरी। तया सुगंधाची थोरी । कवण वानी॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāce niḻeṃpa anulepu karī| je anaṃguhī sarvāṃgī dharī| tayā sugaṃdhācī thorī | kavaṇa vānī|| 25||
verses.meaning: Whose mere touch becomes an anointing, who holds even the bodiless (Cupid) within their being, who can describe the greatness of that fragrance?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी एकैक श्रेंगारशोभा। पाहतां अर्जुन जातसे क्षोभा। तेवींचि देवो बैसला कौं उभा। कीं शयालु हें नेणवे॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī ekaika śreṃgāraśobhā| pāhatāṃ arjuna jātase kṣobhā| tevīṃci devo baisalā kauṃ ubhā| kīṃ śayālu heṃ neṇave|| 26||
verses.meaning: As Arjuna beheld each such beautiful adornment, he was filled with wonder. Similarly, it was unclear whether the Lord was seated or standing, or even reclining.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाहेर दिठी उघडोनि पाहे। तंब आधवें मूर्तिमय देखत आहे। मग आतां न पाहें म्हणौनि उगा राहे। तरी आंतुही तैसेंचि ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāhera diṭhī ughaḍoni pāhe| taṃba ādhaveṃ mūrtimaya dekhata āhe| maga ātāṃ na pāheṃ mhaṇauni ugā rāhe| tarī āṃtuhī taiseṃci || 27||
verses.meaning: When one opens their eyes and looks outside, they see everything as having form. Then, if they decide not to look and remain silent, they find the same within themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनाबरें मुखें समोर देखे । तयाभेणें पाठीमोरा जंव ठाके । तंव तयाहीकडे श्रीमुखें। करचरण तैसेचि ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: anābareṃ mukheṃ samora dekhe | tayābheṇeṃ pāṭhīmorā jaṃva ṭhāke | taṃva tayāhīkaḍe śrīmukheṃ| karacaraṇa taiseci || 28||
verses.meaning: When one sees an ugly face before them, they turn their back in fear. But even then, the divine face, hands, and feet are present on that side as well.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो पाहतां कीर प्रतिभासे। एथ नवलावो काय असे। परि न पाहतांही दिसे। चोज आइका॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho pāhatāṃ kīra pratibhāse| etha navalāvo kāya ase| pari na pāhatāṃhī dise| coja āikā|| 29||
verses.meaning: Indeed, it appears when seen; what wonder is there in that? But hear the marvel: it is seen even without seeing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसें अनुग्रहाचें करणें । पार्थाचें पाहणें आणि न पाहणें । 'तयाहीसकट नारायणें। व्यापूनि घेतलें॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaiseṃ anugrahāceṃ karaṇeṃ | pārthāceṃ pāhaṇeṃ āṇi na pāhaṇeṃ | 'tayāhīsakaṭa nārāyaṇeṃ| vyāpūni ghetaleṃ|| 230||
verses.meaning: How the grace was bestowed! Arjuna's seeing and not seeing—even with that, Narayana encompassed everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आश्‍चर्याच्या पुरीं एकीं। पडिला ठायेंठाव थडीं ठाकी। तंब चमत्काराचिया आणिकीं । महार्णवीं पडे॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āś‍caryācyā purīṃ ekīṃ| paḍilā ṭhāyeṃṭhāva thaḍīṃ ṭhākī| taṃba camatkārāciyā āṇikīṃ | mahārṇavīṃ paḍe|| 31||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in the city of wonder, one falls from place to place, reaching the shore, and then again plunges into another great ocean of marvels.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अर्जुनु असाधारणें। आपुलिया दर्शनाचेनि विंदाणें। कवळूनि घेतला तेणें । अनंतरूपें॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā arjunu asādhāraṇeṃ| āpuliyā darśanāceni viṃdāṇeṃ| kavaḻūni ghetalā teṇeṃ | anaṃtarūpeṃ|| 32||
verses.meaning: Thus, Arjuna, by the extraordinary display of His own form, was embraced by that Infinite Being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो विश्‍वतोमुख स्वभावें। आणि तेंचि दावावयालागीं पांडवें। प्रार्थिला आतां आघवें। होऊनि ठेला॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to viś‍vatomukha svabhāveṃ| āṇi teṃci dāvāvayālāgīṃ pāṃḍaveṃ| prārthilā ātāṃ āghaveṃ| hoūni ṭhelā|| 33||
verses.meaning: That all-pervading nature, and to reveal that very nature, Arjuna prayed, and now He has become all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि दौीपें कां सूर्ये प्रगटे। अथवा निमुटलिया देखावेंचि खुंटे । तैसी दिठी नव्हे जे वैकुंठें। दिधली आहे ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi dauīpeṃ kāṃ sūrye pragaṭe| athavā nimuṭaliyā dekhāveṃci khuṃṭe | taisī diṭhī navhe je vaikuṃṭheṃ| didhalī āhe || 34||
verses.meaning: It is not like a lamp that reveals the sun, nor does it cease to exist when one closes their eyes. Such is not the sight bestowed by Vaikuntha (the divine abode).

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि किरीटीसि दोहीं परी। तें देखणें देखें अंधारीं। हें संजयो हस्तिनापुरीं । सांगतसे राया॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kirīṭīsi dohīṃ parī| teṃ dekhaṇeṃ dekheṃ aṃdhārīṃ| heṃ saṃjayo hastināpurīṃ | sāṃgatase rāyā|| 35||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Kiriti, in both ways, that seeing is seen in darkness. This, Sanjaya, in Hastinapura, is telling the King.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे किंबहुना अवधारिलें। पार्थे विश्वरूप देखिलें। नाना आभरणीं भरलें। विश्‍्वतोमुख॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe kiṃbahunā avadhārileṃ| pārthe viśvarūpa dekhileṃ| nānā ābharaṇīṃ bharaleṃ| viś‍vatomukha|| 36||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, having seen the Cosmic Form, was filled with countless ornaments, and it had faces everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये अंगप्रभेचा देवा। नबलावो काइसया ऐसा सांगावा । कल्पांती 'एकुचि मेळावा । द्वादशादित्यांचा होय॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye aṃgaprabhecā devā| nabalāvo kāisayā aisā sāṃgāvā | kalpāṃtī 'ekuci meḻāvā | dvādaśādityāṃcā hoya|| 37||
verses.meaning: How can I describe the splendor of that divine form? It is like the gathering of the twelve suns at the end of a cosmic cycle, all united in one brilliant confluence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे ते दिव्यसूर्य सहस्त्रवरी । जरी उदयजती कां एकेचि अवसरीं। तऱही तया तेजाची थोरी । उपमूं नये॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise te divyasūrya sahastravarī | jarī udayajatī kāṃ ekeci avasarīṃ| taṟahī tayā tejācī thorī | upamūṃ naye|| 38||
verses.meaning: Even if a thousand divine suns were to rise simultaneously, their combined brilliance would not compare to that supreme light.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आघवयाचि विजूंचा मेळावा कीजे। आणि प्रळयाग्नीची सर्व सामग्री आणिजे । तेवींचि दशकुही मेळविजे । महातेजांचा ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āghavayāci vijūṃcā meḻāvā kīje| āṇi praḻayāgnīcī sarva sāmagrī āṇije | tevīṃci daśakuhī meḻavije | mahātejāṃcā || 39||
verses.meaning: Gather all the lightning bolts, and bring forth all the materials for the fire of cosmic dissolution. Similarly, collect ten such assemblies of immense brilliance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तऱही तिये अंगप्रभेचेनि पाडें। हें तेज कांहीं कांहीं होईल थोडें । आणि तयाऐसें कीर चोखडें । त्रिशुद्धी नोहे ॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṟahī tiye aṃgaprabheceni pāḍeṃ| heṃ teja kāṃhīṃ kāṃhīṃ hoīla thoḍeṃ | āṇi tayāaiseṃ kīra cokhaḍeṃ | triśuddhī nohe || 240||
verses.meaning: Even the radiance of that divine form would make this light seem insignificant. And truly, nothing in the three worlds can compare to its purity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें माहात्म्य या श्रीहरीचें सहज । फांकतसे सर्वांगींचें तेज। तें मुनिकृपा जी मज। दृष्ट जाहळें॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ māhātmya yā śrīharīceṃ sahaja | phāṃkatase sarvāṃgīṃceṃ teja| teṃ munikṛpā jī maja| dṛṣṭa jāhaḻeṃ|| 41||
verses.meaning: Such is the glory of Lord Shri Hari, whose inherent radiance spreads everywhere. This I have been able to perceive through the grace of my Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तिये विश्वरूपीं एकीकडे। जग आघवें आपुळेनि पवाडें । जैसें महोदधीमाजीं बुडबुडे। सिनाने दिसती ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tiye viśvarūpīṃ ekīkaḍe| jaga āghaveṃ āpuḻeni pavāḍeṃ | jaiseṃ mahodadhīmājīṃ buḍabuḍe| sināne disatī || 42||
verses.meaning: And in that Cosmic Form, on one side, the entire world, with its vastness, appears like bubbles in the great ocean, visible as they emerge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां आकाशीं गंधर्वनगर। भूतळीं पिपीलिका बांधे घर। नाना मेरुवरी सपुर। परमाणु बैसळे॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ākāśīṃ gaṃdharvanagara| bhūtaḻīṃ pipīlikā bāṃdhe ghara| nānā meruvarī sapura| paramāṇu baisaḻe|| 43||
verses.meaning: Or like a city of Gandharvas in the sky, or an ant building its home on the earth, or a tiny atom sitting upon the great Meru mountain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विश्व आघवेंचि तयापरी। तया देवचक्रवर्तीचिया शरीरीं। अर्जुन तिये अवसरीं । देखता जाहला॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: viśva āghaveṃci tayāparī| tayā devacakravartīciyā śarīrīṃ| arjuna tiye avasarīṃ | dekhatā jāhalā|| 44||
verses.meaning: In that very manner, Arjuna, at that moment, beheld the entire universe within the body of that Emperor of Gods.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ एक विश्व एक आपण । ऐसें अळुमाळ होतें जें दुजेपण । तेंही आटोनि गेलें अंतःकरण । विरालें सहसा ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha eka viśva eka āpaṇa | aiseṃ aḻumāḻa hoteṃ jeṃ dujepaṇa | teṃhī āṭoni geleṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇa | virāleṃ sahasā || 45||
verses.meaning: There, the distinction of 'one world' and 'one self' that subtly existed, that duality too dissolved within the heart, suddenly merging into oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंतु आनंदा चेडरें जाहलें। बाहेरि गात्रांचें बळ हारपोनि गेळें। आपाद पां गुंतलें। पुलकांचलें॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃtu ānaṃdā ceḍareṃ jāhaleṃ| bāheri gātrāṃceṃ baḻa hāraponi geḻeṃ| āpāda pāṃ guṃtaleṃ| pulakāṃcaleṃ|| 46||
verses.meaning: Within, a surge of joy arose, while outwardly, the body's strength vanished. From head to toe, it was enveloped in goosebumps.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वार्षिये प्रथमदशे। बोहळलया शैलांचें सर्वांग जैसें। विरुढे कोमल्ांकुरीं तैसे। रोमाञ्यच जाहळे॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vārṣiye prathamadaśe| bohaḻalayā śailāṃceṃ sarvāṃga jaiseṃ| viruḍhe komalāṃkurīṃ taise| romāñyaca jāhaḻe|| 47||
verses.meaning: In the first year of the monsoon, just as the entire body of the mountains, having been washed clean, sprouts tender shoots, so too did goosebumps appear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शिवतला चंद्रकरीं। सोमकांतु द्रावो धरी । तैसिया स्वेदकणिका शरीरीं । दाटलिया ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: śivatalā caṃdrakarīṃ| somakāṃtu drāvo dharī | taisiyā svedakaṇikā śarīrīṃ | dāṭaliyā || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the moonstone melts and exudes liquid when touched by moonlight, so too did beads of perspiration densely cover the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माजीं सांपडळेनि अलिकुळें। जळावरी कमळकळिका जेवीं आंदोळे | तेवीं आंतुळिया सुखोर्माचेनि बळें । बाहेरि कांपे॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājīṃ sāṃpaḍaḻeni alikuḻeṃ| jaḻāvarī kamaḻakaḻikā jevīṃ āṃdoḻe | tevīṃ āṃtuḻiyā sukhormāceni baḻeṃ | bāheri kāṃpe|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as a lotus bud trembles on the water, caught in the swarm of bees, so too does the body tremble outwardly, empowered by the inner surge of bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्प्रकर्दळीचीं गर्भपुटें। उकलतां कापुराचेनि कोंदाटें । पुलिका गळती तेवीं थेबुटें । नेत्रौनि पडती ॥ २५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: karprakardaḻīcīṃ garbhapuṭeṃ| ukalatāṃ kāpurāceni koṃdāṭeṃ | pulikā gaḻatī tevīṃ thebuṭeṃ | netrauni paḍatī || 250||
verses.meaning: Just as when the layers of a camphor plant are peeled, drops of camphor fall, so too tears stream from the eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदयलेनि सुधाकरें। जैसा भरलाचि समुद्र भरे। तैसा वेळोवेळां ऊर्मिभरें। उचंबळत असे॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: udayaleni sudhākareṃ| jaisā bharalāci samudra bhare| taisā veḻoveḻāṃ ūrmibhareṃ| ucaṃbaḻata ase|| 51||
verses.meaning: Just as the ocean, already full, swells even more with the rising of the moon, so too does it surge again and again with waves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा सात्त्विकांही आठां भावां। परस्परें वर्ततसे हेवा। तेथ ब्रह्मानंदाची जीवा। राणीब फावली॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā sāttvikāṃhī āṭhāṃ bhāvāṃ| paraspareṃ vartatase hevā| tetha brahmānaṃdācī jīvā| rāṇība phāvalī|| 52||
verses.meaning: Thus, even among the eight sattvic emotions, a mutual longing for the Supreme Bliss arises, and the soul attains the sovereignty of that Brahmananda.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसाचि तया सुखानुभवापाठीं। केला ह्ैताचा सांभाळु दिठी । मग उसासौनि किरीटी । बास पाहिली॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisāci tayā sukhānubhavāpāṭhīṃ| kelā haitācā sāṃbhāḻu diṭhī | maga usāsauni kirīṭī | bāsa pāhilī|| 53||
verses.meaning: In the same way, after experiencing that bliss, the duality was preserved by the sight. Then, sighing, O Kiriti, he saw the flute.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ बैसला होता जिया सवा। तियाचियाकडे मस्तक खालविला देवा। मग जोडूनि करसंपुट बरवा । बोलतु असे॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha baisalā hotā jiyā savā| tiyāciyākaḍe mastaka khālavilā devā| maga joḍūni karasaṃpuṭa baravā | bolatu ase|| 54||
verses.meaning: Then, towards the direction where he was seated, the Lord bowed his head. And then, joining his beautiful hands in reverence, he began to speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे जयजयाजी स्वामी । नवल कृपा केली तुम्हीं । जें हें विश्वरूप कीं आम्ही । प्राकृत देखों ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe jayajayājī svāmī | navala kṛpā kelī tumhīṃ | jeṃ heṃ viśvarūpa kīṃ āmhī | prākṛta dekhoṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: He says, "Hail, hail, O Lord! You have shown wondrous grace, that we, ordinary beings, can behold this cosmic form."

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि साचचि भलें केलें गोसाविया। मज 'परितोषु जाहला साविया । जी देखिलासि जो इया । सृष्टीसी तूं आश्रयो ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari sācaci bhaleṃ keleṃ gosāviyā| maja 'paritoṣu jāhalā sāviyā | jī dekhilāsi jo iyā | sṛṣṭīsī tūṃ āśrayo || 56||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Lord, you have done well. I am completely satisfied, for I have seen you, who are the support of this entire creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा मंदराचेनि अंगलगें । ठायीं ठायीं इवापदांचीं दांगें । तैसीं इयें तुझ्या देहीं अनेगें। देखतसें भुवनें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā maṃdarāceni aṃgalageṃ | ṭhāyīṃ ṭhāyīṃ ivāpadāṃcīṃ dāṃgeṃ | taisīṃ iyeṃ tujhyā dehīṃ anegeṃ| dekhataseṃ bhuvaneṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: Just as a mountain's body is adorned with many caves, so too do I see countless worlds within your form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो आकाशाचिये खोळे । दिसती ग्रहगणांचीं कुळें) कां महावृक्षीं अविसाळें। पक्षिजातीचीं ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho ākāśāciye khoḻe | disatī grahagaṇāṃcīṃ kuḻeṃ) kāṃ mahāvṛkṣīṃ avisāḻeṃ| pakṣijātīcīṃ || 58||
verses.meaning: Just as in the vast expanse of the sky, families of planets are seen, or like on a mighty tree, various species of birds gather.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी श्रीहरी । तुझिया विश्वात्मकीं इये शरीरीं । स्वर्गु देखतसें अवधारीं । सुरगणेंसीं ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī śrīharī | tujhiyā viśvātmakīṃ iye śarīrīṃ | svargu dekhataseṃ avadhārīṃ | suragaṇeṃsīṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: In this way, O Shrihari, in this cosmic body of Yours, I behold heaven with all its celestial hosts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रभु महाभूतांचें पंचक । येथ देखत आहें अनेक । आणि भूतग्राम एकेक । भूतसृष्टीचें ॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: prabhu mahābhūtāṃceṃ paṃcaka | yetha dekhata āheṃ aneka | āṇi bhūtagrāma ekeka | bhūtasṛṣṭīceṃ || 260||
verses.meaning: O Lord, I see here the multitude of the five great elements, and each individual living being, part of the creation of beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी सत्यलोकु तुजमाजीं आहे । देखिला चतुराननु हा नोहे। आणि येरीकडे जंब पाहें॥ तंव कैलासुही दिसे॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī satyaloku tujamājīṃ āhe | dekhilā caturānanu hā nohe| āṇi yerīkaḍe jaṃba pāheṃ|| taṃva kailāsuhī dise|| 61||
verses.meaning: The realm of truth (Satyaloka) is within you; the four-faced Brahma is not seen as separate. And when I look in the other direction, even Kailasa (Shiva's abode) is visible within you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीमहादेव भवानियेशीं। तुझ्या दिसतसे एके अंशीं। आणि तूंतेंही गा हृषीकेशी । तुजमाजीं देखें॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīmahādeva bhavāniyeśīṃ| tujhyā disatase eke aṃśīṃ| āṇi tūṃteṃhī gā hṛṣīkeśī | tujamājīṃ dekheṃ|| 62||
verses.meaning: O Lord of the senses, I see Lord Mahadeva and Bhavani as a part of you, and I also see you within them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं कश्यपादि क्रषिकुळें। इयें तुझिया स्वरूपी सकळें । देखतसें पाताळें। पन्नगेंशीं ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kaśyapādi kraṣikuḻeṃ| iyeṃ tujhiyā svarūpī sakaḻeṃ | dekhataseṃ pātāḻeṃ| pannageṃśīṃ || 63||
verses.meaning: O Lord, I see all the lineages of sages like Kashyapa, and the netherworlds with their serpents, all within Your form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना त्रैलोक्यपती । तुझिया एकेकाचि अवयवाचिये भिंती । इयें चतुर्दशभुवनें चित्राकृती। अंकुरलीं जाणों॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā trailokyapatī | tujhiyā ekekāci avayavāciye bhiṃtī | iyeṃ caturdaśabhuvaneṃ citrākṛtī| aṃkuralīṃ jāṇoṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Lord of the three worlds, these fourteen realms are like painted figures, as if they have sprouted from the very walls of your individual limbs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तेथिंचे जे जे लोक । ते चित्ररचना जी अनेक । ऐसें देखतसें अलौकिक । गांभीर्य तुझें ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tethiṃce je je loka | te citraracanā jī aneka | aiseṃ dekhataseṃ alaukika | gāṃbhīrya tujheṃ || 65 ||
verses.meaning: And all the people there, they see your extraordinary profundity as if it were many wondrous paintings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्या दिव्यचक्षूंचेनि पैसें । चहूंकडे जंब पाहात असें। तंब दोर्दंडीं कां जैसें आकाश कोंभेलें॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tyā divyacakṣūṃceni paiseṃ | cahūṃkaḍe jaṃba pāhāta aseṃ| taṃba dordaṃḍīṃ kāṃ jaiseṃ ākāśa koṃbheleṃ|| 66||
verses.meaning: With the expanse of those divine eyes, as I looked all around, it was as if the sky itself had condensed into two mighty arms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसे एकचि निरंतर। देवा देखत असें तुझे 'कर। करीत आघवेचि व्यापार। एकेचि काळीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tese ekaci niraṃtara| devā dekhata aseṃ tujhe 'kara| karīta āghaveci vyāpāra| ekeci kāḻīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: In the same way, I continuously see all your deeds, O God, being performed by your single hand at the same time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग महाशून्याचेनि पैसारें। उघडलीं ब्रह्मकटाहाचीं भांडारें। तैसीं देखतसें अपारें। उदरें तुझीं ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mahāśūnyāceni paisāreṃ| ughaḍalīṃ brahmakaṭāhācīṃ bhāṃḍāreṃ| taisīṃ dekhataseṃ apāreṃ| udareṃ tujhīṃ || 68 ||
verses.meaning: Then, as if through the vast expanse of the great void, the storehouses of the cosmic egg of Brahman were opened, so do I behold your innumerable forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी सहस्त्रशीर्षयाचें देखिळें। कोडीवरी होताति एकिवेळें। कीं परब्रह्मचि बदनफळें । मोडोनि आलें॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī sahastraśīrṣayāceṃ dekhiḻeṃ| koḍīvarī hotāti ekiveḻeṃ| kīṃ parabrahmaci badanaphaḻeṃ | moḍoni āleṃ|| 69||
verses.meaning: As if a million manifestations of the thousand-headed being (Vishnu) were to appear simultaneously, or as if the Supreme Brahman itself had descended in a physical form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेैसीं वक्‍्त्रें जेउतीं तेउतीं । तुझीं देखतसें बिशवबमूर्ती। आणि तयाचिपरी नेत्रपंक्ती। अनेका सैंघ॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teaisīṃ vak‍treṃ jeutīṃ teutīṃ | tujhīṃ dekhataseṃ biśavabamūrtī| āṇi tayāciparī netrapaṃktī| anekā saiṃgha|| 270||
verses.meaning: Wherever I look, I see Your universal form, with countless mouths and innumerable eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो स्वर्ग पाताळ। कीं भूमी दिशा अंतराळ। हे विवक्षा ठेळी सकळ। मूर्तिमय देखतसें ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso svarga pātāḻa| kīṃ bhūmī diśā aṃtarāḻa| he vivakṣā ṭheḻī sakaḻa| mūrtimaya dekhataseṃ || 71||
verses.meaning: Let it be heaven or the netherworld, or the earth, directions, or the sky; setting aside all such distinctions, I perceive everything as embodied (divine form).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुजवीण एकादियाकडे । परमाणूहि एतुला कोडें । अवकाशु 'पाहतसें परि न सांपडे । ऐसें व्यापिले तुवां ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujavīṇa ekādiyākaḍe | paramāṇūhi etulā koḍeṃ | avakāśu 'pāhataseṃ pari na sāṃpaḍe | aiseṃ vyāpile tuvāṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: Without You, even a single atom, with such longing, searches for space but finds none, so completely are You pervasive.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इये नानापरी अपरिमितें। जेतुलीं सांठविलीं होतीं महाभूतें। तेतुलाही पवाडु तुवां अनंतें। कोंदला देखतसें ॥७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: iye nānāparī aparimiteṃ| jetulīṃ sāṃṭhavilīṃ hotīṃ mahābhūteṃ| tetulāhī pavāḍu tuvāṃ anaṃteṃ| koṃdalā dekhataseṃ ||73||
verses.meaning: In this way, all the innumerable great elements that were contained within you, O Infinite One, I see that you have filled and pervaded them all to their utmost extent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा कवणे ठायाहूनि तूं आलासी । एथ बैसलासि कौ उभा आहासी । आणि तूं कवणिये मायेचिये पोटीं होतासी। तुझें ठाण केवढें॥७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā kavaṇe ṭhāyāhūni tūṃ ālāsī | etha baisalāsi kau ubhā āhāsī | āṇi tūṃ kavaṇiye māyeciye poṭīṃ hotāsī| tujheṃ ṭhāṇa kevaḍheṃ||74||
verses.meaning: From what place have You come? Are You seated here or standing? And from which mother's womb were You born? How vast is Your abode?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुझें रूप वय कैसें। तुज पैलीकडे काय असे। तूं 'काइसयावरी आहासि ऐसें। पाहिलें मियां ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujheṃ rūpa vaya kaiseṃ| tuja pailīkaḍe kāya ase| tūṃ 'kāisayāvarī āhāsi aiseṃ| pāhileṃ miyāṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: What is Your form, Your age? What exists beyond You? Upon what do You rest? All this I have seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब देखिले जी आघवेंचि । तरि आतां तुझा ठावो तूंचि। तूं कवणाचा नव्हेसि ऐसाचि। अनादि आयता ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba dekhile jī āghaveṃci | tari ātāṃ tujhā ṭhāvo tūṃci| tūṃ kavaṇācā navhesi aisāci| anādi āyatā || 76||
verses.meaning: Having seen all this, you are now your own abode. You are not anyone's, but eternally self-existent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं उभा ना बैठा । दिघडु ना खुजटा। तुज तळींबरी वैकुंठा । तूंचि आहासी॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ ubhā nā baiṭhā | dighaḍu nā khujaṭā| tuja taḻīṃbarī vaikuṃṭhā | tūṃci āhāsī|| 77||
verses.meaning: You are neither standing nor sitting, neither tall nor short. The entire Vaikuntha is beneath your feet, for you are indeed that very essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं रूपें आपणयांचि ऐसा। देवा तुझी तूंचि वयसा । 'पाठी पोट परेशा। तुझें तूं गा ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ rūpeṃ āpaṇayāṃci aisā| devā tujhī tūṃci vayasā | 'pāṭhī poṭa pareśā| tujheṃ tūṃ gā || 78||
verses.meaning: O Lord, You are Your own form, Your own age. You are Your own beginning and end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना आतां। तुझें तूंचि आधवें अनंता । हें पुढत पुढती पाहतां। देखिलें मियां॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā ātāṃ| tujheṃ tūṃci ādhaveṃ anaṃtā | heṃ puḍhata puḍhatī pāhatāṃ| dekhileṃ miyāṃ|| 79||
verses.meaning: In short, O Infinite One, you alone are your own support. This is what I have repeatedly observed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि या तुझिया रूपाआंतु।) जी उणीव एक असें देखतु। जे आदि मध्य अंतु। तिन्ही नाहीं ॥ २८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari yā tujhiyā rūpāāṃtu|) jī uṇīva eka aseṃ dekhatu| je ādi madhya aṃtu| tinhī nāhīṃ || 280||
verses.meaning: But in this form of Yours, I perceive one deficiency: that it has no beginning, middle, or end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं गिंवसलें आघवा ठायीं । परि सोय न लाहेचि कहीं । म्हणोनि त्रिशुद्धी हे नाहीं। तीन्ही एथ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ giṃvasaleṃ āghavā ṭhāyīṃ | pari soya na lāheci kahīṃ | mhaṇoni triśuddhī he nāhīṃ| tīnhī etha|| 81||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, it is sought everywhere, but its true nature is never found. Therefore, it is certainly not present in these three states.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं आदिमध्यांतरहिता । तूं विश्वेश्‍्वरा अपरिमिता। देखिलासि जी तत्त्वता । विश्‍वरूपा॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ ādimadhyāṃtarahitā | tūṃ viśveś‍varā aparimitā| dekhilāsi jī tattvatā | viś‍varūpā|| 82||
verses.meaning: Thus, O Lord of the universe, You are without beginning, middle, or end, O immeasurable One. I have truly seen You in Your universal form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुज महामूर्तीचिया आंगीं । उमटलिया पृथक्‌ मूर्ती अनेगी। ळेइलासि वानेपरींची आंगीं। ऐसा आवडतु आहासी ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuja mahāmūrtīciyā āṃgīṃ | umaṭaliyā pṛthak‌ mūrtī anegī| ḻeilāsi vāneparīṃcī āṃgīṃ| aisā āvaḍatu āhāsī || 83||
verses.meaning: Upon your grand form, many distinct forms have manifested. You have adorned yourself with various hues, and thus you are beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना पृथक्‌ मूर्ती तिया द्रुमबल्ली । तुझिया स्वरूपमहाचळीं। दिव्यालंकार फुलीं फळीं। सासिन्नलिया ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā pṛthak‌ mūrtī tiyā drumaballī | tujhiyā svarūpamahācaḻīṃ| divyālaṃkāra phulīṃ phaḻīṃ| sāsinnaliyā || 84||
verses.meaning: Various distinct forms, those trees and vines, on the great mountain of Your true nature, adorned with divine ornaments, in flowers and fruits, are ever-present.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां जे महोदधी तूं देवा । जाहलासि तरंगमूर्ती हेलावा। कीं तूं एक वृक्षु बरवा । मूर्तिफळीं फळलासी॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ je mahodadhī tūṃ devā | jāhalāsi taraṃgamūrtī helāvā| kīṃ tūṃ eka vṛkṣu baravā | mūrtiphaḻīṃ phaḻalāsī|| 85||
verses.meaning: Are you not, O God, the great ocean itself, from which the waves playfully arise? Or are you a beautiful tree, laden with the fruits of various forms?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी भूतीं भूतळ मांडिलें। जैसें नक्षत्रीं २२६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी गगन गुढलें। तैसें मूर्तिमय भरलें। देखतसें तुझें रूप॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī bhūtīṃ bhūtaḻa māṃḍileṃ| jaiseṃ nakṣatrīṃ 226 śrījñāneśvarī gagana guḍhaleṃ| taiseṃ mūrtimaya bharaleṃ| dekhataseṃ tujheṃ rūpa|| 86||
verses.meaning: Just as the earth is established within all beings, and the sky is enveloped by the stars, so too do I perceive your form, pervading everything in its manifest glory.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी एकेकीच्या अंगप्रांतीं । होय जाय हें त्रिजगती । एवढियाही तुझ्या आंगीं मूर्ती । कीं रोमां जालिया ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī ekekīcyā aṃgaprāṃtīṃ | hoya jāya heṃ trijagatī | evaḍhiyāhī tujhyā āṃgīṃ mūrtī | kīṃ romāṃ jāliyā || 87||
verses.meaning: The entire three worlds are created and dissolved within each part of your being. Yet, are these worlds even a part of your form, or are they merely like the hairs on your body?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा पवाडु मांडूनि विश्वाचा। तूं कवण पां एथ कोणाचा । हें पाहिलें तंव आमुचा । सारथी तोचि तूं ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā pavāḍu māṃḍūni viśvācā| tūṃ kavaṇa pāṃ etha koṇācā | heṃ pāhileṃ taṃva āmucā | sārathī toci tūṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: Having thus unfolded the spectacle of the universe, when I pondered who you are and to whom you belong, I realized that you are indeed our charioteer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मज पाहतां मुकुंदा। तूं ऐसाचि व्यापकु सर्वदा । मग भक्तानुग्रहें तया मुग्धा । रूपातें धरिसी ॥८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī maja pāhatāṃ mukuṃdā| tūṃ aisāci vyāpaku sarvadā | maga bhaktānugraheṃ tayā mugdhā | rūpāteṃ dharisī ||89||
verses.meaning: Yet, when I behold You, Mukunda, You are always thus, all-pervading. But out of grace for Your devotees, You assume a form for those simple-minded ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसें चहूं भुजांचें सांवळें।॥ पाहतां बोल्हावती मन डोळे । खेंब देऊं जाइजे तरी आकळे । दोहींचि बाहीं॥ २९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaiseṃ cahūṃ bhujāṃceṃ sāṃvaḻeṃ||| pāhatāṃ bolhāvatī mana ḍoḻe | kheṃba deūṃ jāije tarī ākaḻe | dohīṃci bāhīṃ|| 290||
verses.meaning: How the dark-hued four-armed form, when seen, delights the mind and eyes! If one tries to embrace it, it is grasped by both arms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी मूर्ति 'कोडिसवाणी कृपा। करूनि होसी ना विश्‍्वरूपा। कौं आमुचियाचि दिठी सलेपा। जें सामान्यत्वें देखिती ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī mūrti 'koḍisavāṇī kṛpā| karūni hosī nā viś‍varūpā| kauṃ āmuciyāci diṭhī salepā| jeṃ sāmānyatveṃ dekhitī || 91||
verses.meaning: Oh Vishwaroopa, will you not, with such a form, bestow your grace upon us? Why do our eyes, which perceive you as ordinary, remain veiled?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आतां दिठीचा विटाळू गेला । तुवां सहजें दिव्यचक्षू केला । म्हणौनि यथारूपें देखवला । महिमा तुझा ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātāṃ diṭhīcā viṭāḻū gelā | tuvāṃ sahajeṃ divyacakṣū kelā | mhaṇauni yathārūpeṃ dekhavalā | mahimā tujhā || 92||
verses.meaning: Now, the impurity of my sight is gone. You have effortlessly bestowed upon me divine vision. Therefore, I could behold your glory in its true form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी मकरतुंडामागिलेकडे । तोचि होतासि तूं एवढें। रूप जाहलासि हें फुडें । बोळखिलें मियां॥९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī makaratuṃḍāmāgilekaḍe | toci hotāsi tūṃ evaḍheṃ| rūpa jāhalāsi heṃ phuḍeṃ | boḻakhileṃ miyāṃ||93||
verses.meaning: But behind the elephant-headed one, you were indeed that very same one. This form has now become manifest, and I have recognized it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नोहे तोचि हा शिरीं। मुकुट लेइलासि श्रीहरी । परी आतांचें तेज आणि थोरी । नवल कौं बहु हें ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nohe toci hā śirīṃ| mukuṭa leilāsi śrīharī | parī ātāṃceṃ teja āṇi thorī | navala kauṃ bahu heṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: O Shrihari, it is indeed the same crown you have worn before, but the radiance and greatness it possesses now are truly wondrous and extraordinary!

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि हें वरिळियेचि हातीं । चक्र परिजितया आयती । सांवरितासि विश्‍वमूर्ती। ते न मोडे खूण॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci heṃ variḻiyeci hātīṃ | cakra parijitayā āyatī | sāṃvaritāsi viś‍vamūrtī| te na moḍe khūṇa|| 95||
verses.meaning: That very same wheel, held in your upper hand, O Universal Form, you wield for the protection of your devotees, and this secret of your power remains unbroken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरीकडे तेचि हे नोहे गदा। आणि तळिलिया दोनी भुजा निरायुधा। वागोरे सांवरावया गोविंदा । संसरिलिया ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yerīkaḍe teci he nohe gadā| āṇi taḻiliyā donī bhujā nirāyudhā| vāgore sāṃvarāvayā goviṃdā | saṃsariliyā || 96||
verses.meaning: On the other hand, this is not that same mace. And when both arms were rendered weaponless, Govinda quickly came to support them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तेणेंचि वेगें सहसा । माझिया मनोरथासरिसा । जाहलासि विश्वरूपा विशवेशा। म्हणौनि जाणें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi teṇeṃci vegeṃ sahasā | mājhiyā manorathāsarisā | jāhalāsi viśvarūpā viśaveśā| mhaṇauni jāṇeṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: And with that very speed, O Vishvesha, you have suddenly become the Universal Form, just as my heart desired. Therefore, I know you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी कायसें बा हें चोज । विस्मयो करावयाहि पाडू नाहीं मज। चित्त होऊनि जातसे निर्बुज। आश्चर्ये येणें॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī kāyaseṃ bā heṃ coja | vismayo karāvayāhi pāḍū nāhīṃ maja| citta hoūni jātase nirbuja| āścarye yeṇeṃ|| 98||
verses.meaning: But what is this, O child? I have no room even for wonder. My mind becomes utterly still, overcome by this astonishment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें एथ आधि कां येथ नाहीं। ऐसें श्‍वसोंही नये कांहीं । नवल अंगप्रभेची नवाई । कैसी कोंदली सेंघ ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ etha ādhi kāṃ yetha nāhīṃ| aiseṃ ś‍vasoṃhī naye kāṃhīṃ | navala aṃgaprabhecī navāī | kaisī koṃdalī seṃgha || 99||
verses.meaning: Whether it was here before or not, such a thought should not even be breathed. How wonderfully the newness of its inherent radiance is enshrined!

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ अग्नीचीही दिठी करपत । सूर्य खद्योतु तैसा हारपत । ऐसें तीव्रपण अदभुत । तेजाचे यया॥ ३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha agnīcīhī diṭhī karapata | sūrya khadyotu taisā hārapata | aiseṃ tīvrapaṇa adabhuta | tejāce yayā|| 300||
verses.meaning: Here, even the sight of fire is scorched, and the sun appears like a mere firefly, so wondrously intense is the brilliance of this light.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां महातेजाचिया महार्णवीं। बुडोनि गेली सृष्टी आघवी । कीं युगांतविजूंच्या पालवीं । झांकलें गगन ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ mahātejāciyā mahārṇavīṃ| buḍoni gelī sṛṣṭī āghavī | kīṃ yugāṃtavijūṃcyā pālavīṃ | jhāṃkaleṃ gagana || 1||
verses.meaning: Has the entire creation drowned in the great ocean of immense light? Or has the sky been covered by the flashes of lightning at the end of a cosmic age?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी संहारतेजाचिया ज्वाळा । तोडोनि माचू बांधला अंतराळां। आतां दिव्य ज्ञानाचिया डोळां । पाहवेना ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī saṃhāratejāciyā jvāḻā | toḍoni mācū bāṃdhalā aṃtarāḻāṃ| ātāṃ divya jñānāciyā ḍoḻāṃ | pāhavenā || 2||
verses.meaning: Or, as if having cut through the flames of destructive radiance, a platform has been built in the sky, now it cannot be seen even with the eyes of divine knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उजाळु अधिकाधिक बहुवसु। धडाडीत आहे अतिदाहसु । पडत दिव्यचक्षूंसही त्रासु। न्याहाळितां॥३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ujāḻu adhikādhika bahuvasu| dhaḍāḍīta āhe atidāhasu | paḍata divyacakṣūṃsahī trāsu| nyāhāḻitāṃ||3||
verses.meaning: The light is ever-increasing, intensely radiant, and exceedingly hot. Even divine eyes find it difficult to behold, experiencing distress upon gazing at it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां जे महाप्रळयींचा भडाडु। होता काळाग्निरुद्राचिया ठायीं गूढु। तो तृतीयनयनाचा मदढू। फुटला जैसा॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ je mahāpraḻayīṃcā bhaḍāḍu| hotā kāḻāgnirudrāciyā ṭhāyīṃ gūḍhu| to tṛtīyanayanācā madaḍhū| phuṭalā jaisā|| 4||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the great conflagration of the cosmic dissolution, which lay hidden within the Rudra of the fire of time, burst forth as if from his third eye.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें पसरलेनि प्रकाशें। सैंघ पांचवनिया ज्वाळांचे वळसे। पडतां ब्रह्मकटाह कोळिसे। होत आहाती॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ pasaraleni prakāśeṃ| saiṃgha pāṃcavaniyā jvāḻāṃce vaḻase| paḍatāṃ brahmakaṭāha koḻise| hota āhātī|| 5||
verses.meaning: In the same way, by the spread of this light, the entire cosmic egg (Brahmakatāha) is being charred and blackened by the swirling flames of the five elements.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अदभुत तेजोराशी। जन्मा नवल म्यां देखिलासी । नाहीं व्याप्ति आणि कांतीसी । पारु जी तुझिये॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā adabhuta tejorāśī| janmā navala myāṃ dekhilāsī | nāhīṃ vyāpti āṇi kāṃtīsī | pāru jī tujhiye|| 6||
verses.meaning: Such a wondrous mass of light, I have seen your birth as a marvel. There is no limit to your pervasiveness and radiance, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा तूं अक्षर। औटाविये मात्रेसि पर। श्रुती जयाचें घर। गिंवसीत आहाती ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā tūṃ akṣara| auṭāviye mātresi para| śrutī jayāceṃ ghara| giṃvasīta āhātī || 7||
verses.meaning: O God, You are the imperishable, beyond even the 'aum' syllable's highest measure. The Vedas themselves are searching for Your abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें आकाराचें आयतन। जें विश्‍वनिक्षेपेकनिधान । तें अव्यय तूं गहन। अविनाश जी॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ ākārāceṃ āyatana| jeṃ viś‍vanikṣepekanidhāna | teṃ avyaya tūṃ gahana| avināśa jī|| 8||
verses.meaning: You are the very form of all forms, the treasure house where the entire universe is deposited. You are the imperishable, the profound, the indestructible, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं धर्माचा बोलावा । अनादिसिद्ध तूं नित्य नवा। जाणें मी सदतिसावा। पुरुषविशेष तूं ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ dharmācā bolāvā | anādisiddha tūṃ nitya navā| jāṇeṃ mī sadatisāvā| puruṣaviśeṣa tūṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: You are the very call of Dharma, eternally new and beginningless. I know you as the thirty-seventh, the unique Purusha.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं आदिमध्यांतरहितु । स्वसामर्थ्ये तूं अनंतु। विश्वबाहु अपरिमितु। विश्वचरण तूं॥ ३१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ ādimadhyāṃtarahitu | svasāmarthye tūṃ anaṃtu| viśvabāhu aparimitu| viśvacaraṇa tūṃ|| 310||
verses.meaning: You are without beginning, middle, or end. By Your own power, You are infinite. You have countless arms, immeasurable, and You have the whole universe as Your feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं चंद्र चंडांशु डोळां। दावितासि कोपप्रसाद लीळा। एकां रुससी तमाचिया डोळां। एकां पाळितोसि कृपादृष्टी ॥ ९११॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ caṃdra caṃḍāṃśu ḍoḻāṃ| dāvitāsi kopaprasāda līḻā| ekāṃ rusasī tamāciyā ḍoḻāṃ| ekāṃ pāḻitosi kṛpādṛṣṭī || 911||
verses.meaning: You, who are the moon and the sun to the eyes, display the sport of anger and grace. To some, you show displeasure with the eyes of darkness, while others you protect with a glance of mercy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी एवंबिधा तूंतें। मी देखतसें हें निरुतें । पेटलें प्रळयाग्नीचें उजितें । तैसें बक्‍्त्र हें तुझें ॥१२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī evaṃbidhā tūṃteṃ| mī dekhataseṃ heṃ niruteṃ | peṭaleṃ praḻayāgnīceṃ ujiteṃ | taiseṃ bak‍tra heṃ tujheṃ ||12||
verses.meaning: I see your mouth, which is of such a nature, truly like the blazing fire of the cosmic dissolution.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २२८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी वणिवेनि पेटले पर्वत । कवळूनि ज्वाळांचे उभड उठत । तैसी चाटीत दाढा दांत। जीभ लोळे ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: 228 śrījñāneśvarī vaṇiveni peṭale parvata | kavaḻūni jvāḻāṃce ubhaḍa uṭhata | taisī cāṭīta dāḍhā dāṃta| jībha loḻe || 93||
verses.meaning: Just as mountains engulfed by a forest fire emit rising flames, so too does the tongue of the demoness lick her fangs and teeth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इये बदनींचिया उबा । आणि जी सर्वांगकांतीचिया प्रभा। विश्व तातळें अति क्षोभा। जात आहे॥९१४॥
verses.shloka_iast: iye badanīṃciyā ubā | āṇi jī sarvāṃgakāṃtīciyā prabhā| viśva tātaḻeṃ ati kṣobhā| jāta āhe||914||
verses.meaning: Due to the heat of this speech and the radiance of the entire body, the universe is greatly agitated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे द्योर्लाक आणि पाताळ। पृथिवी आणि अंतराळ। अथवा दशदिशा समाकुळ । दिशाचक्र ॥ ९१५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je dyorlāka āṇi pātāḻa| pṛthivī āṇi aṃtarāḻa| athavā daśadiśā samākuḻa | diśācakra || 915||
verses.meaning: For the heavens and the netherworld, the earth and the space between, or the ten directions and the entire cosmic sphere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें आधवेंचि तुवां एकें । भरलें देखत आहे कौतुकें॥ परि गगनाहीसकट भयानकें । आप्लविजे जेवीं॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ ādhaveṃci tuvāṃ ekeṃ | bharaleṃ dekhata āhe kautukeṃ|| pari gaganāhīsakaṭa bhayānakeṃ | āplavije jevīṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: You alone are seen to be filled with this entire wonder, yet it is as if the terrifying (universal form) pervades even the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी अदभुत रसाचिया कल्लोळीं । जाहली चवदाही भुवनांसि कडियाळीं । तैसें आश्चर्यच मग मी आकळीं। काय एक॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī adabhuta rasāciyā kalloḻīṃ | jāhalī cavadāhī bhuvanāṃsi kaḍiyāḻīṃ | taiseṃ āścaryaca maga mī ākaḻīṃ| kāya eka|| 17||
verses.meaning: Or, as if in the waves of the wondrous rasa, the fourteen worlds became like a girdle. Such a wonder, then, how can I comprehend even one part of it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नावरे व्याप्ती हे असाधारण। न साहवे रूपाचें उग्रपण। सुख दुरी गेलें परि प्राण। विपायें धरिजे॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāvare vyāptī he asādhāraṇa| na sāhave rūpāceṃ ugrapaṇa| sukha durī geleṃ pari prāṇa| vipāyeṃ dharije|| 18||
verses.meaning: The pervasiveness of this is extraordinary. The fierce form cannot be endured. Happiness has gone far away, yet life is held by chance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा ऐसें देखोनि तूंतें। नेणों कैसें आलें भयाचें भरितें । आतां दुःखकल्लोळीं झळंबतें। तिन्हीं भुवनें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā aiseṃ dekhoni tūṃteṃ| neṇoṃ kaiseṃ āleṃ bhayāceṃ bhariteṃ | ātāṃ duḥkhakalloḻīṃ jhaḻaṃbateṃ| tinhīṃ bhuvaneṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: O God, seeing You thus, I know not how this flood of fear has come, and now the three worlds are engulfed in waves of sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं तुज महात्मयाचें देखणे । तरि भयदुःखासि कां मेळवणें। परि हें सुख नव्हेचि जेणें गुणें । तें जाणवत आहे मज॥ ३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ tuja mahātmayāceṃ dekhaṇe | tari bhayaduḥkhāsi kāṃ meḻavaṇeṃ| pari heṃ sukha navheci jeṇeṃ guṇeṃ | teṃ jāṇavata āhe maja|| 320||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, if I were to perceive Your greatness, why would I encounter fear and sorrow? But this is not true happiness, and I am aware of this fact.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंब तुझें रूप नोहे दिठें। तंव जगासि संसारिक गोमटें।॥ आतां देखिलासि तरी विषयविटें। उपनला त्रासु॥२१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃba tujheṃ rūpa nohe diṭheṃ| taṃva jagāsi saṃsārika gomaṭeṃ||| ātāṃ dekhilāsi tarī viṣayaviṭeṃ| upanalā trāsu||21||
verses.meaning: As long as your form is not seen, the worldly existence seems good to the world. But now that you are seen, a weariness of worldly pleasures has arisen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि तुज देखिळियासाठीं। काइ सहसा तुज देवों येईल मिठी। आणि नेदीं तरी शोकसंकटीं । राहों केवीं ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci tuja dekhiḻiyāsāṭhīṃ| kāi sahasā tuja devoṃ yeīla miṭhī| āṇi nedīṃ tarī śokasaṃkaṭīṃ | rāhoṃ kevīṃ || 22||
verses.meaning: Similarly, just to see You, how can I suddenly embrace You? And if I don't, how can I remain in the distress of sorrow?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मागां सरों तंव संसारु । आडवीत येतसे अनिवारु। आणि पुढां तूं तंव अनावरु। न येसि घेवों ॥२३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni māgāṃ saroṃ taṃva saṃsāru | āḍavīta yetase anivāru| āṇi puḍhāṃ tūṃ taṃva anāvaru| na yesi ghevoṃ ||23||
verses.meaning: Therefore, when one tries to retreat, the irresistible worldly existence obstructs the path. And when one tries to advance, You, the uncontrollable, cannot be grasped.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा माझारलिया सांकडां। बापुड्या त्रैलोक्याचा होतसे हुरडा। ऐसा हा ध्वनि जी फुडा। चोजवला मज॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā mājhāraliyā sāṃkaḍāṃ| bāpuḍyā trailokyācā hotase huraḍā| aisā hā dhvani jī phuḍā| cojavalā maja|| 24||
verses.meaning: When such a calamity befalls, the poor three worlds are scorched. Such a sound, indeed, became clear to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा आरंबळला आगीं। तो समुद्रा ये निवावयालागीं। तंब कल्लोळपाणियाचिया तरंगीं । आगळा बिहे॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā āraṃbaḻalā āgīṃ| to samudrā ye nivāvayālāgīṃ| taṃba kalloḻapāṇiyāciyā taraṃgīṃ | āgaḻā bihe|| 25||
verses.meaning: Just as a fire, having started, comes to the sea to be extinguished, but then, seeing the waves of water, becomes even more afraid.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें या जगासि जाहलें। तूंतें देखोनि तळमळित ठेलें। यामाजीं पैल भले। ज्ञानशूरांचे मेळावे॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ yā jagāsi jāhaleṃ| tūṃteṃ dekhoni taḻamaḻita ṭheleṃ| yāmājīṃ paila bhale| jñānaśūrāṃce meḻāve|| 26||
verses.meaning: The world has become like this: seeing You, it remains restless. Among them, there are indeed great gatherings of the brave in knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे तुझेनि आंगिकें तेजें। जाळूनि सर्व कर्मांची बीजें। मिळत तुज आंतु सहजें। सदभावेंसीं ॥ ९२७॥
verses.shloka_iast: he tujheni āṃgikeṃ tejeṃ| jāḻūni sarva karmāṃcī bījeṃ| miḻata tuja āṃtu sahajeṃ| sadabhāveṃsīṃ || 927||
verses.meaning: By your inherent radiance, the seeds of all actions are effortlessly consumed, and with pure devotion, they merge into you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिक एक सावियाचि भयभीरु। सर्वस्वें धरूनि तुझी मोहरु। तुज प्रार्थिताति करु। जोडोनियां॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇika eka sāviyāci bhayabhīru| sarvasveṃ dharūni tujhī moharu| tuja prārthitāti karu| joḍoniyāṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: And others, fearful, completely devoted to you, pray to you with folded hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा अविद्यार्णवीं पडिलों। जी विषयवागुरें आतुडलों। स्वर्गसंसाराचिया सांकडलों। दोहीं भागीं ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā avidyārṇavīṃ paḍiloṃ| jī viṣayavāgureṃ ātuḍaloṃ| svargasaṃsārāciyā sāṃkaḍaloṃ| dohīṃ bhāgīṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: O Lord, I have fallen into the ocean of ignorance, ensnared by the nets of worldly pleasures, and trapped in the dual suffering of heaven and samsara.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें आमुचें सोडवणें। तुजबांचोनि कौजेळ कवणें। तुज शरण गा सर्वप्राणें। म्हणत देवा ॥ ३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ āmuceṃ soḍavaṇeṃ| tujabāṃconi kaujeḻa kavaṇeṃ| tuja śaraṇa gā sarvaprāṇeṃ| mhaṇata devā || 330||
verses.meaning: Who else but You can liberate us? We surrender to You with all our being, O Lord!

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि महर्षी अथवा सिद्ध । कां विद्याधरसमूह विविध। हे बोळत तुज स्वस्तिवाद। करिती स्तबन॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi maharṣī athavā siddha | kāṃ vidyādharasamūha vividha| he boḻata tuja svastivāda| karitī stabana|| 31||
verses.meaning: And great sages or Siddhas, or various groups of Vidyadharas, bid you farewell with blessings and praise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे रुद्रादित्यांचे मेळावे। वसु हन साध्य आघवे। अश्‍विनौ देव विश्वे देव विभवें। वायुही हे जी॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: he rudrādityāṃce meḻāve| vasu hana sādhya āghave| aś‍vinau deva viśve deva vibhaveṃ| vāyuhī he jī|| 32||
verses.meaning: These are the assemblies of the Rudras and Adityas, all the Vasus and Sadhyas, the Ashwins and the Vishwadevas, and even Vayu himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवधारा पितर हन गंधर्व। पैल यक्षरक्षोगण सर्व । जी महेंद्रमुख्य देव । कां सिऱ्धादिक ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: avadhārā pitara hana gaṃdharva| paila yakṣarakṣogaṇa sarva | jī maheṃdramukhya deva | kāṃ siṟdhādika || 33||
verses.meaning: Listen, O ancestors, Gandharvas, and all the hosts of Yakshas and Rakshasas! And you, the chief among gods, Indra, along with the Siddhas and others!

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे आघवेचि आपुलालिया लोकीं। सोत्कंठित अवलोकीं। हे महामूर्ती दैविकी । पाहात आहाती ॥ ३४॥
