verses.shloka_iast: he āghaveci āpulāliyā lokīṃ| sotkaṃṭhita avalokīṃ| he mahāmūrtī daivikī | pāhāta āhātī || 34||
verses.meaning: All these, in their respective realms, eagerly gaze upon this great form of Devaki.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पाहात पाहात प्रतिक्षणीं । विस्मित होऊनि अंत:करणीं । करित निजमुकुटीं बोबाळणी। प्रभुजी तुज॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga pāhāta pāhāta pratikṣaṇīṃ | vismita hoūni aṃta:karaṇīṃ | karita nijamukuṭīṃ bobāḻaṇī| prabhujī tuja|| 35||
verses.meaning: Then, as I gaze upon You, moment by moment, my heart is filled with wonder, and I cry out to You, my Lord, placing my head at Your feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते जयजय घोष 'कलरवें। स्वर्ग गाजविताती आघवे । ठेवित ललाटावरी बरवे। करसंपुट ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: te jayajaya ghoṣa 'kalaraveṃ| svarga gājavitātī āghave | ṭhevita lalāṭāvarī barave| karasaṃpuṭa || 36||
verses.meaning: With shouts of 'Jai Jai', they make the heavens resound, and reverently place their cupped hands on their foreheads.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये विनयद्रुमाचिये आरवीं। सुरवाडली सात्त्विकांची माधवी । म्हणौनि करसंपुटपल्लवीं। तूं होतासि फळ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye vinayadrumāciye āravīṃ| suravāḍalī sāttvikāṃcī mādhavī | mhaṇauni karasaṃpuṭapallavīṃ| tūṃ hotāsi phaḻa|| 37||
verses.meaning: In the garden of that tree of humility, the spring of sattvic qualities blossomed, and therefore, you became the fruit in the cupped hands (of devotees).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी लोचनां भाग्य उदेलें। मना सुखाचें सुयाणें पाहलें। जे अगाध तुझें देखिलें। विश्वरूप इहीं ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī locanāṃ bhāgya udeleṃ| manā sukhāceṃ suyāṇeṃ pāhaleṃ| je agādha tujheṃ dekhileṃ| viśvarūpa ihīṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: O Lord, what fortune has dawned upon these eyes! What a joyous birth has occurred in my mind! For through them, I have beheld Your unfathomable cosmic form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें लोकत्रयव्यापक रूपडें। पाहतां देवांही वचक पडे । याचें सन्मुखपण जोडे। भलतयाकडुनी॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ lokatrayavyāpaka rūpaḍeṃ| pāhatāṃ devāṃhī vacaka paḍe | yāceṃ sanmukhapaṇa joḍe| bhalatayākaḍunī|| 39||
verses.meaning: This form, which pervades the three worlds, instills fear even in the gods. Yet, its presence can be attained by anyone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें एकचि परी विचित्रें। आणि भयानकें वक्‍त्रें। बहुलोचन हे सशस्त्रें। अनंतभुजा ॥ ३४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ ekaci parī vicitreṃ| āṇi bhayānakeṃ vak‍treṃ| bahulocana he saśastreṃ| anaṃtabhujā || 340||
verses.meaning: In this way, there were many strange and terrifying faces, with many eyes, armed, and with infinite arms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनंत चारु बाहु चरण । बहूदर आणि नानावर्ण । कैसें प्रतिवदनीं मातलेपण । आवेशाचें॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: anaṃta cāru bāhu caraṇa | bahūdara āṇi nānāvarṇa | kaiseṃ prativadanīṃ mātalepaṇa | āveśāceṃ|| 41||
verses.meaning: Innumerable are the beautiful arms and feet, with many bellies and various colors. How can one describe the overwhelming pride and passion on each face?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां महाकल्पाचिया अंतीं । तबकलेनि यमें जेउततेउतीं । प्रळयाग्नीचीं उजितीं। आंबुखिलीं जैसीं ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ mahākalpāciyā aṃtīṃ | tabakaleni yameṃ jeutateutīṃ | praḻayāgnīcīṃ ujitīṃ| āṃbukhilīṃ jaisīṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: Or, at the end of the great cosmic cycle, when the universe is consumed by the fire of dissolution, it is as if the flames of the doomsday fire are kindled by Yama, the god of death, and they blaze forth with immense intensity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी संहारत्रिपुरारीचीं यंत्रें कौं प्रळयभेरवांचीं क्षेत्रे नाना युगांतशक्‍्तीचीं पात्रें भूतखिचा बोढविलीं ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī saṃhāratripurārīcīṃ yaṃtreṃ kauṃ praḻayabheravāṃcīṃ kṣetre nānā yugāṃtaśak‍tīcīṃ pātreṃ bhūtakhicā boḍhavilīṃ || 43||
verses.meaning: Or are they the instruments of Shiva, the destroyer of the three cities, or the abodes of Bhairava at the time of dissolution, or the vessels of the powers of the end of the yugas, which have been filled with the spirits of the dead?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं जियेतियेकडे । तुझीं वक्‍्त्रें जीं प्रचंडें। न समाती दरीमाजीं सिंव्हाडे। तैसे दशन दिसती रागीट ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ jiyetiyekaḍe | tujhīṃ vak‍treṃ jīṃ pracaṃḍeṃ| na samātī darīmājīṃ siṃvhāḍe| taise daśana disatī rāgīṭa || 44||
verses.meaning: Similarly, towards the living beings, your mouths, which are formidable, do not fit into the caves, like the fierce teeth that are seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें काळरात्रीचेनि अंधारें । उल्हासत निघती संहारखेचरें। तैसिया वदनीं प्रळयरुधिरें। काटलिया दाढा ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ kāḻarātrīceni aṃdhāreṃ | ulhāsata nighatī saṃhārakhecareṃ| taisiyā vadanīṃ praḻayarudhireṃ| kāṭaliyā dāḍhā || 45||
verses.meaning: Just as in the darkness of the night of destruction, the demons of annihilation emerge with delight, similarly, their jaws are stained with the blood of the cosmic dissolution.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो काळें अवंतिलें रण। कां सर्वसंहारें मातळें मरण । तैसें अतिभिंगुळवाणेंपण । वदनीं तुझिये ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso kāḻeṃ avaṃtileṃ raṇa| kāṃ sarvasaṃhāreṃ mātaḻeṃ maraṇa | taiseṃ atibhiṃguḻavāṇeṃpaṇa | vadanīṃ tujhiye || 46||
verses.meaning: Or as if the battlefield is enveloped in darkness, or death has become rampant in a universal destruction, such a terrifying sight is on your face.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे बापुडी लोकसृष्टी । मोटकीये विपाइली दिठी । आणि दुःखकालिंदीचिया तटीं । झाड होऊनि ठेली ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: he bāpuḍī lokasṛṣṭī | moṭakīye vipāilī diṭhī | āṇi duḥkhakāliṃdīciyā taṭīṃ | jhāḍa hoūni ṭhelī || 47||
verses.meaning: These poor people, with their limited vision, are like trees standing on the banks of the river of sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुज महामृत्यूचिया सागरीं । आतां हे त्रेलोक्यजीविताची तरी । शोकदुर्बातलहरी । आंदोळत असे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuja mahāmṛtyūciyā sāgarīṃ | ātāṃ he trelokyajīvitācī tarī | śokadurbātalaharī | āṃdoḻata ase|| 48||
verses.meaning: In the ocean of your great death, the waves of sorrow and despair now toss the life of the three worlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ कोपोनि जरी वैकुंठें। ऐसें हन म्हणिपैल अवचटें।॥ जे तुज लोकांचें काई वाटे। तूं ध्यानसुख हें भोगी ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha koponi jarī vaikuṃṭheṃ| aiseṃ hana mhaṇipaila avacaṭeṃ||| je tuja lokāṃceṃ kāī vāṭe| tūṃ dhyānasukha heṃ bhogī || 49||
verses.meaning: Here, if Vaikuntha (the abode of Vishnu) were to become angry, it might suddenly be said, "What do you care for the people? You should enjoy this bliss of meditation."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जी लोकांचें कीर साधारण। वायां आड सूतसे बोडण | केवीं सहसा म्हणे प्राण । माझेचि कांपती॥ ३५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jī lokāṃceṃ kīra sādhāraṇa| vāyāṃ āḍa sūtase boḍaṇa | kevīṃ sahasā mhaṇe prāṇa | mājheci kāṃpatī|| 350||
verses.meaning: How can I suddenly say that my very life trembles, when it is merely a common, useless, and insignificant offering for the people?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्या मज संहाररुद्र वासिपे। ज्या मजभेणें मृत्यु लपे। तो मी एथें अहाळबाहळीं कांपें। ऐसें तुवां केलें॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jyā maja saṃhārarudra vāsipe| jyā majabheṇeṃ mṛtyu lape| to mī etheṃ ahāḻabāhaḻīṃ kāṃpeṃ| aiseṃ tuvāṃ keleṃ||51||
verses.meaning: You have made me, who am the destructive Rudra, who am feared by Death itself, tremble here in this state of distress.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि नवल बापा हे महामारी । इया नाम विश्वरूप जरी । हें भ्यासुरपणें हारी । भयासि आणी॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari navala bāpā he mahāmārī | iyā nāma viśvarūpa jarī | heṃ bhyāsurapaṇeṃ hārī | bhayāsi āṇī|| 52||
verses.meaning: But wonder of wonders, this epidemic, though it bears the name of the Universal Form, by its very terror, brings fear even to fear itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ठेलीं महाकाळेंसि हटेंतटें । तैसी कितीएकें मुखें रागिटें । इहीं वाढोनियां धाकुटें। आकाश केलें॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ṭhelīṃ mahākāḻeṃsi haṭeṃtaṭeṃ | taisī kitīekeṃ mukheṃ rāgiṭeṃ | ihīṃ vāḍhoniyāṃ dhākuṭeṃ| ākāśa keleṃ|| 53||
verses.meaning: As if challenging even the great Destroyer, many such angry mouths, having grown, made the sky small.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गगनाचेंनि वाडपणें नाकळे । त्रिभुवनींचियाही वारिया न वेंटाळे । ययाचेनि वाफा आगी जळे। कैसें धडाडीत असे॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: gaganāceṃni vāḍapaṇeṃ nākaḻe | tribhuvanīṃciyāhī vāriyā na veṃṭāḻe | yayāceni vāphā āgī jaḻe| kaiseṃ dhaḍāḍīta ase|| 54||
verses.meaning: By the vastness of the sky, it cannot be grasped. It is not contained even by the winds of the three worlds. By its very breath, fire burns. How mighty and blazing it is!

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि एकासरिखें एक नोहे। एथ वर्णावर्णाचा भेदु आहे । हो कां जें प्रळयीं सावावो लाहे। वही ययाचा॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci ekāsarikheṃ eka nohe| etha varṇāvarṇācā bhedu āhe | ho kāṃ jeṃ praḻayīṃ sāvāvo lāhe| vahī yayācā|| 55||
verses.meaning: Thus, one is not like another; here there is a distinction of varnas (social classes). Or rather, in the cosmic dissolution, this distinction finds its support.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचिये आंगींची दीप्ती येवढी । जे त्रैलोक्य कोजे राखोंडी। कौं तयाही तोंडें आणि तोंडीं । दांत दाढा॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāciye āṃgīṃcī dīptī yevaḍhī | je trailokya koje rākhoṃḍī| kauṃ tayāhī toṃḍeṃ āṇi toṃḍīṃ | dāṃta dāḍhā|| 56||
verses.meaning: Whose very bodily radiance is so immense that it reduces the three worlds to ashes, and even then, from those ashes, mouths and teeth and fangs emerge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसा वारया धनुर्वात चढला। समुद्र कीं महापुरीं पडिला । विषाग्नि मारा प्रवर्तळा। बडवानळासि॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaisā vārayā dhanurvāta caḍhalā| samudra kīṃ mahāpurīṃ paḍilā | viṣāgni mārā pravartaḻā| baḍavānaḻāsi|| 57||
verses.meaning: How can a paralytic wind afflict the wind itself? Or how can a great flood fall into the ocean? How can a poisonous fire attack the submarine fire?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हळाहळ आगी पियालें। नवल मरण मारा प्रवर्तलें। तैसें संहारतेजा या जाहलें। बदन देखा ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: haḻāhaḻa āgī piyāleṃ| navala maraṇa mārā pravartaleṃ| taiseṃ saṃhāratejā yā jāhaleṃ| badana dekhā || 58||
verses.meaning: It was as if poison had drunk fire, or as if death itself had begun to kill. Such was the destructive radiance that emanated from his mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी कोणें मानें विशाळ। जैसें तुटलिया अंतराळ। आकाशासि कव्हळ। 'पडोनि ठेलें॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī koṇeṃ māneṃ viśāḻa| jaiseṃ tuṭaliyā aṃtarāḻa| ākāśāsi kavhaḻa| 'paḍoni ṭheleṃ|| 59||
verses.meaning: But how can it be measured as vast? It is like the sky, when a part of space is broken off, how can it fall and remain separate?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी काखें सूनि वसुंधरी। जैं हिरण्याक्षु रिगाला विवरीं। तैं उघडलें हाटकेशवरीं। जेवीं पाताळकुहर॥ ३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī kākheṃ sūni vasuṃdharī| jaiṃ hiraṇyākṣu rigālā vivarīṃ| taiṃ ughaḍaleṃ hāṭakeśavarīṃ| jevīṃ pātāḻakuhara|| 360||
verses.meaning: When Hiranyaksha carried the Earth under his arm and entered the netherworld, it was as if the Hatakeshwara region had opened up like a chasm into the underworld.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा वक्‍्त्रांचा बिकाशु। माजीं जिव्हांचा आगळाचि आवेशु। विश्‍व न पुरे म्हणौनि घांसु। न भरीचि कोडें ॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā vak‍trāṃcā bikāśu| mājīṃ jivhāṃcā āgaḻāci āveśu| viś‍va na pure mhaṇauni ghāṃsu| na bharīci koḍeṃ ||61||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the blossoming of words, and the extraordinary fervor of the tongue, are such that even the entire universe would not suffice as a morsel, nor would it fill the longing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि पाताळव्याळांचिया फूत्कारीं। गरळज्वाळा लागती अंबरीं । तैसी पसरलिये बदनदरी-। माजीं हे जिव्हा ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi pātāḻavyāḻāṃciyā phūtkārīṃ| garaḻajvāḻā lāgatī aṃbarīṃ | taisī pasaraliye badanadarī-| mājīṃ he jivhā || 62||
verses.meaning: And just as the poisonous flames from the breath of the serpents of Patala reach the sky, so too does this tongue spread within the cavern of the mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काढूनि प्रळयविजूंचीं जुंबाडें। जैसें पन्नासिळें गगनाचे हुडे। तैसे आवाळुवांवरी आंकडे । धगधगीत दाढांचे ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāḍhūni praḻayavijūṃcīṃ juṃbāḍeṃ| jaiseṃ pannāsiḻeṃ gaganāce huḍe| taise āvāḻuvāṃvarī āṃkaḍe | dhagadhagīta dāḍhāṃce || 63||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky, having shed the thunderbolts of the cosmic dissolution, appears like fifty-hued fragments, so too do the fangs on the demons' faces glow fiercely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ललाटपटाचिये खोळे। कैसे भयातें भेडविताती डोळे । हो कां जे महामृत्यूचे उमाळे। कडवसां राहिळे॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi lalāṭapaṭāciye khoḻe| kaise bhayāteṃ bheḍavitātī ḍoḻe | ho kāṃ je mahāmṛtyūce umāḻe| kaḍavasāṃ rāhiḻe|| 64||
verses.meaning: And on the forehead's canvas, how do the eyes frighten fear itself? Or rather, the surges of great death, have they been held back by a mere fence?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें वाऊनि भयाचें भोज। एथ काय निपजवूं पाहतोसि काज । तें नेणें परी मज। मरणभय आलें॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ vāūni bhayāceṃ bhoja| etha kāya nipajavūṃ pāhatosi kāja | teṃ neṇeṃ parī maja| maraṇabhaya āleṃ|| 65||
verses.meaning: Having taken on this fear, what do you intend to accomplish here? I do not know, but the fear of death has come upon me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा विश्वरूप पहावयाचे डोहळे । केले तियें पावलों प्रतिफळें। बापा देखिलासि आतां डोळे । निवावे तैसे निवाळे॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā viśvarūpa pahāvayāce ḍohaḻe | kele tiyeṃ pāvaloṃ pratiphaḻeṃ| bāpā dekhilāsi ātāṃ ḍoḻe | nivāve taise nivāḻe|| 66||
verses.meaning: O Lord, the longing to behold Your cosmic form has been fulfilled; I have received its fruit. Father, now that I have seen You, my eyes are truly appeased and have found solace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो देहो पार्थिब कीर जाये । ययाची काकुळती कवणा आहे। परि आतां चैतन्य माझें विपायें। वांचे कों न वांचे ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho deho pārthiba kīra jāye | yayācī kākuḻatī kavaṇā āhe| pari ātāṃ caitanya mājheṃ vipāyeṃ| vāṃce koṃ na vāṃce || 67||
verses.meaning: Oh, this physical body will surely perish. Who then would lament its passing? But now, my very consciousness is in peril, whether it will survive or not.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं भयास्तव आंग २३२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी कांपे। नावेक आगळें तरी मन तापे। अथवा बुद्धीही वासिपे। अभिमानु बिसरिजे॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ bhayāstava āṃga 232 śrījñāneśvarī kāṃpe| nāveka āgaḻeṃ tarī mana tāpe| athavā buddhīhī vāsipe| abhimānu bisarije|| 68||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, the body trembles out of fear. The mind becomes agitated even by a slight excess, or the intellect becomes disturbed, and one forgets their ego.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी येतुलियाही वेगळा। जो केवळ आनंदैककळा। तया अंतरात्मयाही निश्‍चळा। शियारी आली ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī yetuliyāhī vegaḻā| jo kevaḻa ānaṃdaikakaḻā| tayā aṃtarātmayāhī niś‍caḻā| śiyārī ālī || 69||
verses.meaning: But even beyond this, the one who is solely the essence of bliss, that unwavering inner Self, has now come to my doorstep.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाप साक्षात्काराचा वेधु । कैसा देशधडी केला बोधु। हा गुरुशिष्यसंबंधु । विपायें नांदे ॥ ३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāpa sākṣātkārācā vedhu | kaisā deśadhaḍī kelā bodhu| hā guruśiṣyasaṃbaṃdhu | vipāyeṃ nāṃde || 370||
verses.meaning: Oh, how the realization of the Father, the ultimate truth, has been made so accessible through this teaching! This sacred relationship between guru and disciple truly flourishes with such grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा तुझ्या ये दर्शनीं। जें वैकल्य उपजलें आहे अंतःकरणीं। तें सांवरावयालागीं गंबसणी। धेर्याची करितसें॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā tujhyā ye darśanīṃ| jeṃ vaikalya upajaleṃ āhe aṃtaḥkaraṇīṃ| teṃ sāṃvarāvayālāgīṃ gaṃbasaṇī| dheryācī karitaseṃ||79||
verses.meaning: O Lord, the emotional turmoil that has arisen in my heart at your sight, I am now trying to steady it by holding onto patience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब माझेनि नामें धेर्य हारपलें। कीं तयाहीवरी विश्वरूपदर्शन जाहलें। हें असो परि मज भलें अतुडविलें। उपदेशा इया॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba mājheni nāmeṃ dherya hārapaleṃ| kīṃ tayāhīvarī viśvarūpadarśana jāhaleṃ| heṃ aso pari maja bhaleṃ atuḍavileṃ| upadeśā iyā||72||
verses.meaning: My name made him lose his courage, and then he was granted the vision of the Universal Form. Let this be, but this teaching has brought me great good fortune.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जीव विसंबावयाचिया चाडा। सैंघ धांबाधांबवी करितसे बापुडा। परि सोयही कवणेंकडां। न लभे एथ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jīva visaṃbāvayāciyā cāḍā| saiṃgha dhāṃbādhāṃbavī karitase bāpuḍā| pari soyahī kavaṇeṃkaḍāṃ| na labhe etha|| 73||
verses.meaning: In its desire for rest and solace, the poor soul ceaselessly rushes about, yet nowhere here does it find true refuge or understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें विश्वरूपाचिया महामारी । जीवित्व गेलें आहे चराचरीं। जी न बोलें तरि काय करीं। कैसेनि राहें॥७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ viśvarūpāciyā mahāmārī | jīvitva geleṃ āhe carācarīṃ| jī na boleṃ tari kāya karīṃ| kaiseni rāheṃ||74||
verses.meaning: In this great epidemic of the universal form, life has departed from all animate and inanimate beings. If I do not speak, what can I do? How can I remain silent?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं अखंड डोळ्यांपुढें। फुटलें जैसें महाभयाचें भांडें। तैसी तुझीं मुखें वितंडें । पसरलीं देखें ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ akhaṃḍa ḍoḻyāṃpuḍheṃ| phuṭaleṃ jaiseṃ mahābhayāceṃ bhāṃḍeṃ| taisī tujhīṃ mukheṃ vitaṃḍeṃ | pasaralīṃ dekheṃ || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Before my eyes, it is as if a vessel of great terror has burst open. So do I see your mouths, O Lord, spread wide and terrible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: असो दांतदाढांची दाटी। न झांकवे मा दों दों बोठीं। सैंघ प्रळयशस्त्रांचिया दाट कांटी । लागलिया जैशा॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aso dāṃtadāḍhāṃcī dāṭī| na jhāṃkave mā doṃ doṃ boṭhīṃ| saiṃgha praḻayaśastrāṃciyā dāṭa kāṃṭī | lāgaliyā jaiśā|| 76||
verses.meaning: The dense array of teeth and fangs, which cannot be covered even by two handfuls, is like the thick thorns of the weapons of cosmic dissolution that have become entangled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेसें तक्षका विष भरलें। हो कां जे काळरात्रीं भूत संचरळें। कौं आग्नेयास्त्र परजिलें। वज्राग्नि जैसें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeseṃ takṣakā viṣa bharaleṃ| ho kāṃ je kāḻarātrīṃ bhūta saṃcaraḻeṃ| kauṃ āgneyāstra parajileṃ| vajrāgni jaiseṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as a cobra is filled with venom, or as a ghost possesses one on a dark night, or as a fiery missile is unleashed, or like a thunderbolt of fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशी तुझीं वक्‍्त्रें प्रचंडें। वरि आवेश हा बाहेरी बोसंडे । आले मरणरसाचे लोंढें। आम्हांवरी ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśī tujhīṃ vak‍treṃ pracaṃḍeṃ| vari āveśa hā bāherī bosaṃḍe | āle maraṇarasāce loṃḍheṃ| āmhāṃvarī || 78 ||
verses.meaning: Your mouths are enormous, and from them, a torrent of death's essence gushes forth upon us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संहारसमयींचा चंडानिळु । आणि महाकल्यपांत प्रळयानळु। या दोहीं जैं होय मेळु। तैं काय एक न जळे॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃhārasamayīṃcā caṃḍāniḻu | āṇi mahākalyapāṃta praḻayānaḻu| yā dohīṃ jaiṃ hoya meḻu| taiṃ kāya eka na jaḻe|| 79||
verses.meaning: When the fierce wind of destruction at the time of dissolution and the fire of cosmic annihilation at the great dissolution combine, what indeed will not be consumed?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं संहारकें तुझीं मुखें। देखोनि धीरु कां आम्हां 'पारुखे। आतां भुललो मी दिशा न देखें। आपणपें नेणें ॥ ३८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ saṃhārakeṃ tujhīṃ mukheṃ| dekhoni dhīru kāṃ āmhāṃ 'pārukhe| ātāṃ bhulalo mī diśā na dekheṃ| āpaṇapeṃ neṇeṃ || 380||
verses.meaning: Seeing your destructive mouths, how can our courage remain? Now I am bewildered, I cannot see the directions, I do not know myself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोटकें विश्वरूप डोळां देखिलें। आणि सुखाचें अवर्षण पडिलें। आतां जापाणीं जापाणीं आपुलें। अस्ताव्यस्त हें ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: moṭakeṃ viśvarūpa ḍoḻāṃ dekhileṃ| āṇi sukhāceṃ avarṣaṇa paḍileṃ| ātāṃ jāpāṇīṃ jāpāṇīṃ āpuleṃ| astāvyasta heṃ || 81||
verses.meaning: The universal form was seen by the eyes, and a shower of bliss descended. Now, in every moment, this disarray of ours is set right.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें करिसी म्हणोनि जरी जाणें । तरी हे गोष्टि सांगावी कां मी म्हणें । आतां एकवेळ वांचवबी जी प्राणें । या स्वरूपप्रळयापासोनि॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ karisī mhaṇoni jarī jāṇeṃ | tarī he goṣṭi sāṃgāvī kāṃ mī mhaṇeṃ | ātāṃ ekaveḻa vāṃcavabī jī prāṇeṃ | yā svarūpapraḻayāpāsoni|| 82||
verses.meaning: If you know that you will do this, then why should I tell you this? Now, save my life once from this dissolution of my very being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी तूं गोसावी आमुचा अनंता । तरी सुई बोडण माझिया जीविता | सांटवीं पसारा हा मागुता । महामारीचा ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī tūṃ gosāvī āmucā anaṃtā | tarī suī boḍaṇa mājhiyā jīvitā | sāṃṭavīṃ pasārā hā māgutā | mahāmārīcā || 83||
verses.meaning: Though You are my Lord, O Infinite One, please remove this affliction from my life. Take back this widespread epidemic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आइकें सकळ देवांचिया परदेवते। तुवां चैतन्यें गा विश्व वसतें। तें बिसरलासि हें उपरतें। संहारूं आदरिलें॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āikeṃ sakaḻa devāṃciyā paradevate| tuvāṃ caitanyeṃ gā viśva vasateṃ| teṃ bisaralāsi heṃ uparateṃ| saṃhārūṃ ādarileṃ|| 84||
verses.meaning: Listen, O Supreme Deity of all gods! The universe resides in Your consciousness. Forgetting this, You have begun to destroy it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि वेगीं प्रसन्न होई देवराया । संहरीं संहरीं आपुली माया । काढीं मातें महाभया-। पासोनियां ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vegīṃ prasanna hoī devarāyā | saṃharīṃ saṃharīṃ āpulī māyā | kāḍhīṃ māteṃ mahābhayā-| pāsoniyāṃ || 85 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, quickly be pleased, O Lord of Gods. Withdraw, withdraw Your Maya. Deliver me from this great fear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठायवरी पुढतपुढती । तूंतें म्हणिजे बहुबा काकुळती । ऐसा मी विशवमूर्ती । भेडका जाहलों ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāyavarī puḍhatapuḍhatī | tūṃteṃ mhaṇije bahubā kākuḻatī | aisā mī viśavamūrtī | bheḍakā jāhaloṃ || 86||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I repeatedly implore You with great earnestness, O Vishwamurti, that I have become a frightened one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें अमरावतीये आला धाडा । तैं म्यां एकलेनि केला उबेडा। जो मी काळाचियाही तोंडा। वासिपु न धरीं ॥८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ amarāvatīye ālā dhāḍā | taiṃ myāṃ ekaleni kelā ubeḍā| jo mī kāḻāciyāhī toṃḍā| vāsipu na dharīṃ ||87||
verses.meaning: When the messenger of Amravati (Indra's city) arrived, I alone caused its destruction. I am the one who does not fear even the mouth of death itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तया आंतुल नव्हे हें देवा । एथ मृत्यूसही करूनि चढावा । तुवां आमुचाचि घोटु भरावा । या सकळ विशवेंसीं॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī tayā āṃtula navhe heṃ devā | etha mṛtyūsahī karūni caḍhāvā | tuvāṃ āmucāci ghoṭu bharāvā | yā sakaḻa viśaveṃsīṃ|| 88||
verses.meaning: But this is not within You, O Lord. Here, even death is surpassed. You must swallow us whole, in this entire universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसा नव्हता प्रळयाचा वेळु। गोखा तूंचि मिनलासि काळु । बापुडा हा त्रिभुबनगोळु। अल्पायु जाहला॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaisā navhatā praḻayācā veḻu| gokhā tūṃci minalāsi kāḻu | bāpuḍā hā tribhubanagoḻu| alpāyu jāhalā|| 89||
verses.meaning: Was it not the time of cosmic dissolution? You alone, O Lord, became the devourer of time. This poor sphere of the three worlds became short-lived.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहा भाग्या विपरीता। विध्न उठिलें शांत करितां। कटकटा विश्‍व गेलें आतां। तूं लागलासि ग्रासूं॥ ३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahā bhāgyā viparītā| vidhna uṭhileṃ śāṃta karitāṃ| kaṭakaṭā viś‍va geleṃ ātāṃ| tūṃ lāgalāsi grāsūṃ|| 390||
verses.meaning: Oh, what an unfortunate turn of events! As I tried to bring peace, obstacles arose. The whole world is now in turmoil, and you have begun to consume it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें नव्हे मा रोकडें। सैंघ पसरूनियां तोंडें। कवळितासि चहूंकडे । सैन्ये इयें॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ navhe mā rokaḍeṃ| saiṃgha pasarūniyāṃ toṃḍeṃ| kavaḻitāsi cahūṃkaḍe | sainye iyeṃ|| 91||
verses.meaning: This is not a mere spectacle, for with mouths agape, you are devouring these armies from all directions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नोहेति हे कौरवकुळींचे वीर। आंधळिया धृतराष्ट्राचे कुमर । हे गेले गेळे सहपरिवार। तुझिया वदनीं ॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: noheti he kauravakuḻīṃce vīra| āṃdhaḻiyā dhṛtarāṣṭrāce kumara | he gele geḻe sahaparivāra| tujhiyā vadanīṃ ||92||
verses.meaning: These are not the warriors of the Kuru lineage, nor the sons of the blind Dhritarashtra. They have all, along with their families, entered your mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जे जे यांचेनि सावायें। आले देशोदेशींचे राये । तयांचें सांगावया जावों न लाहे । ऐसें सरकटित आहासी ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi je je yāṃceni sāvāyeṃ| āle deśodeśīṃce rāye | tayāṃceṃ sāṃgāvayā jāvoṃ na lāhe | aiseṃ sarakaṭita āhāsī || 93||
verses.meaning: And all those kings from various lands who have come with their help, there is no need to mention them, as you are already encompassing them all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मदमुखाचिया संघटा । घेत आहासि घटघटां। आरणीं हन थाटा। देतासि मिठी ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: madamukhāciyā saṃghaṭā | gheta āhāsi ghaṭaghaṭāṃ| āraṇīṃ hana thāṭā| detāsi miṭhī || 94||
verses.meaning: You are drinking from the cups of the intoxicated, gulping them down. You are embracing the very essence of their revelry.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंत्रावरिचील मार। पदातींचे मोगर। मुखाआंत भार । हारपताति मा॥९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃtrāvaricīla māra| padātīṃce mogara| mukhāāṃta bhāra | hārapatāti mā||95||
verses.meaning: The blows on the instruments, the maces of the foot soldiers, and the burdens in the mouth all disappear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कृतांताचिया जावळी । जें एकचि विश्‍्वातें गिळी। तियें 'कोटीवरी सगळीं। गिळितासि शस्त्रें ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṛtāṃtāciyā jāvaḻī | jeṃ ekaci viś‍vāteṃ giḻī| tiyeṃ 'koṭīvarī sagaḻīṃ| giḻitāsi śastreṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: You devour countless weapons, just as the twin jaws of death consume the entire universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चतुरंगा परिवारा । संजोडियां रहंबरां। दांत न लाविसी मा परमेश्वरा । कैसा तुष्टलासि बरवा ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: caturaṃgā parivārā | saṃjoḍiyāṃ rahaṃbarāṃ| dāṃta na lāvisī mā parameśvarā | kaisā tuṣṭalāsi baravā || 97||
verses.meaning: O Lord, how wonderfully pleased You are, that You have not even touched the teeth of the four-fold family (of creation) with the bridle of destruction, but rather joined them together in harmony.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा भीष्माऐसा कवणु । सत्यशौर्यनिपुणु। तोही आणि ब्राह्मण द्रोणु। २३४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी ग्रासिलासि कटकटा॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā bhīṣmāaisā kavaṇu | satyaśauryanipuṇu| tohī āṇi brāhmaṇa droṇu| 234 śrījñāneśvarī grāsilāsi kaṭakaṭā|| 98||
verses.meaning: Alas, how could even Bhishma, so skilled in truth and valor, and the Brahmin Drona, be swallowed up by this calamity?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहा सहस्त्रकराचा कुमरु। एथ गेला गेला कर्णवीरी। आणि आमुचिया आघवयांचा केरु। फेडिला देखें॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahā sahastrakarācā kumaru| etha gelā gelā karṇavīrī| āṇi āmuciyā āghavayāṃcā keru| pheḍilā dekheṃ||99||
verses.meaning: Ah, the son of the thousand-rayed sun (Arjuna) has gone to the valiant Karna, and I see that all our troubles have been removed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'कटकटा धातया। कैसें जाहलें अनुग्रहा यया । मियां प्रार्थूनि जगा बापुडिया । आणिलें मरण॥ ४००॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'kaṭakaṭā dhātayā| kaiseṃ jāhaleṃ anugrahā yayā | miyāṃ prārthūni jagā bāpuḍiyā | āṇileṃ maraṇa|| 400||
verses.meaning: Alas, alas, O Destroyer! How did this grace come to be? I, by my prayers, have brought death upon this poor world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मागां थोडिया बहुवा उपपत्ती । येणें सांगितलिया विभूती। तैसा नसेचि मा पुढती । बैसलों पुसों॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: māgāṃ thoḍiyā bahuvā upapattī | yeṇeṃ sāṃgitaliyā vibhūtī| taisā naseci mā puḍhatī | baisaloṃ pusoṃ|| 1||
verses.meaning: Earlier, I had asked about Your various manifestations, and You had explained them. But I am not satisfied; I am still seated here, eager to ask more.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भोग्य तें त्रिशुद्धी न चुके । आणि बुद्धीही होणारासारिखी ठाके । माझ्यां कपाळीं पिटाबें लोकें। तें लोटेल कांह्यां॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhogya teṃ triśuddhī na cuke | āṇi buddhīhī hoṇārāsārikhī ṭhāke | mājhyāṃ kapāḻīṃ piṭābeṃ lokeṃ| teṃ loṭela kāṃhyāṃ|| 2||
verses.meaning: Therefore, what is destined to be experienced cannot be avoided. And the intellect also becomes aligned with what is to happen. What people have written on my forehead (my destiny), how can it be erased?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पूर्वी अमृतही हातां आलें। परी देव नसतीचि उगले। मग काळकूट उठविलें। शेवटीं जैसें ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pūrvī amṛtahī hātāṃ āleṃ| parī deva nasatīci ugale| maga kāḻakūṭa uṭhavileṃ| śevaṭīṃ jaiseṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: Just as nectar was obtained earlier, but the gods were not satisfied, so at last, poison was churned out.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तें एकबगीं थोडें । केलिया प्रतिकारामाजिवडें। आणि तिये अवसरींचें तें सांकडें। निस्तरविलें शंभू॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teṃ ekabagīṃ thoḍeṃ | keliyā pratikārāmājivaḍeṃ| āṇi tiye avasarīṃceṃ teṃ sāṃkaḍeṃ| nistaravileṃ śaṃbhū|| 4||
verses.meaning: But that was a small matter, considering the retaliation. And in that moment of distress, Shambhu (Lord Shiva) delivered them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां हा जळता वारा कें वेंटाळे। कोणाही विषा भरलें गगन गिळे। महाकाळेंसि कें खेळें। आंगवत असे॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ hā jaḻatā vārā keṃ veṃṭāḻe| koṇāhī viṣā bharaleṃ gagana giḻe| mahākāḻeṃsi keṃ kheḻeṃ| āṃgavata ase|| 5||
verses.meaning: How can this burning wind entwine itself? How can the sky, filled with poison, be swallowed by anyone? How can one play with the great Destroyer? Is it possible?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अर्जुन दुःखें शिणतु। शोचित असे जीवाआंतु। परि न देखे तो प्रस्तुतु। अभिप्राय देवाचा ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā arjuna duḥkheṃ śiṇatu| śocita ase jīvāāṃtu| pari na dekhe to prastutu| abhiprāya devācā || 6||
verses.meaning: Thus, Arjuna, weary with sorrow, lamented within himself, yet he did not perceive the present intention of God.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे मी मारिता हे कौरव मरते। ऐसेनि वेंटाळिला होता मोहें बहुतें। तो फेडावयालागीं अनंतें। हें दाखविलें निज॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: je mī māritā he kaurava marate| aiseni veṃṭāḻilā hotā moheṃ bahuteṃ| to pheḍāvayālāgīṃ anaṃteṃ| heṃ dākhavileṃ nija|| 7||
verses.meaning: He was greatly entangled in the delusion that if he killed these Kauravas, they would die. To dispel this, the Infinite One revealed this true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अरे कोण्ही कोणातें न मारी। एथ मीचि हो सर्व संहारीं। हें विश्वरूपव्याजें हरी । प्रकटित असे॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: are koṇhī koṇāteṃ na mārī| etha mīci ho sarva saṃhārīṃ| heṃ viśvarūpavyājeṃ harī | prakaṭita ase|| 8||
verses.meaning: Oh, no one truly kills anyone here. It is I alone who am the destroyer of all. Hari (God) reveals this through the pretext of this cosmic form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी वायांचि व्याकुलता। तें न चोजवेचि पंडुसुता । मग अहा कंपु नव्हता। वाढवित असे॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī vāyāṃci vyākulatā| teṃ na cojaveci paṃḍusutā | maga ahā kaṃpu navhatā| vāḍhavita ase|| 9||
verses.meaning: But this unnecessary agitation, O son of Pandu, cannot be understood. Then, without any tremor, it continues to grow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ म्हणे पाहा हो एके वेळे। सासिकवचेंसि दोन्ही दळें। वबदनीं गेलीं आभाळें। गगनीं कां जैसीं ॥ ४१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha mhaṇe pāhā ho eke veḻe| sāsikavaceṃsi donhī daḻeṃ| vabadanīṃ gelīṃ ābhāḻeṃ| gaganīṃ kāṃ jaisīṃ || 410||
verses.meaning: Then he said, "Behold, at one time, both armies, with their protective coverings, ascended into the sky like clouds."

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां महाकल्पाचिया शेवटीं । जैं कृतांतु कोपला होय सृष्टी । तें एकविसांही स्वर्गा मिठी । पाताळासकट दे॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ mahākalpāciyā śevaṭīṃ | jaiṃ kṛtāṃtu kopalā hoya sṛṣṭī | teṃ ekavisāṃhī svargā miṭhī | pātāḻāsakaṭa de|| 11||
verses.meaning: Or, at the end of the great cosmic cycle, when the Destroyer becomes enraged at creation, it embraces even the twenty-one heavens, along with the netherworlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी उदासीनें दैवें। संचकाचीं वैभवें।॥ जेथींचीं तेथ स्वभावें । विल्या जाती ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī udāsīneṃ daiveṃ| saṃcakācīṃ vaibhaveṃ||| jethīṃcīṃ tetha svabhāveṃ | vilyā jātī || 12||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, by the indifferent hand of destiny, the accumulated wealth naturally dissolves back to its origin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं सासिन्नलीं सैन्ये एकवटें । इयें मुखीं जाहलीं प्रविष्टें। परी एकही तोंडौनि न सुटे। कैसें कर्म देखा ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ sāsinnalīṃ sainye ekavaṭeṃ | iyeṃ mukhīṃ jāhalīṃ praviṣṭeṃ| parī ekahī toṃḍauni na suṭe| kaiseṃ karma dekhā || 13||
verses.meaning: Just as these armies, having gathered with great fury, entered into these mouths, yet not a single one could escape from any mouth. Behold, such is the nature of karma!

verses.shloka_devanagari: अशोकाचे अंगवसे। चघळिले कऱर्‍्हेनि जैसे। लोक वक्‍्त्रांमाजीं तैसे। वायां गेळे॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aśokāce aṃgavase| caghaḻile kaṟar‍heni jaise| loka vak‍trāṃmājīṃ taise| vāyāṃ geḻe|| 14||
verses.meaning: Just as the leaves of the Ashoka tree, when chewed by a camel, are wasted, so too are people's words wasted when they speak ill of others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि सिसाळें मुकुटेंसीं। पडिलीं दाढांचे सांडसीं। पीठ होत कैसीं। दिसत आहाती ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari sisāḻeṃ mukuṭeṃsīṃ| paḍilīṃ dāḍhāṃce sāṃḍasīṃ| pīṭha hota kaisīṃ| disata āhātī || 15||
verses.meaning: Just as a head, adorned with a crown, is crushed between the jaws, so too are these beings ground into dust.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियें रत्ने दातांचिये सवडीं। कूट लागलें जिभेच्या बुडीं॥ कांहीं कांहीं आगरडीं। दंष्ट्रांची माखलीं ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyeṃ ratne dātāṃciye savaḍīṃ| kūṭa lāgaleṃ jibhecyā buḍīṃ|| kāṃhīṃ kāṃhīṃ āgaraḍīṃ| daṃṣṭrāṃcī mākhalīṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: Those jewels, at the convenience of the giver, became embedded at the root of the tongue; some of them were smeared with the fangs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां जे विशवरूपें काळें । ग्रासिलीं लोकांचीं शरीरें बळें । परि जीवित्व देहींचीं सिसाळें। अवश्य कीं राखिलीं ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ je viśavarūpeṃ kāḻeṃ | grāsilīṃ lokāṃcīṃ śarīreṃ baḻeṃ | pari jīvitva dehīṃcīṃ sisāḻeṃ| avaśya kīṃ rākhilīṃ || 17||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the dark form of time, though it forcefully devours the bodies of people, yet it certainly preserves the vital essence within those very bodies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी शरीरामाजीं चोखडीं। इयें उत्तमांगें होतीं फुडीं। म्हणौनि महाकाळाचियाही तोंडीं । परि उरलीं शेखीं ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī śarīrāmājīṃ cokhaḍīṃ| iyeṃ uttamāṃgeṃ hotīṃ phuḍīṃ| mhaṇauni mahākāḻāciyāhī toṃḍīṃ | pari uralīṃ śekhīṃ || 18||
verses.meaning: Similarly, these excellent parts of the body, being pure, remained intact even in the mouth of Mahakala (the great destroyer).

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणे हें काई । जन्मलयां आन मोहरचि नाहीं । जग आपैसेंचि बदनडोहीं । संचारताहे ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇe heṃ kāī | janmalayāṃ āna moharaci nāhīṃ | jaga āpaiseṃci badanaḍohīṃ | saṃcāratāhe || 99||
verses.meaning: Then one might ask, "Is there no other joy for those who are born? Is the world merely moving along in the current of its own nature?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया आपेंआप आघविया सृष्टी। लागलिया आहाति वदनाचिया वाटीं। आणि हा जेथिंचिया तेथ मिठी । देतसे उगळा॥ ४२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā āpeṃāpa āghaviyā sṛṣṭī| lāgaliyā āhāti vadanāciyā vāṭīṃ| āṇi hā jethiṃciyā tetha miṭhī | detase ugaḻā|| 420||
verses.meaning: By this very self, the entire creation, as if through the mouth, has come into being. And this (self) dissolves back into its original state, just as it arose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ब्रह्मादिक समस्त । उंचा मुखामाजीं धांबवत। येर सामान्य हे भरत। ऐलीच वदनीं॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: brahmādika samasta | uṃcā mukhāmājīṃ dhāṃbavata| yera sāmānya he bharata| ailīca vadanīṃ|| 21||
verses.meaning: All the great beings, like Brahma, are seen in the upper part of the mouth, while ordinary people like Bharata are seen in the lower part of the mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिकही भूतजात। जें उपजलेचि ठायीं ग्रासित। परि याचिया मुखा निभ्रांत। न सुटेचि कांहीं ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇikahī bhūtajāta| jeṃ upajaleci ṭhāyīṃ grāsita| pari yāciyā mukhā nibhrāṃta| na suṭeci kāṃhīṃ || 22||
verses.meaning: And also, all beings that are born are consumed in the very place of their birth. But from the mouth of this (death), nothing ever truly escapes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसे महानदीचे बोघ । वहिले ठाकिती समुद्राचें आंग । तैसें आघवाचिकडूनि जग।॥ प्रवेशत मुखीं॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaise mahānadīce bogha | vahile ṭhākitī samudrāceṃ āṃga | taiseṃ āghavācikaḍūni jaga||| praveśata mukhīṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: Just as the great river's waters flow into the ocean, so too all the worlds enter into Your mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आयुष्यपंथें प्राणिंगणीं। करोनि अहोरात्रांची सोवाणीं। वेगें वक्‍्त्रामिळणीं । साधिजत आहाती॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āyuṣyapaṃtheṃ prāṇiṃgaṇīṃ| karoni ahorātrāṃcī sovāṇīṃ| vegeṃ vak‍trāmiḻaṇīṃ | sādhijata āhātī|| 24||
verses.meaning: Life's journey is like a marketplace where day and night are the transactions, and with great haste, the mouth of death is being approached.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जळतया गिरीच्या गवखा-। माजीं घापती पतंगाचिया झाका तेसे समग्र लोक देखा। इये वदनीं पडती ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaḻatayā girīcyā gavakhā-| mājīṃ ghāpatī pataṃgāciyā jhākā tese samagra loka dekhā| iye vadanīṃ paḍatī || 25||
verses.meaning: Just as swarms of moths fall into the blazing mouth of a burning mountain, so too do all these people fall into this mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि जेतुलें येथ प्रवेशलें। तें 'तातलिया लोहें पाणीचि पां गिळिलें। बहिवटींहि पुसिलें। नामरूप तयांचें ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari jetuleṃ yetha praveśaleṃ| teṃ 'tātaliyā loheṃ pāṇīci pāṃ giḻileṃ| bahivaṭīṃhi pusileṃ| nāmarūpa tayāṃceṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: Whatever entered here, it was as if water was swallowed by hot iron. Even its outward form was erased, along with its name and identity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि येतुलाही आरोगण। करितां भुके नाहीं उणेपण। कैसें दीपन असाधारण। उदयलें यया॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi yetulāhī ārogaṇa| karitāṃ bhuke nāhīṃ uṇepaṇa| kaiseṃ dīpana asādhāraṇa| udayaleṃ yayā|| 27||
verses.meaning: Even after partaking of this, hunger does not diminish. How can such an extraordinary light arise from this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा रोगिया ज्वराहूनि उठिला। कां भणगा दुकाळु पाहला। तैसा जिभांचा लळलळाटु देखिला । आवाळुवें चाटितां॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā rogiyā jvarāhūni uṭhilā| kāṃ bhaṇagā dukāḻu pāhalā| taisā jibhāṃcā laḻalaḻāṭu dekhilā | āvāḻuveṃ cāṭitāṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: Just as a patient recovers from fever, or a beggar sees the end of a famine, so too the tongue, having licked the palate, experiences a similar longing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें आहाराचे नांवें कांहीं। तोंडापासूनि उरलेंचि नाहीं। कैसी समसमीत नवाई। भुकेळेपणाची॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ āhārāce nāṃveṃ kāṃhīṃ| toṃḍāpāsūni uraleṃci nāhīṃ| kaisī samasamīta navāī| bhukeḻepaṇācī|| 29||
verses.meaning: Similarly, nothing remains from the mouth in the name of food. How amazing is this newness of hunger, which consumes everything?

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय सागराचा घोंटु भरावा । कीं पर्वताचा घांसु करावा। ब्रह्मकटाहो घाळलावा। आघवाचि दाढे ॥ ४३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya sāgarācā ghoṃṭu bharāvā | kīṃ parvatācā ghāṃsu karāvā| brahmakaṭāho ghāḻalāvā| āghavāci dāḍhe || 430||
verses.meaning: How can one gulp down the ocean, or swallow a mountain? How can the entire cosmic egg be crushed between the teeth?

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिशा सगळियाचि गिळाविया। चांदणिया चाटूनि घ्याविया । ऐसें वर्तत आहे साविया। लोलुप्य बा तुझें ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: diśā sagaḻiyāci giḻāviyā| cāṃdaṇiyā cāṭūni ghyāviyā | aiseṃ vartata āhe sāviyā| lolupya bā tujheṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: O Lord, your greed is such that it would swallow all directions and lick up all the moonlight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा भोगीं कामु वाढे। कां इंधने आगीसि हाकाक चढे। तैसी खातखातांचि तोंडें। खाखांतें ठेलीं॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā bhogīṃ kāmu vāḍhe| kāṃ iṃdhane āgīsi hākāka caḍhe| taisī khātakhātāṃci toṃḍeṃ| khākhāṃteṃ ṭhelīṃ||32||
verses.meaning: Just as desire grows with indulgence, or fire rages higher with fuel, so too, the mouths, even while eating, remained insatiable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसें एकचि केवढें पसरलें। त्रिभुवन जिव्हाग्रीं आहे टेंकलें। जैसें कां कवबीठ घातलें। बडवानळीं॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaiseṃ ekaci kevaḍheṃ pasaraleṃ| tribhuvana jivhāgrīṃ āhe ṭeṃkaleṃ| jaiseṃ kāṃ kavabīṭha ghātaleṃ| baḍavānaḻīṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: How can one describe the vastness of this single entity, which holds the three worlds poised on its tongue, like a tiny seed cast into the great fire of the cosmic dissolution?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसीं अपार वदनें। आतां येतुलीं कैंचीं त्रिभुवनें। कां आहारु न मिळतां येणें मानें। वाढविलीं सैंघ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisīṃ apāra vadaneṃ| ātāṃ yetulīṃ kaiṃcīṃ tribhuvaneṃ| kāṃ āhāru na miḻatāṃ yeṇeṃ māneṃ| vāḍhavilīṃ saiṃgha|| 34||
verses.meaning: With so many mouths, where would there be enough worlds to feed them? Or, without finding sustenance, how could they have grown so immensely?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा हा लोकु बापुडा। जाहला वदनज्वाळां वरपडा। जेसीं वणवेयाचिया वेढां। सांपडती मृगें॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā hā loku bāpuḍā| jāhalā vadanajvāḻāṃ varapaḍā| jesīṃ vaṇaveyāciyā veḍhāṃ| sāṃpaḍatī mṛgeṃ|| 35||
verses.meaning: Alas, this poor world is caught in the flames of the mouth of time, just as deer are trapped in the encirclement of a forest fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तैसें या विश्वा जाहाळें। देव नव्हे हें कर्म आलें। कां जग चळचळां पांगिळें। काळजाळें ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ taiseṃ yā viśvā jāhāḻeṃ| deva navhe heṃ karma āleṃ| kāṃ jaga caḻacaḻāṃ pāṃgiḻeṃ| kāḻajāḻeṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: Now, the universe has become like this: it is not God, but rather the consequence of karma. Or perhaps the world is completely entangled in the net of time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां इये अंगप्रभेचिये वागुरे। कोणीकडूनि निगिजैल चराचरें। हीं वक्‍्त्रें नोहेति जोहारें। बोडवलीं जगा ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ iye aṃgaprabheciye vāgure| koṇīkaḍūni nigijaila carācareṃ| hīṃ vak‍treṃ noheti johāreṃ| boḍavalīṃ jagā || 37||
verses.meaning: Now, by the radiance of this body, how can the entire animate and inanimate world be contained? These are not mere mouths, but rather the very essence that illuminates the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आगी आपुले दाहकपणें। कैसेनि पोळिजे तें नेणें। परी जया लागे तया प्राणें। सुटिकाची नाहीं ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āgī āpule dāhakapaṇeṃ| kaiseni poḻije teṃ neṇeṃ| parī jayā lāge tayā prāṇeṃ| suṭikācī nāhīṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: The fire itself does not know how it burns, yet for whomever it touches, there is no escape from its grasp.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी माझेनि तिखटपणें । कैसें निवटे हें शस्त्र कायि जाणें। कां आपुल्यां मारा नेणें । विष जैसें ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī mājheni tikhaṭapaṇeṃ | kaiseṃ nivaṭe heṃ śastra kāyi jāṇeṃ| kāṃ āpulyāṃ mārā neṇeṃ | viṣa jaiseṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Just as poison does not know its own destructive power, how can this weapon understand the sharpness of my being, by which it is rendered ineffective?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी तुज कांहीं । आपुलिया उग्रपणाची सेचि नाहीं । परि ऐलीकडिले मुखीं खाई। हो सरळी जगाची ॥ ४४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī tuja kāṃhīṃ | āpuliyā ugrapaṇācī seci nāhīṃ | pari ailīkaḍile mukhīṃ khāī| ho saraḻī jagācī || 440||
verses.meaning: Similarly, you have no concern for your own fierce nature, but for the sake of the world's salvation, you devour it with your mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा आत्मा तूं एकु । सकळविश्वव्यापकु। तरि कां आम्हां अंतकु । बोडवलासी॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā ātmā tūṃ eku | sakaḻaviśvavyāpaku| tari kāṃ āmhāṃ aṃtaku | boḍavalāsī|| 41||
verses.meaning: Oh, you are the one Self, pervading the entire universe. Why then have you become a destroyer for us?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मियां सांडिली जीवित्वाची चाड । आणि तुवांही न धरावी भीड । मनीं आहे तें उघड। बोल पां सुखें॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī miyāṃ sāṃḍilī jīvitvācī cāḍa | āṇi tuvāṃhī na dharāvī bhīḍa | manīṃ āhe teṃ ughaḍa| bola pāṃ sukheṃ|| 42||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I have abandoned the desire for life, and you too should not hold back out of shyness. Speak freely and happily whatever is in your mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किती वाढविसी या उग्ररूपा। आंगींचें भगवंतपण आठवीं बापा। नाहीं तरी कृपा । मजपुरती पाहीं ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kitī vāḍhavisī yā ugrarūpā| āṃgīṃceṃ bhagavaṃtapaṇa āṭhavīṃ bāpā| nāhīṃ tarī kṛpā | majapuratī pāhīṃ || 43||
verses.meaning: Why do you prolong this fierce form? Remember your divine nature, O Lord. Otherwise, let your grace be directed solely towards me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी एक वेळ वेदवेद्या। जी त्रिभुवनैक आद्या । विनवणी विशश्‍ववंद्या । आडके माझी ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī eka veḻa vedavedyā| jī tribhuvanaika ādyā | vinavaṇī viśaś‍vavaṃdyā | āḍake mājhī || 44||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Knower of the Vedas, the primal source of the three worlds, my humble plea, O universally revered one, is stuck within me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें बोलोनि वीरें। चरण नमस्कारिले शिरें। मग म्हणे तरी सर्वेश्‍वरें। अवधारिजो॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ boloni vīreṃ| caraṇa namaskārile śireṃ| maga mhaṇe tarī sarveś‍vareṃ| avadhārijo|| 45 ||
verses.meaning: Having spoken thus, the warrior bowed his head at the feet, and then said, "May the Lord of all hear this."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मियां होआवया समाधान। जी पुसिलें विश्‍्वरूपध्यान । आणि एकेंचि काळें त्रिभुवन । गिळितुचि उठिलासि॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: miyāṃ hoāvayā samādhāna| jī pusileṃ viś‍varūpadhyāna | āṇi ekeṃci kāḻeṃ tribhuvana | giḻituci uṭhilāsi|| 46||
verses.meaning: To satisfy me, you asked about the meditation on the Universal Form, and at that very moment, you rose, swallowing the three worlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि तूं कोण कां येतुलीं। इयें भ्यासुरें मुखें कां मेळविलीं । अबघियाचि करीं परिजिलीं। शस्त्रें कांह्या॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari tūṃ koṇa kāṃ yetulīṃ| iyeṃ bhyāsureṃ mukheṃ kāṃ meḻavilīṃ | abaghiyāci karīṃ parijilīṃ| śastreṃ kāṃhyā|| 47||
verses.meaning: Then who are you, and why have you come? Why have these terrifying mouths gathered? Why have you prepared all these weapons?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी जंब तंब रागीटपणें । वाढोनि गगना आणितोसि उणें । कां डोळे करूनि भिंगुळवाणे । भेडसावीत आहासी ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī jaṃba taṃba rāgīṭapaṇeṃ | vāḍhoni gaganā āṇitosi uṇeṃ | kāṃ ḍoḻe karūni bhiṃguḻavāṇe | bheḍasāvīta āhāsī || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Why do you, in your anger, swell up and diminish the sky, or with terrifying eyes, try to frighten me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ कृतांतेंसि देवा। कासया किजतसे हेवा। हा आपुला तुवां सांगावा । अभिप्राय मज॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha kṛtāṃteṃsi devā| kāsayā kijatase hevā| hā āpulā tuvāṃ sāṃgāvā | abhiprāya maja|| 49||
verses.meaning: O Lord, why is there such envy towards the God of Death? You must explain this intention of yours to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या बोला म्हणे अनंतु। मी कोण हें आहासी पुसतु । आणि कायिसयालागीं असें वाढतु। उग्रतेसीं ॥ ४५० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā bolā mhaṇe anaṃtu| mī koṇa heṃ āhāsī pusatu | āṇi kāyisayālāgīṃ aseṃ vāḍhatu| ugratesīṃ || 450 ||
verses.meaning: To these words, Ananta replied, "Who do you ask me to be? And why do I grow in fierceness?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि मी काळु गा हें फुडें। लोक संहारावयालागीं वाढें। सैंघ पसरिलीं आहातीं तोंडें । आतां ग्रासीन हें आघवें ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari mī kāḻu gā heṃ phuḍeṃ| loka saṃhārāvayālāgīṃ vāḍheṃ| saiṃgha pasarilīṃ āhātīṃ toṃḍeṃ | ātāṃ grāsīna heṃ āghaveṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Indeed, I am Time, grown vast, with mouths spread everywhere to devour the worlds. Now I shall consume all of them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ अर्जुन म्हणे कटकटा। उबगिलों मागिल्या संकटा । म्हणौनि आळविला तंव बोखटा। उवाइला हा॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha arjuna mhaṇe kaṭakaṭā| ubagiloṃ māgilyā saṃkaṭā | mhaṇauni āḻavilā taṃva bokhaṭā| uvāilā hā|| 52||
verses.meaning: Here Arjuna said, "Alas! I am weary of past troubles. Therefore, when I called upon You, this evil one has appeared."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि कठिण बोलें आसतुटी। अर्जुन होईल हिंपुटी । म्हणौनि सवेंचि म्हणे किरीटी। परि आन एक असे॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci kaṭhiṇa boleṃ āsatuṭī| arjuna hoīla hiṃpuṭī | mhaṇauni saveṃci mhaṇe kirīṭī| pari āna eka ase||53||
verses.meaning: Similarly, with harsh words, Arjuna might become disheartened. Therefore, Krishna immediately addresses him as 'Kireeti' (Arjuna), but there is something else to consider.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आतांचिये संहारवाहरे। तुम्ही पांडव असा बाहिरे। तेथ जातजातां धनुर्धरें। सांवरिळे २३८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी प्राण॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātāṃciye saṃhāravāhare| tumhī pāṃḍava asā bāhire| tetha jātajātāṃ dhanurdhareṃ| sāṃvariḻe 238 śrījñāneśvarī prāṇa|| 54||
verses.meaning: But now, in this great destruction, you Pandavas are outside its reach. As the destruction was about to engulf them, the archer (Arjuna) was restrained. This is the very life of Shri Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: होता मरणमहामारीं गेला। तो मागुता सावधु जाहला । मग लागला बोला। चित्त देऊं ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: hotā maraṇamahāmārīṃ gelā| to māgutā sāvadhu jāhalā | maga lāgalā bolā| citta deūṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: He who was caught in the great plague of death, became conscious again. Then he began to speak, giving his full attention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें म्हण्जित आहे देवें। अर्जुना तुम्ही माझें हें जाणावें। येर जाण मी आघवें। सरलों ग्रासूं॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ mhaṇjita āhe deveṃ| arjunā tumhī mājheṃ heṃ jāṇāveṃ| yera jāṇa mī āghaveṃ| saraloṃ grāsūṃ|| 56||
verses.meaning: The Lord says, "Arjuna, know that you are Mine. All other knowledge, I have consumed and transcended."

verses.shloka_devanagari: वज्नानळीं प्रचंडीं। जैसी घापे लोणियाची उंडी। तैसें जग हें माझिया तोंडीं। तुवां देखिलें जें॥५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vajnānaḻīṃ pracaṃḍīṃ| jaisī ghāpe loṇiyācī uṃḍī| taiseṃ jaga heṃ mājhiyā toṃḍīṃ| tuvāṃ dekhileṃ jeṃ||57||
verses.meaning: Just as a lump of butter melts effortlessly in a blazing fire, so too have you witnessed this entire universe dissolving within my mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तयामाझारीं कांहीं । भरंबसेनि उणें नाहीं । इयें वायांचि सैन्ये पाहीं । बरवतें आहाती ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tayāmājhārīṃ kāṃhīṃ | bharaṃbaseni uṇeṃ nāhīṃ | iyeṃ vāyāṃci sainye pāhīṃ | baravateṃ āhātī || 58||
verses.meaning: Yet, among them, there is no lack of confidence. Look, these armies are merely for show, they are just for display.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा चतुरंगाचिया संपदा । करित महाकाळेंसीं स्पर्धा। वांटिवेचिया मदा। वळघळे जे॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā caturaṃgāciyā saṃpadā | karita mahākāḻeṃsīṃ spardhā| vāṃṭiveciyā madā| vaḻaghaḻe je||59||
verses.meaning: Such a person, with the wealth of the fourfold army, challenges even the great destroyer, Death, inflated by the pride of his inheritance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे जे मिळोनियां मेळे। कुंथती वौरवृत्तीचेनि बळें। यमावरी गजदळें। वाखाणिजताती ॥ ४६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he je miḻoniyāṃ meḻe| kuṃthatī vauravṛttīceni baḻeṃ| yamāvarī gajadaḻeṃ| vākhāṇijatātī || 460||
verses.meaning: These, who gather together and struggle with the strength of their enmity, are praised as elephant armies against Yama (death).

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणती सृष्टीवरी सृष्टी करूं। आण वाहूनि मृत्यूतें मारूं। आणि जगाचा भरूं। घोंटु यया॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇatī sṛṣṭīvarī sṛṣṭī karūṃ| āṇa vāhūni mṛtyūteṃ mārūṃ| āṇi jagācā bharūṃ| ghoṃṭu yayā|| 61||
verses.meaning: They say, "We will create creation upon creation, and swearing an oath, we will conquer death, and swallow the entire world in one gulp."

verses.shloka_devanagari: पृथ्वी सगळीचि गिळूं। आकाश वरिच्यावरी जाळूं। कां बाणवरी खिळूं। वारयातें ॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pṛthvī sagaḻīci giḻūṃ| ākāśa varicyāvarī jāḻūṃ| kāṃ bāṇavarī khiḻūṃ| vārayāteṃ ||62||
verses.meaning: We will swallow the entire earth, burn the sky above, or nail the wind with arrows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बोल हतियेराहूनि तिखट । दिसती अग्निपरिस दासट । मारकपणें काळकूट। महुर म्हणत ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: bola hatiyerāhūni tikhaṭa | disatī agniparisa dāsaṭa | mārakapaṇeṃ kāḻakūṭa| mahura mhaṇata || 63||
verses.meaning: Their words are sharper than weapons, appearing fiercer than fire. In their deadliness, they make even the deadliest poison seem sweet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी हे गंधर्वनगरींचे उमाळे) जाण पोकळीचे पेंडवळे । अगा चित्रीव फळें। वीर हे देखें॥६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī he gaṃdharvanagarīṃce umāḻe) jāṇa pokaḻīce peṃḍavaḻe | agā citrīva phaḻeṃ| vīra he dekheṃ||64||
verses.meaning: These emotional outbursts are like a city of Gandharvas (a mirage), know them to be like a bundle of straw in the void, or like painted fruits, O brave one, see them thus.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा मृगजळाचा पूर आला । दळ नव्हे कापडाचा साप केला। इया श्रृंगारूनियां खाला । मांडिलिया पै॥६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā mṛgajaḻācā pūra ālā | daḻa navhe kāpaḍācā sāpa kelā| iyā śrṛṃgārūniyāṃ khālā | māṃḍiliyā pai||65||
verses.meaning: This is like a flood of mirage water, not a real army; it's like a snake made of cloth. Such illusions are adorned and set up.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर चेष्टवितें जें बळ। तें मागांचि मियां ग्रासिळें सकळ। आतां कोल्हारिचे वेताळ। तैसे निर्जीव हे आहाती ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera ceṣṭaviteṃ jeṃ baḻa| teṃ māgāṃci miyāṃ grāsiḻeṃ sakaḻa| ātāṃ kolhārice vetāḻa| taise nirjīva he āhātī || 66||
verses.meaning: The power that was mocking me, I have already devoured it all. Now, these are lifeless, like the demons of Kolhar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हालविती दोरी तुटली । तरि तियें खांबावरील बाहुलीं। भलतेणें लोटिलीं। उलथोनि पडती ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hālavitī dorī tuṭalī | tari tiyeṃ khāṃbāvarīla bāhulīṃ| bhalateṇeṃ loṭilīṃ| ulathoni paḍatī || 67||
verses.meaning: If the string that moves the puppets breaks, then those puppets on the pillar, pushed by anyone, will fall over.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सैन्याचा यया बगा । मोडतां वेळु न लगेल पैं गा। म्हणोनि उठीं उठीं वेगां। शहाणा होई ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sainyācā yayā bagā | moḍatāṃ veḻu na lagela paiṃ gā| mhaṇoni uṭhīṃ uṭhīṃ vegāṃ| śahāṇā hoī || 68||
verses.meaning: Just as an army can be routed in no time, so too, rise up quickly and become wise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुवां गोग्रहणाचेनि अवसरें। घातलें मोहनास्त्र एकसरें। मग विराटाचेनि महाभेडें उत्तरें आसडूनि नागविलें॥ ६९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuvāṃ gograhaṇāceni avasareṃ| ghātaleṃ mohanāstra ekasareṃ| maga virāṭāceni mahābheḍeṃ uttareṃ āsaḍūni nāgavileṃ|| 69 ||
verses.meaning: At the time of the cattle raid, you cast a powerful spell of delusion. Then, with the great warrior Virat, you stripped them bare, taunting them with words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां हें त्याहूनि निपटारें जहालें। निवटीं आयितें रण पडिलें। घेई यश रिपु जिंतिळे। एकलेनि अर्जुनें ॥ ४७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ heṃ tyāhūni nipaṭāreṃ jahāleṃ| nivaṭīṃ āyiteṃ raṇa paḍileṃ| gheī yaśa ripu jiṃtiḻe| ekaleni arjuneṃ || 470||
verses.meaning: Now, this has become even easier. The battle is already won. Take the glory, for the enemy has been conquered by Arjuna alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि कोरडें यशचि नोहे। समग्र राज्यही आलें आहे। तूं निमित्तमात्रचि होयें। सव्यसाची ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi koraḍeṃ yaśaci nohe| samagra rājyahī āleṃ āhe| tūṃ nimittamātraci hoyeṃ| savyasācī || 71||
verses.meaning: And it is not just dry success; the entire kingdom has come to you. You are merely an instrument, O Savyasachi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: द्रोणाचा पाडु न करीं। भीष्माचें भय न धरीं। कैसेनि कर्णावरी। परजूं हें न म्हण॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: droṇācā pāḍu na karīṃ| bhīṣmāceṃ bhaya na dharīṃ| kaiseni karṇāvarī| parajūṃ heṃ na mhaṇa|| 72||
verses.meaning: I will not cause Dronacharya's defeat, nor will I fear Bhishma. How can I even think of attacking Karna?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कोण उपायो जयद्रथा कौजे। हें न चिंतू चित्त तुझें । आणिकही आधि जे जे। नावाणिगे वीर॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: koṇa upāyo jayadrathā kauje| heṃ na ciṃtū citta tujheṃ | āṇikahī ādhi je je| nāvāṇige vīra|| 73||
verses.meaning: What use is Jayadratha to you? Do not let your mind dwell on this. And what about the other insignificant warriors?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेही एक एक आघवे । चित्रींचे सिंहाडे मानावे । जैसे बोलेनि हातें घ्यावे । पुसोनियां ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tehī eka eka āghave | citrīṃce siṃhāḍe mānāve | jaise boleni hāteṃ ghyāve | pusoniyāṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Consider all of them, each one, as lions drawn in a picture. It is like trying to grasp them with your hands after merely speaking about them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यावरी पांडवा । काइसा युद्धाचा मेळावा। हा आभासु गा आघवा । येर ग्रासिलें मियां ॥७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāvarī pāṃḍavā | kāisā yuddhācā meḻāvā| hā ābhāsu gā āghavā | yera grāsileṃ miyāṃ ||75||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, what is this assembly for battle? This is all an illusion, for I have already devoured the others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेव्हां तुवां देखिलें। हे माझिया बदनीं पडिले। तेव्हांचि यांचें आयुष्य सरलें। आतां रितीं सोपें ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jevhāṃ tuvāṃ dekhileṃ| he mājhiyā badanīṃ paḍile| tevhāṃci yāṃceṃ āyuṣya saraleṃ| ātāṃ ritīṃ sopeṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: When you saw them, they fell into my mouth. Their life ended then. Now, they are empty and easy to take.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि वहिला उठीं । मियां मारिले तूं निवटीं।॥ न रिगे शोकसंकटीं । नाथिलिया ॥ ७७9 ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vahilā uṭhīṃ | miyāṃ mārile tūṃ nivaṭīṃ||| na rige śokasaṃkaṭīṃ | nāthiliyā || 779 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, rise quickly; slay those I have already slain. Do not fall into the sorrowful distress of the baseless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपणचि आडखिळा कौजे। तो कौतुकें जैसा विंधोनि पाडिजे। तैसें देखें गा तुझें । निमित्त आहे॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpaṇaci āḍakhiḻā kauje| to kautukeṃ jaisā viṃdhoni pāḍije| taiseṃ dekheṃ gā tujheṃ | nimitta āhe|| 78||
verses.meaning: Just as one might playfully trip oneself and then fall, so too, understand that your actions are merely an excuse (for the divine play).

verses.shloka_devanagari: बापा विरुद्ध जें जाहलें। तें उपजतांचि वाघें नेलें) आतां राज्येंशीं संचलें। यश तूं भोगीं ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāpā viruddha jeṃ jāhaleṃ| teṃ upajatāṃci vāgheṃ neleṃ) ātāṃ rājyeṃśīṃ saṃcaleṃ| yaśa tūṃ bhogīṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: Whatever was against your father, the tiger of time devoured it at birth. Now, with the kingdom, you have accumulated glory; enjoy it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सावियाचि उतत होते दायाद। आणि बळिये जगीं दुर्मद। ते बधिले विशद । सायासु न लागतां ॥ ४८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāviyāci utata hote dāyāda| āṇi baḻiye jagīṃ durmada| te badhile viśada | sāyāsu na lāgatāṃ || 480||
verses.meaning: The Kauravas, who were born of the same lineage and were powerful and arrogant in the world, were clearly vanquished without much effort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया इया गोष्टी । विश्वाच्या वाक्‍्पटीं । लिहूनि घालीं किरीटी। जगामाजीं ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā iyā goṣṭī | viśvācyā vāk‍paṭīṃ | lihūni ghālīṃ kirīṭī| jagāmājīṃ || 89||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, in this manner, inscribe these matters upon the canvas of the universe, for all the world to see.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी आघवीचि हे कथा । तया अपूर्ण मनोरथा । संजयो सांगे कुरुनाथा। ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī āghavīci he kathā | tayā apūrṇa manorathā | saṃjayo sāṃge kurunāthā| jñānadevo mhaṇe|| 82||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev says, "Sanjaya narrated this entire story to the Lord of the Kurus, who had unfulfilled desires."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग सत्यलोकौनि गंगाजळ। सुटलिया वाजत खळाळ तैशी वाचा विशाळ। बोलतां तया॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga satyalokauni gaṃgājaḻa| suṭaliyā vājata khaḻāḻa taiśī vācā viśāḻa| bolatāṃ tayā|| 83||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganges river, originating from Satyaloka, flows forth with a resounding gurgle, so too does his vast speech pour out.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी महामेघांचे २४० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी उमाळे । घडघडीत एके वेळे। कां घुमघुमिला मंदराचळें। क्षीराब्यी जैसा ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī mahāmeghāṃce 240 śrījñāneśvarī umāḻe | ghaḍaghaḍīta eke veḻe| kāṃ ghumaghumilā maṃdarācaḻeṃ| kṣīrābyī jaisā || 84||
verses.meaning: Or, like the great clouds that thunder all at once, or like the Mandara mountain that churned the ocean of milk, so too did the divine wisdom of Shri Dnyaneshwari manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें गंभीरें महानादें। हें वाक्य बिशवकंदें। बोलिलें अगाधें । अनंतरूपें ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ gaṃbhīreṃ mahānādeṃ| heṃ vākya biśavakaṃdeṃ| bolileṃ agādheṃ | anaṃtarūpeṃ || 85 ||
verses.meaning: In the same way, with a profound and great sound, this sentence was spoken by the root of the universe, in infinite forms, immeasurably.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अर्जुने मोटके ऐकिलें। आणि सुख कीं भय दुणावलें। हें नेणों परि कांपिन्नलें। सर्वांग तयाचें ॥ ८६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ arjune moṭake aikileṃ| āṇi sukha kīṃ bhaya duṇāvaleṃ| heṃ neṇoṃ pari kāṃpinnaleṃ| sarvāṃga tayāceṃ || 86 ||
verses.meaning: Arjuna heard these words, and whether it was joy or fear that intensified, he did not know, but his entire body trembled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सखोलपणें बळली मोट । आणि तैसैचि जोडले करसंपुट। वेळोवेळां ललाट । चरणीं ठेवी॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sakholapaṇeṃ baḻalī moṭa | āṇi taisaici joḍale karasaṃpuṭa| veḻoveḻāṃ lalāṭa | caraṇīṃ ṭhevī|| 87||
verses.meaning: With profound devotion, he joined his palms and repeatedly bowed his forehead at the feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवबींचि कांहीं बोलों जाये। तंव गळा बुजालाचि ठाये। हें सुख कीं भय होये। हें विचारा तुम्ही ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevabīṃci kāṃhīṃ boloṃ jāye| taṃva gaḻā bujālāci ṭhāye| heṃ sukha kīṃ bhaya hoye| heṃ vicārā tumhī || 88 ||
verses.meaning: As soon as I try to speak of it, my throat chokes up. Is this joy or fear? You yourselves consider this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तेव्हां देवाचेनि बोलें। अर्जुना हें ऐसें जाहलें। मियां पदांवरूनि देखिळें। एलोकींचिया॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari tevhāṃ devāceni boleṃ| arjunā heṃ aiseṃ jāhaleṃ| miyāṃ padāṃvarūni dekhiḻeṃ| elokīṃciyā|| 89||
verses.meaning: But then, by the word of God, Arjuna, this is how it happened. I saw it from the words, as if from another world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तैसाचि भेणभेण। पुढती जोहारूनि चरण। मग म्हणे जी आपण ऐसें बोलिलेती॥ ४९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga taisāci bheṇabheṇa| puḍhatī johārūni caraṇa| maga mhaṇe jī āpaṇa aiseṃ boliletī|| 490||
verses.meaning: Then, with the same reverence, again bowing at the feet, he said, "You have spoken thus, my Lord."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी अर्जुना मी काळु । आणि ग्रासिजे तो माझा खेळु । हा बोलु तुझा कौर अढळु । मानूं आम्ही ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī arjunā mī kāḻu | āṇi grāsije to mājhā kheḻu | hā bolu tujhā kaura aḍhaḻu | mānūṃ āmhī || 91||
verses.meaning: Or, Arjuna, I am Time (Death), and whatever is consumed is My play. This statement of yours, O Kaurava, we consider to be unwavering truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तुवां जी काळें। आजि स्थितीचिये वेळे। ग्रासिजे हें न मिळे। विचारासी॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari tuvāṃ jī kāḻeṃ| āji sthitīciye veḻe| grāsije heṃ na miḻe| vicārāsī|| 92||
verses.meaning: But that which you have swallowed, at this very moment of existence, is not grasped by intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसेनि आंगींचें तारुण्य काढावें। कैंचें नव्हे तें वार्धक्य आणावें। म्हणौनि करूं म्हणसी तें नव्हे । बहुतकरुनी॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaiseni āṃgīṃceṃ tāruṇya kāḍhāveṃ| kaiṃceṃ navhe teṃ vārdhakya āṇāveṃ| mhaṇauni karūṃ mhaṇasī teṃ navhe | bahutakarunī|| 93||
verses.meaning: How can one remove their youth? How can one bring about old age that is not yet due? Therefore, what you intend to do is not possible, for the most part.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां जी चौपाहारी न भरतां। कोणेही वेळे श्रीअनंता । काय माध्यान्हीं सविता। मावळतु आहे॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ jī caupāhārī na bharatāṃ| koṇehī veḻe śrīanaṃtā | kāya mādhyānhīṃ savitā| māvaḻatu āhe|| 94||
verses.meaning: Indeed, without waiting for the four watches of the day, does the sun ever set at midday for the infinite Lord?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं तुज अखंडिता काळा। तिन्ही आहाती जी वेळा । तया तिन्ही परी सबळा । आपुलालिया समयीं ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ tuja akhaṃḍitā kāḻā| tinhī āhātī jī veḻā | tayā tinhī parī sabaḻā | āpulāliyā samayīṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: Indeed, for you, O timeless one, all three periods of time exist. All three, in their own powerful ways, manifest at their respective times.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे वेळीं हों लागे उत्पत्ती) ते वेळीं स्थिति प्रळयो हारपती। आणि स्थितिकाळीं न मिरविती । उत्पत्ति प्रळयो ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: je veḻīṃ hoṃ lāge utpattī) te veḻīṃ sthiti praḻayo hārapatī| āṇi sthitikāḻīṃ na miravitī | utpatti praḻayo || 96||
verses.meaning: When creation begins, then the states of sustenance and dissolution disappear. And during the period of sustenance, creation and dissolution do not manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं प्रळयाचिये वेळे । उत्पत्ति स्थिति मावळे । हें कायसेनही न ढळे । अनादि ऐसें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ praḻayāciye veḻe | utpatti sthiti māvaḻe | heṃ kāyasenahī na ḍhaḻe | anādi aiseṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Even at the time of the great dissolution, when creation and sustenance cease to exist, this (the Self) does not waver in the slightest, for it is beginningless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आजि तंब भरें भोगें। स्थिति वर्तिजत आहे जगें । एथ ग्रसिसी तूं हें न लगे। माझ्या जीवीं ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āji taṃba bhareṃ bhogeṃ| sthiti vartijata āhe jageṃ | etha grasisī tūṃ heṃ na lage| mājhyā jīvīṃ || 98||
verses.meaning: Therefore, today, the world is filled with enjoyment, and it continues to exist. That you would consume all this, I cannot bear in my heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब संकेतें देव बोले। अगा या दोन्हीं सेन्यांसींचि मरण पुरलें । तें प्रत्यक्षच तुज दाविलें । येर यथाकाळें जाण ॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba saṃketeṃ deva bole| agā yā donhīṃ senyāṃsīṃci maraṇa puraleṃ | teṃ pratyakṣaca tuja dāvileṃ | yera yathākāḻeṃ jāṇa ||99||
verses.meaning: Then, by a gesture, the Lord said, "Indeed, the death of both these armies has been accomplished. I have shown it to you directly; the rest you will know in due course."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा संकेतु जंव अनंता । वेळु लागला बोलतां। तंव अर्जुने लोकु मागुता । देखिला यथास्थिति॥ ५००॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā saṃketu jaṃva anaṃtā | veḻu lāgalā bolatāṃ| taṃva arjune loku māgutā | dekhilā yathāsthiti|| 500||
verses.meaning: While this indication of the Infinite was being spoken, Arjuna again saw the people in their proper state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणतसे देवा। तूं सूत्री विएवलाघवा । जग आला मा आघवा पूर्वस्थिति पुढती ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇatase devā| tūṃ sūtrī vievalāghavā | jaga ālā mā āghavā pūrvasthiti puḍhatī || 9||
verses.meaning: Then he says to God, "You are woven into the thread of this universe. The entire world has come from me, and will return to its original state."

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी पडिलिया दुःखसागरीं। तूं काढिसी कां जयापरी। ते कौर्ति तुझी श्रीहरी। आठवित असें॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī paḍiliyā duḥkhasāgarīṃ| tūṃ kāḍhisī kāṃ jayāparī| te kaurti tujhī śrīharī| āṭhavita aseṃ|| 2||
verses.meaning: But when I fall into the ocean of sorrow, the way you rescue me, that glory of yours, O Shrihari, I remember.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कौर्ति आठवितां वेळोवेळां। भोगीतसें महासुखाचा सोहळा । तेथ हर्षामृतकल्लोळा-। वरी लोळत आहें॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaurti āṭhavitāṃ veḻoveḻāṃ| bhogītaseṃ mahāsukhācā sohaḻā | tetha harṣāmṛtakalloḻā-| varī loḻata āheṃ|| 3||
verses.meaning: Remembering Your glory again and again, I experience the celebration of great joy. There, I am immersed in waves of the nectar of bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवा जियालेपणें जग। धरी तुझ्या ठायीं अनुराग। आणि दुष्टां तयां भंग अधिकाधिक ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: devā jiyālepaṇeṃ jaga| dharī tujhyā ṭhāyīṃ anurāga| āṇi duṣṭāṃ tayāṃ bhaṃga adhikādhika || 4||
verses.meaning: O God, by Your very existence, the world holds love for You, and the wicked are increasingly destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं त्रिभुवनींचिया राक्षसां। महाभय तूं हृषीकेशा। म्हणोनि पळताती दाही दिशां। पैळलीकडे ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ tribhuvanīṃciyā rākṣasāṃ| mahābhaya tūṃ hṛṣīkeśā| mhaṇoni paḻatātī dāhī diśāṃ| paiḻalīkaḍe || 5||
verses.meaning: O Hrishikesha, you are a great terror to the demons of the three worlds, which is why they flee in all ten directions, even beyond the farthest reaches.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ सुर नर सिद्ध किन्नर । किंबहुना चराचर। ते तुज देखोनि हर्षनिर्भर। नमस्कारित असती ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha sura nara siddha kinnara | kiṃbahunā carācara| te tuja dekhoni harṣanirbhara| namaskārita asatī || 6||
verses.meaning: Here, gods, humans, Siddhas, Kinnaras, and indeed all animate and inanimate beings, seeing you, are filled with joy and offer their salutations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ गा कवणा कारणा । राक्षस हे नारायणा। न लगतीचि चरणा । 'पळते जाहले॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha gā kavaṇā kāraṇā | rākṣasa he nārāyaṇā| na lagatīci caraṇā | 'paḻate jāhale|| 7||
verses.meaning: For what reason, O Narayana, did these demons not touch your feet, but instead fled?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि हें काय तूंतें पुसावें। येतुलें आम्हांसिही जाणवें । तरी सूर्योदयीं राहावें। कैसेनि तमें॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi heṃ kāya tūṃteṃ pusāveṃ| yetuleṃ āmhāṃsihī jāṇaveṃ | tarī sūryodayīṃ rāhāveṃ| kaiseni tameṃ||8||
verses.meaning: And why should I ask you this? Even we know this much: how can darkness remain at sunrise?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी तूं स्वप्रकाशाचा आगरू। आणि जाहाला आम्हांसि गोचरू। म्हणौनियां निशाचरां केरू। फिटला सहजें॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī tūṃ svaprakāśācā āgarū| āṇi jāhālā āmhāṃsi gocarū| mhaṇauniyāṃ niśācarāṃ kerū| phiṭalā sahajeṃ||9||
verses.meaning: You are the very source of self-effulgence, and have become manifest to us. Therefore, the darkness of ignorance has naturally been dispelled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें येतुले दिवस आम्हां। कांहीं नेणवेचि श्रीरामा) आतां देखतसों महिमा । गंभीर तुझा॥ ५१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ yetule divasa āmhāṃ| kāṃhīṃ neṇaveci śrīrāmā) ātāṃ dekhatasoṃ mahimā | gaṃbhīra tujhā|| 510||
verses.meaning: For all these days, we knew nothing, O Shri Rama. Now we behold Your profound glory.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथूनि नाना सृष्टींचिया बोळी । 'पसरती भूतग्रामाचिया वेली । तया महदद्रह्मातें व्याली । दैविकी इच्छा ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: jethūni nānā sṛṣṭīṃciyā boḻī | 'pasaratī bhūtagrāmāciyā velī | tayā mahadadrahmāteṃ vyālī | daivikī icchā || 11||
verses.meaning: From where the diverse creations, like vines of living beings, spread forth, that great Brahman was conceived by the divine will.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवो निःसीम तत्त्व सदोदितु। देवो निःसीम गुण अनंतु। देवो निःसीम साम्य सततु । नरेंद्र देवांचा ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: devo niḥsīma tattva sadoditu| devo niḥsīma guṇa anaṃtu| devo niḥsīma sāmya satatu | nareṃdra devāṃcā || 12||
verses.meaning: God is the boundless, eternal essence. God is the boundless, infinite attribute. God is the boundless, constant equality. He is the king of gods.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी तूं त्रिजगतिये बोलावा । अक्षर तूं सदाशिवा । तूंचि सदसत्‌ देवा। तयाही अतीत तें तूं॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī tūṃ trijagatiye bolāvā | akṣara tūṃ sadāśivā | tūṃci sadasat‌ devā| tayāhī atīta teṃ tūṃ|| 13||
verses.meaning: You are the one who calls forth the three worlds. You are the imperishable Sadashiva. You are both being and non-being, O Lord. And you are beyond even that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २४२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तूं प्रकृतिपुर्षांचिया आदी। जी महत्तत्त्वां तूंचि अवधी। स्वयें तूं अनादि । पुरातनु॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: 242 śrījñāneśvarī tūṃ prakṛtipurṣāṃciyā ādī| jī mahattattvāṃ tūṃci avadhī| svayeṃ tūṃ anādi | purātanu|| 14||
verses.meaning: O Dnyaneshwari, You are the origin of Prakriti and Purusha. You are the entirety of the Mahat-tattva. You are inherently without beginning, the most ancient.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं सकळ विश्‍वजीवन। जीवांसि तूंचि निधान । भूतभविष्याचें ज्ञान । तुझ्याचि हातीं ॥ १५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ sakaḻa viś‍vajīvana| jīvāṃsi tūṃci nidhāna | bhūtabhaviṣyāceṃ jñāna | tujhyāci hātīṃ || 15 ||
verses.meaning: You are the life of the entire universe, You alone are the treasure for all beings. The knowledge of past and future is in Your hands alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी श्रुतीचिया लोचनां । स्वरूपसुख तूंचि अभिन्ना। त्रिभुवनाचिया आयतना । आयतन तूं॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī śrutīciyā locanāṃ | svarūpasukha tūṃci abhinnā| tribhuvanāciyā āyatanā | āyatana tūṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: You are the very form of bliss, indistinguishable from the eyes of the Vedas. You are the abode of the three worlds, indeed, the ultimate abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि जी 'परम। तूंतें म्हणिजे महाधाम। कल्पांती महठ्ठह्य। तुजमाजीं रिगे॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni jī 'parama| tūṃteṃ mhaṇije mahādhāma| kalpāṃtī mahaṭhṭhahya| tujamājīṃ rige|| 17||
verses.meaning: Therefore, it is said, 'O Supreme Being, you are the great abode. At the end of the kalpa, the great illusion merges into you.'

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना तुवां देवें। विश्व विस्तारिळें आहे आघवें । तरि अनंतरूपा वानावें। कवणें तूंतें॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā tuvāṃ deveṃ| viśva vistāriḻeṃ āhe āghaveṃ | tari anaṃtarūpā vānāveṃ| kavaṇeṃ tūṃteṃ|| 18||
verses.meaning: Indeed, by You, the Divine, the entire universe has been expanded. Therefore, O Infinite Form, who can truly praise You?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी काय एक तूं नव्हसी। कवणे ठायीं नससी। हें असो जैसा आहासी । तैसिया नमों॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī kāya eka tūṃ navhasī| kavaṇe ṭhāyīṃ nasasī| heṃ aso jaisā āhāsī | taisiyā namoṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: You are not just one, nor are you absent anywhere. Let this be; we bow to you as you are.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वायु तूं अनंता । यम तूं नियमिता । प्राणिंगणीं बसता । अग्नि तो तूं५॥ ५२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāyu tūṃ anaṃtā | yama tūṃ niyamitā | prāṇiṃgaṇīṃ basatā | agni to tūṃ5|| 520||
verses.meaning: You are the endless wind, You are Yama, the disciplinarian. You reside in all living beings as the fire of life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरुण तूं सोम । स्तष्टा तूं ब्रह्म । पितामहाचाही परम । आदिजनक तूं॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: varuṇa tūṃ soma | staṣṭā tūṃ brahma | pitāmahācāhī parama | ādijanaka tūṃ|| 21||
verses.meaning: You are the Moon God, Varuna. You are the Creator, Brahma. You are the ultimate primordial father, even of the great-grandfather (Brahma).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणीकही जें जें कांहीं । रूप आधि अथवा नाहीं । तया नमो तुज तैसयाही । जगन्नाथा ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇīkahī jeṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ | rūpa ādhi athavā nāhīṃ | tayā namo tuja taisayāhī | jagannāthā || 22||
verses.meaning: And whatever else exists, whether it has form or not, I bow to You, O Lord of the Universe, in all those manifestations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें सानुरागें चित्तें। नमन केलें पंडुसुतें। मग पुढती म्हणे नमस्ते । नमस्ते प्रभो ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ sānurāgeṃ citteṃ| namana keleṃ paṃḍusuteṃ| maga puḍhatī mhaṇe namaste | namaste prabho || 23||
verses.meaning: With such a loving heart, the son of Pandu offered salutations. Then again he said, "Salutations, salutations, O Lord!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं तिये साद्यंतें । न्याहाळी श्रीमूर्तीते। आणि पुढती म्हणे नमस्ते । नमस्ते प्रभो ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ tiye sādyaṃteṃ | nyāhāḻī śrīmūrtīte| āṇi puḍhatī mhaṇe namaste | namaste prabho || 24||
verses.meaning: Then, from beginning to end, gaze upon that divine form, and again say, "Salutations, salutations, O Lord!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहतां पाहतां प्रांतें। समाधान पावे चित्तें। आणि पुढती म्हणे नमस्ते । नमस्ते प्रभो॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhatāṃ pāhatāṃ prāṃteṃ| samādhāna pāve citteṃ| āṇi puḍhatī mhaṇe namaste | namaste prabho|| 25||
verses.meaning: As I behold, my heart finds contentment, and again it proclaims, "Salutations, salutations, O Lord!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें चराचरीं जीं भूतें । सर्वत्र देखे तयांतें। आणि पुढती म्हणे नमस्ते । नमस्ते प्रभो॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ carācarīṃ jīṃ bhūteṃ | sarvatra dekhe tayāṃteṃ| āṇi puḍhatī mhaṇe namaste | namaste prabho|| 26||
verses.meaning: In all these animate and inanimate beings, he sees You everywhere. And again he says, "Salutations, salutations to You, O Lord!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसीं रूपें तियें अदभुतें। आश्‍चर्ये स्फुरती अनंतें। तंव तंव नमस्ते । नमस्तेचि म्हणे ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisīṃ rūpeṃ tiyeṃ adabhuteṃ| āś‍carye sphuratī anaṃteṃ| taṃva taṃva namaste | namasteci mhaṇe || 27||
verses.meaning: Such forms are wondrous, infinite marvels that manifest. To each of them, he says, "Salutations, salutations!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिक स्तुतिही नाठवे । आणि निवबांतुही न बैसवे। नेणें कैसा प्रेमभावें। गाजोंचि लागे॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇika stutihī nāṭhave | āṇi nivabāṃtuhī na baisave| neṇeṃ kaisā premabhāveṃ| gājoṃci lāge|| 28||
verses.meaning: I cannot remember any more praises, nor can I sit still in peace. I do not know how, but out of sheer love, I begin to sing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना इयापरी । नमन केलें सहस्त्रवरी। कीं पुढती म्हणे श्रीहरी। तुज सन्मुखा नमो॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā iyāparī | namana keleṃ sahastravarī| kīṃ puḍhatī mhaṇe śrīharī| tuja sanmukhā namo|| 29||
verses.meaning: Indeed, in this manner, I have bowed a thousand times, and again, I say, "O Shrihari, salutations to you, facing you."

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवासि पाठी पोट आथि कीं नाहीं। येणें उपयोगु आम्हां काई । तरि तुज पाठिमोरेयाही । नमो स्वामी ॥ ५३० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: devāsi pāṭhī poṭa āthi kīṃ nāhīṃ| yeṇeṃ upayogu āmhāṃ kāī | tari tuja pāṭhimoreyāhī | namo svāmī || 530 ||
verses.meaning: Whether God has a back or a belly, what use is that to us? Therefore, even if you turn your back on me, I bow to you, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उभा माझिये पाठीसी । म्हणौनि पाठिमोरें म्हणावें तुम्हांसी । सन्मुख विमुख जगेंसीं । न घडे तुज॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ubhā mājhiye pāṭhīsī | mhaṇauni pāṭhimoreṃ mhaṇāveṃ tumhāṃsī | sanmukha vimukha jageṃsīṃ | na ghaḍe tuja|| 31||
verses.meaning: You stand behind me, therefore I must address you as if you are behind me. For you, there is no facing towards or away from the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां वेगळालिया अवयवां। नेणें रूप करूं देवा। म्हणौनि नमो तुज सर्वा । सर्वात्मका॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ vegaḻāliyā avayavāṃ| neṇeṃ rūpa karūṃ devā| mhaṇauni namo tuja sarvā | sarvātmakā|| 32||
verses.meaning: Now, I cannot describe Your form through separate limbs, O God. Therefore, I bow to You, the All-Pervading, the Soul of all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी अनंतबळसंभ्रमा। तुज नमो अमित विक्रमा। सकळकाळीं समा। सर्वरूपा ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī anaṃtabaḻasaṃbhramā| tuja namo amita vikramā| sakaḻakāḻīṃ samā| sarvarūpā || 33||
verses.meaning: Salutations to You, who possess infinite power and splendor, whose valor is immeasurable, who are always present in all forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आघविया आकाशीं जेसें। अवकाशचि होऊनि आकाश असे । तूं सर्वपणें तैसें। पातलासि सर्व॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āghaviyā ākāśīṃ jeseṃ| avakāśaci hoūni ākāśa ase | tūṃ sarvapaṇeṃ taiseṃ| pātalāsi sarva|| 34||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky, pervading all space, itself becomes the space, so too have You, in Your entirety, pervaded everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना केवळ । सर्व हें तूंचि निखिळ। परी क्षीरार्णवीं कल्लोळ । पयाचे जैसे॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā kevaḻa | sarva heṃ tūṃci nikhiḻa| parī kṣīrārṇavīṃ kalloḻa | payāce jaise|| 35||
verses.meaning: Indeed, everything is entirely you, just as waves in the ocean of milk are nothing but milk.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनियां देवा। तूं वेगळा नव्हसी सर्वा । हें आलें मज सदभावा। आतां तूंचि सर्व॥३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauniyāṃ devā| tūṃ vegaḻā navhasī sarvā | heṃ āleṃ maja sadabhāvā| ātāṃ tūṃci sarva||36||
