verses.meaning: Therefore, O Lord, You are not separate from anyone. This truth has dawned upon me: now You are everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी ऐसिया तूंतें स्वामी। कहींच नेणों जी आम्ही । म्हणौनि सोयरे संबंधधर्मी । राहाटलों तुजसी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī aisiyā tūṃteṃ svāmī| kahīṃca neṇoṃ jī āmhī | mhaṇauni soyare saṃbaṃdhadharmī | rāhāṭaloṃ tujasī || 37||
verses.meaning: But, O Lord, we never truly knew You in this way. Therefore, we have related to You through the bonds of kinship and worldly connections.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहा थोर वाउर जाहलें। अमृते संमार्जन म्यां केलें। वारिकें घेऊनि दिधलें। कामधेनूतें ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahā thora vāura jāhaleṃ| amṛte saṃmārjana myāṃ keleṃ| vārikeṃ gheūni didhaleṃ| kāmadhenūteṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: Oh, what a great wonder has occurred! I have cleansed with nectar, and given a barber's service to the wish-fulfilling cow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परिसाचा खडवाचि जोडला । कौं फोडोनि आम्ही गाडोर घातला । कल्पतरू तोडोनि केला। कूप शेता॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parisācā khaḍavāci joḍalā | kauṃ phoḍoni āmhī gāḍora ghātalā | kalpatarū toḍoni kelā| kūpa śetā|| 39||
verses.meaning: It is like joining a piece of stone to the philosopher's stone, or breaking a precious gem to make a necklace, or cutting down a wish-fulfilling tree to dig a well in a field.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चिंतामणीची खाणी लागली। तेणें करें बोढाळें बोल्हांडिली । तैसी तुझी जवळिक धाडिली। सांगातीपणें ॥ ५४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ciṃtāmaṇīcī khāṇī lāgalī| teṇeṃ kareṃ boḍhāḻeṃ bolhāṃḍilī | taisī tujhī javaḻika dhāḍilī| sāṃgātīpaṇeṃ || 540||
verses.meaning: As if a mine of Chintamani jewels has been discovered, and its treasures are overflowing, so too has your closeness been sent to me as a companion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें अजिचेंचि पाहें पां रोकडें। कवण झुंज हें केवढें। एथ परब्रह्म तूं उघडें। सारथी केलासी॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ ajiceṃci pāheṃ pāṃ rokaḍeṃ| kavaṇa jhuṃja heṃ kevaḍheṃ| etha parabrahma tūṃ ughaḍeṃ| sārathī kelāsī|| 49||
verses.meaning: Behold, this is a direct and immediate wonder! What kind of battle is this, and how great is it? Here, You, the manifest Supreme Brahman, have been made the charioteer!

verses.shloka_devanagari: ययां कौरवांचिया घरा। शिष्टाई धाडिलासि दातारा । ऐसा वणिजेसाठीं जागेश्‍्वरा । विकलासि आम्हीं ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayāṃ kauravāṃciyā gharā| śiṣṭāī dhāḍilāsi dātārā | aisā vaṇijesāṭhīṃ jāgeś‍varā | vikalāsi āmhīṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: O Lord, we have sent you as an envoy to the Kauravas' house. It is as if we have sold the Lord of the universe for the sake of trade.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं योगियांचें समाधिसुख। कैसा जाणेचिना मी मूर्ख। उपरोधु जी सन्मुख। तुजसीं करूं॥४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ yogiyāṃceṃ samādhisukha| kaisā jāṇecinā mī mūrkha| uparodhu jī sanmukha| tujasīṃ karūṃ||43||
verses.meaning: How can I, a fool, understand the bliss of samadhi experienced by yogis? How can I, in your presence, make such a presumptuous statement?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूंया विश्वाची अनादि आदी । बैससी जिये सभासदीं। तेथें सोयरीकीचिया संबंधीं। रळीं बोलों ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃyā viśvācī anādi ādī | baisasī jiye sabhāsadīṃ| tetheṃ soyarīkīciyā saṃbaṃdhīṃ| raḻīṃ boloṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: You are the primordial origin of this universe, and in the assembly where you reside, I wish to speak with you in the intimacy of kinship.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विपायें राउळा येवों। तरि तुझेनि अंगें मानु पावों॥ न मानिसी तरी जावों। रुसोनि सलगी॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: vipāyeṃ rāuḻā yevoṃ| tari tujheni aṃgeṃ mānu pāvoṃ|| na mānisī tarī jāvoṃ| rusoni salagī|| 45||
verses.meaning: If by chance I come to your temple, I will receive honor through your presence. If you do not honor me, I will leave, sulking in familiarity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पायां लागोनि बुझावणी। तुझ्या ठायीं शार्डुपाणी। पाहिजे ऐशी करणी। बहु केली आम्हीं ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāyāṃ lāgoni bujhāvaṇī| tujhyā ṭhāyīṃ śārḍupāṇī| pāhije aiśī karaṇī| bahu kelī āmhīṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: Falling at your feet, we have performed many such deeds, O Sharngapani, to appease you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सजणपणाचिया वाटा। तुजपुढें बैसे उफराटा। हा पाडु काय वैकुंठा। परि चुकलो आम्हीं ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sajaṇapaṇāciyā vāṭā| tujapuḍheṃ baise upharāṭā| hā pāḍu kāya vaikuṃṭhā| pari cukalo āmhīṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: The path of true devotion, when placed before You, seems to turn upside down. What comparison can there be to Vaikuntha (Your abode)? But we have erred.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवेंसि कोलकाठी धरूं । आखाडां झोंबीलोंबी करूं । सारी खेळतां आविष्करूं। निकरेंही भांडों ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: deveṃsi kolakāṭhī dharūṃ | ākhāḍāṃ jhoṃbīloṃbī karūṃ | sārī kheḻatāṃ āviṣkarūṃ| nikareṃhī bhāṃḍoṃ || 48 ||
verses.meaning: I will hold the gods by their necks, wrestle with them in the arena, reveal my true self while playing, and even fight with determination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चांग तें उराउरी मागों। देवासि कीं बुद्धि सांगों । तेवींचि म्हणों काय लागों । तुझें आम्हीं ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: cāṃga teṃ urāurī māgoṃ| devāsi kīṃ buddhi sāṃgoṃ | tevīṃci mhaṇoṃ kāya lāgoṃ | tujheṃ āmhīṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: How can we ask God for good things, or advise Him? How can we say, "We are devoted to You"?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अपराधु हा आहे। जो त्रिभुवनीं न समाये। जी नेणतांचि कीं पाये। शिवतिले तुझे ॥ ५५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā aparādhu hā āhe| jo tribhuvanīṃ na samāye| jī neṇatāṃci kīṃ pāye| śivatile tujhe || 550||
verses.meaning: Such is this offense, which cannot be contained in the three worlds, that unknowingly, your feet were touched.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवो बोनयाच्या अवसरीं । लोभें कौर आठवण करी । परी माझा निसुग गर्व अवधारीं। जे फुगूनचि बैसें॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: devo bonayācyā avasarīṃ | lobheṃ kaura āṭhavaṇa karī | parī mājhā nisuga garva avadhārīṃ| je phugūnaci baiseṃ|| 51||
verses.meaning: When God comes to give, out of greed, who remembers Him? But listen to my utter pride, that I just sit puffed up.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवाचिया भोगायतनीं । खेळतां आशंकेना मनीं। जी रिगोनियां शयनीं। सरिसा पहुडें॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: devāciyā bhogāyatanīṃ | kheḻatāṃ āśaṃkenā manīṃ| jī rigoniyāṃ śayanīṃ| sarisā pahuḍeṃ||52||
verses.meaning: In the Lord's abode of enjoyment, playing without any apprehension in the mind, one enters the bed and lies down beside Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कृष्ण म्हणौनि हाकारिजे। यादवपणें तूंतें लेखिजे । आपली आण घालिजे। जातां तुज ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṛṣṇa mhaṇauni hākārije| yādavapaṇeṃ tūṃteṃ lekhije | āpalī āṇa ghālije| jātāṃ tuja || 53||
verses.meaning: You are called Krishna, and you are considered a Yadava. One takes an oath on oneself when going to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज एकासनीं बैसणें। कां तुझा बोलु न मानणें । हें बोतटीचेनि दाटपणें। बहुत घडलें॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja ekāsanīṃ baisaṇeṃ| kāṃ tujhā bolu na mānaṇeṃ | heṃ botaṭīceni dāṭapaṇeṃ| bahuta ghaḍaleṃ|| 54||
verses.meaning: To sit on the same seat as me, or to disregard your words – such audacity has occurred many times due to my arrogance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि काय काय आतां। निवेदिजेल अनंता। मी राशि आहें समस्तां । अपराधांचि ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kāya kāya ātāṃ| nivedijela anaṃtā| mī rāśi āheṃ samastāṃ | aparādhāṃci || 55||
verses.meaning: Therefore, what more can I offer to the Infinite? I am a collection of all offenses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं पुढां अथवा पाठीं। जियें राहटलों बहुवें बोखटीं । तियें मायेचिया परी पोटीं । सामावीं प्रभो ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ puḍhāṃ athavā pāṭhīṃ| jiyeṃ rāhaṭaloṃ bahuveṃ bokhaṭīṃ | tiyeṃ māyeciyā parī poṭīṃ | sāmāvīṃ prabho || 56||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Lord, all those many terrible deeds that I have done, whether in the past or in the future, please absorb them within You, just as a mother absorbs her child within her womb.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी कोण्ही एके वेळे । सरिता घेऊन येती खडुळें। तियें सामाविजेति सिंधुजळें । आन उपायो नाहीं ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī koṇhī eke veḻe | saritā gheūna yetī khaḍuḻeṃ| tiyeṃ sāmāvijeti siṃdhujaḻeṃ | āna upāyo nāhīṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: Whatever impurities the rivers bring at one time, they are absorbed by the ocean's waters; there is no other way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं प्रीती कां प्रमादें । देवेंसीं मज विरुद्धें। बोलविली तियें मुकुंदें। उपसाहावीं जी ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ prītī kāṃ pramādeṃ | deveṃsīṃ maja viruddheṃ| bolavilī tiyeṃ mukuṃdeṃ| upasāhāvīṃ jī || 58||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whether out of love or inadvertence, if I have spoken anything against You, O Mukunda, please bear with it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि देवाचेनि क्षमत्वें क्षमा । आधारु जाली आहे या भूतग्रामा। म्हणौनि जी पुरुषोत्तमा। विनवूं तें थोडें ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi devāceni kṣamatveṃ kṣamā | ādhāru jālī āhe yā bhūtagrāmā| mhaṇauni jī puruṣottamā| vinavūṃ teṃ thoḍeṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: And by the Lord's forgiveness, this multitude of beings has found its support. Therefore, O Purushottama, whatever we implore is but little.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आतां अप्रमेया। मज शरणागता आपुलिया । क्षमा कीजो जी यया। अपराधांसि॥ ५६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātāṃ aprameyā| maja śaraṇāgatā āpuliyā | kṣamā kījo jī yayā| aparādhāṃsi|| 560||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Immeasurable One, please forgive these offenses of mine, who have surrendered to You.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी जाणितलें मियां साचें। महिमान आतां देवाचें। जे देवो होय चराचराचें। जन्मस्थान ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī jāṇitaleṃ miyāṃ sāceṃ| mahimāna ātāṃ devāceṃ| je devo hoya carācarāceṃ| janmasthāna || 61||
verses.meaning: I have now truly understood the glory of God, who is the birthplace of all creation, both animate and inanimate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हरिहरादि समस्तां। देवा तूं परम देवता । वेदांतेंही पढविता । आदिगुरु तूं ।॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hariharādi samastāṃ| devā tūṃ parama devatā | vedāṃteṃhī paḍhavitā | ādiguru tūṃ ||| 62||
verses.meaning: O Lord, You are the supreme deity even for Hari, Hara, and all other gods. You are the primordial guru who teaches even the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गंभीर तूं श्रीरामा । नाना भूतैकसमा । सकळगुणीं अप्रतिमा । अद्वितीया ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: gaṃbhīra tūṃ śrīrāmā | nānā bhūtaikasamā | sakaḻaguṇīṃ apratimā | advitīyā || 63||
verses.meaning: O Rama, you are profound, the sole essence of all beings, incomparable in all virtues, and without a second.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुजसी नाहीं सरिसें। हें प्रतिपादनचि कायसें। तुवां जालेनि आकाशें। सामाविळें जग॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujasī nāhīṃ sariseṃ| heṃ pratipādanaci kāyaseṃ| tuvāṃ jāleni ākāśeṃ| sāmāviḻeṃ jaga|| 64||
verses.meaning: There is nothing equal to you; what is the need for such an assertion? The entire world is contained within the sky that you have become.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया तुझेनि पाडें दुजें। ऐसें बोलतांचि लाजिजे। तेथ अधिकाची कीजे। गोठी केवीं ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā tujheni pāḍeṃ dujeṃ| aiseṃ bolatāṃci lājije| tetha adhikācī kīje| goṭhī kevīṃ || 65||
verses.meaning: To speak of another being equal to You would be shameful. How then can one even begin to speak of anyone being greater than You?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि त्रिभुवनीं तूं एकु । तुजसारिखा ना अधिकु । तुझा महिमा अलौकिकु । नेणिजे वानूं॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tribhuvanīṃ tūṃ eku | tujasārikhā nā adhiku | tujhā mahimā alaukiku | neṇije vānūṃ|| 66||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in all three worlds, You are the only one. There is none like You, nor greater than You. Your glory is extraordinary, beyond description.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अर्जुनें म्हिणितळें। मग पुढती दंडवत घातलें। तेथें सात्त्विकाचें आलें। भरतें तया॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ arjuneṃ mhiṇitaḻeṃ| maga puḍhatī daṃḍavata ghātaleṃ| tetheṃ sāttvikāceṃ āleṃ| bharateṃ tayā|| 67||
verses.meaning: Thus spoke Arjuna, and then he bowed down again. There, a surge of sattvic emotion overcame him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणतसे प्रसीद प्रसीद। वाचा होतसे सद्‌गद। काढी जी अपराध-। समुद्रौनि मातें ॥६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇatase prasīda prasīda| vācā hotase sad‌gada| kāḍhī jī aparādha-| samudrauni māteṃ ||68||
verses.meaning: Then he says, 'Be gracious, be gracious!' His voice becomes choked with emotion. 'Pull me out of this ocean of offenses!'

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुज विश्‍वसुह्दातें कहीं॥ सोयरेपणें न मनूंचि पाहीं। तुज विशवेश्वराचिया ठायीं। ऐश्वर्य केलें॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tuja viś‍vasuhdāteṃ kahīṃ|| soyarepaṇeṃ na manūṃci pāhīṃ| tuja viśaveśvarāciyā ṭhāyīṃ| aiśvarya keleṃ||69||
verses.meaning: I have never considered you a relative, nor have I ever thought of you as a friend. I have always seen you as the Lord of the Universe, and I have always offered you my devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं वर्णनीय परी लोभें। मातें वर्णिसी पां सभे। तरि मियां वल्गिजें क्षोभें। अधिकाधिक ॥ ५७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ varṇanīya parī lobheṃ| māteṃ varṇisī pāṃ sabhe| tari miyāṃ valgijeṃ kṣobheṃ| adhikādhika || 570||
verses.meaning: Though you are beyond description, yet out of love, you describe me in this assembly. Then, I am filled with even greater joy and enthusiasm.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां ऐसिया अपराधां। मर्यादा नाहीं मुकुंदा। म्हणौनि रक्ष रक्ष प्रमादा-। पासोनियां॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ aisiyā aparādhāṃ| maryādā nāhīṃ mukuṃdā| mhaṇauni rakṣa rakṣa pramādā-| pāsoniyāṃ|| 71||
verses.meaning: Now, for such transgressions, there is no limit, O Mukunda. Therefore, protect, protect me from error.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी हेंचि विनवावयालागीं। कैंची योग्यता माझिया आंगीं । परी अपत्य जैसें सलगी । बापेंसीं बोळे॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī heṃci vinavāvayālāgīṃ| kaiṃcī yogyatā mājhiyā āṃgīṃ | parī apatya jaiseṃ salagī | bāpeṃsīṃ boḻe|| 72||
verses.meaning: How can I be worthy of making such a request? But just as a child speaks intimately with its father.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुत्राचे अपराध। जरी जाहले अगाध । तरी पिता साहे निट्ठंड। तैसें साहिजो जी ॥७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: putrāce aparādha| jarī jāhale agādha | tarī pitā sāhe niṭṭhaṃḍa| taiseṃ sāhijo jī ||73||
verses.meaning: Just as a father endures the boundless transgressions of his son, so too, please bear with me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सख्याचें उद्धत । सखा साहे निवांत । २४६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तैसें तुवां समस्त। साहिजो जी॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: sakhyāceṃ uddhata | sakhā sāhe nivāṃta | 246 śrījñāneśvarī taiseṃ tuvāṃ samasta| sāhijo jī|| 74||
verses.meaning: Just as a friend patiently endures the impudence of another friend, so too should you patiently bear all things.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रियाचिया ठायीं सन्मान। प्रिय न पाहे सर्वथा जाण। तेवीं उच्छिष्ट काढिळें आपण। तें क्षमा कौजो जी॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: priyāciyā ṭhāyīṃ sanmāna| priya na pāhe sarvathā jāṇa| tevīṃ ucchiṣṭa kāḍhiḻeṃ āpaṇa| teṃ kṣamā kaujo jī|| 75||
verses.meaning: Just as a beloved does not at all consider the honor shown by the lover, so too, please forgive what I have offered as leftovers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी प्राणाचे सोयरें भेटे । मग जीवें भूतलीं जियें संकटें । तियें निवेदितां न वाटे । संकोचु कांहीं ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī prāṇāce soyareṃ bheṭe | maga jīveṃ bhūtalīṃ jiyeṃ saṃkaṭeṃ | tiyeṃ niveditāṃ na vāṭe | saṃkocu kāṃhīṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: Or, when the beloved of one's life is met, then the troubles that the soul has endured in the world, when narrated, do not cause any hesitation or shyness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां उखितें आंगें जीवें । आपणपें दिधलें जिया मनोभावें। तिया कांतु मिनलिया न राहवे । हृदय जेवीं ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ukhiteṃ āṃgeṃ jīveṃ | āpaṇapeṃ didhaleṃ jiyā manobhāveṃ| tiyā kāṃtu minaliyā na rāhave | hṛdaya jevīṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as a heart cannot remain without its beloved, so too, one who has offered their very being, their entire self, with such profound devotion, cannot remain without that beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी जी मियां। हें विनविलें तुमतें गोसाविया। आणीक कांहीं एक म्हणावया। कारण असे॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī jī miyāṃ| heṃ vinavileṃ tumateṃ gosāviyā| āṇīka kāṃhīṃ eka mhaṇāvayā| kāraṇa ase|| 78||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Lord, I have thus made this request to you, for there is another reason to speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी देवेंसीं सलगी केली । जे विश्‍वरूपाची आळी घेतली । ते मायबापें पुरविली । स्नेहाळाचेनि॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī deveṃsīṃ salagī kelī | je viś‍varūpācī āḻī ghetalī | te māyabāpeṃ puravilī | snehāḻāceni|| 79||
verses.meaning: Thus, a close relationship was formed with God, and the desire to see the universal form was expressed. This wish was fulfilled by the divine parents, out of their immense love for the devotee.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुरतरूंचीं झाडें । आंगणीं लावावीं कोडें । देयावें कामधेनूचें पाडें। खेळावया॥ ५८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: suratarūṃcīṃ jhāḍeṃ | āṃgaṇīṃ lāvāvīṃ koḍeṃ | deyāveṃ kāmadhenūceṃ pāḍeṃ| kheḻāvayā|| 580||
verses.meaning: Plant wish-fulfilling trees in your courtyard with delight, and let the calf of the wish-granting cow be given for play.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मियां नक्षत्रीं डाव पाडावा । चंद्र चेंडुबालागीं आणावा। हा छंदु सिद्धी नेला आघवा । माउलीये तुवां॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: miyāṃ nakṣatrīṃ ḍāva pāḍāvā | caṃdra ceṃḍubālāgīṃ āṇāvā| hā chaṃdu siddhī nelā āghavā | māulīye tuvāṃ|| 81||
verses.meaning: You, Mother, have brought to fruition this entire desire, that one should play a game with the stars, and bring the moon down to play with as a ball.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिया अमृतळेशालागीं सायास। तयाचा पाऊस केला चारी मास पृथ्वी वाहून चासेचास। चिंतामणी पेरिळे॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiyā amṛtaḻeśālāgīṃ sāyāsa| tayācā pāūsa kelā cārī māsa pṛthvī vāhūna cāsecāsa| ciṃtāmaṇī periḻe|| 82||
verses.meaning: For the sake of that drop of nectar, efforts were made, and it rained for four months, saturating the earth, as if wish-fulfilling gems were sown.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा कृतकृत्य केला स्वामी। बहुवे लळा पाळिला तुम्हीं । दाविलें जें हरब्रह्मी । नायकिजे कानीं॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā kṛtakṛtya kelā svāmī| bahuve laḻā pāḻilā tumhīṃ | dāvileṃ jeṃ harabrahmī | nāyakije kānīṃ|| 83||
verses.meaning: Thus, the Master made me fulfilled. You cherished me with great affection. You revealed that which is not heard even in Shiva and Brahma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मा देखावयाची केउती गोठी । जयाची उपनिषदां नाहीं भेटी । ते जिव्हारींची गांठी। मजलागी सोडिली॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mā dekhāvayācī keutī goṭhī | jayācī upaniṣadāṃ nāhīṃ bheṭī | te jivhārīṃcī gāṃṭhī| majalāgī soḍilī|| 84||
verses.meaning: How can one describe the sight of that which even the Upanishads cannot fully grasp? Yet, for my sake, the innermost knot of that mystery has been untied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी कल्पादीलागोनि। आजिची घडी धरुनी। माझीं जेतुलीं होउनी । गेलीं जन्में॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī kalpādīlāgoni| ājicī ghaḍī dharunī| mājhīṃ jetulīṃ hounī | gelīṃ janmeṃ|| 85||
verses.meaning: From the beginning of creation until this very moment, all the births I have taken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां आघवियांचि आंतु। घरडोळी घेऊनि असें पाहतु। परि ही देखिली ऐकिली मातु। आतुडेचिना॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ āghaviyāṃci āṃtu| gharaḍoḻī gheūni aseṃ pāhatu| pari hī dekhilī aikilī mātu| ātuḍecinā|| 86||
verses.meaning: I search for it within all of them, but this matter, which I have seen and heard, cannot be grasped.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुद्धीचे जाणणें। कहीं न वचेचि याचेनि आंगणें। हें सादही अंतःकरणें। करवेचिना॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: buddhīce jāṇaṇeṃ| kahīṃ na vaceci yāceni āṃgaṇeṃ| heṃ sādahī aṃtaḥkaraṇeṃ| karavecinā|| 87||
verses.meaning: The intellect cannot grasp this truth, nor can the heart comprehend it, for it is beyond the reach of both.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ डोळ्यां देखी होआवी । ही गोठीचि कायसया करावी । किंबहुना पूर्वी । दृष्ट ना श्रुत ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha ḍoḻyāṃ dekhī hoāvī | hī goṭhīci kāyasayā karāvī | kiṃbahunā pūrvī | dṛṣṭa nā śruta || 88 ||
verses.meaning: How can one even speak of seeing it with the eyes? Such a thing has never been seen or heard before.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें हें विश्वरूप आपुलें। तुम्हीं मज डोळां दाविलें । तरी माझें मन झालें । हृष्ट देवा॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ heṃ viśvarūpa āpuleṃ| tumhīṃ maja ḍoḻāṃ dāvileṃ | tarī mājheṃ mana jhāleṃ | hṛṣṭa devā|| 89||
verses.meaning: You have revealed this universal form of yours to my eyes, O Lord, and my heart is filled with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि आतां ऐसी चाड जीवीं। जे तुजसीं गोठी करावी । जवळीक हे भोगावी । आलिंगावासी ॥ ५९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari ātāṃ aisī cāḍa jīvīṃ| je tujasīṃ goṭhī karāvī | javaḻīka he bhogāvī | āliṃgāvāsī || 590||
verses.meaning: But now, such is the longing in my heart, that I wish to converse with You, to experience this closeness, to embrace You.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते याचि रूपीं करूं म्हणिजे । तरि कोणे एके मुखेंसिं चावळिजे। आणि कवणा खेंब देईजे। तुज ळेख नाहीं ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: te yāci rūpīṃ karūṃ mhaṇije | tari koṇe eke mukheṃsiṃ cāvaḻije| āṇi kavaṇā kheṃba deīje| tuja ḻekha nāhīṃ || 91||
verses.meaning: If one were to say that You are to be made manifest in this form, then with which single mouth could one speak of You? And to whom could one give a challenge? For You are immeasurable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि वारियासबें धांवणें। न ठके गगना खेंब देणें। जळकेली खेळणें। समुद्री केउतें॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vāriyāsabeṃ dhāṃvaṇeṃ| na ṭhake gaganā kheṃba deṇeṃ| jaḻakelī kheḻaṇeṃ| samudrī keuteṃ|| 92||
verses.meaning: Therefore, running with the wind, or trying to embrace the sky, or playing with water in the ocean, are all futile endeavors.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं जी देवा। एथिंचें भय उपजतसे जीवा । म्हणौनि येतुला लळा पाळावा । जे पुरे हें आतां॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ jī devā| ethiṃceṃ bhaya upajatase jīvā | mhaṇauni yetulā laḻā pāḻāvā | je pure heṃ ātāṃ|| 93||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Lord, fear arises in the soul here. So, please fulfill this much longing, that this is enough now.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं चराचर विनोदें पाहिजे। मग तेणें सुखें घरीं राहिजे। तैसें चतुर्भुज रूप तुझें। तो विसांबा आम्हां॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ carācara vinodeṃ pāhije| maga teṇeṃ sukheṃ gharīṃ rāhije| taiseṃ caturbhuja rūpa tujheṃ| to visāṃbā āmhāṃ|| 94||
verses.meaning: Just as one observes the play of the animate and inanimate world with delight, and then finds solace in their own home, so too, your four-armed form, O Lord, is our ultimate refuge and rest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्ही योगजात अभ्यासावें। तेणें याचि अनुभवा यावें । शास्त्रांते आलोडावें। परि सिद्धांतु तो हाचि ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhī yogajāta abhyāsāveṃ| teṇeṃ yāci anubhavā yāveṃ | śāstrāṃte āloḍāveṃ| pari siddhāṃtu to hāci || 95||
verses.meaning: We should practice Yoga; through it, this experience (of the Self) should be attained. One may study the scriptures, but this indeed is the ultimate truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं यजनें किजती सकळें। परि तियें फळावीं येणेंचि फळें। तीर्थे होतु सकळें । याचिलागीं ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ yajaneṃ kijatī sakaḻeṃ| pari tiyeṃ phaḻāvīṃ yeṇeṃci phaḻeṃ| tīrthe hotu sakaḻeṃ | yācilāgīṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: All sacrifices are performed by us, but they bear fruit only through this. All pilgrimages become fruitful for this very reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिकही कांहीं जें जें। दान पुण्य आम्हीं कौजे। तया 'फळीं फळ तुझें। चतुर्भुज रूप॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇikahī kāṃhīṃ jeṃ jeṃ| dāna puṇya āmhīṃ kauje| tayā 'phaḻīṃ phaḻa tujheṃ| caturbhuja rūpa|| 97||
verses.meaning: And whatever other good deeds and merits we perform, the fruit of all those is Your four-armed form, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी तेथिंची जीवा आवडी । म्हणौनि तेंचि देखावया लबडसवडी। वर्तत असे ते सांकडी। फेडिजे वेगीं ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī tethiṃcī jīvā āvaḍī | mhaṇauni teṃci dekhāvayā labaḍasavaḍī| vartata ase te sāṃkaḍī| pheḍije vegīṃ || 98||
verses.meaning: Such is the soul's longing there; therefore, to behold that very thing, the soul is in great haste. Quickly remove this obstacle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा जीवींचें जाणतेया । सकळ विश्‍ववसवितेया । प्रसन्न होई 'पूजितया। देवांचिया देवा॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā jīvīṃceṃ jāṇateyā | sakaḻa viś‍vavasaviteyā | prasanna hoī 'pūjitayā| devāṃciyā devā||99||
verses.meaning: O Knower of all beings, O Creator of the entire universe, be pleased with this worshipper, O God of gods!

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैसें नीलोत्पलातें रांवित। आकाशाही रंगु लावित। तेजाची बोज दावित। इंद्रनीळा ॥ ६००॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaiseṃ nīlotpalāteṃ rāṃvita| ākāśāhī raṃgu lāvita| tejācī boja dāvita| iṃdranīḻā || 600||
verses.meaning: How the blue lotus is adorned, how the sky is colored, how the splendor of light is displayed, like a sapphire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा परिमळ जाहला मरगजा। कां आनंदासि निघालिया भुजा । ज्याचे जानूबरी मकरध्वजा। जोडली बरव॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā parimaḻa jāhalā maragajā| kāṃ ānaṃdāsi nighāliyā bhujā | jyāce jānūbarī makaradhvajā| joḍalī barava|| 1||
verses.meaning: Just as fragrance emanates from musk, or as joy finds its arms, so too is the beauty of the God of Love, Kamadeva, joined with his beloved Rati.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मस्तकीं मुगुटातें ठेविळें। कौं मुकुटा मुकुट मस्तक झाळें। शंगारा लेणें लाधलें। आंगाचेनि जया॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: mastakīṃ muguṭāteṃ ṭheviḻeṃ| kauṃ mukuṭā mukuṭa mastaka jhāḻeṃ| śaṃgārā leṇeṃ lādhaleṃ| āṃgāceni jayā|| 2||
verses.meaning: Was a crown placed on the head, or did the crown itself become the head? Adornments found their beauty from the body they graced.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रधनुष्याचिये आडणी-। माजीं मेघ गगनरंगणीं । तैसें आवरिलें शार्ईुुपाणी। वैजयंतिया ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdradhanuṣyāciye āḍaṇī-| mājīṃ megha gaganaraṃgaṇīṃ | taiseṃ āvarileṃ śārīuupāṇī| vaijayaṃtiyā || 3||
verses.meaning: Just as a rainbow appears in the sky, adorning the clouds, so too does the Vaijayanti garland adorn Lord Vishnu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां कवणी ते उदार गदा । असुरां देत कैवल्यपदा। कैसें चक्र हन गोविंदा । सौम्यतेजें मिरवे॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ kavaṇī te udāra gadā | asurāṃ deta kaivalyapadā| kaiseṃ cakra hana goviṃdā | saumyatejeṃ mirave|| 4||
verses.meaning: Now, which generous mace is this that grants liberation to demons? And how does the discus of Govinda shine with such gentle radiance?

verses.shloka_devanagari: २४८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी किंबहुना स्वामी । तें देखावया उत्कंठित पां मी। म्हणोनि आतां तुम्हीं । तैसया होआवें॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: 248 śrījñāneśvarī kiṃbahunā svāmī | teṃ dekhāvayā utkaṃṭhita pāṃ mī| mhaṇoni ātāṃ tumhīṃ | taisayā hoāveṃ|| 5||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Lord, I am eager to behold You. Therefore, now, please manifest Yourself in that form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे विश्‍्वरूपाचे सोहळे । भोगूनि निवाळे जी डोळे । आतां होताति आंधले। कृष्णमूर्तीलागीं ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: he viś‍varūpāce sohaḻe | bhogūni nivāḻe jī ḍoḻe | ātāṃ hotāti āṃdhale| kṛṣṇamūrtīlāgīṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: Having enjoyed the grandeur of this cosmic form, my eyes are now satiated and yearn to be blind to all else, seeing only the form of Krishna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें साकार कृष्णरूपडें। वांचूनि पाहों नावडे। तें न देखतां थोडें । मानिताती हे॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ sākāra kṛṣṇarūpaḍeṃ| vāṃcūni pāhoṃ nāvaḍe| teṃ na dekhatāṃ thoḍeṃ | mānitātī he||7||
verses.meaning: They do not like to see anything other than that embodied form of Krishna. If they do not see Him, they consider it a great loss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हां भोगमोक्षाचिया ठायीं । श्रीमूर्तीवांचूनि नाहीं । म्हणौनि तैसाचि साकारु होई । हें सांवरीं आतां॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhāṃ bhogamokṣāciyā ṭhāyīṃ | śrīmūrtīvāṃcūni nāhīṃ | mhaṇauni taisāci sākāru hoī | heṃ sāṃvarīṃ ātāṃ||8||
verses.meaning: For us, in matters of worldly enjoyment and liberation, there is nothing apart from Your divine form. Therefore, assume that very form now and sustain us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या अर्जुनाचिया बोला । विश्वरूपा विस्मयो जाहला । म्हणे ऐसा नाहीं देखिला। धसाळ कोणी॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā arjunāciyā bolā | viśvarūpā vismayo jāhalā | mhaṇe aisā nāhīṃ dekhilā| dhasāḻa koṇī||9||
verses.meaning: Upon hearing Arjuna's words, the Universal Form (Vishwaroopa) was astonished, thinking, "I have never seen anyone so bold!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: कोण हे वस्तु पावला आहासी । तया लाभाचा तोषु न घेसी । मा भेणें काय नेणों बोलसी । हेकाडु ऐसा॥ ६१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: koṇa he vastu pāvalā āhāsī | tayā lābhācā toṣu na ghesī | mā bheṇeṃ kāya neṇoṃ bolasī | hekāḍu aisā|| 610||
verses.meaning: Who has attained this reality? You do not rejoice in that gain. What is it that you speak out of fear, so stubbornly?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं सावियाची जें प्रसन्न होणें । तैं आंगचिवरी म्हणे देणें । बांचोनि जीव असे वेंचणें। कवणासि गा॥११॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ sāviyācī jeṃ prasanna hoṇeṃ | taiṃ āṃgacivarī mhaṇe deṇeṃ | bāṃconi jīva ase veṃcaṇeṃ| kavaṇāsi gā||11||
verses.meaning: When we are pleased, it is as if we are giving ourselves. Otherwise, who would sacrifice their life?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें हें तुझिये चाडे आजि जिवाचेंचि दळवाडें । कामऊनियां येवढें। रचिलें ध्यान ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ heṃ tujhiye cāḍe āji jivāceṃci daḻavāḍeṃ | kāmaūniyāṃ yevaḍheṃ| racileṃ dhyāna || 12||
verses.meaning: Today, for your sake, I have fashioned this entire edifice of the soul, this meditation, by grinding it down to its very essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी काय नेणों तुझिये आवडी । जाहली प्रसन्नता आमुची वेडी । म्हणौनि गौप्याची ही गुढी । उभविली जगीं ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī kāya neṇoṃ tujhiye āvaḍī | jāhalī prasannatā āmucī veḍī | mhaṇauni gaupyācī hī guḍhī | ubhavilī jagīṃ || 13||
verses.meaning: I know not what devotion to you has made my foolish self so pleased, that this banner of the secret has been unfurled in the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें हें अपारां अपार । स्वरूप माझें परात्पर) एथूनि ते अवतार। कृष्णादिक॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ heṃ apārāṃ apāra | svarūpa mājheṃ parātpara) ethūni te avatāra| kṛṣṇādika|| 14||
verses.meaning: This immeasurable and supreme form is mine, from which all incarnations like Krishna originate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें ज्ञानतेजाचें निखिळ। विश्‍वात्मक केवळ। अनंत हें अढळ। आद्य सकळां॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jñānatejāceṃ nikhiḻa| viś‍vātmaka kevaḻa| anaṃta heṃ aḍhaḻa| ādya sakaḻāṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: This entire universe is the light of knowledge, purely universal, infinite, unwavering, and the origin of all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें तुजवांचोनि अर्जुना । पूर्वी श्रुत दृष्ट नाहीं आना । जें जोगें नव्हे साधना। म्हणौनियां॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ tujavāṃconi arjunā | pūrvī śruta dṛṣṭa nāhīṃ ānā | jeṃ jogeṃ navhe sādhanā| mhaṇauniyāṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, this knowledge, which is beyond any means of spiritual practice, has never been heard or seen by anyone before you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साधकीं देखिला आयासु। म्हणौनि वाळिला योगाभ्यासु| आणि अध्ययनें सौरसु। नाहीं एथ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sādhakīṃ dekhilā āyāsu| mhaṇauni vāḻilā yogābhyāsu| āṇi adhyayaneṃ saurasu| nāhīṃ etha|| 18||
verses.meaning: Seeing the arduousness of the spiritual path, they abandoned the practice of Yoga. And in this path, there is no joy in mere study.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सौगेचीं सत्करमे । धाविन्नलीं संभ्रमें। तिहीं बहुतेकीं श्रमें। सत्यळोकु ठाकिला॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: saugecīṃ satkarame | dhāvinnalīṃ saṃbhrameṃ| tihīṃ bahutekīṃ śrameṃ| satyaḻoku ṭhākilā|| 19||
verses.meaning: The good deeds performed in previous births, with great enthusiasm and effort, have reached the realm of truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तपीं ऐश्वर्य देखिले आणि उग्रपण उभयांचि सांडिलें। एवं तपसाधन जें ठेलें। अपारांतरें ॥ ६२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tapīṃ aiśvarya dekhile āṇi ugrapaṇa ubhayāṃci sāṃḍileṃ| evaṃ tapasādhana jeṃ ṭheleṃ| apārāṃtareṃ || 620||
verses.meaning: When austerity beheld divine glory, both shed their fierce nature. Thus, the means of austerity remained, boundless and infinite.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें हें तुवां अनायासें । विश्वरूप देखिलें जैसें । इये मनुष्यलोकीं तैसें न फवेचि कवणा॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ heṃ tuvāṃ anāyāseṃ | viśvarūpa dekhileṃ jaiseṃ | iye manuṣyalokīṃ taiseṃ na phaveci kavaṇā|| 21||
verses.meaning: This cosmic form that you have effortlessly seen, no one else in this human world can ever attain such a vision.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आजि ध्यानसंपत्तीलागीं । तूंचि एकु आथिला जगीं। हें परमभाग्य आंगीं । विरंचीही नाहीं ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āji dhyānasaṃpattīlāgīṃ | tūṃci eku āthilā jagīṃ| heṃ paramabhāgya āṃgīṃ | viraṃcīhī nāhīṃ || 22||
verses.meaning: Today, for the attainment of meditation, you alone are the one in this world who is capable. This supreme fortune is not even with Brahma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विश्‍्वरूपलाभें एलाघ । एथिंचें भय नेघ नेघ। हें बांचूनि अन्य चांग। न मनीं कांहीं॥२३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni viś‍varūpalābheṃ elāgha | ethiṃceṃ bhaya negha negha| heṃ bāṃcūni anya cāṃga| na manīṃ kāṃhīṃ||23||
verses.meaning: Therefore, having attained the vision of the Universal Form, do not fear this, do not fear. Consider nothing else to be good besides this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा समुद्र अमृताचा भरला । आणि अवसांत वबरपडा जाहला । मग कोणीही आधि बोसंडिला । बुडिजेल म्हणौनि॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā samudra amṛtācā bharalā | āṇi avasāṃta vabarapaḍā jāhalā | maga koṇīhī ādhi bosaṃḍilā | buḍijela mhaṇauni|| 24||
verses.meaning: If the ocean were filled with nectar, and then suddenly became a barren desert, would anyone still fear drowning in it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी सोनयाचा डोंगरु । येसणा न चले हा थोरु । ऐसें म्हणौनि अव्हेरु । करणें घडे॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī sonayācā ḍoṃgaru | yesaṇā na cale hā thoru | aiseṃ mhaṇauni avheru | karaṇeṃ ghaḍe|| 25||
verses.meaning: Or, if a mountain of gold is offered, and one rejects it saying, "This is too great a burden to carry," such a rejection would be foolish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवें चिंतामणि लेईजे। कीं हे ओझें म्हणौनि सांडिजे। कामधेनु दवडिजे। न पोसवे म्हणौनि॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: deveṃ ciṃtāmaṇi leīje| kīṃ he ojheṃ mhaṇauni sāṃḍije| kāmadhenu davaḍije| na posave mhaṇauni|| 26||
verses.meaning: Would one accept a Chintamani jewel, or discard it as a burden? Would one drive away a Kamadhenu cow, saying it cannot be maintained?

verses.shloka_devanagari: चंद्रमा आलिया घरा । म्हणे निगें करितोसि उबारा। पडिसायि पाडितोसि दिनकरा । परता सर॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: caṃdramā āliyā gharā | mhaṇe nigeṃ karitosi ubārā| paḍisāyi pāḍitosi dinakarā | paratā sara|| 27||
verses.meaning: When the moon arrives at home, it says, "You are creating warmth, you are causing the sun to cast a shadow, move aside!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें ऐश्वर्य हें महातेज। आजि हातां आलें आहे सहज। कीं एथ तुज गजबज। होआवी कां॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ aiśvarya heṃ mahāteja| āji hātāṃ āleṃ āhe sahaja| kīṃ etha tuja gajabaja| hoāvī kāṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: Such great splendor has come into your hands effortlessly today. Why then should you be agitated?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि नेणसीच गांवठिया। काय कोपों आतां धनंजया । आंग सांडोनि छाया। आलिंगितोसि मा॥२९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari neṇasīca gāṃvaṭhiyā| kāya kopoṃ ātāṃ dhanaṃjayā | āṃga sāṃḍoni chāyā| āliṃgitosi mā||29||
verses.meaning: But you do not know the village, Dhananjaya. Why should I be angry now? You are embracing the shadow, abandoning the body itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें नव्हे जो मी साचें) एथ मन करूनियां काचें। प्रेम धरिसी अवगणियेचें। चतुर्भुज जें॥६३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ navhe jo mī sāceṃ) etha mana karūniyāṃ kāceṃ| prema dharisī avagaṇiyeceṃ| caturbhuja jeṃ||630||
verses.meaning: This is not truly me. Here, with a mind made of glass, you hold affection for the neglected, the four-armed one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि आझुनिवरी पार्था । सांडीं सांडीं हे व्यवस्था । इयेविषयीं आस्था । करिसी झणें ॥३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari ājhunivarī pārthā | sāṃḍīṃ sāṃḍīṃ he vyavasthā | iyeviṣayīṃ āsthā | karisī jhaṇeṃ ||39||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Partha, abandon this arrangement even now. Do not be eager for it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें रूप जरी घोर। विकृती आणि थोर| तरी कृतनिश्चयाचें घर। हेंचि करीं॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ rūpa jarī ghora| vikṛtī āṇi thora| tarī kṛtaniścayāceṃ ghara| heṃci karīṃ||32||
verses.meaning: Though this form is terrifying, distorted, and immense, it is indeed the abode of resolute determination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कृपण चित्तवृत्ति जैसी । २५० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी रोंबोनि घाली ठेवयापासीं । मग नुसधेनि देहेंसीं। आपण असे॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṛpaṇa cittavṛtti jaisī | 250 śrījñāneśvarī roṃboni ghālī ṭhevayāpāsīṃ | maga nusadheni deheṃsīṃ| āpaṇa ase|| 33||
verses.meaning: Just as a miser's mind is completely engrossed in his treasure, and he himself remains with a mere body, so too is the nature of attachment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां अजातपक्षिया जवळा। जीव बैसवूनि अविसाळां। पक्षिणी अंतराळा-। माजीं जाय॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ajātapakṣiyā javaḻā| jīva baisavūni avisāḻāṃ| pakṣiṇī aṃtarāḻā-| mājīṃ jāya|| 34||
verses.meaning: Just as a mother bird, having placed her unfeathered chicks in the nest, flies away into the sky,

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना गाय चरे डोंगरीं। परि चित्त बांधिले वत्सें घरीं । तेसें प्रेम एथिंचें करीं । स्थानपती ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā gāya care ḍoṃgarīṃ| pari citta bāṃdhile vatseṃ gharīṃ | teseṃ prema ethiṃceṃ karīṃ | sthānapatī || 35 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a cow grazes on the mountain but her mind remains tied to her calf at home, so too, O Lord of the place, should your love be for this place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरें वरिचिलेनि चित्तें। बाह्य सख्य सुखापुरतें। भोगिजो कां श्रीमूर्तीतें। चतुर्भुज ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yereṃ varicileni citteṃ| bāhya sakhya sukhāpurateṃ| bhogijo kāṃ śrīmūrtīteṃ| caturbhuja || 36||
verses.meaning: With a superficial mind, one may enjoy external friendship with the four-armed divine form, but only for the sake of worldly pleasure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि पुढतपुढती पांडवा। हा एक बोलु न विसरावा। जे इये रूपींहूनि सदभावा । नेदावें निघों॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari puḍhatapuḍhatī pāṃḍavā| hā eka bolu na visarāvā| je iye rūpīṃhūni sadabhāvā | nedāveṃ nighoṃ|| 37||
verses.meaning: But again and again, O Pandava, do not forget this one thing: that from this form, one should not let go of the true essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें कहीं नव्हतेंचि देखिलें। म्हणौनि भय जें तुज उपजलें | तें सांडीं एथ संचलें। असों दे प्रेम॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ kahīṃ navhateṃci dekhileṃ| mhaṇauni bhaya jeṃ tuja upajaleṃ | teṃ sāṃḍīṃ etha saṃcaleṃ| asoṃ de prema|| 38||
verses.meaning: You have never seen this before, and therefore the fear that has arisen in you, cast it aside. Let love abide here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां करूं तुजयासारिखें। ऐसें म्हणितलें विश्‍वतोमुखें। तरि मागील रूप सुखें । न्याहाळीं पां तूं॥& ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ karūṃ tujayāsārikheṃ| aiseṃ mhaṇitaleṃ viś‍vatomukheṃ| tari māgīla rūpa sukheṃ | nyāhāḻīṃ pāṃ tūṃ||& 39||
verses.meaning: Now, I will make you like myself, so said the all-pervading Lord. Therefore, behold with joy your previous form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें वाक्य बोलतखेंबो। मागुता मनुष्य जाहला देवो। हें ना परि नवलावबो। आवडीचा तिये॥ ६४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ vākya bolatakheṃbo| māgutā manuṣya jāhalā devo| heṃ nā pari navalāvabo| āvaḍīcā tiye|| 640||
verses.meaning: As soon as these words were spoken, the human became divine again. This is not a new wonder, but the power of that devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीकृष्णचि कैवल्य उघडें। वरि सर्वस्व विश्वरूपायेवढें। हातीं दिधलें कीं नावडे। अर्जुनासि॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīkṛṣṇaci kaivalya ughaḍeṃ| vari sarvasva viśvarūpāyevaḍheṃ| hātīṃ didhaleṃ kīṃ nāvaḍe| arjunāsi|| 41||
verses.meaning: Lord Krishna Himself is the manifest liberation, and He gave His entire universal form, as vast as the cosmos, into Arjuna's hands, yet Arjuna did not appreciate it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वस्तु घेऊनि वाळिजे। जैसें रत्नासि दूषण ठेविजे। नातरी कन्या पाहूनियां म्हणिजे। मना न ये हे॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: vastu gheūni vāḻije| jaiseṃ ratnāsi dūṣaṇa ṭhevije| nātarī kanyā pāhūniyāṃ mhaṇije| manā na ye he|| 42||
verses.meaning: Just as one might discard an object, or find fault with a jewel, or look at a maiden and say, "She is not to my liking" --

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया विश्‍वरूपायेवढी दशा । करितां प्रीतीचा वाढू कैसा। सेल दिधलीसे उपदेशा। किरीटीसिं देवें ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā viś‍varūpāyevaḍhī daśā | karitāṃ prītīcā vāḍhū kaisā| sela didhalīse upadeśā| kirīṭīsiṃ deveṃ || 43||
verses.meaning: The Lord, seeing Arjuna's state of universal vision, gave him the teaching out of love, as if to say, "How can love grow in such a state?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोडोनि भांगाराचा रवा। लेणें घडिलें आपलिया सवा । मग नावडे जरी जीवा । तरी आटिजे पुढती ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: moḍoni bhāṃgārācā ravā| leṇeṃ ghaḍileṃ āpaliyā savā | maga nāvaḍe jarī jīvā | tarī āṭije puḍhatī || 44||
verses.meaning: If one melts gold to fashion an ornament according to their desire, and then finds it displeasing, they can simply melt it down again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें शिष्याचिये प्रीती जाहलें। कृष्णत्व होतें तें विश्वरूप केलें। तें मना नयेचि मग आणिलें। कृष्णपण मागुतें ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śiṣyāciye prītī jāhaleṃ| kṛṣṇatva hoteṃ teṃ viśvarūpa keleṃ| teṃ manā nayeci maga āṇileṃ| kṛṣṇapaṇa māguteṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: Thus, out of love for his disciple, what was Krishna's form became the universal form. But as that was not acceptable, he resumed his Krishna form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठाववरी शिष्याची निकसी । सहाते गुरु आहाती कवणे देशीं। परि नेणिजे आवडी कैशी । संजयो म्हणे॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāvavarī śiṣyācī nikasī | sahāte guru āhātī kavaṇe deśīṃ| pari neṇije āvaḍī kaiśī | saṃjayo mhaṇe|| 46||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya says, "To this extent, the disciple's devotion is tested. In what land do such Gurus exist? But the nature of this love is unknown."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग विश्‍व व्यापूनि भोंवतें। जें दिव्यतेज प्रगटलें होतें। तेंचि सामावले मागुतें । कृष्णरूपीं तये ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga viś‍va vyāpūni bhoṃvateṃ| jeṃ divyateja pragaṭaleṃ hoteṃ| teṃci sāmāvale māguteṃ | kṛṣṇarūpīṃ taye || 47||
verses.meaning: Then, that divine effulgence, which had manifested, pervading and encompassing the universe, again merged back into that form of Krishna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें त्वंपद हें आघवें । तत्पदीं सामावे । अथवा द्रुमाकारु सांठवे। बीजकणिके जेवीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ tvaṃpada heṃ āghaveṃ | tatpadīṃ sāmāve | athavā drumākāru sāṃṭhave| bījakaṇike jevīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: Just as the entire 'tvampada' (individual self) merges into the 'tatpada' (universal self), or as the form of a tree is contained within a tiny seed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी स्वणसंभ्रमु जैसा। गिळी चेइली जीवदशा । श्रीकृष्णें योगु हा तैसा। संहारिळा तो॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī svaṇasaṃbhramu jaisā| giḻī ceilī jīvadaśā | śrīkṛṣṇeṃ yogu hā taisā| saṃhāriḻā to|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as a dream, when one awakens, is swallowed by the waking state, so too was that yoga (the illusion of separate existence) destroyed by Shri Krishna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी प्रभा हारपली बिंबीं। कीं जळदसंपत्ती नभीं। नाना भरतें सिंधुगर्भी । रिगाळें राया॥ ६५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī prabhā hārapalī biṃbīṃ| kīṃ jaḻadasaṃpattī nabhīṃ| nānā bharateṃ siṃdhugarbhī | rigāḻeṃ rāyā|| 650||
verses.meaning: Just as the radiance is lost in the sun, or the clouds in the sky, or as the tides enter the depths of the ocean, O King.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां जे कृष्णाकृतीचिये मोडी । होती विश्‍्वरूपपटाची घडी । ते अर्जुनाचिये आवडी । उकळलूनि दाविळी॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ je kṛṣṇākṛtīciye moḍī | hotī viś‍varūpapaṭācī ghaḍī | te arjunāciye āvaḍī | ukaḻalūni dāviḻī|| 51||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the very form of Krishna was the folded canvas of the cosmic vision. For Arjuna's delight, He unfolded and revealed it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब परिमाणा रंगु । तेणें देखिलें साविया चांगु । तेथ ग्राहकीये नव्हेचि लागु। म्हणौनि घडी केली पुढती॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba parimāṇā raṃgu | teṇeṃ dekhileṃ sāviyā cāṃgu | tetha grāhakīye navheci lāgu| mhaṇauni ghaḍī kelī puḍhatī|| 52||
verses.meaning: The color, though of immense size, was seen as truly beautiful. Yet, it found no buyer, so it was folded up again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें वाढीचेनि बहुवसपणें। रूपें विश्व जिंतिलें जेणें । तें सौम्य कोडिसवाणें। साकार जाहलें॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ vāḍhīceni bahuvasapaṇeṃ| rūpeṃ viśva jiṃtileṃ jeṇeṃ | teṃ saumya koḍisavāṇeṃ| sākāra jāhaleṃ||53||
verses.meaning: In the same way, by the abundance of its growth, the form that conquered the universe, that gentle and beautiful form, became manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना अनंतें। धरिळें धाकुटपण मागुतें। परि आशश्‍वासिलें पार्थातें। ब्िहाळियासी॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā anaṃteṃ| dhariḻeṃ dhākuṭapaṇa māguteṃ| pari āśaś‍vāsileṃ pārthāteṃ| bihāḻiyāsī|| 54||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the Infinite One assumed a small form again, but reassured Arjuna, who was frightened.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो स्वप्नीं स्वर्गा गेला। तो अवसांत जैसा चेइला। तैसा विस्मयो जाहला । किरीटीसी ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo svapnīṃ svargā gelā| to avasāṃta jaisā ceilā| taisā vismayo jāhalā | kirīṭīsī || 55||
verses.meaning: Just as one who dreams of going to heaven awakens from that dream, so too was Arjuna filled with wonder.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी गुरूकृपेसवें । बोसरलेया प्रपंचज्ञान आघवें। स्फुरे तत्त्व तेवीं पांडवें। श्रीमूर्ति देखिली ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī gurūkṛpesaveṃ | bosaraleyā prapaṃcajñāna āghaveṃ| sphure tattva tevīṃ pāṃḍaveṃ| śrīmūrti dekhilī || 56||
verses.meaning: Or, by the grace of the Guru, all worldly knowledge is dispelled, and the true essence is revealed, just as Pandavas beheld the divine form of Shri Krishna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया पांडवा ऐसें चित्तीं। आड विश्‍्वरूपाची जवनिका होती। ते फिटोनि गेली परौती। हें भलें जाहलें॥५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā pāṃḍavā aiseṃ cittīṃ| āḍa viś‍varūpācī javanikā hotī| te phiṭoni gelī parautī| heṃ bhaleṃ jāhaleṃ||57||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, such was the state of mind, that there was a curtain of the Universal Form. That has now been removed, which is a very good thing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय काळातें जिणोनि आला । कीं महाबातु मागां सांडिला । आपुलिया बाहीं उतरला । सात ही सिंधु ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya kāḻāteṃ jiṇoni ālā | kīṃ mahābātu māgāṃ sāṃḍilā | āpuliyā bāhīṃ utaralā | sāta hī siṃdhu || 58||
verses.meaning: What has he overcome to arrive here? Or has he left behind the great illusion? He has crossed all seven oceans by his own arm.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा संतोषु बहु चित्तें। घेडइजत असे पंडुसुतें। विश्‍्वरूपापाठीं कृष्णातें। देखोनियां ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā saṃtoṣu bahu citteṃ| gheḍaijata ase paṃḍusuteṃ| viś‍varūpāpāṭhīṃ kṛṣṇāteṃ| dekhoniyāṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: Such great contentment filled many hearts, O son of Pandu, upon seeing Krishna after the cosmic form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग सूर्याचिया अस्तमानीं। मागुती तारा उगवती गगनीं । तैसी देखों लागळा अवनी। लोकांसहित ॥ ६६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga sūryāciyā astamānīṃ| māgutī tārā ugavatī gaganīṃ | taisī dekhoṃ lāgaḻā avanī| lokāṃsahita || 660||
verses.meaning: Then, just as stars reappear in the sky after the sun sets, so too did the earth, along with its inhabitants, begin to be seen again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहे तंव तेंचि कुरुक्षेत्र । तैसेंचि देखे दोहीं भागीं गोत्र। वीर वर्षताती शस्त्रास्त्र । संघाटवरी ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhe taṃva teṃci kurukṣetra | taiseṃci dekhe dohīṃ bhāgīṃ gotra| vīra varṣatātī śastrāstra | saṃghāṭavarī || 61||
verses.meaning: He saw the same Kurukshetra, and in the same way, he saw his kinsmen on both sides. The warriors were showering weapons in battle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया बाणांचिया मांडवाआंतु । तैसाची रथु देखे निवांतु। धुरे बैसला लक्ष्मीकांतु| आपण तळीं ॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā bāṇāṃciyā māṃḍavāāṃtu | taisācī rathu dekhe nivāṃtu| dhure baisalā lakṣmīkāṃtu| āpaṇa taḻīṃ ||62||
verses.meaning: Within the canopy of those arrows, He saw the chariot, serene and undisturbed. The Lord of Lakshmi, seated at the helm, was Himself below.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं मागील जेसें तैसें । तेणें देखिलें वीरविलासें। मग म्हणे जियालों ऐसें। जाहलें आतां॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ māgīla jeseṃ taiseṃ | teṇeṃ dekhileṃ vīravilāseṃ| maga mhaṇe jiyāloṃ aiseṃ| jāhaleṃ ātāṃ|| 63||
verses.meaning: Thus, just as it was before, he saw the heroic sport. Then he said, "I have lived now."

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुद्धीतें सांडोनि ज्ञान। भेणें बळघलें रान। २५२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी अहंकारेंसीं मन। देशोधडी जाहलें॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: buddhīteṃ sāṃḍoni jñāna| bheṇeṃ baḻaghaleṃ rāna| 252 śrījñāneśvarī ahaṃkāreṃsīṃ mana| deśodhaḍī jāhaleṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: Wisdom, abandoning the intellect, has taken refuge in the forest out of fear. The mind, along with ego, has been banished from its home.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियें प्रवृत्ती भुललीं । वाचा प्राणा चुकली। ऐसी आपांपरी होती जाली। शरीरग्रामीं ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyeṃ pravṛttī bhulalīṃ | vācā prāṇā cukalī| aisī āpāṃparī hotī jālī| śarīragrāmīṃ || 65||
verses.meaning: The senses were deluded by worldly inclinations, and speech lost its vitality. Such was the state of each within the body's village.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियें आघवबींचि मागुतीं। जिवंत भेटलीं प्रकृती । आतां जिताणें श्रीमूर्ती। जाहलें मियां॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyeṃ āghavabīṃci māgutīṃ| jivaṃta bheṭalīṃ prakṛtī | ātāṃ jitāṇeṃ śrīmūrtī| jāhaleṃ miyāṃ|| 66||
verses.meaning: Through that, all of nature, as if alive, met again. Now, by me, the living form has been attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें सुख जीवीं घेतलें। मग श्रीकृष्णातें म्हणितळें। मियां तुमचें रूप देखिलें। मानुष हें ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ sukha jīvīṃ ghetaleṃ| maga śrīkṛṣṇāteṃ mhaṇitaḻeṃ| miyāṃ tumaceṃ rūpa dekhileṃ| mānuṣa heṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Having thus experienced bliss in his soul, Arjuna then said to Shri Krishna, "I have seen your human form."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें रूप दाखवणें देवराया। कीं मज अपत्या चुकलिया। बुझावोनि तुवां माया। स्तनपान दिधलें॥६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ rūpa dākhavaṇeṃ devarāyā| kīṃ maja apatyā cukaliyā| bujhāvoni tuvāṃ māyā| stanapāna didhaleṃ||68||
verses.meaning: O Lord, by showing me this form, it is as if you have found your lost child and, with motherly affection, have given me the milk of your grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी बिश्‍वरूपाचिया सागरीं । होतों तरंग मवित वांवेवरी। तो इये निजमूर्तीच्या तीरीं । निगालों आतां ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī biś‍varūpāciyā sāgarīṃ | hotoṃ taraṃga mavita vāṃvevarī| to iye nijamūrtīcyā tīrīṃ | nigāloṃ ātāṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: I, who was but a wave on the ocean of the cosmic form, am now, by the grace of my true form, safely ashore.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आईकें द्वारकापुरसुहाडा। मज सुकतिया जी झाडा। हे भेटी नव्हे बहुडा। मेघाचा केला॥ ६७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āīkeṃ dvārakāpurasuhāḍā| maja sukatiyā jī jhāḍā| he bheṭī navhe bahuḍā| meghācā kelā|| 670||
verses.meaning: Listen, O Dwarka's beloved, to me, a withered tree. This meeting is not like the return of many clouds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सावियाचि तृषा फुटला। तया मज अमृतसिंधु हा भेटला । आतां जिणयाचा जाहला । भरंवसा मज॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāviyāci tṛṣā phuṭalā| tayā maja amṛtasiṃdhu hā bheṭalā | ātāṃ jiṇayācā jāhalā | bharaṃvasā maja|| 71||
verses.meaning: I was parched with thirst, and now I have found this ocean of nectar. Now I have gained confidence in my life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझिया हृदयरंगणीं। होताहे हरिखळलतांची लावणी । सुखेंसि बुझावणी। जाहळी मज ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhiyā hṛdayaraṃgaṇīṃ| hotāhe harikhaḻalatāṃcī lāvaṇī | sukheṃsi bujhāvaṇī| jāhaḻī maja || 72||
verses.meaning: In the theater of my heart, the joyful creeper of Hari's play is being planted. With happiness, I have been consoled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया पार्थाचिया बोलासवें। हें काय म्हणितलें देवें। तुवां प्रेम ठेवूनि यावें। विएवरूपीं कीं ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā pārthāciyā bolāsaveṃ| heṃ kāya mhaṇitaleṃ deveṃ| tuvāṃ prema ṭhevūni yāveṃ| vievarūpīṃ kīṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: As Partha spoke, what did the Lord say? "You should come to Me in My universal form, with love."

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग इये श्रीमूर्ती। भेटावे सडिया आयती । ते शिकवण सुभद्रापती। विसरलासि मा॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga iye śrīmūrtī| bheṭāve saḍiyā āyatī | te śikavaṇa subhadrāpatī| visaralāsi mā|| 74||
verses.meaning: Then, to meet this glorious form, one must be ready and prepared. Oh, husband of Subhadra, have you forgotten that teaching?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा आंधळिया अर्जूना। हाता आलिया मेरुही होय साना। ऐसा आथी मना । चुकीचा भावो॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā āṃdhaḻiyā arjūnā| hātā āliyā meruhī hoya sānā| aisā āthī manā | cukīcā bhāvo|| 75||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, who are blind to the truth, even if Mount Meru were to come into your hands, it would seem small. Such is the deluded state of the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि विश्‍वात्मक रूपडें। जें दाविलें आम्हीं तुजपुढें। तें शंभूही परि न जोडे । तपें करितां॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari viś‍vātmaka rūpaḍeṃ| jeṃ dāvileṃ āmhīṃ tujapuḍheṃ| teṃ śaṃbhūhī pari na joḍe | tapeṃ karitāṃ|| 76||
verses.meaning: The universal form that I have revealed to you, even Shiva could not attain through severe penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि अष्टांगादिसंकटीं। योगी शिणताति किरीटी । परि अवसरु नाहीं भेटी। जयाचिये ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi aṣṭāṃgādisaṃkaṭīṃ| yogī śiṇatāti kirīṭī | pari avasaru nāhīṃ bheṭī| jayāciye || 77||
verses.meaning: And even in the hardships of Ashtanga Yoga, yogis toil, O Kiriti, yet they find no opportunity for a meeting with Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें विश्वरूप एकादे वेळ। कैसेनि देखों अळुमाळ। ऐसें स्मरतां काळ। जातसे देवां ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ viśvarūpa ekāde veḻa| kaiseni dekhoṃ aḻumāḻa| aiseṃ smaratāṃ kāḻa| jātase devāṃ || 78||
verses.meaning: How can I ever behold that cosmic form, even for a moment? While contemplating this, time passes, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आशेचिये अंजुळी। ठेऊनि हृदयाचिया निडळीं। चातक निराळीं । लागले जैसे ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āśeciye aṃjuḻī| ṭheūni hṛdayāciyā niḍaḻīṃ| cātaka nirāḻīṃ | lāgale jaise || 79||
verses.meaning: Like the chataka bird, with hope in its cupped hands, and with a pure heart, it waits eagerly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे उत्कंठानिर्भर। होऊनियां सुरवर घोकीत आठही पाहार। भेटी जयाची ॥ ६८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise utkaṃṭhānirbhara| hoūniyāṃ suravara ghokīta āṭhahī pāhāra| bheṭī jayācī || 680||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the gods, filled with intense longing, chant His name through all eight watches of the day and night, yearning for His presence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि विश्‍वरूपासारिखें। स्वप्नींही कोण्ही न देखे। तें प्रत्यक्ष तुवां सुखें। देखिले हें॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari viś‍varūpāsārikheṃ| svapnīṃhī koṇhī na dekhe| teṃ pratyakṣa tuvāṃ sukheṃ| dekhile heṃ||81||
verses.meaning: Indeed, no one, not even in dreams, has ever seen a form like the Universal Form. Yet, you have joyfully beheld it directly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं उपायांसि वाटा। न वाहती एथ सुभटा । साहीसहित वबोहटा । वाहिला वेदीं ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ upāyāṃsi vāṭā| na vāhatī etha subhaṭā | sāhīsahita vabohaṭā | vāhilā vedīṃ || 82||
verses.meaning: Indeed, for these means, O brave one, the Vedas themselves have carried the burden of six systems of philosophy, along with their explanations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज विश्‍्वरूपाचिया मोहरा । चालावया धनुर्धरा । तपांचियाही संभारा। नव्हेचि लागु॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja viś‍varūpāciyā moharā | cālāvayā dhanurdharā | tapāṃciyāhī saṃbhārā| navheci lāgu|| 83||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, to approach My cosmic form, even the accumulation of austerities is not sufficient.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि दानादि कौर कानडें। मी यज्ञींही तैसा न सांपडें। जैसेनि कां सुरवाडें। देखिला तुवां॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi dānādi kaura kānaḍeṃ| mī yajñīṃhī taisā na sāṃpaḍeṃ| jaiseni kāṃ suravāḍeṃ| dekhilā tuvāṃ|| 84||
verses.meaning: And in acts of charity and other good deeds, I am not easily found; nor am I found in sacrifices, just as you have seen me in the form of a feast.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मी एकीचि परि। आतुडें गा अवधारीं। जरी भक्ति येऊनि वरी । चित्तातें गा॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mī ekīci pari| ātuḍeṃ gā avadhārīṃ| jarī bhakti yeūni varī | cittāteṃ gā|| 85 ||
verses.meaning: In the same way, I alone can be attained, O listener, if devotion comes and takes hold of the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तेचि भक्ति ऐसी। पर्जन्याची सुटिका जैसी । धराबांचूनि अनारिसी । गतीचि नेणे॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teci bhakti aisī| parjanyācī suṭikā jaisī | dharābāṃcūni anārisī | gatīci neṇe|| 86||
verses.meaning: True devotion is like the rain, which knows no other path but to fall upon the earth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां सकळ जळसंपत्ती। घेऊनि समुद्रातें गिंवसिती । गंगा जैसी अनन्यगती। मिळाळीचि मिळे ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ sakaḻa jaḻasaṃpattī| gheūni samudrāteṃ giṃvasitī | gaṃgā jaisī ananyagatī| miḻāḻīci miḻe || 87||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganga, with all its waters, embraces the ocean, so too does it merge with it, having no other destination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सर्वभावसंभारें। न धरत प्रेम एकसरें। मजमाजीं संचरे। मीचि होऊनि॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sarvabhāvasaṃbhāreṃ| na dharata prema ekasareṃ| majamājīṃ saṃcare| mīci hoūni|| 88||
verses.meaning: In the same way, with all emotions and being, love does not hold back but flows into Me, becoming one with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तेवींचि मी ऐसा। थडिये माझारीं सरिसा। क्षीराब्धि कां जैसा । क्षीराचाचि॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tevīṃci mī aisā| thaḍiye mājhārīṃ sarisā| kṣīrābdhi kāṃ jaisā | kṣīrācāci|| 89||
verses.meaning: And just as I am, so too is the shore, entirely made of milk, like the Milk Ocean itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें मजलागुनी मुंगीवरी । किंबहुना चराचरीं। भजनासि कां दुसरी । परीचि नाहीं ॥ ६९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ majalāgunī muṃgīvarī | kiṃbahunā carācarīṃ| bhajanāsi kāṃ dusarī | parīci nāhīṃ || 690||
verses.meaning: For me, from an ant to the entire universe, there is no other way to worship than through devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचि क्षणासवें। एवंबिध मी जाणवें। जाणितला तरी स्वभावें। दृष्टही होय ॥ ९१ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāci kṣaṇāsaveṃ| evaṃbidha mī jāṇaveṃ| jāṇitalā tarī svabhāveṃ| dṛṣṭahī hoya || 91 ||
verses.meaning: At that very moment, I am known in this manner. Once known, I naturally become visible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग इंधनीं अग्नि उद्दीपे। आणि इंधन हें भाष हारपे। तें अग्नीचि होऊनि आरोपें। मूर्त जेवीं ॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga iṃdhanīṃ agni uddīpe| āṇi iṃdhana heṃ bhāṣa hārape| teṃ agnīci hoūni āropeṃ| mūrta jevīṃ ||92||
verses.meaning: Then, as the fire intensifies with fuel, and the fuel itself vanishes into the flame, it becomes the very form of the fire, as if embodied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां उदय न कीजे तेजाकारें। तंव गगनचि होऊनि असे आंधारें। मग उदईलिया एकसरें। प्रकाशु होय॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ udaya na kīje tejākāreṃ| taṃva gaganaci hoūni ase āṃdhāreṃ| maga udaīliyā ekasareṃ| prakāśu hoya|| 93||
verses.meaning: Why does the sun not rise with its full brilliance? Because the sky itself is dark. But when it rises, light immediately appears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें माझिये साक्षात्कारीं। सरे अहंकाराची वारी । अहंकारलोपीं अवधारी । द्वैत जाय ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ mājhiye sākṣātkārīṃ| sare ahaṃkārācī vārī | ahaṃkāralopīṃ avadhārī | dvaita jāya || 94||
verses.meaning: In the realization of My true nature, the ego's journey ends. When the ego is dissolved, all duality vanishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मगमी तो हें आघवें। एक मीचि आधथी स्वभावें। किंबहुना सामावे। समरसें तो॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: magamī to heṃ āghaveṃ| eka mīci ādhathī svabhāveṃ| kiṃbahunā sāmāve| samaraseṃ to|| 95||
verses.meaning: Then, in that state, all this is naturally me alone, and moreover, it is absorbed in me through complete oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २५४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जो मजचि एकालागीं। कर्मे बाहातसे आंगीं । जया मजवांचोनि जगीं । गोमटें नाहीं ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: 254 śrījñāneśvarī jo majaci ekālāgīṃ| karme bāhātase āṃgīṃ | jayā majavāṃconi jagīṃ | gomaṭeṃ nāhīṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Dnyaneshwari, which speaks of Me alone, whose actions are performed for Me, and for whom there is nothing good in the world apart from Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दृष्टादृष्ट सकळ । जयाचें मीचि केवळ । जेणें जिणयाचें 'फळ । मजचि नाम ठेविलें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dṛṣṭādṛṣṭa sakaḻa | jayāceṃ mīci kevaḻa | jeṇeṃ jiṇayāceṃ 'phaḻa | majaci nāma ṭhevileṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: All that is seen is solely Me. It is I who have given the fruit of life its name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग भूतें हें भाष विसरला । जे दिठी मीचि आहें सूदला। म्हणौनि निर्वेर जाहला । सर्वत्र भजे॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga bhūteṃ heṃ bhāṣa visaralā | je diṭhī mīci āheṃ sūdalā| mhaṇauni nirvera jāhalā | sarvatra bhaje|| 98||
verses.meaning: Then, all beings forgot their differences, realizing that 'I am indeed the pure Self.' Therefore, they became free from enmity and worshipped the Self everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा जो भक्तु होये। तयाचें त्रिधातुक हें जें जाये। तैं मीचि होऊनि ठाये। पांडवा गा॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā jo bhaktu hoye| tayāceṃ tridhātuka heṃ jeṃ jāye| taiṃ mīci hoūni ṭhāye| pāṃḍavā gā||99||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, when such a devotee, whose three-fold nature dissolves, becomes one with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जगदुदरदोंदिलें। तेणें करुणारसरसाळें। संजयो म्हणे बोलिलें । श्रीकृष्णदेवें ॥ ७००॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jagadudaradoṃdileṃ| teṇeṃ karuṇārasarasāḻeṃ| saṃjayo mhaṇe bolileṃ | śrīkṛṣṇadeveṃ || 700||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said, "Thus, the Lord Shri Krishna, whose belly holds the universe and whose heart is filled with the nectar of compassion, spoke."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ययावरी तो पंडुकुमरु । जाहला आनंदसंपदा थोरु । आणि कृष्णचरणचतुरु । एक तो जगीं ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayāvarī to paṃḍukumaru | jāhalā ānaṃdasaṃpadā thoru | āṇi kṛṣṇacaraṇacaturu | eka to jagīṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: Upon this, that son of Pandu was filled with immense joy and prosperity, and he alone in the world was skilled in the service of Krishna's feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें देवाचिया दोनही मूर्ती निकिया न्याहाळिळिया चित्तीं। तंव विश्वरूपाहूनि कृष्णाकृतीं। देखिला लाभु॥२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ devāciyā donahī mūrtī nikiyā nyāhāḻiḻiyā cittīṃ| taṃva viśvarūpāhūni kṛṣṇākṛtīṃ| dekhilā lābhu||2||
verses.meaning: With that, he carefully observed both forms of the Lord in his mind. Then, he realized that the form of Krishna was more beneficial than the cosmic form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तयाचिये जाणिवे। मानु न कोजेचि देवें। जे व्यापकाहूनि नव्हे । एकदेशी ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari tayāciye jāṇive| mānu na kojeci deveṃ| je vyāpakāhūni navhe | ekadeśī || 3||
verses.meaning: But God does not accept that knowledge, for He is not confined to one place, unlike the pervasive (knowledge).

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेंचि समर्थाबयालागीं। एक दोन चांगी । उपपत्ती शार्डी । दाविता जाहला॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃci samarthābayālāgīṃ| eka dona cāṃgī | upapattī śārḍī | dāvitā jāhalā|| 4||
verses.meaning: To support this, he presented one or two good, clear arguments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिया ऐकोनी सुभद्राकांतु। चित्तीं आहे म्हणतु। तरि होय बरवें दोन्हीं आंतु। तें पुढतीं पुसों॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyā aikonī subhadrākāṃtu| cittīṃ āhe mhaṇatu| tari hoya baraveṃ donhīṃ āṃtu| teṃ puḍhatīṃ pusoṃ|| 5||
verses.meaning: Hearing this, Arjuna thought to himself, "If this is the case, then it would be good to ask about both aspects further."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा आलोचु करूनि जीवीं। आतां पुसती बोज बरवी । आदरील ते परिसावी । पुढें कथा॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā ālocu karūni jīvīṃ| ātāṃ pusatī boja baravī | ādarīla te parisāvī | puḍheṃ kathā|| 6||
verses.meaning: Having thus deliberated within their hearts, they now ask for the excellent and auspicious words. Listen to the story that follows, which they have begun.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रांजळ ओंबीप्रबंधें। गोष्टी सांगिजेळ विनोदें। तें परिसा आंनदें। ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: prāṃjaḻa oṃbīprabaṃdheṃ| goṣṭī sāṃgijeḻa vinodeṃ| teṃ parisā āṃnadeṃ| jñānadevo mhaṇe || 7||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev says, listen with joy to these stories, which are told in a simple and delightful manner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भरोनि सदभावाची अंजुळी । मियां बोंबियाफुलें मोकळीं। अर्पिली अंध्रियुगुलीं। विश्वरूपाच्या ॥ ७०८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: bharoni sadabhāvācī aṃjuḻī | miyāṃ boṃbiyāphuleṃ mokaḻīṃ| arpilī aṃdhriyugulīṃ| viśvarūpācyā || 708 ||
verses.meaning: With hands cupped, filled with pure devotion, I offer these unblemished flowers of my heartfelt cries at the feet of the Universal Form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय वो शुद्धे। उदारे प्रसिद्धे। अनवरत आनंदे। वर्षतिये॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya vo śuddhe| udāre prasiddhe| anavarata ānaṃde| varṣatiye|| 9||
verses.meaning: Hail, O Pure One! O Renowned, Generous One! Who showers incessant bliss!

verses.shloka_devanagari: विषयव्याळें मिठी । दिधळिया नुठी ताठी । ते तुझिये गुरुकृपादृष्टी । निर्विष होय॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: viṣayavyāḻeṃ miṭhī | didhaḻiyā nuṭhī tāṭhī | te tujhiye gurukṛpādṛṣṭī | nirviṣa hoya|| 2||
verses.meaning: When the serpent of worldly pleasures coils around, and one cannot rise, by the grace-filled glance of your Guru, it becomes poisonless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि कवणातें तापु पोळी। कैसेनि बो शोकु जाळी । जरी प्रसादरसकल्लोळीं । पुरें येसि तूं ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari kavaṇāteṃ tāpu poḻī| kaiseni bo śoku jāḻī | jarī prasādarasakalloḻīṃ | pureṃ yesi tūṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: Then whom can heat afflict? How can sorrow burn? If you come to the full tide of the nectar of grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: योगसुखाचे सोहळे । सेवकां तुझेनि स्नेहाळे। सोहंसिद्धीचे लळे । पाळिसी तूं॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yogasukhāce sohaḻe | sevakāṃ tujheni snehāḻe| sohaṃsiddhīce laḻe | pāḻisī tūṃ|| 4||
verses.meaning: You, through your affection for your devotees, fulfill their desires for the bliss of yoga and the joy of realizing their oneness with the Divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधारशक्‍्तीचिया अंकी । वबाढविसी कौतुकीं । हृदयाकाशपल्लकीं । परिये देसी निजें ॥ ५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhāraśak‍tīciyā aṃkī | vabāḍhavisī kautukīṃ | hṛdayākāśapallakīṃ | pariye desī nijeṃ || 5 ||
verses.meaning: You playfully expand the primordial energy, and in the expanse of the heart-space, you grant true sleep.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रत्यगूज्योतीची बोबाळणी। करिसी मनपवनाचीं खेळणीं। आत्मसुखाचीं बाळलेणीं। लेवविसी॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pratyagūjyotīcī bobāḻaṇī| karisī manapavanācīṃ kheḻaṇīṃ| ātmasukhācīṃ bāḻaleṇīṃ| levavisī|| 6||
verses.meaning: You make the mind and breath playthings of the inner light, adorning them with the ornaments of self-bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सतरावियेचें स्तन्य देसी। अनुहताचा हल्लरू गासी। समाधिबोधें निजविसी। बुझाऊनि॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: satarāviyeceṃ stanya desī| anuhatācā hallarū gāsī| samādhibodheṃ nijavisī| bujhāūni|| 7||
verses.meaning: You give the milk of the seventeenth state, sing the lullaby of the unstruck sound (Anahata), and put to sleep (the seeker) through the knowledge of Samadhi, comforting them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि साधकां तूं माउली । पिके सारस्वत तुझिया पाउलीं। याकारणें मी साउली । न संडीं तुझी॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sādhakāṃ tūṃ māulī | pike sārasvata tujhiyā pāulīṃ| yākāraṇeṃ mī sāulī | na saṃḍīṃ tujhī|| 8||
verses.meaning: Therefore, you are the mother to seekers; knowledge flourishes at your feet. For this reason, I will not leave your shadow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो सद्गुरुचिये कृपादृष्टी। तुझें कारुण्य जयातें अधिष्ठी। तो सकळ विद्यांचिये सृष्टी । धात्रा होय ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho sadguruciye kṛpādṛṣṭī| tujheṃ kāruṇya jayāteṃ adhiṣṭhī| to sakaḻa vidyāṃciye sṛṣṭī | dhātrā hoya || 9||
verses.meaning: Oh, by the compassionate gaze of the Sadguru, he whom Your grace indwells, becomes the creator of all knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अंबे श्रीमंते। निजजनकल्पलते आज्ञापीं मातें। ग्रंथनिरूपणीं ॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aṃbe śrīmaṃte| nijajanakalpalate ājñāpīṃ māteṃ| graṃthanirūpaṇīṃ || 90||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Mother, the wish-fulfilling vine for your devotees, the wealthy one, command me to expound upon this scripture.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नवरसीं भरवीं सागरु । करवीं उचित रलांचें आगरु । भावार्थाचे गिरिवरु । निफजबीं माये॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: navarasīṃ bharavīṃ sāgaru | karavīṃ ucita ralāṃceṃ āgaru | bhāvārthāce girivaru | niphajabīṃ māye|| 11||
verses.meaning: Oh Mother, fill the ocean with the nine rasas (emotions), make it a mine of appropriate jewels, and bring forth mountains of profound spiritual meaning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साहित्यसोनियाचिया खाणी । उघडवीं देशियेचिया क्षोणी। विवेकवल्लीची लावणी। हों देई सैंघ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāhityasoniyāciyā khāṇī | ughaḍavīṃ deśiyeciyā kṣoṇī| vivekavallīcī lāvaṇī| hoṃ deī saiṃgha|| 12||
verses.meaning: Let the mines of literary gold be opened in the land of the vernacular. Let the planting of the creeper of discrimination be established.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संबादफळनिधानें। प्रमेयाचीं उद्यानें। लावीं म्हणे गहनें। निरंतर॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃbādaphaḻanidhāneṃ| prameyācīṃ udyāneṃ| lāvīṃ mhaṇe gahaneṃ| niraṃtara|| 13||
verses.meaning: He says, "I will continuously plant deep gardens of spiritual truths, which are the fruits of spiritual discourse."

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाखांडाचे दरकुटे। मोडीं वाग्वाद अव्हांटे। कुतर्कांचीं दुष्टें। सावजें फेडीं ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pākhāṃḍāce darakuṭe| moḍīṃ vāgvāda avhāṃṭe| kutarkāṃcīṃ duṣṭeṃ| sāvajeṃ pheḍīṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Break down the strongholds of heresy, dismantle the thorny paths of debate, and clear away the evil beasts of false logic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीकृष्णगुणीं मातें। सर्वत्र करीं वो सरतें। राणिवे बैसबीं श्रोते। श्रवणाचिये॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīkṛṣṇaguṇīṃ māteṃ| sarvatra karīṃ vo sarateṃ| rāṇive baisabīṃ śrote| śravaṇāciye|| 15||
verses.meaning: O Lord Krishna, make me worthy everywhere to sing Your praises. Seat the listeners in the royal court of hearing, so they may listen attentively.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ये मऱ्हाठियेचिया नगरीं। ब्रह्मविद्येचा सुकाळु करीं । घेणें देणें सुखचिवरी । हों देई या जगा॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ye maṟhāṭhiyeciyā nagarīṃ| brahmavidyecā sukāḻu karīṃ | gheṇeṃ deṇeṃ sukhacivarī | hoṃ deī yā jagā|| 16||
verses.meaning: In this city of Marathi, may there be an abundance of divine knowledge. May the world experience the pure joy of giving and receiving it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं आपुलेनि स्नरेहपल्लबें । मातें पांघुरविशीळ सदैवें। तरी आतांचि हें आघवें। निर्मीन माये ॥ ९१७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ āpuleni snarehapallabeṃ | māteṃ pāṃghuraviśīḻa sadaiveṃ| tarī ātāṃci heṃ āghaveṃ| nirmīna māye || 917||
verses.meaning: If you, with your loving embrace, will cover me, O Mother, then all this will be created right now.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इये विनवणीयेसाठीं। अवलोकिलें गुरुकृपादृष्टी । म्हणे गीतार्थेसीं उठीं। न बोलें बहु॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: iye vinavaṇīyesāṭhīṃ| avalokileṃ gurukṛpādṛṣṭī | mhaṇe gītārthesīṃ uṭhīṃ| na boleṃ bahu|| 18||
verses.meaning: For this very request, the Guru's compassionate gaze fell upon me, as if to say, "Arise with the meaning of the Gita; speak no more." (This implies that the Guru's grace empowered Dnyaneshwar to expound the Gita's meaning without further need for words or requests.)

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ जी जी महाप्रसादु । म्हणौनि साविया जाहला आनंदु। आतां निरोपीन प्रबंधु| अवधान दीजे॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha jī jī mahāprasādu | mhaṇauni sāviyā jāhalā ānaṃdu| ātāṃ niropīna prabaṃdhu| avadhāna dīje|| 19||
verses.meaning: There, whatever great grace was received, it brought forth joy. Now, I will narrate this composition; please give your attention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'तरि सकळवीराधिराजु। जो सोमवंशीं विजयध्वजु। तो बोळता जाहला आत्मजु । पंडुनृपाचा॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'tari sakaḻavīrādhirāju| jo somavaṃśīṃ vijayadhvaju| to boḻatā jāhalā ātmaju | paṃḍunṛpācā|| 20||
verses.meaning: Then, the supreme king of all warriors, the banner of victory in the lunar dynasty, that son of King Pandu, set out.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कृष्णातें म्हणे अबधारिलें। आपण विश्वरूप मज दाविलें। तें नवल म्हणौनि बिहाळें। चित्त माझें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṛṣṇāteṃ mhaṇe abadhārileṃ| āpaṇa viśvarūpa maja dāvileṃ| teṃ navala mhaṇauni bihāḻeṃ| citta mājheṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Krishna, I have understood. You showed me your cosmic form. That was a wonder, and because of it, my mind was disturbed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि इये कृष्णमूर्तीची सवे। यालागीं सोय धरिली जीवें। तंब नको म्हणोनि देवें। वारिलें मातें ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi iye kṛṣṇamūrtīcī save| yālāgīṃ soya dharilī jīveṃ| taṃba nako mhaṇoni deveṃ| vārileṃ māteṃ || 22||
verses.meaning: And because my soul had become accustomed to this form of Krishna, the Lord forbade me, saying, "No, not this."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी व्यक्‍त आणि अव्यक्त। हें तूंचि एक निश्नांत । भक्‍्तीं पाविजे व्यक्‍्त। अव्यक्त योगें॥२३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī vyak‍ta āṇi avyakta| heṃ tūṃci eka niśnāṃta | bhak‍tīṃ pāvije vyak‍ta| avyakta yogeṃ||23||
verses.meaning: You alone are both the manifest and the unmanifest. The manifest is attained through devotion, and the unmanifest through yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या दोनी जी वाटा तूंतें 'पाबावया वैकुंठा । व्यक्‍ताव्यक्‍त दारवंठां। रिगिजे येथ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā donī jī vāṭā tūṃteṃ 'pābāvayā vaikuṃṭhā | vyak‍tāvyak‍ta dāravaṃṭhāṃ| rigije yetha|| 24||
verses.meaning: These two paths, to reach Vaikuntha, are the thresholds of the manifest and the unmanifest, through which one must enter here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जे बानी श्यातुका। तेचि वेगळिया वाळा येका। म्हणौनि एकदेशिया व्यापका। सरिसा पाडू ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ je bānī śyātukā| teci vegaḻiyā vāḻā yekā| mhaṇauni ekadeśiyā vyāpakā| sarisā pāḍū || 25||
verses.meaning: Just as the same gold, when fashioned into various ornaments, appears different, so too the all-pervading Brahman, though one, manifests in diverse forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अमृताचिया सागरीं। जे लाभे सामर्थ्याची थोरी । तेचि दे अमृतलहरी । चुळीं घेतळलिया ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: amṛtāciyā sāgarīṃ| je lābhe sāmarthyācī thorī | teci de amṛtalaharī | cuḻīṃ ghetaḻaliyā || 26||
verses.meaning: The immense power gained from the ocean of immortality is like the waves of nectar, which are experienced by merely taking a sip.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे कौर माझ्या चित्तीं । प्रतीति आथि जी निरुती। परि पुसणें योगपती । तें याचिलागीं ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: he kaura mājhyā cittīṃ | pratīti āthi jī nirutī| pari pusaṇeṃ yogapatī | teṃ yācilāgīṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: O Kaurava, this truth is indeed firmly established in my mind. Yet, I question the Lord of Yoga for this very reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें देवा तुम्हीं नावेक । अंगिकारिलें व्यापक । तें साचचि कीं कवतिक । हें जाणावया॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ devā tumhīṃ nāveka | aṃgikārileṃ vyāpaka | teṃ sācaci kīṃ kavatika | heṃ jāṇāvayā|| 28||
verses.meaning: O Lord, when You, the all-pervading One, are embraced even for a moment, it is truly a wonder to behold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तुजलागीं कर्म। तूंचि जयाचें परम। भक्तीसी मनोधर्म। विकोनि घातला ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tujalāgīṃ karma| tūṃci jayāceṃ parama| bhaktīsī manodharma| vikoni ghātalā || 29||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for your sake, all actions, and indeed the highest devotion, are offered to you, with the mind's inclinations completely surrendered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इत्यादि सर्वी परीं। जे भक्त तूंतें श्रीहरी । बांधोनियां जिव्हारीं । उपासिती॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ityādi sarvī parīṃ| je bhakta tūṃteṃ śrīharī | bāṃdhoniyāṃ jivhārīṃ | upāsitī|| 30||
verses.meaning: In all these ways, O Shrihari, those devotees who bind You within their hearts worship You.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जें प्रणवापैलीकडे। बैखरीयेसी जें कानडें। कायिसयाहि सांगडें। नव्हेचि जें बस्तु॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jeṃ praṇavāpailīkaḍe| baikharīyesī jeṃ kānaḍeṃ| kāyisayāhi sāṃgaḍeṃ| navheci jeṃ bastu|| 31||
verses.meaning: And that which is beyond the Pranava, which is inaccessible to speech, and which cannot be compared to anything, that is the true reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अक्षर जी अव्यक्त निर्देश देशरहित। सो$हंभावें उपासित। ज्ञानिये जें॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ akṣara jī avyakta nirdeśa deśarahita| so$haṃbhāveṃ upāsita| jñāniye jeṃ||32||
verses.meaning: That imperceptible, indescribable, and spaceless Absolute, which the wise worship with the feeling of "I am That."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां आणि जी भवक्तां। येरयेरांमाजीं अनंता। कवणें योगु तत्त्वतां। जाणितला सांगा॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ āṇi jī bhavaktāṃ| yerayerāṃmājīṃ anaṃtā| kavaṇeṃ yogu tattvatāṃ| jāṇitalā sāṃgā|| 33||
verses.meaning: Among those devotees and the infinite Lord, who truly understood the yoga of oneness? Please tell me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया किरीटीचिया बोळा । तो जगद्वंधु संतोषला । म्हणे हो प्रश्‍नु भला । जाणसी करूं॥३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā kirīṭīciyā boḻā | to jagadvaṃdhu saṃtoṣalā | mhaṇe ho praś‍nu bhalā | jāṇasī karūṃ||34||
verses.meaning: The Lord of the Universe was pleased with Arjuna's question, saying, "Indeed, you know how to ask a good question."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि अस्तुगिरीचिया उपकंठीं। रिगालिया रविबिंबापाठीं। रश्मी जैसे किरीटी। संचरती गा॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari astugirīciyā upakaṃṭhīṃ| rigāliyā ravibiṃbāpāṭhīṃ| raśmī jaise kirīṭī| saṃcaratī gā|| 35||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun's rays, after the sun disc has set behind the western mountain, still linger and spread their light, so too does the divine presence remain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां वर्षाकाळीं सरिता। जैसी चढों लागे पंडुसुता । तैसी नीच नवी भजतां। श्रद्धा दिसे॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ varṣākāḻīṃ saritā| jaisī caḍhoṃ lāge paṃḍusutā | taisī nīca navī bhajatāṃ| śraddhā dise|| 36||
verses.meaning: Just as a river swells during the rainy season, O son of Pandu, so too does faith grow ever new when one engages in devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि ठाकिलियाहि सागरु। जैसा मागीलही यावा अनिवारु। तिये गंगेचिये ऐसा पडिभरु। प्रेमभावा ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari ṭhākiliyāhi sāgaru| jaisā māgīlahī yāvā anivāru| tiye gaṃgeciye aisā paḍibharu| premabhāvā || 37||
verses.meaning: Even if the ocean is filled, the Ganga's flow remains irresistible, just like the overwhelming surge of divine love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सर्वेद्रियांसहित । मजमाजीं सूनि चित्त । जे रात्रिदिवस न म्हणत। उपासिती॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sarvedriyāṃsahita | majamājīṃ sūni citta | je rātridivasa na mhaṇata| upāsitī|| 38||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who, with all their senses, fix their minds on Me, and worship Me day and night without ceasing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयापरी जे भक्‍त। आपणपें मज देत। तेचि मी योगयुक्‍त। परम मानीं॥३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyāparī je bhak‍ta| āpaṇapeṃ maja deta| teci mī yogayuk‍ta| parama mānīṃ||39||
verses.meaning: Thus, those devotees who offer themselves to Me, them alone do I consider supremely united with Me in Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि येर तेही पांडवा । जे आरूढोनि सो$हंभावा। झोंबती निरवयवा । अक्षरासी॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi yera tehī pāṃḍavā | je ārūḍhoni so$haṃbhāvā| jhoṃbatī niravayavā | akṣarāsī|| 40||
verses.meaning: And others, O Pandava, who, having ascended to the state of 'I am That' (So'ham), strive to unite with the indivisible, imperishable Absolute.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मनाची नखी न लगे। जेथ बुद्धीची दृष्टी न रिगे। ते इंद्रियां कौर जोगें । कायि होईल॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: manācī nakhī na lage| jetha buddhīcī dṛṣṭī na rige| te iṃdriyāṃ kaura jogeṃ | kāyi hoīla|| 41||
verses.meaning: Where the mind's nail cannot reach, where the intellect's sight cannot enter, what can the senses possibly achieve there?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि ध्यानाही कुवाडें। म्हणौनि एके ठायीं न संपडे। व्यक्‍तीसि माजिवडें। कवणेही नोहे॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari dhyānāhī kuvāḍeṃ| mhaṇauni eke ṭhāyīṃ na saṃpaḍe| vyak‍tīsi mājivaḍeṃ| kavaṇehī nohe|| 42||
