verses.meaning: Even meditation finds it difficult to grasp, and thus it cannot be confined to one place. No individual can truly comprehend its vastness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया सर्वत्र सर्वपणें। सर्वांही काळीं असणें । जें पावूनि चिंतवणें । हिंपुटी जाहलें॥ ४३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā sarvatra sarvapaṇeṃ| sarvāṃhī kāḻīṃ asaṇeṃ | jeṃ pāvūni ciṃtavaṇeṃ | hiṃpuṭī jāhaleṃ|| 43 ||
verses.meaning: That which is everywhere, in all forms, and exists at all times; attaining which, all worries and anxieties are completely dispelled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें होय ना नोहे । जें नाहीं ना आहे । ऐसें म्हणौनि उपाये । उपजतीचिना॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ hoya nā nohe | jeṃ nāhīṃ nā āhe | aiseṃ mhaṇauni upāye | upajatīcinā|| 44||
verses.meaning: That which neither is nor is not, that which neither exists nor does not exist; therefore, no means can arise to describe it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें चळे ना ढळे। सरे ना मैळे। तें आपुलेनीचि बळें। आंगविलें जिहीं ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ caḻe nā ḍhaḻe| sare nā maiḻe| teṃ āpulenīci baḻeṃ| āṃgavileṃ jihīṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: That which does not move, nor waver, nor diminish, nor become soiled; that very Self is realized by those who, through their own strength, have made it manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं वैराग्यमहापावकें । जाळूनि विषयांचीं कटकें । अधपलीं तवकें । इंद्रियें धरिली ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ vairāgyamahāpāvakeṃ | jāḻūni viṣayāṃcīṃ kaṭakeṃ | adhapalīṃ tavakeṃ | iṃdriyeṃ dharilī || 46 ||
verses.meaning: With the great fire of detachment, burning away the armies of worldly pleasures, the senses, though weakened, are held in check.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग संयमाची धाटी । सूनि मुरडिलीं उफराटी । इंद्रियें कोंडिलीं कपाटीं। हृदयाचिया ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga saṃyamācī dhāṭī | sūni muraḍilīṃ upharāṭī | iṃdriyeṃ koṃḍilīṃ kapāṭīṃ| hṛdayāciyā || 47||
verses.meaning: Then, with the strong rope of self-control, the senses were turned inward and confined within the chamber of the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अपानींचिया कवाडा । लावोनि आसनमुद्रा सुहाडा। मूळबंधाचा हुडा। पन्नासिळा ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: apānīṃciyā kavāḍā | lāvoni āsanamudrā suhāḍā| mūḻabaṃdhācā huḍā| pannāsiḻā || 48||
verses.meaning: Closing the door of the apana vayu with the comfortable asana mudra, one should firmly establish the Mulabandha.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आशेचे लाग तोडिले। अधेर्याचे कडे झाडिले। निद्रेचें शोधिलें। काळवखें॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āśece lāga toḍile| adheryāce kaḍe jhāḍile| nidreceṃ śodhileṃ| kāḻavakheṃ|| 49||
verses.meaning: The bonds of desire were severed, the cliffs of darkness were cleared, and the deep shadows of sleep were sought out and dispelled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वज्राग्नीचिया ज्वाळीं। करूनि सप्तधातूंची होळी । व्याधींच्या सिसाळीं । पूजिलीं यंत्रे ॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vajrāgnīciyā jvāḻīṃ| karūni saptadhātūṃcī hoḻī | vyādhīṃcyā sisāḻīṃ | pūjilīṃ yaṃtre || 50||
verses.meaning: With the flames of a thunderbolt-like fire, reducing the seven bodily constituents to ashes, and with the venomous bites of diseases, the mystical diagrams were worshipped.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग कुंडलिनियेचा टेंभा। आधारीं केला उभा। तया चोजवले प्रभा। निमथावरी ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kuṃḍaliniyecā ṭeṃbhā| ādhārīṃ kelā ubhā| tayā cojavale prabhā| nimathāvarī || 51||
verses.meaning: Then, the Kundalini, like a lamp, was made to stand at the base, and its light illuminated the very summit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नवद्वारांचिया चौचकीं। बाणूनि संयतीची आडवंकी। उघडिली खिडकी । ककारांतींची॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: navadvārāṃciyā caucakīṃ| bāṇūni saṃyatīcī āḍavaṃkī| ughaḍilī khiḍakī | kakārāṃtīṃcī||52||
verses.meaning: At the crossroads of the nine gates, by establishing the barrier of self-restraint, the window to the ultimate reality, symbolized by the letter 'Ka', was opened.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्राणशक्तिचांमुडे । प्रहारूनि संकल्प मेंढे। मनोमहिषाचेनि मुंडे। दिधलीं बळी ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: prāṇaśakticāṃmuḍe | prahārūni saṃkalpa meṃḍhe| manomahiṣāceni muṃḍe| didhalīṃ baḻī || 53 ||
verses.meaning: By the power of the life-force, striking down the ram-like resolves, and with the head of the buffalo-like mind, sacrifices were offered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चंद्रसूर्या बुझावणी । करूनि अनाहताची सुडावणी । सतरावियेचें पाणी । जिंतिलें वेगीं ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: caṃdrasūryā bujhāvaṇī | karūni anāhatācī suḍāvaṇī | satarāviyeceṃ pāṇī | jiṃtileṃ vegīṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: Having extinguished the sun and moon, and having established the unstruck sound (Anahata), the water of the seventeenth state was quickly conquered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग मध्यमा मध्यविवरें। तेणें कोरिवें दादरें। २५८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी ठाकिलें चवरें। ब्रह्मरंध्र ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga madhyamā madhyavivareṃ| teṇeṃ koriveṃ dādareṃ| 258 śrījñāneśvarī ṭhākileṃ cavareṃ| brahmaraṃdhra || 55||
verses.meaning: Then, through the central channel, by that carved staircase, the Brahmarandhra is reached.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरी मकारांत सोपान । तें सांडोनियां गहन । काखे सूनियां गगन । भरलें ब्रह्मीं॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: varī makārāṃta sopāna | teṃ sāṃḍoniyāṃ gahana | kākhe sūniyāṃ gagana | bharaleṃ brahmīṃ|| 56||
verses.meaning: Leaving behind the steps of the 'M' sound (Om), and embracing the profound, the sky (consciousness) is filled with Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे जे समबुद्धी। गिळावया सो$हंसिन्धी । आंगविताति निरवधी । योगदुर्गे ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise je samabuddhī| giḻāvayā so$haṃsindhī | āṃgavitāti niravadhī | yogadurge || 57||
verses.meaning: Those who possess such equanimity, in order to fully absorb the realization of "I am That," continuously engage in the formidable fortress of Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलिया साटोवाटीं । शून्य घेती उठाउठीं। तेही मातेंचि किरीटी। पावती गा॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpuliyā sāṭovāṭīṃ | śūnya ghetī uṭhāuṭhīṃ| tehī māteṃci kirīṭī| pāvatī gā|| 58||
verses.meaning: Those who, in exchange for themselves, readily embrace the void, they too, O Kiriti, attain Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि योगाचेनि बळें। अधिक कांहीं मिळे। ऐसें नाहीं आगळें। कष्टचि तयां॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni yogāceni baḻeṃ| adhika kāṃhīṃ miḻe| aiseṃ nāhīṃ āgaḻeṃ| kaṣṭaci tayāṃ|| 59||
verses.meaning: There is nothing more to be gained through the power of Yoga; it is not something extraordinary, but rather a mere effort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं सकळभूतांचिया हिती । निरालंबीं अव्यक्‍्तीं । पसरळिया आसक्ती । भक्तीवीण॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ sakaḻabhūtāṃciyā hitī | nirālaṃbīṃ avyak‍tīṃ | pasaraḻiyā āsaktī | bhaktīvīṇa|| 60||
verses.meaning: Those who, for the welfare of all beings, without any support, in the unmanifest, have spread their devotion, even without formal worship.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां महेंद्रादि पदें। करिताति वाटवधें । आणि क्रस्द्विसिद्धींचीं दृंद्रे। पडोनि ठाती॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ maheṃdrādi padeṃ| karitāti vāṭavadheṃ | āṇi krasdvisiddhīṃcīṃ dṛṃdre| paḍoni ṭhātī|| 61||
verses.meaning: The positions of Indra and other deities become obstacles, and the multitudes of worldly attainments fall away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कामक्रोधांचें विलग । उठावती अनेग। आणि शून्येंसी आंग । झुंजवावें कौं ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāmakrodhāṃceṃ vilaga | uṭhāvatī anega| āṇi śūnyeṃsī āṃga | jhuṃjavāveṃ kauṃ || 62||
verses.meaning: When lust and anger arise in many forms, how can one fight them with a body that is empty or devoid of true self?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ताहानें ताहानचि पियावी । भुकेलिया भूकचि खावी । अहोरात्र वावीं। मवाबा वारा ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tāhāneṃ tāhānaci piyāvī | bhukeliyā bhūkaci khāvī | ahorātra vāvīṃ| mavābā vārā || 63||
verses.meaning: Thirst should be quenched by thirst itself; hunger should be consumed by hunger itself. Day and night, let the wind blow gently.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उनीं दिहाचें पहुडणें । निरोधाचें वेल्हावणें । झाडासि साजणें । चावळावें गा॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: unīṃ dihāceṃ pahuḍaṇeṃ | nirodhāceṃ velhāvaṇeṃ | jhāḍāsi sājaṇeṃ | cāvaḻāveṃ gā|| 64||
verses.meaning: Just as a tree is adorned by its leaves, so too is the mind adorned by the restraint of the senses, which is like a bed for the soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शीत वेढावें। उष्ण पांघुरावें। वृष्टीचिया असावें । घराआंतु ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: śīta veḍhāveṃ| uṣṇa pāṃghurāveṃ| vṛṣṭīciyā asāveṃ | gharāāṃtu || 65||
verses.meaning: One should wrap themselves in cold, cover themselves with warmth, and remain inside the house during rain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना पांडवा । हा अग्निप्रवेशु नीच नवा । भातारेंबीण करावा। तो हा योगु॥६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā pāṃḍavā | hā agnipraveśu nīca navā | bhātāreṃbīṇa karāvā| to hā yogu||66||
verses.meaning: Indeed, Pandava, this is like entering fire, a new and unique path. It is a spiritual union to be achieved without a physical husband.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ स्वामीचें काज। ना बापिकें व्याज। परी मरणेंसीं झुंज। नीच नबें॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha svāmīceṃ kāja| nā bāpikeṃ vyāja| parī maraṇeṃsīṃ jhuṃja| nīca nabeṃ|| 67||
verses.meaning: Here, it is not for the master's work, nor for the father's interest, but a constant struggle with death that never ceases.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें मृत्यूहूनि तीख। कां घोंटे कढत विख। डोंगर गिळितां मुख। न फाटे काई॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ mṛtyūhūni tīkha| kāṃ ghoṃṭe kaḍhata vikha| ḍoṃgara giḻitāṃ mukha| na phāṭe kāī|| 68||
verses.meaning: Is death more bitter than this? Or is it like swallowing boiling poison? Does one's mouth not tear when swallowing a mountain?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि योगाचियां वाटा। जे निगाले गा सुभटा। तयां दुःखाचाचि शेलवांटा। भागा आला ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yogāciyāṃ vāṭā| je nigāle gā subhaṭā| tayāṃ duḥkhācāci śelavāṃṭā| bhāgā ālā || 69||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O brave one, those who set out on the path of Yoga, their lot is only a share of sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां लोहाचे चणे। जें बोचरिया पडती खाणें। तैं पोट भरणें कीं प्राणें। शुद्धी म्हणों ॥ ७० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ lohāce caṇe| jeṃ bocariyā paḍatī khāṇeṃ| taiṃ poṭa bharaṇeṃ kīṃ prāṇeṃ| śuddhī mhaṇoṃ || 70 ||
verses.meaning: Consider, for instance, the eating of iron chickpeas. When one has to eat such sharp, hard things, is it truly filling the stomach, or is it rather a matter of losing one's very life?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि समुद्र बाहीं । तरणें आधि केंही। कां गगनामाजीं पाई । खोलिजतु असे॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni samudra bāhīṃ | taraṇeṃ ādhi keṃhī| kāṃ gaganāmājīṃ pāī | kholijatu ase|| 71||
verses.meaning: Therefore, can one cross the ocean by swimming with one's arms? Or can one walk through the sky with one's feet?

verses.shloka_devanagari: वळघलिया रणाची थाटी। आंगीं न लागतां काठी । सूर्याची पाउटी। कां होय गा॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: vaḻaghaliyā raṇācī thāṭī| āṃgīṃ na lāgatāṃ kāṭhī | sūryācī pāuṭī| kāṃ hoya gā|| 72||
verses.meaning: When the sun rises, its light spreads everywhere, but it remains untouched by the dust and dirt of the earth. Similarly, a true yogi remains detached from worldly affairs even while being active in them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं पांगुळा हेवा । नव्हे वायूसि पांडवा । तेवीं देहवंतां जीवां । अव्यक्‍तीं गति॥ ७३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ pāṃguḻā hevā | navhe vāyūsi pāṃḍavā | tevīṃ dehavaṃtāṃ jīvāṃ | avyak‍tīṃ gati|| 73 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Pandava, just as a lame person cannot envy the wind, so too embodied beings cannot attain the unmanifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसाही जरी धिंबसा । बांधोनियां आकाशा । झोंबती तरी क्लेशा। पात्र होती॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisāhī jarī dhiṃbasā | bāṃdhoniyāṃ ākāśā | jhoṃbatī tarī kleśā| pātra hotī|| 74||
verses.meaning: Even if one were to tie a rope around the sky and try to climb it, they would still only encounter suffering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि येर ते पार्था । नेणतीचि हे व्यथा। जे कां भक्तिपंथा। बोटंगळे॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yera te pārthā | neṇatīci he vyathā| je kāṃ bhaktipaṃthā| boṭaṃgaḻe|| 75 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Partha, those who are devoted to the path of devotion do not experience this suffering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्मेद्रियें सुखें। करिती कर्मे अशेखें। जियें कां वर्णविशेखें । भागा आलीं ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: karmedriyeṃ sukheṃ| karitī karme aśekheṃ| jiyeṃ kāṃ varṇaviśekheṃ | bhāgā ālīṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: The organs of action, with ease, perform all their respective duties, which are allotted to them according to their specific functions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विधीतें पाळित। निषेधातें गाळित । मज देऊनि जाळित। कर्मफळें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vidhīteṃ pāḻita| niṣedhāteṃ gāḻita | maja deūni jāḻita| karmaphaḻeṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: By observing the prescribed actions and discarding the prohibited ones, and by offering the fruits of all actions to Me, one burns away all karma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ययापरी पाहीं। अर्जुना माझे ठाई । संन्यासूनि नाहीं। करिती कर्मे ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayāparī pāhīṃ| arjunā mājhe ṭhāī | saṃnyāsūni nāhīṃ| karitī karme || 78||
verses.meaning: In this manner, Arjuna, they perform actions by renouncing them within Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणीकही जे जे सर्व। कायिक वाचिक मानसिक भाव। तयां मीवांचूनि धांव । आनोती नाहीं ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇīkahī je je sarva| kāyika vācika mānasika bhāva| tayāṃ mīvāṃcūni dhāṃva | ānotī nāhīṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: And whatever else there is, whether physical, verbal, or mental actions, they have no refuge or support other than Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे जे मत्पर। उपासिती निरंतर । ध्यानमिषें घर । माझें झाळें॥ ८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise je matpara| upāsitī niraṃtara | dhyānamiṣeṃ ghara | mājheṃ jhāḻeṃ|| 80||
verses.meaning: Those who are devoted to Me in this way, who constantly worship Me, through the pretense of meditation, have made My abode their own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचिये आवडी । केली मजशीं कुळवाडी । भोग मोक्ष बापुडीं। त्यजिलीं कुळें॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃciye āvaḍī | kelī majaśīṃ kuḻavāḍī | bhoga mokṣa bāpuḍīṃ| tyajilīṃ kuḻeṃ|| 81||
verses.meaning: For their love, I made myself a servant, abandoning the paltry pleasures and liberation, along with my lineage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें अनन्ययोगें। विकले जीवें मनें आंगें। तयांचें कायि एक सांगें। जें सर्व मी करीं ॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ ananyayogeṃ| vikale jīveṃ maneṃ āṃgeṃ| tayāṃceṃ kāyi eka sāṃgeṃ| jeṃ sarva mī karīṃ ||82||
verses.meaning: Thus, those who are devoted to me with their very life, mind, and body, what can I say about them? I do everything for them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना धनुर्धरा। जो मातेचिया ये उदरा। तो मातेचा सोयरा । केतुला पां॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā dhanurdharā| jo māteciyā ye udarā| to mātecā soyarā | ketulā pāṃ||83||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Arjuna, how much more closely related is one who is born from the mother's womb to that very mother?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं मी तयां। जैसे असती तैसियां। कळिकाळ नोकोनियां। घेतला पट्टा॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ mī tayāṃ| jaise asatī taisiyāṃ| kaḻikāḻa nokoniyāṃ| ghetalā paṭṭā|| 84||
verses.meaning: In the same way, I have taken a vow to protect those who are devoted to me, just as they are, from the clutches of time and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं तरी माझिया भक्तां। आणि संसाराची चिंता । 'काय समर्थाची कांता। कोरान्न मागे॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ tarī mājhiyā bhaktāṃ| āṇi saṃsārācī ciṃtā | 'kāya samarthācī kāṃtā| korānna māge|| 85||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, my devotees would worry about worldly affairs, thinking, 'How can the wife of an all-powerful Lord beg for food?'

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे ते माझें। कल्त्र हें जाणिजे। कायिसेनिही न ल्जें । तयांचेनि मी ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise te mājheṃ| kaltra heṃ jāṇije| kāyisenihī na ljeṃ | tayāṃceni mī || 86||
verses.meaning: Know that they are My very own, and I am not ashamed of them in any way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जन्ममृत्यूचिया लाटीं । झळंबती इया सृष्टी । तें देखोनियां पोटीं । ऐसें जाहलें॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: janmamṛtyūciyā lāṭīṃ | jhaḻaṃbatī iyā sṛṣṭī | teṃ dekhoniyāṃ poṭīṃ | aiseṃ jāhaleṃ|| 87||
verses.meaning: The waves of birth and death toss this creation. Seeing this, such a thought arose in my heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भवसिंधूचेनि माजें। कवणासि धाकु नुपजे। तेथ जरी कीं माझे। ब्िहिती हन॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhavasiṃdhūceni mājeṃ| kavaṇāsi dhāku nupaje| tetha jarī kīṃ mājhe| bihitī hana|| 88||
verses.meaning: Who would not be afraid of the vast ocean of worldly existence? Even if it were mine, I would still be afraid.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गा पांडवा । मूर्तीचा मेळावा। करूनि त्यांचिया गांवा । धांबतु आलों ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gā pāṃḍavā | mūrtīcā meḻāvā| karūni tyāṃciyā gāṃvā | dhāṃbatu āloṃ || 89||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Pandava, having gathered the forms, I have come running to their village.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नामाचिया सहस्त्रवरी। नावा इया अवधारीं। सजूनियां संसारीं । तारू जाहलो ॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāmāciyā sahastravarī| nāvā iyā avadhārīṃ| sajūniyāṃ saṃsārīṃ | tārū jāhalo || 90||
verses.meaning: By the thousand names of the Lord, I have become a boat in this world, ready to carry souls across.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सडे जे देखिले। ते ध्यानकासे लाविले । परिग्रहीं घातळे। तरियावरी ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: saḍe je dekhile| te dhyānakāse lāvile | parigrahīṃ ghātaḻe| tariyāvarī || 91||
verses.meaning: What was seen as solitary, how was it brought into meditation? It was placed in the household, upon the river.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रेमाची पेटी । बांधळी एकाचिया पोटीं । मग आणिले तटीं। सायुज्याचिया॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: premācī peṭī | bāṃdhaḻī ekāciyā poṭīṃ | maga āṇile taṭīṃ| sāyujyāciyā|| 92||
verses.meaning: The casket of love, bound within the heart of one, then brought to the shore of ultimate union.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि भव्तांचेनि नांवें । चतुष्पदादि आघवे । वैकुंठीचिये राणिवे। योग्य केळे॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari bhavtāṃceni nāṃveṃ | catuṣpadādi āghave | vaikuṃṭhīciye rāṇive| yogya keḻe|| 93||
verses.meaning: But by the mere utterance of the devotees' names, all beings, even the four-footed animals, became worthy of the kingdom of Vaikuntha.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गा भक्तां । नाहीं एकही चिंता । तयांतें समुद्धर्ता। आधि मी सदा॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gā bhaktāṃ | nāhīṃ ekahī ciṃtā | tayāṃteṃ samuddhartā| ādhi mī sadā|| 94||
verses.meaning: Therefore, devotees have no worries at all. I am always the first to uplift them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जेव्हांचि कां भक्‍तीं। दिधली आपुली चित्तवृत्ती । तेव्हांचि मज सूति। त्यांचिये नाटीं ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jevhāṃci kāṃ bhak‍tīṃ| didhalī āpulī cittavṛttī | tevhāṃci maja sūti| tyāṃciye nāṭīṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: And when devotees surrender their minds to Me, from that very moment, I am born into their lives.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २६० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी याकारणें गा भक्‍तराया। हा मंत्र तुवां धनंजया । शिकिजे जैं यया । मार्गा भजिजे॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: 260 śrījñāneśvarī yākāraṇeṃ gā bhak‍tarāyā| hā maṃtra tuvāṃ dhanaṃjayā | śikije jaiṃ yayā | mārgā bhajije|| 96||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O King of Devotees, Dhananjaya, you must learn this mantra. When this path is followed, it is worshipped.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा मानस हें एक। माझ्या स्वरूपी वृत्तिक। करूनि घालीं निष्टंक । बुद्धि निशचयेंसीं ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā mānasa heṃ eka| mājhyā svarūpī vṛttika| karūni ghālīṃ niṣṭaṃka | buddhi niśacayeṃsīṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: O mind, fix your thoughts on My true nature, and with unwavering intellect, firmly establish your conviction there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें दोनीं सरिसीं । मजमाजीं प्रेमेंसीं । रिगालीं तरी पावसी । मातें तूं गा॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ donīṃ sarisīṃ | majamājīṃ premeṃsīṃ | rigālīṃ tarī pāvasī | māteṃ tūṃ gā|| 98||
verses.meaning: If these two, with love, enter into Me, then you will attain Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे मन बुद्धि इहीं। घर केलें माझ्या ठायीं । तरी सांगे मज काई। मी तूं ऐसें उरे॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je mana buddhi ihīṃ| ghara keleṃ mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ | tarī sāṃge maja kāī| mī tūṃ aiseṃ ure|| 99||
verses.meaning: If the mind and intellect make their home in Me, then tell me, what remains of 'I' and 'you'?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि दीप पालवे । सवेंचि तेज मालवे । कां रविबिंबासवें। प्रकाशु जाय ॥ १००॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni dīpa pālave | saveṃci teja mālave | kāṃ ravibiṃbāsaveṃ| prakāśu jāya || 100||
verses.meaning: Therefore, when a lamp is extinguished, its light immediately fades away. Or, when the sun's orb sets, its radiance departs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उचललेया प्राणासरिसीं । इंद्रियेंही निगती जैसीं । तैसा मनोबुद्धिपाशीं। अहंकारु ये॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: ucalaleyā prāṇāsarisīṃ | iṃdriyeṃhī nigatī jaisīṃ | taisā manobuddhipāśīṃ| ahaṃkāru ye|| 1||
verses.meaning: Just as the senses depart along with the departing life-breath, so too does the ego follow the mind and intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि माझिया स्वरूपीं। मनबुग्यि इयें निक्षेपीं। येतुलेनि सर्वव्यापी। मीचि होसी॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mājhiyā svarūpīṃ| manabugyi iyeṃ nikṣepīṃ| yetuleni sarvavyāpī| mīci hosī|| 2||
verses.meaning: Therefore, immerse your mind and intellect into My true form. By doing so, you will become all-pervading, just like Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया बोला कांहीं । अनारिसें नाहीं । आपली आण पाहीं । वाहतु असें गा॥३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā bolā kāṃhīṃ | anāriseṃ nāhīṃ | āpalī āṇa pāhīṃ | vāhatu aseṃ gā||3||
verses.meaning: By these words, there is nothing else. See, I swear by myself, I am telling you this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा हें चित्त। मनबुद्धिसहित। माझ्या हातीं अचुंबित। न शकसी देवो ॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā heṃ citta| manabuddhisahita| mājhyā hātīṃ acuṃbita| na śakasī devo ||4||
verses.meaning: Or, if you cannot offer this mind, along with the intellect and ego, untouched into My hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी गा ऐसें करीं। ययां आठां पाहारांमाझारीं। मोटकें निमिषभरी। देतु जाय ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī gā aiseṃ karīṃ| yayāṃ āṭhāṃ pāhārāṃmājhārīṃ| moṭakeṃ nimiṣabharī| detu jāya || 5||
verses.meaning: Therefore, please do this: within these eight watches of the day, grant me just a moment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग जें जें कां निमिख। देखेल माझें सुख। तेतुलें अरोचक । विषयीं घेईल॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga jeṃ jeṃ kāṃ nimikha| dekhela mājheṃ sukha| tetuleṃ arocaka | viṣayīṃ gheīla|| 6||
verses.meaning: Then, whatever little glimpse of My bliss one experiences, that much will make worldly pleasures distasteful.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा शरत्कालु रिगे। आणि सरिता बोहटूं लागे। तैसें चित्त काढेल वेगें । प्रपंचौनि॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā śaratkālu rige| āṇi saritā bohaṭūṃ lāge| taiseṃ citta kāḍhela vegeṃ | prapaṃcauni|| 7||
verses.meaning: Just as the autumn season arrives, and the rivers begin to recede, so too will the mind swiftly withdraw from worldly affairs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पुनवेहूनि जैसें। शशिबिंब दिसेंदिसें। हारपत अंवसे। नाहींचि होय॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga punavehūni jaiseṃ| śaśibiṃba diseṃdiseṃ| hārapata aṃvase| nāhīṃci hoya|| 8||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon's orb, after the full moon, diminishes day by day, until on the new moon it is no more.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें भोगाआंतूनि निगतां । चित्त मजमाजीं रिगतां। हळू हळू पंडुसुता । मीचि होईलळ।॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ bhogāāṃtūni nigatāṃ | citta majamājīṃ rigatāṃ| haḻū haḻū paṃḍusutā | mīci hoīlaḻa||| 9||
verses.meaning: In the same way, as the mind withdraws from worldly enjoyments and enters into Me, O son of Pandu, it will gradually become one with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा अभ्यासयोगु म्हणिजे) तो हा एकु जाणिजे येणें कांहीं न निपजे। ऐसें नाहीं ॥ ११०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā abhyāsayogu mhaṇije) to hā eku jāṇije yeṇeṃ kāṃhīṃ na nipaje| aiseṃ nāhīṃ || 110||
verses.meaning: This is called the yoga of practice; know that there is nothing that cannot be achieved through it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं अभ्यासाचेनि बळें। एकां गति अंतराळें। व्याघ्र सर्प प्रांजळें। केलें एकीं॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ abhyāsāceni baḻeṃ| ekāṃ gati aṃtarāḻeṃ| vyāghra sarpa prāṃjaḻeṃ| keleṃ ekīṃ|| 11||
verses.meaning: By the power of practice, some have attained the state of being in the void, while others have made tigers and snakes gentle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विष कों आहारीं पडे। समुद्री पायवाट जोडे । 'एकीं वाग्ब्रह्म थोकडें। अभ्यासें केलें॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: viṣa koṃ āhārīṃ paḍe| samudrī pāyavāṭa joḍe | 'ekīṃ vāgbrahma thokaḍeṃ| abhyāseṃ keleṃ|| 12||
verses.meaning: Poison becomes food, a path appears in the ocean; thus, through practice, some have made even the vast 'Vagbrahma' (the ultimate reality of speech/knowledge) their own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अभ्यासासी कांहीं । सर्वथा दुष्कर नाहीं। यालागीं माझ्या ठायीं। अभ्यासें मीळ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni abhyāsāsī kāṃhīṃ | sarvathā duṣkara nāhīṃ| yālāgīṃ mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ| abhyāseṃ mīḻa|| 13||
verses.meaning: Therefore, nothing is truly difficult for spiritual practice. For this reason, through practice, unite with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां अभ्यासाही लागीं। कसु नाहीं तुझिया अंगीं । तरी आहासी जया भागीं। तैसाचि आस ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ abhyāsāhī lāgīṃ| kasu nāhīṃ tujhiyā aṃgīṃ | tarī āhāsī jayā bhāgīṃ| taisāci āsa || 94||
verses.meaning: Or, if you lack the capacity for spiritual practice, then remain as you are, in whatever state you find yourself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियें न कोंडीं। भोगातें न तोडीं। अभिमानु न संडीं। स्वजातीचा ॥ ९१५॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyeṃ na koṃḍīṃ| bhogāteṃ na toḍīṃ| abhimānu na saṃḍīṃ| svajātīcā || 915||
verses.meaning: One does not suppress the senses, nor does one renounce worldly pleasures, nor does one abandon the pride of their own nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुळधर्मु चाळीं। विधिनिषेध पाळीं । मग सुखें तुज सरळी । दिधली आहे॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuḻadharmu cāḻīṃ| vidhiniṣedha pāḻīṃ | maga sukheṃ tuja saraḻī | didhalī āhe|| 16||
verses.meaning: Follow the traditions of your family and lineage, observe the prescribed rituals and prohibitions. Then, with ease, the path to spiritual progress is opened for you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि मनें वाचा देहें। जैसा जो व्यापारु होये। तो मी करीतु आहें। ऐसें न म्हणें॥ १९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari maneṃ vācā deheṃ| jaisā jo vyāpāru hoye| to mī karītu āheṃ| aiseṃ na mhaṇeṃ|| 197||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever actions are performed by the mind, speech, or body, one should not say, "I am doing this."

verses.shloka_devanagari: करणें कां न करणें । हें आधघवबें तोचि जाणे । विश्‍व चळतसे जेणें । परमात्मेनि॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: karaṇeṃ kāṃ na karaṇeṃ | heṃ ādhaghavabeṃ toci jāṇe | viś‍va caḻatase jeṇeṃ | paramātmeni|| 18||
verses.meaning: To act or not to act, this is known only by that through which the universe moves, the Supreme Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उणयापुरेयाचें कांहीं॥ उरों नेदी आपुलिया ठायीं। स्वजाती करूनि घेई । जीवित्व आपुलें ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: uṇayāpureyāceṃ kāṃhīṃ|| uroṃ nedī āpuliyā ṭhāyīṃ| svajātī karūni gheī | jīvitva āpuleṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: It does not allow any deficiency or excess to remain within itself. It assimilates everything into its own nature, making it its very life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माळियें जेउतें नेलें। तेउतें निवांतचि गेळें। तया पाणिया ऐसें केलें। होआवें गा॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: māḻiyeṃ jeuteṃ neleṃ| teuteṃ nivāṃtaci geḻeṃ| tayā pāṇiyā aiseṃ keleṃ| hoāveṃ gā|| 120||
verses.meaning: Just as water, when led by a gardener, flows calmly and obediently wherever it is directed, so too should one's mind become.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि प्रवृत्ति आणि निवृत्ती । इयें बोझीं नेघें मती । अखंड चित्तवृत्ती । माझ्या ठायीं ॥ २१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni pravṛtti āṇi nivṛttī | iyeṃ bojhīṃ negheṃ matī | akhaṃḍa cittavṛttī | mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ || 219||
verses.meaning: Therefore, do not burden your intellect with engagement or disengagement. Let your mind's inclination be continuously fixed on Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी सुभटा । उजू कां अव्हांटा । रथु काई खटपटा। करीतु असे॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī subhaṭā | ujū kāṃ avhāṃṭā | rathu kāī khaṭapaṭā| karītu ase|| 22||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, O brave one, why would the chariot struggle, whether on a straight path or a difficult one?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जें जें कर्म निपजे। तें थोडें बहु न म्हणिजे । निवांतचि अर्पिजे। माझ्या ठायीं ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jeṃ jeṃ karma nipaje| teṃ thoḍeṃ bahu na mhaṇije | nivāṃtaci arpije| mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: And whatever action is performed, whether small or great, should be offered to Me with a tranquil mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया मदभावना । तनुत्यागीं अर्जुना । तूं सायुज्यसदना। माझिया येसी॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā madabhāvanā | tanutyāgīṃ arjunā | tūṃ sāyujyasadanā| mājhiyā yesī|| 24||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, if you have such a feeling of devotion towards Me, then upon leaving your body, you will come to My abode of oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना तरी हेंही तुज । नेदवे कर्म मज। तरी तूं गा बुझ ( भज ) । पंडुकुमरा ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā tarī heṃhī tuja | nedave karma maja| tarī tūṃ gā bujha ( bhaja ) | paṃḍukumarā || 25||
verses.meaning: If even this (the path of knowledge) is not possible for you, then O Arjuna, just worship Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुद्धीचिये पाठीं पोटीं । कर्माआदि कां शेवटीं । मातें बांधणें किरीटी । दुवाड जरी॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: buddhīciye pāṭhīṃ poṭīṃ | karmāādi kāṃ śevaṭīṃ | māteṃ bāṃdhaṇeṃ kirīṭī | duvāḍa jarī|| 26||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), it is indeed difficult to bind Me, whether before or after actions, or within the intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि हेंही असो। सांडीं माझा अतिसो। परि संयतिसीं वसो । बुद्धि तुझी ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari heṃhī aso| sāṃḍīṃ mājhā atiso| pari saṃyatisīṃ vaso | buddhi tujhī || 27||
verses.meaning: Let this also be. Leave my excessiveness. But let your intellect dwell in self-restraint.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जेणें जेणें वेळें। घडती कर्मे सकळें। तयांचीं तियें फळें। त्यजितु जाय ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jeṇeṃ jeṇeṃ veḻeṃ| ghaḍatī karme sakaḻeṃ| tayāṃcīṃ tiyeṃ phaḻeṃ| tyajitu jāya || 28||
verses.meaning: And whatever actions are performed at any time, one should renounce the fruits of those actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वृक्ष कां वेली। लोटती फळें आलीं। तैसीं सांडीं निपजली । कर्मे सिद्धें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vṛkṣa kāṃ velī| loṭatī phaḻeṃ ālīṃ| taisīṃ sāṃḍīṃ nipajalī | karme siddheṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Just as trees or vines bear abundant fruits, so too do actions, when perfected, yield their results.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि मातें मनीं धरावें । कां मजउड्देशें करावें। हें कांहीं नको आधवें। जाऊं दे शून्यीं॥ ९३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari māteṃ manīṃ dharāveṃ | kāṃ majauḍdeśeṃ karāveṃ| heṃ kāṃhīṃ nako ādhaveṃ| jāūṃ de śūnyīṃ|| 930||
verses.meaning: Therefore, do not hold Me in your mind, nor perform actions with Me as your sole intention. Let go of all such thoughts and let them dissolve into nothingness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: खडकोीं जेसें वर्षळें। कां आगीमाजीं पेरिलें। कर्म मानीं देखिलें। स्वप्न जैसें॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: khaḍakoīṃ jeseṃ varṣaḻeṃ| kāṃ āgīmājīṃ perileṃ| karma mānīṃ dekhileṃ| svapna jaiseṃ|| 31||
verses.meaning: Actions performed by one who is not established in the Self are like seeds sown on a rock or in fire; they are as unreal as a dream.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा आत्मजेच्या विषीं। जिवु जैसा निरभिलाषी। तैसा कर्मी अशोषीं। निष्कामु होई ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā ātmajecyā viṣīṃ| jivu jaisā nirabhilāṣī| taisā karmī aśoṣīṃ| niṣkāmu hoī || 32||
verses.meaning: Just as a father's love for his child is selfless, so too should you perform actions without attachment to their results.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वन्हीची ज्वाळा जैसी । वायां जाय आकाशीं । क्रिया जिरों दे तैसी । शून्यामाजीं ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vanhīcī jvāḻā jaisī | vāyāṃ jāya ākāśīṃ | kriyā jiroṃ de taisī | śūnyāmājīṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Just as a flame's light dissipates into the sky, so too let actions dissolve into the void.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना हा फलत्यागु। आवडे कौर २६२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी असलगु । परी योगामाजीं योगु। धुरेचा हा ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā hā phalatyāgu| āvaḍe kaura 262 śrījñāneśvarī asalagu | parī yogāmājīṃ yogu| dhurecā hā || 34||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, this renunciation of the fruits of action is indeed pleasing to Me, and it is the foremost among all yogas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें फलत्यागें सांडे । तें तें कर्म न विरूढे। एकचि वेळे वेळु झाडें । वांझें जैसीं ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ phalatyāgeṃ sāṃḍe | teṃ teṃ karma na virūḍhe| ekaci veḻe veḻu jhāḍeṃ | vāṃjheṃ jaisīṃ || 35 ||
verses.meaning: By this renunciation of the fruits of action, all actions cease to sprout again, just like trees that become barren all at once.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें येणेंचि शरीरें। शरीरा येणें सरे। किंबहुना येरझारें। चिरा पडे ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ yeṇeṃci śarīreṃ| śarīrā yeṇeṃ sare| kiṃbahunā yerajhāreṃ| cirā paḍe || 36||
verses.meaning: In the same way, through this very body, the cycle of birth and death for the body ends. In short, the coming and going ceases.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं अभ्यासाचिया पाउटीं । ठाकिजे ज्ञान किरीटी । ज्ञानें येइजे भेटी । ध्यानाचिये ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ abhyāsāciyā pāuṭīṃ | ṭhākije jñāna kirīṭī | jñāneṃ yeije bheṭī | dhyānāciye || 37||
verses.meaning: Through the steps of spiritual practice, O Kiriti (Arjuna), one attains knowledge; and through knowledge, one meets with meditation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग ध्यानासि खेंव । देती आघवेचि भाव । तेव्हां कर्मजात सर्व । दूरी ठाके ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga dhyānāsi kheṃva | detī āghaveci bhāva | tevhāṃ karmajāta sarva | dūrī ṭhāke || 38||
verses.meaning: Then all thoughts embrace meditation, and at that time, all actions cease.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्म जेथ दुरावे। तेथ फलत्यागु संभवे । त्यागास्तब आंगवे। शांति सगळी ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: karma jetha durāve| tetha phalatyāgu saṃbhave | tyāgāstaba āṃgave| śāṃti sagaḻī || 39||
verses.meaning: Where action is renounced, there the relinquishment of its fruits becomes possible. Through such renunciation, complete peace is attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि यावया शांति। हाचि अनुक्रमु सुभद्रापती । म्हणौनि अभ्यासुचि प्रस्तुतीं। करणें एथ॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yāvayā śāṃti| hāci anukramu subhadrāpatī | mhaṇauni abhyāsuci prastutīṃ| karaṇeṃ etha|| 140||
verses.meaning: Therefore, to attain peace, this is the sequence, O husband of Subhadra. Therefore, practice is indeed the present need here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अभ्यासाहूनि गहन । पार्था मग ज्ञान । ज्ञानापासोनि ध्यान । विशेषिजे॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: abhyāsāhūni gahana | pārthā maga jñāna | jñānāpāsoni dhyāna | viśeṣije|| 41||
verses.meaning: O Partha, knowledge is profounder than practice, and meditation is superior to knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग कर्मफलत्यागु) तो ध्यानापासोनि चांगु। त्यागाहूनि भोगु। शांतिसुखाचा ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga karmaphalatyāgu) to dhyānāpāsoni cāṃgu| tyāgāhūni bhogu| śāṃtisukhācā || 42||
verses.meaning: Renunciation of the fruits of action is superior to meditation. And superior to that renunciation is the enjoyment of the bliss of peace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया या वाटा। इहींचि पेणा सुभटा । शांतीचा माजिवटा। ठाकिला जेणें॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā yā vāṭā| ihīṃci peṇā subhaṭā | śāṃtīcā mājivaṭā| ṭhākilā jeṇeṃ|| 43||
verses.meaning: By these very paths, O good warrior, the abode of peace is attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो सर्व भूतांच्या ठायीं । द्वेषातें नेणेंचि कहीं । आपपरु नाहीं । चैतन्या जैसा॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo sarva bhūtāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ | dveṣāteṃ neṇeṃci kahīṃ | āpaparu nāhīṃ | caitanyā jaisā|| 44||
verses.meaning: Just as consciousness makes no distinction between self and other, and never knows hatred towards any being, so too is the true devotee.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उत्तमातें धरिजे। अधमातें अव्हेरिजे। हें कांहींचि नेणिजे। वसुधा जेवीं ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: uttamāteṃ dharije| adhamāteṃ avherije| heṃ kāṃhīṃci neṇije| vasudhā jevīṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: Just as the earth does not discriminate, neither holding onto the good nor rejecting the bad, so too should one be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां रायाचें देह चाळूं । रंका परौतें गाळूं। हें न म्हणेचि कृपाळू । प्राणु पैं गा॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ rāyāceṃ deha cāḻūṃ | raṃkā parauteṃ gāḻūṃ| heṃ na mhaṇeci kṛpāḻū | prāṇu paiṃ gā|| 46||
verses.meaning: For the compassionate life-force does not discriminate, saying, "I will animate the king's body, and discard that of a pauper."

verses.shloka_devanagari: गाईची तृषा हरूं। कां व्याप्रा विष होऊनि मारूं । ऐसें नेणेंचि गा करूं। तोय जैसें॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: gāīcī tṛṣā harūṃ| kāṃ vyāprā viṣa hoūni mārūṃ | aiseṃ neṇeṃci gā karūṃ| toya jaiseṃ|| 47||
verses.meaning: Just as water does not know how to quench the thirst of a cow or to become poison and kill a tiger, so too is the nature of the divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी आघवियांचि भूतमात्रीं । एकपणें जया मैत्री । कृपेसी धात्री। आपणचि जो॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī āghaviyāṃci bhūtamātrīṃ | ekapaṇeṃ jayā maitrī | kṛpesī dhātrī| āpaṇaci jo|| 48 ||
verses.meaning: Just as he, who inherently possesses a friendship with all beings, is himself the very source and sustainer of compassion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मी हे भाष नेणे। माझें कांहींचि न म्हणे। सुखदुःख जाणणें। नाहीं जया ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mī he bhāṣa neṇe| mājheṃ kāṃhīṃci na mhaṇe| sukhaduḥkha jāṇaṇeṃ| nāhīṃ jayā || 49||
verses.meaning: And I do not know this language; I do not claim anything as mine. For that which knows neither joy nor sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि क्षमेलागीं। पृथ्वीसि पवाडु आंगीं। संतोषा उत्संगीं। दिधलें घर॥ १५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci kṣamelāgīṃ| pṛthvīsi pavāḍu āṃgīṃ| saṃtoṣā utsaṃgīṃ| didhaleṃ ghara|| 150||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the earth has taken forgiveness into its very being, and contentment has been given a home in its lap.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वार्षियेबीण सागरु । जैसा जळें नित्य निर्भरु । तैसा निरुपचारु । संतोषी जो॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: vārṣiyebīṇa sāgaru | jaisā jaḻeṃ nitya nirbharu | taisā nirupacāru | saṃtoṣī jo|| 51||
verses.meaning: Just as the ocean is always full of water without the need for rain, so too is the one who is content without external causes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जीवु परमात्मा दोन्ही। बैसऊनि ऐक्यासनीं। जयाचिया हृदयभुवनीं । विराजती ॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jīvu paramātmā donhī| baisaūni aikyāsanīṃ| jayāciyā hṛdayabhuvanīṃ | virājatī ||53||
verses.meaning: In whose heart-temple, the individual soul and the Supreme Soul are seated together on the throne of oneness, shining forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा योगसमृन्दि। होऊनि जो निरवधि। अर्पी मनोबुद्धी। माझ्या ठायीं ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā yogasamṛndi| hoūni jo niravadhi| arpī manobuddhī| mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: Having attained such a state of yoga, one who is constantly absorbed, offers their mind and intellect to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंतु बाहेरि योगु। निर्वाळलेयाहि चांगु। तरि माझा अनुरागु। सप्रेम जया॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃtu bāheri yogu| nirvāḻaleyāhi cāṃgu| tari mājhā anurāgu| saprema jayā|| 55||
verses.meaning: Even if one achieves union (yoga) within and without, and becomes pure, if their love for Me is not filled with devotion, then it is not truly good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना गा तो भक्तु। तोचि योगी तोचि मुक्तु। तो वल्लभा मी कांतु। ऐसा पढिये॥५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā gā to bhaktu| toci yogī toci muktu| to vallabhā mī kāṃtu| aisā paḍhiye||56||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, that devotee is indeed the true yogi, the truly liberated one. I consider him my beloved, my very own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें ना तो आवडे । मज जीवाचेनि पाडें। हेंही एथ थोकडें। रूप करणें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ nā to āvaḍe | maja jīvāceni pāḍeṃ| heṃhī etha thokaḍeṃ| rūpa karaṇeṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: Indeed, this is not merely as dear to me as my own life; even that comparison falls short in describing its true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी 'पढियंतयाची काहाणी। हे भुलीची भारणी । इयें तंव न बोलणीं। परी बोलवी श्रद्धा ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī 'paḍhiyaṃtayācī kāhāṇī| he bhulīcī bhāraṇī | iyeṃ taṃva na bolaṇīṃ| parī bolavī śraddhā || 58||
verses.meaning: Indeed, this is a tale for the learned, a burden of forgetfulness. These words are not to be spoken, yet faith compels them to be uttered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गा आम्हां । वेगां आळी उपमा । एऱ्हवीं काय प्रेमा । अनुवादु असे॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gā āmhāṃ | vegāṃ āḻī upamā | eṟhavīṃ kāya premā | anuvādu ase|| 59||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for us, analogies and comparisons are quickly drawn. Otherwise, what is the purpose of expressing love?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां असो हें किरीटी। पैं प्रियाचिया गोष्टी । दुणा थांब उठी। आवडी गा॥ १६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ aso heṃ kirīṭī| paiṃ priyāciyā goṣṭī | duṇā thāṃba uṭhī| āvaḍī gā|| 160||
verses.meaning: Now, let this be, O Kiriti (Arjuna)! For the beloved's words, the eagerness rises twofold, so stop and stand up with great love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाही वरी विपायें। प्रेमळु संबादिया होये। तिये गोडीसी आहे। कांटाळें मग॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāhī varī vipāyeṃ| premaḻu saṃbādiyā hoye| tiye goḍīsī āhe| kāṃṭāḻeṃ maga|| 61||
verses.meaning: Even if there is some bitterness, if the conversation is loving, then that sweetness becomes tiresome.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गा पंडुसुता। तूंचि प्रियु आणि तूंचि श्रोता। वरी प्रियाची वार्ता । प्रसंगें आली ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gā paṃḍusutā| tūṃci priyu āṇi tūṃci śrotā| varī priyācī vārtā | prasaṃgeṃ ālī || 62||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O son of Pandu, you are both the beloved and the listener. Moreover, the discourse of the beloved has arisen incidentally.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आतां बोलो । भलें या सुखा मीनलो । ऐसें म्हणतखेंबीं डोलो । लागला देवो॥ ६३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātāṃ bolo | bhaleṃ yā sukhā mīnalo | aiseṃ mhaṇatakheṃbīṃ ḍolo | lāgalā devo|| 63 ||
verses.meaning: Then, as soon as he said, "Now I shall speak, I have indeed attained this bliss," the Lord began to sway.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणे जाण। तया भक्ताचे लक्षण। जया मी अंतःकरण बैसों घालीं ॥६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇe jāṇa| tayā bhaktāce lakṣaṇa| jayā mī aṃtaḥkaraṇa baisoṃ ghālīṃ ||64||
verses.meaning: Then, I will describe the characteristics of that devotee in whose heart I reside.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सिंधूचेनि माजें। जळचरां भय नुपजे। आणि जळचरीं नुबगिजे। समुद्रु जैसा ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī siṃdhūceni mājeṃ| jaḻacarāṃ bhaya nupaje| āṇi jaḻacarīṃ nubagije| samudru jaisā || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the creatures of the sea are not afraid of the ocean's vastness, nor does the ocean feel aversion towards its creatures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं उन्मत्तें जगें। जयासी खंती न लगे। आणि जयाचेनि आंगें। न शिणे लोकु ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ unmatteṃ jageṃ| jayāsī khaṃtī na lage| āṇi jayāceni āṃgeṃ| na śiṇe loku || 66||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the intoxicated world, which feels no remorse, and by whose actions people are not troubled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना पांडवा । शरीर जेसें अवयबां। तैसा नुबगे जीवां। जीवपणें जो॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā pāṃḍavā | śarīra jeseṃ avayabāṃ| taisā nubage jīvāṃ| jīvapaṇeṃ jo|| 67||
verses.meaning: Indeed, Pandava, just as the body is to its limbs, so is the Self to all beings, by virtue of its very being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जगचि देह जाहलळें। म्हणोनि प्रियाप्रिय गेलें। हर्षामर्ष ठेळे। दुजेनविण ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jagaci deha jāhalaḻeṃ| mhaṇoni priyāpriya geleṃ| harṣāmarṣa ṭheḻe| dujenaviṇa || 68 ||
verses.meaning: The entire world has become my body; therefore, likes and dislikes have vanished. Joy and sorrow have ceased, as there is no otherness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा दवंद्रनिर्मुक्‍्तु। भयोद्ठेगरहितु। याहीवरी भक्‍तु। माझ्या ठायीं ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā davaṃdranirmuk‍tu| bhayodṭhegarahitu| yāhīvarī bhak‍tu| mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: Such a person, free from dualities, devoid of fear and anxiety, is devoted to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तयाचा गा मज मोहो । काय सांगों तो पढियावो। हें असो जीवें जीवो । माझेनि तो॥ १७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tayācā gā maja moho | kāya sāṃgoṃ to paḍhiyāvo| heṃ aso jīveṃ jīvo | mājheni to|| 170||
verses.meaning: But what can I say about my deep affection for him? How can I describe that belovedness? Let it be, he is my very life, through me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो निजानंदें धाला । परिणामु आयुष्या आला । पूर्णते जाहला । वबल्लभु जो॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo nijānaṃdeṃ dhālā | pariṇāmu āyuṣyā ālā | pūrṇate jāhalā | vaballabhu jo||71||
verses.meaning: One who is satiated with the bliss of the Self, whose life has reached its culmination, and who has attained perfect fulfillment, becomes the beloved of all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचिया ठायीं पांडवा। अपेक्षे नाहीं रिगावा। सुखासि चढावा । जयाचें असणें ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāciyā ṭhāyīṃ pāṃḍavā| apekṣe nāhīṃ rigāvā| sukhāsi caḍhāvā | jayāceṃ asaṇeṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, in whom there is no room for desire, whose very existence is an ascent to bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोक्ष देऊनि उदार। काशी होय कौर। परि वेंचावें लागे शरीर। तिये गांवीं ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mokṣa deūni udāra| kāśī hoya kaura| pari veṃcāveṃ lāge śarīra| tiye gāṃvīṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: Kashi (Varanasi) is generous in granting liberation, but one has to sacrifice the body in that city.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हिमवंतु दोष खाये। परि जीविताची हानि होये। तैसें शुचित्व नोहे । सज्जनाचें ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: himavaṃtu doṣa khāye| pari jīvitācī hāni hoye| taiseṃ śucitva nohe | sajjanāceṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Just as snow, though pure, can cause harm to life, such is not the purity of a saint.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शुचित्वें शुचि गांग होये । आणि 'पापतापही जाये । परी तेथें आहे । बुडणें एक ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: śucitveṃ śuci gāṃga hoye | āṇi 'pāpatāpahī jāye | parī tetheṃ āhe | buḍaṇeṃ eka || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Purity is attained by the purity of the Ganges, and sins and sorrows are washed away. But there is one immersion there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: खोलिये पारु नेणिजे। तरी भक्तीं न बुडिजे। रोकडाचि लाहिजे। न मरतां मोक्षु॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kholiye pāru neṇije| tarī bhaktīṃ na buḍije| rokaḍāci lāhije| na maratāṃ mokṣu|| 76||
verses.meaning: If the depth is not known, then one does not drown in devotion. One directly attains liberation without dying.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संताचेनि अंगलगें । पापातें जिणणें गंगें। तेणें संतसंगे । शुचित्वब कैसें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃtāceni aṃgalageṃ | pāpāteṃ jiṇaṇeṃ gaṃgeṃ| teṇeṃ saṃtasaṃge | śucitvaba kaiseṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: The Ganges purifies sins by merely touching the bodies of saints. How then can one describe the purity attained through the company of such saints?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि असो जो ऐसा। शुचित्बें तीर्था कुवासा । जेणें उल्लंघविलें दिशां। मनोमळ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aso jo aisā| śucitbeṃ tīrthā kuvāsā | jeṇeṃ ullaṃghavileṃ diśāṃ| manomaḻa|| 78||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let it be so, that one who is pure, like a sacred pilgrimage site, has transcended the defilements of the mind in all directions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंतु बाहेरी चोखाळु । सूर्य तैसा निर्मळु । आणि तत्त्वार्थींचा पायाळु। देखणा जो॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃtu bāherī cokhāḻu | sūrya taisā nirmaḻu | āṇi tattvārthīṃcā pāyāḻu| dekhaṇā jo|| 79||
verses.meaning: Pure within and without, like the sun, he is untainted; and he is the foundation of true principles, the seer of reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: व्यापक आणि उदास जैसें कां आकाश । तैसें जयाचें मानस। सर्वत्र गा॥ १८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vyāpaka āṇi udāsa jaiseṃ kāṃ ākāśa | taiseṃ jayāceṃ mānasa| sarvatra gā|| 180||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky is all-pervading and vast, so too is the mind of such a one, present everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संसारव्यथें फिटला । जो नैराश्यें बिनटला । व्याधाहातोनि सुटला । विहंगु जैसा ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃsāravyatheṃ phiṭalā | jo nairāśyeṃ binaṭalā | vyādhāhātoni suṭalā | vihaṃgu jaisā || 81||
verses.meaning: Like a bird that, having escaped the hunter's snare, is freed from the pain of worldly existence through detachment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सतत जो सुखें। कोणीही टवंच न देखे। नेणिजे गतायुषें। लज्जा जेवीं॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā satata jo sukheṃ| koṇīhī ṭavaṃca na dekhe| neṇije gatāyuṣeṃ| lajjā jevīṃ||82||
verses.meaning: Just as a person who is constantly happy does not see any fault in anyone, similarly, a person who has lived a full life does not feel shame.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि कर्मारेभालागीं। जया अहंकृती नाहीं आंगीं । जैसें निरिंधन आगी । विझोनि जाय॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi karmārebhālāgīṃ| jayā ahaṃkṛtī nāhīṃ āṃgīṃ | jaiseṃ niriṃdhana āgī | vijhoni jāya|| 83||
verses.meaning: And for the one who performs actions, yet has no ego attached to them, it is like a fire that, having consumed all its fuel, extinguishes itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा उपशमुचि भागा। जयासि आला पैं गा। जो मोक्षाचिया आंगा। लिहिला असे॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā upaśamuci bhāgā| jayāsi ālā paiṃ gā| jo mokṣāciyā āṃgā| lihilā ase||84||
verses.meaning: Similarly, one who has attained inner peace and is destined for liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना हा ठावोबरी। जो सो$हंभावो सरोभरी । द्वैताच्या पैलतीरीं । निगों सरला ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā hā ṭhāvobarī| jo so$haṃbhāvo sarobharī | dvaitācyā pailatīrīṃ | nigoṃ saralā || 85||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, the realization of 'I am That' (Soham) transcends duality, reaching the other shore beyond it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं भक्‍क्तिसुखालागीं। आपणपेंचि दोहीं भागीं। वांटूनिया आंगीं । सेवकै बाणे॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ bhak‍ktisukhālāgīṃ| āpaṇapeṃci dohīṃ bhāgīṃ| vāṃṭūniyā āṃgīṃ | sevakai bāṇe|| 86||
verses.meaning: Or, for the joy of devotion, the Lord Himself divides into two parts, taking on the role of a servant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरा नाम मी ठेवी। मग भजती बोज बरवी । न भजतया दावी । योगिया जो॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yerā nāma mī ṭhevī| maga bhajatī boja baravī | na bhajatayā dāvī | yogiyā jo|| 87||
verses.meaning: I give them a name, and then they worship me beautifully. To those who do not worship, I reveal myself as the Yogi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचें आम्हां व्यसन । आमुचें तो निजध्यान किंबहुना समाधान। तो मिळे तैं॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāceṃ āmhāṃ vyasana | āmuceṃ to nijadhyāna kiṃbahunā samādhāna| to miḻe taiṃ|| 88||
verses.meaning: We are addicted to Him; He is our true meditation, and indeed, our contentment. All this is attained when He is found.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयालागीं मज रूपा येणें। तयाचेनि मज येथें असणें। तया लोण कौजे जीवेंप्राणें। ऐसा पढिये॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayālāgīṃ maja rūpā yeṇeṃ| tayāceni maja yetheṃ asaṇeṃ| tayā loṇa kauje jīveṃprāṇeṃ| aisā paḍhiye|| 89||
verses.meaning: For their sake, I take on a form; through them, I exist here. They are so beloved to me that I cherish them with my very life and soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो आत्मलाभासारिखें। गोमटें कांहींचि न देखे । म्हणौनि भोगविशेखें। हरिखेजेना ॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo ātmalābhāsārikheṃ| gomaṭeṃ kāṃhīṃci na dekhe | mhaṇauni bhogaviśekheṃ| harikhejenā || 190||
verses.meaning: One who sees nothing as excellent as the realization of the Self, therefore does not rejoice in worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपणचि विश्‍व जाहला। तरी भेदभावो सहजचि गेला। म्हणौनि द्वेषु ठेला। जया पुरुषा॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpaṇaci viś‍va jāhalā| tarī bhedabhāvo sahajaci gelā| mhaṇauni dveṣu ṭhelā| jayā puruṣā||91||
verses.meaning: When one realizes that they themselves have become the universe, then all distinctions naturally disappear. Therefore, for such a person, all hatred ceases.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आपुलें जें साचें। ते कल्पांतींही न वचे। हें जाणोनि गताचें। न शोची जो॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āpuleṃ jeṃ sāceṃ| te kalpāṃtīṃhī na vace| heṃ jāṇoni gatāceṃ| na śocī jo||92||
verses.meaning: That which is truly one's own, even at the end of a kalpa, does not perish. Knowing this, one does not grieve for what is lost.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जयापरोतें कांहीं नाहीं । तें आपणपेंचि आपुल्या ठायीं । जाहला यालागीं जो कांहीं। आकांक्षी ना॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jayāparoteṃ kāṃhīṃ nāhīṃ | teṃ āpaṇapeṃci āpulyā ṭhāyīṃ | jāhalā yālāgīṃ jo kāṃhīṃ| ākāṃkṣī nā|| 93||
verses.meaning: And beyond whom there is nothing, He Himself, within Himself, became everything. Therefore, He desires nothing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वोखटें कां गोमटें। हें कांहींचि तया नुमटे। रात्रिदिवस न घटे। सूर्यासि जेवीं ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: vokhaṭeṃ kāṃ gomaṭeṃ| heṃ kāṃhīṃci tayā numaṭe| rātridivasa na ghaṭe| sūryāsi jevīṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Just as day and night do not affect the sun, similarly, good or bad do not touch the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा बोधुचि केवळु। जो होऊनि असे निखळु। त्याहीवरी भजनशीळु । माझ्या ठायीं ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā bodhuci kevaḻu| jo hoūni ase nikhaḻu| tyāhīvarī bhajanaśīḻu | mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: Such pure knowledge, which is completely unblemished, and moreover, devotion to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि तया ऐसें दुसरें। आम्हां पढियंतें सोयरें। नाहीं गा साचोकारें। तुझी आण॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari tayā aiseṃ dusareṃ| āmhāṃ paḍhiyaṃteṃ soyareṃ| nāhīṃ gā sācokāreṃ| tujhī āṇa|| 96||
verses.meaning: Truly, there is no other beloved relative to us like you, I swear by you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्था जयाचिया ठायीं । वैषम्याची वार्ता नाहीं । रिपुमित्रां दोहीं । सरिसा पाडु॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārthā jayāciyā ṭhāyīṃ | vaiṣamyācī vārtā nāhīṃ | ripumitrāṃ dohīṃ | sarisā pāḍu|| 97||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, in whom there is no trace of partiality, who regards both enemies and friends with equal measure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां घरींचियां उजियेडु करावा । पारखियां आंधारु पाडावा । हें नेणेंचि गा पांडवा । दीपु जैसा॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ gharīṃciyāṃ ujiyeḍu karāvā | pārakhiyāṃ āṃdhāru pāḍāvā | heṃ neṇeṃci gā pāṃḍavā | dīpu jaisā|| 98||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp does not know whether to illuminate its own household or to cast darkness upon strangers, so too is the divine light, O Pandava.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो खांडाबया घाबो घाली । कां लावणी जयानें केली । दोघां एकचि साउली । वृक्षु दे जैसा ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo khāṃḍābayā ghābo ghālī | kāṃ lāvaṇī jayāneṃ kelī | doghāṃ ekaci sāulī | vṛkṣu de jaisā || 99||
verses.meaning: Just as a tree provides the same shade to both the one who cuts it down and the one who plants it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी इक्षुदंडु। पाळितया गोडु । गाळितया कडु । नोहेचि जेवीं ॥ २००॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī ikṣudaṃḍu| pāḻitayā goḍu | gāḻitayā kaḍu | noheci jevīṃ || 200||
verses.meaning: Just as a sugarcane stalk is sweet to one who nurtures it, but not bitter to one who crushes it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अरिमित्रीं तैसा । अर्जुना जया भावो ऐसा । मानापमानीं सरिसा । होतु जाय॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: arimitrīṃ taisā | arjunā jayā bhāvo aisā | mānāpamānīṃ sarisā | hotu jāya|| 1||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, just as one's feeling towards a friend and an enemy becomes the same, so too does one's attitude towards honor and dishonor become equal.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिहीं क्रतूंसमान। जैसें कां गगन। तैसा एकचि मान। शीतोष्णीं जया॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: tihīṃ kratūṃsamāna| jaiseṃ kāṃ gagana| taisā ekaci māna| śītoṣṇīṃ jayā|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky remains unaffected by the seasons, so too does the one who has attained spiritual realization remain equanimous in heat and cold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दक्षिण उत्तर मारुता। मेरु जैसा पंडुसुता । तैसा सुखदुःखप्राप्तां। मध्यस्तु जो॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: dakṣiṇa uttara mārutā| meru jaisā paṃḍusutā | taisā sukhaduḥkhaprāptāṃ| madhyastu jo|| 3||
verses.meaning: Just as Mount Meru stands unmoved by the winds from the south and north, so too is the one who remains steadfast amidst the arrival of joy and sorrow, O son of Pandu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माधुर्ये चंद्रिका । सरिसी राया रंका। तैसा जो सकळिकां। भूतां समु॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mādhurye caṃdrikā | sarisī rāyā raṃkā| taisā jo sakaḻikāṃ| bhūtāṃ samu||4||
verses.meaning: Just as the moonlight is equally sweet to a king and a pauper, so too is the Divine equally present in all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आघविया जगा एक।॥ सेव्य जैसें उदक। तैसें जयातें तिन्हीं लोक । आकांक्षिती॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āghaviyā jagā eka||| sevya jaiseṃ udaka| taiseṃ jayāteṃ tinhīṃ loka | ākāṃkṣitī|| 5||
verses.meaning: Just as water is essential and sought after by the entire world, so too is He desired by all three realms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो सबाह्यसंग। सांडोनिया लाग। एकाकी असे आंग। आंगीं सूनी॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo sabāhyasaṃga| sāṃḍoniyā lāga| ekākī ase āṃga| āṃgīṃ sūnī||6||
verses.meaning: One who, abandoning all external attachments, remains alone, absorbed in the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो निंदेतें नेघे । स्तुति न एलाघे। आकाशा न लगे। लेपु जैसा ॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo niṃdeteṃ neghe | stuti na elāghe| ākāśā na lage| lepu jaisā ||7||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky is untouched by either praise or slander, so too is the enlightened one unaffected by criticism or adulation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २६६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तैसें निंदे आणि स्तुति। मानु करूनि एके पांती । विचरे प्राणवृत्ती । जनीं वनीं॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: 266 śrījñāneśvarī taiseṃ niṃde āṇi stuti| mānu karūni eke pāṃtī | vicare prāṇavṛttī | janīṃ vanīṃ||8||
verses.meaning: Just as one considers both praise and blame with equal regard, so does the life-force move through people and forests.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साच लटिकें दोन्हीं। बोळोनि न बोळे जाहला मौनी। जो भोगितां उन्मनी । आरायेना॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāca laṭikeṃ donhīṃ| boḻoni na boḻe jāhalā maunī| jo bhogitāṃ unmanī | ārāyenā|| 9||
verses.meaning: Having transcended both truth and untruth, he became silent, not speaking. He who, in experiencing, attains a state beyond the mind, does not perceive it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो यथालाभें न तोखे। अलाभें न पारुखे। 'पाउसेंबीण न सुके । समुद्र जैसा॥ २१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo yathālābheṃ na tokhe| alābheṃ na pārukhe| 'pāuseṃbīṇa na suke | samudra jaisā|| 210||
verses.meaning: One who is neither pleased by gain nor disheartened by loss, remains like the ocean, which neither dries up without rain nor overflows with it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि वायूसि एके ठायीं । बिढार जैसें नाहीं। तैसा न धरीच कहीं। आश्रयो जो॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi vāyūsi eke ṭhāyīṃ | biḍhāra jaiseṃ nāhīṃ| taisā na dharīca kahīṃ| āśrayo jo|| 11||
verses.meaning: And just as the wind has no fixed abode, so too does He never take refuge anywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आघवाचि आकाशस्थिति। जेवीं वायूसि नित्य बसती । तेवीं जगचि विश्रांति-। स्थान जया॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āghavāci ākāśasthiti| jevīṃ vāyūsi nitya basatī | tevīṃ jagaci viśrāṃti-| sthāna jayā|| 12||
verses.meaning: Just as the entire expanse of the sky is the eternal abode for the wind, so too is the universe the resting place for Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें विश्‍वचि माझें घर। ऐसी मती जयाची स्थिर। किंबहुना चराचर। आपण जाहला॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ viś‍vaci mājheṃ ghara| aisī matī jayācī sthira| kiṃbahunā carācara| āpaṇa jāhalā|| 13||
verses.meaning: One whose intellect is firmly established in the understanding that this entire universe is their home, indeed, they themselves have become the animate and inanimate creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग याहीवरी पार्था। माझ्या भजनीं आस्था । तरी तयातें मी माथां। मुकुट करीं ॥ ९१४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga yāhīvarī pārthā| mājhyā bhajanīṃ āsthā | tarī tayāteṃ mī māthāṃ| mukuṭa karīṃ || 914||
verses.meaning: Then, O Partha, if one has faith in My devotion, I will make him the crown upon My head.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उत्तमासि मस्तक । खालविजे हें काय कौतुक । परि मानु करिती तीन्ही लोक । पायवणिया॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: uttamāsi mastaka | khālavije heṃ kāya kautuka | pari mānu karitī tīnhī loka | pāyavaṇiyā|| 15||
verses.meaning: It is no wonder that the head bows before the excellent. But all three worlds honor the feet of such a one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी श्रब्धावस्तू्मी आदरु । करितां जाणिजे प्रकारु। जरी होय श्रीगुरु । सदाशिवु॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī śrabdhāvastūmī ādaru | karitāṃ jāṇije prakāru| jarī hoya śrīguru | sadāśivu|| 16||
verses.meaning: Even then, if one reveres the object of faith, the true nature of the path is known, especially if the Guru is none other than Lord Sadashiva himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हें असो आतां । महेशातें वानितां। आत्मस्तुति होतां । संचारु असे । १७॥ ययालागीं हें नोहे । म्हणितलें रमानाहें । अर्जुना मी वाहें । शिरीं तयातें ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī heṃ aso ātāṃ | maheśāteṃ vānitāṃ| ātmastuti hotāṃ | saṃcāru ase | 17|| yayālāgīṃ heṃ nohe | mhaṇitaleṃ ramānāheṃ | arjunā mī vāheṃ | śirīṃ tayāteṃ || 18||
verses.meaning: But let this be. If I were to praise Lord Shiva, it would be a form of self-praise. Therefore, Lord Vishnu said, "Arjuna, I carry him on my head."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे पुरुषार्थसिद्धि चौथी। घेऊनि आपुलिया हातीं । रिगालळा भक्क्‍तिपंथीं। जगा देतु॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je puruṣārthasiddhi cauthī| gheūni āpuliyā hātīṃ | rigālaḻā bhakk‍tipaṃthīṃ| jagā detu|| 19||
verses.meaning: Those who, holding the fourth and ultimate human pursuit (Moksha) in their hands, enter the path of devotion, bestow it upon the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैवल्याचा अधिकारी । मोक्षाची सोडीबांधी करी। कीं जळाचिये परी। तळवटु घे॥ २२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaivalyācā adhikārī | mokṣācī soḍībāṃdhī karī| kīṃ jaḻāciye parī| taḻavaṭu ghe|| 220||
verses.meaning: He is the master of liberation, who can grant or withhold salvation, just as water takes the shape of its container.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गा नमस्कारूं। तयातें आम्हीं माथां मुकुट करूं। तयाची टांच धरूं । हृदयीं आम्हीं ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gā namaskārūṃ| tayāteṃ āmhīṃ māthāṃ mukuṭa karūṃ| tayācī ṭāṃca dharūṃ | hṛdayīṃ āmhīṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: Therefore, we bow to them. We will crown them with our heads. We will hold their feet in our hearts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचिया गुणांचीं लेणीं। लेववूं आपुलिये वाणीं। तयाची 'कौर्ति श्रवणीं। आम्ही ळेवू ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāciyā guṇāṃcīṃ leṇīṃ| levavūṃ āpuliye vāṇīṃ| tayācī 'kaurti śravaṇīṃ| āmhī ḻevū || 22||
verses.meaning: We shall adorn our speech with His virtues, and listen to His glories with our ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो पहावा हे डोहळे । म्हणौनि अचक्षूसी मज डोळे । हातींचेनि लीलाकमळें । पुजूं तयातें ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to pahāvā he ḍohaḻe | mhaṇauni acakṣūsī maja ḍoḻe | hātīṃceni līlākamaḻeṃ | pujūṃ tayāteṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: To behold Him, I, who am without eyes, have been given eyes. With the lotus flower in my hand, I shall worship Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दोंवरी दोनी । भुजा आलो घेउनी । आलिंगावयालागुनी। तयाचें आंग॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: doṃvarī donī | bhujā ālo gheunī | āliṃgāvayālāgunī| tayāceṃ āṃga|| 24||
verses.meaning: I have come with two arms to embrace his body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया संगाचेनि सुरवाडें। मज विदेहा देह धरणें घडे। किंबहुना आवडे । निरुपमु॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā saṃgāceni suravāḍeṃ| maja videhā deha dharaṇeṃ ghaḍe| kiṃbahunā āvaḍe | nirupamu|| 25||
verses.meaning: Through the joy of that association, I, the bodiless, am compelled to assume a body. In short, the incomparable one is beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणेंसीं आम्हां मैत्र। एथ कायसें विचित्र। परि तयाचें चरित्र। ऐकती जे॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃsīṃ āmhāṃ maitra| etha kāyaseṃ vicitra| pari tayāceṃ caritra| aikatī je|| 26||
verses.meaning: With them, we share a friendship. What is so strange about that? But listen to those who hear His divine story.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेही प्राणापरौते। आवडती हें निरुतें। जे भक्‍्तचरित्रातें । प्रशंसिती ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tehī prāṇāparaute| āvaḍatī heṃ niruteṃ| je bhak‍tacaritrāteṃ | praśaṃsitī || 27||
verses.meaning: They are dearer than life itself, those who praise the character and deeds of devotees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो हा अर्जुना साद्यंत । सांगितला प्रस्तुत । भक्क्‍तियोगु समस्त । योगरूप॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo hā arjunā sādyaṃta | sāṃgitalā prastuta | bhakk‍tiyogu samasta | yogarūpa|| 28||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, this entire path of devotion, which I have just now fully explained, is the very essence of all yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया मी प्रीति करीं। कां मनीं शिरसा धरीं । येवढी थोरी। जया स्थितीये॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā mī prīti karīṃ| kāṃ manīṃ śirasā dharīṃ | yevaḍhī thorī| jayā sthitīye|| 29||
verses.meaning: I love that state, or hold it in my mind with reverence, for such is its greatness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते हे गोष्टी रम्य। अमृतधारा धर्म्य। करिती प्रतीतिगम्य। आइकोनि जे॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: te he goṣṭī ramya| amṛtadhārā dharmya| karitī pratītigamya| āikoni je|| 230||
verses.meaning: Those who listen to these delightful, nectar-like, righteous words will experience their truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीचि श्रद्धेचेनि आदरें। जयांचे ठायीं बिस्तरे। जीवीं जयां थारे। जे अनुष्ठिती॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīci śraddheceni ādareṃ| jayāṃce ṭhāyīṃ bistare| jīvīṃ jayāṃ thāre| je anuṣṭhitī|| 31||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those in whom faith expands with reverence, those in whose hearts it finds a place, they are the ones who practice it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी निरूपली जैसी । तैसीच स्थिति मानसीं । मग सुल्षेत्रीं जैसी । पेरणी केळी ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī nirūpalī jaisī | taisīca sthiti mānasīṃ | maga sulṣetrīṃ jaisī | peraṇī keḻī || 32||
verses.meaning: Just as the situation is perceived in the mind, so it is like sowing seeds in fertile ground.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी मातें परम करूनि। इये अर्थी प्रेम धरूनि। हेंचि सर्वस्व मानूनि। घेती जे पैं॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī māteṃ parama karūni| iye arthī prema dharūni| heṃci sarvasva mānūni| ghetī je paiṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: But those who, with utmost devotion, hold this meaning in their hearts, considering it their everything, truly grasp it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्था गा जगीं। तेचि भक्त तेचि योगी । उत्कंठा तयांलागीं । अखंड मज॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārthā gā jagīṃ| teci bhakta teci yogī | utkaṃṭhā tayāṃlāgīṃ | akhaṃḍa maja|| 34||
verses.meaning: O Partha, those alone are true devotees and true yogis in this world who have an unceasing longing for Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते तीर्थ ते क्षेत्र । जगीं तेचि पवित्र। भक्तिकथेसी मैत्र। जयां पुरुषां॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: te tīrtha te kṣetra | jagīṃ teci pavitra| bhaktikathesī maitra| jayāṃ puruṣāṃ|| 35||
verses.meaning: Those places are sacred, those pilgrimage sites are pure in the world, where men are friends with stories of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्ही तयांचें करूं ध्यान। ते आमुचें देवतार्चन। तेवांचूनि आन । गोमटें नाहीं ॥३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhī tayāṃceṃ karūṃ dhyāna| te āmuceṃ devatārcana| tevāṃcūni āna | gomaṭeṃ nāhīṃ ||36||
verses.meaning: We shall meditate upon them; they are our deity, our worship. There is nothing more beautiful than them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयांचें आम्हां व्यसन । ते आमुचें निधिनिधान। किंबहुना समाधान ते मिळती तैं ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃceṃ āmhāṃ vyasana | te āmuceṃ nidhinidhāna| kiṃbahunā samādhāna te miḻatī taiṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: We are addicted to them; they are our treasure. Indeed, only when we meet them do we find true contentment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं प्रेमळाची वार्ता। जे अनुवादती पंडुसुता । ते मानूं 'परमदेवता। आपुली आम्ही ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ premaḻācī vārtā| je anuvādatī paṃḍusutā | te mānūṃ 'paramadevatā| āpulī āmhī || 38||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, those who lovingly narrate these tales, we consider them our supreme deity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें निजजनानंदें । तेणें जगदादिकंदें । बोलिलें मुकुंदें। संजयो म्हणे ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ nijajanānaṃdeṃ | teṇeṃ jagadādikaṃdeṃ | bolileṃ mukuṃdeṃ| saṃjayo mhaṇe || 39||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya says that Mukunda, the root cause of the universe, spoke thus, out of joy for his devotees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: राया जो निर्मळु। निष्कलंक लोककृपाळु । शरणागतां प्रतिपाळु। शरण्यु जो॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: rāyā jo nirmaḻu| niṣkalaṃka lokakṛpāḻu | śaraṇāgatāṃ pratipāḻu| śaraṇyu jo|| 240||
verses.meaning: He is the King, pure and blemishless, compassionate to all beings, the protector of those who surrender to Him, and the ultimate refuge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सुरसहायशीळु। लोकलालनलीळु । प्रणतप्रतिपाळु। हा खेळु जयाचा ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ surasahāyaśīḻu| lokalālanalīḻu | praṇatapratipāḻu| hā kheḻu jayācā || 41||
verses.meaning: He whose play is to be the helper of gods, the delight of the people, and the protector of the humble.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो धर्मकीर्तिधवळु । अगाधदातृत्बें सरळु। अतुळबळें प्रबळु। बळिबंधनु॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo dharmakīrtidhavaḻu | agādhadātṛtbeṃ saraḻu| atuḻabaḻeṃ prabaḻu| baḻibaṃdhanu|| 42||
verses.meaning: He who is a white mansion of righteous fame, straightforward in his unfathomable generosity, and powerful with incomparable strength, the one who bound Bali.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो भक्तजनवत्सलु। प्रेमळजनप्रांजळु । सत्यसेतु सरळु । कलानिधी ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo bhaktajanavatsalu| premaḻajanaprāṃjaḻu | satyasetu saraḻu | kalānidhī || 43||
verses.meaning: He who is affectionate to His devotees, straightforward with those who love Him, the bridge of truth, simple, and the treasure of arts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो श्रीकृष्ण वैकुंठींचा । चक्रवर्ती निजांचा। सांगे येरु दैवाचा। आइकतु असे॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to śrīkṛṣṇa vaikuṃṭhīṃcā | cakravartī nijāṃcā| sāṃge yeru daivācā| āikatu ase|| 44||
verses.meaning: That Shri Krishna, the emperor of Vaikuntha, was narrating, and Arjuna, the fortunate one, was listening.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां ययावरी । निरूपिती परी । संजयो म्हणे अवधारीं । धृतराष्ट्रातें ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yayāvarī | nirūpitī parī | saṃjayo mhaṇe avadhārīṃ | dhṛtarāṣṭrāteṃ || 45 ||
verses.meaning: Now, listen, Dhritarashtra, to how Sanjaya narrates further on this matter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेचि रसाळ कथा । मऱहाठिया प्रतिपथा। आणिजेल आतां। अवधारिजो॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teci rasāḻa kathā | maṟahāṭhiyā pratipathā| āṇijela ātāṃ| avadhārijo|| 46||
verses.meaning: That same delightful narrative, I shall now bring forth in Marathi for your understanding. Please listen attentively.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानदेव म्हणे तुम्ही। संत बोळगावेति आम्हीं। हें पढविलों जी स्वामी । निवृत्तिदेवीं ॥ २४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñānadeva mhaṇe tumhī| saṃta boḻagāveti āmhīṃ| heṃ paḍhaviloṃ jī svāmī | nivṛttidevīṃ || 247||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev says, "You, the saints, should be bid farewell by us. This, O Master, was taught to me by Nivrittinath."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आत्मरूप गणेशु केलिया स्मरण। सकळ विद्यांचें अधिकरण। तेचि वंदूं श्रीचरण। श्रीगुरूचे॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātmarūpa gaṇeśu keliyā smaraṇa| sakaḻa vidyāṃceṃ adhikaraṇa| teci vaṃdūṃ śrīcaraṇa| śrīgurūce|| 1||
verses.meaning: Remembering the Ganesh who is the very form of the Self, the abode of all knowledge, I bow to those holy feet of the Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांचेनि आठवें। शब्दसृष्टी आंगवे । सारस्वत आघवें। जिव्हेसि ये॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃceni āṭhaveṃ| śabdasṛṣṭī āṃgave | sārasvata āghaveṃ| jivhesi ye|| 2||
verses.meaning: By whose remembrance, the world of words becomes accessible, and all eloquence comes to the tongue.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वक्‍्तृत्वा गोडपणें। अमृतातें पारुखें म्हणे। रस होती बोळंगणें । अक्षरांसी ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vak‍tṛtvā goḍapaṇeṃ| amṛtāteṃ pārukheṃ mhaṇe| rasa hotī boḻaṃgaṇeṃ | akṣarāṃsī || 3||
verses.meaning: The sweetness of this discourse makes nectar seem tasteless. Its words are like a feast of divine rasa.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भावाचें अवतरण । अवतरविती खूण हाता चढे संपूर्ण । तत्त्वभेद॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhāvāceṃ avataraṇa | avataravitī khūṇa hātā caḍhe saṃpūrṇa | tattvabheda|| 4||
verses.meaning: The descent of spiritual experience, the sign that brings it down, fully comes into one's hands, revealing the distinction of principles.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीगुरूंचे पाय । जैं हृदय गिंवसूनि ठाय। तैं येवढें भाग्य होय । उन्मेखासी ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīgurūṃce pāya | jaiṃ hṛdaya giṃvasūni ṭhāya| taiṃ yevaḍheṃ bhāgya hoya | unmekhāsī || 5||
verses.meaning: When the feet of the Guru are embraced by the heart, then such great fortune dawns upon the intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते नमस्कारूनि आतां। जो पितामहाचा पिता । लक्ष्मीयेचा भर्ता। ऐसें म्हणे॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: te namaskārūni ātāṃ| jo pitāmahācā pitā | lakṣmīyecā bhartā| aiseṃ mhaṇe|| 6||
verses.meaning: Having bowed to Him, who is the father of the father of Brahma, and the husband of Lakshmi, thus he spoke.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पार्था परिसिजे। देह हें क्षेत्र म्हिणिजे। जो हें जाणे तो बोलिजे । क्षेत्रज्ञु एथें ॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pārthā parisije| deha heṃ kṣetra mhiṇije| jo heṃ jāṇe to bolije | kṣetrajñu etheṃ ||7||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, listen then: this body is called the 'field.' One who knows this is called the 'knower of the field' here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि क्षेत्रज्ञु जो एथें । तो मीचि जाण निरुतें । जो सर्व क्षेत्रांते । संगोपोनि असे॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari kṣetrajñu jo etheṃ | to mīci jāṇa niruteṃ | jo sarva kṣetrāṃte | saṃgoponi ase|| 8||
verses.meaning: Know for certain that the Knower of the field, who resides here, is indeed Me, who protects and sustains all fields.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्षेत्र आणि क्षेत्रज्ञातें। जाणणें जें निरुतें। ज्ञान ऐसें तयातें । मानूं आम्ही॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṣetra āṇi kṣetrajñāteṃ| jāṇaṇeṃ jeṃ niruteṃ| jñāna aiseṃ tayāteṃ | mānūṃ āmhī||9||
verses.meaning: We consider that true knowledge which discerns the field and the knower of the field.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि क्षेत्र येणें नांवें । हें शरीर जेणें भावें । म्हणितलें तें आघवें । सांगों आतां॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari kṣetra yeṇeṃ nāṃveṃ | heṃ śarīra jeṇeṃ bhāveṃ | mhaṇitaleṃ teṃ āghaveṃ | sāṃgoṃ ātāṃ|| 10||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the body is called 'Kshetra' (field). I will now explain in detail all the reasons why it is called so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें क्षेत्र कां म्हणिजे) कैसें कें हें उपजे। कवणकवणीं वाढविजे। विकारीं एथ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ kṣetra kāṃ mhaṇije) kaiseṃ keṃ heṃ upaje| kavaṇakavaṇīṃ vāḍhavije| vikārīṃ etha|| 11||
verses.meaning: Why is this called a field? How does it arise? By whom is it nourished? What are its transformations?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें औट हात मोटकें । कीं केवढें पां केतुकें । बरड कोौं पिकें । कोणाचें हें॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ auṭa hāta moṭakeṃ | kīṃ kevaḍheṃ pāṃ ketukeṃ | baraḍa koauṃ pikeṃ | koṇāceṃ heṃ|| 12||
verses.meaning: This body, merely three and a half cubits tall, how vast is its potential? Whose barren land is this that yields such a harvest?

verses.shloka_devanagari: इत्यादि सर्व। जे जे याचे भाव। ते बोळिजती सावेव। अवधान देई ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ityādi sarva| je je yāce bhāva| te boḻijatī sāveva| avadhāna deī || 13||
verses.meaning: All these and other such emotions that arise in the mind, I shall explain them with their full significance. Please listen attentively.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं याचि स्थळाकारणें। श्रुति सदा बोबाणे । तर्कु येणेंचि ठी करणें। तोंडाळु केला ॥ १९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ yāci sthaḻākāraṇeṃ| śruti sadā bobāṇe | tarku yeṇeṃci ṭhī karaṇeṃ| toṃḍāḻu kelā || 194||
verses.meaning: For this very place, the scriptures always proclaim, and logic is made eloquent by this very reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चाळितां हेंचि बोली । दर्शनें शेवटा आलीं । तेवींचि नाहीं बुझविलीं । अझुनी दंद्रें॥ १५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: cāḻitāṃ heṃci bolī | darśaneṃ śevaṭā ālīṃ | tevīṃci nāhīṃ bujhavilīṃ | ajhunī daṃdreṃ|| 15 ||
verses.meaning: Even after contemplating these words, the visions have come to an end, yet the senses are not satisfied even now.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शास्त्रांचिये सोयरिके । विचळिजे येणेंचि एकें । याचेनि एकवंकें । जगासि वादु॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: śāstrāṃciye soyarike | vicaḻije yeṇeṃci ekeṃ | yāceni ekavaṃkeṃ | jagāsi vādu|| 16||
verses.meaning: By this alone, the scriptures are disturbed, and by its mere inclination, the world is embroiled in disputes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोंडेंसी तोंडा न पडे। बोला बोलेंसी न घडे। इया युक्ति बडबडें॥ त्राय जाहली ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: toṃḍeṃsī toṃḍā na paḍe| bolā boleṃsī na ghaḍe| iyā yukti baḍabaḍeṃ|| trāya jāhalī || 17||
verses.meaning: The mouth cannot be contained by the mouth, nor can words be bound by words. These clever arguments have become a nuisance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नेणों कोणाचें हें स्थळ॥ परि कैसें अभिलाषाचें बळ। जे घरोघरीं कपाळ। पिटवीत असे॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: neṇoṃ koṇāceṃ heṃ sthaḻa|| pari kaiseṃ abhilāṣāceṃ baḻa| je gharogharīṃ kapāḻa| piṭavīta ase|| 18||
verses.meaning: I do not know whose place this is, but such is the power of desire that it makes one knock on every door, begging.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नास्तिका द्यावया तोंड । वेदांचें गाढें बंड । तें देखोनि पाखांड । आनचि वाजे॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāstikā dyāvayā toṃḍa | vedāṃceṃ gāḍheṃ baṃḍa | teṃ dekhoni pākhāṃḍa | ānaci vāje|| 19||
verses.meaning: To give a voice to the atheists, the deep-rooted tradition of the Vedas, seeing that, the heretics rejoice differently.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणती तुम्ही निर्मूळ। लटिकें हें वाग्जाळ। ना म्हणसी तरी पोफळ। घातलें आहे॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇatī tumhī nirmūḻa| laṭikeṃ heṃ vāgjāḻa| nā mhaṇasī tarī pophaḻa| ghātaleṃ āhe|| 20||
verses.meaning: You say that I am baseless, that this is a false web of words. But if you say no, then it is as if you have planted a hollow seed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाखांडाचे कडे। नागवीं लुंचिती मुंडें। नियोजिलीं वितंडें । ताळासि येती॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pākhāṃḍāce kaḍe| nāgavīṃ luṃcitī muṃḍeṃ| niyojilīṃ vitaṃḍeṃ | tāḻāsi yetī|| 21||
verses.meaning: The cliffs of false doctrines strip and plunder the heads of the ignorant, who, engaged in futile arguments, come to ruin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मृत्युबळाचेनि माजें। हें जाईल वीण काजें। तें देखोनियां व्याजें। निघाळे योगी ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mṛtyubaḻāceni mājeṃ| heṃ jāīla vīṇa kājeṃ| teṃ dekhoniyāṃ vyājeṃ| nighāḻe yogī || 22||
verses.meaning: Seeing that this body will perish uselessly due to the might of death, the yogi, through spiritual practice, transcends it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मृत्यूनी आधाधिलें। तिहीं निरंजन सेविलें। यमनियमांचे केले। मेळावे पुरे॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mṛtyūnī ādhādhileṃ| tihīṃ niraṃjana sevileṃ| yamaniyamāṃce kele| meḻāve pure|| 23||
verses.meaning: Those who were afflicted by death, they served the pure, formless God. They completed the gatherings of Yama and Niyama (yogic restraints and observances).

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणेंचि क्षेत्राभिमानें । राज्य त्यजिळें ईशानें। गुंति जाणोनि स्मशानें। वासु केला॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃci kṣetrābhimāneṃ | rājya tyajiḻeṃ īśāneṃ| guṃti jāṇoni smaśāneṃ| vāsu kelā|| 24||
verses.meaning: Due to this very attachment to the body, even Lord Shiva abandoned his kingdom and, knowing the entanglement of the cremation ground, made it his abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया पैजा महेशा। पांघुरणें दाही दिशा। लांचकरु म्हणौनि कोळसा । कामु केला॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā paijā maheśā| pāṃghuraṇeṃ dāhī diśā| lāṃcakaru mhaṇauni koḻasā | kāmu kelā|| 25||
verses.meaning: Thus, O Mahesh, the ten directions became your covering. You made charcoal your ornament, considering it a bribe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सत्यलोकनाथा। वदनें आलीं बळार्था। तरि तो सर्वथा । जाणेचिना॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ satyalokanāthā| vadaneṃ ālīṃ baḻārthā| tari to sarvathā | jāṇecinā|| 26||
verses.meaning: Even if the Lord of Satyaloka (Brahma) were to come and speak with all his might, he would still not fully comprehend it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक म्हणती हें स्थळ । जीवाचेंचि समूळ । मग प्राण हें कूळ । तयाचें एथ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka mhaṇatī heṃ sthaḻa | jīvāceṃci samūḻa | maga prāṇa heṃ kūḻa | tayāceṃ etha|| 27||
