verses.meaning: Some say this place is the very root of the individual soul, and that the life-breath is its lineage here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया प्राणाचे घरीं । अंगें राबती भाऊ चारी। आणि मनाऐसा आवरी । कुळवाडीकरु ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā prāṇāce gharīṃ | aṃgeṃ rābatī bhāū cārī| āṇi manāaisā āvarī | kuḻavāḍīkaru || 28||
verses.meaning: The four brothers (Antahkarana's components) themselves work diligently in the house of Prana, and the mind, like a diligent householder, controls them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयातें इंद्रियबैलांची पेटी। न म्हणे अंबसीं पाहाटीं । विषयक्षेत्री आटी । काढी भळी॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāteṃ iṃdriyabailāṃcī peṭī| na mhaṇe aṃbasīṃ pāhāṭīṃ | viṣayakṣetrī āṭī | kāḍhī bhaḻī|| 29||
verses.meaning: The senses, like bulls, do not heed the dawn, but rather toil relentlessly in the field of worldly pleasures, exhausting themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग विधीची वाफ चुकवी । आणि अमन्यायाचें बीज वाफवी। कुकर्माचा करवी । राबु जरी ॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vidhīcī vāpha cukavī | āṇi amanyāyāceṃ bīja vāphavī| kukarmācā karavī | rābu jarī || 30||
verses.meaning: Then, he avoids the trap of destiny and sows the seeds of injustice, even if it means toiling in evil deeds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी 'तयाचिसारिखें। असंभड पाप पिके । मग जन्मकोटी दुःखें। भोगी जीवु ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī 'tayācisārikheṃ| asaṃbhaḍa pāpa pike | maga janmakoṭī duḥkheṃ| bhogī jīvu || 39||
verses.meaning: Thus, a similar immense sin ripens, and then the soul experiences suffering for millions of births.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी विधीचिये वाफे । सत्क्रिया बीज आरोपे। तरी जन्मशतांचीं मापें। २७० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी सुखचि मबीजे॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī vidhīciye vāphe | satkriyā bīja ārope| tarī janmaśatāṃcīṃ māpeṃ| 270 śrījñāneśvarī sukhaci mabīje|| 32||
verses.meaning: If the seed of good deeds is sown in the field of prescribed rituals, then the harvest of happiness will be reaped for hundreds of births.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव आणिक म्हणती हें नव्हे। हें जिवाचेंचि न म्हणावें । आमुतें पुसा आघवें। क्षेत्राचे या ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva āṇika mhaṇatī heṃ navhe| heṃ jivāceṃci na mhaṇāveṃ | āmuteṃ pusā āghaveṃ| kṣetrāce yā || 33||
verses.meaning: Then others said, "This is not it. This should not even be called the individual soul. Ask us everything about this body."

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो जीवु एथ उखिता। बस्तीकरु वाटे जातां। आणि प्राणु हा बलौता। म्हणौनि जागे॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho jīvu etha ukhitā| bastīkaru vāṭe jātāṃ| āṇi prāṇu hā balautā| mhaṇauni jāge|| 34||
verses.meaning: Alas, the soul is a temporary guest here, a mere traveler passing through, and life itself is a transient companion, which is why it remains awake and aware.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनादि हे प्रकृती । सांख्य जियेतें गाती । क्षेत्र हे वृत्ती । तियेचि जाणा ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: anādi he prakṛtī | sāṃkhya jiyeteṃ gātī | kṣetra he vṛttī | tiyeci jāṇā || 35 ||
verses.meaning: This Prakriti is beginningless, which the Samkhya philosophers sing about. Know that this is the field (Kshetra) of its modifications.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि इयेतेंचि आघवा। आथी घरमेळावा। म्हणौनि ते बाहिवा। घरीं वाहे ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi iyeteṃci āghavā| āthī gharameḻāvā| mhaṇauni te bāhivā| gharīṃ vāhe || 36||
verses.meaning: And in this very place, all things come together, like a family gathering. Therefore, it carries itself outwardly, as if in a home.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वाह्याचिये रहाटी। जे कां मुद्दल तिघे इये सृष्टी । ते इयेच्याचि पोटीं । जहाळे गुण ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāhyāciye rahāṭī| je kāṃ muddala tighe iye sṛṣṭī | te iyecyāci poṭīṃ | jahāḻe guṇa || 37||
verses.meaning: The fundamental three qualities (Sattva, Rajas, Tamas) that are the very essence of the world's activity, were born from within this very Prakriti (primordial nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: रजोगुण पेरी । तेतुलें सत्त्व सोंकरी। मग एकलें तम करी। संवगणी ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: rajoguṇa perī | tetuleṃ sattva soṃkarī| maga ekaleṃ tama karī| saṃvagaṇī || 38||
verses.meaning: The quality of Rajas (passion and activity) sows its seeds, and then Sattva (goodness and purity) withers away, leaving only Tamas (ignorance and inertia) to take over completely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रचूनि महत्तत्त्वाचें खळें । मळी एकें काळुगेनि पोळें। तेथ अव्यक्‍ताची मिळे। सांज भली ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: racūni mahattattvāceṃ khaḻeṃ | maḻī ekeṃ kāḻugeni poḻeṃ| tetha avyak‍tācī miḻe| sāṃja bhalī || 39||
verses.meaning: Having created the threshing floor of the Mahat-tattva, the Unmanifest (Prakriti) then gathers the harvest, and there, in the evening, a beautiful union takes place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव एकीं मतिवंतीं। या बोलाचिया खंतीं । म्हणितलें या ज्ञप्ती । अर्वबाचीना ॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva ekīṃ mativaṃtīṃ| yā bolāciyā khaṃtīṃ | mhaṇitaleṃ yā jñaptī | arvabācīnā || 40||
verses.meaning: Then, a wise woman, troubled by these words, said, "This knowledge is not new."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां हो परतत्त्वाआंतु । कें प्रकृतीची मातु । हा क्षेत्रवृत्तांतु। उगेच्यि आइका ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ ho paratattvāāṃtu | keṃ prakṛtīcī mātu | hā kṣetravṛttāṃtu| ugecyi āikā || 49||
verses.meaning: Listen quietly to this account of the field, whether it is within the Supreme Principle or the essence of Prakriti (primordial nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: शून्यसेजेशालिये । सुलीनतेचिये तुळिये। निद्रा केली होती बळियें। संकल्पें येणें॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: śūnyasejeśāliye | sulīnateciye tuḻiye| nidrā kelī hotī baḻiyeṃ| saṃkalpeṃ yeṇeṃ|| 42||
verses.meaning: On the bed of emptiness, on the beam of dissolution, the powerful resolve had slept.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अवसांत चेइला । उद्यमीं सदैव भला । म्हणौनि ठेवा जोडला । इच्छावशें ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: to avasāṃta ceilā | udyamīṃ sadaiva bhalā | mhaṇauni ṭhevā joḍalā | icchāvaśeṃ || 43 ||
verses.meaning: He awoke in that state of enthusiasm, always good in his endeavors, and thus accumulated a treasure according to his desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निरालंबींची वाडी। होती त्रिभुबनायेवढी। हे तयाचिये जोडी । रूपा आली ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nirālaṃbīṃcī vāḍī| hotī tribhubanāyevaḍhī| he tayāciye joḍī | rūpā ālī || 44||
verses.meaning: The garden of the supportless, which was as vast as the three worlds, came into being through His companionship.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग महाभूतांचें एकवाट। सैरा वेंटाळूनि भाट । भूतग्रामांचे आघाट'। चिरिले चारी ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mahābhūtāṃceṃ ekavāṭa| sairā veṃṭāḻūni bhāṭa | bhūtagrāmāṃce āghāṭa'| cirile cārī || 45||
verses.meaning: Then, the great elements, uniting as one, fiercely entangled and tore apart the abodes of all beings into four parts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यावरी आदी । पांचभूतिकांची मांदी । बांधली प्रभेदीं। पंचभूतिकीं ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāvarī ādī | pāṃcabhūtikāṃcī māṃdī | bāṃdhalī prabhedīṃ| paṃcabhūtikīṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: Then, the assembly of the five elements was created by the Lord, in the form of the five elements themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्माकर्माचे गुंडे। बांध घातळे दोहींकडे । नपुंसकें बरडें। रानें केली ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: karmākarmāce guṃḍe| bāṃdha ghātaḻe dohīṃkaḍe | napuṃsakeṃ baraḍeṃ| rāneṃ kelī || 47||
verses.meaning: The barren lands, like eunuchs, have been made to block both sides with the boulders of action and inaction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ येरझारेलागीं। जन्ममृत्यूची सुरंगी । सुहाविली निलागी। संकल्पें येणें ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha yerajhārelāgīṃ| janmamṛtyūcī suraṃgī | suhāvilī nilāgī| saṃkalpeṃ yeṇeṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: There, the cycle of birth and death, which is like a mine of suffering, is made pleasant and harmless by this very resolve (of devotion).

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अहंकारासि एकलाधी। करूनि जीवितावधी। वहाविलें बुद्धि। चराचर॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga ahaṃkārāsi ekalādhī| karūni jīvitāvadhī| vahāvileṃ buddhi| carācara|| 49||
verses.meaning: Then, having made ego the sole ruler and the very limit of life, the intellect was made to carry the entire animate and inanimate world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यापरी निराळी । वाढे संकल्पाची डाहाळी । म्हणौनि तो मुळीं । प्रपंचा यया ॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāparī nirāḻī | vāḍhe saṃkalpācī ḍāhāḻī | mhaṇauni to muḻīṃ | prapaṃcā yayā || 50||
verses.meaning: In this way, the branch of संकल्प (resolve/intention) grows separately, and therefore, it is the very root of this worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यापरी मतमुगुतकीं। तेथ पडिघायिळें आणिकीं। म्हणती हां हो विवेकीं। कैसें तुम्हीं ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāparī matamugutakīṃ| tetha paḍighāyiḻeṃ āṇikīṃ| mhaṇatī hāṃ ho vivekīṃ| kaiseṃ tumhīṃ || 59||
verses.meaning: In this way, when the mind is thus captivated, others, struck by wonder, exclaim, "Oh, how discerning and wise you are!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: परतत्त्वाचिया गावीं। संकल्पसेज देखावी। तरी कां पां न मनावी। प्रकृति तयाची ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paratattvāciyā gāvīṃ| saṃkalpaseja dekhāvī| tarī kāṃ pāṃ na manāvī| prakṛti tayācī || 52||
verses.meaning: If the realm of the Supreme Reality can manifest as the bed of creation's thought, then why should we not accept that this very nature is its own?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी असो हें नव्हे। तुम्ही या न लगावें। आतांचि हें आघवें। सांगिजेळ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī aso heṃ navhe| tumhī yā na lagāveṃ| ātāṃci heṃ āghaveṃ| sāṃgijeḻa|| 53||
verses.meaning: But let it be, you should not get involved in this. Now, all this will be told.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आकाशीं कवणें। केलीं मेघाचीं भरणें। अंतरिक्ष तारांगणे धरी कवण॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ākāśīṃ kavaṇeṃ| kelīṃ meghācīṃ bharaṇeṃ| aṃtarikṣa tārāṃgaṇe dharī kavaṇa|| 54||
verses.meaning: Who filled the sky with clouds? Who holds the stars in space?

verses.shloka_devanagari: गगनाचा तडावा। कोणें वेढिला केधवां । पवनु हिंडतु असावा । हें कवणाचें मत ॥५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: gaganācā taḍāvā| koṇeṃ veḍhilā kedhavāṃ | pavanu hiṃḍatu asāvā | heṃ kavaṇāceṃ mata ||55||
verses.meaning: Who has ever measured the expanse of the sky? Who believes that the wind moves by its own will?

verses.shloka_devanagari: रोमां कवण पेरी । सिंधू कवण भरी । पर्जन्याचिया करी । धारा कवण॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: romāṃ kavaṇa perī | siṃdhū kavaṇa bharī | parjanyāciyā karī | dhārā kavaṇa|| 56||
verses.meaning: Who sows the hair on the body? Who fills the ocean? Who holds the streams of rain in their hands?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें क्षेत्र हें स्वभावें । हे वृत्ती कवणाची नव्हे। हें वाहे तया फावे । येरां तुटे ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ kṣetra heṃ svabhāveṃ | he vṛttī kavaṇācī navhe| heṃ vāhe tayā phāve | yerāṃ tuṭe || 57||
verses.meaning: Just as this field (body) is inherently natural, this disposition is not of anyone else. It is attained by those who bear it, while for others, it is severed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब आणिके एकें। क्षोभें म्हिणितलें निकें । तरी भोगिजे एकें । काळें केवीं हे॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba āṇike ekeṃ| kṣobheṃ mhiṇitaleṃ nikeṃ | tarī bhogije ekeṃ | kāḻeṃ kevīṃ he|| 58||
verses.meaning: Then another, with great agitation, said, "How can one experience all these at once?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी ययाचा मारु । देखताति अनिवारु । परी स्वमतीं भरु । अभिमानिया॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī yayācā māru | dekhatāti anivāru | parī svamatīṃ bharu | abhimāniyā|| 59||
verses.meaning: Yet, they witness its irresistible impact, but the arrogant remain full of their own intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जाणों मृत्यू रागिटा । सिंहाडयाचा दरकुटा। परी काय कीजे वांजटा। पूरिजत असे॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jāṇoṃ mṛtyū rāgiṭā | siṃhāḍayācā darakuṭā| parī kāya kīje vāṃjaṭā| pūrijata ase|| 60||
verses.meaning: This is like a fierce lion's roar, but what can be done when a barren woman is filled with a child?

verses.shloka_devanagari: महाकल्पापरौतीं। कव घाळूनि अवचितीं। सत्यलळोकभद्रजाती। आंगीं वाजे॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mahākalpāparautīṃ| kava ghāḻūni avacitīṃ| satyalaḻokabhadrajātī| āṃgīṃ vāje|| 61||
verses.meaning: Beyond the great dissolution, suddenly, the auspicious qualities of the realm of truth resonate within one's being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लोकपाळ नित्य नवे । दिग्गजांचे मेळावे । स्वर्गीचिये आडवे । रिगोनि मोडी ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: lokapāḻa nitya nave | diggajāṃce meḻāve | svargīciye āḍave | rigoni moḍī || 62||
verses.meaning: The guardians of the world, ever new, and the assemblies of the Diggajas (mythical elephants supporting the earth) are obstructed and broken down by the divine power.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर ययाचेनि अंगवातें । जन्ममृत्यूचिये गर्त । निर्जिवें होऊनि भ्रमतें। जीवमूगें ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera yayāceni aṃgavāteṃ | janmamṛtyūciye garta | nirjiveṃ hoūni bhramateṃ| jīvamūgeṃ || 63 ||
verses.meaning: And by its very touch, the multitude of beings, lifeless, wander in the pit of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न्याहाळीं पां केव्हडा। पसरलासे चवडा। जो करूनियां माजिवडा। आकारगजु ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nyāhāḻīṃ pāṃ kevhaḍā| pasaralāse cavaḍā| jo karūniyāṃ mājivaḍā| ākāragaju || 64||
verses.meaning: Behold, how vast is the expanse, which, having created, it then fills with its majestic form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि काळाची सत्ता । हाचि बोलु निरुता। ऐसे वाद पंडुसुता । क्षेत्रालागीं ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kāḻācī sattā | hāci bolu nirutā| aise vāda paṃḍusutā | kṣetrālāgīṃ || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the dominion of time, this is the absolute truth, O son of Pandu, regarding the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बहु उखिविखी। क्रषीं केली नैमिषीं। पुराणें इयेविषीं। मतपत्रिका ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ bahu ukhivikhī| kraṣīṃ kelī naimiṣīṃ| purāṇeṃ iyeviṣīṃ| matapatrikā || 66||
verses.meaning: This was extensively discussed and debated by the sages in Naimisharanya. The Puranas serve as the authoritative record on this subject.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनुष्टुभादि छंदें। प्रबंधीं जे विविधें। तें पत्रावलंबन मदें। करिती अझुनी ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: anuṣṭubhādi chaṃdeṃ| prabaṃdhīṃ je vividheṃ| teṃ patrāvalaṃbana madeṃ| karitī ajhunī || 67||
verses.meaning: Even today, those who are intoxicated by the support of the scriptures, which are composed in various meters like Anushtubh and others, still do so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वेदींचे बृहत्सामसूत्र। जें देखणेपणें पवित्र । परी तयाही हें क्षेत्र । नेणवेचि ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: vedīṃce bṛhatsāmasūtra| jeṃ dekhaṇepaṇeṃ pavitra | parī tayāhī heṃ kṣetra | neṇaveci || 68 ||
verses.meaning: Even the sacred hymns of the Vedas, which are inherently pure and profound in their wisdom, cannot fully comprehend this spiritual field (the true nature of the Self).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणीक आणिकींही बहुतीं। महाकवीं हेतुमंतीं । ययालागीं मती । वेंचिलिया॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇīka āṇikīṃhī bahutīṃ| mahākavīṃ hetumaṃtīṃ | yayālāgīṃ matī | veṃciliyā|| 69||
verses.meaning: And many other great poets, with profound intentions, have also expended their intellect for this very purpose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी ऐसें हें एवढें । कौं अमुकेयाचेंचि फु्डे। हें कोणाही वरपडे। होयचिना ॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī aiseṃ heṃ evaḍheṃ | kauṃ amukeyāceṃci phuḍe| heṃ koṇāhī varapaḍe| hoyacinā || 70||
verses.meaning: But such a vast and profound truth cannot be confined to any specific individual or group; it is not something that can be grasped or claimed by anyone exclusively.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां यावरी जेसें। क्षेत्र हें असे। तुज सांगों तैसें । साद्यंतु गा ॥ ७१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yāvarī jeseṃ| kṣetra heṃ ase| tuja sāṃgoṃ taiseṃ | sādyaṃtu gā || 719||
verses.meaning: Now, I will explain to you in detail, just as this field (body) is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि महाभूतपंचकु । आणि अहंकारु एकु । बुद्धि अव्यक्त दशकु । इंद्रियांचा ॥ ७२ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari mahābhūtapaṃcaku | āṇi ahaṃkāru eku | buddhi avyakta daśaku | iṃdriyāṃcā || 72 ||
verses.meaning: Then the five great elements, and ego, intellect, and the unmanifested, along with the ten senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मन आणीकही एकु । विषयांचा दशकु । सुख दुःख द्वेषु। संघात इच्छा ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mana āṇīkahī eku | viṣayāṃcā daśaku | sukha duḥkha dveṣu| saṃghāta icchā || 73||
verses.meaning: The mind is also one, the ten senses of perception and action, pleasure and pain, hatred, and the desire for association.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि चेतना धूृती। एवं क्षेत्रव्यक्‍्ती। सांगितली तुजप्रती। आघवीचि ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi cetanā dhūṛtī| evaṃ kṣetravyak‍tī| sāṃgitalī tujapratī| āghavīci || 74||
verses.meaning: And thus, the consciousness and the individual soul, along with the field of experience, have been fully explained to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां महाभूते कवणें । कवण विषयो कैसीं २७२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी करणें। हें वेगळाळेपणें । एकैक सांगों ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ mahābhūte kavaṇeṃ | kavaṇa viṣayo kaisīṃ 272 śrījñāneśvarī karaṇeṃ| heṃ vegaḻāḻepaṇeṃ | ekaika sāṃgoṃ || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Now, what are the great elements? What are their objects? How do they function? We shall explain each of these distinctly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पृथ्वी आप तेज। वायु व्योम इयें तुज। सांगितली बुझ। महाभूतें पांचें ॥ ७६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pṛthvī āpa teja| vāyu vyoma iyeṃ tuja| sāṃgitalī bujha| mahābhūteṃ pāṃceṃ || 76 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, earth, water, fire, air, and ether—these five great elements have been explained to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जागतिये दशे । स्वप्न लपालें असे । नातरी अंवसे । चंद्र गूढु ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jāgatiye daśe | svapna lapāleṃ ase | nātarī aṃvase | caṃdra gūḍhu || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as a dream is hidden in the waking state, or the moon is concealed on a new moon night.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना अप्रौढबाळकीं। तारुण्य राहे थोकीं। कां न फुलतां कळिकीं। आमोदु जैसा॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā aprauḍhabāḻakīṃ| tāruṇya rāhe thokīṃ| kāṃ na phulatāṃ kaḻikīṃ| āmodu jaisā|| 78||
verses.meaning: Just as the fragrance remains within the bud, not yet bloomed, so too does youth reside within an immature child.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना काष्ठीं। वन्हि जेबीं किरीटी। तेवीं प्रकृतीचिया पोटीं। गोप्यु जो असे॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā kāṣṭhīṃ| vanhi jebīṃ kirīṭī| tevīṃ prakṛtīciyā poṭīṃ| gopyu jo ase|| 79||
verses.meaning: Just as fire is hidden within wood, so too is the divine essence concealed within nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा ज्वरु धातुगतु। अपथ्याचें मिष पहातु। मग जालिया आंतु। बाहेरी व्यापी॥ ८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā jvaru dhātugatu| apathyāceṃ miṣa pahātu| maga jāliyā āṃtu| bāherī vyāpī|| 80||
verses.meaning: Just as a fever, having entered the body, seeks the pretext of improper diet, and then, having established itself within, spreads its affliction outwardly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी पांचांही गांठी पडे । जैं देहाकारु उघडे । तैं नाचवी चहूंकडे। तो अहंकारु गा॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī pāṃcāṃhī gāṃṭhī paḍe | jaiṃ dehākāru ughaḍe | taiṃ nācavī cahūṃkaḍe| to ahaṃkāru gā||81||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when the five elements unite and the body takes form, then that ego makes one dance in all directions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नवल अहंकाराची गोठी। बिशेषें न लगे अज्ञानापाठीं । सज्ञानाचे झोंबे कंठीं । नाना संकटीं नाचवी ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: navala ahaṃkārācī goṭhī| biśeṣeṃ na lage ajñānāpāṭhīṃ | sajñānāce jhoṃbe kaṃṭhīṃ | nānā saṃkaṭīṃ nācavī || 82||
verses.meaning: It is a wonder how ego, though not particularly clinging to the ignorant, seizes the neck of the wise and makes them dance through various troubles.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां बुद्धि जे म्हणिजे। ते ऐशिया चिन्हीं जाणिजे। बोलिले यदुराजें। तें आडके सांगों ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ buddhi je mhaṇije| te aiśiyā cinhīṃ jāṇije| bolile yadurājeṃ| teṃ āḍake sāṃgoṃ || 83||
verses.meaning: Now, what is called 'intellect' (buddhi) is known by these characteristics, which the Lord of Yadus (Krishna) has spoken of, and I will briefly explain them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी कंदर्पाचेनि बळें । इंद्रियवृत्तीचेनि मेळें । विभांडूनि येती पाळे। विषयांचे ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kaṃdarpāceni baḻeṃ | iṃdriyavṛttīceni meḻeṃ | vibhāṃḍūni yetī pāḻe| viṣayāṃce || 84||
verses.meaning: Yet, by the power of Cupid, and with the combined force of the senses, the branches of worldly pleasures come forth, breaking all bounds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो सुखदुःखांचा नागोवा। जेथ उगाणों लागे जीवा । तेथ दोहींसी बरवा । पाडु जे धरी॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: to sukhaduḥkhāṃcā nāgovā| jetha ugāṇoṃ lāge jīvā | tetha dohīṃsī baravā | pāḍu je dharī|| 85||
verses.meaning: Where the soul is caught in the entanglement of joy and sorrow, there it holds both in equal measure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें सुख हें दुःख हें पुण्य हें दोष। कां हें मैळ हें चोख । ऐसें जे निवडी ॥ ८६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ sukha heṃ duḥkha heṃ puṇya heṃ doṣa| kāṃ heṃ maiḻa heṃ cokha | aiseṃ je nivaḍī || 86 ||
verses.meaning: This is happiness, this is sorrow; this is merit, this is demerit; or this is impurity, this is purity—those who discern such distinctions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये अधमोत्तम सुझे । जिये सानें थोर बुझे। जिया दिठीं पारखिजे। विषो जीवें॥८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye adhamottama sujhe | jiye sāneṃ thora bujhe| jiyā diṭhīṃ pārakhije| viṣo jīveṃ||87||
verses.meaning: By which the lowliest and the highest are understood, by which the small and the great are comprehended, by which the essence of life is discerned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे तेजतत्त्वाची आदी। जे सत्त्वगुणाची वृद्धी। जे आत्मया जीवाची संधी । वसवीत असे जे॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: je tejatattvācī ādī| je sattvaguṇācī vṛddhī| je ātmayā jīvācī saṃdhī | vasavīta ase je|| 88||
verses.meaning: That which is the origin of the element of light, that which is the growth of the quality of sattva, that which establishes the union of the soul and the individual self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना ते गा जाण । बुद्धि तूं संपूर्ण । आतां आईकें 'बोळखण। अव्यक्‍्ताची॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā te gā jāṇa | buddhi tūṃ saṃpūrṇa | ātāṃ āīkeṃ 'boḻakhaṇa| avyak‍tācī|| 89||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, now listen carefully to the complete understanding of the Unmanifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सांख्यांचिया सिद्धांतीं। प्रकृती जे महामती । तेचि एथें प्रस्तुती । अव्यक्त गा॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ sāṃkhyāṃciyā siddhāṃtīṃ| prakṛtī je mahāmatī | teci etheṃ prastutī | avyakta gā|| 90||
verses.meaning: In the philosophy of Samkhya, that which is called Prakriti, the great intelligence, is here referred to as the Unmanifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सांख्ययोगमतें। प्रकृती परिसविली तूंतें। ऐसी दोहीं परी जेथें । विवंचिळी॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sāṃkhyayogamateṃ| prakṛtī parisavilī tūṃteṃ| aisī dohīṃ parī jetheṃ | vivaṃciḻī|| 91||
verses.meaning: And in this way, both the Sankhya and Yoga philosophies have explained Prakriti to you, thus elucidating it in two ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ दुजी जे जीवबदशा। तिये नांब वीरेशा। येथें अव्यक्त ऐसा। पर्यावबो हा॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha dujī je jīvabadaśā| tiye nāṃba vīreśā| yetheṃ avyakta aisā| paryāvabo hā||92||
verses.meaning: There, the second state, that of the embodied soul, O Lord of the brave, is here understood as the 'Unmanifest'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तऱही पाहालया रजनी । तारा लोपती गगनीं। कां हारपे अस्तमानीं । भूतक्रिया॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṟahī pāhālayā rajanī | tārā lopatī gaganīṃ| kāṃ hārape astamānīṃ | bhūtakriyā|| 93||
verses.meaning: Just as at dawn, the stars vanish from the sky, or as the activities of beings cease at sunset.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी देहो गेलिया पाठीं । देहादिक किरीटी। उपाधि लपे पोटीं। कृतकर्माच्या ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī deho geliyā pāṭhīṃ | dehādika kirīṭī| upādhi lape poṭīṃ| kṛtakarmācyā || 94||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, after the body perishes, the body and other limiting adjuncts, which are the result of past actions, remain hidden within the causal body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां बीजमुद्रेआंतु। थोके तरु समस्तु। कां वस्त्रपण तंतु-। दशे राहे॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bījamudreāṃtu| thoke taru samastu| kāṃ vastrapaṇa taṃtu-| daśe rāhe|| 95||
verses.meaning: Just as a mighty tree is contained within a tiny seed, or a complete garment exists in the state of threads.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सांडोनियां स्थूळधर्म। महाभूतें भूतग्राम।॥ लया जाती सूक्ष्म। होऊनि जेथें ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sāṃḍoniyāṃ sthūḻadharma| mahābhūteṃ bhūtagrāma||| layā jātī sūkṣma| hoūni jetheṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Just as the gross forms of the great elements and the multitude of beings dissolve into their subtle forms, so too do they ultimately merge into that from which they originated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना तया नांबें। अव्यक्त हें जाणावें । आतां आडके आघवे । इंद्रियभेद ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā tayā nāṃbeṃ| avyakta heṃ jāṇāveṃ | ātāṃ āḍake āghave | iṃdriyabheda || 97||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, know that this is the unmanifest. Now, all the distinctions of the senses are hindered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी श्रवण नयन त्वचा प्राण रसन। इयें जाणें ज्ञान। करणें पांचें॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī śravaṇa nayana tvacā prāṇa rasana| iyeṃ jāṇeṃ jñāna| karaṇeṃ pāṃceṃ|| 98||
verses.meaning: Thus, the ears, eyes, skin, breath (nose), and tongue—these five are known as the instruments of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें तत्त्वमेळापंकीं । सुखदुःखांची उखिविखी। बुद्धि करिते मुखीं। पांचें इहीं ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ tattvameḻāpaṃkīṃ | sukhaduḥkhāṃcī ukhivikhī| buddhi karite mukhīṃ| pāṃceṃ ihīṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: In this gathering of fundamental principles, the intellect, through these five senses, experiences the alternation of joy and sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वाचा आणि कर। चरण आणि अधोद्वार। पायु हे प्रकार । पांच आणिक ॥ ९००॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vācā āṇi kara| caraṇa āṇi adhodvāra| pāyu he prakāra | pāṃca āṇika || 900||
verses.meaning: Then the organs of speech, the hands, the feet, the lower orifices, and the anus—these are the five types of organs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्मेंद्रिये म्हणिपती। तीं इयें जाणिजती। आझऊकें कैवल्यपती । सांगतसे ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: karmeṃdriye mhaṇipatī| tīṃ iyeṃ jāṇijatī| ājhaūkeṃ kaivalyapatī | sāṃgatase || 1||
verses.meaning: These are known as the organs of action. The Lord of Kaivalya (liberation) further explains them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं प्राणाची अंतौरी। क्रियाशक्ति जे शरीरीं । तियेची रिगिनिगी द्वारीं । पांचें इहीं ॥ २ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ prāṇācī aṃtaurī| kriyāśakti je śarīrīṃ | tiyecī riginigī dvārīṃ | pāṃceṃ ihīṃ || 2 ||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the life force within, the very power of action in the body, through these five doors, it manifests its activity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं दाहाही करणें । सांगितली देवो म्हणे। परिस आतां फुडेपणें। मन तें ऐसें ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ dāhāhī karaṇeṃ | sāṃgitalī devo mhaṇe| parisa ātāṃ phuḍepaṇeṃ| mana teṃ aiseṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: Thus, the Lord says, I have described all ten senses. Now, listen further to the nature of the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें इंद्रियां आणि बुद्धी । माझारिल्िये संधीं। रजोगुणाच्या खांदीं । तरळत असे ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ iṃdriyāṃ āṇi buddhī | mājhāriliye saṃdhīṃ| rajoguṇācyā khāṃdīṃ | taraḻata ase || 4||
verses.meaning: When the senses and intellect, in the midst of their interaction, are carried away by the impulses of Rajas (the quality of activity and passion).

verses.shloka_devanagari: नीळिमा अंबरी । कां मृगतृष्णालहरी। तैसें बायांचि फरारी। वबाबो जाहळें॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nīḻimā aṃbarī | kāṃ mṛgatṛṣṇālaharī| taiseṃ bāyāṃci pharārī| vabābo jāhaḻeṃ||5||
verses.meaning: Like the blueness of the sky, or the waves of a mirage, so too is the fleeting nature of women's allure, which quickly fades away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि शुक्रशोणिताचा सांधा । मिळतां पांचांचा बांधा । वायुतत्त्व दशधा। एकचि जाहळलें॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi śukraśoṇitācā sāṃdhā | miḻatāṃ pāṃcāṃcā bāṃdhā | vāyutattva daśadhā| ekaci jāhaḻaleṃ|| 6||
verses.meaning: And when the union of semen and ovum occurred, forming the fivefold body, the ten-fold vital breath became one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तिहीं दाहे भागीं । देहधर्माच्या खैवंगीं । अधिष्ठिलें आंगीं । आपुलाल्या॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tihīṃ dāhe bhāgīṃ | dehadharmācyā khaivaṃgīṃ | adhiṣṭhileṃ āṃgīṃ | āpulālyā|| 7||
verses.meaning: Then, in those ten parts, in the various functions of the body, they established themselves, each in their own place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ चांचल्य निखळ। एकळलें ठेलें निढाळ। म्हणौनि रजाचें बळ। धरिले तेणें॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha cāṃcalya nikhaḻa| ekaḻaleṃ ṭheleṃ niḍhāḻa| mhaṇauni rajāceṃ baḻa| dharile teṇeṃ||8||
verses.meaning: There, restlessness, having been completely purified, became steadfast. Therefore, it assumed the power of Rajas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें बुद्धीसि बाहेरी । अहंकाराच्या उरावरी । ऐसा ठायीं माझारीं। बळियावलें॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ buddhīsi bāherī | ahaṃkārācyā urāvarī | aisā ṭhāyīṃ mājhārīṃ| baḻiyāvaleṃ|| 9||
verses.meaning: It is beyond the intellect, upon the chest of ego, in such a place within, that it has grown strong.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वायां मन हें नांव। एऱ्हवीं कल्पनाचि सावेव। जयाचेनि संगें जीब-। दशा वस्तु॥११०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāyāṃ mana heṃ nāṃva| eṟhavīṃ kalpanāci sāveva| jayāceni saṃgeṃ jība-| daśā vastu||110||
verses.meaning: The mind is merely a name; in reality, it is a collection of thoughts and imaginations. It is through the mind's association that the true Self appears to be in the state of an individual soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें प्रवृत्तीसि मूळ। कामा जयाचें बळ। जें अखंड सूये छळ । अहंकारासी ॥११॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ pravṛttīsi mūḻa| kāmā jayāceṃ baḻa| jeṃ akhaṃḍa sūye chaḻa | ahaṃkārāsī ||11||
verses.meaning: That which is the root of all worldly activity, whose strength is desire, and which constantly gives rise to the torment of ego.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें इच्छेतें बाढवी । आशेतें चढवी। जें पाठी पुरवी । भयासि गा॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ iccheteṃ bāḍhavī | āśeteṃ caḍhavī| jeṃ pāṭhī puravī | bhayāsi gā|| 12||
verses.meaning: That which increases desire, inflames hope, and supports fear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: द्वैत जेथें उठी। अविद्या जेणें लाठी । जें इंद्रियांतें लोटी । विषयांमाजीं ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: dvaita jetheṃ uṭhī| avidyā jeṇeṃ lāṭhī | jeṃ iṃdriyāṃteṃ loṭī | viṣayāṃmājīṃ || 13||
verses.meaning: Where duality arises, where ignorance is strong, which pushes the senses into worldly objects.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संकल्पें सृष्टी घडी । सवेंचि विकल्पूनि मोडी । मनोरथांच्या उतरंडी । उतरी रची॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃkalpeṃ sṛṣṭī ghaḍī | saveṃci vikalpūni moḍī | manorathāṃcyā utaraṃḍī | utarī racī|| 14||
verses.meaning: With a mere thought, He creates the universe, and with that same thought, He dissolves it. He builds and dismantles the stacks of desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें भुलीचें कुहर। वायुतत्त्वाचें अंतर । बुद्धीचें द्वार। झांकविलें जेणें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ bhulīceṃ kuhara| vāyutattvāceṃ aṃtara | buddhīceṃ dvāra| jhāṃkavileṃ jeṇeṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: That which covers the cave of delusion, the inner space of the air element, and the door of the intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें गा किरीटी मन। या बोला नाहीं आन । आतां विषयाभिधान-। भेदु आइकें ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ gā kirīṭī mana| yā bolā nāhīṃ āna | ātāṃ viṣayābhidhāna-| bhedu āikeṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, there is no other meaning to this statement. Now, listen to the distinction of the names of the sense objects.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी स्पर्श्‌ आणि शब्दु। रूप रस गंधु। हा विषयो पंचविधु । ज्ञानेंद्रियांचा ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sparś‌ āṇi śabdu| rūpa rasa gaṃdhu| hā viṣayo paṃcavidhu | jñāneṃdriyāṃcā || 97||
verses.meaning: Thus, touch, sound, form, taste, and smell—these five types of objects are perceived by the sense organs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहीं पांचै द्वारीं । ज्ञानासि धांब बाहेरी । जैसा कां हिरवे चारीं। भांबावे पशु॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃ pāṃcai dvārīṃ | jñānāsi dhāṃba bāherī | jaisā kāṃ hirave cārīṃ| bhāṃbāve paśu|| 18||
verses.meaning: Through these five doors (senses), knowledge rushes out, just as a bewildered animal wanders into green pastures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग स्वर वर्ण विसर्गु।) अथवा स्वीकार त्यागु। संक्रमण उत्सर्गु। विण्मूत्राचा॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga svara varṇa visargu|) athavā svīkāra tyāgu| saṃkramaṇa utsargu| viṇmūtrācā|| 99||
verses.meaning: Then, just as the body naturally discards waste like feces and urine without effort, so too should one naturally let go of or accept the sounds and letters of speech, without attachment or aversion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे कर्मेद्रियांचे पांच । विषय गा साच। जे बांधोनियां माच । क्रिया धांवे॥ १२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he karmedriyāṃce pāṃca | viṣaya gā sāca| je bāṃdhoniyāṃ māca | kriyā dhāṃve|| 120||
verses.meaning: These five objects of the organs of action, indeed, are like a stage upon which the actions perform their dance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे हे दाही । विषय गा इये देहीं। आतां इच्छा तेही। सांगिजेळ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise he dāhī | viṣaya gā iye dehīṃ| ātāṃ icchā tehī| sāṃgijeḻa|| 21||
verses.meaning: Thus, these ten sense objects are present in the body; now, the desire for them will also be explained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि भूतलें २७४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आठवे। कां बोलें कान झांकावे। ऐसियावरि चेतवे। जे गा वृत्ती॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari bhūtaleṃ 274 śrījñāneśvarī āṭhave| kāṃ boleṃ kāna jhāṃkāve| aisiyāvari cetave| je gā vṛttī|| 22||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the Dnyaneshwari should be remembered, or one should cover their ears with their hands, for such is the nature of the mind that it becomes alert and attentive to these words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियाविषयांचिये भेटी-। सरसीच जे गा उठी। कामाची बाहुटी। धरूनियां॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyāviṣayāṃciye bheṭī-| sarasīca je gā uṭhī| kāmācī bāhuṭī| dharūniyāṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: As soon as the senses encounter their objects, desire immediately arises, taking hold like a banner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जियेचेनि उठिलेपणें। मना सैंघ धांवबणें । न रिगावें तेथ करणें। तोंडें सुती॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiyeceni uṭhilepaṇeṃ| manā saiṃgha dhāṃvabaṇeṃ | na rigāveṃ tetha karaṇeṃ| toṃḍeṃ sutī|| 24||
verses.meaning: That which, by its mere arising, causes the mind to run wild in all directions, one should not enter there, but rather remain silent with one's mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये वृत्तीचिया आवडी । बुद्धी होय वेडी । विषयां जिया गोडी | ते गा इच्छा ॥ २५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye vṛttīciyā āvaḍī | buddhī hoya veḍī | viṣayāṃ jiyā goḍī | te gā icchā || 25 ||
verses.meaning: That inclination, for whose sake the intellect becomes deluded, and through which objects of the senses become desirable, is indeed called desire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि इच्छिलिया सांगडें । इंद्रियां आमिष न जोडे । तेथ जोडें ऐसा जो डावो पडे । तोचि द्वेषु॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi icchiliyā sāṃgaḍeṃ | iṃdriyāṃ āmiṣa na joḍe | tetha joḍeṃ aisā jo ḍāvo paḍe | toci dveṣu|| 26||
verses.meaning: And when the senses do not find satisfaction in what they desire, then whatever action arises from that dissatisfaction is indeed hatred.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां यावरी सुख तें एवंविध देख। जेणें एकेंचि अशेख। विसरे जीवु॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yāvarī sukha teṃ evaṃvidha dekha| jeṇeṃ ekeṃci aśekha| visare jīvu|| 27||
verses.meaning: Now, the joy that follows is of such a nature that by it alone, the entire individual soul forgets itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मना वाचे काये। जें आपुली आण वाये। देहस्मृतीची त्राये। मोडित जें ये॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: manā vāce kāye| jeṃ āpulī āṇa vāye| dehasmṛtīcī trāye| moḍita jeṃ ye|| 28||
verses.meaning: That which, by thought, word, and deed, takes an oath upon itself, and thereby breaks the hold of body-consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचेनि जाळेपणें। पांगुळा होइजे प्राणें । सात्त्विकासी दुणें-। वबरीही लाभु॥२९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceni jāḻepaṇeṃ| pāṃguḻā hoije prāṇeṃ | sāttvikāsī duṇeṃ-| vabarīhī lābhu||29||
verses.meaning: Through whose mere existence, the very life-force becomes crippled, yet for the virtuous, this brings a double benefit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां आधवियाचि इंद्रियवृत्ती। हृदयाचिया एकांती । थापटूनि सुषुप्ती। आणी जें गा॥ १३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ādhaviyāci iṃdriyavṛttī| hṛdayāciyā ekāṃtī | thāpaṭūni suṣuptī| āṇī jeṃ gā|| 130||
verses.meaning: Or, by lulling all the senses' tendencies in the solitude of the heart, it brings about deep sleep.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना सोये। जीव आत्मयाची लाहे। तेथ जें होये। तया नाम सुख॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā soye| jīva ātmayācī lāhe| tetha jeṃ hoye| tayā nāma sukha|| 31||
verses.meaning: When the individual soul attains the Self, the experience that arises is called bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ऐसी हे अवस्था। न जोडतां पार्था। जे जीजे तेंचि सर्वथा । दुःख जाणें॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi aisī he avasthā| na joḍatāṃ pārthā| je jīje teṃci sarvathā | duḥkha jāṇeṃ|| 32||
verses.meaning: And such a state, O Partha, if not attained, whatever exists is indeed sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें मनोरथसंगें नव्हे। एऱहवी सिद्धि गेळेंचि आहे। हे दोनीचि उपाये। सुखदुःखासी ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ manorathasaṃgeṃ navhe| eṟahavī siddhi geḻeṃci āhe| he donīci upāye| sukhaduḥkhāsī || 33||
verses.meaning: It is not by the association of desires; otherwise, success is already achieved. These two alone are the means to happiness and sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां असंगा साक्षिभूता । देहीं चैतन्याची जे सत्ता । तिये नाम पंडुसुता । चेतना येथें॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ asaṃgā sākṣibhūtā | dehīṃ caitanyācī je sattā | tiye nāma paṃḍusutā | cetanā yetheṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: Now, O son of Pandu, the consciousness that is the witness in the body, that is called 'chetana' here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे नखौनि केशवरी। उभी जागे शरीरीं । जे तिहीं अवस्थांतरीं । 'पालटेना ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: je nakhauni keśavarī| ubhī jāge śarīrīṃ | je tihīṃ avasthāṃtarīṃ | 'pālaṭenā || 35||
verses.meaning: That which, from the tip of the nail to the hair, stands awake in the body, and which does not change through the three states of consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मनबुद्धयादि आघवीं । जियेचेनि टवटवीं । प्रकृतिवनमाधवी । सदाचि जे॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: manabuddhayādi āghavīṃ | jiyeceni ṭavaṭavīṃ | prakṛtivanamādhavī | sadāci je|| 36||
verses.meaning: The mind, intellect, and all else, by whose freshness and vibrancy, the spring of the forest of nature is ever present.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जडाजडीं अंशीं । राहाटे जे सरिसी। ते चेतना गा तुजसी । लटिकें नाहीं ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaḍājaḍīṃ aṃśīṃ | rāhāṭe je sarisī| te cetanā gā tujasī | laṭikeṃ nāhīṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: Amongst the inert, that which moves equally, that consciousness is indeed You; there is no falsehood in this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं रावो परिवारु नेणे। आज्ञाचि परचक्र जिणे । कां चंद्राचेनि पूर्णपणें । सिंधू भरती ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ rāvo parivāru neṇe| ājñāci paracakra jiṇe | kāṃ caṃdrāceni pūrṇapaṇeṃ | siṃdhū bharatī || 38||
verses.meaning: Just as a king does not need to personally fight, but his command conquers enemy forces, or as the full moon causes the oceans to swell.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना भ्रामकाचें सन्निधान। लोहो करी सचेतन। कां सूर्यसंगु जन। चेष्टवी गा॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā bhrāmakāceṃ sannidhāna| loho karī sacetana| kāṃ sūryasaṃgu jana| ceṣṭavī gā|| 39||
verses.meaning: Just as the proximity of a magnet makes iron appear alive, or the presence of the sun makes people active, so too does the divine presence animate everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा मुखमेळेंबीण । पिलियाचें पोषण। करी निरीक्षण । कूर्मी जेवीं ॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā mukhameḻeṃbīṇa | piliyāceṃ poṣaṇa| karī nirīkṣaṇa | kūrmī jevīṃ || 140||
verses.meaning: Just as a tortoise nourishes its young simply by looking at them, without any physical contact.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्था तियापरी । आत्मसंगती इये शरीरीं । सजीवत्वाचा करी । उपेगु जडा॥ ४१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārthā tiyāparī | ātmasaṃgatī iye śarīrīṃ | sajīvatvācā karī | upegu jaḍā|| 419||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, in this way, through the association of the Self with this body, the inert becomes enlivened.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तियेतें चेतना । म्हणिपे पैं अर्जुना । आतां धृतिविवंचना-। भेदु आइक ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tiyeteṃ cetanā | mhaṇipe paiṃ arjunā | ātāṃ dhṛtivivaṃcanā-| bhedu āika || 42||
verses.meaning: Then, Arjuna, listen to the distinction of fortitude, which is called consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी भूतां परस्परें। उघड जाति स्वभावबेरें । नव्हे पृथ्बीतें नीरें। न नाशिजे ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī bhūtāṃ paraspareṃ| ughaḍa jāti svabhāvabereṃ | navhe pṛthbīteṃ nīreṃ| na nāśije || 43 ||
verses.meaning: Just as water does not destroy the earth, so too, beings, by their very nature, do not destroy each other.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नीरातें आटी तेज। तेजा वायूसिं झुंज। आणि गगन तंव सहज। वायू भक्षी॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nīrāteṃ āṭī teja| tejā vāyūsiṃ jhuṃja| āṇi gagana taṃva sahaja| vāyū bhakṣī|| 44||
verses.meaning: The fire consumes the water, the wind battles the fire, and the sky effortlessly devours the wind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि कोणेही वेळे। आपण कायिसयाही न मिळे। आंत रिगोनि वेगळें। आकाश हें॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci koṇehī veḻe| āpaṇa kāyisayāhī na miḻe| āṃta rigoni vegaḻeṃ| ākāśa heṃ|| 45||
verses.meaning: Similarly, at no time does the sky, by entering into anything, become separate from itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसीं पांचही भूतें। न साहती एकमेकांतें। कीं तियेंही ऐक्यातें । देहासी येती ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisīṃ pāṃcahī bhūteṃ| na sāhatī ekamekāṃteṃ| kīṃ tiyeṃhī aikyāteṃ | dehāsī yetī || 46||
verses.meaning: Though these five elements cannot tolerate each other, they still come together to form the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: द्वंद्राची उख्िविखी । सोडूनि बसती एकीं। एकेकातें पोखी। निजगुणें गा॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dvaṃdrācī ukhivikhī | soḍūni basatī ekīṃ| ekekāteṃ pokhī| nijaguṇeṃ gā|| 47||
verses.meaning: Abandoning the conflict of dualities, they settle into oneness. Each nourishes the other with its inherent qualities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें न मिळे तयां साजणें । चळे धेर्ये जेणें । तयां नांव म्हणें । धृती मी गा॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ na miḻe tayāṃ sājaṇeṃ | caḻe dherye jeṇeṃ | tayāṃ nāṃva mhaṇeṃ | dhṛtī mī gā|| 48 ||
verses.meaning: When such a companion is not found, and one's resolve wavers, then I am called that very steadfastness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जीवेंसी पांडवा। या छत्तिसांचा मेळावा। तो हा एथ जाणावा । संघातु पैं गा॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jīveṃsī pāṃḍavā| yā chattisāṃcā meḻāvā| to hā etha jāṇāvā | saṃghātu paiṃ gā|| 49||
verses.meaning: And O Pandava, know that the gathering of these thirty-six principles is indeed this very 'sanghat' (aggregate/collection) here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं छत्तीसही भेद। सांगितले तुज विशद। यया येतुलेयातें प्रसिद्ध । क्षेत्र म्हिणिजे॥ १५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ chattīsahī bheda| sāṃgitale tuja viśada| yayā yetuleyāteṃ prasiddha | kṣetra mhiṇije|| 150||
verses.meaning: Thus, all these thirty-six distinctions have been clearly explained to you. All of this, in its entirety, is known as the 'Field' (Kshetra).

verses.shloka_devanagari: रथांगांचा मेळावा। जेवीं रथु म्हणिजे पांडवा । कां अधोर्ध्व अवेबां । नांब देहो ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: rathāṃgāṃcā meḻāvā| jevīṃ rathu mhaṇije pāṃḍavā | kāṃ adhordhva avebāṃ | nāṃba deho || 51||
verses.meaning: Just as a collection of chariot parts is called a chariot, O Pandava, or a collection of upper and lower limbs is called a body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: करीतुरंगसमाजें । सेना नाम निफजे। कां वाक्यें म्हिणिजती पुंजे। अक्षरांचे ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: karīturaṃgasamājeṃ | senā nāma niphaje| kāṃ vākyeṃ mhiṇijatī puṃje| akṣarāṃce || 52||
verses.meaning: Just as a collection of elephants is called an army, or a collection of letters is called a sentence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जळधरांचा मेळा । वाच्य होय आभाळा । नाना लोकां सकळां। नाम जग॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jaḻadharāṃcā meḻā | vācya hoya ābhāḻā | nānā lokāṃ sakaḻāṃ| nāma jaga||53||
verses.meaning: Just as a gathering of clouds is called the sky, so too, the multitude of people is called the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां स्नेहसूत्रवन्ही। मेळु एकिचि स्थानीं। धरिजे तो जनीं। दीपु होय॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ snehasūtravanhī| meḻu ekici sthānīṃ| dharije to janīṃ| dīpu hoya|| 54||
verses.meaning: Just as a wick and oil, when brought together in one place, become a lamp for people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं छत्तीसही इयें तत्त्वें । मिळतीं जेणें एकत्बें। तेणें समूहपरत्वें । क्षेत्र म्हणिपे॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ chattīsahī iyeṃ tattveṃ | miḻatīṃ jeṇeṃ ekatbeṃ| teṇeṃ samūhaparatveṃ | kṣetra mhaṇipe|| 55||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when these thirty-six principles unite into a single entity, that collective whole is called the 'field'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि वाहतेनि भौतिकें । पाप पुण्य येथें पिके । म्हणौनि आम्ही कौतुकें। क्षेत्र म्हणों ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi vāhateni bhautikeṃ | pāpa puṇya yetheṃ pike | mhaṇauni āmhī kautukeṃ| kṣetra mhaṇoṃ || 56||
verses.meaning: And by the actions of the physical body, both merit and demerit ripen here. Therefore, we affectionately call this a field of action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि एकाचेनि मतें। देह म्हणती ययातें। परि असो हें अनंतें॥ नामें यया॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ekāceni mateṃ| deha mhaṇatī yayāteṃ| pari aso heṃ anaṃteṃ|| nāmeṃ yayā|| 57||
verses.meaning: And according to some, they call this the body. But let these be its endless names.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं परतत्त्वाआरोतें। स्थावराआंतोौतें। जें कांहीं होतें जातें । क्षेत्रचि हें ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ paratattvāāroteṃ| sthāvarāāṃtoauteṃ| jeṃ kāṃhīṃ hoteṃ jāteṃ | kṣetraci heṃ || 58 ||
verses.meaning: From the supreme principle down to the inert, whatever comes into being and passes away, all of this is indeed the 'field' (Kshetra).

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि सुरनरऊरगीं। घडत आहे योनिविभागीं। तें गुणकर्मसंगीं। पडिलें सातें ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari suranaraūragīṃ| ghaḍata āhe yonivibhāgīṃ| teṃ guṇakarmasaṃgīṃ| paḍileṃ sāteṃ ||59||
verses.meaning: However, among gods, humans, and serpents, in the divisions of species, it is due to attachment to qualities and actions that they are entangled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेचि गुणविवंचना। पुढां म्हणिपैल अर्जुना। प्रस्तुत आतां तुज ज्ञाना। रूप दावूं ॥ १६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heci guṇavivaṃcanā| puḍhāṃ mhaṇipaila arjunā| prastuta ātāṃ tuja jñānā| rūpa dāvūṃ || 160||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, this analysis of qualities will be explained further. For now, I will reveal to you the true nature of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्षेत्र तंव सविस्तर। सांगितळें सविकार। म्हणौनि आतां उदार। ज्ञान आइकें ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṣetra taṃva savistara| sāṃgitaḻeṃ savikāra| mhaṇauni ātāṃ udāra| jñāna āikeṃ || 61||
verses.meaning: The field (kshetra) has been elaborately described, along with its modifications. Therefore, now listen to the profound knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया ज्ञानालागीं। गगन गिळिताती योगी । स्वर्गाची आडवंगी। उमरडोनि॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā jñānālāgīṃ| gagana giḻitātī yogī | svargācī āḍavaṃgī| umaraḍoni|| 62||
verses.meaning: For the sake of that knowledge, yogis swallow the sky, transcending the obstacles of heaven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न करिती सिद्धीची चाड। न धरिती क्रवद्धीची भीड। योगाऐसें दुवाड। हेळसिती॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: na karitī siddhīcī cāḍa| na dharitī kravaddhīcī bhīḍa| yogāaiseṃ duvāḍa| heḻasitī|| 63||
verses.meaning: They do not crave for spiritual attainments, nor do they fear the difficulties of the path. They even disdain the arduous practice of Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तपोदुर्गे बोलांडित। क्रल्तुकोटि बोवांडित । उलथूनि सांडित। कर्मवल्ली ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tapodurge bolāṃḍita| kraltukoṭi bovāṃḍita | ulathūni sāṃḍita| karmavallī || 64||
verses.meaning: Overcoming the fortress of austerities, trampling millions of sacrifices, uprooting and casting aside the creeper of karma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना भजनमार्गी । धांबत उघडिया आंगीं । एक रिगताती सुरंगीं। सुषुम्नेचिये ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā bhajanamārgī | dhāṃbata ughaḍiyā āṃgīṃ | eka rigatātī suraṃgīṃ| suṣumneciye || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Many, on the path of devotion, run with open bodies, while some enter the beautiful Sushumna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी जिये ज्ञानीं। मुनीश्वरांची उतान्ही। वेदतरूच्या पानोबानीं। हिंडताती॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī jiye jñānīṃ| munīśvarāṃcī utānhī| vedatarūcyā pānobānīṃ| hiṃḍatātī|| 66||
verses.meaning: Such enlightened ones, the great sages, wander through the leaves of the Veda-tree.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देईल गुरुसेवा । इया बुद्धि पांडवा । जन्मशतांचा सांडोवा । टाकित जे॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: deīla gurusevā | iyā buddhi pāṃḍavā | janmaśatāṃcā sāṃḍovā | ṭākita je|| 67||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, those who dedicate themselves to the service of the Guru, with this understanding, cast off the burden of hundreds of births.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया ज्ञानाची रिगवणी। अविद्ये उणें आणी । जीवा आत्मया बुझावणी । २७६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी मांडूनि दे॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā jñānācī rigavaṇī| avidye uṇeṃ āṇī | jīvā ātmayā bujhāvaṇī | 276 śrījñāneśvarī māṃḍūni de|| 68||
verses.meaning: The knowledge that diminishes ignorance and enlightens the soul and the Self, that is what Shri Dnyaneshwari bestows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें इंद्रियांची द्वारे आडी । प्रवृत्तीचे पाय मोडी । जें दैन्यचि फेडी । मानसाचे ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ iṃdriyāṃcī dvāre āḍī | pravṛttīce pāya moḍī | jeṃ dainyaci pheḍī | mānasāce || 69||
verses.meaning: That which obstructs the doors of the senses, breaks the feet of worldly प्रवृत्ति (tendencies), and removes the poverty of the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: द्वैताचा दुकाळु पाहे । साम्याचें सुयाणें होये । जया ज्ञानाची सोये। ऐसें करी ॥ १७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: dvaitācā dukāḻu pāhe | sāmyāceṃ suyāṇeṃ hoye | jayā jñānācī soye| aiseṃ karī || 170||
verses.meaning: When the famine of duality ends, and the harvest of oneness appears, then such knowledge is attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मदाचा ठावोचि पुसी । जें महामोहातें ग्रासी। नेदी आपपरु ऐसी । भाष उरों॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: madācā ṭhāvoci pusī | jeṃ mahāmohāteṃ grāsī| nedī āpaparu aisī | bhāṣa uroṃ||71||
verses.meaning: It completely eradicates the very root of pride, devours the greatest delusion, and does not allow any distinction of 'mine' or 'yours' to remain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें संसारातें उन्मूळी । संकल्पपंकु पाखाळी । अनावरातें वेंटाळी । ज्ञेयातें जें ॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ saṃsārāteṃ unmūḻī | saṃkalpapaṃku pākhāḻī | anāvarāteṃ veṃṭāḻī | jñeyāteṃ jeṃ ||72||
verses.meaning: That which uproots worldly existence, washes away the mire of desires, embraces the uncontrollable, and is itself the knowable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचेनि जालेपणें। पांगुळा होइजे प्राणें। जयाचेनि विंदाणें। जग हें चेष्टें॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceni jālepaṇeṃ| pāṃguḻā hoije prāṇeṃ| jayāceni viṃdāṇeṃ| jaga heṃ ceṣṭeṃ|| 73||
verses.meaning: By whose very existence the soul becomes lame (inactive), and by whose mere presence this world becomes active.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचेनि उजाळें। उघडती बुद्धीचे डोळे। जीवु दोंदावरी लोळे । आनंदाचिया॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceni ujāḻeṃ| ughaḍatī buddhīce ḍoḻe| jīvu doṃdāvarī loḻe | ānaṃdāciyā|| 74||
verses.meaning: By whose radiance, the eyes of intellect open, and the soul revels in the embrace of bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जें ज्ञान। पवित्रेकनिधान। जेथ विटाळळें मन। चोख कौजे॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jeṃ jñāna| pavitrekanidhāna| jetha viṭāḻaḻeṃ mana| cokha kauje|| 75||
verses.meaning: Such knowledge is a treasure of purity, where the defiled mind becomes pure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आत्मया जीवबुद्धी। जे लागली होती क्षयव्याधी। ते जयाचिये सन्निधी। निरुजा कीजे॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātmayā jīvabuddhī| je lāgalī hotī kṣayavyādhī| te jayāciye sannidhī| nirujā kīje|| 76||
verses.meaning: The disease of identifying the Self with the individual soul, which had afflicted it, is cured in His presence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अनिरूप्य कों निरूपिजे। ऐकतां बुद्धी आणिजे । वांचूनि डोळां देखिजे । ऐसें नाहीं ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ anirūpya koṃ nirūpije| aikatāṃ buddhī āṇije | vāṃcūni ḍoḻāṃ dekhije | aiseṃ nāhīṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: How can that which is formless be described? It can only be understood by the intellect upon hearing, not seen with the eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेंचि इये शरीरीं। जें आपुला प्रभावो करी । तैं इंद्रियांचिया व्यापारीं। डोळांहि दिसे॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga teṃci iye śarīrīṃ| jeṃ āpulā prabhāvo karī | taiṃ iṃdriyāṃciyā vyāpārīṃ| ḍoḻāṃhi dise|| 78||
verses.meaning: Then, that very same (divine power) which manifests its influence in this body, becomes visible even to the eyes through the activities of the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं वसंताचें रिगवणें। झाडांचेनि साजेपणें। जाणिजे तेवीं करणें । सांगती ज्ञान ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ vasaṃtāceṃ rigavaṇeṃ| jhāḍāṃceni sājepaṇeṃ| jāṇije tevīṃ karaṇeṃ | sāṃgatī jñāna || 79||
verses.meaning: Just as the arrival of spring is known by the beauty of the trees, so too is knowledge revealed through actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा वृक्षासि पाताळीं। जळ सांपडे मुळीं । तें शाखांचिये बाहाळीं। बाहेर दिसे॥ १८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā vṛkṣāsi pātāḻīṃ| jaḻa sāṃpaḍe muḻīṃ | teṃ śākhāṃciye bāhāḻīṃ| bāhera dise|| 180||
verses.meaning: Just as the roots of a tree find water deep underground, yet its effect is seen in the blossoming branches.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां भूमीचें मार्दव । सांगे कोंभाची लवलव।॥ नाना आचार गौरव। सुकुलीनाचें ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bhūmīceṃ mārdava | sāṃge koṃbhācī lavalava||| nānā ācāra gaurava| sukulīnāceṃ || 81||
verses.meaning: Just as the softness of the earth is revealed by the tender sprout, so too is the nobility of a good family shown by its virtuous conduct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा संभ्रमाचिया आयती। स्त्रेहो जैसा ये व्यक्‍ती। कां दर्शनाचिये प्रशस्ती । पुण्यपुरुष ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā saṃbhramāciyā āyatī| streho jaisā ye vyak‍tī| kāṃ darśanāciye praśastī | puṇyapuruṣa || 82||
verses.meaning: Or, just as love manifests itself through confusion, so too does a virtuous person manifest through the excellence of their vision.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी केळीं कापूर जाहला । जेवीं परिमळें जाणों आला । कौं भिंगारीं दीपु ठेविला । बाहेरि फांके ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī keḻīṃ kāpūra jāhalā | jevīṃ parimaḻeṃ jāṇoṃ ālā | kauṃ bhiṃgārīṃ dīpu ṭhevilā | bāheri phāṃke || 83||
verses.meaning: Or like a banana tree that has turned into camphor, its fragrance revealing its presence. Or like a lamp placed inside a bhringari (a type of container), its light still spreads outwards.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें हृदयींचेनि ज्ञानें । जिये देहीं उमटती चिन्हें । तियें सांगों आतां अवधानें। चांगें आइक ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ hṛdayīṃceni jñāneṃ | jiye dehīṃ umaṭatī cinheṃ | tiyeṃ sāṃgoṃ ātāṃ avadhāneṃ| cāṃgeṃ āika || 84||
verses.meaning: Just as the signs that manifest in the body due to the knowledge within the heart, I will now tell you about them, so listen carefully.

verses.shloka_devanagari: | तरी कवणेही विषयींचें। साम्य होणें न रुचे। संभावितपणाचें । बोझें जया॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: | tarī kavaṇehī viṣayīṃceṃ| sāmya hoṇeṃ na ruce| saṃbhāvitapaṇāceṃ | bojheṃ jayā|| 85||
verses.meaning: However, to those who bear the burden of their own perceived importance, equality in any matter is not pleasing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधथिलेचि गुण वानितां। मान्यपणें मानितां। योग्यतेचें येतां । रूप आंगा॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhathileci guṇa vānitāṃ| mānyapaṇeṃ mānitāṃ| yogyateceṃ yetāṃ | rūpa āṃgā|| 86||
verses.meaning: When the inherent qualities are described, and accepted with reverence, the very form of worthiness manifests in one's being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैं गजबजों लागे कैसा । व्याधें रुंधला मृगु जैसा । कां बाहीं तरतां बळसा। दाटला जेवीं ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiṃ gajabajoṃ lāge kaisā | vyādheṃ ruṃdhalā mṛgu jaisā | kāṃ bāhīṃ taratāṃ baḻasā| dāṭalā jevīṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: How it began to be agitated, like a deer trapped by a hunter, or like a whirlpool that forms when one tries to swim with arms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्था तेणें पाडें। सन्मानें जो सांकडें। गरिमेतें आंगाकडे। येवोंचि नेदी॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārthā teṇeṃ pāḍeṃ| sanmāneṃ jo sāṃkaḍeṃ| garimeteṃ āṃgākaḍe| yevoṃci nedī|| 88||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, in that way, he does not allow honor and greatness to come to him, even in difficult situations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पूज्यता डोळां न देखावी। स्वकीर्ती कानीं नायकावी। हा अमुका ऐसी नोहावी। सेचि 'लोकां॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pūjyatā ḍoḻāṃ na dekhāvī| svakīrtī kānīṃ nāyakāvī| hā amukā aisī nohāvī| seci 'lokāṃ|| 89||
verses.meaning: One should not see one's own worship with their eyes, nor hear their own praise with their ears. One should not be known among people as 'this is so and so'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सत्काराची कें गोठी। कें आदरा देईल भेटी । मरणेसीं साटी । नमस्कारितां ॥ १९० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha satkārācī keṃ goṭhī| keṃ ādarā deīla bheṭī | maraṇesīṃ sāṭī | namaskāritāṃ || 190 ||
verses.meaning: Where then is the talk of honor? Where will respect meet him? It is a bargain with death, just to bow down.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वाचस्पतीचेनि पाडें। सर्वज्ञता तरी जोडे । परि वेडिवेमाजीं दडे। महिमेभेणें ॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: vācaspatīceni pāḍeṃ| sarvajñatā tarī joḍe | pari veḍivemājīṃ daḍe| mahimebheṇeṃ ||91||
verses.meaning: Even if one attains omniscience comparable to Brihaspati, it hides itself in foolishness, fearing its own glory.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चातुर्य लपवी। महत्त्व हारवी। पिसेपण मिरवी। आवडोनि॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: cāturya lapavī| mahattva hāravī| pisepaṇa miravī| āvaḍoni|| 92||
verses.meaning: It conceals cleverness, diminishes importance, and proudly displays foolishness, out of love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लौकिकाचा उद्देगु। शास्त्रांवरी उबगु। उगेपणीं चांगु) आथी भरु ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: laukikācā uddegu| śāstrāṃvarī ubagu| ugepaṇīṃ cāṃgu) āthī bharu || 93||
verses.meaning: The purpose of worldly life, the weariness of scriptures, and the goodness of silence, all have their own significance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जगें अवज्ञाचि करावी । संबंधीं सोयचि न धरावबी। ऐसी ऐसी जीवीं। चाड बहु॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jageṃ avajñāci karāvī | saṃbaṃdhīṃ soyaci na dharāvabī| aisī aisī jīvīṃ| cāḍa bahu|| 94||
verses.meaning: One should indeed disregard the world, and not hold any affection for relationships; such a strong desire is within the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तळौटेपण बाणे। आंगीं हिणावो खेंबणें। तें तेंचि करणें।॥ बहुतकरूनी॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taḻauṭepaṇa bāṇe| āṃgīṃ hiṇāvo kheṃbaṇeṃ| teṃ teṃci karaṇeṃ||| bahutakarūnī|| 95||
verses.meaning: To be humble, to embrace one's flaws, and to act accordingly, is indeed the essence of true conduct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा जीतु ना नोहे । लोक कल्पी येणें भावें । तैसें जिणें होआवें। ऐसी आशा ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā jītu nā nohe | loka kalpī yeṇeṃ bhāveṃ | taiseṃ jiṇeṃ hoāveṃ| aisī āśā || 96||
verses.meaning: People imagine that this is not a victory, but rather a life that should be lived with such hope.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं चालतु कां नोहे। कीं वारेनि जातु आहे। जना ऐसा भ्रमु जाये । तैसें होईजे ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ cālatu kāṃ nohe| kīṃ vāreni jātu āhe| janā aisā bhramu jāye | taiseṃ hoīje || 97||
verses.meaning: Just as people are deluded into thinking that a moving cloud is the moon itself, or that the wind is carrying the moon, so too does the true nature of the Self remain obscured by such illusions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझें असतेपण लोपो। नामरूप हारपो। मज झणें वासिपो। भूतजात ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheṃ asatepaṇa lopo| nāmarūpa hārapo| maja jhaṇeṃ vāsipo| bhūtajāta || 98 ||
verses.meaning: My existence would vanish, my name and form would be lost. Let no creature dwell in me then.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी जयाचीं नवसियें।॥ जो नित्य एकांता जातु जाये। नामेंचि जो जिये । विजनाचेनि॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī jayācīṃ navasiyeṃ||| jo nitya ekāṃtā jātu jāye| nāmeṃci jo jiye | vijanāceni|| 99||
verses.meaning: Such is the one whose vows are fulfilled, who constantly seeks solitude, and who lives by the very name of the wilderness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वायू आणि तया पडे। गगनेंसीं बोलों आवडे । जीवें प्राणें झाडें । पढियंतीं जया॥ २००॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāyū āṇi tayā paḍe| gaganeṃsīṃ boloṃ āvaḍe | jīveṃ prāṇeṃ jhāḍeṃ | paḍhiyaṃtīṃ jayā|| 200||
verses.meaning: The wind, and the trees that fall, and the sky that speaks, all are beloved to him with their very life and soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना ऐसीं । चिन्हें जया देखसी । जाण तया ज्ञानेंसीं। शेज जाहली ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā aisīṃ | cinheṃ jayā dekhasī | jāṇa tayā jñāneṃsīṃ| śeja jāhalī || 1||
verses.meaning: Indeed, when you perceive such signs in someone, know that they have found their resting place in true knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं अमानित्व पुरुषीं। तें जाणावें इहीं मिषीं। आतां अदंभाचिया बोळखीसी । सौरसु देवों॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ amānitva puruṣīṃ| teṃ jāṇāveṃ ihīṃ miṣīṃ| ātāṃ adaṃbhāciyā boḻakhīsī | saurasu devoṃ|| 2||
verses.meaning: Know that the quality of humility in a person is recognized by these signs. Now, let us delight in understanding the characteristic of non-hypocrisy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी अदंभित्व ऐसें॥ लोभियाचें मन जैसें। जीवु जावो परी नुमसे। ठेविला ठावो॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī adaṃbhitva aiseṃ|| lobhiyāceṃ mana jaiseṃ| jīvu jāvo parī numase| ṭhevilā ṭhāvo|| 3||
verses.meaning: Just as a miser's mind is so attached to his treasure that he would rather die than let go of its place, so too is true humility: it is firmly rooted and unwavering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी किरीटी। पडिलाही प्राणसंकटीं। तरी सुकृत न प्रकटी। आंगें बोलळें॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī kirīṭī| paḍilāhī prāṇasaṃkaṭīṃ| tarī sukṛta na prakaṭī| āṃgeṃ bolaḻeṃ|| 4||
verses.meaning: Even if Arjuna were to fall into a life-threatening crisis, his good deeds would not manifest themselves through his own words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: खडाणें आला पान्हा। पळवी जेवीं अर्जुना। कां लपवी पण्यांगना। वडिलपण॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: khaḍāṇeṃ ālā pānhā| paḻavī jevīṃ arjunā| kāṃ lapavī paṇyāṃganā| vaḍilapaṇa|| 5||
verses.meaning: Just as a cow, upon seeing her calf, lets down her milk, or as a prostitute hides her true nature from her elders, so too, Arjuna, does the divine essence manifest or conceal itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आढ्यु आतुडे आडवीं। मग आढ्यता जेवीं हारवी। नातरी कुळवधू लपवी। अवेवांतें ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āḍhyu ātuḍe āḍavīṃ| maga āḍhyatā jevīṃ hāravī| nātarī kuḻavadhū lapavī| avevāṃteṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: When a rich man is caught in a narrow alley, his richness is lost, just as a chaste wife hides her limbs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना कृषीवळु आपुलें। पांघुरवी पेरिलें। तैसें झांकी निपजलें। दानपुण्य ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā kṛṣīvaḻu āpuleṃ| pāṃghuravī perileṃ| taiseṃ jhāṃkī nipajaleṃ| dānapuṇya || 7||
verses.meaning: Just as a farmer covers his sown seeds, so too does charity and merit conceal the fruits of actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरिबरी देहो न पूजी । लोकांतें न रंजी। स्वधर्म वाग्ध्वजीं । बांधों नेणे ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: varibarī deho na pūjī | lokāṃteṃ na raṃjī| svadharma vāgdhvajīṃ | bāṃdhoṃ neṇe || 8||
verses.meaning: He does not worship the body externally, nor does he please people. He does not know how to uphold his own dharma like a banner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परोपकारु न बोले । न मिरबी अभ्यासिलें। न शके विकू जोडलें। स्फीतीसाठीं ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paropakāru na bole | na mirabī abhyāsileṃ| na śake vikū joḍaleṃ| sphītīsāṭhīṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: One who performs good deeds does not speak of them, nor does he boast of his learning, nor does he sell what he has acquired for personal gain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शरीरभोगांकडे । पहातां कृपणु आवडे । एऱहवी धर्मविषयीं थोडें । बहु न म्हणे ॥ २१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: śarīrabhogāṃkaḍe | pahātāṃ kṛpaṇu āvaḍe | eṟahavī dharmaviṣayīṃ thoḍeṃ | bahu na mhaṇe || 210||
verses.meaning: When it comes to worldly pleasures, he appears miserly; otherwise, in matters of Dharma, he does not distinguish between little and much.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घरीं दिसे सांकड । देहींची आयती रोड । परी दानीं जया होड । सुरतरूसीं ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: gharīṃ dise sāṃkaḍa | dehīṃcī āyatī roḍa | parī dānīṃ jayā hoḍa | suratarūsīṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Though his home may appear troubled and his body frail, he competes with the wish-fulfilling tree in generosity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना स्वधर्मी थोरु । अवसरीं उदारु । आत्मचर्चे चतुरु । एम्हबीं वेडा॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā svadharmī thoru | avasarīṃ udāru | ātmacarce caturu | emhabīṃ veḍā|| 12||
verses.meaning: Indeed, one who is great in their own dharma, generous in times of need, and skilled in self-inquiry, is otherwise considered foolish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २७८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी केळीचें दळवाडें। हळू पोकळ आवडे । परि फळोनियां गाढें। रसाळ जैसें॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: 278 śrījñāneśvarī keḻīceṃ daḻavāḍeṃ| haḻū pokaḻa āvaḍe | pari phaḻoniyāṃ gāḍheṃ| rasāḻa jaiseṃ|| 13||
verses.meaning: Just as the banana plant, though appearing soft and hollow, bears firm and juicy fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां मेघाचें आंग झील। दिसे वारेनि जैसें जाईल। परी वर्षती नवल घनवट तें॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ meghāceṃ āṃga jhīla| dise vāreni jaiseṃ jāīla| parī varṣatī navala ghanavaṭa teṃ|| 14||
verses.meaning: Or, just as a cloud appears to be carried away by the wind, yet it is a wonder how it pours down rain with such density.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा जो पूर्णपणीं । पाहतां धाती आयणी । एऱ्हवीं तरी वबाणी। तोचि ठावो॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā jo pūrṇapaṇīṃ | pāhatāṃ dhātī āyaṇī | eṟhavīṃ tarī vabāṇī| toci ṭhāvo|| 15||
verses.meaning: Just as one who is completely satisfied by seeing, otherwise, that very place is a source of longing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो या चिन्हांचा। नटनाचु ठायीं जयाच्या। जाण ज्ञान तयाच्या । हातां चढे॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso yā cinhāṃcā| naṭanācu ṭhāyīṃ jayācyā| jāṇa jñāna tayācyā | hātāṃ caḍhe|| 16||
verses.meaning: Let it be known that the one in whose heart these signs (of devotion and spiritual experience) dance, truly attains spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा अदंभपण। म्हणितलें तें हें जाण। आंता आईक खूण। अहिंसेची ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā adaṃbhapaṇa| mhaṇitaleṃ teṃ heṃ jāṇa| āṃtā āīka khūṇa| ahiṃsecī || 97||
verses.meaning: Know that what was called 'adambhapana' (absence of deceit) has been explained. Now, listen to the essence of 'ahimsa' (non-violence).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि अहिंसा बहुतीं परी । बोलिली असे अवधारीं । आपुल्मलिया मतांतरीं । निरूपिळी ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari ahiṃsā bahutīṃ parī | bolilī ase avadhārīṃ | āpulmaliyā matāṃtarīṃ | nirūpiḻī || 18||
verses.meaning: Thus, non-violence has been spoken of in many ways. Listen, it has been expounded in various schools of thought.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी ते ऐसी देखा । जैशा खांडूनियां शाखा । मग तयाचिया बुडुखा। कुंप कौजे॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī te aisī dekhā | jaiśā khāṃḍūniyāṃ śākhā | maga tayāciyā buḍukhā| kuṃpa kauje|| 19||
verses.meaning: But consider it like this: just as branches are cut, and then a fence is made from their stumps.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां बाहू तोडोनि पचविजे। मग भुकेची पीडा राखिजे। नाना देऊळ मोडोनि कीजे। पौळी देवा॥ २२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bāhū toḍoni pacavije| maga bhukecī pīḍā rākhije| nānā deūḻa moḍoni kīje| pauḻī devā|| 220||
verses.meaning: Why would one cut off their own arm and cook it to satisfy hunger? Or why would one demolish a temple to build a porch for the deity?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी हिंसाचि करूनि अहिंसा । निफजविजे हा ऐसा । पैं पूर्वमीमांसा । निर्णी केला ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī hiṃsāci karūni ahiṃsā | niphajavije hā aisā | paiṃ pūrvamīmāṃsā | nirṇī kelā || 21||
verses.meaning: In the same way, non-violence is achieved through violence; this is indeed the conclusion established by the Purva Mimamsa philosophy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे अवृष्टीचेनि उपद्रवें। गादलें विश्व आघवें । म्हणौनि पर्जन्येष्टी करावे । नाना याग॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je avṛṣṭīceni upadraveṃ| gādaleṃ viśva āghaveṃ | mhaṇauni parjanyeṣṭī karāve | nānā yāga|| 22||
verses.meaning: When the entire world is afflicted by the troubles of drought, then various sacrifices and rituals for rain are performed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव तिये इष्टीचिया बुडीं। पशुहिंसा रोकडी। मग अहिंसेची थडी। कैंची दिसे॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva tiye iṣṭīciyā buḍīṃ| paśuhiṃsā rokaḍī| maga ahiṃsecī thaḍī| kaiṃcī dise|| 23||
verses.meaning: When the foundation of that sacrifice is the direct killing of animals, then where can the shore of non-violence be seen?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पेरिजे नुसधी हिंसा। तेथ उगवैळ काय अहिंसा। परी नवळ बापा धिंवसा । या याज्ञिकांचा॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: perije nusadhī hiṃsā| tetha ugavaiḻa kāya ahiṃsā| parī navaḻa bāpā dhiṃvasā | yā yājñikāṃcā|| 24||
verses.meaning: Where there is only violence, how can non-violence arise? But behold the audacity of these sacrificers!

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आयुर्वेद आघवा । तो याच मोहोरा पांडवा। जे जीवाकारणें करावा। जीवघातु॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi āyurveda āghavā | to yāca mohorā pāṃḍavā| je jīvākāraṇeṃ karāvā| jīvaghātu|| 25||
verses.meaning: And the entire Ayurveda, O Pandava, is for this very purpose: that for the sake of life, one should commit the destruction of life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नानारोगें आहाळळलीं। लोळतीं भूतें देखिली । ते हिंसा निवारावया केली । चिकित्सा कां॥२६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānārogeṃ āhāḻaḻalīṃ| loḻatīṃ bhūteṃ dekhilī | te hiṃsā nivārāvayā kelī | cikitsā kāṃ||26||
verses.meaning: When one sees beings afflicted by various diseases, writhing in pain, why would one resort to violence instead of treatment?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब ते चिकित्से पहिलें) एकाचे कंद खणविलळे। एका उपडविलें।॥ समूळीं सपत्रीं॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba te cikitse pahileṃ) ekāce kaṃda khaṇavilaḻe| ekā upaḍavileṃ||| samūḻīṃ sapatrīṃ|| 27||
verses.meaning: First, for treatment, some had their roots dug up, while others were uprooted entirely, with all their leaves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकें आड मोडविली । अजंगमाची खाल 'काढविली । एकें गर्भिणी उकडविली । पुटामाजीं ॥ २८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekeṃ āḍa moḍavilī | ajaṃgamācī khāla 'kāḍhavilī | ekeṃ garbhiṇī ukaḍavilī | puṭāmājīṃ || 28 ||
verses.meaning: One destroyed the obstruction, removed the impurity of the unmoving. One caused the pregnant woman to be boiled within the womb.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अजातशत्रु तरुवरां । सर्वांगी देवविल्या शिरा। ऐसे जीव घेऊनि धनुर्धरा। कोरडे केळे॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ajātaśatru taruvarāṃ | sarvāṃgī devavilyā śirā| aise jīva gheūni dhanurdharā| koraḍe keḻe|| 29||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, the one without enemies, you have made all these warriors, who had their heads held high, fall to the ground. You have made them like dry wood, taking their lives.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जंगमाही हात । लाऊनि काढिले पित्त। मग राखिले शिणत। आणिक जीव॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jaṃgamāhī hāta | lāūni kāḍhile pitta| maga rākhile śiṇata| āṇika jīva|| 230||
verses.meaning: And even the moving beings, by laying hands on them, had their bile removed, and then the weary lives were protected.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो वसतीं धवळारें। मोडूनि केलीं देव्हारें। नागवूनि वेव्हारें। गवबांदी घातली ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho vasatīṃ dhavaḻāreṃ| moḍūni kelīṃ devhāreṃ| nāgavūni vevhāreṃ| gavabāṃdī ghātalī || 39||
verses.meaning: Alas, they demolished mansions and made them into shrines, and by stripping away worldly affairs, they established a spiritual path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मस्तक पांघुरविलें। तंव तळवटीं उघडें पडलें। घर मोडोनि केले। मांडव पुढें ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mastaka pāṃghuravileṃ| taṃva taḻavaṭīṃ ughaḍeṃ paḍaleṃ| ghara moḍoni kele| māṃḍava puḍheṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: When the head is covered, the feet are exposed. It is like dismantling one's home to build a temporary shelter outside.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना पांघुरणें । जाळूनि जैसें तापणें। कां जालें आंगधुणें । कुंजराचें ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā pāṃghuraṇeṃ | jāḻūni jaiseṃ tāpaṇeṃ| kāṃ jāleṃ āṃgadhuṇeṃ | kuṃjarāceṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Just as one warms oneself by burning various coverings, or as an elephant bathes itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी बैल विकूनि गोठा । पुंसा लावोनि बांधिजे गांठा। इया करणीं कीं चेष्टा। काइ हंसों ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī baila vikūni goṭhā | puṃsā lāvoni bāṃdhije gāṃṭhā| iyā karaṇīṃ kīṃ ceṣṭā| kāi haṃsoṃ || 34||
verses.meaning: Or, selling the bull and then building a cowshed, and then tying a knot with the tail. Is this an act or a jest? What should I laugh at?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकीं धर्माचिया बाहणी। गाळूं आदरिलें पाणी । तंव गाळितया आहाळणीं । जीव मेळे॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekīṃ dharmāciyā bāhaṇī| gāḻūṃ ādarileṃ pāṇī | taṃva gāḻitayā āhāḻaṇīṃ | jīva meḻe|| 35||
verses.meaning: Some, in the name of religion, begin to strain water, but in the very act of straining, many living beings perish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक न पचवितीचि कण । इये हिंसेचे भेण। तेथ कदर्थले प्राण। तेचि हिंसा॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka na pacavitīci kaṇa | iye hiṃsece bheṇa| tetha kadarthale prāṇa| teci hiṃsā|| 36||
verses.meaning: Even a single grain of food cannot be digested due to the fear of this violence. When life itself is thus tormented, that indeed is violence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं हिंसाचि अहिंसा। कर्मकांडीं हा ऐसा। सिद्धांतु सुमनसा। बोळखें तूं ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ hiṃsāci ahiṃsā| karmakāṃḍīṃ hā aisā| siddhāṃtu sumanasā| boḻakheṃ tūṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: Thus, violence itself is non-violence; this is the established principle in the path of ritualistic actions, O good-hearted one, understand this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पहिलें अहिंसेचें नांव। आम्हीं केलें जंब। तंब स्फूर्ति बांधली हांव। इये मती॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pahileṃ ahiṃseceṃ nāṃva| āmhīṃ keleṃ jaṃba| taṃba sphūrti bāṃdhalī hāṃva| iye matī|| 38||
verses.meaning: First, the name of non-violence, we have made it the foundation. With this inspiration, we have bound our desire in this intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी कैसेनि ययातें गाळावें। म्हणौनि पडिलें बोलावें । तेबींचि तुवांही जाणावें । ऐसा भावो॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kaiseni yayāteṃ gāḻāveṃ| mhaṇauni paḍileṃ bolāveṃ | tebīṃci tuvāṃhī jāṇāveṃ | aisā bhāvo|| 39||
verses.meaning: How then can this be avoided? Therefore, it became necessary to speak, and you too should understand it in this way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बहुतकरूनि किरीटी। हाचि विषो इये गोठी। एऱ्हवीं कां आडवाटीं । धांविजैलगा॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: bahutakarūni kirīṭī| hāci viṣo iye goṭhī| eṟhavīṃ kāṃ āḍavāṭīṃ | dhāṃvijailagā|| 240||
verses.meaning: Indeed, Arjuna, this is the main subject of this discourse; otherwise, why would one run astray on a wrong path?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि स्वमताचिया निर्धारा-। लागोनियां धनुर्धरा। प्राप्तां मतांतरां। निर्वेचु कीजे॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi svamatāciyā nirdhārā-| lāgoniyāṃ dhanurdharā| prāptāṃ matāṃtarāṃ| nirvecu kīje|| 41||
verses.meaning: And to establish one's own conviction, O Arjuna, one should thoroughly examine the differing opinions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी हे अवधारीं। निरूपिती परी । आतां ययावरी। मुख्य जें गा॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī he avadhārīṃ| nirūpitī parī | ātāṃ yayāvarī| mukhya jeṃ gā|| 42||
verses.meaning: Listen to this explanation. Now, beyond this, what is most important...

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें स्वमत बोलिजैळ। अहिंसे रूप किजैळ। जिया उठलिया आंतुल। ज्ञान दिसे॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ svamata bolijaiḻa| ahiṃse rūpa kijaiḻa| jiyā uṭhaliyā āṃtula| jñāna dise|| 43||
verses.meaning: That is called one's own opinion, which takes the form of non-violence, from which, when it arises within, knowledge becomes visible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तें अधिष्ठिलेनि आंगें। जाणिजे आचरतेनि बगें। जैसी कसवटी सांगे । वानियातें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teṃ adhiṣṭhileni āṃgeṃ| jāṇije ācarateni bageṃ| jaisī kasavaṭī sāṃge | vāniyāteṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: But that (Brahman) is known by the body that it indwells, and by the manner of its actions, just as a touchstone reveals the purity of gold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें ज्ञानामनाचिये भेटी । सरिसेंचि अहिंसेचे बिंब उठी । तेंचि ऐसें किरीटी । परिस आतां॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jñānāmanāciye bheṭī | sariseṃci ahiṃsece biṃba uṭhī | teṃci aiseṃ kirīṭī | parisa ātāṃ|| 45 ||
verses.meaning: Just as knowledge and mind meet, so too does the image of non-violence arise. Listen to this, O Kiriti, now.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि तरंगु नोलांडितु। लहरी पायें न फोडितु। सांचलु न मोडितु। पाणियाचा ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari taraṃgu nolāṃḍitu| laharī pāyeṃ na phoḍitu| sāṃcalu na moḍitu| pāṇiyācā || 46||
verses.meaning: Just as a wave does not transgress the water, nor does it break the water with its feet, nor does it disturb the water's natural flow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वेगें आणि लेसा। दिठी घाळूनि आंविसा। जळीं बकु जैसा । पाउल सुये॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vegeṃ āṇi lesā| diṭhī ghāḻūni āṃvisā| jaḻīṃ baku jaisā | pāula suye|| 47||
verses.meaning: Just as a heron, with swiftness and grace, casts its gaze upon the fish in the water, and then carefully steps forward.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां कमळावरी भ्रमर। पाय ठेविती हळुवार। कुचुंबेल केसर। इया शंका ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ kamaḻāvarī bhramara| pāya ṭhevitī haḻuvāra| kucuṃbela kesara| iyā śaṃkā || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a bumblebee gently places its feet on a lotus, fearing it might damage the delicate filaments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे परमाणुपां गुंतळे। जाणूनि जीव सानुले। कारुण्यामाजीं पाउलें। ळपवूनि चाळे॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise paramāṇupāṃ guṃtaḻe| jāṇūni jīva sānule| kāruṇyāmājīṃ pāuleṃ| ḻapavūni cāḻe|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as the soul, entangled in the atomic particles of the body, is a tiny life, so too does the divine compassion move, concealing its footsteps within itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वाट कृपेची करितु। ते दिशाचि स्नरेहभरितु। जीबातळीं आंथरितु। आपुला जीवु ॥ २५० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: te vāṭa kṛpecī karitu| te diśāci snarehabharitu| jībātaḻīṃ āṃtharitu| āpulā jīvu || 250 ||
verses.meaning: They pave the path with grace, they fill the directions with love, they spread their very life beneath the feet of others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया जतना । चालणें जया अर्जुना । हें अनिर्वाच्य परिमाणा । पुरिजेना ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā jatanā | cālaṇeṃ jayā arjunā | heṃ anirvācya parimāṇā | purijenā || 51||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, to walk with such care and caution is immeasurable; its extent cannot be fully described.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं मोहाचेनि सांगडें। लासी पिलीं धरी तोंडें । तेथ दांतांचे आगरडे । लागती जैसे॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ mohāceni sāṃgaḍeṃ| lāsī pilīṃ dharī toṃḍeṃ | tetha dāṃtāṃce āgaraḍe | lāgatī jaise||52||
verses.meaning: Just as a louse, in its attachment, carries its young in its mouth, and in doing so, its own teeth prick them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां स्ेहाळु माये। तान्हयाची वास पाहे। तिये दिठी आहे। हळुवार जें॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ sehāḻu māye| tānhayācī vāsa pāhe| tiye diṭhī āhe| haḻuvāra jeṃ||53||
verses.meaning: Just as a loving mother's gaze tenderly watches over her child, so too is the divine gaze upon us.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना कमळदळें। डोलविजती ढाळें। तो जेणें पाडें बुबुळें। वारा घेपे॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā kamaḻadaḻeṃ| ḍolavijatī ḍhāḻeṃ| to jeṇeṃ pāḍeṃ bubuḻeṃ| vārā ghepe|| 54||
verses.meaning: Just as a lotus petal sways gently in the breeze, so too does the pupil of the eye take in the air.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेैसेनि मार्दवें पाय। भूमीवरी न्यसीतु जाय । लागती तेथ होय। जीवां सुख॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teaiseni mārdaveṃ pāya| bhūmīvarī nyasītu jāya | lāgatī tetha hoya| jīvāṃ sukha|| 55||
verses.meaning: In the same way, with such gentleness, as the feet are placed on the ground, wherever they touch, it brings joy to all beings.
