verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया लघिमा चालतां। कृमि 'कौटक पंडुसुता। देखे तरि माघौता। हळूचि निघे॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā laghimā cālatāṃ| kṛmi 'kauṭaka paṃḍusutā| dekhe tari māghautā| haḻūci nighe|| 56||
verses.meaning: When such a one, possessing the power of 'laghima' (the ability to become light), walks, if he sees even a tiny insect, O Arjuna, he carefully steps back so as not to harm it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे पावो धडफडील। तरी स्वामीची निद्रा मोडेल । रचलेपणा पडेल । झोती हन॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe pāvo dhaḍaphaḍīla| tarī svāmīcī nidrā moḍela | racalepaṇā paḍela | jhotī hana|| 57||
verses.meaning: He thinks, "If my foot stirs, my Master's sleep will be disturbed, and the carefully arranged bed will be ruined."

verses.shloka_devanagari: २८० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी इया काकुळती । वाहणी घे माघौती । कोणेही व्यक्‍ती । न वचे वरी ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: 280 śrījñāneśvarī iyā kākuḻatī | vāhaṇī ghe māghautī | koṇehī vyak‍tī | na vace varī || 58||
verses.meaning: Shri Dnyaneshwari, with such earnest plea, takes back its flow, for no individual can ascend beyond it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जीवाचेनि नांवें। तृणातेंही नोलळांडवे।) मग न लेखितां जावें। हे कें गोठी ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jīvāceni nāṃveṃ| tṛṇāteṃhī nolaḻāṃḍave|) maga na lekhitāṃ jāveṃ| he keṃ goṭhī || 59||
verses.meaning: Even a blade of grass cannot be crossed without acknowledging its life. How then can one pass without acknowledging the Lord?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुंगिये मेरु नोलांडवे। मशका सिंधु न तरवे। तैसें भेटलियां न करवे। अतिक्रमु॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: muṃgiye meru nolāṃḍave| maśakā siṃdhu na tarave| taiseṃ bheṭaliyāṃ na karave| atikramu|| 260||
verses.meaning: An ant cannot cross Mount Meru, nor can a mosquito swim across the ocean. Similarly, when one meets a true saint, one cannot commit any transgression.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी जयाची चाली । कृपाफळीं फळा आली । देखसी जियाली। दया वाचे॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī jayācī cālī | kṛpāphaḻīṃ phaḻā ālī | dekhasī jiyālī| dayā vāce||61||
verses.meaning: Such is the nature of one whose actions are fruitful due to grace, and whose compassion is evident in their speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वयें श्‍इवसणेंचि सुकुमार। मुख मोहाचें माहेर। माधुर्या जाहळे अंकुर। दशन तैसे ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: svayeṃ ś‍ivasaṇeṃci sukumāra| mukha mohāceṃ māhera| mādhuryā jāhaḻe aṃkura| daśana taise || 62||
verses.meaning: Her breath itself is delicate and soft, her face is the abode of enchantment, and her teeth are like the budding sprouts of sweetness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढां स्नेह पाझरे। माघां चालती अक्षरें। शब्द पाठीं अवतरे। कृपा आधीं॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhāṃ sneha pājhare| māghāṃ cālatī akṣareṃ| śabda pāṭhīṃ avatare| kṛpā ādhīṃ||63||
verses.meaning: First, affection overflows, then words follow. The utterance manifests later, but grace precedes it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव बोलणेंचि नाहीं। बोलो म्हणे जरी कांहीं । तरी बोळ कोणाही । खुपेल कां॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva bolaṇeṃci nāhīṃ| bolo mhaṇe jarī kāṃhīṃ | tarī boḻa koṇāhī | khupela kāṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: Then there is no speech. If one says something, then to whom will the word be hurtful?

verses.shloka_devanagari: बोलतां अधिकुही निघे। तरी कोण्हाही वर्मी न लगे। आणि 'कोण्हासि न रिघे। शंका मनीं ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: bolatāṃ adhikuhī nighe| tarī koṇhāhī varmī na lage| āṇi 'koṇhāsi na righe| śaṃkā manīṃ || 65||
verses.meaning: Even if more is spoken, it should not reveal any secrets to anyone, and no one should have any doubt in their mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मांडिली गोठी हन मोडेळ। वासिपैल कोणी उडेळ। आइकोनि वबोबांडिळ। कोण्ही जरी॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: māṃḍilī goṭhī hana moḍeḻa| vāsipaila koṇī uḍeḻa| āikoni vabobāṃḍiḻa| koṇhī jarī|| 66||
verses.meaning: This discourse, once begun, will not cease. Who can fathom its depth? Even if someone were to hear it and become bewildered, it would still continue.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी दुवाळी कोणा नोहावी। भुंबई कवणाची नुचलावी। ऐसा भावो जीवीं । म्हणौनि उगा॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī duvāḻī koṇā nohāvī| bhuṃbaī kavaṇācī nucalāvī| aisā bhāvo jīvīṃ | mhaṇauni ugā|| 67||
verses.meaning: Therefore, no one should suffer, and no one's livelihood should be disturbed. With such a feeling in my heart, I remain silent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग प्रार्थिला विपायें। जरी लोभें बोलों जाये। तरी परिसतया होये। मायबापु ॥॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga prārthilā vipāyeṃ| jarī lobheṃ boloṃ jāye| tarī parisatayā hoye| māyabāpu |||| 68||
verses.meaning: Then, if out of love I speak, even with some imperfection, may the listeners be like my parents, understanding and forgiving.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां नादब्रह्मचि मुसे आलें। कीं गंगापय असलले । पतित्रतें आलें। वार्धक्य जैसें ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ nādabrahmaci muse āleṃ| kīṃ gaṃgāpaya asalale | patitrateṃ āleṃ| vārdhakya jaiseṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: Or has the sound-Brahman itself taken form? Or is it like the old age that comes to a chaste woman, pure as the waters of the Ganga?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें साच आणि मवाळ। मितले आणि रसाळ। शब्द जैसे कल्लोळ। अमृताचे॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sāca āṇi mavāḻa| mitale āṇi rasāḻa| śabda jaise kalloḻa| amṛtāce|| 270||
verses.meaning: Just as words, true and gentle, measured and sweet, surge forth like waves of nectar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विरोधुवादुबळु । प्राणितापढाळु । उपहासु छळु। वर्मस्पर्शु॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: virodhuvādubaḻu | prāṇitāpaḍhāḻu | upahāsu chaḻu| varmasparśu|| 71||
verses.meaning: Opposition, arguments, and the suffering of living beings; ridicule, torment, and touching upon one's vulnerable points.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आटु वेगु विंदाणु। आशा शंका प्रतारणु। हे संन्यासिळे अवगुणु। जया वाचा ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṭu vegu viṃdāṇu| āśā śaṃkā pratāraṇu| he saṃnyāsiḻe avaguṇu| jayā vācā || 72||
verses.meaning: The one whose speech is devoid of these defects: attachment, haste, doubt, hope, and deceit, is truly a renunciate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तयाचि परी किरीटी । थाउ जयाचिये दिठी । सांडिलिया थ्रुकुटी । मोकळिया ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tayāci parī kirīṭī | thāu jayāciye diṭhī | sāṃḍiliyā thrukuṭī | mokaḻiyā || 73||
verses.meaning: And in that manner, O Kiriti, the one whose vision, having abandoned the three-fold division of time, is free.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे भूतीं वस्तु आहे। तिये रुपों शके विपायें। म्हणौनि वासु न पाहे । बहुतकरूनी॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je bhūtīṃ vastu āhe| tiye rupoṃ śake vipāyeṃ| mhaṇauni vāsu na pāhe | bahutakarūnī|| 74||
verses.meaning: Because that which exists in all beings, it is rarely seen. Therefore, it is not sought after by many.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसाही कोणे एके वेळे। भीतरळले कृपेचेनि बळें। उघडोनियां डोळे । दृष्टी घाली ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisāhī koṇe eke veḻe| bhītaraḻale kṛpeceni baḻeṃ| ughaḍoniyāṃ ḍoḻe | dṛṣṭī ghālī || 75 ||
verses.meaning: And so, at some point, by the power of grace, opening the eyes, He casts His gaze.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी चंद्रबिंबौनि धारा । निघतां नव्हती गोचरा। परी एकसरें चकोरां। निघती दोंदें ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī caṃdrabiṃbauni dhārā | nighatāṃ navhatī gocarā| parī ekasareṃ cakorāṃ| nighatī doṃdeṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: Even though streams of nectar do not visibly flow from the moon, the chakor birds are instantly filled with satisfaction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें प्राणियांसि होये । जरी तो कहीं वासु पाहे। तया अबलोकनाची सोये । कूर्मीही नेणे॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ prāṇiyāṃsi hoye | jarī to kahīṃ vāsu pāhe| tayā abalokanācī soye | kūrmīhī neṇe|| 77||
verses.meaning: Just as it happens to living beings, if one ever looks upon it, the very awareness of that sight is unknown even to a tortoise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना ऐसी । दिठी जयाची भूतांसी । करही देखसी । तैसेचि ते॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā aisī | diṭhī jayācī bhūtāṃsī | karahī dekhasī | taiseci te|| 78||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the way one perceives others, so too does one act towards them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी होऊनियां कृतार्थ। राहिळे सिद्धांचे मनोरथ। तैसे जयाचे हात। निर्व्यापार॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī hoūniyāṃ kṛtārtha| rāhiḻe siddhāṃce manoratha| taise jayāce hāta| nirvyāpāra|| 79||
verses.meaning: Thus, having become fulfilled, the desires of the Siddhas (perfected beings) remain unfulfilled, just as their hands are free from action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अक्षमें आणि संन्यासिलें। कां निरिंधन आणि विझालें। मुकेनि घेतलें। मौन जैसें ॥ २८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: akṣameṃ āṇi saṃnyāsileṃ| kāṃ niriṃdhana āṇi vijhāleṃ| mukeni ghetaleṃ| mauna jaiseṃ || 280||
verses.meaning: It is like forgiveness and renunciation, or like a fire that has run out of fuel and extinguished itself, or like silence embraced by one who has taken a vow of silence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी कांहीं ।॥ जयां करां करणें नाहीं । जे अकर्तयाच्या ठायीं। बैसों येती ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī kāṃhīṃ ||| jayāṃ karāṃ karaṇeṃ nāhīṃ | je akartayācyā ṭhāyīṃ| baisoṃ yetī || 81||
verses.meaning: In that way, there are some who have no actions to perform, who come to reside in the non-doer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आसुडेल वारा। नख लागेल अंबरा । इया बुद्धी करां। चळों नेदी॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āsuḍela vārā| nakha lāgela aṃbarā | iyā buddhī karāṃ| caḻoṃ nedī|| 82||
verses.meaning: The wind may lash, the sky may be scratched by a nail, but do not let your intellect waver from this understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ आंगावरिलीं उडवावीं। कां डोळां रिगतें झाडावीं। पशुपक्ष्यां दाबावी । त्रासमुद्रा॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha āṃgāvarilīṃ uḍavāvīṃ| kāṃ ḍoḻāṃ rigateṃ jhāḍāvīṃ| paśupakṣyāṃ dābāvī | trāsamudrā|| 83||
verses.meaning: Just as one brushes off dust from the body, or removes something that enters the eye, or restrains animals and birds from causing trouble.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया केउतिया गोठी। नावडे दंडु काठी। मग शस्त्राचें किरीटी। बोलणें कें॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā keutiyā goṭhī| nāvaḍe daṃḍu kāṭhī| maga śastrāceṃ kirīṭī| bolaṇeṃ keṃ||84||
verses.meaning: When even words and speech are disliked, and the stick and rod are not favored, then, O Kiriti, how can there be talk of weapons?

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'लीलाकमळें खेळणें। कां पुष्पमाळा झेलणें। न करी म्हणे गोफणें । ऐसें होईल॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'līlākamaḻeṃ kheḻaṇeṃ| kāṃ puṣpamāḻā jhelaṇeṃ| na karī mhaṇe gophaṇeṃ | aiseṃ hoīla|| 85||
verses.meaning: It will be like playing with lotus flowers, or catching garlands of flowers, and not needing a sling to do so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हालवतील रोमावळी । यालागीं आंग न कुरवाळी । नखांची गुंडाळी । बोटांवरी ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hālavatīla romāvaḻī | yālāgīṃ āṃga na kuravāḻī | nakhāṃcī guṃḍāḻī | boṭāṃvarī || 86||
verses.meaning: The hair on the body will stand on end, so one does not caress the body; the nails curl over the fingers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब करणेंयाचाचि अभावो। परी ऐसाही पडे प्रस्तावो। तरी हातां हाचि सरावो। जे जोडिजती॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba karaṇeṃyācāci abhāvo| parī aisāhī paḍe prastāvo| tarī hātāṃ hāci sarāvo| je joḍijatī|| 87||
verses.meaning: Even if such a situation arises where one is compelled to perform actions, let the hands be trained in such a way that they are always engaged in good deeds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां नाभिकारा उचलिजे। हातु पडिलियां देइजे। नातरी आर्तातें स्पर्शिजे। अळुमाळु ॥८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ nābhikārā ucalije| hātu paḍiliyāṃ deije| nātarī ārtāteṃ sparśije| aḻumāḻu ||88||
verses.meaning: Why should one lift a drowning person? Why should one give to someone whose hand is extended? Or why should one touch the distressed, even a little?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेंही उपरोधें करणें। तरी आर्तभय हरणें। नेणती चंद्रकिरणें । जिव्हाळा तो॥८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃhī uparodheṃ karaṇeṃ| tarī ārtabhaya haraṇeṃ| neṇatī caṃdrakiraṇeṃ | jivhāḻā to||89||
verses.meaning: If this too is done with sarcasm, then the moonbeams do not know the essence of removing the fear of the distressed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पावबोनि तो स्पर्शु। मल्यानिळु खरपुसु। येणें मानें पशु । 'कुरवाळणें ॥ २९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāvaboni to sparśu| malyāniḻu kharapusu| yeṇeṃ māneṃ paśu | 'kuravāḻaṇeṃ || 290||
verses.meaning: The touch of the gentle breeze, fragrant with sandalwood, caresses the animals.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे सदा रिते मोकळे । जैशीं चंदनांगें शीतळे। न 'फळतांही निर्फळें। होतीचि ना॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: je sadā rite mokaḻe | jaiśīṃ caṃdanāṃgeṃ śītaḻe| na 'phaḻatāṃhī nirphaḻeṃ| hotīci nā|| 91||
verses.meaning: Just as the cool limbs of a sandalwood tree, though always empty and unburdened, never become fruitless, so too are the enlightened ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां असो हें वाग्जाळ। जाणें तें 'करतळ। सज्जनांचें शीळ। स्वभाव जैसें ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ aso heṃ vāgjāḻa| jāṇeṃ teṃ 'karataḻa| sajjanāṃceṃ śīḻa| svabhāva jaiseṃ || 92||
verses.meaning: Let this elaborate speech be. For it is known that the nature of good people is like a fruit in the palm of one's hand, easily understood.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां मन तयाचें । सांगों म्हणों जरी साचें । तरी सांगितळे कोणाचे । विलास हे॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ mana tayāceṃ | sāṃgoṃ mhaṇoṃ jarī sāceṃ | tarī sāṃgitaḻe koṇāce | vilāsa he|| 93||
verses.meaning: Now, if I were to truly describe the mind, whose playful expressions would these be that are being described?

verses.shloka_devanagari: काह शाखा नव्हे तरु । जळेंबीण असे सागरु । तेज आणि तेजाकारु । आन काई ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāha śākhā navhe taru | jaḻeṃbīṇa ase sāgaru | teja āṇi tejākāru | āna kāī || 94||
verses.meaning: Is a branch not a tree? Is the ocean without water? What else are light and its form?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवयव आणि शरीर। हे वेगळाळे कौर। कीं रसु आणि नीर। सिनानीं आथी ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: avayava āṇi śarīra| he vegaḻāḻe kaura| kīṃ rasu āṇi nīra| sinānīṃ āthī || 95||
verses.meaning: Are the limbs and the body separate? Or are the juice and water in the sugarcane distinct?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि हे जे सर्व। सांगितले बाह्मभाव। तें मनचि गा सावयव । ऐसें जाणें ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni he je sarva| sāṃgitale bāhmabhāva| teṃ manaci gā sāvayava | aiseṃ jāṇeṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all these external manifestations that have been described, know them to be nothing but the mind itself, with all its parts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें बीज भुई खोंविलें। तेंचि वरी रुख जाहलें। तेसें इंद्रियद्वारीं फांकलें। अंतरचि कौं॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ bīja bhuī khoṃvileṃ| teṃci varī rukha jāhaleṃ| teseṃ iṃdriyadvārīṃ phāṃkaleṃ| aṃtaraci kauṃ|| 97||
verses.meaning: Just as a seed buried in the earth grows into a tree, so too does the inner consciousness manifest itself through the gates of the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं मानसींचि जरी। अहिंसेची अवसरी । तरी कैंची बाहेरी। बोसंडेल॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ mānasīṃci jarī| ahiṃsecī avasarī | tarī kaiṃcī bāherī| bosaṃḍela|| 98||
verses.meaning: If non-violence is truly established in the mind, then how can it manifest externally as violence?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आवडे ते वृत्ती किरीटी। आधीं मनौनीचि उठी । मग ते वाचे दिठी। करांसि ये॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āvaḍe te vṛttī kirīṭī| ādhīṃ manaunīci uṭhī | maga te vāce diṭhī| karāṃsi ye||99||
verses.meaning: Whatever the mind desires, it first conceives it within itself. Then, through speech, sight, and action, it brings it into being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि मनींचि नाहीं। तें बाचेसि उमटेल काई । बींबीण भुई । अंकुर असे॥ ३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni manīṃci nāhīṃ| teṃ bācesi umaṭela kāī | bīṃbīṇa bhuī | aṃkura ase|| 300||
verses.meaning: That which is not in the mind, how can it manifest in speech? Just as a reflection in a mirror does not have a sprout in the ground.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मनपण जें मोडे । तैं इंद्रिय आधींचि उबडे । सूत्रधारेंबीण साइखडें । वाबो जैसें ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni manapaṇa jeṃ moḍe | taiṃ iṃdriya ādhīṃci ubaḍe | sūtradhāreṃbīṇa sāikhaḍeṃ | vābo jaiseṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: Therefore, when the mind's identity is broken, the senses are already uprooted, just as puppets are useless without their puppeteer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उगमींचि वाळूनि जाये । तें बोघीं कैचें वाहे । जीवु गेलिया आहे । चेष्टा देहीं ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: ugamīṃci vāḻūni jāye | teṃ boghīṃ kaiceṃ vāhe | jīvu geliyā āhe | ceṣṭā dehīṃ || 2||
verses.meaning: If a plant withers at its very origin, how can it bear fruit? Similarly, after the life-force has departed, how can the body continue to act?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें मन हें पांडवा । मूळ या इंद्रियभावां । हेंचि राहटें २८२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आधघवां । द्वारीं इहीं ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ mana heṃ pāṃḍavā | mūḻa yā iṃdriyabhāvāṃ | heṃci rāhaṭeṃ 282 śrījñāneśvarī ādhaghavāṃ | dvārīṃ ihīṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, the mind is the root of all sensory experiences; it operates through all these doors (senses).

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी जिये वेळीं जैसें । जें होऊनि आंतु असे । बाहेरी ये तैसें। व्यापाररूपें ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī jiye veḻīṃ jaiseṃ | jeṃ hoūni āṃtu ase | bāherī ye taiseṃ| vyāpārarūpeṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: But at whatever time, in whatever form it exists within, it manifests outwardly in that very form as activity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं साचोकारें। मनीं अहिंसा थांबे थोरें। जैसी पिकली द्रुती आदरें। बोभात निघे ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ sācokāreṃ| manīṃ ahiṃsā thāṃbe thoreṃ| jaisī pikalī drutī ādareṃ| bobhāta nighe || 5||
verses.meaning: Therefore, truly, non-violence firmly establishes itself in the mind, just as a ripe fruit, with great respect, falls from the tree.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि इंद्रियें तेचि संपदा । वेंचितां हीं उदावादा। अहिंसेचा धंदा । करितें आहाती ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni iṃdriyeṃ teci saṃpadā | veṃcitāṃ hīṃ udāvādā| ahiṃsecā dhaṃdā | kariteṃ āhātī || 6||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the senses themselves are the true wealth. When these are spent, they engage in the practice of non-violence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: समुद्री दाटे भरितें। तें समुद्रचि भरी तरियांतें । तैसें स्वसंपत्ति चित्तें । इंद्रियां केलें ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: samudrī dāṭe bhariteṃ| teṃ samudraci bharī tariyāṃteṃ | taiseṃ svasaṃpatti citteṃ | iṃdriyāṃ keleṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: Just as the sea fills the clouds, and those clouds in turn fill the sea with rain, so too the mind, with its own inherent wealth, empowers the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बहु असो पंडितु। धरूनि बाळकाचा हातु। बोळी लिही व्यक्‍्तु । आपणचि ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ bahu aso paṃḍitu| dharūni bāḻakācā hātu| boḻī lihī vyak‍tu | āpaṇaci || 8||
verses.meaning: Let this be enough. A learned person, holding a child's hand, teaches them to write the alphabet clearly, just as they themselves learned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें दयाळुत्व आपुलें। मनें हातापायां आणिलें। मग तेथ उपजविलें। अहिंसेतें ॥ ९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ dayāḻutva āpuleṃ| maneṃ hātāpāyāṃ āṇileṃ| maga tetha upajavileṃ| ahiṃseteṃ || 9 ||
verses.meaning: Similarly, compassion, brought into action by the mind, then gave rise to non-violence there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें किरीटी । इंद्रियांचिया गोठी । मनाचिये राहाटी । रूप केलें॥ ३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ kirīṭī | iṃdriyāṃciyā goṭhī | manāciye rāhāṭī | rūpa keleṃ|| 390||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, the mind's activity has been given the form of the senses' experiences.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा मनें देहें वाचा । सर्व संन्यासु दंडाचा । जाहला ठायीं जयाचा । देखशीळ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā maneṃ deheṃ vācā | sarva saṃnyāsu daṃḍācā | jāhalā ṭhāyīṃ jayācā | dekhaśīḻa|| 11||
verses.meaning: When you see someone whose mind, body, and speech have completely renounced everything, that is the true ascetic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो जाण वेल्हाळ। ज्ञानाचें वेळाउळ । हें असो निखिळ। ज्ञानचि तो॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to jāṇa velhāḻa| jñānāceṃ veḻāuḻa | heṃ aso nikhiḻa| jñānaci to|| 12||
verses.meaning: Know Him to be the very essence of knowledge, the abode of knowledge. Indeed, He is nothing but pure knowledge itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे अहिंसा कानें ऐकिजे। ग्रंथाधारें निरूपिजे। ते पहावी हें उपजे। तें तोचि पाहावा॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je ahiṃsā kāneṃ aikije| graṃthādhāreṃ nirūpije| te pahāvī heṃ upaje| teṃ toci pāhāvā|| 13||
verses.meaning: That non-violence which is heard through the ears, and expounded upon through scriptures, the desire to see it arises, then that very non-violence should be seen (experienced).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें म्हणितलें देवें। तें बोलें एकें सांगावें। परि फांकला हें उपसाहावें। तुम्हीं मज॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ mhaṇitaleṃ deveṃ| teṃ boleṃ ekeṃ sāṃgāveṃ| pari phāṃkalā heṃ upasāhāveṃ| tumhīṃ maja|| 14||
verses.meaning: The Lord spoke thus. Though it could be conveyed in a single word, please bear with me as it has expanded.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणाल हिरवें चारीं गुरूं। विसरे मागील मोहर धरूं । कां वारेलगें पांखिरूं । गगनीं भरें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇāla hiraveṃ cārīṃ gurūṃ| visare māgīla mohara dharūṃ | kāṃ vārelageṃ pāṃkhirūṃ | gaganīṃ bhareṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: You might say, "The green grass lures the cattle, making them forget the previous harvest." Or, "A bird caught in the wind soars high in the sky." (Similarly, the mind is drawn to worldly pleasures, forgetting its true nature, or is carried away by external forces.)

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसिया प्रेमाचिया स्फूर्ती। फावळिया रसवृत्तीं। वाहविला मती। आकळेना॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tesiyā premāciyā sphūrtī| phāvaḻiyā rasavṛttīṃ| vāhavilā matī| ākaḻenā|| 16||
verses.meaning: Thus, the inspiration of love, blossoming with the essence of devotion, flows forth, and the intellect cannot grasp it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि तैसें नोहे अवधारा । कारण असें विस्तारा। एऱ्हबीं पद तरी अक्षरां। तिहींचेंचि ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari taiseṃ nohe avadhārā | kāraṇa aseṃ vistārā| eṟhabīṃ pada tarī akṣarāṃ| tihīṃceṃci || 17||
verses.meaning: But understand, it is not so. The reason for this is extensive. Otherwise, the word itself is made of those very letters.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहिंसा म्हणतां थोडी । परि ते तैचि होय उघडी । जें लोटिजती कोडी । मतांचिया ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahiṃsā mhaṇatāṃ thoḍī | pari te taici hoya ughaḍī | jeṃ loṭijatī koḍī | matāṃciyā || 18||
verses.meaning: The word "non-violence" is small, but it becomes truly revealed when countless opinions are set aside.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱहवी प्राप्तें मतांतरे । थातंबूनि आंगभरें। बोलिजेल तें न सरे। तुम्हांपाशीं ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟahavī prāpteṃ matāṃtare | thātaṃbūni āṃgabhareṃ| bolijela teṃ na sare| tumhāṃpāśīṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, if I were to speak with the pride of acquired knowledge and differing opinions, it would not be fitting in your presence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रत्नपारखियांच्या गांवीं । जाईल गंडकी तरी सोडावी । काश्मिरी न करावी । मिडगण जेवीं ॥ ३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ratnapārakhiyāṃcyā gāṃvīṃ | jāīla gaṃḍakī tarī soḍāvī | kāśmirī na karāvī | miḍagaṇa jevīṃ || 320||
verses.meaning: If a Gandaki stone were to go to a village of jewel appraisers, it would be discarded, just as a Kashmiri saffron would not be considered ordinary.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काइसा वासु कापुरा | मंद जेथ अवधारा । पिठाचा बिकरा । तिये सातें॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāisā vāsu kāpurā | maṃda jetha avadhārā | piṭhācā bikarā | tiye sāteṃ|| 29||
verses.meaning: Consider, for instance, how camphor, though fragrant, is consumed by the fire that burns it, leaving no trace behind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणोनि इये सभे। बोलकेपणाचेनि क्षोभें। लाग सरू न लभे। बोला प्रभु॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇoni iye sabhe| bolakepaṇāceni kṣobheṃ| lāga sarū na labhe| bolā prabhu|| 22||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in this assembly, due to the agitation of excessive speech, it is not possible to approach the Lord through words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सामान्या आणि विशेषा। सकळे कीजेलळ देखा। तरि कानाचेया मुखा-। कडे न्याल ना तुम्ही ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāmānyā āṇi viśeṣā| sakaḻe kījelaḻa dekhā| tari kānāceyā mukhā-| kaḍe nyāla nā tumhī || 23||
verses.meaning: If all things, both general and specific, are to be created, then why would you not bring them to the mouth of the ear?

verses.shloka_devanagari: शंकेचेनि गदळें । जैं शुद्ध प्रमेय मैळे । तैं मागुतिया पाउलीं पळे । अवधान येतें ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: śaṃkeceni gadaḻeṃ | jaiṃ śuddha prameya maiḻe | taiṃ māgutiyā pāulīṃ paḻe | avadhāna yeteṃ || 24||
verses.meaning: When pure knowledge is obscured by the dust of doubt, then attention retreats, turning back on its steps.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां करूनि बाबुळियेची बुंथी। जळें जियें ठाती। तयांची वास पाहाती । हसु काई ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ karūni bābuḻiyecī buṃthī| jaḻeṃ jiyeṃ ṭhātī| tayāṃcī vāsa pāhātī | hasu kāī || 25||
verses.meaning: Why would one plant a thorny acacia tree and then expect to find sweet fruits on it? What is there to laugh about in such an expectation?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां अभ्रापैलीकडे। जैं येत चांदिणें कोडें। तें चकोरें चांचुबडें। उचलितीना॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ abhrāpailīkaḍe| jaiṃ yeta cāṃdiṇeṃ koḍeṃ| teṃ cakoreṃ cāṃcubaḍeṃ| ucalitīnā|| 26||
verses.meaning: Just as the moonlight, though beautiful, cannot be picked up by the chakora bird when it is beyond the clouds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तुम्ही वास न पाहाल ग्रंथु नेघा बरी 'कोपाळ। जरी निर्विवाद नव्हैळ। निरूपण॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ tumhī vāsa na pāhāla graṃthu neghā barī 'kopāḻa| jarī nirvivāda navhaiḻa| nirūpaṇa|| 27||
verses.meaning: Similarly, you should not disregard this scripture, nor should you consider it insignificant, even if the exposition is not entirely flawless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न बुझावितां मतें। न फिटे आक्षेपाचें लागतें। तें व्याख्यान जी तुमतें । जोडूनि नेदी ॥ २८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: na bujhāvitāṃ mateṃ| na phiṭe ākṣepāceṃ lāgateṃ| teṃ vyākhyāna jī tumateṃ | joḍūni nedī || 28 ||
verses.meaning: Unless the arguments are refuted, the accusations will not cease. Such an explanation, O Lord, does not lead to union (with the Divine).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि माझें तंव आघवें। ग्रथन येणेंचि भावें। जे तुम्हीं संतीं होआवें। सन्मुख सदा ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mājheṃ taṃva āghaveṃ| grathana yeṇeṃci bhāveṃ| je tumhīṃ saṃtīṃ hoāveṃ| sanmukha sadā || 29||
verses.meaning: And indeed, my entire composition is for this very purpose: that you, the saints, should always be favorably disposed towards it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येऱ्हवीं तरी साचोकारें। तुम्ही गीतार्थाचे सोइरे। जाणोनि गीता एकसरें। धरिली मियां॥ ३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṟhavīṃ tarī sācokāreṃ| tumhī gītārthāce soire| jāṇoni gītā ekasareṃ| dharilī miyāṃ|| 330||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, truly, knowing you to be the kin of the Gita's meaning, I have embraced the Gita wholeheartedly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें आपुलें सर्वस्व द्याळ। मग इयेतें सोडवूनि न्याळ। म्हणौनि ग्रंथु नव्हे वोळ। साचचि हे ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ āpuleṃ sarvasva dyāḻa| maga iyeteṃ soḍavūni nyāḻa| mhaṇauni graṃthu navhe voḻa| sācaci he || 31||
verses.meaning: When one's entire being becomes compassionate, then this (knowledge) is released and seen. Therefore, this scripture is not merely a collection of words, but truly a profound reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां सर्वस्वाचा लोभु धरा। बोलीचा अव्हेर करा। तरी गीते मज अवधारा) एकचि गती॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ sarvasvācā lobhu dharā| bolīcā avhera karā| tarī gīte maja avadhārā) ekaci gatī|| 32||
verses.meaning: Or, if you desire everything, and reject mere words, then listen to me, for the Gita is your only refuge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना मज। तुमचिया कृपा काज। तियेलागीं व्याज । ग्रंथाचें केलें॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā maja| tumaciyā kṛpā kāja| tiyelāgīṃ vyāja | graṃthāceṃ keleṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: Indeed, for the sake of your grace, I have made this scripture a mere pretext.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तुम्हां रसिकांजोगें। व्याख्यान शोधाबें लागे । म्हणौनि जी मतांगें। बोलों गेलो॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tumhāṃ rasikāṃjogeṃ| vyākhyāna śodhābeṃ lāge | mhaṇauni jī matāṃgeṃ| boloṃ gelo|| 34||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I must find an explanation suitable for you, O connoisseurs. That is why I have come to speak about these principles.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब कथेसि पसरु जाहला । शलोकार्थु दूरी गेला। कीजो क्षमा यया बोला । अपत्या मज॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba kathesi pasaru jāhalā | śalokārthu dūrī gelā| kījo kṣamā yayā bolā | apatyā maja|| 35||
verses.meaning: The story has expanded, and the meaning of the shloka has gone far. Please forgive these words, considering me as your child.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि घांसाआंतिल हरळु। फेडितां लागे वेळु। तें दूषण नव्हें खडळु । सांडावा कौं॥३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ghāṃsāāṃtila haraḻu| pheḍitāṃ lāge veḻu| teṃ dūṣaṇa navheṃ khaḍaḻu | sāṃḍāvā kauṃ||36||
verses.meaning: And if it takes time to remove a pebble from a morsel of food, that is not a fault to be discarded.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां संवचोरा चुकवितां। दिवस लागलिया माता। कोपाबें कीं जीविता । जिताणें कौजे॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ saṃvacorā cukavitāṃ| divasa lāgaliyā mātā| kopābeṃ kīṃ jīvitā | jitāṇeṃ kauje|| 37||
verses.meaning: If a thief is caught during the day, will he not be angry and try to harm the one who caught him?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी यावरील हें नव्हे। तुम्हीं उपसाहिलें तेंचि बरवें। आतां अवधारिजो देवें। बोलिलें ऐसें॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī yāvarīla heṃ navhe| tumhīṃ upasāhileṃ teṃci baraveṃ| ātāṃ avadhārijo deveṃ| bolileṃ aiseṃ|| 38||
verses.meaning: But this is not the point. What you have endured is good. Now, let the Lord listen to what has been said.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे उन्मेखसुलोचना । सावध होई अर्जुना । करूं तुज ज्ञाना । वोळखी आतां॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe unmekhasulocanā | sāvadha hoī arjunā | karūṃ tuja jñānā | voḻakhī ātāṃ|| 39||
verses.meaning: Krishna said, "O Arjuna, with the eye of spiritual insight, awaken now! I shall now introduce you to true knowledge."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि ज्ञान गा तें एथें। बोळखें तूं निरुतें। आक्रोशेंबीण जेथें । क्षमा असे ॥ ३४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari jñāna gā teṃ etheṃ| boḻakheṃ tūṃ niruteṃ| ākrośeṃbīṇa jetheṃ | kṣamā ase || 340||
verses.meaning: Therefore, know that true knowledge is where forgiveness exists without any clamor or demand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगाध सरोवरीं । कमळिणी जियापरी । कां सदैवाचिया घरीं । संपत्ति जैसी ॥ ४१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: agādha sarovarīṃ | kamaḻiṇī jiyāparī | kāṃ sadaivāciyā gharīṃ | saṃpatti jaisī || 419||
verses.meaning: Just as a lotus blooms in a deep lake, or wealth flourishes in the home of the fortunate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्था तेणें पाडें । क्षमा जयातें वाढे । तेही लक्षे तें फुडें । लक्षण सांगो ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārthā teṇeṃ pāḍeṃ | kṣamā jayāteṃ vāḍhe | tehī lakṣe teṃ phuḍeṃ | lakṣaṇa sāṃgo || 42||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, I will now clearly explain the characteristics of one in whom forgiveness grows to such an extent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि पढियंतें लेणें। आंगीं भावें जेणें। धरिजे तेवीं साहणें। सर्वचि जया॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari paḍhiyaṃteṃ leṇeṃ| āṃgīṃ bhāveṃ jeṇeṃ| dharije tevīṃ sāhaṇeṃ| sarvaci jayā|| 43||
verses.meaning: Just as one adorns themselves with ornaments out of love, so too does one embrace all suffering with the same devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्रिविध मुख्य आघवे । उपद्रवांचे मेळावे । वरि पडिलिया नव्हे । वांकुडा जो॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: trividha mukhya āghave | upadravāṃce meḻāve | vari paḍiliyā navhe | vāṃkuḍā jo|| 44||
verses.meaning: Even when the three types of afflictions, a multitude of troubles, fall upon him, he does not become crooked (deviate from his path).

verses.shloka_devanagari: अपेक्षित पावे। तें जेणें तोषें मानवें । अनपेक्षिताही करवे । तोचि मानु॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: apekṣita pāve| teṃ jeṇeṃ toṣeṃ mānaveṃ | anapekṣitāhī karave | toci mānu|| 45||
verses.meaning: That which is desired is attained, and that which is not desired is also accomplished, by the grace of the Lord. This indeed is true honor.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो मानापमानातें साहे । सुखदुःख जेथ सामाये । निंदास्तुती नोहे । दुखंडु जो॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo mānāpamānāteṃ sāhe | sukhaduḥkha jetha sāmāye | niṃdāstutī nohe | dukhaṃḍu jo|| 46||
verses.meaning: One who endures honor and dishonor, in whom joy and sorrow are contained, and who is not divided by praise or blame.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उन्हाळेनि जो न तपे। हिमवंतीं न कांपे । 'कायसेनिही न वासिपे। पातलेया॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: unhāḻeni jo na tape| himavaṃtīṃ na kāṃpe | 'kāyasenihī na vāsipe| pātaleyā|| 47||
verses.meaning: One who is not scorched by summer's heat, nor shivers in winter's cold, and remains unafraid of any approaching calamity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वशिखरांचा भारु । नेणें जैसा मेरु। कीं धरा यज्ञसूकरु। बोझें न म्हणे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: svaśikharāṃcā bhāru | neṇeṃ jaisā meru| kīṃ dharā yajñasūkaru| bojheṃ na mhaṇe|| 48||
verses.meaning: Just as Mount Meru does not feel the burden of its own peaks, or the Varaha (boar incarnation) does not consider the Earth a burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना चराचरीं भूतीं। २८४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी दाटणी नव्हे क्षिती । तैसा नाना द्वुंद्रीं प्राप्तीं। घामेजेना ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā carācarīṃ bhūtīṃ| 284 śrījñāneśvarī dāṭaṇī navhe kṣitī | taisā nānā dvuṃdrīṃ prāptīṃ| ghāmejenā || 49 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the earth is not crowded by the various moving and non-moving beings, so too, one who has attained the Supreme does not sweat (is not troubled) by various dualities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घेऊनी जळाचे 'लोट। आलिया नदीनदांचे संघाट। करी वाड पोट । समुद्र जेवीं ॥ ३५० तैसें जयाचिया ठायीं। न साहणें कांहींचि नाहीं। आणि साहतु असे ऐसेंही । स्मरण नुरे॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: gheūnī jaḻāce 'loṭa| āliyā nadīnadāṃce saṃghāṭa| karī vāḍa poṭa | samudra jevīṃ || 350 taiseṃ jayāciyā ṭhāyīṃ| na sāhaṇeṃ kāṃhīṃci nāhīṃ| āṇi sāhatu ase aiseṃhī | smaraṇa nure|| 51||
verses.meaning: Just as the ocean, receiving the vast currents of water from rivers and streams, swells its belly, so too, in one who has attained this state, there is nothing that cannot be endured, and yet, there remains no memory of having endured anything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंगा जें पातलें। तें करूनि घाली आपुलें। तेथ साहतेनि नवलें। घेपिजेना ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃgā jeṃ pātaleṃ| teṃ karūni ghālī āpuleṃ| tetha sāhateni navaleṃ| ghepijenā || 52||
verses.meaning: Whatever comes to one's lot, one should make it one's own. There is no wonder in accepting it with endurance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे अनाक्रोश क्षमा । जयापाशीं प्रियोत्तमा। जाण तेणें महिमा। ज्ञानासि गा॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: he anākrośa kṣamā | jayāpāśīṃ priyottamā| jāṇa teṇeṃ mahimā| jñānāsi gā||53||
verses.meaning: O dearest one, know that the glory of knowledge resides with one who possesses forgiveness and is free from anger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो पुरुषु पांडवा । ज्ञानाचा बोलावा । आतां परिस आर्जवा। रूप करूं ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to puruṣu pāṃḍavā | jñānācā bolāvā | ātāṃ parisa ārjavā| rūpa karūṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, now listen to the discourse on knowledge, which I shall present in a gentle manner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आर्जव तें ऐसें। प्राणाचें सौजन्य जैसें। आवडे तयाही दोषें। एकचि गा॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ārjava teṃ aiseṃ| prāṇāceṃ saujanya jaiseṃ| āvaḍe tayāhī doṣeṃ| ekaci gā|| 55||
verses.meaning: Thus, entreaty is like the gentleness of life itself. Even with its flaws, it is one and the same.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां तोंड पाहूनि प्रकाशु । न करी जेवीं चंडांशु। जगा एकुचि अबकाशु। आकाश जेसें ॥५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ toṃḍa pāhūni prakāśu | na karī jevīṃ caṃḍāṃśu| jagā ekuci abakāśu| ākāśa jeseṃ ||56||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun does not shine by looking at faces, and just as the sky provides a single, undifferentiated space for all the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जयाचें मन। माणुसाप्ती आन आन। नव्हे आणि वर्तन। ऐसें पैं तें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jayāceṃ mana| māṇusāptī āna āna| navhe āṇi vartana| aiseṃ paiṃ teṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: Just as one's mind, when it attains humanity, does not act otherwise, so too is its conduct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें जगेंचि सनोळख । जगेंसीं जुनाट सोयरिक । आपपर हे भाख । जाणणें नाहीं ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ jageṃci sanoḻakha | jageṃsīṃ junāṭa soyarika | āpapara he bhākha | jāṇaṇeṃ nāhīṃ || 58||
verses.meaning: That which is intimately familiar with the world, having an ancient kinship with it, knows no distinction of 'mine' and 'thine'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भलतेणेंसीं मेळु। पाणिया ऐसा ढाळु। कवणेविखीं आडळु । नेघे चित्त ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhalateṇeṃsīṃ meḻu| pāṇiyā aisā ḍhāḻu| kavaṇevikhīṃ āḍaḻu | neghe citta || 59||
verses.meaning: The mind, like water, flows freely and does not encounter any obstruction in any matter, even when it is with the unworthy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वारियाची धांव । तैसें सरळ भाव। शंका आणि हांब। नाहीं जया॥ ३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāriyācī dhāṃva | taiseṃ saraḻa bhāva| śaṃkā āṇi hāṃba| nāhīṃ jayā|| 360||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind moves freely, so too are their intentions straightforward, without doubt or hesitation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मायेपुढें बाळका। रिगतां न पडे शंका। तैसें मन देतां लोकां। नाळोची जो॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: māyepuḍheṃ bāḻakā| rigatāṃ na paḍe śaṃkā| taiseṃ mana detāṃ lokāṃ| nāḻocī jo|| 61||
verses.meaning: Just as a child approaches its mother without any hesitation, so too should one offer their mind to the divine without any attachment or reservation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: फांकलिया इंदीवरा। परिवारु नाहीं धनुर्धरा। तैसा कोनकोंपरा । नेणेचि जो॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: phāṃkaliyā iṃdīvarā| parivāru nāhīṃ dhanurdharā| taisā konakoṃparā | neṇeci jo|| 62||
verses.meaning: Just as a lotus blooming in a lake has no family or lineage, so too the Self (Atman) is not confined to any corner or direction, being all-pervading and without boundaries.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चोखाळपण रताचें। कां रत्नावरी किरणाचें । तैसें पुढां मन जयाचें । करणें पाठीं ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: cokhāḻapaṇa ratāceṃ| kāṃ ratnāvarī kiraṇāceṃ | taiseṃ puḍhāṃ mana jayāceṃ | karaṇeṃ pāṭhīṃ || 63||
verses.meaning: Just as the purity is inherent in a gem, or the rays are inherent in a jewel, so too is the mind of one whose actions follow their intentions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आलोचुं जो नेणें। अनुभवचि जोगावणें । धरी मोकली अंतःकरणे । नव्हेचि जया॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ālocuṃ jo neṇeṃ| anubhavaci jogāvaṇeṃ | dharī mokalī aṃtaḥkaraṇe | navheci jayā|| 64||
verses.meaning: One who does not know how to come and go, who does not know how to experience, whose mind does not grasp or release, is not truly living.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिठी नोहे मिणधी । बोलणें नाहीं संदिग्धी। कवणेंसीं हीनबुद्धी । राहाटीजे ना॥६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: diṭhī nohe miṇadhī | bolaṇeṃ nāhīṃ saṃdigdhī| kavaṇeṃsīṃ hīnabuddhī | rāhāṭīje nā||65||
verses.meaning: The vision is not blurred, nor is the speech ambiguous. With whom should one live with a dull intellect?

verses.shloka_devanagari: दाही इंद्रियें प्रांजळें । निष्प्रपंचें निर्मळें।॥ पांचही पाळव मोकळे । आठही पाहर॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: dāhī iṃdriyeṃ prāṃjaḻeṃ | niṣprapaṃceṃ nirmaḻeṃ||| pāṃcahī pāḻava mokaḻe | āṭhahī pāhara|| 66||
verses.meaning: The ten senses are pure and unblemished, free from worldly entanglement. The five vital airs are released, and all eight watches of the day are observed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अमृताची धार। तैसें उज अंतर। किंबहुना जो माहेर । या चिन्हांचे ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: amṛtācī dhāra| taiseṃ uja aṃtara| kiṃbahunā jo māhera | yā cinhāṃce || 67||
verses.meaning: Like a stream of nectar, so is the inner light. In short, it is the very home of these signs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो पुरुष सुभटा। आर्जवाचा आंगवठा । जाण तेथेंचि घरटा। ज्ञाने केला ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: to puruṣa subhaṭā| ārjavācā āṃgavaṭhā | jāṇa tetheṃci gharaṭā| jñāne kelā || 68||
verses.meaning: That person, O brave one, made the abode of humility and sincerity his home, as Dnyaneshwar knew.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां ययावरी। गुरुभक्तीची परी । सांगों गा अवधारीं । चतुरनाथा ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yayāvarī| gurubhaktīcī parī | sāṃgoṃ gā avadhārīṃ | caturanāthā || 69||
verses.meaning: Now, upon this, O Lord of the wise, I shall explain the nature of devotion to the Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आघवीयाचि दैवां। जन्मभूमि हे सेवा । जे ब्रह्म करी जीवा । शोच्यातेंहि॥ ३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āghavīyāci daivāṃ| janmabhūmi he sevā | je brahma karī jīvā | śocyāteṃhi|| 370||
verses.meaning: All destinies find their birthplace in this service, which makes even the Brahman, the very soul, worthy of lamentation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते आचार्योपास्ती । प्रकटिजैळ तुजप्रती । बैसों दे एकपांतीं। अवधानाची ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: te ācāryopāstī | prakaṭijaiḻa tujapratī | baisoṃ de ekapāṃtīṃ| avadhānācī || 71||
verses.meaning: That devotion to the Guru, I shall reveal to you. Let it sit in the same row as your attention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सकळ जळसमृद्धी। घेऊनि गंगा निघाली उदधी। कों श्रुति हे महापदीं। पैठी जाहाली ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sakaḻa jaḻasamṛddhī| gheūni gaṃgā nighālī udadhī| koṃ śruti he mahāpadīṃ| paiṭhī jāhālī || 72||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganga, with all its abundant waters, flows towards the ocean, so too the Vedas (Shruti) have entered this supreme state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना वेंटाळूनि जीवितें। गुणागुण उखितें। प्राणनाथा उचितें। दिधलें प्रिया ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā veṃṭāḻūni jīviteṃ| guṇāguṇa ukhiteṃ| prāṇanāthā uciteṃ| didhaleṃ priyā || 73||
verses.meaning: Having embraced various lives, and having experienced both good and bad, O Lord of my life, I have offered myself to you, my beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सबाह्य आपुलें। जेणें गुरुकुळीं बोपिलें। आपणपें केलें। भक्‍तीचें घर॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sabāhya āpuleṃ| jeṇeṃ gurukuḻīṃ bopileṃ| āpaṇapeṃ keleṃ| bhak‍tīceṃ ghara|| 74||
verses.meaning: Just as one who has completely dedicated themselves to the guru's lineage, making their very being a home for devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरुगृह जये देशीं। तो देशुचि बसे मानसीं । विरहिणी कां जैसी । वल्लभातें ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: gurugṛha jaye deśīṃ| to deśuci base mānasīṃ | virahiṇī kāṃ jaisī | vallabhāteṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Just as a separated lover constantly remembers her beloved, so too does the disciple's mind dwell on the land where the Guru resides.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियेकडोनि येतसे वारा। देखोनि धांवे सामोरा । आड पडे म्हणे घरा। बीजें कीजो॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyekaḍoni yetase vārā| dekhoni dhāṃve sāmorā | āḍa paḍe mhaṇe gharā| bījeṃ kījo|| 76||
verses.meaning: When the wind comes from that direction, seeing it, he runs to meet it. He stands in its way and says, "Please come into my house."

verses.shloka_devanagari: साचा प्रेमाचिया भुली । तया दिशेसीचि आवडे बोली । जीवु थानपती करूनि घाली । गुरुगृही जो॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sācā premāciyā bhulī | tayā diśesīci āvaḍe bolī | jīvu thānapatī karūni ghālī | gurugṛhī jo|| 77||
verses.meaning: The one who, out of true love's forgetfulness, finds delight in the words of that direction, and dedicates their very life to the guru's abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी गुरुआज्ञा धरिलें। देह गांबीं असे एकलें। वांसरुवा लाविलें । दावें जैसें ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī guruājñā dharileṃ| deha gāṃbīṃ ase ekaleṃ| vāṃsaruvā lāvileṃ | dāveṃ jaiseṃ || 78||
verses.meaning: But the body, having held onto the Guru's command, remains alone, like a calf tied with a rope.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे कै हें बिरडे फिटेल। कै तो स्वामी भेटेल। युगाहूनि वडिल। निमिष मानी ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe kai heṃ biraḍe phiṭela| kai to svāmī bheṭela| yugāhūni vaḍila| nimiṣa mānī || 79||
verses.meaning: When will this separation end? When will I meet that Lord? A moment feels longer than an age.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेया गुरुग्रामींचें आलें। कां स्वयें गुरूंनींचि धाडिलें। तरी गतायुष्या जोडलें। आयुष्य जैसें ॥ ३८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseyā gurugrāmīṃceṃ āleṃ| kāṃ svayeṃ gurūṃnīṃci dhāḍileṃ| tarī gatāyuṣyā joḍaleṃ| āyuṣya jaiseṃ || 380||
verses.meaning: When such a guru's message arrives, or when the guru himself sends it, it is like life being added to one who has already lost their life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां सुकतया अंकुरा-। वरी पडलिया पीयूषधारा। ना ना अल्पोदकींचा सागरा) आला मासा॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ sukatayā aṃkurā-| varī paḍaliyā pīyūṣadhārā| nā nā alpodakīṃcā sāgarā) ālā māsā|| 81||
verses.meaning: Or, if a fish from a small pond were to find itself in the ocean, or if a stream of nectar were to fall upon a withered sprout.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी रंकें निधान देखिलें। कां आंधळिया डोळे उघडले । भणंगाचिया आंगा आलें। इंद्रपद॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī raṃkeṃ nidhāna dekhileṃ| kāṃ āṃdhaḻiyā ḍoḻe ughaḍale | bhaṇaṃgāciyā āṃgā āleṃ| iṃdrapada|| 82||
verses.meaning: It is like a pauper finding a treasure, or a blind person regaining sight, or a beggar attaining the status of Indra.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें गुरुकुळाचेनि नांवें । महासुखें अति थोरावे । जें कोडेंही पोटाळवे। आकाश कां॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ gurukuḻāceni nāṃveṃ | mahāsukheṃ ati thorāve | jeṃ koḍeṃhī poṭāḻave| ākāśa kāṃ|| 83||
verses.meaning: Just as the name of the Guru's lineage brings immense joy and profound greatness, which cannot be contained even by the vastness of the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गुरुकुळीं ऐसी । आवडी जया देखसी । जाण ज्ञान तयापासीं । पाइकी करी॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gurukuḻīṃ aisī | āvaḍī jayā dekhasī | jāṇa jñāna tayāpāsīṃ | pāikī karī||84||
verses.meaning: Know that one who has such devotion for the lineage of the Guru, knowledge itself serves him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि अभ्यंतरील्यिकडे । प्रेमाचेनि पवाडे । श्रीगुरूचें रूपडें । उपासी ध्यानीं ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi abhyaṃtarīlyikaḍe | premāceni pavāḍe | śrīgurūceṃ rūpaḍeṃ | upāsī dhyānīṃ || 85 ||
verses.meaning: And within, through the power of love, the devotee meditates on the form of the Guru in their mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हृदयशुद्धीचिया आवारीं । आराध्यु तो निश्चल ध्रुव करी । मग सर्व भावेंसीं परिवारीं । आपण होय ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hṛdayaśuddhīciyā āvārīṃ | ārādhyu to niścala dhruva karī | maga sarva bhāveṃsīṃ parivārīṃ | āpaṇa hoya || 86||
verses.meaning: In the courtyard of a pure heart, one should make the worshipped deity a steadfast pole star. Then, with all emotions as its retinue, one becomes that very deity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां चैतन्यांचिये पोबळी-। माजीं आनंदाचिया राउळीं। श्रीगुरुलिंगा ढाळी । ध्यानामृत ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ caitanyāṃciye pobaḻī-| mājīṃ ānaṃdāciyā rāuḻīṃ| śrīguruliṃgā ḍhāḻī | dhyānāmṛta || 87||
verses.meaning: Or, in the temple of bliss within the abode of consciousness, the divine Guru-linga pours forth the nectar of meditation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदयिजतां बोधार्का । बुद्धीची डाळ सात्त्विका। भरोनियां त्र्यंबका। लाखोली वाहे॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: udayijatāṃ bodhārkā | buddhīcī ḍāḻa sāttvikā| bharoniyāṃ tryaṃbakā| lākholī vāhe|| 88||
verses.meaning: When the sun of knowledge rises, the pure intellect, like a sacred offering, reverently worships Lord Shiva.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काळणशुद्धी त्रिकाळीं। जीवबदशा धूप जाळी । ज्ञानदीपें बोंबाळी । निरंतर ॥ ८९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāḻaṇaśuddhī trikāḻīṃ| jīvabadaśā dhūpa jāḻī | jñānadīpeṃ boṃbāḻī | niraṃtara || 89 ||
verses.meaning: The purification of time, in all three periods, burns away the incense of the individual soul's bondage. With the lamp of knowledge, the clamor of ignorance is continuously dispelled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सामरस्याची रससोय । अखंड अर्पितु जाय । आपण भराडा होय । गुरु तो लिंग॥ ३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāmarasyācī rasasoya | akhaṃḍa arpitu jāya | āpaṇa bharāḍā hoya | guru to liṃga|| 390||
verses.meaning: The Guru is like a linga, a sacred symbol, who continuously offers the essence of harmonious union, becoming a vessel himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी जीवाचिये सेजे। गुरु कांतु करूनि भुंजे। ऐसी प्रेमाचेनि भोजें। बुद्धी बाहे ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī jīvāciye seje| guru kāṃtu karūni bhuṃje| aisī premāceni bhojeṃ| buddhī bāhe || 91||
verses.meaning: Or, the intellect, through the feast of love, makes the Guru her husband and enjoys the union of the soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कोणे एके अवसरीं । अनुरागु भरे अंतरीं । कीं तया नाम करी । क्षीराब्धी ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: koṇe eke avasarīṃ | anurāgu bhare aṃtarīṃ | kīṃ tayā nāma karī | kṣīrābdhī || 92||
verses.meaning: At some opportune moment, love fills the heart, and that love is named the Ocean of Milk.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ ध्येयध्यान बहु सुख । तेंचि शेषतुळिका निर्दोख। वरी जळशयन देख भावी गुरु॥९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha dhyeyadhyāna bahu sukha | teṃci śeṣatuḻikā nirdokha| varī jaḻaśayana dekha bhāvī guru||93||
verses.meaning: There, the object of meditation and the meditation itself are of great joy. That very pure remnant, and the vision of the water-bed, are considered the future guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वोळगती पाय। ते लक्ष्मी आपण होय। गरुड होऊनि उभा राहे। आपणचि॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga voḻagatī pāya| te lakṣmī āpaṇa hoya| garuḍa hoūni ubhā rāhe| āpaṇaci|| 94||
verses.meaning: Then the feet become Lakshmi herself. The devotee himself becomes Garuda and stands ready to serve.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाभी आपण जनम्मे। २८६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी ऐसें गुरुमूर्तिप्रेमें। अनुभवी मनोधरमे । ध्यानसुख ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nābhī āpaṇa janamme| 286 śrījñāneśvarī aiseṃ gurumūrtipremeṃ| anubhavī manodharame | dhyānasukha || 95||
verses.meaning: Thus, with the love for the Guru's form, one experiences the joy of meditation through the mind's devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकाधिये वेळें। गुरु माय करी भावबळें। मग स्तन्यसुखें लोळें। अंकावरी ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekādhiye veḻeṃ| guru māya karī bhāvabaḻeṃ| maga stanyasukheṃ loḻeṃ| aṃkāvarī || 96||
verses.meaning: Sometimes, by the power of his devotion, the Guru becomes like a mother. Then, the disciple, experiencing the joy of her milk, rolls in her lap.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी गा किरीटी । चैतन्यतरुतळवटीं। गुरु धेनु आपण पाठीं । वत्स होय ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī gā kirīṭī | caitanyatarutaḻavaṭīṃ| guru dhenu āpaṇa pāṭhīṃ | vatsa hoya || 97||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Kiriti, under the tree of consciousness, the Guru is the cow, and you yourself become the calf.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरुकृपास्नेहसलिलीं। आपण होय मासोळी । कोणे एके वेळीं। हेंचि भावीं ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: gurukṛpāsnehasalilīṃ| āpaṇa hoya māsoḻī | koṇe eke veḻīṃ| heṃci bhāvīṃ || 98||
verses.meaning: In the waters of the Guru's grace and love, one becomes a fish. Always remember this truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरुकृपामृताचें बडप। आपण सेवावृत्तीचें होय रोप । ऐसेसे संकल्प। विये मन॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: gurukṛpāmṛtāceṃ baḍapa| āpaṇa sevāvṛttīceṃ hoya ropa | aisese saṃkalpa| viye mana|| 99||
verses.meaning: The mind conceives such thoughts: "I am a sapling of service, nourished by the nectar of the Guru's grace."

verses.shloka_devanagari: चक्षुपक्षेंबीण। पिळू होय आपण। कैसें पैं अपारपण। आवडीचें॥ ४००॥
verses.shloka_iast: cakṣupakṣeṃbīṇa| piḻū hoya āpaṇa| kaiseṃ paiṃ apārapaṇa| āvaḍīceṃ|| 400||
verses.meaning: How can one describe the immeasurable nature of love, which, without eyes, becomes the very act of seeing?

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरूतें पक्षिणी करी। चारा घे चांचूबरी । गुरु तारू धरी। आपण कांस॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: gurūteṃ pakṣiṇī karī| cārā ghe cāṃcūbarī | guru tārū dharī| āpaṇa kāṃsa|| 1||
verses.meaning: The bird makes the Guru its mother, taking sustenance from the Guru's beak. The Guru holds the boat, while the bird itself becomes the rope.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें प्रेमाचेनि थावें। ध्यानचि ध्यानातें प्रसवे। पूर्णसिंधू हेळावे। फुटती जैसे॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ premāceni thāveṃ| dhyānaci dhyānāteṃ prasave| pūrṇasiṃdhū heḻāve| phuṭatī jaise|| 2||
verses.meaning: Such is the abundance of love, that meditation itself gives birth to more meditation, just as waves naturally arise from the full ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना यापरी । श्रीगुरुमूर्ति अंतरीं । भोगी आतां अवधारीं । बाह्यसेवा॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā yāparī | śrīgurumūrti aṃtarīṃ | bhogī ātāṃ avadhārīṃ | bāhyasevā|| 3||
verses.meaning: Indeed, in this manner, the form of the revered Guru within me now enjoys, listen, the external service.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जीवीं ऐसें आवांके । म्हणे दास्य करीन निकें । जैसेनि गुरु कौतुकें । माग म्हणती ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jīvīṃ aiseṃ āvāṃke | mhaṇe dāsya karīna nikeṃ | jaiseni guru kautukeṃ | māga mhaṇatī || 4||
verses.meaning: Thus, with such longing in my heart, I say I will serve diligently, just as the Guru affectionately says, "Ask."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसिया साचा उपास्ती। गोसावी प्रसन्न होती। तेथ मी विनंती। ऐसी करीन ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisiyā sācā upāstī| gosāvī prasanna hotī| tetha mī vinaṃtī| aisī karīna || 5||
verses.meaning: In such a truly devoted worship, the Lord becomes pleased. Then, I will make such a request.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणेन तुमचा देवा। परिवारु जो आधवा। तेतुलें रूपें होआवा। मीचि एकु ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇena tumacā devā| parivāru jo ādhavā| tetuleṃ rūpeṃ hoāvā| mīci eku || 6||
verses.meaning: I will say, "O Lord, all your entire family, in all those forms, let me alone become them."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि उपकरतीं आपुली । उपकरणें आथि जेतुली । माझीं रूपें तेतुलीं। होआवीं स्वामी ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi upakaratīṃ āpulī | upakaraṇeṃ āthi jetulī | mājhīṃ rūpeṃ tetulīṃ| hoāvīṃ svāmī || 7||
verses.meaning: And all the instruments and tools that are used for service, let them all become my forms, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा मागेन वरु । तेथ हो म्हणती श्रीगुरु । मग तो परिवारु। मीचि होईन ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā māgena varu | tetha ho mhaṇatī śrīguru | maga to parivāru| mīci hoīna || 8||
verses.meaning: I will ask for such a boon, and if the Guru says yes, then I myself will become that entire retinue.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उपकरणजात सकळिक। तें मीचि होईन एकैक । तेव्हां उपास्तीचें कौतुक । देखिजैेळ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: upakaraṇajāta sakaḻika| teṃ mīci hoīna ekaika | tevhāṃ upāstīceṃ kautuka | dekhijaieḻa|| 9||
verses.meaning: All the instruments of worship, I alone will become each one of them. Then, the wonder of devotion will be seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरु बहुतांची माये । परि एकलौति होऊनि ठाये। तैसें करूनि आण वायें। कृपे तिये॥ ४१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: guru bahutāṃcī māye | pari ekalauti hoūni ṭhāye| taiseṃ karūni āṇa vāyeṃ| kṛpe tiye|| 410||
verses.meaning: The Guru's love is for many, yet it becomes singular, as if one's only child. In this way, he brings forth his grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अनुरागा वेधु लावीं। एकपत्नीव्रत घेववीं। क्षेत्रसंन्यासु करवीं। लोभाकरवीं॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā anurāgā vedhu lāvīṃ| ekapatnīvrata ghevavīṃ| kṣetrasaṃnyāsu karavīṃ| lobhākaravīṃ|| 11||
verses.meaning: Through that love, He inspires devotion, makes one take the vow of a single-minded spouse, and through greed, makes one renounce the worldly field.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चतुर्दिक्षु वारा। न लाहे निघों बाहिरा। तैसा गुरुकृपें पांजिरा। मीचि होईन॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: caturdikṣu vārā| na lāhe nighoṃ bāhirā| taisā gurukṛpeṃ pāṃjirā| mīci hoīna|| 12||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind, from all four directions, cannot escape once confined, so too, by the grace of the Guru, I shall become completely contained within myself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलिया गुणांचीं लेणीं। करीन गुरुसेवे स्वामिणी | हें असो होईन गंवसणी । मीचि भक्‍तीसी ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpuliyā guṇāṃcīṃ leṇīṃ| karīna guruseve svāmiṇī | heṃ aso hoīna gaṃvasaṇī | mīci bhak‍tīsī || 13||
verses.meaning: I will adorn the mistress of Guru-seva with my own virtues. Let this be; I will become the very essence of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरुस्नेहाचिये वृष्टी। मी पृथ्वी होईन तळवटीं। ऐसिया मनोरथांचिया सृष्टी । अनंता रची॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: gurusnehāciye vṛṣṭī| mī pṛthvī hoīna taḻavaṭīṃ| aisiyā manorathāṃciyā sṛṣṭī | anaṃtā racī|| 14||
verses.meaning: By the showering of the Guru's affection, I shall become the earth below. In this way, I shall create endless realms of desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे श्रीगुरूचें भुवन । आपण मी होईन । आणि दास होऊनि करीन । दास्य तेथिंचें ॥ १५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe śrīgurūceṃ bhuvana | āpaṇa mī hoīna | āṇi dāsa hoūni karīna | dāsya tethiṃceṃ || 15 ||
verses.meaning: He says, "I will become the abode of the Guru, and as a servant, I will perform service there."

verses.shloka_devanagari: निर्गमागमीं दातारें। जें बोलांडिजती उंबरे। ते मी होईन आणि हारें। द्वारपाळु ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nirgamāgamīṃ dātāreṃ| jeṃ bolāṃḍijatī uṃbare| te mī hoīna āṇi hāreṃ| dvārapāḻu || 16||
verses.meaning: I will become the threshold that is crossed by those who come and go, and I will be the doorkeeper, standing in line.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाउवा मी होईन। तियां मीचि 'लेववीन | छत्र मी आणि करीन । बारीपण॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāuvā mī hoīna| tiyāṃ mīci 'levavīna | chatra mī āṇi karīna | bārīpaṇa|| 17||
verses.meaning: I will become the sandals, I will adorn them myself. I will hold the umbrella, and I will be the doorkeeper.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी तळ उपरु जाणविता । चंबरधरु हातु देता। स्वामीपुढे खोलता। होईन मी॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī taḻa uparu jāṇavitā | caṃbaradharu hātu detā| svāmīpuḍhe kholatā| hoīna mī|| 18||
verses.meaning: When I, the humble servant, make my request known, and the Lord extends His hand, I shall then open up before my Master.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मीचि होईन सागळा। करूं सुईन गुरुळां। सांडिती तो नेपाळा। पडिघा मीचि॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mīci hoīna sāgaḻā| karūṃ suīna guruḻāṃ| sāṃḍitī to nepāḻā| paḍighā mīci|| 19||
verses.meaning: I myself will become the entire world, and I will make the Gurulas (disciples) happy. I am the one who casts off the Nepala (ignorance) and becomes the echo.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हडप मी बोळगेन । मीचि उगाळु घेईन । उळिंग मी करीन । आंघोळीचे ॥ ४२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: haḍapa mī boḻagena | mīci ugāḻu gheīna | uḻiṃga mī karīna | āṃghoḻīce || 420||
verses.meaning: I will chew the betel nut, I will take the juice myself, I will perform the ritual cleansing of the bath.

verses.shloka_devanagari: होईन गुरूंचें आसन । अळंकार परिधान । चंदनादि होईन । उपचार ते॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: hoīna gurūṃceṃ āsana | aḻaṃkāra paridhāna | caṃdanādi hoīna | upacāra te|| 21||
verses.meaning: I will become the seat for the Gurus, their ornaments, and the sandalwood and other offerings for their worship.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मीचि होईन सुआरु । बोगरीन उपहारु । आपणपें श्रीगुरु । बोंबाळीन ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mīci hoīna suāru | bogarīna upahāru | āpaṇapeṃ śrīguru | boṃbāḻīna || 22||
verses.meaning: I myself will become the charioteer, I will carry the offering, and I will proclaim the Guru's glory myself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे वेळीं देवो आरोगिती । तेव्हां पांतीकरु मीचि पांतीं। मीचि होईन पुढती । देईन विडा॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je veḻīṃ devo ārogitī | tevhāṃ pāṃtīkaru mīci pāṃtīṃ| mīci hoīna puḍhatī | deīna viḍā|| 23||
verses.meaning: When the gods partake of the meal, I myself become the server. I myself will come forward again and offer the betel leaf.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ताट मी काढीन । सेज मी झाडीन । चरणसंवाहन। मीचि करीन ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tāṭa mī kāḍhīna | seja mī jhāḍīna | caraṇasaṃvāhana| mīci karīna || 24||
verses.meaning: I will remove the plate. I will sweep the bed. I will massage your feet myself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सिंहासन होईन आपण। वरि गुरु करिती आरोहण । होईन पुरेपण । वोळगेचें ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: siṃhāsana hoīna āpaṇa| vari guru karitī ārohaṇa | hoīna purepaṇa | voḻageceṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: I shall become the throne, upon which the Guru will ascend, and thus my service will be fulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीगुरूंचें मन। जया देईल अवधान। तो मी पुढां होईन। चमत्कारु॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīgurūṃceṃ mana| jayā deīla avadhāna| to mī puḍhāṃ hoīna| camatkāru|| 26||
verses.meaning: The one to whom the Guru's mind will grant attention, that one I shall become, a miracle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया श्रवणाचे आंगणीं। होईन शब्दांचिया अक्षोहिणी। स्पर्श होईन घसणी। आंगाचिया॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā śravaṇāce āṃgaṇīṃ| hoīna śabdāṃciyā akṣohiṇī| sparśa hoīna ghasaṇī| āṃgāciyā|| 27||
verses.meaning: In the courtyard of that listening, I will become the armies of words. I will experience the touch of friction, of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीगुरूंचे डोळे । अवलोकनें स्नेहाळें। पाहाती तियें सकळें। होईन रूपें॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīgurūṃce ḍoḻe | avalokaneṃ snehāḻeṃ| pāhātī tiyeṃ sakaḻeṃ| hoīna rūpeṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: The Guru's eyes, with their loving gaze, behold all those forms, and I shall become those forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये रसने जो जो रुचेल तो तो रसु म्यां होईजैळ। गंधरूपें कीजेळ। घ्राणसेवा॥ २९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye rasane jo jo rucela to to rasu myāṃ hoījaiḻa| gaṃdharūpeṃ kījeḻa| ghrāṇasevā|| 29 ||
verses.meaning: Whatever taste that tongue desires, that very taste I shall become. And as fragrance, I shall serve the sense of smell.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'एवं बाह्ममनोगत। श्रीगुरुसेवा समस्त । बेंटाळीन वस्तुजात । होऊनियां ॥ ४३० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'evaṃ bāhmamanogata| śrīgurusevā samasta | beṃṭāḻīna vastujāta | hoūniyāṃ || 430 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, all external and internal service to the Guru, becoming one with the entire creation, will be fulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जंब देह हें असेळ। तंव बोळगी ऐसी कीजेळ। मग देहांतीं नवल। बुद्धि आहे॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaṃba deha heṃ aseḻa| taṃva boḻagī aisī kījeḻa| maga dehāṃtīṃ navala| buddhi āhe|| 31||
verses.meaning: As long as this body is present, one should engage in such spiritual practice. Then, at the end of the body, there will be a new understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इये शरीरींची माती । मेळवीन तिये क्षितीं। जेथ श्रीचरण उभे ठाती। श्रीगुरूंचे ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: iye śarīrīṃcī mātī | meḻavīna tiye kṣitīṃ| jetha śrīcaraṇa ubhe ṭhātī| śrīgurūṃce || 32||
verses.meaning: I will mingle the dust of this body with the earth where the holy feet of my Guru stand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझा स्वामी कवतिकें । स्पर्शीजति जियें उदकें । तेथ लया नेईन निकें । आपीं आप॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhā svāmī kavatikeṃ | sparśījati jiyeṃ udakeṃ | tetha layā neīna nikeṃ | āpīṃ āpa|| 33||
verses.meaning: The waters that my Lord playfully touches, I shall surely merge them into their own essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीगुरु बोंबाळिजती। कां भुवनीं जे उजळिजती। तयां दीपांचिया दीप्तीं। ठेवीन तेज॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīguru boṃbāḻijatī| kāṃ bhuvanīṃ je ujaḻijatī| tayāṃ dīpāṃciyā dīptīṃ| ṭhevīna teja|| 34||
verses.meaning: The light of those lamps, which are lit by the revered Guru or which illuminate the world, I shall place within my own radiance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चंबरी हन विंजणा । तेथ लयो करीन प्राणा । मग आंगाचा बोळगणा। होईन मी॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: caṃbarī hana viṃjaṇā | tetha layo karīna prāṇā | maga āṃgācā boḻagaṇā| hoīna mī|| 35||
verses.meaning: I will then make my life merge into that (divine) fan, and then I will become a sacrifice of my own body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये जिये अवकाशीं। श्रीगुरु असती परिवारेंसीं । आकाश लया आकाशीं । नेईन तिये ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye jiye avakāśīṃ| śrīguru asatī parivāreṃsīṃ | ākāśa layā ākāśīṃ | neīna tiye || 36||
verses.meaning: Wherever the revered Guru resides with his disciples, I will merge that space into the infinite space, just as the sky merges into the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि जीतु मेला न संडीं। निमेषु लोकां न धाडीं। ऐसेनि गणाविया कोडी। कल्पांचिया॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari jītu melā na saṃḍīṃ| nimeṣu lokāṃ na dhāḍīṃ| aiseni gaṇāviyā koḍī| kalpāṃciyā|| 37||
verses.meaning: But if one were to conquer death, and not allow even a moment to pass for people, such countless eons would be measured.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलेवरी धिंवसा। जयाचिया मानसा। आणि करूनियांहि तैसा। अपारु जो॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetulevarī dhiṃvasā| jayāciyā mānasā| āṇi karūniyāṃhi taisā| apāru jo|| 38||
verses.meaning: Beyond this, the one whose mind is thus filled with courage, and who acts accordingly, is indeed boundless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रात्र दिवस नेणे। थोडें बहु न म्हणें । म्हणियाचेनि दाटपणें। साजा होय॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: rātra divasa neṇe| thoḍeṃ bahu na mhaṇeṃ | mhaṇiyāceni dāṭapaṇeṃ| sājā hoya|| 39||
verses.meaning: It knows neither day nor night, nor does it distinguish between little or much. With such profound abundance, it becomes complete.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो व्यापारु येणें नांवे । गगनाहूनि थोरावे। एकला करी आधघवें। एकेचि काळीं ॥ ४४० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: to vyāpāru yeṇeṃ nāṃve | gaganāhūni thorāve| ekalā karī ādhaghaveṃ| ekeci kāḻīṃ || 440 ||
verses.meaning: That trader, by this name, becomes greater than the sky. He alone accomplishes everything at once.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हृदयवृत्ती पुढां) आंगचि घे दवडा। काज करी होडा। मानसेंशीं ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hṛdayavṛttī puḍhāṃ) āṃgaci ghe davaḍā| kāja karī hoḍā| mānaseṃśīṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: The heart's inclinations, when they precede, take hold of the body and make it act in accordance with the mind's desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २८८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी 'एकादियां वेळां । श्रीगुरूचिया खेळा । लोण करी सकळा । जीविताचें ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: 288 śrījñāneśvarī 'ekādiyāṃ veḻāṃ | śrīgurūciyā kheḻā | loṇa karī sakaḻā | jīvitāceṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: At times, for the divine play of the Guru, one offers their entire life as a sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो गुरुदास्यें कृशु। जो गुरुप्रेमें सपोषु। गुरुआज्ञेनिवासु, आपणचि जो॥४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo gurudāsyeṃ kṛśu| jo gurupremeṃ sapoṣu| guruājñenivāsu, āpaṇaci jo||43||
verses.meaning: He who is lean from serving the Guru, who is nourished by the Guru's love, and who himself resides in the Guru's command.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो गुरुकुळें सुकुलीनु। जो गुरुबंधुसौजन्यें सुजनु) जो गुरुसेवाव्यसनें सव्यसनु। निरंतर॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo gurukuḻeṃ sukulīnu| jo gurubaṃdhusaujanyeṃ sujanu) jo gurusevāvyasaneṃ savyasanu| niraṃtara|| 44||
verses.meaning: He who is of good lineage through his guru's family, who is noble through the kindness of his guru-brothers, and who is constantly devoted to serving his guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरुसंप्रदायधर्म। तेचि जयाचे वर्णाश्रम । गुरुपरिचर्या नित्यकर्म। जयाचें गा॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: gurusaṃpradāyadharma| teci jayāce varṇāśrama | guruparicaryā nityakarma| jayāceṃ gā|| 45 ||
verses.meaning: The tradition of the Guru is their very dharma, their social order and stage of life. The daily service to the Guru is their constant duty.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरु क्षेत्र गुरु देवता । गुरु माता गुरु पिता । जो गुरुसेवेपरौता । मार्ग नेणे ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: guru kṣetra guru devatā | guru mātā guru pitā | jo guruseveparautā | mārga neṇe || 46||
verses.meaning: The Guru is the sacred field, the Guru is the deity. The Guru is the mother, the Guru is the father. One who knows no other path beyond serving the Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीगुरूचें द्वार । तें जयाचें सर्वस्व सार। गुरुसेवकां सहोदर प्रेमें भजे ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīgurūceṃ dvāra | teṃ jayāceṃ sarvasva sāra| gurusevakāṃ sahodara premeṃ bhaje || 47||
verses.meaning: He who considers the Guru's abode as his entire essence and serves the Guru's devotees with brotherly love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचें वक्‍्त्र। वाहे गुरुनामाचे मंत्र । गुरुवाक्‍्यांबांचूनि शास्त्र। हातीं न शिवे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceṃ vak‍tra| vāhe gurunāmāce maṃtra | guruvāk‍yāṃbāṃcūni śāstra| hātīṃ na śive|| 48||
verses.meaning: Whose mouth always chants the Guru's name, and who does not touch any scripture without the Guru's command.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शिवतळें गुरुचरणीं। भलतैसें हो पाणी। तया सकळ तीर्थे आणी । त्रैलोक्यींचीं ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: śivataḻeṃ gurucaraṇīṃ| bhalataiseṃ ho pāṇī| tayā sakaḻa tīrthe āṇī | trailokyīṃcīṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: The water that touches the Guru's feet, however ordinary it may be, brings with it the essence of all the holy places in the three worlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीगुरूचें उशिटें । लाहे जें अवचटें । तैं तेणें लाभें विटे । समाधीसी ॥ ४५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīgurūceṃ uśiṭeṃ | lāhe jeṃ avacaṭeṃ | taiṃ teṇeṃ lābheṃ viṭe | samādhīsī || 450||
verses.meaning: One who, by chance, receives the remnants of the Guru's grace, finds even the state of samadhi to be insignificant in comparison to that gain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कैवल्यसुखासाठीं। परमाणु घे किरीटीं। उधळती पायांपाठीं। चालतां जे॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaivalyasukhāsāṭhīṃ| paramāṇu ghe kirīṭīṃ| udhaḻatī pāyāṃpāṭhīṃ| cālatāṃ je||51||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, for the bliss of liberation, particles of dust from the feet of such a one, as they walk, are scattered and sought after by even the greatest beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो सांगावें किती। नाहीं पारु गुरुभक्ती । परी गा उत्क्रांतमती। कारण हें॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso sāṃgāveṃ kitī| nāhīṃ pāru gurubhaktī | parī gā utkrāṃtamatī| kāraṇa heṃ||52||
verses.meaning: Let this be. How much more can be said? There is no limit to devotion to the Guru. But for the one with an evolving mind, this is the reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया इये भक्तीची चाड। जया इये विषयींचें कोड। जो हे सेवेवांचून गोड। न मनी कांहीं ॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā iye bhaktīcī cāḍa| jayā iye viṣayīṃceṃ koḍa| jo he sevevāṃcūna goḍa| na manī kāṃhīṃ ||53||
verses.meaning: One who yearns for this devotion, who finds joy in this subject, who considers nothing sweet without this service.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो तत्त्वज्ञानाचा ठावो। ज्ञाना तेणेंचि आवो। हें असो तो देवो । ज्ञान भक्तु ॥५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to tattvajñānācā ṭhāvo| jñānā teṇeṃci āvo| heṃ aso to devo | jñāna bhaktu ||54||
verses.meaning: He is the very abode of philosophy, the essence of knowledge. Let it be said, he is the divine knowledge and the devotee.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जाण पां साचोकारें। तेथ ज्ञान उघडेनि द्वारें। नांदत असे जगा पुरे। इया रीती॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jāṇa pāṃ sācokāreṃ| tetha jñāna ughaḍeni dvāreṃ| nāṃdata ase jagā pure| iyā rītī|| 55||
verses.meaning: Know this truly: there, through an open door, knowledge resides, sufficient for the world, in this manner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये गुरुसेवेविखीं। माझा जीव अभिलाखी। म्हणौनि सोयचुकी। बोली केली ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye gurusevevikhīṃ| mājhā jīva abhilākhī| mhaṇauni soyacukī| bolī kelī || 56||
verses.meaning: My soul yearns for the service of the Guru, and thus, I have spoken these words with great care and devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येऱ्हबीं असता हातीं खुळा। भजनावधानीं आंधळा । परिचर्येलागीं पांगुळा-। पासूनि मंदु ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṟhabīṃ asatā hātīṃ khuḻā| bhajanāvadhānīṃ āṃdhaḻā | paricaryelāgīṃ pāṃguḻā-| pāsūni maṃdu || 57||
verses.meaning: Even if one is foolish in hand, blind in devotion, and lame in service, still, one is slow to understand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरुवर्णनीं मुका। आळशी पोशिजे फुका। परि मनीं आथी निका। सानुरागु॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: guruvarṇanīṃ mukā| āḻaśī pośije phukā| pari manīṃ āthī nikā| sānurāgu|| 58||
verses.meaning: Even if one is mute in praising the Guru, and lazy, yet if their mind is pure and filled with love, they are cherished without effort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणेंचि पैं कारणें। हें स्थूळ पोसणें। पडलें मज म्हणे। ज्ञानदेबो ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃci paiṃ kāraṇeṃ| heṃ sthūḻa posaṇeṃ| paḍaleṃ maja mhaṇe| jñānadebo || 59||
verses.meaning: For that very reason, this gross body must be nourished, says Dnyandev.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तो बोलु उपसाहावा। आणि वोळगे अवसरु देयावा । आतां म्हणेन जी बरवा । ग्रंथार्थूचि ॥ ४६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari to bolu upasāhāvā| āṇi voḻage avasaru deyāvā | ātāṃ mhaṇena jī baravā | graṃthārthūci || 460||
verses.meaning: But one should endure that speech and give it an opportunity. Now, I will say, indeed, the meaning of the scripture itself is beautiful.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परिसा परिसा श्रीकृष्णु। जो भूतभारसहिष्णु। तो बोलतसे विष्णु । पार्थु ऐके ॥ ६१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parisā parisā śrīkṛṣṇu| jo bhūtabhārasahiṣṇu| to bolatase viṣṇu | pārthu aike || 619||
verses.meaning: Listen, listen, to Shri Krishna, who endures the burden of all beings. That Vishnu speaks, and Partha listens.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे शुचित्व गा ऐसें॥ जयापाशीं दिसे। आंग मन जेैसें। कापुराचें॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe śucitva gā aiseṃ|| jayāpāśīṃ dise| āṃga mana jeaiseṃ| kāpurāceṃ||62||
verses.meaning: Purity, it is said, is such that wherever it is seen, the body and mind are like camphor.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां रतांचें दळवाडें । जैसें सबाह्य चोखडें । आंत बाहेरि एके पाडें। सूर्यु जैसा ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ratāṃceṃ daḻavāḍeṃ | jaiseṃ sabāhya cokhaḍeṃ | āṃta bāheri eke pāḍeṃ| sūryu jaisā || 63||
verses.meaning: Just as a ruby, whether viewed from within or without, shines with an equal brilliance, like the sun itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाहेरीं कर्मे क्षाळला । भीतरीं ज्ञाने उजळला । इहीं दोही. परी आला । 'पाखाळा एका ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāherīṃ karme kṣāḻalā | bhītarīṃ jñāne ujaḻalā | ihīṃ dohī. parī ālā | 'pākhāḻā ekā || 64||
verses.meaning: Outwardly, he is cleansed by actions; inwardly, he is illuminated by knowledge. Through both these, he has become uniquely pure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मृत्तिका आणि जळें । बाह्य येणें मेळें । निर्मळु होय बोलें। वेदाचेनी ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mṛttikā āṇi jaḻeṃ | bāhya yeṇeṃ meḻeṃ | nirmaḻu hoya boleṃ| vedācenī || 65||
verses.meaning: Just as earth and water, when combined, become pure through the words of the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भलतेथ बुद्धीबळी । रज आरिसा उजळी। सौंदणी फेडी थिगळी । वस्त्रांचिया ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhalatetha buddhībaḻī | raja ārisā ujaḻī| sauṃdaṇī pheḍī thigaḻī | vastrāṃciyā || 66||
verses.meaning: Just as a mirror is polished by dust, or a beautiful woman removes patches from her clothes, so too does the intellect, when it engages in improper thoughts, become purified.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना इयापरी । बाह्य चोख अवधारीं । आणि ज्ञानदीपु अंतरीं । म्हणौनि शुद्ध ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā iyāparī | bāhya cokha avadhārīṃ | āṇi jñānadīpu aṃtarīṃ | mhaṇauni śuddha || 67||
verses.meaning: In this way, the external actions are pure, and the lamp of knowledge shines within, thus making everything pure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येऱ्हबीं तरी पंडुसुता । आंत शुद्ध नसतां। बाहेरी कर्म तो तत्त्वतां। विटंबु गा॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṟhabīṃ tarī paṃḍusutā | āṃta śuddha nasatāṃ| bāherī karma to tattvatāṃ| viṭaṃbu gā|| 68||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, if there is no inner purity, then external actions are truly a mere mockery.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मृत जैसा शृंगारिला। गाढव तीर्थी न्हाणिला । कडुदुधिया माखिला । गुळें जैसा ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mṛta jaisā śṛṃgārilā| gāḍhava tīrthī nhāṇilā | kaḍududhiyā mākhilā | guḻeṃ jaisā || 69||
verses.meaning: Like a corpse adorned, or a donkey bathed in holy waters, or bitter milk smeared with jaggery, so is this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बोस गृहीं तोरण बांधिलें। कां उपवासी अन्ने लिंपिलें। कुंकुमसेंदुर केलें। 'कांतहीनेनें ॥ ४७० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: bosa gṛhīṃ toraṇa bāṃdhileṃ| kāṃ upavāsī anne liṃpileṃ| kuṃkumaseṃdura keleṃ| 'kāṃtahīneneṃ || 470 ||
verses.meaning: It is like decorating an empty house with a garland, or plastering food on a fasting person, or a woman without a husband applying vermillion and kumkum.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कळस ढिमाचे पोकळ । जळो वरील ते झळाळ । काय करूं चित्रींब फळ। आंतु शेण॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaḻasa ḍhimāce pokaḻa | jaḻo varīla te jhaḻāḻa | kāya karūṃ citrīṃba phaḻa| āṃtu śeṇa|| 71||
verses.meaning: What good is the glitter on a hollow temple spire, or a painted fruit filled with dung? It is all useless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें कर्म वरिचिलेंकडां। न सरे थोर मोलें कुडा। नव्हे मदिरेचा घडा । पवित्र गंगें ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ karma varicileṃkaḍāṃ| na sare thora moleṃ kuḍā| navhe madirecā ghaḍā | pavitra gaṃgeṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: Just as a deed, though outwardly grand, cannot be purified by a great price if it is inherently flawed, so too a pot of liquor cannot become as pure as the Ganges.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि अंतरीं ज्ञान व्हावें। मग बाह्य लाभेल स्वभावें। वरी ज्ञान कर्मे संभवें। ऐसें कें जोडे ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aṃtarīṃ jñāna vhāveṃ| maga bāhya lābhela svabhāveṃ| varī jñāna karme saṃbhaveṃ| aiseṃ keṃ joḍe || 73||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let knowledge arise within; then naturally, external benefits will follow. How can such a combination of knowledge and action be attained?

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं बाह्य भागु। कर्मे धुतला चांगु । ज्ञाने फेडिला वंगु। अंतरींचा ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ bāhya bhāgu| karme dhutalā cāṃgu | jñāne pheḍilā vaṃgu| aṃtarīṃcā || 74||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the outer part (of the being) is well cleansed by actions, and the inner impurity is removed by knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अंतरबाह्य गेलें। निर्मळत्व एक जाहलें। किंबहुना उरळें। शुचित्वचि॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha aṃtarabāhya geleṃ| nirmaḻatva eka jāhaleṃ| kiṃbahunā uraḻeṃ| śucitvaci|| 75||
verses.meaning: Then, both internally and externally, a singular purity emerged. In short, only sanctity remained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सद्भाव जीवगत। बाहेरी दिसती 'फांकत। स्फटिकगृहींचे डोळत। दीप जैसे॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sadbhāva jīvagata| bāherī disatī 'phāṃkata| sphaṭikagṛhīṃce ḍoḻata| dīpa jaise|| 76||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the inherent good qualities of the soul, like lamps within a crystal palace, shine forth and are visible outside.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विकल्प जेणें उपजे। नाथिली विकृती निपजे । अप्रवृत्तीची बीजें । अंकुर घेती ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vikalpa jeṇeṃ upaje| nāthilī vikṛtī nipaje | apravṛttīcī bījeṃ | aṃkura ghetī || 77||
verses.meaning: From this arise doubts, from this springs forth unreal deformity, and the seeds of non-action begin to sprout.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें आइके देखे अथवा भेटे। परी मनीं कांहींचि नुमटे। मेघरंगें न कांटे । व्योम जैसें ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ āike dekhe athavā bheṭe| parī manīṃ kāṃhīṃci numaṭe| megharaṃgeṃ na kāṃṭe | vyoma jaiseṃ || 78 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky is not affected by the color of the clouds, so too, the Self, though it hears, sees, or touches, remains untouched by anything in the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱहवी इंद्रियांचेनि मेळें । विषयांवरी तरी लोळे । परी विकाराचेनि बिटाळें । लिंपिजेना ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟahavī iṃdriyāṃceni meḻeṃ | viṣayāṃvarī tarī loḻe | parī vikārāceni biṭāḻeṃ | liṃpijenā || 79||
verses.meaning: Even if the senses engage with worldly objects, they do not get tainted by the impurities of desire and attachment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भेटलेया वाटेवरी । चोखी आणि माहारी। तेथ नातळें तियापरी। राहाटों जाणे ॥ ४८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: bheṭaleyā vāṭevarī | cokhī āṇi māhārī| tetha nātaḻeṃ tiyāparī| rāhāṭoṃ jāṇe || 480||
verses.meaning: On the path where the pure and the impure meet, one knows how to conduct oneself without being affected by either.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां पतिपुत्रांते आलळिंगी। एकचि ते तरुणांगी। तेथ पुत्रभावाच्या आंगीं। न रिगे कामु॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ patiputrāṃte ālaḻiṃgī| ekaci te taruṇāṃgī| tetha putrabhāvācyā āṃgīṃ| na rige kāmu|| 81||
verses.meaning: When a young woman embraces her husband and her son, though the embrace is the same, the feeling of lust does not enter the embrace of the son.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें हृदय चोख । संकल्पविकल्पीं सनोळख। कृत्याकृत्य विशेख। फुडें जाणे॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ hṛdaya cokha | saṃkalpavikalpīṃ sanoḻakha| kṛtyākṛtya viśekha| phuḍeṃ jāṇe|| 82||
verses.meaning: Similarly, a pure heart, discerning between right and wrong, recognizes the nature of thoughts and doubts that arise within it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाणियें हिरा न भिजे। आधणीं हरळु न शिजे। तैसी बिकल्पजातें न लिंपिजे। मनोवृत्ती ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṇiyeṃ hirā na bhije| ādhaṇīṃ haraḻu na śije| taisī bikalpajāteṃ na liṃpije| manovṛttī || 83||
verses.meaning: Just as a diamond is not soaked by water, and a pebble is not cooked by boiling, so too, the mind's modifications are not tainted by the multitude of thoughts.
