verses.shloka_devanagari: तया नांव शुचिपण । पार्था गा संपूर्ण । हें देखसी तेथ जाण। ज्ञान असे॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā nāṃva śucipaṇa | pārthā gā saṃpūrṇa | heṃ dekhasī tetha jāṇa| jñāna ase|| 84||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, know that this is indeed purity. Wherever you see this, know that true knowledge resides there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि स्थिरता साचें। घर रिघाली जयाचें। तो पुरुष ज्ञानाचें। आयुष्य गा॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sthiratā sāceṃ| ghara righālī jayāceṃ| to puruṣa jñānāceṃ| āyuṣya gā|| 85||
verses.meaning: And stability truly entered his home, that man is the very life of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देह तरी वरिचिलीकडे। आपुलिया परी हिंडे। परी बैसका न मोडे । मानसींची ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: deha tarī varicilīkaḍe| āpuliyā parī hiṃḍe| parī baisakā na moḍe | mānasīṃcī || 86||
verses.meaning: Though the body may wander outwardly, the mind's inner seat remains undisturbed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वत्सावरूनि धेनूचें । २९० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी स्नेह राना न वचे। नव्हती भोग सतियेचे । प्रेमभोग॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vatsāvarūni dhenūceṃ | 290 śrījñāneśvarī sneha rānā na vace| navhatī bhoga satiyece | premabhoga|| 87||
verses.meaning: Just as a cow's affection for its calf does not diminish even when it goes into the forest, so too, the love of a chaste wife for her husband is not for worldly pleasures, but is pure love itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां लोभिया दूर जाये। परी जीव ठेविलाचि ठाये। तैसा देहो चाळितां नव्हे। चळु चित्ता ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ lobhiyā dūra jāye| parī jīva ṭhevilāci ṭhāye| taisā deho cāḻitāṃ navhe| caḻu cittā || 88||
verses.meaning: Just as a greedy person may wander far, but his heart remains fixed on his wealth, so too, even if the body moves, the mind does not waver.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जातया अभ्रासबें। जैसें आकाश न धांवे। भ्रमणचक्रीं न भंवे। ध्रुव जैसा ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jātayā abhrāsabeṃ| jaiseṃ ākāśa na dhāṃve| bhramaṇacakrīṃ na bhaṃve| dhruva jaisā || 89||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky does not run with the moving clouds, and just as the North Star does not revolve with the rotating celestial sphere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पांथिकाचिया येरझारा । सवें पंथु न वचे धनुर्धरा। कां नाहीं जेवीं तरुवरां। येणें जाणें ॥ ४९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṃthikāciyā yerajhārā | saveṃ paṃthu na vace dhanurdharā| kāṃ nāhīṃ jevīṃ taruvarāṃ| yeṇeṃ jāṇeṃ || 490||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, the path does not accompany the traveler in their comings and goings, just as trees do not move with those who pass by them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा चळणवळणात्मकीं। असोनि ये पांचभौतिकीं। भूतोर्मी एकीं । चळिजेना॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā caḻaṇavaḻaṇātmakīṃ| asoni ye pāṃcabhautikīṃ| bhūtormī ekīṃ | caḻijenā|| 91||
verses.meaning: Just as the five elements, though active and in motion, do not disturb the earth, so too the Self remains undisturbed by the activities of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वबाहुटळीचेनि बळें॥ पृथ्वी जैसी न ढळे। तेसा उपद्रव उमाळे। न लोटे जो॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: vabāhuṭaḻīceni baḻeṃ|| pṛthvī jaisī na ḍhaḻe| tesā upadrava umāḻe| na loṭe jo||92||
verses.meaning: Just as the earth does not waver due to the strength of the tortoise's support, so too, the one who is not swayed by afflictions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दैन्यदुःखीं न तपे। भयशोकीं न कंपे। देहमृत्यु न वासिपे। पातळेनी॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: dainyaduḥkhīṃ na tape| bhayaśokīṃ na kaṃpe| dehamṛtyu na vāsipe| pātaḻenī|| 93||
verses.meaning: One who has attained the highest state does not suffer in poverty and sorrow, nor trembles in fear and grief, nor fears the death of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आर्ति आशा पडिभरें। वय व्याधी गजरें। उजू असतां पाठिमोरें। नव्हे चित्त॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ārti āśā paḍibhareṃ| vaya vyādhī gajareṃ| ujū asatāṃ pāṭhimoreṃ| navhe citta|| 94||
verses.meaning: When desires and hopes weigh heavily, and old age and diseases roar, the mind, even when facing straightforwardly, turns its back.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निंदा निस्तेज दंडी। कामलोभा वरपडी। परी रोमा नव्हे बांकुडी । मानसाची ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: niṃdā nisteja daṃḍī| kāmalobhā varapaḍī| parī romā navhe bāṃkuḍī | mānasācī || 95||
verses.meaning: Slander may make one dull and weak, and lust and greed may overcome one, but the mind's hair is not crooked.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आकाश हें बोसरो। पृथ्वी वरि विरो। परि नेणें मोहरों। चित्तवृत्ती ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ākāśa heṃ bosaro| pṛthvī vari viro| pari neṇeṃ moharoṃ| cittavṛttī || 96||
verses.meaning: The sky may be empty, the earth may be barren, but the mind's tendencies know no such restraint.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हाती हाळा फुलीं । पासवणा जेवीं न घाली । तैसा न लोटे दुर्वाक्यशेली । शेलिला सांता ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hātī hāḻā phulīṃ | pāsavaṇā jevīṃ na ghālī | taisā na loṭe durvākyaśelī | śelilā sāṃtā || 97||
verses.meaning: Just as one does not put a garland of flowers on a dog, so too, a saint, even when insulted, does not retaliate with harsh words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्षीरार्णवाचिया कल्लोळीं। कंपु नाहीं मंदराचळीं । आकाश न जळें जाळीं । बणवियाच्या ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṣīrārṇavāciyā kalloḻīṃ| kaṃpu nāhīṃ maṃdarācaḻīṃ | ākāśa na jaḻeṃ jāḻīṃ | baṇaviyācyā || 98 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the Mandara mountain remains unshaken by the waves of the ocean of milk, and the sky is not consumed by the flames of a forest fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशा आल्या गेल्या ऊर्मी। नव्हे गजबज मनोधर्मी। किंबहुना धैर्य क्षमी। 'कल्पांतींही ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśā ālyā gelyā ūrmī| navhe gajabaja manodharmī| kiṃbahunā dhairya kṣamī| 'kalpāṃtīṃhī || 99||
verses.meaning: Just as waves come and go, they do not disturb the mind's nature; rather, its patience endures even through the dissolution of the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी स्थैर्य ऐसी भाष। बोलिजे जे सविशेष। ते हे दशा गा देख। देखणया॥ ५००॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī sthairya aisī bhāṣa| bolije je saviśeṣa| te he daśā gā dekha| dekhaṇayā|| 500||
verses.meaning: However, the state that is specifically called 'steadfastness' is this, O Seer, behold it!

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें स्थैर्य निधडें। जेथ आंगें जीवें जोडे तें ज्ञानाचें उघडें । निधान साचें ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ sthairya nidhaḍeṃ| jetha āṃgeṃ jīveṃ joḍe teṃ jñānāceṃ ughaḍeṃ | nidhāna sāceṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: This unwavering stability, where one attains it with their very being, is truly the manifest treasure of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि इसाळु जैसा घरा। कां दंदिया हतियेरा। न विसंबे भांडारा । बद्धकु जैसा॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi isāḻu jaisā gharā| kāṃ daṃdiyā hatiyerā| na visaṃbe bhāṃḍārā | baddhaku jaisā|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as a miser never abandons his home, or a warrior his weapon, or a miser his treasure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां एकलौतिया बाळका । वरि पडौनि ठाके अंबिका। मधुविषीं मधुमक्षिका। लोभिणी जैसी ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ekalautiyā bāḻakā | vari paḍauni ṭhāke aṃbikā| madhuviṣīṃ madhumakṣikā| lobhiṇī jaisī || 3||
verses.meaning: Or, like a mother who, upon seeing her only child, embraces it with immense love, or like a honeybee that is drawn to the sweetness of honey, so too is the divine presence drawn to the devotee.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना जो यापरी । अंतःकरण जतन करी। नेदी उभें ठाको द्वारीं। इंद्रियांच्या ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā jo yāparī | aṃtaḥkaraṇa jatana karī| nedī ubheṃ ṭhāko dvārīṃ| iṃdriyāṃcyā || 4||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, one who thus guards the inner self, does not allow the senses to stand at the doorstep.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे काम बागुळ ऐकेल। हे आशा सियारी देखैळ। तरी जीवा टेंकैल। म्हणौनि ब्िहे ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe kāma bāguḻa aikela| he āśā siyārī dekhaiḻa| tarī jīvā ṭeṃkaila| mhaṇauni bihe || 5||
verses.meaning: He says, "If the demon of desire hears this, and if hope sees it, then it will cling to the soul." Therefore, he fears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाहेरी धीट जैसी । दाटुगा पति कळासि। करी टेहणी तैसी । प्रवृत्तीसीं ॥ ६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāherī dhīṭa jaisī | dāṭugā pati kaḻāsi| karī ṭehaṇī taisī | pravṛttīsīṃ || 6 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a bold and powerful husband keeps a watchful eye on his clever wife, so too does the Self observe the activities of the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सचेतनी वाणेपणें ( सतेचेनि बाणिपणें )। देहासकट आटणें। संयमावरी करणें। बुझूनि घाली ॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sacetanī vāṇepaṇeṃ ( sateceni bāṇipaṇeṃ )| dehāsakaṭa āṭaṇeṃ| saṃyamāvarī karaṇeṃ| bujhūni ghālī ||7||
verses.meaning: With conscious effort, one should dissolve the body itself, performing this act of restraint with understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मनाचिया महाद्वारी । प्रत्याहाराचिया ठाणांतरीं । जो यमदम शरीरीं । जागवी उभे॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: manāciyā mahādvārī | pratyāhārāciyā ṭhāṇāṃtarīṃ | jo yamadama śarīrīṃ | jāgavī ubhe|| 8||
verses.meaning: At the grand entrance of the mind, within the station of withdrawal of the senses, Yama and Dama stand vigilant, awakening the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधारीं नाभीं कंठीं। बंधत्रयाचीं घरटीं। चंद्रसूर्य संपुटीं । सूये चित्त ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhārīṃ nābhīṃ kaṃṭhīṃ| baṃdhatrayācīṃ gharaṭīṃ| caṃdrasūrya saṃpuṭīṃ | sūye citta || 9||
verses.meaning: In the Mooladhara, Manipura, and Vishuddha chakras, the three bandhas (locks) are established. The moon and sun (Ida and Pingala nadis) are brought into balance, and the mind is focused.

verses.shloka_devanagari: समाधीचे शेजेपासीं । बांधोनि घाली ध्यानासीं । चित्त चैतन्य समरसीं । आंतु रते॥ ५१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: samādhīce śejepāsīṃ | bāṃdhoni ghālī dhyānāsīṃ | citta caitanya samarasīṃ | āṃtu rate|| 510||
verses.meaning: Binding the mind to meditation near the bed of samadhi, the consciousness merges with the universal consciousness, becoming absorbed within.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा अंतःकरणनिग्रहो जो। तो हा हें जाणिजो। हा आथी तेथ वबिजयो । ज्ञानाचा पैं॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā aṃtaḥkaraṇanigraho jo| to hā heṃ jāṇijo| hā āthī tetha vabijayo | jñānācā paiṃ|| 11||
verses.meaning: Understand that the control of the inner self is this very thing. Where this control exists, there is indeed the victory of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाची आज्ञा आपण । शिरीं वाहे अंतःकरण । मनुष्याकारें जाण। ज्ञानचि तो॥ ९१२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayācī ājñā āpaṇa | śirīṃ vāhe aṃtaḥkaraṇa | manuṣyākāreṃ jāṇa| jñānaci to|| 912||
verses.meaning: He whose command the heart carries on its head, know that he is knowledge itself in human form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि विषयांविखीं। वैराग्याची निकी। पुरवणी मानसीं कीं। जिती आथी ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi viṣayāṃvikhīṃ| vairāgyācī nikī| puravaṇī mānasīṃ kīṃ| jitī āthī || 13||
verses.meaning: And regarding worldly pleasures, a strong and genuine detachment arises in the mind, as if it were alive.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वमिलिया अन्ना) लाळ न घोंटी रसना। कां आंग न सूये आलिंगना। प्रेताचिया॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: vamiliyā annā) lāḻa na ghoṃṭī rasanā| kāṃ āṃga na sūye āliṃganā| pretāciyā|| 14||
verses.meaning: The tongue does not taste food that has been vomited, nor does the body embrace a corpse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विष खाणें नागवे। जळत घरीं न रिगवे। व्याघ्रविवरां न वचवे। बस्ती जेवीं ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: viṣa khāṇeṃ nāgave| jaḻata gharīṃ na rigave| vyāghravivarāṃ na vacave| bastī jevīṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: One does not eat poison, nor enter a burning house, nor go into a tiger's den, just as one does not willingly go to a place of danger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: धडाडीत लोहरसीं। उडी न घालवे जैसी। न करवे उशी। अजगराची ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: dhaḍāḍīta loharasīṃ| uḍī na ghālave jaisī| na karave uśī| ajagarācī || 16||
verses.meaning: Just as one cannot jump into a raging fire, nor can one awaken a python from its slumber.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना तेणें पाडें।॥ जयासी विषयवार्ता नावडे । नेदी इंद्रियांचेनि तोंडें। कांहींच जावो ॥ १९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā teṇeṃ pāḍeṃ||| jayāsī viṣayavārtā nāvaḍe | nedī iṃdriyāṃceni toṃḍeṃ| kāṃhīṃca jāvo || 197||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, in the same way, one who dislikes worldly pleasures and does not allow the senses to indulge in anything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचे मनीं आलस्य। देहीं अतिकार्श्य। शमदमीं सौरस्य। जयासि गा॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāce manīṃ ālasya| dehīṃ atikārśya| śamadamīṃ saurasya| jayāsi gā|| 18||
verses.meaning: One in whose mind there is no laziness, whose body is not excessively emaciated, and who finds joy in tranquility and self-control.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तपोव्रतांचा मेळावा। जयाचे ठायीं पांडवा । युगांत जया गांवां-। आंतु येतां॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tapovratāṃcā meḻāvā| jayāce ṭhāyīṃ pāṃḍavā | yugāṃta jayā gāṃvāṃ-| āṃtu yetāṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, in whom is the confluence of all penances and vows, and to whose abode the ages come at their end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बहु योगाभ्यासीं हांब। विजनाकडे धांब। न साहे जो नांव । संघाताचें ॥ ५२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: bahu yogābhyāsīṃ hāṃba| vijanākaḍe dhāṃba| na sāhe jo nāṃva | saṃghātāceṃ || 520||
verses.meaning: Many yogis, in their practice, flee to solitary places, unable to bear the very name of association.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाराचांचीं आंथुरणें। पूयपंकीं लोळणें। तैसें लेखी भोगणें । ऐहिकींचें ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: nārācāṃcīṃ āṃthuraṇeṃ| pūyapaṃkīṃ loḻaṇeṃ| taiseṃ lekhī bhogaṇeṃ | aihikīṃceṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: Just as one would consider lying on a bed of human intestines and wallowing in a mire of pus, so too should one regard the pleasures of this worldly life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि स्वर्गातें मानसें। ऐकोनि मानी ऐसें। कुहिलें पिशित जेैसें। शवानाचें कां॥२२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi svargāteṃ mānaseṃ| aikoni mānī aiseṃ| kuhileṃ piśita jeaiseṃ| śavānāceṃ kāṃ||22||
verses.meaning: And hearing of heaven, people consider it to be like a piece of rotten flesh from a corpse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें हें विषयबैराग्य। जें आत्मलाभाचें सभाग्य। येणें ब्रह्मानंदा योग्य। जीव होती॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ heṃ viṣayabairāgya| jeṃ ātmalābhāceṃ sabhāgya| yeṇeṃ brahmānaṃdā yogya| jīva hotī|| 23||
verses.meaning: This dispassion towards worldly objects is indeed a blessing for attaining the Self. Through it, beings become worthy of the bliss of Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा उभयभोगीं त्रासु| देखसी जेथ बहुवसु। तेथ जाण रहिवासु। ज्ञानाचा तूं५॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā ubhayabhogīṃ trāsu| dekhasī jetha bahuvasu| tetha jāṇa rahivāsu| jñānācā tūṃ5|| 24||
verses.meaning: Wherever you see great abundance, yet also suffering for both the enjoyer and the enjoyed, know that there resides true knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सचाडाचिये परी। इष्टापूर्त करी । परी केळेंपण शरीरीं । वबसों नेदी॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sacāḍāciye parī| iṣṭāpūrta karī | parī keḻeṃpaṇa śarīrīṃ | vabasoṃ nedī|| 25||
verses.meaning: And like a sentient being, he performs all prescribed duties and charitable acts, yet he does not allow the sense of doership to dwell within his body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वर्णाश्रमपोषकें । कर्मे नित्यनैमित्तिकें । तयांमाजीं कांहीं न ठके। आचरतां॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: varṇāśramapoṣakeṃ | karme nityanaimittikeṃ | tayāṃmājīṃ kāṃhīṃ na ṭhake| ācaratāṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: The daily and occasional rituals that sustain the social order, when performed, are never obstructed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि हें मियां केलें। कीं हें माझेनि सिद्धी गेलें। ऐसें नाहीं ठेविलें। वासनेमाजीं ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari heṃ miyāṃ keleṃ| kīṃ heṃ mājheni siddhī geleṃ| aiseṃ nāhīṃ ṭhevileṃ| vāsanemājīṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: But the thought, "I did this," or "This was accomplished by me," is not harbored in my mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें अवचितपणें। वायूसि सर्वत्र विचरणें। कों निरभिमान उदैजणें । सूर्याचें जैसें ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ avacitapaṇeṃ| vāyūsi sarvatra vicaraṇeṃ| koṃ nirabhimāna udaijaṇeṃ | sūryāceṃ jaiseṃ || 28||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind moves everywhere spontaneously, or as the sun rises without any ego.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां श्रुति स्वभावतां बोलळे। गंगा काजेंबीण चाले। तैसें अवष्टंभहीन भलें। वर्तणें जयाचें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ śruti svabhāvatāṃ bolaḻe| gaṃgā kājeṃbīṇa cāle| taiseṃ avaṣṭaṃbhahīna bhaleṃ| vartaṇeṃ jayāceṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Just as the Vedas speak naturally, and the Ganges flows without any specific purpose, so too is the conduct of one who is free from all support and self-consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्रतुकाळीं तरी फळती । परी फळलो हें नेणती । तयां वृक्षांचिये ऐसी वृत्ती । २९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी कर्मी सदा॥५३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kratukāḻīṃ tarī phaḻatī | parī phaḻalo heṃ neṇatī | tayāṃ vṛkṣāṃciye aisī vṛttī | 292 śrījñāneśvarī karmī sadā||530||
verses.meaning: Just as trees bear fruit in due season but are unaware of their own fruiting, so too are those who are always engaged in action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं मनीं कर्मी बोलीं। जेथ अहंकारा उखी जाहली । 'एकावळीची काढिली । दोरी जैसी ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ manīṃ karmī bolīṃ| jetha ahaṃkārā ukhī jāhalī | 'ekāvaḻīcī kāḍhilī | dorī jaisī || 39||
verses.meaning: Thus, in mind, action, and speech, where the ego has been uprooted, it is like a string being removed from a necklace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संबंधेंबीण जैसी । अभ्रें असतीं आकाशीं । देहीं कर्मे तैसीं। जयासि गा॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃbaṃdheṃbīṇa jaisī | abhreṃ asatīṃ ākāśīṃ | dehīṃ karme taisīṃ| jayāsi gā|| 32||
verses.meaning: Just as clouds exist in the sky without attachment, so too are actions for one who is detached from the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मद्यपाआंगींचें वस्त्र। कां लेपाहातींचें शस्त्र। बैलावरी शास्त्र। बांधलें आहे ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: madyapāāṃgīṃceṃ vastra| kāṃ lepāhātīṃceṃ śastra| bailāvarī śāstra| bāṃdhaleṃ āhe || 33||
verses.meaning: Like a garment on a drunkard, or a weapon in the hands of a leper, or scriptures tied to a bullock.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापाडें देहीं । जया मी आहें हे सेचि नाहीं । निरहंकारता पाहीं । तया नांव॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāpāḍeṃ dehīṃ | jayā mī āheṃ he seci nāhīṃ | nirahaṃkāratā pāhīṃ | tayā nāṃva|| 34||
verses.meaning: In such a body, there is no sense of "I am this body." Know that this is called egolessness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें संपूर्ण जेथें दिसे। तेथेंचि ज्ञान असे। इयेविषयीं अनारिसें। बोलो नये॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ saṃpūrṇa jetheṃ dise| tetheṃci jñāna ase| iyeviṣayīṃ anāriseṃ| bolo naye|| 35||
verses.meaning: Where this entirety is seen, there alone is knowledge. In this matter, one should not speak falsely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखें। व्याधिवार्धक्यकलुषें । तियें आंगा न येतां देखें । दुरूनि जो॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: janmamṛtyujarāduḥkheṃ| vyādhivārdhakyakaluṣeṃ | tiyeṃ āṃgā na yetāṃ dekheṃ | durūni jo|| 36||
verses.meaning: He who, from a distance, sees that birth, death, old age, sorrow, disease, and the impurities of decrepitude do not touch him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साधकु विवसिया। कां उपसर्गु योगिया। पावे उणेयापुरेया । बोथंबा जेवीं ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sādhaku vivasiyā| kāṃ upasargu yogiyā| pāve uṇeyāpureyā | bothaṃbā jevīṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: Just as a seeker of truth might be confused, or a yogi might be afflicted by obstacles, or a person might be bewildered by a lack or excess of knowledge, so too is the spiritual path fraught with such challenges.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वैर जन्मांतरींचें। सर्पा मनौनि न वचे। तेवीं अतीता जन्माचें। उणें जो बाहे ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vaira janmāṃtarīṃceṃ| sarpā manauni na vace| tevīṃ atītā janmāceṃ| uṇeṃ jo bāhe || 38||
verses.meaning: Just as the enmity of a snake does not vanish even after many births, so too, the deficiencies of past lives are carried forward.

verses.shloka_devanagari: डोळां हरळ न वबिरे। घाई कोत न जिरे तेसें काळींचें न विसरे । जन्मदुःख ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ḍoḻāṃ haraḻa na vabire| ghāī kota na jire teseṃ kāḻīṃceṃ na visare | janmaduḥkha || 39||
verses.meaning: Just as a speck of dust in the eye is unbearable, and a wound in the body does not heal, so too the heart does not forget the suffering of birth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे पूयगर्ते रिगाला । अहा मूत्ररंश्रें निघाला । कटा रे मियां चाटिला। कुचस्वेदु॥ ५४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe pūyagarte rigālā | ahā mūtraraṃśreṃ nighālā | kaṭā re miyāṃ cāṭilā| kucasvedu|| 540||
verses.meaning: He says, "Alas, I entered a pit of pus, and emerged through a stream of urine. Oh, I licked the sweat from a woman's breast!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसएऐसियापरी। जन्माचा कांटाळा धरी । म्हणे आतां तें मी न करीं। जेणें ऐसें होय॥ ४१९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisaeaisiyāparī| janmācā kāṃṭāḻā dharī | mhaṇe ātāṃ teṃ mī na karīṃ| jeṇeṃ aiseṃ hoya|| 419 ||
verses.meaning: In this way, one develops an aversion to rebirth, saying, "Now I will not do that which causes such a state."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हारी उमचावया। जुंबारी जैसा ये डाया। कीं वैरा बापाचेया। पुत्र जचे॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hārī umacāvayā| juṃbārī jaisā ye ḍāyā| kīṃ vairā bāpāceyā| putra jace|| 42||
verses.meaning: Just as a gambler stakes everything to win, or a son avenges his father's enemy, so too should one strive with utmost dedication.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मारिलियाचेनि रागें। पाठीचा जेवीं सूड मागे। तेणें आक्षेपें लागे। जन्मापाठीं ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: māriliyāceni rāgeṃ| pāṭhīcā jevīṃ sūḍa māge| teṇeṃ ākṣepeṃ lāge| janmāpāṭhīṃ || 43||
verses.meaning: Just as one seeks revenge against the one who killed them, so too does the soul pursue birth after birth, driven by the force of past actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी जन्मती ते लाज। न सांडी जयाचें निज। संभाविता निस्तेज। न जिरे जेवीं ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī janmatī te lāja| na sāṃḍī jayāceṃ nija| saṃbhāvitā nisteja| na jire jevīṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: But those who are born, their inherent shame does not leave them. Just as a respected person does not tolerate being disgraced, so too, the inherent nature of beings does not tolerate being diminished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मृत्यु पुढां आहे। तोचि कल्पांती कां पाहे। परी आजीचि होये। सावधु जो॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mṛtyu puḍhāṃ āhe| toci kalpāṃtī kāṃ pāhe| parī ājīci hoye| sāvadhu jo|| 45||
verses.meaning: And death is ahead. Why wait until the end of time? Be alert today itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माजीं अथांव म्हणतां। थडियेचि पंडुसुता । पोहणारा आइता। कासे जेवीं॥४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājīṃ athāṃva mhaṇatāṃ| thaḍiyeci paṃḍusutā | pohaṇārā āitā| kāse jevīṃ||46||
verses.meaning: My depth is immeasurable, yet for Arjuna, it is like a shallow bank; just as a swimmer finds a convenient waist-deep spot.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां न पवतां रणाचा ठावो। सांभाळिजे जैसा आवो। बोडण सुइजे घाबो। न 'लागतांचि॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ na pavatāṃ raṇācā ṭhāvo| sāṃbhāḻije jaisā āvo| boḍaṇa suije ghābo| na 'lāgatāṃci|| 47||
verses.meaning: Just as one prepares for battle without having seen the battlefield, or as a sacrifice is made without the need for a specific ritual, so too is the preparation for the spiritual journey.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहेचा पेणा वाटवधा। तंव आजीचि होइजे सावबधा। जीवु न वचतां औषधा । धांबिजे जेवीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhecā peṇā vāṭavadhā| taṃva ājīci hoije sāvabadhā| jīvu na vacatāṃ auṣadhā | dhāṃbije jevīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: Just as one takes medicine to prevent an illness from worsening and taking a life, so too should one become alert and cautious when facing the dangers of the path of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येऱ्हवीं ऐसें घडे । जो जळत घरीं सांपडे) तो मग न पवाडे । कुहा खणों॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṟhavīṃ aiseṃ ghaḍe | jo jaḻata gharīṃ sāṃpaḍe) to maga na pavāḍe | kuhā khaṇoṃ|| 49||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, it is like this: one who is trapped in a burning house does not then start digging a well.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चोंढिये पाथरु गेला । तैसेनि जो बुडाला। तो बोंबेहीसकट निमाला। कोण सांगे॥ ५५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: coṃḍhiye pātharu gelā | taiseni jo buḍālā| to boṃbehīsakaṭa nimālā| koṇa sāṃge|| 550||
verses.meaning: Just as one who is swallowed by a quicksand pit disappears entirely, along with their cries, who can tell of their fate?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि समर्थेसीं वैर। जया पडिलें हाडखाइर। तो जैसा आठही पाहर। 'परजून असे॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni samarthesīṃ vaira| jayā paḍileṃ hāḍakhāira| to jaisā āṭhahī pāhara| 'parajūna ase|| 51||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one who has enmity with the Almighty, whose bones are consumed by hatred, remains agitated and restless for all eight watches of the day and night.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी केळवली नोवरी। कां संन्यासी जियापरी । तैसा न मरतां जो करी । मृत्युसूचना ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī keḻavalī novarī| kāṃ saṃnyāsī jiyāparī | taisā na maratāṃ jo karī | mṛtyusūcanā || 52||
verses.meaning: Just as a newlywed bride or a renunciate prepares for a new life, so too does one who, without dying, makes preparations for their own death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा जो ययापरी । जन्मेंचि जन्म निवारी । मरणें मृत्यु मारी। आपण उरे॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā jo yayāparī | janmeṃci janma nivārī | maraṇeṃ mṛtyu mārī| āpaṇa ure|| 53||
verses.meaning: Behold, one who in this manner, by birth itself, eradicates birth, and by death, conquers death, remains as their true Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया घरीं ज्ञानाचें। सांकडें नाहीं साचें॥ जया जन्ममृत्यूचें। निमाळें शल्य ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā gharīṃ jñānāceṃ| sāṃkaḍeṃ nāhīṃ sāceṃ|| jayā janmamṛtyūceṃ| nimāḻeṃ śalya || 54||
verses.meaning: In that abode, there is truly no scarcity of knowledge, for those who have overcome the pain of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तयाचिपरी जरा। न टेंकतां शरीरा। तारुण्याचिया भरा-। माजीं देखें॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tayāciparī jarā| na ṭeṃkatāṃ śarīrā| tāruṇyāciyā bharā-| mājīṃ dekheṃ|| 55||
verses.meaning: And in the same way, old age does not touch the body; rather, it remains in the fullness of youth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे आजिच्या अवसरीं। पुष्टि जे शरीरीं । ते पाहे होईल काचरी। वाळली जैसी ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe ājicyā avasarīṃ| puṣṭi je śarīrīṃ | te pāhe hoīla kācarī| vāḻalī jaisī || 56||
verses.meaning: He said, "In today's opportunity, the nourishment that is in the body, see, it will become like a dried-up chip."

verses.shloka_devanagari: निदैव्याचे व्यवसाय । तैसे ठाकती हातपाय । अमंत्र्या राजाची परी आहे। बळा यया॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nidaivyāce vyavasāya | taise ṭhākatī hātapāya | amaṃtryā rājācī parī āhe| baḻā yayā|| 57||
verses.meaning: Like the endeavors of the unfortunate, so too do the hands and feet become still. It is like the strength of a king without a mantra (power/authority), which is useless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: फुलांचिया भोगा-। लागीं प्रेम टांगा । तें 'करेयाचा गुडघा । तैसें होईल॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: phulāṃciyā bhogā-| lāgīṃ prema ṭāṃgā | teṃ 'kareyācā guḍaghā | taiseṃ hoīla|| 58||
verses.meaning: If one desires to enjoy the flowers, but then kneels to pick them, that is how it will be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वोढाळाच्या खुरीं । आखरुआतें बुरी। ते दशा माझ्या शिरीं । पावेळ गा॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: voḍhāḻācyā khurīṃ | ākharuāteṃ burī| te daśā mājhyā śirīṃ | pāveḻa gā|| 59||
verses.meaning: The state of a bullock, whose hooves are worn out from pulling a heavy load, that same plight will befall me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पदादळेंसी इसाळें। भांडताति हे डोळे। ते होती पडवळें । पिकलीं जैसीं ॥ ५६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: padādaḻeṃsī isāḻeṃ| bhāṃḍatāti he ḍoḻe| te hotī paḍavaḻeṃ | pikalīṃ jaisīṃ || 560||
verses.meaning: The eyes, like tender gourds, contend with each other, as if ripened and ready to fall.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भंबईचीं पडळें । बोमथती सिनसाळें। उरु कुहिजेल जळें। आंसुवांचेनि॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhaṃbaīcīṃ paḍaḻeṃ | bomathatī sinasāḻeṃ| uru kuhijela jaḻeṃ| āṃsuvāṃceni|| 61||
verses.meaning: The eyelids will become swollen, the eyes will be inflamed, and the thighs will be soaked with tears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें बाभुळीचें खोड । गिरबडूनि जाती सरड। तैसें पिचडीं तोंड । सरकटिजैळ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ bābhuḻīceṃ khoḍa | girabaḍūni jātī saraḍa| taiseṃ picaḍīṃ toṃḍa | sarakaṭijaiḻa|| 62||
verses.meaning: Just as a lizard clings to and climbs a babhul tree trunk, so too does the mouth cling to and climb the throat.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रांधवणी चुलीपुढें। पऱ्हे उन्मादती खातवडे । तैसींचि यें नाकाडें। बिडबिडती ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: rāṃdhavaṇī culīpuḍheṃ| paṟhe unmādatī khātavaḍe | taisīṃci yeṃ nākāḍeṃ| biḍabiḍatī || 63||
verses.meaning: Just as the cooking pots in front of the stove become agitated and the flatbreads swell up, so too do these insignificant ones (the senses) become restless and make a fuss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तांबूलें बोंठ राऊं। हांसतां दांत दाऊं। सनागर मिरऊं। बोल जेणें ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tāṃbūleṃ boṃṭha rāūṃ| hāṃsatāṃ dāṃta dāūṃ| sanāgara miraūṃ| bola jeṇeṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: With betel-stained lips, and teeth revealed in laughter, the beautiful one speaks, her words shining forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'तयाचि पाहे या तोंडा। येईल जळंबटाचा लोंढा। इया उमळती दाढा। दांतांसहित ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'tayāci pāhe yā toṃḍā| yeīla jaḻaṃbaṭācā loṃḍhā| iyā umaḻatī dāḍhā| dāṃtāṃsahita || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Behold, from that mouth, a torrent of saliva will flow, and these fangs will emerge, along with the teeth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुळवाडी रिणें दाटलीं। कां वांकडिया ढोरें बैसली । तैसी नुठी कांहीं केली । जीभचि हे॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuḻavāḍī riṇeṃ dāṭalīṃ| kāṃ vāṃkaḍiyā ḍhoreṃ baisalī | taisī nuṭhī kāṃhīṃ kelī | jībhaci he|| 66||
verses.meaning: Just as a field is overgrown with weeds, or crooked cattle are seated, so too this tongue does not rise for anything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुसळें कोरडीं। वारेनें जाती बरडीं। तैसी आपदा तोंडीं । दाढीयेसीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kusaḻeṃ koraḍīṃ| vāreneṃ jātī baraḍīṃ| taisī āpadā toṃḍīṃ | dāḍhīyesīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Just as dry grass is scattered by the wind, so too are calamities dispersed from the beard (of a devotee).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आषाढींचेनि जळें। जैसीं झिरपती शैलांचीं मोळें। तैसें खांडीहूनि लाळे । पडती पूर॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṣāḍhīṃceni jaḻeṃ| jaisīṃ jhirapatī śailāṃcīṃ moḻeṃ| taiseṃ khāṃḍīhūni lāḻe | paḍatī pūra|| 68||
verses.meaning: Just as the monsoon rains cause streams to flow from the mountains, so too do torrents of saliva pour from the mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वाचेसि अपवाडु। कानीं अनुघडु। पिंड गरुवा माकडु। होईल हा॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vācesi apavāḍu| kānīṃ anughaḍu| piṃḍa garuvā mākaḍu| hoīla hā|| 69||
verses.meaning: If the tongue speaks ill and the ears hear what is improper, then this body, though weighty, will become like a monkey.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तृणाचें बुझवणें । आंदोळे वारेनगुणें । तैसें येईल कांपणें । सर्वांगासी ॥ ५७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tṛṇāceṃ bujhavaṇeṃ | āṃdoḻe vārenaguṇeṃ | taiseṃ yeīla kāṃpaṇeṃ | sarvāṃgāsī || 570||
verses.meaning: Just as a scarecrow made of straw trembles due to the wind, so too will the entire body shiver.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पायां पडती वेंगडी । हात वळती मुरकुंडी। बरवेपणा बागडी । नाचविजैल॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāyāṃ paḍatī veṃgaḍī | hāta vaḻatī murakuṃḍī| baravepaṇā bāgaḍī | nācavijaila|| 79||
verses.meaning: They fall at the feet, their hands fold in reverence, and their goodness will dance with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मळमपूत्रद्वारे। होऊनि ठाती खोंकरें। नवसियें होती इतरें। माझिया निधनीं ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maḻamapūtradvāre| hoūni ṭhātī khoṃkareṃ| navasiyeṃ hotī itareṃ| mājhiyā nidhanīṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: Through the excretory passages, they become entangled and bound. Others make vows for my demise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखोनि थुंकील जगु । मृत्यूचा पडेल पांगु। सोइरियां उबगु । येईल माझा ॥ ७३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhoni thuṃkīla jagu | mṛtyūcā paḍela pāṃgu| soiriyāṃ ubagu | yeīla mājhā || 73 ||
verses.meaning: The world will spit upon me, death will be my only refuge, and even my loved ones will turn away in disgust.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्त्रिया म्हणती विवसी। बाळें जाती मूर्च्छीं। किंबहुना चिळसी। पात्र होईन ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: striyā mhaṇatī vivasī| bāḻeṃ jātī mūrcchīṃ| kiṃbahunā ciḻasī| pātra hoīna || 74||
verses.meaning: Women will say I am a madwoman; children will faint. In short, I will become an object of disgust.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उभळीचा उजगरा। सेजारियां साइलिया घरा। शिणवील म्हणती म्हातारा । बहुतांतें हा ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ubhaḻīcā ujagarā| sejāriyāṃ sāiliyā gharā| śiṇavīla mhaṇatī mhātārā | bahutāṃteṃ hā || 75 ||
verses.meaning: The old man, like a lamp that has burned out, is a burden to his neighbors. They say he troubles many.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी वार्धक्याची सूचणी । आपणियां तरुणपणी । देखे मग मनीं। बिटे जो गा॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī vārdhakyācī sūcaṇī | āpaṇiyāṃ taruṇapaṇī | dekhe maga manīṃ| biṭe jo gā|| 76||
verses.meaning: One who, in their youth, foresees the onset of old age and becomes detached from worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे पाहे हें येईल। २९४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आणि आतांचें भोगितां जाईल। मग काय उरेल। हितालागीं ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe pāhe heṃ yeīla| 294 śrījñāneśvarī āṇi ātāṃceṃ bhogitāṃ jāīla| maga kāya urela| hitālāgīṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: He says, "Look, this will come to pass, and what is being experienced now will also fade away. Then what will remain for one's true well-being?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि नाइकणें पावे। तंव आइकोनि घालीं आघवें। पंगु न होतां जावें। तेथ जाय॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni nāikaṇeṃ pāve| taṃva āikoni ghālīṃ āghaveṃ| paṃgu na hotāṃ jāveṃ| tetha jāya|| 78||
verses.meaning: Therefore, until the hearing is complete, listen to everything. Go there without becoming lame.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दृष्टी जंव आहे। तंब पाहावें तेतुलें पाहे । मूकत्वा आधीं वाचा वाहे । सुभाषिते ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: dṛṣṭī jaṃva āhe| taṃba pāhāveṃ tetuleṃ pāhe | mūkatvā ādhīṃ vācā vāhe | subhāṣite || 79||
verses.meaning: As long as there is sight, one sees only that much which is visible. Similarly, before speech becomes mute, it flows forth as eloquent words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हात होती खुळे। हें पुढील मोटकें कळे। तंब करूनि घाली सकळें। दानादिकें ॥ ५८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāta hotī khuḻe| heṃ puḍhīla moṭakeṃ kaḻe| taṃba karūni ghālī sakaḻeṃ| dānādikeṃ || 580||
verses.meaning: With hands, he would perform all acts of charity and other good deeds, understanding that this body is temporary.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी दशा येईल पुढें। तैं मन होईल वेडें। तंब चिंतूनि ठेवी चोखडें। आत्मज्ञान ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī daśā yeīla puḍheṃ| taiṃ mana hoīla veḍeṃ| taṃba ciṃtūni ṭhevī cokhaḍeṃ| ātmajñāna || 81||
verses.meaning: When such a state arises in the future, the mind will become bewildered. Therefore, contemplate and firmly establish the pure knowledge of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैं चोर पाहे झोंबती। तंब आजीचि रुसिजे संपत्ती । कां झांकाझांकी वाती। न वबचतां कौजे॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiṃ cora pāhe jhoṃbatī| taṃba ājīci rusije saṃpattī | kāṃ jhāṃkājhāṃkī vātī| na vabacatāṃ kauje|| 82||
verses.meaning: Just as thieves, seeing an opportunity, rush to seize wealth, or as a lamp, when covered, cannot illuminate, so too is the nature of things.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें वार्धक्य यावें। मग जें वायां जावें। तें आतांचि आघवें। सवतें करीं ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ vārdhakya yāveṃ| maga jeṃ vāyāṃ jāveṃ| teṃ ātāṃci āghaveṃ| savateṃ karīṃ || 83||
verses.meaning: Just as old age comes, and then everything goes to waste, so too, let all of it be wasted now, by your own hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां मोडूनि ठेलीं दुर्गे। कां बळित धरिलें खगें। तेथ उपेक्षूनि जो निघे। तो नागवला कौं॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ moḍūni ṭhelīṃ durge| kāṃ baḻita dharileṃ khageṃ| tetha upekṣūni jo nighe| to nāgavalā kauṃ|| 84||
verses.meaning: Now, if a fort is broken down, or if a bird of prey has seized a sacrifice, and one neglects it and leaves, then surely they are ruined.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें वृद्धाप्य होये। आळेपण ते वायां जाये। जे तो शतवृद्ध आहे। नेणों कैंचा ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ vṛddhāpya hoye| āḻepaṇa te vāyāṃ jāye| je to śatavṛddha āhe| neṇoṃ kaiṃcā || 85||
verses.meaning: Similarly, old age comes, but its weakness is in vain, for he is a hundred years old, yet we do not know from where he comes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: झाडिलींची कोळें झाडी । तया न फळे जेवीं बोंडी। जाहला अग्नि तरी राखोंडी। जाळील काई ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jhāḍilīṃcī koḻeṃ jhāḍī | tayā na phaḻe jevīṃ boṃḍī| jāhalā agni tarī rākhoṃḍī| jāḻīla kāī || 86||
verses.meaning: Just as a tree that has been stripped of its leaves and branches cannot bear fruit, and ashes, though once fire, cannot burn, so too is the nature of things.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि वार्धक्याचेनि आठवें । वार्धक्या जो नागवे । तयाच्या ठायीं जाणावें। ज्ञान आहे ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vārdhakyāceni āṭhaveṃ | vārdhakyā jo nāgave | tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ jāṇāveṃ| jñāna āhe || 87||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by remembering old age, one who is not overcome by old age, in him, know that there is true knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसेचि नाना रोग। पडिघाती ना जंब पुढांआंग। तंब आरोग्याचे उपेग। करूनि घाली॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseci nānā roga| paḍighātī nā jaṃba puḍhāṃāṃga| taṃba ārogyāce upega| karūni ghālī|| 88||
verses.meaning: Similarly, before various diseases attack the body, one should take measures to maintain good health.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सापाच्या तोंडीं । पडली जे उंडी। ते लावूनि सांडी । प्रबुद्ध जैसा ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāpācyā toṃḍīṃ | paḍalī je uṃḍī| te lāvūni sāṃḍī | prabuddha jaisā || 89||
verses.meaning: Just as a wise person abandons a morsel of food that has fallen into a snake's mouth, so too should one abandon worldly attachments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा वियोगें जेणें दुःखें। विपत्ति शोक पोखे। तें स्नेह सांडूनि सुखें। उदासु होय ॥ ५९० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā viyogeṃ jeṇeṃ duḥkheṃ| vipatti śoka pokhe| teṃ sneha sāṃḍūni sukheṃ| udāsu hoya || 590 ||
verses.meaning: Just as by separation, sorrow and calamity are nourished, so too, by abandoning such affection, one becomes happily indifferent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जेणें जेणें कडे। दोष सूतील तोंडें । तयां कर्मरंश्री गुंडे। नियमाचे दाटी ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jeṇeṃ jeṇeṃ kaḍe| doṣa sūtīla toṃḍeṃ | tayāṃ karmaraṃśrī guṃḍe| niyamāce dāṭī || 91||
verses.meaning: And wherever faults raise their heads, the strict rules of karma will crush them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसऐसिया आइती । जयाची परी असती । तोचि तो ज्ञानसंपत्ती । गोसावी गा॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisaaisiyā āitī | jayācī parī asatī | toci to jñānasaṃpattī | gosāvī gā||92||
verses.meaning: One whose intellect is thus, and whose understanding is of this nature, that very person is the master of the wealth of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां आणीकही एक। लक्षण अलौकिक । सांगेन आइक । धनंजया॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ āṇīkahī eka| lakṣaṇa alaukika | sāṃgena āika | dhanaṃjayā|| 93||
verses.meaning: Now, listen, Arjuna, I will tell you another extraordinary characteristic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि जो या देहावरी । उदासु ऐसिया परी । उखिता जैसा बिढारीं। बैसला आहे॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari jo yā dehāvarī | udāsu aisiyā parī | ukhitā jaisā biḍhārīṃ| baisalā āhe|| 94||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one who is detached from this body, just like a temporary guest who has settled in a lodging.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां वृक्षाची साउली । वाटे जातां मीनली। घरावरी तेतुली । आस्था नाहीं ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ vṛkṣācī sāulī | vāṭe jātāṃ mīnalī| gharāvarī tetulī | āsthā nāhīṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: Just as the shade of a tree is found by a traveler on the way, so too is there no such attachment to one's home.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साउली सरिसीच असे। परी असे हें नेणिजे जैसें। स्त्रियेचें तैसें । लोलुप्य नाहीं ॥ ९६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāulī sarisīca ase| parī ase heṃ neṇije jaiseṃ| striyeceṃ taiseṃ | lolupya nāhīṃ || 96 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a shadow is always with a person, yet one does not perceive its presence, so too is the longing of a woman; it is not truly there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि प्रजा जे जाली । तियें बस्ती कीर आलीं। कां गोरुवें बैसलीं । रुखातळीं ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi prajā je jālī | tiyeṃ bastī kīra ālīṃ| kāṃ goruveṃ baisalīṃ | rukhātaḻīṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: And the people who were born, they came to settle, or like cattle, they sat under the trees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो संपत्तीमाजी असतां । ऐसा गमे पंडुसुता । जैसा कां वाटे जातां। साक्षी ठेविला ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo saṃpattīmājī asatāṃ | aisā game paṃḍusutā | jaisā kāṃ vāṭe jātāṃ| sākṣī ṭhevilā || 98||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, when one is amidst wealth, it seems as if it has been kept as a witness for a journey.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना पुंसा। पांजरियामाजीं जैसा । वेदाज्ञेसी तैसा। बिहूनि असे॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā puṃsā| pāṃjariyāmājīṃ jaisā | vedājñesī taisā| bihūni ase|| 99||
verses.meaning: Indeed, just as a bird is confined within a cage, so too is a man bound by the fear of the Vedas' commands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं दारागृहपुत्रीं । नाहीं जया मैत्री। तो जाण पां धात्री। ज्ञानासि गा॥ ६००॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ dārāgṛhaputrīṃ | nāhīṃ jayā maitrī| to jāṇa pāṃ dhātrī| jñānāsi gā|| 600||
verses.meaning: Indeed, one who has no attachment to wife, house, or children, know that he is the true nourisher of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: महासिंधु जैसे । ग्रीष्मवर्षी सरिसे। इष्टानिष्ट तैसें। जयाच्या ठायीं ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: mahāsiṃdhu jaise | grīṣmavarṣī sarise| iṣṭāniṣṭa taiseṃ| jayācyā ṭhāyīṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: Just as the great ocean remains unaffected by the rivers that flow into it during summer or monsoon, so too are desirable and undesirable things in His abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां तिन्ही काळ होतां। त्रिधा नव्हे सविता । तैसा सुखदुःखीं चित्ता । भेदु नाहीं ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ tinhī kāḻa hotāṃ| tridhā navhe savitā | taisā sukhaduḥkhīṃ cittā | bhedu nāhīṃ || 2||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun remains one, unaffected by the three divisions of time (past, present, future), so too the mind, when established in the Self, sees no distinction between joy and sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ नभाचेनि पाडें। समत्वा उणें न पडे। तेथ ज्ञान रोकडें। बोळख तूं॥३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha nabhāceni pāḍeṃ| samatvā uṇeṃ na paḍe| tetha jñāna rokaḍeṃ| boḻakha tūṃ||3||
verses.meaning: Where, in comparison to the sky, equality does not diminish, there know true knowledge to be directly present.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मौीवांचूनी कांहीं । आणीक गोमटें नाहीं । ऐसा निशचयोचि तिहीं । जयाचा केला॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mauīvāṃcūnī kāṃhīṃ | āṇīka gomaṭeṃ nāhīṃ | aisā niśacayoci tihīṃ | jayācā kelā|| 4||
verses.meaning: And they have firmly resolved that there is nothing more beautiful or excellent than silence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शरीर वाचा मानस। पियालीं कृतनिशचयाचा कोश । एक मीवांचूनि वास। न पाहती आन॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: śarīra vācā mānasa| piyālīṃ kṛtaniśacayācā kośa | eka mīvāṃcūni vāsa| na pāhatī āna|| 5||
verses.meaning: Body, speech, and mind, having drunk from the treasury of resolute determination, see no other dwelling place than Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना निकट निज । जयाचें जाहलें मज। तेणें आपणयां आम्हां सेज। एकी केली ॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā nikaṭa nija | jayāceṃ jāhaleṃ maja| teṇeṃ āpaṇayāṃ āmhāṃ seja| ekī kelī ||6||
verses.meaning: Indeed, when I became intimately close to Him, He made a single bed for Himself and me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रिगतां वल्लभापुढें। नाहीं आंगीं जीवीं सांकडें। तिये कांतेचेनि पाडें। एकसरला जो॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: rigatāṃ vallabhāpuḍheṃ| nāhīṃ āṃgīṃ jīvīṃ sāṃkaḍeṃ| tiye kāṃteceni pāḍeṃ| ekasaralā jo|| 7||
verses.meaning: When a beloved enters the presence of her husband, she feels no distress in her body or soul. Similarly, one who is completely united with the Divine experiences such a state of oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मिळोनि मिळतचि असे। समुद्री गंगाजळ जैसें । मी होऊनि मज तैसें । सर्वस्वें भजती ॥ ८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: miḻoni miḻataci ase| samudrī gaṃgājaḻa jaiseṃ | mī hoūni maja taiseṃ | sarvasveṃ bhajatī || 8 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganges water merges into the sea and becomes one with it, so too do they, becoming one with Me, worship Me with their entire being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सूर्याच्या होण्यां होइजे । कां सूर्यासबेंचि जाइजे । हें विकलेपण साजे । प्रभेसि जेवीं ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sūryācyā hoṇyāṃ hoije | kāṃ sūryāsabeṃci jāije | heṃ vikalepaṇa sāje | prabhesi jevīṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Just as the radiance is born with the sun, or rather, goes along with the sun, such is its inherent nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं पाणियाचिये भूमिके। पाणी तळपे कौतुकें। ते लहरी म्हणती लौकिकें। येऱ्हबीं तें पाणी॥ ६१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ pāṇiyāciye bhūmike| pāṇī taḻape kautukeṃ| te laharī mhaṇatī laukikeṃ| yeṟhabīṃ teṃ pāṇī|| 610||
verses.meaning: Just as water, in its own nature, playfully ripples, and people commonly call these ripples 'waves,' yet fundamentally, it is all just water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो अनन्यु ही यापरी। मी जाहलाही मातें वरी। तोचि तो मूर्तधारी । ज्ञान पैं गा॥११॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo ananyu hī yāparī| mī jāhalāhī māteṃ varī| toci to mūrtadhārī | jñāna paiṃ gā||11||
verses.meaning: One who, in this manner, becomes completely one with Me, and chooses Me as their ultimate refuge, that embodied soul is indeed true knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तीर्थे धौतें तटें। तपोबनें चोखटें। आवडती कपाटें। वबसवूं जया॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tīrthe dhauteṃ taṭeṃ| tapobaneṃ cokhaṭeṃ| āvaḍatī kapāṭeṃ| vabasavūṃ jayā|| 12||
verses.meaning: And sacred places, pure riverbanks, and pristine hermitages are dear to those who wish to reside there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शैलकक्षांचीं कुहरें। जळाशयपरिसरें। अधिष्ठी जो आदेरें। नगरा न ये॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: śailakakṣāṃcīṃ kuhareṃ| jaḻāśayaparisareṃ| adhiṣṭhī jo ādereṃ| nagarā na ye|| 13||
verses.meaning: He who, with reverence, dwells in mountain caves and by the banks of water bodies, does not come to the city.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बहु एकांतावरी प्रीति। जया जनपदाची खंती । जाण मनुष्याकारें मूर्ती । ज्ञानाची तो॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: bahu ekāṃtāvarī prīti| jayā janapadācī khaṃtī | jāṇa manuṣyākāreṃ mūrtī | jñānācī to|| 14||
verses.meaning: He who loves solitude, who is indifferent to worldly affairs, know that he is the very embodiment of knowledge in human form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिकहि पुढती । चिन्हें गा सुमती । ज्ञानाचिये निरुती-। लागीं सांगों ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇikahi puḍhatī | cinheṃ gā sumatī | jñānāciye nirutī-| lāgīṃ sāṃgoṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Furthermore, O good-minded one, I shall tell you more signs that lead to the certainty of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: २९६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तरी परमात्मा ऐसें । जें एक वस्तु असे | तें जया दिसें । ज्ञानास्तब ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: 296 śrījñāneśvarī tarī paramātmā aiseṃ | jeṃ eka vastu ase | teṃ jayā diseṃ | jñānāstaba || 16||
verses.meaning: Thus, the Supreme Self, which is the one reality, is revealed to one whose knowledge is steadfast.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें एकवांचूनि आनें। जिये भवस्वर्गादि ज्ञानें । तें अज्ञान ऐसा मनें । निश्चयो करी॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ ekavāṃcūni āneṃ| jiye bhavasvargādi jñāneṃ | teṃ ajñāna aisā maneṃ | niścayo karī|| 17||
verses.meaning: Except for that one (Brahman), all knowledge of existence, heaven, etc., is ignorance; thus, one should firmly resolve in the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वर्गा जाणें हें सांडी । भवविषयीं कान झाडी । दे अध्यात्मज्ञानीं बुडी । सद्‌भावाची ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: svargā jāṇeṃ heṃ sāṃḍī | bhavaviṣayīṃ kāna jhāḍī | de adhyātmajñānīṃ buḍī | sad‌bhāvācī || 18||
verses.meaning: Abandon the desire to go to heaven, and turn away from worldly affairs. Immerse yourself in spiritual knowledge with sincere devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भंगल्ये वाटे । शोधूनियां अव्हांटे । निघिजे जेवीं नीटें। राजपंथें ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhaṃgalye vāṭe | śodhūniyāṃ avhāṃṭe | nighije jevīṃ nīṭeṃ| rājapaṃtheṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Just as one, having lost their way, searches for the correct path and then proceeds straight along the royal road.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें ज्ञानजातां करी । आघवेंचि एकीकडे सारी । मग मन बुद्धि मोहरी। अध्यात्मज्ञानीं ॥ ६२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jñānajātāṃ karī | āghaveṃci ekīkaḍe sārī | maga mana buddhi moharī| adhyātmajñānīṃ || 620||
verses.meaning: Just as knowledge, when it arises, gathers everything together and then, with a mind and intellect absorbed in spiritual wisdom, it becomes completely unified.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणें एक हेंचि आथी। येर जाणणें ते भ्रांती। ऐसी निकुरेंसीं मती। मेरु होय ॥ २९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇeṃ eka heṃci āthī| yera jāṇaṇeṃ te bhrāṃtī| aisī nikureṃsīṃ matī| meru hoya || 291||
verses.meaning: He says, "This alone is real; all else is illusion." With such firm conviction, his intellect becomes as unshakeable as Mount Meru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं निश्चयो जयाचा । द्वारीं अध्यात्मज्ञानाचा । ध्रुवदेवो गगनींचा । तैसा राहिळा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ niścayo jayācā | dvārīṃ adhyātmajñānācā | dhruvadevo gaganīṃcā | taisā rāhiḻā|| 22||
verses.meaning: Thus, one whose resolve is firm, at the threshold of spiritual knowledge, remains steadfast like the Pole Star in the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'तयाचिया ठायीं ज्ञान। या बोला नाहीं आन । जें ज्ञानीं बेसलें मन। तेव्हांच तें तो मी॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'tayāciyā ṭhāyīṃ jñāna| yā bolā nāhīṃ āna | jeṃ jñānīṃ besaleṃ mana| tevhāṃca teṃ to mī|| 23||
verses.meaning: In that very place, there is knowledge. There is no other word for it. When the mind is absorbed in knowledge, then it is I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी बैसलेपणें जें होये। तें बैसतांचि बोलें न होये। तरी ज्ञाना तया आहे। सरिसा पाडु॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī baisalepaṇeṃ jeṃ hoye| teṃ baisatāṃci boleṃ na hoye| tarī jñānā tayā āhe| sarisā pāḍu|| 24||
verses.meaning: Even if one is seated, that which is attained is not achieved merely by sitting and speaking. For that, knowledge is equally essential.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तत्त्वज्ञान निर्मळ। फळें जें एक फळ। तें ज्ञेयहीवरी सरळ। दिठी जया॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tattvajñāna nirmaḻa| phaḻeṃ jeṃ eka phaḻa| teṃ jñeyahīvarī saraḻa| diṭhī jayā|| 25||
verses.meaning: And the pure fruit of philosophy, which is one fruit, is the straightforward vision of that knowable (Brahman).

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं बोधा आलेनि ज्ञानें) जरी ज्ञेय न दिसेचि मनें।॥ तरी ज्ञानलळाभुही न मने। जाहला सांता॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ bodhā āleni jñāneṃ) jarī jñeya na diseci maneṃ||| tarī jñānalaḻābhuhī na mane| jāhalā sāṃtā|| 26||
verses.meaning: Even if the mind, enlightened by knowledge, does not perceive the knowable, then the joy of knowledge is not truly experienced, even if it is said to have occurred.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंधळेनि हातीं दिवा। घेऊनि काय करावा । तेसा ज्ञाननिश्चयो आघवा । वायांचि जाय॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃdhaḻeni hātīṃ divā| gheūni kāya karāvā | tesā jñānaniścayo āghavā | vāyāṃci jāya|| 27||
verses.meaning: What good is a lamp in the hands of a blind person? Similarly, all knowledge and certainty go to waste.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरि ज्ञानाचेनि प्रकाशें। परतत्त्वी दिठी न पैसे। ते स्फूर्तीचि असे। अंध होऊनी ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jari jñānāceni prakāśeṃ| paratattvī diṭhī na paise| te sphūrtīci ase| aṃdha hoūnī || 28||
verses.meaning: Even if the light of knowledge does not allow the sight to penetrate the Supreme Reality, that very inspiration becomes blind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ज्ञान जेतुलें दाबीं। तेतुली वस्तुचि आघवी । तें देखे ऐशी व्हावी । बुद्धि चोख॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni jñāna jetuleṃ dābīṃ| tetulī vastuci āghavī | teṃ dekhe aiśī vhāvī | buddhi cokha|| 29||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the intellect should be so pure that it perceives the entire reality as being precisely what knowledge reveals.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं ज्ञानें निर्दोखें। दाविलें ज्ञेय देखे। तैसेनि उन्मेखें। आथिला जो॥ ६३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ jñāneṃ nirdokheṃ| dāvileṃ jñeya dekhe| taiseni unmekheṃ| āthilā jo|| 630||
verses.meaning: Therefore, knowledge, being flawless, reveals the knowable. One who is endowed with such an awakening (or insight) attains it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेवढी ज्ञानाची वृष्धी। तेवढीच जयाची बुद्धी । तो ज्ञान हे शब्दीं। करणें न लगे॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jevaḍhī jñānācī vṛṣdhī| tevaḍhīca jayācī buddhī | to jñāna he śabdīṃ| karaṇeṃ na lage|| 31||
verses.meaning: The extent of one's wisdom is the measure of their intellect. Such a person does not need to express this knowledge through words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पै ज्ञानाचिये प्रभेसवें। जयाची मती ज्ञेयीं पावे। तो हातधरणिया शिवे । परतत्त्वातें ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pai jñānāciye prabhesaveṃ| jayācī matī jñeyīṃ pāve| to hātadharaṇiyā śive | paratattvāteṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: When, with the light of knowledge, one's intellect reaches the knowable, then, by holding its hand, it touches the Supreme Reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोचि ज्ञान हें बोलतां । विस्मयो कवण पांडुसुता। काय सवितयातें सविता । म्हणावें असे॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: toci jñāna heṃ bolatāṃ | vismayo kavaṇa pāṃḍusutā| kāya savitayāteṃ savitā | mhaṇāveṃ ase|| 33||
verses.meaning: When that very knowledge is spoken of, what wonder is there, O son of Pandu? It is like asking the sun to describe itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव श्रोते म्हणती असो । न सांगें तयाचा अतिसो। ग्रंथोक्ती तेथ आडसो । घालितोसी कां॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva śrote mhaṇatī aso | na sāṃgeṃ tayācā atiso| graṃthoktī tetha āḍaso | ghālitosī kāṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: Then the listeners say, "Let it be. Do not exaggerate it. Why do you obstruct the scriptural statement there?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुझा हाचि आम्हां थोरु । बक्‍तृत्वाचा पाहुणेरु । जे ज्ञानविषो फारु । निरोपिला ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tujhā hāci āmhāṃ thoru | bak‍tṛtvācā pāhuṇeru | je jñānaviṣo phāru | niropilā || 35||
verses.meaning: This indeed is a great feast of eloquence for us, that you have expounded so much on the subject of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रसु होआवा अतिमात्रु| हा घेतासि कविमंत्रु। तरि अवंतूनि शत्रु करितोसि कां गा॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: rasu hoāvā atimātru| hā ghetāsi kavimaṃtru| tari avaṃtūni śatru karitosi kāṃ gā|| 36||
verses.meaning: If you are to become exceedingly sweet, and you accept this poetic mantra, then why do you make an enemy out of yourself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ठायीं बैसतिये वेळे। जे रससोय घेऊनि पळे। तियेचा येरू बोडव मिळे। कोणा अर्था॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ṭhāyīṃ baisatiye veḻe| je rasasoya gheūni paḻe| tiyecā yerū boḍava miḻe| koṇā arthā|| 37||
verses.meaning: When it is time to sit down for a meal, if someone takes the prepared food and runs away, then what is the use of the remaining empty vessels?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आघवांचि विषयीं भादी। परि सांजवणी टेंकों नेदी। ते खुरतोडी नुसधी। पोषी कवण॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āghavāṃci viṣayīṃ bhādī| pari sāṃjavaṇī ṭeṃkoṃ nedī| te khuratoḍī nusadhī| poṣī kavaṇa|| 38||
verses.meaning: In all worldly matters, there is a constant struggle, yet one does not allow the evening lamp to be extinguished. Who then nourishes this mere cutting, this transient existence?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी ज्ञानीं मती न फांके। येर जल्पती नेणों केतुकें। परि तें असो निकें। केलें तुवां॥३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī jñānīṃ matī na phāṃke| yera jalpatī neṇoṃ ketukeṃ| pari teṃ aso nikeṃ| keleṃ tuvāṃ||39||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the intellect of the wise does not get entangled in such discussions. Others, however, babble on endlessly. But let that be; You have done well.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया ज्ञानलेशोद्देशें। किजती योगादि सायासें। ते धणीचें आथी तुझिया ऐसें । निरूपण ॥ ६४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā jñānaleśoddeśeṃ| kijatī yogādi sāyāseṃ| te dhaṇīceṃ āthī tujhiyā aiseṃ | nirūpaṇa || 640||
verses.meaning: The yogic practices and other efforts undertaken to gain even a fragment of that knowledge, all find their ultimate fulfillment and satisfaction in your discourse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अमृताची सांतवांकुडी। लागो कां अनुघडी। सुखाच्या दिवस कोडी । गणिजतु कां॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: amṛtācī sāṃtavāṃkuḍī| lāgo kāṃ anughaḍī| sukhācyā divasa koḍī | gaṇijatu kāṃ|| 49||
verses.meaning: May the sweet taste of immortality be experienced continuously, and may countless days of joy be counted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पूर्णचंद्रेसी राती। युग एक असोनि 'पहाती। तरी काय न पाहत आहाती । चकोरी ते॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: pūrṇacaṃdresī rātī| yuga eka asoni 'pahātī| tarī kāya na pāhata āhātī | cakorī te|| 42||
verses.meaning: If a full moon night were to last for an entire age, would the chakori bird ever cease gazing at it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें ज्ञानाचें बोलणें । आणि येणें रसाळपणें । आतां पुरे कोण म्हणे । आकणितां॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ jñānāceṃ bolaṇeṃ | āṇi yeṇeṃ rasāḻapaṇeṃ | ātāṃ pure koṇa mhaṇe | ākaṇitāṃ|| 43||
verses.meaning: Such is the discourse of knowledge, and so sweet is its essence, that who would say 'enough' when listening to it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सभाग्यु पाहुणा ये। सुभगाचि वाढती होये। तें सरों नेणें रससोये । ऐसें आथी॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sabhāgyu pāhuṇā ye| subhagāci vāḍhatī hoye| teṃ saroṃ neṇeṃ rasasoye | aiseṃ āthī|| 44||
verses.meaning: And when a fortunate guest arrives, the joy of the hostess increases. That joy, full of rasa (essence/delight), never diminishes. Such is its nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा जाहला प्रसंगु। जे ज्ञानीं आम्हांसि लागु) आणि तुजही अनुरागु) आथि तेथ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā jāhalā prasaṃgu| je jñānīṃ āmhāṃsi lāgu) āṇi tujahī anurāgu) āthi tetha|| 45||
verses.meaning: Such is the situation, that we are connected with the wise, and you too have affection there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि यया वाखाणा-। पासीं से आली चौगुणा। ना म्हणों नयेसि देखणा । होसी ज्ञानी ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yayā vākhāṇā-| pāsīṃ se ālī cauguṇā| nā mhaṇoṃ nayesi dekhaṇā | hosī jñānī || 46||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by this explanation, you will attain the fourfold spiritual wealth. You will not be called ignorant, but will become truly wise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आतां ययावरी । प्रज्ञेच्या माजघरीं। पदें साच करीं। निरूपणीं॥४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātāṃ yayāvarī | prajñecyā mājagharīṃ| padeṃ sāca karīṃ| nirūpaṇīṃ||47||
verses.meaning: Therefore, now, in the inner chamber of wisdom, make these words true in this discourse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या संतवाक्‍्यासरिसें । म्हणितलें निवृत्तिदासें। माझेंहि जी ऐसें । मनोगत ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā saṃtavāk‍yāsariseṃ | mhaṇitaleṃ nivṛttidāseṃ| mājheṃhi jī aiseṃ | manogata || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Following these words of the saints, Nivrittidas says, "Such is also my heartfelt desire."

verses.shloka_devanagari: यावरी आतां तुम्हीं। आज्ञापिला स्वामी। तरी वायां वागूं मी। वाढों नेदी ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāvarī ātāṃ tumhīṃ| ājñāpilā svāmī| tarī vāyāṃ vāgūṃ mī| vāḍhoṃ nedī || 49||
verses.meaning: Now that you, my Lord, have commanded me, I will not let this effort go to waste or be fruitless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं इयें अवधारा । ज्ञानलक्षणें अठरा । श्रीकृष्णें धनुर्धरा । निरूपिलीं ॥ ६५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ iyeṃ avadhārā | jñānalakṣaṇeṃ aṭharā | śrīkṛṣṇeṃ dhanurdharā | nirūpilīṃ || 650||
verses.meaning: Thus, these eighteen characteristics of knowledge were expounded by Shri Krishna to Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणे या नांवें। ज्ञान एथ जाणावें । हें स्वमत आणि आधवबें। ज्ञानियेही म्हणती ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇe yā nāṃveṃ| jñāna etha jāṇāveṃ | heṃ svamata āṇi ādhavabeṃ| jñāniyehī mhaṇatī || 51||
verses.meaning: Then, it is said that this is called knowledge. This is my own opinion, and the wise also say the same.

verses.shloka_devanagari: करतळावरी वाटोळा । डोलतु देखिजे आंवळा। तैसें ज्ञान आम्हीं डोळां। दाविलें तुज ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: karataḻāvarī vāṭoḻā | ḍolatu dekhije āṃvaḻā| taiseṃ jñāna āmhīṃ ḍoḻāṃ| dāvileṃ tuja || 52||
verses.meaning: Just as a small fruit like an amalaka (Indian gooseberry) can be seen clearly swaying on the palm of one's hand, so have I revealed this knowledge to your eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां धनंजया महामती । अज्ञान ऐसी वदंती । तेंही सांगों व्यक्‍ती । लक्षणेंसीं ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ dhanaṃjayā mahāmatī | ajñāna aisī vadaṃtī | teṃhī sāṃgoṃ vyak‍tī | lakṣaṇeṃsīṃ || 53||
verses.meaning: Now, O Dhananjaya, the great-minded one, I shall also explain the nature of ignorance, along with its characteristics.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येऱ्हवीं ज्ञान फुडें जालिया । अज्ञान जाणवे धनंजया । जें ज्ञान नव्हे तें अपैसया । अज्ञानचि॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṟhavīṃ jñāna phuḍeṃ jāliyā | ajñāna jāṇave dhanaṃjayā | jeṃ jñāna navhe teṃ apaisayā | ajñānaci|| 54||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, once true knowledge dawns, ignorance is recognized, Dhananjaya. That which is not knowledge is inherently ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां दिवसु आघवा सरे। मग रात्रीची बारी उरे। बांचूनि कांहीं तिसरें। नाहीं जेवीं ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ divasu āghavā sare| maga rātrīcī bārī ure| bāṃcūni kāṃhīṃ tisareṃ| nāhīṃ jevīṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Behold, the entire day passes, and then the turn of night remains. There is nothing else, no third thing, just as it is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें ज्ञान जेथ नाहीं । तेंचि अज्ञान पाहीं। तरि सांगों कांहीं कांहीं । चिन्हें तियें ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jñāna jetha nāhīṃ | teṃci ajñāna pāhīṃ| tari sāṃgoṃ kāṃhīṃ kāṃhīṃ | cinheṃ tiyeṃ || 56||
verses.meaning: Where there is no knowledge, that indeed is ignorance. Therefore, I will tell you some of its characteristics.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी संभावने जिये । जो मानाची वाट पाहे। सत्कारें होये। तोषु जया॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī saṃbhāvane jiye | jo mānācī vāṭa pāhe| satkāreṃ hoye| toṣu jayā|| 57||
verses.meaning: Yet, if one expects honor, and anticipates respect, and is pleased by felicitations, then that is a sign of ego.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गर्वे पर्वताचीं शिखरें। तैसा महत्त्वावरूनि नुतरे। तयाचिया ठायीं पुरें। अज्ञान आहे ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: garve parvatācīṃ śikhareṃ| taisā mahattvāvarūni nutare| tayāciyā ṭhāyīṃ pureṃ| ajñāna āhe || 58||
verses.meaning: Just as the peaks of mountains are filled with pride, so too does ignorance abound in one who does not descend from their sense of self-importance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि स्वधर्माची मांगळी । बांधे वाचेच्या पिंपळीं । उभिला जैसा देऊळीं । जाणोनि २९८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी कुंचा॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi svadharmācī māṃgaḻī | bāṃdhe vācecyā piṃpaḻīṃ | ubhilā jaisā deūḻīṃ | jāṇoni 298 śrījñāneśvarī kuṃcā||59||
verses.meaning: And the auspiciousness of one's own dharma, tied to the sacred fig tree of speech, stands like a temple, knowing this. This is the brush of Shri Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घाली विद्येचा पसारा । सुये सुकृताचा डांगोरा । करी तेतुलें मोहरा । स्फीतीचिया॥ ६६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghālī vidyecā pasārā | suye sukṛtācā ḍāṃgorā | karī tetuleṃ moharā | sphītīciyā|| 660||
verses.meaning: He spreads the expanse of knowledge, proclaims the glory of good deeds, and turns all that into a blossoming of prosperity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंग वरिवरी चर्ची। जनातें अभ्यर्चितां वंची। तो जाण पां अज्ञानाची) खाणी एथ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃga varivarī carcī| janāteṃ abhyarcitāṃ vaṃcī| to jāṇa pāṃ ajñānācī) khāṇī etha|| 61||
verses.meaning: One who outwardly anoints their body, but deceives people while worshipping, know that such a person is a mine of ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि वन्ही वनीं वबिचरे। तेथ जळती जेैसीं जंगमें स्थावरें। तैसें जयाचेनि आचारें। जगा दुःख॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi vanhī vanīṃ vabicare| tetha jaḻatī jeaisīṃ jaṃgameṃ sthāvareṃ| taiseṃ jayāceni ācāreṃ| jagā duḥkha||62||
verses.meaning: And just as in a forest fire, both moving and stationary creatures are consumed, so too, the world suffers due to the actions of such a person.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कौतुके जें जें जल्पे। तें साबळाहूनि तीख रुपे। विषाहूनि संकल्पें। मारकु जे॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kautuke jeṃ jeṃ jalpe| teṃ sābaḻāhūni tīkha rupe| viṣāhūni saṃkalpeṃ| māraku je|| 63||
verses.meaning: Whatever is spoken playfully, it appears sharper than a spear. Its resolve is more deadly than poison.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयातें बहु अज्ञान) तो अज्ञानाचें निधान। हिंसेसि आयतन। जयाचें जिणें ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāteṃ bahu ajñāna) to ajñānāceṃ nidhāna| hiṃsesi āyatana| jayāceṃ jiṇeṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: He is extremely ignorant, a very abode of ignorance. His life is a dwelling place for violence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि फुंकें भाता फुगे। रेचिलिया सवेंचि उफगे। तैसा संयोगवियोगें। चढे बोहटे ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi phuṃkeṃ bhātā phuge| reciliyā saveṃci uphage| taisā saṃyogaviyogeṃ| caḍhe bohaṭe || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a blacksmith's bellows, when blown, inflates, and when the air is released, it deflates, so too does the mind expand and contract with union and separation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पडली वारयाचिया वळसा । धुळी चढे आकाशा । हरिखा वळघे तैसा । स्तुतीवेळे ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paḍalī vārayāciyā vaḻasā | dhuḻī caḍhe ākāśā | harikhā vaḻaghe taisā | stutīveḻe || 66||
verses.meaning: Just as dust, caught in a whirlwind, rises to the sky, so too does praise ascend with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निंदा मोटकी आइके। आणि कपाळ धरूनि ठाके । थेंबें विरे वारेनि शोखे। चिखलु जैसा ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: niṃdā moṭakī āike| āṇi kapāḻa dharūni ṭhāke | theṃbeṃ vire vāreni śokhe| cikhalu jaisā || 67||
verses.meaning: Upon hearing even a little slander, it (the mind) becomes agitated and holds its forehead in distress, just as a puddle of mud dries up and vanishes with a drop of water and a gust of wind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मानापमानीं होये। जो कोण्हीचि उर्मी न साहे। तयाच्या ठायीं आहे। अज्ञान पुरें॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mānāpamānīṃ hoye| jo koṇhīci urmī na sāhe| tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ āhe| ajñāna pureṃ|| 68 ||
verses.meaning: Similarly, in honor and dishonor, whoever does not endure any emotion, in them, ignorance is complete.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जयाचिया मनीं गांठी । वरिवरी मोकळी वाचा दिठी । आंगें मिळे जीवें पाठीं । भलतया दे॥ ६९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jayāciyā manīṃ gāṃṭhī | varivarī mokaḻī vācā diṭhī | āṃgeṃ miḻe jīveṃ pāṭhīṃ | bhalatayā de|| 69 ||
verses.meaning: And one whose mind is entangled in worldly attachments, though outwardly appearing detached, will always find their true self drawn to whatever they desire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: व्याधाचें चारा घालणें । तैसे प्रांजळ जोगावणें । चांगाचीं अंत:करणें । विरु करी ॥ ६७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vyādhāceṃ cārā ghālaṇeṃ | taise prāṃjaḻa jogāvaṇeṃ | cāṃgācīṃ aṃta:karaṇeṃ | viru karī || 670||
verses.meaning: Just as a hunter lays out bait, so too does the Lord, with pure and sincere care, capture the hearts of the good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गार शेवाळें गुंडाळली । कां निंबोळी जैसी पिकली । तैसी जयाची भली । बाह्य क्रिया॥ ७१। अज्ञान तयाचिया ठायीं। ठेविलें असे पाहीं॥ या बोला आन नाहीं। सत्य मानीं ॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: gāra śevāḻeṃ guṃḍāḻalī | kāṃ niṃboḻī jaisī pikalī | taisī jayācī bhalī | bāhya kriyā|| 71| ajñāna tayāciyā ṭhāyīṃ| ṭhevileṃ ase pāhīṃ|| yā bolā āna nāhīṃ| satya mānīṃ ||72||
verses.meaning: Just as moss covers a stone, or a neem fruit ripens, so too are the external actions of such a person. Know that ignorance resides within them; there is no doubt about this, believe it to be true.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि गुरुकुळीं लाजे। जो गुरुभक्ती उभजे। विद्या घेऊनि माजे। गुरूसींचि जो॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi gurukuḻīṃ lāje| jo gurubhaktī ubhaje| vidyā gheūni māje| gurūsīṃci jo|| 73||
verses.meaning: And one who feels ashamed in the guru's lineage, who rises in devotion to the guru, yet after acquiring knowledge, becomes arrogant towards the guru himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचें नाम घेणें। तें बाचे शूद्रान्न होणें। परि घडलें लक्षणें । बोलतां इयें ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāceṃ nāma gheṇeṃ| teṃ bāce śūdrānna hoṇeṃ| pari ghaḍaleṃ lakṣaṇeṃ | bolatāṃ iyeṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: To utter His name is like partaking of the purest food for the tongue. This is the essence of what is spoken here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां गुरुभक्तांचें नांब घेवों। तेणें वाचे प्रायश्चित्त देवो । गुरुसेबका नांव पावों। सुर्यु जैसा ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ gurubhaktāṃceṃ nāṃba ghevoṃ| teṇeṃ vāce prāyaścitta devo | gurusebakā nāṃva pāvoṃ| suryu jaisā || 75||
verses.meaning: Now, let us utter the names of the Guru's devotees, thereby purifying our speech. May the name of the Guru's servant reach everywhere, just like the sun.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलेनि पांगु पापाचा । निस्तरेळ हे बाचा । जो गुरुतल्पगाचा । नामीं जाला ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetuleni pāṃgu pāpācā | nistareḻa he bācā | jo gurutalpagācā | nāmīṃ jālā || 76||
verses.meaning: With this, the burden of sin, even of one who has committed the gravest sin of violating the guru's trust, is absolved, for he has taken the Guru's name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठायवरी। तया नामाचें भय हरी । मग म्हणे अवधारीं। आणिके चिन्हें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāyavarī| tayā nāmāceṃ bhaya harī | maga mhaṇe avadhārīṃ| āṇike cinheṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: At this point, the fear of that Name is dispelled. Then, the Lord says, 'Listen, there are other signs as well.'

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आंगें कर्मे ढिला । जो मनें विकल्पें भरला । अडवींचा अवगळला। कुहा जैसा॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī āṃgeṃ karme ḍhilā | jo maneṃ vikalpeṃ bharalā | aḍavīṃcā avagaḻalā| kuhā jaisā|| 78||
verses.meaning: Even if one performs actions physically, if their mind is filled with doubts and indecision, they are like a well that has been abandoned and fallen into disuse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया तोंडीं कांटिवडे। आंतु नुसधीं हाडें । अशुचि तेणें पाडें। सबाह्य जो॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā toṃḍīṃ kāṃṭivaḍe| āṃtu nusadhīṃ hāḍeṃ | aśuci teṇeṃ pāḍeṃ| sabāhya jo|| 79||
verses.meaning: Such a person, though outwardly appearing to speak sweet words, is inwardly filled with nothing but bones, and is impure both inside and out to that extent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेसें 'पोटालागीं सुणें। उघडें झांकलें न म्हणे। तैसें आपलें परावें नेणें । दरव्यालागीं॥ ६८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeseṃ 'poṭālāgīṃ suṇeṃ| ughaḍeṃ jhāṃkaleṃ na mhaṇe| taiseṃ āpaleṃ parāveṃ neṇeṃ | daravyālāgīṃ|| 680||
verses.meaning: Just as a dog, for the sake of its stomach, does not distinguish between what is covered and what is uncovered, so too, for the sake of wealth, one does not distinguish between one's own and another's.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया ग्रामसिंहाचिया ठायीं। जैसा मिळणी ठावो अठाबो नाहीं। तैसा स्त्रीविषयीं कांहीं। विचारीना॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā grāmasiṃhāciyā ṭhāyīṃ| jaisā miḻaṇī ṭhāvo aṭhābo nāhīṃ| taisā strīviṣayīṃ kāṃhīṃ| vicārīnā|| 81||
verses.meaning: Just as a village dog has no sense of what is edible or inedible, so too, such a person does not consider anything regarding women.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्माचा वेळु चुके । कां नित्य नैमित्तिक ठाके । तें जया न दुखे। जीवामाजीं ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: karmācā veḻu cuke | kāṃ nitya naimittika ṭhāke | teṃ jayā na dukhe| jīvāmājīṃ || 82||
verses.meaning: When the time for action passes, or daily and occasional duties cease, if this does not cause distress to one's soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पापी जो निसुगु। पुण्याविषयीं अति निलागु। जयाचिया मनीं वेगु। विकल्पाचा॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāpī jo nisugu| puṇyāviṣayīṃ ati nilāgu| jayāciyā manīṃ vegu| vikalpācā|| 83||
verses.meaning: The sinner, who is utterly devoid of good qualities, and extremely indifferent towards virtuous deeds, whose mind is constantly agitated by doubts and indecision.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो जाण निखिळा । अज्ञानाचा पुतळा । जो बांधोनि असे डोळां । वित्ताशेतें॥ ८४ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: to jāṇa nikhiḻā | ajñānācā putaḻā | jo bāṃdhoni ase ḍoḻāṃ | vittāśeteṃ|| 84 ||
verses.meaning: Know him to be a complete embodiment of ignorance, who has blindfolded himself with the desire for wealth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: । आणि स्वार्थे अळुमाळें। जो धैर्यापासोनि चळे। जैसें तृणबीज ढळे। मुंगियेचेनि॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: | āṇi svārthe aḻumāḻeṃ| jo dhairyāpāsoni caḻe| jaiseṃ tṛṇabīja ḍhaḻe| muṃgiyeceni|| 85||
verses.meaning: And when, for selfish reasons, one deviates even slightly from patience, it is like a tiny seed of grass being dislodged by an ant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पावो सूदलिया सवें॥ जैसें थिल्लर कालवे । तैसा भयाचेनि नांबें। गजबजे जो ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāvo sūdaliyā saveṃ|| jaiseṃ thillara kālave | taisā bhayāceni nāṃbeṃ| gajabaje jo || 86||
verses.meaning: Just as a small puddle becomes turbulent with the slightest disturbance, so too does he become agitated at the mere mention of fear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मनोरथांचिया धारसा । वाहणें जयाचिया मानसा । पूरीं पडिला जैसा । दुधिया पाहीं ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: manorathāṃciyā dhārasā | vāhaṇeṃ jayāciyā mānasā | pūrīṃ paḍilā jaisā | dudhiyā pāhīṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: Just as a river of milk flows into the ocean, so too do all desires flow into the mind of one who is truly devoted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वायूचेनि सावायें। धू दिगंतरा जाये । दुःखवार्ता होये । तैसें जया ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāyūceni sāvāyeṃ| dhū digaṃtarā jāye | duḥkhavārtā hoye | taiseṃ jayā || 88 ||
verses.meaning: Just as smoke, with the help of the wind, spreads to the ends of the directions, so too does the news of sorrow spread far and wide.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वाउधणाचिया परी । जो आश्रो कहींचि न धरी । क्षेत्री तीर्थी पुरीं। थारों नेणें ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāudhaṇāciyā parī | jo āśro kahīṃci na dharī | kṣetrī tīrthī purīṃ| thāroṃ neṇeṃ || 89||
verses.meaning: Like a cloud, he does not take shelter anywhere. He knows no dwelling place in fields, holy places, or cities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां मातलिया सरडा । पुढती बुडुख पुढती शेंडा । हिंडणवारा कोरडा । तैसा जया ॥ ६९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ mātaliyā saraḍā | puḍhatī buḍukha puḍhatī śeṃḍā | hiṃḍaṇavārā koraḍā | taisā jayā || 690||
verses.meaning: Or like a chameleon that is intoxicated, its head and tail moving back and forth, or like a dry whirlwind, so is the one who is deluded.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा रोविल्याविणें। रांजणु थारों नेणें। तैसा पडे तैं राहणें। एऱहवी हिंडे॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā rovilyāviṇeṃ| rāṃjaṇu thāroṃ neṇeṃ| taisā paḍe taiṃ rāhaṇeṃ| eṟahavī hiṃḍe|| 91||
verses.meaning: Just as a water pot cannot stand without being placed, so too, the mind only stays when it is settled; otherwise, it wanders.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाच्या ठायीं उदंड। अज्ञान असे वितंड। जो चांचल्यें भावंड । मर्कटाचें ॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ udaṃḍa| ajñāna ase vitaṃḍa| jo cāṃcalyeṃ bhāvaṃḍa | markaṭāceṃ ||92||
verses.meaning: Within him, there is an abundance of formidable ignorance, whose fickleness is akin to that of a monkey.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि पैं गा धनुर्धरा। जयाचिया अंतरा । नाहीं वबोढावारा। संयमाचा ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi paiṃ gā dhanurdharā| jayāciyā aṃtarā | nāhīṃ vaboḍhāvārā| saṃyamācā || 93||
verses.meaning: And indeed, O Arjuna, in whose heart there is no burden of self-control.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लेंडिये आला लोंढा। न मनी वाळुवेचा बरवंडा। तैसा निषेधाचिया तोंडा । बिहेना जो॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: leṃḍiye ālā loṃḍhā| na manī vāḻuvecā baravaṃḍā| taisā niṣedhāciyā toṃḍā | bihenā jo|| 94||
verses.meaning: Just as a strong current of water does not heed the sandbanks, so too, one who is not deterred by the words of prohibition (of the Vedas) is truly liberated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: व्रतातें आड मोडी । स्वधर्मु पायें बोलांडी । नियमाची आस तोडी । जयाची क्रिया॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: vratāteṃ āḍa moḍī | svadharmu pāyeṃ bolāṃḍī | niyamācī āsa toḍī | jayācī kriyā|| 95||
verses.meaning: Whose actions break vows, trample upon one's own dharma, and sever the hope of spiritual discipline.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाहीं पापाचा कंटाळा। नेणें पुण्याचा जिव्हाळा । लाजेचा पेंडबळा। खाणोनि घाली ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāhīṃ pāpācā kaṃṭāḻā| neṇeṃ puṇyācā jivhāḻā | lājecā peṃḍabaḻā| khāṇoni ghālī || 96||
verses.meaning: It feels no aversion to sin, nor does it know the affection for merit. It completely destroys the very foundation of shame.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुळेंसीं जो पाठमोरा । वेदाज्ञेसीं दुऱ्हा। कृत्याकृत्यव्यापारा । निवाडु नेणे ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuḻeṃsīṃ jo pāṭhamorā | vedājñesīṃ duṟhā| kṛtyākṛtyavyāpārā | nivāḍu neṇe || 97||
verses.meaning: One who turns their back on their lineage, disregards the commands of the Vedas, and does not discern between right and wrong actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वसू जैसा मोकाटु। वारा जैसा अफाटु। फुटला जैसा पाटु। निर्जनीं॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vasū jaisā mokāṭu| vārā jaisā aphāṭu| phuṭalā jaisā pāṭu| nirjanīṃ|| 98||
verses.meaning: Like a spring that bursts forth, like a powerful wind, like a dam that breaks in a desolate place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंधळें हातिरूं मातलें। कां डोंगरी जैसें पेटलें। तैसें विषयीं सुटलें। चित्त जयाचें ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃdhaḻeṃ hātirūṃ mātaleṃ| kāṃ ḍoṃgarī jaiseṃ peṭaleṃ| taiseṃ viṣayīṃ suṭaleṃ| citta jayāceṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: Like a blind elephant gone mad, or a mountain ablaze, so is the mind of one who is unrestrainedly attached to worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं उबधडां काय न पडे। मोकाटु 'कोणां नातुडे । ग्रामद्ारींचें आडें । नोळांडी कोण ॥ ७०० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ ubadhaḍāṃ kāya na paḍe| mokāṭu 'koṇāṃ nātuḍe | grāmadārīṃceṃ āḍeṃ | noḻāṃḍī koṇa || 700 ||
verses.meaning: What cannot be achieved by effort? What cannot be attained by liberation? Who does not cross the threshold of the village gate?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेसें सत्रीं अन्न जालें) कीं सामान्या बीक आलें। वाणसियेचें उभलें। कोण न रिगे॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeseṃ satrīṃ anna jāleṃ) kīṃ sāmānyā bīka āleṃ| vāṇasiyeceṃ ubhaleṃ| koṇa na rige|| 1||
verses.meaning: Just as food is prepared in a sattra (a place of alms-giving), or when a general call for alms is made, or when a feast is announced, who would not enter?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जयाचें अंतःकरण । तयाच्या ठायीं संपूर्ण । अज्ञानाची जाण । क्रब्द्ि आहे॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jayāceṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇa | tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ saṃpūrṇa | ajñānācī jāṇa | krabdi āhe|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as one's inner being is, so too is the complete ignorance within them, know this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि विषयांची गोडी। जो जीतु मेला न संडी। स्वगींही खावया जोडी । येथूनिची॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi viṣayāṃcī goḍī| jo jītu melā na saṃḍī| svagīṃhī khāvayā joḍī | yethūnicī|| 3||
verses.meaning: And the attachment to worldly pleasures, which one does not abandon even after death, accompanies them to heaven as well, from here itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो अखंड भोगा जचे। जया व्यसन ३०० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी काम्यक्रियेचें। मुख देखोनि विरक्‍्ताचें । सचैळ करी॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo akhaṃḍa bhogā jace| jayā vyasana 300 śrījñāneśvarī kāmyakriyeceṃ| mukha dekhoni virak‍tāceṃ | sacaiḻa karī|| 4||
verses.meaning: One who constantly experiences pleasure, who is addicted to performing actions with desire, upon seeing the face of a detached person, immediately becomes pure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विषो शिणोनि जाये। परि न शिणे सावधु नोहे। कुहीला हातीं खाये। कोढी जैसा ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: viṣo śiṇoni jāye| pari na śiṇe sāvadhu nohe| kuhīlā hātīṃ khāye| koḍhī jaisā || 5||
verses.meaning: Poison, though it may be consumed, does not lose its potency; it remains as dangerous as a leper who eats a diseased fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: खरी टेंकों नेदी उडे। लातौनि फोडी नाकाडे । तऱही जेवीं न काढे । माघौता खरु॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kharī ṭeṃkoṃ nedī uḍe| lātauni phoḍī nākāḍe | taṟahī jevīṃ na kāḍhe | māghautā kharu||6||
verses.meaning: Just as a donkey, even if it kicks and breaks its nose, does not turn back from its stubbornness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा जो विषयांलागीं। उडी घाळी जळतिये आगीं। व्यसनाची आंगीं । लेणीं मिरवी ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā jo viṣayāṃlāgīṃ| uḍī ghāḻī jaḻatiye āgīṃ| vyasanācī āṃgīṃ | leṇīṃ miravī || 7||
verses.meaning: Just as one who, for the sake of worldly pleasures, leaps into a burning fire, so too does one adorn themselves with the ornaments of addiction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: फुटोनि पडे तंव । मृग वाढवी हांव । परी न म्हणे ते माव। रोहिणीची॥ ८॥
