verses.shloka_iast: phuṭoni paḍe taṃva | mṛga vāḍhavī hāṃva | parī na mhaṇe te māva| rohiṇīcī|| 8||
verses.meaning: Even as the star Rohini sets, the deer, unaware of its disappearance, continues to long for rain, its desire growing stronger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा जन्मोनि मृत्यूवरी । विषयीं त्रासितां बहुतीं परी । तऱही त्रासु नेघे धरी । अधिक प्रेम ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā janmoni mṛtyūvarī | viṣayīṃ trāsitāṃ bahutīṃ parī | taṟahī trāsu neghe dharī | adhika prema || 9||
verses.meaning: Just as, from birth until death, despite being tormented by worldly desires in many ways, one does not give up, but rather holds onto them with even greater love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पहिलिये बाळदशे। आई बा हेंचि पिसें। तें सरे मग स्त्रीमांसें। भुलोनि ठाके ॥ ७१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pahiliye bāḻadaśe| āī bā heṃci piseṃ| teṃ sare maga strīmāṃseṃ| bhuloni ṭhāke || 710||
verses.meaning: In the first stage of childhood, the child is obsessed with 'mother' and 'father'. When that stage passes, he becomes infatuated with women.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग स्त्री भोगितां थांबो । वृद्धाप्य लागे येवो । तेव्हां तोचि प्रेमभावो । बाळकांसि आणी॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga strī bhogitāṃ thāṃbo | vṛddhāpya lāge yevo | tevhāṃ toci premabhāvo | bāḻakāṃsi āṇī|| 11||
verses.meaning: Then, when a man, having enjoyed his wife, grows old, that very love is transferred to his children.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंधळें व्यालें जैसें। तैसा बाळें परिवसे। परी जीवें मरे तों न त्रासे। विषयांसि जो॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃdhaḻeṃ vyāleṃ jaiseṃ| taisā bāḻeṃ parivase| parī jīveṃ mare toṃ na trāse| viṣayāṃsi jo|| 12||
verses.meaning: Just as a blind person gives birth, and the child is born, but the blind mother does not suffer until the child dies, similarly, a person does not suffer from worldly pleasures until their soul perishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जाण तयाच्या ठायीं। अज्ञानासि पारु नाहीं। आतां आणीक कांहीं। चिन्हें सांगो॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jāṇa tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ| ajñānāsi pāru nāhīṃ| ātāṃ āṇīka kāṃhīṃ| cinheṃ sāṃgo|| 13||
verses.meaning: In the one who knows, there is no limit to ignorance. Now, let me tell you some other signs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि देह हाचि आत्मा। ऐसेया जो मनोधर्मा । बळघोनियां कर्मा । आरंभु करी॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari deha hāci ātmā| aiseyā jo manodharmā | baḻaghoniyāṃ karmā | āraṃbhu karī|| 14||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one who, with such a mindset that this body itself is the soul, undertakes actions with great force and determination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि उणें कां पुरें। जें जें कांहीं आचरे। तयाचेनि आविष्करें। कुंथो लागे ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi uṇeṃ kāṃ pureṃ| jeṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ ācare| tayāceni āviṣkareṃ| kuṃtho lāge || 15||
verses.meaning: And whether it is less or more, whatever one practices, by its manifestation, one begins to feel its burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: डोईये ठेविलेनि भोजें। देवलविसें जेवीं फुंजे। तैसा विद्यावयसा माजे । उताणा चाळे॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ḍoīye ṭhevileni bhojeṃ| devalaviseṃ jevīṃ phuṃje| taisā vidyāvayasā māje | utāṇā cāḻe|| 16||
verses.meaning: Just as a temple, burdened by the weight of its dome, appears to swell, so too does a person, puffed up by knowledge and youth, behave arrogantly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे मीचि एकु आथी । माझ्याचि घरीं संपत्ती । माझी आचरती रीती । कोणा आहे॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe mīci eku āthī | mājhyāci gharīṃ saṃpattī | mājhī ācaratī rītī | koṇā āhe|| 17||
verses.meaning: He says, "I alone exist; wealth resides in my own home; who possesses a conduct like mine?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाहीं माझेनि पाडें वाडु। मी सर्वज्ञ एकचि रूढु। ऐसा गर्वतुष्टीगंडु। घेऊनि ठाके ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāhīṃ mājheni pāḍeṃ vāḍu| mī sarvajña ekaci rūḍhu| aisā garvatuṣṭīgaṃḍu| gheūni ṭhāke || 18||
verses.meaning: There is no one equal to me; I alone am the all-knowing. With such a swollen pride of self-satisfaction, he stands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: व्याधि ळागलिया माणुसा । नयेचि भोग दाऊं जैसा । निकें न साहे जो तैसा । पुढिलांचें ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vyādhi ḻāgaliyā māṇusā | nayeci bhoga dāūṃ jaisā | nikeṃ na sāhe jo taisā | puḍhilāṃceṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Just as a sick person cannot bear to see others enjoying food, similarly, one who is not well-disposed cannot tolerate the well-being of others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गुण तेतुला खाय । स्नेह कौं जाळितु जाय। जेथ ठेविजे तेथ होय । मसीऐसें ॥ ७२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ guṇa tetulā khāya | sneha kauṃ jāḻitu jāya| jetha ṭhevije tetha hoya | masīaiseṃ || 720||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp consumes its own oil, so too does the quality of sattva consume itself. Wherever it is placed, it becomes like ash.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जीवनें शिंपिळा तिडपिडी। विजिला प्राण सांडी। लागला तरी काडी। उरों नेदी॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jīvaneṃ śiṃpiḻā tiḍapiḍī| vijilā prāṇa sāṃḍī| lāgalā tarī kāḍī| uroṃ nedī|| 21||
verses.meaning: Life, like a drop of water, struggles and then departs, leaving no trace behind, just as a spark, once ignited, leaves no ember.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आळुमाळ प्रकाशु करी। तेतुलेनीचि उबारा धरी। तैसिया दीपाचि परी । सुविद्यु जो॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āḻumāḻa prakāśu karī| tetulenīci ubārā dharī| taisiyā dīpāci parī | suvidyu jo|| 22||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp, though small, emits light and warmth, so too does a wise person illuminate and uplift.

verses.shloka_devanagari: औषधाचेनि नांवें अमृतें। जैसा नवज्वरु आंबुथे। कां विषचि होऊनि परतें। सर्पा दूध ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: auṣadhāceni nāṃveṃ amṛteṃ| jaisā navajvaru āṃbuthe| kāṃ viṣaci hoūni parateṃ| sarpā dūdha || 23||
verses.meaning: Just as nectar, when called medicine, becomes a new fever, or milk, when given to a snake, turns into poison.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सदगुणीं मत्सरु । व्युत्पत्ती अहंकारु । तपोज्ञानें अपारु। ताठा चढे॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sadaguṇīṃ matsaru | vyutpattī ahaṃkāru | tapojñāneṃ apāru| tāṭhā caḍhe|| 24||
verses.meaning: Similarly, envy arises from good qualities, arrogance from learning, and boundless pride from penance and knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अंत्यु राणिवे बैसबिला । आरें धारणु गिळिला। तैसा गर्वे फुगला । देखसी जो॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aṃtyu rāṇive baisabilā | āreṃ dhāraṇu giḻilā| taisā garve phugalā | dekhasī jo|| 25||
verses.meaning: Just as a person, having been seated on the throne of a kingdom, becomes arrogant and swallows all humility, so too do you see him puffed up with pride.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो लाटणें ऐसा न लवे। पाथरु तेवीं न द्रवे। गुणियासि नागवे। फोडसें जैसें॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo lāṭaṇeṃ aisā na lave| pātharu tevīṃ na drave| guṇiyāsi nāgave| phoḍaseṃ jaiseṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: Just as a stone does not soften when rolled, and a wise person is not deceived by a false appearance, so too the true nature remains untouched.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना तयापाशीं। अज्ञान आहे वाढीसीं। हें निकरें गा तुजसीं । बोलत असों ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā tayāpāśīṃ| ajñāna āhe vāḍhīsīṃ| heṃ nikareṃ gā tujasīṃ | bolata asoṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Indeed, ignorance is ever-increasing in them; this, I tell you, is the absolute truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणीकही धनंजया । जो गृहदेह सामग्रिया । न देखे कालचेया। जन्मातें गा॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇīkahī dhanaṃjayā | jo gṛhadeha sāmagriyā | na dekhe kālaceyā| janmāteṃ gā|| 28||
verses.meaning: And furthermore, O Dhananjaya, one who does not perceive the household, the body, or the material possessions as belonging to yesterday's birth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कृतघ्ना उपकारु केला । कां चोरा व्यवबहारु दिधला । निसुगु स्तविला। विसरे जैसा॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṛtaghnā upakāru kelā | kāṃ corā vyavabahāru didhalā | nisugu stavilā| visare jaisā|| 29||
verses.meaning: Just as a thankless person forgets a favor done to them, or a thief forgets a business transaction, or a heartless person forgets praise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वबोढाळितां लाविलें।॥ तें तैसेंच कान पूंस बोलें। कों पुढती बोढाळूं आलें। सुणें जैसें ॥७३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vaboḍhāḻitāṃ lāvileṃ||| teṃ taiseṃca kāna pūṃsa boleṃ| koṃ puḍhatī boḍhāḻūṃ āleṃ| suṇeṃ jaiseṃ ||730||
verses.meaning: When one is shooed away, they should listen and understand. But like a dog that has been shooed away, it comes back again to be shooed away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बेडूक सापाचिया तोंडीं । जातसे सबुडबुडीं। तो मक्षिकांचिया कोडीं। स्मरेना कांहीं ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: beḍūka sāpāciyā toṃḍīṃ | jātase sabuḍabuḍīṃ| to makṣikāṃciyā koḍīṃ| smarenā kāṃhīṃ || 31||
verses.meaning: A frog, even as it is being swallowed whole by a snake, does not remember the swarm of flies it was just about to eat.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं नवही द्वारें स्त्रवती । आंगीं देहाची लुती जिती । जेणें जाली तें चित्तीं। सळेना जया॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ navahī dvāreṃ stravatī | āṃgīṃ dehācī lutī jitī | jeṇeṃ jālī teṃ cittīṃ| saḻenā jayā|| 32||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the nine gates of the body constantly discharge, and the body itself is afflicted by disease and decay. Yet, the mind does not dwell on the source from which it arose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मातेच्या उदरकुहरीं। 'पचूनि विष्ठेच्या दाथरीं। जठरीं नवमासवरीं। उकडला जो॥३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mātecyā udarakuharīṃ| 'pacūni viṣṭhecyā dātharīṃ| jaṭharīṃ navamāsavarīṃ| ukaḍalā jo||33||
verses.meaning: In the mother's womb, having been digested amidst the filth of excrement, boiled for nine months in the stomach.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते गर्भींची जे व्यथा। कां जें जालें उपजतां। तें कांहींचि सर्वथा। नाठवी जो॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: te garbhīṃcī je vyathā| kāṃ jeṃ jāleṃ upajatāṃ| teṃ kāṃhīṃci sarvathā| nāṭhavī jo|| 34||
verses.meaning: He remembers nothing of the suffering endured in the womb, nor of the pain experienced at birth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मलपूत्रपंकीं। जें लोळतें बाळ अंकीं। तें देखोनि जो न थुंकीं। त्रासु नेघे ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: malapūtrapaṃkīṃ| jeṃ loḻateṃ bāḻa aṃkīṃ| teṃ dekhoni jo na thuṃkīṃ| trāsu neghe || 35||
verses.meaning: A child, rolling in mud, feces, and urine, is seen by its mother, who does not recoil in disgust or feel troubled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कालचि ना जन्म गेलें। पाहेच पुढती आलें। ऐसें हें कांहीं वाटलें। नाहीं जया॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kālaci nā janma geleṃ| pāheca puḍhatī āleṃ| aiseṃ heṃ kāṃhīṃ vāṭaleṃ| nāhīṃ jayā|| 36||
verses.meaning: For whom there is no sense of having been born yesterday, nor of coming into being again tomorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि पैं तयाची परी। जीविताचि फरारी । देखोनि जो न करी। मृत्युचिंता ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi paiṃ tayācī parī| jīvitāci pharārī | dekhoni jo na karī| mṛtyuciṃtā || 37||
verses.meaning: And indeed, seeing the fleeting nature of life, one who does not worry about death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिणेयाचेनि विश्‍वासें । मृत्यु एक एथ असे। हें जयाचेनि मानसें। मानिजेना॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiṇeyāceni viś‍vāseṃ | mṛtyu eka etha ase| heṃ jayāceni mānaseṃ| mānijenā|| 38||
verses.meaning: One who, with unwavering faith, does not even conceive in their mind that death exists.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अल्पोदकींचा मासा । हें नाटे ऐसिया आशा। न वचेचि कां जैसा। अगाध डोहां॥३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: alpodakīṃcā māsā | heṃ nāṭe aisiyā āśā| na vaceci kāṃ jaisā| agādha ḍohāṃ||39||
verses.meaning: Just as a fish in shallow water, hoping for more, never goes to the unfathomable depths.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां गोरीचिया भुली। मृग व्याधा दृष्टि न घाळी। गळु न पाहतां गिळिली। उंडी मीनें ॥७४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ gorīciyā bhulī| mṛga vyādhā dṛṣṭi na ghāḻī| gaḻu na pāhatāṃ giḻilī| uṃḍī mīneṃ ||740||
verses.meaning: Just as a deer, enchanted by the beauty of the doe, does not notice the hunter, or a fish, without looking, swallows the bait.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दीपाचिया झगमगा। जाळील हें पतंगा। नेणवेचि पैं गा । जयापरी ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: dīpāciyā jhagamagā| jāḻīla heṃ pataṃgā| neṇaveci paiṃ gā | jayāparī || 41||
verses.meaning: Just as a moth, drawn by the dazzling light of a lamp, unknowingly perishes in its flame.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गव्हारु निद्रासुखें। घर जळत असे तें न देखे । नेणतां जेवीं विखें। रांधिळें अन्न ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: gavhāru nidrāsukheṃ| ghara jaḻata ase teṃ na dekhe | neṇatāṃ jevīṃ vikheṃ| rāṃdhiḻeṃ anna || 42||
verses.meaning: Just as a person deep in the comfort of sleep does not see their house burning, or unknowingly eats poisoned food, so too is the ignorant soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा जीविताचेनि मिषें। हा मृत्यूचि आला असे । हें नेणेचि राजसें। सुखें जो गा॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā jīvitāceni miṣeṃ| hā mṛtyūci ālā ase | heṃ neṇeci rājaseṃ| sukheṃ jo gā|| 43||
verses.meaning: Thus, under the guise of life, death itself has arrived. This truth is not known by those who are engrossed in worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शरीरींची वाढी । अहोरात्रांची जोडी । विषयसुखप्रौढी । साचचि मानी॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: śarīrīṃcī vāḍhī | ahorātrāṃcī joḍī | viṣayasukhaprauḍhī | sācaci mānī|| 44||
verses.meaning: The growth of the body, the passing of days and nights, and the indulgence in worldly pleasures—these are truly considered real.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी बापुडा ऐसें नेणें । जें वेश्येचें सर्वस्व देणें। तेंचि तें नागवणें। रूप एथ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī bāpuḍā aiseṃ neṇeṃ | jeṃ veśyeceṃ sarvasva deṇeṃ| teṃci teṃ nāgavaṇeṃ| rūpa etha|| 45||
verses.meaning: But the poor, ignorant soul does not know that what appears as the complete giving of a courtesan is, in reality, a form of being plundered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संवचोराचें साजणें। तेंचि तें प्राण घेणें। ळेपा स्नपन करणें। तोचि नाशु॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃvacorāceṃ sājaṇeṃ| teṃci teṃ prāṇa gheṇeṃ| ḻepā snapana karaṇeṃ| toci nāśu|| 46||
verses.meaning: Befriending a thief is like taking one's own life. Anointing a leper is like inviting destruction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पांडुरोगें आंग सुटळें। तें तयाचि नांवें खुंटलें। तैसें नेणें भुललें। आहारनिद्रा ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṃḍurogeṃ āṃga suṭaḻeṃ| teṃ tayāci nāṃveṃ khuṃṭaleṃ| taiseṃ neṇeṃ bhulaleṃ| āhāranidrā || 47||
verses.meaning: Just as a body afflicted with jaundice loses its vitality, so too does one deluded by ignorance lose their awareness of proper eating and sleeping.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सन्मुख शूला । धांबतया पायें चपळा । प्रतिपदीं ये जवळा । मृत्यु जेवीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sanmukha śūlā | dhāṃbatayā pāyeṃ capaḻā | pratipadīṃ ye javaḻā | mṛtyu jevīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: With a spear facing him, his feet tremble and falter, as death approaches him at every step.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं देहा जंब जंब वाढु। जंव जंब दिवसांचा पवाडु। जंब जंब सुरवाडु । ३०२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी भोगांचा या॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ dehā jaṃba jaṃba vāḍhu| jaṃva jaṃba divasāṃcā pavāḍu| jaṃba jaṃba suravāḍu | 302 śrījñāneśvarī bhogāṃcā yā|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as the body grows day by day, so too do the days of enjoyment and pleasure increase.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब तंव अधिकाधिकें । मरण आयुष्यातें जिके। मीठ जेबीं उदकें। घांसिजत असे॥ ७५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba taṃva adhikādhikeṃ | maraṇa āyuṣyāteṃ jike| mīṭha jebīṃ udakeṃ| ghāṃsijata ase|| 750||
verses.meaning: The more it is, the more death conquers life, just as salt is dissolved by water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जीवित्व जाये। तयास्तब काळु पाहे। हें हातोहातींचें न होये। ठाउकें जया॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jīvitva jāye| tayāstaba kāḻu pāhe| heṃ hātohātīṃceṃ na hoye| ṭhāukeṃ jayā|| 51||
verses.meaning: Just as life departs, so too does time await. This is not something that happens immediately, but rather something that is known to those who understand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना पांडवा । हा आंगींचा मृत्यु नित्य नवा। न देखे जो मावा। विषयांचिया॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā pāṃḍavā | hā āṃgīṃcā mṛtyu nitya navā| na dekhe jo māvā| viṣayāṃciyā||52||
verses.meaning: Indeed, Pandava, this death of the body is ever new, yet one who is engrossed in worldly pleasures does not perceive it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अज्ञानदेशींचा रावो। या बोला महाबाहो । न पडे गा ठावो। आणिकांचा ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to ajñānadeśīṃcā rāvo| yā bolā mahābāho | na paḍe gā ṭhāvo| āṇikāṃcā || 53||
verses.meaning: He is the king of the realm of ignorance; in this matter, O mighty-armed one, no one else has any place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जीविताचेनि तोखें। जैसा कां मृत्यु न देखे। तैसाचि तारुण्यें पोखें। जरा न गणी ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jīvitāceni tokheṃ| jaisā kāṃ mṛtyu na dekhe| taisāci tāruṇyeṃ pokheṃ| jarā na gaṇī || 54||
verses.meaning: Just as a person, engrossed in the joy of life, does not perceive death, similarly, one nourished by youth does not consider old age.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कडाडीं लोटला गाडा। कां शिखरौनि सुटला धोंडा । तैसा न देखे जो पुढां। वार्धक्य आहे ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaḍāḍīṃ loṭalā gāḍā| kāṃ śikharauni suṭalā dhoṃḍā | taisā na dekhe jo puḍhāṃ| vārdhakya āhe || 55||
verses.meaning: Just as a cart rolls down a steep slope, or a stone breaks loose from a peak, so too does old age approach, unseen by those who do not look ahead.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां आडवोहळा पाणी आलें। कां जैसें म्हेसयाचें झुंज मातलें। तैसें तारुण्याचे चढलें। भुररें जया ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ āḍavohaḻā pāṇī āleṃ| kāṃ jaiseṃ mhesayāceṃ jhuṃja mātaleṃ| taiseṃ tāruṇyāce caḍhaleṃ| bhurareṃ jayā || 56||
verses.meaning: Or like a sudden flood of water, or like the fierce fight of buffaloes, so does the intoxication of youth rise in one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुष्टि लागे विघरों। कांति पाहे निसरों। मस्तक आदरीं शिरो-। भागीं कंप ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: puṣṭi lāge vigharoṃ| kāṃti pāhe nisaroṃ| mastaka ādarīṃ śiro-| bhāgīṃ kaṃpa || 57||
verses.meaning: The body's strength begins to wane, its radiance fades, and the head, once held high, now trembles.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दाढी साउळ धरी। मान हालौनि वारी। तरी जो करी । मायेचा पैसु॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: dāḍhī sāuḻa dharī| māna hālauni vārī| tarī jo karī | māyecā paisu|| 58||
verses.meaning: Even if one holds a beard, shakes their head in denial, and tries to ward off illusion, if they still engage in worldly affairs, they are caught in the illusion of Maya.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढील उरीं आदळे। तंब न देखे जेवीं आंधळें। कां डोळ्यावरलें निगळें । आळशी तोषें ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhīla urīṃ ādaḻe| taṃba na dekhe jevīṃ āṃdhaḻeṃ| kāṃ ḍoḻyāvaraleṃ nigaḻeṃ | āḻaśī toṣeṃ ||59||
verses.meaning: Just as a blind person cannot see what is right in front of them, or a lazy person is content with what is right before their eyes, so too is the spiritual truth often missed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तारुण्य आजिचें। भोगितां वृद्धाप्य पाहेचें। न देखे तोचि साचें । अज्ञानु गा॥ ७६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ tāruṇya ājiceṃ| bhogitāṃ vṛddhāpya pāheceṃ| na dekhe toci sāceṃ | ajñānu gā|| 760||
verses.meaning: One who, while enjoying the youth of today, does not foresee the old age that is surely to come, is truly ignorant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखें अक्षमें कुब्जें। कीं बिटावूं लागे फुंजें॥ परि न म्हणे पाहे माझें। ऐसेंचि भवे॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekheṃ akṣameṃ kubjeṃ| kīṃ biṭāvūṃ lāge phuṃjeṃ|| pari na mhaṇe pāhe mājheṃ| aiseṃci bhave||61||
verses.meaning: Even if one is imperfect or deformed, or if one's body is afflicted with boils, the Lord does not say, "Look at My form." He accepts all as they are.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आंगीं वृद्धाप्यतेची । संज्ञा ये मरणाची । परि जया तारुण्याची । भुली न फिटे॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi āṃgīṃ vṛddhāpyatecī | saṃjñā ye maraṇācī | pari jayā tāruṇyācī | bhulī na phiṭe|| 62||
verses.meaning: And even when the signs of old age, which are the harbingers of death, appear in the body, yet the delusion of youth does not fade away for some.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अज्ञानाचें घर। हें साचचि घे उत्तर । तेवींचि परियेसीं थोर। चिन्हें आणिक ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to ajñānāceṃ ghara| heṃ sācaci ghe uttara | tevīṃci pariyesīṃ thora| cinheṃ āṇika || 63||
verses.meaning: That is indeed the abode of ignorance; truly accept this answer. Similarly, listen to other significant signs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि वाघाचिये अडवे। एक वेळ आला चरोनि देवें। तेणें वबिश्वासें पुढती धांवे। वसू जैसा ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari vāghāciye aḍave| eka veḻa ālā caroni deveṃ| teṇeṃ vabiśvāseṃ puḍhatī dhāṃve| vasū jaisā || 64||
verses.meaning: Just as a calf, having once grazed in a tiger's lair and returned safely by divine grace, confidently returns there again, so too should one approach the divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां सर्पघराआंतु। अवचटें ठेवा आणिला स्वस्थु। येतुलियासाठीं निश्‍चितु। नास्तिक होय ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ sarpagharāāṃtu| avacaṭeṃ ṭhevā āṇilā svasthu| yetuliyāsāṭhīṃ niś‍citu| nāstika hoya || 65||
verses.meaning: Or, if a treasure is unexpectedly found within a snake's abode, would one, for this reason alone, become an atheist?

verses.shloka_devanagari: बैरिया नीद आली । आतां दृंद्रें माझीं सरली । हें मानी तो सपिली । मुकला जेबीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: bairiyā nīda ālī | ātāṃ dṛṃdreṃ mājhīṃ saralī | heṃ mānī to sapilī | mukalā jebīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: When sleep, the enemy, arrives, all my dualities cease. He who believes this is truly lost, like one whose pocket is picked.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी आहारनिद्रेची उजरी। रोग निवांतु जोंबरी। तंव जो न करी। व्याधीचिंता॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī āhāranidrecī ujarī| roga nivāṃtu joṃbarī| taṃva jo na karī| vyādhīciṃtā|| 68||
verses.meaning: Just as one does not worry about illness as long as one is healthy and eats and sleeps well.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि स्त्रीपुत्रादिमेळें। संपत्ति जंव जंव फळे । तेणें रजें डोळे। जाती जयाचे॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi strīputrādimeḻeṃ| saṃpatti jaṃva jaṃva phaḻe | teṇeṃ rajeṃ ḍoḻe| jātī jayāce|| 69||
verses.meaning: And as long as the wealth of wife, son, and so on, bears fruit, the dust of that attachment blinds the eyes of a person.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सवेंचि बियोगु पडेल) विळौनि विपत्ति येईल। हें दुःख पुढील । देखेना जो॥ ७७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: saveṃci biyogu paḍela) viḻauni vipatti yeīla| heṃ duḥkha puḍhīla | dekhenā jo|| 770||
verses.meaning: He who does not foresee the future sorrow, that separation will immediately occur, and calamity will befall.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अज्ञान गा पांडवा । आणि तोहि तोचि जाणावा । जो इंद्रियें अव्हासबा। चारी एथ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: to ajñāna gā pāṃḍavā | āṇi tohi toci jāṇāvā | jo iṃdriyeṃ avhāsabā| cārī etha|| 71||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, that ignorance, know it to be the same as that which, through the senses, grasps all four (objects of perception).

verses.shloka_devanagari: वयसेचेनि उवायें । संपत्तीचेनि सावायें। सेव्यासेव्य जाये। सरकटितु॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: vayaseceni uvāyeṃ | saṃpattīceni sāvāyeṃ| sevyāsevya jāye| sarakaṭitu|| 72||
verses.meaning: With the rise of youth and the aid of wealth, the distinction between what is to be served and what is not, becomes blurred.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न करावें तें करी। असंभाव्य मनीं धरी। चिंतूं नये तें विचारी । जयाची मती ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: na karāveṃ teṃ karī| asaṃbhāvya manīṃ dharī| ciṃtūṃ naye teṃ vicārī | jayācī matī || 73||
verses.meaning: One whose intellect engages in what should not be done, holds impossible thoughts in mind, and contemplates what should not be contemplated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रिघे जेथ न रिघावें। मागे जें न घ्यावें । स्पर्शे जेथ न लागावें । आंग मन॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: righe jetha na righāveṃ| māge jeṃ na ghyāveṃ | sparśe jetha na lāgāveṃ | āṃga mana|| 74||
verses.meaning: It enters where it should not enter, it asks for what it should not take, it touches where it should not touch, with its body and mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न जावें तेथ जाये। न पाहावें तें जो पाहे। न खावें तें खाये । तेवींचि तोषें ॥७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: na jāveṃ tetha jāye| na pāhāveṃ teṃ jo pāhe| na khāveṃ teṃ khāye | tevīṃci toṣeṃ ||75||
verses.meaning: He goes where he should not go, sees what he should not see, and eats what he should not eat; thus he is satisfied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न धरावा तो संगु। न लागावें तेथ लागु । नाचरावा तो मार्ग। आचरे जो॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: na dharāvā to saṃgu| na lāgāveṃ tetha lāgu | nācarāvā to mārga| ācare jo|| 76||
verses.meaning: One should not associate with that, nor get involved in it. One should not follow that path, which is followed by others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नायकावें तें आइके। न बोलावें तें बके। परि दोष होतील हें न देखे । प्रवर्ततां ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāyakāveṃ teṃ āike| na bolāveṃ teṃ bake| pari doṣa hotīla heṃ na dekhe | pravartatāṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: One hears what should not be heard, and speaks what should not be spoken. Yet, one does not perceive the faults that arise from such actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंगा मनासि रुचावें। येतुलेनि कृत्याकृत्य नाठवें। जो करणेयाचेनि नांवें । भलतेंचि करी ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃgā manāsi rucāveṃ| yetuleni kṛtyākṛtya nāṭhaveṃ| jo karaṇeyāceni nāṃveṃ | bhalateṃci karī || 78 ||
verses.meaning: When the mind is pleased, it forgets what is right and wrong. In the name of doing something, it does whatever it pleases.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि पाप मज होईल। कां नरकयातना येईल हें कांहींचि पुढीळ। देखेना जो॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari pāpa maja hoīla| kāṃ narakayātanā yeīla heṃ kāṃhīṃci puḍhīḻa| dekhenā jo|| 79||
verses.meaning: Such a person does not foresee any future consequences, neither the sin that might accrue to him nor the torments of hell that might befall him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचेनि आंगलगें। अज्ञान जगीं दाटुगें। जें सज्ञानाहि संगें । झोंबों सके ॥ ७८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāceni āṃgalageṃ| ajñāna jagīṃ dāṭugeṃ| jeṃ sajñānāhi saṃgeṃ | jhoṃboṃ sake || 780||
verses.meaning: By its very nature, ignorance is so powerful in the world that it can even entangle the enlightened.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी असो हें आइक । अज्ञानचिन्हें आणिक । जेणें तुज सम्यक्‌ । जाणवे तें॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī aso heṃ āika | ajñānacinheṃ āṇika | jeṇeṃ tuja samyak‌ | jāṇave teṃ|| 89||
verses.meaning: But listen to this. There are other signs of ignorance, by which you will understand it perfectly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जयाची प्रीति पुरी । गुंतली देखसी घरीं । नवगंधकेसरीं । भ्रमरी जैशी ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jayācī prīti purī | guṃtalī dekhasī gharīṃ | navagaṃdhakesarīṃ | bhramarī jaiśī || 82||
verses.meaning: You see how one's love is completely entangled in worldly affairs, just as a bee is engrossed in the fresh fragrance of a flower.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साकरेचिया राशीं। बैसली नुठे माशी । तैसेनि स्त्रीचित्त आवेशीं। जयाचें मन॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sākareciyā rāśīṃ| baisalī nuṭhe māśī | taiseni strīcitta āveśīṃ| jayāceṃ mana|| 83||
verses.meaning: Just as a fly, once settled on a heap of sugar, never wishes to leave, so too is the mind of one whose consciousness is absorbed in the divine feminine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ठेला बेडूक कुंडीं। मशक गुंतला शेंबुडीं। जैसा ढोरु सबुडबुडीं। रुतला पंकीं ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ṭhelā beḍūka kuṃḍīṃ| maśaka guṃtalā śeṃbuḍīṃ| jaisā ḍhoru sabuḍabuḍīṃ| rutalā paṃkīṃ || 84||
verses.meaning: A frog stuck in a well, a mosquito caught in mucus, or a beast mired in mud, all are trapped in their own ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें घरींहूनि निघणें॥ नाहीं जीवें मनें प्राणें। जया साप होऊनि असणें । भाटीं तियें ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ gharīṃhūni nighaṇeṃ|| nāhīṃ jīveṃ maneṃ prāṇeṃ| jayā sāpa hoūni asaṇeṃ | bhāṭīṃ tiyeṃ || 85 ||
verses.meaning: Similarly, there is no departure from home with one's life, mind, or breath for those who are like a snake residing in a hole.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रियोत्तमाचिया कंठीं । प्रमदा घे आटी । तैशी जीवेंसी कोंपटी। धरूनि ठाके ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: priyottamāciyā kaṃṭhīṃ | pramadā ghe āṭī | taiśī jīveṃsī koṃpaṭī| dharūni ṭhāke || 86||
verses.meaning: Just as a beloved woman embraces her dearest, so too does the individual soul cling to the divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मधुरसोहेशें । मधुकर जचे जैसें । गृहसंगोपन तैसें । करी जो गा॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: madhurasoheśeṃ | madhukara jace jaiseṃ | gṛhasaṃgopana taiseṃ | karī jo gā|| 87||
verses.meaning: Just as a bee diligently gathers honey, so too does one who nurtures their home with care.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हातारपणीं जाळें। मा आणिक एक विपायिलें। तयाचें कां जेतुलें। मातापितरां ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhātārapaṇīṃ jāḻeṃ| mā āṇika eka vipāyileṃ| tayāceṃ kāṃ jetuleṃ| mātāpitarāṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: In old age, the parents are ensnared in a net of worries, and then another calamity befalls them. How much more suffering do they endure for their child!

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेतुलेनि पाडें पार्था। घरीं जया प्रेमआस्था। आणि स्त्रीवांचूनि सर्वथा । जाणेना जो॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetuleni pāḍeṃ pārthā| gharīṃ jayā premaāsthā| āṇi strīvāṃcūni sarvathā | jāṇenā jo|| 89||
verses.meaning: O Partha, one who holds such love and devotion, and who knows nothing else but his wife, is truly blessed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: महापुरुषाचें चित्त । जालिया वस्तुगत। ठाके व्यवहारजात। जयापरी ॥ ७९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mahāpuruṣāceṃ citta | jāliyā vastugata| ṭhāke vyavahārajāta| jayāparī || 790||
verses.meaning: Just as the mind of a great soul, having realized the ultimate reality, transcends all worldly activities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा स्त्रीदेहीं जो जीवें । 'पडोनियां सर्वभावे । कोण मी काय करावें। कांहीं नेणें ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā strīdehīṃ jo jīveṃ | 'paḍoniyāṃ sarvabhāve | koṇa mī kāya karāveṃ| kāṃhīṃ neṇeṃ || 91||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the soul embodied in a woman, having completely surrendered, thinks, "Who am I? What should I do? I know nothing."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हानि लाज न देखे। परापवादु नाइके । जयाचीं इंद्रियें एकमुखें। स्त्रिया केलीं ॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāni lāja na dekhe| parāpavādu nāike | jayācīṃ iṃdriyeṃ ekamukheṃ| striyā kelīṃ ||92||
verses.meaning: One who does not see loss or shame, does not hear slander, and whose senses are singularly focused on women.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चित्त आराधी स्त्रियेचें। आणि तियेचेनि छंदें नाचे। माकड गारुडियाचें। जैसें होय ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: citta ārādhī striyeceṃ| āṇi tiyeceni chaṃdeṃ nāce| mākaḍa gāruḍiyāceṃ| jaiseṃ hoya || 93||
verses.meaning: The mind worships the woman, and dances to her tune, just like a monkey does for its charmer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपणपेंही शिणवी। इष्टमित्र दुखवी। मग कवडाचि वाढवी । लोभी जैसा॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpaṇapeṃhī śiṇavī| iṣṭamitra dukhavī| maga kavaḍāci vāḍhavī | lobhī jaisā|| 94||
verses.meaning: Just as a greedy person, in his pursuit of wealth, exhausts himself and causes distress to his dear friends and relatives, only to accumulate more, so too does the worldly person.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा दानपुण्यें खांची। गोत्रकुटुंबा वंची। ३०४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी परी गारी भरी स्त्रियेची । उणी हों नेदी ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā dānapuṇyeṃ khāṃcī| gotrakuṭuṃbā vaṃcī| 304 śrījñāneśvarī parī gārī bharī striyecī | uṇī hoṃ nedī || 95||
verses.meaning: Similarly, one who accumulates merit through charity and good deeds, and who protects their family and lineage, never allows their wife to feel any lack or deficiency.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पूजितीं दैवतें जोगावी । गुरुतें बोलें झकवी। मायबापां दाबी । निदारपण॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pūjitīṃ daivateṃ jogāvī | guruteṃ boleṃ jhakavī| māyabāpāṃ dābī | nidārapaṇa|| 96||
verses.meaning: They worship deities, serve them diligently, but deceive their Guru with words, and show harshness to their parents.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्त्रियेच्या तरी विखीं । भोगसंपत्ती अनेकीं । आणी वस्तु निकी। जे जे देखे॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: striyecyā tarī vikhīṃ | bhogasaṃpattī anekīṃ | āṇī vastu nikī| je je dekhe|| 97||
verses.meaning: In the case of a woman, she sees many objects of enjoyment and excellent things.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रेमाथिलेनि भक्ते । जैसेनि भजिजे कुळदैवतें । तैसा एकाग्रचित्तें। स्त्री जो उपासी ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: premāthileni bhakte | jaiseni bhajije kuḻadaivateṃ | taisā ekāgracitteṃ| strī jo upāsī || 98||
verses.meaning: Just as a family deity is worshipped with loving devotion, so too does a woman serve her husband with a focused mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साच आणि चोख तें स्त्रियेसीचि अशेख । येरांविषयीं जोगावणूक । तेहीं नाहीं ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāca āṇi cokha teṃ striyesīci aśekha | yerāṃviṣayīṃ jogāvaṇūka | tehīṃ nāhīṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: Truth and purity are found only in the feminine principle; in all other things, such preservation does not exist.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयेतें हन कोणी देखैळ। इयेसी वेखासें जाईल। तरी युगचि बुडेळ। ऐसें जया॥ ८००॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeteṃ hana koṇī dekhaiḻa| iyesī vekhāseṃ jāīla| tarī yugaci buḍeḻa| aiseṃ jayā|| 800||
verses.meaning: If anyone were to see this, or go to see this, then the age itself would be submerged, so it is for them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नायट्यांभेण। न मोडिजे नागांची आण। तैसी 'पाळी उणखुण। स्त्रियेची जो॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāyaṭyāṃbheṇa| na moḍije nāgāṃcī āṇa| taisī 'pāḻī uṇakhuṇa| striyecī jo|| 1||
verses.meaning: Just as one does not break the oath of serpents, so too should one not break the trust of a woman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना धनंजया। स्त्रीचि सर्वस्व जया । आणि तियेचिया जालियां-। लागीं प्रेम ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā dhanaṃjayā| strīci sarvasva jayā | āṇi tiyeciyā jāliyāṃ-| lāgīṃ prema || 2||
verses.meaning: Indeed, Dhananjaya, for one whose everything is a woman, and who loves her deeply.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिकही जें समस्त । तियेचें संपत्तिजात। तें जीवाहूनि आप्त। मानी जो कां॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇikahī jeṃ samasta | tiyeceṃ saṃpattijāta| teṃ jīvāhūni āpta| mānī jo kāṃ|| 3||
verses.meaning: And all other possessions, he considers them dearer than his own life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अज्ञानासी मूळ। अज्ञाना त्याचेनि बळ। हें असो केवळ। तेंचि रूप॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to ajñānāsī mūḻa| ajñānā tyāceni baḻa| heṃ aso kevaḻa| teṃci rūpa||4||
verses.meaning: That (ignorance) is the root of ignorance. Ignorance gains strength from it. Let this be, that (ignorance) is merely its form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मातलिया सागरीं । मोकललिया तरी । लाटांच्या येरझारीं । आंदोळे जेवीं ॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mātaliyā sāgarīṃ | mokalaliyā tarī | lāṭāṃcyā yerajhārīṃ | āṃdoḻe jevīṃ ||5||
verses.meaning: And just as a boat, when released into the turbulent ocean, is tossed about by the coming and going of the waves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं प्रिय वस्तु पावे। आणि सुखें जो उंचावे । तैसाचि अप्रियासबें । तळवट घे॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ priya vastu pāve| āṇi sukheṃ jo uṃcāve | taisāci apriyāsabeṃ | taḻavaṭa ghe|| 6||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when a beloved object is attained, one is uplifted with joy; and when an unpleasant one is encountered, one is cast down.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि जयाचे चित्तीं । वैषम्यसाम्याची बोखती । वाहे तो महामती । अज्ञान गा॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni jayāce cittīṃ | vaiṣamyasāmyācī bokhatī | vāhe to mahāmatī | ajñāna gā||7||
verses.meaning: Thus, in whose mind the distinction of inequality and equality is carried, that great intellect is indeed ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि माझ्या ठायीं भक्‍ती। फळालागीं जया आरती । धनोहदेशें विरक्ती । नटणें जेवीं ॥ ८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ bhak‍tī| phaḻālāgīṃ jayā āratī | dhanohadeśeṃ viraktī | naṭaṇeṃ jevīṃ || 8 ||
verses.meaning: And devotion to Me, which is for the sake of fruit, is like a pretense of detachment for the sake of wealth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी कांताच्या मानसीं । रिगोनि स्वैरिणी जैसी । राहाटे जारेंसीं। जावयालागीं ॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī kāṃtācyā mānasīṃ | rigoni svairiṇī jaisī | rāhāṭe jāreṃsīṃ| jāvayālāgīṃ ||9||
verses.meaning: Or, like a wanton woman who enters her husband's mind, yet behaves with her paramour, for the sake of going to him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मातें किरीटी। भजती गा पाउटी। करूनि जो दिठी। विषोसूये॥ ८१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā māteṃ kirīṭī| bhajatī gā pāuṭī| karūni jo diṭhī| viṣosūye|| 810||
verses.meaning: Just as, O Kiriti, those who worship Me with a vision free from envy and attachment, they attain Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि भजिन्नलियासवें। तो विषो जरी न पावे। तरी सांडी म्हणे आघवें। टवाळ हें॥११॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi bhajinnaliyāsaveṃ| to viṣo jarī na pāve| tarī sāṃḍī mhaṇe āghaveṃ| ṭavāḻa heṃ||11||
verses.meaning: And if, after devotion, one does not attain that object, then one declares everything to be worthless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुणबट कुळवाडी। तैसा आन आन देव मांडी। आदिलाची परवडी । करी तया॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuṇabaṭa kuḻavāḍī| taisā āna āna deva māṃḍī| ādilācī paravaḍī | karī tayā|| 12||
verses.meaning: Just as a farmer cultivates his land, so too does one worship various deities, following the tradition of their ancestors.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया गुरुमार्गा टेंके । जयाचा सुगरवा देखे । तरी तयाचा मंत्र शिके। येरु नेघे॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā gurumārgā ṭeṃke | jayācā sugaravā dekhe | tarī tayācā maṃtra śike| yeru neghe|| 13||
verses.meaning: If one sees the excellence of that guru's path, then one learns his mantra; otherwise, one does not accept it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्राणिजातेंसीं निष्ठुरु । स्थाबरीं बहु भरु । तेवींचि नाहीं एकसरु । निर्वाहो जया ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: prāṇijāteṃsīṃ niṣṭhuru | sthābarīṃ bahu bharu | tevīṃci nāhīṃ ekasaru | nirvāho jayā || 94||
verses.meaning: The one who is harsh towards living beings, and who has a great burden of inertness, and whose sustenance is not uniform (or consistent) in the same way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझी मूर्ति निफजवी। ते घराचे कोनीं बैसवबी। आपण देवो देवी। यात्रे जाय॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhī mūrti niphajavī| te gharāce konīṃ baisavabī| āpaṇa devo devī| yātre jāya|| 15||
verses.meaning: He who creates my image, seats it in a corner of the house, and then, as if it were a deity, goes on a pilgrimage to it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नित्य आराधन माझें॥ काजीं कुळदैवता भजे । पर्वविशेषें कीजे। पूजा आना॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nitya ārādhana mājheṃ|| kājīṃ kuḻadaivatā bhaje | parvaviśeṣeṃ kīje| pūjā ānā|| 16||
verses.meaning: My constant worship is like worshipping a family deity, or performing special rituals on festive occasions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझें अधिष्ठान घरीं। आणि वोवसे आनाचे करी। पितृकार्यावसरीं। पितरांचा होय ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheṃ adhiṣṭhāna gharīṃ| āṇi vovase ānāce karī| pitṛkāryāvasarīṃ| pitarāṃcā hoya || 17||
verses.meaning: My abode is in the home, and I perform the rites for others. At the time of ancestral rites, I become the ancestors themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकादशीच्या दिवशीं। जेतुला पाडु आम्हांसी । तेतुलाचि नागांसी। पंचमीच्या दिवशीं ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekādaśīcyā divaśīṃ| jetulā pāḍu āmhāṃsī | tetulāci nāgāṃsī| paṃcamīcyā divaśīṃ || 18||
verses.meaning: The same importance we give to Ekadashi, the Nagas give to Panchami.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चौथ मोटकी पाहे। आणि गणेशाचाचि होये । चावदसी म्हणे माये । तुझाचि वो दुर्गे॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: cautha moṭakī pāhe| āṇi gaṇeśācāci hoye | cāvadasī mhaṇe māye | tujhāci vo durge|| 19||
verses.meaning: The fourth part is seen, and it belongs to Ganesha. The fourteenth day says, "Mother, I am yours, O Durga!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: नित्यनैमित्तिकें कर्मे सांडी । मग बैसे नवचंडी । आदित्यवारीं वाढी । बहिरवां पात्रीं॥ ८२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: nityanaimittikeṃ karme sāṃḍī | maga baise navacaṃḍī | ādityavārīṃ vāḍhī | bahiravāṃ pātrīṃ|| 820||
verses.meaning: Abandon all regular and occasional rituals. Then, on Sundays, sit and offer food to the Navachandi and Bahirav deities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं सोमवार पावे। आणि बेलेंसी लिंगा धांवे। ऐसा एकलाचि आघवे । जोगावी जो॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ somavāra pāve| āṇi beleṃsī liṃgā dhāṃve| aisā ekalāci āghave | jogāvī jo|| 21||
verses.meaning: Just as Monday arrives, and the bel leaf rushes to the lingam, so too does the one who alone sustains all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अखंड भजन करी । उगा नोहे क्षणभरी । अवघेन गांबद्वारीं । अहेब जैसी ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā akhaṃḍa bhajana karī | ugā nohe kṣaṇabharī | avaghena gāṃbadvārīṃ | aheba jaisī || 22||
verses.meaning: Such a one continuously performs devotion, not ceasing for even a moment, just as a river flows ceaselessly towards the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि जो भक्तु। देखसी सैरा धांवतु। जाण अज्ञानाचा मूर्तु। अवतार तो॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni jo bhaktu| dekhasī sairā dhāṃvatu| jāṇa ajñānācā mūrtu| avatāra to|| 23||
verses.meaning: Such a devotee, who you see wandering aimlessly, know that he is the very embodiment of ignorance, an incarnation of it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि एकांतें चोखटें। तपोवनें तीर्थे तटें। देखोनि जो गा विटे) तोहि तोचि॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ekāṃteṃ cokhaṭeṃ| tapovaneṃ tīrthe taṭeṃ| dekhoni jo gā viṭe) tohi toci|| 24||
verses.meaning: And he who, seeing secluded, pure hermitages, holy places, and riverbanks, feels aversion, is also that same (Brahman).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया जनपदीं सुख । गजबजेचें कवतिक । वानू आवडे लौकिक । तोहि तोची ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā janapadīṃ sukha | gajabajeceṃ kavatika | vānū āvaḍe laukika | tohi tocī || 25||
verses.meaning: Where people live in joy, and there is a delightful bustle, and the worldly fame is praised, that too is Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आत्मा गोचरु होये। ऐसी जे विद्या आहे। ते आइकोनि डौर वाहे । विद्ठांसु जो॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ātmā gocaru hoye| aisī je vidyā āhe| te āikoni ḍaura vāhe | vidṭhāṃsu jo|| 26||
verses.meaning: And the Self becomes perceptible; such is the knowledge that, upon hearing it, the wise one is filled with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उपनिषदांकडे न वचे। योगशास्त्र न रुचे। अध्यात्मज्ञानीं जयाचें।॥ मनचि नाहीं ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: upaniṣadāṃkaḍe na vace| yogaśāstra na ruce| adhyātmajñānīṃ jayāceṃ||| manaci nāhīṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: He does not turn to the Upanishads, nor does he find Yoga Shastra appealing; his mind is simply not in spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आत्मचर्चा एकी आथी । ऐसिये बुद्धीची भिंती । पाडूनि जयाची मती । बोढाळ जाहळी॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātmacarcā ekī āthī | aisiye buddhīcī bhiṃtī | pāḍūni jayācī matī | boḍhāḻa jāhaḻī|| 28||
verses.meaning: When the wall of intellect, which limits the self to a singular discussion, is broken down, one's understanding expands boundlessly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्मकांड तरी जाणे । मुखोद्गत पुराणें । ज्योतिषीं तो म्हणे । तैसेचि होय॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: karmakāṃḍa tarī jāṇe | mukhodgata purāṇeṃ | jyotiṣīṃ to mhaṇe | taiseci hoya|| 29||
verses.meaning: Even if one knows all rituals, has memorized the Puranas, and is an astrologer, things will happen just as they are destined.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शिल्पीं अति निपुण। सूपकर्मीही प्रवीण । विधि आथर्वण। हातीं आथी॥ ८३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: śilpīṃ ati nipuṇa| sūpakarmīhī pravīṇa | vidhi ātharvaṇa| hātīṃ āthī|| 830||
verses.meaning: He is exceedingly skilled in sculpture, proficient in all crafts, and holds the Atharva Veda in his hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कोकीं नाहीं ठेळें। भारत कौर म्हणितळें आगम आफाविले। मूर्त होती॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kokīṃ nāhīṃ ṭheḻeṃ| bhārata kaura mhaṇitaḻeṃ āgama āphāvile| mūrta hotī|| 31||
verses.meaning: In some places, the Puranas are not considered authoritative, but the Mahabharata is accepted as such. The Vedas are expanded upon and take form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नीतिजात सुझे। वैद्यकही बुझे। काव्यनाटकीं दुजें। चतुर नाहीं ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nītijāta sujhe| vaidyakahī bujhe| kāvyanāṭakīṃ dujeṃ| catura nāhīṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: In matters of ethics, in the understanding of medicine, and in the creation of poetry and drama, there is no one else as skilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्मृतींची चर्चा । दंशु जाणे गारुडियाचा । निघंदटु प्रज्ञेचा । पाइकी करी ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: smṛtīṃcī carcā | daṃśu jāṇe gāruḍiyācā | nighaṃdaṭu prajñecā | pāikī karī || 33||
verses.meaning: The discussion of memories, like a snake charmer's bite, makes the intellect a servant of the lexicon.

verses.shloka_devanagari: व्याकरणीं चोखडा। तकी अतिगाढा। परी एक अध्यात्मज्ञानीं फुडा। जात्यंधु जो॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: vyākaraṇīṃ cokhaḍā| takī atigāḍhā| parī eka adhyātmajñānīṃ phuḍā| jātyaṃdhu jo|| 34||
verses.meaning: One may be excellent in grammar, and extremely profound in logic, but in spiritual knowledge, such a person is truly blind from birth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें एकवांचूनि आघवां शास्त्री । सिद्धांतनिर्माणधात्री । परी जळों तें मूळनक्षत्रीं । न पाहें गा ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ ekavāṃcūni āghavāṃ śāstrī | siddhāṃtanirmāṇadhātrī | parī jaḻoṃ teṃ mūḻanakṣatrīṃ | na pāheṃ gā || 35 ||
verses.meaning: That one, without exception, is the source of all established truths in the scriptures. But let that be burnt, do not look at it under the Moola Nakshatra.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोराआंगीं अशोषें। पिसें असतीं डोळसें। परी एकली दृष्टि नसे। तैसें तें गा॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: morāāṃgīṃ aśoṣeṃ| piseṃ asatīṃ ḍoḻaseṃ| parī ekalī dṛṣṭi nase| taiseṃ teṃ gā|| 36||
verses.meaning: Just as a peacock's body is entirely covered with eyes on its feathers, yet it has no single, central eye for vision, so it is with that (Brahman).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी परमाणूएवढें। संजीवनीमूळ जोडे । तरी बहु काय गाडे । भरणें येरें॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī paramāṇūevaḍheṃ| saṃjīvanīmūḻa joḍe | tarī bahu kāya gāḍe | bharaṇeṃ yereṃ|| 37||
verses.meaning: If a root of Sanjeevani, even as small as an atom, is found, then what is the need to fill many carts with other things?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आयुष्येंबीण लक्षणें । सिसेंबीण अळंकरणें । बोहरेंबीण वाधावणें। तो विटंबु गा॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āyuṣyeṃbīṇa lakṣaṇeṃ | siseṃbīṇa aḻaṃkaraṇeṃ | bohareṃbīṇa vādhāvaṇeṃ| to viṭaṃbu gā|| 38||
verses.meaning: A life without auspicious signs, an adornment without lead (or substance), a barren tree without fruit — such is a mockery, indeed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें शास्त्रजात जाण। आघवेंचि अप्रमाण। पार्था अध्यात्मज्ञानेंबीण । एकलेनी ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śāstrajāta jāṇa| āghaveṃci apramāṇa| pārthā adhyātmajñāneṃbīṇa | ekalenī || 39||
verses.meaning: Just as all other scriptures, O Partha, are considered invalid without the knowledge of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं अर्जुना पाहीं। अध्यात्मज्ञानाच्या ठायीं । जया नित्यबोधु नाहीं । शास्त्रमूढा ॥ ८४० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ arjunā pāhīṃ| adhyātmajñānācyā ṭhāyīṃ | jayā nityabodhu nāhīṃ | śāstramūḍhā || 840 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, know this: one who is deluded by scriptures does not possess constant spiritual knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया शरीर जें जालें। तें अज्ञानाचे बीं ३०६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी विरूढलें। तयाचें व्युत्पन्नत्व गेळें। अज्ञानवेलीं ॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā śarīra jeṃ jāleṃ| teṃ ajñānāce bīṃ 306 śrījñāneśvarī virūḍhaleṃ| tayāceṃ vyutpannatva geḻeṃ| ajñānavelīṃ || 41||
verses.meaning: That body which came into being, it was the seed of ignorance that sprouted. Its true nature was lost in the creeper of ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो जें जें बोले। तें अज्ञानचि फुललें। तयाचें पुण्य जें फळळलें। तें अज्ञान गा॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: to jeṃ jeṃ bole| teṃ ajñānaci phulaleṃ| tayāceṃ puṇya jeṃ phaḻaḻaleṃ| teṃ ajñāna gā|| 42||
verses.meaning: Whatever he speaks, it is ignorance that blossoms. The fruit of his merit, that which ripens, is also ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि अध्यात्मज्ञान कांहीं । जेणें मानिलेंचि नाहीं। तो ज्ञानार्थु न देखे काई हें बोलावें असें ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi adhyātmajñāna kāṃhīṃ | jeṇeṃ mānileṃci nāhīṃ| to jñānārthu na dekhe kāī heṃ bolāveṃ aseṃ || 43||
verses.meaning: And what of spiritual knowledge? He who has not even considered it, how can he perceive the true meaning of knowledge? What more needs to be said?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐलीचि थडी न पवतां। पळे जो माघोता। तया पैलट्टीपींची वार्ता। काय होय ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ailīci thaḍī na pavatāṃ| paḻe jo māghotā| tayā pailaṭṭīpīṃcī vārtā| kāya hoya || 44||
verses.meaning: One who, without reaching this shore, turns back, how can they ever know of the other shore?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां दारवंठाचि जयाचें। शीर रोंविलें खांचे। तो केवीं परिवरींचें। ठेविलें देखे॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ dāravaṃṭhāci jayāceṃ| śīra roṃvileṃ khāṃce| to kevīṃ parivarīṃceṃ| ṭhevileṃ dekhe|| 45||
verses.meaning: How can one whose head is stuck in the threshold see what is kept inside the house?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं अध्यात्मज्ञानीं जया । अनोळख धनंजया । तया ज्ञानार्थु देखावया। विषो काई ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ adhyātmajñānīṃ jayā | anoḻakha dhanaṃjayā | tayā jñānārthu dekhāvayā| viṣo kāī || 46||
verses.meaning: Just as for one who is ignorant of spiritual knowledge, O Dhananjaya, what is the use of trying to understand the meaning of knowledge?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आतां विशेषें। तो ज्ञानाचें तत्त्व न देखे। हें सांगावें आंखेंलेखें। न लगे तुज ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ātāṃ viśeṣeṃ| to jñānāceṃ tattva na dekhe| heṃ sāṃgāveṃ āṃkheṃlekheṃ| na lage tuja || 47||
verses.meaning: Therefore, now, specifically, that person does not perceive the essence of knowledge. There is no need to explain this to you in detail.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेव्हां सगर्भे वाढिलें। तेव्हांचि पोटींचें धालें। तैसें मागिलें पदें बोलिलें। तेंचि होय ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jevhāṃ sagarbhe vāḍhileṃ| tevhāṃci poṭīṃceṃ dhāleṃ| taiseṃ māgileṃ padeṃ bolileṃ| teṃci hoya || 48||
verses.meaning: Just as a child in the womb is nourished when the mother eats, so too are the previous verses fulfilled and understood by what has been said now.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनियां वेगळें । रूप करणें हें न मिळे । जेवीं अवंतिळें आंधळें। तें दुजेनसीं ये॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūniyāṃ vegaḻeṃ | rūpa karaṇeṃ heṃ na miḻe | jevīṃ avaṃtiḻeṃ āṃdhaḻeṃ| teṃ dujenasīṃ ye|| 49||
verses.meaning: Except for this, no other form can be created. Just as a blind person, when born, comes with that blindness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं इये उपरतीं। अज्ञानचिन्हें मागुती । अमानित्वादि प्रभृती । वाखाणिलीं ॥ ८५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ iye uparatīṃ| ajñānacinheṃ māgutī | amānitvādi prabhṛtī | vākhāṇilīṃ || 850||
verses.meaning: Thus, in this state of turning away (from worldly attachments), the signs of ignorance, such as 'amanitva' (humility) and others, were again praised.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें ज्ञानपदें अठरा । केलियां येरी मोहरां। अज्ञान या आकारा। सहजें येती॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ jñānapadeṃ aṭharā | keliyāṃ yerī moharāṃ| ajñāna yā ākārā| sahajeṃ yetī|| 51||
verses.meaning: When the eighteen chapters of knowledge are turned to the other side, ignorance naturally takes form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मागां शलोकाचेनि अर्धार्धे। ऐसें सांगितलें श्रीमुकुंदें। ना उफराटीं इये ज्ञानपदें। तेंचि अज्ञान॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: māgāṃ śalokāceni ardhārdhe| aiseṃ sāṃgitaleṃ śrīmukuṃdeṃ| nā upharāṭīṃ iye jñānapadeṃ| teṃci ajñāna|| 52||
verses.meaning: In the previous half-verse, Lord Mukunda (Krishna) explained that what is considered knowledge is not actually knowledge if it is contrary to the true spiritual path; rather, that very thing is ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि इया वाहणीं। केली म्यां उपलवणी । वांचूनि दुधा मेळऊनि पाणी। फार कीजे॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni iyā vāhaṇīṃ| kelī myāṃ upalavaṇī | vāṃcūni dudhā meḻaūni pāṇī| phāra kīje|| 53||
verses.meaning: Therefore, through this narration, I have made an offering, as one might add water to milk to increase its quantity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जी न बडबडीं । पदाची कोर न सांडीं।॥ परी मूळध्वनींचिये वाढी । निमित्त जाहलो ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jī na baḍabaḍīṃ | padācī kora na sāṃḍīṃ||| parī mūḻadhvanīṃciye vāḍhī | nimitta jāhalo || 54||
verses.meaning: Thus, I do not babble meaninglessly, nor do I abandon the essence of the words. Rather, I have become the instrument for the growth of the primordial sound.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव श्रोते म्हणती राहें। कें परिहारा ठावो आहे । बिहिसी कां वायें। कविपोषका ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva śrote mhaṇatī rāheṃ| keṃ parihārā ṭhāvo āhe | bihisī kāṃ vāyeṃ| kavipoṣakā || 55 ||
verses.meaning: Then the listeners say, "Stop! Where is there any room for doubt or fear? Why are you needlessly afraid, O patron of poets?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूतें श्रीमुरारीं।॥ म्हणितलें प्रगट करीं। जे अभिप्राय गव्हरीं। झांकिले आम्हीं ॥५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūteṃ śrīmurārīṃ||| mhaṇitaleṃ pragaṭa karīṃ| je abhiprāya gavharīṃ| jhāṃkile āmhīṃ ||56||
verses.meaning: Then Shri Murari (Krishna) said, "Reveal those intentions which we have kept hidden in the cave of our hearts."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें देवाचें मनोगत। दावित आहासी तूं मूर्त । हेंहीं म्हणतां चित्त। दाटेल तुझें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ devāceṃ manogata| dāvita āhāsī tūṃ mūrta | heṃhīṃ mhaṇatāṃ citta| dāṭela tujheṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: You are revealing the very intention of God in a tangible form. Even saying this, your mind will be overwhelmed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि असो हें न बोलों । परि साविया गा तोषलों। जे ज्ञानतरिये मेळविलों। श्रवणसुखाचिये ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni aso heṃ na boloṃ | pari sāviyā gā toṣaloṃ| je jñānatariye meḻaviloṃ| śravaṇasukhāciye || 58||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let this not be spoken. But truly, I am greatly pleased, for I have been granted the boat of knowledge, leading to the joy of hearing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां इयावरी । जे तो श्रीहरी । बोलिला तें करीं । कथन वेगां॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ iyāvarī | je to śrīharī | bolilā teṃ karīṃ | kathana vegāṃ|| 59||
verses.meaning: Now, after this, whatever Lord Shrihari has spoken, I will quickly narrate that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया संतवाक्यासरिसें । म्हणितळें निवृत्तिदासें। जी अवधारा तरी ऐसें। बोलिलें देवें॥ ८६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā saṃtavākyāsariseṃ | mhaṇitaḻeṃ nivṛttidāseṃ| jī avadhārā tarī aiseṃ| bolileṃ deveṃ|| 860||
verses.meaning: Thus, in accordance with the words of the saints, Nivruttidas says, "O Lord, if you would but listen, this is what the Lord has spoken."

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणती तुवां पांडवा । हा चिन्हसमुच्चययो आघवा । आयकिला तो जाणावा । अज्ञानभागु॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇatī tuvāṃ pāṃḍavā | hā cinhasamuccayayo āghavā | āyakilā to jāṇāvā | ajñānabhāgu|| 61||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, know that this entire collection of signs that you have heard about is a part of ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया अज्ञानविभागा। पाठी देऊनि पैं गा। ज्ञानविखीं चांगा। दृढा होईजे॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā ajñānavibhāgā| pāṭhī deūni paiṃ gā| jñānavikhīṃ cāṃgā| dṛḍhā hoīje|| 62||
verses.meaning: Therefore, turning your back on this division of ignorance, become firm and steadfast in the realm of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग निर्वाळिलेनि ज्ञानें। ज्ञेय भेटेल मनें। तें जाणावया अर्जुनें) आस केली ॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga nirvāḻileni jñāneṃ| jñeya bheṭela maneṃ| teṃ jāṇāvayā arjuneṃ) āsa kelī ||63||
verses.meaning: Then, through the purified knowledge, the knowable will be met by the mind. Arjuna yearned to know that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव सर्वज्ञांचा रावो। म्हणे जाणौनि तयाचा भावो । परिसें ज्ञेयाचा अभिप्रावो। सांगों आतां॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva sarvajñāṃcā rāvo| mhaṇe jāṇauni tayācā bhāvo | pariseṃ jñeyācā abhiprāvo| sāṃgoṃ ātāṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: Then the King of all-knowing ones, understanding his sentiment, said, "Listen now, I will explain the essence of what is to be known."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि ज्ञेय ऐसें म्हणणें । वस्तुतें येणेंचि कारणें । जें ज्ञानेंबांचूनि कवणें। उपायें न ये॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari jñeya aiseṃ mhaṇaṇeṃ | vastuteṃ yeṇeṃci kāraṇeṃ | jeṃ jñāneṃbāṃcūni kavaṇeṃ| upāyeṃ na ye|| 65 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, it is called 'the knowable' precisely because it cannot be attained by any means other than knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जाणितलेयावरीतें। कांहींच करणें नाहीं जेथें । जाणणेंचि तन्मयातें। आणी जयाचें ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jāṇitaleyāvarīteṃ| kāṃhīṃca karaṇeṃ nāhīṃ jetheṃ | jāṇaṇeṃci tanmayāteṃ| āṇī jayāceṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: And after knowing that, there is nothing left to do. That knowing itself brings about absorption in it, and makes it one's own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें जाणितलेयाचिसाठीं । संसार 'काढूनियां कांठीं । जिरोनि जाइजे पोटीं । नित्यानंदाच्या ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ jāṇitaleyācisāṭhīṃ | saṃsāra 'kāḍhūniyāṃ kāṃṭhīṃ | jironi jāije poṭīṃ | nityānaṃdācyā || 67||
verses.meaning: By knowing this, the worldly existence is cast aside, and one dissolves into the eternal bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें ज्ञेय गा ऐसें। आदि जया नसे। परब्रह्म आपैसें। नाम जया॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ jñeya gā aiseṃ| ādi jayā nase| parabrahma āpaiseṃ| nāma jayā|| 68||
verses.meaning: That which is to be known, indeed, has no beginning; it is the Supreme Brahman itself, self-existent, to which this name is given.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें नाहीं म्हणों जाइजे। तंव विश्‍वाकारें देखिजे। आणि विश्‍वचि ऐसें म्हणिजे। तरि हे माया ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ nāhīṃ mhaṇoṃ jāije| taṃva viś‍vākāreṃ dekhije| āṇi viś‍vaci aiseṃ mhaṇije| tari he māyā || 69||
verses.meaning: When one tries to say that it (the Brahman) does not exist, it is seen in the form of the universe. And if one says that it is indeed the universe, then this (universe) is Maya (illusion).

verses.shloka_devanagari: रूप वर्ण व्यक्‍ती । नाहीं दृश्य द्रष्टा स्थिती । तरि कोणें कैसें आधी । म्हणावें पां॥ ८७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: rūpa varṇa vyak‍tī | nāhīṃ dṛśya draṣṭā sthitī | tari koṇeṃ kaiseṃ ādhī | mhaṇāveṃ pāṃ|| 870||
verses.meaning: When there is no form, color, or individual, and no state of seer or seen, then how can one even begin to describe it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि साचचि जरी नाहीं। तरि महदादि कोणें ठाई । स्फुरत कैंचें काई । तेणेंबीण असे ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sācaci jarī nāhīṃ| tari mahadādi koṇeṃ ṭhāī | sphurata kaiṃceṃ kāī | teṇeṃbīṇa ase || 71||
verses.meaning: And if it truly does not exist, then how could the Mahat and other principles manifest anywhere? How could anything exist without it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आथी नाथी हे बोली । जें देखोनि मुकी जाहली । विचारेंसी मोडली । वाट जेथें ॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āthī nāthī he bolī | jeṃ dekhoni mukī jāhalī | vicāreṃsī moḍalī | vāṭa jetheṃ ||72||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the concepts of 'is' and 'is not' become silent upon seeing it. The path of thought itself breaks down where it is encountered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसीं भांडघटशरावीं। तदाकारें असे पृथ्वी । तैसें सर्व होऊनियां सर्वी । असे जे वस्तु॥७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisīṃ bhāṃḍaghaṭaśarāvīṃ| tadākāreṃ ase pṛthvī | taiseṃ sarva hoūniyāṃ sarvī | ase je vastu||73||
verses.meaning: Just as the earth takes the form of pots and vessels, so too the ultimate reality, though pervading all, remains itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधघवांचि देशीं काळीं । नव्हतां देशकाळांवेगळी । जे क्रिया स्थूळास्थूळीं । तेचि हात जयाचे ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhaghavāṃci deśīṃ kāḻīṃ | navhatāṃ deśakāḻāṃvegaḻī | je kriyā sthūḻāsthūḻīṃ | teci hāta jayāce || 74||
verses.meaning: In all directions, in all times, and beyond time and space, whatever actions occur in the gross and subtle realms, they are indeed His hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयातें याकारणें। विश्‍वबाहु ऐसें म्हणणें । जें सर्वचि सर्वपणें। सर्वदा करी ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāteṃ yākāraṇeṃ| viś‍vabāhu aiseṃ mhaṇaṇeṃ | jeṃ sarvaci sarvapaṇeṃ| sarvadā karī || 75 ||
verses.meaning: For this reason, He is called 'Vishwabahu' (one with arms everywhere), because He, in His entirety, always does everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि समस्तांही ठायां। एके काळीं धनंजया । आलें असे म्हणौनि जया। विशवांघ्रिनाम ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi samastāṃhī ṭhāyāṃ| eke kāḻīṃ dhanaṃjayā | āleṃ ase mhaṇauni jayā| viśavāṃghrināma || 76||
verses.meaning: And because, O Dhananjaya, all beings at one time come to rest at His feet, He is known as Vishwānghri (one whose feet are the universe).

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सवितया आंग डोळे । नाहींत वेगळे वेगळे । तैसें सर्वद्रष्टें सकळें। स्वरूपें जें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ savitayā āṃga ḍoḻe | nāhīṃta vegaḻe vegaḻe | taiseṃ sarvadraṣṭeṃ sakaḻeṃ| svarūpeṃ jeṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun's body and its eyes are not separate, so too is the all-seeing, all-encompassing divine essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विश्‍वतशचक्षु। हा अचक्लूच्या ठायीं पक्षु| बोलावया दक्षु| जाहला वेदु॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni viś‍vataśacakṣu| hā acaklūcyā ṭhāyīṃ pakṣu| bolāvayā dakṣu| jāhalā vedu|| 78||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the Vedas, which are the eyes of the universe, became adept at speaking on behalf of the one who is without eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें सर्वांचे शिरावरी । नित्य नांदे सर्वांपरी । ऐसिये स्थितीवरी । वबिश्‍वमूर्धा म्हणिपे॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sarvāṃce śirāvarī | nitya nāṃde sarvāṃparī | aisiye sthitīvarī | vabiś‍vamūrdhā mhaṇipe|| 79||
verses.meaning: That which is above all, eternally residing in all, in such a state is called the Universal Head.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा मूर्ति तेंचि मुख। हुताशनी जैसें देख । तैसें सर्वपणें अशेख । भोक्ते जें॥ ८८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā mūrti teṃci mukha| hutāśanī jaiseṃ dekha | taiseṃ sarvapaṇeṃ aśekha | bhokte jeṃ|| 880||
verses.meaning: Just as fire consumes everything, so too does the divine form, with all its aspects, become the enjoyer of everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं तया पार्था । विश्वतोमुख हे ३०८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी व्यवस्था। आली वाक्‍्पथा। श्रुतीचिया ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ tayā pārthā | viśvatomukha he 308 śrījñāneśvarī vyavasthā| ālī vāk‍pathā| śrutīciyā || 81||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Partha, this universal form, as described in the Shrimad Dnyaneshwari, has come into the realm of speech through the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि वतस्तुमात्रीं गगन । जैसें असे संलग्न। तैसें शब्दजातीं कान। सर्वत्र जया॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi vatastumātrīṃ gagana | jaiseṃ ase saṃlagna| taiseṃ śabdajātīṃ kāna| sarvatra jayā||82||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky is inherently connected to all things, so too is the ear (or the sense of hearing) universally present in all sounds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आम्ही तयातें । म्हणों सर्वत्र आइकतें। एवं जें सर्वांते। आवरूनि असे॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āmhī tayāteṃ | mhaṇoṃ sarvatra āikateṃ| evaṃ jeṃ sarvāṃte| āvarūni ase|| 83||
verses.meaning: Therefore, we call it all-hearing, and it encompasses all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी महामती। विश्‍वतश्चक्षु इया श्रुती। तयाचिया व्याप्ती। रूप केलें॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī mahāmatī| viś‍vataścakṣu iyā śrutī| tayāciyā vyāptī| rūpa keleṃ|| 84||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, O great sage, the Shruti (Vedas) describe the omnipresent one as having eyes everywhere, and His form is made of this all-pervading nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि हस्त नेत्र पाये। हें भाष तेथ कें आहे। सर्व शून्याचा न साहे। निष्कर्ष जें ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni hasta netra pāye| heṃ bhāṣa tetha keṃ āhe| sarva śūnyācā na sāhe| niṣkarṣa jeṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: Without hands, eyes, or feet, how can there be any speech? That which is the ultimate conclusion of all nothingness cannot endure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं कल्लोळातें कल्लोळें। ग्रसिजत असे ऐसें कळे । परी ग्रसितें ग्रासावेगळें। असे काई ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kalloḻāteṃ kalloḻeṃ| grasijata ase aiseṃ kaḻe | parī grasiteṃ grāsāvegaḻeṃ| ase kāī || 86||
verses.meaning: Just as one wave seems to swallow another, yet the swallower is not separate from the swallowed, so too is the relationship between the individual soul and the Universal Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें साचचि जें एक । तेथ कें व्याप्यव्यापक। परी बोलावया नावेक । करावें लागे॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ sācaci jeṃ eka | tetha keṃ vyāpyavyāpaka| parī bolāvayā nāveka | karāveṃ lāge|| 87||
verses.meaning: In that which is truly one, how can there be the concepts of pervaded and pervader? Yet, for the sake of discourse, it becomes necessary to speak of them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं शून्य जैं दावावें जाहलें। तैं बिंदुळे एक पाहिजे केलें। तैसें अद्वैत सांगावें बोलें। तैं द्वैत कीजे॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ śūnya jaiṃ dāvāveṃ jāhaleṃ| taiṃ biṃduḻe eka pāhije keleṃ| taiseṃ advaita sāṃgāveṃ boleṃ| taiṃ dvaita kīje|| 88||
verses.meaning: Just as to show a void, one must make a point, similarly, to express non-duality through words, duality must be employed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं तरी पार्था । गुरुशिष्यसत्पथा। आडळु पडे सर्वथा। बोल खुंटे ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ tarī pārthā | guruśiṣyasatpathā| āḍaḻu paḍe sarvathā| bola khuṃṭe || 89||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, O Partha, the path of the guru and disciple would be completely obstructed, and all discourse would cease.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गा श्रुती । ह्वैतभावें अद्वैतीं। निरूपणाची वाहती। वाट केली ॥ ८९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gā śrutī | hvaitabhāveṃ advaitīṃ| nirūpaṇācī vāhatī| vāṭa kelī || 890||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the Vedas, though speaking of duality, have paved the way for the exposition of non-duality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि आतां अवधारीं। इये नेत्रगोचरें आकारीं। तें ज्ञेय गा जयापरी। व्यापक असे॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci ātāṃ avadhārīṃ| iye netragocareṃ ākārīṃ| teṃ jñeya gā jayāparī| vyāpaka ase||91||
verses.meaning: Now listen to how that knowable, which is all-pervading, manifests in this visible form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तें गा किरीटी ऐसें । अबकाशीं आकाश जैसें। पटीं पटु होऊनि असे। तंतु जेवीं॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī teṃ gā kirīṭī aiseṃ | abakāśīṃ ākāśa jaiseṃ| paṭīṃ paṭu hoūni ase| taṃtu jevīṃ|| 92||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, just as the sky exists within space, and as a thread is woven into a cloth, so too is the universe contained within Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदक होऊनि उदकीं। रसु जैसा अवलोकीं। दीपपणें दीपकीं।॥ तेज जैसें॥९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: udaka hoūni udakīṃ| rasu jaisā avalokīṃ| dīpapaṇeṃ dīpakīṃ||| teja jaiseṃ||93||
verses.meaning: Just as water, becoming water, perceives its own taste, and just as a lamp, through its lamphood, perceives its own light.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्पूरत्वें कापुरीं। सौरभ्य असे जयापरी । शरीर होऊनि शरीरीं। कर्म जेवीं ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: karpūratveṃ kāpurīṃ| saurabhya ase jayāparī | śarīra hoūni śarīrīṃ| karma jevīṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Just as camphor inherently possesses its fragrance, so too does the embodied soul naturally perform actions within the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना जैसें पांडवा । सोनेंचि सोनयाचा रवा । तैसें जें या सर्वा । सर्वांगी असे॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā jaiseṃ pāṃḍavā | soneṃci sonayācā ravā | taiseṃ jeṃ yā sarvā | sarvāṃgī ase|| 95||
verses.meaning: Indeed, just as gold is the essence of gold, so too is the Self present in all beings, in every part of them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी रवेपणामाजिवडे। तंव रवा ऐसें आवडे । वांचूनि सोनें सांगडें। सोनया जेबीं॥९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī ravepaṇāmājivaḍe| taṃva ravā aiseṃ āvaḍe | vāṃcūni soneṃ sāṃgaḍeṃ| sonayā jebīṃ||96||
verses.meaning: However, when the sun is within the sun, it appears as the sun itself. Similarly, gold is gold when it is within gold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गा बोघुचि बांकुडा। परि पाणी उजू सुहाडा। वन्हि आला 'लोखंडा। लोह नव्हे कौं॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ gā boghuci bāṃkuḍā| pari pāṇī ujū suhāḍā| vanhi ālā 'lokhaṃḍā| loha navhe kauṃ|| 97||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the bow is crooked, but the arrow is straight and pleasing. When fire comes to iron, does it not become iron?

verses.shloka_devanagari: घटाकारें बेंटाळें। तेथ नभ गमे वाटोळें । मठीं तरी चौफळें। आये दिसे॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghaṭākāreṃ beṃṭāḻeṃ| tetha nabha game vāṭoḻeṃ | maṭhīṃ tarī cauphaḻeṃ| āye dise|| 98||
verses.meaning: The sky appears round when seen through a round pot, and square when seen through a square hut, yet the sky itself remains formless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि ते अवकाश जेसें। नोहेजतीचि कां आकाशें। जें विकार होऊनि तैसें। विकारी नोहे॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari te avakāśa jeseṃ| nohejatīci kāṃ ākāśeṃ| jeṃ vikāra hoūni taiseṃ| vikārī nohe|| 99||
verses.meaning: Just as space does not become the sky, and though it appears to undergo change, it remains unaffected by those changes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मन मुख्य इंद्रियां । सत्त्वादि गुणां ययां-। सारिखें ऐसें धनंजया । आवडे कीर॥ ९००॥
verses.shloka_iast: mana mukhya iṃdriyāṃ | sattvādi guṇāṃ yayāṃ-| sārikheṃ aiseṃ dhanaṃjayā | āvaḍe kīra|| 900||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, the mind is the chief among the senses, and it delights in the qualities of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas, as if they were its wealth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं गुळाची गोडी। नोहे बांधया सांगडी। तैसीं गुण इंद्रियें फुडीं। नाहीं तेथ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ guḻācī goḍī| nohe bāṃdhayā sāṃgaḍī| taisīṃ guṇa iṃdriyeṃ phuḍīṃ| nāhīṃ tetha|| 1||
verses.meaning: Just as the sweetness of jaggery cannot be separated from it, so too the qualities and senses are not truly separate from the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा क्षीराचिये दशे । घृत क्षीराकारें असे । परी क्षीरचि नोहे जैसें । 'कपिध्वजा॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā kṣīrāciye daśe | ghṛta kṣīrākāreṃ ase | parī kṣīraci nohe jaiseṃ | 'kapidhvajā|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as ghee, though derived from milk, is not milk itself, so too, O Arjuna, is the nature of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जें इये विकारीं। विकार नोहे अवधारीं। पैं आकारा नाम भोंबरीं। येर सोनें तें सोनें ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jeṃ iye vikārīṃ| vikāra nohe avadhārīṃ| paiṃ ākārā nāma bhoṃbarīṃ| yera soneṃ teṃ soneṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: Just as gold, though it takes on various forms, does not undergo any real change; the forms are merely names given to its appearances, but the gold itself remains gold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया उघड मऱ्हाटिया। तें वेगळेपण धनंजया । जाण गुणडंद्रियां-। पासोनियां ॥ ४ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā ughaḍa maṟhāṭiyā| teṃ vegaḻepaṇa dhanaṃjayā | jāṇa guṇaḍaṃdriyāṃ-| pāsoniyāṃ || 4 ||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, understand that this manifest Marathi language is distinct from the qualities of the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नामरूपसंबंधु। जातिक्रियाभेदु । हा आकारासीच प्रवादु। वस्तूसि नाहीं॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāmarūpasaṃbaṃdhu| jātikriyābhedu | hā ākārāsīca pravādu| vastūsi nāhīṃ||5||
verses.meaning: The distinctions of name, form, relation, caste, and action are merely attributes of the manifested form, not of the true essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें गुण नव्हे कहीं। गुणा तया संबंधु नाहीं। परि तयाच्याचि ठायीं। आभासती ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ guṇa navhe kahīṃ| guṇā tayā saṃbaṃdhu nāhīṃ| pari tayācyāci ṭhāyīṃ| ābhāsatī || 6||
verses.meaning: These are not qualities in themselves; the Self has no connection with them. Yet, it is within the Self that they appear to manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलेयासाठीं । संभ्रांताच्या पोटीं । ऐसें जाय किरीटी । जे हेंचि धरी॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetuleyāsāṭhīṃ | saṃbhrāṃtācyā poṭīṃ | aiseṃ jāya kirīṭī | je heṃci dharī|| 7||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in the heart of the bewildered, O Kiriti, this thought arises: "Hold on to this alone."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तें गा धरणें ऐसें॥ अभ्रातें जेवी आकाशें। कां प्रतिवदन जैसें । आरसेनि॥ ८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī teṃ gā dharaṇeṃ aiseṃ|| abhrāteṃ jevī ākāśeṃ| kāṃ prativadana jaiseṃ | āraseni|| 8 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that holding is like the sky holding clouds, or like a mirror reflecting a face.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी सूर्यप्रतिमंडळ। जैसेनि धरी सलिल। कां रशमिकरीं मृगजळ। धरिजे जेवीं ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī sūryapratimaṃḍaḻa| jaiseni dharī salila| kāṃ raśamikarīṃ mṛgajaḻa| dharije jevīṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Or, just as the sun's orb holds water, or as rays of light hold a mirage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें गा संबंधेंबिण। यया सर्वांतें धरी निर्गुण। परी तें वायां जाण मिथ्यादृष्टी ॥ ९१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ gā saṃbaṃdheṃbiṇa| yayā sarvāṃteṃ dharī nirguṇa| parī teṃ vāyāṃ jāṇa mithyādṛṣṭī || 910||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the attributeless Brahman holds all this without any connection. But know that such a perception is vain and based on illusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि यापरी निर्गुणें। गुणातें भोगणें । रंका राज्य करणें । स्वप्नीं जैसें। १९॥ म्हणौनि गुणाचा संगु। अथवा गुणभोगु। हा निर्गुणीं लागु। बोलो नये॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi yāparī nirguṇeṃ| guṇāteṃ bhogaṇeṃ | raṃkā rājya karaṇeṃ | svapnīṃ jaiseṃ| 19|| mhaṇauni guṇācā saṃgu| athavā guṇabhogu| hā nirguṇīṃ lāgu| bolo naye|| 12||
verses.meaning: And in this way, for the attributeless (Nirguna) to experience attributes (Guna) is like a pauper ruling a kingdom in a dream. Therefore, association with attributes or the enjoyment of attributes cannot be attributed to the attributeless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें चराचर भूतां-। माजीं असे पंडुसुता । नाना वन्हीं उष्णता । अभेदें जैसी ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ carācara bhūtāṃ-| mājīṃ ase paṃḍusutā | nānā vanhīṃ uṣṇatā | abhedeṃ jaisī || 13||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, just as the heat is indistinguishable from the various fires, so too is the Self present in all animate and inanimate beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसेनि अविनाशभावें। जें सूक्ष्मदशे आघवें। व्यापूनि असे तें जाणावें । ज्ञेय एथ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseni avināśabhāveṃ| jeṃ sūkṣmadaśe āghaveṃ| vyāpūni ase teṃ jāṇāveṃ | jñeya etha|| 14||
verses.meaning: In the same way, know that which, with an imperishable nature, pervades everything in its subtle state, is the object of knowledge here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें एक आंतुबाहेरी। जें एक जवळ दुरी । जें 'एकवांचूनि परी । दुजीं नाहीं ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ eka āṃtubāherī| jeṃ eka javaḻa durī | jeṃ 'ekavāṃcūni parī | dujīṃ nāhīṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: That which is one, within and without; that which is one, near and far; that which is one, and without it, there is no other.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्षीरसागरींची गोडी । माजीं बहु थडिये थोडी । हें नाहीं तया परवबडी। पूर्ण जें गा॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kṣīrasāgarīṃcī goḍī | mājīṃ bahu thaḍiye thoḍī | heṃ nāhīṃ tayā paravabaḍī| pūrṇa jeṃ gā|| 16||
verses.meaning: The sweetness of the ocean of milk is very little compared to Me. There is no limit to My fullness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वेदजादिप्रभृती । वेगळाल्या भूतीं। जयाचिये अनुस्यूतीं। खोमणें नाहीं. ॥१७॥
verses.shloka_iast: svedajādiprabhṛtī | vegaḻālyā bhūtīṃ| jayāciye anusyūtīṃ| khomaṇeṃ nāhīṃ. ||17||
verses.meaning: From sweat-born beings and others, in various forms, there is no separation from His pervasive presence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं श्रोतेमुखटिळका। घटसहस्त्रा अनेका -। माजीं बिंबोनि चंद्रिका । न भेदे जेवीं ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ śrotemukhaṭiḻakā| ghaṭasahastrā anekā -| mājīṃ biṃboni caṃdrikā | na bhede jevīṃ || 18||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon's reflection, though appearing in thousands of pots, remains undivided and one, so too is the divine essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना लबणकणाचिये राशी । क्षारता एकचि जैसी । कां कोडी एकीं ऊसीं। एकचि गोडी॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā labaṇakaṇāciye rāśī | kṣāratā ekaci jaisī | kāṃ koḍī ekīṃ ūsīṃ| ekaci goḍī|| 19||
verses.meaning: Just as a heap of various salt crystals all share the same saltiness, or a multitude of sugarcane stalks all share the same sweetness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें अनेकीं भूतजातीं। जें आहे एकी व्याप्ती । विशवकार्या सुमती । ३१९० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी कारण जें गा॥ ९२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ anekīṃ bhūtajātīṃ| jeṃ āhe ekī vyāptī | viśavakāryā sumatī | 3190 śrījñāneśvarī kāraṇa jeṃ gā|| 920||
verses.meaning: Just as the one pervading essence exists in many forms of beings, O good-minded one, that is the cause of the universal creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि हा भूताकारु । जेथोनि तेंचि तया आधारु । कल्लोळा सागरु । जियापरी॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni hā bhūtākāru | jethoni teṃci tayā ādhāru | kalloḻā sāgaru | jiyāparī|| 21||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that from which this form of beings arises, that alone is its support, just as the ocean is the support for its waves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाल्यादि तिन्ही बयसीं । काया एकचि जैसी । तैसें आदिस्थितिग्रासीं। अखंड जें॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: bālyādi tinhī bayasīṃ | kāyā ekaci jaisī | taiseṃ ādisthitigrāsīṃ| akhaṃḍa jeṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: Just as the body remains one through childhood, youth, and old age, so too is that which is unbroken through creation, sustenance, and dissolution.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सायंप्रातर्मध्यान। होतां जातां दिनमान। जैसें कां गगन। पालटेना॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāyaṃprātarmadhyāna| hotāṃ jātāṃ dinamāna| jaiseṃ kāṃ gagana| pālaṭenā|| 23||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky does not change with the passing of day, from morning to evening and through midday, so too the true self remains unaltered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा सृष्टिवेळे प्रियोत्तमा । जया नांव म्हणती ब्रह्मा । व्याप्ति जें विष्णुनामा । पात्र जाहलें॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā sṛṣṭiveḻe priyottamā | jayā nāṃva mhaṇatī brahmā | vyāpti jeṃ viṣṇunāmā | pātra jāhaleṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: O dearest, at the time of creation, that which is called Brahma, and that which became the vessel for the name of Vishnu, is the all-pervading reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आकारु हा हरपे। तेव्हां रुद्र जें म्हणिपे। तेंही गुणत्रय जेव्हां लोपे । तें जें शून्य॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga ākāru hā harape| tevhāṃ rudra jeṃ mhaṇipe| teṃhī guṇatraya jevhāṃ lope | teṃ jeṃ śūnya|| 25||
verses.meaning: When this form disappears, and even that which is called Rudra, when the three gunas also vanish, that which remains is the void.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नभाचें शून्यत्व गिळून । गुणत्रयातें नुरऊन। तें शून्य तें महाशून्य। श्रुतिवचनसंमत॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nabhāceṃ śūnyatva giḻūna | guṇatrayāteṃ nuraūna| teṃ śūnya teṃ mahāśūnya| śrutivacanasaṃmata|| 26||
verses.meaning: Swallowing the void of the sky, and leaving no trace of the three Gunas, that very void, that great void, is affirmed by the Vedic scriptures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें अग्नीचें दीपन । जें चंद्राचे जीवन । सूर्याचे नयन । देखती जेणें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ agnīceṃ dīpana | jeṃ caṃdrāce jīvana | sūryāce nayana | dekhatī jeṇeṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: That which is the kindling of fire, the life of the moon, the eye of the sun, by which all these are seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचेनि उजियेडें । तारांगण उभडें । महातेज सुरवाडें । राहाटे जेणें ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceni ujiyeḍeṃ | tārāṃgaṇa ubhaḍeṃ | mahāteja suravāḍeṃ | rāhāṭe jeṇeṃ || 28||
verses.meaning: By whose light the constellations shine forth, and by whose great splendor the sun moves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें आदीची आदी। जें वृद्धीची वृद्धी। बुद्धीची जें बुद्धी। जीवाचा जीवु॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ ādīcī ādī| jeṃ vṛddhīcī vṛddhī| buddhīcī jeṃ buddhī| jīvācā jīvu|| 29||
verses.meaning: That which is the origin of all origins, the growth of all growth, the intellect of all intellect, the very life of life itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें मनाचें मन। जें नेत्राचे नयन। कानाचे कान। वाचेची वाचा ॥ ९३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ manāceṃ mana| jeṃ netrāce nayana| kānāce kāna| vācecī vācā || 930||
verses.meaning: That which is the mind of the mind, the eye of the eyes, the ear of the ears, and the speech of speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें प्राणाचा प्राण। जें गतीचे चरण। क्रियेचें कर्तेपण । जयाचेनि॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ prāṇācā prāṇa| jeṃ gatīce caraṇa| kriyeceṃ kartepaṇa | jayāceni|| 39||
verses.meaning: That which is the life of life, the very feet of motion, and the doer of all action, all by its power.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आकारु जेणें आकारे। विस्तारु जेणें विस्तारे। संहारु जेणें संहारे। पंडुकुमरा॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ākāru jeṇeṃ ākāre| vistāru jeṇeṃ vistāre| saṃhāru jeṇeṃ saṃhāre| paṃḍukumarā|| 32||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, He is the one by whom forms take shape, by whom the universe expands, and by whom it is ultimately dissolved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें मेदिनीची मेदिनी । जें पाणी पिऊनि असे 'पाणी। तेजा दिवेलावणी। जेणें तेजें॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ medinīcī medinī | jeṃ pāṇī piūni ase 'pāṇī| tejā divelāvaṇī| jeṇeṃ tejeṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: That which is the very earth of the earth, that which drinks water and yet remains water, that which ignites the light of fire, by its own inherent brilliance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें वायूचा श्‍वासोश्वासु । जें गगनाचा अवकाश । हें असो आघवाचि आभासु। आभासे जेणें॥ ३४॥
