verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ vāyūcā ś‍vāsośvāsu | jeṃ gaganācā avakāśa | heṃ aso āghavāci ābhāsu| ābhāse jeṇeṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: That which is the very breath of air, that which is the space of the sky, let alone these, that by which all appearances appear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना पांडवा। जें आघवेंचि असे आघवा । जेथ नाहीं रिगावा। ह्वैतभावासी ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā pāṃḍavā| jeṃ āghaveṃci ase āghavā | jetha nāhīṃ rigāvā| hvaitabhāvāsī || 35||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Pandava, that which is entirely complete in itself, where there is no entry for duality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें देखिलियाचिसवें। दृश्य द्रष्टा हें आघवें। एकवाट कालवे । सामरस्यें ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ dekhiliyācisaveṃ| dṛśya draṣṭā heṃ āghaveṃ| ekavāṭa kālave | sāmarasyeṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: When that is seen, the seer and the seen, all of this, become one, merging in harmony.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेंचि होय ज्ञान । ज्ञाता ज्ञेय हन। ज्ञानें गमिजे स्थान तेंहि तेंची ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga teṃci hoya jñāna | jñātā jñeya hana| jñāneṃ gamije sthāna teṃhi teṃcī || 37||
verses.meaning: Then that itself becomes knowledge, the knower, and the knowable. The state attained through knowledge is also that very same.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसे सरलियां लेख। आंख होती एक। तेसें साध्यसाधनादिक। ऐक्यासि ये॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaise saraliyāṃ lekha| āṃkha hotī eka| teseṃ sādhyasādhanādika| aikyāsi ye|| 38||
verses.meaning: Just as a single eye perceives all written words, so too do the means and the end become one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना जिये ठायीं। न सरे द्वैताची वही। हें असो जें हृदयीं। सर्वांच्या असे॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā jiye ṭhāyīṃ| na sare dvaitācī vahī| heṃ aso jeṃ hṛdayīṃ| sarvāṃcyā ase|| 39||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, where the duality does not cease, let alone that, He who resides in the hearts of all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं तुजपुढां । आदि क्षेत्र सुहाडा । दाविले फाडोवाडां। विवंचुनी ॥ ९४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ tujapuḍhāṃ | ādi kṣetra suhāḍā | dāvile phāḍovāḍāṃ| vivaṃcunī || 940||
verses.meaning: Thus, before you, the primordial field, the source of all joy, has been revealed and thoroughly explained in detail.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसेंचि क्षेत्रापाठीं । जैसेंनि देखसी दिठी । तें ज्ञानही किरीटी । सांगितलें ॥ ४१९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃci kṣetrāpāṭhīṃ | jaiseṃni dekhasī diṭhī | teṃ jñānahī kirīṭī | sāṃgitaleṃ || 419 ||
verses.meaning: Just as you perceive the field with your sight, that too, O Kiriti, is said to be knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अज्ञानाही कौतुकें।॥ रूप केलें निर्के। जंब आयणी तुझी टेंके। पुरे म्हणे ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ajñānāhī kautukeṃ||| rūpa keleṃ nirke| jaṃba āyaṇī tujhī ṭeṃke| pure mhaṇe || 42||
verses.meaning: Even ignorance, with wonder, created a form so pure. When your gaze falls upon it, it says, 'Enough!'

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आतां हें रोकडे । उपपत्तीचेनि पवाडें । निरूपिलें उघडें । ज्ञेय पैं गा॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ātāṃ heṃ rokaḍe | upapattīceni pavāḍeṃ | nirūpileṃ ughaḍeṃ | jñeya paiṃ gā|| 43||
verses.meaning: And now, this very knowledge, through the power of reasoning, has been clearly expounded, O Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे आघवीच विवंचना । बुद्धी भरोनि अर्जुना । मत्सिद्धिभावना । माझिया येती॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: he āghavīca vivaṃcanā | buddhī bharoni arjunā | matsiddhibhāvanā | mājhiyā yetī|| 44||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, all these thoughts and deliberations, when filled with the intention of realizing Me, ultimately lead to My attainment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देहादि परिग्रहीं।॥ संन्यासु करूनियां जिहीं। जीवु माझ्या ठाई। वृत्तिकु केळा॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: dehādi parigrahīṃ||| saṃnyāsu karūniyāṃ jihīṃ| jīvu mājhyā ṭhāī| vṛttiku keḻā|| 45||
verses.meaning: Those who, having renounced identification with the body and other possessions, have made their very life's purpose to reside in Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते मातें किरीटी। हेंचि जाणौनियां शेवटीं । आपणपयां साटोवाटीं। मीचि होती॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: te māteṃ kirīṭī| heṃci jāṇauniyāṃ śevaṭīṃ | āpaṇapayāṃ sāṭovāṭīṃ| mīci hotī|| 46||
verses.meaning: Knowing this truth at the very end, they, O Kiriti, become Me in exchange for themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मीचि होती परी हें मुख्य गा अवधारीं। सोहोपी सर्वांपरी । रचिलीं आम्हीं ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mīci hotī parī heṃ mukhya gā avadhārīṃ| sohopī sarvāṃparī | racilīṃ āmhīṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: I was indeed the one, but understand this main point: I have easily created all these forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कडां पायरी 'कौजे। निराळीं माचु बांधिजे। अथावीं सुइुजे। तरी जैसी ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaḍāṃ pāyarī 'kauje| nirāḻīṃ mācu bāṃdhije| athāvīṃ suiuje| tarī jaisī || 48||
verses.meaning: Just as a ladder is placed against a wall, or a separate platform is constructed, or a needle is used in a deep well, so it is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं अवघेंचि आत्मा। हें सांगों जरी वीरोत्तमा। परी तुझिया मनोधर्मा । मिळेल ना॥४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ avagheṃci ātmā| heṃ sāṃgoṃ jarī vīrottamā| parī tujhiyā manodharmā | miḻela nā||49||
verses.meaning: O best among warriors, if I were to tell you that everything is indeed the Self, it would not align with your current understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि एकचि संचलळें। चतुर्धा आम्हीं केलें। जें अदळपण देखिलें। तुझिये प्रज्ञे॥ ९५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ekaci saṃcalaḻeṃ| caturdhā āmhīṃ keleṃ| jeṃ adaḻapaṇa dekhileṃ| tujhiye prajñe|| 950||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that which is one and undivided, we have made into four. This is the unseen aspect that has been perceived by your wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं बाळ जैं जेवविजे। तें घांसु विसा ठायीं कौजे। तेसें एकचि हें चतुर्व्याजें। कथिलें आम्हीं ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ bāḻa jaiṃ jevavije| teṃ ghāṃsu visā ṭhāyīṃ kauje| teseṃ ekaci heṃ caturvyājeṃ| kathileṃ āmhīṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Just as a child is fed, and that one morsel is made into twenty different forms, so too have we expounded this one (truth) in four ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक क्षेत्र एक ज्ञान। एक ज्ञेय एक अज्ञान । हे भाग केळे अबधान। जाणोनि तुझें ॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka kṣetra eka jñāna| eka jñeya eka ajñāna | he bhāga keḻe abadhāna| jāṇoni tujheṃ ||52||
verses.meaning: One field, one knowledge, one knowable, one ignorance – these divisions are made, knowing You.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ऐसेनही पार्था । जरी हा अभिप्राबो तुज हाता। न ये तरी हे व्यवस्था । एक वेळ सांगों ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi aisenahī pārthā | jarī hā abhiprābo tuja hātā| na ye tarī he vyavasthā | eka veḻa sāṃgoṃ || 53||
verses.meaning: And even if, O Partha, this intention does not come to your hand, then I will explain this arrangement to you once more.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां चौठायीं न करूं। एकही म्हणौनि न सरूं। आत्मानात्मया धरूं । सरिसा पाडु ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ cauṭhāyīṃ na karūṃ| ekahī mhaṇauni na sarūṃ| ātmānātmayā dharūṃ | sarisā pāḍu || 54||
verses.meaning: Now, let's not make a distinction between the fourth state and the others. Let's not dismiss any as merely one. Let's consider the Self and the non-Self as equally significant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तुवां येतुलें करावें । मागो तें आम्हां देआवें। जे कानचि नांव ठेवावें) आपण पैं गा॥५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari tuvāṃ yetuleṃ karāveṃ | māgo teṃ āmhāṃ deāveṃ| je kānaci nāṃva ṭhevāveṃ) āpaṇa paiṃ gā||55||
verses.meaning: But you should do this much for us: whatever we ask, please grant it to us, that you may be named as the one who fulfills all desires.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या श्रीकृष्णाचिया बोला । पार्थ रोमांचितु जाहलळा। तेथ देवो म्हणती भला । उचंबळेना ॥५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā śrīkṛṣṇāciyā bolā | pārtha romāṃcitu jāhalaḻā| tetha devo mhaṇatī bhalā | ucaṃbaḻenā ||56||
verses.meaning: Upon hearing these words of Shri Krishna, Arjuna was thrilled. The Lord then said, "Excellent!" and was overcome with emotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि तो येतां वेगु। धरूनि म्हणे श्रीरंगु। प्रकृतिपुर्षविभागु । परिसें सांगों ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni to yetāṃ vegu| dharūni mhaṇe śrīraṃgu| prakṛtipurṣavibhāgu | pariseṃ sāṃgoṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: When he arrived, Shri Ranga (Krishna) held him and said, "Listen, I will explain the distinction between Prakriti and Purusha."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया मार्गातें जगीं । सांख्य म्हणती योगी। जयाचिये भाटिवेलागीं। मी कपिल जाहलो ॥५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā mārgāteṃ jagīṃ | sāṃkhya mhaṇatī yogī| jayāciye bhāṭivelāgīṃ| mī kapila jāhalo ||58||
verses.meaning: The path which the Sāṅkhyas call Yoga, for the sake of whose glorification I became Kapila.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो आईक निर्दोखु। प्रकृतिपुरुषविवेकु। म्हणे आदिपुरुखु। अर्जुनातें॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to āīka nirdokhu| prakṛtipuruṣaviveku| mhaṇe ādipurukhu| arjunāteṃ|| 59||
verses.meaning: Listen, O Arjuna, to this flawless discourse on the distinction between Prakriti and Purusha, which the Primeval Being then imparted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पुरुष अनादि आथी। आणि तैंचि लागोनि प्रकृति। संसरिसी ३९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी दिवोराती। दोनी जैसी॥ ९६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī puruṣa anādi āthī| āṇi taiṃci lāgoni prakṛti| saṃsarisī 392 śrījñāneśvarī divorātī| donī jaisī|| 960||
verses.meaning: Just as day and night are eternally connected, so too are the eternal Purusha (Consciousness) and Prakriti (Nature) intertwined, giving rise to the cycle of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां रूप नोहे वायां। परी रूपा लागली छाया। निकणु वाढे धनंजया । कणेंसीं कोंडा॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ rūpa nohe vāyāṃ| parī rūpā lāgalī chāyā| nikaṇu vāḍhe dhanaṃjayā | kaṇeṃsīṃ koṃḍā|| 61||
verses.meaning: Is it not that the form is not in vain? But a shadow has fallen upon the form. Just as the husk grows around the grain, O Dhananjaya, so does illusion cling to reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं जाण जबटें। दोन्हीं इयें एकवटें । प्रकृतिपुरुष प्रकटें। अनादिसिद्धें ॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ jāṇa jabaṭeṃ| donhīṃ iyeṃ ekavaṭeṃ | prakṛtipuruṣa prakaṭeṃ| anādisiddheṃ ||62||
verses.meaning: Understand that these two, Prakriti (Nature) and Purusha (Consciousness), are eternally united and manifest together, having existed from time immemorial.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं क्षेत्र येणें नांवें ।॥ जें सांगितलें आघवें। तेंचि एथ जाणावें । प्रकृति हे गा॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kṣetra yeṇeṃ nāṃveṃ ||| jeṃ sāṃgitaleṃ āghaveṃ| teṃci etha jāṇāveṃ | prakṛti he gā|| 63||
verses.meaning: Indeed, what has been described as the 'field' (Kshetra), know that to be Prakriti (primordial nature) here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि क्षेत्रज्ञ ऐसें।॥ जयातें म्हणितलें असे। तो पुरुष हें अनारिसें। न बोलो घेई ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi kṣetrajña aiseṃ||| jayāteṃ mhaṇitaleṃ ase| to puruṣa heṃ anāriseṃ| na bolo gheī || 64||
verses.meaning: And that Purusha, who is called the Knower of the Field, does not allow this to be spoken of as something different.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें आनानें नांवें । परि निरूप्य आन नोहे। हें लक्षण न चुकावें । पुढतपुढती ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ ānāneṃ nāṃveṃ | pari nirūpya āna nohe| heṃ lakṣaṇa na cukāveṃ | puḍhatapuḍhatī || 65||
verses.meaning: Though the names may differ, the essence being described remains the same. This characteristic should not be forgotten, again and again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी केवळ जे सत्ता। तो पुरुष गा पंडुसुता । प्रकृतीतें समस्तां । क्रिया नाम ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kevaḻa je sattā| to puruṣa gā paṃḍusutā | prakṛtīteṃ samastāṃ | kriyā nāma || 66||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, that which is pure existence is Purusha, and the entire Prakriti is known as action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुद्धि इंद्रियें अंतःकरण । इत्यादि विकारभरण । आणि ते तिन्ही गुण। सत्त्वादिक ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: buddhi iṃdriyeṃ aṃtaḥkaraṇa | ityādi vikārabharaṇa | āṇi te tinhī guṇa| sattvādika || 67||
verses.meaning: The intellect, senses, and inner mind, along with other modifications, and the three qualities of Sattva and others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा आघवाचि मेळावा । प्रकृती जाहला जाणावा । हेचि हेतु संभवा। कर्माचिया॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā āghavāci meḻāvā | prakṛtī jāhalā jāṇāvā | heci hetu saṃbhavā| karmāciyā|| 68||
verses.meaning: Understand that this entire gathering is born of Prakriti (primordial nature), and this is the very cause of all actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ इच्छा आणि बुद्धी। घडवी अहंकारेंसीं आधीं । मग तिया लाविती वेधीं।॥ कारणाच्या ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha icchā āṇi buddhī| ghaḍavī ahaṃkāreṃsīṃ ādhīṃ | maga tiyā lāvitī vedhīṃ||| kāraṇācyā || 69||
verses.meaning: There, desire and intellect, along with ego, first create the world, and then they direct it towards the causal principle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि कारण ठाकावया। जें सूत्र धरणें उपाया । तया नांव धनंजया। कार्य पैं गा॥ ९७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci kāraṇa ṭhākāvayā| jeṃ sūtra dharaṇeṃ upāyā | tayā nāṃva dhanaṃjayā| kārya paiṃ gā|| 970||
verses.meaning: That which is the cause of all actions, that which holds the thread of all means, O Dhananjaya, that indeed is called action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि इच्छा मदाच्या थावीं। 'लागली मनातें उठवी । तें इंद्रियें राहाटवी। हें कर्तृत्व पैं गा ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi icchā madācyā thāvīṃ| 'lāgalī manāteṃ uṭhavī | teṃ iṃdriyeṃ rāhāṭavī| heṃ kartṛtva paiṃ gā || 71||
verses.meaning: And when the mind is stirred by the intoxication of desire, it sets the senses into motion; this indeed is its agency.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तीन्ही या जाणा । कार्यकर्तृत्वकारणा। प्रकृति मूळ हे राणा । सिद्धांचा म्हणे॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tīnhī yā jāṇā | kāryakartṛtvakāraṇā| prakṛti mūḻa he rāṇā | siddhāṃcā mhaṇe|| 72||
verses.meaning: Therefore, know that these three—the doer, the deed, and the cause—have their root in Prakriti, O King, say the perfected ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं तिहींचेनि समवायें। प्रकृति कर्मरूप होये। परि जया गुणा वाढे त्राये। त्याचि सारिखी॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ tihīṃceni samavāyeṃ| prakṛti karmarūpa hoye| pari jayā guṇā vāḍhe trāye| tyāci sārikhī|| 73||
verses.meaning: Thus, through the combination of these three (gunas), Prakriti takes the form of action. However, it aligns itself with whichever guna becomes predominant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें सत्त्वगुणें अधिष्ठिजे। तें सत्कर्म म्हणिजे। रजोगुणें निफजे। मध्यम तें ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sattvaguṇeṃ adhiṣṭhije| teṃ satkarma mhaṇije| rajoguṇeṃ niphaje| madhyama teṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: That which is founded on the quality of goodness (sattva) is called a good action. That which arises from the quality of passion (rajas) is considered mediocre.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें कां केवळ तमें। होतीं जिये कर्मे । निषिद्धें अधमें। जाण तियें ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ kāṃ kevaḻa tameṃ| hotīṃ jiye karme | niṣiddheṃ adhameṃ| jāṇa tiyeṃ || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Know that those actions which are born purely of ignorance, those forbidden and base deeds, are indeed such.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि संतासंतें । कर्मे प्रकृतीस्तव होतें। तयापासोनि निर्वाळतें। सुखदुःख गा॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni saṃtāsaṃteṃ | karme prakṛtīstava hoteṃ| tayāpāsoni nirvāḻateṃ| sukhaduḥkha gā|| 76||
verses.meaning: Thus, good and bad deeds arise from nature, and from them, happiness and sorrow are determined.

verses.shloka_devanagari: असंतीं दुःख उपजे। सत्कर्मी सुख निफजे । तया दोहींचा बोलिजे । भोगु पुरुषा ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: asaṃtīṃ duḥkha upaje| satkarmī sukha niphaje | tayā dohīṃcā bolije | bhogu puruṣā || 77||
verses.meaning: Sorrow arises from unrighteous deeds, and happiness is born from righteous actions. The experience of both is said to be the lot of a person.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुखदुःखें जंवबरी। निफजती साचोकारीं। तंव प्रकृति उद्यमु करी। पुरुषु भोगी ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sukhaduḥkheṃ jaṃvabarī| niphajatī sācokārīṃ| taṃva prakṛti udyamu karī| puruṣu bhogī || 78||
verses.meaning: As long as happiness and sorrow truly manifest, Prakriti (nature) continues its activity, and Purusha (the self) experiences them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रकृतिपुरुषांची कुळवाडी । सांगतां असंगडी। जे आंबुली जोडी । आंबुला खाय॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: prakṛtipuruṣāṃcī kuḻavāḍī | sāṃgatāṃ asaṃgaḍī| je āṃbulī joḍī | āṃbulā khāya|| 79||
verses.meaning: The lineage of Prakriti and Purusha is difficult to explain, like a sour fruit that consumes its own sourness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंबुला आंबुलिये। संगती ना सोये। कीं आंबुली जग विये। चोज ऐका ॥ ९८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃbulā āṃbuliye| saṃgatī nā soye| kīṃ āṃbulī jaga viye| coja aikā || 980||
verses.meaning: Listen to this wonder: the sourness in the tamarind fruit does not have a separate companion, nor does the tamarind fruit itself give birth to the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे अनंगु तो पेंधा। निकवडा नुसधा। जीर्णु अतिवृद्धा-। पासोनि वृद्ध ॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: je anaṃgu to peṃdhā| nikavaḍā nusadhā| jīrṇu ativṛddhā-| pāsoni vṛddha ||81||
verses.meaning: That which is formless is the very root, pure and unadulterated, older than the most ancient and aged.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया आडनांव पुरुषु। एऱ्हवीं स्त्री ना नपुंसकु । किंबहुना एकु । निश्चयो नाहीं ॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā āḍanāṃva puruṣu| eṟhavīṃ strī nā napuṃsaku | kiṃbahunā eku | niścayo nāhīṃ ||82||
verses.meaning: That Supreme Being has no specific name or gender; it is neither male, female, nor neuter. Indeed, there is no single definitive characteristic that can describe it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अचक्षु अश्रवणु। अहस्तु अचरणु। रूप ना वर्णु। नाम आथी॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to acakṣu aśravaṇu| ahastu acaraṇu| rūpa nā varṇu| nāma āthī|| 83||
verses.meaning: That (Brahman) is without eyes, without ears, without hands, without feet. It has no form or color, yet it has a name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना कांहींचि जेथ नाहीं। तो प्रकृतीचा भरर्ता पाहीं । कीं भोगणें ऐसयाही । सुखदुःखांचें ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā kāṃhīṃci jetha nāhīṃ| to prakṛtīcā bharartā pāhīṃ | kīṃ bhogaṇeṃ aisayāhī | sukhaduḥkhāṃceṃ || 84||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, where there is absolutely nothing, know that He is the sustainer of Prakriti, and also the experiencer of pleasures and pains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो तरी अकर्ता । उदासु अभोक्ता। परि इया पतित्रता। भोगविजे॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: to tarī akartā | udāsu abhoktā| pari iyā patitratā| bhogavije|| 85||
verses.meaning: Though He is not the doer, nor the enjoyer, nor attached, yet by this chaste devotion, He is made to experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जियेतें अळुमाळु । रूपागुणाचा चाळढाळु। ते भलतैसाही खेळु । लेखा आणी ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiyeteṃ aḻumāḻu | rūpāguṇācā cāḻaḍhāḻu| te bhalataisāhī kheḻu | lekhā āṇī || 86||
verses.meaning: Even a slight manifestation of the divine form and qualities, however playful, brings everything into account.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मा इये प्रकृती तंव। गुणमयी हेंचि नांब। किंबहुना सावेब। गुण तेचि हे॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mā iye prakṛtī taṃva| guṇamayī heṃci nāṃba| kiṃbahunā sāveba| guṇa teci he|| 87||
verses.meaning: In this way, this very nature is called 'Gunamayi' (full of qualities). In short, these very qualities are its essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे प्रतिक्षणीं नित्य नवी । रूपागुणाचीच आघवी । जडातेंही माजवी । इयेचा माजु॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: he pratikṣaṇīṃ nitya navī | rūpāguṇācīca āghavī | jaḍāteṃhī mājavī | iyecā māju|| 88||
verses.meaning: This (creation), ever new at every moment, is entirely composed of form and qualities. It even intoxicates the inert with its exuberance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नामें इयें प्रसिद्धें। स्नेहो इया स्निग्धें। इंद्रियें प्रबुद्धें । इयेचेनि॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāmeṃ iyeṃ prasiddheṃ| sneho iyā snigdheṃ| iṃdriyeṃ prabuddheṃ | iyeceni|| 89||
verses.meaning: By these names, the senses become renowned and vibrant, filled with affection and awakened by their influence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कायि मन हें नपुंसक। कीं तें भोगवी तिन्ही लोक । ऐसें ऐसें अलौकिक । करणें इयेचें॥ ९९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāyi mana heṃ napuṃsaka| kīṃ teṃ bhogavī tinhī loka | aiseṃ aiseṃ alaukika | karaṇeṃ iyeceṃ|| 990||
verses.meaning: Is the mind impotent, or does it make one experience all three worlds? Such extraordinary deeds are its doing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे भ्रमाचें महाद्वीप। हे व्याप्तीचें रूप। विकार उमप। इया केळे॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: he bhramāceṃ mahādvīpa| he vyāptīceṃ rūpa| vikāra umapa| iyā keḻe|| 91||
verses.meaning: This is a great continent of illusion, a form of pervasiveness, with countless modifications, all born from this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे कामाची मांडवी । हे मोहवनींची माधवी । इये प्रसिद्धचि देवी। माया हें नाम॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: he kāmācī māṃḍavī | he mohavanīṃcī mādhavī | iye prasiddhaci devī| māyā heṃ nāma|| 92||
verses.meaning: This is the canopy of desires, this is the spring of infatuation. This well-known goddess is called Maya.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे वाडूमयाची वाढी । हे साकारपणाची जोडी । प्रपंचाची धाडी। अभंग हे॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: he vāḍūmayācī vāḍhī | he sākārapaṇācī joḍī | prapaṃcācī dhāḍī| abhaṃga he|| 93||
verses.meaning: This is the growth of literature, this is the companionship of embodiment, this is the attack on worldly existence, this is imperishable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कळा एथूनि जालिया । विद्या इयेच्या केलिया । इच्छा ज्ञान क्रिया । वियाली हे॥९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaḻā ethūni jāliyā | vidyā iyecyā keliyā | icchā jñāna kriyā | viyālī he||94||
verses.meaning: From this very source, all arts have originated, and all knowledge has been created. It is from this that desire, knowledge, and action have been born.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे नादाची टांकसाळ हे चमत्काराचें वेळाउळ। किंबहुना सकळ। खेळु इयेचा॥ ९५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: he nādācī ṭāṃkasāḻa he camatkārāceṃ veḻāuḻa| kiṃbahunā sakaḻa| kheḻu iyecā|| 95 ||
verses.meaning: This is the mint of sound, this is the temple of miracles. Indeed, all play is hers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे उत्पत्ति प्रलयो होत। ते इयेचे सायंप्रात। हें असो अदभुत । मोहन हे॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: je utpatti pralayo hota| te iyece sāyaṃprāta| heṃ aso adabhuta | mohana he|| 96||
verses.meaning: What are creation and dissolution are but her dawn and dusk. Let this be, for it is a wondrous enchantment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे अट्वयाचें दुसरें। हे निःसंगाचें सोयरें। हे निराळेंसि घरें । नांदत असे॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: he aṭvayāceṃ dusareṃ| he niḥsaṃgāceṃ soyareṃ| he nirāḻeṃsi ghareṃ | nāṃdata ase|| 97||
verses.meaning: This is the second of the eightfold path, the companion of the unattached, the home of the detached, where it resides.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयेतें येतुलावरी । सौभाग्यव्याप्तीची थोरी । म्हणौनि तया आवरी । अनावरातें॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeteṃ yetulāvarī | saubhāgyavyāptīcī thorī | mhaṇauni tayā āvarī | anāvarāteṃ|| 98||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the greatness of this auspiciousness is so profound that it encompasses even the uncontrollable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाच्या तंव ठायीं। निपटूनि कांहींचि नाहीं।॥ कीं तया आघवेंही । आपणचि होय॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayācyā taṃva ṭhāyīṃ| nipaṭūni kāṃhīṃci nāhīṃ||| kīṃ tayā āghaveṃhī | āpaṇaci hoya|| 99||
verses.meaning: In that state, there is absolutely nothing left to be done, or rather, everything becomes oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया स्वयंभाची संभूती । तया अमपूर्ताची मूर्ती। आपण होय स्थिती। ठावो तया॥ १०००॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā svayaṃbhācī saṃbhūtī | tayā amapūrtācī mūrtī| āpaṇa hoya sthitī| ṭhāvo tayā|| 1000||
verses.meaning: That very self-existent being, the embodiment of the formless, becomes the state of being, and that is its abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अनार्ताची आर्ती। तया पूर्णाची तृप्ती तया अकुळाची जाती-। गोत होय॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā anārtācī ārtī| tayā pūrṇācī tṛptī tayā akuḻācī jātī-| gota hoya|| 1||
verses.meaning: For that one who has no distress, it is distress; for that complete one, it is satisfaction; for that one without lineage, it is family and clan.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अचर्चार्चे चिन्ह। तया अपाराचें मान। तया अमनस्काचें ३श्ड श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी मन। बुद्धीही होय॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā acarcārce cinha| tayā apārāceṃ māna| tayā amanaskāceṃ 3śḍa śrījñāneśvarī mana| buddhīhī hoya|| 2||
verses.meaning: The sign of that unmoving, the measure of that infinite, the mind and intellect of that formless, is indeed Shri Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया निराकाराचा आकारु । तया निर्व्यापाराचा व्यापारु । निरहंकाराचा अहंकारु ।॥ होऊनि ठाके ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā nirākārācā ākāru | tayā nirvyāpārācā vyāpāru | nirahaṃkārācā ahaṃkāru ||| hoūni ṭhāke || 3||
verses.meaning: That formless one takes on form; that actionless one engages in action; that egoless one becomes the ego.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अनामाचें नाम । तया अजाचें जन्म। आपण होय कर्म-। क्रिया तया॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā anāmāceṃ nāma | tayā ajāceṃ janma| āpaṇa hoya karma-| kriyā tayā|| 4||
verses.meaning: Of that nameless one, the name; of that unborn one, the birth; He Himself becomes the action and the deed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया निर्गुणाचे गुण। अचरणाचे चरण। तया अश्रवणाचे श्रवण। अचक्षूचे चक्षु॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā nirguṇāce guṇa| acaraṇāce caraṇa| tayā aśravaṇāce śravaṇa| acakṣūce cakṣu|| 5||
verses.meaning: He is the qualities of the attributeless, the feet of the footless, the hearing of the earless, and the eyes of the sightless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया भावातीताचे भाव। तया निरवयवाचे अवयव। किंबहुना होय सर्व । पुरुषाचें हे॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā bhāvātītāce bhāva| tayā niravayavāce avayava| kiṃbahunā hoya sarva | puruṣāceṃ he|| 6||
verses.meaning: The very essence of that which transcends all states of being, the limbs of that which is without parts, indeed, all of this becomes the Purusha (the Supreme Being).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि इया प्रकृती। आपुलिया सर्व व्याप्ती। तया अविकारातें विकृती-। माजीं कौजे॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni iyā prakṛtī| āpuliyā sarva vyāptī| tayā avikārāteṃ vikṛtī-| mājīṃ kauje|| 7||
verses.meaning: In this way, through its all-pervading nature, Prakriti causes that unchangeable (Brahman) to appear as if it has undergone change.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ पुरुषत्व जें असे| तें ये इये प्रकतिदशे। चंद्रमा अंबसे। पडिळा जैसा॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha puruṣatva jeṃ ase| teṃ ye iye prakatidaśe| caṃdramā aṃbase| paḍiḻā jaisā||8||
verses.meaning: There, the Purusha, which is of the nature of masculinity, falls into the state of Prakriti, just as the moon falls into the new moon night.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विदळ बहु चोखा । मीनलिया वाळा एका। कसु होय पांचका। जयापरी॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vidaḻa bahu cokhā | mīnaliyā vāḻā ekā| kasu hoya pāṃcakā| jayāparī|| 9||
verses.meaning: Just as a worthless pebble, when mixed with a precious gem, does not become valuable itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां साधूतें गोंधळी । संचरोनि सुये मैळीं । नाना सुदिनाचा आभाळीं । दुर्दिनु कीजे॥ १०१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ sādhūteṃ goṃdhaḻī | saṃcaroni suye maiḻīṃ | nānā sudinācā ābhāḻīṃ | durdinu kīje|| 1010||
verses.meaning: Or, as a performer, having entered a holy place, defiles it; or as a good day is turned into a bad one by clouds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेवीं पय पशूच्या पोटीं। कां वन्हि जैसा काष्ठीं। गुंडूनि घेतला पटीं । रत्नदीपु॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jevīṃ paya paśūcyā poṭīṃ| kāṃ vanhi jaisā kāṣṭhīṃ| guṃḍūni ghetalā paṭīṃ | ratnadīpu|| 91||
verses.meaning: Just as milk is within the body of a cow, or fire is hidden within wood, or a radiant lamp is concealed within a cloth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: राजा पराधीनु जाहला । कीं सिंहु रोगें रुंधला । तैसा पुरुष प्रकृती आला । स्वतेजा मुके ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: rājā parādhīnu jāhalā | kīṃ siṃhu rogeṃ ruṃdhalā | taisā puruṣa prakṛtī ālā | svatejā muke || 92||
verses.meaning: When a king becomes dependent, or a lion is confined by illness, similarly, a man who comes under the sway of Prakriti loses his inherent brilliance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जागता नरु सहसा। निद्रा पाडूनि जैसा। स्वप्नींचिया सोसा। वश्यु कौजे॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jāgatā naru sahasā| nidrā pāḍūni jaisā| svapnīṃciyā sosā| vaśyu kauje|| 13||
verses.meaning: Just as a person, while awake, suddenly falls asleep and becomes subject to the desires of dreams.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें प्रकृति जालेपणें । पुरुषा गुण भोगणें । उदास अंतुरीगुणें। आतुडे जेवीं ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ prakṛti jālepaṇeṃ | puruṣā guṇa bhogaṇeṃ | udāsa aṃturīguṇeṃ| ātuḍe jevīṃ || 14||
verses.meaning: Just as a man, by being born into a body, experiences the qualities of nature, so too does he become entangled by the indifferent qualities of the inner self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें अजा नित्या होये। आंगीं जन्ममृत्यूचे घाये। वाजती जें लाहे । गुणसंगातें ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ ajā nityā hoye| āṃgīṃ janmamṛtyūce ghāye| vājatī jeṃ lāhe | guṇasaṃgāteṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Just as the unborn and eternal soul, through its association with the gunas (qualities of nature), experiences the blows of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि तें ऐसें पंडुसुता । तातळें लोह पिटितां। जेवीं बन्हीसीचि घाता । बोलती तया॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari teṃ aiseṃ paṃḍusutā | tātaḻeṃ loha piṭitāṃ| jevīṃ banhīsīci ghātā | bolatī tayā|| 16||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, it is like this: when iron is struck while hot, people say that the fire itself is being struck.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां आंदोळलिया उदक । प्रतिमा होय अनेक तें नानात्व म्हणती लोक । चंद्रीं जेवीं ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ āṃdoḻaliyā udaka | pratimā hoya aneka teṃ nānātva mhaṇatī loka | caṃdrīṃ jevīṃ || 17||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon's reflection appears manifold in disturbed water, people perceive this multiplicity as inherent to the moon itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दर्पणाचिया जवळिका। दुजेपण जेसें ये मुखा। कां कुंकुमें स्फटिका। लोहितत्व ये॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: darpaṇāciyā javaḻikā| dujepaṇa jeseṃ ye mukhā| kāṃ kuṃkumeṃ sphaṭikā| lohitatva ye|| 18||
verses.meaning: Just as a face appears as a second in the proximity of a mirror, or as a crystal acquires redness from vermilion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा गुणसंगमें। अजन्मा हा जन्मे। पावतु ऐसा गमे। एऱ्हवीं नाहीं ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā guṇasaṃgameṃ| ajanmā hā janme| pāvatu aisā game| eṟhavīṃ nāhīṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: In the same way, through association with the gunas, the unborn appears to be born; otherwise, it is not so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अधमोत्तमा योनी । यासि ऐसिया मानीं। जैसा संन्यासी होय स्वप्नीं । अंत्यजादि जाती॥ ९०२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: adhamottamā yonī | yāsi aisiyā mānīṃ| jaisā saṃnyāsī hoya svapnīṃ | aṃtyajādi jātī|| 9020||
verses.meaning: Consider these low and high births to be like a renunciate who, in a dream, becomes a person of the lowest caste.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि केवळा पुरुषा। नाहीं होणें भोगणें देखा। येथ गुणसंगुचि अशेखा-। लागीं मूळ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kevaḻā puruṣā| nāhīṃ hoṇeṃ bhogaṇeṃ dekhā| yetha guṇasaṃguci aśekhā-| lāgīṃ mūḻa|| 21||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for the pure Purusha, there is no experiencing or enjoying; rather, the association with the Gunas is the root cause for all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा प्रकृतिमाजीं उभा । परि जुई जैसा बोथंबा । इया प्रकृति पृथ्वी नभा । तेतुला पाडु॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā prakṛtimājīṃ ubhā | pari juī jaisā bothaṃbā | iyā prakṛti pṛthvī nabhā | tetulā pāḍu|| 22||
verses.meaning: He stands amidst nature, yet is like a seed that remains unsprouted. For Him, there is no difference between this earth and the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रकृतिसरितेच्या तटीं। मेरु होय हा किरीटी । माजीं बिंबे परी लोटीं। लोटों नेणें॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: prakṛtisaritecyā taṭīṃ| meru hoya hā kirīṭī | mājīṃ biṃbe parī loṭīṃ| loṭoṃ neṇeṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), just as the great Meru mountain, standing on the bank of a river, sees its reflection in the water, but is not swept away by the current, so too is the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रकृति होय जाये। हा तो असतुचि आहे। म्हणौनि आब्रह्माचें होये। शासन हा॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: prakṛti hoya jāye| hā to asatuci āhe| mhaṇauni ābrahmāceṃ hoye| śāsana hā|| 24||
verses.meaning: Nature itself becomes the ruler; this is its inherent state. Therefore, it governs everything, even up to Brahma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रकृति येणें जिये। याचिया सत्ता जग विये। इयालागीं इये। बरयेतु हा॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: prakṛti yeṇeṃ jiye| yāciyā sattā jaga viye| iyālāgīṃ iye| barayetu hā|| 25||
verses.meaning: By whose power nature gives birth to the world, for this reason, she is called the good one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनंतें काळें किरीटी। जिया मिळती इया सृष्टी। तिया रिगती ययाच्या पोटीं । कल्पांतसमयीं ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: anaṃteṃ kāḻeṃ kirīṭī| jiyā miḻatī iyā sṛṣṭī| tiyā rigatī yayācyā poṭīṃ | kalpāṃtasamayīṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, all these creations, which arise over endless ages, merge back into Him at the time of the cosmic dissolution.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा महट्रहागोसावी । ब्रह्मयोळ लाघवी । अपारपणें मवबी। प्रपंचातें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā mahaṭrahāgosāvī | brahmayoḻa lāghavī | apārapaṇeṃ mavabī| prapaṃcāteṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: This great sage, a master of Brahman, effortlessly encompasses the entire universe within himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं या देहामाझारीं। परमात्मा ऐसी जे परी । बोलिजे तें अवधारीं। ययातेंचि॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ yā dehāmājhārīṃ| paramātmā aisī je parī | bolije teṃ avadhārīṃ| yayāteṃci|| 28||
verses.meaning: Listen, the way the Supreme Soul is spoken of within this body, that is exactly what this refers to.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा प्रकृतिपरौता। एकु आथी पंडुसुता । ऐसा प्रवादु तो तत्त्वता । पुरुष हा पैं॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā prakṛtiparautā| eku āthī paṃḍusutā | aisā pravādu to tattvatā | puruṣa hā paiṃ|| 29||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, there is indeed one who is beyond Prakriti. This is truly the Purusha, as it is said.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो निखळपणें येणें। पुरुषा यया जाणे) आणि गुणाचें करणें । प्रकृतीचें तें॥ १०३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo nikhaḻapaṇeṃ yeṇeṃ| puruṣā yayā jāṇe) āṇi guṇāceṃ karaṇeṃ | prakṛtīceṃ teṃ|| 1030||
verses.meaning: One who truly understands that all actions are performed by the qualities of nature, and not by the self, truly knows the Purusha.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें रूप हे छाया । पैल जळ हे माया। ऐसा निवाडु धनंजया । जेवीं कीजे॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ rūpa he chāyā | paila jaḻa he māyā| aisā nivāḍu dhanaṃjayā | jevīṃ kīje|| 31||
verses.meaning: This form is but a shadow, that water a mere illusion; such is the discrimination, O Dhananjaya, that one should make.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें पाडें अर्जुना । प्रकृतिपुरु्षविवंचना । जयाचिया मना । गोचर जाहली ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ pāḍeṃ arjunā | prakṛtipuruṣavivaṃcanā | jayāciyā manā | gocara jāhalī || 32||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, to that extent, the distinction between Prakriti and Purusha becomes clear to the mind of one who understands it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो शरीराचेनि मेळें। करू कां कर्मे सकळें । परी आकाश धुई न मैळे। तैसा असे॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: to śarīrāceni meḻeṃ| karū kāṃ karme sakaḻeṃ | parī ākāśa dhuī na maiḻe| taisā ase|| 33||
verses.meaning: Even though the Self performs all actions in conjunction with the body, it remains untainted, just as the sky is not soiled by dust.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आथिलेनि देहें।॥ जो न घेपे देहमोहें। देह गेलिया नोहे। पुनरपि तो॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āthileni deheṃ||| jo na ghepe dehamoheṃ| deha geliyā nohe| punarapi to|| 34||
verses.meaning: The one who is not swayed by the illusion of the body, even while inhabiting it, will not be reborn into a body once this one perishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा तया एकु । प्रकृतिपुरुषविवेकु । उपकारु अलौकिकु। करी पैं गा॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā tayā eku | prakṛtipuruṣaviveku | upakāru alaukiku| karī paiṃ gā|| 35||
verses.meaning: Such a unique understanding of the distinction between Prakriti (matter) and Purusha (consciousness) bestows an extraordinary benefit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हाचि अंतरीं । विवेक भानूचियापरी। उदैजे ते अवधारीं। उपाय बहुत ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī hāci aṃtarīṃ | viveka bhānūciyāparī| udaije te avadhārīṃ| upāya bahuta || 36||
verses.meaning: But listen, there are many ways for this sun of discrimination to rise within the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कोणी एकु सुभटा। विचाराचा आगिटां। आत्मानात्मकिटा। पुटें देउनी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: koṇī eku subhaṭā| vicārācā āgiṭāṃ| ātmānātmakiṭā| puṭeṃ deunī || 37||
verses.meaning: Some brave warrior, with the fire of discrimination, by applying layers of self and non-self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: छत्तीसही वानीभेद। तोडोनियां निर्विवाद। निवडिती शुद्ध । आपणपें॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: chattīsahī vānībheda| toḍoniyāṃ nirvivāda| nivaḍitī śuddha | āpaṇapeṃ|| 38||
verses.meaning: They undoubtedly break through all thirty-six distinctions and purely choose their true Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया आपणपयाच्या पोटीं।॥। आत्मध्यानाचिया दिठी । देखती गा किरीटी। आपणपेंचि॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā āpaṇapayācyā poṭīṃ|||| ātmadhyānāciyā diṭhī | dekhatī gā kirīṭī| āpaṇapeṃci|| 39||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, they see their own self through the eye of self-realization, within their own being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणिक पैं दैवबगें। चित्त देती सांख्ययोगें। एक ते अंगलगें। कर्माचेनि॥ १०४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇika paiṃ daivabageṃ| citta detī sāṃkhyayogeṃ| eka te aṃgalageṃ| karmāceni|| 1040||
verses.meaning: And by the grace of destiny, some apply their minds to Sankhya Yoga, while others, by their very nature, are engaged in action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें येणें प्रकारें। निस्तरती साचोकारें। हें भवा भेउठरें। आघवेंचि॥ ४१ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ yeṇeṃ prakāreṃ| nistaratī sācokāreṃ| heṃ bhavā bheuṭhareṃ| āghaveṃci|| 41 ||
verses.meaning: In this way, truly, all the fears of worldly existence are overcome.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी ते करिती ऐसें । अभिमानु दवडूनि देशें। एकाचिया विश्‍्वासें।॥ टेंकती बोला॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī te karitī aiseṃ | abhimānu davaḍūni deśeṃ| ekāciyā viś‍vāseṃ||| ṭeṃkatī bolā|| 42||
verses.meaning: But they do this: casting aside all pride, they rely solely on the word of the Guru with unwavering faith.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे हिताहित देखती। हानिकणवा घेपती। पुसोनि शिणु हरिती। देती सुख॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je hitāhita dekhatī| hānikaṇavā ghepatī| pusoni śiṇu haritī| detī sukha|| 43||
verses.meaning: Those who discern what is beneficial and what is harmful, they take pity on the suffering and, by inquiring, remove their weariness, bestowing happiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयांचेनि मुखें जे निघे। तेतुलें आदरें चांगें । ऐकोनियां आंगें। मनें होती॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃceni mukheṃ je nighe| tetuleṃ ādareṃ cāṃgeṃ | aikoniyāṃ āṃgeṃ| maneṃ hotī|| 44||
verses.meaning: Whatever emanates from their mouths, that much is heard with good reverence, and by body and mind, they become one with it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया ऐकणेयाचि नांवें। ठेविती गा आधघवें॥ तया अक्षरांसी जीवें। लोण करिती॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā aikaṇeyāci nāṃveṃ| ṭhevitī gā ādhaghaveṃ|| tayā akṣarāṃsī jīveṃ| loṇa karitī|| 45||
verses.meaning: They give the name 'listening' to that very act, and they dedicate their lives to those words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेही अंतीं कपिध्बजा। इया मरणार्णबसमाजा-। पासूनि निघती बोजा । गोमटिया॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tehī aṃtīṃ kapidhbajā| iyā maraṇārṇabasamājā-| pāsūni nighatī bojā | gomaṭiyā|| 46||
verses.meaning: Even they, O Arjuna, will emerge from this ocean of death, carrying a good and auspicious burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेसे हे उपाये। बहुवस एथें पाहें।॥ जाणावया होये। एकी वस्तु ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisese he upāye| bahuvasa etheṃ pāheṃ||| jāṇāvayā hoye| ekī vastu || 47||
verses.meaning: These are the many means to know the one reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां पुरे हें बहुत। पैं सर्वार्थाचें मथित। सिद्धांतनवनीत । देऊं तुज॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ pure heṃ bahuta| paiṃ sarvārthāceṃ mathita| siddhāṃtanavanīta | deūṃ tuja|| 48||
verses.meaning: Now, enough of this extensive discourse. I will give you the butter, the essence, the ultimate conclusion of all meanings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलेनि पंडुसुता। अनुभव लाहाणा आयिता। येर तंब तुज होतां। सायास नाहीं ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetuleni paṃḍusutā| anubhava lāhāṇā āyitā| yera taṃba tuja hotāṃ| sāyāsa nāhīṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, with this understanding, the experience of the Self becomes readily available to you, and there is no need for any other effort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ते बुन्दि रचूं। मतवाद हे खांचूं। सोलींव निर्वचूं। फलितार्थूची ॥ ९०५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni te bundi racūṃ| matavāda he khāṃcūṃ| solīṃva nirvacūṃ| phalitārthūcī || 9050||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I shall construct this foundation, discard these differing opinions, and clearly explain the essence of the ultimate truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी क्षेत्रज्ञ येणें बोलें तुज आपणपें जें दाविलें। आणि क्षेत्रही सांगितलें) आधघवें जें ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kṣetrajña yeṇeṃ boleṃ tuja āpaṇapeṃ jeṃ dāvileṃ| āṇi kṣetrahī sāṃgitaleṃ) ādhaghaveṃ jeṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Thus, through these words, the Knower of the field has revealed Himself to you, and also fully described the field.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया येरयेरांच्या मेळीं । होइजे भूतीं सकळीं । अनिलसंगे सलिलीं । कल्लोळ जैसे॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā yerayerāṃcyā meḻīṃ | hoije bhūtīṃ sakaḻīṃ | anilasaṃge salilīṃ | kalloḻa jaise|| 52||
verses.meaning: In that mingling of one with another, one becomes all beings, just as waves arise in water through the agency of the wind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां तेजा आणि उखरा। भेटी जालिया वीरा । मृगजळाचिया पूरा। रूप होय ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ tejā āṇi ukharā| bheṭī jāliyā vīrā | mṛgajaḻāciyā pūrā| rūpa hoya || 53||
verses.meaning: Just as a mirage appears as a flood of water to a thirsty deer, so too does the world appear real to the ignorant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना धाराधरधारीं । झळंबळिया वसुंधरी। उठिजे जेवीं अंकुरीं। नानाविधीं ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā dhārādharadhārīṃ | jhaḻaṃbaḻiyā vasuṃdharī| uṭhije jevīṃ aṃkurīṃ| nānāvidhīṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: Just as the earth, burdened by various clouds, sprouts forth in diverse ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें चराचर आधवें। जें कांहीं जीवु नांवें। तें तो उभययोगें संभवे । ऐसें जाण ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ carācara ādhaveṃ| jeṃ kāṃhīṃ jīvu nāṃveṃ| teṃ to ubhayayogeṃ saṃbhave | aiseṃ jāṇa || 55 ||
verses.meaning: Understand that all animate and inanimate beings, whatever is called life, are born from the union of these two.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयालागीं अर्जुना । क्षेत्रज्ञा प्रधाना-। पासूनि न होती भिन्ना । भूतव्यक्‍ती ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyālāgīṃ arjunā | kṣetrajñā pradhānā-| pāsūni na hotī bhinnā | bhūtavyak‍tī || 56||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, the individual beings are not distinct from the Primal Consciousness, the Knower of the Field.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं पटत्ब तंतु नव्हे । तरी तंतूसीचि तें आहे। ऐसें खोलीं डोळां पाहें । ऐक्य हें गा॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ paṭatba taṃtu navhe | tarī taṃtūsīci teṃ āhe| aiseṃ kholīṃ ḍoḻāṃ pāheṃ | aikya heṃ gā|| 57||
verses.meaning: Just as the cloth is not different from the threads, but rather the threads themselves are the cloth, so too, if you look deeply, you will see this oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भूतें आघवींचि होती। एकाचीं एक आहाती । परी तूं प्रतीती । यांची घे पां॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhūteṃ āghavīṃci hotī| ekācīṃ eka āhātī | parī tūṃ pratītī | yāṃcī ghe pāṃ|| 58||
verses.meaning: All beings are indeed one, belonging to each other. But you must experience this truth for yourself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यांचीं नामेंही आनानें। अनारिसीं वर्तनें। वेषही सिनानें। आघवेयांचे ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāṃcīṃ nāmeṃhī ānāneṃ| anārisīṃ vartaneṃ| veṣahī sināneṃ| āghaveyāṃce ||59||
verses.meaning: Their names are different, their behaviors are unusual, and their appearances are also distinct from everyone else.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें देखोनि किरीटी। भेद सूसी हन पोटीं । तरी जन्माचिया कोटी। न लाहसी निघों॥ १०६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ dekhoni kirīṭī| bheda sūsī hana poṭīṃ | tarī janmāciyā koṭī| na lāhasī nighoṃ|| 1060||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, if you see such distinctions in your heart, then for millions of births you will not be able to escape.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं नानाप्रयोजनशीळें । दीर्घे वक्रे वर्तुळें। होती एकाचींच फळें । तुंबिणीयेचीं ॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ nānāprayojanaśīḻeṃ | dīrghe vakre vartuḻeṃ| hotī ekācīṃca phaḻeṃ | tuṃbiṇīyecīṃ ||61||
verses.meaning: Just as a single gourd plant yields fruits of various shapes and sizes—some long, some curved, some round—all serving different purposes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: होतु कां उजू बांकुडें। परी बोरीचें हें न मोडे । तैसीं भूतें अबघडें । परी बस्तु उजू॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hotu kāṃ ujū bāṃkuḍeṃ| parī borīceṃ heṃ na moḍe | taisīṃ bhūteṃ abaghaḍeṃ | parī bastu ujū|| 62||
verses.meaning: Whether straight or crooked, the nature of the thornbush does not change. Similarly, beings may be difficult to comprehend, but the ultimate reality (Brahman) is always straightforward and true.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अंगारकणीं बहुवसीं। उष्णता समान जैशी । तैसा नाना जीवराशीं। परेशु असे॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aṃgārakaṇīṃ bahuvasīṃ| uṣṇatā samāna jaiśī | taisā nānā jīvarāśīṃ| pareśu ase|| 63||
verses.meaning: Just as the heat is uniformly present in countless embers, so too is the Supreme Lord present in various living beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गगनभरी धारा । परी पाणी एकचि वीरा । तैसा या भूताकारा । सर्वांगी तो॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: gaganabharī dhārā | parī pāṇī ekaci vīrā | taisā yā bhūtākārā | sarvāṃgī to|| 64||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky is filled with rain, yet the water is one and the same, so too is He present in all beings, pervading their entire form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे भूतग्राम विषम। परी वस्तु ते एथ सम। घटमठीं व्योम । जियापरी ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: he bhūtagrāma viṣama| parī vastu te etha sama| ghaṭamaṭhīṃ vyoma | jiyāparī || 65||
verses.meaning: Though the multitude of beings are diverse, the underlying reality is the same, just as the sky is uniformly present in a pot and in a monastery.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा नाशतां भूताभासु। एथ आत्मा तो अविनाशु । जैसा केयूरादिकीं कसु। सुवर्णाचा ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā nāśatāṃ bhūtābhāsu| etha ātmā to avināśu | jaisā keyūrādikīṃ kasu| suvarṇācā || 66||
verses.meaning: This world of beings is an illusion, but the Self within is imperishable, just as the gold in an armlet or other ornaments remains gold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं जीवधर्महीनु। जो जीवेंसीं अभिन्नु। देखे तो सुनयनु । ज्ञानियांमाजीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ jīvadharmahīnu| jo jīveṃsīṃ abhinnu| dekhe to sunayanu | jñāniyāṃmājīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Thus, one who is devoid of the attributes of a living being, yet sees himself as one with all beings, is truly the one with beautiful eyes, the foremost among the wise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानाचा डोळा डोळसां-। माजीं डोळसु तो वीरेशा। हे स्तुति नोहे बहुवसा । भाग्याचा तो॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñānācā ḍoḻā ḍoḻasāṃ-| mājīṃ ḍoḻasu to vīreśā| he stuti nohe bahuvasā | bhāgyācā to|| 68||
verses.meaning: Among those with the eye of knowledge, the most discerning is Viresha. This is not mere praise, but a great fortune.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे गुणेंद्रिय धोकोटी । देह धातूंची त्रिकुटी । पांचमेळावा बोखटी । दारुण हे॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: he guṇeṃdriya dhokoṭī | deha dhātūṃcī trikuṭī | pāṃcameḻāvā bokhaṭī | dāruṇa he||69||
verses.meaning: This body, a bundle of senses, a combination of the three humors, and a wretched mixture of the five elements, is indeed terrible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे उघड पांचवेउली। पंचधां आगीं लागली । जीवपंचानना सांपडली । हरिणकुटी हे॥ १०७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he ughaḍa pāṃcaveulī| paṃcadhāṃ āgīṃ lāgalī | jīvapaṃcānanā sāṃpaḍalī | hariṇakuṭī he|| 1070||
verses.meaning: This body, composed of five elements, is caught in the fire of five senses, like a deer caught by a lion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा असोनि इये शरीरीं।॥। कोण नित्यबुद्धीची सुरी। अनित्यभावाच्या उदरीं । दाटीचिना ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā asoni iye śarīrīṃ|||| koṇa nityabuddhīcī surī| anityabhāvācyā udarīṃ | dāṭīcinā || 71||
verses.meaning: Even though the Self resides in this body, who is there whose intellect, like a sharp knife, does not penetrate the impermanent nature of things?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी इये देहीं असतां। जो न येचि आपणया घाता । आणि शेखीं पंडुसुता । तेथेंचि मिळे ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī iye dehīṃ asatāṃ| jo na yeci āpaṇayā ghātā | āṇi śekhīṃ paṃḍusutā | tetheṃci miḻe || 72||
verses.meaning: But while residing in this body, one who does not cause harm to oneself, O son of Pandu, ultimately merges there (with the divine).

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ योगज्ञानाचिया प्रौढी । बोलांडूनियां जन्मकोडी। न निगों इया भाषा बुडी। देती योगी ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha yogajñānāciyā prauḍhī | bolāṃḍūniyāṃ janmakoḍī| na nigoṃ iyā bhāṣā buḍī| detī yogī || 73||
verses.meaning: Where the profound knowledge of Yoga transcends countless births, yogis, through this profound immersion, do not emerge into the cycle of rebirth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें आकाराचें पैल तीर। जें नादाची पैल मेर। तुर्येचें माजघर। परब्रह्म जें ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ ākārāceṃ paila tīra| jeṃ nādācī paila mera| turyeceṃ mājaghara| parabrahma jeṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: That which is beyond all form, that which is beyond all sound, that which is the very center of Turiya – that is the Supreme Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोक्षासकट गती । जेथें येती विश्रांती । गंगादि आपांपती । सरिता जेवीं ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mokṣāsakaṭa gatī | jetheṃ yetī viśrāṃtī | gaṃgādi āpāṃpatī | saritā jevīṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Where all paths, including that to liberation, find their ultimate rest, just as all rivers, including the Ganges, merge into the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें सुख येणेंचि देहें। पाय 'पाखाळणिया लाहे। जो भूतवैषम्यें नोहे । विषमबुन््धी ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ sukha yeṇeṃci deheṃ| pāya 'pākhāḻaṇiyā lāhe| jo bhūtavaiṣamyeṃ nohe | viṣamabundhī || 76||
verses.meaning: That joy is attained by the very body that, through the cleansing of the feet (of the Guru), does not hold a divisive intellect due to the inequalities of beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दीपांचिया कोडीं जैसें एकचि तेज सरिसें। तैसा जो असतुचि असे । सर्वत्र ईशु ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dīpāṃciyā koḍīṃ jaiseṃ ekaci teja sariseṃ| taisā jo asatuci ase | sarvatra īśu || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as the light from a million lamps is uniformly one, so too is the Lord, who exists everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि समत्वें पंडुसुता। जिये जो देखतसाता। तो मरण आणि जीविता। नागवे फुडा॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni samatveṃ paṃḍusutā| jiye jo dekhatasātā| to maraṇa āṇi jīvitā| nāgave phuḍā|| 78||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, one who thus perceives equality in all beings, truly transcends both death and life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तो दैवागळा। वानीत असो वेळोवेळां। जे साम्यसेजे डोळा। लागला तया ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni to daivāgaḻā| vānīta aso veḻoveḻāṃ| je sāmyaseje ḍoḻā| lāgalā tayā || 79||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that fortunate one, time and again, praises the state of equanimity, for his eyes have become accustomed to it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मनोबुद्िप्रमुखें । कर्मेंद्रिये अशेखें । करी प्रकृतीचि हें देखे । साच जो गा॥ १०८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi manobudipramukheṃ | karmeṃdriye aśekheṃ | karī prakṛtīci heṃ dekhe | sāca jo gā|| 1080||
verses.meaning: And the mind, intellect, and all the organs of action—these are all truly seen to be the work of Prakriti (primordial nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: घरींचीं राहटतीं घरीं। घर कांहीं न करी । अभ्र धांबें अंबरीं। अंबर तें उगें॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: gharīṃcīṃ rāhaṭatīṃ gharīṃ| ghara kāṃhīṃ na karī | abhra dhāṃbeṃ aṃbarīṃ| aṃbara teṃ ugeṃ||81||
verses.meaning: Just as things move within a house, but the house itself does nothing; and clouds drift in the sky, but the sky remains still.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी प्रकृती आत्मप्रभा। खेळे गुणीं विविधारंभा। येथ आत्मा तो बोथंबा। नेणे कोण॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī prakṛtī ātmaprabhā| kheḻe guṇīṃ vividhāraṃbhā| yetha ātmā to bothaṃbā| neṇe koṇa|| 82||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the Prakriti (nature) plays with its diverse qualities, illuminated by the light of the Atman (Self). Yet, the Atman remains unaware of this play, like a mere support.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि येणें निवाडें । जयाच्या जीवीं उजिवबडें। अकर्तयातें फुडें। देखिलें तेणें ॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni yeṇeṃ nivāḍeṃ | jayācyā jīvīṃ ujivabaḍeṃ| akartayāteṃ phuḍeṃ| dekhileṃ teṇeṃ ||83||
verses.meaning: In this way, with such a clear and decisive understanding, in whose heart light dawns, he has truly seen the Non-doer (the ultimate reality) before him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तैंचि अर्जुना। होईजे ब्रह्मसंपन्ना। जैं या भूताकृती भिन्ना। दिसती एकी॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ taiṃci arjunā| hoīje brahmasaṃpannā| jaiṃ yā bhūtākṛtī bhinnā| disatī ekī|| 84||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, one becomes Brahman-realized when all these diverse forms of beings are seen as one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लहरी जैसिया जळीं। परमाणुकणिका स्थळीं । रश्मीकरमंडळीं। सूर्याच्या जेवीं ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: laharī jaisiyā jaḻīṃ| paramāṇukaṇikā sthaḻīṃ | raśmīkaramaṃḍaḻīṃ| sūryācyā jevīṃ || 85 ||
verses.meaning: Just as waves are in water, and atomic particles are on land, so too are the rays of light from the sun.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी देहीं अवेव। मनीं आघवेचि भाव। विस्फुलिंग सावेव। वन्हीं एकीं ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī dehīṃ aveva| manīṃ āghaveci bhāva| visphuliṃga sāveva| vanhīṃ ekīṃ || 86||
verses.meaning: Just as all the limbs are in the body, and all feelings are in the mind, so too are all sparks contained within a single fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे भूताकार एकाचे । हें दिठी रिगे जें साचें । तैंचि ब्रह्मसंपत्तीचें । तारूं लागे ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise bhūtākāra ekāce | heṃ diṭhī rige jeṃ sāceṃ | taiṃci brahmasaṃpattīceṃ | tārūṃ lāge || 87||
verses.meaning: When one truly perceives the form of all beings as one, then the ship of Brahman's wealth begins its journey.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग जयातयाकडे । ब्रहोंचि दिठी उघडे। किंबहुना जोडे। अपार सुख॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga jayātayākaḍe | brahoṃci diṭhī ughaḍe| kiṃbahunā joḍe| apāra sukha|| 88||
verses.meaning: Then, for one towards whom the eye of Brahman opens, or rather, one who attains immeasurable bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलेनि तुज पार्था । प्रकृतिपुरुषव्यवस्था । ठायें ठावो प्रतीतिपथा-। माजीं जाहळी॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetuleni tuja pārthā | prakṛtipuruṣavyavasthā | ṭhāyeṃ ṭhāvo pratītipathā-| mājīṃ jāhaḻī|| 89||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, through this explanation, the distinction between Prakriti (matter) and Purusha (consciousness) has become clear and evident to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अमृत जेसें ये चुळा। कां निधान देखिजे डोळां । तेतुला जिव्हाळा । मानावा हा॥ १०९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: amṛta jeseṃ ye cuḻā| kāṃ nidhāna dekhije ḍoḻāṃ | tetulā jivhāḻā | mānāvā hā|| 1090||
verses.meaning: Consider this (spiritual) affection to be like nectar held in the palm of one's hand, or like a treasure seen with one's own eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी जाहल्यि प्रतीती । घर बांधणें जें चित्तीं। तें आतां ना सुभद्रापती । इयावरी ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī jāhalyi pratītī | ghara bāṃdhaṇeṃ jeṃ cittīṃ| teṃ ātāṃ nā subhadrāpatī | iyāvarī || 91||
verses.meaning: The realization that has dawned, the mental construction of a home, O husband of Subhadra, will not be built upon this anymore.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी एक दोन्ही ते बोळ। बोलिजती सखोल देई मनातें बोळ। मग तें घेई । ९२॥ ऐसें देवें म्हणितलें। मग बोलो आदरिलें। तेथें अवबधानाचेंचि केलें। सर्वांग येरें॥९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī eka donhī te boḻa| bolijatī sakhola deī manāteṃ boḻa| maga teṃ gheī | 92|| aiseṃ deveṃ mhaṇitaleṃ| maga bolo ādarileṃ| tetheṃ avabadhānāceṃci keleṃ| sarvāṃga yereṃ||93||
verses.meaning: Though they are one, they are spoken of as two, deeply. Give your mind a passage, then it will grasp it. Thus spoke the Lord, and then began to speak. There, the entire being became attention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी परमात्मा म्हणिपे। तो ऐसा जाण स्वरूपें। जळीं जळें न लिंपे। सूर्य जैसा॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī paramātmā mhaṇipe| to aisā jāṇa svarūpeṃ| jaḻīṃ jaḻeṃ na liṃpe| sūrya jaisā|| 94||
verses.meaning: The Supreme Self is thus known by its nature: just as the sun is not stained by water, so too is it untouched by the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जे जळा आदीं पाठीं। तो असतुचि असे किरीटी। माजीं बिंबे तें दृष्टी। आणिकांचिये ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ je jaḻā ādīṃ pāṭhīṃ| to asatuci ase kirīṭī| mājīṃ biṃbe teṃ dṛṣṭī| āṇikāṃciye || 95||
verses.meaning: Just as water exists before and after, and the reflection within it is seen by others, so too is the true nature of reality. The reflection is not the water itself, but a temporary appearance. Similarly, the world we perceive is a reflection of the ultimate reality, which exists independently.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा आत्मा देहीं । आधि म्हणिपे हें कांहीं।॥ साचें तरी नाहीं। तो जेथिंचा तेथें ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā ātmā dehīṃ | ādhi mhaṇipe heṃ kāṃhīṃ||| sāceṃ tarī nāhīṃ| to jethiṃcā tetheṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the Self is said to be in the body, but this is not truly so. It remains where it always is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आरिसां मुख जेसें। बिंबळिया नाम असे। देहीं बसणें तैसें । आत्मतत्त्वा ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ārisāṃ mukha jeseṃ| biṃbaḻiyā nāma ase| dehīṃ basaṇeṃ taiseṃ | ātmatattvā || 97||
verses.meaning: Just as a reflection in a mirror is called an image, so too is the soul's dwelling in the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया देहा म्हणती भेटी। हे सपायी निर्जीब गोठी। वारिया वाळुवे गांठी। केंही आहे॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā dehā mhaṇatī bheṭī| he sapāyī nirjība goṭhī| vāriyā vāḻuve gāṃṭhī| keṃhī āhe|| 98||
verses.meaning: They call this body a meeting, but it is a lifeless thing, like tying the wind to sand. How can that be?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आगी आणि कापुसा। दोरा सुवाबा कैसा। केउता सादा आकाशा । पाषाणेंसीं ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āgī āṇi kāpusā| dorā suvābā kaisā| keutā sādā ākāśā | pāṣāṇeṃsīṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: How can a thread be made from fire and cotton? How can a stone be tied to the sky?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक निघे पूर्वेकडे । एक तें पश्‍चिमेकडे । तिये भेटीचेनि पाडें। संबंधु हा ॥ ११०० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka nighe pūrvekaḍe | eka teṃ paś‍cimekaḍe | tiye bheṭīceni pāḍeṃ| saṃbaṃdhu hā || 1100 ||
verses.meaning: One goes to the east, another to the west; their meeting is as rare as this relationship.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उजियेडा आणि अंधारेया। जो पाडु मृता उभेयां। तोचि गा आत्मया। देहा जाण॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: ujiyeḍā āṇi aṃdhāreyā| jo pāḍu mṛtā ubheyāṃ| toci gā ātmayā| dehā jāṇa|| 1||
verses.meaning: The difference between light and darkness, or between the living and the dead, is the same difference, know this, between the Atman and the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रात्री आणि दिवसा । 'कनका आणि कापुसा। अपाडु कां जैसा। तैसाचि यासी॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: rātrī āṇi divasā | 'kanakā āṇi kāpusā| apāḍu kāṃ jaisā| taisāci yāsī|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as there is a natural opposition between gold and cotton, so too is there between day and night.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देह तंव पांचांचें जालें। हें कर्माचे गुणीं गुंथलें। भंवतसे चाकी सूदलें। जन्ममृत्यूच्या ॥ ३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: deha taṃva pāṃcāṃceṃ jāleṃ| heṃ karmāce guṇīṃ guṃthaleṃ| bhaṃvatase cākī sūdaleṃ| janmamṛtyūcyā || 3 ||
verses.meaning: The body is made of five elements; it is entangled in the qualities of karma, and it revolves on the wheel of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें काळानळाच्या तोंडीं । घातली लोणियाची उंडी । माशी पांख्तु पाखडी । तंब हें सरे॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ kāḻānaḻācyā toṃḍīṃ | ghātalī loṇiyācī uṃḍī | māśī pāṃkhtu pākhaḍī | taṃba heṃ sare|| 4||
verses.meaning: This is like a lump of butter thrown into the mouth of the fire of time. Just as a fly flutters its wings, so too does this come to an end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें विपायें आगींत पडे। तरी भस्म होऊनि उडे। जाहलें शबाना वरपडें। तरी ते विष्ठा॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ vipāyeṃ āgīṃta paḍe| tarī bhasma hoūni uḍe| jāhaleṃ śabānā varapaḍeṃ| tarī te viṣṭhā|| 5||
verses.meaning: If this body falls into fire, it turns to ashes and disperses. If it becomes food for dogs, it turns into their excrement.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या चुके दोहीं काजा । तरी होय कृमींचा पुंजा। हा परिणामु कपिध्वजा। कश्मलु गा॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā cuke dohīṃ kājā | tarī hoya kṛmīṃcā puṃjā| hā pariṇāmu kapidhvajā| kaśmalu gā|| 6||
verses.meaning: If one fails in both these duties, then one becomes a heap of worms. This is the wretched outcome, O Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या देहाची हे दशा । आणि आत्मा तो एथ ऐसा । पैं नित्य सिद्ध आपैसा। अनादिपणें॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā dehācī he daśā | āṇi ātmā to etha aisā | paiṃ nitya siddha āpaisā| anādipaṇeṃ||7||
verses.meaning: Such is the state of this body, and the soul here is inherently eternal, self-existent, and without beginning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सकळु ना निष्कळु। अक्नियु ना क्रियाशीळु। कृश ना स्थूळु। निर्गुणपणें॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sakaḻu nā niṣkaḻu| akniyu nā kriyāśīḻu| kṛśa nā sthūḻu| nirguṇapaṇeṃ|| 8||
verses.meaning: He is neither whole nor part, neither inactive nor active, neither lean nor stout, for He is without attributes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आभासु ना निराभासु । प्रकाशु ना अप्रकाशु । अल्प ना बहुवसु। अरूपपणें ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ābhāsu nā nirābhāsu | prakāśu nā aprakāśu | alpa nā bahuvasu| arūpapaṇeṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Neither illusion nor reality, neither light nor darkness, neither little nor much, it exists in a formless state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रिता ना भरितु। रहितु ना सहितु। मूर्तु ना अपूर्तु। शून्यपणें ॥ १११०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ritā nā bharitu| rahitu nā sahitu| mūrtu nā apūrtu| śūnyapaṇeṃ || 1110||
verses.meaning: It is neither empty nor full, neither devoid nor accompanied, neither with form nor formless, in its state of nothingness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आनंदु ना निरानंदु) एकु ना विविधु। मुक्‍त ना बद्धु। आत्मपणें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ānaṃdu nā nirānaṃdu) eku nā vividhu| muk‍ta nā baddhu| ātmapaṇeṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: Neither joy nor sorrow, neither one nor many, neither liberated nor bound — such is the nature of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुला ना तेतुला । आइता ना रचिला । बोलता ना उगला । अलक्षपणें ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetulā nā tetulā | āitā nā racilā | bolatā nā ugalā | alakṣapaṇeṃ || 12||
verses.meaning: It is neither this nor that; it is neither created nor uncreated; it is neither spoken nor silent; it is beyond all perception.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सृष्टीचां होणां न रचे। सर्वसंहारें न वेंचे। आथी नाथी या दोहींचें । पंचत्व तो॥१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sṛṣṭīcāṃ hoṇāṃ na race| sarvasaṃhāreṃ na veṃce| āthī nāthī yā dohīṃceṃ | paṃcatva to||13||
verses.meaning: It is not created when the universe comes into being, nor is it destroyed when everything perishes. It is the essence of both existence and non-existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मवे ना चर्चे । वाढे ना खांचे। विटे ना वेंचे । अव्ययपणें ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mave nā carce | vāḍhe nā khāṃce| viṭe nā veṃce | avyayapaṇeṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: It does not die in discussion, nor does it grow in argument. It does not diminish through spending, remaining eternally immutable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'एवंरूप पैं आत्मा । देहीं जें म्हणती प्रियोत्तमा। तें मठाकारें व्योमा। नाम जैसें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'evaṃrūpa paiṃ ātmā | dehīṃ jeṃ mhaṇatī priyottamā| teṃ maṭhākāreṃ vyomā| nāma jaiseṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: Thus, the Self (Atman) is indeed like the beloved within the body, just as the sky is named by the shape of a monastery.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तयाचिये अनुस्यूती। होती जाती देहाकृती। तो घे ना सांडी सुमती । जैसा तैसा॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ tayāciye anusyūtī| hotī jātī dehākṛtī| to ghe nā sāṃḍī sumatī | jaisā taisā|| 16||
verses.meaning: Just as bodies are born and perish within His continuous presence, He neither accepts nor rejects them, remaining ever as He is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहोरात्रें जैशीं। येती जाती आकाशीं । आत्मसत्तें तेसीं । देहे जाण॥ ९१७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahorātreṃ jaiśīṃ| yetī jātī ākāśīṃ | ātmasatteṃ tesīṃ | dehe jāṇa|| 917||
verses.meaning: Just as day and night come and go in the sky, so too do bodies appear and disappear due to the power of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि इये शरीरीं। कांहीं करवी ना करी। आयताही व्यापारीं। सज्ज न होय॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni iye śarīrīṃ| kāṃhīṃ karavī nā karī| āyatāhī vyāpārīṃ| sajja na hoya|| 18||
verses.meaning: Therefore, this body neither does anything nor causes anything to be done. It does not even become ready for any activity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं स्वरूपें। उणा पुरा न घेपे। हें असो तो न लिंपे। देहीं देहा॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ svarūpeṃ| uṇā purā na ghepe| heṃ aso to na liṃpe| dehīṃ dehā|| 19||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the Self is neither deficient nor complete. Let it be known that it is not tainted by the body, nor by the actions of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा आकाश कें नाहीं। हें न रिघेचि कवणे ठायीं। परि कायिसेनि कहीं॥ गादिजेना ॥ १९२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā ākāśa keṃ nāhīṃ| heṃ na righeci kavaṇe ṭhāyīṃ| pari kāyiseni kahīṃ|| gādijenā || 1920||
verses.meaning: The sky, though it has no form, does not enter any particular place. Yet, how can it be contained or limited?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सर्वत्र सर्व देहीं। आत्मा असतुचि असे पाहीं॥ परी संगदोषें एकेंही। लिप्त नोहे ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sarvatra sarva dehīṃ| ātmā asatuci ase pāhīṃ|| parī saṃgadoṣeṃ ekeṃhī| lipta nohe || 21||
verses.meaning: In the same way, the Atman (Self) exists everywhere, in all bodies, yet it is not tainted by any attachment or fault.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढतपुढती एशथें। हेंचि लक्षण निरुतें। जे जाणावें क्षेत्रज्ञातें। श्षेत्रविहिना ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhatapuḍhatī eśatheṃ| heṃci lakṣaṇa niruteṃ| je jāṇāveṃ kṣetrajñāteṃ| śṣetravihinā || 22||
verses.meaning: Again and again, this is the true characteristic by which the Knower of the Field (Kshetrajna) should be understood as being without a field (Kshetra-vihina).

verses.shloka_devanagari: संसर्ग चेष्टिजे लोहें॥। परी लोह भ्रामकु नोहे । क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञां आहे। तेतुला पाडु ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃsarga ceṣṭije loheṃ||| parī loha bhrāmaku nohe | kṣetrakṣetrajñāṃ āhe| tetulā pāḍu || 23||
verses.meaning: Iron is drawn to a magnet, but the iron itself is not the magnet. Such is the relationship between the body and the soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दीपकाची अर्ची । रहाटी वाहे घरींची । परी वेगळीक कोडीची । दीपा आणि घरा॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: dīpakācī arcī | rahāṭī vāhe gharīṃcī | parī vegaḻīka koḍīcī | dīpā āṇi gharā|| 24||
verses.meaning: The flame of a lamp illuminates the house, yet the lamp and the house remain distinct entities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं काष्ठाच्या पोटीं । वन्हि असे किरीटी । परी काष्ठ नोहे या दृष्टी। पाहिजे हा॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kāṣṭhācyā poṭīṃ | vanhi ase kirīṭī | parī kāṣṭha nohe yā dṛṣṭī| pāhije hā|| 25||
verses.meaning: Just as fire resides within wood, O Kiriti, yet wood is not fire; this should be understood.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अपाडु नभा आभाळा । रवि आणि मृगजळा। तैसाचि हाही डोळां। देखसी जरी॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: apāḍu nabhā ābhāḻā | ravi āṇi mṛgajaḻā| taisāci hāhī ḍoḻāṃ| dekhasī jarī|| 26||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky and its reflection in a mirage, or the sun and its reflection in water, appear distinct yet are not separate, so too is what you perceive with your eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें आघवेंचि असो एकु । गगनौनि जैसा अर्कु । प्रगटबी लोकु। नांबें नांवें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ āghaveṃci aso eku | gaganauni jaisā arku | pragaṭabī loku| nāṃbeṃ nāṃveṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Let all this be as one. Just as the sun from the sky reveals the world with its names and forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ क्षेत्रजु तो ऐसा । प्रकाशकु क्षेत्राभासा। यावरुतें हें न पुसा। शंका नेघा॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha kṣetraju to aisā | prakāśaku kṣetrābhāsā| yāvaruteṃ heṃ na pusā| śaṃkā neghā|| 28||
verses.meaning: Here, the Knower of the field is such that He illuminates the field of illusion. Do not ask anything beyond this, do not entertain any doubts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शब्दतत्त्वसारज्ञा। पैं देखणे तेचि प्रज्ञा। जे क्षेत्र क्षेत्रज्ञा अपाडु देखे॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: śabdatattvasārajñā| paiṃ dekhaṇe teci prajñā| je kṣetra kṣetrajñā apāḍu dekhe|| 29||
verses.meaning: O Knower of the essence of the Word-Principle, true wisdom is that which perceives the distinction between the body (field) and the knower of the body (field-knower).

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया दोहींचें अंतर। देखावया चतुर। ज्ञानियांचें द्वार । आराधिती ॥ ११३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā dohīṃceṃ aṃtara| dekhāvayā catura| jñāniyāṃceṃ dvāra | ārādhitī || 1130||
verses.meaning: To discern the distinction between these two, the wise ones worship at the door of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याचिलागीं सुमती । जोडिती शांतिसंपत्ती । शास्त्रांची दुभतीं। पोसिती घरीं ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yācilāgīṃ sumatī | joḍitī śāṃtisaṃpattī | śāstrāṃcī dubhatīṃ| positī gharīṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Therefore, those with good intellect accumulate the wealth of peace. They nurture the scriptures, which are like milch cows, in their homes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: योगाचिया आकाशा । वळघिजे येवढाचि धिंबसा। याचियाचि आशा । पुरुषासि गा॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yogāciyā ākāśā | vaḻaghije yevaḍhāci dhiṃbasā| yāciyāci āśā | puruṣāsi gā||32||
verses.meaning: The only hope for a person is to attain the vastness of Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शरीरादि समस्त। मानिताति तृणवत। जीवें संतांचे होत। वाहणधरू ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: śarīrādi samasta| mānitāti tṛṇavata| jīveṃ saṃtāṃce hota| vāhaṇadharū || 33||
verses.meaning: They consider their own bodies and all else as mere straw, becoming the bearers of the saints' burdens with their very lives.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसैसियापरी। ज्ञानाचिया भरोबरी । करूनियां अंतरीं । निरुतें होती ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisaisiyāparī| jñānāciyā bharobarī | karūniyāṃ aṃtarīṃ | niruteṃ hotī || 34||
verses.meaning: In this manner, through the abundance of knowledge within, they become truly pure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञांचें । जें अंतर देखती साचें । ज्ञानें उन्मेख तयांचे । ओवाळूं आम्ही ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kṣetrakṣetrajñāṃceṃ | jeṃ aṃtara dekhatī sāceṃ | jñāneṃ unmekha tayāṃce | ovāḻūṃ āmhī || 35 ||
verses.meaning: Then, those who truly perceive the distinction between the field and the knower of the field, we shall illuminate their understanding with knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि महाभूतादिकीं। प्रभेदलीं अनेकीं। पसरलीसे लटिकी। प्रकृति जे हे॥३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mahābhūtādikīṃ| prabhedalīṃ anekīṃ| pasaralīse laṭikī| prakṛti je he||36||
verses.meaning: And this illusory Prakriti, which has manifested in many forms, such as the great elements, has spread itself out.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे शुकनळिकान्यायें। न लगती लागली आहे। हें जैसें तैसें होये। ठाउवें जयां॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: je śukanaḻikānyāyeṃ| na lagatī lāgalī āhe| heṃ jaiseṃ taiseṃ hoye| ṭhāuveṃ jayāṃ|| 37||
verses.meaning: Just as a parrot, though seemingly caught in a snare, is not truly bound, so too is the true nature of reality understood by those who realize this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी माळा ते माळा। ऐसीचि देखिजे डोळां। सर्पबुद्धि टवाळा । उखी होउनी॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī māḻā te māḻā| aisīci dekhije ḍoḻāṃ| sarpabuddhi ṭavāḻā | ukhī hounī|| 38||
verses.meaning: Just as a garland is seen as a garland by the eyes, so too, the foolish perception of a snake is dispelled, revealing the truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां शुक्ति ते शुक्ति। हे साच होय प्रतीती । रुपेयाची भ्रांती) जाऊनियां॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ śukti te śukti| he sāca hoya pratītī | rupeyācī bhrāṃtī) jāūniyāṃ|| 39||
verses.meaning: Just as the true nature of the shell is realized, and the illusion of silver vanishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी वेगळी वेगळेपणें। प्रकृति जे अंत:करणें। देखती ते मी म्हणें। ब्रह्म होती ॥ ११४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī vegaḻī vegaḻepaṇeṃ| prakṛti je aṃta:karaṇeṃ| dekhatī te mī mhaṇeṃ| brahma hotī || 1140||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who perceive the distinctness of Prakriti (nature) and the inner consciousness as separate entities, I say, they become Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें आकाशाहूनि वाड। जें अव्यक्ताची पैल कड। जें भेटलिया अपाडा पाड। पडों नेदी ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ ākāśāhūni vāḍa| jeṃ avyaktācī paila kaḍa| jeṃ bheṭaliyā apāḍā pāḍa| paḍoṃ nedī || 49||
verses.meaning: That which is greater than the sky, that which is beyond the unmanifest, that which, when attained, allows no comparison to fall short.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आकारु जेथ सरे। जीवत्ब जेथ विरे। द्वैत जेथ नुरे। अद्वय जें॥४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ākāru jetha sare| jīvatba jetha vire| dvaita jetha nure| advaya jeṃ||42||
verses.meaning: Where form ends, where individuality dissolves, where duality ceases to exist, that is non-duality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें परम तत्त्व पार्था। होती ते सर्वथा । जे आत्मानात्मव्यवस्था । राजहंसु॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ parama tattva pārthā| hotī te sarvathā | je ātmānātmavyavasthā | rājahaṃsu|| 43||
verses.meaning: That Supreme Principle, O Partha, is indeed the one who, like a royal swan, discerns between the Self and the non-Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा हा जी आधवा। श्रीकृष्णें तया पांडवा । उगाणा दिधला जीवा । जीवाचिया। ४४॥ येर कलशींचें येरीं । रिचविजे जयापरी। आपणणपें तया श्रीहरी । दिधलें तैसें ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā hā jī ādhavā| śrīkṛṣṇeṃ tayā pāṃḍavā | ugāṇā didhalā jīvā | jīvāciyā| 44|| yera kalaśīṃceṃ yerīṃ | ricavije jayāparī| āpaṇaṇapeṃ tayā śrīharī | didhaleṃ taiseṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: Thus, Shri Krishna gave this profound explanation to Arjuna, revealing the very essence of the Self. Just as one pot pours its contents into another, so did Shri Hari pour His own essence into Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि कोणा देता कोण। तो नर तैसा नारायण । वरी अर्जुनातें श्रीकृष्ण। हा मी म्हणे ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi koṇā detā koṇa| to nara taisā nārāyaṇa | varī arjunāteṃ śrīkṛṣṇa| hā mī mhaṇe || 46||
verses.meaning: And to whom does He give Himself? That man is like Narayana (God). Moreover, to Arjuna, Shri Krishna says, "I am this."

verses.shloka_devanagari: परि असो तें नाथिलें। न पुसतां कां मी बोलें। किंबहुना दिधलें। सर्वस्व देवें ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pari aso teṃ nāthileṃ| na pusatāṃ kāṃ mī boleṃ| kiṃbahunā didhaleṃ| sarvasva deveṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: But let that be, it is useless. Why do I speak without being asked? In short, God has given everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं तो पार्थु जी मनीं । अझुनी तृप्ती न मनी । अधिकाधिक उतान्ही । वाढवबीतु असे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ to pārthu jī manīṃ | ajhunī tṛptī na manī | adhikādhika utānhī | vāḍhavabītu ase|| 48||
verses.meaning: Arjuna's mind was still not satisfied; he yearned for more and more, his eagerness growing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्नेहाचिया भरोवरी। आंबुथिला दीपु घे थोरी। चाड अर्जुना अंतरीं । परिसतां तैसी ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: snehāciyā bharovarī| āṃbuthilā dīpu ghe thorī| cāḍa arjunā aṃtarīṃ | parisatāṃ taisī || 49||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, just as a lamp, filled with oil, shines brightly, so too does my desire to speak grow when I see your eager attention.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सुगरिणी आणि उदारे। रसज्ञ आणि जेवणारे । मिळती मग अवबतरे। हातु जैसा ॥ ११५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha sugariṇī āṇi udāre| rasajña āṇi jevaṇāre | miḻatī maga avabatare| hātu jaisā || 1150||
verses.meaning: There, the skilled and generous, the connoisseurs and the diners, all come together, just like hands working in unison.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जी होतसे देवा । तया अवधानाचिया लवलवा। पाहतां व्याख्यान चढलें थांबा । चौगुणें वबरी॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jī hotase devā | tayā avadhānāciyā lavalavā| pāhatāṃ vyākhyāna caḍhaleṃ thāṃbā | cauguṇeṃ vabarī|| 51||
verses.meaning: Just as the Lord becomes manifest, so too, by the eagerness of that attention, the discourse, having reached its peak, overflows with fourfold enthusiasm.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुवायें मेघु सांबरे। जैसा चंद्रें सिंधु भरे। तैसा मातला रसु आदेरें। श्रोतयांचेनि॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: suvāyeṃ meghu sāṃbare| jaisā caṃdreṃ siṃdhu bhare| taisā mātalā rasu ādereṃ| śrotayāṃceni|| 52||
verses.meaning: Just as clouds gather by themselves, and the ocean swells by the moon's rise, so too does the rasa (essence/joy) of this discourse overflow with the reverence of the listeners.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां आनंदमय आघवें। विश्‍व कौजेल देवें । तें रायें परिसावें। संजयो म्हणे॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ ānaṃdamaya āghaveṃ| viś‍va kaujela deveṃ | teṃ rāyeṃ parisāveṃ| saṃjayo mhaṇe|| 53||
verses.meaning: Now, the entire universe will be filled with divine bliss. O King, please listen to this, said Sanjaya.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं जें महाभारतीं। श्रीव्यासें आप्रांतमती । भीष्मपर्वसंगतीं । म्हणितली कथा॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ jeṃ mahābhāratīṃ| śrīvyāseṃ āprāṃtamatī | bhīṣmaparvasaṃgatīṃ | mhaṇitalī kathā|| 54||
verses.meaning: Thus, the story that Vyasa, of boundless intellect, narrated in the Mahabharata, in the context of the Bhishma Parva.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो कृष्णार्जुनसंवादु । ३२२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी नागरीं बोलीं विशदु। सांगोनि दाऊं प्रबंधु। बोवियेचा ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: to kṛṣṇārjunasaṃvādu | 322 śrījñāneśvarī nāgarīṃ bolīṃ viśadu| sāṃgoni dāūṃ prabaṃdhu| boviyecā || 55||
verses.meaning: We shall now present this discourse, the dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, clearly explained in the vernacular language of Shri Dnyaneshwari, in the form of an ovi (verse).

verses.shloka_devanagari: नुसधीचि शांतिकथा । आणिजेळ कीर वाक्‍्पथा । जे शृंगाराच्या माथां । पाय ठेवी ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nusadhīci śāṃtikathā | āṇijeḻa kīra vāk‍pathā | je śṛṃgārācyā māthāṃ | pāya ṭhevī || 56||
verses.meaning: The discourse on peace, indeed, brings forth such a path of words that it places its foot upon the very head of sensuality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दाऊं वेल्हाळे देशी नवी। जे साहित्यातें बोजावी। अमृतातें चुकी ठेवी । गोडिसेंपणें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dāūṃ velhāḻe deśī navī| je sāhityāteṃ bojāvī| amṛtāteṃ cukī ṭhevī | goḍiseṃpaṇeṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: It will bestow new life upon the literary works, making them vibrant and profound. It will even surpass the sweetness of nectar, establishing a new standard of delight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बोल ओल्हावतेनि गुणें। चंद्रासि घे उमाणे। रसरंगीं भुलवणें। नादु लोपी। ५८॥ खेचरांचियाही मना। आणीन सात्त्विकाचा पान्हा । श्रवणासवें सुमना । समाधि जोडे ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: bola olhāvateni guṇeṃ| caṃdrāsi ghe umāṇe| rasaraṃgīṃ bhulavaṇeṃ| nādu lopī| 58|| khecarāṃciyāhī manā| āṇīna sāttvikācā pānhā | śravaṇāsaveṃ sumanā | samādhi joḍe || 59||
verses.meaning: By the quality of my words, I shall make the moon feel humble. My words will enchant with their essence and beauty, making even the celestial beings' minds flow with sattvic devotion. Simply by listening, a state of deep meditation will be attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा वाग्बिलास विस्तारू । गीतार्थेसी विश्व भरूं। आनंदाचे आवारूं। मांडूं जगा॥ ११६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā vāgbilāsa vistārū | gītārthesī viśva bharūṃ| ānaṃdāce āvārūṃ| māṃḍūṃ jagā|| 1160||
verses.meaning: In the same way, I shall expand the play of words, fill the universe with the meaning of the Gita, and establish a canopy of bliss for the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: फिटो विवेकाची वाणी। हो कानामनाची जिणी। देखो आवडे तो खाणी। ब्रह्मविद्येची ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: phiṭo vivekācī vāṇī| ho kānāmanācī jiṇī| dekho āvaḍe to khāṇī| brahmavidyecī || 61||
verses.meaning: May the voice of discrimination be dispelled, and may the mind and ears become a mine of Brahman-knowledge, which is so delightful to behold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिसो परतत्त्व डोळां। पाहो सुखाचा सोहळा । रिघो महाबोधसुकाळा-। माजीं विश्‍व॥ ६२॥
