verses.meaning: Similarly, with the purity of sattva, knowledge grows abundantly, and the intellect begins to flow towards discrimination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं महदादि परिपाठीं। विचारूनि शेवटीं। विचारासकट पोटीं । जिरोनि जाय॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ mahadādi paripāṭhīṃ| vicārūni śevaṭīṃ| vicārāsakaṭa poṭīṃ | jironi jāya|| 23||
verses.meaning: In the sequence of the Mahat and other principles, after thorough deliberation, the very act of deliberation, along with its object, dissolves into the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: छत्तिसां सदतिसावें। चोविसां पंचविसावें। तिन्ही नुरोनि स्वभावें।॥ चतुर्थ जें॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: chattisāṃ sadatisāveṃ| covisāṃ paṃcavisāveṃ| tinhī nuroni svabhāveṃ||| caturtha jeṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: The thirty-sixth in the thirty-seventh, the twenty-fourth in the twenty-fifth, when these three naturally cease to exist, that which remains is the Fourth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें सर्व जें सर्वोत्तम । जालें असे जया सुगम । तयासवें निरुपम । लाहे देह॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ sarva jeṃ sarvottama | jāleṃ ase jayā sugama | tayāsaveṃ nirupama | lāhe deha|| 25||
verses.meaning: Thus, all that is supreme and easily accessible to one, that incomparable one attains a body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयाचि परी देख। तमसत्त्व अधोमुख। बैसोनि जें आगळीक । धरी रज॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyāci parī dekha| tamasattva adhomukha| baisoni jeṃ āgaḻīka | dharī raja|| 26||
verses.meaning: In this way, the Tamas and Sattva qualities, facing downwards, are overcome by the dominance of Rajas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलिया कार्याचा । धुमाड गांवीं देहाचा । माजवी तें चिन्हांचा। उदयो ऐसा॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpuliyā kāryācā | dhumāḍa gāṃvīṃ dehācā | mājavī teṃ cinhāṃcā| udayo aisā|| 27||
verses.meaning: The body, in its actions, creates a commotion in the village, and this is the sign of its emergence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पांजरली वाहटुळी। करी वेगळ वेंटाळी। तैसी विषयीं सरळी। इंद्रियां होय॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṃjaralī vāhaṭuḻī| karī vegaḻa veṃṭāḻī| taisī viṣayīṃ saraḻī| iṃdriyāṃ hoya|| 28||
verses.meaning: Just as a whirlwind, when it gathers force, separates and scatters things, so too do the senses, when engrossed in worldly pleasures, become entangled and dispersed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परदारादि पडे। परी विरुद्ध ऐसें नावडे । मग शेळियेचेनि तोंडें । सेंघ चारी ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paradārādi paḍe| parī viruddha aiseṃ nāvaḍe | maga śeḻiyeceni toṃḍeṃ | seṃgha cārī || 29||
verses.meaning: Even if one falls into the company of another's wife, if it is not considered wrong, then it is like a sheep feeding on a tiger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठायवरी लोभु। करी स्वैरत्वाचा राबु। वेंटाळितां अलाभु । तें तें उरे॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāyavarī lobhu| karī svairatvācā rābu| veṃṭāḻitāṃ alābhu | teṃ teṃ ure|| 230||
verses.meaning: When one is greedy for a particular place, and acts arbitrarily, then only loss remains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आड पडलिया। उद्यमजाती भलतिया । प्रवृत्ति धनंजया । हातु न काढी ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi āḍa paḍaliyā| udyamajātī bhalatiyā | pravṛtti dhanaṃjayā | hātu na kāḍhī || 31||
verses.meaning: And even if obstacles arise, the diligent one, O Dhananjaya, does not withdraw his hand from his endeavors.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि एखादा प्रासादु। कां करावा अश्वमेधु। ऐसा अचाट छंदु। घेऊनि उठी॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci ekhādā prāsādu| kāṃ karāvā aśvamedhu| aisā acāṭa chaṃdu| gheūni uṭhī|| 32||
verses.meaning: Similarly, one might undertake the construction of a grand temple or perform an Ashwamedha sacrifice, driven by such an extraordinary and ambitious desire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नगरेंचि रचावीं। जलाशयें निर्मावीं। महावनें लावावीं। नानाविधें॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nagareṃci racāvīṃ| jalāśayeṃ nirmāvīṃ| mahāvaneṃ lāvāvīṃ| nānāvidheṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: One should build cities, construct reservoirs, and plant various kinds of great forests.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसैसां अफाटीं कर्मी । समारंभु उपक्रमी । आणि दृष्टादृष्ट ३३४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी कामीं। पुरे न म्हणे॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisaisāṃ aphāṭīṃ karmī | samāraṃbhu upakramī | āṇi dṛṣṭādṛṣṭa 334 śrījñāneśvarī kāmīṃ| pure na mhaṇe|| 34||
verses.meaning: In such boundless actions, in the beginning of the undertaking, and in visible and invisible deeds, He never says 'enough'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सागरुही सांडीं पडे । आगी न लाहे तीन कवडे । ऐसें अभिलाषीं जोडे । दुर्भरत्व॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāgaruhī sāṃḍīṃ paḍe | āgī na lāhe tīna kavaḍe | aiseṃ abhilāṣīṃ joḍe | durbharatva|| 35||
verses.meaning: Even the ocean would be considered a mere puddle, and fire would not be worth three cowries (a negligible amount), such is the insatiable desire for more, leading to an unbearable burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्पृहा मना पुढां पुढां। आशेचा घे दवडा। विश्व घापे चाडा। पायांतळीं ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: spṛhā manā puḍhāṃ puḍhāṃ| āśecā ghe davaḍā| viśva ghāpe cāḍā| pāyāṃtaḻīṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: Let the mind eagerly pursue, let it hasten with hope, and the entire world will be brought under its feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इत्यादि वाढतां रजीं। इयें चिन्हें होतीं साजीं। आणि ऐशा समाजीं। वेंचे जरी देह॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ityādi vāḍhatāṃ rajīṃ| iyeṃ cinheṃ hotīṃ sājīṃ| āṇi aiśā samājīṃ| veṃce jarī deha|| 37||
verses.meaning: Thus, when these signs of increasing Rajas become prominent, and even if the body perishes in such a state of being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आघवाचि इहीं । परिवारला आनीं देहीं । रिगे परी योनिही । मानुषीचि ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī āghavāci ihīṃ | parivāralā ānīṃ dehīṃ | rige parī yonihī | mānuṣīci || 38||
verses.meaning: Thus, though encompassed by all these, and entering other bodies, he still enters only the human womb.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुरवाडेंसि भिकारी। बसो पां राजमंदिरीं। तरी काय अवधारीं। रावो होईल॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: suravāḍeṃsi bhikārī| baso pāṃ rājamaṃdirīṃ| tarī kāya avadhārīṃ| rāvo hoīla|| 39||
verses.meaning: If a beggar sits in a royal palace, will he immediately become a king?

verses.shloka_devanagari: बेल तेथें करबाडें। हें न चुके गा फुडें। नेइजो कां वऱ्हाडे । समर्थाचेनी ॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: bela tetheṃ karabāḍeṃ| heṃ na cuke gā phuḍeṃ| neijo kāṃ vaṟhāḍe | samarthācenī || 240||
verses.meaning: Where there is a bel tree, there will be karbade (weeds). This is inevitable. Why then should the wedding procession not be taken by the powerful?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि व्यापाराहातीं । उसंतु देहा ना राती । तैसयाचिये पांतीं। जुंपिजे तो॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vyāpārāhātīṃ | usaṃtu dehā nā rātī | taisayāciye pāṃtīṃ| juṃpije to|| 41||
verses.meaning: Therefore, through constant activity, the body finds no rest, day or night; into such a state is it yoked.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्मजडाच्या ठायीं। किंबहुना होय देहीं। जो रजोवृत्तीच्या डोहीं । बुडोनि निमे ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: karmajaḍācyā ṭhāyīṃ| kiṃbahunā hoya dehīṃ| jo rajovṛttīcyā ḍohīṃ | buḍoni nime || 42||
verses.meaning: Or rather, in the body of one who is inert in action, who is submerged and perishes in the whirlpool of the rajasic tendency.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तैसाचि पुढती । रजसत्त्ववृत्ती । गिळूनि ये उन्नती । तमोगुण॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga taisāci puḍhatī | rajasattvavṛttī | giḻūni ye unnatī | tamoguṇa|| 43||
verses.meaning: Then, in the same way, the tamas guna again rises, swallowing the rajas and sattva gunas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैंचि जियें लिंगे । देहींचीं सबाह्य सांगें । तियें परिस चांगें । श्रोत्रबळें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiṃci jiyeṃ liṃge | dehīṃcīṃ sabāhya sāṃgeṃ | tiyeṃ parisa cāṃgeṃ | śrotrabaḻeṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: Those very lingas, which are within the body and also outside, listen to them well with the power of your ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी होय ऐसें मन। जैसें रविचंद्रहीन । रात्रींचें का गगन । अंवसेचिये ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī hoya aiseṃ mana| jaiseṃ ravicaṃdrahīna | rātrīṃceṃ kā gagana | aṃvaseciye || 45||
verses.meaning: Then the mind becomes like the sky on a moonless night, devoid of sun and moon, like the night of the new moon.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें अंतर असोस । होय स्फूर्तिहीन उद्गस। विचाराची भाष। हारपे तैं ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ aṃtara asosa | hoya sphūrtihīna udgasa| vicārācī bhāṣa| hārape taiṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the inner self becomes restless, devoid of inspiration, and the language of contemplation is lost.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुव्हि मेचवेना धोंडी । हा ठायवरी मवाळें सांडी। आठवो देशधडी। जाला दिसे॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: buvhi mecavenā dhoṃḍī | hā ṭhāyavarī mavāḻeṃ sāṃḍī| āṭhavo deśadhaḍī| jālā dise|| 47||
verses.meaning: The intellect cannot grasp it, for it is so soft and subtle. All memory seems to have been banished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अविवेकाचेनि माजें। सबाह्य शरीर गाजे । एकलेनि घेपे दीजे। मोढ्य तेथ ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: avivekāceni mājeṃ| sabāhya śarīra gāje | ekaleni ghepe dīje| moḍhya tetha || 48 ||
verses.meaning: Due to the intoxication of ignorance, the body, both inside and out, becomes arrogant. In such a state of foolishness, one only takes and gives nothing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आचारभंगाचीं हाडें।॥ रुपतीं इंद्रियांपुढें॥ मरे जरी तेणेंकडे। क्रिया जाय ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ācārabhaṃgācīṃ hāḍeṃ||| rupatīṃ iṃdriyāṃpuḍheṃ|| mare jarī teṇeṃkaḍe| kriyā jāya || 49||
verses.meaning: The bones of transgressions prick the senses; even if one dies, the actions continue in that direction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आणिकही एक दिसे। जे दुष्कृतीं चित्त उल्हासे। आंधारीं देखणें जैसें । डुडुळाचें ॥ २५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āṇikahī eka dise| je duṣkṛtīṃ citta ulhāse| āṃdhārīṃ dekhaṇeṃ jaiseṃ | ḍuḍuḻāceṃ || 250||
verses.meaning: And another thing is seen: that the minds of the wicked rejoice in darkness, just as an owl's sight is in the dark.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें निषिद्धाचेनि नांवें। भलतेंही भरे हांवे । तियेविषयीं धांबें। घेती करणें ॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ niṣiddhāceni nāṃveṃ| bhalateṃhī bhare hāṃve | tiyeviṣayīṃ dhāṃbeṃ| ghetī karaṇeṃ ||51||
verses.meaning: Similarly, at the mere mention of forbidden things, all sorts of desires arise, and people rush to engage in them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मदिरा न घेतां डुले। सन्निपातेंबीण बरळे। निष्प्रेमेंचि भुले। पिसें जैसें ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: madirā na ghetāṃ ḍule| sannipāteṃbīṇa baraḻe| niṣpremeṃci bhule| piseṃ jaiseṃ || 52||
verses.meaning: It sways without drinking wine, raves without delirium, and is deluded by pure love, like a madman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चित्त तरी गेलें आहे । परी उन्मनी ते नोहे । ऐसें माल्हातिजे मोहें। माजिरेनि॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: citta tarī geleṃ āhe | parī unmanī te nohe | aiseṃ mālhātije moheṃ| mājireni|| 53||
verses.meaning: The mind has indeed gone, but it has not reached the state of unmani (transcendental consciousness). Thus, it is deluded by infatuation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना ऐसैसीं। इयें चिन्हें तम पोषीं। जें वाढे आयितीसी। आपुलिया ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā aisaisīṃ| iyeṃ cinheṃ tama poṣīṃ| jeṃ vāḍhe āyitīsī| āpuliyā || 54||
verses.meaning: Indeed, these are the signs by which ignorance (Tamas) thrives, growing by its own accord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि हेंचि होय प्रसंगें। मरणाचें जरी पडे खागें। तरी तेतुलेनि रिगे। तमेंसीं तो ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi heṃci hoya prasaṃgeṃ| maraṇāceṃ jarī paḍe khāgeṃ| tarī tetuleni rige| tameṃsīṃ to || 55||
verses.meaning: And if by chance, the shadow of death falls upon him, he enters into darkness to that extent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: राई राईपण बीजीं। सांठवूनियां अंग त्यजी। मग विरूढे तैं दुजी। गोठी आहे ॥५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: rāī rāīpaṇa bījīṃ| sāṃṭhavūniyāṃ aṃga tyajī| maga virūḍhe taiṃ dujī| goṭhī āhe ||56||
verses.meaning: The mustard seed, having stored its mustard-ness within, then sheds its body. What sprouts forth then is a different matter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पै होऊनि दीपकळिका। येरु आगी विझो कां। जेथ लागे तेथ असका। तोचि आहे॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pai hoūni dīpakaḻikā| yeru āgī vijho kāṃ| jetha lāge tetha asakā| toci āhe|| 57||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp's flame, though appearing to be extinguished by fire, is in fact the very same fire wherever it touches.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तमाचिये लोथें। बांधोनियां संकल्पातें। देह जाय तैं मागोौतें। तमाचेंचि होय ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tamāciye lotheṃ| bāṃdhoniyāṃ saṃkalpāteṃ| deha jāya taiṃ māgoauteṃ| tamāceṃci hoya || 58||
verses.meaning: Therefore, when the body, bound by the resolve of ignorance, perishes, it returns to ignorance itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां काय येणें बहुवें। जो तमोवृब्यि मृत्यु लाहे। तो पशु कां पक्षी होये। झाड कां कृमी ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ kāya yeṇeṃ bahuveṃ| jo tamovṛbyi mṛtyu lāhe| to paśu kāṃ pakṣī hoye| jhāḍa kāṃ kṛmī || 59||
verses.meaning: What more can be said? One who dies with an abundance of tamas (ignorance/darkness) is reborn as an animal, a bird, a tree, or an insect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणेंचि पैं कारणें। जें निपजे सत्त्वगुणें। तें सुकृत ऐसें म्हणे । श्रौतसमो ॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃci paiṃ kāraṇeṃ| jeṃ nipaje sattvaguṇeṃ| teṃ sukṛta aiseṃ mhaṇe | śrautasamo || 260||
verses.meaning: For this very reason, whatever arises from the quality of goodness (sattva) is called a virtuous deed, akin to a Vedic ritual.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तया निर्मळा। सुखज्ञानी सरळा। अपूर्व ये 'फळा। सात्त्विक तें॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tayā nirmaḻā| sukhajñānī saraḻā| apūrva ye 'phaḻā| sāttvika teṃ||61||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for that pure, blissful, and straightforward knowledge, the fruit that arises is uniquely sattvic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग राजसा जिया क्रिया। तया इंद्रावणी 'फळलिया। जे सुखें चितारूनियां। फळतीं दुःखें ॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga rājasā jiyā kriyā| tayā iṃdrāvaṇī 'phaḻaliyā| je sukheṃ citārūniyāṃ| phaḻatīṃ duḥkheṃ ||62||
verses.meaning: Then, O King, those actions, like the fruits of the bitter apple, though seemingly drawn with pleasure, ultimately bear only sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां निंबोळियेचें पिक । वरि गोड आंत विख । तैसें तें राजस देख । क्रियाफळ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ niṃboḻiyeceṃ pika | vari goḍa āṃta vikha | taiseṃ teṃ rājasa dekha | kriyāphaḻa|| 63 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the fruit of the neem tree is sweet on the outside but poisonous within, so too is the fruit of actions performed with Rajasic qualities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तामस कर्म जितुकें। अज्ञान फळेंचि पिके । विषांकुर विखें। जियापरी ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tāmasa karma jitukeṃ| ajñāna phaḻeṃci pike | viṣāṃkura vikheṃ| jiyāparī || 64||
verses.meaning: All actions born of ignorance, like a poisonous seed, bear only the fruit of poison.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि बा रे अर्जुना। येथ सत्त्वचि हेतु ज्ञाना । जैसा कां दिनमाना। सूर्य हा पैं॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bā re arjunā| yetha sattvaci hetu jñānā | jaisā kāṃ dinamānā| sūrya hā paiṃ|| 65||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Arjuna, here the sattva quality is indeed the cause of knowledge, just as the sun is the cause of daylight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तैसेंचि हें जाण। लोभासि रज कारण। आपलें विस्मरण । अद्वैता जेवीं ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi taiseṃci heṃ jāṇa| lobhāsi raja kāraṇa| āpaleṃ vismaraṇa | advaitā jevīṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: And know that similarly, the quality of 'rajas' (passion, activity) is the cause of greed, just as forgetting one's true Self leads to the experience of duality instead of non-duality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोह अज्ञान प्रमादा । ययां मैळेया दोषवृंदा । पुढती पुढती प्रबुद्धा। तमचि मूळ ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: moha ajñāna pramādā | yayāṃ maiḻeyā doṣavṛṃdā | puḍhatī puḍhatī prabuddhā| tamaci mūḻa || 67||
verses.meaning: Delusion, ignorance, and inadvertence—these are the impurities and hosts of faults. O enlightened one, their root cause is darkness itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें विचाराच्या डोळां । तिन्ही गुण हे वेगवेगळां। दाविले जैसा आंबळा। तळहातींचा ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ vicārācyā ḍoḻāṃ | tinhī guṇa he vegavegaḻāṃ| dāvile jaisā āṃbaḻā| taḻahātīṃcā || 68||
verses.meaning: Thus, to the eye of discriminative thought, the three Gunas are revealed distinctly, like an amalaka fruit held in the palm of the hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब रजतमें दोन्हीं । देखिली प्रौढपतनीं । सत्त्वावांचूनि नाणीं । ज्ञानाकडे ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba rajatameṃ donhīṃ | dekhilī prauḍhapatanīṃ | sattvāvāṃcūni nāṇīṃ | jñānākaḍe || 69||
verses.meaning: Just as one perceives silver in mother-of-pearl, so too does one perceive knowledge in the absence of Sattva (purity/goodness).

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सात्त्विक वृत्ती) एक जाले गा जन्मत्रती। सर्वत्यागें चतुर्थी। भक्ति जैसी ॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sāttvika vṛttī) eka jāle gā janmatratī| sarvatyāgeṃ caturthī| bhakti jaisī || 270||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the sattvic disposition becomes one with the fourth stage of devotion, which is characterized by complete renunciation, as if it were a birth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सत्त्वाचेनि नटनाचें । असणें जाणें जयांचे । ते तनुत्यागीं स्वर्गीचे । राय होती ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sattvāceni naṭanāceṃ | asaṇeṃ jāṇeṃ jayāṃce | te tanutyāgīṃ svargīce | rāya hotī || 71||
verses.meaning: Just as those whose very being and movement are a dance of Sattva (purity, goodness), they become kings in heaven upon leaving their bodies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयाचि परी रजें। जिहीं कां जीजे मरिजे। तिहीं मनुष्य होइजे । मृत्युलोकी ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyāci parī rajeṃ| jihīṃ kāṃ jīje marije| tihīṃ manuṣya hoije | mṛtyulokī || 72||
verses.meaning: In this very way, those who are born and die through the influence of Rajas, they become human beings in the mortal world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सुखदुःखाचें खिचटें । जेविजें एकेचि ताटें । जेथ इये मरणवाटे। पडिलें नुठी॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha sukhaduḥkhāceṃ khicaṭeṃ | jevijeṃ ekeci tāṭeṃ | jetha iye maraṇavāṭe| paḍileṃ nuṭhī|| 73||
verses.meaning: There, the mixture of happiness and sorrow is eaten from the same plate. From there, one who has fallen on this path of death does not rise again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तयाचि स्थिति तमीं। जे वाढोनि निमती भोगक्षमीं। ते घेती नरकभूमी। मूळपत्र॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tayāci sthiti tamīṃ| je vāḍhoni nimatī bhogakṣamīṃ| te ghetī narakabhūmī| mūḻapatra|| 74||
verses.meaning: And those whose existence is in darkness, who grow and then perish, capable of experiencing worldly pleasures, they take birth in the hellish realms as their original abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं वस्तूचिया सत्ता । त्रिगुणासी पंडुसुता । दाविली सकारणता । आघवीचि ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ vastūciyā sattā | triguṇāsī paṃḍusutā | dāvilī sakāraṇatā | āghavīci || 75||
verses.meaning: Thus, O son of Pandu, the very existence of things, along with their causes, was entirely revealed to the three Gunas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं वस्तु वस्तुत्वें असिकें । तें आपणपें गुणासारिखें। देखोनि कार्यविशेखें। ३३६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी अनुकरे गा॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ vastu vastutveṃ asikeṃ | teṃ āpaṇapeṃ guṇāsārikheṃ| dekhoni kāryaviśekheṃ| 336 śrījñāneśvarī anukare gā|| 76||
verses.meaning: The very essence of existence, in its true nature, is like its own inherent qualities. Observing this, the special work of Shri Dnyaneshwari is to imitate that essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें कां स्वणींचेनि राजें। जें परचक्र देखिजे। तें हारी जैत होइजे। आपणपांचि ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ kāṃ svaṇīṃceni rājeṃ| jeṃ paracakra dekhije| teṃ hārī jaita hoije| āpaṇapāṃci || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as a king, dreaming of an invading army, conquers it within himself, so too is the victory achieved within oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसे मध्योर्ध्व अध। हे जे गुणवृत्तिभेद। ते दृष्टीवांचूनि शुद्ध । वस्तुचि असे॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taise madhyordhva adha| he je guṇavṛttibheda| te dṛṣṭīvāṃcūni śuddha | vastuci ase|| 78||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the distinctions of middle, upper, and lower, which are differentiations of the gunas and their functions, are pure reality, independent of perception.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हे वबाहणी असो। तरी तुज आन न दिसो। परिसें तें सांगतसों। मागील गोठी ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī he vabāhaṇī aso| tarī tuja āna na diso| pariseṃ teṃ sāṃgatasoṃ| māgīla goṭhī || 79||
verses.meaning: But let this be a secret, O wise one. May you not see anything else. Listen, I am telling you the past story.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी ऐसें जाणिजे। सामर्थ्ये तिन्ही सहजें। होती देहव्याजें। गुणचि हे ॥ २८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī aiseṃ jāṇije| sāmarthye tinhī sahajeṃ| hotī dehavyājeṃ| guṇaci he || 280||
verses.meaning: Therefore, know this: the three powers (creation, sustenance, destruction) naturally arise through the medium of the body; these are indeed the Gunas (qualities of nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंधनाचेनि आकारें। अग्नि जैसा अवतरे । कां आंगवे तरुवरें। भूमिरसु॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdhanāceni ākāreṃ| agni jaisā avatare | kāṃ āṃgave taruvareṃ| bhūmirasu|| 81||
verses.meaning: Just as fire manifests in the form of fuel, or as the earth's essence takes the form of trees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना दहिंयाचेनि मिसें। परिणमे दूधचि जैसें। कां मूर्त होय ऊंसें। गोडी जेवीं ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā dahiṃyāceni miseṃ| pariṇame dūdhaci jaiseṃ| kāṃ mūrta hoya ūṃseṃ| goḍī jevīṃ || 82||
verses.meaning: Just as milk transforms into various forms of curd, or as sugarcane takes on a tangible form while its sweetness remains inherent within, so too does the divine manifest in diverse ways while its essence remains unchanged.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें हें स्वांतःकरण । देहचि होती त्रिगुण । म्हणोनि बंधासि कारण। घडे कौर॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ heṃ svāṃtaḥkaraṇa | dehaci hotī triguṇa | mhaṇoni baṃdhāsi kāraṇa| ghaḍe kaura|| 83||
verses.meaning: Similarly, this inner self becomes the body itself, composed of the three Gunas. Therefore, it becomes the cause of bondage, which is then experienced.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी चोज हें धनुर्धगा। जे एवढा हा गुंफिरा। मोक्षाचा संसारा। उणा नोहे॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī coja heṃ dhanurdhagā| je evaḍhā hā guṃphirā| mokṣācā saṃsārā| uṇā nohe|| 84||
verses.meaning: But this is the wonder, O Arjuna, that this entire entanglement of worldly existence is no less than liberation itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्रिगुण आपुलालेनि धर्मे। देहींचे माघुत साउमें। चाळितांही न खोमें। गुणातीतता॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: triguṇa āpulāleni dharme| dehīṃce māghuta sāumeṃ| cāḻitāṃhī na khomeṃ| guṇātītatā|| 85||
verses.meaning: Even when the three Gunas (qualities of nature) act according to their inherent nature and stir the body, the state of being beyond the Gunas (Gunatitata) is not diminished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी मुक्ति असे सहज। ते आतां परिसऊं तुज। जे तूं ज्ञानांबुज-। द्विरेफे कीं ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī mukti ase sahaja| te ātāṃ parisaūṃ tuja| je tūṃ jñānāṃbuja-| dvirephe kīṃ || 86||
verses.meaning: Such liberation is inherent. Now, listen to me, you who are like a bee to the lotus of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि गुणीं गुणाजोगें। चैतन्य नोहे मागें । बोलिलों तें खागें। तेवींचि हें ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi guṇīṃ guṇājogeṃ| caitanya nohe māgeṃ | boliloṃ teṃ khāgeṃ| tevīṃci heṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: And just as qualities are inherent in their attributes, so too is consciousness not separate from them. What I have said before, that is also true here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पार्था जें ऐसें। बोधलेनि जीवें दिसें। स्वप्न कां जैसें। चेइलेनी ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pārthā jeṃ aiseṃ| bodhaleni jīveṃ diseṃ| svapna kāṃ jaiseṃ| ceilenī || 88||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, just as a dream vanishes upon waking, so too does this world appear to the enlightened soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी आपण जळीं । बिंबलों तीरोनी न्याहळी। चळण होतां कल्लोळीं। अनेकधा॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī āpaṇa jaḻīṃ | biṃbaloṃ tīronī nyāhaḻī| caḻaṇa hotāṃ kalloḻīṃ| anekadhā|| 89||
verses.meaning: Or, just as one sees their own reflection in water, and when the waves stir, that single reflection appears in many forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां नटलेनि लाघवें। नटु जैसा न झकवे। तैसें गुणजात देखावें। न होनियां॥ २९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ naṭaleni lāghaveṃ| naṭu jaisā na jhakave| taiseṃ guṇajāta dekhāveṃ| na honiyāṃ|| 290||
verses.meaning: Just as an actor, despite his skillful disguise, is not deceived by his own acting, so too should one perceive the world of qualities (gunas) without becoming entangled in them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं क्रतुत्रय आकाशें । धरूनियांहि जैसें । नेदिजेचि येवों वोसें । वेगळेपणा ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kratutraya ākāśeṃ | dharūniyāṃhi jaiseṃ | nedijeci yevoṃ voseṃ | vegaḻepaṇā || 91||
verses.meaning: Just as the three sacrificial fires, though held within the sky, do not allow any separation or distinctness to arise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें गुणीं गुणापरौतें । जें आपणपें असे आयितें। तिये अहं बैसे अहंते। मूळकेचिये॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ guṇīṃ guṇāparauteṃ | jeṃ āpaṇapeṃ ase āyiteṃ| tiye ahaṃ baise ahaṃte| mūḻakeciye|| 92||
verses.meaning: Just as the ego of the primordial root (Moolamaya) rests upon that which is beyond attributes, yet inherently present within them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं तेथूनि मग पाहतां। म्हणे साक्षी मी अकर्ता। हे गुणचि क्रियाजातां । नियोजित ॥ ९३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ tethūni maga pāhatāṃ| mhaṇe sākṣī mī akartā| he guṇaci kriyājātāṃ | niyojita || 93 ||
verses.meaning: From that point onwards, when one observes, one says, "I am the witness, the non-doer. These qualities are merely engaged in actions."

verses.shloka_devanagari: सत्त्वरजतमांचा । भेदीं पसरु कर्माचा । होत असे तो गुणांचा । विकारु हा॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: sattvarajatamāṃcā | bhedīṃ pasaru karmācā | hota ase to guṇāṃcā | vikāru hā|| 94||
verses.meaning: The spread of actions, which is a distortion of the Gunas (Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas), arises from these very Gunas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ययामाजीं मी ऐसा। वनीं कां बसंतु जैसा। वनलक्ष्मीविलासा । हेतुभूत ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayāmājīṃ mī aisā| vanīṃ kāṃ basaṃtu jaisā| vanalakṣmīvilāsā | hetubhūta || 95||
verses.meaning: I am like the spring season in a forest, the very cause of the forest's beauty and prosperity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां तारांगणीं लोपावें। सूर्यकांती उद्दीपाबे। कमळीं विकासावें। जावें तमे ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ tārāṃgaṇīṃ lopāveṃ| sūryakāṃtī uddīpābe| kamaḻīṃ vikāsāveṃ| jāveṃ tame || 96||
verses.meaning: Just as stars disappear in the presence of the sun, and the lotus blooms, so too does darkness vanish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ये कोणाचीं काजें कहीं। सवितिया जैसीं नाहीं । तैसा अकर्ता मी देहीं । सत्तारूप ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ye koṇācīṃ kājeṃ kahīṃ| savitiyā jaisīṃ nāhīṃ | taisā akartā mī dehīṃ | sattārūpa || 97||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun has no specific tasks to perform, so too am I, the Self, though residing in the body, truly the non-doer, existing as pure being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी दाऊनि गुण देखे। गुणता हे मियां पोखे। ययाचेनि निःशेखें। उरे तें मी॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī dāūni guṇa dekhe| guṇatā he miyāṃ pokhe| yayāceni niḥśekheṃ| ure teṃ mī|| 98||
verses.meaning: I reveal qualities, and through these qualities, I am nourished. When these qualities completely cease to exist, what remains is Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि विवेकें जया। उदो होय धनंजया । ये गुणातीतत्व तया । अर्थपंथें ( उर्ध्वपंथें )॥ ९९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni vivekeṃ jayā| udo hoya dhanaṃjayā | ye guṇātītatva tayā | arthapaṃtheṃ ( urdhvapaṃtheṃ )|| 99 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, O Dhananjaya, through such discrimination, the state of being beyond the gunas (qualities of nature) arises for that person, leading them on the path of true meaning (or the upward path).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां निर्गुण असे आणीक । तें तो जाणें अचुक । जे ज्ञानें केलें टीक । 'तयाचिवरी ॥ ३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ nirguṇa ase āṇīka | teṃ to jāṇeṃ acuka | je jñāneṃ keleṃ ṭīka | 'tayācivarī || 300||
verses.meaning: Now, that which is attributeless, only he truly knows it, upon whom knowledge has bestowed its mark.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना पंडुसुता। ऐसी तो माझी सत्ता । पावे जैसी सरिता । सिंधुत्व गा॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā paṃḍusutā| aisī to mājhī sattā | pāve jaisī saritā | siṃdhutva gā|| 1||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O son of Pandu, My power is attained just as a river merges into the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नळिकेवरूनि उठिला । जैसा शुक शाखे बैसला । तैसा मूळअहंतें वेठिला। तो मी म्हणौनि॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: naḻikevarūni uṭhilā | jaisā śuka śākhe baisalā | taisā mūḻaahaṃteṃ veṭhilā| to mī mhaṇauni|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as a parrot, having risen from a hollow pipe, settles on a branch, so too is the 'I' (ego) entangled by the root-ego, identifying with it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा अज्ञानाचिया निदा। जो घोरत होता बदबदा। तो स्वस्वरूपीं प्रबुद्धा। चेइला कीं॥३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā ajñānāciyā nidā| jo ghorata hotā badabadā| to svasvarūpīṃ prabuddhā| ceilā kīṃ||3||
verses.meaning: Alas, he who was deeply snoring in the sleep of ignorance, has now awakened into his true Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं बुद्दिभेदाचा आरिसा । तया हातोनि पडिला वीरेशा । म्हणौनि प्रतिमुखाभासा । मुकला तो॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ buddibhedācā ārisā | tayā hātoni paḍilā vīreśā | mhaṇauni pratimukhābhāsā | mukalā to|| 4||
verses.meaning: The mirror of intellectual distinction fell from his hands, O Virupaksha, and thus he was deprived of the reflection of his own face.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देहाभिमानाचा वारा। आतां वाजों ठेला वीरा। तैं ऐक्य वीचिसागरां । जीवेशां हें ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: dehābhimānācā vārā| ātāṃ vājoṃ ṭhelā vīrā| taiṃ aikya vīcisāgarāṃ | jīveśāṃ heṃ || 5||
verses.meaning: O brave one, when the wind of body-consciousness ceases to blow, then the individual soul and the Lord become one, like waves merging into the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मदभावेंसी । प्राप्ति पाविजे तेणेंसरिसी । वर्षांती आकाशीं । घनजात जेवीं ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni madabhāveṃsī | prāpti pāvije teṇeṃsarisī | varṣāṃtī ākāśīṃ | ghanajāta jevīṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: Therefore, through devotion to Me, attainment is achieved immediately, just as clouds disperse in the sky at the end of the rainy season.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं मी होऊनि निरुता । मग देहींचि ये असतां। नांगवे देहसंभूतां। गुणांसि तो॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ mī hoūni nirutā | maga dehīṃci ye asatāṃ| nāṃgave dehasaṃbhūtāṃ| guṇāṃsi to|| 7||
verses.meaning: In the same way, when I become completely free from the body, then even while existing in the body, the qualities born of the body cannot touch me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा भिंगाचेनि घरें। दीपप्रकाशु नावरे। कां न विझेचि सागरें। वडवानळु ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā bhiṃgāceni ghareṃ| dīpaprakāśu nāvare| kāṃ na vijheci sāgareṃ| vaḍavānaḻu || 8||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp's light cannot be contained by a glass house, or the submarine fire (Vadavanala) cannot be extinguished by the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा आला गेला गुणांचा। बोधु न मैळे तयाचा। तो देहीं जैसा व्योमींचा । चंद्र जळीं ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā ālā gelā guṇāṃcā| bodhu na maiḻe tayācā| to dehīṃ jaisā vyomīṃcā | caṃdra jaḻīṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon in the sky, though reflected in water, remains untouched by the water's coming and going, so too the enlightened one is not affected by the play of the gunas (qualities of nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिन्ही गुण आपुलाल्यि प्रौढी । देहीं नाचविती बागडीं। तो 'पाहोंही न धाडी । अहंतेतें॥ ३१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tinhī guṇa āpulālyi prauḍhī | dehīṃ nācavitī bāgaḍīṃ| to 'pāhoṃhī na dhāḍī | ahaṃteteṃ|| 310||
verses.meaning: The three Gunas, with their respective strengths, make the body dance like a puppet. Yet, they do not even allow the ego to perceive this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठायवरी। नेहटोनि ठेला अंतरीं । आतां काय वर्ते शरीरीं । हेंही नेणे॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāyavarī| nehaṭoni ṭhelā aṃtarīṃ | ātāṃ kāya varte śarīrīṃ | heṃhī neṇe|| 91||
verses.meaning: Having reached this state, he remains absorbed within; now, what transpires in the body, even that he does not know.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांडूनि आंगींची खोळी। सर्प रिगालिया पाताळीं। ते त्वचा कोण सांभाळी । तैसें जाळें॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃḍūni āṃgīṃcī khoḻī| sarpa rigāliyā pātāḻīṃ| te tvacā koṇa sāṃbhāḻī | taiseṃ jāḻeṃ|| 12||
verses.meaning: Just as a snake sheds its skin and enters the netherworld, leaving the discarded skin behind, so too is the body burned away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां सौरभ्य जीर्णु जैसा। आमोदु मिळोनि जाय आकाशा । माघारा कमळकोशा । नयेचि तो॥१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ saurabhya jīrṇu jaisā| āmodu miḻoni jāya ākāśā | māghārā kamaḻakośā | nayeci to||13||
verses.meaning: Just as the fragrance, having mingled with the air, ascends to the sky, it never returns to the lotus bud.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं स्वरूपसमरसें। ऐक्य गा जालें तैसें । तेथ किंधर्म हें कैसें । नेणें देह ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ svarūpasamaraseṃ| aikya gā jāleṃ taiseṃ | tetha kiṃdharma heṃ kaiseṃ | neṇeṃ deha || 94||
verses.meaning: Just as the self and the universe become one, so too does the body merge into that oneness, losing all sense of its individual identity and purpose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि जन्मजरामरण। इत्यादि जे साही गुण। ते देहींचि ठेले कारण । नाहीं तया॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni janmajarāmaraṇa| ityādi je sāhī guṇa| te dehīṃci ṭhele kāraṇa | nāhīṃ tayā|| 15||
verses.meaning: Therefore, birth, old age, death, and the other six qualities, remain only with the body; they do not exist for the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घटाचिया खापरिया | घटभंगीं फेडिलिया । महदाकाश आपैसया। जालेंचि असे॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghaṭāciyā khāpariyā | ghaṭabhaṃgīṃ pheḍiliyā | mahadākāśa āpaisayā| jāleṃci ase|| 16||
verses.meaning: When the pot is broken, its fragments are discarded, and the great space (Mahadakasha) naturally remains as it always was.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी देहबुन्यि जाये। जें आपणपां आठी होये। तैं आन कांहीं आहे। तेंबांचुनी ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī dehabunyi jāye| jeṃ āpaṇapāṃ āṭhī hoye| taiṃ āna kāṃhīṃ āhe| teṃbāṃcunī || 97||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the body-consciousness dissolves when one realizes their true Self. Then, what else remains apart from that Self?

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें थोर बोधलेपणें। तयासि गा देहीं असणें । म्हणूनि तो मी म्हणें । गुणातीत ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ thora bodhalepaṇeṃ| tayāsi gā dehīṃ asaṇeṃ | mhaṇūni to mī mhaṇeṃ | guṇātīta || 18||
verses.meaning: By this great enlightenment, he is in the body, yet I call him beyond the gunas (qualities of nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ३३८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी यया देवाचिया बोला । पार्थ अति सुखावला । मेघें संबोखिला । मोरु जैसा॥१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: 338 śrījñāneśvarī yayā devāciyā bolā | pārtha ati sukhāvalā | megheṃ saṃbokhilā | moru jaisā||19||
verses.meaning: Arjuna was greatly pleased by these words of the Lord, just as a peacock is delighted by the rumbling of clouds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें तोषें बीर पुसे। जी कोण्हीं चिन्हीं तो दिसे। जयामाजीं बसे । ऐसा बोधु॥ ३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ toṣeṃ bīra puse| jī koṇhīṃ cinhīṃ to dise| jayāmājīṃ base | aisā bodhu|| 320||
verses.meaning: With that joy, the hero asks, "By what signs is He known, within whom such understanding resides?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो निर्गुण काय आचरे। कैसेनि गुण निस्तरे। हें सांगिजो माहेरें। कृपेचेनि॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to nirguṇa kāya ācare| kaiseni guṇa nistare| heṃ sāṃgijo māhereṃ| kṛpeceni|| 29||
verses.meaning: How does that attributeless (Brahman) act? How does it transcend qualities? Please explain this, O home of compassion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया अर्जुनाचिया प्रश्‍ना। तो षडूगुणांचा राणा । परिहारु आकर्णा । बोलतु असे॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā arjunāciyā praś‍nā| to ṣaḍūguṇāṃcā rāṇā | parihāru ākarṇā | bolatu ase|| 22||
verses.meaning: Arjuna's questions are being answered by the Lord, who is endowed with six divine qualities. Listen to this explanation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे पार्था तुझी नवाई । हें येतुलेंचि पुससी काई । तें नामचि तया पाहीं। सत्य लटिकें॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe pārthā tujhī navāī | heṃ yetuleṃci pusasī kāī | teṃ nāmaci tayā pāhīṃ| satya laṭikeṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, what is so new about your question? You ask about this very small thing, whether that name is true or false.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुणातीत जया नांवें॥ तो गुणाधीन तरी नव्हे। ना होय तरी नांगवे। गुणां यया॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: guṇātīta jayā nāṃveṃ|| to guṇādhīna tarī navhe| nā hoya tarī nāṃgave| guṇāṃ yayā|| 24||
verses.meaning: Though called 'beyond qualities', he is not subject to them, nor is he entangled by them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी अधीन कां नांगवें। हेंचि कैसेनि जाणावें। गुणांचिये रवरवे-। माजीं असतां॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī adhīna kāṃ nāṃgaveṃ| heṃci kaiseni jāṇāveṃ| guṇāṃciye ravarave-| mājīṃ asatāṃ|| 25||
verses.meaning: But how can one know if one is truly subservient, when one is still amidst the turmoil of the gunas?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा संदेह जरी वाहसी। तरी सुखें पुसों लाहसी। परिस आतां तयासी । रूप करूं॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā saṃdeha jarī vāhasī| tarī sukheṃ pusoṃ lāhasī| parisa ātāṃ tayāsī | rūpa karūṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: If you still harbor this doubt, you may happily ask. Listen now, I will explain it clearly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी रजाचेनि माजें। देहीं कर्माचे आणोजें। प्रवृत्ति जें घेईजे। वेंटाळुनि॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī rajāceni mājeṃ| dehīṃ karmāce āṇojeṃ| pravṛtti jeṃ gheīje| veṃṭāḻuni|| 27||
verses.meaning: Thus, due to the dominance of 'rajas' (passion), the body becomes entangled in the performance of actions, driven by the urge to engage in worldly activities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैं मीचि कां कर्मठ। ऐसा न ये श्रीमाठ। कां दरिद्रलिये बुट्यि बीट । तोही नाहीं ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiṃ mīci kāṃ karmaṭha| aisā na ye śrīmāṭha| kāṃ daridraliye buṭyi bīṭa | tohī nāhīṃ || 28||
verses.meaning: Therefore, why should I be considered a doer of actions? Such a thought does not even enter the mind of the glorious Lord. Or, is it like a seed that has become impoverished and lost its potency? No, that is not the case either.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा सत्त्वेंचि अधिकें । जें सर्वेद्रियीं ज्ञान फांके । तैं सुविद्यता तोखे। उभजेही ना॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā sattveṃci adhikeṃ | jeṃ sarvedriyīṃ jñāna phāṃke | taiṃ suvidyatā tokhe| ubhajehī nā|| 29||
verses.meaning: Or, when Sattva predominates, and knowledge spreads through all senses, then true wisdom is delighted and does not even arise (as a separate effort).

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां वाढिन्नलेनि तमें। न गिळिजेचि मोहृभ्रमें । तैं अज्ञानत्वें न श्रमे । घेणेंही नाहीं ॥ ३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ vāḍhinnaleni tameṃ| na giḻijeci mohṛbhrameṃ | taiṃ ajñānatveṃ na śrame | gheṇeṃhī nāhīṃ || 330||
verses.meaning: When the darkness of delusion does not swallow one, then the effort of acquiring knowledge is also not needed, as ignorance itself ceases to exist.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं मोहाच्या अवसरीं। ज्ञानाची चाड न धरी । ज्ञानें कर्मे नादरी। होतां न दुःखी ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ mohācyā avasarīṃ| jñānācī cāḍa na dharī | jñāneṃ karme nādarī| hotāṃ na duḥkhī || 39||
verses.meaning: When delusion takes over, one does not care for knowledge. Even if one does not respect knowledge or actions, one does not become unhappy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सायंप्रातर्मध्यान्हा। या तिन्ही काळांची गणना । नाहीं जेवीं तपना। तैसा असे॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāyaṃprātarmadhyānhā| yā tinhī kāḻāṃcī gaṇanā | nāhīṃ jevīṃ tapanā| taisā ase|| 32||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun is not bound by the calculations of morning, noon, or evening, so too is the Self (Atman) unconstrained by such temporal divisions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया वेगळाचि काय प्रकाशें॥ ज्ञानित्व यावें असें। कायि जळार्णव पाउसें । साजा होय ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā vegaḻāci kāya prakāśeṃ|| jñānitva yāveṃ aseṃ| kāyi jaḻārṇava pāuseṃ | sājā hoya || 33||
verses.meaning: How can knowledge arise from anything other than that (the Self)? Can the ocean be adorned by rain?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना प्रवर्तळेनि कर्मे । कर्मठत्व तयां कां गमे। सांगें हिमवंतु हिमें। कांपे कायी ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā pravartaḻeni karme | karmaṭhatva tayāṃ kāṃ game| sāṃgeṃ himavaṃtu himeṃ| kāṃpe kāyī || 34||
verses.meaning: How can one who is not engaged in actions be considered an actor? Tell me, does the Himalayas shiver from cold?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी मोह आलिया । काई पां ज्ञाना मुकिजैल तया । हो मा आगीतें उन्हाळेया। जाळवत असे॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī moha āliyā | kāī pāṃ jñānā mukijaila tayā | ho mā āgīteṃ unhāḻeyā| jāḻavata ase|| 35||
verses.meaning: If delusion arises, how can knowledge be abandoned? Can the summer heat burn fire itself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें गुणागुणकार्य हें । आघवेंचि आपण आहे । म्हणौनि एकेका नोहे । 'तडातोडी॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ guṇāguṇakārya heṃ | āghaveṃci āpaṇa āhe | mhaṇauni ekekā nohe | 'taḍātoḍī|| 36||
verses.meaning: Just as the qualities and their actions are all within oneself, so there is no separation or division among them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येवढे गा प्रतीती। तो देहा आलासे वस्ती । वाटे जातां गुंती-। माजीं जैसा॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yevaḍhe gā pratītī| to dehā ālāse vastī | vāṭe jātāṃ guṃtī-| mājīṃ jaisā|| 37||
verses.meaning: Such is the experience: it has come to reside in the body, like one entangled on a path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो जिणता ना हारवी। तैसा गुण नव्हे ना करवी । जैसी कां श्रोणवी । संग्रामींची ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: to jiṇatā nā hāravī| taisā guṇa navhe nā karavī | jaisī kāṃ śroṇavī | saṃgrāmīṃcī || 38 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a warrior in battle does not lose or cause defeat, so too, this quality (of the Self) neither wins nor loses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां शरीराआंतील प्राणु । घरीं आतिथ्याचा ब्राह्मणु। नाना चोहटांचा स्थाणु। उदासु जैसा ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ śarīrāāṃtīla prāṇu | gharīṃ ātithyācā brāhmaṇu| nānā cohaṭāṃcā sthāṇu| udāsu jaisā || 39||
verses.meaning: Or, the life-breath within the body is like a Brahmin guest in a house, or like a neutral statue at a crossroads.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि गुणाचा यावाजावा। ढळे चळे ना पांडवा। मृगजळाचा हेलावा। मेरु जैसा॥ ३४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi guṇācā yāvājāvā| ḍhaḻe caḻe nā pāṃḍavā| mṛgajaḻācā helāvā| meru jaisā|| 340||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, the coming and going of qualities does not affect the unwavering Meru mountain, just as the mirage's shimmer does not move it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बहुत कायि बोलिजे। व्योम वारेनि न बचिजे। कां सूर्य ना गिळिजे। अंधकारें॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ bahuta kāyi bolije| vyoma vāreni na bacije| kāṃ sūrya nā giḻije| aṃdhakāreṃ|| 41||
verses.meaning: What more can be said? The sky cannot be swallowed by the wind, nor can the sun be devoured by darkness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वप्न कां गा जियापरी। जागतयातें न सिंतरी । गुणीं तैसा अवधारीं। न बंधिजे तो॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: svapna kāṃ gā jiyāparī| jāgatayāteṃ na siṃtarī | guṇīṃ taisā avadhārīṃ| na baṃdhije to|| 42||
verses.meaning: Just as a dream does not bind one who is awake, so too, the Self is not bound by the gunas (qualities of nature).

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुणांसि कौर नातुडे । परी दुरूनि जैं पाहे कोडें। तैं गुणदोष सायिखडें। सभ्यु जैसा ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: guṇāṃsi kaura nātuḍe | parī durūni jaiṃ pāhe koḍeṃ| taiṃ guṇadoṣa sāyikhaḍeṃ| sabhyu jaisā || 43||
verses.meaning: The qualities (of the world) do not touch the Self, but when it observes them from afar with curiosity, it sees both merits and flaws, like a discerning spectator.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सत्करमे सात्त्विकीं। रज तें रजोविषयकीं । तम मोहादिकीं । वर्तत असे॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: satkarame sāttvikīṃ| raja teṃ rajoviṣayakīṃ | tama mohādikīṃ | vartata ase|| 44||
verses.meaning: Good deeds are performed by those in the mode of goodness (sattva), passionate actions by those in the mode of passion (rajas), and delusion-driven actions by those in the mode of ignorance (tamas).

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'परिस तयाचिया गा सत्ता । होती गुणक्रिया समस्ता । हें फुडें जाणे सविता । लौकिका जेवीं ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'parisa tayāciyā gā sattā | hotī guṇakriyā samastā | heṃ phuḍeṃ jāṇe savitā | laukikā jevīṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun illuminates the world, so too all qualities and actions exist under His dominion. This truth is known to the wise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: समुद्रचि भरती। सोमकांतचि द्रवती। कुमुदें विकासती। चंद्रु तो उगा॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: samudraci bharatī| somakāṃtaci dravatī| kumudeṃ vikāsatī| caṃdru to ugā|| 46||
verses.meaning: Just as the ocean swells, moonstones melt, and water lilies bloom when the moon rises.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां वाराचि वाजे विझे। गगनें निश्चळ असिजे। तैसा गुणाचिये गजबजे। डोळेना जो ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ vārāci vāje vijhe| gaganeṃ niścaḻa asije| taisā guṇāciye gajabaje| ḍoḻenā jo || 47||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind may blow and then subside, but the sky remains ever still and undisturbed, so too is the one who, amidst the clamor and activity of the Gunas (qualities of nature), remains unshaken and unaffected.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना येणें लक्षणें । तो गुणातीतु जाणणें। परिस आतां आचरणें। तयाचीं जीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā yeṇeṃ lakṣaṇeṃ | to guṇātītu jāṇaṇeṃ| parisa ātāṃ ācaraṇeṃ| tayācīṃ jīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, by these characteristics, know him to be beyond the three Gunas. Now listen to his actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी वस्त्रासि पाठीं पोटीं । नाहीं सुतावांचूनि किरीटी। ऐसें सुये दिठी । चराचर मद्रूपें॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī vastrāsi pāṭhīṃ poṭīṃ | nāhīṃ sutāvāṃcūni kirīṭī| aiseṃ suye diṭhī | carācara madrūpeṃ|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as a cloth, whether front or back, is nothing but threads, so too, all animate and inanimate creation is seen by Me as My own form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सुखदुःखासरिसें। कांटाळें आचरे ऐसें। रिपुभक्तां जैसें । हरीचें देणें ॥ ३५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sukhaduḥkhāsariseṃ| kāṃṭāḻeṃ ācare aiseṃ| ripubhaktāṃ jaiseṃ | harīceṃ deṇeṃ || 350||
verses.meaning: Therefore, just as the Lord's grace is bestowed upon both enemies and devotees alike, so too does the soul experience both joy and sorrow with equal detachment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं तरी सहजें। सुखदुःख तैंचि सेविजे। देहजळीं होइजे। मासोळीं जै॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ tarī sahajeṃ| sukhaduḥkha taiṃci sevije| dehajaḻīṃ hoije| māsoḻīṃ jai|| 51||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, happiness and sorrow are naturally experienced, just as a fish is born in water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तें तंब तेणें सांडिलें। आहे स्वस्वरूपेंसीचि मांडिलें। सस्यांतीं निवडिलें। बीज जैसें ॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ teṃ taṃba teṇeṃ sāṃḍileṃ| āhe svasvarūpeṃsīci māṃḍileṃ| sasyāṃtīṃ nivaḍileṃ| bīja jaiseṃ ||52||
verses.meaning: Now, that (illusion) has been abandoned by it (the Self); it is established in its own true nature, like a seed chosen at the end of the harvest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां बोघ सांडूनि गांग । रिघोनि समुद्राचें आंग । निस्तरलळी लगबग । खळाळाची ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bogha sāṃḍūni gāṃga | righoni samudrāceṃ āṃga | nistaralaḻī lagabaga | khaḻāḻācī || 53||
verses.meaning: Or, just as the Ganges, abandoning its own form, enters the ocean and becomes one with its vastness, losing the tumultuous rush of its waves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं आपणपांचि जया। वस्ती जाली गा धनंजया । तया देहीं अपैसया। सुख तैसें दुःख ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ āpaṇapāṃci jayā| vastī jālī gā dhanaṃjayā | tayā dehīṃ apaisayā| sukha taiseṃ duḥkha || 54||
verses.meaning: Just as one who has found their true self, O Dhananjaya, experiences both happiness and sorrow naturally within their body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रात्रि तैसें पाहलें। हें धारणा जेवीं एक जाळें। ३४० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आत्माराम देहीं आतलें। दृंद्र तैसें। ५५ ॥ पैं निद्रिताचेनि आंगेंशी । साप तैशी उर्वशी । तेवीं स्वरूपस्था सरिशीं । देहीं दंद्रें॥ ५६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: rātri taiseṃ pāhaleṃ| heṃ dhāraṇā jevīṃ eka jāḻeṃ| 340 śrījñāneśvarī ātmārāma dehīṃ ātaleṃ| dṛṃdra taiseṃ| 55 || paiṃ nidritāceni āṃgeṃśī | sāpa taiśī urvaśī | tevīṃ svarūpasthā sariśīṃ | dehīṃ daṃdreṃ|| 56 ||
verses.meaning: Just as night gives way to dawn, and a net holds its catch, so too is the Self (Atmaram) contained within the body, like a serpent within a sleeping person, or a celestial nymph (Urvashi) within a dream. Thus, the duality (dwaṃdra) of the Self and the body is experienced by those established in their true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तयाच्या ठायीं । शेणा सोनया विशेष नाहीं। रत्ना गुंडेया कांहीं । नेणिजे भेदु ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ | śeṇā sonayā viśeṣa nāhīṃ| ratnā guṃḍeyā kāṃhīṃ | neṇije bhedu || 57||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for such a one, there is no distinction between cow dung and gold. They do not perceive any difference between a gem and a pebble.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घरा येवो पां स्वर्ग कां वरिपडो वाघ। परी आत्मबुद्धीसि भंग) कदा नोहे ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: gharā yevo pāṃ svarga kāṃ varipaḍo vāgha| parī ātmabuddhīsi bhaṃga) kadā nohe || 58||
verses.meaning: Whether heaven comes to one's home, or a tiger attacks, the realization of the Self is never disturbed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निवटळें न उपवडे। जळिनलें न विरूढे। साम्यबुन्धि न मोडे । तयापरी ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nivaṭaḻeṃ na upavaḍe| jaḻinaleṃ na virūḍhe| sāmyabundhi na moḍe | tayāparī || 59||
verses.meaning: Just as a burnt seed will not sprout, and a withered plant will not grow, so too, the equanimous intellect remains unbroken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ब्रह्मा ऐसेनि स्तविजो। कां नीच म्हणोनि निंदिजो। परी नेणें जळो विझों। राखोंडी जैसी ॥ ३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā brahmā aiseni stavijo| kāṃ nīca mhaṇoni niṃdijo| parī neṇeṃ jaḻo vijhoṃ| rākhoṃḍī jaisī || 360||
verses.meaning: Whether it is praised as Brahman or condemned as lowly, it knows not how to be extinguished, just like ashes that cannot be put out by water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसी निंदा आणि स्तुति । नये कोण्हेचि व्यक्‍ती । नाहीं अंधारें कां वाती । सूर्या घरीं ॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tesī niṃdā āṇi stuti | naye koṇheci vyak‍tī | nāhīṃ aṃdhāreṃ kāṃ vātī | sūryā gharīṃ ||69||
verses.meaning: Similarly, neither slander nor praise can affect the Self. Just as darkness or lamps have no effect on the sun's abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ईश्‍वर म्हणौनि पूजिला । कां चोरु म्हणौनि गांजिला । वृषगजीं वेढिला । केला रावो॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: īś‍vara mhaṇauni pūjilā | kāṃ coru mhaṇauni gāṃjilā | vṛṣagajīṃ veḍhilā | kelā rāvo|| 62||
verses.meaning: Whether worshipped as God, or persecuted as a thief, or surrounded by a herd of bulls and elephants, or made a king.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां सुहृद पासी आळे। अथवा वैरी वरपडे जाळे। परी नेणें राती पाहालें। तेज जेवीं ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ suhṛda pāsī āḻe| athavā vairī varapaḍe jāḻe| parī neṇeṃ rātī pāhāleṃ| teja jevīṃ || 63||
verses.meaning: Just as light does not distinguish between a friend approaching or an enemy appearing, it simply shines.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साही क्रतु येतां आकाशें । लिंपिजेचि ना जैसें। तेवीं वैषम्य मानसें । जाणिजेना ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāhī kratu yetāṃ ākāśeṃ | liṃpijeci nā jaiseṃ| tevīṃ vaiṣamya mānaseṃ | jāṇijenā || 64||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky is not stained even when six seasons pass through it, so too, the mind is not affected by adversity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणीकही एकु पाहीं । आचारु तयाच्या ठायीं । तरी व्यापारासि नाहीं । जालें दिसे॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇīkahī eku pāhīṃ | ācāru tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ | tarī vyāpārāsi nāhīṃ | jāleṃ dise|| 65||
verses.meaning: And behold, there is another characteristic in him: his actions appear to be without any motive or purpose.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्वारंभा उटकळें। प्रवृत्तीचे तेथ मावळलें । जळती गा कर्मफळें। ते तो आगी ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarvāraṃbhā uṭakaḻeṃ| pravṛttīce tetha māvaḻaleṃ | jaḻatī gā karmaphaḻeṃ| te to āgī || 66||
verses.meaning: All undertakings cease, and worldly inclinations fade away. The fruits of actions are consumed, as if by fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दृष्टादृष्टाचेनि नांवें। भावचि जीवीं नुगवे। सेवी जें कां स्वभावें । पैठें होय॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dṛṣṭādṛṣṭāceni nāṃveṃ| bhāvaci jīvīṃ nugave| sevī jeṃ kāṃ svabhāveṃ | paiṭheṃ hoya|| 67||
verses.meaning: The very thought of the seen and the unseen does not arise in the mind; it is naturally absorbed in that which is inherently present.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुखे ना शिणे। पाषाणु कां जेणें मानें। तैसीं सांडीमांडी मनें। वर्जिली असे॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sukhe nā śiṇe| pāṣāṇu kāṃ jeṇeṃ māneṃ| taisīṃ sāṃḍīmāṃḍī maneṃ| varjilī ase|| 68||
verses.meaning: Just as a stone does not tire from its own weight, so too the mind, having renounced all attachments and detachments, remains undisturbed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां किती हा विस्तारु । जाणें ऐसा आचारु । जयातें तोचि साचारु । गुणातीतु॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ kitī hā vistāru | jāṇeṃ aisā ācāru | jayāteṃ toci sācāru | guṇātītu|| 69||
verses.meaning: Why elaborate further? One who understands this conduct is truly beyond the three Gunas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुणांतें अतिक्रमणे । घडे उपायें जेणें। तो आतां आईक म्हणे । श्रीकृष्णनाथु ॥ ३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: guṇāṃteṃ atikramaṇe | ghaḍe upāyeṃ jeṇeṃ| to ātāṃ āīka mhaṇe | śrīkṛṣṇanāthu || 370||
verses.meaning: Lord Krishna now says, "Listen to the means by which one transcends the Gunas."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी व्यभिचाररहित चित्तें। भक्‍्तियोगें मातें। सेवी तो गुणातें। जाकळूं शके ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī vyabhicārarahita citteṃ| bhak‍tiyogeṃ māteṃ| sevī to guṇāteṃ| jākaḻūṃ śake || 71||
verses.meaning: Therefore, with a mind free from deviation, through the path of devotion, one who serves Me can overcome the qualities of nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी कोण मी कैसी भक्ती। अव्यभिचारा काय व्यक्‍ती । हे आघवीचि निरुती । होआवी लागे॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī koṇa mī kaisī bhaktī| avyabhicārā kāya vyak‍tī | he āghavīci nirutī | hoāvī lāge|| 72||
verses.meaning: Therefore, who am I, and what is this devotion? What is the nature of unwavering devotion? All these must be clearly understood.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पार्था परियेसा। मी तंव येथ ऐसा। रत्नीं किळावो जैसा। रत्नचि कीं तो॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī pārthā pariyesā| mī taṃva yetha aisā| ratnīṃ kiḻāvo jaisā| ratnaci kīṃ to|| 73||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen, O Partha, I am like this here: just as a sparkle is in a gem, so too is that gem itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां द्रवपणचि नीर। अवकाशचि अंबर। गोडी तेचि साखर। आन नाहीं॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ dravapaṇaci nīra| avakāśaci aṃbara| goḍī teci sākhara| āna nāhīṃ|| 74||
verses.meaning: Just as liquidity is water itself, and space is the sky itself, and sweetness is sugar itself, there is no difference.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वन्हि तेचि ज्वाळ। दळाचि नांब कमळ। रुख तेंचि डाळ-। फळादिक ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: vanhi teci jvāḻa| daḻāci nāṃba kamaḻa| rukha teṃci ḍāḻa-| phaḻādika || 75||
verses.meaning: Fire is indeed its flame; a lotus is its stalk; a tree is its branches and fruits.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा हिम जें आकर्षलें। तेंचि हिमवंत जेवीं जालें। नाना दूध मुरालें। तेंचि दहीं ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā hima jeṃ ākarṣaleṃ| teṃci himavaṃta jevīṃ jāleṃ| nānā dūdha murāleṃ| teṃci dahīṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: Just as the snow that is drawn together becomes the Himalayas, or milk that curdles becomes yogurt.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें विश्व येणें नांवें। हें मीचि पै आधवें। घेई चंद्रबिंब सोलावें॥ न लगे जेवीं ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ viśva yeṇeṃ nāṃveṃ| heṃ mīci pai ādhaveṃ| gheī caṃdrabiṃba solāveṃ|| na lage jevīṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon's reflection in water is not separate from the moon itself, so too is this universe, known by the name 'world,' entirely Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घृताचें थिजलेंपण। न मोडितां घृतचि जाण । कां नाटितां कांकण। सोनेंचि तें ॥७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghṛtāceṃ thijaleṃpaṇa| na moḍitāṃ ghṛtaci jāṇa | kāṃ nāṭitāṃ kāṃkaṇa| soneṃci teṃ ||78||
verses.meaning: Just as solidified ghee remains ghee, or a bangle, even when shaped, remains gold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न उकलितां पटु। तंतुचि असे स्पष्टु। न विरवितां घटु। मृत्तिका जेवीं ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: na ukalitāṃ paṭu| taṃtuci ase spaṣṭu| na viravitāṃ ghaṭu| mṛttikā jevīṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: Just as a cloth, without being unraveled, is clearly thread, and a pot, without being destroyed, is clearly clay.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विश्वपण जावें। मग मातें घेयावें। तैसा नव्हे आघवें। सकटचि मी॥ ३८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni viśvapaṇa jāveṃ| maga māteṃ gheyāveṃ| taisā navhe āghaveṃ| sakaṭaci mī|| 380||
verses.meaning: Therefore, it is not that the universe must first cease to exist for Me to be perceived. Rather, I am the entirety, including the universe itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि मातें जाणिजे। ते अव्यभिचारी भक्ति म्हणिजे। येथ भेद कांहीं देखिजे। तरी व्यभिचारु तो ॥८९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni māteṃ jāṇije| te avyabhicārī bhakti mhaṇije| yetha bheda kāṃhīṃ dekhije| tarī vyabhicāru to ||891||
verses.meaning: To know Me in this way is called unswerving devotion. If any difference is perceived here, then that is unfaithfulness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें भेदातें। सांडूनि अभेदें चित्तें। आपणा सकट मातें। जाणावें गा॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ bhedāteṃ| sāṃḍūni abhedeṃ citteṃ| āpaṇā sakaṭa māteṃ| jāṇāveṃ gā||82||
verses.meaning: Therefore, abandoning all distinctions and with a mind fixed on non-duality, know Me along with yourself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्था सोनियाची टिका। सोनियासी लागली देखा । तैसें आपणपें आणिका । मानावें ना॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārthā soniyācī ṭikā| soniyāsī lāgalī dekhā | taiseṃ āpaṇapeṃ āṇikā | mānāveṃ nā|| 83||
verses.meaning: O Partha, just as a golden ornament is made of gold, and that gold is seen to be in the ornament itself, so too should one not consider oneself to be separate from the Divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेजाचा तेजौनि निघाला । परी तेजींचि असे लागला । तया रश्मी ऐसा भला । बोधु होआवा॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tejācā tejauni nighālā | parī tejīṃci ase lāgalā | tayā raśmī aisā bhalā | bodhu hoāvā|| 84||
verses.meaning: Just as a ray of light, though emanating from the sun, remains intrinsically connected to the sun, so too should understanding arise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं परमाणु भूतळीं । हिमकणु हिमाचळीं । मजमाजीं न्याहाळीं । अहं तैसें॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ paramāṇu bhūtaḻīṃ | himakaṇu himācaḻīṃ | majamājīṃ nyāhāḻīṃ | ahaṃ taiseṃ|| 85||
verses.meaning: Just as an atom on the earth, or a snowflake on the Himalayas, behold them within Me; so too am I.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हो कां तरंगु लहानु । परी सिंधूसी नाहीं भिन्नु। तैसा ईश्वरी मी आनु । नोहेचि मा॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ho kāṃ taraṃgu lahānu | parī siṃdhūsī nāhīṃ bhinnu| taisā īśvarī mī ānu | noheci mā|| 86||
verses.meaning: Just as a small wave is not different from the ocean, so too, I am not separate from God.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि बा समरसें। दृष्टि जे उल्हासे। ते भक्ति पै ऐसें। आम्ही म्हणो ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni bā samaraseṃ| dṛṣṭi je ulhāse| te bhakti pai aiseṃ| āmhī mhaṇo || 87||
verses.meaning: Thus, when the vision blossoms into oneness, that, we say, is devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ज्ञानाचे चांगावें। इयेचि दृष्टि नांवें । योगाचेंही आघवें। सर्वस्व हें ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jñānāce cāṃgāveṃ| iyeci dṛṣṭi nāṃveṃ | yogāceṃhī āghaveṃ| sarvasva heṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: And the goodness of knowledge, in this very vision it resides. This is also the entire essence of Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सिंधू आणि जळधरा-। माजीं लागळी अखंड धारा तैसी वृत्ति वीरा। प्रवर्ते ते॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: siṃdhū āṇi jaḻadharā-| mājīṃ lāgaḻī akhaṃḍa dhārā taisī vṛtti vīrā| pravarte te|| 89||
verses.meaning: Just as there is an unceasing flow between the ocean and the clouds, so too does the mind of a true hero act.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां कुहेसीं आकाशा । तोडीं सांदा नाहीं जैंसा। तो परम पुरुषीं तैसा। एकवटे गा॥ ३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ kuhesīṃ ākāśā | toḍīṃ sāṃdā nāhīṃ jaiṃsā| to parama puruṣīṃ taisā| ekavaṭe gā|| 390||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky has no joints or seams, so too does the Supreme Being remain undivided and one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रतिबिंबौनि बिंबवरी । प्रभेची जैसी उजरी। ते सो$हंवृत्ती अवधारीं। तेसी होय ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pratibiṃbauni biṃbavarī | prabhecī jaisī ujarī| te so$haṃvṛttī avadhārīṃ| tesī hoya || 91||
verses.meaning: Just as the reflection illuminates the original image, so too does the 'I am That' realization manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि मग परस्परें। ते सो5हंवृत्ति जें अवतरे। तैं तियेहि सकट सरे। अपैसया॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni maga paraspareṃ| te so5haṃvṛtti jeṃ avatare| taiṃ tiyehi sakaṭa sare| apaisayā|| 92||
verses.meaning: Then, through such mutual interaction, when that 'So'ham' (I am He) consciousness arises, even that too spontaneously dissolves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसा सैंधवाचा रवा । सिंधूमाजीं पांडवा । विरालेया विरवावा । हेंही ठाके ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisā saiṃdhavācā ravā | siṃdhūmājīṃ pāṃḍavā | virāleyā viravāvā | heṃhī ṭhāke || 93||
verses.meaning: Just as a grain of salt, O Pandava, dissolves and merges into the ocean, so too does this (distinction between the individual self and the Supreme Self) cease to exist.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी जाळूनि तृण। वबन्हिही विझे आपण । तैसें भेदु नाशूनि जाण । ज्ञानही नुरे॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī jāḻūni tṛṇa| vabanhihī vijhe āpaṇa | taiseṃ bhedu nāśūni jāṇa | jñānahī nure|| 94||
verses.meaning: Just as fire, having consumed the grass, extinguishes itself, so too, upon the destruction of duality, knowledge itself ceases to exist.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझें पैलपण जाये। भक्त हें ऐलपण ठाये। अनादि ऐक्य जें आहे। तेंचि निवडे॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājheṃ pailapaṇa jāye| bhakta heṃ ailapaṇa ṭhāye| anādi aikya jeṃ āhe| teṃci nivaḍe|| 95||
verses.meaning: My otherness vanishes, and the devotee's presence is established. The eternal oneness that exists then becomes clear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां गुणातें तो किरीटी। जिणे या नव्हती गोष्टी। जे एकपणाही मिठी। पडों सरली ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ guṇāteṃ to kirīṭī| jiṇe yā navhatī goṣṭī| je ekapaṇāhī miṭhī| paḍoṃ saralī || 96||
verses.meaning: Now, O Kiriti, the one who has conquered these qualities, for him, these are not mere words; even the embrace of oneness has ceased to exist.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना ऐसी दशा । तें ब्रह्मत्व गा सुदंशा। हें तो पावें जो ऐसा । मातें भजे ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā aisī daśā | teṃ brahmatva gā sudaṃśā| heṃ to pāveṃ jo aisā | māteṃ bhaje || 97||
verses.meaning: Indeed, such a state, that very Brahmanhood, O beautiful one, is attained by one who worships Me in this manner.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढती इहीं लिंगीं । भक्‍तु जो माझा जगीं। हे ब्रह्मता ३४२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तयालागीं । पतित्रता ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhatī ihīṃ liṃgīṃ | bhak‍tu jo mājhā jagīṃ| he brahmatā 342 śrījñāneśvarī tayālāgīṃ | patitratā || 98||
verses.meaning: Furthermore, for those who are devoted to me in this world, this very devotion is their chastity, their ultimate truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें गंगेचेनि बोघें। डळमळीत जळ जें निघे। सिंधुपद तयाजोगें। आन नाहीं ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ gaṃgeceni bogheṃ| ḍaḻamaḻīta jaḻa jeṃ nighe| siṃdhupada tayājogeṃ| āna nāhīṃ || 99||
verses.meaning: Just as the turbulent waters that flow from the Ganges find no other suitable destination than the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा ज्ञानाचिया दिठी। जो मातें सेवी किरीटी। तो होय ब्रह्मतेच्या मुकुटीं। चूडारत्न॥ ४००॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā jñānāciyā diṭhī| jo māteṃ sevī kirīṭī| to hoya brahmatecyā mukuṭīṃ| cūḍāratna|| 400||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti, he who perceives Me through the eye of knowledge becomes the crest-jewel in the crown of Brahmanhood.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया ब्रह्मत्वासीचि पार्था । सायुज्य ऐसी व्यवस्था । याचि नांवें चौथा । पुरुषार्थ गा॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā brahmatvāsīci pārthā | sāyujya aisī vyavasthā | yāci nāṃveṃ cauthā | puruṣārtha gā|| 1||
verses.meaning: O Partha, this very state of Brahman, this very union, is known as the fourth human pursuit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी माझें आराधन । ब्रह्ात्वीं होय सोपान । तेथ मी हन साधन । गमेन हो॥२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī mājheṃ ārādhana | brahātvīṃ hoya sopāna | tetha mī hana sādhana | gamena ho||2||
verses.meaning: But my worship becomes the very ladder to Brahmanhood. There, I myself become the means to attain it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी झणीं ऐसें। तुझ्या चित्तीं पैसें। पैं ब्रह्म आन नसे। मीवबांचूनि॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jhaṇīṃ aiseṃ| tujhyā cittīṃ paiseṃ| paiṃ brahma āna nase| mīvabāṃcūni|| 3||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let this truth quickly enter your mind: there is no Brahman other than Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा ब्रह्म या नांवा। अभिप्राबो मी पांडवा। मीचि बोलिजे आघवा । शब्दीं इहीं ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā brahma yā nāṃvā| abhiprābo mī pāṃḍavā| mīci bolije āghavā | śabdīṃ ihīṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, the very word 'Brahman' refers to Me. Indeed, all these words speak of Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं मंडळ आणि चंद्रमा । दोन्ही नव्हती सुवर्मा। तैसा मज आणि ब्रह्मा। भेदु नाहीं ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ maṃḍaḻa āṇi caṃdramā | donhī navhatī suvarmā| taisā maja āṇi brahmā| bhedu nāhīṃ || 5||
verses.meaning: Just as there is no difference between the sun and the moon, so too there is no difference between Me and Brahma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा नित्य जें निष्कंप। अनावृत धर्मरूप। सुख जें उमप। अद्वितीय ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā nitya jeṃ niṣkaṃpa| anāvṛta dharmarūpa| sukha jeṃ umapa| advitīya || 6||
verses.meaning: That which is eternally unwavering, the unmanifest form of righteousness, that immeasurable and unparalleled bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विवेकु आपलें काम। सारूनि ठाकी जें धाम। निष्कर्षाचें निःसीम। किंबहुना मी॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: viveku āpaleṃ kāma| sārūni ṭhākī jeṃ dhāma| niṣkarṣāceṃ niḥsīma| kiṃbahunā mī|| 7||
verses.meaning: When discrimination completes its task and reaches the ultimate conclusion, that supreme, boundless truth is none other than Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेसें हो अवधारा । तो अनन्याचा सोयरा । सांगतसे वीरा । पार्थासी ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseseṃ ho avadhārā | to ananyācā soyarā | sāṃgatase vīrā | pārthāsī || 8||
verses.meaning: Listen carefully to this, Arjuna, for the Lord, the companion of those who are devoted to Him alone, is now speaking to the valiant Partha.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ धृतराष्ट्र म्हणे । संजया हें तूतें कोणें । पुसलेनिविण वायाणें। कां बोलसी ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha dhṛtarāṣṭra mhaṇe | saṃjayā heṃ tūteṃ koṇeṃ | pusaleniviṇa vāyāṇeṃ| kāṃ bolasī || 9||
verses.meaning: Here Dhritarashtra says, "Sanjaya, who asked you to speak these unnecessary words? Why do you speak them?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझी अवसरी ते फेडीं। विजयाची सांगें गुढी। येरु जीवीं म्हणे सांडीं। गोठी इया॥ ४९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhī avasarī te pheḍīṃ| vijayācī sāṃgeṃ guḍhī| yeru jīvīṃ mhaṇe sāṃḍīṃ| goṭhī iyā|| 490||
verses.meaning: Remove my unworthiness, and raise the banner of victory. The other (Arjuna) thought in his heart, "Let go of these words."

verses.shloka_devanagari: संजयो विस्मयो मानसीं । आहा करूनी रसरसी। म्हणे कैसें पां देवेंसी । दं यया ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃjayo vismayo mānasīṃ | āhā karūnī rasarasī| mhaṇe kaiseṃ pāṃ deveṃsī | daṃ yayā || 19||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya, with wonder in his mind, exclaimed with great emotion, "How can I describe the Lord's divine power?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तो कृपाळु तुष्टो। यया विवेकु हा घोंटो । मोहाचा फिटो । महारोगु॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī to kṛpāḻu tuṣṭo| yayā viveku hā ghoṃṭo | mohācā phiṭo | mahārogu|| 12||
verses.meaning: May that compassionate one be pleased, and may this discrimination be imbibed, so that the great disease of delusion may be cured.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संजयो ऐसें चिंतितां। संवादु तो सांभाळितां । हरिखाचा येतु चित्ता। महापूर ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃjayo aiseṃ ciṃtitāṃ| saṃvādu to sāṃbhāḻitāṃ | harikhācā yetu cittā| mahāpūra || 13||
verses.meaning: As Sanjaya thus contemplated and remembered that dialogue, a great flood of joy came to his mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आतां येणें। उत्साहाचेनि अवतरणें । श्रीकृष्णाचे बोलणें । सांगिजेळ ॥१४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ātāṃ yeṇeṃ| utsāhāceni avataraṇeṃ | śrīkṛṣṇāce bolaṇeṃ | sāṃgijeḻa ||14||
verses.meaning: Therefore, now, with this enthusiastic introduction, the words of Shri Krishna will be expounded.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अक्षराआंतील भावो । 'पाववीन मी तुमचा ठावो। आइका म्हणे ज्ञानदेवो। निवृत्तीचा ॥ ४९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā akṣarāāṃtīla bhāvo | 'pāvavīna mī tumacā ṭhāvo| āikā mhaṇe jñānadevo| nivṛttīcā || 495||
verses.meaning: The inner meaning of those words is, 'I will lead you to your true abode.' Thus says Dnyandev, the disciple of Nivrutti, 'Listen!'

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां हृदय हें आपुलें। चौफळूनियां भलें। वरी बैसऊं पाठळलें। श्रीगुरूंची ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ hṛdaya heṃ āpuleṃ| cauphaḻūniyāṃ bhaleṃ| varī baisaūṃ pāṭhaḻaleṃ| śrīgurūṃcī || 1||
verses.meaning: Now, let us make our heart a beautiful, four-petaled lotus, and upon it, seat the divine form of Shri Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐक्यभावाची अंजुळी। सर्वेद्रिय कुड्मुळीं। भरूनियां पुष्पांजुळी। अर्घ्यु देवो ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: aikyabhāvācī aṃjuḻī| sarvedriya kuḍmuḻīṃ| bharūniyāṃ puṣpāṃjuḻī| arghyu devo || 2||
verses.meaning: With the cupped hands of unity, let us offer a floral oblation, filling the senses with devotion, as an offering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनन्योदर्के धुबट। वासना जे तन्निष्ठ। तें 'लागलेंसे अबोट । चंदनाचे ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ananyodarke dhubaṭa| vāsanā je tanniṣṭha| teṃ 'lāgaleṃse aboṭa | caṃdanāce || 3||
verses.meaning: When the mind, with its desires, becomes completely absorbed in the divine, it is like the sandalwood tree, which, even in its raw state, inherently possesses its fragrance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रेमाचेनि भांगारें । निर्वाळूनि नूपुरें।॥ लेवऊं सुकुमारें। पदें तियें ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: premāceni bhāṃgāreṃ | nirvāḻūni nūpureṃ||| levaūṃ sukumāreṃ| padeṃ tiyeṃ || 4||
verses.meaning: With the pure gold of love, I shall fashion anklets and adorn those tender feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घणावळी आवडी । अव्यभिचारें चोखडी । तिये घाळूं जोडी । आंगोळिया॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghaṇāvaḻī āvaḍī | avyabhicāreṃ cokhaḍī | tiye ghāḻūṃ joḍī | āṃgoḻiyā|| 5||
verses.meaning: With unwavering devotion, pure and true, I shall offer my fingers, like a garland, to You.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आनंदामोदबहळ। सात्त्विकाचें मुकुळ। तें उमललें अष्टदळ। ठेऊं वरी॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ānaṃdāmodabahaḻa| sāttvikāceṃ mukuḻa| teṃ umalaleṃ aṣṭadaḻa| ṭheūṃ varī||6||
verses.meaning: The joy and fragrance, the bud of sattva, blossomed into an eight-petaled flower, which we shall place upon the head.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथें अहं हा धूप जाळूं। नाहं तेजें बोवाळूं। सामरस्यें पोटाळूं । निरंतर ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetheṃ ahaṃ hā dhūpa jāḻūṃ| nāhaṃ tejeṃ bovāḻūṃ| sāmarasyeṃ poṭāḻūṃ | niraṃtara || 7||
verses.meaning: There, I will burn the incense of ego, and with the light of non-ego, I will offer the arati, embracing the oneness of all, continuously.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझी तनु आणि प्राण । इया दोनी 'पाउवा लेऊं श्रीगुरुचरण। करूं भोगमोक्षनिंबळोण। पायां तयां ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhī tanu āṇi prāṇa | iyā donī 'pāuvā leūṃ śrīgurucaraṇa| karūṃ bhogamokṣaniṃbaḻoṇa| pāyāṃ tayāṃ || 8||
verses.meaning: My body and life, these two I offer at the feet of my Guru. I make them an offering for the sake of both worldly enjoyment and liberation, at his feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया गुरुचरणसेवा। हों पात्र तया दैवा। जे सकळार्थमेळावा । पाटू बांधे ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā gurucaraṇasevā| hoṃ pātra tayā daivā| je sakaḻārthameḻāvā | pāṭū bāṃdhe || 9||
verses.meaning: Through this service to the Guru's feet, one becomes worthy of that divine fortune, which is the culmination of all attainments, firmly established.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ब्रह्मींचें बिसवणेंवरी । उन्मेख लाहे उजरी । जें वाचेतें इयें करी । सुधासिंधु ॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: brahmīṃceṃ bisavaṇeṃvarī | unmekha lāhe ujarī | jeṃ vāceteṃ iyeṃ karī | sudhāsiṃdhu || 10||
verses.meaning: Upon the blossoming of Brahman, the intellect attains illumination, and this very speech becomes a nectarous ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पूर्णचंद्राचिया कोडी । ववतृत्वा घापें कुरोंडी । तैसी आणी गोडी । अक्षरांतें ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pūrṇacaṃdrāciyā koḍī | vavatṛtvā ghāpeṃ kuroṃḍī | taisī āṇī goḍī | akṣarāṃteṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Just as the full moon's radiance brings joy, so too does the eloquence of these words bring sweetness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सूर्ये अधिष्ठिली प्राची । जगा राणीव दे प्रकाशाची। तैसी वाचा श्रोतयां ज्ञानाची । दिवाळी करी॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: sūrye adhiṣṭhilī prācī | jagā rāṇīva de prakāśācī| taisī vācā śrotayāṃ jñānācī | divāḻī karī|| 12||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun, rising in the east, bestows the gift of light upon the world, so too does this discourse illuminate the listeners with the light of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नादब्रह्म खुजें। कैवल्यही तैसें न सजे। ऐसा बोलु देखिजे। जेणें दैवें ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nādabrahma khujeṃ| kaivalyahī taiseṃ na saje| aisā bolu dekhije| jeṇeṃ daiveṃ || 13||
verses.meaning: The sound-Brahman is dwarfed, and even liberation does not appear as grand. Such a statement is seen, by which fortune.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रवणसुखाच्या मांडवीं । विश्व भोगी माधवीं। तैसी सासिन्नली बरवी। वाचावल्ली ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: śravaṇasukhācyā māṃḍavīṃ | viśva bhogī mādhavīṃ| taisī sāsinnalī baravī| vācāvallī || 14||
verses.meaning: Just as the world enjoys the sweetness of spring in the delightful canopy of hearing, so too does this beautiful vine of speech blossom forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ठावो न पवता जयाचा मनेंसी मुरडली वाचा। तो देवो होय शब्दाचा । चमत्कार ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ṭhāvo na pavatā jayācā maneṃsī muraḍalī vācā| to devo hoya śabdācā | camatkāra || 15||
verses.meaning: The mind cannot grasp Him, nor can speech describe Him; yet, that very God manifests through words as a miracle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें ज्ञानासि न चोजवे। ध्यानासिही जें नागवे। तें अगोचर फावे। गोठीमाजीं ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ jñānāsi na cojave| dhyānāsihī jeṃ nāgave| teṃ agocara phāve| goṭhīmājīṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: That which cannot be grasped by knowledge, nor attained through meditation, that unperceivable truth is revealed through discourse.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येवढे एक सौभग । वळघे वाचेचें आंग । श्रीगुरुपादपदापराग । लाहे जैं कां॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yevaḍhe eka saubhaga | vaḻaghe vāceceṃ āṃga | śrīgurupādapadāparāga | lāhe jaiṃ kāṃ|| 97||
verses.meaning: This is the sole fortune that adorns the faculty of speech, when it attains the dust from the lotus feet of the revered Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी बहु बोलूं काई । आजि तें आनी ठाई । मातेंवांचूनि नाहीं । ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī bahu bolūṃ kāī | āji teṃ ānī ṭhāī | māteṃvāṃcūni nāhīṃ | jñānadevo mhaṇe|| 18||
verses.meaning: Why should I speak much more? Today, there is no other place, no other being, apart from me. So says Dnyandev.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे तान्हेनि मियां अपत्ये । आणि माझे गुरु 'एकलोतें। म्हणौनि कृपेंसि एकहातें। जालें तिये।॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je tānheni miyāṃ apatye | āṇi mājhe guru 'ekaloteṃ| mhaṇauni kṛpeṃsi ekahāteṃ| jāleṃ tiye||| 19||
verses.meaning: Because I am a child thirsty for knowledge, and my Guru is my only refuge, therefore, compassion has become one-handed (focused solely on me).

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहा पां भरोवरी आधवी। मेघ चातकांसी रिचवी। मजलागीं गोसावीं। तैसें केलें॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhā pāṃ bharovarī ādhavī| megha cātakāṃsī ricavī| majalāgīṃ gosāvīṃ| taiseṃ keleṃ|| 20||
verses.meaning: Behold, just as the cloud completely fills the Chataka bird, so too has my Lord done for me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ३ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी म्हणौनि रिकामें तोंड । करूं गेळें बडबड । कीं गीता ऐसें गोड। आतुडळें॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: 3 śrījñāneśvarī mhaṇauni rikāmeṃ toṃḍa | karūṃ geḻeṃ baḍabaḍa | kīṃ gītā aiseṃ goḍa| ātuḍaḻeṃ|| 21||
verses.meaning: Therefore, when the mouth, otherwise empty, began to babble, it found something as sweet as the Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: होय अदृष्ट आपेतें। तैं वबाळूचि रत्ने परते । उजू आयुष्य तैं मारितें। लोभु करी॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hoya adṛṣṭa āpeteṃ| taiṃ vabāḻūci ratne parate | ujū āyuṣya taiṃ māriteṃ| lobhu karī|| 22||
verses.meaning: When destiny is favorable, even ordinary stones turn into jewels. When life is straightforward, greed itself becomes a killer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधणीं घातळिया हरळ। होती अमृताचे तांदुळ । जरी भुकेची राखे वेळ। श्रीजगन्नाथु ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhaṇīṃ ghātaḻiyā haraḻa| hotī amṛtāce tāṃduḻa | jarī bhukecī rākhe veḻa| śrījagannāthu || 23||
verses.meaning: If Lord Jagannath protects one in times of hunger, then even pebbles thrown into a cooking pot would turn into rice as sweet as nectar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी श्रीगुरु । करिती जैं अंगीकारु । तैं होऊनि ठाके संसारु । मोक्षमय आघवा ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī śrīguru | karitī jaiṃ aṃgīkāru | taiṃ hoūni ṭhāke saṃsāru | mokṣamaya āghavā || 24||
verses.meaning: When the Guru accepts one, then the entire worldly existence transforms into liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहा पां श्रीनारायणें। तया पांडवांचें उणें । कीजेचि ना पुराणें । विश्‍ववंद्ये ॥ २५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhā pāṃ śrīnārāyaṇeṃ| tayā pāṃḍavāṃceṃ uṇeṃ | kījeci nā purāṇeṃ | viś‍vavaṃdye || 25 ||
verses.meaning: Behold, the ancient, universally revered Shri Narayana Himself did not allow any deficiency to befall those Pandavas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें श्रीनिवृत्तिराजें। अज्ञानपण हें माझें । आणिलें बोजें। ज्ञानाचिये॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śrīnivṛttirājeṃ| ajñānapaṇa heṃ mājheṃ | āṇileṃ bojeṃ| jñānāciye|| 26||
verses.meaning: Thus, my ignorance, by the grace of Shri Nivrutti, was transformed into the essence of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हें असो आतां । प्रेम रुळतसे बोलतां। कॅ गुरुगौरव वर्णितां। उन्मेष असे॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī heṃ aso ātāṃ | prema ruḻatase bolatāṃ| kaॅ gurugaurava varṇitāṃ| unmeṣa ase|| 27||
verses.meaning: But let this be. Now, love flows forth as I speak. And in describing the glory of the Guru, there is an awakening.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तेणेंचि पसायें । तुम्हां संतांचे मी पायें । बोळगेन अभिप्रायें । गीतेचेनि॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ teṇeṃci pasāyeṃ | tumhāṃ saṃtāṃce mī pāyeṃ | boḻagena abhiprāyeṃ | gīteceni|| 28||
verses.meaning: Now, with that very grace, I shall, at your feet, O Saints, reverently bid farewell to the essence of the Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तोचि प्रस्तुतीं। चौदाविया अध्यायाच्या अंतीं । निर्णयो कैवल्यपती । ऐसा केला॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī toci prastutīṃ| caudāviyā adhyāyācyā aṃtīṃ | nirṇayo kaivalyapatī | aisā kelā|| 29||
verses.meaning: Thus, at the end of the fourteenth chapter, the Lord of Kaivalya made this decision.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें ज्ञान जयाच्या हातीं। तोचि समर्थ मुक्‍ती। जैसा शतमख संपत्ती । स्वर्गीचिये॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ jñāna jayācyā hātīṃ| toci samartha muk‍tī| jaisā śatamakha saṃpattī | svargīciye|| 30||
verses.meaning: The one who possesses this knowledge is indeed capable of liberation, just as Indra is the master of the wealth of heaven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां शत एक जन्मां। जो जन्मोनि ब्रह्मकर्मा । करी तोचि ब्रह्मा। आनु नोहे ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ śata eka janmāṃ| jo janmoni brahmakarmā | karī toci brahmā| ānu nohe || 39||
verses.meaning: Even if one takes a hundred births, whoever performs actions dedicated to Brahman, that very person becomes Brahman; no one else does.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना सूयाचा प्रकाशु । लाहे जेवीं डोळसु। तेवीं ज्ञानेंचि सौरसु। मोक्षाचा तो॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā sūyācā prakāśu | lāhe jevīṃ ḍoḻasu| tevīṃ jñāneṃci saurasu| mokṣācā to||32||
