verses.shloka_iast: jarī nāṃgiyā āpuliyā | viṃcū karī gudaguliyā| tarī sācā bolī boliyā| bolatī te|| 290||
verses.meaning: Even if a scorpion tickles itself with its own pincers, it is still considered to be speaking truthfully.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अपानाचेनि तोंडें । जरी सुगंधा येणें घडे। तरी सत्य तयां जोडे। आसुरांतें॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: apānāceni toṃḍeṃ | jarī sugaṃdhā yeṇeṃ ghaḍe| tarī satya tayāṃ joḍe| āsurāṃteṃ||91||
verses.meaning: If, through the mouth of the apana, fragrance were to arise, then truly, such a one would attain the realm of the gods.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें तें न करितां कांहीं । आंगेंचि बोखटें पाहीं। आतां बोलती ते नवाई । सांगिजेळ ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ teṃ na karitāṃ kāṃhīṃ | āṃgeṃci bokhaṭeṃ pāhīṃ| ātāṃ bolatī te navāī | sāṃgijeḻa || 92||
verses.meaning: If one does not do such things, but instead acts foolishly, then what they say now is indeed a wonder to behold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं करेयाच्या ठायीं चांग। तें तयासि कैंचें नीट आंग। तैसा आसुरांचा प्रसंग । ३८८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी प्रसंगें परिस ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ kareyācyā ṭhāyīṃ cāṃga| teṃ tayāsi kaiṃceṃ nīṭa āṃga| taisā āsurāṃcā prasaṃga | 388 śrījñāneśvarī prasaṃgeṃ parisa || 93||
verses.meaning: Just as a bitter gourd, by its very nature, cannot be sweet, similarly, the nature of demons is inherently evil. This is the context of the discourse in Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उधवणीचें जेवीं तोंड। उगळी धुंबाचे उभड। हें जाणिजे तेवीं उघड। सांगों ते बोळ ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: udhavaṇīceṃ jevīṃ toṃḍa| ugaḻī dhuṃbāce ubhaḍa| heṃ jāṇije tevīṃ ughaḍa| sāṃgoṃ te boḻa || 94||
verses.meaning: Just as the mouth of a cow that has given birth is cleansed by the calf, so too, know that this explanation is clear and easy to understand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी विश्‍व हा अनादि ठावो । येथ नियंता ईश्वररावो। चावडिये न्यावो अन्याबो। निवडी वेदु॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī viś‍va hā anādi ṭhāvo | yetha niyaṃtā īśvararāvo| cāvaḍiye nyāvo anyābo| nivaḍī vedu|| 95||
verses.meaning: Thus, this universe is known to be without beginning. Here, the Lord God is the ruler. The Vedas, like a judge in a court, distinguish between justice and injustice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वेदीं अन्यायीं पडे। तो निरयभोगें दंडे । सन्यायी तो सुरवाडे । स्वर्गी जिये॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: vedīṃ anyāyīṃ paḍe| to nirayabhogeṃ daṃḍe | sanyāyī to suravāḍe | svargī jiye|| 96||
verses.meaning: One who falls into unrighteousness suffers the torments of hell. But the righteous one enjoys the pleasures of heaven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी हे विश्‍्वव्यवस्था। अनादि जे पार्था । इयेतें म्हणती ते वृथा । अवघेंचि हें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī he viś‍vavyavasthā| anādi je pārthā | iyeteṃ mhaṇatī te vṛthā | avagheṃci heṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Such is this arrangement of the universe, O Partha, which is beginningless. Those who call it unreal, their words are in vain, for all of this is real.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यज्ञमूढ ठकिले यागीं । देवपिसें प्रतिमालिंगीं। नागवले भगवे योगी । समाधिभ्रमें॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yajñamūḍha ṭhakile yāgīṃ | devapiseṃ pratimāliṃgīṃ| nāgavale bhagave yogī | samādhibhrameṃ|| 98||
verses.meaning: Those deluded by rituals are trapped in sacrifices; those with a mad devotion to God are caught in idol worship; and saffron-clad yogis are deceived by the illusion of samadhi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ आपुलेनि बळें। भोगिजे जें जें वेंटाळें। हें बांचोनि कें वेगळें। पुण्य आहे॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha āpuleni baḻeṃ| bhogije jeṃ jeṃ veṃṭāḻeṃ| heṃ bāṃconi keṃ vegaḻeṃ| puṇya āhe||99||
verses.meaning: Whatever is experienced by one's own strength, entangled in worldly affairs, where else can there be merit apart from this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना अशक्तपणें आंगिकें। वेगळवेंटाळीं न टकें। ऐसा गादिजेबीण विषयसुखें। तेंचि पाप॥ ३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā aśaktapaṇeṃ āṃgikeṃ| vegaḻaveṃṭāḻīṃ na ṭakeṃ| aisā gādijebīṇa viṣayasukheṃ| teṃci pāpa|| 300||
verses.meaning: It is a sin to be so engrossed in worldly pleasures that one becomes weak and unable to perform their duties, and is thus separated from the divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्राण घेपती संपन्नांचे। तें पाप जरी साचें । तरी सर्वस्व हाता ये तयांचें । हे पुण्यफळ कीं॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: prāṇa ghepatī saṃpannāṃce| teṃ pāpa jarī sāceṃ | tarī sarvasva hātā ye tayāṃceṃ | he puṇyaphaḻa kīṃ|| 1||
verses.meaning: If taking the life of the wealthy is truly a sin, then how can their entire fortune come into one's hands? Is this not the fruit of merit?

verses.shloka_devanagari: बळी अबळातें खाय। हेंचि बाधित जरी होय। तरी मासयां कां न होय। निसंतान॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: baḻī abaḻāteṃ khāya| heṃci bādhita jarī hoya| tarī māsayāṃ kāṃ na hoya| nisaṃtāna|| 2||
verses.meaning: If the strong devouring the weak were truly a hindrance, then why would fish not become extinct?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि कुळें शोधूनि दोन्ही । कुमारेंचि शुभलग्नीं। मेळवीजती प्रजासाधनीं। हेतु जरी ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi kuḻeṃ śodhūni donhī | kumāreṃci śubhalagnīṃ| meḻavījatī prajāsādhanīṃ| hetu jarī || 3||
verses.meaning: And when both families are thoroughly investigated, the young couple is united in a शुभलग्न (auspicious marriage) with the intention of procreation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी पशुपक्षादि जाती। जया मिती नाहीं संतती । तयां कोणें प्रतिपत्तीं। विवाह केळे॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī paśupakṣādi jātī| jayā mitī nāhīṃ saṃtatī | tayāṃ koṇeṃ pratipattīṃ| vivāha keḻe|| 4||
verses.meaning: For the species of birds and animals, whose progeny is countless, by whom were their marriages arranged?

verses.shloka_devanagari: चोरियेचें धन आलें। तरी तें कोणासि विष जालें। वालभें परद्वार केलें। कोढी कोणी होय॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: coriyeceṃ dhana āleṃ| tarī teṃ koṇāsi viṣa jāleṃ| vālabheṃ paradvāra keleṃ| koḍhī koṇī hoya|| 5||
verses.meaning: If wealth is acquired through theft, to whom does it become poison? If a beloved commits adultery, who becomes leprous?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि देवो गोसांवी । तो धर्माधर्मु भोगवी। आणि परत्राच्या गांवीं । करी तो भोगी ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni devo gosāṃvī | to dharmādharmu bhogavī| āṇi paratrācyā gāṃvīṃ | karī to bhogī || 6||
verses.meaning: Therefore, God, the Lord, makes one experience both dharma (righteousness) and adharma (unrighteousness), and in the realm of the afterlife, He is the one who makes one experience the consequences.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी परत्र ना देवो। न दिसे म्हणौनि तें बाबो। आणि कर्ता निमे मा ठावो। भोग्यासि कवणु ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī paratra nā devo| na dise mhaṇauni teṃ bābo| āṇi kartā nime mā ṭhāvo| bhogyāsi kavaṇu || 7||
verses.meaning: If there is no God in the other world, and He is not seen, then what is the use of that? And if the doer ceases to exist, then who is there to experience the fruits of action?

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ उर्वशिया इंद्र सुखी। जैसा कां स्वर्गळोकीं। तैसाचि कृमिही नरकौं। ळोळतु श्लाघे॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha urvaśiyā iṃdra sukhī| jaisā kāṃ svargaḻokīṃ| taisāci kṛmihī narakauṃ| ḻoḻatu ślāghe|| 8||
verses.meaning: Just as Urvashi brings joy to Indra in the celestial realms, so too does a worm, wallowing in the filth of hell, find its own satisfaction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि नरक स्वर्गु। नव्हे पापपुण्यभागु। जे दोहीं ठायीं सुखभोगु। कामाचाचि तो॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni naraka svargu| navhe pāpapuṇyabhāgu| je dohīṃ ṭhāyīṃ sukhabhogu| kāmācāci to|| 9||
verses.meaning: Therefore, neither hell nor heaven is a consequence of sin or merit, for in both places, the experience of pleasure is solely due to desire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें कामें । स्त्रीपुरुषयुग्मे। मिळती तेथ जन्मे। आघवें जग॥ ३१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ kāmeṃ | strīpuruṣayugme| miḻatī tetha janme| āghaveṃ jaga|| 310||
verses.meaning: For this reason, where the pairs of male and female unite, all of creation is born.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जें जें अभिलाषें। स्वार्थालागीं हें पोषे। पाठीं परस्परद्वेषें। कामचि नाशी॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jeṃ jeṃ abhilāṣeṃ| svārthālāgīṃ heṃ poṣe| pāṭhīṃ parasparadveṣeṃ| kāmaci nāśī|| 11||
verses.meaning: And whatever desires arise, fostering self-interest, they ultimately destroy themselves through mutual hatred.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं कामावांचूनि कांहीं। जगा मूळचि आन नाहीं। ऐसें बोलती पाहीं। आसुर गा ते॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ kāmāvāṃcūni kāṃhīṃ| jagā mūḻaci āna nāhīṃ| aiseṃ bolatī pāhīṃ| āsura gā te|| 12||
verses.meaning: Thus, without desire, there is no other origin for the world. Those who speak like this are indeed demons.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां असो हें किडाळ। बोली न करूं 'पघळ। सांगतांचि सफोळ। होतसे वाचा ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ aso heṃ kiḍāḻa| bolī na karūṃ 'paghaḻa| sāṃgatāṃci saphoḻa| hotase vācā || 13||
verses.meaning: Let this impurity be. I will not let my words become verbose. For as soon as I speak, my words bear fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ईशश्‍वराचिया खंती । नुसधियाचि करिती चांथी । हेंही नाहीं चित्तीं । निश्चयो एकु ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi īśaś‍varāciyā khaṃtī | nusadhiyāci karitī cāṃthī | heṃhī nāhīṃ cittīṃ | niścayo eku || 94||
verses.meaning: And they do not even have the slightest thought of God in their minds, nor do they have any firm conviction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना उघड | आंगीं भरूनियां पाखांड । नास्तिकपणाचें हाड। रोंबिलें जीवीं ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā ughaḍa | āṃgīṃ bharūniyāṃ pākhāṃḍa | nāstikapaṇāceṃ hāḍa| roṃbileṃ jīvīṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Indeed, openly, filled with hypocrisy, the bone of atheism is rooted in their very being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वेळीं स्वर्गालागीं आदरु। कां नरकाचा अडदरु। या वासनांचा अंकुरू। जळोनि गेला॥१६॥
verses.shloka_iast: te veḻīṃ svargālāgīṃ ādaru| kāṃ narakācā aḍadaru| yā vāsanāṃcā aṃkurū| jaḻoni gelā||16||
verses.meaning: At that time, the longing for heaven or the fear of hell, the very sprout of such desires, was burnt away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग केवळ ये देहखोडां । अमेध्योदकाचा बुडबुडा । विषयपंकीं सुहाडा । बुडाले गा॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kevaḻa ye dehakhoḍāṃ | amedhyodakācā buḍabuḍā | viṣayapaṃkīṃ suhāḍā | buḍāle gā|| 17||
verses.meaning: Then, this mere body, a bubble of impure water, is immersed in the mud of worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैं आटावें होती जळचर। तैं डोहीं मिळतीं ढीवर। कां पडावें होय शरीर। तैं रोगा उदयो॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiṃ āṭāveṃ hotī jaḻacara| taiṃ ḍohīṃ miḻatīṃ ḍhīvara| kāṃ paḍāveṃ hoya śarīra| taiṃ rogā udayo|| 18||
verses.meaning: Just as when aquatic creatures are to be caught, fishermen gather at the pond, or when the body is destined to fall, diseases arise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदैजणें केतूचें जैसें । विश्वा अनिष्टोहेशें । जन्मती ते तैेसे। लोकां आटूं॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: udaijaṇeṃ ketūceṃ jaiseṃ | viśvā aniṣṭoheśeṃ | janmatī te taiese| lokāṃ āṭūṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: Just as the appearance of Ketu (a malefic planet) is considered inauspicious for the world, so too are those born who cause distress to people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विरूढलिया अशुभ। फुटती तें ते कोंभ। पापाचे कौर्तिस्तंभ । चालते ते॥ ३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: virūḍhaliyā aśubha| phuṭatī teṃ te koṃbha| pāpāce kaurtistaṃbha | cālate te|| 320||
verses.meaning: From the sprouted seeds of inauspiciousness, new shoots emerge, which are like walking pillars of sin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मागांपुढां जाळणें । वांचूनि आगी कांहीं नेणें । तैसें विरुद्धचि एक करणें । भलतेयां॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi māgāṃpuḍhāṃ jāḻaṇeṃ | vāṃcūni āgī kāṃhīṃ neṇeṃ | taiseṃ viruddhaci eka karaṇeṃ | bhalateyāṃ|| 21||
verses.meaning: Just as fire knows nothing but to burn, whether it be in front or behind, so too does the Self perform its singular action of being, regardless of the circumstances.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तेंचि गा करणें । आदरिती संभ्रमें जेणें । तो आइक पार्था म्हणे । श्रीनिवासु॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teṃci gā karaṇeṃ | ādaritī saṃbhrameṃ jeṇeṃ | to āika pārthā mhaṇe | śrīnivāsu|| 22||
verses.meaning: But the one who undertakes that very action with great reverence, listen, O Partha, is called Shrinivasa (the abode of prosperity/Vishnu).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जाळ पाणियें न भरे। आगी इंधन न पुरे। तयां दुर्भरांचिये धुरे। भुकाळु जो॥२३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jāḻa pāṇiyeṃ na bhare| āgī iṃdhana na pure| tayāṃ durbharāṃciye dhure| bhukāḻu jo||23||
verses.meaning: Just as a fire cannot be quenched by water, nor can it be satisfied by fuel, so too is the hunger of those insatiable ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया कामाचा बोलावा) जीवीं धरूनि पांडवा । दंभमानाचा मेळावा । मेळविती॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā kāmācā bolāvā) jīvīṃ dharūni pāṃḍavā | daṃbhamānācā meḻāvā | meḻavitī|| 24||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, they hold on to the call of that desire in their hearts and gather a multitude of hypocrisy and pride.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मातलिया कुंजरा। आगळी जाली मदिरा । तैसा मदाचा ताठा तंव जरा । चढतां आंगीं ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mātaliyā kuṃjarā| āgaḻī jālī madirā | taisā madācā tāṭhā taṃva jarā | caḍhatāṃ āṃgīṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Just as an elephant, already intoxicated, becomes even more frenzied with more liquor, so too does the arrogance of youth intensify as old age approaches.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आग्रहा तोचि ठावो। वरि मोढ्याऐसा सावावो। मग काय वानूं निर्वाहो। निश्चयाचा ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi āgrahā toci ṭhāvo| vari moḍhyāaisā sāvāvo| maga kāya vānūṃ nirvāho| niścayācā || 26||
verses.meaning: And if such insistence is the very foundation, supported by a strong resolve, then how can I describe the ultimate outcome of such determination?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं परोपतापु घडे। परावा जीवु रगडे। तिहीं कर्मी होऊनि गाढे । जन्मवृत्ती ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ paropatāpu ghaḍe| parāvā jīvu ragaḍe| tihīṃ karmī hoūni gāḍhe | janmavṛttī || 27||
verses.meaning: Those who cause harm to others, who torment other beings, through such actions, they become deeply entangled in the cycle of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आपुलें केलें फोकारिती। आणि जगातें धिक्कारिती। दाहीं दिशीं पसरिती। स्पृहाजाळ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āpuleṃ keleṃ phokāritī| āṇi jagāteṃ dhikkāritī| dāhīṃ diśīṃ pasaritī| spṛhājāḻa|| 28||
verses.meaning: Then they proclaim their own deeds and denounce the world, spreading the net of their desires in all ten directions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि गा आटोपें । थोरियें आणती पापें। धर्मधेनु खुरपें। सुटलें जैसें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni gā āṭopeṃ | thoriyeṃ āṇatī pāpeṃ| dharmadhenu khurapeṃ| suṭaleṃ jaiseṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: In this way, great sins are committed, just as the cow of Dharma is injured by a loose hoof.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याचि येका आयती । तयाचिया कर्मप्रवृत्ती। आणि जिणियाही परौती । वाहती चिंता ॥ ३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāci yekā āyatī | tayāciyā karmapravṛttī| āṇi jiṇiyāhī parautī | vāhatī ciṃtā || 330||
verses.meaning: Their actions are solely for this purpose, and their worries extend beyond their very lives.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाताळाहूनि निम्न। जियेचिये उंचीये सानें गगन । जें पाहातां त्रिभुवन। अणुही नोहे॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pātāḻāhūni nimna| jiyeciye uṃcīye sāneṃ gagana | jeṃ pāhātāṃ tribhuvana| aṇuhī nohe|| 39||
verses.meaning: Lower than the netherworld, with its height, the sky is small. When one sees it, the three worlds are not even an atom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते योगपटाची मवणी। ३९० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जीवीं अनियम चिंतवणी । जे सांडूं नेणे मरणीं । वल्लभा जैसी ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te yogapaṭācī mavaṇī| 390 śrījñāneśvarī jīvīṃ aniyama ciṃtavaṇī | je sāṃḍūṃ neṇe maraṇīṃ | vallabhā jaisī || 32||
verses.meaning: Just as a devoted wife, even at the moment of death, never ceases to contemplate her beloved husband, so too, the mind, when absorbed in the practice of Yoga, constantly and unfailingly meditates upon the divine, never abandoning this contemplation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी चिंता अपार। वाढविती निरंतर। जीवीं सूनि असार। विषयादिक॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī ciṃtā apāra| vāḍhavitī niraṃtara| jīvīṃ sūni asāra| viṣayādika|| 33||
verses.meaning: Similarly, endless worries constantly increase, as the mind is filled with the insubstantial objects of the senses and other worldly things.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्त्रिया गाइळें आडकावें। स्त्रीर्प डोळां देखावें। सर्वेद्रियीं आलिंगावें । स्त्रियेतेंचि॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: striyā gāiḻeṃ āḍakāveṃ| strīrpa ḍoḻāṃ dekhāveṃ| sarvedriyīṃ āliṃgāveṃ | striyeteṃci|| 34||
verses.meaning: One should avoid women, but if seen, one should see them with the eyes of a woman, embracing them with all senses as if they were women themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुरवंडी कीजे अमृतें। ऐसें सुख स्त्रियेपरौतें । नाहींचि म्हणौनि चित्तें। निश्चयो केला ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuravaṃḍī kīje amṛteṃ| aiseṃ sukha striyeparauteṃ | nāhīṃci mhaṇauni citteṃ| niścayo kelā || 35||
verses.meaning: Just as one would perform an offering with nectar, so too is the joy derived from a woman. There is no other joy like it, thus the mind has made this firm decision.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तयाचि स्त्रीभोगा-। लागीं 'पाताळ स्वर्गा। धांवती दिग्बिभागा। परौतेही ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayāci strībhogā-| lāgīṃ 'pātāḻa svargā| dhāṃvatī digbibhāgā| parautehī || 36||
verses.meaning: Then, for the enjoyment of that woman, they would run to the netherworld, to heaven, and even beyond the ends of the directions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आमिषकवळु थोरी आशा । न विचारितां गिळी मासा । तैसें कीजे विषयाशा। तयांसि गा॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmiṣakavaḻu thorī āśā | na vicāritāṃ giḻī māsā | taiseṃ kīje viṣayāśā| tayāṃsi gā|| 37||
verses.meaning: Just as a fish, without thinking, swallows a large bait, so too do those who crave worldly pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांछित तंव न पवति। मग कोरडियेचि आशेची संतती । वाढऊं वाढऊं होती। कोशकिडे॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃchita taṃva na pavati| maga koraḍiyeci āśecī saṃtatī | vāḍhaūṃ vāḍhaūṃ hotī| kośakiḍe|| 38||
verses.meaning: As long as desires are not fulfilled, the progeny of dry hope keeps growing and growing, becoming like silkworms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि पसरिला अभिलाषु। अपूर्णु होय तोचि द्वेषु। एवं कामक्रोधांहूनि अधिकु । पुरुषार्थ नाहीं ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi pasarilā abhilāṣu| apūrṇu hoya toci dveṣu| evaṃ kāmakrodhāṃhūni adhiku | puruṣārtha nāhīṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: And the unfulfilled desire spreads as hatred. Thus, there is no greater human endeavor than to overcome desire and anger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिहा खोलणें रात्रीं जागोवा। ठाणांतरियां जैसा पांडवा । अहोरात्रींही बिसांबा। भेटेचिना ॥ ३४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: dihā kholaṇeṃ rātrīṃ jāgovā| ṭhāṇāṃtariyāṃ jaisā pāṃḍavā | ahorātrīṃhī bisāṃbā| bheṭecinā || 340||
verses.meaning: Just as a watchman guarding a fort day and night, O Pandava, finds no rest, so too the body, whether awake or asleep, never truly finds peace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें उंचौनि लोटिलें कामें । नेहटती क्रोधाचिये ढेमे। तरी रागद्वेष प्रेमें। न माती केंही॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ uṃcauni loṭileṃ kāmeṃ | nehaṭatī krodhāciye ḍheme| tarī rāgadveṣa premeṃ| na mātī keṃhī|| 41||
verses.meaning: Just as desires, once they have surged forth, cannot be contained by the force of anger, so too, attachment and aversion cannot be contained by love.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि जीवींचिया हांवा। विषयवासनांचा मेळावा। केला तरी भोगावा । अर्थे कीं ना॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci jīvīṃciyā hāṃvā| viṣayavāsanāṃcā meḻāvā| kelā tarī bhogāvā | arthe kīṃ nā|| 42||
verses.meaning: Similarly, if one gathers a multitude of desires for worldly pleasures within their heart, they must inevitably experience the consequences, whether good or bad.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भोगावयाजोगा । पुरता अर्थ पैं गा। आणावया जगा । झोंबती सैरा॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhogāvayājogā | puratā artha paiṃ gā| āṇāvayā jagā | jhoṃbatī sairā|| 43||
verses.meaning: Therefore, to fully experience the meaning of life, people eagerly strive in the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एकातें साधूनि मारिती। एकाचि सर्वस्वें हरिती। एकालागीं उभारिती। अपाययंत्रें॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ekāteṃ sādhūni māritī| ekāci sarvasveṃ haritī| ekālāgīṃ ubhāritī| apāyayaṃtreṃ|| 44||
verses.meaning: They kill some by trapping them, they steal everything from others, and for some, they set up instruments of harm.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाशिकें पोतीं वागुरा। सुणीं ससाणें चिकाटी खोंचारा। घेऊनि निघती डोंगरा । पारधी जैसे॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāśikeṃ potīṃ vāgurā| suṇīṃ sasāṇeṃ cikāṭī khoṃcārā| gheūni nighatī ḍoṃgarā | pāradhī jaise|| 45||
verses.meaning: Just as hunters, carrying nets, snares, dogs, and falcons, set out for the mountains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते 'पोसावया पोट । मारूनि प्राणियांचे संघाट । आणिती ऐसें निकृष्ट । तेंही करिती ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: te 'posāvayā poṭa | mārūni prāṇiyāṃce saṃghāṭa | āṇitī aiseṃ nikṛṣṭa | teṃhī karitī || 46||
verses.meaning: To fill their stomachs, they kill many living beings and bring such inferior things. They do even that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परप्राणघातें। मेळविती वित्तें। मिळाल्या चित्तें। तोषणें कैसें ॥४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paraprāṇaghāteṃ| meḻavitī vitteṃ| miḻālyā citteṃ| toṣaṇeṃ kaiseṃ ||47||
verses.meaning: How can one find contentment in wealth acquired by taking the lives of others, even if it is obtained with great effort?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे आजि मियां । संपत्ति बहुतेकांचिया । आपुल्या हातीं केलिया । धन्यु ना मी॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe āji miyāṃ | saṃpatti bahutekāṃciyā | āpulyā hātīṃ keliyā | dhanyu nā mī|| 48||
verses.meaning: He says, "Today, I have taken possession of the wealth of many. Am I not blessed?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा शलाघों जंव जाये। तंव मन आणीकही वाहे । सवेंचि म्हणे पाहे। आणिकांचेंही आणूं॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā śalāghoṃ jaṃva jāye| taṃva mana āṇīkahī vāhe | saveṃci mhaṇe pāhe| āṇikāṃceṃhī āṇūṃ|| 49||
verses.meaning: As long as such praise continues, the mind carries other thoughts. Immediately it says, "Let me bring others too."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें जेतुलें असे जोडिलें। तयाचेनि भांडवलें। लाभा घेईन उरलें। चराचर हें ॥ ३५० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ jetuleṃ ase joḍileṃ| tayāceni bhāṃḍavaleṃ| lābhā gheīna uraleṃ| carācara heṃ || 350 ||
verses.meaning: All that has been accumulated, with that capital, I will take the remaining profit, which is this entire animate and inanimate world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि धना विशवाचिया। मीचि होईन स्वामिया। मग दिठी पडे तया । उरों नेदी॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni dhanā viśavāciyā| mīci hoīna svāmiyā| maga diṭhī paḍe tayā | uroṃ nedī||51||
verses.meaning: Thus, I will become the master of the entire universe. Then, whatever comes into my sight, I will not let it remain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे मारिळे वैरी थोडे। आणीकही साधीन गाढे। मग नांदेन पवाडें। येकलाचि मी॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: he māriḻe vairī thoḍe| āṇīkahī sādhīna gāḍhe| maga nāṃdena pavāḍeṃ| yekalāci mī|| 52||
verses.meaning: Having slain these few enemies, I shall achieve even greater feats, and then I alone shall reign supreme.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग माझीं होतील कामारीं। तियेंबांचूनि येरें मारी । किंबहुना चराचरीं। ईश्वरु तो मी॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mājhīṃ hotīla kāmārīṃ| tiyeṃbāṃcūni yereṃ mārī | kiṃbahunā carācarīṃ| īśvaru to mī||53||
verses.meaning: Then all my tasks will be accomplished. Without them, all others are destroyed. In short, in the entire animate and inanimate world, I am that God.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी भोगभूमिचा रावो। आजि सर्वसुखासी ठावो । म्हणौनि इंद्रुही वावो । मातें पाहूनि ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī bhogabhūmicā rāvo| āji sarvasukhāsī ṭhāvo | mhaṇauni iṃdruhī vāvo | māteṃ pāhūni || 54||
verses.meaning: I am the king of the land of enjoyment, the abode of all happiness. Therefore, even Indra is insignificant compared to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी मनें वाचा देहें। करीं तें कैसें नोहे। कें मजवांचूनि आहे। आज्ञासिद्ध आन॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī maneṃ vācā deheṃ| karīṃ teṃ kaiseṃ nohe| keṃ majavāṃcūni āhe| ājñāsiddha āna|| 55||
verses.meaning: Whatever I do with my mind, speech, and body, how can it not happen? Is there any command or accomplishment that exists without me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंवचि बळिया काळु । जंव न दिसें मी अतुर्बळु। सुखाचा कीर निखळु। रासिवा मीचि॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃvaci baḻiyā kāḻu | jaṃva na diseṃ mī aturbaḻu| sukhācā kīra nikhaḻu| rāsivā mīci|| 56||
verses.meaning: The formidable Time (death) holds sway only as long as I, the embodiment of supreme bliss, am not perceived in My true, invincible form. Indeed, I alone am the pure, unadulterated essence of happiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुबेरु आथिला होये। परी तो नेणे माझी सोये । संपत्ती मजसम नव्हे । श्रीनाथाही ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuberu āthilā hoye| parī to neṇe mājhī soye | saṃpattī majasama navhe | śrīnāthāhī || 57||
verses.meaning: Even if one becomes Kubera, the god of wealth, he does not know my true nature. His wealth is not equal to mine, not even that of Lakshmi's consort, Vishnu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझिया कुळाचा उजाळू। कां जातिगोतांचा मेळू। पाहतां ब्रह्माही हळू । उणाचि दिसे॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhiyā kuḻācā ujāḻū| kāṃ jātigotāṃcā meḻū| pāhatāṃ brahmāhī haḻū | uṇāci dise|| 58||
verses.meaning: The glory of my lineage, or the gathering of my kinsfolk, when seen, even Brahma appears to be of lesser significance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मिरविती नांवें । वायां ईश्वरादि आघवे। नाहीं मजसीं सरी पावे। ऐसें कोण्ही ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni miravitī nāṃveṃ | vāyāṃ īśvarādi āghave| nāhīṃ majasīṃ sarī pāve| aiseṃ koṇhī ||59||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all the names like 'God' and others are useless, as there is no one who can compare to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां 'लोपळा अभिचारु। तया करीन मी जौर्णोद्धारु। प्रतिष्ठीन परमारु । यागवरी॥ ३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ 'lopaḻā abhicāru| tayā karīna mī jaurṇoddhāru| pratiṣṭhīna paramāru | yāgavarī|| 360||
verses.meaning: Now, I will restore the lost spiritual practices. I will establish the Supreme Self through the sacrifice of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मातें गाती वानिती। नटनाचें रिझविती। तयां देईन मागती। ते ते वस्तु ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: māteṃ gātī vānitī| naṭanāceṃ rijhavitī| tayāṃ deīna māgatī| te te vastu || 61||
verses.meaning: Those who sing my praises, worship me, and please me with their dance and drama, I will grant them whatever they desire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माजिरा अन्नपानीं। प्रमदांच्या आलिंगनीं। मी होईन त्रिभुवनी । आनंदाकारु ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājirā annapānīṃ| pramadāṃcyā āliṃganīṃ| mī hoīna tribhuvanī | ānaṃdākāru || 62||
verses.meaning: I shall become the very form of bliss throughout the three worlds, just as one becomes intoxicated by food and drink, or by the embrace of a beloved woman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय बहु सांगो ऐसे। ते आसुरीप्रकृती पिसें। तुरंबिती असोसें। गगनोळें तियें ॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya bahu sāṃgo aise| te āsurīprakṛtī piseṃ| turaṃbitī asoseṃ| gaganoḻeṃ tiyeṃ ||63||
verses.meaning: What more can I say? Those with demonic nature, driven by insatiable desires, are like madmen chasing after the mirage of the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्वराचेनि आटोपें।॥ रोगी भलतैसें जल्पे। चावळती संकल्पें। जाण ते तैसे॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jvarāceni āṭopeṃ||| rogī bhalataiseṃ jalpe| cāvaḻatī saṃkalpeṃ| jāṇa te taise|| 64||
verses.meaning: Just as a feverish patient raves incoherently, so too do the thoughts of the ignorant wander aimlessly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अज्ञान आतले धुळी । म्हणौनि आशा वाहटुळी। भोवंडीजती अंतराळीं । मनोरथांच्या ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ajñāna ātale dhuḻī | mhaṇauni āśā vāhaṭuḻī| bhovaṃḍījatī aṃtarāḻīṃ | manorathāṃcyā || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Ignorance is like dust within, and so desires are like whirlwinds, spinning in the inner space of aspirations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनियम आषाढ मेघ। कां समुद्रोर्मी अभंग । तैसे कामिती अनेग। अखंड काम॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aniyama āṣāḍha megha| kāṃ samudrormī abhaṃga | taise kāmitī anega| akhaṃḍa kāma|| 66||
verses.meaning: Just as the clouds of Ashadha bring incessant rain, or the ocean waves are ceaseless, so too are desires that arise in countless forms, unendingly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पैं कामनाचि तया। ३९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जिवीं जाल्या वेलरिया। बोरपिली कांटिया। कमळें जैसीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga paiṃ kāmanāci tayā| 392 śrījñāneśvarī jivīṃ jālyā velariyā| borapilī kāṃṭiyā| kamaḻeṃ jaisīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Then, just as thorns grow around lotuses, so too do desires sprout within the heart of such a person.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां 'पाषाणाचिया माथां। हांडी फुटली पार्था । जीवीं तैसे सर्वथा। कुटके जाले॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ 'pāṣāṇāciyā māthāṃ| hāṃḍī phuṭalī pārthā | jīvīṃ taise sarvathā| kuṭake jāle|| 68||
verses.meaning: Or, Arjuna, it is like a pot breaking upon a stone. Similarly, all the desires in the mind are shattered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां चढतिये रजनी। तमाची होय पुरवणी । तैसा मोहो अंतःकरणीं। वाढोंचि लागे॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ caḍhatiye rajanī| tamācī hoya puravaṇī | taisā moho aṃtaḥkaraṇīṃ| vāḍhoṃci lāge|| 69||
verses.meaning: As the night progresses, darkness increases; similarly, delusion began to grow in the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि वाढे जंब जंव मोहो। तंव तंव विषयीं रोहो। विषय तेथ ठावो। पातकासी ॥ ३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi vāḍhe jaṃba jaṃva moho| taṃva taṃva viṣayīṃ roho| viṣaya tetha ṭhāvo| pātakāsī || 370||
verses.meaning: And as much as the delusion grows, so much does the attachment to worldly pleasures increase. Where there are worldly pleasures, there is a place for sin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पापें आपलेनि थांबें । जंब करिती मेळावे। तंव जितांचि आघवे । येती नरकां ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāpeṃ āpaleni thāṃbeṃ | jaṃba karitī meḻāve| taṃva jitāṃci āghave | yetī narakāṃ || 71||
verses.meaning: When sins gather in their own groups, then all those who commit them, while still alive, go to hell.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि गा सुमती । जे कुमनोरथां पाळिती। ते आसुर येती बस्ती । तया ठाया ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni gā sumatī | je kumanorathāṃ pāḻitī| te āsura yetī bastī | tayā ṭhāyā || 72||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O good-minded one, those who harbor evil desires, demonic beings come and reside in that place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ असिपत्रतरुवर। खदिरांगाराचे डोंगर । तातला तेलीं सागर । उतताती ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha asipatrataruvara| khadirāṃgārāce ḍoṃgara | tātalā telīṃ sāgara | utatātī || 73||
verses.meaning: Where there are trees with sword-like leaves, mountains of burning acacia coals, and oceans of boiling oil.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेथ यातनांची श्रेणी। हे नित्य नवी यमजाचणी। पडती तिये दारुणीं। नरकलोकीं॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jetha yātanāṃcī śreṇī| he nitya navī yamajācaṇī| paḍatī tiye dāruṇīṃ| narakalokīṃ|| 74||
verses.meaning: Where a series of torments, ever new, and the relentless trials of Yama, fall upon the wretched inhabitants of hell.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे नरकाचिये शेले। भागीं जे जे जन्मले । तेही देखों भुलले। यजिती यागीं ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise narakāciye śele| bhāgīṃ je je janmale | tehī dekhoṃ bhulale| yajitī yāgīṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Those who are born into the lineage of hell, even they are deluded and perform sacrifices.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं यागादिक क्रिया। आहाण तेचि धनंजया । परी विफळती आचरोनियां। नाटकी जैसे॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ yāgādika kriyā| āhāṇa teci dhanaṃjayā | parī viphaḻatī ācaroniyāṃ| nāṭakī jaise|| 76||
verses.meaning: Indeed, actions like performing sacrifices, O Dhananjaya, are like a drama. They are performed, but ultimately bear no fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वल्लभाचिया उजरिया । आपणयाप्रति कुस्त्रिया । जोडोनि तोषिती जैसिया । अहेबपणें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vallabhāciyā ujariyā | āpaṇayāprati kustriyā | joḍoni toṣitī jaisiyā | ahebapaṇeṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as a woman, adorned with her husband's love, delights in her marital bliss, so too does the soul find joy in its true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें. आपणयां आपण। मानिता महंतपण। फुगती असाधारण । गर्वे तेणें ॥७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ. āpaṇayāṃ āpaṇa| mānitā mahaṃtapaṇa| phugatī asādhāraṇa | garve teṇeṃ ||78||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who consider themselves great, swell up extraordinarily with that pride.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग लबों नेणती कैसे। आटिवा लोहाचे खांब जैसे। कां उधवळे आकाशें। शिळाराशी॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga laboṃ neṇatī kaise| āṭivā lohāce khāṃba jaise| kāṃ udhavaḻe ākāśeṃ| śiḻārāśī|| 79||
verses.meaning: Then how can they not know? Just like iron pillars melt, or like heaps of stones are scattered by the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें आपुलिये बरवे। आपणचि रिझतां जीवें। तृणाहीहूनि आघवें। मानिती नीच ॥ ३८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ āpuliye barave| āpaṇaci rijhatāṃ jīveṃ| tṛṇāhīhūni āghaveṃ| mānitī nīca || 380||
verses.meaning: Just as they are pleased with their own goodness, they consider themselves lower than a blade of grass.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरी धनाचिया मदिरा । माजूनि धनुर्धरा। कृत्याकृत्यविचारा। सवतें केलें॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: varī dhanāciyā madirā | mājūni dhanurdharā| kṛtyākṛtyavicārā| savateṃ keleṃ||81||
verses.meaning: Drunk with the intoxication of wealth, O Arjuna, I have made the consideration of right and wrong my rival.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया आंगीं आयती ऐसी । तेथ यज्ञाची गोठी कायसी । तरी काय काय पिसीं। न करिती गा॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā āṃgīṃ āyatī aisī | tetha yajñācī goṭhī kāyasī | tarī kāya kāya pisīṃ| na karitī gā||82||
verses.meaning: When such inherent spiritual readiness is present, what need is there for rituals like yajna? Yet, what foolish acts do people not commit?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कोणे एके वेळे। मोढ्यमद्याचेनि बळें । यागाचींही टवाळें। आदरिती॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni koṇe eke veḻe| moḍhyamadyāceni baḻeṃ | yāgācīṃhī ṭavāḻeṃ| ādaritī||83||
verses.meaning: Therefore, at some point, emboldened by the strength of their ignorance, they even undertake sacrifices with a frivolous attitude.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना कुंड मंडप वेदी। ना उचित साधनसमृद्धी। आणि तयांसी तंव विधी। द्वंद्रचि सदा॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā kuṃḍa maṃḍapa vedī| nā ucita sādhanasamṛddhī| āṇi tayāṃsī taṃva vidhī| dvaṃdraci sadā||84||
verses.meaning: There are no sacrificial pits, no altars, no proper ritualistic materials, and for them, the prescribed rituals are always a source of conflict.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवां ब्राह्मणांचेनि नांवें। आडवारेनहि नोहावें। ऐसें आथी तेथ यावें। लागे 'कवणा॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: devāṃ brāhmaṇāṃceni nāṃveṃ| āḍavārenahi nohāveṃ| aiseṃ āthī tetha yāveṃ| lāge 'kavaṇā|| 85||
verses.meaning: If one should not even come across the names of gods and Brahmins, then who would need to come to such a place?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं बासरुवाचा भोकसा। गाईपुढें ठेवूनि जैसा । उगाणा घेती क्षीररसा। बुद्धिवंत॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ bāsaruvācā bhokasā| gāīpuḍheṃ ṭhevūni jaisā | ugāṇā ghetī kṣīrarasā| buddhivaṃta|| 86||
verses.meaning: Just as a wise person places a calf's muzzle before a cow and then takes the essence of milk, so too should one approach spiritual wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें यागाचेनि नांवें। जग वाऊनि हांबे। नागविती आधवें। अहेरावारी ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ yāgāceni nāṃveṃ| jaga vāūni hāṃbe| nāgavitī ādhaveṃ| aherāvārī || 87||
verses.meaning: Similarly, in the name of sacrifice, they deceive and plunder the world completely, like a thief.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशा कांहीं आपुलिया । होमिती जे उजरिया। तेणें कामिती प्राणिया। सर्वनाशु॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśā kāṃhīṃ āpuliyā | homitī je ujariyā| teṇeṃ kāmitī prāṇiyā| sarvanāśu|| 88||
verses.meaning: Some, in their own arrogance, perform sacrifices that lead to the destruction of all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पुढां भेरी निशाण । लाउनी ते दीक्षितपण । जगीं फोकारिती आपण । वाबो वाबो॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga puḍhāṃ bherī niśāṇa | lāunī te dīkṣitapaṇa | jagīṃ phokāritī āpaṇa | vābo vābo|| 89||
verses.meaning: Then, with the drums and banners of initiation leading the way, they proclaim throughout the world, "Wabo Wabo!"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां महत्त्वे तेणें अधमां। गर्वा चढे महिमा । जैसे लेवे दिधले तमा। काजळाचे॥ ३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ mahattve teṇeṃ adhamāṃ| garvā caḍhe mahimā | jaise leve didhale tamā| kājaḻāce|| 390||
verses.meaning: Then, due to that importance, the glory of pride ascends in the wicked, just as darkness is adorned with kohl.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें मौढ्य घणावे। औद्धत्य उंचावे। अहंकारु दुणावे। अविवेकुही॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ mauḍhya ghaṇāve| auddhatya uṃcāve| ahaṃkāru duṇāve| avivekuhī|| 91||
verses.meaning: Ignorance will increase, arrogance will rise, ego will double, and indiscretion will also grow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग दुजयाची भाष। नुरवाबया निःशेष। बळियेपणा अधिक । होय बळ॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga dujayācī bhāṣa| nuravābayā niḥśeṣa| baḻiyepaṇā adhika | hoya baḻa||92||
verses.meaning: Then, to completely silence the speech of others, one's own strength becomes even greater.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा अहंकार बळा। जालिया एकवळा। दर्पसागरु मर्यादवेळा। सांडूनि उते॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā ahaṃkāra baḻā| jāliyā ekavaḻā| darpasāgaru maryādaveḻā| sāṃḍūni ute|| 93||
verses.meaning: When such a powerful ego, having gathered strength, overflows like an ocean breaking its bounds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग बोसंडिलेनि दर्पे। कामाही पित्त कुरुपे। तया धगीं सैंघ पळिपे। क्रोधाग्नि तो॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga bosaṃḍileni darpe| kāmāhī pitta kurupe| tayā dhagīṃ saiṃgha paḻipe| krodhāgni to|| 94||
verses.meaning: Then, with the arrogance born of desire, the bile of lust becomes disfigured, and in that heat, the fire of anger flares up intensely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ उन्हाळा आगी खरमरा। तेलातुपाचिया कोठारा। लागला आणि वारा। सुटला जैसा॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha unhāḻā āgī kharamarā| telātupāciyā koṭhārā| lāgalā āṇi vārā| suṭalā jaisā|| 95||
verses.meaning: There, the summer's fire, scorching and intense, is like a blaze that has caught hold of a storehouse of oil and ghee, and then a strong wind has begun to blow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा अहंकारु बळा आला । दर्पु कामक्रोधीं गूढला। या दोहींचा मेळु जाला । जयांच्या ठायीं ॥९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā ahaṃkāru baḻā ālā | darpu kāmakrodhīṃ gūḍhalā| yā dohīṃcā meḻu jālā | jayāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ ||96||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when ego becomes strong, and pride is hidden within lust and anger, these two (ego and pride) combine in those individuals.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते आपुलिया सवेशा। मग कोणी कोणी हिंसा। या प्राणियातें बीरेशा। न साधिती गा॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: te āpuliyā saveśā| maga koṇī koṇī hiṃsā| yā prāṇiyāteṃ bīreśā| na sādhitī gā|| 97||
verses.meaning: Then, by their very nature, no one can inflict any harm upon these beings, O Lord of the brave.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पहिलें तंब धनुर्धरा। आपुलिया मांसरुधिरा। वेंचु करिती अभिचारा-। लागोनियां ॥९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pahileṃ taṃba dhanurdharā| āpuliyā māṃsarudhirā| veṃcu karitī abhicārā-| lāgoniyāṃ ||98||
verses.meaning: First, O Arjuna, they offer their own flesh and blood as a sacrifice for black magic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ जाळिती जियें देहें॥ यामाजीं जो मी आहें।॥ तया आत्मया मज घाये। वाजती ते॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha jāḻitī jiyeṃ deheṃ|| yāmājīṃ jo mī āheṃ||| tayā ātmayā maja ghāye| vājatī te||99||
verses.meaning: The bodies that are burnt there, within them, I who am the Self, am struck by those blows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि अभिचारकीं तिहीं ।॥ उपद्रविजे जेतुलें कांहीं । तेथ चैतन्य मी पाहीं। सीणु पावे॥ ४००॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi abhicārakīṃ tihīṃ ||| upadravije jetuleṃ kāṃhīṃ | tetha caitanya mī pāhīṃ| sīṇu pāve|| 400||
verses.meaning: And whatever is troubled by the sorcerers, there I, the Consciousness, become weary.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि अभिचारावेगळें । विपायें जें अवगळें। तया टाकिती इटाळें । पैशून्याचीं ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi abhicārāvegaḻeṃ | vipāyeṃ jeṃ avagaḻeṃ| tayā ṭākitī iṭāḻeṃ | paiśūnyācīṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: And if by chance, something is discarded as useless, they throw stones of malice at it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सती आणि सत्पुरुख । दानशीळ याज्ञिक । तपस्वी अलौकिक संन्यासी जे॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: satī āṇi satpurukha | dānaśīḻa yājñika | tapasvī alaukika saṃnyāsī je|| 2||
verses.meaning: Satis (chaste women) and holy men, generous sacrificers, and extraordinary ascetics and renunciates.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां भक्‍त हन महात्मे। इयें माझीं निजाचीं धामें। निर्वाळलीं होमधर्मे। श्रौतादिकीं ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bhak‍ta hana mahātme| iyeṃ mājhīṃ nijācīṃ dhāmeṃ| nirvāḻalīṃ homadharme| śrautādikīṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: Or, the great devotees, these are My true abodes, purified by the sacrificial rites and other Vedic rituals.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां द्वेषाचेनि काळकूटें । बासटोनि तिखटें।॥ कुबोलांची सदटें। सूति कांडें॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ dveṣāceni kāḻakūṭeṃ | bāsaṭoni tikhaṭeṃ||| kubolāṃcī sadaṭeṃ| sūti kāṃḍeṃ||4||
verses.meaning: With the bitter poison of hatred, and the sharp sting of harsh words, they weave a dense net of evil speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसे आघवाचि परी । प्रवर्तले माझ्या वैरीं। तयां पापियां जें मी करीं । तें आइक पां॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aise āghavāci parī | pravartale mājhyā vairīṃ| tayāṃ pāpiyāṃ jeṃ mī karīṃ | teṃ āika pāṃ||5||
verses.meaning: Thus, in every way, those wicked ones who have become my enemies, hear what I do to them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मनुष्यदेहाचा तागा। घेऊनि रुसती जे जगा । ते पदवी हिरोनि पैं गा। ऐसे ठेवीं॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī manuṣyadehācā tāgā| gheūni rusatī je jagā | te padavī hironi paiṃ gā| aise ṭhevīṃ||6||
verses.meaning: Those who, having attained the human form, then become resentful of the world, lose this exalted status, know this for certain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे क्लेशगांबींचा उकरडा। ३९४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी भवपुरींचा पानवडा। ते तमोयोनि तयां मूढां। वृत्तीचि दें॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: je kleśagāṃbīṃcā ukaraḍā| 394 śrījñāneśvarī bhavapurīṃcā pānavaḍā| te tamoyoni tayāṃ mūḍhāṃ| vṛttīci deṃ||7||
verses.meaning: The Dnyaneshwari, which is like a watering hole for the city of worldly existence and a compost heap for the seeds of suffering, bestows this very nature upon those deluded by ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आहाराचेनि नांवें। तृणही जेथ नुगवे। ते व्याघ्र वृश्चिक आडवे । तैसिये करीं॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āhārāceni nāṃveṃ| tṛṇahī jetha nugave| te vyāghra vṛścika āḍave | taisiye karīṃ|| 8||
verses.meaning: Then, in a place where even grass does not grow due to lack of sustenance, make it such that tigers and scorpions obstruct the path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ क्षुधादुःखें बहुतें। तोडूनि खाती आपणयातें । मरमरों मागुतें। होतचि असती॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha kṣudhāduḥkheṃ bahuteṃ| toḍūni khātī āpaṇayāteṃ | maramaroṃ māguteṃ| hotaci asatī|| 9||
verses.meaning: There, tormented by intense hunger, they devour themselves, dying repeatedly only to be reborn again.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां आपुला गरळजाळीं। जाळिती आंगाची पेंदळी । ते सर्पचि करीं बिळीं। निरुंधला ॥ ४१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ āpulā garaḻajāḻīṃ| jāḻitī āṃgācī peṃdaḻī | te sarpaci karīṃ biḻīṃ| niruṃdhalā || 410||
verses.meaning: Or, like a snake that has trapped itself in its own venomous coils, it is confined within its hole.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी घेतला शवासु घापे। येतुलेनही मापे । विसांबा तयां नाटोपे। दुर्जनांसी ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī ghetalā śavāsu ghāpe| yetulenahī māpe | visāṃbā tayāṃ nāṭope| durjanāṃsī || 99||
verses.meaning: However, the breath taken in, even if measured, does not bring rest to the wicked.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि कल्पांचिया कोडी । गणितांही संख्या थोडी । तेतुला वेळु न काढी । क्लेशौनि तयां॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni kalpāṃciyā koḍī | gaṇitāṃhī saṃkhyā thoḍī | tetulā veḻu na kāḍhī | kleśauni tayāṃ|| 92||
verses.meaning: Even if one were to count kalpas in crores, that number would be too small to represent the time He does not take to relieve them of their suffering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तयांसी जेथ जाणें। तेथिंचें हें पहिलें पेणें। तें पावोनि येरें दारुणें। न होती दुःखें॥१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tayāṃsī jetha jāṇeṃ| tethiṃceṃ heṃ pahileṃ peṇeṃ| teṃ pāvoni yereṃ dāruṇeṃ| na hotī duḥkheṃ||13||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for those who are destined to go there, this is the first stop on their journey. Having reached this, the other terrible sufferings will not occur.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठायवरी । संपत्ति ते आसुरी । अधोगति अवधारीं । जोडिली तिहीं ॥१४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāyavarī | saṃpatti te āsurī | adhogati avadhārīṃ | joḍilī tihīṃ ||14||
verses.meaning: Up to this point, these demonic qualities lead to a downward path, understand this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं व्याघ्रादि तामसा। योनी तो अळुमाळु ऐसा । देहाधाराचा उसासा । आथी जोही॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ vyāghrādi tāmasā| yonī to aḻumāḻu aisā | dehādhārācā usāsā | āthī johī|| 15||
verses.meaning: Behind them, there are fierce and dark beings like tigers, whose very breath is a sigh for the body, and who are filled with such qualities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोही मी बोल्हावा हिरें। मग तमचि होती एकसरें। जेथ गेलें आंधारें। काळवंडेजे॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tohī mī bolhāvā hireṃ| maga tamaci hotī ekasareṃ| jetha geleṃ āṃdhāreṃ| kāḻavaṃḍeje|| 16||
verses.meaning: I will speak of Him, the brilliant gem, and then all darkness will vanish, just as the night's gloom disappears when the sun rises.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयांची पापा चिळसी। नरक घेती विवसी । शीण जाय मूर्च्छी । सिणें जेणें ॥ ९१७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāṃcī pāpā ciḻasī| naraka ghetī vivasī | śīṇa jāya mūrcchī | siṇeṃ jeṇeṃ || 917||
verses.meaning: The very thought of their sins makes hell itself recoil in disgust, as if fainting from the sheer exhaustion of bearing such a burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मळु जेणें मैळे। तापु जेणें 'पोळे। जयाचेनि नांवें सळे। महाभय॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maḻu jeṇeṃ maiḻe| tāpu jeṇeṃ 'poḻe| jayāceni nāṃveṃ saḻe| mahābhaya|| 18||
verses.meaning: That which defiles the impure, that which burns the afflicted, that by whose name great fear vanishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पापा जयाचा कंटाळा । उपजे अमंगळ अमंगळा। विटाळुही विटाळा। बिहे जया॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāpā jayācā kaṃṭāḻā | upaje amaṃgaḻa amaṃgaḻā| viṭāḻuhī viṭāḻā| bihe jayā|| 19||
verses.meaning: Sin itself detests him, impurity finds him impure, and even defilement fears him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें बिश्‍वाचेया बोखटेया। अधम जे धनंजया । तें ते होती भोगूनियां। तामसा योनी ॥ ४२० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ biś‍vāceyā bokhaṭeyā| adhama je dhanaṃjayā | teṃ te hotī bhogūniyāṃ| tāmasā yonī || 420 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, those who are the worst among the beings of the world, O Dhananjaya, they, after experiencing the consequences of their actions, are born into Tamasic wombs.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहा सांगतां वाचा रडे । आठवितां मन खिरडे। कटारे मूरखी केवढे । जोडिले निरय॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ahā sāṃgatāṃ vācā raḍe | āṭhavitāṃ mana khiraḍe| kaṭāre mūrakhī kevaḍhe | joḍile niraya|| 21||
verses.meaning: Alas, the tongue weeps to speak of it, the mind shudders to recall it. How great is the hell accumulated by such foolishness!

verses.shloka_devanagari: कायिसया ते आसुर । संपत्ति पोषिती वाउर। जिया दिधलें घोर । पतन ऐसें॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāyisayā te āsura | saṃpatti poṣitī vāura| jiyā didhaleṃ ghora | patana aiseṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: Why do those of demonic nature nurture such wealth, which ultimately leads to a terrible downfall?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तुवां धनुर्धरा। नोहावें गा तिया मोहरा । जेउता वासु आसुरा। संपत्तिवंता॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tuvāṃ dhanurdharā| nohāveṃ gā tiyā moharā | jeutā vāsu āsurā| saṃpattivaṃtā|| 23||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Arjuna, you should not turn your face towards that direction where the demonic wealth is found.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि दंभादि दोष साही। हे संपूर्ण जयांच्या ठायीं । ते त्यजावे हें काई । म्हणों कीर॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi daṃbhādi doṣa sāhī| he saṃpūrṇa jayāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ | te tyajāve heṃ kāī | mhaṇoṃ kīra|| 24||
verses.meaning: And the six vices like hypocrisy, those in whom they are complete, should certainly be abandoned. What more can be said?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी काम क्रोध लोभ। या तिहींचेंही थोंब। थांबे तेथें अशुभ। पिकलें जाण॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī kāma krodha lobha| yā tihīṃceṃhī thoṃba| thāṃbe tetheṃ aśubha| pikaleṃ jāṇa|| 25||
verses.meaning: But where these three—lust, anger, and greed—are restrained, know that misfortune has ripened there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्व दुःखीं आपुलिया । दर्शना धनंजया । पाढाऊ हे भलतया । दिधलें आहाती॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarva duḥkhīṃ āpuliyā | darśanā dhanaṃjayā | pāḍhāū he bhalatayā | didhaleṃ āhātī|| 26||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, all who are suffering have offered themselves to your sight, as if they have given a gift to anyone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां पापियां नरकभोगीं। सुवावयालागीं जगीं । 'पातकांची दाटुगी। सभाचि हे॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ pāpiyāṃ narakabhogīṃ| suvāvayālāgīṃ jagīṃ | 'pātakāṃcī dāṭugī| sabhāci he|| 27||
verses.meaning: For the sinners who are destined for hell, this world is indeed a formidable assembly of sins.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते रौरव गा तंवचिवरी । आइकिजती पटांतरीं । जंव हे तिन्ही अंतरीं । उठती ना॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: te raurava gā taṃvacivarī | āikijatī paṭāṃtarīṃ | jaṃva he tinhī aṃtarīṃ | uṭhatī nā|| 28||
verses.meaning: Those hells are spoken of in the scriptures only as long as these three (desire, anger, and greed) do not arise within one's heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अपाय तिहीं आसलग । यातना इहीं सवंग । हाणी हाणी नोहे हे तिघ। हेचि हाणी॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: apāya tihīṃ āsalaga | yātanā ihīṃ savaṃga | hāṇī hāṇī nohe he tigha| heci hāṇī|| 29||
verses.meaning: Harm is inherent in these three (lust, anger, greed); suffering is easily found in them. These three are not just harmful; they are harm itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय बहु बोलो सुभटा । सांगितलिया निकृष्टा । नरकाचा दारवंटा। त्रिशंकु हा॥ ४३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya bahu bolo subhaṭā | sāṃgitaliyā nikṛṣṭā | narakācā dāravaṃṭā| triśaṃku hā|| 430||
verses.meaning: What more can I say, O brave one? As I have explained, this wretched state is the very threshold of hell, like a Trishanku.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या कामक्रोधलोभां-। माजीं जीवें जो होय उभा। तो निरयपुरीची सभा । सन्मानु पावे॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā kāmakrodhalobhāṃ-| mājīṃ jīveṃ jo hoya ubhā| to nirayapurīcī sabhā | sanmānu pāve|| 31||
verses.meaning: One who stands firm in the midst of lust, anger, and greed, will be honored in the assembly of hell.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि पुढत पुढतीं किरीटी । हे कामादि दोषत्रिपुटी। त्यजावींचि गा बोखटी। आघवाविषयीं॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni puḍhata puḍhatīṃ kirīṭī | he kāmādi doṣatripuṭī| tyajāvīṃci gā bokhaṭī| āghavāviṣayīṃ|| 32||
verses.meaning: Therefore, again and again, O Kiriti, this wicked triad of faults, beginning with desire, must be abandoned in all respects.

verses.shloka_devanagari: धर्मादिकां चौंहीआंतु। पुरुषार्थाची तैंचि मातु। करावी जें संघातु । सांडील हा॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: dharmādikāṃ cauṃhīāṃtu| puruṣārthācī taiṃci mātu| karāvī jeṃ saṃghātu | sāṃḍīla hā|| 33||
verses.meaning: Among the four pursuits of human life, namely Dharma and others, that alone is the true pursuit which leads to the dissolution of this physical body and its attachments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे तिन्ही जीवीं जंब जागती । तंववरी निकियाची प्राप्ती । हे माझे कान नाइकती। देवोही म्हणे॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: he tinhī jīvīṃ jaṃba jāgatī | taṃvavarī nikiyācī prāptī | he mājhe kāna nāikatī| devohī mhaṇe|| 34||
verses.meaning: As long as these three (states of consciousness) awaken in beings, there is a good attainment. My ears do not hear this, even God says.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया आपणपें पढिये। आत्मनाशा जो ब्िहे। तेणें न धरावी हे सोये। सावधु होइजे॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā āpaṇapeṃ paḍhiye| ātmanāśā jo bihe| teṇeṃ na dharāvī he soye| sāvadhu hoije|| 35 ||
verses.meaning: One who loves their own self and fears the destruction of the Self should not embrace this path (of worldly attachments); rather, they should be vigilant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पोटीं बांधोनि पाषाण। समुद्री बाही आंगबण। कां जियावया जेवण। काळकूटाचें ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: poṭīṃ bāṃdhoni pāṣāṇa| samudrī bāhī āṃgabaṇa| kāṃ jiyāvayā jevaṇa| kāḻakūṭāceṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: It is like tying a stone to one's belly and trying to cross the ocean, or eating a meal of deadly poison in order to live.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इहीं कामक्रोधलोभेंसीं। कार्यसिन्दि जाण तैसी। म्हणौनि ठावोचि पुसीं। ययांचा गा॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ihīṃ kāmakrodhalobheṃsīṃ| kāryasindi jāṇa taisī| mhaṇauni ṭhāvoci pusīṃ| yayāṃcā gā|| 37||
verses.meaning: Know that success in any endeavor is achieved through these very qualities of desire, anger, and greed. Therefore, inquire into their very origin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैं कहीं अवचटें। हे तिकडी सांखळ तुटे । तैं सुखें आपुलिये वाटे । चालो लाभे॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiṃ kahīṃ avacaṭeṃ| he tikaḍī sāṃkhaḻa tuṭe | taiṃ sukheṃ āpuliye vāṭe | cālo lābhe|| 38||
verses.meaning: When, by chance, this chain of three (gunas) breaks, then one can happily walk on their own path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्रिदोषीं सांडिलें शरीर । त्रिकुटीं फिटलिया नगर। त्रिदाह निमालिया अंतर । जैसें होय॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tridoṣīṃ sāṃḍileṃ śarīra | trikuṭīṃ phiṭaliyā nagara| tridāha nimāliyā aṃtara | jaiseṃ hoya|| 39||
verses.meaning: When the body is rid of the three humors, the city of the three knots is dissolved, and the three kinds of suffering within are extinguished, such is the state that comes to be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा कामादिकीं तिघीं। सांडिला सुख पाबोनि जगीं । संगु लाहे मोक्षमार्गी । सज्जनांचा ॥ ४४० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā kāmādikīṃ tighīṃ| sāṃḍilā sukha pāboni jagīṃ | saṃgu lāhe mokṣamārgī | sajjanāṃcā || 440 ||
verses.meaning: Just as one who has abandoned the three desires (lust, anger, and greed) finds happiness in the world, so too does one attain the company of the virtuous on the path to liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग सत्संगें प्रबळें। सच्छास्त्राचेनि बळें । जन्ममृत्यूचीं निमाळें । निस्तरें रानें॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga satsaṃgeṃ prabaḻeṃ| sacchāstrāceni baḻeṃ | janmamṛtyūcīṃ nimāḻeṃ | nistareṃ rāneṃ|| 41||
verses.meaning: Then, by the powerful association with the virtuous, and by the strength of true scriptures, one crosses the dense forest of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते वेळीं आत्मानंदें आधवें। जें सदा वसतें बरबें। तें तैसेचि पाटण पावे । गुरुकृपेचें ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te veḻīṃ ātmānaṃdeṃ ādhaveṃ| jeṃ sadā vasateṃ barabeṃ| teṃ taiseci pāṭaṇa pāve | gurukṛpeceṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: At that time, one is completely filled with the bliss of the Self, which always resides beautifully within. Such a state is attained through the grace of the Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ प्रियाची परमसीमा। तो भेटे माउली आत्मा । तयें खेंबीं आटे डिंडिमा । सांसारिक हे ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha priyācī paramasīmā| to bheṭe māulī ātmā | tayeṃ kheṃbīṃ āṭe ḍiṃḍimā | sāṃsārika he || 43 ||
verses.meaning: There, the ultimate beloved, the Mother, the Self, is met. In that embrace, the worldly clamor and distinctions dissolve.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा जो कामक्रोधलोभां। झाडी करूनि ठाके उभा। तोचि येवढिया लाभा । गोसावी होय॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā jo kāmakrodhalobhāṃ| jhāḍī karūni ṭhāke ubhā| toci yevaḍhiyā lābhā | gosāvī hoya|| 44||
verses.meaning: One who stands firm, having uprooted lust, anger, and greed, becomes the master of such great spiritual wealth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ३९६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी ना हें नावडोनि कांहीं । कामादिकांच्याचि ठायीं । दाटिली जेणें डोई । आत्मचोरें ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: 396 śrījñāneśvarī nā heṃ nāvaḍoni kāṃhīṃ | kāmādikāṃcyāci ṭhāyīṃ | dāṭilī jeṇeṃ ḍoī | ātmacoreṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: 396. Dnyaneshwari: Not liking anything, the head is filled with lust and other vices by the thief of the Self. ||45||

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो जगीं समान सकृपु। हिताहित दाविता दीपु। तो अमान्यु केला बापु । वेदु जेणें ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo jagīṃ samāna sakṛpu| hitāhita dāvitā dīpu| to amānyu kelā bāpu | vedu jeṇeṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: He who is equally compassionate to all in the world, who is a lamp showing what is beneficial and what is harmful, that very Veda, which was made by him, was disrespected.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न धरीचि विधीची भीड। न करीचि आपली चाड । वाढवीत गेळा कोड । इंद्रियांचे ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: na dharīci vidhīcī bhīḍa| na karīci āpalī cāḍa | vāḍhavīta geḻā koḍa | iṃdriyāṃce || 47||
verses.meaning: It does not respect the rules of conduct, nor does it care for its own well-being; it only increases the desires of the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कामक्रोधलोभांची 'कास। न सोडीच पाळिली भाष । स्वैराचाराचे असोस । वळघला रान॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāmakrodhalobhāṃcī 'kāsa| na soḍīca pāḻilī bhāṣa | svairācārāce asosa | vaḻaghalā rāna|| 48 ||
verses.meaning: He did not abandon the grip of lust, anger, and greed, but rather nurtured their language. He entered the forest of unrestrained behavior.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो सुटकेचिया वाहिणीं। मग पिवों न लाहे पाणी । स्वप्नींही ते काहाणी । दुरीचि तया॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to suṭakeciyā vāhiṇīṃ| maga pivoṃ na lāhe pāṇī | svapnīṃhī te kāhāṇī | durīci tayā|| 49||
verses.meaning: Then he does not even get to drink the water of liberation; even in a dream, that story is far from him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि परत्र तंव जाये। हें कौर तया आहे। परी ऐहिकही न लाहे। भोग भोगूं॥ ४५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi paratra taṃva jāye| heṃ kaura tayā āhe| parī aihikahī na lāhe| bhoga bhogūṃ|| 450||
verses.meaning: And in the afterlife, he certainly goes there, but even in this life, he does not get to enjoy the pleasures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी माशालागीं भुलला । ब्राह्मण 'पाणबुडां रिघाला । कीं तेथही पावला । नास्तिकवादु ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī māśālāgīṃ bhulalā | brāhmaṇa 'pāṇabuḍāṃ righālā | kīṃ tethahī pāvalā | nāstikavādu || 51||
verses.meaning: Even if a Brahmin, deluded by the fish, enters the water to catch it, has atheism reached even there?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें विषयांचेनि कोडें । जेणें परत्रा केलें उबर्डे। तंव तोचि आणिकीकडे। मरणें नेला॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ viṣayāṃceni koḍeṃ | jeṇeṃ paratrā keleṃ ubarḍe| taṃva toci āṇikīkaḍe| maraṇeṃ nelā|| 52||
verses.meaning: Just as one who, captivated by worldly pleasures, neglects the spiritual path, is then snatched away by death from another direction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं परत्र ना स्वर्गु। ना ऐहिकही विषयभोगु। तेथ केउता प्रसंगु। मोक्षाचा तो॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ paratra nā svargu| nā aihikahī viṣayabhogu| tetha keutā prasaṃgu| mokṣācā to||53||
verses.meaning: Thus, there is neither heaven in the afterlife nor worldly enjoyments in this life. How then can there be any occasion for liberation?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि कामाचेनि बळें। जो विषय सेवूं पाहे सळें। तया विषयो ना स्वर्गु मिळे। ना उद्धरे तो॥५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kāmāceni baḻeṃ| jo viṣaya sevūṃ pāhe saḻeṃ| tayā viṣayo nā svargu miḻe| nā uddhare to||54||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one who, driven by the force of desire, seeks to enjoy worldly pleasures with deceit, gains neither worldly enjoyment nor heaven, nor is he liberated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें पैं बापा। जया आथी आपुली कृपा । तेणें वेदांचिया निरोपा । आन न कीजे॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ paiṃ bāpā| jayā āthī āpulī kṛpā | teṇeṃ vedāṃciyā niropā | āna na kīje|| 55||
verses.meaning: Therefore, my child, one who has His grace does not disregard the injunctions of the Vedas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पतीचिया मता (व्रता )॥ अनुसरोनि पतित्रता । अनायासें आत्महिता । भेटेचि ते॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: patīciyā matā (vratā )|| anusaroni patitratā | anāyāseṃ ātmahitā | bheṭeci te|| 56||
verses.meaning: Just as a devoted wife, by following her husband's wishes, effortlessly attains her own well-being, so too does the soul find its true good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी श्रीगुरुवचना। दिठी देतु जतना। शिष्य आत्मभुवना-। माजीं पैसे॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī śrīguruvacanā| diṭhī detu jatanā| śiṣya ātmabhuvanā-| mājīṃ paise|| 57||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, by carefully following the words of the Guru, the disciple enters the abode of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो आपुला ठेवा । हाता आथी जरी यावा । तरी आदरें जेवीं दिवा। पुढां कौजे॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso āpulā ṭhevā | hātā āthī jarī yāvā | tarī ādareṃ jevīṃ divā| puḍhāṃ kauje|| 58||
verses.meaning: If one's own treasure is to come into one's hands, then with reverence, a lamp is placed in front.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा अशेषांही पुरुषार्थां, जो गोसावी हो म्हणे पार्था । तेणें श्रुतिस्मृति माथां । बैसणें घापे॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā aśeṣāṃhī puruṣārthāṃ, jo gosāvī ho mhaṇe pārthā | teṇeṃ śrutismṛti māthāṃ | baisaṇeṃ ghāpe|| 59||
verses.meaning: Just as the master of all human endeavors, who says 'yes' to Arjuna, places the Shruti and Smriti upon his head.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शास्त्र म्हणेल जें सांडावें। तें राज्यही तृण मानावें। जें घेववी तें न म्हणावें। विषही विरुद्ध ॥ ४६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: śāstra mhaṇela jeṃ sāṃḍāveṃ| teṃ rājyahī tṛṇa mānāveṃ| jeṃ ghevavī teṃ na mhaṇāveṃ| viṣahī viruddha || 460||
verses.meaning: That which the scriptures advise to abandon, even a kingdom should be considered as mere straw. That which they advise to accept, even if it seems contrary like poison, should not be refused.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया वेदैकनिष्ठा। जालिया जरी सुभटा। तरी कें आहे अनिष्टा। भेटणें गा॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā vedaikaniṣṭhā| jāliyā jarī subhaṭā| tarī keṃ āhe aniṣṭā| bheṭaṇeṃ gā||61||
verses.meaning: If one becomes so steadfast in the Vedas, O brave one, then where is the possibility of encountering misfortune?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं अहितापासूनि काढिती। हित देऊनि वाढविती। नाहीं गा श्रुतिपरौती । माउली जगा॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ ahitāpāsūni kāḍhitī| hita deūni vāḍhavitī| nāhīṃ gā śrutiparautī | māulī jagā|| 62||
verses.meaning: Indeed, they (the Vedas) draw one away from harm, and by bestowing welfare, they foster growth. There is no mother in the world greater than the Shrutis (Vedas).

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ब्रहेंशीं मेळवी । तंव हे कोणें न सांडावी। अगा तुवांही ऐसीचि भजावी । विशेषेंसी॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni braheṃśīṃ meḻavī | taṃva he koṇeṃ na sāṃḍāvī| agā tuvāṃhī aisīci bhajāvī | viśeṣeṃsī|| 63||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should unite with Brahman. This should not be abandoned by anyone. O Arjuna, you too should worship in this very special way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे आजि अर्जुना तूं येथें। करावया सत्य शास्त्रें सार्थे। जन्मलासि बळार्थे । धर्माचेनि॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: je āji arjunā tūṃ yetheṃ| karāvayā satya śāstreṃ sārthe| janmalāsi baḻārthe | dharmāceni|| 64||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, you have taken birth in this world for the sake of Dharma, to establish the truth of the scriptures with your might.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि धर्मानुज हें ऐसें । ओघेंचि आलें अपैसें। म्हणौनि अनारिसें । करूं नये ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi dharmānuja heṃ aiseṃ | ogheṃci āleṃ apaiseṃ| mhaṇauni anāriseṃ | karūṃ naye || 65||
verses.meaning: And this, O younger brother of Dharma, has come naturally, of its own accord. Therefore, it should not be treated as ordinary or disregarded.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कार्याकार्यविवेकीं। शास्त्रेच्षि करावीं पारखीं। अकृत्य तें कुडें लोकीं। वाळावें गा॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāryākāryavivekīṃ| śāstrecṣi karāvīṃ pārakhīṃ| akṛtya teṃ kuḍeṃ lokīṃ| vāḻāveṃ gā|| 66||
verses.meaning: In discerning what is to be done and what is not to be done, one should rely on the scriptures as the ultimate guide. That which is improper and considered bad in the world should be completely avoided.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग कृत्यपणें खरें निगे। तें तुवां आपलेनि आंगें। आचरोनि आदरें चांगें । सारावें गा ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kṛtyapaṇeṃ khareṃ nige| teṃ tuvāṃ āpaleni āṃgeṃ| ācaroni ādareṃ cāṃgeṃ | sārāveṃ gā || 67||
verses.meaning: Then, the true path of action that emerges, you must diligently and with good intention, perform it yourself and bring it to completion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे विश्वप्रामाण्याची मुदी। आजि तुझ्या हातीं असे सुबुद्धी । लोकसंग्रहासि त्रिशुद्धी । योग्यु होसी ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: je viśvaprāmāṇyācī mudī| āji tujhyā hātīṃ ase subuddhī | lokasaṃgrahāsi triśuddhī | yogyu hosī || 68 ||
verses.meaning: O wise one, the seal of universal validity is now in your hands. You are indeed truly worthy of guiding the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं आसुरवर्ग्‌ आघवा । सांगोनि तेथिंचा निगावा। तोही देवें पांडवा । निरूपिला ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ āsuravarg‌ āghavā | sāṃgoni tethiṃcā nigāvā| tohī deveṃ pāṃḍavā | nirūpilā || 69||
verses.meaning: Thus, having described the entire class of demonic beings and their ultimate fate, the Lord also explained that to Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयावरी तो पंडूचा। कुमरु सदभावो जीवींचा। पुसेल तो चैतन्याचा। कानीं ऐका॥ ४७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyāvarī to paṃḍūcā| kumaru sadabhāvo jīvīṃcā| pusela to caitanyācā| kānīṃ aikā|| 470||
verses.meaning: After this, the son of Pandu, with a sincere heart, will ask a question of the conscious Self; listen to it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संजयें व्यासाचिया निरोपा। तो वेळु फेडिला तया नृपा। तैसा मीही निवृत्तिकृपा। सांगेन तुम्हां ॥ ७१ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃjayeṃ vyāsāciyā niropā| to veḻu pheḍilā tayā nṛpā| taisā mīhī nivṛttikṛpā| sāṃgena tumhāṃ || 71 ||
verses.meaning: Just as Sanjaya, by Vyasa's command, narrated the events to that king, so too, by the grace of Nivrutti, I shall narrate to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुम्ही संत माझिया कडा। दिठीचा कराल बहुडा। तरी तुम्हां माने येवढा। होईन मी॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tumhī saṃta mājhiyā kaḍā| diṭhīcā karāla bahuḍā| tarī tumhāṃ māne yevaḍhā| hoīna mī|| 72||
verses.meaning: If you, O Saints, look upon me with your gracious gaze, then I shall become worthy of your esteem.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि निज अवधान। मज वबोळगे पसायदान दीजो जी सनाथु होईन । ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे ॥ ४७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni nija avadhāna| maja vaboḻage pasāyadāna dījo jī sanāthu hoīna | jñānadevo mhaṇe || 473||
verses.meaning: Therefore, grant me the boon of Your grace, so that I may become truly blessed, says Dnyandev.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्रिगुणत्रिपुरीं वेढिला । जीवत्वदुर्गी आडिला । तो आत्मशंभूनें सोडविला । तुझिया स्मृती ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: triguṇatripurīṃ veḍhilā | jīvatvadurgī āḍilā | to ātmaśaṃbhūneṃ soḍavilā | tujhiyā smṛtī || 2||
verses.meaning: The soul, imprisoned in the fortress of individuality, encircled by the three Gunas, is liberated by the remembrance of You, O Self-Shambhu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि शिवेंसीं कांटाळा । गुरुत्वें तूंचि आगळा । तऱही हळु मायाजळा-। माजीं तारूनि॥३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni śiveṃsīṃ kāṃṭāḻā | gurutveṃ tūṃci āgaḻā | taṟahī haḻu māyājaḻā-| mājīṃ tārūni||3||
verses.meaning: Therefore, even if you are superior to Shiva in your spiritual gravity, you still gently guide us through the waters of illusion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे तुझ्याविखीं मूढ । तयांलागीं तूं वक्रतुंड । ज्ञानियांसी तरी अखंड। उजूचि आहासि॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: je tujhyāvikhīṃ mūḍha | tayāṃlāgīṃ tūṃ vakratuṃḍa | jñāniyāṃsī tarī akhaṃḍa| ujūci āhāsi||4||
verses.meaning: To those who are ignorant of You, You appear as one with a twisted mouth (difficult to comprehend). But to the wise, You are always straightforward.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दैविकी दिठी पाहतां सानी। तऱही मीलनोन्मीलनीं । उत्पत्ति प्रळयो दोन्ही। ळीलाचि करिसी॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: daivikī diṭhī pāhatāṃ sānī| taṟahī mīlanonmīlanīṃ | utpatti praḻayo donhī| ḻīlāci karisī|| 5||
verses.meaning: When seen with the divine eye, even in the cycles of creation and dissolution, you perform both creation and destruction as mere sport.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रवृत्तिकर्णाच्या चाळीं। उठली मदगंधानिळीं। पूजीजसी नीलोत्पलीं । जीवभंगांच्या ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pravṛttikarṇācyā cāḻīṃ| uṭhalī madagaṃdhāniḻīṃ| pūjījasī nīlotpalīṃ | jīvabhaṃgāṃcyā || 6||
verses.meaning: You are worshipped with blue lotuses, which are the destruction of lives, arising from the fragrant breeze of the actions of worldly engagement.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं निवृत्तिकर्णताळें। आहाळी ते पूजा विधुळे। तेव्हां मिरविसी मोकळें। आंगाचें लेणें ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ nivṛttikarṇatāḻeṃ| āhāḻī te pūjā vidhuḻe| tevhāṃ miravisī mokaḻeṃ| āṃgāceṃ leṇeṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: When the ear-ornament of Nivritti is behind, and the worship is destroyed by the clamor, then you adorn yourself freely with the ornament of your own being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वामांगीचा लास्यविलासु। जो हा जगद्रूप आभासु। तो तांडवमिसें कळासु। दाविसी तूं॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāmāṃgīcā lāsyavilāsu| jo hā jagadrūpa ābhāsu| to tāṃḍavamiseṃ kaḻāsu| dāvisī tūṃ|| 8||
verses.meaning: The playful dance of your left side, which is this illusion of the world, you reveal through the guise of the Tandava dance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो विस्मो दातारा। तूं होसी जयाचा सोयरा । सोइरिकेचिया व्यवहारा । मुकेचि तो॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso vismo dātārā| tūṃ hosī jayācā soyarā | soirikeciyā vyavahārā | mukeci to|| 9||
verses.meaning: Let this be. O Giver, if You become someone's kinsman, then that person becomes mute in the dealings of kinship.

verses.shloka_devanagari: फेडितां बंधनाचा ठावो । तूं जगद्वंधु ऐसा भावो। धरू बोळगे उबाबो। तुझाचि आंगीं ॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pheḍitāṃ baṃdhanācā ṭhāvo | tūṃ jagadvaṃdhu aisā bhāvo| dharū boḻage ubābo| tujhāci āṃgīṃ || 10||
verses.meaning: When the bonds are broken, You are the friend of the world, this is the feeling. You are the one who embraces and supports, within Your own being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंव दुजयाचेनि नांवें तया। देहही नुरेचि पैं देवराया। जेणें तूं आपणपयां। केलासि दुजा॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃva dujayāceni nāṃveṃ tayā| dehahī nureci paiṃ devarāyā| jeṇeṃ tūṃ āpaṇapayāṃ| kelāsi dujā|| 11||
verses.meaning: O Lord, by the very name of another, the body itself does not remain, for by that, you have made yourself into another.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूंतें करूनि पुढें। जे उपायें घेती दवडे। तयां ठासी बहुबें पाडें। मागांचि तूं॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃteṃ karūni puḍheṃ| je upāyeṃ ghetī davaḍe| tayāṃ ṭhāsī bahubeṃ pāḍeṃ| māgāṃci tūṃ|| 92||
verses.meaning: Those who, by any means, place You in front and then proceed, You Yourself clear many obstacles from their path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो ध्यानें सूये मानसीं । तयालागीं नाहीं तूं त्याचे देशीं। ध्यानही विसरे तेणेंसीं। वालभ तुज॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo dhyāneṃ sūye mānasīṃ | tayālāgīṃ nāhīṃ tūṃ tyāce deśīṃ| dhyānahī visare teṇeṃsīṃ| vālabha tuja|| 13||
verses.meaning: One who meditates upon You in their mind, for them, You are not in that land (of meditation). Even the meditation itself is forgotten in that devotion to You.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूंतें सिद्धचि जो नेणें। तो नांदे सर्वज्ञपणे । वेदांही येवढें बोलणें । नेघसी कानीं ॥ ९१४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃteṃ siddhaci jo neṇeṃ| to nāṃde sarvajñapaṇe | vedāṃhī yevaḍheṃ bolaṇeṃ | neghasī kānīṃ || 914||
verses.meaning: You, who are inherently perfect, are not known by those who dwell in the illusion of omniscience. Even the Vedas' extensive declarations about You do not reach their ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मौन गा तुझें राशिनांव । आतां स्तोत्रीं कें बांधो हांव । दिससी तेतुली माव । भजों काई ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mauna gā tujheṃ rāśināṃva | ātāṃ stotrīṃ keṃ bāṃdho hāṃva | disasī tetulī māva | bhajoṃ kāī || 15||
verses.meaning: Silence is Your true name. How then can I bind You with hymns of praise? All that is seen is but an illusion. How then can I worship it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: दैविकें सेवकु हों पाहों। तरी भेदितां द्रोहोचि लाहों। म्हणौनि आतां कांहीं नोहों । तुजलागीं जी॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: daivikeṃ sevaku hoṃ pāhoṃ| tarī bheditāṃ drohoci lāhoṃ| mhaṇauni ātāṃ kāṃhīṃ nohoṃ | tujalāgīṃ jī|| 16||
verses.meaning: If I were to become a servant of the divine, then by distinguishing myself, I would only incur harm. Therefore, I am nothing to You, O Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें सर्वथा सर्वही नोहिजे। तैं अट्टया तूतें लाहिजे। हें जाणें मी वर्म तुझें । आराध्यलिंगा॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sarvathā sarvahī nohije| taiṃ aṭṭayā tūteṃ lāhije| heṃ jāṇeṃ mī varma tujheṃ | ārādhyaliṃgā|| 17||
verses.meaning: When everything else ceases to be, then You alone are attained. This, O Adorable Linga, I know to be Your secret.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी नुरोनि वेगळेंपण । रसीं भजिन्नळें लबण। तैसें नमन माझें जाण। बहु काय बोलो ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī nuroni vegaḻeṃpaṇa | rasīṃ bhajinnaḻeṃ labaṇa| taiseṃ namana mājheṃ jāṇa| bahu kāya bolo || 18||
verses.meaning: Just as salt dissolves and becomes one with water, my salutations merge with you, becoming indistinguishable. What more can I say?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां रिता कुंभ समुद्री रिगे। तो उचंबळत भरोनि निगे।॥ कां दशीं दीपसंगें। दीपुचि होय॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ ritā kuṃbha samudrī rige| to ucaṃbaḻata bharoni nige||| kāṃ daśīṃ dīpasaṃgeṃ| dīpuci hoya|| 19||
verses.meaning: When an empty pot enters the ocean, it emerges overflowing. Similarly, when a lamp is lit by another lamp, it too becomes a lamp.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा तुझिया प्रणितीं। मी पूर्णु जाहलो श्रीनिवृत्ति। आतां आणीन व्यक्तीं । गीतार्थ्‌ तो ॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā tujhiyā praṇitīṃ| mī pūrṇu jāhalo śrīnivṛtti| ātāṃ āṇīna vyaktīṃ | gītārth‌ to || 20||
verses.meaning: O Shri Nivrutti, through your grace, I have become complete. Now, I will bring forth the meaning of the Gita into expression.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी षोडशाध्यायशेखीं । तिये समाप्तीच्या लोकीं । जो ऐसा निर्णयो निष्टंकीं । ठेविला देवें॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ṣoḍaśādhyāyaśekhīṃ | tiye samāptīcyā lokīṃ | jo aisā nirṇayo niṣṭaṃkīṃ | ṭhevilā deveṃ|| 21||
verses.meaning: At the conclusion of the sixteenth chapter, in that realm of culmination, the Lord firmly established this unwavering truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे कृत्याकृत्यव्यवस्था। अनुष्ठावया पार्था । शास्त्रचि एक सर्वथा । प्रमाण तुज॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je kṛtyākṛtyavyavasthā| anuṣṭhāvayā pārthā | śāstraci eka sarvathā | pramāṇa tuja|| 22||
verses.meaning: O Partha, for you, in determining what is to be done and what is not to be done, the scriptures alone are the ultimate authority.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अर्जुन मानसें। म्हणे हें ऐसें कैसें। जे शास्त्रेंबीण नसे । सुटिका कर्मा॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha arjuna mānaseṃ| mhaṇe heṃ aiseṃ kaiseṃ| je śāstreṃbīṇa nase | suṭikā karmā|| 23||
verses.meaning: Then Arjuna, in his mind, wondered, "How can this be, that without the scriptures, there is no liberation from karma?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तक्षकाची फडे। ठाकोनि कैं तो मणि काढे। कैं नाकोंचा केशु जोडे । सिंहाचिये ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī takṣakācī phaḍe| ṭhākoni kaiṃ to maṇi kāḍhe| kaiṃ nākoṃcā keśu joḍe | siṃhāciye || 24||
verses.meaning: How can one extract a gem from the hood of the serpent Takshaka? Or how can one pluck a hair from the lion's nose?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेणें तो बोंबिजे। तरीच लेणें पाविजे। एऱहवी काय असिजे। रिक्तकंठीं॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga teṇeṃ to boṃbije| tarīca leṇeṃ pāvije| eṟahavī kāya asije| riktakaṃṭhīṃ|| 25||
verses.meaning: Only by that, one is adorned; otherwise, what is the use of remaining with an empty neck?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी शास्त्रांची मोकळी । यां कैं कोण पां वेंटाळीं। एकवाक्यतेच्या फळीं। पैसिजे कै॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī śāstrāṃcī mokaḻī | yāṃ kaiṃ koṇa pāṃ veṃṭāḻīṃ| ekavākyatecyā phaḻīṃ| paisije kai|| 26||
verses.meaning: Similarly, how can one attain the fruit of unified understanding, when the scriptures are so vast and diverse, and who can untangle their complexities?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जालयाही एकवाक्यता । कां लाभे वेळु अनुष्ठितां। कैंचा पैसारु जीविता । येतुलालिया ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jālayāhī ekavākyatā | kāṃ lābhe veḻu anuṣṭhitāṃ| kaiṃcā paisāru jīvitā | yetulāliyā || 27||
verses.meaning: When such oneness is attained, or when the opportune moment for spiritual practice arrives, how can life's expanse be measured, for it becomes boundless?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि शास्त्रें अर्थे देशें काळें। या चहूंही जें एकफळे। तो उपावो कें मिळे। आघवयांसी॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi śāstreṃ arthe deśeṃ kāḻeṃ| yā cahūṃhī jeṃ ekaphaḻe| to upāvo keṃ miḻe| āghavayāṃsī|| 28||
verses.meaning: And that which is the singular fruit of scriptures, meaning, place, and time—where can such a means be found for all?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि शास्त्राचें घडतें। नोहे प्रकारें बहुतें। तरी मूर्खा मुमुक्षां येथें। काय गती पां॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni śāstrāceṃ ghaḍateṃ| nohe prakāreṃ bahuteṃ| tarī mūrkhā mumukṣāṃ yetheṃ| kāya gatī pāṃ|| 29||
verses.meaning: Therefore, if the scriptures are not understood in their true essence, what hope is there for the ignorant and those seeking liberation?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा पुसावया अभिप्राबो। जो अर्जुन करी प्रस्तावो। तो सतराविया ठावो । अध्याया येथ॥ ३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā pusāvayā abhiprābo| jo arjuna karī prastāvo| to satarāviyā ṭhāvo | adhyāyā yetha|| 30||
verses.meaning: The inquiry that Arjuna makes, the proposition he puts forth, is the subject of the seventeenth chapter here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सर्वविषयीं वितृष्णु| जो सकळकळीं प्रवीणु। कृष्णाही नवल कृष्णु। अर्जुनत्वें जो॥ ३१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sarvaviṣayīṃ vitṛṣṇu| jo sakaḻakaḻīṃ pravīṇu| kṛṣṇāhī navala kṛṣṇu| arjunatveṃ jo|| 319||
verses.meaning: He who is detached from all things, who is skilled in all arts, and who, through his Arjuna-ness, is a wonder even to Krishna himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शौर्या जोडळा आधारू । जो सोमवंशाचा शंगारु । सुखादि उपकारु । जयाची लीला ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: śauryā joḍaḻā ādhārū | jo somavaṃśācā śaṃgāru | sukhādi upakāru | jayācī līlā || 32||
verses.meaning: He is the foundation of bravery, the adornment of the lunar dynasty, whose divine play bestows happiness and blessings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो प्रज्ञेचा प्रियोत्तमु। ब्रह्मविद्येचा विश्रामु| सहचरु मनोधर्मु। देवाचा जो॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo prajñecā priyottamu| brahmavidyecā viśrāmu| sahacaru manodharmu| devācā jo|| 33||
verses.meaning: Who is the dearest beloved of wisdom, the resting place of divine knowledge, the companion of the mind's nature, who is God Himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो अर्जुन म्हणे गा तमालश्यामा । इंद्रियां फांबलिया ब्रह्मा। तुझा बोलु आम्हां। साकांक्षु पैं जी॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to arjuna mhaṇe gā tamālaśyāmā | iṃdriyāṃ phāṃbaliyā brahmā| tujhā bolu āmhāṃ| sākāṃkṣu paiṃ jī|| 34||
verses.meaning: Arjuna said to the dark-hued Lord, "O Brahma, whose senses are expanded everywhere, Your words are indeed full of longing for us."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें शास्त्रेंबांचूनि आणिकें । प्राणिया स्वमोक्षु न देखे। ऐसें कां कैंपखें। बोलिलासी॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ śāstreṃbāṃcūni āṇikeṃ | prāṇiyā svamokṣu na dekhe| aiseṃ kāṃ kaiṃpakheṃ| bolilāsī|| 35||
verses.meaning: Why do you speak such foolish words, that without the scriptures, a living being cannot attain its own liberation?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी न मिळेचि तो देशु। नव्हेचि काळा अवकाशु । जो करवी शास्त्राभ्यासु। तोही दुरी ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī na miḻeci to deśu| navheci kāḻā avakāśu | jo karavī śāstrābhyāsu| tohī durī || 36||
verses.meaning: That state is not attained, nor is there any time for it. Even that which makes one study the scriptures is far away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि अभ्यासीं विरजिया। होती जिया सामुग्रिया । त्याही नाहीं आपैतिया । तिये वेळीं ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi abhyāsīṃ virajiyā| hotī jiyā sāmugriyā | tyāhī nāhīṃ āpaitiyā | tiye veḻīṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: And the materials that are needed for spiritual practice are not readily available at that time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उजू नोहेचि प्राचीन। नेदीचि प्रज्ञा संवाहन। ऐसें ठेलें आपादन । शास्त्राचें जयां ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ujū noheci prācīna| nedīci prajñā saṃvāhana| aiseṃ ṭheleṃ āpādana | śāstrāceṃ jayāṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: For those whose intellect is not straightforward, who do not engage in the transmission of wisdom, the scriptures remain inaccessible, their teachings unreceived.
