verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना शास्त्रविखीं । एकही न लाहातीचि ४०० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी नखी । म्हणौनि उखिविखी । सांडिली जिहीं ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā śāstravikhīṃ | ekahī na lāhātīci 400 śrījñāneśvarī nakhī | mhaṇauni ukhivikhī | sāṃḍilī jihīṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Indeed, they do not gain even a single insight from the scriptures. Therefore, they have abandoned the study of the Dnyaneshwari, considering it a trivial matter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी निर्धारूनि शास्त्रें। अर्थानुष्ठानें पवित्रे नांदताति परत्रें। साचारें जे॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī nirdhārūni śāstreṃ| arthānuṣṭhāneṃ pavitre nāṃdatāti paratreṃ| sācāreṃ je|| 40||
verses.meaning: But those who, having ascertained the scriptures, live by their pure and true injunctions, truly thrive in the afterlife.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयांऐसें आम्हीं होआवें। ऐसी चाड बांधोनि जीवें । घेती तयांचे मागावे । आचरावया॥ ४१ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃaiseṃ āmhīṃ hoāveṃ| aisī cāḍa bāṃdhoni jīveṃ | ghetī tayāṃce māgāve | ācarāvayā|| 41 ||
verses.meaning: Desiring to become like them, they earnestly seek to follow in their footsteps and emulate their conduct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: धड्याचियां आखरां। तळीं बाळ ल्िहे दातारा। कां पुढांसूनि पडिकरा (काठिकरा )। अक्षमु चाले॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: dhaḍyāciyāṃ ākharāṃ| taḻīṃ bāḻa lihe dātārā| kāṃ puḍhāṃsūni paḍikarā (kāṭhikarā )| akṣamu cāle|| 42||
verses.meaning: Just as a child, seeing the letters of a lesson, tries to write them below, or an incapable person, seeing someone walk ahead, tries to follow, so too I attempt this task.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सर्वशास्त्रनिपुण। तयाचें जें आचरण तेंचि करिती प्रमाण। आपल्लिये श्रद्धे ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sarvaśāstranipuṇa| tayāceṃ jeṃ ācaraṇa teṃci karitī pramāṇa| āpalliye śraddhe || 43||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who are proficient in all scriptures, their conduct itself becomes the standard for others, who follow it with their own faith.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग शिवादिकें पूजन । भूम्यादिकें महादानें । अग्निहोत्रादि यजनें। करिती जे श्रद्धा ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga śivādikeṃ pūjana | bhūmyādikeṃ mahādāneṃ | agnihotrādi yajaneṃ| karitī je śraddhā || 44||
verses.meaning: Then, those who perform worship of Shiva and other deities, great donations of land and other things, and sacrifices like Agnihotra, do so with faith.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयां सत्त्वरजतमां-। माजीं कोण पुरुषोत्तमा। गति होय ते आम्हां। सांगिजो जी॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃ sattvarajatamāṃ-| mājīṃ koṇa puruṣottamā| gati hoya te āmhāṃ| sāṃgijo jī|| 45||
verses.meaning: O Purushottama, please tell us what destiny awaits those who are influenced by Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब वैकुंठपिठींचें लिंग जो निगमपद्याचा पराग। जिये जयाचेनि हें जग। अंगच्छाया॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba vaikuṃṭhapiṭhīṃceṃ liṃga jo nigamapadyācā parāga| jiye jayāceni heṃ jaga| aṃgacchāyā|| 46||
verses.meaning: He is the very essence of Vaikuntha, the pollen of the Vedic lotus. It is by His grace that this entire world is but a shadow of His being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काळ सावियाचि वाढु । लोकोत्तर प्रौढु। अद्वितीय गूढु। आनंदघनु॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāḻa sāviyāci vāḍhu | lokottara prauḍhu| advitīya gūḍhu| ānaṃdaghanu|| 47||
verses.meaning: Time itself grows, supremely mature, uniquely mysterious, a dense mass of bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इयें ए्लाधिजती जेणें बिकें। तें जयाचें आंगीं असिकें। तो श्रीकृष्ण स्वमुखें। बोलत असे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyeṃ elādhijatī jeṇeṃ bikeṃ| teṃ jayāceṃ āṃgīṃ asikeṃ| to śrīkṛṣṇa svamukheṃ| bolata ase|| 48||
verses.meaning: The one who possesses the power to manifest this entire universe, that very Shri Krishna, speaks these words from his own mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणे पार्था तुझा अतिसो । हेंही आम्ही जाणतसों। जे शास्त्राभ्यासाचा आडमसो । मानितोसि कौं॥ ४९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇe pārthā tujhā atiso | heṃhī āmhī jāṇatasoṃ| je śāstrābhyāsācā āḍamaso | mānitosi kauṃ|| 49 ||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, I know that you are overly attached to this, and you consider the study of scriptures to be a mere pretense.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नुसधियाचि श्रब्धा । झोंबो पाहसी परमपदा । तरी तैसें हें प्रबुद्धा । सोहोपें नोहे ॥ ५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: nusadhiyāci śrabdhā | jhoṃbo pāhasī paramapadā | tarī taiseṃ heṃ prabuddhā | sohopeṃ nohe || 50||
verses.meaning: O enlightened one, if you wish to attain the highest state merely through faith, know that it is not that easy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रद्धा म्हणितलियासाठीं । पातेजों नये किरीटी | काय द्विजु अंत्यजघृष्टी । अंत्यजु नोहे ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: śraddhā mhaṇitaliyāsāṭhīṃ | pātejoṃ naye kirīṭī | kāya dviju aṃtyajaghṛṣṭī | aṃtyaju nohe || 51||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, just because someone is called 'Shraddha' (faith), it doesn't mean they are truly faithful. For example, does a Brahmin become an untouchable just by being in the company of an untouchable? No, the untouchable remains an untouchable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गंगोदक जरी जालें। तरी मद्यभांडां आलें। तें घेऊं न ये कांहीं केलें। विचारीं पां॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: gaṃgodaka jarī jāleṃ| tarī madyabhāṃḍāṃ āleṃ| teṃ gheūṃ na ye kāṃhīṃ keleṃ| vicārīṃ pāṃ||52||
verses.meaning: Even if Ganga water enters a vessel that held liquor, it cannot be accepted, no matter what. Consider this carefully.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चंदनु होय शीतळू । परी अग्नीसी पावे मेळू । तैं हातीं धरितां जाळूं। न शके काई॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: caṃdanu hoya śītaḻū | parī agnīsī pāve meḻū | taiṃ hātīṃ dharitāṃ jāḻūṃ| na śake kāī||53||
verses.meaning: Sandalwood is cool by nature, but if it comes into contact with fire, can it not burn when held in hand?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां किडाचिये आटतिये पुटीं। पडिलें सोळें किरीटी । घेतलें चोखासाठीं। नागवीना॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ kiḍāciye āṭatiye puṭīṃ| paḍileṃ soḻeṃ kirīṭī | ghetaleṃ cokhāsāṭhīṃ| nāgavīnā|| 54||
verses.meaning: Just as a silkworm, when it falls into the cocoon it has spun, is not harmed but rather protected by it, so too is the devotee protected by their devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें श्रद्धेचे दळवाडें। अंगें कौर चोखडें। परी प्राणियांच्या पडे। विभागीं जैं॥५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śraddhece daḻavāḍeṃ| aṃgeṃ kaura cokhaḍeṃ| parī prāṇiyāṃcyā paḍe| vibhāgīṃ jaiṃ||55||
verses.meaning: Just as the fortress of faith, inherently pure and strong, becomes a refuge for beings when it falls to their lot.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते प्राणिये तंव स्वभावें । अनादिमायाप्रभावें। त्रिगुणाचेचि आघवे। वळिळे आहाती ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: te prāṇiye taṃva svabhāveṃ | anādimāyāprabhāveṃ| triguṇāceci āghave| vaḻiḻe āhātī || 56||
verses.meaning: All these beings, by their very nature, are bound by the influence of the beginningless Maya, and are entirely shaped by the three Gunas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथही दोन गुण खांचती। मग एक धरी उन्नती। तैं तैसियाचि होती वृत्ती । जीवांचिया ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tethahī dona guṇa khāṃcatī| maga eka dharī unnatī| taiṃ taisiyāci hotī vṛttī | jīvāṃciyā || 57||
verses.meaning: Even there, two qualities diminish, and then one quality rises. Similarly, the tendencies of beings become like that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वृत्तीऐसें मन धरिती । मनाऐसी क्रिया करिती । केलियाऐसी बरिती । मरोनि देहें ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: vṛttīaiseṃ mana dharitī | manāaisī kriyā karitī | keliyāaisī baritī | maroni deheṃ || 58||
verses.meaning: The mind holds onto thoughts, and actions follow the mind. They experience the fruits of their actions, even after death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बीज मोडे झाड होये । झाड मोडे बीजीं सामाये । ऐसेनि कल्पकोडी जाये । परी जाति न नशे॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: bīja moḍe jhāḍa hoye | jhāḍa moḍe bījīṃ sāmāye | aiseni kalpakoḍī jāye | parī jāti na naśe|| 59||
verses.meaning: The seed breaks and becomes a tree; the tree breaks and merges back into the seed. In this way, countless eons pass, yet the fundamental nature is not destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियापरी यियें अपारें। होत जात जन्मांतरें । परी त्रिगुणत्व न व्यभिचरे। प्राणियांचें ॥ ६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyāparī yiyeṃ apāreṃ| hota jāta janmāṃtareṃ | parī triguṇatva na vyabhicare| prāṇiyāṃceṃ || 60||
verses.meaning: In this way, countless births and deaths occur, yet the three Gunas (Sattva, Rajas, Tamas) never deviate from their influence on beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि प्राणियांच्या पैकीं । पडिली श्रद्धा अवबलोकौं। ते होय गुणासारिखी। तिहीं ययां ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni prāṇiyāṃcyā paikīṃ | paḍilī śraddhā avabalokauṃ| te hoya guṇāsārikhī| tihīṃ yayāṃ || 61||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the faith that arises in beings is in accordance with their nature, and it is of these three types.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विपायें वाढे सत्त्व शुद्ध । तेव्हां ज्ञानासी करी साद। परी एका दोघे बोखद। येर आहाती ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: vipāyeṃ vāḍhe sattva śuddha | tevhāṃ jñānāsī karī sāda| parī ekā doghe bokhada| yera āhātī || 62||
verses.meaning: Through adversity, pure sattva (goodness) grows, which then calls forth knowledge. But these two, sattva and knowledge, are like two sides of the same coin, inseparable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सत्त्वाचेनि आंगलगें। ते श्रद्धा मोक्षफळा रिगे। तंव रज तम उगे। कां पां राहाती॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sattvāceni āṃgalageṃ| te śraddhā mokṣaphaḻā rige| taṃva raja tama uge| kāṃ pāṃ rāhātī|| 63||
verses.meaning: When faith, imbued with the quality of Sattva (goodness), embarks on the path to liberation, why would Rajas (passion) and Tamas (ignorance) remain silent and inactive?

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोडोनि सत्त्वाची त्राये। रजोगुण आकाशें जाये । तेव्हां तेचि श्रद्धा होये । कर्मकेरसुणी ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: moḍoni sattvācī trāye| rajoguṇa ākāśeṃ jāye | tevhāṃ teci śraddhā hoye | karmakerasuṇī || 64||
verses.meaning: When the sattva quality is broken and the rajas quality ascends to the sky, then that very faith becomes the broom of action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तमाची उठी आगी। तेव्हां तेचि श्रद्धा भंगी। हों लागे भोगालागीं। भलतेया ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tamācī uṭhī āgī| tevhāṃ teci śraddhā bhaṃgī| hoṃ lāge bhogālāgīṃ| bhalateyā || 65||
verses.meaning: Then, when ignorance arises, that very faith is broken, and one becomes engrossed in enjoyment of all kinds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं सत्त्वरजतमा-। वेगळी श्रद्धा सुवर्मा । नाहीं गा जीवग्रामा-। माजीं यया ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ sattvarajatamā-| vegaḻī śraddhā suvarmā | nāhīṃ gā jīvagrāmā-| mājīṃ yayā || 66||
verses.meaning: Thus, faith, which is a good armor, is not separate from the qualities of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas in this realm of living beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि श्रद्धा स्वाभाविक । असे पैं त्रिगुणात्मक । रजतमसात्त्विक । भेदीं इहीं ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni śraddhā svābhāvika | ase paiṃ triguṇātmaka | rajatamasāttvika | bhedīṃ ihīṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Therefore, faith, being inherent, is indeed threefold, divided into Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें जीबनचि उदक। परी विषीं होय मारक । कां मिरयामाजीं तीख । उंसीं गोड ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ jībanaci udaka| parī viṣīṃ hoya māraka | kāṃ mirayāmājīṃ tīkha | uṃsīṃ goḍa || 68||
verses.meaning: Just as water, which is life itself, can become deadly poison, or as chili peppers are pungent, and sugarcane is sweet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा बहुवसें तमें। जो सदाचि होय निमे। तेथ श्रद्धा परिणमे। तेंचि होऊनि ॥ ६९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā bahuvaseṃ tameṃ| jo sadāci hoya nime| tetha śraddhā pariṇame| teṃci hoūni || 69 ||
verses.meaning: Just as abundant darkness always prevails, so too does faith transform into that very darkness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग काजळा आणि मसी । न दिसे विवंचना जैसी। तेवीं श्रद्धा तामसी । सिनी नाहीं ॥ ७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kājaḻā āṇi masī | na dise vivaṃcanā jaisī| tevīṃ śraddhā tāmasī | sinī nāhīṃ || 70||
verses.meaning: Just as there is no distinction between lampblack and soot, so too, faith that is born of ignorance (Tamas) is not pure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीच राजसीं जीवीं। रजोमय जाणावी | सात्त्विकीं आघवी । सत्त्वाचीच ॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīca rājasīṃ jīvīṃ| rajomaya jāṇāvī | sāttvikīṃ āghavī | sattvācīca ||71||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those with a Rajasic nature are known to be full of passion, and those with a Sattvic nature are entirely composed of goodness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि हा सकळु। जगडंबरु निखिळु। श्रब्धेचाचि केवळु। बोतला असे॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni hā sakaḻu| jagaḍaṃbaru nikhiḻu| śrabdhecāci kevaḻu| botalā ase|| 72||
verses.meaning: Thus, this entire magnificent universe, in its entirety, is solely a manifestation of faith, having taken form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी गुणत्रयवशें। त्रिविधपणाचें लासें। श्रर्दधें जें उठिलें असे । तें बोळख तूं॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī guṇatrayavaśeṃ| trividhapaṇāceṃ lāseṃ| śrardadheṃ jeṃ uṭhileṃ ase | teṃ boḻakha tūṃ|| 73||
verses.meaning: But know that whatever arises from faith, marked by the three qualities, is of a threefold nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जाणिजे झाड फुलें। कां मानस जाणिजे बोलें । भोगें जाणिजे केलें। पूर्वजन्मींचें ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jāṇije jhāḍa phuleṃ| kāṃ mānasa jāṇije boleṃ | bhogeṃ jāṇije keleṃ| pūrvajanmīṃceṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Just as a tree is known by its flowers, or a mind is known by its words, so too are the deeds of a past life known by one's present experiences.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं जिहीं चिन्हीं। श्रद्धेची रूपें तीन्ही । देखिजती ते बानी । अवधारीं पां ॥७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ jihīṃ cinhīṃ| śraddhecī rūpeṃ tīnhī | dekhijatī te bānī | avadhārīṃ pāṃ ||75||
verses.meaning: In the same way, listen to the characteristics by which the three forms of faith are recognized.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सात्त्विक श्रद्धा। जयांचा होय बांधा। तयां बहुतकरूनि मेधा । स्वर्गी आथी॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sāttvika śraddhā| jayāṃcā hoya bāṃdhā| tayāṃ bahutakarūni medhā | svargī āthī|| 76||
verses.meaning: Those whose very foundation is sattvic faith, they are endowed with great intelligence in heaven.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते विद्याजात पढती । यज्ञक्रिये निवडती। किंबहुना पडती । देवलोकीं ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: te vidyājāta paḍhatī | yajñakriye nivaḍatī| kiṃbahunā paḍatī | devalokīṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: They study various branches of knowledge, perform sacrifices, and as a result, they ascend to the heavenly realms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि श्रब्धा राजसा । घडले जे वीरेशा। ते भजती ४०२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी राक्षसां। खेचरां हन ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi śrabdhā rājasā | ghaḍale je vīreśā| te bhajatī 402 śrījñāneśvarī rākṣasāṃ| khecarāṃ hana || 78||
verses.meaning: And those who are endowed with such faith, O King, worship demons and celestial beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रब्धा जे कां तामसी । ते मी सांगेन तुजपाशी । जे कां केवळ पापराशी । अतिकर्कशी निर्दयत्वें॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrabdhā je kāṃ tāmasī | te mī sāṃgena tujapāśī | je kāṃ kevaḻa pāparāśī | atikarkaśī nirdayatveṃ|| 79||
verses.meaning: I will now tell you about the faith that is Tamasic, which is a mere heap of sins, extremely harsh and merciless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जीववधें साधूनि बळी । भूतप्रेतकुळें मैळीं। स्मशानीं संध्याकाळीं। पूजिती जे॥८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jīvavadheṃ sādhūni baḻī | bhūtapretakuḻeṃ maiḻīṃ| smaśānīṃ saṃdhyākāḻīṃ| pūjitī je||80||
verses.meaning: Those who, by killing living beings, gather strength, and worship ghosts and spirits in cremation grounds at dusk.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते तमोगुणाचें सार। काढूनि निर्मिळे नर। जाण तामसियेचें घर| श्रद्धेचे तें ॥८९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: te tamoguṇāceṃ sāra| kāḍhūni nirmiḻe nara| jāṇa tāmasiyeceṃ ghara| śraddhece teṃ ||891||
verses.meaning: The essence of Tamas Guna, when extracted, creates a human being. Know that such a person is a dwelling place of Tamasic Shraddha (faith).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी इहीं तिहीं लिंगीं। त्रिविध श्रद्धा जगीं। पैं हें ययालागीं। सांगतु असें ॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī ihīṃ tihīṃ liṃgīṃ| trividha śraddhā jagīṃ| paiṃ heṃ yayālāgīṃ| sāṃgatu aseṃ ||82||
verses.meaning: Thus, these three types of faith exist in the world, and I am explaining this for that very reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे हे सात्त्विक श्रद्धा ।॥ जतन करावी प्रबुद्धा। येरी दोनी विरुद्धा। सांडाविया॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je he sāttvika śraddhā ||| jatana karāvī prabuddhā| yerī donī viruddhā| sāṃḍāviyā|| 83||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O enlightened one, preserve this pure faith, and abandon the other two opposing ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे सात्त्विक मति जया। निर्वाहती होय धनंजया । बागुल नोहे तया । कैवल्य तें ॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: he sāttvika mati jayā| nirvāhatī hoya dhanaṃjayā | bāgula nohe tayā | kaivalya teṃ ||84||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, for those whose minds are guided by such pure and virtuous intellect, liberation is not a mere illusion or a trick; it is their true and certain attainment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो न पढो कां ब्रह्मसूत्र । ना लोढो सर्व शास्त्र। सिद्धांत न होत स्वतंत्र । तयाच्या हातीं ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: to na paḍho kāṃ brahmasūtra | nā loḍho sarva śāstra| siddhāṃta na hota svataṃtra | tayācyā hātīṃ || 85 ||
verses.meaning: He does not need to study the Brahma Sutras, nor does he need to burden himself with all scriptures. The ultimate truth does not become independent in his hands.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी श्रृतिस्मृतींचे अर्थ। जे आपण होऊनि मूर्त । अनुष्ठाने जगा देत। वडील जे हे॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī śrṛtismṛtīṃce artha| je āpaṇa hoūni mūrta | anuṣṭhāne jagā deta| vaḍīla je he|| 86||
verses.meaning: The elders, who themselves embodied the essence of the Shrutis and Smritis, imparted their teachings to the world through their actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयांची आचरतीं पाउलें। पाऊनि सात्त्विकी श्रद्धा चाले। तो तेंचि फळ ठेविलें। ऐसें लाहे ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃcī ācaratīṃ pāuleṃ| pāūni sāttvikī śraddhā cāle| to teṃci phaḻa ṭhevileṃ| aiseṃ lāhe || 87||
verses.meaning: Seeing their footsteps, a sattvic (pure) faith follows. Such a one attains the very fruit that was destined.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं एक दीपु लावी सायासें। आणिक तेथें लाऊं बैसे। तरी तो काय प्रकाशें। वंचिजे गा॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ eka dīpu lāvī sāyāseṃ| āṇika tetheṃ lāūṃ baise| tarī to kāya prakāśeṃ| vaṃcije gā|| 88||
verses.meaning: If one lamp is lit with effort, and then another is brought to be lit from it, does the first lamp lose any of its light?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां येके मोळ अपार । वेंचोनि केलें धवळार। तो सुरवाडु वस्तीकर। न भोगी काई ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ yeke moḻa apāra | veṃconi keleṃ dhavaḻāra| to suravāḍu vastīkara| na bhogī kāī || 89||
verses.meaning: Or, having spent immeasurable effort to build a magnificent palace, why would one not enjoy the comfort of dwelling within it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो जो तळें करी। ते तयाचीच तृषा हरी । कीं सुआरासीचि अन्न घरीं । येरां नोहे ॥ ९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso jo taḻeṃ karī| te tayācīca tṛṣā harī | kīṃ suārāsīci anna gharīṃ | yerāṃ nohe || 90||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Just as one who digs a well quenches their own thirst, or a cook prepares food for themselves, so it is for others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बहुत काय बोलों पैं गा। येका गौतमासीचि गंगा । येरां समस्तां 'काय जगां। बोहोळ जाली ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: bahuta kāya boloṃ paiṃ gā| yekā gautamāsīci gaṃgā | yerāṃ samastāṃ 'kāya jagāṃ| bohoḻa jālī || 91||
verses.meaning: What more can I say? The Ganges of knowledge flowed only for Gautama. Did it not then become abundant for all others in the world?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आपुलियापरी । शास्त्र अनुष्ठिती कुसरी । जाणे तयातें श्रद्धाळु जो वरी। तो मूर्खुही तरे॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āpuliyāparī | śāstra anuṣṭhitī kusarī | jāṇe tayāteṃ śraddhāḻu jo varī| to mūrkhuhī tare||92||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one who, like himself, skillfully practices the scriptures and reveres them, even if he is a fool, will be saved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना शास्त्राचेनि कौर नांबें। खाकरोंही नेणती जीवें। परी शास्त्रज्ञांही शिवबें। टेंकों नेदिती॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā śāstrāceni kaura nāṃbeṃ| khākaroṃhī neṇatī jīveṃ| parī śāstrajñāṃhī śivabeṃ| ṭeṃkoṃ neditī|| 93||
verses.meaning: They do not even know how to scratch themselves with the sharp edge of scriptures, yet they do not allow even the learned scholars to touch them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वडिलांचिया क्रिया । देखोनि वाती वांकुलिया। पंडितां डाकुलिया। वाजविती॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: vaḍilāṃciyā kriyā | dekhoni vātī vāṃkuliyā| paṃḍitāṃ ḍākuliyā| vājavitī|| 94||
verses.meaning: Seeing the actions of their elders, children make faces and mock the learned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलेनीचि आटोपें।॥ धनित्वाचेनि दर्पे। साचचि पाखंडाचीं तपें। आदरिती॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpulenīci āṭopeṃ||| dhanitvāceni darpe| sācaci pākhaṃḍācīṃ tapeṃ| ādaritī|| 95||
verses.meaning: With their own efforts, and with the pride of their wealth, they truly undertake hypocritical austerities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलिया पुढिलांचिया। आंगीं घाळूनि कातिया। रक्‍तमांसा प्रणीतया। भरभरु ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpuliyā puḍhilāṃciyā| āṃgīṃ ghāḻūni kātiyā| rak‍tamāṃsā praṇītayā| bharabharu || 96||
verses.meaning: They would cut the bodies of their own people and fill vessels with blood and flesh.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रिचविती जळतकुंडीं। लाविती चेड्याच्या तोंडीं । नवसियां देती उंडी । बाळकांची ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ricavitī jaḻatakuṃḍīṃ| lāvitī ceḍyācyā toṃḍīṃ | navasiyāṃ detī uṃḍī | bāḻakāṃcī || 97||
verses.meaning: They offer children as sacrifices, throwing them into fire pits, or placing them in the mouths of idols, fulfilling their vows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आग्रहाचिया उजरिया । क्षुद्र देवतां वरिया। अन्नत्यागें सातरिया। ठाकती एक ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āgrahāciyā ujariyā | kṣudra devatāṃ variyā| annatyāgeṃ sātariyā| ṭhākatī eka || 98||
verses.meaning: Driven by insistence, they worship petty deities, and by fasting for seven days, they reach a certain state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा आत्मपरपीडा। बीज तमक्षेत्रीं सुहाडा । पेरिती मग पुढां । तेंचि पिके॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā ātmaparapīḍā| bīja tamakṣetrīṃ suhāḍā | peritī maga puḍhāṃ | teṃci pike|| 99||
verses.meaning: Oh, the seeds of self-inflicted suffering and harm to others, sown in the field of ignorance, will inevitably yield the same bitter harvest in the future.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाहू नाहीं आपलिया। आणि नावेतेंही धनंजया । न धरी होय तया । समुद्री जैसें॥ १००॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāhū nāhīṃ āpaliyā| āṇi nāveteṃhī dhanaṃjayā | na dharī hoya tayā | samudrī jaiseṃ|| 100||
verses.meaning: One who has no arms, O Dhananjaya, cannot hold a boat; it is like being in the middle of the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां वैद्यातें करी सळा। रसु सांडी 'पायखोळां। तो रोगिया जेवीं जिव्हाळा । सवता होय ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ vaidyāteṃ karī saḻā| rasu sāṃḍī 'pāyakhoḻāṃ| to rogiyā jevīṃ jivhāḻā | savatā hoya || 1||
verses.meaning: Just as a physician treats a patient, and the medicine removes the disease, so too does the patient become healthy and vibrant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना पडिकराचेनि सळें। काढी आपुलेचि डोळे। तें बानवसां आंधळें। जैसें ठाके ॥२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā paḍikarāceni saḻeṃ| kāḍhī āpuleci ḍoḻe| teṃ bānavasāṃ āṃdhaḻeṃ| jaiseṃ ṭhāke ||2||
verses.meaning: Just as a person, by various tricks, blinds himself and then remains blind by his own doing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तयां आसुरां होये । निंदूनि शास्त्रांची सोये। सैंघ धांबताती मोहें। आडवीं जे कां॥३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ tayāṃ āsurāṃ hoye | niṃdūni śāstrāṃcī soye| saiṃgha dhāṃbatātī moheṃ| āḍavīṃ je kāṃ||3||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those demons, criticizing the path of the scriptures, run wildly driven by delusion, which is indeed an obstacle.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कामु करवी तें करिती। क्रोधु मारवी तें मारिती । किंबहुना मातें पुरिती। दुःखाचा गुंडां॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāmu karavī teṃ karitī| krodhu māravī teṃ māritī | kiṃbahunā māteṃ puritī| duḥkhācā guṃḍāṃ|| 4||
verses.meaning: They do what lust makes them do, they kill whom anger makes them kill. In short, they fill me with bundles of sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुलां परावां देहीं। दुःख देती जें जें कांहीं। मज आत्मया तेतुलाही । होय शीणु॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpulāṃ parāvāṃ dehīṃ| duḥkha detī jeṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ| maja ātmayā tetulāhī | hoya śīṇu|| 5||
verses.meaning: Whatever suffering is inflicted upon one's own body or another's, that much weariness is experienced by Me, the indwelling Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं वाचेचेनिहि पालवें । पापियां तया नातळावें । परी पडिलें सांगाबें। त्यजावया॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ vācecenihi pālaveṃ | pāpiyāṃ tayā nātaḻāveṃ | parī paḍileṃ sāṃgābeṃ| tyajāvayā|| 6||
verses.meaning: One should not even touch the leaves of the speech of such sinners. But if one happens to encounter it, one should abandon it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रेत बाहिरें घालिजे। कां अंत्यजु संभाषणीं त्यजिजे। हें असो हातें क्षाळिजे। कश्मलातें ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: preta bāhireṃ ghālije| kāṃ aṃtyaju saṃbhāṣaṇīṃ tyajije| heṃ aso hāteṃ kṣāḻije| kaśmalāteṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: Just as a corpse is cast out, or an untouchable is avoided in conversation, or filth is washed away by hand, so too should one discard impurities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ शुष्धीचिया आशा । तो लेपु न मनवे जैसा। तयांतें सांडावया तैसा। अनुबादु हा॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha śuṣdhīciyā āśā | to lepu na manave jaisā| tayāṃteṃ sāṃḍāvayā taisā| anubādu hā||8||
verses.meaning: Just as a person does not consider a stain to be pure, even if they hope for purity, similarly, this translation is meant to discard such impurities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी अर्जुना तूं तयांतें। देखसी तैं स्मर हो मातें । जे आन प्रायश्‍चित्त येथें । मानेळ ना॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī arjunā tūṃ tayāṃteṃ| dekhasī taiṃ smara ho māteṃ | je āna prāyaś‍citta yetheṃ | māneḻa nā||9||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, when you see them, remember Me, for no other penance is acceptable here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि श्रद्धा जे सात्त्विकी । पुढती तेचि पैं येकी । जतन करावी निकी। सर्वांपरी ॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni śraddhā je sāttvikī | puḍhatī teci paiṃ yekī | jatana karāvī nikī| sarvāṃparī || 190||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the faith that is sattvic, that alone should be carefully preserved above all else.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी धरावा तैसा संगु। जेणें पोखे सात्त्विक लागु । सत्त्ववृद्धीचा भागु। आहारु घेपें॥११॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī dharāvā taisā saṃgu| jeṇeṃ pokhe sāttvika lāgu | sattvavṛddhīcā bhāgu| āhāru ghepeṃ||11||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should associate with that which nourishes sattvic qualities. That which promotes the growth of sattva should be consumed as food.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी पाहीं। स्वभाववृद्धीच्या ठाई । आहारावांचूनि नाहीं । बळी हेतु ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī pāhīṃ| svabhāvavṛddhīcyā ṭhāī | āhārāvāṃcūni nāhīṃ | baḻī hetu || 12||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, observe: there is no stronger cause for the growth of one's nature than food.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रत्यक्ष पाहें पां बीरा। जो सावध घे मदिरा। तो होऊनि ठाके माजिरा। तियेचि क्षणीं ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pratyakṣa pāheṃ pāṃ bīrā| jo sāvadha ghe madirā| to hoūni ṭhāke mājirā| tiyeci kṣaṇīṃ || 13||
verses.meaning: Behold, O brave one, the one who consciously drinks wine, becomes intoxicated at that very moment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जो साविया अन्नरसु सेवी । तो व्यापिजे वातशलेष्मस्वभावीं । काय ज्वरु जालिया निववी। पयादिक॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jo sāviyā annarasu sevī | to vyāpije vātaśaleṣmasvabhāvīṃ | kāya jvaru jāliyā nivavī| payādika|| 14||
verses.meaning: Just as one who consumes only a single type of food is afflicted by imbalances of wind and phlegm, so too, what can alleviate a fever once it has set in, even milk and other remedies?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी अमृत जयापरी। घेतलिया मरण वारी । कां आपुल्याऐसें करी । जैसें विष॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī amṛta jayāparī| ghetaliyā maraṇa vārī | kāṃ āpulyāaiseṃ karī | jaiseṃ viṣa|| 15||
verses.meaning: Just as nectar, when consumed, wards off death, or poison, when taken, transforms one into its own nature (i.e., causes death).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं जैसा घेपे आहारु । धातु तैसाचि होय आकारु । आणि धातुऐसा अंतरु । भावो 'पोखे ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ jaisā ghepe āhāru | dhātu taisāci hoya ākāru | āṇi dhātuaisā aṃtaru | bhāvo 'pokhe || 16||
verses.meaning: Just as the food consumed shapes the body's constitution, so too does the inner disposition nourish itself according to that constitution.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें भांडियाचेनि तापें। आंतुलें उदकही तापे । तैसी धातुवशों आटोपे। चित्तवृत्ती ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ bhāṃḍiyāceni tāpeṃ| āṃtuleṃ udakahī tāpe | taisī dhātuvaśoṃ āṭope| cittavṛttī || 17||
verses.meaning: Just as the water inside a vessel heats up due to the heat applied to the vessel, similarly, the mind's tendencies are controlled by the influence of the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सात्त्विक रसु सेविजे। तें सत्त्वाची वाढी पाविजे । राजसा तामसा होडजे । येरीं रसीं ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sāttvika rasu sevije| teṃ sattvācī vāḍhī pāvije | rājasā tāmasā hoḍaje | yerīṃ rasīṃ || 18||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should partake of the sattvic rasa, for by doing so, sattva grows, while rajas and tamas are diminished by other rasas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सात्त्विक कोण आहारु । राजसा तामसा कायी आकारु । हें सांगों करीं आदरु । आकर्णनीं ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sāttvika koṇa āhāru | rājasā tāmasā kāyī ākāru | heṃ sāṃgoṃ karīṃ ādaru | ākarṇanīṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: So, what is sattvic food? What is the nature of rajasic and tamasic? I will explain this with reverence, so listen attentively.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि एकसरें आहारा। कैसेनि तिनी मोहरा। जालिया तेही वीरा । रोकडें दाऊं॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ekasareṃ āhārā| kaiseni tinī moharā| jāliyā tehī vīrā | rokaḍeṃ dāūṃ|| 190||
verses.meaning: And how these three aspects of food, when consumed in moderation, lead to spiritual liberation, O brave one, I shall now clearly explain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जेवणाराचिया रुची । निष्पत्ति कीं बोनियांची । आणि जेवितां तंव गुणांची । दासी येथ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jevaṇārāciyā rucī | niṣpatti kīṃ boniyāṃcī | āṇi jevitāṃ taṃva guṇāṃcī | dāsī yetha|| 21||
verses.meaning: The taste of the eater determines the preparation of the sweets; and when one eats, the qualities become subservient.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे जीव कर्ता भोक्ता । तो गुणास्तव स्वभावता । पावोनियां त्रिविधता। चेष्टे त्रिधा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je jīva kartā bhoktā | to guṇāstava svabhāvatā | pāvoniyāṃ trividhatā| ceṣṭe tridhā|| 22||
verses.meaning: The individual soul, which is the doer and the enjoyer, by its very nature, due to the gunas, attains a threefold state and acts in three ways.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि त्रिविधु आहारु। यज्ञुही त्रिप्रकारी। तप दान हन व्यापारु । त्रिविधचि ते॥२३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni trividhu āhāru| yajñuhī triprakārī| tapa dāna hana vyāpāru | trividhaci te||23||
verses.meaning: Therefore, food is of three kinds, and sacrifice is also of three types. Similarly, penance, charity, and actions are also threefold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आहारलक्षण पहिलें। सांगों जें म्हणितलें। तें आईक गा भलें। रूप करूं॥२४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āhāralakṣaṇa pahileṃ| sāṃgoṃ jeṃ mhaṇitaleṃ| teṃ āīka gā bhaleṃ| rūpa karūṃ||24||
verses.meaning: Now, I shall explain the first characteristic of food, as promised. Listen carefully, and I will elaborate on its nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सत्त्वगुणाकडे। जैं दैवें भोक्ता पडे। तैं मधुरीं रसीं वाढे। मेचु तया॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sattvaguṇākaḍe| jaiṃ daiveṃ bhoktā paḍe| taiṃ madhurīṃ rasīṃ vāḍhe| mecu tayā|| 25||
verses.meaning: When by chance a person of sattvic nature experiences the world, their attachment grows for sweet and pleasant things.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंगेंचि द्रव्यें सुरसें। जे आंगेंचि पदार्थ गोडसे । आंगेंचि स्नेहें बहुवसें । सुपक्कें जियें ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃgeṃci dravyeṃ suraseṃ| je āṃgeṃci padārtha goḍase | āṃgeṃci sneheṃ bahuvaseṃ | supakkeṃ jiyeṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: Just as some substances are inherently delicious, some ingredients are naturally sweet, and some oils are naturally abundant and well-matured.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आकारें नव्हती डगळें। स्पर्शे अति मवाळें । जिभेलागीं स्नेहाळें। स्वादें जियें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ākāreṃ navhatī ḍagaḻeṃ| sparśe ati mavāḻeṃ | jibhelāgīṃ snehāḻeṃ| svādeṃ jiyeṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: They are not formless clouds; they are exceedingly soft to the touch. To the tongue, they are affectionate in their taste.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रसें गाढीं वरी ढिलीं। द्रवभावीं आथिली। ठायेंठावो सांडिलीं । अग्नितापें॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: raseṃ gāḍhīṃ varī ḍhilīṃ| dravabhāvīṃ āthilī| ṭhāyeṃṭhāvo sāṃḍilīṃ | agnitāpeṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: The solid forms, though seemingly firm, become loose and fluid, melting away from their fixed positions due to the intense heat of the fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंगें सानें परिणामें थोरु । जैसें गुरुमुखींचें अक्षरु । तैशी अल्पीं जिहीं अपारु । तृप्ति राहे ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃgeṃ sāneṃ pariṇāmeṃ thoru | jaiseṃ gurumukhīṃceṃ akṣaru | taiśī alpīṃ jihīṃ apāru | tṛpti rāhe || 29||
verses.meaning: Small in body, but great in effect, like the अक्षर (letter/word) from the Guru's mouth. Similarly, in small things, immense satisfaction resides.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मुखीं जैसीं गोर्डे । तैसीचिहि ते आंतुळेकडे । तिये अन्नीं प्रीति वाढे । सात्त्विकांसी ॥ ९३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mukhīṃ jaisīṃ gorḍe | taisīcihi te āṃtuḻekaḍe | tiye annīṃ prīti vāḍhe | sāttvikāṃsī || 930||
verses.meaning: Just as the mouth finds sweetness, so too does the inner self. Thus, love for such food grows among the sattvic (pure-minded) people.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं गुणलक्षण। सात्त्विक भोज्य जाण । आयुष्याचे त्राण। नीच नवें हें ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ guṇalakṣaṇa| sāttvika bhojya jāṇa | āyuṣyāce trāṇa| nīca naveṃ heṃ || 31||
verses.meaning: Thus, food with these qualities is known to be sattvic. It is the very essence of life, ever new and invigorating.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें सात्त्विक रसें। जंव देहीं मेहो वरिषे। तंव आयुष्यनदी उससे। दिहाचि दिहा॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ sāttvika raseṃ| jaṃva dehīṃ meho variṣe| taṃva āyuṣyanadī usase| dihāci dihā|| 32||
verses.meaning: When the body is showered by this sattvic essence, the river of life overflows day by day.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सत्त्वाचिये कीर पाळती। कारण हाचि सुमती । दिवसाचिये उन्नती । भानु जैसा ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sattvāciye kīra pāḻatī| kāraṇa hāci sumatī | divasāciye unnatī | bhānu jaisā || 33||
verses.meaning: Indeed, it is the sun that nurtures the sattvic qualities, just as the sun itself brings about the day's progress.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि शरीरा हन मानसा। बळाचा पैं कुवासा। हा आहारु तरी दशा । कैंची रोगां॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi śarīrā hana mānasā| baḻācā paiṃ kuvāsā| hā āhāru tarī daśā | kaiṃcī rogāṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: And if the body and mind are strengthened by this food, then how can diseases arise?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा सात्त्विक होय भोग्यु। तेंचि भोगावया आरोग्यु। शरीरासी भाग्यु। उदयलें जाणों॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā sāttvika hoya bhogyu| teṃci bhogāvayā ārogyu| śarīrāsī bhāgyu| udayaleṃ jāṇoṃ|| 35||
verses.meaning: This sattvic (pure) experience is to be enjoyed. It is a blessing for the body, a sign of good fortune that has dawned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सुखाचे घेणें देणें। निकें उवाया ये येणें। हें असो वाढे साजणें। आनंदेंसीं ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sukhāce gheṇeṃ deṇeṃ| nikeṃ uvāyā ye yeṇeṃ| heṃ aso vāḍhe sājaṇeṃ| ānaṃdeṃsīṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: And the giving and taking of happiness, this coming and going, let it be. This is how the beloved grows with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा सात्त्विक आहारु । परिणमला थोरु । करी हा उपकारु । सबाह्यासी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā sāttvika āhāru | pariṇamalā thoru | karī hā upakāru | sabāhyāsī || 37||
verses.meaning: Such a pure and wholesome diet, when fully assimilated, bestows this great benefit upon both the inner and outer being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां राजसासि प्रीती । जिहीं रसीं आथी । करूं तयाही व्यक्‍ती । प्रसंगें गा॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ rājasāsi prītī | jihīṃ rasīṃ āthī | karūṃ tayāhī vyak‍tī | prasaṃgeṃ gā|| 38||
verses.meaning: Now, I will also describe the qualities that are dear to the passionate (Rajasic) nature, as the occasion arises.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मारें उणें काळकूट । तेणें मानें जें कडुवट। कां चुनियाहूनि दासट । आम्ळ हन॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī māreṃ uṇeṃ kāḻakūṭa | teṇeṃ māneṃ jeṃ kaḍuvaṭa| kāṃ cuniyāhūni dāsaṭa | āmḻa hana|| 39||
verses.meaning: Even the deadly poison is less bitter than this; it is more acrid than lime, or perhaps more sour.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कणिकोीतें जैसें पाणी। तैसेंचि मीठ बांधया आणी । तेतुलीच मेळवणी । रसांतरांची ॥ १४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaṇikoīteṃ jaiseṃ pāṇī| taiseṃci mīṭha bāṃdhayā āṇī | tetulīca meḻavaṇī | rasāṃtarāṃcī || 140||
verses.meaning: Just as a grain of sand holds water, so too does salt bind it. Such is the mingling of different essences.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें खारट अपाडें। राजसा तया आवडे । उन्हाचेनि मिषें तोंडें। आगीचि गिळी ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ khāraṭa apāḍeṃ| rājasā tayā āvaḍe | unhāceni miṣeṃ toṃḍeṃ| āgīci giḻī || 49||
verses.meaning: Such salty and unpalatable food is liked by the Rajasic person. Under the guise of heat, they consume fire itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वाफेचिया सिगे। वातीही लाविल्या लागे। तैसें उन्ह मागे। राजसु तो॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāpheciyā sige| vātīhī lāvilyā lāge| taiseṃ unha māge| rājasu to|| 42||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp is lit by the tip of a wick, so too does the sun follow the Rajasic (passionate) quality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वावदळ पाडूनि ठाये। साबळु डाहारळा आहे। तैसें तीख तो खाये। जें घायेंबिण रुपे॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāvadaḻa pāḍūni ṭhāye| sābaḻu ḍāhāraḻā āhe| taiseṃ tīkha to khāye| jeṃ ghāyeṃbiṇa rupe|| 43||
verses.meaning: Just as a whirlwind, without striking, uproots a tree, so too does the sharp intellect penetrate without a physical blow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि राखेहूनि कोरडें। आंत बाहेरी येकें पाडें। तो जिव्हादंशु आवडे | बहु तया॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi rākhehūni koraḍeṃ| āṃta bāherī yekeṃ pāḍeṃ| to jivhādaṃśu āvaḍe | bahu tayā|| 44||
verses.meaning: And drier than ash, inside and out, in the same way, that touch of the tongue is very much liked by them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परस्परें दांतां। आदळु होय खातां। तो गा तोंडीं घेतां। तोषों लागे ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paraspareṃ dāṃtāṃ| ādaḻu hoya khātāṃ| to gā toṃḍīṃ ghetāṃ| toṣoṃ lāge || 45||
verses.meaning: When teeth clash against each other while eating, the food that is taken into the mouth begins to give satisfaction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधींच द्रव्यें चुरमुरीं । वरी परिवडिजती मोहरी । जियें घेतां होती धुवारी । नाकेंतोंडें ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhīṃca dravyeṃ curamurīṃ | varī parivaḍijatī moharī | jiyeṃ ghetāṃ hotī dhuvārī | nākeṃtoṃḍeṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: The food is already spicy, and on top of that, mustard seeds are added, which, when eaten, cause smoke to come out of the nose and mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो उगें आगीतें। म्हणे तैसें राइतें। पढियें प्राणापरौतें। राजसासि गा॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso ugeṃ āgīteṃ| mhaṇe taiseṃ rāiteṃ| paḍhiyeṃ prāṇāparauteṃ| rājasāsi gā|| 47||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Just as fire is naturally hot, so too, for a king, his kingdom is dearer than his own life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा न पुरोनि तोंडा। जिभा केला वेडा । अन्नमिषें अग्नि भडभडां। पोटीं भरी॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā na puroni toṃḍā| jibhā kelā veḍā | annamiṣeṃ agni bhaḍabhaḍāṃ| poṭīṃ bharī|| 48||
verses.meaning: Not satisfied with merely filling the mouth, he makes his tongue mad, and under the guise of food, he fills his stomach with a blazing fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसाचि लवंगा सुंठे । मग भुई ना सेजे खाटे। पाणियाचें न सुटे । तोंडोनि पात्र॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisāci lavaṃgā suṃṭhe | maga bhuī nā seje khāṭe| pāṇiyāceṃ na suṭe | toṃḍoni pātra|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as cloves and dry ginger, once picked, do not return to the earth, nor to the bed or cot, and water, once poured, does not leave the vessel through its mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते आहार नव्हती घेतले । व्याधिव्याळ जे सुतले। ते चेववावया घातलें । माजवण पोटीं ॥ १५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: te āhāra navhatī ghetale | vyādhivyāḻa je sutale| te cevavāvayā ghātaleṃ | mājavaṇa poṭīṃ || 150||
verses.meaning: The food that was not consumed, the serpent of disease that lay dormant, was awakened and unleashed within the stomach.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें एकमेकां सळें। रोग उठति एके वेळे । ऐसा राजसु आहारु फळे । केवळ दुःखें ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ ekamekāṃ saḻeṃ| roga uṭhati eke veḻe | aisā rājasu āhāru phaḻe | kevaḻa duḥkheṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Just as many diseases arise simultaneously from a single cause, so too does a Rajasic diet result solely in suffering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं राजसा आहारा । रूप केलें धनुर्धग। परिणामाचाही विसुरा। सांगितला॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ rājasā āhārā | rūpa keleṃ dhanurdhaga| pariṇāmācāhī visurā| sāṃgitalā|| 52||
verses.meaning: Thus, O Arjuna, the nature of Rajasic food has been described, and its consequences have also been explained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तया तामसा । आवडे आहारु जैसा तेंही सांगों चिळसा। झणें तुम्ही ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ tayā tāmasā | āvaḍe āhāru jaisā teṃhī sāṃgoṃ ciḻasā| jhaṇeṃ tumhī || 53 ||
verses.meaning: Now, what kind of food is dear to the Tamasic? I will tell you, but do not be disgusted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी कुहिलें उष्टे खातां। न मनिजे तेणें अनहिता। जैसें कां उपहिता। म्हैसी खाय ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kuhileṃ uṣṭe khātāṃ| na manije teṇeṃ anahitā| jaiseṃ kāṃ upahitā| mhaisī khāya || 54||
verses.meaning: Even if one eats something that has been defiled, it is not considered harmful, just as a buffalo eats the leftovers of a sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निपजले अन्न तैसें । दुपाहरीं कां येरें दिवसें। अतिकरें तैं तामसें । घेईजे तें॥५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: nipajale anna taiseṃ | dupāharīṃ kāṃ yereṃ divaseṃ| atikareṃ taiṃ tāmaseṃ | gheīje teṃ||55||
verses.meaning: Just as food prepared at noon or on other days, when consumed excessively, becomes Tamasic (leading to inertia and ignorance).

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी अर्ध उकडिलें। का निपट करपोनि गेलें। तैसेंहि खाय चुकलें। रसा जें येवो ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī ardha ukaḍileṃ| kā nipaṭa karaponi geleṃ| taiseṃhi khāya cukaleṃ| rasā jeṃ yevo || 56||
verses.meaning: Just as food that is half-cooked or completely burnt is unfit to be eaten, so too is that which has missed its essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया कां आधि पूर्ण निष्पत्ती) जेथ रसु धरी व्यक्‍ती । तें अन्न ऐसी प्रतीती । तामसा नाहीं ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā kāṃ ādhi pūrṇa niṣpattī) jetha rasu dharī vyak‍tī | teṃ anna aisī pratītī | tāmasā nāhīṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: The Tamasic person does not understand that food which is inherently complete and fully nourishing, and which embodies the very essence of taste, is truly sattvic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि कहीं विपायें। ४०६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी सदन्ना वरपडा होये। तरी घाणी सुटे तंब राहे। व्याघु जैसा॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni kahīṃ vipāyeṃ| 406 śrījñāneśvarī sadannā varapaḍā hoye| tarī ghāṇī suṭe taṃba rāhe| vyāghu jaisā|| 58||
verses.meaning: If, by some misfortune, a tiger were to enter a house, it would immediately abandon its stench and remain there, just like a domestic animal.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां बहुवे दिवशीं बोलांडिलें। स्वादपणें सांडिलें। शुष्क अथवा सडलें। गाभिणेंही हो॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bahuve divaśīṃ bolāṃḍileṃ| svādapaṇeṃ sāṃḍileṃ| śuṣka athavā saḍaleṃ| gābhiṇeṃhī ho|| 59||
verses.meaning: Or, after many days, it has been transgressed, its taste abandoned, become dry or rotten, or even pregnant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंही बाळाचे हातवरी । चिवडलें जैसी राडी करी । कां सवें बैसोनि नारी । गोतांबील करी॥ १६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃhī bāḻāce hātavarī | civaḍaleṃ jaisī rāḍī karī | kāṃ saveṃ baisoni nārī | gotāṃbīla karī|| 160||
verses.meaning: Just as a child plays with its hands, or a woman sits and plays with a doll, so too did the Lord play with the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि कश्मळें जें खाय तें तया सुखभोजन ऐसें होय। परी येणेंही न धाय। पापिया तो ॥ ६९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni kaśmaḻeṃ jeṃ khāya teṃ tayā sukhabhojana aiseṃ hoya| parī yeṇeṃhī na dhāya| pāpiyā to || 691||
verses.meaning: Whatever defilement such a person consumes, it becomes like a delightful meal to them. Yet, even with this, that sinner is not satisfied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग चमत्कारु देखा । निषेधाचा आंबुखा । जया का सदोखा । कुद्रव्यासी ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga camatkāru dekhā | niṣedhācā āṃbukhā | jayā kā sadokhā | kudravyāsī || 62||
verses.meaning: Then behold the miracle: the very denial, which is like a bitter medicine, for the bad elements.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अपेयांच्या पानीं। अखाद्यांच्या भोजनीं। वाढविजे उतान्ही । तामसें तेणें ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā apeyāṃcyā pānīṃ| akhādyāṃcyā bhojanīṃ| vāḍhavije utānhī | tāmaseṃ teṇeṃ || 63||
verses.meaning: Such a person, with great enthusiasm, indulges in drinks that are forbidden and food that is impure, thereby increasing their tamasic nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं तामस जेवणारा । ऐसैसी मेचु हे वीरा । तयाचें फल दुसरां । क्षणीं नाहीं ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ tāmasa jevaṇārā | aisaisī mecu he vīrā | tayāceṃ phala dusarāṃ | kṣaṇīṃ nāhīṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: Thus, O brave one, such is the nature of one who eats in the mode of ignorance. The fruit of such action is not delayed even for a moment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे जेव्हांचि हें अपवित्र। शिवे तयाचें वक्‍्त्र। तेव्हांचि पापा पात्र। जाळा तो कीं॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: je jevhāṃci heṃ apavitra| śive tayāceṃ vak‍tra| tevhāṃci pāpā pātra| jāḻā to kīṃ|| 65||
verses.meaning: When someone's mouth utters such impure words, they instantly become deserving of sin, and indeed, they are consumed by it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यावरतें जे जेवीं। ते जेविती बोज न म्हणावी । पोटभरती जाणावी । यातना ते॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāvarateṃ je jevīṃ| te jevitī boja na mhaṇāvī | poṭabharatī jāṇāvī | yātanā te|| 66||
verses.meaning: Beyond this, whatever they eat, they eat without any burden. Know that their stomachs are filled, and that is their penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शिरच्छेदें काय होये। का आगीं रिघतां कैसें आहे। हें जाणावें काई पाहें । परी साहातुचि असे॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: śiracchedeṃ kāya hoye| kā āgīṃ righatāṃ kaiseṃ āhe| heṃ jāṇāveṃ kāī pāheṃ | parī sāhātuci ase|| 67||
verses.meaning: What is gained by beheading? Or what is it like to enter fire? Why should one know this? Yet, one endures it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तामसा अन्ना । परिणामु गा सिनाना। न सांगोंचि गा अर्जुना । देवो म्हणे ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tāmasā annā | pariṇāmu gā sinānā| na sāṃgoṃci gā arjunā | devo mhaṇe || 68||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the result of Tamasic food, Arjuna, is indeed very bad. The Lord says, "I will not even describe it."

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां ययावरी। आहाराचिया परी। यजञुही अवधारीं। त्रिधा असे॥६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yayāvarī| āhārāciyā parī| yajañuhī avadhārīṃ| tridhā ase||69||
verses.meaning: Now, listen to the three kinds of sacrifices, just as there are three kinds of food.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तिहींमाजीं प्रथम। सात्त्विक यज्ञाचें वर्म। आईक पां सुमहिम। शिरोमणी ॥ १७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī tihīṃmājīṃ prathama| sāttvika yajñāceṃ varma| āīka pāṃ sumahima| śiromaṇī || 170||
verses.meaning: Among these, first, listen, O great and glorious one, to the secret of the Sattvic sacrifice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी एकु प्रियोत्तमु-। वांचोनि वाढों नेदी कामु। जैसा का मनोधर्मु। 'पतित्रतेचा ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī eku priyottamu-| vāṃconi vāḍhoṃ nedī kāmu| jaisā kā manodharmu| 'patitratecā || 79||
verses.meaning: Just as a chaste woman's mind does not allow any desire to grow except for her beloved husband, so too, the devotee's mind should be solely focused on the divine Beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना सिंधूतें ठाकोनि गंगा । पुढारां न करीचि रिगा। कां आत्मा देखोनि उगा। वेदु ठेला ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā siṃdhūteṃ ṭhākoni gaṃgā | puḍhārāṃ na karīci rigā| kāṃ ātmā dekhoni ugā| vedu ṭhelā || 72||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganges, upon reaching the ocean, does not proceed further, so too the Vedas, having perceived the Self, become silent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जे आपुल्या स्वहितीं । वेंचूनियां चित्तवृत्ती) नुरवितीचि अहंकृती। फळालागीं ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ je āpulyā svahitīṃ | veṃcūniyāṃ cittavṛttī) nuravitīci ahaṃkṛtī| phaḻālāgīṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: Similarly, those who, for their own spiritual well-being, dedicate their mental faculties completely, do not retain any ego for the fruits of their actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पातलेया झाडाचें मूळ। मागुतें सरों नेणेंचि जळ जिरालें कां केवळ । तयाच्याचि आंगीं ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pātaleyā jhāḍāceṃ mūḻa| māguteṃ saroṃ neṇeṃci jaḻa jirāleṃ kāṃ kevaḻa | tayācyāci āṃgīṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Just as water, once it has reached the root of a tree, does not return, but is absorbed into the tree itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें मनें देहीं । यजननिश्चयाच्या ठायीं । हारपोनि जें कांहीं । बांछितीना ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ maneṃ dehīṃ | yajananiścayācyā ṭhāyīṃ | hāraponi jeṃ kāṃhīṃ | bāṃchitīnā || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the mind and body, absorbed in the certainty of worship, desire nothing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिहीं फळवांछात्यागीं। स्वधर्मावांचूनि विरागीं। कीजे जो यु सर्वांगी । अळंकृतु॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tihīṃ phaḻavāṃchātyāgīṃ| svadharmāvāṃcūni virāgīṃ| kīje jo yu sarvāṃgī | aḻaṃkṛtu|| 76||
verses.meaning: The one who renounces the desire for fruits, and is detached from everything except their own dharma, performs yoga, which adorns them completely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी आरिसा आपणपें। डोळां जैसें घेपें। कां तळहातींचें दीपें।॥ रत्न पाहिजे ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī ārisā āpaṇapeṃ| ḍoḻāṃ jaiseṃ ghepeṃ| kāṃ taḻahātīṃceṃ dīpeṃ||| ratna pāhije || 77||
verses.meaning: Just as one sees their own reflection in a mirror, or as one perceives an object with their eyes, or as one needs a lamp to see a gem held in the palm of their hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना उदितें दिवाकरें।॥ गमावा मार्ग दिठी भरे। तैसा वेदु निर्धारें। देखोनियां॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā uditeṃ divākareṃ||| gamāvā mārga diṭhī bhare| taisā vedu nirdhāreṃ| dekhoniyāṃ|| 78||
verses.meaning: Just as the path becomes visible when the sun rises, so too is the Veda seen with certainty.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियें कुंडें मंडप वेदी। आणीकही संभारसमृद्धी। ते मेळवणी जैसी विधी आपणपां केली॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyeṃ kuṃḍeṃ maṃḍapa vedī| āṇīkahī saṃbhārasamṛddhī| te meḻavaṇī jaisī vidhī āpaṇapāṃ kelī||79||
verses.meaning: The sacrificial pit, the pavilion, the altar, and all other abundant preparations—it was as if the ritual itself had gathered them for its own sake.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सकळावयवउचितें। लेणीं पातलीं जैसीं आंगातें। तैसें पदार्थ जेथिंचें तेथें । बिनियोगुनी ॥ १८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: sakaḻāvayavauciteṃ| leṇīṃ pātalīṃ jaisīṃ āṃgāteṃ| taiseṃ padārtha jethiṃceṃ tetheṃ | biniyogunī || 180||
verses.meaning: Just as ornaments, suitable for each limb, adorn the body, so too, all things are utilized in their proper places.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय वानूं बहुतीं बोली । जैसीं सर्वाभरणीं भरली । ते यज्ञविद्याचि रूपा आली । यजनमिषें ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya vānūṃ bahutīṃ bolī | jaisīṃ sarvābharaṇīṃ bharalī | te yajñavidyāci rūpā ālī | yajanamiṣeṃ || 81||
verses.meaning: What more can I describe in many words? It is as if she is adorned with all ornaments, the very science of sacrifice (Yajna-Vidya) has taken form, under the guise of the sacrifice itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सांगोपांगु। निफजे जो यागु। नुठऊनियां लागु। महत्त्वाचा ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sāṃgopāṃgu| niphaje jo yāgu| nuṭhaūniyāṃ lāgu| mahattvācā || 82||
verses.meaning: In the same way, the yoga that is accomplished completely, without initiating any attachment to importance or ego.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रतिपाळु तरी पाटाचा । झाडीं कौजे तुळसीचा। परी फळा फुला छायेचा। आश्रयो नाहीं ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pratipāḻu tarī pāṭācā | jhāḍīṃ kauje tuḻasīcā| parī phaḻā phulā chāyecā| āśrayo nāhīṃ || 83||
verses.meaning: Even if one nurtures a plant, like a tulsi in a garden, it offers no shelter of fruit, flower, or shade.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना फळाशेवीण। ऐसेया निगुती निर्माण। होय तो यागु जाण| सात्त्विक गा॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā phaḻāśevīṇa| aiseyā nigutī nirmāṇa| hoya to yāgu jāṇa| sāttvika gā||84||
verses.meaning: Indeed, a sacrifice performed without desire for fruit, with such a pure intention, know that it is sattvic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां यजञु कौर वीरेशा। करी पैं याचिऐसा । परी श्राब्धाळागीं जैसा । अवंतिला रावो॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yajañu kaura vīreśā| karī paiṃ yāciaisā | parī śrābdhāḻāgīṃ jaisā | avaṃtilā rāvo|| 85||
verses.meaning: Now, O Lord of warriors, the Yajur Veda is like this: just as a king is invited for a Shraddha ceremony.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी राजा घरासि ये। तरी बहुत उपेगा जाये। आणि कौर्तीही होये। श्राद्ध न ठके॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī rājā gharāsi ye| tarī bahuta upegā jāye| āṇi kaurtīhī hoye| śrāddha na ṭhake|| 86||
verses.meaning: Even if a king comes to one's house, it is of great benefit and brings fame, yet the Shraddha ritual should not be neglected.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा धरूनि आवांका। म्हणे स्वर्गु जोडेल असिका । दीक्षितु होईन मान्यु लोकां। घडेल यागु॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā dharūni āvāṃkā| mhaṇe svargu joḍela asikā | dīkṣitu hoīna mānyu lokāṃ| ghaḍela yāgu|| 87||
verses.meaning: Similarly, with such ambition, he thinks, "Heaven will be easily attained. I will become a respected sacrificer among people, and the sacrifice will be accomplished."

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी केवळ फळालागीं। महत्त्व फोकारावया जगीं। पार्था निष्पत्ति जे यागीं। राजस पैंते॥८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī kevaḻa phaḻālāgīṃ| mahattva phokārāvayā jagīṃ| pārthā niṣpatti je yāgīṃ| rājasa paiṃte||88||
verses.meaning: O Partha, such a sacrifice, performed solely for its fruit, to gain importance and fame in the world, is indeed considered Rajasic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि पशुपक्षिविवाहीं। जोशी कामापरौता नाहीं। तैसा तामसा यज्ञा पाहीं । आग्रहोचि मूळ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi paśupakṣivivāhīṃ| jośī kāmāparautā nāhīṃ| taisā tāmasā yajñā pāhīṃ | āgrahoci mūḻa|| 89||
verses.meaning: Just as animals and birds have no knowledge beyond their immediate needs, so too, for a Tamasic sacrifice, obstinacy is its very root.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वारया वाट न वाहे। कीं मरण मुहूर्त पाहे । निषिद्धांसि ब्िहे। आगी जरी ॥ १९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: vārayā vāṭa na vāhe| kīṃ maraṇa muhūrta pāhe | niṣiddhāṃsi bihe| āgī jarī || 190||
verses.meaning: The wind does not avoid its path, nor does death await an auspicious moment. Fire does not fear forbidden things.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तामसाचिया आचारा। विधीचा आथी वोढावारा। म्हणौनि तो धनुर्धरा। उत्सृंखळु ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tāmasāciyā ācārā| vidhīcā āthī voḍhāvārā| mhaṇauni to dhanurdharā| utsṛṃkhaḻu || 91||
verses.meaning: However, the actions of the Tamasic are bound by the injunctions of the scriptures. Therefore, O Arjuna, they are not unrestrained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाहीं विधीची तेथ चाड। नये मंत्रादिक तयाकड। अन्नजातां न सुये तोंड। मासिये जेबीं॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nāhīṃ vidhīcī tetha cāḍa| naye maṃtrādika tayākaḍa| annajātāṃ na suye toṃḍa| māsiye jebīṃ||92||
verses.meaning: There is no need for rituals there, nor do mantras approach it. It does not open its mouth to eat, just as a fish does not.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वैराचा बोधु ब्राह्मणा। तेथ कें रिगेल दक्षिणा । अग्नि जाला वाउधाणा। वरपडा जैसा॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vairācā bodhu brāhmaṇā| tetha keṃ rigela dakṣiṇā | agni jālā vāudhāṇā| varapaḍā jaisā|| 93||
verses.meaning: When a Brahmin becomes an enemy, how can an offering be made there? It is like fire becoming a destructive whirlwind, consuming everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें वायांचि सर्वस्व वेंचे। मुख न देखती श्रद्धेचें। नागविलें निपुत्रिकाचें । जैसें घर॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ vāyāṃci sarvasva veṃce| mukha na dekhatī śraddheceṃ| nāgavileṃ niputrikāceṃ | jaiseṃ ghara|| 94||
verses.meaning: Just as a childless person's house is plundered, so too is all effort wasted if it lacks faith, never seeing its face.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा जो यज्ञाभासु। तया नाम यागु तामसु। आइकें म्हणे निवासु। श्रियेचा तो ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā jo yajñābhāsu| tayā nāma yāgu tāmasu| āikeṃ mhaṇe nivāsu| śriyecā to || 95||
verses.meaning: Such a semblance of sacrifice is called Tamasic Yajna. Listen, says the abode of prosperity (Lord Krishna).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां गंगेचें एक पाणी । परी नेलें आनानीं वाहणीं। एक मळीं एक आणी । शुद्धत्व ४०८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी जैसें॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ gaṃgeceṃ eka pāṇī | parī neleṃ ānānīṃ vāhaṇīṃ| eka maḻīṃ eka āṇī | śuddhatva 408 śrījñāneśvarī jaiseṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: Just as the water of the Ganga is one, but when carried through different channels, some becomes impure and some remains pure.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तिहीं गुणीं तप। येथ जाहलें आहे त्रिरूप। तें एक केलें दे पाप। उद्धरी एक ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ tihīṃ guṇīṃ tapa| yetha jāhaleṃ āhe trirūpa| teṃ eka keleṃ de pāpa| uddharī eka || 97||
verses.meaning: Thus, the penance of the three Gunas has manifested here in three forms: one form leads to sin, while another liberates.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तेंचि तिहीं भेदीं। कैसेनि पां म्हणौनि सुबुद्धी । जाणों पाहासी तरी आधीं । तपचि जाण॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī teṃci tihīṃ bhedīṃ| kaiseni pāṃ mhaṇauni subuddhī | jāṇoṃ pāhāsī tarī ādhīṃ | tapaci jāṇa|| 98||
verses.meaning: If you, O wise one, wish to understand how that very Brahman can be perceived in these three ways, then first know that it is through penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ तप म्हणिजे काई तें स्वरूप दाऊं पाहीं । मग भेदिलें गुणीं तिहीं । तें पाठीं बोलो ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha tapa mhaṇije kāī teṃ svarūpa dāūṃ pāhīṃ | maga bhedileṃ guṇīṃ tihīṃ | teṃ pāṭhīṃ bolo || 99||
verses.meaning: Here, what is meant by penance, I shall reveal its true nature. Then, how it is divided by the three Gunas, I shall speak of that later.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तप जें कां सम्यक्‌ । तेंही त्रिविध आइक । शारीर मानसिक । शाब्द गा॥ २००॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tapa jeṃ kāṃ samyak‌ | teṃhī trividha āika | śārīra mānasika | śābda gā|| 200||
verses.meaning: Listen, the penance that is truly righteous is also of three kinds: physical, mental, and verbal.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां या तिहीं माझारीं। शारीर तंब अवधारीं। तरी शंभू कां श्रीहरी । पढियंता होय॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ yā tihīṃ mājhārīṃ| śārīra taṃba avadhārīṃ| tarī śaṃbhū kāṃ śrīharī | paḍhiyaṃtā hoya|| 1||
verses.meaning: Now, among these three, consider the physical body as a tent. Then, whether it is Shiva or Vishnu, it becomes dear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया प्रिय देवतालया । यात्रादिकें करावया। आठही पाहार जैसें पायां । उळिग घापे॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā priya devatālayā | yātrādikeṃ karāvayā| āṭhahī pāhāra jaiseṃ pāyāṃ | uḻiga ghāpe|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as one's feet are constantly engaged in pilgrimages and other services to a beloved deity, all eight watches of the day are dedicated to that divine service.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देवांगणमिरवणियां। अंगोपचार पुरवणियां। करावया म्हणियां। शोभती हात ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: devāṃgaṇamiravaṇiyāṃ| aṃgopacāra puravaṇiyāṃ| karāvayā mhaṇiyāṃ| śobhatī hāta || 3||
verses.meaning: The hands are beautiful, for they are engaged in adorning the divine courtyard and offering various services.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लिंग कां प्रतिमा दिठीं। देखतखेंबों अंगेष्टी । लोटिजे कां काठी। पडली जैसी॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: liṃga kāṃ pratimā diṭhīṃ| dekhatakheṃboṃ aṃgeṣṭī | loṭije kāṃ kāṭhī| paḍalī jaisī|| 4||
verses.meaning: Just as a stick, once fallen, is cast aside, so too is the body, upon seeing the Linga or an idol, immediately abandoned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि विधिविनयादिकीं। गुणीं वबडील जे लोकीं। तया ब्राह्मणांची निकी। पाइकी कौोजे॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi vidhivinayādikīṃ| guṇīṃ vabaḍīla je lokīṃ| tayā brāhmaṇāṃcī nikī| pāikī kauoje|| 5||
verses.meaning: And those who excel in virtues like prescribed rituals and humility, I serve those Brahmins with utmost devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा प्रवासें का पीडा। का शिणले जे सांकडां। ते जीव सुरवाडा। आणिजती ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā pravāseṃ kā pīḍā| kā śiṇale je sāṃkaḍāṃ| te jīva suravāḍā| āṇijatī || 6||
verses.meaning: Or those who are afflicted by travel, or those who are weary from difficulties, such souls are brought to comfort.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सकल तीर्थांचिये धुरे। जियें कां मातापितरें। तयां सेवेसि कीर शरीरें। लोण कौजे॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: sakala tīrthāṃciye dhure| jiyeṃ kāṃ mātāpitareṃ| tayāṃ sevesi kīra śarīreṃ| loṇa kauje||7||
verses.meaning: Parents are like the foremost of all holy places; therefore, one's body should be dedicated to their service, like an offering of salt.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि संसाराऐसा दारुणु। जो भेटलाचि हरी शीणु। तो ज्ञानदानीं सकरुणु। भजिजे गुरु॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi saṃsārāaisā dāruṇu| jo bheṭalāci harī śīṇu| to jñānadānīṃ sakaruṇu| bhajije guru||8||
verses.meaning: And the Guru, who is compassionate in bestowing knowledge, should be worshipped, for he removes the weariness of this harsh worldly existence as soon as one encounters him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि स्वधर्माचा आगिठां। देह जाड्याचिया किटा । आवृत्तिपुटीं सुभटा । झाडी कीजे॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi svadharmācā āgiṭhāṃ| deha jāḍyāciyā kiṭā | āvṛttipuṭīṃ subhaṭā | jhāḍī kīje|| 9||
verses.meaning: And with the fire of one's own Dharma, the dross of the body is burnt away. Through the repeated practice of spiritual disciplines, O brave one, this purification is achieved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वस्तु भूतमात्रीं नमिजे। परोपकारीं भजिजे। स्त्रीविषयीं नियमिजे। नांबेंनांवें॥ २१० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: vastu bhūtamātrīṃ namije| paropakārīṃ bhajije| strīviṣayīṃ niyamije| nāṃbeṃnāṃveṃ|| 210 ||
verses.meaning: One should bow down to all beings, engage in acts of benevolence, and observe restraint in matters concerning women, without any distinction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जन्मतेनि प्रसंगें। स्त्रीदेह शिवणे आंगें। तेथूनि जन्म आघवें। सोंबिळें कौजे॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: janmateni prasaṃgeṃ| strīdeha śivaṇe āṃgeṃ| tethūni janma āghaveṃ| soṃbiḻeṃ kauje|| 11||
verses.meaning: From the moment of birth, the body is touched by a woman, and from that point, the entire life becomes impure and defiled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भूतमात्राचेनि नांबें। तृणही नासुडावें। किंबहुना सांडाववे । छेद भेद॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhūtamātrāceni nāṃbeṃ| tṛṇahī nāsuḍāveṃ| kiṃbahunā sāṃḍāvave | cheda bheda|| 12||
verses.meaning: Do not even trample a blade of grass, let alone cause harm or division, in the name of any living being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसैसी जें शरीरीं । रहाटीची पडे उजरी। तै शारीर तप घुमरी। आलें जाण॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisaisī jeṃ śarīrīṃ | rahāṭīcī paḍe ujarī| tai śārīra tapa ghumarī| āleṃ jāṇa|| 13||
verses.meaning: When such a disciplined routine becomes evident in the body, know that physical penance has blossomed forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्था समस्तही हें करणें । देहाचेनि प्रधानपणें । म्हणौनि ययातें मी म्हणें । शारीर तप॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārthā samastahī heṃ karaṇeṃ | dehāceni pradhānapaṇeṃ | mhaṇauni yayāteṃ mī mhaṇeṃ | śārīra tapa|| 14||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, all these actions are performed primarily by the body. Therefore, I call this bodily penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं शारीर जें तप। तयाचें दाविलें रूप। आतां आइक निष्पाप। वाडूममय तें ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ śārīra jeṃ tapa| tayāceṃ dāvileṃ rūpa| ātāṃ āika niṣpāpa| vāḍūmamaya teṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: Thus, the nature of bodily austerity has been revealed. Now, O sinless one, listen to that which is austerity of speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी लोहाचें आंग तुक । न तोडितांचि कनक। केलें जैसें देख। परिसें तेणें ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī lohāceṃ āṃga tuka | na toḍitāṃci kanaka| keleṃ jaiseṃ dekha| pariseṃ teṇeṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: Just as a touchstone transforms iron into gold without altering its form, so too does the Guru's grace transform the disciple.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें न दुखवितां सेजे। जावळिया सुख निपजे। ऐसें साधुत्व कां देखिजे। बोलणां जिये॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ na dukhavitāṃ seje| jāvaḻiyā sukha nipaje| aiseṃ sādhutva kāṃ dekhije| bolaṇāṃ jiye|| 17||
verses.meaning: Just as without causing pain, a comfortable sleep is attained, similarly, such saintliness is seen in words that bring solace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाणी मुदल झाडा जाये। तृण तें प्रसंगॅचि जिये। तैसें एका बोलिलें होये। सर्वांहि हित॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṇī mudala jhāḍā jāye| tṛṇa teṃ prasaṃgaॅci jiye| taiseṃ ekā bolileṃ hoye| sarvāṃhi hita|| 18||
verses.meaning: Just as water reaches the root of a tree, and by that, the grass also thrives, similarly, a single word spoken (by a saint) brings benefit to all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जोडे अमृताची सुरसरी । तैं प्राणांतें अमर करी । स्नानें पाप ताप वारी। गोडीही दे॥१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: joḍe amṛtācī surasarī | taiṃ prāṇāṃteṃ amara karī | snāneṃ pāpa tāpa vārī| goḍīhī de||19||
verses.meaning: When the nectar of immortality flows, it makes the vital breath immortal. Bathing in it removes sins and sorrows, and bestows sweetness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा अविवेकुही फिटे। आपुलें अनादित्व भेटे। आइकतां रुचि न विटे। पीयुषीं जैसी ॥ २२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā avivekuhī phiṭe| āpuleṃ anāditva bheṭe| āikatāṃ ruci na viṭe| pīyuṣīṃ jaisī || 220||
verses.meaning: Similarly, ignorance also dissipates, and one encounters their own beginningless nature. Listening to this, the taste for it never diminishes, just like the taste for nectar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जरी कोणी करी पुसणें । तरी होआवें ऐसें बोलणें । नातरी आवर्तणें । निगमु का नाम ( निगमाचळीं )॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jarī koṇī karī pusaṇeṃ | tarī hoāveṃ aiseṃ bolaṇeṃ | nātarī āvartaṇeṃ | nigamu kā nāma ( nigamācaḻīṃ )|| 21||
verses.meaning: If someone asks, then the answer should be like this, otherwise, the Vedas themselves would have to repeat it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्र्ग्वेदादि तिन्ही । प्रतिष्ठीजती वाग्भुवनीं। केली जैसी बदनीं। ब्रह्मशाळा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: krgvedādi tinhī | pratiṣṭhījatī vāgbhuvanīṃ| kelī jaisī badanīṃ| brahmaśāḻā|| 22||
verses.meaning: Just as the Rigveda and the other two Vedas are established in the realm of speech, so too is the school of Brahman established in the mouth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी एकाधें नांव। तेंचि शैव कां वैष्णव । वाचे वसे तें वाग्भव। तप जाणावें॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī ekādheṃ nāṃva| teṃci śaiva kāṃ vaiṣṇava | vāce vase teṃ vāgbhava| tapa jāṇāveṃ|| 23||
verses.meaning: Or, if a single name, be it of Shiva or Vishnu, resides on the tongue, know that to be the penance of speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तप जें मानसिक तेंहीं सांगों आइक । म्हणे 'लोकनाथनायक-। नायकु तो॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ tapa jeṃ mānasika teṃhīṃ sāṃgoṃ āika | mhaṇe 'lokanāthanāyaka-| nāyaku to|| 24||
verses.meaning: Now, listen to what the Lord of the Universe, the Master of all masters, says about mental penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सरोवर तरंगीं। सांडिलें आकाश मेघीं। कां चंदनाचें उरगीं। उद्यान जैसें॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sarovara taraṃgīṃ| sāṃḍileṃ ākāśa meghīṃ| kāṃ caṃdanāceṃ uragīṃ| udyāna jaiseṃ|| 25||
verses.meaning: Just as a lake is abandoned by its waves, the sky by its clouds, or a sandalwood forest by its snakes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना कळावैषगम्यें चंद्र। कां सांडिला आधीं नरेंद्र नातरी क्षीरसमुद्रु। मंदराचळें ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā kaḻāvaiṣagamyeṃ caṃdra| kāṃ sāṃḍilā ādhīṃ nareṃdra nātarī kṣīrasamudru| maṃdarācaḻeṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon, with its various phases, is not abandoned by the king, nor is the ocean abandoned by the Mandara mountain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं नाना विकल्पजाळें । सांडूनि गेलिया सकळें॥ मन राहे कां केवळें। स्वरूपें जें॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ nānā vikalpajāḻeṃ | sāṃḍūni geliyā sakaḻeṃ|| mana rāhe kāṃ kevaḻeṃ| svarūpeṃ jeṃ|| 27||
verses.meaning: When all the various nets of doubt and delusion are cast aside, the mind then rests purely in its true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तपनेंबीण प्रकाशु । जाड्येंबीण रसीं रसु। पोकळीवीण अवकाशु। होय जैसा॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tapaneṃbīṇa prakāśu | jāḍyeṃbīṇa rasīṃ rasu| pokaḻīvīṇa avakāśu| hoya jaisā|| 28||
verses.meaning: Just as there is light without heat, taste in juice without dullness, and space without emptiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी आपली सोय देखे । आणि आपलिया स्वभावा मुके । हिंबली जैसी आंगिकें । हिवों नेदी निजांग॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī āpalī soya dekhe | āṇi āpaliyā svabhāvā muke | hiṃbalī jaisī āṃgikeṃ | hivoṃ nedī nijāṃga|| 29||
verses.meaning: Just as a person, seeing their own convenience, loses their true nature, like a blanket that, being part of the body, does not allow the body to shiver.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न चलतें कळंकेंबीण। शशिबिंब जैसें परिपूर्ण । तैसें चोखी शृंगारपण। मनाचें जें॥ २३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: na calateṃ kaḻaṃkeṃbīṇa| śaśibiṃba jaiseṃ paripūrṇa | taiseṃ cokhī śṛṃgārapaṇa| manāceṃ jeṃ|| 230||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon's orb, though full, moves without blemish, so too is the pure adornment of the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुजाली वैराग्याची बोरप। जिराळी मनाची धांपकांप। तेथ केवळ जाली वाफ। निजबोधाची ॥ ३९१ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: bujālī vairāgyācī borapa| jirāḻī manācī dhāṃpakāṃpa| tetha kevaḻa jālī vāpha| nijabodhācī || 391 ||
verses.meaning: The fear and trembling of the mind, which is like a thicket of worldly attachments, has been completely extinguished by the fire of detachment. There, only the pure vapor of self-realization remains.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विचारावया शास्त्र । राहाटवावें जें वक्‍्त्र। तें वाचेचेंही सूत्र । हातीं न धरी॥३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vicārāvayā śāstra | rāhāṭavāveṃ jeṃ vak‍tra| teṃ vāceceṃhī sūtra | hātīṃ na dharī||32||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the mouth that is to be engaged in deliberating upon the scriptures, does not even hold the thread of that speech in its hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें स्वलळाभ लाभलेपणें । मन मनपणाही धरूं नेणे । शिवतलें जैसें लवणें। आपुलें निज॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ svalaḻābha lābhalepaṇeṃ | mana manapaṇāhī dharūṃ neṇe | śivataleṃ jaiseṃ lavaṇeṃ| āpuleṃ nija|| 33||
verses.meaning: When one attains the bliss of the Self, the mind loses its mental faculty, just as salt dissolves into the ocean, becoming one with its true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ कें उठिती ते भाव । जिहीं इंद्रियमार्गी धांब। घेऊनि ठाकावे गांव । विषयांचे ते॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha keṃ uṭhitī te bhāva | jihīṃ iṃdriyamārgī dhāṃba| gheūni ṭhākāve gāṃva | viṣayāṃce te|| 34||
verses.meaning: How then can those emotions arise there, which, through the path of the senses, would rush to the village of worldly pleasures?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तियें मानसीं । ४९० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी भावशुव्द्रिचि असे अपैसी । रोमशुचि जैसी । तळहातासी॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tiyeṃ mānasīṃ | 490 śrījñāneśvarī bhāvaśuvdrici ase apaisī | romaśuci jaisī | taḻahātāsī|| 35||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in that mind, the purity of devotion to Shri Dnyaneshwari arises spontaneously, just as hair naturally grows on the palm of the hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय बहु बोलो अर्जुना । जैं हे दशा ये मना । तैं मनोतपाभिधाना । पात्र होय ती॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya bahu bolo arjunā | jaiṃ he daśā ye manā | taiṃ manotapābhidhānā | pātra hoya tī|| 36||
verses.meaning: What more can I say, Arjuna? When this state comes to the mind, then it becomes worthy of the name 'mental penance'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तें असो हें जाण। मानस तपाचें लक्षण। देवो म्हणे संपूर्ण । सांगितलें॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teṃ aso heṃ jāṇa| mānasa tapāceṃ lakṣaṇa| devo mhaṇe saṃpūrṇa | sāṃgitaleṃ|| 37||
verses.meaning: But let that be. Know this: I have fully explained the characteristics of mental austerity, said the Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं देहवाचाचित्तें। जें पातलें त्रिविधत्वातें। तें सामान्य तप तूंतें। परिसविलें गा॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ dehavācācitteṃ| jeṃ pātaleṃ trividhatvāteṃ| teṃ sāmānya tapa tūṃteṃ| parisavileṃ gā|| 38||
verses.meaning: Thus, the threefold penance, which is attained through the body, speech, and mind, has been explained to you as common penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां गुणत्रयसंगें। हेंचि विशेषीं त्रिविधीं रिगे। तेंही आइक चांगें। प्रज्ञाबळें ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ guṇatrayasaṃgeṃ| heṃci viśeṣīṃ trividhīṃ rige| teṃhī āika cāṃgeṃ| prajñābaḻeṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Now, due to the association with the three Gunas, this very thing enters into three distinct forms. Listen to that well, with the strength of your intellect.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी हेंचि तप त्रिविधा। जें दाविलें तुज प्रबुद्धा । तेंचि करीं पूर्ण श्रद्धा । सांडूनि फळ॥ २४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī heṃci tapa trividhā| jeṃ dāvileṃ tuja prabuddhā | teṃci karīṃ pūrṇa śraddhā | sāṃḍūni phaḻa|| 240||
verses.meaning: Therefore, this very threefold austerity, which I have revealed to you, O enlightened one, perform it with complete faith, renouncing the fruits of your actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें पुरतिया सत्त्वशुद्धी। आचरिजे आस्तिक्यबुद्धी। तैं तयातेंचि गा प्रबुद्धीं। सात्त्विक म्हणिपे॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ puratiyā sattvaśuddhī| ācarije āstikyabuddhī| taiṃ tayāteṃci gā prabuddhīṃ| sāttvika mhaṇipe|| 41||
verses.meaning: When actions are performed with complete purity of being and with a mind rooted in faith, then such actions are called 'sattvic' by the wise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी तपस्थापनेलागीं। दुजेपण मांडूनि जगीं। महत्त्वाच्या शंगीं। बैसावया॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī tapasthāpanelāgīṃ| dujepaṇa māṃḍūni jagīṃ| mahattvācyā śaṃgīṃ| baisāvayā|| 42||
verses.meaning: Or, to establish one's penance, setting up a duality in the world, to sit on the horns of importance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्रिभुवनींचिया सन्माना। न वचावें ठाया आना । धुरेचिया आसना । भोजनालागीं॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tribhuvanīṃciyā sanmānā| na vacāveṃ ṭhāyā ānā | dhureciyā āsanā | bhojanālāgīṃ|| 43||
verses.meaning: One should not go to another place for food, even if it means receiving honor from all three worlds, for that is like abandoning one's rightful seat of authority.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विश्‍वाचिया स्तोत्रा। आपण होआवया पात्रा । विश्‍वें आपल्या यात्रा। कराविया यावें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: viś‍vāciyā stotrā| āpaṇa hoāvayā pātrā | viś‍veṃ āpalyā yātrā| karāviyā yāveṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: To become worthy of the universe's praise, and for the universe to undertake its pilgrimages through oneself, one must come.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लोकांचिया विविधा पूजा। आश्रयो न धराबया दुजा । भोग भोगावे वोजा । महत्त्वाचिया ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: lokāṃciyā vividhā pūjā| āśrayo na dharābayā dujā | bhoga bhogāve vojā | mahattvāciyā || 45 ||
verses.meaning: One should not seek refuge in various worships of people. One should experience the fruits of one's own actions, which are of great importance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अंग बोल माखूनि तपें। विकावया आपणपें । अंगहीन पडपे । जियापरी ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aṃga bola mākhūni tapeṃ| vikāvayā āpaṇapeṃ | aṃgahīna paḍape | jiyāparī || 46||
verses.meaning: Just as a person, having smeared their body with ashes and performed austerities, sells themselves, becoming devoid of their own body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो धनमानीं आस। वाढउनी तप कौजे सायास । तैं तेंचि तप राजस। बोलिजे गा॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso dhanamānīṃ āsa| vāḍhaunī tapa kauje sāyāsa | taiṃ teṃci tapa rājasa| bolije gā|| 47||
verses.meaning: Let this be. If, with the desire for wealth and honor, one undertakes arduous penance, then that very penance is called Rajasic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी पहुरणीं जें दुहिलें। तैं तें गुरू न दुभेचि व्यालें। का उभें शेत चारिलें। पिकावया नुरे॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī pahuraṇīṃ jeṃ duhileṃ| taiṃ teṃ gurū na dubheci vyāleṃ| kā ubheṃ śeta cārileṃ| pikāvayā nure|| 48||
verses.meaning: If a cow is milked before it has calved, it will not yield milk when it does calve. Similarly, if a standing crop is grazed, nothing will remain to ripen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें फोकारितां तप। कीजे जें साक्षेप। तें फळीं तंव सोप। नि:शेष जाय॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ phokāritāṃ tapa| kīje jeṃ sākṣepa| teṃ phaḻīṃ taṃva sopa| ni:śeṣa jāya|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as a penance performed with great effort, when its fruit is obtained, completely vanishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें निर्फळ देखोनि करितां । माझारीं सांडी पंडुसुता । म्हणौनि नाहीं स्थिरता । तपा तया ॥ २५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ nirphaḻa dekhoni karitāṃ | mājhārīṃ sāṃḍī paṃḍusutā | mhaṇauni nāhīṃ sthiratā | tapā tayā || 250||
verses.meaning: Seeing such penance as fruitless, O son of Pandu, one abandons it midway. Therefore, there is no steadfastness in that penance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं तरी आकाश मांडी । जो गर्जोनि ब्रह्मांड फोडी। तो अवकाळु मेघु काय घडी । राहत आहे॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ tarī ākāśa māṃḍī | jo garjoni brahmāṃḍa phoḍī| to avakāḻu meghu kāya ghaḍī | rāhata āhe|| 51||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, the sky would have already been torn apart. The cloud that roars and shatters the universe, how long can it remain?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें राजस तप जें होये। तें फळीं कौर वांझ जाये। परी आचरणींही नोहे। निर्वाहतें गा ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ rājasa tapa jeṃ hoye| teṃ phaḻīṃ kaura vāṃjha jāye| parī ācaraṇīṃhī nohe| nirvāhateṃ gā || 52||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the penance that is Rajasic, though it may bear fruit, that fruit is barren. But even in its practice, it does not lead to true fulfillment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तेंचि तप पुढती । तामसाचिया रीती। पैं परत्रा आणि कौर्ती। मुकोनि कीजे॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ teṃci tapa puḍhatī | tāmasāciyā rītī| paiṃ paratrā āṇi kaurtī| mukoni kīje|| 53||
verses.meaning: Now, that very penance, when performed again in the mode of ignorance (Tamas), is done with the intention of gaining respect and fame in the afterlife, thereby missing the true spiritual benefit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: केवळ मूर्खपणाचा वारा। जीवीं घेऊनि धनुर्धरा। नाम ठेविजे शरीरा । बैरियाचें ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kevaḻa mūrkhapaṇācā vārā| jīvīṃ gheūni dhanurdharā| nāma ṭhevije śarīrā | bairiyāceṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, it is sheer foolishness to harbor the wind of ignorance within oneself and then name one's own body as an enemy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पंचाग्नीची दडगी ( हडगी )। खोलबीजती शरीरालागीं। कां इंधन कोजे हें आगी-। आंतु लावी॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paṃcāgnīcī daḍagī ( haḍagī )| kholabījatī śarīrālāgīṃ| kāṃ iṃdhana koje heṃ āgī-| āṃtu lāvī|| 55||
verses.meaning: Or, like a fire that is kindled within a heap of fuel, so too does the fire of the five senses burn the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माथां जाळिजती गुगुळु । पाठीं घालिजती गळु। आंग जाळिती इंगळु। जळतभीतां ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: māthāṃ jāḻijatī guguḻu | pāṭhīṃ ghālijatī gaḻu| āṃga jāḻitī iṃgaḻu| jaḻatabhītāṃ || 56||
verses.meaning: They burn frankincense on their heads, put hooks in their backs, and burn their bodies with embers, fearing the burning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दवडोनि शइवासोच्छ्वास। कोजती वायांचि उपवास । कां घेपती धूमाचे घांस । अधोमुखें ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: davaḍoni śaivāsocchvāsa| kojatī vāyāṃci upavāsa | kāṃ ghepatī dhūmāce ghāṃsa | adhomukheṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: They waste their breath and fast in vain, or inhale smoke with their heads bowed down.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हिमोदकें आकंठें। खडकें सेविजती तटें । जितया मांसाचे चिमुटे। तोडिती जेथ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: himodakeṃ ākaṃṭheṃ| khaḍakeṃ sevijatī taṭeṃ | jitayā māṃsāce cimuṭe| toḍitī jetha|| 58||
