verses.meaning: Where the banks are consumed by the icy waters up to their necks, and where chunks of living flesh are torn away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी नानापरी हे काया। घाय सूरत्तां पैं धनंजया । तप कौजे नाशावया। पुढिलातें॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī nānāparī he kāyā| ghāya sūrattāṃ paiṃ dhanaṃjayā | tapa kauje nāśāvayā| puḍhilāteṃ|| 59||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, this body is of various kinds, and it is meant to be destroyed for the sake of penance, for the future.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंगभारें सुटला धोंडा । आपण फुटोनि होय खंडखंडा। कां आड जालियातें रगडा। करी जैसा॥ २६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃgabhāreṃ suṭalā dhoṃḍā | āpaṇa phuṭoni hoya khaṃḍakhaṃḍā| kāṃ āḍa jāliyāteṃ ragaḍā| karī jaisā|| 260||
verses.meaning: Like a stone that, having been hurled with force, shatters itself into pieces, or like a stone that crushes whatever comes in its way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं आपल्या आटणिया। सुखें असतया प्राणिया। जिणावया शिराणिया। कीजती गा॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ āpalyā āṭaṇiyā| sukheṃ asatayā prāṇiyā| jiṇāvayā śirāṇiyā| kījatī gā|| 61||
verses.meaning: Similarly, for the sake of those beings who are naturally content in their own being, these scriptures are created for their spiritual victory.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना हे बोखटी । घेऊनि क्लेशाची हातवटी। तप निफजे तें किरीटी। तामस होय ॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā he bokhaṭī | gheūni kleśācī hātavaṭī| tapa niphaje teṃ kirīṭī| tāmasa hoya ||62||
verses.meaning: In fact, O Kiriti, that penance which is performed with the intention of causing harm and suffering is considered to be of a Tamasic nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं सत्त्वादिकांच्या आंगीं । पडिलें तप तिहीं भागीं। जालें तेंही तुज चांगी । दाविलें व्यक्‍ती ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ sattvādikāṃcyā āṃgīṃ | paḍileṃ tapa tihīṃ bhāgīṃ| jāleṃ teṃhī tuja cāṃgī | dāvileṃ vyak‍tī || 63||
verses.meaning: Thus, the penance performed by those endowed with the qualities of Sattva and others, divided into three parts, has also been clearly explained to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां बोलतां प्रसंगा । आलें म्हणौनि पैं गा। करूं रूप दानलिंगा। त्रिविधा तया ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ bolatāṃ prasaṃgā | āleṃ mhaṇauni paiṃ gā| karūṃ rūpa dānaliṃgā| trividhā tayā || 64||
verses.meaning: Now, as the occasion has arisen, I shall describe the three types of the Linga, which is the form of the divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ गुणाचेनि बोलें। दानही त्रिविध असे जालें। तेंचि आइक पहिलें। सात्त्विक ऐसें ॥६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha guṇāceni boleṃ| dānahī trividha ase jāleṃ| teṃci āika pahileṃ| sāttvika aiseṃ ||65||
verses.meaning: Here, by the mention of qualities, even charity has become threefold. Listen first to that which is called Sattvic.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी स्वधर्माआंतौतें। जें जें मिळेल आपणयातें। तें तें दीजे बहुतें। सन्मानयोगें ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī svadharmāāṃtauteṃ| jeṃ jeṃ miḻela āpaṇayāteṃ| teṃ teṃ dīje bahuteṃ| sanmānayogeṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever comes to you through your own dharma, offer it with great reverence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जाल्या सुबीजप्रसंगु। पडे क्षेत्रवाफेचा पांगु। तैसाचि दानाचा हा लागु। देखतसें ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jālyā subījaprasaṃgu| paḍe kṣetravāphecā pāṃgu| taisāci dānācā hā lāgu| dekhataseṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: Just as a seed, when sown in fertile soil, sprouts and grows, so too does the act of giving bear fruit, as I perceive it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अनर्ध्य रत्न हातां चढे। तैं भांगाराची बोढी पडे। दोनी जालीं तरी न जोडे । लेतें आंग॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: anardhya ratna hātāṃ caḍhe| taiṃ bhāṃgārācī boḍhī paḍe| donī jālīṃ tarī na joḍe | leteṃ āṃga|| 68||
verses.meaning: When an invaluable gem comes into hand, it is set in gold. Even if both are obtained, they do not adorn the body by themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी सण सुहृद संपत्ती । हे तिन्ही येकीं मिळती । जैं भाग्य धरी उन्नती । आपुल्याविषयीं ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī saṇa suhṛda saṃpattī | he tinhī yekīṃ miḻatī | jaiṃ bhāgya dharī unnatī | āpulyāviṣayīṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: However, when good fortune elevates itself in one's regard, then these three—a festival, a good friend, and wealth—all come together in one place.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें निफजावया दान। जें सत्त्वासि ये संवाहन। तैं देश काळ भाजन। द्रव्यही मिळे॥ २७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ niphajāvayā dāna| jeṃ sattvāsi ye saṃvāhana| taiṃ deśa kāḻa bhājana| dravyahī miḻe|| 270||
verses.meaning: Similarly, for a charitable act to be performed, when it is aligned with sattva (purity/goodness), then the right place, time, recipient, and resources all come together.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आधीं तंव प्रयत्नेंसीं। होआवें कुरुक्षेत्र का काशी । नातरी तुके जो इहींसीं। तो देशुही हो ॥७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ādhīṃ taṃva prayatneṃsīṃ| hoāveṃ kurukṣetra kā kāśī | nātarī tuke jo ihīṃsīṃ| to deśuhī ho ||71||
verses.meaning: Therefore, first and foremost, with great effort, one should strive to make their inner being like Kurukshetra or Kashi. Or, if one cannot achieve this, then at least the place where one resides should be made sacred like these holy sites.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ रविचंद्रराहुमेळु । ४९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी होतां पाहे पुण्यकाळु। कां तयासारिखा निर्मळु। आनुही जाला ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha ravicaṃdrarāhumeḻu | 492 śrījñāneśvarī hotāṃ pāhe puṇyakāḻu| kāṃ tayāsārikhā nirmaḻu| ānuhī jālā || 72||
verses.meaning: There, the conjunction of the sun, moon, and Rahu, 492, O Dnyaneshwari, behold, a sacred time has arrived. Or, has another, as pure as that, also come to be?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैशा काळीं तिये देशीं। होआवी पात्र संपत्ती ऐसी । मूर्ति आहे धरिली जैसी । शुचित्वेंचि कां॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiśā kāḻīṃ tiye deśīṃ| hoāvī pātra saṃpattī aisī | mūrti āhe dharilī jaisī | śucitveṃci kāṃ|| 73||
verses.meaning: Just as in that era, in that land, there should be such worthy wealth, as if the idol itself has been held in purity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आचाराचें मूळपीठ । वेदांची उतारपेठ । तैसें द्विजरत्न चोखट । पावोनियां ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ācārāceṃ mūḻapīṭha | vedāṃcī utārapeṭha | taiseṃ dvijaratna cokhaṭa | pāvoniyāṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Just as the Vedas are the marketplace where the principles of conduct are established, so too does a pure Brahmin, like a precious gem, attain that sacred knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तयाच्या ठाई वित्ता । निवर्तवाबी स्वसत्ता । परी प्रियापुढें कांता। रिगे जैसी ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayācyā ṭhāī vittā | nivartavābī svasattā | parī priyāpuḍheṃ kāṃtā| rige jaisī || 75||
verses.meaning: Then, in that state, wealth, or rather, one's own power, ceases to exist, just as a beloved woman enters before her lover.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जयाचें ठेविलें तया। देऊनि होईजे उतराइया। नाना हडपें विडा राया। दिधला जैसा॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jayāceṃ ṭhevileṃ tayā| deūni hoīje utarāiyā| nānā haḍapeṃ viḍā rāyā| didhalā jaisā|| 76||
verses.meaning: Just as one becomes free from debt by returning what was entrusted to them, or like a betel leaf offering given to a king by his attendant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेैसेनि निष्कामें जीवें। भूम्यादिक अर्पाबें। किंबहुना हांवे। नेदावें उठो ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teaiseni niṣkāmeṃ jīveṃ| bhūmyādika arpābeṃ| kiṃbahunā hāṃve| nedāveṃ uṭho || 77||
verses.meaning: In the same way, with a selfless heart, one should offer the earth and other elements, and indeed, one should not allow any desire to arise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि दान जया द्यावें। तयातें ऐसेया पाहावें) जया घेतलें नुमचवे। 'कायसेंनही ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi dāna jayā dyāveṃ| tayāteṃ aiseyā pāhāveṃ) jayā ghetaleṃ numacave| 'kāyaseṃnahī || 78 ||
verses.meaning: And to whom a gift is to be given, one should look upon them in such a way that they cannot repay what they have received, in any manner whatsoever.

verses.shloka_devanagari: साद घातलिया आकाशा । नेदी प्रतिशब्दु जैसा । कां पाहिला आरसा । येरीकडे ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāda ghātaliyā ākāśā | nedī pratiśabdu jaisā | kāṃ pāhilā ārasā | yerīkaḍe || 79||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky does not echo back a call, or a mirror does not reflect on the other side.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी उदकाचिये भूमिके । आफळिलेनि कंदुकें। उधळौनि कवतिकें। न येईजे हाता॥ २८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī udakāciye bhūmike | āphaḻileni kaṃdukeṃ| udhaḻauni kavatikeṃ| na yeīje hātā|| 280||
verses.meaning: Just as a ball, when thrown forcefully into water, bounces back playfully and cannot be held, so too is the nature of the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना वसो घातला चारू । माथां तुरंबिला बुरू। न करी प्रत्युपकारू । जियापरी॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā vaso ghātalā cārū | māthāṃ turaṃbilā burū| na karī pratyupakārū | jiyāparī|| 89||
verses.meaning: Just as a tree, though adorned with various beautiful flowers and its head crowned with a cluster of blossoms, does not offer any return for these adornments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें दिधलें दातयाचें। जो कोणेही आंगें नुमचे। अर्पिलया साम्य तयाचें । कौजे पै गा॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ didhaleṃ dātayāceṃ| jo koṇehī āṃgeṃ numace| arpilayā sāmya tayāceṃ | kauje pai gā||82||
verses.meaning: Just as a gift given by a generous donor, which cannot be repaid in any way, becomes one with the recipient when offered, so too is the offering to the divine.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया जें सामग्रिया। दान निफजे वीरराया। तें सात्त्विक दानवर्या। सर्वाही जाण ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā jeṃ sāmagriyā| dāna niphaje vīrarāyā| teṃ sāttvika dānavaryā| sarvāhī jāṇa || 83||
verses.meaning: Oh great warrior, know that such a donation, performed with such materials, is considered the best of all donations, being sattvic (pure and virtuous).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तोचि देशु काळु । घडे तैसाचि पात्रमेळु। दानभागुही निर्मळु। न्यायगतु॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi toci deśu kāḻu | ghaḍe taisāci pātrameḻu| dānabhāguhī nirmaḻu| nyāyagatu|| 84||
verses.meaning: And that very place and time, the gathering of worthy recipients, and the pure portion of the offering, all come together righteously.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी मनीं धरूनि दुभतें। चारिजे जेवीं गाईतें। का पेंब करूनि आइतें। पेरू जाइजे ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī manīṃ dharūni dubhateṃ| cārije jevīṃ gāīteṃ| kā peṃba karūni āiteṃ| perū jāije || 85 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a cow is fed with milk in mind, or a pear is grafted onto a ready stock.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना दिठी घाळूनि आहेरा । अवंतु जाइजे सोचिरा। वाण धाडिजे घरा । बोबसीयाचे ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā diṭhī ghāḻūni āherā | avaṃtu jāije socirā| vāṇa dhāḍije gharā | bobasīyāce || 86||
verses.meaning: With various glances, one should go to the in-laws' house, and gifts should be sent to the house of the dumb.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं कळांतर गांठीं बांधिजे। मग पुढिलांचें काज कीजे। पूजा घेऊनि रसु दीजे। पीडितांसी ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kaḻāṃtara gāṃṭhīṃ bāṃdhije| maga puḍhilāṃceṃ kāja kīje| pūjā gheūni rasu dīje| pīḍitāṃsī || 87||
verses.meaning: First, one should gather the necessary resources, then attend to the needs of others. After accepting their worship, one should provide comfort to the distressed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जया जें दान देणें। तो तेणेंचि गा जीवनें। पुढती भुंजावा भावें येणें । दीजे जें का॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jayā jeṃ dāna deṇeṃ| to teṇeṃci gā jīvaneṃ| puḍhatī bhuṃjāvā bhāveṃ yeṇeṃ | dīje jeṃ kā|| 88||
verses.meaning: Whatever one gives as a donation, one should enjoy the fruits of that giving in this life and the next, with the same devotion with which it was given.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा कोणी वाटे जातां। घेतलें उमचों न शकतां। मिळे जें पंडुसुता । ह्विजोत्तमु ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā koṇī vāṭe jātāṃ| ghetaleṃ umacoṃ na śakatāṃ| miḻe jeṃ paṃḍusutā | hvijottamu || 89||
verses.meaning: Or, if someone, while walking on the path, unknowingly takes something, whatever he receives, O son of Pandu, is a Brahmin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी कवड्या एकासाठीं । अशेषां गोत्रांचींच किरीटी । सर्व प्रायश्‍चित्ते सुयें मुठीं।॥ तयाचिये॥ २९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kavaḍyā ekāsāṭhīṃ | aśeṣāṃ gotrāṃcīṃca kirīṭī | sarva prāyaś‍citte suyeṃ muṭhīṃ||| tayāciye|| 290||
verses.meaning: Even for a single cowrie, all the sins of entire lineages, all the penances, are held in his fist.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि पारलौकिकें। फळें वांछिजती अनेकें । आणि दीजे तरी भुके । येकाही नोहे॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci pāralaukikeṃ| phaḻeṃ vāṃchijatī anekeṃ | āṇi dīje tarī bhuke | yekāhī nohe|| 91||
verses.meaning: Similarly, many fruits of the other world are desired, but even if given, not one satisfies the hunger.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंही ब्राह्मणु नेवों सरे। कीं हाणिचेनि शिणें झांसुरे। सर्वस्व जैसें चोरें। नागऊनि नेळें॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃhī brāhmaṇu nevoṃ sare| kīṃ hāṇiceni śiṇeṃ jhāṃsure| sarvasva jaiseṃ coreṃ| nāgaūni neḻeṃ||92||
verses.meaning: Even a Brahmin, when robbed of everything by a thief, becomes weary and distressed, just as if he were stripped bare and left with nothing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बहु काय सांगों सुमती। जें दीजे या मनोवृत्ती। तें दान गा त्रिजगतीं। राजस पैं॥९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: bahu kāya sāṃgoṃ sumatī| jeṃ dīje yā manovṛttī| teṃ dāna gā trijagatīṃ| rājasa paiṃ||93||
verses.meaning: What more can I tell you, O wise one? Whatever is given with such a mindset, that indeed is known as Rajasic charity in all three worlds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्लेंच्छांचे वसौटे। दांगाणे हन कैकटे। कां शिबिरें चोहटे । नगरींचे ते॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mleṃcchāṃce vasauṭe| dāṃgāṇe hana kaikaṭe| kāṃ śibireṃ cohaṭe | nagarīṃce te|| 94||
verses.meaning: Then, the settlements of the Mlecchas, their camps, or their cities, would be destroyed and scattered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेही ठाई मिळणी । समयो सांजवेळु कां रजनी । तेव्हां उदार होणें धनीं। चोरियेच्या ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tehī ṭhāī miḻaṇī | samayo sāṃjaveḻu kāṃ rajanī | tevhāṃ udāra hoṇeṃ dhanīṃ| coriyecyā || 95||
verses.meaning: At such a place, at dusk or night, the master becomes generous with his stolen goods.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पात्रें भाट नागारी । सामान्य स्त्रिया का जुवारी। जियें मूर्तिमंतें भुररीं। भुळे तयां ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pātreṃ bhāṭa nāgārī | sāmānya striyā kā juvārī| jiyeṃ mūrtimaṃteṃ bhurarīṃ| bhuḻe tayāṃ || 96||
verses.meaning: Whether they are actors, singers, or ordinary women, or even gamblers, those who are foolish are easily deceived by their captivating forms.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रूपानृत्याची पुरवणी । ते पुढां डोळेभारणी । गीतभाटीव तो श्रवणीं। कर्णजपु॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: rūpānṛtyācī puravaṇī | te puḍhāṃ ḍoḻebhāraṇī | gītabhāṭīva to śravaṇīṃ| karṇajapu|| 97||
verses.meaning: The dance of His form is a feast for the eyes, and the song of His glory is a mantra for the ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाहीवरी अळुमाळु । जैं घे फुलागंधाचा गुगुळु। तंव भ्रमाचा तो वेताळु। अवतरे तैसा॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāhīvarī aḻumāḻu | jaiṃ ghe phulāgaṃdhācā guguḻu| taṃva bhramācā to vetāḻu| avatare taisā|| 98||
verses.meaning: Even then, if a little bit of the fragrance of flowers is perceived, then the demon of illusion descends, as it were.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ विभांडूनियां जग। आणिले पदार्थ अनेग। तेणें घाळुं लागे मातंग । गवादी जैसी ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha vibhāṃḍūniyāṃ jaga| āṇile padārtha anega| teṇeṃ ghāḻuṃ lāge mātaṃga | gavādī jaisī || 99||
verses.meaning: There, having divided the world, many things were brought forth. With these, the elephant-driver began to throw, just like a wild elephant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं ऐसेनि जें देणें। तें तामसदान मी म्हणें । आणि घडे दैवगुणें। आणिकही ऐक॥ ३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ aiseni jeṃ deṇeṃ| teṃ tāmasadāna mī mhaṇeṃ | āṇi ghaḍe daivaguṇeṃ| āṇikahī aika|| 300||
verses.meaning: Thus, such a gift, I call it a Tamasic donation. And if it happens by chance, listen to more.

verses.shloka_devanagari: विपायें घुणाक्षर पडे। टाळिये काउळा सांपडे । तैसें तामसां पर्व जोडे । पुण्यदेशीं ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: vipāyeṃ ghuṇākṣara paḍe| ṭāḻiye kāuḻā sāṃpaḍe | taiseṃ tāmasāṃ parva joḍe | puṇyadeśīṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: Just as a worm-eaten letter might accidentally appear, or a crow might accidentally get caught in a trap, so too do the ignorant and deluded (tamasic) sometimes stumble upon a virtuous land or opportunity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ देखोनि तो आथिला । योग्यु मागोंही आला । तोही दर्पा चढला । भांबावे जरी॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha dekhoni to āthilā | yogyu māgoṃhī ālā | tohī darpā caḍhalā | bhāṃbāve jarī|| 2||
verses.meaning: Seeing him there, the deserving seeker, who had come to ask for it, was also filled with pride and became bewildered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी श्रद्धा न धरी जीवीं। तया माथाही न खालवी। स्वयें न करी ना करवी । अर्ध्यादिक॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī śraddhā na dharī jīvīṃ| tayā māthāhī na khālavī| svayeṃ na karī nā karavī | ardhyādika|| 3||
verses.meaning: Yet, if one does not hold faith in their heart, they will not bow their head, nor will they perform or cause to be performed any spiritual acts, even the simplest ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आल्या न घाली बैसो। तेथ गंधाक्षतांचा काय अतिसो। हा अप्रसंगु कोर असो। तामसीं नरीं॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ālyā na ghālī baiso| tetha gaṃdhākṣatāṃcā kāya atiso| hā aprasaṃgu kora aso| tāmasīṃ narīṃ|| 4||
verses.meaning: If one does not even allow a guest to sit, what is the point of offering fragrant powders and unbroken rice? This impropriety is inherent in a person of Tamasic nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं बोळविजे रिणाइतु। तैसा झकवी तयाचा हातु । तूं करणें याचा बहुतु । प्रयोगु तेथ ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ boḻavije riṇāitu| taisā jhakavī tayācā hātu | tūṃ karaṇeṃ yācā bahutu | prayogu tetha || 5||
verses.meaning: Just as a debtor is sent away, so too is his hand deceived. You must employ many such methods there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि जया जें दे किरीटी। तयातें उमाणी तयासाठी । मग कुबोलें कां लोटी । अवज्ञेच्या ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jayā jeṃ de kirīṭī| tayāteṃ umāṇī tayāsāṭhī | maga kuboleṃ kāṃ loṭī | avajñecyā || 6||
verses.meaning: And whatever He gives to Arjuna, He gives it for his sake. Why then would He reject him with harsh words of disdain?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बहु असो यापरी । मोल वेंचणें जें अबधारीं। तया नांव चराचरीं। तामस दान॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ bahu aso yāparī | mola veṃcaṇeṃ jeṃ abadhārīṃ| tayā nāṃva carācarīṃ| tāmasa dāna|| 7||
verses.meaning: Let alone this much; but that which is given with a heavy heart, with a sense of burden, that is called Tamasic charity in this world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें आपुलाला चिन्हीं । अळंकृतें तिन्ही । दानें दाविली अभिधानीं। रजतमाचिया॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ āpulālā cinhīṃ | aḻaṃkṛteṃ tinhī | dāneṃ dāvilī abhidhānīṃ| rajatamāciyā|| 8||
verses.meaning: Thus, by their own distinct characteristics, the three types of charity, associated with Rajas and Tamas, have been described.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ मी जाणत असें। विपायें तूं गा ऐसें। कल्पिसील मानसें। विचक्षणा॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha mī jāṇata aseṃ| vipāyeṃ tūṃ gā aiseṃ| kalpisīla mānaseṃ| vicakṣaṇā|| 9||
verses.meaning: I know that you might, by chance, think this way in your mind, O discerning one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे भवबंधमोचक । येकलें कर्म सात्त्विक। तरी कां वेखासी सदोख। येर बोलावीं॥ ३१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je bhavabaṃdhamocaka | yekaleṃ karma sāttvika| tarī kāṃ vekhāsī sadokha| yera bolāvīṃ|| 310||
verses.meaning: If a single sattvic action can liberate one from the bonds of worldly existence, then why should one speak of other actions, whether good or bad?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी नोसंतितां विवसी । भेटी नाहीं निधीसी। कां धूं न साहतां जैसी। वाती न लगे॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī nosaṃtitāṃ vivasī | bheṭī nāhīṃ nidhīsī| kāṃ dhūṃ na sāhatāṃ jaisī| vātī na lage|| 11||
verses.meaning: Just as one cannot find a hidden treasure without digging, or a lamp cannot be lit without enduring the smoke, so too is the path to spiritual realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें शुद्धसत्त्वाआड । आहे रजतमाचें कवाड। तें भेदणें यातें 'कौड। म्हणावें कां॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śuddhasattvāāḍa | āhe rajatamāceṃ kavāḍa| teṃ bhedaṇeṃ yāteṃ 'kauḍa| mhaṇāveṃ kāṃ|| 92||
verses.meaning: Just as there is a door of Rajas and Tamas obstructing pure Sattva, to pierce through it, how can one call that 'difficult'?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं श्रद्धादि दानांत। जें समस्तही क्रियाजात । ४९४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी सांगितलें का व्याप्त । तिहीं गुणीं॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ śraddhādi dānāṃta| jeṃ samastahī kriyājāta | 494 śrījñāneśvarī sāṃgitaleṃ kā vyāpta | tihīṃ guṇīṃ|| 13||
verses.meaning: We have explained in the Dnyaneshwari that all the actions, such as faith and charity, are encompassed by the three Gunas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ भरंबसेनि तिन्ही । न सांगोंचि ऐसें मानीं । परी सत्त्व दावावया दोन्ही । बोलिलो येरें॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha bharaṃbaseni tinhī | na sāṃgoṃci aiseṃ mānīṃ | parī sattva dāvāvayā donhī | bolilo yereṃ|| 14||
verses.meaning: There, the three (qualities) are not to be spoken of with such certainty, I believe. But to demonstrate the sattva quality, I have spoken of the other two.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें दोहींमाजीं तिजें असे । तें दोन्हीं सांडितांचि दिसे । अहोरात्रत्यागें जैसें । संध्यारूप ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ dohīṃmājīṃ tijeṃ ase | teṃ donhīṃ sāṃḍitāṃci dise | ahorātratyāgeṃ jaiseṃ | saṃdhyārūpa || 15||
verses.meaning: That which is the third between two, becomes apparent when both are abandoned, just as the twilight appears when day and night are relinquished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें रजतमविनाशें। तिजें जें उत्तम दिसे। तें सत्त्व हें आपैसें। फावासि ये॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ rajatamavināśeṃ| tijeṃ jeṃ uttama dise| teṃ sattva heṃ āpaiseṃ| phāvāsi ye|| 16||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when Rajas and Tamas are destroyed, that which appears as the best, that Sattva, naturally comes into being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं दाखवावया सत्त्व तुज । निरूपिलें तम रज तें सांडूनि सत्त्वें 'काज। साधीं आपुलें॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ dākhavāvayā sattva tuja | nirūpileṃ tama raja teṃ sāṃḍūni sattveṃ 'kāja| sādhīṃ āpuleṃ|| 17||
verses.meaning: Thus, to show you the path of Sattva, I have explained it. Abandoning Tamas and Rajas, accomplish your purpose through Sattva.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सत्त्वेंचि येणें चोखाळें। करीं यज्ञादिकें सकळे। पावसी तें करतळें। आपुलें निज॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sattveṃci yeṇeṃ cokhāḻeṃ| karīṃ yajñādikeṃ sakaḻe| pāvasī teṃ karataḻeṃ| āpuleṃ nija|| 18||
verses.meaning: By this very purity, perform all sacrifices and rituals, and you will attain your true self, as if it were in the palm of your hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सूर्ये दाविलें सांतें। काय एक न दिसे तेथें। तेवीं सत्त्वे केलें फळातें। काय नेदी॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sūrye dāvileṃ sāṃteṃ| kāya eka na dise tetheṃ| tevīṃ sattve keleṃ phaḻāteṃ| kāya nedī|| 19||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun reveals all things, leaving nothing unseen, so too, when the quality of Sattva brings forth its fruit, what is there that it does not bestow?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे कीर आवडतांविखीं । शक्‍्क्‍ि सत्त्वी आथी निकी । परी मोक्षेंसी एकीं । मिसळणें जें॥३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: he kīra āvaḍatāṃvikhīṃ | śak‍k‍i sattvī āthī nikī | parī mokṣeṃsī ekīṃ | misaḻaṇeṃ jeṃ||320||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the power of Sattva guna is inherently good and pure, yet it must ultimately merge with liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें एक आनचि आहे। तयाचा सावावो जें लाहे। तें मोक्षाचाही होये। गांबीं सरतें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ eka ānaci āhe| tayācā sāvāvo jeṃ lāhe| teṃ mokṣācāhī hoye| gāṃbīṃ sarateṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: That is a unique thing. Whatever attains its support, that becomes the ultimate goal, even of liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पें भांगार जऱ्ही पंधरें।॥ तऱही राजावळीचीं अक्षरें । लाहें तैंचि सरे। जियापरी॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: peṃ bhāṃgāra jaṟhī paṃdhareṃ||| taṟahī rājāvaḻīcīṃ akṣareṃ | lāheṃ taiṃci sare| jiyāparī|| 22||
verses.meaning: Just as a royal decree, even if written on gold, is valid only as long as its letters are legible.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वच्छें शीतळें सुगंधें। जळें होतीं सुखप्रदें। परी पवित्रत्व संबंधें। तीर्थाचेनि॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: svaccheṃ śītaḻeṃ sugaṃdheṃ| jaḻeṃ hotīṃ sukhapradeṃ| parī pavitratva saṃbaṃdheṃ| tīrthāceni|| 23||
verses.meaning: Water, by its very nature, is cool and fragrant, bringing comfort. Yet, it attains sacredness through its association with a holy place of pilgrimage.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नई हो कां भलतैसी थोरी । परी गंगा जैं अंगिकारी। तैंचि तिये सागरीं । प्रवेशु गा॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: naī ho kāṃ bhalataisī thorī | parī gaṃgā jaiṃ aṃgikārī| taiṃci tiye sāgarīṃ | praveśu gā|| 24||
verses.meaning: No matter how great a river may be, only when the Ganga accepts it does it gain entry into the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा बोलु आइकतखेवीं। अर्जुना आधि न माये जीवीं । म्हणे देवें कृपा करावी । सांगावें तें ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā bolu āikatakhevīṃ| arjunā ādhi na māye jīvīṃ | mhaṇe deveṃ kṛpā karāvī | sāṃgāveṃ teṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: As soon as Arjuna heard these words, his heart was filled with an intense longing, and he thought, "May the Lord be gracious and tell me what is to be said."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ कृपाळुचक्रवर्ती। म्हणे आईक तयाची व्यक्‍ती । जेणें सात्त्विक तें मुक्‍ती-। रत्न देखे॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha kṛpāḻucakravartī| mhaṇe āīka tayācī vyak‍tī | jeṇeṃ sāttvika teṃ muk‍tī-| ratna dekhe|| 27||
verses.meaning: Then the compassionate Emperor (Lord Krishna) said, "Listen to the nature of that (devotion) by which one perceives the jewel of liberation as truly sattvic (pure and virtuous)."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी अनादि परब्रह्म । जें जगदादि विश्रामधाम । तयाचें एक नाम। त्रिधा पै असे॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī anādi parabrahma | jeṃ jagadādi viśrāmadhāma | tayāceṃ eka nāma| tridhā pai ase|| 28||
verses.meaning: That beginningless Supreme Brahman, which is the ultimate resting place and origin of the universe, has three names.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें कीर अनाम अजाती। परी अविद्यावर्गाचिये राती-। माजीं 'बोळखावया श्रुती । खूण केली ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ kīra anāma ajātī| parī avidyāvargāciye rātī-| mājīṃ 'boḻakhāvayā śrutī | khūṇa kelī || 29||
verses.meaning: That indeed is nameless and without caste, yet in the night of ignorance, to guide the Shruti (Vedas), a sign was made.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उपजल्िया बाळकासी । नांव नाहीं तयापासीं। ठेविलेनि नांवेंसीं। ओ देत उठी॥ ३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: upajaliyā bāḻakāsī | nāṃva nāhīṃ tayāpāsīṃ| ṭhevileni nāṃveṃsīṃ| o deta uṭhī|| 330||
verses.meaning: A newborn child has no name of its own. Yet, when called by the name given to it, it responds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कष्टले संसारशिणें । जे देवो येती गाऱहाणें । तयां ओ दे नांबें जेणें। तो संकेतु हा॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kaṣṭale saṃsāraśiṇeṃ | je devo yetī gāṟahāṇeṃ | tayāṃ o de nāṃbeṃ jeṇeṃ| to saṃketu hā|| 31||
verses.meaning: Those who are weary from the toils of worldly existence and come to God with their grievances, to them He gives a sign of solace and assurance. This is that very sign.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ब्रह्माचा अबोला फिटावा। अह्ैतत्बें ( द्वैतत्वे) तो भेटावा। ऐसा मंत्रु देखिला 'कणवा। वेदें बापें॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: brahmācā abolā phiṭāvā| ahaitatbeṃ ( dvaitatve) to bheṭāvā| aisā maṃtru dekhilā 'kaṇavā| vedeṃ bāpeṃ|| 32||
verses.meaning: The estrangement from Brahman should end; through non-duality, one should meet Him. Such a compassionate mantra was seen by the Vedas, our father.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग दाविलेनि जेणें एकें। ब्रह्म आळविलें कवतिकें । मागां असत ठाके । पुढां उभें ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga dāvileni jeṇeṃ ekeṃ| brahma āḻavileṃ kavatikeṃ | māgāṃ asata ṭhāke | puḍhāṃ ubheṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Then, by that one who playfully invoked Brahman, it stood behind and appeared in front.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी निगमाचळशिखरीं। उपनिषदार्थनगरीं । आहाति जे ब्रह्माच्या येकाहारीं । तयांसीच कळे॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī nigamācaḻaśikharīṃ| upaniṣadārthanagarīṃ | āhāti je brahmācyā yekāhārīṃ | tayāṃsīca kaḻe|| 34||
verses.meaning: However, only those who reside in the city of Upanishadic meaning, on the peak of the mountain of Vedas, and are one with Brahman, can comprehend this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेंही असो प्रजापती। शक्ति जे सृष्टि करिती। ते जया एका आवृत्ती । नामाचिये ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃhī aso prajāpatī| śakti je sṛṣṭi karitī| te jayā ekā āvṛttī | nāmāciye || 35||
verses.meaning: Let this also be. The Prajapati, the power that creates the universe, is but one repetition of His Name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं सृष्टीचिया उपक्रमा-। पूर्वी गा वीरोत्तमा। वेडा ऐसा ब्रह्मा। एकला होता॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ sṛṣṭīciyā upakramā-| pūrvī gā vīrottamā| veḍā aisā brahmā| ekalā hotā|| 36||
verses.meaning: Before the creation of the universe, O best of heroes, Brahma was alone, as if bewildered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज ईशश्‍वरातें नोळखे। ना सृष्टीही करूं न शके । तो थोरु केला एकें। नामें जेणें ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja īśaś‍varāteṃ noḻakhe| nā sṛṣṭīhī karūṃ na śake | to thoru kelā ekeṃ| nāmeṃ jeṇeṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: He does not know Me, the Lord, nor can he create the universe. Yet, he was made great by a single Name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचा अर्थ जीवीं ध्यातां । जें वर्णत्रयच्चि जपतां। विश्‍वसृजनयोग्यता। आली तया॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayācā artha jīvīṃ dhyātāṃ | jeṃ varṇatrayacci japatāṃ| viś‍vasṛjanayogyatā| ālī tayā|| 38||
verses.meaning: By meditating on whose meaning in the heart, and by chanting whose three-syllable mantra, one attains the ability to create the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेधवां रचिले ब्रह्मजन। तयां वेद दिधलें शासन । यज्ञाऐसें वर्तन । जीविकें केलें॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tedhavāṃ racile brahmajana| tayāṃ veda didhaleṃ śāsana | yajñāaiseṃ vartana | jīvikeṃ keleṃ|| 39||
verses.meaning: Then, the Brahmins were created, and the Vedas were given to them as their guiding principle. They made the performance of Yajnas (sacrifices) their way of life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं नेणों किती येर। स्त्रजिळे लोक अपार । जाले ब्रह्मदत्त अग्रहार । तिन्हीं भुवनें ॥ ३४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ neṇoṃ kitī yera| strajiḻe loka apāra | jāle brahmadatta agrahāra | tinhīṃ bhuvaneṃ || 340||
verses.meaning: I do not know how many other worlds were created, countless indeed. The three worlds became like a gift of land (agrahara) bestowed by Brahma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें नाममंत्रें जेणें। धातया अढंच करणें। तयाचें स्वरूप आइक म्हणे। श्रीकांतु तो॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ nāmamaṃtreṃ jeṇeṃ| dhātayā aḍhaṃca karaṇeṃ| tayāceṃ svarūpa āika mhaṇe| śrīkāṃtu to|| 41||
verses.meaning: The Lord of Lakshmi, Vishnu, is the one who, through the chanting of His name, makes even Brahma, the creator, subservient. Listen to His nature, says Dnyaneshwar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सर्व मंत्रांचा राजा। तो प्रणबो आदिवर्णु बुझा । आणि तत्कारु जो दुजा । तिजा सत्कारु॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sarva maṃtrāṃcā rājā| to praṇabo ādivarṇu bujhā | āṇi tatkāru jo dujā | tijā satkāru|| 42||
verses.meaning: The king of all mantras is that Pranava, the primordial sound, understand this. And the second is 'Tat', and the third is 'Sat'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं 3%तत्सदाकारुू । ब्रह्मनाम हें त्रिप्रकारु । हे फूल तुरंबी सुंदर । उपनिषदाचें ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ 3%tatsadākāruū | brahmanāma heṃ triprakāru | he phūla turaṃbī suṃdara | upaniṣadāceṃ || 43 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, the three-fold name of Brahman, 'Om Tat Sat', is the beautiful flower of the Upanishads.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणेंसीं गा होऊनि एक । जैं कर्म चाले सात्त्विक । तें कैवल्यातें पाइक । घरींचें करी॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃsīṃ gā hoūni eka | jaiṃ karma cāle sāttvika | teṃ kaivalyāteṃ pāika | gharīṃceṃ karī|| 44||
verses.meaning: When, with this understanding, sattvic actions are performed, they make liberation a servant of the household.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी कापुराचें थळींब। आणूनि देईल दैव। लेबों जाणणेंचि आडव। तेथ असे बापा॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī kāpurāceṃ thaḻīṃba| āṇūni deīla daiva| leboṃ jāṇaṇeṃci āḍava| tetha ase bāpā|| 45||
verses.meaning: But if fate brings a camphor lamp, and one knows not how to light it, then it is an obstruction, my child.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें आदरिजेळ सत्कर्म । उच्चरिजेल ब्रह्मनाम। परी नेणिजेल जरी वर्म। विनियोगाचें ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ ādarijeḻa satkarma | uccarijela brahmanāma| parī neṇijela jarī varma| viniyogāceṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: Similarly, one may undertake good deeds, or utter the name of Brahman, but if the secret of their proper application is not known, it is all in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी महंताचिया कोडी। घरा आलियाही वोढी। मानूं नेणतां परवडी । मुद्दल तुटे ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī mahaṃtāciyā koḍī| gharā āliyāhī voḍhī| mānūṃ neṇatāṃ paravaḍī | muddala tuṭe || 47||
verses.meaning: If a great soul, a saint, comes to one's house, and one does not know how to honor them, then the very root of one's spiritual capital is severed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां ल्यावया चोखट । टीक भांगार एकवट । घाळूनि बांधली मोट। गळां जेवीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ lyāvayā cokhaṭa | ṭīka bhāṃgāra ekavaṭa | ghāḻūni bāṃdhalī moṭa| gaḻāṃ jevīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: Or, as if a pure, unblemished gold ornament, along with a piece of gold, were tied together and hung around the neck.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तोंडीं ब्रह्मनाम। हातीं तें सात्त्विक कर्म । विनियोगेंबीण काम । विफळ होय॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ toṃḍīṃ brahmanāma| hātīṃ teṃ sāttvika karma | viniyogeṃbīṇa kāma | viphaḻa hoya|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as the chanting of the Lord's name and the performance of sattvic deeds, if done without proper dedication and intention, become fruitless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा अन्न आणि भूक पासीं असे परी देख । जेऊं नेणतां बाळक । ल॑ंघनचि कौों॥ ३५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā anna āṇi bhūka pāsīṃ ase parī dekha | jeūṃ neṇatāṃ bāḻaka | la̭ṃghanaci kauoṃ|| 350||
verses.meaning: Just as food and hunger are present, yet a child, not knowing how to eat, starves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां स्नेहसूत्र बैश्वानरा । जालियाही संसारा । हातवटी नेणतां वीरा । प्रकाशु नोहे ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ snehasūtra baiśvānarā | jāliyāhī saṃsārā | hātavaṭī neṇatāṃ vīrā | prakāśu nohe || 51||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp, though filled with oil and having a wick, will not illuminate if one does not know the art of lighting it, so too is the spiritual light not kindled without proper understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें वेळे कृत्य पावे। तेथिंचा मंत्रुही आठवे। परी व्यर्थ तें आघवें। वबिनियोगेंबीण ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ veḻe kṛtya pāve| tethiṃcā maṃtruhī āṭhave| parī vyartha teṃ āghaveṃ| vabiniyogeṃbīṇa || 52||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when the time for action arrives, the mantra for it is remembered, but all of that is in vain without proper application.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि वर्णत्रयात्मक । जें हें परब्रह्नानाम एक । विनियोगु तूं आइक । आतां याचा॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni varṇatrayātmaka | jeṃ heṃ parabrahnānāma eka | viniyogu tūṃ āika | ātāṃ yācā||53||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen now to the application of this one Supreme Brahman, which is of the nature of the three varnas (colors/qualities).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ४९६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तरी या नामींचीं अक्षरे तिन्ही । कर्मा आदिमध्यनिदानीं । प्रयोजावीं पैं स्थानीं । इहीं तिन्हीं ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: 496 śrījñāneśvarī tarī yā nāmīṃcīṃ akṣare tinhī | karmā ādimadhyanidānīṃ | prayojāvīṃ paiṃ sthānīṃ | ihīṃ tinhīṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: The three syllables of this Name should be employed at the beginning, middle, and end of all actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेचि एकी हातवटी । घेउनी हन किरीटी । आले ब्रह्मविद भेटी । ब्रह्माचिये ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: heci ekī hātavaṭī | gheunī hana kirīṭī | āle brahmavida bheṭī | brahmāciye || 55 ||
verses.meaning: With this very skill, O Kiriti (Arjuna), the knowers of Brahman came to meet Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ब्रहयोंसी होआवया एकी। ते न वंचती यज्ञादिकीं। जें चावळलें बोळखीं। शास्त्रांचिया॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: brahayoṃsī hoāvayā ekī| te na vaṃcatī yajñādikīṃ| jeṃ cāvaḻaleṃ boḻakhīṃ| śāstrāṃciyā|| 56||
verses.meaning: Those who seek oneness with Brahman do not get entangled in rituals like Yajnas, which are merely the ramblings found in scriptures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो आदि तंव ओंकारु । ध्यानें करिती गोचरु । पाठीं आणिती उच्चारु । बाचेही तो॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to ādi taṃva oṃkāru | dhyāneṃ karitī gocaru | pāṭhīṃ āṇitī uccāru | bācehī to|| 57||
verses.meaning: First, through meditation, they perceive that primal Omkara, and then they bring it forth through speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें ध्यानें प्रकटें । प्रणवोच्चारें स्पष्टें ॥ लागती मग वाटे । क्रियांचिये ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ dhyāneṃ prakaṭeṃ | praṇavoccāreṃ spaṣṭeṃ || lāgatī maga vāṭe | kriyāṃciye || 58||
verses.meaning: Through that meditation, by clearly uttering the Pranava (Om), one then embarks on the path of actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आंधारीं अभंगु दिवा। आडवीं समर्थ बोळावा। तैसा प्रणवो जाणावा । कर्मारंभी ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṃdhārīṃ abhaṃgu divā| āḍavīṃ samartha boḻāvā| taisā praṇavo jāṇāvā | karmāraṃbhī || 59||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp is indispensable in darkness, or a guide is essential in a dense forest, so too should one understand the Pranava (Om) at the commencement of any action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उचितदेवोद्देशें । द्रव्यें धर्म्यें आणि बहुवसें। द्विजद्वारां हन हुताशें। यजिती पैं ते॥ ३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: ucitadevoddeśeṃ | dravyeṃ dharmyeṃ āṇi bahuvaseṃ| dvijadvārāṃ hana hutāśeṃ| yajitī paiṃ te|| 360||
verses.meaning: They perform sacrifices, offering appropriate and abundant wealth to the proper deities, through Brahmins and into the sacred fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आहवनीयादि वन्ही । निक्षेपरूपीं हवनीं। यजिती पैं विधानीं। फुडे होउनी ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āhavanīyādi vanhī | nikṣeparūpīṃ havanīṃ| yajitī paiṃ vidhānīṃ| phuḍe hounī || 61||
verses.meaning: The sacrificial fires, like Ahavaniya and others, are offered into the fire of renunciation, performing the sacrifice with proper rituals, moving forward.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना नाना याग। निष्पत्तीचें घेऊनी अंग। करिती नावडतेया त्याग। उपाधीचा ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā nānā yāga| niṣpattīceṃ gheūnī aṃga| karitī nāvaḍateyā tyāga| upādhīcā || 62||
verses.meaning: Indeed, they embrace the essence of various sacrifices and renounce all unwanted worldly attachments.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां न्यायें जोडला पवित्रीं। भूम्यादिकीं स्वतंत्री । देशकाळशुद्ध पात्रीं। देती दानें॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ nyāyeṃ joḍalā pavitrīṃ| bhūmyādikīṃ svataṃtrī | deśakāḻaśuddha pātrīṃ| detī dāneṃ||63||
verses.meaning: Or, they give donations, earned righteously, to worthy recipients, in pure places and at auspicious times, on occasions like solar or lunar eclipses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा एकांतरा कृच्छीं। चांद्रायणें मासोपवासीं । शोषोनि गा धातुराशी । करिती तपें॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā ekāṃtarā kṛcchīṃ| cāṃdrāyaṇeṃ māsopavāsīṃ | śoṣoni gā dhāturāśī | karitī tapeṃ|| 64||
verses.meaning: Or through severe penances like Ekantara, Krichchhra, Chandrayana, and fasting for months, they dry up their bodily elements, performing such austerities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं यज्ञदानतपें। जियें गाजती बंधरूपें। तिहींच होय सोपें । मोक्षार्चे तयां ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ yajñadānatapeṃ| jiyeṃ gājatī baṃdharūpeṃ| tihīṃca hoya sopeṃ | mokṣārce tayāṃ || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, sacrifices, charities, and penances, which are renowned as binding actions, become the easy path to liberation for them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्थळीं नावा जिया दाटिजे। जळीं तियांचि जेवीं तरिजे। तेवीं बंधकीं कर्मी सुटिजे। नामें येणें ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: sthaḻīṃ nāvā jiyā dāṭije| jaḻīṃ tiyāṃci jevīṃ tarije| tevīṃ baṃdhakīṃ karmī suṭije| nāmeṃ yeṇeṃ || 66||
verses.meaning: Just as a boat, though made of wood, helps one cross the water, so too does chanting the Lord's name release one from the bondage of karma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हें असो ऐसिया । या यज्ञदानादि क्रिया। ओंकारें सावायिलिया। प्रवर्तती ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī heṃ aso aisiyā | yā yajñadānādi kriyā| oṃkāreṃ sāvāyiliyā| pravartatī || 67||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Such acts of sacrifice and charity, when empowered by Om, proceed forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिया मोटकिया जेथ फळीं। रिगों पाहाती निहाळीं। प्रयोजिती तिये काळीं । तच्छब्दु तो॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyā moṭakiyā jetha phaḻīṃ| rigoṃ pāhātī nihāḻīṃ| prayojitī tiye kāḻīṃ | tacchabdu to|| 68||
verses.meaning: When those small, insignificant beings try to enter and observe the fruit of their actions, at that very moment, the word 'Tat' (That) is applied to them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे सर्वांही जगापरीतें। जें एक सर्वही देखतें। जें तच्छब्दें बोलिजे तें । पैल वस्तु ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je sarvāṃhī jagāparīteṃ| jeṃ eka sarvahī dekhateṃ| jeṃ tacchabdeṃ bolije teṃ | paila vastu || 69||
verses.meaning: That which is beyond all worlds, that which alone sees everything, that which is spoken of by the word 'Tat' (That) - that is the Supreme Reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें सर्वादिकत्वें चित्तीं । तद्रूप ध्यावूनियां सुमती । उच्चारेंही व्यक्तीं । आणिती पुढती ॥ ३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ sarvādikatveṃ cittīṃ | tadrūpa dhyāvūniyāṃ sumatī | uccāreṃhī vyaktīṃ | āṇitī puḍhatī || 370||
verses.meaning: Thus, with their minds absorbed in the all-pervading nature of the Divine, the wise meditate upon that form and bring it forth again through their utterances.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणती तदूपा ब्रह्मा तया । फळेंसीं क्रिया इयां। तेंचि होतु आम्हां भोगावया। कांहींचि नुरो॥ ७१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇatī tadūpā brahmā tayā | phaḻeṃsīṃ kriyā iyāṃ| teṃci hotu āmhāṃ bhogāvayā| kāṃhīṃci nuro|| 719||
verses.meaning: They say that Brahma is the fruit of these actions. Let that be our experience, so that nothing remains to be enjoyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि तदात्मकें ब्रह्मे | तेथ उगाणूनि कर्मे । आंग झाडिती न ममें। येणें बोळें॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni tadātmakeṃ brahme | tetha ugāṇūni karme | āṃga jhāḍitī na mameṃ| yeṇeṃ boḻeṃ|| 72||
verses.meaning: Thus, in that Brahman, which is of the nature of the Self, actions are shed and cast off, not by effort, but by this very path of realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां ओंकारें आदरिळें। तत्कारें समर्पिलें। इया रिती जया आलें। ब्रह्मत्व कर्मा॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ oṃkāreṃ ādariḻeṃ| tatkāreṃ samarpileṃ| iyā ritī jayā āleṃ| brahmatva karmā|| 73||
verses.meaning: Now, that which began with Om, and was dedicated to That (Brahman) through the syllable 'Tat', in this manner, attained the state of Brahman through action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें कर्म कौर ब्रह्माकारें। जालें तेणेंही न सरे। जे करी तेणेंसी दुसरें। आहे म्हणौनि ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ karma kaura brahmākāreṃ| jāleṃ teṇeṃhī na sare| je karī teṇeṃsī dusareṃ| āhe mhaṇauni || 74||
verses.meaning: Even if that action becomes one with Brahman, it does not cease, because there is still a sense of 'otherness' with the one who performs it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मीठ आंगें जळीं विरे। परी क्षारता वेगळी उरे । तैसें कर्म ब्रह्माकारें। गमे तें द्वैत ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mīṭha āṃgeṃ jaḻīṃ vire| parī kṣāratā vegaḻī ure | taiseṃ karma brahmākāreṃ| game teṃ dvaita || 75||
verses.meaning: Just as salt dissolves in water, yet its saltiness remains distinct, so too does the duality of action persist even when it appears to merge with Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि दुजें जंब जंब घडे । तंव तंव संसारभय जोडे । हे देवो आपुलेनि तोंडें । बोलती वेद॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi dujeṃ jaṃba jaṃba ghaḍe | taṃva taṃva saṃsārabhaya joḍe | he devo āpuleni toṃḍeṃ | bolatī veda|| 76||
verses.meaning: And as long as duality persists, so long does the fear of worldly existence remain. These are the words spoken by the Vedas themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि परत्वें ब्रह्म असे। तें आत्मत्वें परियवसे। सच्छब्द या रिणादोषें। ठेविला देवें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni paratveṃ brahma ase| teṃ ātmatveṃ pariyavase| sacchabda yā riṇādoṣeṃ| ṭhevilā deveṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Brahman exists as the ultimate reality, and it is realized as the Self. The word 'Sat' (Existence/Truth) is thus bestowed by God to signify this inherent purity and freedom from imperfection.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी ओंकार तत्कारीं। कर्म केलें जें ब्रह्मशरीरीं । जें प्रशस्तादि बोलवरी । वाखाणिलें॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī oṃkāra tatkārīṃ| karma keleṃ jeṃ brahmaśarīrīṃ | jeṃ praśastādi bolavarī | vākhāṇileṃ|| 78 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, the 'Omkar' (Pranava) is the sound that initiated creation, the very body of Brahman, which is praised and glorified by the scriptures and sages.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रशस्तकर्मी तिये । सच्छब्दा विनियोगु आहे । तोचि आइका होये। तैसा सांगों ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: praśastakarmī tiye | sacchabdā viniyogu āhe | toci āikā hoye| taisā sāṃgoṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: To such auspicious actions, the word 'Sat' is applied. Listen, I will explain it accordingly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: | तरी सच्छब्दें येणें । आटूनि असताचें नाणें । दाविजे अव्यंगवाणें । सत्तेचें रूप॥ ३८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: | tarī sacchabdeṃ yeṇeṃ | āṭūni asatāceṃ nāṇeṃ | dāvije avyaṃgavāṇeṃ | satteceṃ rūpa|| 380||
verses.meaning: Thus, through the word 'Sat' (Existence), the illusion of non-existence is dispelled, revealing the flawless form of pure Being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें सत्‌ तेंचि काळें देशें। होऊं नेणेचि अनारिसें। आपणपां आपण असे। अखंडित॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sat‌ teṃci kāḻeṃ deśeṃ| hoūṃ neṇeci anāriseṃ| āpaṇapāṃ āpaṇa ase| akhaṃḍita||81||
verses.meaning: That which is 'Sat' (Existence/Truth) can never, by time or space, become otherwise. It remains eternally in its own nature, unbroken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें दिसतें जेतुलें आहे। तें असतपणें जें नोहे। देखतां रूपीं सोये। लाभे जयाची ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ disateṃ jetuleṃ āhe| teṃ asatapaṇeṃ jeṃ nohe| dekhatāṃ rūpīṃ soye| lābhe jayācī || 82||
verses.meaning: All that is seen, though it appears to exist, is not truly existent. The form that is perceived is merely a reflection of that which truly is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणेंसीं प्रशस्त तें कर्म। जें जालें सर्वात्मक ब्रह्म। देखिजे करूनि सम। ऐक्यबोधें ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃsīṃ praśasta teṃ karma| jeṃ jāleṃ sarvātmaka brahma| dekhije karūni sama| aikyabodheṃ || 83||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that action is truly praiseworthy which, through the understanding of oneness, perceives the all-pervading Brahman as the essence of all beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी ओंकार तत्कारें। जें कर्म दाविले ब्रह्माकारें। तें गिळूनि होइजे एकसरें। सन्मात्रचि॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī oṃkāra tatkāreṃ| jeṃ karma dāvile brahmākāreṃ| teṃ giḻūni hoije ekasareṃ| sanmātraci|| 84||
verses.meaning: Thus, through the sacred syllable Om, the actions that reveal the form of Brahman are swallowed, and one becomes solely the pure existence (Sat).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा हा अंतरंगु। सच्छब्दाचा विनियोगु। जाणा म्हणे श्रीरंगु मी ना म्हणें हो॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā hā aṃtaraṃgu| sacchabdācā viniyogu| jāṇā mhaṇe śrīraṃgu mī nā mhaṇeṃ ho|| 85||
verses.meaning: Such is the inner meaning, the proper application of the true word, know this, says Shriranga, I do not say it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना मीचि जरी हो म्हणें। तरी श्रीरंगीं दुजें हेंचि उणें । म्हणौनि हें बोलणें । देवाचेंचि ॥ ८६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā mīci jarī ho mhaṇeṃ| tarī śrīraṃgīṃ dujeṃ heṃci uṇeṃ | mhaṇauni heṃ bolaṇeṃ | devāceṃci || 86 ||
verses.meaning: Even if I were to say 'no', that would still be a duality in the divine Lord. Therefore, this utterance is indeed of the Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां आणिकीही परी । सच्छब्दु हा अवधारी । सात्त्विका कर्मा करी। उपकारु जो॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ āṇikīhī parī | sacchabdu hā avadhārī | sāttvikā karmā karī| upakāru jo|| 87||
verses.meaning: Now, in another way, listen to this word 'Sat': it is that which benefits sattvic actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सत्कर्मे चांगें। चालिली अधिकारबगें। परी एकाधें का आंगें। हिणावती जैं॥८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī satkarme cāṃgeṃ| cālilī adhikārabageṃ| parī ekādheṃ kā āṃgeṃ| hiṇāvatī jaiṃ||88||
verses.meaning: Even if good deeds are performed with great authority, sometimes a single limb may become weak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें उणें एकें अवयवें। शरीर ठाके आघवें। का अंगहीन भांडावें । रथाची गती॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ uṇeṃ ekeṃ avayaveṃ| śarīra ṭhāke āghaveṃ| kā aṃgahīna bhāṃḍāveṃ | rathācī gatī|| 89||
verses.meaning: If one limb is deficient, the entire body becomes incomplete. Similarly, how can a chariot move swiftly if it lacks a part?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें एकेंचि गुणेंबीण । सतचि परी असतपण। कर्म धरी गा जाण । जिये वेळे॥ ३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ ekeṃci guṇeṃbīṇa | sataci parī asatapaṇa| karma dharī gā jāṇa | jiye veḻe|| 390||
verses.meaning: Just as a single quality can make existence seem non-existent, so too does karma take hold at that very moment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां ओंकार तत्कारीं। सावायिला हा चांगी परी। सच्छब्दु कर्मा करी। जीर्णोद्धार ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ oṃkāra tatkārīṃ| sāvāyilā hā cāṃgī parī| sacchabdu karmā karī| jīrṇoddhāra || 91||
verses.meaning: Then, in that very sound of Om, this good word, the true sound, undertakes the renovation of actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें असतपण फेडी । आणी सदभावाचिये रूढी। निजसत्त्वाचिये प्रौढी। सच्छब्दु हा॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ asatapaṇa pheḍī | āṇī sadabhāvāciye rūḍhī| nijasattvāciye prauḍhī| sacchabdu hā||92||
verses.meaning: That 'asat' (non-existence) is dispelled, and through the tradition of 'sadbhava' (true being), by the grandeur of its own essence, this word 'Sat' (Existence) manifests.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिव्यौषध जैसें रोगिया। कां सावाबो ये भंगलिया। सच्छब्दु कर्मा व्यंगळिया । तैसा जाण॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: divyauṣadha jaiseṃ rogiyā| kāṃ sāvābo ye bhaṃgaliyā| sacchabdu karmā vyaṃgaḻiyā | taisā jāṇa|| 93||
verses.meaning: Just as divine medicine is for the sick, or a support for the broken, so too is the true word for those deficient in action, know this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा कांहीं प्रमादें।॥ कर्म आपुलियि मर्यादे । चुकोनि पडे निषिद्धे। वाटे हन ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā kāṃhīṃ pramādeṃ||| karma āpuliyi maryāde | cukoni paḍe niṣiddhe| vāṭe hana || 94||
verses.meaning: Or if, due to some error, one's actions, transgressing their proper limits, fall into forbidden ways, it is as if by chance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चालतयाचि मार्ग सांडे । पारखियाचि अखरें पडे । राहाटीमाजीं न घडे। काइ काइ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: cālatayāci mārga sāṃḍe | pārakhiyāci akhareṃ paḍe | rāhāṭīmājīṃ na ghaḍe| kāi kāi|| 95||
verses.meaning: What is it that does not happen in the world? The traveler loses his way, the stranger's letters fall apart (are not understood).

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तेसी कर्मा । ४९८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी राभस्यें सांडे सीमा। असाधुत्वाचिया दुर्नामा । येवो पाहे जें॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tesī karmā | 498 śrījñāneśvarī rābhasyeṃ sāṃḍe sīmā| asādhutvāciyā durnāmā | yevo pāhe jeṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: Therefore, such actions, O Dnyaneshwari, transcend all boundaries, and even the stigma of unrighteousness cannot touch them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ गा हा सच्छब्दु। येरां दोहींपरीस प्रबुद्धु। प्रयोजिला करी साधु । कर्मातें यया॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha gā hā sacchabdu| yerāṃ dohīṃparīsa prabuddhu| prayojilā karī sādhu | karmāteṃ yayā|| 97||
verses.meaning: There, this word 'Sat' (truth/existence) is more enlightened than the other two (referring to 'Om' and 'Tat'). The साधु (seeker/sage) employs it in this action (karma).

verses.shloka_devanagari: लोहा परिसाची घृष्टी। बोहळा गंगेची भेटी। कां मृता जैसी वृष्टी । पीयूषाची ॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: lohā parisācī ghṛṣṭī| bohaḻā gaṃgecī bheṭī| kāṃ mṛtā jaisī vṛṣṭī | pīyūṣācī || 98||
verses.meaning: Just as iron is touched by the philosopher's stone, or a small stream meets the Ganges, or nectar rains upon the dead.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं असाधुकर्मा तैसा । सच्छब्दुप्रयोगु बीरेशा । हें असो गौरवुच्नि ऐसा। नामाचा यया॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ asādhukarmā taisā | sacchabduprayogu bīreśā | heṃ aso gauravucni aisā| nāmācā yayā||99||
verses.meaning: Just as 'asadhukarma' (evil deeds) is an unholy word, so too is the word 'sat' (good) used for good deeds. Let this be the glory of this name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घेऊनि येथिंचें वर्म । जें विचारिसी हें नाम। तें केवळ हेंचि ब्रह्म। जाणसी तूं॥ ४००॥
verses.shloka_iast: gheūni yethiṃceṃ varma | jeṃ vicārisī heṃ nāma| teṃ kevaḻa heṃci brahma| jāṇasī tūṃ|| 400||
verses.meaning: By understanding this secret here, that which you contemplate as this name, know that it is verily this Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहें पां ३ तत्‌ सत्‌ ऐसें । हें बोलणें तेथ नेतसे। जेथूनि कां हें प्रकाशे । दृश्यजात॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāheṃ pāṃ 3 tat‌ sat‌ aiseṃ | heṃ bolaṇeṃ tetha netase| jethūni kāṃ heṃ prakāśe | dṛśyajāta|| 1||
verses.meaning: Behold, the words "Tat Sat" lead to that from which this entire visible world emanates and is illuminated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें तंव निर्विशिष्ट । परब्रह्म चोखट । तयाचें हें आंतुवट । व्यंजक नाम ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ taṃva nirviśiṣṭa | parabrahma cokhaṭa | tayāceṃ heṃ āṃtuvaṭa | vyaṃjaka nāma || 2||
verses.meaning: That pure, unconditioned Supreme Brahman, this is its inner, indicative name.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी आश्रयो आकाशा। आकाशचि का जैसा। या नामा नामी आश्रयो तैसा। अभेदु असे॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī āśrayo ākāśā| ākāśaci kā jaisā| yā nāmā nāmī āśrayo taisā| abhedu ase|| 3||
verses.meaning: Just as space is the support for the sky, and the sky itself is space, so too is the name (Nama) the support for the Named (Nami), and the Named is the name. Thus, there is no difference between them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदयिला आकाशीं। रवीचि रवीतें प्रकाशी । हे नामव्यक्‍ती तैसी । ब्रह्माचि करी॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: udayilā ākāśīṃ| ravīci ravīteṃ prakāśī | he nāmavyak‍tī taisī | brahmāci karī|| 4||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun in the sky illuminates itself, so too does Brahman manifest names and forms through its own power.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि त्र्यक्षर हें नाम । नव्हे जाण केवळ ब्रह्म। ययालागीं कर्म। जें जें कौजे॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tryakṣara heṃ nāma | navhe jāṇa kevaḻa brahma| yayālāgīṃ karma| jeṃ jeṃ kauje||5||
verses.meaning: Therefore, this three-syllable name is not merely Brahman. For this reason, whatever actions are performed...

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें याग अथवा दानें। तपादिकेंही गहनें। तियें निफजतु कां न्यूनें। होऊनि ठातु॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ yāga athavā dāneṃ| tapādikeṃhī gahaneṃ| tiyeṃ niphajatu kāṃ nyūneṃ| hoūni ṭhātu|| 6||
verses.meaning: Or through sacrifices, or donations, or profound austerities, how do these become deficient or incomplete?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी परिसाचां वरकलीं। नाहीं चोखाकिडाची बोली । तैसीं ब्रह्मी अर्पितां केली । ब्रह्मच होती ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī parisācāṃ varakalīṃ| nāhīṃ cokhākiḍācī bolī | taisīṃ brahmī arpitāṃ kelī | brahmaca hotī || 7||
verses.meaning: Just as a touchstone, when applied to other metals, does not speak of its own purity, so too, actions offered to Brahman become Brahman itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उणिया पुरियाची परी । नुरेची तेथ अवधारीं। निवडूं न येती सागरीं। जैसिया नदी॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: uṇiyā puriyācī parī | nurecī tetha avadhārīṃ| nivaḍūṃ na yetī sāgarīṃ| jaisiyā nadī||8||
verses.meaning: Listen, there is no distinction of less or more there, just as rivers cannot be distinguished once they merge into the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं पार्था तुजप्रती । ब्रह्मननामाची हे शक्‍ती । सांगितली उपपत्ती। डोळसा गा॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ pārthā tujapratī | brahmananāmācī he śak‍tī | sāṃgitalī upapattī| ḍoḻasā gā|| 9||
verses.meaning: Thus, O Partha, I have explained to you the power of the name Brahman, with its full significance, O discerning one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि येकेकाही अक्षरा। वेगळवेगळा वीरा । विनियोगु नागरा। बोलिलों रीती॥ ४१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi yekekāhī akṣarā| vegaḻavegaḻā vīrā | viniyogu nāgarā| boliloṃ rītī|| 410||
verses.meaning: And for each and every letter, O brave and discerning one, I have explained the distinct application and method.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं ऐसें सुमहिम। म्हणौनि हें ब्रह्मनाम । आतां जाणितलें कीं सुवर्म । राया तुवां॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ aiseṃ sumahima| mhaṇauni heṃ brahmanāma | ātāṃ jāṇitaleṃ kīṃ suvarma | rāyā tuvāṃ|| 11||
verses.meaning: Thus, such is the glory of this name of Brahman. Now, O King, you have understood its profound secret.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी येथूनि याचि श्रद्धा । उपलविली हो सर्वदा । जयाचें जालें बंधा। उरों नेदी॥१२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī yethūni yāci śraddhā | upalavilī ho sarvadā | jayāceṃ jāleṃ baṃdhā| uroṃ nedī||12||
verses.meaning: Therefore, this very faith always uplifts and liberates, allowing no bondage to remain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये कर्मी हा प्रयोगु। अनुष्ठिजे सद्विनियोगु। तेथ अनुष्ठिला सांगु। वेदुचि तो॥१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye karmī hā prayogu| anuṣṭhije sadviniyogu| tetha anuṣṭhilā sāṃgu| veduci to||13||
verses.meaning: Where this practice is performed, and the proper application is observed, there the Veda itself is completely followed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना सांडूनि हे सोये । मोडूनि श्रद्धेची बाहे। दुराग्रहाची त्राये। वाढऊनियां ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā sāṃḍūni he soye | moḍūni śraddhecī bāhe| durāgrahācī trāye| vāḍhaūniyāṃ || 94||
verses.meaning: Not abandoning this path, but breaking the arm of faith, and increasing the three-fold stubbornness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अश्वमेध कोडी कौजे। रत्ने भरोनि पृथ्वी दीजे । एकांगुष्ठींही तपिजे । तपसाहस्त्रीं ॥ ९५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga aśvamedha koḍī kauje| ratne bharoni pṛthvī dīje | ekāṃguṣṭhīṃhī tapije | tapasāhastrīṃ || 95 ||
verses.meaning: Then, performing millions of Ashwamedha sacrifices, filling the earth with jewels, and undertaking thousands of penances with just one toe, all these are considered insignificant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जळाशयाचेनि नांवें । समुद्र कीजती नवे। परी किंबहुना आघवें। वृथाचि तें ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaḻāśayāceni nāṃveṃ | samudra kījatī nave| parī kiṃbahunā āghaveṃ| vṛthāci teṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: Naming a small body of water as the ocean does not make it so; in truth, it is all in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: खडकावरी वर्षलें। जैसें भस्मीं हवन केलें। कां खेंब दिधलें। साउलिये॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: khaḍakāvarī varṣaleṃ| jaiseṃ bhasmīṃ havana keleṃ| kāṃ kheṃba didhaleṃ| sāuliye|| 17||
verses.meaning: Like rain falling on a rock, or an oblation offered into ashes, or a gift given to a shadow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी जेसें चडकणा । गगना हाणितलें अर्जुना । तैसा समारंभु सुना । गेलाचि तो॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī jeseṃ caḍakaṇā | gaganā hāṇitaleṃ arjunā | taisā samāraṃbhu sunā | gelāci to|| 18||
verses.meaning: Just as a thunderbolt strikes the sky, O Arjuna, so too that grand celebration vanished into nothingness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घाणां गाळिले गुंडे। तेथ तेल ना पेंडी जोडे । तैसें दरिद्र तेवढें । ठेळेंचि आंगीं ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghāṇāṃ gāḻile guṃḍe| tetha tela nā peṃḍī joḍe | taiseṃ daridra tevaḍheṃ | ṭheḻeṃci āṃgīṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Just as an oil press, when grinding stones, yields neither oil nor oilcake, so too does poverty cling to the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गांठीं बांधली खापरी । येथ अथवा पैलतीरीं। न सरोनि जैसी मारी । उपवासी गा॥ ४२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: gāṃṭhīṃ bāṃdhalī khāparī | yetha athavā pailatīrīṃ| na saroni jaisī mārī | upavāsī gā|| 420||
verses.meaning: Just as a beggar, having tied a piece of pottery to himself, suffers from hunger whether he is on this side or the other, without that pottery ever being used up.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें कर्मजातें तेणें । नाहीं ऐहिकींचें भोगणे । तेथ परत्र तें कवणें। अपेक्षावें ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ karmajāteṃ teṇeṃ | nāhīṃ aihikīṃceṃ bhogaṇe | tetha paratra teṃ kavaṇeṃ| apekṣāveṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: Just as the actions performed by such a person do not lead to worldly enjoyments, how can one expect any rewards in the afterlife?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ब्रह्मनामश्रद्धा। सांडूनि कौजे जो धांदा। हें असो सिणु नुसधा। दृष्टादृष्टीं तो॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni brahmanāmaśraddhā| sāṃḍūni kauje jo dhāṃdā| heṃ aso siṇu nusadhā| dṛṣṭādṛṣṭīṃ to|| 22||
verses.meaning: Therefore, abandoning faith in the divine name, whatever other pursuits one engages in, let it be known that such efforts are utterly futile, both in this world and the next.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें 'कलुषकरिकेसरी । त्रितापतिमिरतमारी । श्रीवर बीर नरहरी । बोलिलें तेणें ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ 'kaluṣakarikesarī | tritāpatimiratamārī | śrīvara bīra naraharī | bolileṃ teṇeṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: Thus spoke the lion-like remover of impurities, the sun dispelling the darkness of the three afflictions, the valiant Narahari, the beloved of Shri.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ निजानंदा बहुवसा-। माजीं अर्जुन तो सहसा । हरपला चंद्र जैसा । चांदिणेनि॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha nijānaṃdā bahuvasā-| mājīṃ arjuna to sahasā | harapalā caṃdra jaisā | cāṃdiṇeni|| 24||
verses.meaning: There, in that abundance of true bliss, Arjuna was suddenly lost, like the moon absorbed by its own moonlight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो संग्रामु हा वाणिया। मापें नाराचांचिया आणिया । सूनि माप घे मवणिया। जीवितेंसी॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho saṃgrāmu hā vāṇiyā| māpeṃ nārācāṃciyā āṇiyā | sūni māpa ghe mavaṇiyā| jīviteṃsī|| 25||
verses.meaning: Oh, this battle is a merchant, measuring with the sharp points of arrows, taking the measure of life itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसिया समयीं कर्कशे। भोगीजत स्वानंदराज्य कैसें । आजि भाग्योदयो हा नसे। आनी ठाई ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisiyā samayīṃ karkaśe| bhogījata svānaṃdarājya kaiseṃ | āji bhāgyodayo hā nase| ānī ṭhāī || 26||
verses.meaning: At such a time, how can one experience the kingdom of one's own bliss, O harsh one? Such a fortunate day is not found elsewhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संजयो म्हणे कौरवराया। गुणा रिझों ये रिपूचिया। आणि गुरुही हा आमुचिया। सुखाचा येथ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃjayo mhaṇe kauravarāyā| guṇā rijhoṃ ye ripūciyā| āṇi guruhī hā āmuciyā| sukhācā yetha|| 27||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said to the King of the Kauravas, 'He is pleased by the enemy's virtues, and this guru is also the source of our happiness here.'

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा न पुसता हे गोठी। तरी देवो कां सोडिते गांठी । तरी कैसेंनि आम्हां भेटी । परमार्थेसी ॥ २८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā na pusatā he goṭhī| tarī devo kāṃ soḍite gāṃṭhī | tarī kaiseṃni āmhāṃ bheṭī | paramārthesī || 28 ||
verses.meaning: If these matters were not inquired about, would God then untie the knot (of illusion)? How then would we encounter the ultimate truth?

verses.shloka_devanagari: होतों अज्ञानाच्या आंधारां । बोसंतीत जन्मवाहरा । तों आत्मप्रकाशमंदिरा-। आंतु आणिलें॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hotoṃ ajñānācyā āṃdhārāṃ | bosaṃtīta janmavāharā | toṃ ātmaprakāśamaṃdirā-| āṃtu āṇileṃ|| 29||
verses.meaning: I was in the darkness of ignorance, wandering through cycles of birth, when I was brought into the temple of self-illumination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येवढा आम्हां तुम्हां थोरु । केला येणें उपकारु । म्हणौनि हा व्याससहोदरु । गुरुत्वें होय॥ ४३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yevaḍhā āmhāṃ tumhāṃ thoru | kelā yeṇeṃ upakāru | mhaṇauni hā vyāsasahodaru | gurutveṃ hoya|| 430||
verses.meaning: He has done us and you such a great favor, therefore, he is like a brother to Vyasa in his spiritual authority.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि संजयो म्हणे चित्तीं । हा अतिशयो या नृपती । खुपेल म्हणौनि किती। बोळत असों॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci saṃjayo mhaṇe cittīṃ | hā atiśayo yā nṛpatī | khupela mhaṇauni kitī| boḻata asoṃ|| 31||
verses.meaning: Sanjaya thought in his mind, "This exaggeration might displease the king, so how much should I speak?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी हे बोली सांडिली । मग येरीचिं गोठी आदरिली। जे पार्थे कां पुसिली। श्रीकृष्णातें॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī he bolī sāṃḍilī | maga yerīciṃ goṭhī ādarilī| je pārthe kāṃ pusilī| śrīkṛṣṇāteṃ|| 32||
verses.meaning: Having spoken thus, He then began to speak of other matters, those which Arjuna had asked of Shri Krishna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याचें जैसें कां करणें। तेसें मीही करीन बोलणें । ऐकिजो ज्ञानदेवो म्हणे । निवृत्तीचा ॥ ४३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāceṃ jaiseṃ kāṃ karaṇeṃ| teseṃ mīhī karīna bolaṇeṃ | aikijo jñānadevo mhaṇe | nivṛttīcā || 433||
verses.meaning: Just as it is to be done, so will I speak, says Dnyandev, the disciple of Nivritti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव निर्मळ। निजजनाखिलमंगळ। जन्मजराजलदजाळ। प्रभंजन॥ १ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva nirmaḻa| nijajanākhilamaṃgaḻa| janmajarājaladajāḻa| prabhaṃjana|| 1 ||
verses.meaning: Hail, hail to the pure God, the source of all auspiciousness for his devotees, the mighty wind that scatters the clouds of birth and old age.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव प्रबळ । विदळितामंगळकुळ। निगमागमद्रुमफळ। फलप्रद॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva prabaḻa | vidaḻitāmaṃgaḻakuḻa| nigamāgamadrumaphaḻa| phalaprada|| 2||
verses.meaning: Hail, hail, O powerful God! You are the destroyer of the lineage of inauspiciousness, the giver of the fruit of the tree of Vedas and Agamas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव सकल। विगतविषयवत्सळ। कलितकाळकौतूहळ। कलातीत॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva sakala| vigataviṣayavatsaḻa| kalitakāḻakautūhaḻa| kalātīta|| 3||
verses.meaning: Hail, hail to the Lord, who is affectionate towards those who have renounced worldly pleasures, and who playfully controls the power of time, transcending all arts and limitations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव निश्चळ । चलितचित्तपानतुंदिल। जगदुन्मीलनाविरल। केलिप्रिय ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva niścaḻa | calitacittapānatuṃdila| jagadunmīlanāvirala| kelipriya || 4||
verses.meaning: Victory, victory to the unwavering Lord, whose mind is not restless, who is full of joy in the creation of the world, and who delights in play.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव निष्कळ। स्फुरदमंदानंदबहळ । नित्यनिरस्ताख्िलमळ । मूळभूत ॥ ५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva niṣkaḻa| sphuradamaṃdānaṃdabahaḻa | nityanirastākhilamaḻa | mūḻabhūta || 5 ||
verses.meaning: Hail, hail to the Lord, the Immaculate One! The source of boundless, intense bliss, eternally free from all impurities, the very root of existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव स्वप्रभ । जगदंबुदगर्भनभ । भुवनोदभवारंभस्तंभ । भवध्बंस ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva svaprabha | jagadaṃbudagarbhanabha | bhuvanodabhavāraṃbhastaṃbha | bhavadhbaṃsa || 6||
verses.meaning: Victory, victory to the Self-effulgent Lord, the sky within the cloud of the universe, the pillar of the origin of all worlds, the destroyer of worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव विशुद्ध । बिदुदयोद्यानद्विरद । शमदममदनमदभेद । दयार्णब ॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva viśuddha | bidudayodyānadvirada | śamadamamadanamadabheda | dayārṇaba ||7||
verses.meaning: Hail, O God, the Pure One, the elephant in the garden of the rising Bindu, the destroyer of the pride of lust, tranquility, and self-control, the ocean of compassion!

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देवैकरूप । अतिकृतकंदर्पसर्पदर्प। भक्‍तभावभुबनदीप। तापापह॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya devaikarūpa | atikṛtakaṃdarpasarpadarpa| bhak‍tabhāvabhubanadīpa| tāpāpaha|| 8||
verses.meaning: Hail, hail to the One God, who has completely crushed the pride of the serpent of lust. You are the lamp that illuminates the world of devotion for your devotees, dispelling all suffering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव अद्वितीय। परिणतोपरमैकप्रिय। निजजनजित भजनीय। मायागम्य॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva advitīya| pariṇatoparamaikapriya| nijajanajita bhajanīya| māyāgamya|| 9||
verses.meaning: Hail, hail to the unique God, who is the beloved of the supreme Self, conquered by His own devotees, and accessible through Maya.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयजय देव श्रीगुरो।) अकल्पनाख्यकल्पतरो। स्वसंबिद्द्रुमबीजप्ररोे-। हणावनी॥ १०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayajaya deva śrīguro|) akalpanākhyakalpataro| svasaṃbiddrumabījapraroe-| haṇāvanī|| 10||
verses.meaning: Hail, all hail, O Lord, my Guru! You are the wish-fulfilling tree of inconceivable knowledge, the very ground for the sprouting of the seed of self-realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें काय एकैक ऐसैसें। नानापरिभाषावशें। स्तोत्र करूं तुजोद्देशें । निर्विशेषा ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ kāya ekaika aisaiseṃ| nānāparibhāṣāvaśeṃ| stotra karūṃ tujoddeśeṃ | nirviśeṣā || 19||
verses.meaning: How can I, in my limited capacity, offer a hymn of praise to You, the attributeless One, using various languages and expressions?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिहीं विशेषणीं बिशेषिजे। तें दृश्य नव्हे रूप तुझें। हें जाणें मी म्हणौनि लाजें। वानणां इहीं ॥१२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jihīṃ viśeṣaṇīṃ biśeṣije| teṃ dṛśya navhe rūpa tujheṃ| heṃ jāṇeṃ mī mhaṇauni lājeṃ| vānaṇāṃ ihīṃ ||12||
verses.meaning: The attributes by which You are described, are not Your true form. Knowing this, I am ashamed to describe You with these words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी मर्यादेचा सागरु। हा तंवचि तया डगरु। जंब न देखे सुधाकरु । उदया आला ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī maryādecā sāgaru| hā taṃvaci tayā ḍagaru| jaṃba na dekhe sudhākaru | udayā ālā || 13||
verses.meaning: The ocean of limitations, however, is a formidable obstacle only until the moon rises.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सोमकांतु निजनिर्झरीं। चंद्रा अर्घ्यादिक न करी तें तोचि अवधारीं। करवी कीं जी॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: somakāṃtu nijanirjharīṃ| caṃdrā arghyādika na karī teṃ toci avadhārīṃ| karavī kīṃ jī|| 14||
verses.meaning: Just as the moonstone, by its very nature, causes its own essence to flow forth, yet does not offer oblations to the moon, so too, O Lord, does He Himself bring about all actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नेणों कैसी वसंतसंगें। अवचितिया वृक्षाची अंगें। फुटती तैं हें तयांही जोगें। धरणें नोहे॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: neṇoṃ kaisī vasaṃtasaṃgeṃ| avacitiyā vṛkṣācī aṃgeṃ| phuṭatī taiṃ heṃ tayāṃhī jogeṃ| dharaṇeṃ nohe|| 15||
verses.meaning: Just as trees unexpectedly burst forth with new life in the company of spring, so too is it not appropriate for them to hold back their blossoming.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'पद्मिनी रविकिरण । लाहे मग लाजे कवण कां जळें शिवतळें लवण । आंग भुलें॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'padminī ravikiraṇa | lāhe maga lāje kavaṇa kāṃ jaḻeṃ śivataḻeṃ lavaṇa | āṃga bhuleṃ|| 16||
verses.meaning: Just as the lotus blossoms upon receiving the sun's rays, and water merges with salt, losing its separate identity, so too does the individual soul become absorbed in the divine, forgetting its own distinct existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा तूंतें जेथ मी स्मरें। तेथ मीपण मी विसरें। मग जाकळिला ढेंकरें। तृप्तु जैसा ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā tūṃteṃ jetha mī smareṃ| tetha mīpaṇa mī visareṃ| maga jākaḻilā ḍheṃkareṃ| tṛptu jaisā || 17||
verses.meaning: Just as I remember You, I forget my own self. Then, like one who is fully satisfied and burps, I am completely content.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज तुवां जी केलें तेसें। माझें मीपण दवडूनि देशें। स्तुतिमिषेंच पां पिसें। बांधलें बाचे॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja tuvāṃ jī keleṃ teseṃ| mājheṃ mīpaṇa davaḍūni deśeṃ| stutimiṣeṃca pāṃ piseṃ| bāṃdhaleṃ bāce|| 18||
verses.meaning: You have made me such that, by dispelling my ego, you have, as it were, bound my speech with the pretext of praise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना एऱ्हवीं तरी आठवीं । राहोनि स्तुति जें करावी । तैं गुणागुणिया धरावी । सरोभरी कीं ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā eṟhavīṃ tarī āṭhavīṃ | rāhoni stuti jeṃ karāvī | taiṃ guṇāguṇiyā dharāvī | sarobharī kīṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, if one were to praise by remembering, then one would have to consider both merits and demerits equally.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तूं जी एकरसाचें लिंग) केवीं करूं गुणागुणीं विभाग। मोतीं फोडोनि सांधितां चांग। कीं तैसेंचि भळें॥ २०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tūṃ jī ekarasāceṃ liṃga) kevīṃ karūṃ guṇāguṇīṃ vibhāga| motīṃ phoḍoni sāṃdhitāṃ cāṃga| kīṃ taiseṃci bhaḻeṃ|| 20||
verses.meaning: How then can I divide into good and bad, that which is a singular essence? Is it good to break a pearl and then mend it, or is it better as it is?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि बाप तूं माय। इहीं बोली ना स्तुति होय। डिंभोपाधिक आहे । विटाळु तेथें ॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi bāpa tūṃ māya| ihīṃ bolī nā stuti hoya| ḍiṃbhopādhika āhe | viṭāḻu tetheṃ || 21||
verses.meaning: And You are the Father, You are the Mother. Such words cannot praise You, for they are tainted by the limitations of the physical form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी जालेनि पाइकें आलें। तें गोसावीपण केवीं बोळें। ऐसें उपाधी उशिटळें। काय वर्णू ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī jāleni pāikeṃ āleṃ| teṃ gosāvīpaṇa kevīṃ boḻeṃ| aiseṃ upādhī uśiṭaḻeṃ| kāya varṇū || 22||
verses.meaning: How can one describe the state of being a master, which is attained through service? Such is the defiled nature of worldly attachments; what can I say about it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आत्मा तूं एकसरा। हेंही म्हणतां दातारा। तरी आंतुल तूं बाहेरा । घापतासी ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātmā tūṃ ekasarā| heṃhī mhaṇatāṃ dātārā| tarī āṃtula tūṃ bāherā | ghāpatāsī || 23||
verses.meaning: Even if you say, "O Lord, You alone are the Self," you are still confining the inner Self to the outer, thereby limiting it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सत्यचि तुजलागीं। स्तुति न देखों जी जगीं। मौनावांचूनि लेणें आंगीं । सुसीना मा॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni satyaci tujalāgīṃ| stuti na dekhoṃ jī jagīṃ| maunāvāṃcūni leṇeṃ āṃgīṃ | susīnā mā|| 24||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for you, I see no praise in the world. Besides silence, no adornment suits your being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्तुती कांहीं न बोलणें । पूजा कांहीं न करणे। सन्निधी कांहीं न होणें। तुझ्या ठायीं ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: stutī kāṃhīṃ na bolaṇeṃ | pūjā kāṃhīṃ na karaṇe| sannidhī kāṃhīṃ na hoṇeṃ| tujhyā ṭhāyīṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: No praise is spoken, no worship is offered, no presence is felt in You.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जिंतलें जैसें भुली। पिसें आलापु घाली । तैसें वानूं तें माउली । उपसाहावें तुवां ॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jiṃtaleṃ jaiseṃ bhulī| piseṃ ālāpu ghālī | taiseṃ vānūṃ teṃ māulī | upasāhāveṃ tuvāṃ || 26||
verses.meaning: Just as one who is deluded or mad utters incoherent words, so too, Mother, I will describe it; please bear with me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां गीतार्थाची मुक्‍तमुदी। लावीं माझिये वाग्वृद्धी। जे माने हे सभासदीं। सज्जनांच्या ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ gītārthācī muk‍tamudī| lāvīṃ mājhiye vāgvṛddhī| je māne he sabhāsadīṃ| sajjanāṃcyā || 27||
verses.meaning: Now, with the seal of the Gita's meaning, I shall adorn my speech, so that it may be honored in this assembly of noble souls.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ म्हणितलें श्रीनिवृत्ती। नको हें पुढतपुढती । परिसीं लोहा घृष्टी किती। वेळवेळां कौजे गा॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha mhaṇitaleṃ śrīnivṛttī| nako heṃ puḍhatapuḍhatī | parisīṃ lohā ghṛṣṭī kitī| veḻaveḻāṃ kauje gā|| 28||
verses.meaning: There, Shri Nivrutti said, "Do not repeat this again and again. How many times can you rub iron with a touchstone?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब विनवी ज्ञानदेवो। म्हणे हो कां जी पसाबो। तरी अवधान देतु देवो। ग्रंथा आतां॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba vinavī jñānadevo| mhaṇe ho kāṃ jī pasābo| tarī avadhāna detu devo| graṃthā ātāṃ|| 29||
verses.meaning: Dnyandev humbly requests, "May there be grace, O Lord, and may you now grant your attention to this scripture."

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी गीतारलप्रासादाचा। कळसु अर्थचिंतामणीचा। सर्व गीतादर्शनाचा। पाढाऊं जो॥३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī gītāralaprāsādācā| kaḻasu arthaciṃtāmaṇīcā| sarva gītādarśanācā| pāḍhāūṃ jo||30||
verses.meaning: This Dnyaneshwari ovi, like the pinnacle of a grand palace, is the wish-fulfilling jewel of meaning, and a foundational text for understanding the entire Bhagavad Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लोकीं तरी आथी ऐसें। जे दुरूनि 'कळसु दिसे। आणि भेटीचि हातवसे। देवतेची तिये॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: lokīṃ tarī āthī aiseṃ| je durūni 'kaḻasu dise| āṇi bheṭīci hātavase| devatecī tiye|| 31||
verses.meaning: In the world, it is seen that from a distance, the pinnacle of a temple is visible, and that sight itself is like meeting the deity within.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसेंचि एथही आहे। जे एकेंचि येणें अध्यायें। आघवाचि दृष्ट होये । गीतागमु हा ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃci ethahī āhe| je ekeṃci yeṇeṃ adhyāyeṃ| āghavāci dṛṣṭa hoye | gītāgamu hā || 32||
verses.meaning: Similarly, here too, by this single chapter, the entire essence of the Gita becomes clear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी कळसु याचि कारणें। अठरावा अध्यायो म्हणें। उवाइला बादरायणें। गीताप्रासादा॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī kaḻasu yāci kāraṇeṃ| aṭharāvā adhyāyo mhaṇeṃ| uvāilā bādarāyaṇeṃ| gītāprāsādā|| 33||
verses.meaning: For this very reason, I say that the eighteenth chapter was composed by Badarayana as the pinnacle of the Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नोहे कळसापरतें कांहीं। प्रासादीं काम नाहीं। तें सांगतसे गीता ही। संपलेपणें॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nohe kaḻasāparateṃ kāṃhīṃ| prāsādīṃ kāma nāhīṃ| teṃ sāṃgatase gītā hī| saṃpalepaṇeṃ|| 34||
verses.meaning: There is nothing beyond the pinnacle; the temple's work is complete. This is what the Gita declares, in its entirety.

verses.shloka_devanagari: व्यासु सहजें सूत्री बळी । तेणें निगमरत्नाचळीं । उपनिषदर्थाची माळी-। माजीं खांडिली॥३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: vyāsu sahajeṃ sūtrī baḻī | teṇeṃ nigamaratnācaḻīṃ | upaniṣadarthācī māḻī-| mājīṃ khāṃḍilī||35||
verses.meaning: Vyasa, with his inherent strength in sutras, strung together the Upanishadic meanings like a garland from the mountain of Vedic jewels.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ त्रिवर्गाचा अणुआरु। आडऊ निघाला जो अपारु। तो महाभारतप्राकारु । भोंबता केला॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha trivargācā aṇuāru| āḍaū nighālā jo apāru| to mahābhārataprākāru | bhoṃbatā kelā|| 36||
verses.meaning: There, the immeasurable and boundless one, who emerged as the very atom of the three goals of human life (dharma, artha, kama), became the surrounding wall of the Mahabharata.

verses.shloka_devanagari: माजीं आत्मज्ञानाचे एकवट। दळवाडें झाडूनि चोखट । घडिलें पार्थबैकुंठ- । संवाद कुसरी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājīṃ ātmajñānāce ekavaṭa| daḻavāḍeṃ jhāḍūni cokhaṭa | ghaḍileṃ pārthabaikuṃṭha- | saṃvāda kusarī || 37||
verses.meaning: From my own spiritual knowledge, I have meticulously crafted this pure and excellent discourse, the Bhagavad Gita, as a dialogue between Arjuna and Krishna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निवृत्तिसूत्र सोडवणिया । सर्व शास्त्रार्थ पुरवणिया। आवो साधिला मांडणिया । मोक्षरेखेचा ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nivṛttisūtra soḍavaṇiyā | sarva śāstrārtha puravaṇiyā| āvo sādhilā māṃḍaṇiyā | mokṣarekhecā || 38||
verses.meaning: He, who unravels the thread of renunciation, who fulfills the essence of all scriptures, has prepared the foundation for the path to liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि करितां उभारा । पंधरा अध्यायांत पंधरा । भूमी निर्वाळलिया पुरा । प्रासादु जाहला ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni karitāṃ ubhārā | paṃdharā adhyāyāṃta paṃdharā | bhūmī nirvāḻaliyā purā | prāsādu jāhalā || 39||
verses.meaning: Thus, by erecting this structure, the fifteen chapters, like the purified ground, have become a temple.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उपरि सोळावा अध्यायो। तो ग्रीवेघंटेचा आवो । सप्तदशु तोचि ठावो । पडघाणिये ॥ ४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: upari soḻāvā adhyāyo| to grīveghaṃṭecā āvo | saptadaśu toci ṭhāvo | paḍaghāṇiye || 40||
verses.meaning: The sixteenth chapter is like the bell of the throat. The seventeenth is the place of the reverberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाहीवरी अष्टादशु। तो अपैसा मांडला कळसु। उपरि गीतादिकीं व्यासु। ध्वजें लागला ॥ ४१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāhīvarī aṣṭādaśu| to apaisā māṃḍalā kaḻasu| upari gītādikīṃ vyāsu| dhvajeṃ lāgalā || 419||
verses.meaning: Above all, the eighteen chapters of the Gita are like a beautifully erected pinnacle, and Vyasa, through his composition of the Gita, has placed a flag upon it.
