verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sakaḻa bhāgyācī sīmā | mokṣalābhācī jeṃ pramā| nānā karmamārgaśramā | śevaṭu jetha|| 1||
verses.meaning: That which is the ultimate limit of all good fortune, the measure of attaining liberation, and the culmination of the efforts of various paths of action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोक्षफळें दिधली बोळ। जें सुकृततरूचें फूल। तयें वैराग्यीं ठेवी 'पाऊल। भंवबरु जैसा॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: mokṣaphaḻeṃ didhalī boḻa| jeṃ sukṛtatarūceṃ phūla| tayeṃ vairāgyīṃ ṭhevī 'pāūla| bhaṃvabaru jaisā|| 2||
verses.meaning: The fruit of liberation was given as a farewell gift, which is the flower of the tree of good deeds. Upon that detachment, one should place their foot, like a bumblebee.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहीं आत्मज्ञानसुदिनाचा। वाधावा सांगतया अरुणाचा। उदयो त्या वैराग्याचा। ठावो पावे॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhīṃ ātmajñānasudinācā| vādhāvā sāṃgatayā aruṇācā| udayo tyā vairāgyācā| ṭhāvo pāve|| 3||
verses.meaning: Behold the dawn of self-knowledge, the rising sun that heralds its arrival. It is the very place where dispassion (vairagya) takes its stand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना आत्मज्ञान । जेणें हाता ये निधान तें वैराग्य दिव्यांजन । जीवें ळे तो॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā ātmajñāna | jeṇeṃ hātā ye nidhāna teṃ vairāgya divyāṃjana | jīveṃ ḻe to|| 4||
verses.meaning: In fact, spiritual knowledge is the treasure that comes into one's hands. That detachment is the divine collyrium, which one applies to their eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी मोक्षाची योग्यता । सिल्धी जाय तया पंडुसुता । अनुसरोनि विहिता। कर्मा यया ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī mokṣācī yogyatā | sildhī jāya tayā paṃḍusutā | anusaroni vihitā| karmā yayā || 5||
verses.meaning: Such is the worthiness of liberation, O son of Pandu, that it is attained by following the prescribed actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें विहित कर्म पांडवा । आपुला अनन्य बोलावा । आणि हेचि परम सेवा । मज सर्वात्मकाची ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ vihita karma pāṃḍavā | āpulā ananya bolāvā | āṇi heci parama sevā | maja sarvātmakācī || 6||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, this prescribed action is your unique calling, and this alone is the supreme service to Me, the Self of all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आघवाचि भोगेंसीं । पतित्रता क्रीडे प्रियेंसीं । कीं 'तयाचीं नामें जैसीं। तपें तियां केलीं ॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āghavāci bhogeṃsīṃ | patitratā krīḍe priyeṃsīṃ | kīṃ 'tayācīṃ nāmeṃ jaisīṃ| tapeṃ tiyāṃ kelīṃ ||7||
verses.meaning: Just as a devoted wife delights in her beloved, so too do these devotees find joy in their spiritual practices, which are like chanting the names of the Lord.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां बाळका एकी माये-। बांचोनि जिणें काय आहे । म्हणौनि सेविजे कौं तो होये । पाटाचा धर्मु॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ bāḻakā ekī māye-| bāṃconi jiṇeṃ kāya āhe | mhaṇauni sevije kauṃ to hoye | pāṭācā dharmu|| 8||
verses.meaning: What life is there for a child without its mother? Therefore, one should serve the husband, for that is the duty of a wife.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना ना पाणी म्हणौनि मासा । गंगा न सांडितां जैसा । सर्व तीर्थ सहवासा। बरपडा जाला॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā nā pāṇī mhaṇauni māsā | gaṃgā na sāṃḍitāṃ jaisā | sarva tīrtha sahavāsā| barapaḍā jālā|| 9||
verses.meaning: Just as a fish, without leaving the Ganga, does not say "no, no water," and thus experiences the company of all holy places.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें आपुलिया विहिता। उपायो असे न विसंबितां। ऐसा कौोजे कीं जगन्नाथा) आभारु पडे॥ ९१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ āpuliyā vihitā| upāyo ase na visaṃbitāṃ| aisā kauoje kīṃ jagannāthā) ābhāru paḍe|| 910||
verses.meaning: Just as one's prescribed duties, when performed without neglect, become a means (to liberation), so too, O Lord of the Universe, does this (devotion) become a burden (of gratitude upon You).

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा जया जें विहित । तें ईश्वराचे मनोगत। म्हणौनि केलिया निभ्रांत। सांपडेचि तो॥ ९११॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā jayā jeṃ vihita | teṃ īśvarāce manogata| mhaṇauni keliyā nibhrāṃta| sāṃpaḍeci to|| 911||
verses.meaning: Whatever is ordained for a person, that is the divine will of God. Therefore, by undoubtedly performing it, one attains Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जीवाचे कसीं उतरली । ते दासी कीं गोसांबीण जाली। सिसे वेंचि तया मविली। बही जेवीं॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jīvāce kasīṃ utaralī | te dāsī kīṃ gosāṃbīṇa jālī| sise veṃci tayā mavilī| bahī jevīṃ|| 12||
verses.meaning: How did the soul descend into the body? It became a servant or a mistress. It was molded by the lead, just as a sister would be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें स्वामीचिया मनोभावा। न चुकिजे हेचि परमसेवा। येर तें गा पांडवा । वाणिज्य करणें॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ svāmīciyā manobhāvā| na cukije heci paramasevā| yera teṃ gā pāṃḍavā | vāṇijya karaṇeṃ|| 13||
verses.meaning: Similarly, not deviating from the Lord's inner intention is the highest service. All else, O Pandava, is merely a transaction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि विहित क्रिया केली । नव्हे तयाची खूण पाळिली । जयापासूनि कां आलीं । आकारा भूतें॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vihita kriyā kelī | navhe tayācī khūṇa pāḻilī | jayāpāsūni kāṃ ālīṃ | ākārā bhūteṃ|| 94||
verses.meaning: Therefore, performing prescribed actions is not a sign of having observed the true nature of that from which all beings came into existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो अविद्येचिया चिंधिया । गुंडूनि जीव बाहुलिया। खेळवीतसे तिगुणिया। अहंकाररजू॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo avidyeciyā ciṃdhiyā | guṃḍūni jīva bāhuliyā| kheḻavītase tiguṇiyā| ahaṃkārarajū|| 15||
verses.meaning: He, who, with the rags of ignorance, fashions the doll of the individual soul, and makes it play with the three qualities, is the ego-thread.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें जग हें समस्त । आंत बाहेरी पूर्ण भरित। जालें आहे दीपजात। तेजें जैसें ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ jaga heṃ samasta | āṃta bāherī pūrṇa bharita| jāleṃ āhe dīpajāta| tejeṃ jaiseṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: By which this entire world, within and without, is completely filled, just as a lamp's light fills everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया सर्वात्मका ईश्वरा । स्वकर्मकुसुमांची वीरा । पूजा केली होय अपारा । तोषालागीं ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā sarvātmakā īśvarā | svakarmakusumāṃcī vīrā | pūjā kelī hoya apārā | toṣālāgīṃ || 17||
verses.meaning: O, all-pervading God, this worship of countless flowers of my own actions is offered to You for Your satisfaction.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तिये पूजे। रिझलेनि आत्मराजें। वैराग्यसिन्यि देईजे | पसाय तया ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tiye pūje| rijhaleni ātmarājeṃ| vairāgyasinyi deīje | pasāya tayā || 18||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the Self-King, pleased by this worship, bestows upon that ascetic the grace of spiritual liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिये वैराग्यदशें । ईश्वराचेनि वेधवशें । हें सर्वही नावडे जैसें।॥ वांत होय ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiye vairāgyadaśeṃ | īśvarāceni vedhavaśeṃ | heṃ sarvahī nāvaḍe jaiseṃ||| vāṃta hoya || 19||
verses.meaning: When, by the influence of devotion to God, one reaches a state of detachment, everything in the world becomes as unappealing as vomit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्राणनाथाचिया आधी । विरहणीतें जिणेंही बाधी। तैसें सुखजात त्रिशुद्धी। दुःखचि लागे॥ ९२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: prāṇanāthāciyā ādhī | virahaṇīteṃ jiṇeṃhī bādhī| taiseṃ sukhajāta triśuddhī| duḥkhaci lāge|| 920||
verses.meaning: Just as a separated lover suffers even in life without her beloved, so too, all worldly pleasures ultimately lead to sorrow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सम्यकज्ञान नुदैजतां। वेधेंचि तन्मयता । उपजे ऐसी योग्यता। बोधाची लाहे॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: samyakajñāna nudaijatāṃ| vedheṃci tanmayatā | upaje aisī yogyatā| bodhācī lāhe|| 29||
verses.meaning: Without the rise of perfect knowledge, through mere absorption, such a capacity for enlightenment is attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मोक्षलाभालागीं। जो व्रतें बाहातसे आंगीं । तेणें स्वधर्म आस्था चांगी। अनुष्ठावा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mokṣalābhālāgīṃ| jo vrateṃ bāhātase āṃgīṃ | teṇeṃ svadharma āsthā cāṃgī| anuṣṭhāvā|| 22||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for the attainment of liberation, one who undertakes vows should diligently practice their own dharma with great faith.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा आपुला हा स्वधर्मु) आचरणीं जरी विषमु। तरी पाहावा तो ४६६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी परिणामु। फळेल जेणें ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā āpulā hā svadharmu) ācaraṇīṃ jarī viṣamu| tarī pāhāvā to 466 śrījñāneśvarī pariṇāmu| phaḻela jeṇeṃ || 23||
verses.meaning: Even if one's own Dharma (righteous duty) seems difficult to practice, one should still observe its outcome, for it will surely bear fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैं सुखालागीं आपणपयां। निंबचि आथी धनंजया । तैं कडुबटपणा तयाचिया । उबगिजेना ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiṃ sukhālāgīṃ āpaṇapayāṃ| niṃbaci āthī dhanaṃjayā | taiṃ kaḍubaṭapaṇā tayāciyā | ubagijenā || 24||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, when the neem tree itself is the source of its bitterness, then one does not get annoyed by its bitter taste.

verses.shloka_devanagari: फळणया ऐलीकडे । केळीतें पाहातां आस मोडे । ऐसी त्यजिली तरी जोडे । तेसें कें गोमटें ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: phaḻaṇayā ailīkaḍe | keḻīteṃ pāhātāṃ āsa moḍe | aisī tyajilī tarī joḍe | teseṃ keṃ gomaṭeṃ || 25||
verses.meaning: Before the banana tree bears fruit, if one looks at it, hope is lost. But if it is abandoned, then it yields fruit. How beautiful is that!

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं स्वधर्मु सांकडु। देखोनि केला जरी कडु । तरी मोक्षसुरवाडु । अंतरला कौं॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ svadharmu sāṃkaḍu| dekhoni kelā jarī kaḍu | tarī mokṣasuravāḍu | aṃtaralā kauṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: Similarly, if one finds their own dharma (duty/nature) difficult and makes it bitter, how can they attain the joy of liberation?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आपुली माये। कुब्ज जरी आहे। तरी जीये तें नोहे। स्नेह कुऱहें कौं५€ २७॥ येरी जिया पराविया। रंभेहूनिे बरविया। तिया काय कराविया। बाळकें तेणें ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi āpulī māye| kubja jarī āhe| tarī jīye teṃ nohe| sneha kuṟaheṃ kauṃ5€ 27|| yerī jiyā parāviyā| raṃbhehūnie baraviyā| tiyā kāya karāviyā| bāḻakeṃ teṇeṃ || 28||
verses.meaning: And even if one's own mother is like Kubja (ugly and deformed), she is not to be abandoned, for her love is true and deep. What good are other women, even if more beautiful than Rambha, to a child?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा पाणियाहूनि बहुवें। तुपीं गुण कीर आहे। परी मीना काय होये। असणें तेथ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā pāṇiyāhūni bahuveṃ| tupīṃ guṇa kīra āhe| parī mīnā kāya hoye| asaṇeṃ tetha|| 29||
verses.meaning: Indeed, ghee possesses more qualities than water. But what good is that to a fish, to reside there?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आघविया जगा जें विख॥ तें विख कोडियाचें पीयूख। आणि जगा गुळ तें देख। मरण तया ॥ ९३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āghaviyā jagā jeṃ vikha|| teṃ vikha koḍiyāceṃ pīyūkha| āṇi jagā guḻa teṃ dekha| maraṇa tayā || 930||
verses.meaning: Indeed, what is poison to the entire world, that poison is nectar to the one who understands its true nature. And what is sweet to the world, that indeed brings death to such a one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि जें विहित जया जेणें । फिटे संसाराचें धरणें । क्रिया कठोर तऱही तेणें । तेचि करावी॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni jeṃ vihita jayā jeṇeṃ | phiṭe saṃsārāceṃ dharaṇeṃ | kriyā kaṭhora taṟahī teṇeṃ | teci karāvī|| 31||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever is prescribed for a person, by which the bondage of worldly existence is broken, even if that action is difficult, it alone should be performed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरा पराचारा बरविया। ऐसें होईल टेंकलेया । पायांचें चालणें डोड्या । केलें जैसें ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yerā parācārā baraviyā| aiseṃ hoīla ṭeṃkaleyā | pāyāṃceṃ cālaṇeṃ ḍoḍyā | keleṃ jaiseṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: When one leans on the support of others, it is like the legs of a lame person being made to walk.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं कर्म आपुलें । जें जातिस्वभावें असे आलें। तें करी तेणें जिंतिळें। कर्मबंधातें॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ karma āpuleṃ | jeṃ jātisvabhāveṃ ase āleṃ| teṃ karī teṇeṃ jiṃtiḻeṃ| karmabaṃdhāteṃ|| 33||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one who performs their own actions, which come naturally from their inherent nature, conquers the bondage of karma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि स्वधर्मुचि पाळावा। परधर्मु तो गाळावा । हा नेमुही पांडवा। न कौजेचि पैं गा॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi svadharmuci pāḻāvā| paradharmu to gāḻāvā | hā nemuhī pāṃḍavā| na kaujeci paiṃ gā|| 34||
verses.meaning: And one should only follow their own dharma, and abandon the dharma of others. This rule, O Pandava, should not be observed at all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी आत्मा दृष्ट नोहे। तंव कर्म करणें कां ठाये। आणि करणें तेथ आहे। आयासु आधीं॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī ātmā dṛṣṭa nohe| taṃva karma karaṇeṃ kāṃ ṭhāye| āṇi karaṇeṃ tetha āhe| āyāsu ādhīṃ|| 35||
verses.meaning: As long as the Self is not perceived, actions will continue to be performed. And where there is action, there is effort and hardship.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भलतिये कर्मी । आयासु जऱ्ही उपक्रमीं। तरी काय स्वधर्मी । दोषु सांगे ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhalatiye karmī | āyāsu jaṟhī upakramīṃ| tarī kāya svadharmī | doṣu sāṃge || 36||
verses.meaning: Therefore, if any action, even at its inception, involves effort, then tell me, what fault is there in one's own prescribed duty?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आगा उजू वाटा चालावें। तऱही पा्यचे शिणवावे। आडरानें धांवावें । तऱही तेंचि ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āgā ujū vāṭā cālāveṃ| taṟahī pāyace śiṇavāve| āḍarāneṃ dhāṃvāveṃ | taṟahī teṃci || 37||
verses.meaning: Whether one walks on a straight path, the feet will still tire. Even if one runs through a thorny wilderness, the same applies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं शिळा कां सिदोरिया। दाटणें एक धनंजया । परी जें बाहतां विसांवया । मिळिजे तें घेपे॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ śiḻā kāṃ sidoriyā| dāṭaṇeṃ eka dhanaṃjayā | parī jeṃ bāhatāṃ visāṃvayā | miḻije teṃ ghepe|| 38||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, a stone and a lump of food are both dense. But that which offers rest and sustenance is accepted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं कणा आणि भूसा। कांडितांही सोसु सरिसा। जेंचि रंधन श्‍वान मांसा। तेंचि हवी॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ kaṇā āṇi bhūsā| kāṃḍitāṃhī sosu sarisā| jeṃci raṃdhana ś‍vāna māṃsā| teṃci havī|| 39||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, husk and grain, when threshed, bear the same burden. The cooking of dog meat is the same as a sacrificial offering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दधी जळाचिया घुसळणा। व्यापार सारिखेचि विचक्षणा । वाळुवे तिळा घाणा । गाळणें एक॥ ९४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: dadhī jaḻāciyā ghusaḻaṇā| vyāpāra sārikheci vicakṣaṇā | vāḻuve tiḻā ghāṇā | gāḻaṇeṃ eka|| 940||
verses.meaning: Churning water is like churning curds; it's a futile effort for the wise. Similarly, pressing sand for oil in a mill is like sifting it for sesame seeds—both are equally pointless.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं नित्य होम देयावया। कां सैरा आगी सुवाबया। फुंकितां धू धनंजया । साहणें तेंचि॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ nitya homa deyāvayā| kāṃ sairā āgī suvābayā| phuṃkitāṃ dhū dhanaṃjayā | sāhaṇeṃ teṃci|| 41||
verses.meaning: Just as one must endure the smoke when performing a daily fire ritual or when blowing on a fire to ignite it, so too must one endure the difficulties that arise in spiritual practice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी धर्मपत्नी धांगडी । पोसितां जरी एकी बोढी। तरी कां अपरवबडी । आणावी आंगा॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī dharmapatnī dhāṃgaḍī | positāṃ jarī ekī boḍhī| tarī kāṃ aparavabaḍī | āṇāvī āṃgā|| 42||
verses.meaning: If one has a faithful wife, even if she is simple and uneducated, why should one bring another woman into their life?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा पाठीं लागळा घाई। मरण न चुकेचि पाहीं। तरी समोरला काई । आगळें न कौजे॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā pāṭhīṃ lāgaḻā ghāī| maraṇa na cukeci pāhīṃ| tarī samoralā kāī | āgaḻeṃ na kauje|| 43||
verses.meaning: Indeed, death relentlessly pursues, it cannot be avoided. So why fear what is before you?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुळस्त्री दांड्याचे घाये । परघर रिगालीही जरी साहे। तरी स्वपतीतें वायें। सांडिलें कों॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuḻastrī dāṃḍyāce ghāye | paraghara rigālīhī jarī sāhe| tarī svapatīteṃ vāyeṃ| sāṃḍileṃ koṃ|| 44||
verses.meaning: Just as a chaste wife, even if beaten by her husband and forced to enter another's house, would never abandon her own husband, so too the true devotee remains steadfast.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसें आवडतेंही करणें॥ न निपजे शिणल्याविणें। तरी विहित बा रे कोणें । बोलें भारी॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teseṃ āvaḍateṃhī karaṇeṃ|| na nipaje śiṇalyāviṇeṃ| tarī vihita bā re koṇeṃ | boleṃ bhārī|| 45||
verses.meaning: Just as even a beloved task cannot be accomplished without effort, how then can one speak of the weight of prescribed duties?

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरी थोडेंचि अमृत घेतां। सर्वस्व वेंचो कां पंडुसुता । जेणें जोडे जीविता। अक्षय्यत्व॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: varī thoḍeṃci amṛta ghetāṃ| sarvasva veṃco kāṃ paṃḍusutā | jeṇeṃ joḍe jīvitā| akṣayyatva|| 46||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, even if one has to sacrifice everything to obtain a little bit of this nectar, it is worth it, for it bestows eternal life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर काह्यां मोलें वेंचूनि। विष पियावें घेऊनि । आत्महत्येसि निमोनि। जायिजे जेणें ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera kāhyāṃ moleṃ veṃcūni| viṣa piyāveṃ gheūni | ātmahatyesi nimoni| jāyije jeṇeṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, by paying a price, one drinks poison, and by committing suicide, one perishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जाचूनियां इंद्रियें वेचूनि आयुष्याचेनि दियें। सांचळे पापी आन आहे । दुःखावांचूनि॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jācūniyāṃ iṃdriyeṃ vecūni āyuṣyāceni diyeṃ| sāṃcaḻe pāpī āna āhe | duḥkhāvāṃcūni|| 48||
verses.meaning: Similarly, by tormenting the senses and spending the days of one's life, what else does a sinner accumulate but sorrow?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि करावा स्वधर्मु। जो करितां हिरोनि घे श्रमु। उचित देईल परमु। पुरुषार्थराजु॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni karāvā svadharmu| jo karitāṃ hironi ghe śramu| ucita deīla paramu| puruṣārtharāju|| 49||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one should perform their own dharma, which, when done, removes all weariness and bestows the supreme reward, the king of all human endeavors.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें किरीटी । स्वधर्माचिये राहाटी । न विसंबिजे संकटीं । सिद्धमंत्र जैसा ॥ ९५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ kirīṭī | svadharmāciye rāhāṭī | na visaṃbije saṃkaṭīṃ | siddhamaṃtra jaisā || 950||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, in the practice of one's own dharma, one should not abandon it even in times of crisis, just as a potent mantra is never forsaken.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां नाव जैसी उदधीं । महारोगीं दिव्यौषधी । न विसंबिजे तया बुद्धी। स्वकर्म येथ ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ nāva jaisī udadhīṃ | mahārogīṃ divyauṣadhī | na visaṃbije tayā buddhī| svakarma yetha || 51||
verses.meaning: Just as a boat is for crossing the ocean, or a divine medicine for a great illness, so too should one's own prescribed duties not be abandoned by such wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग ययाचि गा कपिध्वजा। स्वकर्माचिया महापूजा। तोषला ईशु तमरजा। झाडा करुनी॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga yayāci gā kapidhvajā| svakarmāciyā mahāpūjā| toṣalā īśu tamarajā| jhāḍā karunī|| 52||
verses.meaning: Then, O Arjuna, by the great worship of his own actions, the Lord, having cleared away the darkness of ignorance, was pleased.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शुद्धसत्त्वाचिया वाटा । आणी आपुली उत्कंठा । भव स्वर्ग काळकूटा। ऐसें दाबी ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: śuddhasattvāciyā vāṭā | āṇī āpulī utkaṃṭhā | bhava svarga kāḻakūṭā| aiseṃ dābī || 53||
verses.meaning: He shows the path of pure sattva, and His own eagerness, as if the world and heaven are like a deadly poison.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जियें वैराग्य येणें बोलें। मागां संसिद्धी रूप केलें। किंबहुना तें आपुलें। मेळवी खागें ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jiyeṃ vairāgya yeṇeṃ boleṃ| māgāṃ saṃsiddhī rūpa keleṃ| kiṃbahunā teṃ āpuleṃ| meḻavī khāgeṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: The renunciation that was previously described as a perfected state, in short, merges with one's own true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग जिंतिलिया हे भोये । पुरुष सर्वत्र जैसा होये। कां जालाही जें लाहे। तें आतां सांगों ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga jiṃtiliyā he bhoye | puruṣa sarvatra jaisā hoye| kāṃ jālāhī jeṃ lāhe| teṃ ātāṃ sāṃgoṃ || 55||
verses.meaning: Then, what the Purusha (the Supreme Being) attains, having conquered everything, or what He inherently possesses everywhere, that I shall now explain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी देहादिक हें संसारें। सर्वही मांडलेंसे जें गुफिरें। तेथ नातुडे तो वागुरें। वारा जैसा ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī dehādika heṃ saṃsāreṃ| sarvahī māṃḍaleṃse jeṃ guphireṃ| tetha nātuḍe to vāgureṃ| vārā jaisā || 56||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind cannot be caught in a net, so too the Self cannot be ensnared by the body and the world, which are but a tangled web of illusions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं परिपाकाचिये वेळे। फळ देठें ना देठु फळें । न धरे तैसें स्नेह खुळें । सर्वत्र होय ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ paripākāciye veḻe| phaḻa deṭheṃ nā deṭhu phaḻeṃ | na dhare taiseṃ sneha khuḻeṃ | sarvatra hoya || 57||
verses.meaning: When the fruit ripens, the stem does not hold the fruit, nor does the fruit hold the stem. Similarly, this love becomes boundless, encompassing everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुत्र वित्त कलत्र। हे जालियाही स्वतंत्र । माझें न म्हणे पात्र। विषाचें जैसें ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: putra vitta kalatra| he jāliyāhī svataṃtra | mājheṃ na mhaṇe pātra| viṣāceṃ jaiseṃ || 58||
verses.meaning: Even if one possesses sons, wealth, and a wife, if one considers them independent of the divine, they are like a vessel of poison.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो विषयजाती। बुद्धी पोळली ऐसी माघौती । पाउलें घेऊनि एकांतीं । हृदयाच्या रिगे॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso viṣayajātī| buddhī poḻalī aisī māghautī | pāuleṃ gheūni ekāṃtīṃ | hṛdayācyā rige|| 59||
verses.meaning: Let this be. When the intellect is thus scorched by worldly pleasures, it withdraws, taking steps back into the solitude of the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसया अंत:करण । बाह्य येतां तयाची आण। न मोडी समर्था भेण। दासी जैसी॥ ९६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisayā aṃta:karaṇa | bāhya yetāṃ tayācī āṇa| na moḍī samarthā bheṇa| dāsī jaisī|| 960||
verses.meaning: Such a mind, when it comes out, does not break its vow, fearing the Almighty, like a maidservant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें ऐक्याचिये मुठी-। माजिवबडें चित्त किरीटी। करूनि वेधीं नेहटी । आत्मयाच्या ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ aikyāciye muṭhī-| mājivabaḍeṃ citta kirīṭī| karūni vedhīṃ nehaṭī | ātmayācyā || 61||
verses.meaning: Just as a fist holds something firmly, O Kiriti, make your mind one with the Self, and then pierce through the illusion to realize the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां दृष्टादृष्ट स्पृहे । निमणें जाळेंचि आहे। आगी दडपल्या धुयें। राहिजे जैसें ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭa spṛhe | nimaṇeṃ jāḻeṃci āhe| āgī daḍapalyā dhuyeṃ| rāhije jaiseṃ || 62||
verses.meaning: Then, the desire for seeing and being seen is like a net that burns away, just as smoke remains when fire is suppressed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि नियमिलिया मानसीं। स्पृहा नासौनि जाय आपैसीं। किंबहुना तो ऐसी। भूमिका ४६८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी पावे॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni niyamiliyā mānasīṃ| spṛhā nāsauni jāya āpaisīṃ| kiṃbahunā to aisī| bhūmikā 468 śrījñāneśvarī pāve|| 63||
verses.meaning: Therefore, when the mind is disciplined, desires naturally vanish. In short, such a state is attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं अन्यथा बोधु आघवा । मावळोनि तया पांडवा । बोधमात्रींचि जीवा । ठावो होय॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ anyathā bodhu āghavā | māvaḻoni tayā pāṃḍavā | bodhamātrīṃci jīvā | ṭhāvo hoya|| 64||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, when all other knowledge fades away, the soul finds its abode in pure knowledge itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: धरवणी वेंचें सरे। तैसें भोगें प्राचीन पुरे। नवें तंब नुपकरे। कांहींचि करूं॥६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: dharavaṇī veṃceṃ sare| taiseṃ bhogeṃ prācīna pure| naveṃ taṃba nupakare| kāṃhīṃci karūṃ||65||
verses.meaning: Just as the earth's burden is removed, so too are past karmas exhausted through experience. There is no need to create new ones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसीं कर्मे साम्यदशा। होय तेथ वीरेशा। मग श्रीगुरु आपैसा। भेटेचि गा॥६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisīṃ karme sāmyadaśā| hoya tetha vīreśā| maga śrīguru āpaisā| bheṭeci gā||66||
verses.meaning: When actions reach such a state of equipoise, O Lord of the brave, then the revered Guru naturally reveals himself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रात्रीची चौपाहरी। वेंचलिया अवधारीं। डोळ्यां तमारी। मिळे जैसा॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: rātrīcī caupāharī| veṃcaliyā avadhārīṃ| ḍoḻyāṃ tamārī| miḻe jaisā|| 67||
verses.meaning: When the four watches of the night are spent, it is as if the eyes meet the darkness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां येऊनि फळाचा घडु । पारुषबी केळीची वाढु । श्रीगुरु भेटोनि करी पाडु । बुभुत्सु तैसा ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ yeūni phaḻācā ghaḍu | pāruṣabī keḻīcī vāḍhu | śrīguru bheṭoni karī pāḍu | bubhutsu taisā || 68||
verses.meaning: Just as a banana tree, having borne fruit, ceases to grow further, so too a seeker, upon meeting the Guru, attains fulfillment and their spiritual growth culminates.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग आलिंगिला पूर्णिमा । जैसा उणीव सांडी चंद्रमा । तैसें होय वीरोत्तमा। गुरुकृपा तया॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga āliṃgilā pūrṇimā | jaisā uṇīva sāṃḍī caṃdramā | taiseṃ hoya vīrottamā| gurukṛpā tayā|| 69||
verses.meaning: Then he embraced the full moon, just as the moon sheds its imperfections. Such, O best of heroes, is the grace of the Guru upon him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां अबोधुमात्र असे। तो तंव तया कृपा नासे। तेथ निशीसवें जैसें । आंधारें जाय ॥ ९७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ abodhumātra ase| to taṃva tayā kṛpā nāse| tetha niśīsaveṃ jaiseṃ | āṃdhāreṃ jāya || 970||
verses.meaning: Then, ignorance alone remains. But that too is destroyed by His grace. Just as darkness vanishes with the arrival of dawn.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी अबोधाचिये कुशी । कर्म कर्ता कार्य ऐशी । त्रिपुटी असे ते जैसी। गाभिणी मारिली ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī abodhāciye kuśī | karma kartā kārya aiśī | tripuṭī ase te jaisī| gābhiṇī mārilī || 71||
verses.meaning: Just as a pregnant woman, when struck, loses her unborn child, so too, in the womb of ignorance, the triad of action, doer, and deed is destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसेंचि अबोधनाशासवें। नाशे क्रियाजात आघवबें। ऐसा समूळ संभवे । संन्यासु हा॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃci abodhanāśāsaveṃ| nāśe kriyājāta āghavabeṃ| aisā samūḻa saṃbhave | saṃnyāsu hā|| 72||
verses.meaning: In the same way, with the destruction of ignorance, all actions are completely destroyed. Such is the nature of true renunciation, root and all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येणें मूळाज्ञानसंन्यासें। दृश्याचा जेथ ठावो पुसे । तेथ बुझावें तें आपैसें। तोचि आहे॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yeṇeṃ mūḻājñānasaṃnyāseṃ| dṛśyācā jetha ṭhāvo puse | tetha bujhāveṃ teṃ āpaiseṃ| toci āhe|| 73||
verses.meaning: When, by this renunciation of fundamental ignorance, the very existence of the visible world is questioned, then what needs to be understood is that it is naturally that very Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चेइलियावरी पाहीं॥ स्वप्नींचिया तिये डोहीं। आपणयातें काई । काढूं जाइजे॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ceiliyāvarī pāhīṃ|| svapnīṃciyā tiye ḍohīṃ| āpaṇayāteṃ kāī | kāḍhūṃ jāije|| 74||
verses.meaning: Look, after waking up from a dream, does one go to pull oneself out of that dream-lake?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें मी नेणें आतां जाणेन। हें सरलें तया दु:स्वप्न । जाला ज्ञातृज्ञेयाविहीन । चिदाकाश॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ mī neṇeṃ ātāṃ jāṇena| heṃ saraleṃ tayā du:svapna | jālā jñātṛjñeyāvihīna | cidākāśa|| 75||
verses.meaning: That 'I do not know now, I will know' - this bad dream of his has ended. He has become devoid of the knower and the known, like the sky of consciousness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुखाभासेंसी आरिसा। परौता नेलिया वीरेशा। पाहातेपणेंबीण जैसा । पाहाता ठाके ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mukhābhāseṃsī ārisā| parautā neliyā vīreśā| pāhātepaṇeṃbīṇa jaisā | pāhātā ṭhāke || 76||
verses.meaning: When the mirror is taken away from the face, O great hero, the act of seeing ceases, just as the seer ceases to see.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें नेणणें जें गेलें। तेणें जाणणेंही नेलें। मग निष्क्रिय उरलें। चिन्मात्रचि॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ neṇaṇeṃ jeṃ geleṃ| teṇeṃ jāṇaṇeṃhī neleṃ| maga niṣkriya uraleṃ| cinmātraci|| 77||
verses.meaning: Just as the absence of ignorance, by its very nature, also removes the sense of knowing, what then remains is the inactive, pure consciousness itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ स्वभावें धनंजया । नाहीं कोणीचि क्रिया । म्हणौनि प्रवादु तया । नैष्कर्म्यु ऐसा ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha svabhāveṃ dhanaṃjayā | nāhīṃ koṇīci kriyā | mhaṇauni pravādu tayā | naiṣkarmyu aisā || 78||
verses.meaning: There, O Dhananjaya, naturally there is no action whatsoever. Therefore, it is said to be 'actionless' (Naishkarmya).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें आपुलें आपणपें। असे तेंचि होऊनि आरोपे। तरंगु कां वायुलोपें। समुद्र जैसा ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ āpuleṃ āpaṇapeṃ| ase teṃci hoūni ārope| taraṃgu kāṃ vāyulopeṃ| samudra jaisā || 79||
verses.meaning: That which is one's own self, becomes manifest as that very self, just as a wave, upon the cessation of wind, merges back into the ocean.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें न होणें निफजे । ते नैष्कर्म्यसिट्धि जाणिजे । सर्वसिद्धींत सहजें। परम हेचि ॥ ९८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ na hoṇeṃ niphaje | te naiṣkarmyasiṭdhi jāṇije | sarvasiddhīṃta sahajeṃ| parama heci || 980||
verses.meaning: That which does not come into being, that is known as Naishkarmya Siddhi. Among all accomplishments, this is indeed the supreme one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देउळाचिया कामा कळसु। परम गंगेसी सिंधुप्रवेशु। कां सुवर्णशुद्धी कसु। सोळावा जैसा॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: deuḻāciyā kāmā kaḻasu| parama gaṃgesī siṃdhupraveśu| kāṃ suvarṇaśuddhī kasu| soḻāvā jaisā|| 81||
verses.meaning: Just as a pinnacle completes a temple, or the Ganges merges into the ocean, or gold reaches its sixteenth degree of purity, so too is this spiritual realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें आपुलें नेणणें। फेडिजे का जाणणें। तेंही गिळुनि असणें। ऐसी जे दशा॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ āpuleṃ neṇaṇeṃ| pheḍije kā jāṇaṇeṃ| teṃhī giḻuni asaṇeṃ| aisī je daśā|| 82||
verses.meaning: Just as one's ignorance is dispelled by knowledge, and then that knowledge itself is swallowed, such is the state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियेपरतें कांहीं । निपजणें आन नाहीं। म्हणौनि म्हणिपे पाहीं । परमसिन्छि ते॥८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyeparateṃ kāṃhīṃ | nipajaṇeṃ āna nāhīṃ| mhaṇauni mhaṇipe pāhīṃ | paramasinchi te||83||
verses.meaning: Beyond that, nothing else is produced. Therefore, it is called the ultimate attainment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी हेचि आत्मसिन्द्ि।) जो कोणी भाग्यनिधि। श्रीगुरुकृपालब्धि-। काळीं पावे॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī heci ātmasindi|) jo koṇī bhāgyanidhi| śrīgurukṛpālabdhi-| kāḻīṃ pāve|| 84||
verses.meaning: But this is the attainment of the Self, which a fortunate soul achieves at the time of receiving the grace of the revered Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदयतांचि दिनकरु । प्रकाशुचि आते आंधारु। कां दीपसंगें कापुरु । दीपुचि होय॥ ८५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: udayatāṃci dinakaru | prakāśuci āte āṃdhāru| kāṃ dīpasaṃgeṃ kāpuru | dīpuci hoya|| 85 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun's rising instantly dispels darkness, or camphor, when lit by a lamp, itself becomes the lamp.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया लवणाची कणिका | मिळतखेंबो उदका। उदकचि होऊनि देखा । ठाके जेवीं ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā lavaṇācī kaṇikā | miḻatakheṃbo udakā| udakaci hoūni dekhā | ṭhāke jevīṃ || 86||
verses.meaning: Just as a particle of salt, upon meeting water, immediately becomes water itself and remains so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां निद्रितु चेवविलिया । स्वेंसि नीद वायां। जाऊनि आपणपयां। मिळे जैसा॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ nidritu cevaviliyā | sveṃsi nīda vāyāṃ| jāūni āpaṇapayāṃ| miḻe jaisā|| 87||
verses.meaning: Just as a sleeping person, when awakened, loses their sleep and returns to their true self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जया कोण्हासि दैवें। गुरुवाक्यश्रवणाचि सवबें। द्वैत गिळोनि विसंवे। आपणया वृत्ती ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jayā koṇhāsi daiveṃ| guruvākyaśravaṇāci savabeṃ| dvaita giḻoni visaṃve| āpaṇayā vṛttī || 88||
verses.meaning: Just as, by the grace of destiny, through the opportunity of hearing the Guru's words, the mind, having swallowed duality, rests within itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयासि मग कर्म करणें। हें बोलिजेलचि कवणें। आकाशा येणें जाणें आहे काई ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāsi maga karma karaṇeṃ| heṃ bolijelaci kavaṇeṃ| ākāśā yeṇeṃ jāṇeṃ āhe kāī || 89||
verses.meaning: Then who would speak of performing actions for such a one? Does the sky have coming and going?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तयासि कांहीं। त्रिशुद्धि करणें नाहीं । परी ऐसें जरी हें कांहीं । नव्हे जया ॥ ९९० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tayāsi kāṃhīṃ| triśuddhi karaṇeṃ nāhīṃ | parī aiseṃ jarī heṃ kāṃhīṃ | navhe jayā || 990 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, for such a one, there is nothing to be done with the three purifications. But if someone is not like this...

verses.shloka_devanagari: कानावचनाचिये भेटी-। सरिसाचि पैं किरीटी। वस्तु होऊनि उठी। कवणि एकु जो॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: kānāvacanāciye bheṭī-| sarisāci paiṃ kirīṭī| vastu hoūni uṭhī| kavaṇi eku jo||91||
verses.meaning: As soon as the ear and the word meet, O Kiriti, a unique reality arises.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एव्हवीं स्वकर्माचेनि वन्ही । काम्यनिषिद्धाचिया इंधनीं । रजतमें कीर दोन्ही । जाळिलीं आधीं॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: evhavīṃ svakarmāceni vanhī | kāmyaniṣiddhāciyā iṃdhanīṃ | rajatameṃ kīra donhī | jāḻilīṃ ādhīṃ|| 92||
verses.meaning: Indeed, through the fire of one's own prescribed duties, both rajas and tamas are first burnt away, using the fuel of actions that are either desired or forbidden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुत्र वित्त परलोकु। यया तिहींचा अभिलाखु। घरीं होय 'पाइकु । हेंही जालें ॥ ९३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: putra vitta paraloku| yayā tihīṃcā abhilākhu| gharīṃ hoya 'pāiku | heṃhī jāleṃ || 93 ||
verses.meaning: When one desires a son, wealth, or the afterlife, one becomes a servant in their own home.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इंद्रियें सैरा पदार्थी । रिगतां विटाळलीं होतीं । तियें प्रत्याहार तीर्थी । न्हाणिळलीं कीर॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: iṃdriyeṃ sairā padārthī | rigatāṃ viṭāḻalīṃ hotīṃ | tiyeṃ pratyāhāra tīrthī | nhāṇiḻalīṃ kīra|| 94||
verses.meaning: The senses, which were defiled by indulging in worldly objects, were purified by bathing them in the sacred waters of Pratyahara.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि स्वधर्माचें फळ। ईश्‍वरीं अर्पूनि सकळ । घेऊनि केळें अढळ । वैराग्यपद॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi svadharmāceṃ phaḻa| īś‍varīṃ arpūni sakaḻa | gheūni keḻeṃ aḍhaḻa | vairāgyapada|| 95||
verses.meaning: And offering all the fruits of one's own dharma to God, one attains the unwavering state of detachment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी आत्मसाक्षात्कारीं। लाभे ज्ञानाची उजरी। ते सामुग्री कौर पुरी । मेळविली ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī ātmasākṣātkārīṃ| lābhe jñānācī ujarī| te sāmugrī kaura purī | meḻavilī || 96||
verses.meaning: Such is the illumination of knowledge attained by those who have realized the Self. All the necessary means for this were gathered by the Kauravas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तेचि समयीं । सद्गुरू भेटले पाहीं। तेवींचि तिहीं कांहीं । वंचिजेना ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi teci samayīṃ | sadgurū bheṭale pāhīṃ| tevīṃci tihīṃ kāṃhīṃ | vaṃcijenā || 97||
verses.meaning: And at that very moment, the Sadguru was met. Thus, nothing was hidden from them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी वबोखद घेतखेंबो। काय लाभे आपुला ठावो। कां उदयजतांचि दिवो। मध्यान्ह होय॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī vabokhada ghetakheṃbo| kāya lābhe āpulā ṭhāvo| kāṃ udayajatāṃci divo| madhyānha hoya|| 98||
verses.meaning: If one were to take medicine, what would be gained by knowing its origin? Or, if the day is just dawning, how can it immediately become midday?

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुक्षेत्री आणि वोलटें। बीजही पेरिलें गोमटें। तरी आलोट फळ भेटे। परी वेळे कीं गा॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sukṣetrī āṇi volaṭeṃ| bījahī perileṃ gomaṭeṃ| tarī āloṭa phaḻa bheṭe| parī veḻe kīṃ gā|| 99||
verses.meaning: When good seeds are sown in fertile and moist soil, an abundant harvest is reaped, but only in due time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जोडला मार्गु प्रांजळु। मिनला सुसंगाचाही मेळु। तरी पाविजे वांचूनि वेळु। लागेचि कोौं॥ १०००॥
verses.shloka_iast: joḍalā mārgu prāṃjaḻu| minalā susaṃgācāhī meḻu| tarī pāvije vāṃcūni veḻu| lāgeci koauṃ|| 1000||
verses.meaning: If the path is straightforward and the company of good people is found, then one will surely attain the goal without any delay.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा बैराग्यळाभु जाला । वरी सद्गुरुही भेटला । जीवीं अंकुरु फुटला । विवेकाचा ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā bairāgyaḻābhu jālā | varī sadguruhī bheṭalā | jīvīṃ aṃkuru phuṭalā | vivekācā || 1||
verses.meaning: Just as detachment was attained, and then the Sadguru was also met, a sprout of discrimination blossomed within the soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें ब्रह्म एक आथी । येर आघवीचि भ्रांती । हेंही कौर प्रतीती। गाढ केली ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ brahma eka āthī | yera āghavīci bhrāṃtī | heṃhī kaura pratītī| gāḍha kelī || 2||
verses.meaning: Through this, the oneness of Brahman is established, and all else is merely an illusion. This conviction was firmly instilled in Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तेंचि जें परब्रह्म । सर्वात्मक सर्वोत्तम । मोक्षाचेंही काम । सरे जेथ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī teṃci jeṃ parabrahma | sarvātmaka sarvottama | mokṣāceṃhī kāma | sare jetha|| 3||
verses.meaning: But that very Parabrahma, which is the soul of all, the best of all, is where even the work of liberation culminates.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया तिन्ही अवस्था पोटीं। जिरवी जें गा किरीटी। तया ज्ञानासिही मिठी । दे जे वस्तु ॥ ४ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā tinhī avasthā poṭīṃ| jiravī jeṃ gā kirīṭī| tayā jñānāsihī miṭhī | de je vastu || 4 ||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), that which dissolves these three states within itself, and then embraces even that knowledge, is the true Reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐक्याचें एकपण सरे। जेथ आनंदकणुही विरे। कांहींचि नुरोनि उरे। जें कांहीं गा॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: aikyāceṃ ekapaṇa sare| jetha ānaṃdakaṇuhī vire| kāṃhīṃci nuroni ure| jeṃ kāṃhīṃ gā|| 5||
verses.meaning: The oneness of unity dissolves, where even the particle of bliss vanishes. Nothing at all remains, that which truly is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये ब्रह्मी ऐक्यपणें। ब्रह्मच होऊनि असणें । तें क्रमॅच्ि करूनि तेणें । पाविजे पैं ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye brahmī aikyapaṇeṃ| brahmaca hoūni asaṇeṃ | teṃ kramaॅci karūni teṇeṃ | pāvije paiṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: By becoming one with that Brahman, by becoming Brahman itself, that state is attained through the practice of Krama.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भुकेलियापासीं । वबोगरिलें षडूसीं। तो तृप्ति प्रतिग्रासी । लाहे जेवीं ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhukeliyāpāsīṃ | vabogarileṃ ṣaḍūsīṃ| to tṛpti pratigrāsī | lāhe jevīṃ || 7||
verses.meaning: Just as a hungry person, upon receiving a meal with six tastes, experiences satisfaction with every morsel.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा वैराग्याचा ४७० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी बोलावा । विचाराचा तो दिवा। आंबुथितां आत्मठेवा। काढीचि तो॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā vairāgyācā 470 śrījñāneśvarī bolāvā | vicārācā to divā| āṃbuthitāṃ ātmaṭhevā| kāḍhīci to||8||
verses.meaning: Just as the lamp of discrimination, when lit by detachment, reveals the treasure of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी भोगिजे आत्मत्रश्‍द्धी। येवढी योग्यतेची सिद्धी। जयाच्या आंगीं निरवधी । लेणें जाली ॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī bhogije ātmatraś‍ddhī| yevaḍhī yogyatecī siddhī| jayācyā āṃgīṃ niravadhī | leṇeṃ jālī ||9||
verses.meaning: Therefore, one experiences the unwavering conviction in the Self, a perfection of such profound worth, which has become an eternal adornment within them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो जेणें क्रमें ब्रह्म । होणें करी गा सुगम । तया क्रमाचें आतां वर्म। आईक सांगों॥ १०१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: to jeṇeṃ krameṃ brahma | hoṇeṃ karī gā sugama | tayā kramāceṃ ātāṃ varma| āīka sāṃgoṃ|| 1010||
verses.meaning: Now listen, I will explain the secret of that process by which attaining Brahman becomes easy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी गुरु दाविलिया वाटा । येऊनि विवेकतीर्थतटा । धुऊनियां मळकटा । बुद्धीचा तेणें ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī guru dāviliyā vāṭā | yeūni vivekatīrthataṭā | dhuūniyāṃ maḻakaṭā | buddhīcā teṇeṃ || 91||
verses.meaning: Then, following the path shown by the Guru, one arrives at the shore of the holy wisdom-river, and there, the impurities of the intellect are washed away.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग राहूनें उगळिली। प्रभा चंद्रे आलिंगिली। तैसी शुद्धत्वें जडली । आपणयां बुद्धि॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga rāhūneṃ ugaḻilī| prabhā caṃdre āliṃgilī| taisī śuddhatveṃ jaḍalī | āpaṇayāṃ buddhi|| 92||
verses.meaning: Then, just as the moon's light is embraced by the moon itself after being eclipsed by Rahu, so too did the intellect merge with the Self in its pure state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांडूनि कुळें दोन्ही । प्रियासी अनुसरे कामिनी । दंद्रत्यागें स्वचिंतनीं। पडली तैसी ॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃḍūni kuḻeṃ donhī | priyāsī anusare kāminī | daṃdratyāgeṃ svaciṃtanīṃ| paḍalī taisī || 13||
verses.meaning: Just as a woman, forsaking both her families, follows her beloved, so too the mind, abandoning dualities, becomes absorbed in self-contemplation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ज्ञाना ऐसें जिव्हार। नेवों नेवों निरंतर। इंद्रियी केलें थोर। शब्दादिक जे॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi jñānā aiseṃ jivhāra| nevoṃ nevoṃ niraṃtara| iṃdriyī keleṃ thora| śabdādika je|| 14||
verses.meaning: And knowledge, like the very essence of life, continuously carries and expands the great sensory objects like sound and others into the senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते रश्‍श्मिजाळ काढलेया । मृगजळ जाय लया । तैसें धृतिरोधें तयां । पांचांही केलें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: te raś‍śmijāḻa kāḍhaleyā | mṛgajaḻa jāya layā | taiseṃ dhṛtirodheṃ tayāṃ | pāṃcāṃhī keleṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: Just as the mirage disappears when the sun's rays are withdrawn, so too did the obstruction of steadfastness (dhruti) dissolve those five (senses/elements).

verses.shloka_devanagari: नेणतां अधमाचिया अन्ना। खादलळिया कीजे वमना। तैसीं वबोकविलीं सवासना। इंद्रियें विषयीं ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: neṇatāṃ adhamāciyā annā| khādalaḻiyā kīje vamanā| taisīṃ vabokavilīṃ savāsanā| iṃdriyeṃ viṣayīṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: Just as one vomits out food eaten unknowingly from a low-caste person, so too the senses, along with their latent tendencies, spew out their objects.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग प्रत्यगावृत्ती चोखटें । 'लाविलीं गंगेचेनि तटें। ऐसीं प्रायश्‍चित्तें धुबटें। केलीं येणें ॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga pratyagāvṛttī cokhaṭeṃ | 'lāvilīṃ gaṃgeceni taṭeṃ| aisīṃ prāyaś‍citteṃ dhubaṭeṃ| kelīṃ yeṇeṃ || 17||
verses.meaning: Then, with a pure turning inward, he performed such cleansing penances as if they were washing clothes on the banks of the Ganga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं सात्त्विकें धीरें तेणें। शोधारलीं तियें करणें। मग मनेंसीं योगधारणें । मेळविली ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ sāttvikeṃ dhīreṃ teṇeṃ| śodhāralīṃ tiyeṃ karaṇeṃ| maga maneṃsīṃ yogadhāraṇeṃ | meḻavilī || 18||
verses.meaning: Then, with a pure and steadfast resolve, those senses were purified. Subsequently, through the practice of Yoga, they were united with the mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवींचि प्राचीनें इृष्टानिष्टें। भोगेंसीं येउनी भेटे। तेथ देखलियाही वोखटे । द्वेषु न करी॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃci prācīneṃ iṛṣṭāniṣṭeṃ| bhogeṃsīṃ yeunī bheṭe| tetha dekhaliyāhī vokhaṭe | dveṣu na karī|| 19||
verses.meaning: Similarly, past good and bad deeds come to meet one and are experienced. Even when encountering something unpleasant, one does not harbor hatred.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना गोमटेंचि विपायें। तें आणूनि पुढां सूये। तयालागीं न होये। साभिलाषु॥ ९०२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā gomaṭeṃci vipāyeṃ| teṃ āṇūni puḍhāṃ sūye| tayālāgīṃ na hoye| sābhilāṣu|| 9020||
verses.meaning: Even if something is not beautiful or desirable, if it is placed before him, he does not develop any desire for it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यापरी इष्टानिष्टीं । रागद्वेष किरीटी । त्यजूनि गिरिकपाटीं। निकुंजीं बसे॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāparī iṣṭāniṣṭīṃ | rāgadveṣa kirīṭī | tyajūni girikapāṭīṃ| nikuṃjīṃ base|| 21||
verses.meaning: In this way, having abandoned attachment and aversion to desirable and undesirable things, O Kiriti, one should reside in mountain caves and secluded groves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गजबजा सांडिलिया। बसवी वनस्थळिया। अंगाचियाचि मांदिया। एकलेया॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: gajabajā sāṃḍiliyā| basavī vanasthaḻiyā| aṃgāciyāci māṃdiyā| ekaleyā|| 22||
verses.meaning: The clamor of the world has ceased; the forest is settled. In the solitude of one's own being, one finds oneself alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शमदमादिकीं खेळे। न बोलणेंचि चावळे। गुरुवाक्याचेनि मेळें। नेणे वेळु॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: śamadamādikīṃ kheḻe| na bolaṇeṃci cāvaḻe| guruvākyāceni meḻeṃ| neṇe veḻu|| 23||
verses.meaning: He plays with self-control and restraint, not speaking unnecessarily. With the guidance of the Guru's words, he loses track of time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आंगा बळ यावें। नातरी क्षुधा जावें। कां जिभेचे पुरवावे। मनोरथ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi āṃgā baḻa yāveṃ| nātarī kṣudhā jāveṃ| kāṃ jibhece puravāve| manoratha|| 24||
verses.meaning: And strength should come to the body, or hunger should depart, or the desires of the tongue should be fulfilled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भोजन करितांविखीं। यया तिहींतें न लेखी । आहारीं मिती संतोषीं। माप न सूये ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhojana karitāṃvikhīṃ| yayā tihīṃteṃ na lekhī | āhārīṃ mitī saṃtoṣīṃ| māpa na sūye || 25||
verses.meaning: When it comes to eating, these three (food, hunger, and satisfaction) are not considered. In eating, moderation is pleasing; no measure is applied.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अशनाचेनि पावकें । हारपतां प्राणु पोखे। इतुकियाचि भागु मोटकें । अशन करी॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aśanāceni pāvakeṃ | hārapatāṃ prāṇu pokhe| itukiyāci bhāgu moṭakeṃ | aśana karī|| 26||
verses.meaning: When the life-force is nourished and sustained by the fire of food, that much alone is the purpose of eating.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि परपुरुषें कामिली । कुळवधू आंग न घाली । निद्रालस्या न मोकली । अशन तैसें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi parapuruṣeṃ kāmilī | kuḻavadhū āṃga na ghālī | nidrālasyā na mokalī | aśana taiseṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Just as a virtuous wife would never allow another man to touch her, and a person would not abandon food for sleep or laziness, so too should one not abandon their true spiritual nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दंडवताचेनि प्रसंगें। भुयीं हन अंग लागे। वांचूनि येर नेघे । राभस्य तेथ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: daṃḍavatāceni prasaṃgeṃ| bhuyīṃ hana aṃga lāge| vāṃcūni yera neghe | rābhasya tetha|| 28||
verses.meaning: When prostrating, the body touches the ground. Otherwise, it does not accept the joy there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देहनिर्वाहापुरतें। राहाटवी हातांपायांतें। किंबहुना आपैतें। सबाह्य केलें॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: dehanirvāhāpurateṃ| rāhāṭavī hātāṃpāyāṃteṃ| kiṃbahunā āpaiteṃ| sabāhya keleṃ|| 29||
verses.meaning: The hands and feet are engaged only for the sustenance of the body; indeed, the entire outer and inner self has been made subservient.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मनाचा उंबरा। वृत्तीसी देखो नेदी वीरा । तेथ कें वाग्व्यापारा। अवकाशु असे॥ १०३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi manācā uṃbarā| vṛttīsī dekho nedī vīrā | tetha keṃ vāgvyāpārā| avakāśu ase|| 1030||
verses.meaning: And the threshold of the mind does not allow the vritti (mental modification) to even glimpse it, O brave one. How then can there be any scope for the play of words there?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि देह वाचा मानस। हे जिणौनि बाह्यप्रदेश । आकळिळें आकाश । ध्यानाचें तेणें ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni deha vācā mānasa| he jiṇauni bāhyapradeśa | ākaḻiḻeṃ ākāśa | dhyānāceṃ teṇeṃ || 31||
verses.meaning: Thus, having transcended the body, speech, and mind, he encompassed the vast expanse of the sky with his meditation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गुरुवाक्‍्यें उठविला । बोधीं निश्चयो आपुला । न्याहाळी हातीं घेतला । आरिसा जैसा॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: guruvāk‍yeṃ uṭhavilā | bodhīṃ niścayo āpulā | nyāhāḻī hātīṃ ghetalā | ārisā jaisā|| 32||
verses.meaning: By the Guru's word, one's own conviction in spiritual knowledge is awakened, and it is examined as if holding a mirror in hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं ध्याता आपणचि परी । ध्यानरूप वृत्तिमाझारीं। ध्येयत्वें घे हे अवबधारीं। ध्यानरूढी गा॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ dhyātā āpaṇaci parī | dhyānarūpa vṛttimājhārīṃ| dhyeyatveṃ ghe he avabadhārīṃ| dhyānarūḍhī gā|| 33||
verses.meaning: Understand this: the meditator himself, through the meditative state, assumes the form of the object of meditation, thereby establishing the practice of meditation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ ध्येय ध्यान ध्याता । ययां तिहीं एकरूपता। होय तंब पंडुसुता। कीजे तें गा॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha dhyeya dhyāna dhyātā | yayāṃ tihīṃ ekarūpatā| hoya taṃba paṃḍusutā| kīje teṃ gā|| 34||
verses.meaning: There, the object of meditation, the act of meditation, and the meditator become one. This, O son of Pandu, is what should be done.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तो मुमुक्षु| आत्मज्ञानी जाला दक्षु । परी पुढां सूनि पक्षु| योगाभ्यासाचा ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni to mumukṣu| ātmajñānī jālā dakṣu | parī puḍhāṃ sūni pakṣu| yogābhyāsācā || 35 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that seeker of liberation, having become adept in self-knowledge, then takes up the path of yogic practice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अपानरंश्रद्धयां-। माझारीं धनंजया । पार्ष्णीं पिडूनियां। कांवरुूमूळ ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: apānaraṃśraddhayāṃ-| mājhārīṃ dhanaṃjayā | pārṣṇīṃ piḍūniyāṃ| kāṃvaruūmūḻa || 36||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, by pressing the heel firmly at the root of the perineum, one should draw the apana breath upwards.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आकुंचूनि अध। देऊनि तिन्ही बंध) करूनि एकवद। वायुभेदी॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ākuṃcūni adha| deūni tinhī baṃdha) karūni ekavada| vāyubhedī|| 37||
verses.meaning: By contracting the lower aperture, applying the three bandhas, and unifying the breath, one pierces through the vital air.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कुंडलिनी जागवूनि । मध्यमा विकाशूनि । आधारादि भेदूनि। आज्ञावरी ॥३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kuṃḍalinī jāgavūni | madhyamā vikāśūni | ādhārādi bhedūni| ājñāvarī ||38||
verses.meaning: Awakening the Kundalini, developing the Madhyama, and piercing through the Muladhara and other chakras, up to the Ajna chakra.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सहस्त्रदळाचा मेघु । पीयूषें वर्षोनि चांगु । तो मूळवरी वोघु । आणूनियां ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sahastradaḻācā meghu | pīyūṣeṃ varṣoni cāṃgu | to mūḻavarī voghu | āṇūniyāṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: The thousand-petaled lotus, like a cloud, rains down nectar, bringing that stream to its root.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाचतया पुण्यगिरी। चिदभेरवाच्या खापरीं। मनपवनाची खीच पुरी। वाढूनियां ॥ १०४० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: nācatayā puṇyagirī| cidabheravācyā khāparīṃ| manapavanācī khīca purī| vāḍhūniyāṃ || 1040 ||
verses.meaning: The merit of good deeds dances in the skull-bowl of consciousness, and the full offering of the mind's breath is served.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जालिया योगाचा गाढा । मेळावा सूनि हा पुढां । ध्यान मागिलीकडां। स्वयंभ केळें॥ ४९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jāliyā yogācā gāḍhā | meḻāvā sūni hā puḍhāṃ | dhyāna māgilīkaḍāṃ| svayaṃbha keḻeṃ|| 49 ||
verses.meaning: Having thus gathered the profound essence of Yoga, Dnyaneshwar spontaneously turned his attention to the practice of meditation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ध्यान योग दोन्ही । इये आत्मतत्त्वज्ञानीं। 'पैठी होआवया निर्विघ्नीं। आधींचि तेणें ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi dhyāna yoga donhī | iye ātmatattvajñānīṃ| 'paiṭhī hoāvayā nirvighnīṃ| ādhīṃci teṇeṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: And for the unhindered attainment of the knowledge of the Self, both Dhyana (meditation) and Yoga are essential from the very beginning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वीतरागतेसारिखा । जोडूनि ठेविला सखा। तो आघवियाचि भूमिका-। सवें चाले॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vītarāgatesārikhā | joḍūni ṭhevilā sakhā| to āghaviyāci bhūmikā-| saveṃ cāle|| 43||
verses.meaning: Having befriended detachment, which is like a treasure, it accompanies one through all stages of life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पहावें दिसे तंबवबरी । दिठीतें न संडी दीप जरी । तरी कें आहे अवसरी । देखावया॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pahāveṃ dise taṃbavabarī | diṭhīteṃ na saṃḍī dīpa jarī | tarī keṃ āhe avasarī | dekhāvayā|| 44||
verses.meaning: As long as there is light, the eye sees; but if the lamp is not abandoned, then where is the opportunity to see the lamp itself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें मोक्षीं प्रवर्तलया । वृत्ती ब्रह्मी जाय लया । तंव वैराग्य आथी तया । भंगु कैचा ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ mokṣīṃ pravartalayā | vṛttī brahmī jāya layā | taṃva vairāgya āthī tayā | bhaṃgu kaicā || 45||
verses.meaning: Just as the mind, when engaged in the pursuit of liberation, dissolves into Brahman, so too does dispassion remain unbroken and unwavering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सवबेैराग्यु। ज्ञानाभ्यासु तो सभाग्यु। करूनि जाला योग्यु। आत्मळाभा॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni savabeairāgyu| jñānābhyāsu to sabhāgyu| karūni jālā yogyu| ātmaḻābhā|| 46||
verses.meaning: Therefore, through complete detachment and the diligent practice of knowledge, one becomes worthy of realizing the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी वैराग्याची आंगीं। बाणूनियां वज्रांगीं। राजयोगतुरंगीं। आरूढला ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī vairāgyācī āṃgīṃ| bāṇūniyāṃ vajrāṃgīṃ| rājayogaturaṃgīṃ| ārūḍhalā || 47||
verses.meaning: Thus, having embodied such detachment, making it as strong as a thunderbolt, he mounted the steed of Raja Yoga.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वरी आड पडिलें दिठी। सानें थोर निवटी। तें बळीं विवेकमुष्टीं । ध्यानाचें खांडे ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: varī āḍa paḍileṃ diṭhī| sāneṃ thora nivaṭī| teṃ baḻīṃ vivekamuṣṭīṃ | dhyānāceṃ khāṃḍe || 48 ||
verses.meaning: The obstacles that appear before the eyes, whether small or large, are destroyed by the powerful sword of meditation, wielded by the fist of discrimination.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि संसाररणाआंतु । ४७२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी आंधारीं सूर्यु तैसा असे जातु । मोक्षविजयश्रीये वरैतु। होआवयालागीं ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni saṃsāraraṇāāṃtu | 472 śrījñāneśvarī āṃdhārīṃ sūryu taisā ase jātu | mokṣavijayaśrīye varaitu| hoāvayālāgīṃ || 49 ||
verses.meaning: Thus, in the battle of worldly existence, just as the sun dispels darkness, so too does one proceed towards the attainment of the glory of liberation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ आडवावया आले। दोषवैरी जे धोपटिले। तयांमाजीं पहिळें। देहाहंकारु ॥ ९०५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha āḍavāvayā āle| doṣavairī je dhopaṭile| tayāṃmājīṃ pahiḻeṃ| dehāhaṃkāru || 9050||
verses.meaning: There, to obstruct, came the enemies of faults, which were beaten down. Among them, the first was the ego of the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो न मोकली मारुनी। जीवों नेदी उपजवबोनि । विचंबबी खोडां घालुनी। हाडांचिया॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo na mokalī mārunī| jīvoṃ nedī upajavaboni | vicaṃbabī khoḍāṃ ghālunī| hāḍāṃciyā|| 51||
verses.meaning: He does not release by killing, nor does he allow life to be born. He torments by putting them in shackles of bones.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचा देहदुर्ग हा थारा । मोडूनि घेतला तो वीरा। आणि बळ हा दुसरा । मारिला वैरी॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayācā dehadurga hā thārā | moḍūni ghetalā to vīrā| āṇi baḻa hā dusarā | mārilā vairī||52||
verses.meaning: That warrior broke down the fortress of his body, and killed the second enemy, his strength.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो विषयाचेनि नांवें। चौगुणेंही वरी थांवे। जेणें मृतावस्था धांवे। सर्वत्र जगा॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo viṣayāceni nāṃveṃ| cauguṇeṃhī varī thāṃve| jeṇeṃ mṛtāvasthā dhāṃve| sarvatra jagā|| 53||
verses.meaning: That which, by the very mention of its name, causes the fourfold qualities to cease, and brings about a state of death throughout the entire world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो विषयविषाचा अथावो। आघविया दोषांचा रावो। परी ध्यानखडूगांचा घावो। साहेल कैंचा ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: to viṣayaviṣācā athāvo| āghaviyā doṣāṃcā rāvo| parī dhyānakhaḍūgāṃcā ghāvo| sāhela kaiṃcā || 54||
verses.meaning: That is a sea of the poison of worldly pleasures, the king of all faults. But how can it withstand the blow of the sword of meditation?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि प्रिय विषयप्राप्ती । करी जया सुखाची व्यक्‍ती । तेचि घालूनि बुंथी। आंगीं जो बाजे॥५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi priya viṣayaprāptī | karī jayā sukhācī vyak‍tī | teci ghālūni buṃthī| āṃgīṃ jo bāje||55||
verses.meaning: And the attainment of beloved objects, which brings forth the manifestation of happiness, that very happiness, having donned a disguise, he himself becomes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो सन्मार्गा भुळवी। मग अधर्माच्या आडवीं-। सूनि वाघां सांपडवी। नरकादिकां॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo sanmārgā bhuḻavī| maga adharmācyā āḍavīṃ-| sūni vāghāṃ sāṃpaḍavī| narakādikāṃ|| 56||
verses.meaning: One who misleads from the right path, then traps them in the wilderness of unrighteousness, like a tiger, leading them to hell and other such fates.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो विश्‍वासें मारितां रिपु। निवटूनि घातला दर्पु। आणि जयाचा अहा कंपु। तापसांसी ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to viś‍vāseṃ māritāṃ ripu| nivaṭūni ghātalā darpu| āṇi jayācā ahā kaṃpu| tāpasāṃsī || 57||
verses.meaning: With faith, he struck down the enemy, destroying its pride, and even ascetics trembled at his awe-inspiring presence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्रोधा ऐसा महादोखु । जयाचा देखा परिपाकु । भरिजे तंव अधिकु। रिता होय जो॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: krodhā aisā mahādokhu | jayācā dekhā paripāku | bharije taṃva adhiku| ritā hoya jo|| 58||
verses.meaning: Anger is such a great sin, whose outcome is seen to be that the more it is filled, the emptier it becomes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो कामु कोणेच ठायीं। नसे ऐसें केलें पाहीं । कौं तेंचि क्रोधाही । सहजें आलें॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to kāmu koṇeca ṭhāyīṃ| nase aiseṃ keleṃ pāhīṃ | kauṃ teṃci krodhāhī | sahajeṃ āleṃ|| 59||
verses.meaning: He made it such that desire exists nowhere, and in the same way, anger too naturally ceased to be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुळाचें तोडणें जैसें। होय कां शाखोहेशें । कामु नाशलेनि नाशे । तैसा क्रोधु ॥ १०६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: muḻāceṃ toḍaṇeṃ jaiseṃ| hoya kāṃ śākhoheśeṃ | kāmu nāśaleni nāśe | taisā krodhu || 1060||
verses.meaning: Just as a tree's branches wither and die when its roots are cut, so too does anger perish when desire is destroyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि काम वैरी । जाला जेथ ठाणोरी। तेथ सरली वारी । क्रोधाचीही ॥६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni kāma vairī | jālā jetha ṭhāṇorī| tetha saralī vārī | krodhācīhī ||61||
verses.meaning: Therefore, where desire, the enemy, has been overcome, there the turn of anger also ceases.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि समर्थ आपुला खोडा । शिसें वाहवी जैसा होडा। तैसा भुंजौनि जो गाढा । परिग्रहो॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi samartha āpulā khoḍā | śiseṃ vāhavī jaisā hoḍā| taisā bhuṃjauni jo gāḍhā | parigraho|| 62||
verses.meaning: And just as a powerful person carries their own burden on their head, so too does the strong attachment to possessions become a heavy burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो माथांचि पाळलाणवी। अंगा अवगुण घालवी । जीवें दांडी घेववी । ममत्वाची ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo māthāṃci pāḻalāṇavī| aṃgā avaguṇa ghālavī | jīveṃ dāṃḍī ghevavī | mamatvācī || 63 ||
verses.meaning: One who uproots the very roots of the ego, casts away all flaws from the self, and makes the soul abandon all sense of possessiveness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शिष्यशास्त्रादिविलासें । मठादिमुद्रेचेनि मिसें। घातले आहाती फांसे। निसंगा जेणें ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: śiṣyaśāstrādivilāseṃ | maṭhādimudreceni miseṃ| ghātale āhātī phāṃse| nisaṃgā jeṇeṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: Through the display of discipleship and scriptures, and under the guise of monastic seals, snares have been laid for the unattached.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घरीं कुटुंबपणें सरे। तरी वनीं वन्य होऊनि अवतरे। नागवीयाही शरीरें। लागला आहे ॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: gharīṃ kuṭuṃbapaṇeṃ sare| tarī vanīṃ vanya hoūni avatare| nāgavīyāhī śarīreṃ| lāgalā āhe || 65||
verses.meaning: Even if one's family life ends at home, or one becomes a recluse in the forest, the attachment to the naked body still persists.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा दुर्जयो जो परिग्रहो | तयाचा फेडूनि ठावो । भवविजयाचा उत्साहो । भोगीतसे जो॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā durjayo jo parigraho | tayācā pheḍūni ṭhāvo | bhavavijayācā utsāho | bhogītase jo|| 66||
verses.meaning: One who, by overcoming such an unconquerable attachment, experiences the joy of conquering the cycle of birth and death.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अमानित्वादि आघवे । ज्ञानगुणाचे जे मेळावे । ते कैवल्यदेशींचे आधघवे। रावो जैसे आले॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha amānitvādi āghave | jñānaguṇāce je meḻāve | te kaivalyadeśīṃce ādhaghave| rāvo jaise āle|| 67||
verses.meaning: There, all the virtues of knowledge, such as humility, gather together, as if all the kings from the realm of liberation have arrived.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां सम्यकज्ञानाचिया । राणिवा उगाणूनि तया । परिवारु होऊनियां। राहत आंगें ॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ samyakajñānāciyā | rāṇivā ugāṇūni tayā | parivāru hoūniyāṃ| rāhata āṃgeṃ || 68||
verses.meaning: Then, having attained the sovereignty of perfect knowledge, the individual becomes its retinue, abiding in its very essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: प्रवृत्तीचिये राजबिदीं। अवस्थाभेदप्रमदीं। कौजत आहे प्रतिपदीं। सुखाचें लोण॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pravṛttīciye rājabidīṃ| avasthābhedapramadīṃ| kaujata āhe pratipadīṃ| sukhāceṃ loṇa|| 69||
verses.meaning: On the royal path of worldly activity, in the delightful intoxication of different states of being, at every step, the salt of happiness is being offered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढां बोधाचिये कांबीवरी। विवेकु दृश्याची मांदी सारी। योगभूमिका आरती करी। येती जैसिया॥ १०७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhāṃ bodhāciye kāṃbīvarī| viveku dṛśyācī māṃdī sārī| yogabhūmikā āratī karī| yetī jaisiyā|| 1070||
verses.meaning: Upon the staff of spiritual wisdom, discrimination clears the multitude of worldly illusions. The stages of Yoga then come forward, offering their reverence as if with an arati lamp.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ क्रव्द्विसिद्धींची अनेगें। वृंदें मिळती प्रसंगे। तिये पुष्पवर्षी आंगें। नाहातसे तो ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha kravdvisiddhīṃcī anegeṃ| vṛṃdeṃ miḻatī prasaṃge| tiye puṣpavarṣī āṃgeṃ| nāhātase to || 79||
verses.meaning: There, hosts of Siddhas, those who have attained spiritual perfection, gather in multitudes, and he is bathed by the showering of flowers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि ब्रह्मौक्यासारिखें। स्वराज्य येतां जबळिकें । झळंबित आहे हरिखें। तिन्ही लोक ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni brahmaukyāsārikheṃ| svarājya yetāṃ jabaḻikeṃ | jhaḻaṃbita āhe harikheṃ| tinhī loka || 72||
verses.meaning: When such a state of oneness with Brahman, a true spiritual kingdom, comes near, all three worlds are illuminated with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां वैरिया कां मैत्रिया। तयासि माझें म्हणावया। समानता धनंजया । उरेचिही ना॥७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ vairiyā kāṃ maitriyā| tayāsi mājheṃ mhaṇāvayā| samānatā dhanaṃjayā | urecihī nā||73||
verses.meaning: Then, whether it is an enemy or a friend, to call them 'mine' — that equality, O Dhananjaya, does not remain at all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें ना भलतेणे व्याजें। तो जयातें म्हणे माझें। तें नोडवेचि कां दुजें। अद्वितीय जाला ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ nā bhalateṇe vyājeṃ| to jayāteṃ mhaṇe mājheṃ| teṃ noḍaveci kāṃ dujeṃ| advitīya jālā || 74||
verses.meaning: Indeed, by no other means, when He calls someone His own, that person becomes unrivaled and unique, with no second to him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आपुलिया एकी सत्ता। सर्वही कवळूनियां पंडुसुता। कहीं न लगती ममता । धाडिली तेणें ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āpuliyā ekī sattā| sarvahī kavaḻūniyāṃ paṃḍusutā| kahīṃ na lagatī mamatā | dhāḍilī teṇeṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: By His own single power, O son of Pandu, He encompasses everything, yet He is never attached. He has cast off all attachment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा जिंतिलिया रिपुवर्ग अपमानिळिया हें जगु। अपैसा योगतुरंगु। स्थिर जाला ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā jiṃtiliyā ripuvarga apamāniḻiyā heṃ jagu| apaisā yogaturaṃgu| sthira jālā || 76||
verses.meaning: Having thus conquered the enemies (senses) and humiliated this world (material desires), the horse of Yoga became steady and unwavering.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बैराग्याचें गाढलें। अंगीं त्राण होतें भलें। तेंही नावेक ढिलें। तेव्हां करी ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: bairāgyāceṃ gāḍhaleṃ| aṃgīṃ trāṇa hoteṃ bhaleṃ| teṃhī nāveka ḍhileṃ| tevhāṃ karī || 77||
verses.meaning: The strength of detachment, which was once so great, also became a little slack at that time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि निवटी ध्यानाचें खांडें। तें दुजें नाहींचि पुढें । म्हणौनि हातु आसुडे। वृत्तीचाही ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi nivaṭī dhyānāceṃ khāṃḍeṃ| teṃ dujeṃ nāhīṃci puḍheṃ | mhaṇauni hātu āsuḍe| vṛttīcāhī || 78||
verses.meaning: And it extinguishes the sword of meditation, for there is nothing else beyond. Therefore, it withdraws even the hand of the mind's modifications.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें रसौषध खरें। आपुलें काज करूनि पुरें। आपणही नुरे। तैसें होतसे ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ rasauṣadha khareṃ| āpuleṃ kāja karūni pureṃ| āpaṇahī nure| taiseṃ hotase || 79||
verses.meaning: Just as a true medicinal elixir, having fully accomplished its purpose, itself ceases to exist, so it happens.

verses.shloka_devanagari: देखोनि ठाकिता ठावो। धांवता थिरावे पावो। तैसा ब्रह्मसामीप्यें थाबो। अभ्यासु सांडी ॥ १०८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: dekhoni ṭhākitā ṭhāvo| dhāṃvatā thirāve pāvo| taisā brahmasāmīpyeṃ thābo| abhyāsu sāṃḍī || 1080||
verses.meaning: Just as a person stops running upon seeing their destination, so too does the spiritual practice cease when one attains proximity to Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घडतां महोदधीसी। गंगा वेगु सांडी जैसी। कां कामिनी कांतापासीं। स्थिर होय ॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghaḍatāṃ mahodadhīsī| gaṃgā vegu sāṃḍī jaisī| kāṃ kāminī kāṃtāpāsīṃ| sthira hoya || 81||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganga, upon reaching the great ocean, abandons its swift current, or as a beloved woman becomes still in the presence of her husband.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना फळतिये वेळे। केळीची वाढी मांटुळे। कां गांबापुढें वळे। मार्गु जैसा॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā phaḻatiye veḻe| keḻīcī vāḍhī māṃṭuḻe| kāṃ gāṃbāpuḍheṃ vaḻe| mārgu jaisā|| 82||
verses.meaning: Just as a banana tree grows and bears fruit, or as a path unfolds before a traveler, so too does the spiritual journey progress.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा आत्मसाक्षात्कारु। होईल देखोनि गोचरु । ऐसा साधनहतियेरू । हळूचि ठेवी॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā ātmasākṣātkāru| hoīla dekhoni gocaru | aisā sādhanahatiyerū | haḻūci ṭhevī|| 83||
verses.meaning: When the realization of the Self becomes manifest and visible, then gently lay aside the tools of spiritual practice.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ब्रह्मोंसीं तया । ऐक्याचा समो धनंजया। होतसे तें उपाया। बोहटु पडे॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni brahmoṃsīṃ tayā | aikyācā samo dhanaṃjayā| hotase teṃ upāyā| bohaṭu paḍe|| 84||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Dhananjaya, the union with Brahman, which is the ultimate goal, is achieved through this method.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग वैराग्याची गोंधळुक । जे ज्ञानाभ्यासाचें वार्धक्य । योगफळाचाही परिपाक । दशा जे कां॥८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga vairāgyācī goṃdhaḻuka | je jñānābhyāsāceṃ vārdhakya | yogaphaḻācāhī paripāka | daśā je kāṃ||85||
verses.meaning: Then, the culmination of dispassion, the maturity of the practice of knowledge, and the ripened fruit of yogic attainment—that is the state.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते शांति पैं गा सुभगा। संपूर्ण ये तयाचिया आंगा। तैं ब्रह्म 'होआवयाजोगा । होय तो पुरुषु॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: te śāṃti paiṃ gā subhagā| saṃpūrṇa ye tayāciyā āṃgā| taiṃ brahma 'hoāvayājogā | hoya to puruṣu|| 86||
verses.meaning: O fortunate one, when such peace completely pervades his being, then that person becomes worthy of becoming Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुनवेहूनी चतुर्दशी । जेतुळें उणेपण शशी । कां सोळे पाऊनि जैसी । पंधरावी वानी ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: punavehūnī caturdaśī | jetuḻeṃ uṇepaṇa śaśī | kāṃ soḻe pāūni jaisī | paṃdharāvī vānī || 87||
verses.meaning: Just as the moon on the fourteenth day of the lunar cycle is slightly less than the full moon, or like a sixteenth part of the moon is missing when compared to the full moon.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सागरींही पाणी वेगें। संचरे तें रूप गंगे। येर निश्चळ जें उगें। तें समुद्रु जैसा ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāgarīṃhī pāṇī vegeṃ| saṃcare teṃ rūpa gaṃge| yera niścaḻa jeṃ ugeṃ| teṃ samudru jaisā || 88 ||
verses.meaning: The water that flows swiftly in the ocean takes the form of the Ganga, while the still, calm water is like the ocean itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ब्रह्मा आणि ब्रह्महोतिये। योग्यते तैसा पाडु आहे। तेंचि शांतीचेनि लवलाहें॥ होय तो गा॥८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: brahmā āṇi brahmahotiye| yogyate taisā pāḍu āhe| teṃci śāṃtīceni lavalāheṃ|| hoya to gā||89||
verses.meaning: Brahma and the one who performs the Brahma-sacrifice are alike in their worthiness. This is achieved through the swiftness of peace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं तेंचि होणेंनवीण। प्रतीती आलें जें ब्रह्मपण। तें ब्रह्म होती जाण। योग्यता येथ॥ १०९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ teṃci hoṇeṃnavīṇa| pratītī āleṃ jeṃ brahmapaṇa| teṃ brahma hotī jāṇa| yogyatā yetha|| 1090||
verses.meaning: Indeed, that very state of Brahman, which is realized without any becoming, is the Brahman that one becomes; this is the true qualification.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते ब्रह्ममावयोग्यता। पुरुषु तो मग पंडुसुता । आत्मबोध प्रसन्नता-। पदीं बैसे ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: te brahmamāvayogyatā| puruṣu to maga paṃḍusutā | ātmabodha prasannatā-| padīṃ baise || 91||
verses.meaning: Then, O son of Pandu, that person, having attained the fitness for realizing Brahman, joyfully establishes himself in the state of self-realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें निपजे रससोय । तो तापुही जैं जाय। तैं ते कां होय । प्रसन्न जैसी ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ nipaje rasasoya | to tāpuhī jaiṃ jāya| taiṃ te kāṃ hoya | prasanna jaisī || 92||
verses.meaning: When the very heat that produces the taste and essence of food itself vanishes, how then can that food remain pleasing?

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना भरतिया लगबगा । शरत्काळीं सांडिजे गंगा । कां गीत राहतां उपांगा। बोहटु पडे ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā bharatiyā lagabagā | śaratkāḻīṃ sāṃḍije gaṃgā | kāṃ gīta rāhatāṃ upāṃgā| bohaṭu paḍe || 93||
verses.meaning: Just as various types of grains are discarded in the autumn, or as the accompanying instruments fall silent when the song ends, so too does the illusion of the world cease when true knowledge dawns.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा आत्मबोधीं उद्यमु। करितां होय जो श्रमु। तोही जेथें समु। होऊनि जाय ॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā ātmabodhīṃ udyamu| karitāṃ hoya jo śramu| tohī jetheṃ samu| hoūni jāya || 94||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the effort made in the pursuit of self-knowledge, even that exertion, becomes tranquil and ceases to be a burden.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आत्मबोधप्रशस्ती। हे तिये दशेची ख्याती। ते भोगीतसे महामती । योग्यु तो गा॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātmabodhapraśastī| he tiye daśecī khyātī| te bhogītase mahāmatī | yogyu to gā|| 95||
verses.meaning: The praise of self-realization is the glory of that state. The great-minded, the worthy one, experiences it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां आत्मत्वें ( अप्राप्ते) शोचावें।॥ कांहीं पावावया कामावें। हें सरलें समभावें। भरितें तया॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ ātmatveṃ ( aprāpte) śocāveṃ||| kāṃhīṃ pāvāvayā kāmāveṃ| heṃ saraleṃ samabhāveṃ| bhariteṃ tayā|| 96||
verses.meaning: Then, why lament over the self (which is never truly lost)? Why strive to attain something? All such distinctions cease in the state of equanimity, which fills everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदया येतां गभस्ती। नाना नक्षत्रव्यक्‍्ती। हारवीजती दीप्ती । आंगिका जेवीं॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: udayā yetāṃ gabhastī| nānā nakṣatravyak‍tī| hāravījatī dīptī | āṃgikā jevīṃ|| 97||
verses.meaning: Just as the rising sun diminishes the brilliance of various constellations, so too does the inner light of the self eclipse all external illuminations.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं उठतिया आत्मप्रथा। हे भूतभेदव्यवस्था । मोडीत मोडीत पार्था। वास पाहे तो॥ ९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ uṭhatiyā ātmaprathā| he bhūtabhedavyavasthā | moḍīta moḍīta pārthā| vāsa pāhe to|| 98||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the one who, by breaking down the distinctions of beings, awaits the dawning of the Self, is the true seeker.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाटियेवरील अक्षरें। जेसीं पुसतां येती करें॥ तैसीं हारपती भेदांतरें। तयाचिये दृष्टी ॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭiyevarīla akṣareṃ| jesīṃ pusatāṃ yetī kareṃ|| taisīṃ hārapatī bhedāṃtareṃ| tayāciye dṛṣṭī || 99||
verses.meaning: Just as letters written on a slate can be erased by hand, so too do all distinctions vanish from the sight of such a one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसेनि अन्यथाज्ञानें) जियें घेपती जागरस्वप्नें। तियें दोन्ही केली लीनें। अव्यक्तामाजीं ॥ ११००॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseni anyathājñāneṃ) jiyeṃ ghepatī jāgarasvapneṃ| tiyeṃ donhī kelī līneṃ| avyaktāmājīṃ || 1100||
verses.meaning: Similarly, through this false knowledge, the states of waking and dreaming, which are experienced, are both dissolved into the unmanifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेंही अव्यक्‍त। बोध वाढतां झिजत । पुरलां बोधीं समस्त । बुडोनि जाय॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga teṃhī avyak‍ta| bodha vāḍhatāṃ jhijata | puralāṃ bodhīṃ samasta | buḍoni jāya|| 1||
verses.meaning: Then, that unmanifest, as knowledge grows, diminishes. When completely filled with knowledge, it drowns and disappears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी भोजनाच्या व्यापारीं। क्षुधा जिरत जाय अवधारी । मग तृप्तीच्या अवसरीं । नाहींच होय ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī bhojanācyā vyāpārīṃ| kṣudhā jirata jāya avadhārī | maga tṛptīcyā avasarīṃ | nāhīṃca hoya || 2||
verses.meaning: Just as hunger gradually disappears for one engaged in eating, so too, at the moment of satisfaction, it ceases to exist entirely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना चालीचिया वाढी । वाट होत जाय थोडी । मग पातला ठायीं बुडी। देऊनि निमे॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā cālīciyā vāḍhī | vāṭa hota jāya thoḍī | maga pātalā ṭhāyīṃ buḍī| deūni nime|| 3||
verses.meaning: The path, which was created by various actions, gradually diminishes. Then, having reached its destination, it merges and ceases to be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां जागृती जंव जंव उददीपे। तंब तंब निद्रा हारपे । मग जागीनलिया स्वरूपें। नाहींच होय ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ jāgṛtī jaṃva jaṃva udadīpe| taṃba taṃba nidrā hārape | maga jāgīnaliyā svarūpeṃ| nāhīṃca hoya || 4||
verses.meaning: As wakefulness increasingly dawns, so too does sleep vanish. Then, in the form of one who has awakened, there is no longer any existence (of the dream state).

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें ना आपुलें पूर्णत्व भेटे । जेथ चंद्रासीं वाढी खुंटे । तेथ शुक्‍्लपक्षु आटे। निःशेषु जैसा ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ nā āpuleṃ pūrṇatva bheṭe | jetha caṃdrāsīṃ vāḍhī khuṃṭe | tetha śuk‍lapakṣu āṭe| niḥśeṣu jaisā || 5||
verses.meaning: This is not about attaining one's own completeness, where the moon's waxing ceases, and the bright fortnight ends completely, just as it does.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा बोध्यजात गिळितु। बोधु बोधें ये मज आंतु । मिसळला तेथ साद्यंतु। अबोधु गेला ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā bodhyajāta giḻitu| bodhu bodheṃ ye maja āṃtu | misaḻalā tetha sādyaṃtu| abodhu gelā || 6||
verses.meaning: Just as the knowable is absorbed, so too knowledge, through knowledge, merges into Me. There, ignorance completely vanishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां कल्पांताचिये वेळे। नदी सिंधूचें पेंडवळें। मोडूनि भरलें जळें। आब्रह्म जैसें॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ kalpāṃtāciye veḻe| nadī siṃdhūceṃ peṃḍavaḻeṃ| moḍūni bharaleṃ jaḻeṃ| ābrahma jaiseṃ||7||
verses.meaning: At the time of the cosmic dissolution, just as rivers and oceans overflow and merge, filling everything up to the abode of Brahma, so too does the universe dissolve into the ultimate reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना ना गेलिया घट मठ। आकाश ठाके एकवट। कां जळोनि काष्ठें काष्ठ । वन्हीचि होय ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā nā geliyā ghaṭa maṭha| ākāśa ṭhāke ekavaṭa| kāṃ jaḻoni kāṣṭheṃ kāṣṭha | vanhīci hoya || 8||
verses.meaning: When pots and monasteries are destroyed, the sky remains one and undivided. Similarly, when wood burns, it becomes one with the fire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी लेणियांचे ठसे । आटोनि गेलिया मुसे। नामरूपभेदें जैसें। सांडिजे सोनें ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī leṇiyāṃce ṭhase | āṭoni geliyā muse| nāmarūpabhedeṃ jaiseṃ| sāṃḍije soneṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Just as gold, when melted down from various ornaments, loses its distinct forms and names, yet remains gold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेंही असो चेइलया । तें स्वप्न नाहीं जालिया । मग आपणचि आपणयां। उरिजे जैसें॥ १११०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃhī aso ceilayā | teṃ svapna nāhīṃ jāliyā | maga āpaṇaci āpaṇayāṃ| urije jaiseṃ|| 1110||
verses.meaning: Let this also be. When the dream is gone after waking, then one remains as oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मी एकवांचूनि कांहीं । 'तया तयाहीसकट नाहीं।॥ हे चौथी भक्ति पाहीं । माझी तो लाहे ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mī ekavāṃcūni kāṃhīṃ | 'tayā tayāhīsakaṭa nāhīṃ||| he cauthī bhakti pāhīṃ | mājhī to lāhe || 19||
verses.meaning: Similarly, besides Me, there is nothing else, not even with all of creation. He who understands this attains My fourth form of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर आर्तु जिज्ञासु अर्थार्थी। हे भजती जिये पंथीं। ते तिन्ही पाबोनि चौथी । म्हणिपत आहे॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera ārtu jijñāsu arthārthī| he bhajatī jiye paṃthīṃ| te tinhī pāboni cauthī | mhaṇipata āhe|| 12||
verses.meaning: The distressed, the seeker of knowledge, and the seeker of wealth—these three, by the path they follow, attain the fourth state, it is said.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं तिजी ना चौथी। हे पहिली ना सरती। पैं माझिये सहजस्थिति।) भक्ति नाम॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ tijī nā cauthī| he pahilī nā saratī| paiṃ mājhiye sahajasthiti|) bhakti nāma|| 13||
verses.meaning: My natural state is not a third or fourth, nor a first or last; it is simply called devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें नेणणें माझें प्रकाशूनि । अन्यथात्वें मातें दाऊनि। सर्वही सर्वी भजौनि। बुझावीतसे जें ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ neṇaṇeṃ mājheṃ prakāśūni | anyathātveṃ māteṃ dāūni| sarvahī sarvī bhajauni| bujhāvītase jeṃ || 14||
verses.meaning: That which, by illuminating my ignorance, reveals me in a different light, and by pervading everything, consoles me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो जेथ जैसें पाहों बैसे। तया तेथ तैसेंचि असे। हें उजियेडें कां दिसे। अखंडें जेणें॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo jetha jaiseṃ pāhoṃ baise| tayā tetha taiseṃci ase| heṃ ujiyeḍeṃ kāṃ dise| akhaṃḍeṃ jeṇeṃ|| 15||
verses.meaning: Whatever one perceives, in whatever way, that is how it appears to them. This is because of the unbroken light by which everything is seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वपाचें दिसणें न दिसणें॥ जैसें आपलेनि असलेपणें । विश्वाचे आहे नाहीं जेणें। प्रकाशे तैसें ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: svapāceṃ disaṇeṃ na disaṇeṃ|| jaiseṃ āpaleni asalepaṇeṃ | viśvāce āhe nāhīṃ jeṇeṃ| prakāśe taiseṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: Just as the appearance and disappearance in a dream are due to one's own existence, so too the existence and non-existence of the universe are illuminated by that (Brahman).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा हा सहज माझा । प्रकाशु जो कपिध्वजा। तो भक्ति या बोजा। बोलिजे गा॥ १७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā hā sahaja mājhā | prakāśu jo kapidhvajā| to bhakti yā bojā| bolije gā|| 17||
verses.meaning: This natural radiance of mine, O Arjuna, is called devotion.
