verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आर्तांच्या ठायीं। हें आर्ति होऊनि पाहीं। अपेक्षणीय जें कांहीं । तें मीचि केला॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni ārtāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ| heṃ ārti hoūni pāhīṃ| apekṣaṇīya jeṃ kāṃhīṃ | teṃ mīci kelā|| 18||
verses.meaning: Therefore, among the distressed, I become their distress itself; and whatever they long for, that too I become.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जिज्ञासुपुढां वीरेशा । हेचि होऊनि जिज्ञासा। मी कां जिज्ञास्यु ऐसा । दाखविला ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jijñāsupuḍhāṃ vīreśā | heci hoūni jijñāsā| mī kāṃ jijñāsyu aisā | dākhavilā || 19||
verses.meaning: O Lord of the brave, before the seeker, this very inquiry arises: "Why have I been shown as the object of inquiry?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेचि होऊनि अर्थना । मीचि माझ्या अर्थी अर्जुना । करूनि अर्थाभिधाना । आणी मातें ॥ ९९२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heci hoūni arthanā | mīci mājhyā arthī arjunā | karūni arthābhidhānā | āṇī māteṃ || 9920||
verses.meaning: Becoming this very meaning, I Myself, for My own purpose, Arjuna, by giving Myself a name, bring Myself forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं घेऊनि अज्ञानातें। माझी भक्ति जे हे वर्ते। ते दाबी मज द्रष्ट्याते। दृश्य करूनि॥२१॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ gheūni ajñānāteṃ| mājhī bhakti je he varte| te dābī maja draṣṭyāte| dṛśya karūni||21||
verses.meaning: Thus, taking ignorance, this devotion of mine, which is active, reveals Me, the Seer, by making Me the seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथें मुखचि दिसे मुखें। या बोला कांहीं न चुके । परी दुजेपण हें लटिकें। आरिसा करी॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetheṃ mukhaci dise mukheṃ| yā bolā kāṃhīṃ na cuke | parī dujepaṇa heṃ laṭikeṃ| ārisā karī|| 22||
verses.meaning: Here, only the face sees the face. This statement is not wrong. But this duality is false, created by the mirror.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दिठी चंद्रच घे साचें। परी येतुलें हें तिमिराचें। जे एकचि असे तयाचे। दोनी दावी ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: diṭhī caṃdraca ghe sāceṃ| parī yetuleṃ heṃ timirāceṃ| je ekaci ase tayāce| donī dāvī || 23||
verses.meaning: The eye truly perceives the moon, yet it is this darkness that makes it appear as two, though it is but one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसा सर्वत्र मीचि मियां। घेपतसें भक्ति इया। परी दृश्यत्ब हें वायां। अज्ञानवशें ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tesā sarvatra mīci miyāṃ| ghepataseṃ bhakti iyā| parī dṛśyatba heṃ vāyāṃ| ajñānavaśeṃ || 24||
verses.meaning: Through this devotion, I am perceived everywhere by myself. But this perception of duality is futile, due to ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अज्ञान आतां फिटळें। माझें द्रष्ट्त्व मज भेटलें। निजबिंबीं एकवटलें। प्रतिबिंब जैसें ॥ २५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ ajñāna ātāṃ phiṭaḻeṃ| mājheṃ draṣṭtva maja bheṭaleṃ| nijabiṃbīṃ ekavaṭaleṃ| pratibiṃba jaiseṃ || 25 ||
verses.meaning: That ignorance has now vanished. My true nature has revealed itself to me. It has merged into its own original form, just like a reflection merges into the original object.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जेव्हाही असे किडाळ। तेव्हांही सोनेंचि अढळ। परी ते कीड गेलिया केवळ। उरे जैसें॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jevhāhī ase kiḍāḻa| tevhāṃhī soneṃci aḍhaḻa| parī te kīḍa geliyā kevaḻa| ure jaiseṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: Just as gold, even when tarnished, remains gold, and only when the tarnish is removed does its pure essence remain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा पूर्णिमिआधीं कायी । चंद्रु सावयवु नाहीं । परी तिये दिवशीं भेटे पाहीं । पूर्णता तया ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā pūrṇimiādhīṃ kāyī | caṃdru sāvayavu nāhīṃ | parī tiye divaśīṃ bheṭe pāhīṃ | pūrṇatā tayā || 27||
verses.meaning: Indeed, before the full moon, the moon is not complete in all its parts. But on that very day, behold, it attains its fullness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मीचि अज्ञानद्वारें। दिसें परी हस्तांतरें। मग द्रष्टृत्व तें सरे। मियांचि मी लाभें॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mīci ajñānadvāreṃ| diseṃ parī hastāṃtareṃ| maga draṣṭṛtva teṃ sare| miyāṃci mī lābheṃ|| 28||
verses.meaning: Similarly, through the gateway of ignorance, I appear as if through another's hand. But then, that state of being the 'seer' ceases, and I realize myself through myself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि दृश्यपथा-। अतीतु माझा पार्था । भक्तियोगु चवथा । म्हणितला गा ॥२९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni dṛśyapathā-| atītu mājhā pārthā | bhaktiyogu cavathā | mhaṇitalā gā ||29||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Partha, My path of devotion, the fourth one, is said to be beyond the visible realm.

verses.shloka_devanagari: या ज्ञानभक्ति सहज। भक्‍्तु एकवटला मज। मीचि केवळ हें तुज। श्रुतही आहे॥ ११३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā jñānabhakti sahaja| bhak‍tu ekavaṭalā maja| mīci kevaḻa heṃ tuja| śrutahī āhe|| 1130||
verses.meaning: Through this knowledge and devotion, the devotee becomes one with Me. You have heard that I am indeed the only reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे उभऊनियां भुजा। ज्ञानिया आत्मा माझा । ४७६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी हें बोळलिलों कपिध्वजा । सप्तमाध्यायीं ॥३१९॥
verses.shloka_iast: je ubhaūniyāṃ bhujā| jñāniyā ātmā mājhā | 476 śrījñāneśvarī heṃ boḻaliloṃ kapidhvajā | saptamādhyāyīṃ ||319||
verses.meaning: Thus, with arms raised, I, the soul of the wise, have spoken this Dnyaneshwari to you, O Kapidhwaja, in the seventh chapter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते हे कल्पादीं भक्ति मियां । भागवतमिषें ब्रह्मया। उत्तम म्हणौनि धनंजया । उपदेशिली ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te he kalpādīṃ bhakti miyāṃ | bhāgavatamiṣeṃ brahmayā| uttama mhaṇauni dhanaṃjayā | upadeśilī || 32||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, this very devotion, which is supreme, I taught to Brahma at the beginning of creation, under the guise of the Bhagavata (Purana).

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानी इयेतें स्वसंवित्ती। शैव म्हणती शक्ति। आम्ही परमभक्ति। आपुली म्हणों ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñānī iyeteṃ svasaṃvittī| śaiva mhaṇatī śakti| āmhī paramabhakti| āpulī mhaṇoṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: The wise call this self-realization; Shaivas call it Shakti. We, however, call it our supreme devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हे मज मिळतिये वेळे। तयां क्रमयोगियां फळे । मग समस्तही निखिळें। मियांचि भरे॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: he maja miḻatiye veḻe| tayāṃ kramayogiyāṃ phaḻe | maga samastahī nikhiḻeṃ| miyāṃci bhare|| 34||
verses.meaning: At the time when this (knowledge) is attained by those who follow the path of action (Karma Yoga), then all, everything, is filled by Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ वैराग्यविवेकेंसीं। आटे बंध मोक्षेंसीं। वृत्ती तये आवृत्तीसीं । बुडोनि जाय ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha vairāgyavivekeṃsīṃ| āṭe baṃdha mokṣeṃsīṃ| vṛttī taye āvṛttīsīṃ | buḍoni jāya || 35 ||
verses.meaning: There, with dispassion and discrimination, the bondage and liberation dissolve. The mind's modifications, in that very state, drown and disappear.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घेऊनि ऐलपणातें। परत्व हारपे जेथें गिळूनि चाऱ्ही भूतें आकाश जैसें ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: gheūni ailapaṇāteṃ| paratva hārape jetheṃ giḻūni cāṟhī bhūteṃ ākāśa jaiseṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky, having absorbed the four elements, loses its distinctness in the vastness of space, so too does the individual self, upon realizing its true nature, merge into the Supreme Self, losing its separate identity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया परी थडथाद। साध्यसाधनातीत शुद्ध। तें मी होऊनि एकवद। भोगितो मातें ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā parī thaḍathāda| sādhyasādhanātīta śuddha| teṃ mī hoūni ekavada| bhogito māteṃ || 37||
verses.meaning: In that manner, I, becoming one with that pure, ultimate reality, which is beyond all means and ends, experience myself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घडोनि सिंधूचिया आंगा। सिंधूवरी तळपे गंगा। तैसा पाडु तया भोगा । अवधारी जो॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: ghaḍoni siṃdhūciyā āṃgā| siṃdhūvarī taḻape gaṃgā| taisā pāḍu tayā bhogā | avadhārī jo|| 38||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganga, being born from the ocean, shines upon the ocean itself, so too, understand that this experience (of the Self) is like that.

verses.shloka_devanagari: का आरिसयासि आरिसा। उटूनि दाविलिया जैसा । देखणा अतिशयो तैसा। भोगणा तिये ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kā ārisayāsi ārisā| uṭūni dāviliyā jaisā | dekhaṇā atiśayo taisā| bhogaṇā tiye || 39||
verses.meaning: Or just as a mirror is shown to another mirror, so too is the seer, in his excess, the enjoyer of that very seeing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो दर्पणु नेलिया। तो मुखबोधुही गेलिया । देखलेंपण एकलेया। आस्वादिजे जेवीं॥ ११४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso darpaṇu neliyā| to mukhabodhuhī geliyā | dekhaleṃpaṇa ekaleyā| āsvādije jevīṃ|| 1140||
verses.meaning: Just as when a mirror is taken away, the reflection of the face also disappears, and one experiences the pure joy of seeing, unburdened by the reflection.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चेइलिया स्वप्न नाशे। आपलें ऐक्यचि दिसे। तें दुजेनवीण जैसें ।॥ भोगिजे का॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ceiliyā svapna nāśe| āpaleṃ aikyaci dise| teṃ dujenavīṇa jaiseṃ ||| bhogije kā|| 41||
verses.meaning: When the dream ends, one's own oneness is revealed. How can that be experienced as if it were separate?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोचि जालिया भोगु तयाचा । न घडे हा भावो जयांचा । तिहीं बोलें केवीं बोलाचा । उच्चारु कौजे॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: toci jāliyā bhogu tayācā | na ghaḍe hā bhāvo jayāṃcā | tihīṃ boleṃ kevīṃ bolācā | uccāru kauje|| 42||
verses.meaning: If one does not believe that the experience itself becomes the enjoyer, then how can one even begin to speak of such a concept?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयांच्या नेणों गांबीं। रवी प्रकाशी हन दिवी। कीं व्योमालागीं मांडवी । उभिली तिहीं ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃcyā neṇoṃ gāṃbīṃ| ravī prakāśī hana divī| kīṃ vyomālāgīṃ māṃḍavī | ubhilī tihīṃ || 43||
verses.meaning: Is it that the sun illuminates the lamp in their house? Or that the sky has erected a canopy for them?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा राजन्यत्व नव्हतां आंगीं । रावो रायपण काय भोगी। कां आंधारु हन आलिंगी । दिनकरातें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā rājanyatva navhatāṃ āṃgīṃ | rāvo rāyapaṇa kāya bhogī| kāṃ āṃdhāru hana āliṃgī | dinakarāteṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: How can a king enjoy his kingship without the qualities of a king? Or how can darkness embrace the sun?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आकाश जें नव्हे। तया आकाश काय जाणवे । रत्नाच्या रूपीं मिरवे । गुंजांचें लेणें ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ākāśa jeṃ navhe| tayā ākāśa kāya jāṇave | ratnācyā rūpīṃ mirave | guṃjāṃceṃ leṇeṃ || 45 ||
verses.meaning: And what does the sky, which is not, know of the sky? It is like adorning a jewel with rosary peas.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मी होणें नाहीं । तया मीचि आहें केहीं। मग भजेल हें कायी। बोलों कौर॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mī hoṇeṃ nāhīṃ | tayā mīci āheṃ kehīṃ| maga bhajela heṃ kāyī| boloṃ kaura|| 46||
verses.meaning: Therefore, there is no 'I' for Me. I am indeed that 'I'. Then, what is there to worship? What more can be said?

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं तो क्रमयोगी। मी जालाचि मातें भोगी। तारुण्य कां तरुणांगीं। जियापरी॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ to kramayogī| mī jālāci māteṃ bhogī| tāruṇya kāṃ taruṇāṃgīṃ| jiyāparī|| 47||
verses.meaning: Therefore, that yogi who follows the path of action, experiences Me as if I am his own self, just as youth naturally experiences itself in a young body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरंग सर्वांगी तोय चुंबी। प्रभा सर्वत्र विलसे बिंबीं । नाना अवकाश नभीं। लुंठतु जैसा॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taraṃga sarvāṃgī toya cuṃbī| prabhā sarvatra vilase biṃbīṃ | nānā avakāśa nabhīṃ| luṃṭhatu jaisā|| 48||
verses.meaning: Just as the waves embrace the water everywhere, and the light shines universally in all reflections, or as space pervades all diverse forms in the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा रूप होऊनि माझें। मातें क्रियावीण तो भजे। अलंकारु का सहजें। सोनयातें जेवीं॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā rūpa hoūni mājheṃ| māteṃ kriyāvīṇa to bhaje| alaṃkāru kā sahajeṃ| sonayāteṃ jevīṃ|| 49||
verses.meaning: Just as gold naturally adorns itself, so too does one who becomes one with My form worship Me without any action.

verses.shloka_devanagari: का चंदनाची द्वुती जैसी। चंदनीं भजे अपैसी। का अकृत्रिम शशीं। चंद्रिका ते॥११५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kā caṃdanācī dvutī jaisī| caṃdanīṃ bhaje apaisī| kā akṛtrima śaśīṃ| caṃdrikā te||1150||
verses.meaning: Just as the fragrance of sandalwood naturally permeates the sandalwood itself, or as moonlight inherently belongs to the moon.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी क्रिया कौर न साहे। तऱही अद्वेतीं भक्ति आहे हें अनुभवाचिजोगें नव्हे। बोलाऐसें ॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī kriyā kaura na sāhe| taṟahī advetīṃ bhakti āhe heṃ anubhavācijogeṃ navhe| bolāaiseṃ ||51||
verses.meaning: Just as action cannot be endured by the Kauravas, so too is devotion in non-duality not merely a matter of words; it is to be experienced.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां पूर्वसंस्कारछंदें। जें कांहीं तो अनुवादे। तेणें आळविलेनि वो दें। बोलतां मीचि॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ pūrvasaṃskārachaṃdeṃ| jeṃ kāṃhīṃ to anuvāde| teṇeṃ āḻavileni vo deṃ| bolatāṃ mīci|| 52||
verses.meaning: Then, whatever he speaks, prompted by the impressions of past deeds, through that invocation, it is I who speak.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बोलतया बोलताचि भेटे। तेथें बोलिलें हें न घटे। तें मौन तंव गोमटें। स्तवन माझें ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: bolatayā bolatāci bheṭe| tetheṃ bolileṃ heṃ na ghaṭe| teṃ mauna taṃva gomaṭeṃ| stavana mājheṃ || 53||
verses.meaning: The one who speaks meets the one who is spoken to. There, speaking is not appropriate. Such silence is indeed beautiful, and that is my praise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तया बोलतां। बोली बोलतां मी भेटतां। मोन होय तेणें तत्त्वतां। स्तवितो मातें ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tayā bolatāṃ| bolī bolatāṃ mī bheṭatāṃ| mona hoya teṇeṃ tattvatāṃ| stavito māteṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: Therefore, when one speaks, and in that speech, I am encountered, then truly, through that silence, one praises Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसेंचि बुद्धी का दिठी। जें तो देखों जाय किरीटी।॥ तें देखणें दृश्य लोटी। देखतेंचि दावी ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃci buddhī kā diṭhī| jeṃ to dekhoṃ jāya kirīṭī||| teṃ dekhaṇeṃ dṛśya loṭī| dekhateṃci dāvī || 55||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when the intellect or sight attempts to perceive something, it discards the perceived object and reveals only the perceiver.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आरिसया आधीं जैसें । देखतेंचि मुख दिसे। तयाचें देखणें तैसें । मेळवी द्रष्टे ॥५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ārisayā ādhīṃ jaiseṃ | dekhateṃci mukha dise| tayāceṃ dekhaṇeṃ taiseṃ | meḻavī draṣṭe ||56||
verses.meaning: Just as a face is seen in a mirror even before one looks, so too does the seer perceive it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दृश्य जाउनियां द्रष्टें। द्रष्टयासीचि जैं भेटे। ते एकलेपणें न घटे। द्रष्टेपणही ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: dṛśya jāuniyāṃ draṣṭeṃ| draṣṭayāsīci jaiṃ bheṭe| te ekalepaṇeṃ na ghaṭe| draṣṭepaṇahī || 57||
verses.meaning: When the seen merges into the seer, then even the state of being a seer does not remain in that solitude.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ स्वप्नींचिया प्रिया । चेबोनि झोंबों गेळिया । ठायिजे दोन्ही न होनियां। आपणचि जैसें ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha svapnīṃciyā priyā | ceboni jhoṃboṃ geḻiyā | ṭhāyije donhī na honiyāṃ| āpaṇaci jaiseṃ || 58||
verses.meaning: Just as in a dream, when one tries to embrace a beloved, the two do not remain separate, but become one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: का दोहीं काष्ठांचिये घृष्टी-। माजीं वन्हि एक उठी। तो दोन्ही हे भाष आटी। आपणचि होय ॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kā dohīṃ kāṣṭhāṃciye ghṛṣṭī-| mājīṃ vanhi eka uṭhī| to donhī he bhāṣa āṭī| āpaṇaci hoya ||59||
verses.meaning: Just as fire, born from the friction of two sticks, consumes both and becomes itself, so too does the divine essence manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नाना प्रतिबिंब हातीं। घेऊं गेलिया गभस्ती। बिंबताही असती । जाय जैसी॥ ११६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: nānā pratibiṃba hātīṃ| gheūṃ geliyā gabhastī| biṃbatāhī asatī | jāya jaisī|| 1160||
verses.meaning: Just as one cannot grasp the reflection of the sun, even though it appears to be there, so too is the nature of the ultimate reality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मी होऊनि देखतें। तो घेऊं जाय दृश्यातें। तेथ दृश्य ने थितें। द्रष्टृत्वेंसी ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mī hoūni dekhateṃ| to gheūṃ jāya dṛśyāteṃ| tetha dṛśya ne thiteṃ| draṣṭṛtveṃsī || 61||
verses.meaning: When I become the seer, and try to grasp the seen, the seen vanishes along with the very act of seeing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रवि आंधारु प्रकाशिता । नुरेचि जेवीं प्रकाश्यता । तेवीं दृश्यीं नाहीं द्रष्ट्ता। मी जालिया॥६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ravi āṃdhāru prakāśitā | nureci jevīṃ prakāśyatā | tevīṃ dṛśyīṃ nāhīṃ draṣṭtā| mī jāliyā||62||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun illuminates darkness, yet the darkness itself does not remain as something to be illuminated, so too, when I am realized, there is no seer in the seen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग देखिजे ना न देखिजे। ऐसी जे दशा निपजे। ते तें दर्शन माझें। साचोकारें॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga dekhije nā na dekhije| aisī je daśā nipaje| te teṃ darśana mājheṃ| sācokāreṃ|| 63||
verses.meaning: Then, that state which arises, where one neither sees nor does not see, that indeed is My true vision.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें भलतयाही किरीटी। पदार्थाचिया भेटी । द्रष्ट्दृश्यातीता दृष्टी । भोगितो सदा ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ bhalatayāhī kirīṭī| padārthāciyā bheṭī | draṣṭdṛśyātītā dṛṣṭī | bhogito sadā || 64||
verses.meaning: That (Brahman) always enjoys, with a vision beyond the seer and the seen, the encounter with any object, even the most insignificant.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि आकाश हें आकाशें। दाटलें न ढळें जैसें । मियां आत्मेन आपणणें तैसें । जालें तया ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi ākāśa heṃ ākāśeṃ| dāṭaleṃ na ḍhaḻeṃ jaiseṃ | miyāṃ ātmena āpaṇaṇeṃ taiseṃ | jāleṃ tayā || 65 ||
verses.meaning: And just as the sky is filled with sky, yet does not overflow, so too was it for him, filled with My Self, by My Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कल्पांती उदक उदकें । रुंधिलियां वाहों ठाके। तैसा आत्मेनि मियां येकें। कोंदला तो॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kalpāṃtī udaka udakeṃ | ruṃdhiliyāṃ vāhoṃ ṭhāke| taisā ātmeni miyāṃ yekeṃ| koṃdalā to|| 66||
verses.meaning: When the waters of the deluge rise and merge into one, filling everything, so too is the entire universe pervaded and filled by Me, the one Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पावो आपणपयां बोळघे। केवीं वन्हि आपणपयां लागे। आपणपां पाणी रिघे। स्तनाना कैसें ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāvo āpaṇapayāṃ boḻaghe| kevīṃ vanhi āpaṇapayāṃ lāge| āpaṇapāṃ pāṇī righe| stanānā kaiseṃ || 67||
verses.meaning: How can fire burn itself? How can water enter itself? How can milk enter the breasts?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि सर्व मी जालेपणें। ठेलें तया येणें जाणें। तेचि गा यात्रा करणें। अट्ठटया मज॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni sarva mī jālepaṇeṃ| ṭheleṃ tayā yeṇeṃ jāṇeṃ| teci gā yātrā karaṇeṃ| aṭṭhaṭayā maja|| 68||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by becoming everything, their coming and going ceases. That, indeed, is the pilgrimage, the arduous journey for Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जळावरील तरंगु। जरी धांवबिन्नला सवेगु । तरी नाहीं भूमिभागु। क्रमिला तेणें ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jaḻāvarīla taraṃgu| jarī dhāṃvabinnalā savegu | tarī nāhīṃ bhūmibhāgu| kramilā teṇeṃ || 69||
verses.meaning: Just as a wave on water, though it rushes swiftly, does not leave the water's surface and traverse the land.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें सांडावें कां मांडावें । जें चालणे जेणें चालावें। तें तोयचि एक आघवें। म्हणौनियां॥ ११७० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ sāṃḍāveṃ kāṃ māṃḍāveṃ | jeṃ cālaṇe jeṇeṃ cālāveṃ| teṃ toyaci eka āghaveṃ| mhaṇauniyāṃ|| 1170 ||
verses.meaning: What is to be discarded, or what is to be established; what is to be followed, or by whom it is to be followed—all of that is indeed one. Therefore.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गेलियाही भलतेउता। उदकपणें पंडुसुता । तरंगाची एकात्मता। न मोडेचि जेवीं ॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: geliyāhī bhalateutā| udakapaṇeṃ paṃḍusutā | taraṃgācī ekātmatā| na moḍeci jevīṃ ||79||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, just as water, even when it takes the form of waves, does not lose its oneness with the water itself, so too is the nature of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मीपणें हा लोटला (हालों ठेला )। तो आघवेंयाचि मजआंतु आला । या यात्रा होय भला । कापडी माझा॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mīpaṇeṃ hā loṭalā (hāloṃ ṭhelā )| to āghaveṃyāci majaāṃtu ālā | yā yātrā hoya bhalā | kāpaḍī mājhā|| 72||
verses.meaning: In the same way, this one who has cast off his ego (I-ness) has come entirely within Me. Thus, this pilgrim becomes My true devotee.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि शरीर स्वभाववशें। कांहीं येक करूं जरी बैसे। तरी मीचि तो तेणें मिषें। भेटें तया॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi śarīra svabhāvavaśeṃ| kāṃhīṃ yeka karūṃ jarī baise| tarī mīci to teṇeṃ miṣeṃ| bheṭeṃ tayā|| 73||
verses.meaning: And if, by the very nature of the body, one undertakes any action, then through that very act, I meet them.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ कर्म आणि कर्ता । हें जाऊनि पंडुसुता । मियां आत्मेनि ४७८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी मज पाहतां। मीचि होय॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha karma āṇi kartā | heṃ jāūni paṃḍusutā | miyāṃ ātmeni 478 śrījñāneśvarī maja pāhatāṃ| mīci hoya|| 74||
verses.meaning: There, action and the doer, O son of Pandu, having vanished, by seeing Me, the Self, I Myself become.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं दर्पणातें दर्पणें। पाहिळिया होय न पहाणें। सोनें झांकिलिया सुवर्णे । न झांकें जेवीं ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ darpaṇāteṃ darpaṇeṃ| pāhiḻiyā hoya na pahāṇeṃ| soneṃ jhāṃkiliyā suvarṇe | na jhāṃkeṃ jevīṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Just as a mirror looking into another mirror does not truly see itself, and gold covered by gold is not truly hidden, so too is the nature of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दीपातें दीपें प्रकाशिजे। तें न प्रकाशणेंचि निपजे। तैसें कर्म मियां कौजे। तें करणें कैंचें ॥७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: dīpāteṃ dīpeṃ prakāśije| teṃ na prakāśaṇeṃci nipaje| taiseṃ karma miyāṃ kauje| teṃ karaṇeṃ kaiṃceṃ ||76||
verses.meaning: Just as a lamp cannot illuminate another lamp, so too can my actions not truly be called 'doing' in the conventional sense.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कर्मही करितचि आहे। जैं करावें हें भाष जाये । तैं न करणेंचि होये । तयाचें केलें॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: karmahī karitaci āhe| jaiṃ karāveṃ heṃ bhāṣa jāye | taiṃ na karaṇeṃci hoye | tayāceṃ keleṃ|| 77||
verses.meaning: He is indeed performing actions. When the thought of 'I must do this' vanishes, then his actions become as if they were not done at all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: क्रियाजात मी जालेपणें । घडे कांहींचि न करणें । 'तयाचि नांव पूजणें । खुणेचें माझें ॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kriyājāta mī jālepaṇeṃ | ghaḍe kāṃhīṃci na karaṇeṃ | 'tayāci nāṃva pūjaṇeṃ | khuṇeceṃ mājheṃ || 78||
verses.meaning: When all actions cease to be performed by me, that very state of non-doing is what I call my true worship, a worship of inner realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि करीतयाही वोजा तें न करणें हेंचि कपिध्वजा। निफजे तिया महापूजा । पूजी तो मातें ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni karītayāhī vojā teṃ na karaṇeṃ heṃci kapidhvajā| niphaje tiyā mahāpūjā | pūjī to māteṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Arjuna, not doing anything in the manner of a doer, this itself is the great worship; with this worship, he worships Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं तो बोले तें स्तवन। तो देखे तें दर्शन। अट्ठया मज गमन। तो चाले तेंचि॥ ११८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ to bole teṃ stavana| to dekhe teṃ darśana| aṭṭhayā maja gamana| to cāle teṃci|| 1180||
verses.meaning: Thus, whatever he speaks is praise, whatever he sees is a vision, and whatever he walks is my journey.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो करी तेतुली पूजा। तो कल्पी तो जपु माझा । तो असे तेचि कपिध्वजा। समाधी माझी ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: to karī tetulī pūjā| to kalpī to japu mājhā | to ase teci kapidhvajā| samādhī mājhī || 89||
verses.meaning: Whatever he does, that is My worship. Whatever he imagines, that is My meditation. Whatever state he is in, that, O Arjuna, is My samadhi.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें कनकेंसीं कांकणें। असिजे अनन्यपणें। तो भक्क्‍तियोगें येणें । मजसीं तैसा ॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ kanakeṃsīṃ kāṃkaṇeṃ| asije ananyapaṇeṃ| to bhakk‍tiyogeṃ yeṇeṃ | majasīṃ taisā || 82||
verses.meaning: Just as bangles are inseparably one with gold, so too, through this path of devotion, am I with my devotee.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदकीं कल्लोळु । कापुरीं परिमळु। रत्नीं उजाळु। अनन्यु जैसा॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: udakīṃ kalloḻu | kāpurīṃ parimaḻu| ratnīṃ ujāḻu| ananyu jaisā|| 83||
verses.meaning: Just as a wave is inseparable from water, fragrance from camphor, and luster from a gem, so too is the divine essence inseparable from all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना तंतूंसी पटु । कां मृत्तिकेसीं घटु। तैसा तो एकवटु। मजसीं माझा॥८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā taṃtūṃsī paṭu | kāṃ mṛttikesīṃ ghaṭu| taisā to ekavaṭu| majasīṃ mājhā||84||
verses.meaning: Just as a cloth is to its threads, or a pot to its clay, so too am I inseparably united with myself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया अनन्यसिद्धा भक्‍ती। या आघवाचि दृश्यजातीं। मज आपणपेंया सुमती । द्रष्टयाते जाण ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā ananyasiddhā bhak‍tī| yā āghavāci dṛśyajātīṃ| maja āpaṇapeṃyā sumatī | draṣṭayāte jāṇa || 85||
verses.meaning: Through this unwavering devotion, in all visible creation, know me, the Seer, as your very own self, O wise one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिन्ही अवस्थांचेनि द्वारे। उपाध्युपहिताकारें। भावाभावरूप स्फुरे। दृश्य जें हें॥८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tinhī avasthāṃceni dvāre| upādhyupahitākāreṃ| bhāvābhāvarūpa sphure| dṛśya jeṃ heṃ||86||
verses.meaning: Through the three states of waking, dream, and deep sleep, the world of phenomena, with its positive and negative aspects, appears as if conditioned by adjuncts.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें हें आघवेंचि मी द्रष्टा। ऐसिया बोधाचा माजिवटा। अनुभवाचा सुभटा। धेंडा तो नाचे॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ heṃ āghaveṃci mī draṣṭā| aisiyā bodhācā mājivaṭā| anubhavācā subhaṭā| dheṃḍā to nāce|| 87||
verses.meaning: I am the seer of all this; in the pride of such knowledge, the brave one of experience dances with joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रज्जु जालिया गोचरु । आभासतां तो व्याळाकारु । रजुचि ऐसा निर्धारु । होय जेवीं ॥८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: rajju jāliyā gocaru | ābhāsatāṃ to vyāḻākāru | rajuci aisā nirdhāru | hoya jevīṃ ||88||
verses.meaning: Just as a rope, when perceived as a snake, is definitively known to be a rope upon closer inspection.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भांगारापरतें कांहीं। लेणें गुंजहीभरी नाहीं। हें आटुनियां ठायीं। कीजे जैसें॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhāṃgārāparateṃ kāṃhīṃ| leṇeṃ guṃjahībharī nāhīṃ| heṃ āṭuniyāṃ ṭhāyīṃ| kīje jaiseṃ|| 89||
verses.meaning: Just as, apart from gold, there is no ornament even as heavy as a gunja berry, and this is understood and then acted upon.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उदका येकापरतें। तरंग नाहींचि हें निरुतें। जाणोनि तया आकारातें। न घेपे जेवीं ॥ ११९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: udakā yekāparateṃ| taraṃga nāhīṃci heṃ niruteṃ| jāṇoni tayā ākārāteṃ| na ghepe jevīṃ || 1190||
verses.meaning: Just as a wave is not separate from water, and knowing this, one does not perceive the wave as a distinct form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी स्वप्नविकारां समस्तां । चेऊनियां उमाणें घेतां। तो आपणयापरौता । न दिसे जैसा॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī svapnavikārāṃ samastāṃ | ceūniyāṃ umāṇeṃ ghetāṃ| to āpaṇayāparautā | na dise jaisā|| 91||
verses.meaning: Or, just as a person, upon waking from a dream, realizes that all the dream-experiences were not separate from themselves, but were merely their own projections.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें जें कांहीं आथी नाथी । येणें होय ज्ञेयस्फूर्ती । तें ज्ञाताचि मी हे प्रतीती । होऊनि भोगी॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ āthī nāthī | yeṇeṃ hoya jñeyasphūrtī | teṃ jñātāci mī he pratītī | hoūni bhogī|| 92||
verses.meaning: Whatever exists or does not exist, through this the knowledge of the knowable arises. That knower, I am this realization, and thus experiences it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जाणे अजु मी अजरु। अक्षयो मी अक्षरु। अपूर्व मी अपारु। आनंदु मी॥९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jāṇe aju mī ajaru| akṣayo mī akṣaru| apūrva mī apāru| ānaṃdu mī||93||
verses.meaning: I am unborn, I am ageless. I am imperishable, I am the indestructible syllable (Brahman). I am unprecedented, I am boundless. I am bliss itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अचळु मी अच्युतु। अनंतु मी अद्वैतु। आद्यु मी अव्यक्तु । व्यक्‍्तुही मी॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: acaḻu mī acyutu| anaṃtu mī advaitu| ādyu mī avyaktu | vyak‍tuhī mī|| 94||
verses.meaning: I am the unmoving, the unfallen. I am the infinite, the non-dual. I am the primal, the unmanifest, and also the manifest.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ईश्य मी ईश्वरू। अनादि मी अमरु। अभय मी आधारु । आधेय मी॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: īśya mī īśvarū| anādi mī amaru| abhaya mī ādhāru | ādheya mī|| 95||
verses.meaning: I am the Lord, I am the eternal, I am the immortal. I am the fearless, I am the support, I am the supported.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वामी मी सदोदितु। सहजु मी सततु। सर्व मी सर्वगतु। सर्वातीतु मी॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: svāmī mī sadoditu| sahaju mī satatu| sarva mī sarvagatu| sarvātītu mī|| 96||
verses.meaning: I am the eternal Lord, I am naturally continuous, I am all-pervading, I am beyond all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नवा मी पुराणु । शून्यु मी संपूर्ण । स्थुलु मी अणु । जें कांहीं तें मी ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: navā mī purāṇu | śūnyu mī saṃpūrṇa | sthulu mī aṇu | jeṃ kāṃhīṃ teṃ mī || 97||
verses.meaning: I am the new, I am the ancient. I am the complete void, I am the atom. Whatever exists, that I am.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अक्रियु मी येकु। असंगु मी अशोकु । व्याप्यु मी व्यापकु। पुरुषोत्तु मी॥९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: akriyu mī yeku| asaṃgu mī aśoku | vyāpyu mī vyāpaku| puruṣottu mī||98||
verses.meaning: I am the one who is actionless. I am unattached and sorrowless. I am the pervaded and the pervader. I am the Supreme Being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अशब्दु मी अश्रोत्री| अरूपु मी अगोत्रु। समु मी स्वतंत्रु। ब्रह्म मी परु॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aśabdu mī aśrotrī| arūpu mī agotru| samu mī svataṃtru| brahma mī paru|| 99||
verses.meaning: I am beyond words, beyond hearing. I am formless, without lineage. I am equanimous, self-existent. I am the Supreme Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें आत्मत्वें मज एकातें। इया अट्ठयभक्‍्ती जाणोनि निरुतें। आणि याही बोधा जाणतें। तेंही मीचि जाणें ॥ १२००॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ ātmatveṃ maja ekāteṃ| iyā aṭṭhayabhak‍tī jāṇoni niruteṃ| āṇi yāhī bodhā jāṇateṃ| teṃhī mīci jāṇeṃ || 1200||
verses.meaning: Thus, knowing Me alone as the Self, through these eightfold devotions, and knowing that which knows this understanding, that too is Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं चेइलेयानंतरें । आपुलें एकपण उरे। तेंही तोंबरी स्फुरे। तयाशींचि जैसें ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ ceileyānaṃtareṃ | āpuleṃ ekapaṇa ure| teṃhī toṃbarī sphure| tayāśīṃci jaiseṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: When the world is dissolved, only one's own singular being remains. Even that, however, manifests itself only in relation to that very same singular being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां प्रकाशतां अर्कु। तोचि होय प्रकाशकु । तयाही अभेदा द्योतकु। तोचि जैसा॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ prakāśatāṃ arku| toci hoya prakāśaku | tayāhī abhedā dyotaku| toci jaisā|| 2||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun, by its very nature, illuminates itself and everything else, so too is the Self the illuminator of its own non-duality.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा वेद्यांच्या विलयीं। केवळ वेदकु उरे पाहीं॥ तेणें जाणवे तयातेंही । हेंही जो जाणे ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā vedyāṃcyā vilayīṃ| kevaḻa vedaku ure pāhīṃ|| teṇeṃ jāṇave tayāteṃhī | heṃhī jo jāṇe || 3||
verses.meaning: Just as when the Vedas dissolve, only the essence of the Vedas remains, through that essence, one comes to know even that which knows this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अद्वयपणा आपुलिया । जाणती ज्ञप्ती जे धनंजया। ते ईश्वरचि मी हे तया । बोधासि ये॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā advayapaṇā āpuliyā | jāṇatī jñaptī je dhanaṃjayā| te īśvaraci mī he tayā | bodhāsi ye|| 4||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, those who realize their own non-duality, that knowledge itself, they come to understand that 'I am indeed that Ishwara (God)'.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग ह्वैताद्वैतातीत। मीचि आत्मा एकु निभ्रांत । हें जाणोनि जाणणें जेथ। अनुभवीं रिघे॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga hvaitādvaitātīta| mīci ātmā eku nibhrāṃta | heṃ jāṇoni jāṇaṇeṃ jetha| anubhavīṃ righe||5||
verses.meaning: Then, beyond duality and non-duality, I alone am the undoubted Self. Knowing this, the knowing that enters into direct experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ चेइलयां येकपण। दिसे जें आपुल्यां आपण । तेंही जातां नेणों कोण। होइजे जेवीं ॥६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha ceilayāṃ yekapaṇa| dise jeṃ āpulyāṃ āpaṇa | teṃhī jātāṃ neṇoṃ koṇa| hoije jevīṃ ||6||
verses.meaning: When that awakening of oneness occurs, what is seen as one's own self, upon its departure, becomes something unknown, just as it was before.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां डोळां देखतिये क्षणीं । सुवर्णपण सुवर्णी । नाटितां होय आटणी । अळंकाराचीही॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ḍoḻāṃ dekhatiye kṣaṇīṃ | suvarṇapaṇa suvarṇī | nāṭitāṃ hoya āṭaṇī | aḻaṃkārācīhī|| 7||
verses.meaning: Just as, the moment the eye perceives gold, the goldness in the gold is not diminished, so too, the ornaments do not lose their form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना ना लबण तोय होये । मग क्षारता तोयत्बें राहे। तेही जिरतां जेवीं जाये । जालेपण तें॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā nā labaṇa toya hoye | maga kṣāratā toyatbeṃ rāhe| tehī jiratāṃ jevīṃ jāye | jālepaṇa teṃ||8||
verses.meaning: When salt dissolves in water, it becomes one with the water, and its saltiness remains within the water. But when even that water evaporates, the very existence of the saltiness, and the water, ceases to be.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मी तो हें जें असे। तें स्वानंदानुभवसमरसें। 'कालवूनियां प्रवेशे। मजचिमाजीं ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mī to heṃ jeṃ ase| teṃ svānaṃdānubhavasamaraseṃ| 'kālavūniyāṃ praveśe| majacimājīṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Just as I am, that very 'I' dissolves into the blissful experience of my true self, entering into me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तो हे भाष जेथ जाये तेथें मी हें कोण्हासी आहे। ऐसा मी ना तो तिये सामाये। माझ्याचि रूपीं॥ ९१२१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi to he bhāṣa jetha jāye tetheṃ mī heṃ koṇhāsī āhe| aisā mī nā to tiye sāmāye| mājhyāci rūpīṃ|| 91210||
verses.meaning: And wherever this discourse goes, there I am, not belonging to anyone. I am not that, nor is that me; it merges into my very form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेव्हां कापुर जळों सरे। तयाचि नाम अग्नि पुरे। मग उभयातीत उरे। आकाश जेवीं ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: jevhāṃ kāpura jaḻoṃ sare| tayāci nāma agni pure| maga ubhayātīta ure| ākāśa jevīṃ || 11||
verses.meaning: When camphor burns completely, its name 'fire' also ceases to exist. Then, what remains is beyond both, just like the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां धाडलिया एका एकु । वाढे तो शून्य विशेखु। तैसा आहे नाहींचा शेखु । मीचि मग आथी ॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ dhāḍaliyā ekā eku | vāḍhe to śūnya viśekhu| taisā āhe nāhīṃcā śekhu | mīci maga āthī || 12||
verses.meaning: Just as a single zero, when multiplied by one, remains a zero, similarly, the ultimate reality of 'is' and 'is not' is 'I' (the Self) alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ ब्रह्मा आत्मा ईशु॥ यया बोला मोडे सौरसु। न बोलणें याही पैसु। नाहीं तेथ॥१३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha brahmā ātmā īśu|| yayā bolā moḍe saurasu| na bolaṇeṃ yāhī paisu| nāhīṃ tetha||13||
verses.meaning: There, the Supreme Being, the Soul, the Lord—these words lose their charm. Even silence finds no entry there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न बोलणेही न बोलोनी। तें बोलिजे तोंड भरुनी। जाणिव नेणिव नेणोनी। जाणिजे तें॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: na bolaṇehī na bolonī| teṃ bolije toṃḍa bharunī| jāṇiva neṇiva neṇonī| jāṇije teṃ|| 94||
verses.meaning: That which is beyond speech, yet spoken fully; that which is known by transcending both knowledge and ignorance.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ बुझिजे बोधु बोधें। आनंदु घेपे आनंदें। सुखावरी नुसधें। सुखचि भोगिजे॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha bujhije bodhu bodheṃ| ānaṃdu ghepe ānaṃdeṃ| sukhāvarī nusadheṃ| sukhaci bhogije|| 15||
verses.meaning: There, understanding is realized through understanding itself; bliss is experienced through bliss; and upon happiness, pure happiness is enjoyed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ लाभु जोडला लाभा । प्रभा आलिंगिली प्रभा। विस्मयो बुडाला उभा। विस्मयामाजीं ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha lābhu joḍalā lābhā | prabhā āliṃgilī prabhā| vismayo buḍālā ubhā| vismayāmājīṃ || 16||
verses.meaning: There, gain was joined with gain, light embraced light, and wonder was immersed in wonder.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शमु तेथ सामावला । विश्रामु विश्रांति आला । अनुभवु वेडावला । अनुभूतिपणें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: śamu tetha sāmāvalā | viśrāmu viśrāṃti ālā | anubhavu veḍāvalā | anubhūtipaṇeṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: There, the quietude was absorbed; rest found its repose; experience became ecstatic in its own realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना ऐसें निखळ । मीपणा जोडे तया फळ। सेवूनि वेली वेल्हाळ। क्रमयोगिया ते॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā aiseṃ nikhaḻa | mīpaṇā joḍe tayā phaḻa| sevūni velī velhāḻa| kramayogiyā te|| 18||
verses.meaning: Indeed, such pure fruit of 'I-ness' is attained by the yogi who diligently follows the path of action, by serving the creeper of devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं क्रमयोगिया किरीटी। चक्रवर्तीच्या मुकुटीं। ४८० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी मी चिद्रल ते साटोवाटीं। होय तो माझा॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kramayogiyā kirīṭī| cakravartīcyā mukuṭīṃ| 480 śrījñāneśvarī mī cidrala te sāṭovāṭīṃ| hoya to mājhā|| 19||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), for the Karma Yogi, I am like the crown on the head of an emperor. I am the very essence of consciousness, and through this exchange, he becomes one with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कीं क्रमयोगप्रासादाचा । कळसु जो हा मोक्षाचा । तयावरीळ अवकाशाचा । उबाबो जाला तो॥ ९२२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kīṃ kramayogaprāsādācā | kaḻasu jo hā mokṣācā | tayāvarīḻa avakāśācā | ubābo jālā to|| 9220||
verses.meaning: Or, the pinnacle of the palace of Karma Yoga, which is this liberation, has become the very space above it, the ultimate realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना ना संसार आडवीं। क्रमयोग वाट बरवी । जोडिली ते मदैक्यगांवीं । पैठी जालीसे॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā nā saṃsāra āḍavīṃ| kramayoga vāṭa baravī | joḍilī te madaikyagāṃvīṃ | paiṭhī jālīse|| 21||
verses.meaning: The path of Karma Yoga, which is the best way to cross the obstacles of worldly life, leads one to the village of oneness with Me (God).

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो क्रमयोगबोधें । तेणें भक्तिचिद्गंगें। मी स्वानंदोदधी वेगें ठाकिला कीं गा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso kramayogabodheṃ | teṇeṃ bhakticidgaṃgeṃ| mī svānaṃdodadhī vegeṃ ṭhākilā kīṃ gā|| 22||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Through the knowledge of Karma Yoga, by that Ganga of devotion and consciousness, I quickly reached the ocean of my own bliss.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ठायवरी सुवर्मा । क्रमयोगीं आहे महिमा । म्हणौनि वेळोवेळां तुम्हां। सांगतों आम्ही ॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā ṭhāyavarī suvarmā | kramayogīṃ āhe mahimā | mhaṇauni veḻoveḻāṃ tumhāṃ| sāṃgatoṃ āmhī || 23||
verses.meaning: Up to this point, the glory of Karma Yoga has been explained; therefore, I tell you repeatedly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं देशें काळें पदार्थे । साधूनि घेइजे मातें। तैसा नव्हे मी आयतें। सर्वांचे सर्वही ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ deśeṃ kāḻeṃ padārthe | sādhūni gheije māteṃ| taisā navhe mī āyateṃ| sarvāṃce sarvahī || 24||
verses.meaning: Just as one acquires things by means of space, time, and objects, I am not like that. I am inherently everything to everyone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि माझ्या ठायीं। जाचावें न लगे कांहीं। मी लाभें इयें उपायीं। साचचि गा॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ| jācāveṃ na lage kāṃhīṃ| mī lābheṃ iyeṃ upāyīṃ| sācaci gā|| 25||
verses.meaning: Therefore, there is no need to struggle or suffer in Me. I am truly attained through these means.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एक शिष्य एक गुरु। हा रूढला साच व्यवहारु। तो मत्प्राप्तप्रकारु । जाणावया॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: eka śiṣya eka guru| hā rūḍhalā sāca vyavahāru| to matprāptaprakāru | jāṇāvayā|| 26||
verses.meaning: One disciple, one guru; this is the established, true practice for understanding the means to attain Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा वसुधेच्या पोटीं। निधान सिद्ध किरीटी। वन्हि सिद्ध काष्ठी । बोहां दूध ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā vasudhecyā poṭīṃ| nidhāna siddha kirīṭī| vanhi siddha kāṣṭhī | bohāṃ dūdha || 27||
verses.meaning: Just as a treasure is hidden within the earth, fire is inherent in wood, and milk is present in the udder of a cow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी लाभें तें असतें।॥ तया 'कौजे उपायातें। येर सिद्धचि तैसा तेथें। उपायीं मी॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī lābheṃ teṃ asateṃ||| tayā 'kauje upāyāteṃ| yera siddhaci taisā tetheṃ| upāyīṃ mī|| 28||
verses.meaning: But that which is attained, for its sake, I am the means to that attainment, and the means itself is already perfected there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा फळहीवरी उपावो। कां पां प्रस्तावीतसे देवो। हें पुसतां परी अभिप्रावो। येथिंचा ऐसा॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā phaḻahīvarī upāvo| kāṃ pāṃ prastāvītase devo| heṃ pusatāṃ parī abhiprāvo| yethiṃcā aisā|| 29||
verses.meaning: Why does the Lord propose such a means to attain this fruit? If you ask this, the intention here is as follows.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे गीतार्थाचें चांगावें । मोक्षोपायपर आघवें। आन शास्त्रोपाय कीं नव्हे। प्रमाणसिऱ्ध ॥ १२३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je gītārthāceṃ cāṃgāveṃ | mokṣopāyapara āghaveṃ| āna śāstropāya kīṃ navhe| pramāṇasiṟdha || 1230||
verses.meaning: The Gita's meaning is excellent, entirely focused on the means to liberation. Is there any other scripture or means that is not equally authoritative?

verses.shloka_devanagari: वारा आभाळचि फेडी। वांचूनि सूर्यातें न घडी। कां हातु बाबुळी धाडी। तोय न करी॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: vārā ābhāḻaci pheḍī| vāṃcūni sūryāteṃ na ghaḍī| kāṃ hātu bābuḻī dhāḍī| toya na karī|| 31||
verses.meaning: The wind clears the clouds, but it does not create the sun. Similarly, a hand can stir water, but it cannot create water itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा आत्मदर्शनीं आडळु । असे अविद्येचा जो मळु। तो शास्त्र नाशी येरु निर्मळु। मी प्रकाशें स्वयें ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā ātmadarśanīṃ āḍaḻu | ase avidyecā jo maḻu| to śāstra nāśī yeru nirmaḻu| mī prakāśeṃ svayeṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: Just as the impurity of ignorance obstructs the vision of the Self, so too does scripture destroy this impurity, and the Self, being pure, shines forth on its own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आघवींचि शास्त्रें अविद्याविनाशाचीं पात्रें । बांचोनि न होती स्वतंत्रें। आत्मबोधीं ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āghavīṃci śāstreṃ avidyāvināśācīṃ pātreṃ | bāṃconi na hotī svataṃtreṃ| ātmabodhīṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all scriptures are merely instruments for the destruction of ignorance. They do not independently grant the knowledge of the Self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अध्यात्मशास्त्रांसीं । जें साचपणाची ये पुसी। तें येइजे जया ठायासी। ते हे गीता ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā adhyātmaśāstrāṃsīṃ | jeṃ sācapaṇācī ye pusī| teṃ yeije jayā ṭhāyāsī| te he gītā || 34||
verses.meaning: That which gives true validation to the science of spirituality, that place where it arrives, that is this Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भानुभूषिता प्राचिया । सतेजा दिशा आघविया । तैसी शास्त्रेश्‍वरा गीता या। सनाधथें शास्त्रें ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhānubhūṣitā prāciyā | satejā diśā āghaviyā | taisī śāstreś‍varā gītā yā| sanādhatheṃ śāstreṃ || 35 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the sun adorns the eastern direction, making all other directions radiant, so too does the Gita, the lord of scriptures, empower all other scriptures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो येणें शास्त्रेश्‍वरें। मागां उपाय बहुवे विस्तारें। सांगितला जैसा करें। घेवों ये आत्मा॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso yeṇeṃ śāstreś‍vareṃ| māgāṃ upāya bahuve vistāreṃ| sāṃgitalā jaisā kareṃ| ghevoṃ ye ātmā|| 36||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Through these scriptures, earlier, many methods were extensively explained, by which the Self can be grasped as if by hand.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी प्रथमश्रवणासवें। अर्जुना विपायें हें फावे। हा भावो सकणवे। धरूनि श्रीहरी ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī prathamaśravaṇāsaveṃ| arjunā vipāyeṃ heṃ phāve| hā bhāvo sakaṇave| dharūni śrīharī || 37||
verses.meaning: But, Arjuna, this understanding is attained through the very first hearing, a truth that Lord Krishna compassionately holds.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेंचि प्रमेय एक वेळ। शिष्यीं 'होआवया अढळ सांगतसे मुकुल। मुद्रा आतां॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃci prameya eka veḻa| śiṣyīṃ 'hoāvayā aḍhaḻa sāṃgatase mukula| mudrā ātāṃ|| 38||
verses.meaning: The disciple, in order to firmly grasp that very principle, is now being taught the secret meaning of the mudra.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि प्रसंगें गीता । ठावोही हा संपता । म्हणौनि दावी आद्यंता । एकार्थत्व ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi prasaṃgeṃ gītā | ṭhāvohī hā saṃpatā | mhaṇauni dāvī ādyaṃtā | ekārthatva || 39||
verses.meaning: And as the occasion demands, this Gita, too, concludes. Therefore, it reveals the unity of meaning from beginning to end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे ग्रंथाच्या मध्यभागीं । नाना अधिकारप्रसंगीं । निरूपण अनेगीं । सिद्धांतीं केळें॥ ९२४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: je graṃthācyā madhyabhāgīṃ | nānā adhikāraprasaṃgīṃ | nirūpaṇa anegīṃ | siddhāṃtīṃ keḻeṃ|| 9240||
verses.meaning: All the various discussions and expositions on different topics, which are presented in many doctrines throughout the book, have been done with great care.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तेतुलेही सिद्धांत । इये शास्त्री प्रस्तुत । हें पूर्वापर नेणत। कोण्ही जें मानी ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tetulehī siddhāṃta | iye śāstrī prastuta | heṃ pūrvāpara neṇata| koṇhī jeṃ mānī || 49||
verses.meaning: Even so, if someone, ignorant of the preceding and succeeding context, considers these principles to be established in this scripture.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें महासिद्धांताचा आवांका । सिद्धांतकक्षा अनेका । भिडऊनि आरंभु देखा। संपवितु असे॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ mahāsiddhāṃtācā āvāṃkā | siddhāṃtakakṣā anekā | bhiḍaūni āraṃbhu dekhā| saṃpavitu ase|| 42||
verses.meaning: Thus, the vast expanse of the great doctrine, encompassing numerous theoretical frameworks, begins and concludes its exposition.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एथ अविद्यानाशु हें स्थळ तेणें मोक्षोपादान फळ। या दोहीं केवळ। साधन ज्ञान ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: etha avidyānāśu heṃ sthaḻa teṇeṃ mokṣopādāna phaḻa| yā dohīṃ kevaḻa| sādhana jñāna || 43||
verses.meaning: Here, the destruction of ignorance is the place, and liberation is the fruit of the means. For these two alone, knowledge is the means.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें इतुलेंचि नानापरी । निरूपिलें ग्रंथविस्तारीं । तें आतां दोहीं अक्षरीं । अनुवादावें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ ituleṃci nānāparī | nirūpileṃ graṃthavistārīṃ | teṃ ātāṃ dohīṃ akṣarīṃ | anuvādāveṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: All that has been expounded in various ways throughout this extensive scripture, I shall now summarize in just two words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि उपेयही हातीं । जाळया उपायस्थिती । देव प्रवर्तळे तें पुढती । येणेंचि भावें ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni upeyahī hātīṃ | jāḻayā upāyasthitī | deva pravartaḻe teṃ puḍhatī | yeṇeṃci bhāveṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the means to attain the goal, the very state of the means, God Himself, is manifested again and again through this very sentiment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग म्हणे गा सुभटा । तो क्रमयोगिया निष्ठा। मी होउनी होय पैठा। माझ्या रूपीं ॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga mhaṇe gā subhaṭā | to kramayogiyā niṣṭhā| mī hounī hoya paiṭhā| mājhyā rūpīṃ || 46||
verses.meaning: Then, O brave one, the one steadfast in the path of action, by becoming Me, enters into My very form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वकर्मांच्या चोखोळीं। मज पूजा करूनि भली । तेणें प्रसादे आकळी। ज्ञाननिष्ठेतें ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: svakarmāṃcyā cokhoḻīṃ| maja pūjā karūni bhalī | teṇeṃ prasāde ākaḻī| jñānaniṣṭheteṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: By performing one's own duties with purity and devotion, and offering them to Me as worship, one attains the state of steadfast knowledge through My grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते ज्ञाननिष्ठा जेथ हातवसे। तेथ भक्ति माझी उल्लासे। तिया भजन समरसें। सुखिया होय॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: te jñānaniṣṭhā jetha hātavase| tetha bhakti mājhī ullāse| tiyā bhajana samaraseṃ| sukhiyā hoya|| 48||
verses.meaning: Where there is steadfast devotion to knowledge, there My devotion flourishes. Through such harmonious worship, one becomes blissful.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि विश्वप्रकाशितया। आत्मया मज आपुलिया । अनुसरे जो करूनियां। सर्वत्रता हे ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi viśvaprakāśitayā| ātmayā maja āpuliyā | anusare jo karūniyāṃ| sarvatratā he || 49||
verses.meaning: And one who, realizing the omnipresence of My Self, which illuminates the entire universe, follows Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सांडूनि आपुला आडळ। लवण आश्रयी जळ। का हिंडोनि राहे निश्चळ । वायु व्योमीं ॥ १२५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāṃḍūni āpulā āḍaḻa| lavaṇa āśrayī jaḻa| kā hiṃḍoni rāhe niścaḻa | vāyu vyomīṃ || 1250||
verses.meaning: Just as salt, abandoning its own solidity, merges with water, or as wind, after wandering, finds stillness in the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा बुद्धी वाचा कायें। जो मातें आश्रऊनि ठाये। तो निषिद्धेंही विपायें। कर्मे करूं ॥ ५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā buddhī vācā kāyeṃ| jo māteṃ āśraūni ṭhāye| to niṣiddheṃhī vipāyeṃ| karme karūṃ || 51||
verses.meaning: Similarly, one who takes refuge in Me, whether through intellect, speech, or action, even if they perform forbidden deeds, will be saved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी गंगेच्या संबंधीं । बिदी आणि महानदी । ऐक्य तेवीं माझ्या बोधीं । शुभाशुभांसी ॥५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī gaṃgecyā saṃbaṃdhīṃ | bidī āṇi mahānadī | aikya tevīṃ mājhyā bodhīṃ | śubhāśubhāṃsī ||52||
verses.meaning: Just as the Ganges, when joined by other rivers like the Bidī and Mahānadī, becomes one, so too do auspicious and inauspicious things become unified in my understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: का बावनें आणि धुरें। हा निवाडु तंवचि सरे। जंब न घेपती बैश्वानरें। कवळूनि दोन्ही ॥ ५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: kā bāvaneṃ āṇi dhureṃ| hā nivāḍu taṃvaci sare| jaṃba na ghepatī baiśvānareṃ| kavaḻūni donhī || 53||
verses.meaning: Why do we distinguish between smoke and fire? This distinction holds only as long as the fire has not fully embraced and consumed both.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना पांचिकें आणि सोळें। हें सोनया तंवचि आलें। जंब परिसु आंगमेळें। एकवटीना॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā pāṃcikeṃ āṇi soḻeṃ| heṃ sonayā taṃvaci āleṃ| jaṃba parisu āṃgameḻeṃ| ekavaṭīnā|| 54||
verses.meaning: Just as gold does not need to be purified by five processes or sixteen processes, for it is already pure, so too is the soul inherently pure and does not require external purification, just as a touchstone does not need to be purified to turn base metal into gold.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें शुभाशुभ ऐसें। हें तंवचिवरी आभासे। जंव येकु न प्रकाशें। सर्वत्र मी ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ śubhāśubha aiseṃ| heṃ taṃvacivarī ābhāse| jaṃva yeku na prakāśeṃ| sarvatra mī || 55||
verses.meaning: Good and bad, as such, appear only until I, the Self, do not manifest everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा रात्री आणि दिवो। हा तंवचि द्वैतभावो। जंब न रिगिजे गांबो। गभस्तीचा ॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā rātrī āṇi divo| hā taṃvaci dvaitabhāvo| jaṃba na rigije gāṃbo| gabhastīcā || 56||
verses.meaning: Oh, night and day, this duality exists only as long as one does not enter the sun's (true) abode.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि माझिया भेटी। तयाचीं सर्व कर्मे किरीटी। जाऊनि बैसे तो पाटीं। सायुज्याच्या ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mājhiyā bheṭī| tayācīṃ sarva karme kirīṭī| jāūni baise to pāṭīṃ| sāyujyācyā || 57||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by My very sight, all his karmas, O Kiriti, are dissolved, and he sits in the seat of ultimate union (Sayujya).

verses.shloka_devanagari: देशें काळें स्वभावें । वेंचु जया न संभवे तें पद माझें 'पावे। अविनाश तो॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: deśeṃ kāḻeṃ svabhāveṃ | veṃcu jayā na saṃbhave teṃ pada mājheṃ 'pāve| avināśa to|| 58||
verses.meaning: That state which is not diminished by space, time, or nature, that imperishable state is attained by Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना पंडुसुता । मज आत्मयाची प्रसन्नता । लाहे तेणें न पविजतां। लाभु कवणु असे॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā paṃḍusutā | maja ātmayācī prasannatā | lāhe teṇeṃ na pavijatāṃ| lābhu kavaṇu ase|| 59||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O son of Pandu, what gain is there if one does not attain the grace of My Self?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ४८२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी याकारणें गा तुवां इया। सर्व कर्मा आपुलिया । माझ्या स्वरूपी धनंजया । संन्यासु कीजे॥ १२६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: 482 śrījñāneśvarī yākāraṇeṃ gā tuvāṃ iyā| sarva karmā āpuliyā | mājhyā svarūpī dhanaṃjayā | saṃnyāsu kīje|| 1260||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, dedicate all your actions to My true nature, renouncing them unto Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी तोचि संन्यासु बीरा। करणीयेचा झणें करा। आत्मविवेकीं धरा। चित्तवृत्ति हे॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī toci saṃnyāsu bīrā| karaṇīyecā jhaṇeṃ karā| ātmavivekīṃ dharā| cittavṛtti he|| 61||
verses.meaning: But he alone is truly a renunciate, do not merely perform actions. Hold your mind steadfast in self-realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तेणें विवेकबळें । आपणपें कर्मावेगळें। माझ्या स्वरूपीं निर्मळें। देखिजेलळ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga teṇeṃ vivekabaḻeṃ | āpaṇapeṃ karmāvegaḻeṃ| mājhyā svarūpīṃ nirmaḻeṃ| dekhijelaḻa|| 62||
verses.meaning: Then, by the strength of such discrimination, one will perceive oneself as distinct from actions, pure in My true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि कर्माची जन्मभोये। प्रकृति जे का आहे। ते आपणयाहूनि बहुवे। देखसी दूरी॥६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi karmācī janmabhoye| prakṛti je kā āhe| te āpaṇayāhūni bahuve| dekhasī dūrī||63||
verses.meaning: And the birthplace of actions, which is Prakriti (primordial nature), you will see as far removed from yourself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ प्रकृति आपणयां-। वेगळी नुरे धनंजया । रूपेंबीण का छाया । जयापरी ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha prakṛti āpaṇayāṃ-| vegaḻī nure dhanaṃjayā | rūpeṃbīṇa kā chāyā | jayāparī || 64||
verses.meaning: There, O Dhananjaya, nature does not remain separate from itself, just as a shadow is not separate from its form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि प्रकृतिनाशु । जाल्या कर्मसंन्यासु। निफजेल अनायासु । सकारणु॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni prakṛtināśu | jālyā karmasaṃnyāsu| niphajela anāyāsu | sakāraṇu|| 65 ||
verses.meaning: When the natural tendencies (Prakriti) are thus destroyed, the renunciation of actions (Karma Sanyasa) will effortlessly come to pass, along with its underlying cause.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग कर्मजात गेलिया । मी आत्मा उरें आपणपयां। तेथ बुद्धि घापे करूनियां। पतिव्रता ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga karmajāta geliyā | mī ātmā ureṃ āpaṇapayāṃ| tetha buddhi ghāpe karūniyāṃ| pativratā || 66||
verses.meaning: When the actions cease, I, the Self, remain in my own nature. There, the intellect, like a chaste wife, dedicates itself to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुल्धि अनन्य येणें योगें। मजमाजीं जें रिगे। तें चित्त चेत्यत्यागें। मातेंचि भजे ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: buldhi ananya yeṇeṃ yogeṃ| majamājīṃ jeṃ rige| teṃ citta cetyatyāgeṃ| māteṃci bhaje || 67||
verses.meaning: When the intellect, through this yoga of unwavering devotion, enters into Me, that consciousness, abandoning all objects of thought, worships Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें चैत्यजातें सांडिलें। चित्त माझ्या ठायीं जडळें। ठाके तैसें बहिलें। सर्वदा करी॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ caityajāteṃ sāṃḍileṃ| citta mājhyā ṭhāyīṃ jaḍaḻeṃ| ṭhāke taiseṃ bahileṃ| sarvadā karī|| 68||
verses.meaning: Thus, having abandoned all mental constructs, the mind becomes absorbed in Me. It remains outwardly detached, yet always engaged in My service.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अभिन्ना इया सेवा। चित्त मियांचि भरेल जेधवां। माझा प्रसादु जाण तेधवां। संपूर्ण जाहला॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga abhinnā iyā sevā| citta miyāṃci bharela jedhavāṃ| mājhā prasādu jāṇa tedhavāṃ| saṃpūrṇa jāhalā|| 69||
verses.meaning: Then, when the mind is completely filled with My undivided service, know that My grace has become perfect and complete.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सकळदुःखधामें । भुंजीजती जियें मृत्युजन्में। तियें दुर्गमेंचि सुगमें। होती तुज ॥ १२७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha sakaḻaduḥkhadhāmeṃ | bhuṃjījatī jiyeṃ mṛtyujanmeṃ| tiyeṃ durgameṃci sugameṃ| hotī tuja || 1270||
verses.meaning: There, all the abodes of sorrow, which are birth and death, those difficult paths become easy for you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सूर्याचेनि सावायें। डोळा सावाइला होये। तैं अंधाराचा आहे। पाडु तया ॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: sūryāceni sāvāyeṃ| ḍoḻā sāvāilā hoye| taiṃ aṃdhārācā āhe| pāḍu tayā || 71||
verses.meaning: With the help of the sun, the eye becomes capable; then, what power does darkness hold over it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा माझेनि प्रसादें। जीवकणु जयाचा उपमर्दे । तो संसाराचेनि बाधे। बागुलें केवीं ॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mājheni prasādeṃ| jīvakaṇu jayācā upamarde | to saṃsārāceni bādhe| bāguleṃ kevīṃ ||72||
verses.meaning: Just as by My grace, the individual soul's ego is destroyed, how can such a soul be troubled by the fear of worldly existence?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि धनंजया । तूं संसारदुर्गती यया । तरसील माझिया । प्रसादास्तब ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni dhanaṃjayā | tūṃ saṃsāradurgatī yayā | tarasīla mājhiyā | prasādāstaba || 73||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Arjuna, you will overcome this worldly suffering by My grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा हन अहंभावें । माझें बोलणें हें आघवें। कानामनाचिये शिंवे । नेदिसी टेंकों॥७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā hana ahaṃbhāveṃ | mājheṃ bolaṇeṃ heṃ āghaveṃ| kānāmanāciye śiṃve | nedisī ṭeṃkoṃ||74||
verses.meaning: Or perhaps, due to my ego, you do not allow all my words to even touch the boundaries of your ears and mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी नित्य मुक्‍त अव्ययो। तूं आहासि तें होऊनि वावो । देहसंबंधाचा घावो । वाजेळ आंगीं ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī nitya muk‍ta avyayo| tūṃ āhāsi teṃ hoūni vāvo | dehasaṃbaṃdhācā ghāvo | vājeḻa āṃgīṃ || 75||
verses.meaning: Though you are eternally liberated and imperishable, you become entangled in the illusion of the body, and the wound of this bodily connection afflicts you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जया देहसंबंधा आंतु । प्रतिपदीं आत्मघातु । भुंजतां उसंतु। कहींचि नाहीं ॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayā dehasaṃbaṃdhā āṃtu | pratipadīṃ ātmaghātu | bhuṃjatāṃ usaṃtu| kahīṃci nāhīṃ || 76||
verses.meaning: In this bodily connection, at every step there is self-destruction. There is no respite or satisfaction in experiencing it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येवढेनि दारुणें । निमणेनवीण निमणें। पडेल जरी बोलणें । नेघसी माझें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yevaḍheni dāruṇeṃ | nimaṇenavīṇa nimaṇeṃ| paḍela jarī bolaṇeṃ | neghasī mājheṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: If you do not heed my words, it will be a terrible death, a death without dying.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पथ्यद्वेषिया पोषी ज्वरु । कां दीपद्ठेषिया अंधकारु । विवेकद्वेषें अहंकारु । 'पोषूनि तैसा॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: pathyadveṣiyā poṣī jvaru | kāṃ dīpadṭheṣiyā aṃdhakāru | vivekadveṣeṃ ahaṃkāru | 'poṣūni taisā|| 78||
verses.meaning: Just as a fever nourishes one who dislikes a healthy diet, or darkness nourishes one who dislikes light, so too does ego nourish itself through the dislike of discernment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वदेहा नाम अर्जुनु। परदेहा नाम स्वजनु । संग्रामा नाम मलिनु। पापाचारु ॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: svadehā nāma arjunu| paradehā nāma svajanu | saṃgrāmā nāma malinu| pāpācāru ||79||
verses.meaning: Arjuna is the name given to one's own body, and relatives are the name given to others' bodies. The battlefield is the name given to impure, sinful conduct.

verses.shloka_devanagari: इया मती आपुलिया । तिघां तीन नामें ययां। ठेऊनियां धनंजया । न झुंजे ऐसा॥ १२८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: iyā matī āpuliyā | tighāṃ tīna nāmeṃ yayāṃ| ṭheūniyāṃ dhanaṃjayā | na jhuṃje aisā|| 1280||
verses.meaning: With this understanding, these three, though given three different names, O Dhananjaya, do not truly contend.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जीवामाजीं निष्टंकु । करिसी जो आत्यंतिकु। तो वायां धाडील नैसर्गिकु। स्वभावोचि तुझा॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: jīvāmājīṃ niṣṭaṃku | karisī jo ātyaṃtiku| to vāyāṃ dhāḍīla naisargiku| svabhāvoci tujhā|| 81||
verses.meaning: If you create an absolute, unwavering resolve within your soul, then your inherent nature will not be wasted.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि मी अर्जुन हे आत्मिक । ययां बधु करणें हें पातक। हें मायावांचूनि तात्त्विक । कांहीं आहे॥ ८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi mī arjuna he ātmika | yayāṃ badhu karaṇeṃ heṃ pātaka| heṃ māyāvāṃcūni tāttvika | kāṃhīṃ āhe|| 82||
verses.meaning: And I, Arjuna, the spiritual self, to kill these relatives is a sin. Is there anything truly real apart from this illusion?

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधीं जुंझार तुवां होआवें। मग जुंझावया शस्त्र घेयावें। कां न जुंझावया करावें । देवांगण ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhīṃ juṃjhāra tuvāṃ hoāveṃ| maga juṃjhāvayā śastra gheyāveṃ| kāṃ na juṃjhāvayā karāveṃ | devāṃgaṇa || 83||
verses.meaning: First, you must become a warrior. Only then should you take up weapons to fight. Or, if you do not wish to fight, you should make a divine courtyard.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि न झुंजणें। म्हणसी तें वायाणें॥ ना मानूं लोकपणें। लोकदृष्टीही ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni na jhuṃjaṇeṃ| mhaṇasī teṃ vāyāṇeṃ|| nā mānūṃ lokapaṇeṃ| lokadṛṣṭīhī || 84||
verses.meaning: Therefore, your saying 'I will not fight' is futile. Do not consider worldly opinion or the views of others.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तऱ्हीं न झुंजे ऐसें। निष्टंकिसी जें मानसें। तें प्रकृति अनारिसें। करबीलचि ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṟhīṃ na jhuṃje aiseṃ| niṣṭaṃkisī jeṃ mānaseṃ| teṃ prakṛti anāriseṃ| karabīlaci || 85||
verses.meaning: Even if one does not wish to fight, the mind, being naturally unattached, will be compelled by nature to act otherwise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं पूर्व बाहतां पाणी । पव्हिजे पश्‍चिमेचे बाहणीं। तरी आग्रहोचि उरे तें आणी । आपुलिया लेखा॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ pūrva bāhatāṃ pāṇī | pavhije paś‍cimece bāhaṇīṃ| tarī āgrahoci ure teṃ āṇī | āpuliyā lekhā|| 86||
verses.meaning: Just as water, flowing from the east, is made to flow towards the west with great effort, so too, one must exert similar effort to achieve one's spiritual goals.

verses.shloka_devanagari: का साळीचा कणु म्हणे। मी नुगवें साळीपणें । तरी आहे आन करणें । स्वभावासी ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: kā sāḻīcā kaṇu mhaṇe| mī nugaveṃ sāḻīpaṇeṃ | tarī āhe āna karaṇeṃ | svabhāvāsī || 87||
verses.meaning: If a grain of rice were to say, "I will not sprout as rice," it would still be bound by its inherent nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेसा क्षात्रसंस्कारसिद्ा । प्रकृती घडिलासी प्रबुद्धा। आतां नुठी म्हणसी हा धांदा । परी उठविजसीचि तूं॥८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tesā kṣātrasaṃskārasidā | prakṛtī ghaḍilāsī prabuddhā| ātāṃ nuṭhī mhaṇasī hā dhāṃdā | parī uṭhavijasīci tūṃ||88||
verses.meaning: By the grace of the Kshatriya संस्कार (sacraments/rites), your nature has been made wise. Now you say, "I will not rise for this turmoil," but you will certainly be made to rise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं शौर्य तेज दक्षता। एवमादिक पंडुसुता । गुण दिधले जन्मतां। प्रकृती तुज॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ śaurya teja dakṣatā| evamādika paṃḍusutā | guṇa didhale janmatāṃ| prakṛtī tuja|| 89||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, qualities like valor, brilliance, and skill were bestowed upon you by nature at birth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तयाचिया समवाया-। अनुरूप धनंजया। न करितां उगलियां । नयेळ असों ॥ १२९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tayāciyā samavāyā-| anurūpa dhanaṃjayā| na karitāṃ ugaliyāṃ | nayeḻa asoṃ || 1290||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Dhananjaya, it is not proper to remain silent without acting in accordance with that assembly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनियां तिहीं गुणीं । बांधिळासि तूं कोदंडपाणी । त्रिशुद्धी निघसी वाहणीं । क्षात्राचिया॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauniyāṃ tihīṃ guṇīṃ | bāṃdhiḻāsi tūṃ kodaṃḍapāṇī | triśuddhī nighasī vāhaṇīṃ | kṣātrāciyā|| 91||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by these three Gunas, you are bound, O wielder of the bow. You will certainly emerge victorious in the stream of Kshatriya dharma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना हें आपुलें जन्ममूळ। न विचारीतचि केवळ। न झुंजे ऐसे अढळ। व्रत जरी घेसी॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā heṃ āpuleṃ janmamūḻa| na vicārītaci kevaḻa| na jhuṃje aise aḍhaḻa| vrata jarī ghesī|| 92||
verses.meaning: If you take such a firm vow that you will not fight, without even considering your own origin.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी बांधोनि हात पाये। जो रथीं घातला होये। तो न चले तरी जाये । दिगंता जेवीं ॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī bāṃdhoni hāta pāye| jo rathīṃ ghātalā hoye| to na cale tarī jāye | digaṃtā jevīṃ || 93||
verses.meaning: Just as a person, even if bound hand and foot and placed in a chariot, is carried to the ends of the earth without moving themselves.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा तूं आपुलियाकडुनी। मी कांहींच न करीं म्हणौनि। ठासी परी भरंबसेनि। तूंचि करिसी॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā tūṃ āpuliyākaḍunī| mī kāṃhīṃca na karīṃ mhaṇauni| ṭhāsī parī bharaṃbaseni| tūṃci karisī|| 94||
verses.meaning: Similarly, though you declare, "I do nothing on my own," you accomplish everything through your unwavering faith.

verses.shloka_devanagari: उत्तरु बैराटींचा राजा। पळतां तूं कां निघालासि झुंजा। हा क्षात्रस्वभावो तुझा । झुंजवील तुज॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: uttaru bairāṭīṃcā rājā| paḻatāṃ tūṃ kāṃ nighālāsi jhuṃjā| hā kṣātrasvabhāvo tujhā | jhuṃjavīla tuja|| 95||
verses.meaning: O King of Virata, why have you come to fight while fleeing? This warrior nature of yours will compel you to fight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: महावीर अकरा अक्षौहिणी। तुवां येके नागविळे रणांगणीं । तो स्वभावो कोदंडपाणी। झुंजबील तूंतें॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mahāvīra akarā akṣauhiṇī| tuvāṃ yeke nāgaviḻe raṇāṃgaṇīṃ | to svabhāvo kodaṃḍapāṇī| jhuṃjabīla tūṃteṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: You alone, O wielder of the bow, made the great warriors of eleven akshauhinis fight each other on the battlefield. This is your very nature, that you will make them fight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हां गा रोगु कायी रोगिया। आवडे दरिद्र दरिद्रिया। परी भोगविजे बळिया। अदृष्टें जेणें ॥९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: hāṃ gā rogu kāyī rogiyā| āvaḍe daridra daridriyā| parī bhogavije baḻiyā| adṛṣṭeṃ jeṇeṃ ||97||
verses.meaning: Does a sick person like their illness? Does a poor person like their poverty? Yet, they are forced to endure it by the powerful, unseen destiny.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अदृष्ट अनारिसें॥ न करील ईश्वरवशें। तो ईश्वरुही असे । हृदयीं तुझ्या ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ adṛṣṭa anāriseṃ|| na karīla īśvaravaśeṃ| to īśvaruhī ase | hṛdayīṃ tujhyā || 98 ||
verses.meaning: That unseen, unmanifested power, if it does not act according to God's will, then that very God resides within your heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्व भूतांच्या अंतरीं । हृदयमहाअंबरीं । चिद्वृत्तीच्या सहस्त्रकरीं । उदयला असे जो॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarva bhūtāṃcyā aṃtarīṃ | hṛdayamahāaṃbarīṃ | cidvṛttīcyā sahastrakarīṃ | udayalā ase jo|| 99||
verses.meaning: He who has risen within the hearts of all beings, in the great sky of their consciousness, with a thousand rays of pure awareness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अवस्थात्रय तिन्ही लोक । प्रकाशूनि अशेख । अन्यथादृष्टि 'पांथिक । चेबविले॥ १३००॥
verses.shloka_iast: avasthātraya tinhī loka | prakāśūni aśekha | anyathādṛṣṭi 'pāṃthika | cebavile|| 1300||
verses.meaning: The three states of consciousness and all three worlds are illuminated, and the traveler with a different perspective is awakened.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वेद्योदकाच्या सरोवरीं। फांकतां विषयकल्हारीं । इंद्रियषट्पदा चारी । जीवभ्रमरातें ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: vedyodakācyā sarovarīṃ| phāṃkatāṃ viṣayakalhārīṃ | iṃdriyaṣaṭpadā cārī | jīvabhramarāteṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: In the lake of worldly knowledge, when the lotus of sensory objects blooms, the six-legged bees of the senses roam, attracting the bee of the individual soul.

verses.shloka_devanagari: असो रूपक हें तो ईश्वरु । सकल भूतांचा अहंकारु। पांघरोनि निरंतरु। उल्हासत असे॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: aso rūpaka heṃ to īśvaru | sakala bhūtāṃcā ahaṃkāru| pāṃgharoni niraṃtaru| ulhāsata ase|| 2||
verses.meaning: This form, indeed, is God, who, constantly adorned with the ego of all beings, ever rejoices.

verses.shloka_devanagari: स्वमायेचें आडवस्त्र। लावूनि एकला खेळवी सूत्र। बाहेरी नटी छायाचित्र । चौर्‍्याशीं लक्ष ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: svamāyeceṃ āḍavastra| lāvūni ekalā kheḻavī sūtra| bāherī naṭī chāyācitra | caur‍yāśīṃ lakṣa || 3||
verses.meaning: Concealed by the veil of His own Maya (illusory power), He alone pulls the strings, while outside, like shadow puppets, are the eighty-four lakh (8.4 million) species.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया ब्रह्मादिकीटांता। अशेषांही भूतजातां। देहाकार योग्यता । पाहोनि दावी॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā brahmādikīṭāṃtā| aśeṣāṃhī bhūtajātāṃ| dehākāra yogyatā | pāhoni dāvī|| 4||
verses.meaning: To all beings, from Brahma to the smallest insect, He reveals the suitability of their bodies.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ जें देह जयापुढें । अनुरूपपणें मांडे। तें भूत तया आरूढे। हें मी म्हणौनि॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha jeṃ deha jayāpuḍheṃ | anurūpapaṇeṃ māṃḍe| teṃ bhūta tayā ārūḍhe| heṃ mī mhaṇauni|| 5||
verses.meaning: There, whatever body is presented before it in a suitable manner, that being mounts it, saying, "This is I."

verses.shloka_devanagari: सूत सूत्तें गुंतळें। तृण तृणेंचि बांधलें। का आत्मबिंबा घेतलें। बाळकें जळीं ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: sūta sūtteṃ guṃtaḻeṃ| tṛṇa tṛṇeṃci bāṃdhaleṃ| kā ātmabiṃbā ghetaleṃ| bāḻakeṃ jaḻīṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: A thread is entangled by another thread; grass is bound by grass itself; or a child sees its own reflection in the water.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयापरी देहाकारें। आपणपेंचि दुसरें। देखोनि जीव आविष्करे। आत्मबुद्धी ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāparī dehākāreṃ| āpaṇapeṃci dusareṃ| dekhoni jīva āviṣkare| ātmabuddhī || 7||
verses.meaning: In the same way, the individual soul, seeing itself as another in the form of the body, manifests with the intellect identifying with the self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि शरीराकारीं। यंत्रीं भूतें अवधारीं॥ वाहूनि हालबी दोरी। प्राचीनाची ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni śarīrākārīṃ| yaṃtrīṃ bhūteṃ avadhārīṃ|| vāhūni hālabī dorī| prācīnācī || 8||
verses.meaning: In this way, all beings are embodied in the form of a machine, and are moved by the string of their past actions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ जया जें कर्मसूत्र। मांडूनि ठेविलें स्वतंत्र। तें तिये गती पात्र। होंचि लागे॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha jayā jeṃ karmasūtra| māṃḍūni ṭhevileṃ svataṃtra| teṃ tiye gatī pātra| hoṃci lāge|| 9||
verses.meaning: There, whatever karmic thread has been independently laid out for someone, that person becomes worthy of that very destiny.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना धनुर्धरा । भूतांतें स्वर्गसंसारा-। माजी भोवंडी तृणें वारा । आकाशीं जैसा॥ ९१३१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā dhanurdharā | bhūtāṃteṃ svargasaṃsārā-| mājī bhovaṃḍī tṛṇeṃ vārā | ākāśīṃ jaisā|| 91310||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Arjuna, just as the wind whirls a blade of grass in the sky, so too does it whirl beings through the cycles of heaven and worldly existence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: भ्रामकाचेनि संगें । जैसें लोहो वेढा रिगे। तैसी ईश्वरसत्तायोगें। चेष्टती भूतें ॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: bhrāmakāceni saṃgeṃ | jaiseṃ loho veḍhā rige| taisī īśvarasattāyogeṃ| ceṣṭatī bhūteṃ || 11||
verses.meaning: Just as iron is enveloped by a magnet's influence, so too do all beings act by the power of God's will.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसे चेष्टा आपुलिया । समुद्रादिक धनंजया । चेष्टती चंद्राचिया । सन्निधीं येकीं ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaise ceṣṭā āpuliyā | samudrādika dhanaṃjayā | ceṣṭatī caṃdrāciyā | sannidhīṃ yekīṃ || 92||
verses.meaning: Just as the oceans, O Dhananjaya, surge and swell in the presence of the moon.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया सिंधू भरितें दाटे । सोमकांता पाझरु फुटे। कुमुदांचकोरांचा फिटे। संकोचु तो॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā siṃdhū bhariteṃ dāṭe | somakāṃtā pājharu phuṭe| kumudāṃcakorāṃcā phiṭe| saṃkocu to|| 13||
verses.meaning: The ocean of devotion overflows, the moonstone melts with joy, and the shyness of the kumud flowers and chakora birds vanishes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसीं बीजप्रकृतिवशें। अनेकें भूतें येकें ईशें। चेष्टवबीजती तो असे। तुझ्या हृदयीं ॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisīṃ bījaprakṛtivaśeṃ| anekeṃ bhūteṃ yekeṃ īśeṃ| ceṣṭavabījatī to ase| tujhyā hṛdayīṃ || 14||
verses.meaning: Just as a single seed, by its very nature, gives rise to many beings, so too does the one Ishwara (God) activate and animate all beings, and that very Ishwara resides within your heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुनपण न घेतां। मी ऐसें जें पंडुसुता। उठतसे तें तत्त्वता । तयाचें रूप॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunapaṇa na ghetāṃ| mī aiseṃ jeṃ paṃḍusutā| uṭhatase teṃ tattvatā | tayāceṃ rūpa|| 15||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, that which arises as 'I am' without assuming the state of Arjuna, that indeed is its true form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं तो प्रकृतीतें। प्रवर्तबील हें निरुतें। आणि झुंजवील तूंतें। न झुंजशी जऱ्ही ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ to prakṛtīteṃ| pravartabīla heṃ niruteṃ| āṇi jhuṃjavīla tūṃteṃ| na jhuṃjaśī jaṟhī || 16||
verses.meaning: Therefore, He will certainly activate Prakriti (nature) and make you fight, even if you do not wish to fight.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि ईश्वरु गोसावी । तेणें प्रकृती हे नेमावी । तिया सुखें राबवावीं । इंद्रियें आपुलीं ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni īśvaru gosāvī | teṇeṃ prakṛtī he nemāvī | tiyā sukheṃ rābavāvīṃ | iṃdriyeṃ āpulīṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Therefore, God is the master; He should control this prakriti (nature). Through it, He should effortlessly engage His senses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तूं करणें न करणें दोन्ही । लाऊनि प्रकृतीच्या मानीं । प्रकृतीही कां अधीनी । हृदयस्था जया॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tūṃ karaṇeṃ na karaṇeṃ donhī | lāūni prakṛtīcyā mānīṃ | prakṛtīhī kāṃ adhīnī | hṛdayasthā jayā|| 18||
verses.meaning: You attribute both action and inaction to Prakriti (nature), but even Prakriti is under the control of the one who resides in the heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अहं वाचा चित्त आंग। देऊनियां शरण रिग। महोदधी का गांग । रिगालें जैसें ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā ahaṃ vācā citta āṃga| deūniyāṃ śaraṇa riga| mahodadhī kā gāṃga | rigāleṃ jaiseṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Just as a river merges into the great ocean, so too, with your ego, speech, and mind, surrender to Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तयाचेनि प्रसादें । सर्वोपशांतिप्रमदे । कांतु होऊनियां स्वानंदें। स्वरूपींचि रमसी॥ १३२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayāceni prasādeṃ | sarvopaśāṃtipramade | kāṃtu hoūniyāṃ svānaṃdeṃ| svarūpīṃci ramasī|| 1320||
verses.meaning: Then, by His grace, you will become the beloved of the bride of complete peace, and in that self-joy, you will revel in your true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: संभूति जेणें संभवे । विश्रांति जेथें विसंवे। अनुभूतिही अनुभवे। अनुभवा जया॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: saṃbhūti jeṇeṃ saṃbhave | viśrāṃti jetheṃ visaṃve| anubhūtihī anubhave| anubhavā jayā|| 21||
verses.meaning: That by which creation comes into being, that in which rest finds its repose, that by which even experience experiences itself—know that as the ultimate experience.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये निजात्मपदींचा रावो। होऊनि ठाकसी अव्ययो। म्हणे लह्ष्मीनाहो। पार्था तूं गा॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye nijātmapadīṃcā rāvo| hoūni ṭhākasī avyayo| mhaṇe lahṣmīnāho| pārthā tūṃ gā|| 22||
verses.meaning: Lord Krishna says, "O Arjuna, you will become the imperishable king of that state of the true Self."

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें गीतानाम विख्यात । सर्ववाडूसयाचें मथित । आत्मा जेणें हस्तगत । रत्न होय॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ gītānāma vikhyāta | sarvavāḍūsayāceṃ mathita | ātmā jeṇeṃ hastagata | ratna hoya|| 23||
verses.meaning: This Gita, renowned, is the essence of all scriptures. Through it, the Self, like a precious gem, is attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञान ऐसिया रूढी। वेदांती जयाची प्रौढी । वानितां कीर्ति चोखडी। पातळी जगीं॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñāna aisiyā rūḍhī| vedāṃtī jayācī prauḍhī | vānitāṃ kīrti cokhaḍī| pātaḻī jagīṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: Knowledge, in this tradition, whose glory is proclaimed in the Vedas, its pure fame has spread throughout the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बुल्धययादिके डोळसें। हें जयाचें का कडवसें। मी सर्वद्रष्टाही दिसें। पाहला जया॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: buldhayayādike ḍoḻaseṃ| heṃ jayāceṃ kā kaḍavaseṃ| mī sarvadraṣṭāhī diseṃ| pāhalā jayā|| 25||
verses.meaning: The intellect and other faculties are like eyes, and this is the very essence of it: I, the all-seer, am seen by that very essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें हें गा आत्मज्ञान । मज गोौप्याचेंही गुप्त धन। परी तूं म्हणौनि आन। केवीं करूं॥२६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ heṃ gā ātmajñāna | maja goaupyāceṃhī gupta dhana| parī tūṃ mhaṇauni āna| kevīṃ karūṃ||26||
verses.meaning: This spiritual knowledge, which is my most secret treasure, how can I keep it from you, since you are so dear to me?

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें गा पांडवा । आम्ही आपुला हा गुह्य ठेवा। तुज दिधला कणवा । जाकळिलेपणें ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ gā pāṃḍavā | āmhī āpulā hā guhya ṭhevā| tuja didhalā kaṇavā | jākaḻilepaṇeṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Pandava, I have given you this secret treasure of mine, out of compassion and affection.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी भुलली बोरसें। माय बोले बाळा दोषें। प्रीति ही परी तैसें न करूंचि हो॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī bhulalī boraseṃ| māya bole bāḻā doṣeṃ| prīti hī parī taiseṃ na karūṃci ho|| 28||
verses.meaning: Just as a mother, though she may scold her child in anger, does not truly abandon her love, so too, divine love never ceases.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ आकाश आणि गाळिजे। अमृताही साली फेडिजे। का दिव्याकरवीं करविजे। दिव्य जैसें ॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha ākāśa āṇi gāḻije| amṛtāhī sālī pheḍije| kā divyākaravīṃ karavije| divya jaiseṃ || 29||
verses.meaning: Here, the sky is sifted, the skin of immortality is peeled, or the divine is made manifest through a lamp.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जयाचेनि अंगप्रकाशें। पाताळींचा परमाणु दिसे। तया सूर्याही का जैसें। अंजन सूदलें॥ १३३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jayāceni aṃgaprakāśeṃ| pātāḻīṃcā paramāṇu dise| tayā sūryāhī kā jaiseṃ| aṃjana sūdaleṃ|| 1330||
verses.meaning: Just as a tiny particle in the netherworld becomes visible by the sun's light, so too is collyrium applied to that very sun.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सर्वज्ञेंही मियां। सर्वही निर्धारूनियां। निकें होय तें धनंजया । सांगितलें तुज॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sarvajñeṃhī miyāṃ| sarvahī nirdhārūniyāṃ| nikeṃ hoya teṃ dhanaṃjayā | sāṃgitaleṃ tuja|| 39||
verses.meaning: Thus, I, the Omniscient One, having deliberated on everything, have told you, Dhananjaya, what is truly good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां तूं ययावरी। निकें हें निर्धारीं। निर्धारूनि करीं। आवडे तैसें ॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ tūṃ yayāvarī| nikeṃ heṃ nirdhārīṃ| nirdhārūni karīṃ| āvaḍe taiseṃ || 32||
verses.meaning: Now, upon this, decide well and firmly, and then act as you wish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया देवाचिया बोला । अर्जुनु उगाचि ठेला। तेथ देवो म्हणती भला। अवंचकु होसी॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā devāciyā bolā | arjunu ugāci ṭhelā| tetha devo mhaṇatī bhalā| avaṃcaku hosī|| 33||
verses.meaning: At these words of the Lord, Arjuna remained silent. Then the Lord said, "Well done! You are not deceitful."

verses.shloka_devanagari: वाढतया पुढें भुकेला । उपरोधें म्हणे मी धाला । तैं तोचि पीडे आपुला। आणि दोषुही तया॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāḍhatayā puḍheṃ bhukelā | uparodheṃ mhaṇe mī dhālā | taiṃ toci pīḍe āpulā| āṇi doṣuhī tayā|| 34||
verses.meaning: If a hungry person, when offered food, falsely claims to be full, then he alone suffers the pain of hunger, and the fault is also his.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सर्वजु श्रीगुरु। भेटलिया आत्मनिर्धारुी। न पुसिजे जें आभारु । धरूनियां॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sarvaju śrīguru| bheṭaliyā ātmanirdhāruī| na pusije jeṃ ābhāru | dharūniyāṃ|| 35||
