verses.meaning: Similarly, when the all-knowing Guru is met, there is no need to ask about the self-realization, nor is it a burden to do so.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें आपणपेंचि वंचे। आणि पापही वंचनाचें । आपणयाचि साचें। चुकविलें तेणें ॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ āpaṇapeṃci vaṃce| āṇi pāpahī vaṃcanāceṃ | āpaṇayāci sāceṃ| cukavileṃ teṇeṃ || 36||
verses.meaning: By deceiving others, one ultimately deceives oneself, and the sin of deceit truly falls upon oneself, thus one has truly avoided their own good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं उगेपणा तुझिया। हा अभिप्रावो कौं धनंजया । जें एकवेळ आवांकुनियां। सांगावें ज्ञान ॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ ugepaṇā tujhiyā| hā abhiprāvo kauṃ dhanaṃjayā | jeṃ ekaveḻa āvāṃkuniyāṃ| sāṃgāveṃ jñāna || 37||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, what is this intention of yours, that knowledge should be imparted by merely hinting at it once?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ पार्थ म्हणे दातारा । भळें जाणसी माझिया अंतरा । हें म्हणों तरी दुसरा । जाणता असे काई ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha pārtha mhaṇe dātārā | bhaḻeṃ jāṇasī mājhiyā aṃtarā | heṃ mhaṇoṃ tarī dusarā | jāṇatā ase kāī || 38||
verses.meaning: There, Arjuna said, "O Giver of boons, you indeed know my inner thoughts. If I say this, is there anyone else who knows?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: येर ज्ञेय हें जी आघवें। तूं ज्ञाता एकचि स्वभावें । ४८६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी मा सूर्य म्हणौनि वानावें। सूर्याते काई॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yera jñeya heṃ jī āghaveṃ| tūṃ jñātā ekaci svabhāveṃ | 486 śrījñāneśvarī mā sūrya mhaṇauni vānāveṃ| sūryāte kāī|| 39||
verses.meaning: All that is knowable, you are naturally the sole knower. Why should the sun be praised by calling it the sun?

verses.shloka_devanagari: या बोला श्रीकृष्णें। म्हणितलें काय येणें। हेंचि थोडें गा वानणें। जे बुझतासि तूं॥ १३४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yā bolā śrīkṛṣṇeṃ| mhaṇitaleṃ kāya yeṇeṃ| heṃci thoḍeṃ gā vānaṇeṃ| je bujhatāsi tūṃ|| 1340||
verses.meaning: Upon hearing these words, Shri Krishna said, "What is the use of this? Is this too little praise, that you are understanding?"

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी अवधान पघळ। करूनियां आणिक येक वेळ। वाक्‍य माझें निर्मळ। अवधारीं पां॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī avadhāna paghaḻa| karūniyāṃ āṇika yeka veḻa| vāk‍ya mājheṃ nirmaḻa| avadhārīṃ pāṃ|| 41||
verses.meaning: Therefore, once again, with full attention, listen to my pure words.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें वाच्य म्हणौनि बोळिजे। का श्राव्य मग आयिकिजे । तैसें नव्हे परी तुझें । भाग्य बरवें ॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ vācya mhaṇauni boḻije| kā śrāvya maga āyikije | taiseṃ navhe parī tujheṃ | bhāgya baraveṃ || 42||
verses.meaning: This is not something that can be spoken and then heard, nor is it something that can be heard and then listened to. Rather, your fortune is indeed good.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कूर्मीचिया पिलियां । दिठी पान्हा ये धनंजया। का आकाश वाहे बापिया। घरींचें पाणी ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: kūrmīciyā piliyāṃ | diṭhī pānhā ye dhanaṃjayā| kā ākāśa vāhe bāpiyā| gharīṃceṃ pāṇī || 43 ||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, does a tortoise's young drink milk from its mother's gaze? Or does the sky carry water from its home to the earth?

verses.shloka_devanagari: जो व्यवहारु जेथ न घडे । तयाचें फळचि तेथ जोडे । काय दैवें न सांपडे । सानुकूळें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jo vyavahāru jetha na ghaḍe | tayāceṃ phaḻaci tetha joḍe | kāya daiveṃ na sāṃpaḍe | sānukūḻeṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: That which is not achieved through ordinary effort, its fruit is attained there. What cannot be found by destiny when it is favorable?

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं द्वैताची वारी । सारूनि ऐक्याच्या परिवरीं । भोगिजे तें अवधारीं। रहस्य हें ॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ dvaitācī vārī | sārūni aikyācyā parivarīṃ | bhogije teṃ avadhārīṃ| rahasya heṃ || 45||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, setting aside the duality, and embracing the unity, that experience, listen, is this secret.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि निरुपचारा प्रेमा। विषय होय जें प्रियोत्तमा। तें दुजें नव्हे कौ आत्मा । ऐसेंचि जाणावें ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi nirupacārā premā| viṣaya hoya jeṃ priyottamā| teṃ dujeṃ navhe kau ātmā | aiseṃci jāṇāveṃ || 46 ||
verses.meaning: And that love, which is without remedy (unconditional) and becomes the object of the most beloved, know that it is not separate from the Self (Atma).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आरिसाचिया देखिलया। गोमटें कीजे धनंजया । तें तया नोहे आपणयां-। लागीं जैसें ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: ārisāciyā dekhilayā| gomaṭeṃ kīje dhanaṃjayā | teṃ tayā nohe āpaṇayāṃ-| lāgīṃ jaiseṃ || 47||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, just as one adorns oneself after seeing their reflection in a mirror, the beauty is for oneself, not for the mirror itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें पार्था तुझेनि मिषें। मी बोलें आपणयाचि उद्देशें। माझ्या तुझ्या ठाई असे । मीतूंपण गा॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ pārthā tujheni miṣeṃ| mī boleṃ āpaṇayāci uddeśeṃ| mājhyā tujhyā ṭhāī ase | mītūṃpaṇa gā|| 48||
verses.meaning: O Partha, through your guise, I speak of My own purpose. The distinction of 'I' and 'you' exists within Me and you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि जिव्हारींचें गुज। सांगतसें जीवासी तुज। हें अनन्यगतीचें मज। आथी व्यसन॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni jivhārīṃceṃ guja| sāṃgataseṃ jīvāsī tuja| heṃ ananyagatīceṃ maja| āthī vyasana|| 49||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I am revealing this secret of my heart to you, O Jiva, because I have this deep affection for those who are utterly devoted to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं जळा आपणपें देतां। लवण भुललें पंडुसुता । कौं आधवें तयाचें होतां। न लजेचि तें॥ १३५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ jaḻā āpaṇapeṃ detāṃ| lavaṇa bhulaleṃ paṃḍusutā | kauṃ ādhaveṃ tayāceṃ hotāṃ| na lajeci teṃ|| 1350||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, when water gives itself to salt, the salt is not ashamed to become entirely one with it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा तूं माझ्या ठाई । राखों नेणसीचि कांहीं । तरी आतां तुज काई । गोप्य मी करूं॥५१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā tūṃ mājhyā ṭhāī | rākhoṃ neṇasīci kāṃhīṃ | tarī ātāṃ tuja kāī | gopya mī karūṃ||51||
verses.meaning: Since you do not keep anything hidden from me, what can I now conceal from you?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि आघवींचि गूढें। जें पाऊनि अति उघडें। तें गोप्य माझें चोखडें। वाक्य आइक ॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni āghavīṃci gūḍheṃ| jeṃ pāūni ati ughaḍeṃ| teṃ gopya mājheṃ cokhaḍeṃ| vākya āika || 52||
verses.meaning: Therefore, all mysteries, which become exceedingly clear upon seeing it, that pure secret word of Mine, listen to it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी बाह्य आणि अंतरा। आपुलिया सर्व व्यापारा। मज व्यापकातें बीरा। विषयो करीं ॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī bāhya āṇi aṃtarā| āpuliyā sarva vyāpārā| maja vyāpakāteṃ bīrā| viṣayo karīṃ ||53||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O brave one, in all your external and internal actions, make Me, the all-pervading, your object.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आधवां आंगीं जैसा। वायु मिळोनि आहे आकाशा । तूं सर्व कर्मी तैसा। मजसीचि आस॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ādhavāṃ āṃgīṃ jaisā| vāyu miḻoni āhe ākāśā | tūṃ sarva karmī taisā| majasīci āsa|| 54||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind is inherently one with the sky, so too, in all actions, I am one with you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना आपुलें मन। करीं माझें एकायतन। माझेनि श्रवणें कान। भरूनि घालीं ॥५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā āpuleṃ mana| karīṃ mājheṃ ekāyatana| mājheni śravaṇeṃ kāna| bharūni ghālīṃ ||55||
verses.meaning: Indeed, make your mind my sole abode. Fill your ears by listening to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आत्मज्ञानें चोखडीं । संत जे माझीं रूपडीं। तेथ दृष्टि पडो आवडी । कामिनी जैसी॥५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātmajñāneṃ cokhaḍīṃ | saṃta je mājhīṃ rūpaḍīṃ| tetha dṛṣṭi paḍo āvaḍī | kāminī jaisī||56||
verses.meaning: My saints, who are pure embodiments of Self-knowledge, are like my very forms. May my gaze fall upon them with the same longing as a lover's.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मी सर्व वस्तीचे वसोटें। माझीं नामें जियें चोखटें। तियें जियावया वाटे । वाचेचिये लावीं ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mī sarva vastīce vasoṭeṃ| mājhīṃ nāmeṃ jiyeṃ cokhaṭeṃ| tiyeṃ jiyāvayā vāṭe | vāceciye lāvīṃ || 57||
verses.meaning: I am the very foundation of all existence. My names, which are pure and sacred, are the path to liberation. Place them on the tongue of your speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हातांचें करणें। का पायांचें चालणें। तें होय मजकारणें। तैसें करीं ॥५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: hātāṃceṃ karaṇeṃ| kā pāyāṃceṃ cālaṇeṃ| teṃ hoya majakāraṇeṃ| taiseṃ karīṃ ||58||
verses.meaning: Whatever my hands do, or my feet walk, let it all be for Your sake; that is how I shall act.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आपुला अथवा परावा । ठायीं उपकरसी पांडवा । तेणें यज्ञें होई बरवा । याजञिकु माझा ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āpulā athavā parāvā | ṭhāyīṃ upakarasī pāṃḍavā | teṇeṃ yajñeṃ hoī baravā | yājañiku mājhā || 59||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, whether you do good to your own people or to others, through that sacrifice, become my excellent sacrificer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें एकैक शिकऊं काई । पैं सेवकें आपुल्या ठाई । उरूनि येर सर्वही। मी सेव्यचि करीं॥ १३६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ ekaika śikaūṃ kāī | paiṃ sevakeṃ āpulyā ṭhāī | urūni yera sarvahī| mī sevyaci karīṃ|| 1360||
verses.meaning: Why should I teach each of these individually? For my devotee, I make all other things serve him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ जाऊनियां भूतद्वेषु। सर्वत्र नमवैन मीचि एकु । ऐसेनि आश्रयो आत्यंतिकु । लाहसी तूं माझा ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha jāūniyāṃ bhūtadveṣu| sarvatra namavaina mīci eku | aiseni āśrayo ātyaṃtiku | lāhasī tūṃ mājhā || 61||
verses.meaning: By going there, you will overcome all hatred towards beings, and I alone will make everyone bow down to you. Thus, you will attain my ultimate refuge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग भरलेया जगाआंतु। जाऊनि तिजयाची मातु। होऊनि ठायीळ एकांतु। आम्हां तुम्हां ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga bharaleyā jagāāṃtu| jāūni tijayācī mātu| hoūni ṭhāyīḻa ekāṃtu| āmhāṃ tumhāṃ || 62||
verses.meaning: Then, in this filled world, having gone to that third state, a solitude will be established for us and for you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां भलतिये आवस्थे। मी तूंतें तूं मातें। भोगिसीं ऐसें आइतें। वाढेल सुख॥ ६३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ bhalatiye āvasthe| mī tūṃteṃ tūṃ māteṃ| bhogisīṃ aiseṃ āiteṃ| vāḍhela sukha|| 63 ||
verses.meaning: Then, in that state, you will experience me and I will experience you, and such ready happiness will grow.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तिजें आडळ कारितें। निमाळें अर्जुना जेथें।॥ तैं मीचि म्हणौनि तूं मातें। पावसी शेखीं ॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tijeṃ āḍaḻa kāriteṃ| nimāḻeṃ arjunā jetheṃ||| taiṃ mīci mhaṇauni tūṃ māteṃ| pāvasī śekhīṃ || 64||
verses.meaning: And when all her actions cease, Arjuna, then you will realize that I am the ultimate goal, and you will attain Me in the end.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसी जळींची प्रतिभा । जळनाशीं बिंबा। येतां गाभागोभा। कांहीं आहे ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaisī jaḻīṃcī pratibhā | jaḻanāśīṃ biṃbā| yetāṃ gābhāgobhā| kāṃhīṃ āhe || 65 ||
verses.meaning: Just as the reflection in water, when the water is destroyed, does not affect the original image in any way.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं पबनु अंबरा। कां कल्लोळु सागरा। मिळतां आडवारा। कोणाचा गा॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ pabanu aṃbarā| kāṃ kalloḻu sāgarā| miḻatāṃ āḍavārā| koṇācā gā|| 66||
verses.meaning: Just as the wind merges with the sky, or a wave with the ocean, who can obstruct their union?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तूं आणि आम्हीं । हें दिसताहे देहधर्मी । मग ययाच्या विरामीं । मीचि होसी ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tūṃ āṇi āmhīṃ | heṃ disatāhe dehadharmī | maga yayācyā virāmīṃ | mīci hosī || 67||
verses.meaning: Therefore, you and I, this appears to be due to the nature of the body. But with the cessation of this, you will become Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यया बोलामाझारीं । होय नव्हे झणें करीं। येथ आन आथी तरी । तुझीचि आण॥ ६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yayā bolāmājhārīṃ | hoya navhe jhaṇeṃ karīṃ| yetha āna āthī tarī | tujhīci āṇa|| 68||
verses.meaning: In the midst of these words, do not say 'yes' or 'no' hastily. If there is any other truth here, then it is by your own oath.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं तुझी आण वाहणें । हें आत्मलिंगातें शिवणें। प्रीतीची जाति लाजणें। आठवों नेदी ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ tujhī āṇa vāhaṇeṃ | heṃ ātmaliṃgāteṃ śivaṇeṃ| prītīcī jāti lājaṇeṃ| āṭhavoṃ nedī || 69||
verses.meaning: To swear by You is to touch the very essence of the Self. The nature of love is such that it shames and does not allow for any other thought to arise.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं वेद्यु निष्प्रपंचु। जेणें विश्‍वाभासु हा साचु। आज्ञेचा नटनाचु। काळातें जिणें ॥ १३७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ vedyu niṣprapaṃcu| jeṇeṃ viś‍vābhāsu hā sācu| ājñecā naṭanācu| kāḻāteṃ jiṇeṃ || 1370||
verses.meaning: Indeed, the knowable is beyond the phenomenal world, by which this appearance of the universe is made real, and the dance of His command transcends time.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो देवो मी सत्यसंकल्पु। आणि जगाच्या हितीं बापु) मा आणेचा आक्षेपु। कां करावा॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: to devo mī satyasaṃkalpu| āṇi jagācyā hitīṃ bāpu) mā āṇecā ākṣepu| kāṃ karāvā|| 71||
verses.meaning: That God, I am of true resolve, and the father of the world's well-being. Why should I be accused of partiality?

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी अर्जुना तुझेनि वेधें। मियां देवपणाचीं ब्रिरुदें। सांडिलीं गा मी हें आधें। सगळेनि तुवां ॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī arjunā tujheni vedheṃ| miyāṃ devapaṇācīṃ brirudeṃ| sāṃḍilīṃ gā mī heṃ ādheṃ| sagaḻeni tuvāṃ || 72||
verses.meaning: But Arjuna, because of your devotion, I have set aside my titles of divinity. Indeed, you have completely taken possession of me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं काजा आपुलिया । रावो आपुली आपणया। आण वाहे धनंजया । तैसें हें कौं ॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kājā āpuliyā | rāvo āpulī āpaṇayā| āṇa vāhe dhanaṃjayā | taiseṃ heṃ kauṃ || 73||
verses.meaning: Just as a king, for his own purpose, swears by himself, so too is this, O Dhananjaya.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अर्जुन म्हणे देवें। अचाट हें न बोलावें । जें आमचें काज नांबें । तुझेनि एकें ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha arjuna mhaṇe deveṃ| acāṭa heṃ na bolāveṃ | jeṃ āmaceṃ kāja nāṃbeṃ | tujheni ekeṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Arjuna then said, "O Lord, do not speak such astonishing words. For our purpose is served by Your very name alone."

verses.shloka_devanagari: यावरी सांगों बैससी । कां सांगतां भाषही देसी । या तुझिया विनोदासी । पारु आहे जी॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yāvarī sāṃgoṃ baisasī | kāṃ sāṃgatāṃ bhāṣahī desī | yā tujhiyā vinodāsī | pāru āhe jī|| 75||
verses.meaning: After this, you sit to narrate, or while narrating, you also give a language. Is there an end to your playful sport, O Lord?

verses.shloka_devanagari: कमळवना विकाशु। करी रवीचा एक अंशु । तेथ आघवाचि प्रकाशु। नित्य दे तो॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kamaḻavanā vikāśu| karī ravīcā eka aṃśu | tetha āghavāci prakāśu| nitya de to|| 76||
verses.meaning: Just as a single ray of the sun causes a lotus garden to bloom, so too does it provide constant and complete illumination to the entire world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पृथ्वी निवऊनि सागर। भरीजती येवढें थोर। वर्षे तेथ मिषांतर। चातकु कीं॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pṛthvī nivaūni sāgara| bharījatī yevaḍheṃ thora| varṣe tetha miṣāṃtara| cātaku kīṃ|| 77||
verses.meaning: The earth is cooled and the oceans are filled to such a great extent. Is the cloud merely an excuse for the Chatak bird?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि औदार्या तुझेया । मज निमित्त ना म्हणावया । प्राप्ति असे दानीराया । कृपानिधी ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni audāryā tujheyā | maja nimitta nā mhaṇāvayā | prāpti ase dānīrāyā | kṛpānidhī || 78 ||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Lord, the treasure of compassion, I am but an excuse for the manifestation of Your generosity. Your grace is ever-present.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तंब देवो म्हणती राहें।॥ या बोलाचा प्रस्तावो नोहे । पैं मातें पावसी उपायें। ४८८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी साचचि येणें ॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taṃba devo mhaṇatī rāheṃ||| yā bolācā prastāvo nohe | paiṃ māteṃ pāvasī upāyeṃ| 488 śrījñāneśvarī sācaci yeṇeṃ || 79||
verses.meaning: Then the Lord says, "Stay!" This is not a mere suggestion. Rather, you will attain Me through proper means. Thus, truly, says Shri Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सैंधव सिंधू पडलिया। जो क्षणु धनंजया । तेणें विरेचि 'कौं उरावया। कारण कायी ॥ १३८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: saiṃdhava siṃdhū paḍaliyā| jo kṣaṇu dhanaṃjayā | teṇeṃ vireci 'kauṃ urāvayā| kāraṇa kāyī || 1380||
verses.meaning: O Dhananjaya, when rock salt falls into the ocean, it dissolves in an instant. What then remains of its separate existence?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें सर्वत्र मातें भजतां। सर्व मी होतां अहंता । निःऐेष जाऊनि तत्त्वता। मीचि होसी॥ ८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ sarvatra māteṃ bhajatāṃ| sarva mī hotāṃ ahaṃtā | niḥaieṣa jāūni tattvatā| mīci hosī|| 81||
verses.meaning: In the same way, by worshipping Me everywhere, and by realizing that I am everything, your ego will be completely dissolved, and you will truly become Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं माझिये प्राप्तीवरी । कर्मालागोनि अवधारीं। दाविली तुज उजरी । उपायांची ॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ mājhiye prāptīvarī | karmālāgoni avadhārīṃ| dāvilī tuja ujarī | upāyāṃcī ||82||
verses.meaning: Thus, I have revealed to you the clear path of actions (karma) that lead to My attainment.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे आधीं तंब पंडुसुता । सर्व कर्मे मज अर्पितां। सर्वत्र प्रसन्नता । लाहिजे माझी ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je ādhīṃ taṃba paṃḍusutā | sarva karme maja arpitāṃ| sarvatra prasannatā | lāhije mājhī || 83||
verses.meaning: O son of Pandu, by offering all actions to Me, one attains My complete grace everywhere.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं माझ्या इये प्रसादीं। माझें ज्ञान जाय सिद्धी । तेणें मिसळिजे त्रिशुद्धी । स्वरूपीं माझ्या ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ mājhyā iye prasādīṃ| mājheṃ jñāna jāya siddhī | teṇeṃ misaḻije triśuddhī | svarūpīṃ mājhyā || 84||
verses.meaning: Through this grace of mine, my knowledge attains perfection, and by that, it merges completely into my true nature.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग पार्था तिये ठायीं । साध्य साधन होय नाहीं। किंबहुना तुज कांहीं । उरेचि ना॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga pārthā tiye ṭhāyīṃ | sādhya sādhana hoya nāhīṃ| kiṃbahunā tuja kāṃhīṃ | ureci nā|| 85||
verses.meaning: Then, O Partha, in that state, there is no longer any distinction between the means and the end; indeed, nothing at all remains for you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी सर्व कर्मे आपुलीं॥ तुवां सर्वदा मज आअर्पिलीं। तेणें प्रसन्नता लाधळी। आजि हे माझी ॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī sarva karme āpulīṃ|| tuvāṃ sarvadā maja āarpilīṃ| teṇeṃ prasannatā lādhaḻī| āji he mājhī || 86||
verses.meaning: Thus, all your actions, you have always offered to me. By that, this day, my grace has been attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि येणें प्रसादबळें । नव्हे झुंजाचेनि आडळें।॥ न ठकेचि येकवेळे। भाळलों तुज ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yeṇeṃ prasādabaḻeṃ | navhe jhuṃjāceni āḍaḻeṃ||| na ṭhakeci yekaveḻe| bhāḻaloṃ tuja || 87||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by the power of this grace, I am not hindered by the conflict, nor am I ever defeated. I am completely devoted to you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जेणें सप्रपंच अज्ञान जाये । येकु मी गोचरु होये । तें उपपत्तीचेनि उपायें । गीतारूप हें ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṇeṃ saprapaṃca ajñāna jāye | yeku mī gocaru hoye | teṃ upapattīceni upāyeṃ | gītārūpa heṃ || 88 ||
verses.meaning: Through which the illusion of the world is dispelled, and the singular 'I' becomes perceptible, that is the form of the Gita, achieved through logical reasoning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मियां ज्ञान तुज आपुलें । नानापरी उपदेशिलें। येणें अज्ञानजात सांडीं वियालें। धर्माधर्म जें ॥८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: miyāṃ jñāna tuja āpuleṃ | nānāparī upadeśileṃ| yeṇeṃ ajñānajāta sāṃḍīṃ viyāleṃ| dharmādharma jeṃ ||89||
verses.meaning: I have imparted to you My knowledge in various ways. Through this, abandon the progeny of ignorance, which manifests as dharma and adharma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आशा जैसी दुःखातें। व्याली निंदा दुरितें। हें असो जेसें दैन्यातें। दुर्भगत्व॥ १३९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āśā jaisī duḥkhāteṃ| vyālī niṃdā duriteṃ| heṃ aso jeseṃ dainyāteṃ| durbhagatva|| 1390||
verses.meaning: Just as hope gives birth to sorrow, and slander to sin, so too does poverty give rise to misfortune.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें स्वर्गनरकसूचक। अज्ञान व्याळें धर्मादिक। तें सांडूनि घाळीं अशेख। ज्ञानें येणें ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ svarganarakasūcaka| ajñāna vyāḻeṃ dharmādika| teṃ sāṃḍūni ghāḻīṃ aśekha| jñāneṃ yeṇeṃ || 91||
verses.meaning: Just as the serpent of ignorance, which indicates heaven and hell, and all other such things, is completely destroyed by this knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हातीं घेऊनि तो दोरु । सांडिजे जैसा सर्पाकारु। कां निद्रात्यागें घराचारु । स्वप्नींचा जैसा॥९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: hātīṃ gheūni to doru | sāṃḍije jaisā sarpākāru| kāṃ nidrātyāgeṃ gharācāru | svapnīṃcā jaisā||92||
verses.meaning: Just as one takes up a rope and discards the illusion of a snake, or as one, upon waking, abandons the activities of a dream house.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना ना सांडिलेनि कवळें। चंद्रींचें धुये पिंवळें। व्याधित्यागें कडुवाळें-। पण मुखाचें॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā nā sāṃḍileni kavaḻeṃ| caṃdrīṃceṃ dhuye piṃvaḻeṃ| vyādhityāgeṃ kaḍuvāḻeṃ-| paṇa mukhāceṃ|| 93||
verses.meaning: Just as a child's discarded food, the yellow hue of the moon, or the bitterness in the mouth of a sick person due to their illness, are not inherently flawed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा दिवसा पाठीं देउनी । मृगजळ घापे त्यजुनी। कां काष्ठत्यागें वन्ही । त्यजिजे जैसा॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā divasā pāṭhīṃ deunī | mṛgajaḻa ghāpe tyajunī| kāṃ kāṣṭhatyāgeṃ vanhī | tyajije jaisā|| 94||
verses.meaning: Just as one abandons the mirage after seeing it in the daytime, or as one discards the wood after the fire has consumed it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें धर्माधर्माचें टबाळ। दावी अज्ञान जें कां मूळ। तें त्यजूनि त्यजीं सकळ । धर्मजात॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ dharmādharmāceṃ ṭabāḻa| dāvī ajñāna jeṃ kāṃ mūḻa| teṃ tyajūni tyajīṃ sakaḻa | dharmajāta|| 95||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the root of ignorance that shows the distinction between dharma and adharma, abandon that, and by abandoning it, abandon all forms of dharma.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अज्ञान निमालिया। मीचि येकु असें अपैसया। सनिद्र स्वप्न गेळिया। आपणपें जैसें॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga ajñāna nimāliyā| mīci yeku aseṃ apaisayā| sanidra svapna geḻiyā| āpaṇapeṃ jaiseṃ|| 96||
verses.meaning: Then, when ignorance is dispelled, I alone remain, spontaneously, just as one remains oneself when sleep and dreams have departed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा मी एकवांचूनि कांहीं । मग भिन्नाभिन्न आन नाहीं । सो$हंबोधें तयाच्या ठायीं । अनन्यु होय ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā mī ekavāṃcūni kāṃhīṃ | maga bhinnābhinna āna nāhīṃ | so$haṃbodheṃ tayācyā ṭhāyīṃ | ananyu hoya || 97||
verses.meaning: Just as there is nothing other than Me, there is no distinction of different or non-different. Through the realization of "I am That," one becomes non-dual with Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं आपुलेनि भेदेंबिण । माझें जाणिजे जें एकपण। तयाचि नांब शरण। मज येणें गा॥९८॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ āpuleni bhedeṃbiṇa | mājheṃ jāṇije jeṃ ekapaṇa| tayāci nāṃba śaraṇa| maja yeṇeṃ gā||98||
verses.meaning: Know that my oneness is without any distinction. To come to me is to surrender to this very oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें घटाचेनि नाशें। गगनीं गगन प्रवेशे। मज शरण येणें तेसें। ऐक्य करी॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ ghaṭāceni nāśeṃ| gaganīṃ gagana praveśe| maja śaraṇa yeṇeṃ teseṃ| aikya karī|| 99||
verses.meaning: Just as upon the destruction of a pot, the space within merges into the universal space, similarly, taking refuge in Me leads to oneness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सुवर्णमणि सोनया। ये कल्लोळु जैसा पाणिया। तैसा मज धनंजया। शरण ये तूं॥ १४००॥
verses.shloka_iast: suvarṇamaṇi sonayā| ye kalloḻu jaisā pāṇiyā| taisā maja dhanaṃjayā| śaraṇa ye tūṃ|| 1400||
verses.meaning: Just as gold is to ornaments, or waves are to water, so too, Dhananjaya, surrender to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वांचूनि सागराच्या पोटीं। बडवानळु शरण आला किरीटी । जाळूनि ठाके तया गोठी । वाळूनि दे पां ॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: vāṃcūni sāgarācyā poṭīṃ| baḍavānaḻu śaraṇa ālā kirīṭī | jāḻūni ṭhāke tayā goṭhī | vāḻūni de pāṃ || 9||
verses.meaning: Except for the submarine fire, which, O Kiriti, takes refuge in the ocean's depths, burning and drying up its very essence.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मजही शरण रिघिजे। आणि जीवत्बेंचि असिजे। धिग्‌ बोली विया न लजे। प्रज्ञा केवीं ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: majahī śaraṇa righije| āṇi jīvatbeṃci asije| dhig‌ bolī viyā na laje| prajñā kevīṃ || 2||
verses.meaning: Even if one takes refuge in Me, and yet continues to exist with the sense of individual selfhood, how can such a person, who is not ashamed of such a disgraceful statement, possess true wisdom?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अगा प्राकृताही राया-। आंगीं पडे जें धनंजया तें दासिरूंहि कौं तया-। समान होय॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: agā prākṛtāhī rāyā-| āṃgīṃ paḍe jeṃ dhanaṃjayā teṃ dāsirūṃhi kauṃ tayā-| samāna hoya|| 3||
verses.meaning: O Arjuna, even a common person, if they are devoted to the King, becomes equal to a servant of the King.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मा मी विशवेश्‍्वरु भेटे। आणि जीवग्रंथी न सुटे। हे बोळ नको वोखटें। कानीं लाऊं॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mā mī viśaveś‍varu bheṭe| āṇi jīvagraṃthī na suṭe| he boḻa nako vokhaṭeṃ| kānīṃ lāūṃ|| 4||
verses.meaning: If I do not meet the Lord of the Universe, and the knot of my individual soul is not untied, then do not whisper such inauspicious words into my ears.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि मी होऊनि मातें । सेवणें आहे आयितें। तें करीं हातां येतें। ज्ञानें येणें ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni mī hoūni māteṃ | sevaṇeṃ āhe āyiteṃ| teṃ karīṃ hātāṃ yeteṃ| jñāneṃ yeṇeṃ || 5||
verses.meaning: Therefore, I, becoming Myself, am to be served readily. This knowledge makes that service attainable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग ताकौनियां काढिलें। लोणी मागोतें ताकीं घातलें। परी न घेपेचि कांहीं केळें। तेणें जेवीं ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tākauniyāṃ kāḍhileṃ| loṇī māgoteṃ tākīṃ ghātaleṃ| parī na ghepeci kāṃhīṃ keḻeṃ| teṇeṃ jevīṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: Then, after churning, the butter was removed. The buttermilk was put back into the churn. But nothing could be extracted from it again, just as it is.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें अद्वयत्वें मज । शरण रिघालिया तुज। धर्माधर्म हे सहज । लागतील ना॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ advayatveṃ maja | śaraṇa righāliyā tuja| dharmādharma he sahaja | lāgatīla nā||7||
verses.meaning: Similarly, if you take refuge in Me with non-duality, then dharma and adharma will naturally not affect you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: लोह उभें खाय माती। तें परिसाचिये संगतीं। सोनें जाल्या पुढती। न शिविजे मळें॥८॥
verses.shloka_iast: loha ubheṃ khāya mātī| teṃ parisāciye saṃgatīṃ| soneṃ jālyā puḍhatī| na śivije maḻeṃ||8||
verses.meaning: Just as iron, which rusts and decays in the soil, upon coming into contact with the philosopher's stone, transforms into gold and is thereafter untouched by impurity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो काष्ठापासोनि। मथूनि घेतलिया वन्ही । मग काष्ठेंही कोंडोनी। न ठके जैसा॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso kāṣṭhāpāsoni| mathūni ghetaliyā vanhī | maga kāṣṭheṃhī koṃḍonī| na ṭhake jaisā|| 9||
verses.meaning: Just as fire, once churned out from wood, is not confined by the wood itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना काय दिनकरु । देखत आहे अंधारु । कीं प्रबोधीं होय गोचरु । स्वप्नभ्रमु ॥ १४१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā kāya dinakaru | dekhata āhe aṃdhāru | kīṃ prabodhīṃ hoya gocaru | svapnabhramu || 1410||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, does the sun ever see darkness? Or does the illusion of a dream persist once one awakens?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें मजसीं एकवटलेया। मी सर्वरूप वांचूनियां। आन कांहीं उरावया। कारण असे॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ majasīṃ ekavaṭaleyā| mī sarvarūpa vāṃcūniyāṃ| āna kāṃhīṃ urāvayā| kāraṇa ase|| 19||
verses.meaning: Similarly, when one becomes united with Me, there remains no reason for anything else to exist, for I am everything.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तयाचें कांहीं । चिंती ना आपुल्या ठाई । तुझें पापपुण्य पाहीं। मीचि होईन॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tayāceṃ kāṃhīṃ | ciṃtī nā āpulyā ṭhāī | tujheṃ pāpapuṇya pāhīṃ| mīci hoīna|| 12||
verses.meaning: Therefore, do not worry about your actions; I will take on your merits and demerits.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ सर्वबंधलक्षणें। पापें उरावें दुजेपणें । तें माझ्या बोधीं वायाणें । होऊनि जाईल॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha sarvabaṃdhalakṣaṇeṃ| pāpeṃ urāveṃ dujepaṇeṃ | teṃ mājhyā bodhīṃ vāyāṇeṃ | hoūni jāīla|| 13||
verses.meaning: There, all the characteristics of bondage, sins, and duality, will become futile in my understanding.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जळीं पडिलिया 'लवणा। सर्वही जळ होय विचक्षणा। तुज मी अनन्यशरणा। होईन तैसा॥ १४॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaḻīṃ paḍiliyā 'lavaṇā| sarvahī jaḻa hoya vicakṣaṇā| tuja mī ananyaśaraṇā| hoīna taisā|| 14||
verses.meaning: Just as salt, when it dissolves in water, becomes entirely one with the water, so too, I shall become completely one with you, my refuge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येतुलेनि आपैसया। सुटलाचि आहासी धनंजया । घेई मज प्रकाशोनियां। सोडवीन तूंतें ॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetuleni āpaisayā| suṭalāci āhāsī dhanaṃjayā | gheī maja prakāśoniyāṃ| soḍavīna tūṃteṃ || 15||
verses.meaning: By this, you are automatically freed, Arjuna. Accept me by illuminating me; I will liberate you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें पुढतीं। हे आधी न वाहे चित्तीं । मज एकासि ये सुमती । जाणोनि शरण॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ puḍhatīṃ| he ādhī na vāhe cittīṃ | maja ekāsi ye sumatī | jāṇoni śaraṇa|| 16||
verses.meaning: Therefore, do not worry about this again. Knowing that I alone am the good path, surrender to me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें सर्वरूपरूपसें। सर्वदृष्टिडोळसें । सर्वदेशनिवासें । बोलिलें श्रीकृष्णें ॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ sarvarūparūpaseṃ| sarvadṛṣṭiḍoḻaseṃ | sarvadeśanivāseṃ | bolileṃ śrīkṛṣṇeṃ || 97||
verses.meaning: Thus spoke Shri Krishna, who is the form of all forms, the eye of all sights, and the dweller in all places.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग सांवळा सकंकणु। बाहु पसरोनि दक्षिणु। आलिंगिला स्वशरणु। भक्‍तराजु तो॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga sāṃvaḻā sakaṃkaṇu| bāhu pasaroni dakṣiṇu| āliṃgilā svaśaraṇu| bhak‍tarāju to|| 18||
verses.meaning: Then, the dark-complexioned Lord, wearing bracelets, extended his right arm and embraced that king of devotees, who had surrendered himself to Him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: न पवतां जयातें। काखे सूनि बुद्धीतें। बोलणें मागोौतें । बोसरलें॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: na pavatāṃ jayāteṃ| kākhe sūni buddhīteṃ| bolaṇeṃ māgoauteṃ | bosaraleṃ|| 19||
verses.meaning: Without attaining it, carrying it in the intellect, speech falls short and becomes inadequate.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें जें कांहीं एक । बोला बुद्धीसिही अटक तें द्यावया मिष। खेवाचें केळें॥ १४२० ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ jeṃ kāṃhīṃ eka | bolā buddhīsihī aṭaka teṃ dyāvayā miṣa| khevāceṃ keḻeṃ|| 1420 ||
verses.meaning: That which is beyond the grasp of speech and intellect, that very truth, He made accessible through the pretext of this dialogue.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ४९० श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी हृदया हृदय येक जालें। ये हृदयींचें ते हृदयीं घातळें। द्वैत न मोडितां केलें। आपणाऐसें अर्जुना॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: 490 śrījñāneśvarī hṛdayā hṛdaya yeka jāleṃ| ye hṛdayīṃceṃ te hṛdayīṃ ghātaḻeṃ| dvaita na moḍitāṃ keleṃ| āpaṇāaiseṃ arjunā|| 21||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, without breaking the duality, the heart of one became the heart of the other; what was in this heart was placed in that heart, making the other like oneself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दीपें दीप लाविला। तैसा परिष्वंगु तो जाला । हैत न मोडितां केला। आपणपें पार्थ ॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: dīpeṃ dīpa lāvilā| taisā pariṣvaṃgu to jālā | haita na moḍitāṃ kelā| āpaṇapeṃ pārtha || 22||
verses.meaning: Just as one lamp lights another, so was that embrace, O Partha, accomplished without breaking the original form, by itself.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेव्हां सुखाचा मग तया । पूरु आला जो धनंजया। तेथ वाडु तऱही बुडोनियां। ठेला देवो॥ २३॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevhāṃ sukhācā maga tayā | pūru ālā jo dhanaṃjayā| tetha vāḍu taṟahī buḍoniyāṃ| ṭhelā devo|| 23||
verses.meaning: Then, O Dhananjaya, a flood of happiness came to him, and even the Lord Himself was submerged and remained there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सिंधू सिंधूतें पावो जाये। तें पावणें ठाके दुणा होये। बरी रिगे पुरवणिये। आकाशही ॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: siṃdhū siṃdhūteṃ pāvo jāye| teṃ pāvaṇeṃ ṭhāke duṇā hoye| barī rige puravaṇiye| ākāśahī || 24||
verses.meaning: When a river merges with the ocean, it doesn't just join; it becomes the ocean itself, expanding its vastness. Similarly, the sky, though already boundless, seems to deepen and expand when it encompasses everything within it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें तयां दोघांचें मिळणें । दोघां नावरे जाणावें कवणें। किंबहुना श्रीनारायणें। विश्व कोंदलें॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ tayāṃ doghāṃceṃ miḻaṇeṃ | doghāṃ nāvare jāṇāveṃ kavaṇeṃ| kiṃbahunā śrīnārāyaṇeṃ| viśva koṃdaleṃ|| 25||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the union of the two is such that no one can comprehend it. In short, the entire universe is pervaded by Shri Narayana.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं वेदाचें मूळसूत्र। सर्वाधिकांरेकपवित्र । श्रीकृष्णें गीताशास्त्र। प्रकट केलें॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ vedāceṃ mūḻasūtra| sarvādhikāṃrekapavitra | śrīkṛṣṇeṃ gītāśāstra| prakaṭa keleṃ|| 26||
verses.meaning: Thus, the fundamental principle of the Vedas, sacred and universally applicable, was revealed by Shri Krishna through the scripture of the Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: येथ गीता मूळ वेदां। ऐसें केवीं पां आलें बोधा। हें म्हणाल तरी प्रसिद्धा। उपपत्ति सांगों ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: yetha gītā mūḻa vedāṃ| aiseṃ kevīṃ pāṃ āleṃ bodhā| heṃ mhaṇāla tarī prasiddhā| upapatti sāṃgoṃ || 27||
verses.meaning: If you ask how the Gita came to be understood as the root of the Vedas, then we shall explain this well-known reasoning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी जयाच्या निश्‍्वासीं । जन्म झाले वेदराशी। तो सत्यप्रतिज्ञ पैजेसीं । बोलला स्वमुखें ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī jayācyā niś‍vāsīṃ | janma jhāle vedarāśī| to satyapratijña paijesīṃ | bolalā svamukheṃ || 28||
verses.meaning: He, from whose breath the Vedas were born, spoke these words Himself, with an oath of truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि वेदां मूळभूत । गीता म्हणों हें होय उचित। आणिकही येकी येथ। उपपत्ति असे॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vedāṃ mūḻabhūta | gītā mhaṇoṃ heṃ hoya ucita| āṇikahī yekī yetha| upapatti ase|| 29||
verses.meaning: Therefore, it is appropriate to call the Gita the root of the Vedas. And there is another reason for this here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें न नशतु स्वरूपें। जयाचा विस्तारु जेथ ल्पे। तें तयाचें म्हणिपे। बीज जगीं ॥ ९४३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ na naśatu svarūpeṃ| jayācā vistāru jetha lpe| teṃ tayāceṃ mhaṇipe| bīja jagīṃ || 9430||
verses.meaning: That which does not perish in its essence, and from which all expansion originates, is known in the world as its seed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी कांडत्रयात्मकु । शब्दराशी अशेखु । गीतेमाजीं असे रुखु । बीजीं जैसा ॥ ३१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī kāṃḍatrayātmaku | śabdarāśī aśekhu | gītemājīṃ ase rukhu | bījīṃ jaisā || 31||
verses.meaning: Just as a tree is contained within a seed, so too is the entire expanse of the three Vedas, the essence of all knowledge, contained within the Bhagavad Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि वेदांचें बीज। श्रीगीता होय हें मज। गमे आणि सहज। दिसतही आहे॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vedāṃceṃ bīja| śrīgītā hoya heṃ maja| game āṇi sahaja| disatahī āhe|| 32||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita is the seed of the Vedas, this is what I feel, and it is naturally evident.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे वेदांचे तिन्ही भाग। गीते उमटले असती चांग। भूषणरत्नीं सर्वांग। शोभलें जैसें ॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: je vedāṃce tinhī bhāga| gīte umaṭale asatī cāṃga| bhūṣaṇaratnīṃ sarvāṃga| śobhaleṃ jaiseṃ || 33||
verses.meaning: Just as the three parts of the Vedas are beautifully reflected in the Gita, so too is the entire body adorned with precious jewels.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तियेंचि कर्मादिकें तिन्ही । कांडें कोणकोणे स्थानीं । गीते आहाति तें नयनीं । दाखऊं आईक ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiyeṃci karmādikeṃ tinhī | kāṃḍeṃ koṇakoṇe sthānīṃ | gīte āhāti teṃ nayanīṃ | dākhaūṃ āīka || 34||
verses.meaning: I will now show you, with my own eyes, in which parts of the Gita these three sections, namely Karma, Upasana, and Jnana, are located. Listen carefully.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरि पहिला जो अध्याबो । तो शास्त्रप्रवृत्तिप्रस्तावो । द्वितीयीं सांख्यसदभावो । प्रकाशिला ॥ ३५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tari pahilā jo adhyābo | to śāstrapravṛttiprastāvo | dvitīyīṃ sāṃkhyasadabhāvo | prakāśilā || 35||
verses.meaning: Thus, the first chapter introduces the path of scriptural action, while the second chapter illuminates the true nature of Sankhya philosophy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मोक्षदानीं स्वतंत्र । ज्ञानप्रधान हें शास्त्र । येतुलालें दुजीं सूत्र । उभारिलें॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mokṣadānīṃ svataṃtra | jñānapradhāna heṃ śāstra | yetulāleṃ dujīṃ sūtra | ubhārileṃ|| 36||
verses.meaning: This scripture, which bestows liberation, is supreme due to its emphasis on knowledge. It has established a second, unparalleled path.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग अज्ञानें बांधलेयां । मोक्षपदीं बैसावया । साधनारंभु तो तृतीया-। ध्यायीं बोलिला॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga ajñāneṃ bāṃdhaleyāṃ | mokṣapadīṃ baisāvayā | sādhanāraṃbhu to tṛtīyā-| dhyāyīṃ bolilā|| 37||
verses.meaning: Then, for those bound by ignorance, the means to attain the state of liberation are described in the third chapter.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे देहाभिमानबंधें। सांडूनि काम्यनिषिद्धें। विहित परी अप्रमादें । अनुष्ठावें ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: je dehābhimānabaṃdheṃ| sāṃḍūni kāmyaniṣiddheṃ| vihita parī apramādeṃ | anuṣṭhāveṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: One who, by abandoning the bonds of body-consciousness, gives up all desire-driven and forbidden actions, and diligently performs only the prescribed duties.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसेनि सदभावें कर्म करावें । हा तिजा अध्यावो जो देवें। निर्णय केला तें जाणावें। कर्मकांड येथ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseni sadabhāveṃ karma karāveṃ | hā tijā adhyāvo jo deveṃ| nirṇaya kelā teṃ jāṇāveṃ| karmakāṃḍa yetha|| 39||
verses.meaning: Thus, one should perform actions with such a good disposition. This is the third chapter, which the Lord has decided upon, and it should be understood as the path of action (Karma Kanda).

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तेंचि नित्यादिक । अज्ञानाचे आवश्यक । आचरतां मोचक । केवीं होय पां॥ ९४४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi teṃci nityādika | ajñānāce āvaśyaka | ācaratāṃ mocaka | kevīṃ hoya pāṃ|| 9440||
verses.meaning: And how can that very same daily ritual, which is born of ignorance, become a liberator when practiced?

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी अपेक्षा जालिया । बद्ध मुमुक्षेते आलिया । देवें ब्रह्मार्पणत्वें क्रिया । सांगितली॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī apekṣā jāliyā | baddha mumukṣete āliyā | deveṃ brahmārpaṇatveṃ kriyā | sāṃgitalī|| 41||
verses.meaning: When such an expectation arises, and the bound soul seeks liberation, the Lord instructed the performance of actions as an offering to Brahman.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे देहवाचामानसें। विहित निपजे जें जैसें। तें एक ईश्‍वरोद्देशें। कौजे म्हणितलें॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: je dehavācāmānaseṃ| vihita nipaje jeṃ jaiseṃ| teṃ eka īś‍varoddeśeṃ| kauje mhaṇitaleṃ|| 42||
verses.meaning: Whatever is done by body, speech, and mind, as prescribed, that alone is considered an offering to God.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हेंचि ईश्‍वरीं कर्मयोगें। भजनकथनाचें खागें। आदरिळें शेषभागें। चतुर्थाचेनी॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃci īś‍varīṃ karmayogeṃ| bhajanakathanāceṃ khāgeṃ| ādariḻeṃ śeṣabhāgeṃ| caturthācenī|| 43||
verses.meaning: This is the remaining part of the fourth chapter, which describes the path of devotion through action, as revealed by God.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें विश्वरूप अकरावा । अध्याबो संपे जंव आघवा तंव कर्मे ईशु भजावा । हें जें बोलिलें ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ viśvarūpa akarāvā | adhyābo saṃpe jaṃva āghavā taṃva karme īśu bhajāvā | heṃ jeṃ bolileṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: Until the eleventh chapter, where the universal form of God is fully described, one should worship God through actions, as has been stated.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अष्टाध्यायी उघड । जाण येथें देवताकांड । शास्त्र सांगतसे आड । मोडूनि बोळे॥ ४५॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ aṣṭādhyāyī ughaḍa | jāṇa yetheṃ devatākāṃḍa | śāstra sāṃgatase āḍa | moḍūni boḻe|| 45||
verses.meaning: Here, the Ashtadhyayi, which is the scripture of grammar, clearly explains the section on deities, breaking through all obstacles to reveal its meaning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तेणेंचि ईशप्रसादें। श्रीगुरुसंप्रदायलब्धें। साच ज्ञान उद्घोधे। कोंवळें जें॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi teṇeṃci īśaprasādeṃ| śrīgurusaṃpradāyalabdheṃ| sāca jñāna udghodhe| koṃvaḻeṃ jeṃ|| 46||
verses.meaning: And by that very grace of God, obtained through the tradition of the Guru, true knowledge, which is tender and fresh, awakens.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें अद्वेष्टादिप्रभृतिकीं । अथवा अमानित्वादिकीं । वाढविजे म्हणौनि ळेखीं । बारावा गणूं॥॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ adveṣṭādiprabhṛtikīṃ | athavā amānitvādikīṃ | vāḍhavije mhaṇauni ḻekhīṃ | bārāvā gaṇūṃ|||| 47||
verses.meaning: Therefore, it is considered the twelfth, as it is nurtured by qualities like non-hatred and humility.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो बारावा अध्याय आदी । आणि पंधरावा अवधी । ज्ञानफळपाकसिद्धी । निरूपणासीं ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: to bārāvā adhyāya ādī | āṇi paṃdharāvā avadhī | jñānaphaḻapākasiddhī | nirūpaṇāsīṃ || 48 ||
verses.meaning: The twelfth chapter is the beginning, and the fifteenth chapter is the culmination, of the discourse on the perfection of the fruit of knowledge.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि चहूंही इहीं। ऊर्ध्वमूळांतीं अध्यायी । ज्ञानकांड ये ठायीं । निरूपिजे॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni cahūṃhī ihīṃ| ūrdhvamūḻāṃtīṃ adhyāyī | jñānakāṃḍa ye ṭhāyīṃ | nirūpije|| 49||
verses.meaning: Therefore, in these four chapters, from the root above to the end, the section on knowledge is expounded here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं कांडत्रयनिरूपणी । श्रुतीचि हे कोडिसवाणी । गीतापद्यरत्नांचीं लेणीं। लेयिळी आहे॥ १४५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ kāṃḍatrayanirūpaṇī | śrutīci he koḍisavāṇī | gītāpadyaratnāṃcīṃ leṇīṃ| leyiḻī āhe|| 1450||
verses.meaning: Thus, in expounding the three sections (Karma, Upasana, Jnana), the Vedas themselves, in their beautiful form, are adorned with the jewels of the Gita's verses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो कांडत्रयात्मक। श्रुति मोक्षरू्प फळ येक। बोभावे जें आवश्यक । ठाकावें म्हणौनि ॥ ५१ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso kāṃḍatrayātmaka| śruti mokṣarūpa phaḻa yeka| bobhāve jeṃ āvaśyaka | ṭhākāveṃ mhaṇauni || 51 ||
verses.meaning: Let this be so. The three sections of the Vedas, which are concerned with rituals, worship, and knowledge, all proclaim that liberation is the one essential fruit to be attained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाचेनि साधनज्ञानेंसीं । वैर करी जो प्रतिदिवशीं। तो अज्ञानवर्ग षोडशीं । प्रतिपादिजे॥ ५२॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāceni sādhanajñāneṃsīṃ | vaira karī jo pratidivaśīṃ| to ajñānavarga ṣoḍaśīṃ | pratipādije|| 52||
verses.meaning: One who daily wages war against the knowledge gained through spiritual practice, such a person is considered to be among the sixteen types of ignorant beings.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तोचि शास्त्राचा बोळावा । घेवोनि बैरी जिणावा । हा निरोपु तो सतरावा । अध्याय येथ॥५३॥
verses.shloka_iast: toci śāstrācā boḻāvā | ghevoni bairī jiṇāvā | hā niropu to satarāvā | adhyāya yetha||53||
verses.meaning: This is the essence of the scriptures, to conquer the enemy within. This is the seventeenth chapter here.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसा प्रथमाळलागोनी। सतरावा लाणी करूनी। आत्मनिश्वास विवरूनि। दाविला देवें ॥ ५४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisā prathamāḻalāgonī| satarāvā lāṇī karūnī| ātmaniśvāsa vivarūni| dāvilā deveṃ || 54||
verses.meaning: Thus, from the very beginning, by explaining the seventeenth principle and revealing the true nature of the Self, the Lord demonstrated this.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तया अर्थजातां अशेषा। केला तात्पर्याचा आवांका। तो हा अठरावा देखा । कलशाध्यायो ॥ ५५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayā arthajātāṃ aśeṣā| kelā tātparyācā āvāṃkā| to hā aṭharāvā dekhā | kalaśādhyāyo || 55||
verses.meaning: To encompass the essence of all those meanings, this eighteenth chapter is presented as the pinnacle, the concluding part.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं सकळसंख्यासिद्धु । श्रीभगवद्गीताप्रबंधु। हा औदार्ये आगळा बेदु। मूर्तु जाण॥ ५६॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ sakaḻasaṃkhyāsiddhu | śrībhagavadgītāprabaṃdhu| hā audārye āgaḻā bedu| mūrtu jāṇa|| 56||
verses.meaning: Thus, the entire, perfect, and complete treatise of the Bhagavad Gita is indeed a manifest form of the Vedas, distinguished by its profound generosity and wisdom.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वेदु संपन्नु होय ठाई । परी कृपणु ऐसा आनु नाहीं। जे कानीं लागला तिहीं । वर्णांच्याचि ॥ ५७॥
verses.shloka_iast: vedu saṃpannu hoya ṭhāī | parī kṛpaṇu aisā ānu nāhīṃ| je kānīṃ lāgalā tihīṃ | varṇāṃcyāci || 57||
verses.meaning: The Vedas are complete in themselves, yet they are so miserly that they only speak to those of the three varnas (castes).

verses.shloka_devanagari: येरां भवव्यथा ठेलियां। स्त्रीशूद्रादिकां प्राणियां । अनवसरू मांडूनियां। राहिला आहे ॥ ५८॥
verses.shloka_iast: yerāṃ bhavavyathā ṭheliyāṃ| strīśūdrādikāṃ prāṇiyāṃ | anavasarū māṃḍūniyāṃ| rāhilā āhe || 58||
verses.meaning: The suffering of worldly existence remained for others, for women, Shudras, and other beings, as the inappropriate discourse continued.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी मज पाहतां तें मागील उणें । फेडावया गीतापणें। वेदु वेठला भलतेणें । सेव्य होआवया॥५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī maja pāhatāṃ teṃ māgīla uṇeṃ | pheḍāvayā gītāpaṇeṃ| vedu veṭhalā bhalateṇeṃ | sevya hoāvayā||59||
verses.meaning: Therefore, seeing my deficiency in the past, the Vedas, in the form of the Gita, have come to serve me in every possible way, to fulfill that lack.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ना हे अर्थ रिगोनि मनीं । श्रवणें लागोनि कानीं । जपमिषें बदनीं । वसोनियां ॥ ९४६०॥
verses.shloka_iast: nā he artha rigoni manīṃ | śravaṇeṃ lāgoni kānīṃ | japamiṣeṃ badanīṃ | vasoniyāṃ || 9460||
verses.meaning: May these meanings, having settled in the mind, and having entered the ears through listening, reside in the mouth in the guise of chanting.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ये गीतेचा पाठु जो जाणे। तयाचेनि सांगातीपणें । गीता लिहोनि वाहाणें । पुस्तकमिषें ॥ ६१॥
verses.shloka_iast: ye gītecā pāṭhu jo jāṇe| tayāceni sāṃgātīpaṇeṃ | gītā lihoni vāhāṇeṃ | pustakamiṣeṃ || 61||
verses.meaning: One who understands the meaning of this Gita, through their companionship, carries the Gita in the form of a book, as if the book itself is the Gita written out.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसैसा मिसकटा। संसाराचा चोहटां। गवादी घालीत चोखटा । मोक्षसुखाची ॥ ६२॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisaisā misakaṭā| saṃsārācā cohaṭāṃ| gavādī ghālīta cokhaṭā | mokṣasukhācī || 62||
verses.meaning: In this way, the pure joy of liberation is offered as a pure sacrifice in the marketplace of worldly existence, which is otherwise full of impurities.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी आकाशीं वसावया । पृथ्वीवरी बैसावया । रविदीप्ती राहाटावया। आवारु नभ॥ ६३॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī ākāśīṃ vasāvayā | pṛthvīvarī baisāvayā | ravidīptī rāhāṭāvayā| āvāru nabha|| 63||
verses.meaning: Just as the sky is the abode for the celestial bodies, the resting place for the earth, and the medium through which the sun's light travels, so too is the vast expanse of the universe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेवीं उत्तम अधम ऐसें। सेवितां 'कवणातेंही न पुसे। कैवल्यदानें सरिसें। निववीत जगा॥ ६४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tevīṃ uttama adhama aiseṃ| sevitāṃ 'kavaṇāteṃhī na puse| kaivalyadāneṃ sariseṃ| nivavīta jagā|| 64||
verses.meaning: Similarly, whether one is superior or inferior, upon serving, it asks no one, but equally bestows liberation, comforting the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं मागिली कुटी । भ्याला वेदु गीतेच्या पोटीं। रिगाला आतां गोमटी । ४९२ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी कौर्ति पातला॥ ६५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ māgilī kuṭī | bhyālā vedu gītecyā poṭīṃ| rigālā ātāṃ gomaṭī | 492 śrījñāneśvarī kaurti pātalā|| 65||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the Vedas, fearing the previous interpretations, entered into the womb of the Gita, and now, having attained a beautiful glory, they shine forth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि वेदाची सुसेव्यता । ते हे मूर्त जाण श्रीगीता । श्रीकृष्णें पंडुसुता । उपदेशिली ॥ ६६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni vedācī susevyatā | te he mūrta jāṇa śrīgītā | śrīkṛṣṇeṃ paṃḍusutā | upadeśilī || 66||
verses.meaning: Therefore, the easily served essence of the Vedas is this embodied Shrimad Bhagavad Gita, which Shri Krishna Himself taught to the son of Pandu.

verses.shloka_devanagari: परी वत्साचेनि बोरसें। दुभतें होय घरोद्देशें । जालें पांडवाचेनि मिषें । जगदुब्धरण ॥ ६७॥
verses.shloka_iast: parī vatsāceni boraseṃ| dubhateṃ hoya gharoddeśeṃ | jāleṃ pāṃḍavāceni miṣeṃ | jagadubdharaṇa || 67||
verses.meaning: Just as a calf's longing for milk makes the cow's udder full, so too, through the pretext of the Pandavas, the world was delivered.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चातकाचिये कणवें। मेघु पाणियेसिं धांबे। तेथ चराचर आधघवें। निवालें जेवीं॥६८॥
verses.shloka_iast: cātakāciye kaṇaveṃ| meghu pāṇiyesiṃ dhāṃbe| tetha carācara ādhaghaveṃ| nivāleṃ jevīṃ||68||
verses.meaning: Just as the cloud, out of compassion for the cuckoo, pours down water, thereby bringing solace to all creation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कां अनन्यगतीकमळा-। लागीं सूर्य ये वेळोवेळां। कीं सुखिया होईजे डोळां । त्रिभुवनींचा ॥ ६९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāṃ ananyagatīkamaḻā-| lāgīṃ sūrya ye veḻoveḻāṃ| kīṃ sukhiyā hoīje ḍoḻāṃ | tribhuvanīṃcā || 69||
verses.meaning: Or does the sun repeatedly come for the lotus, which has no other refuge? Or does the eye become happy by seeing the Lord of the three worlds?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसें अर्जुनाचेनि व्याजें। गीता प्रकाशूनि श्रीराजें। संसारायेवढें थोर ओझें। फेडिलें जगाचें ॥ १४७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: taiseṃ arjunāceni vyājeṃ| gītā prakāśūni śrīrājeṃ| saṃsārāyevaḍheṃ thora ojheṃ| pheḍileṃ jagāceṃ || 1470||
verses.meaning: Thus, through the pretext of Arjuna, Shri Raja (Lord Krishna) illuminated the Gita and removed the great burden of worldly existence from the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सर्वशास्त्ररत्नदीप्ती । उजळिता हा त्रिजगती। सूर्य नव्हे लक्ष्मीपती-। वक्‍्त्राकाशींचा॥ ७१॥
verses.shloka_iast: sarvaśāstraratnadīptī | ujaḻitā hā trijagatī| sūrya navhe lakṣmīpatī-| vak‍trākāśīṃcā|| 71||
verses.meaning: The radiance of all scriptural jewels illuminates these three worlds. This is not the sun, but the very face of the Lord of Lakshmi, shining in the sky of speech.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बाप कुळ तें पवित्र। जेथिंचा पार्थू या ज्ञाना पात्र । जेणें गीता केलें शास्त्र । आवारु जगा॥७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: bāpa kuḻa teṃ pavitra| jethiṃcā pārthū yā jñānā pātra | jeṇeṃ gītā keleṃ śāstra | āvāru jagā||72||
verses.meaning: Blessed is the lineage from which Partha (Arjuna) emerged, worthy of this knowledge. Through him, the Gita was made a scripture, a refuge for the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें असो मग तेणें। सदगुरु श्रीकृष्णें। पार्थाचें मिसळणे । आणिलें द्वैता॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ aso maga teṇeṃ| sadaguru śrīkṛṣṇeṃ| pārthāceṃ misaḻaṇe | āṇileṃ dvaitā|| 73||
verses.meaning: Let this be. Then, the Sadguru Shri Krishna brought Arjuna into the duality of the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाठीं म्हणतसे पांडवा । शास्त्र हें मानलें कौं जीवा । तेथ येरु म्हणे देवा। आपुलिया कृपा॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāṭhīṃ mhaṇatase pāṃḍavā | śāstra heṃ mānaleṃ kauṃ jīvā | tetha yeru mhaṇe devā| āpuliyā kṛpā|| 74||
verses.meaning: Then, Arjuna said, "O Lord, has this scripture been accepted by my soul?" To which the Lord replied, "By My grace."

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी निधान जोडावया । भाग्य घडे गा धनंजया। परी जोडिलें भोगावया। विपायें होय ॥ ७५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī nidhāna joḍāvayā | bhāgya ghaḍe gā dhanaṃjayā| parī joḍileṃ bhogāvayā| vipāyeṃ hoya || 75||
verses.meaning: Indeed, O Dhananjaya, one may be fortunate enough to acquire a treasure, but to truly enjoy what has been acquired, that happens only rarely.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं क्षीरसागरायेवढें। अविरजी दुधाचें भांडें। सुरां असुरां केवढें। मथितां जालें॥ ७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ kṣīrasāgarāyevaḍheṃ| avirajī dudhāceṃ bhāṃḍeṃ| surāṃ asurāṃ kevaḍheṃ| mathitāṃ jāleṃ|| 76||
verses.meaning: The ocean of milk, as vast as it was, a vessel of pure milk, how much effort did it take for the gods and demons to churn it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तें सायासही फळा आलें। जें अमृतही डोळां देखिलें। परी वरिचिली चुकलें। जतनेतें ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṃ sāyāsahī phaḻā āleṃ| jeṃ amṛtahī ḍoḻāṃ dekhileṃ| parī varicilī cukaleṃ| jataneteṃ || 77||
verses.meaning: That effort also bore fruit, as if nectar itself was seen with the eyes. But it missed the higher, more careful preservation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ अमरत्वा वोगरिलें। तें मरणाचिलागीं जालें। भोगों नेणतां जोडलें। ऐसें आहे॥७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha amaratvā vogarileṃ| teṃ maraṇācilāgīṃ jāleṃ| bhogoṃ neṇatāṃ joḍaleṃ| aiseṃ āhe||78||
verses.meaning: There, immortality was offered, but it became for the sake of death. It was acquired without knowing how to experience it; such is the situation.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नहुषु स्वर्गाधिपति जाहला । परी राहाटीं भांबावला । तो भुजंगत्व पावला । नेणसी कायी॥ ७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: nahuṣu svargādhipati jāhalā | parī rāhāṭīṃ bhāṃbāvalā | to bhujaṃgatva pāvalā | neṇasī kāyī|| 79||
verses.meaning: Nahusha became the lord of heaven, yet he stumbled in his conduct. He was then transformed into a serpent; do you not know this?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि बहुत पुण्य तुवां। केलें तेणें धनंजया । आजि शास्त्रगजा इया। जालासि विषयो॥ १४८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bahuta puṇya tuvāṃ| keleṃ teṇeṃ dhanaṃjayā | āji śāstragajā iyā| jālāsi viṣayo|| 1480||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Dhananjaya, because of the great merit you have accumulated, you have today become the subject of this elephant of scriptures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी ययाचि शास्त्राचेनि। संप्रदायें पांघुरौनि। शास्त्रार्थ हा निकेनि। अनुष्ठीं हो॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī yayāci śāstrāceni| saṃpradāyeṃ pāṃghurauni| śāstrārtha hā nikeni| anuṣṭhīṃ ho||81||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by embracing the tradition of this very scripture, may you diligently practice its true meaning.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हबीं अमृतमंथना-। सारिखें होईल अर्जुना । जरी रिघसी अनुष्ठाना । संप्रदायेंबीण ॥ ८२ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhabīṃ amṛtamaṃthanā-| sārikheṃ hoīla arjunā | jarī righasī anuṣṭhānā | saṃpradāyeṃbīṇa || 82 ||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, if you undertake spiritual practices without the guidance of a tradition, it will be like churning nectar without proper knowledge, yielding no true benefit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गाय धड जोडे गोमटी तें तैंचि पिवों ये किरीटी । जें जाणिजे हातवटी । सांजवणीची ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: gāya dhaḍa joḍe gomaṭī teṃ taiṃci pivoṃ ye kirīṭī | jeṃ jāṇije hātavaṭī | sāṃjavaṇīcī || 83||
verses.meaning: O Kiriti (Arjuna), just as one can milk a healthy and beautiful cow only if one knows the technique of milking, similarly, the true essence of spiritual knowledge can be attained only by those who understand the proper method.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा श्रीगुरु प्रसन्न होये। शिष्य विद्याही कीर लाहे । परी ते फळे संप्रदायें। उपासिलिया ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā śrīguru prasanna hoye| śiṣya vidyāhī kīra lāhe | parī te phaḻe saṃpradāyeṃ| upāsiliyā || 84||
verses.meaning: When the Guru is pleased, the disciple indeed gains knowledge. But that knowledge bears fruit only when cultivated through tradition.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि शास्त्री जो इये । उचितु संप्रदायो आहे। तो ऐक आतां बहुवें। आदरेंसीं ॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni śāstrī jo iye | ucitu saṃpradāyo āhe| to aika ātāṃ bahuveṃ| ādareṃsīṃ || 85||
verses.meaning: Therefore, listen now with great reverence to the proper tradition as prescribed in the scriptures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तुवां हें जें पार्था । गीताशास्त्र लाधलें आस्था । तें तपोहीना सर्वथा । सांगावें ना हो॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī tuvāṃ heṃ jeṃ pārthā | gītāśāstra lādhaleṃ āsthā | teṃ tapohīnā sarvathā | sāṃgāveṃ nā ho|| 86||
verses.meaning: Therefore, Partha, this scripture of the Gita, which you have received with devotion, should never be told to one who lacks austerity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा तापसुही जाला। परी गुरुभक्तीं जो ढिला। तो वेदीं अंत्यजु वाळिला। तैसा वाळीं ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā tāpasuhī jālā| parī gurubhaktīṃ jo ḍhilā| to vedīṃ aṃtyaju vāḻilā| taisā vāḻīṃ || 87||
verses.meaning: Or even if one becomes an ascetic, but is lax in devotion to the Guru, the Vedas reject him just as they reject an untouchable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी पुरोडाशु जैसा। न घापे वृद्ध तरी वायसा। गीता नेदी तैसी तापसा। गुरु भक्तिहीना॥ ८८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī puroḍāśu jaisā| na ghāpe vṛddha tarī vāyasā| gītā nedī taisī tāpasā| guru bhaktihīnā|| 88 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a crow does not partake of the sacrificial offering, so too does the Gita not reveal itself to an ascetic who lacks devotion to the Guru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: 'का तपही जोडे देहीं। भजे गुरुदेवांच्या ठायीं । परी आकर्णनीं नाहीं । चाड जरी॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: 'kā tapahī joḍe dehīṃ| bhaje gurudevāṃcyā ṭhāyīṃ | parī ākarṇanīṃ nāhīṃ | cāḍa jarī|| 89||
verses.meaning: What is the use of performing austerities and worshipping the Guru if one has no desire to listen to his teachings?

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी तो मागील दोहीं आंगीं। उत्तम होय कौर जगीं। परी या श्रवणालागीं। योग्यु नोहे॥ ९४९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī to māgīla dohīṃ āṃgīṃ| uttama hoya kaura jagīṃ| parī yā śravaṇālāgīṃ| yogyu nohe|| 9490||
verses.meaning: Even though he may be excellent in the two previous aspects and renowned in the world, he is not suitable for this path of listening (Shrvana).

verses.shloka_devanagari: मुक्‍ताफळ भलतेसें। हो परी मुख नसे। तंव गुण प्रवेशे। तेथ कायी ॥ ९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: muk‍tāphaḻa bhalateseṃ| ho parī mukha nase| taṃva guṇa praveśe| tetha kāyī || 91||
verses.meaning: A pearl, however beautiful, if it has no opening, how can its inherent qualities be appreciated?

verses.shloka_devanagari: सागरु गंभीरु होये। हें कोण ना म्हणत आहे। परी वृष्टि वायां जाये। जाळी तेथ॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: sāgaru gaṃbhīru hoye| heṃ koṇa nā mhaṇata āhe| parī vṛṣṭi vāyāṃ jāye| jāḻī tetha|| 92||
verses.meaning: The ocean is indeed deep; who can deny this? Yet, the rain that falls upon it is wasted there.

verses.shloka_devanagari: धालिया दिव्यान्न सुवावें। मग जें वायां धाडावें। तें आरती कां न करावें। उदारपण॥ ९३॥
verses.shloka_iast: dhāliyā divyānna suvāveṃ| maga jeṃ vāyāṃ dhāḍāveṃ| teṃ āratī kāṃ na karāveṃ| udārapaṇa|| 93||
verses.meaning: When a divine feast is prepared, and then wasted, why not offer it in devotion? Such is true generosity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि योग्य भलतैसें । होतु परी चाड नसे। तरी झणें वानिवसें। देसी हें तयां॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni yogya bhalataiseṃ | hotu parī cāḍa nase| tarī jhaṇeṃ vānivaseṃ| desī heṃ tayāṃ|| 94||
verses.meaning: Therefore, whatever is suitable, let it be so, but if there is no desire for it, then do not give it to them as a blessing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: रूपाचा सुजाणु डोळा। वोडवूं ये कायि 'परिमळा। जेथ जें माने तें फळा। तेथचि ये गा॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: rūpācā sujāṇu ḍoḻā| voḍavūṃ ye kāyi 'parimaḻā| jetha jeṃ māne teṃ phaḻā| tethaci ye gā|| 95||
verses.meaning: Can the eye, which is adept at perceiving form, ever perceive fragrance? That which is meant for a particular sense organ, only that can be perceived by it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तपी भक्ति । पाहावे ते सुभद्रापती। परी शास्त्रश्रवणीं अनासक्ति। वबाळावेचि ते॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tapī bhakti | pāhāve te subhadrāpatī| parī śāstraśravaṇīṃ anāsakti| vabāḻāveci te|| 96||
verses.meaning: Therefore, through penance and devotion, one should seek the Lord of Subhadra (Arjuna). But if there is no detachment in listening to the scriptures, then it is all in vain.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नातरी तपभक्ति। होऊनि श्रवणीं आर्ति। आथी ऐसीही आयती । देखसी जरी॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: nātarī tapabhakti| hoūni śravaṇīṃ ārti| āthī aisīhī āyatī | dekhasī jarī|| 97||
verses.meaning: Or, if you see such a readiness, a yearning for listening, arising from penance and devotion.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी गीताशास्त्रनिर्मिता। जो मी सकळलोकशास्ता। तया मातें सामान्यता । बोळेळ जो ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī gītāśāstranirmitā| jo mī sakaḻalokaśāstā| tayā māteṃ sāmānyatā | boḻeḻa jo || 98 ||
verses.meaning: Yet, I, the creator of the Gita-shastra, the ruler of all worlds, if someone speaks to me in a common, ordinary way...

verses.shloka_devanagari: माझ्या सजनेंसिं मातें । पैशून्याचेनि हातें। येक आहाती तयांतें। योग्य न म्हण॥ ९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: mājhyā sajaneṃsiṃ māteṃ | paiśūnyāceni hāteṃ| yeka āhātī tayāṃteṃ| yogya na mhaṇa|| 99||
verses.meaning: Among my devotees, there are some who, with the hands of their actions, are not worthy of being called my own.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयांची येर आघवी । सामग्री ऐसी जाणावी । दीपेंबीण ठाणदिवी । रात्रीची जैसी॥ १५००॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayāṃcī yera āghavī | sāmagrī aisī jāṇāvī | dīpeṃbīṇa ṭhāṇadivī | rātrīcī jaisī|| 1500||
verses.meaning: Know that all their other preparations are like a lampstand at night without a lamp.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अंग गोरें आणि तरुणें। वरी लेइलें आहे लेणें। परी येकलेनि प्राणें। सांडिलें जेवीं ॥ १॥
verses.shloka_iast: aṃga goreṃ āṇi taruṇeṃ| varī leileṃ āhe leṇeṃ| parī yekaleni prāṇeṃ| sāṃḍileṃ jevīṃ || 1||
verses.meaning: Just as a beautiful, youthful body adorned with ornaments is abandoned when life departs from it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सोनयाचें सुंदर। निर्वाळिलें होय घर । परी सर्पांगना द्वार । रुंधलें आहे॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: sonayāceṃ suṃdara| nirvāḻileṃ hoya ghara | parī sarpāṃganā dvāra | ruṃdhaleṃ āhe|| 2||
verses.meaning: A beautiful house of gold has been built, but its entrance is blocked by a serpent.

verses.shloka_devanagari: निपजे दिव्यान्न चोखट । परी माजीं असे काळकूट । असो मैत्री 'कपट-। गर्भिणी जैसी ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: nipaje divyānna cokhaṭa | parī mājīṃ ase kāḻakūṭa | aso maitrī 'kapaṭa-| garbhiṇī jaisī || 3||
verses.meaning: A delicious dish may be prepared, but it contains poison within. Such is a friendship pregnant with deceit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी तपभक्तिमेधा। तयाची जाण प्रबुद्धा। जो माझयांची कां निंदा । माझीचि करी॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī tapabhaktimedhā| tayācī jāṇa prabuddhā| jo mājhayāṃcī kāṃ niṃdā | mājhīci karī|| 4||
verses.meaning: Understand, O enlightened one, that such is the devotion, penance, and intellect of one who, even while criticizing me, is in fact criticizing only my own self.

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें धनंजया । तो भक्तु मेधावी तपिया । तरी नको बापा इया । शास्त्रा आतळों देवों ॥५॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ dhanaṃjayā | to bhaktu medhāvī tapiyā | tarī nako bāpā iyā | śāstrā ātaḻoṃ devoṃ ||5||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Dhananjaya, if that devotee is intelligent and ascetic, then do not let him be entangled in these scriptures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय बहु बोलों निंदका। योग्य स्त्रष्ट्याहीसारिखा। गीता हे कवतिका। लागींही ४९४ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी नेदीं ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya bahu boloṃ niṃdakā| yogya straṣṭyāhīsārikhā| gītā he kavatikā| lāgīṃhī 494 śrījñāneśvarī nedīṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: What more can I say? Even to the Creator, this Gita is not to be given even for amusement, let alone to a slanderer.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तपाचा धनुर्धरा । तळीं दाटोनि गाडोरा । वरी गुरुभक्तीचा पुरा। प्रासादु जो जाला॥७॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tapācā dhanurdharā | taḻīṃ dāṭoni gāḍorā | varī gurubhaktīcā purā| prāsādu jo jālā||7||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Arjuna, the foundation of penance, firmly established and strong, supports the magnificent palace of devotion to the Guru that has been built upon it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि श्रवणेच्छेचा पुढां। दारवंटा सदा उघडा । वरी कलशु चोखडा। अनिंदारत्नांचा ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi śravaṇecchecā puḍhāṃ| dāravaṃṭā sadā ughaḍā | varī kalaśu cokhaḍā| aniṃdāratnāṃcā || 8||
verses.meaning: And for those desirous of hearing, the entrance is always open, adorned with a pure kalasha of faultless jewels.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐशा भक्तालयीं चोखटीं । गीतारत्नेश्‍्वरु हा प्रतिष्ठीं। मग माझिया संबसाटी | तुकसी जगीं ॥९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiśā bhaktālayīṃ cokhaṭīṃ | gītāratneś‍varu hā pratiṣṭhīṃ| maga mājhiyā saṃbasāṭī | tukasī jagīṃ ||9||
verses.meaning: In the pure hearts of such devotees, this Lord of the Gita-jewel is established. Then, through my association, you will be honored in the world.

verses.shloka_devanagari: का जे एकाक्षरपणेंसीं । त्रिमात्रकेचिये कुशीं। प्रणवु होतां गर्भवासीं। सांकडला॥ १५१०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kā je ekākṣarapaṇeṃsīṃ | trimātrakeciye kuśīṃ| praṇavu hotāṃ garbhavāsīṃ| sāṃkaḍalā|| 1510||
verses.meaning: For when the single-syllable Om, within the womb of the three matras, became embodied, it was constrained.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो गीतेचिया बाहाळीं। वेदबीज गेलें पाहाळीं। कीं गायत्री फुलीं फळीं। श्लोकांच्या आली॥ ११॥
verses.shloka_iast: to gīteciyā bāhāḻīṃ| vedabīja geleṃ pāhāḻīṃ| kīṃ gāyatrī phulīṃ phaḻīṃ| ślokāṃcyā ālī|| 11||
verses.meaning: The seed of the Vedas has blossomed into the Gita, just as the Gayatri mantra has manifested in the flowers and fruits of these verses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ते हे मंत्ररहस्य गीता। मेळवी जो माझिया भक्‍्ता। अनन्यजीवबना माता । बाळका जैसी॥ १२॥
verses.shloka_iast: te he maṃtrarahasya gītā| meḻavī jo mājhiyā bhak‍tā| ananyajīvabanā mātā | bāḻakā jaisī|| 12||
verses.meaning: This secret of the mantra, the Gita, unites with My devotee, just as a mother, who is the very life of her child, unites with her baby.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसी भक्तां गीतेसीं। भेटी करी जो आदेरेंसीं । तो देहापाठीं मजसीं। येकचि होय॥ १३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisī bhaktāṃ gītesīṃ| bheṭī karī jo ādereṃsīṃ | to dehāpāṭhīṃ majasīṃ| yekaci hoya|| 13||
verses.meaning: Similarly, the devotee who reverently unites with the Gita, becomes one with Me even after leaving the body.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि देहाचेंही लेणें। लेऊनि वेगळेपणें । असे तंब जीवेंप्राणें। तोचि 'पढिये॥ ९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi dehāceṃhī leṇeṃ| leūni vegaḻepaṇeṃ | ase taṃba jīveṃprāṇeṃ| toci 'paḍhiye|| 94||
verses.meaning: And having adorned the body, he remains distinct, yet with his very life and soul, he is the beloved.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानियां कर्मठां तापसां। यया खुणेचिया माणुसां-। माजीं तो एकु गा जैसा । पढिये मज॥ १५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñāniyāṃ karmaṭhāṃ tāpasāṃ| yayā khuṇeciyā māṇusāṃ-| mājīṃ to eku gā jaisā | paḍhiye maja|| 15||
verses.meaning: Among the wise, the ritualists, and the ascetics, the one who understands this secret is especially dear to Me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा भूतळीं आघवा । आन न देखें पांडवा। जो गीता सांगे मेळावा । भक्‍तजनांचा ॥ १६॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā bhūtaḻīṃ āghavā | āna na dekheṃ pāṃḍavā| jo gītā sāṃge meḻāvā | bhak‍tajanāṃcā || 16||
verses.meaning: O Pandava, I see no one else on this earth who gathers the devotees to the Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मज ईशश्‍वराचेनि लोभें। हे गीता पढतां अक्षोभें। जो मंडन होय सभे। संतांचिये॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: maja īśaś‍varāceni lobheṃ| he gītā paḍhatāṃ akṣobheṃ| jo maṃḍana hoya sabhe| saṃtāṃciye|| 97||
verses.meaning: Out of love for me, God, whoever recites this Gita with unwavering devotion becomes an adornment in the assembly of saints.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नवपल्लबीं रोमांचितु। मंदानिळें कांपवितु। आमोदजळें बोलवितु। फुलांचे डोळे ॥ १८॥
verses.shloka_iast: navapallabīṃ romāṃcitu| maṃdāniḻeṃ kāṃpavitu| āmodajaḻeṃ bolavitu| phulāṃce ḍoḻe || 18||
verses.meaning: The new sprouts, thrilled, are made to tremble by the gentle breeze. The fragrant water calls forth the eyes of the flowers.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कोकिळा कलरवाचेनि मिषें। सद्गद बोलवीत जैसें । वसंत 'का प्रवेशे । मद्भक्‍्तआरामीं ॥ १९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kokiḻā kalaravāceni miṣeṃ| sadgada bolavīta jaiseṃ | vasaṃta 'kā praveśe | madbhak‍taārāmīṃ || 19||
verses.meaning: Just as the cuckoo, through its melodious calls, seems to speak with emotion, so does spring enter the garden of my devotees.

verses.shloka_devanagari: का जन्माचें फळ चकोरां। होत जें चंद्र ये अंबरा। नाना नवघन मयूरां। बो देत पावे॥ १५२०॥
verses.shloka_iast: kā janmāceṃ phaḻa cakorāṃ| hota jeṃ caṃdra ye aṃbarā| nānā navaghana mayūrāṃ| bo deta pāve|| 1520||
verses.meaning: Just as the chakora bird finds the fruit of its birth when the moon appears in the sky, or as peacocks find their joy when new clouds gather.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा सज्जनांच्या मेळापीं। गीतापद्यरत्नीं उमपीं। वर्षे जो माझ्या रूपीं। हेतु ठेऊनि॥ २१॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā sajjanāṃcyā meḻāpīṃ| gītāpadyaratnīṃ umapīṃ| varṣe jo mājhyā rūpīṃ| hetu ṭheūni|| 21||
verses.meaning: Similarly, in the company of the virtuous, the one who, with the intention of realizing My form, showers the jewels of the Gita's verses.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग तयाचेनि पाडें। पढियंतें मज फुडें । नाहींचि गा मागेंपुढें। न्याहाळितां॥ २२॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga tayāceni pāḍeṃ| paḍhiyaṃteṃ maja phuḍeṃ | nāhīṃci gā māgeṃpuḍheṃ| nyāhāḻitāṃ|| 22||
verses.meaning: Then, in comparison to that, there is no one more beloved to me, neither in the past nor in the future, even after searching thoroughly.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अर्जुना हा ठायवरी। मी तयातें सूये जिव्हारी । जो गीतार्थाचें करी । परगुणें संतां॥२३॥
verses.shloka_iast: arjunā hā ṭhāyavarī| mī tayāteṃ sūye jivhārī | jo gītārthāceṃ karī | paraguṇeṃ saṃtāṃ||23||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, I am truly pleased with those who explain the meaning of the Gita to the saints.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पैं माझिया तुझिया मिळणीं। वाढीनली जे हे कहाणी । मोक्षधर्म का जिणीं। आलासे जेथें॥ २४॥
verses.shloka_iast: paiṃ mājhiyā tujhiyā miḻaṇīṃ| vāḍhīnalī je he kahāṇī | mokṣadharma kā jiṇīṃ| ālāse jetheṃ|| 24||
verses.meaning: From this union of yours and mine, this story has grown, where the dharma of liberation has come to life.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो हा सकळार्थप्रबोधु। आम्हां दोघांचा संवादु। न करितां पदभेदु । पाठेंचि जो पढे ॥ २५॥
verses.shloka_iast: to hā sakaḻārthaprabodhu| āmhāṃ doghāṃcā saṃvādu| na karitāṃ padabhedu | pāṭheṃci jo paḍhe || 25||
verses.meaning: This entire discourse, the awakening of all meaning, is our dialogue. It can be understood without separating the words, simply by reading it.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेणें ज्ञानानळीं प्रदीप्तीं । मूळ अविद्येचिया आहुती। तोषविला होय सुमती । परमात्मा मी॥ २६॥
verses.shloka_iast: teṇeṃ jñānānaḻīṃ pradīptīṃ | mūḻa avidyeciyā āhutī| toṣavilā hoya sumatī | paramātmā mī|| 26||
verses.meaning: With the fire of knowledge thus kindled, and the root of ignorance offered as oblation, the Supreme Self, who is I, is propitiated, O wise one.

verses.shloka_devanagari: घेऊनि गीतार्थ उगाणा। ज्ञानिये जें विचक्षणा। ठाकती तें गाणावाणा। गीतेचा तो लाहे ॥ २७॥
verses.shloka_iast: gheūni gītārtha ugāṇā| jñāniye jeṃ vicakṣaṇā| ṭhākatī teṃ gāṇāvāṇā| gītecā to lāhe || 27||
verses.meaning: The wise, having understood the essence of the Gita, attain the true glory of the Gita, which is to sing its praises.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गीतापाठकासि असे। फळ अर्थज्ञाचि सरिसें। गीता माउलियेसि नसे। जाणें तान्हें ॥ २८॥
verses.shloka_iast: gītāpāṭhakāsi ase| phaḻa arthajñāci sariseṃ| gītā māuliyesi nase| jāṇeṃ tānheṃ || 28||
verses.meaning: The one who recites the Gita attains a fruit equal to that of one who understands its meaning. For the Gita, like a mother, does not know her child's immaturity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि सर्वमार्गी निंदा । सांडूनि आस्था पैं शुद्धा। गीताश्रवणीं श्रद्धा । उभारी जो॥ २९॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi sarvamārgī niṃdā | sāṃḍūni āsthā paiṃ śuddhā| gītāśravaṇīṃ śraddhā | ubhārī jo|| 29||
verses.meaning: And abandoning all paths of slander, with pure devotion and faith, one who uplifts himself by listening to the Gita.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तयाच्या श्रवणपुटीं। गीतेचीं अक्षरें जंब पैठीं । होतीना तंव उठाउठीं। पळेचि पाप॥ १५३०॥
verses.shloka_iast: tayācyā śravaṇapuṭīṃ| gītecīṃ akṣareṃ jaṃba paiṭhīṃ | hotīnā taṃva uṭhāuṭhīṃ| paḻeci pāpa|| 1530||
verses.meaning: When the words of the Gita enter his ears, sins flee immediately.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अटवियेमाजीं जैसा । वन्हि रिघतां सहसा । ल॑ंघिती का दिशा। वनौकें तियें॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: aṭaviyemājīṃ jaisā | vanhi righatāṃ sahasā | la̭ṃghitī kā diśā| vanaukeṃ tiyeṃ|| 39||
verses.meaning: Just as when a fire suddenly enters a forest, the forest dwellers (animals) flee in all directions.

verses.shloka_devanagari: का उदयाचळकुळीं। झळकतां अंशुमाळी । तिमिरें अंतराळीं। हारपती॥ ३२॥
verses.shloka_iast: kā udayācaḻakuḻīṃ| jhaḻakatāṃ aṃśumāḻī | timireṃ aṃtarāḻīṃ| hārapatī|| 32||
verses.meaning: When the sun rises on the eastern mountain, darkness vanishes from the sky.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा कानाच्या महाद्वारीं। गीता गजर जेथ करी । तेथ सृष्टीचिये आदीवरी। जायचि पाप॥ ३३॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā kānācyā mahādvārīṃ| gītā gajara jetha karī | tetha sṛṣṭīciye ādīvarī| jāyaci pāpa|| 33||
verses.meaning: Similarly, at the grand entrance of the ears, where the Gita resounds, the sins accumulated since the beginning of creation are dispelled.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी जन्मवेली धुबट। होय पुण्यरूप चोखट । याहीवरी अचाट। लाहे फळ॥ ३४॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī janmavelī dhubaṭa| hoya puṇyarūpa cokhaṭa | yāhīvarī acāṭa| lāhe phaḻa|| 34||
verses.meaning: Such a birth, though seemingly insignificant, becomes pure and meritorious. Moreover, it attains an extraordinary fruit.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे इये गीतेचीं अक्षरें। जेतुलीं का कर्णद्वारें। रिघती तेतुळे होती पुरे। अश्वमेध कीं ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: je iye gītecīṃ akṣareṃ| jetulīṃ kā karṇadvāreṃ| righatī tetuḻe hotī pure| aśvamedha kīṃ || 35 ||
verses.meaning: As many letters of this Gita as enter through the ear, so many Ashwamedha sacrifices are completed.

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि श्रवणें पापें जाती । आणि धर्म धरी उन्नती । तेणें स्वर्गराज्य संपत्ती। लाहेचि शेखीं॥ ३६॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni śravaṇeṃ pāpeṃ jātī | āṇi dharma dharī unnatī | teṇeṃ svargarājya saṃpattī| lāheci śekhīṃ|| 36||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by listening, sins are dispelled, and righteousness flourishes. Ultimately, this leads to the attainment of heavenly realms and prosperity.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो पैं मज यावयालागीं। पहिलें पेणें करी स्वर्गी । मग आवडे तंव भोगी । पाठीं मजचि मिळे॥ ३७॥
verses.shloka_iast: to paiṃ maja yāvayālāgīṃ| pahileṃ peṇeṃ karī svargī | maga āvaḍe taṃva bhogī | pāṭhīṃ majaci miḻe|| 37||
verses.meaning: To reach Me, he first makes his abode in heaven. Then, he enjoys as much as he desires, and thereafter, he merges into Me alone.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसी गीता धनंजया । ऐकतया आणि पढतया। फळे महानंदें मियां। बहु काय बोलों ॥ ३८॥
verses.shloka_iast: aisī gītā dhanaṃjayā | aikatayā āṇi paḍhatayā| phaḻe mahānaṃdeṃ miyāṃ| bahu kāya boloṃ || 38||
verses.meaning: Such is the Gita, O Dhananjaya! For those who listen and those who study, it yields the fruit of great bliss. What more can I say?

verses.shloka_devanagari: याकारणें हें असो। परी जयालागीं शास्त्रातिसो। केला तें तंव तुज पुसों। काज तुझें ॥ ३९॥
verses.shloka_iast: yākāraṇeṃ heṃ aso| parī jayālāgīṃ śāstrātiso| kelā teṃ taṃva tuja pusoṃ| kāja tujheṃ || 39||
verses.meaning: Therefore, let this be. But for what purpose the scriptures have been expounded, that indeed I shall ask you, for that is your true work.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ४९६ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी तरी सांग पां पांडवा । हा शास्त्रसिद्धांतु आघवा । तुज एकचित्ते फावा । गेला आहे॥ १५४०॥
verses.shloka_iast: 496 śrījñāneśvarī tarī sāṃga pāṃ pāṃḍavā | hā śāstrasiddhāṃtu āghavā | tuja ekacitte phāvā | gelā āhe|| 1540||
verses.meaning: Therefore, O Pandava, this entire established truth of the scriptures has been made available to you with a focused mind.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आम्हीं जैसें जया रीतीं। उगाणिलें कानांच्या हातीं । येरीं तैसेंचि तुझ्या चित्तीं । पैठें केलें कौं॥ ४१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āmhīṃ jaiseṃ jayā rītīṃ| ugāṇileṃ kānāṃcyā hātīṃ | yerīṃ taiseṃci tujhyā cittīṃ | paiṭheṃ keleṃ kauṃ|| 41||
verses.meaning: Just as we have instilled this knowledge into the ears of the listeners, so too have we placed it within your heart.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अथवा माझारीं। गेलें सांडिविखुरी। किंवा उपेक्षेवरी। वाळूनि सांडिलें॥ ४२॥
verses.shloka_iast: athavā mājhārīṃ| geleṃ sāṃḍivikhurī| kiṃvā upekṣevarī| vāḻūni sāṃḍileṃ|| 42||
verses.meaning: Or, if it has been scattered and lost in the middle, or if it has been neglected and abandoned.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जैसें आम्हीं सांगितलें। तैसेंचि हृदयीं फावलें। तरी सांग पां बहिलळें। पुसेन तें मी ॥ ४३॥
verses.shloka_iast: jaiseṃ āmhīṃ sāṃgitaleṃ| taiseṃci hṛdayīṃ phāvaleṃ| tarī sāṃga pāṃ bahilaḻeṃ| pusena teṃ mī || 43||
verses.meaning: If what I have said has been understood and accepted in your heart, then tell me, O Bahilala, I will ask you what I wish to know.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तरी स्वाज्ञानजनितें। मागिलें मोहें तूंतें। भुलविलें तो येथें) असे कौं नाहीं ॥ ४४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tarī svājñānajaniteṃ| māgileṃ moheṃ tūṃteṃ| bhulavileṃ to yetheṃ) ase kauṃ nāhīṃ || 44||
verses.meaning: So, the delusion born of past ignorance, which has beguiled you, is it not present here?

verses.shloka_devanagari: हें बहु पुसों काई । सांगे तूं आपल्या ठाई । कर्माकर्म कांहीं । देखतासी ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: heṃ bahu pusoṃ kāī | sāṃge tūṃ āpalyā ṭhāī | karmākarma kāṃhīṃ | dekhatāsī || 45 ||
verses.meaning: Why should I ask you much? Tell me, do you perceive any action or inaction within yourself?

verses.shloka_devanagari: पार्थ स्वानंदैकरसें। विरेळ ऐसा भेददशे। आणिला येणें मिषें। प्रश्‍नाचेनि॥ ४६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pārtha svānaṃdaikaraseṃ| vireḻa aisā bhedadaśe| āṇilā yeṇeṃ miṣeṃ| praś‍nāceni|| 46||
verses.meaning: Arjuna, through the pretext of this question, brought forth the distinction between the individual self and the Supreme Self, which are essentially one in the bliss of self-realization.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पूर्णब्रह्म जाला पार्थ। तरी पुढील साधावया कार्यार्थ। मर्यादा श्रीकृष्णनाथु । उल्लंघों नेदी ॥ ४७॥
verses.shloka_iast: pūrṇabrahma jālā pārtha| tarī puḍhīla sādhāvayā kāryārtha| maryādā śrīkṛṣṇanāthu | ullaṃghoṃ nedī || 47||
verses.meaning: Even though Arjuna had realized the Supreme Brahman, Lord Krishna did not allow him to transgress the limits of his duty, so that the subsequent tasks could be accomplished.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एऱ्हवीं आपुलें करणें । सर्वज्ञ काय तो नेणें। परी केलें पुसणें । याचिलागीं ॥ ४८॥
verses.shloka_iast: eṟhavīṃ āpuleṃ karaṇeṃ | sarvajña kāya to neṇeṃ| parī keleṃ pusaṇeṃ | yācilāgīṃ || 48||
verses.meaning: Otherwise, does the Omniscient not know His own doing? But He asked this question for this very reason.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं करोनियां प्रश्‍न॥ नसतेंचि अर्जुनपण। आणूनियां जालें पूर्णपण। तें बोलवी स्वयें ॥ ४९॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ karoniyāṃ praś‍na|| nasateṃci arjunapaṇa| āṇūniyāṃ jāleṃ pūrṇapaṇa| teṃ bolavī svayeṃ || 49||
verses.meaning: Thus, by asking questions, Arjuna, who was not truly Arjuna (in his limited sense), attained completeness, and that completeness itself spoke through him.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मग क्षीराब्धीतें सांडितु। गगनीं पुंजु मंडितु। निवडे जैसा न निवडितु । पूर्णचंद्र॥ १५५०॥
verses.shloka_iast: maga kṣīrābdhīteṃ sāṃḍitu| gaganīṃ puṃju maṃḍitu| nivaḍe jaisā na nivaḍitu | pūrṇacaṃdra|| 1550||
verses.meaning: Then, leaving the ocean of milk, a cluster of light, adorned in the sky, appears like the full moon, without any blemish.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तैसा ब्रह्म मी हें विसरे। तेथ जगचि ब्रहात्वें भरे। हेंही सांडी तरी विरे। ब्रह्मपणही ॥ ५९॥
verses.shloka_iast: taisā brahma mī heṃ visare| tetha jagaci brahātveṃ bhare| heṃhī sāṃḍī tarī vire| brahmapaṇahī || 59||
