verses.shloka_iast: sāyikhaḍeyāceṃ bāhuleṃ| cālavityā sūtrāceni cāle| taisā māteṃ dābīta bole| svāmī to mājhā || 69 ||
verses.meaning: Just as a puppet made of wood moves by the strings of its operator, so too does my Master make me speak, compelling me.

verses.shloka_devanagari: यालागीं मी गुणदोष-। विषीं क्षमाविना विशेष। जे मी संजात ग्रंथलो देख । आचार्ये कीं ॥ १७७०॥
verses.shloka_iast: yālāgīṃ mī guṇadoṣa-| viṣīṃ kṣamāvinā viśeṣa| je mī saṃjāta graṃthalo dekha | ācārye kīṃ || 1770||
verses.meaning: Therefore, regarding merits and demerits, I am especially forgiving, as I consider myself a book born from the Guru's grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि तुम्हां संतांचिये सभे। जें उणिवेंसी ठाके उभें। तें पूर्ण नोहे तैं लोभें । तुम्हांसीचि कोपें ॥ ७१९ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi tumhāṃ saṃtāṃciye sabhe| jeṃ uṇiveṃsī ṭhāke ubheṃ| teṃ pūrṇa nohe taiṃ lobheṃ | tumhāṃsīci kopeṃ || 719 ||
verses.meaning: And in the assembly of you saints, if anything stands incomplete, it is not perfected until, out of love, it becomes complete in you.

verses.shloka_devanagari: सिवतलियाही परिसें। लोहत्वाचिये अवदसे। न मुकिजे आयसें। तैं कवणा बोलु॥ ७२॥
verses.shloka_iast: sivataliyāhī pariseṃ| lohatvāciye avadase| na mukije āyaseṃ| taiṃ kavaṇā bolu|| 72||
verses.meaning: Even if touched by the philosopher's stone, iron does not shed its iron-ness. Then, what can be said about it?

verses.shloka_devanagari: वोहळें हेंचि करावें। जे गंगेचें आंग ठाकावें । मगही गंगा जरी नोहावें । तैं तो काय करी॥ ७३॥
verses.shloka_iast: vohaḻeṃ heṃci karāveṃ| je gaṃgeceṃ āṃga ṭhākāveṃ | magahī gaṃgā jarī nohāveṃ | taiṃ to kāya karī|| 73||
verses.meaning: A small stream's purpose is to reach the Ganges. Even if it doesn't become the Ganges itself, what else can it do?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि भाग्ययोगें बहुवें। तुम्हां संतांचे मी पाये। पातलों आतां कें लाहे। उणें जगीं ॥ ७४॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni bhāgyayogeṃ bahuveṃ| tumhāṃ saṃtāṃce mī pāye| pātaloṃ ātāṃ keṃ lāhe| uṇeṃ jagīṃ || 74||
verses.meaning: Therefore, by great fortune, I have now reached the feet of you saints. What more could I lack in this world?

verses.shloka_devanagari: अहो जी माझेनि स्वामी । मज संत जोडुनि तुम्हीं । दिधलेति तेणें सर्वकामीं । परिपूर्ण जालो ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: aho jī mājheni svāmī | maja saṃta joḍuni tumhīṃ | didhaleti teṇeṃ sarvakāmīṃ | paripūrṇa jālo || 75 ||
verses.meaning: Oh, by my Lord, by uniting me with the saints, you have made me complete in all respects.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पाहा पां मातें तुम्हां सांगडें। माहेर तेणें सुरवाडें। ग्रंथाचे आळियाडें। सिद्धी गेलें॥७६॥
verses.shloka_iast: pāhā pāṃ māteṃ tumhāṃ sāṃgaḍeṃ| māhera teṇeṃ suravāḍeṃ| graṃthāce āḻiyāḍeṃ| siddhī geleṃ||76||
verses.meaning: Behold, I tell you, the comfort of the maternal home, through the pretext of this scripture, has attained perfection.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जी 'कनकाचें निखळ। वोतूं येईल भूमंडळ। चिंतारत्नी कुळाचळ। निर्मू येती ॥ ७७॥
verses.shloka_iast: jī 'kanakāceṃ nikhaḻa| votūṃ yeīla bhūmaṃḍaḻa| ciṃtāratnī kuḻācaḻa| nirmū yetī || 77||
verses.meaning: If one could pour out a pure golden earth, and create mountains of wish-fulfilling gems...

verses.shloka_devanagari: सातांही हो सागरांतें । सोपें भरितां अमृतें। दुवाड नोहे तारांतें । चंद्र करितां॥ ७८॥
verses.shloka_iast: sātāṃhī ho sāgarāṃteṃ | sopeṃ bharitāṃ amṛteṃ| duvāḍa nohe tārāṃteṃ | caṃdra karitāṃ|| 78||
verses.meaning: It is not difficult to fill the seven oceans with nectar, nor is it difficult to make the stars into the moon.

verses.shloka_devanagari: कल्पतरूचे आराम। लावितां नाहीं विषम। परी गीतार्थाचें वर्म। निवडूं न ये॥७९॥
verses.shloka_iast: kalpatarūce ārāma| lāvitāṃ nāhīṃ viṣama| parī gītārthāceṃ varma| nivaḍūṃ na ye||79||
verses.meaning: Even if one plants a wish-fulfilling tree, it is not difficult. But the secret meaning of the Gita is not easy to discern.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तो मी येकु सर्वमुका। बोलोनि मऱ्हाठिया भाखा। करीं डोळेवरी लोकां। घेवों ये ऐसें जें॥ १९७८०॥
verses.shloka_iast: to mī yeku sarvamukā| boloni maṟhāṭhiyā bhākhā| karīṃ ḍoḻevarī lokāṃ| ghevoṃ ye aiseṃ jeṃ|| 19780||
verses.meaning: I, the one who is mute, by speaking in the Marathi language, make it such that people can take it in with their eyes.

verses.shloka_devanagari: हा ग्रंथसागरु येव्हढा। उतरोनि पैलीकडा। कौर्तिविजयाचा धेंडा। नाचे जो ५०८ श्रीज्ञानेश्वरी कां॥८१॥
verses.shloka_iast: hā graṃthasāgaru yevhaḍhā| utaroni pailīkaḍā| kaurtivijayācā dheṃḍā| nāce jo 508 śrījñāneśvarī kāṃ||81||
verses.meaning: This vast ocean of a book, having been crossed, the banner of glorious victory dances. This is the Shri Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गीतार्थाचा आवारु । कल्झोंसीं महामेरु । रचूनि माजीं श्रीगुरु-। लिंग जें पूजीं॥८२॥
verses.shloka_iast: gītārthācā āvāru | kaljhoṃsīṃ mahāmeru | racūni mājīṃ śrīguru-| liṃga jeṃ pūjīṃ||82||
verses.meaning: I worship the Guru-lingam within me, having constructed a vast edifice of the Gita's meaning, as grand as Mount Meru.

verses.shloka_devanagari: गीता निष्कपट माय। चुकोनि तान्हें हिंडे जें बाय। ते मायपूता भेटी होय। हा धर्म तुमचा ॥ ८३॥
verses.shloka_iast: gītā niṣkapaṭa māya| cukoni tānheṃ hiṃḍe jeṃ bāya| te māyapūtā bheṭī hoya| hā dharma tumacā || 83||
verses.meaning: The Gita is like a sincere mother. Just as a child, having strayed, wanders about, so too does this Gita facilitate the reunion of that mother and child. This is your dharma (righteous duty).

verses.shloka_devanagari: तुम्हां सजनांचें केलें। आकळुनी जी मी बोलळें। ज्ञानदेव म्हणे थेंकुलें। तैसें नोहे ॥ ८४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tumhāṃ sajanāṃceṃ keleṃ| ākaḻunī jī mī bolaḻeṃ| jñānadeva mhaṇe theṃkuleṃ| taiseṃ nohe || 84||
verses.meaning: I have spoken by understanding your nature, O good people. Dnyandev says, this is not a small or insignificant thing.

verses.shloka_devanagari: काय बहु बोलों सकळां। मेळविलों जन्मफळा। ग्रंथसिद्धीचा सोहळा। दाविला जो हा॥ ८५॥
verses.shloka_iast: kāya bahu boloṃ sakaḻāṃ| meḻaviloṃ janmaphaḻā| graṃthasiddhīcā sohaḻā| dāvilā jo hā|| 85||
verses.meaning: What more can I say? I have gathered for all the fruit of birth, which is the celebration of the accomplishment of this scripture.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मियां जैसजैसिया आशा । केला तुमचा भरंवसा । ते पुरवूनि जी बहुवसा। आणिलों सुखा॥ ८६॥
verses.shloka_iast: miyāṃ jaisajaisiyā āśā | kelā tumacā bharaṃvasā | te puravūni jī bahuvasā| āṇiloṃ sukhā|| 86||
verses.meaning: I had placed all my hopes and trust in you, and by fulfilling them abundantly, you have brought me great joy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: मजलागीं ग्रंथाची स्वामी । दुजी सृष्टी जे हे केली तुम्ही । तें पाहोनि हांसों आम्ही । विश्‍वामित्रातेंही ॥ ८७॥
verses.shloka_iast: majalāgīṃ graṃthācī svāmī | dujī sṛṣṭī je he kelī tumhī | teṃ pāhoni hāṃsoṃ āmhī | viś‍vāmitrāteṃhī || 87||
verses.meaning: O Lord, you are the master of this scripture, and you have created this second world. Seeing this, we would even laugh at Vishwamitra.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे असोनि त्रिशंकुदोषें। धातयाही आणावें बोसें। तें नासतें कीजे कीं ऐसें। निर्मावें नाहीं ॥ ८८॥
verses.shloka_iast: je asoni triśaṃkudoṣeṃ| dhātayāhī āṇāveṃ boseṃ| teṃ nāsateṃ kīje kīṃ aiseṃ| nirmāveṃ nāhīṃ || 88||
verses.meaning: That which, due to the fault of being a 'Trishanku' (a state of being suspended between two worlds, neither here nor there), would cause even the creator Brahma to be ashamed, should it be destroyed, or should it not be created at all?

verses.shloka_devanagari: शंभू उपमन्यूचेनि मोहे । क्षीरसागरूही केला आहे। येथ तोही उपमे सरी नोहे। जे विषगर्भ कीं ॥ ८९॥
verses.shloka_iast: śaṃbhū upamanyūceni mohe | kṣīrasāgarūhī kelā āhe| yetha tohī upame sarī nohe| je viṣagarbha kīṃ || 89||
verses.meaning: Even the Milk Ocean was churned out of love for Shiva by Upamanyu. Yet, even that cannot be compared to it, for it contains poison.

verses.shloka_devanagari: अंधकारु निशाचरां। गिळितां सूर्य चराचरां। धांबा केला तरी खरा। ताउनी कीं तो॥ ९७९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: aṃdhakāru niśācarāṃ| giḻitāṃ sūrya carācarāṃ| dhāṃbā kelā tarī kharā| tāunī kīṃ to|| 9790||
verses.meaning: When the sun rises, it dispels the darkness that envelops the world, just as a true spiritual master dispels ignorance. The sun's light is a testament to its power, just as the master's teachings are a testament to their truth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तातलियाही जगाकारणें। चंद्रे वेंचिळें चांदणें। तया सदोषा केवीं म्हणे। सारिखें हें॥९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: tātaliyāhī jagākāraṇeṃ| caṃdre veṃciḻeṃ cāṃdaṇeṃ| tayā sadoṣā kevīṃ mhaṇe| sārikheṃ heṃ||91||
verses.meaning: Even for a world that is burning, the moon pours forth its cooling light. How then can one say that this (the moon's action) is similar to the flawed actions of humans?

verses.shloka_devanagari: म्हणौनि तुम्हीं मज संतीं। ग्रंथरूप जो हा त्रिजगतीं। उपयोग केला तो पुढती। निरुपम जी॥ ९२॥
verses.shloka_iast: mhaṇauni tumhīṃ maja saṃtīṃ| graṃtharūpa jo hā trijagatīṃ| upayoga kelā to puḍhatī| nirupama jī|| 92||
verses.meaning: Therefore, you, the saints, have made use of this scripture, which is like the three worlds, and it is indeed incomparable.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना तुमचें केलें। धर्मकीर्तन हें सिद्धी नेलें। येथ माझें जी उरलें। पाई कपण ॥ ९३ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā tumaceṃ keleṃ| dharmakīrtana heṃ siddhī neleṃ| yetha mājheṃ jī uraleṃ| pāī kapaṇa || 93 ||
verses.meaning: Indeed, this discourse on Dharma, which you have accomplished, has been brought to fruition. What remains for me here is merely to offer my humble service at your feet.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आतां विशवात्मकें देवें । येणें वाग्यज्ञें तोषावें। तोषोनि मज द्यावें । पसायदान हें ॥९४॥
verses.shloka_iast: ātāṃ viśavātmakeṃ deveṃ | yeṇeṃ vāgyajñeṃ toṣāveṃ| toṣoni maja dyāveṃ | pasāyadāna heṃ ||94||
verses.meaning: Now, may the Lord of the Universe be pleased by this sacrifice of words. Being pleased, may He grant me this boon of grace.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जे खळांची व्यंकटी सांडो। तयां सत्कर्मी रती वाढो । भूतां परस्परें पडो । मैत्र जीवाचें ॥ ९५॥
verses.shloka_iast: je khaḻāṃcī vyaṃkaṭī sāṃḍo| tayāṃ satkarmī ratī vāḍho | bhūtāṃ paraspareṃ paḍo | maitra jīvāceṃ || 95||
verses.meaning: May the wickedness of the wicked cease. May their interest in good deeds increase. May all beings develop a friendship among themselves, rooted in their very souls.

verses.shloka_devanagari: दुरिताचें तिमिर जावो। विश्‍व स्वधर्मसूर्ये पाहो। जो जें वांछील तो तें लाहो । प्राणिजात ॥ ९६॥
verses.shloka_iast: duritāceṃ timira jāvo| viś‍va svadharmasūrye pāho| jo jeṃ vāṃchīla to teṃ lāho | prāṇijāta || 96||
verses.meaning: May the darkness of evil vanish. May the universe behold the sun of its own dharma. May all beings obtain whatever they desire.

verses.shloka_devanagari: वर्षत सकळमंगळीं । ईश्‍वरनिष्ठांची मांदियाळी। अनवरत भूतळीं। भेटतु या भूतां॥ ९७॥
verses.shloka_iast: varṣata sakaḻamaṃgaḻīṃ | īś‍varaniṣṭhāṃcī māṃdiyāḻī| anavarata bhūtaḻīṃ| bheṭatu yā bhūtāṃ|| 97||
verses.meaning: May the assembly of those devoted to God, who embody all auspiciousness, continuously meet with all beings on this earth.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चला कल्पतरूंचे आरव । चेतनाचिंतामणीचे गांव । बोलते जे अर्णव । पीयूषाचे ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.shloka_iast: calā kalpatarūṃce ārava | cetanāciṃtāmaṇīce gāṃva | bolate je arṇava | pīyūṣāce || 98 ||
verses.meaning: Come, a garden of wish-fulfilling trees, a village of consciousness-gems, speaking oceans of nectar.

verses.shloka_devanagari: चंद्रमे जे अलांछन । मार्तंड जे तापहीन । ते सर्वांही सदा सज्जन । सोयरे होतु ॥९९॥
verses.shloka_iast: caṃdrame je alāṃchana | mārtaṃḍa je tāpahīna | te sarvāṃhī sadā sajjana | soyare hotu ||99||
verses.meaning: May all good people be like the blemishless moon and the sun that gives light without scorching; may they be friends to all.

verses.shloka_devanagari: किंबहुना सर्वसुखीं। पूर्ण होऊनि तिहीं लोकीं । भजिजो आदिपुरुखीं। अखंडित॥ १८००॥
verses.shloka_iast: kiṃbahunā sarvasukhīṃ| pūrṇa hoūni tihīṃ lokīṃ | bhajijo ādipurukhīṃ| akhaṃḍita|| 1800||
verses.meaning: Indeed, having attained complete happiness in all three worlds, one should incessantly worship the Primeval Being.

verses.shloka_devanagari: आणि ग्रंथोपजीविये । विशेषीं लोकीं इयें। दृष्टादृष्टविजयें । होआवें जी॥१॥
verses.shloka_iast: āṇi graṃthopajīviye | viśeṣīṃ lokīṃ iyeṃ| dṛṣṭādṛṣṭavijayeṃ | hoāveṃ jī||1||
verses.meaning: And may those who live by this scripture, especially in this world, achieve victory both seen and unseen.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ म्हणे श्रीविशवेशरावो। हा होईल दानपसावो। येणें बरें ज्ञानदेवो। सुखिया जाला॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha mhaṇe śrīviśaveśarāvo| hā hoīla dānapasāvo| yeṇeṃ bareṃ jñānadevo| sukhiyā jālā|| 2||
verses.meaning: Then Shri Vishveshvara said, "This will be a gift of grace." By this, Dnyandev became happy.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ऐसें युगीं परी कळीं। आणि महाराष्ट्रमंडळीं । श्रीगोदावरीच्या कूलीं । दक्षिणलिंगीं ॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: aiseṃ yugīṃ parī kaḻīṃ| āṇi mahārāṣṭramaṃḍaḻīṃ | śrīgodāvarīcyā kūlīṃ | dakṣiṇaliṃgīṃ || 3||
verses.meaning: Thus, in this Kali Yuga, in the Maharashtra region, on the banks of the sacred Godavari, in the southern part of the land.

verses.shloka_devanagari: त्रिभुबनैकपवित्र । अनादि पंचक्रोशक्षेत्र। जेथ जगाचें जीवनसूत्र। श्रीमहाळया ( श्रीमहाळसा ) असे॥४॥
verses.shloka_iast: tribhubanaikapavitra | anādi paṃcakrośakṣetra| jetha jagāceṃ jīvanasūtra| śrīmahāḻayā ( śrīmahāḻasā ) ase||4||
verses.meaning: The one holy place in all three worlds, the ancient Panchakrosha Kshetra, where the life-thread of the world is Shreemahalasa.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ यदुवंशविलासु।) जो सकळकळानिवासु । न्यायातें पोषी क्षितीशु । श्रीरामचंद्रु॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha yaduvaṃśavilāsu|) jo sakaḻakaḻānivāsu | nyāyāteṃ poṣī kṣitīśu | śrīrāmacaṃdru|| 5||
verses.meaning: There, the delight of the Yaduvansha, the abode of all arts, the king who upholds justice, is Lord Ramachandra.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तेथ महेशान्वयसंभूतें । श्रीनिवृत्तीनाथसुतें । केलें ज्ञानदेवे गीतें। देशीकार लेणें ॥ ६॥
verses.shloka_iast: tetha maheśānvayasaṃbhūteṃ | śrīnivṛttīnāthasuteṃ | keleṃ jñānadeve gīteṃ| deśīkāra leṇeṃ || 6||
verses.meaning: There, the son of Shri Nivruttinath, born in the lineage of Mahesh (Shiva), Dnyandev, adorned the Gita in the native language.

verses.shloka_devanagari: एवं भारताच्या गांवीं । भीष्मनाम प्रसिद्ध पर्वी । श्रीकृष्णार्जुनीं बरवी । गोठी जे केळी ॥ ७॥
verses.shloka_iast: evaṃ bhāratācyā gāṃvīṃ | bhīṣmanāma prasiddha parvī | śrīkṛṣṇārjunīṃ baravī | goṭhī je keḻī || 7||
verses.meaning: Thus, in the land of Bharat, the renowned Bhishma, in ancient times, narrated the excellent discourse between Shri Krishna and Arjuna.

verses.shloka_devanagari: जें उपनिषदांचें सार । सर्व शास्त्रांचे माहेर । परमहंसीं सरोवर । सेविजे जें ॥ ८॥
verses.shloka_iast: jeṃ upaniṣadāṃceṃ sāra | sarva śāstrāṃce māhera | paramahaṃsīṃ sarovara | sevije jeṃ || 8||
verses.meaning: That which is the essence of the Upanishads, the origin of all scriptures, a sacred lake for the highest spiritual seekers, that which is to be served.

verses.shloka_devanagari: तिये गीतेचा कलशु। संपूर्ण हा अष्टादशु। म्हणे निवृत्तिदासु। ज्ञानदेबो॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: tiye gītecā kalaśu| saṃpūrṇa hā aṣṭādaśu| mhaṇe nivṛttidāsu| jñānadebo|| 9||
verses.meaning: Thus, this Gita's culmination, the eighteenth chapter, is completed, says Dnyandev, the servant of Nivrutti.

verses.shloka_devanagari: पुढती पुढती पुढती । इया ग्रंथपुण्यसंपत्ती । सर्वसुखीं सर्वभूतीं । संपूर्ण होईजे॥ १८९०॥
verses.shloka_iast: puḍhatī puḍhatī puḍhatī | iyā graṃthapuṇyasaṃpattī | sarvasukhīṃ sarvabhūtīṃ | saṃpūrṇa hoīje|| 1890||
verses.meaning: Again and again, through the merit of this scripture, may all beings be completely filled with all happiness.

verses.shloka_devanagari: शके बाराशतें बारोत्तरें। तैं टीका केली ज्ञानेश्‍वरें। सच्चिदानंदबाबा आदेरें। लेखकु जाहला॥ १८१९१॥
verses.shloka_iast: śake bārāśateṃ bārottareṃ| taiṃ ṭīkā kelī jñāneś‍vareṃ| saccidānaṃdabābā ādereṃ| lekhaku jāhalā|| 18191||
verses.meaning: In the Shaka year 1212, Dnyaneshwar composed this commentary. With the blessings of Sacchidananda Baba, he became the scribe.

verses.shloka_devanagari: श्रीएकनाथमहाराजांनी ज्ञानेश्‍वरी ग्रंथ संशोधन केल्यानंतर ज्ञानेशश्‍वरीसंबंधाने केलेल्या ओव्या श्रीशके पंधराशे साहोत्तरीं । तारणनामसंवत्सरीं । एकाजनार्दनें अत्यादरीं । गीता-ज्ञानेश्‍वरीप्रति शुद्ध केली॥ ९॥
verses.shloka_iast: śrīekanāthamahārājāṃnī jñāneś‍varī graṃtha saṃśodhana kelyānaṃtara jñāneśaś‍varīsaṃbaṃdhāne kelelyā ovyā śrīśake paṃdharāśe sāhottarīṃ | tāraṇanāmasaṃvatsarīṃ | ekājanārdaneṃ atyādarīṃ | gītā-jñāneś‍varīprati śuddha kelī|| 9||
verses.meaning: After Shri Eknath Maharaj revised the Dnyaneshwari text, he composed these verses regarding the Dnyaneshwari: In the Shaka year fifteen hundred and seventy-six, in the Tarana Samvatsara, Eka Janardana with great reverence purified the Gita-Dnyaneshwari.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ग्रंथ पूर्वीच अतिशुद्ध । परी पाठांतरीं शुद्ध अबद्ध। तो शोधूनियां एवंविध । प्रतिशुद्ध सिद्ध ज्ञानेश्‍वरी ॥ २॥
verses.shloka_iast: graṃtha pūrvīca atiśuddha | parī pāṭhāṃtarīṃ śuddha abaddha| to śodhūniyāṃ evaṃvidha | pratiśuddha siddha jñāneś‍varī || 2||
verses.meaning: The original text of Dnyaneshwari was already supremely pure, but due to errors in transcription, it became corrupted. This edition, after careful research and purification, presents the Dnyaneshwari in its truly pure and perfected form.

verses.shloka_devanagari: नमो ज्ञानेश्वरा निष्कलंका। जयाची गीतेची वाचितां टीका । ज्ञान होय लोकां । अतिभाविकां ग्रंथार्थियां॥ ३॥
verses.shloka_iast: namo jñāneśvarā niṣkalaṃkā| jayācī gītecī vācitāṃ ṭīkā | jñāna hoya lokāṃ | atibhāvikāṃ graṃthārthiyāṃ|| 3||
verses.meaning: Salutations to Dnyaneshwar, the blemishless one, by whose commentary on the Gita, knowledge dawns upon people, especially the devout and those who delve into the scriptures.

verses.shloka_devanagari: बहुकाळपर्वणी गोमटी । भाद्रपदमास कपिल्मषष्ठी । प्रतिष्ठानीं गोदातटीं । लेखनकामाठी संपूर्ण जाहली ॥ ४॥
verses.shloka_iast: bahukāḻaparvaṇī gomaṭī | bhādrapadamāsa kapilmaṣaṣṭhī | pratiṣṭhānīṃ godātaṭīṃ | lekhanakāmāṭhī saṃpūrṇa jāhalī || 4||
verses.meaning: This auspicious occasion, the Kapila Shashthi in the month of Bhadrapada, on the banks of the Godavari in Pratishthan, marks the completion of the writing work.

verses.shloka_devanagari: ज्ञानेश्‍वरीपाठीं । जो ओंबी करील मऱ्हाटी । तेणे अमृताचे ताटीं। जाण नरोटी ठेविली ॥ ५॥
verses.shloka_iast: jñāneś‍varīpāṭhīṃ | jo oṃbī karīla maṟhāṭī | teṇe amṛtāce tāṭīṃ| jāṇa naroṭī ṭhevilī || 5||
verses.meaning: One who attempts to translate Dnyaneshwari into Marathi, it is as if they have placed a coconut shell in a plate of ambrosia.
